data.name: Bounty Pro Pulling
data.detailed_description:
Truck and tractor pulling is finally here. Built for hardcore pulling fans, Bounty Pro Pulling brings deep tuning, custom paint, serious sled setup, and online competition from the DNA of Bounty Drag Racing.

25 Vehicles to Build Your Way

Customize Semi Trucks, 4x4 Diesels, 4x4 Pro Mods, Pro Stock Tractors, 2WD Modifieds, Light Modifieds, Mini Modifieds, and Unlimited Modifieds inspired by pulling machines from around the world.

Fully Adjustable Sled Settings

Tune the sled like the real thing by adjusting sled weight, weight box speed, and where the pan drops during the pull.

A Track That Changes Every Pull

As more vehicles run, the dirt gets looser. Move the sled, read the surface, and find the best line before your next pass.

Indoor and Outdoor Venues

Pull in both outdoor and indoor arenas, each with the proper exhaust setup for the venue.

Don't Blow Up!

Mechanical damage means tuning and driving matter. Push too hard, and your machine may not survive the full run.

Endless Replayability

Create your own pulling tracks with a fully featured in-game track editor. Recreate your favorite venues without external downloads or mods.

data.name: Euro NumismatCy! Coin Collector
data.detailed_description:
. BECOMES A GREAT NUMISMATIST

In this game, play as a numismatist in search of recognition, try to collect the maximum of commemorative coins among the 219 contained in the catalog then start your ascent in the ranking of Numismatists until becoming the number 1!



. CLIMB THE SOCIAL LADDER

To obtain new coins, you will have to buy packages of commemorative coins, there are several types according to the money that you will have met each turn. Your salary will depend on your position in the ranking, if your collection is growing, your standard of living will inevitably improve. You will then be able to buy a nicer car or a more luxurious house!

. VERSUS MODE



Confronts different numismatists for each level of the ranking.
Chain victories so that your opponents become aware of the extent of your collection
but beware ! You will also need to use cunning and a relentless strategy to reach your goal!

. COMPLEX ECONOMIC MANAGEMENT

Manage your money through various means, first of all by making sure to control your bank account through deposits and cash withdrawals based on the annual interest offered by your bank ... In case of problems, it is also possible to make a credit but beware, a bad credit repayment can lead you to bankruptcy!

. QUICK PART AND OFFICIAL PART

Play one or more "quick games" to improve your knowledge of the game and accumulate "official points" to pass the tricks in the "official game". The official part is longer and closer to the reality of the world coin collection!



No real payment is included in the game.

data.name: 6days
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis

In 1979, a man named Masao Satomi was involved in an accident.

He was taken to the hospital and woke up safe and sound, but had amnesia. When he wonders if there is any memory he can recall,

he recalls an intense childhood memory from 16 years ago.

The nostalgic atmosphere of the Showa period and the somewhat disturbing atmosphere of his childhood.

Masao tries to relive those memories and find out who he is and recover his precious memories.

Game Overview

・Title 6Days

・Genre Adventure, Human Mystery, Human Horror

・Play time About 2-5 hours

・Endings branching (4 endings in total)

・Age 12 and up recommended

Others

This game can be enjoyed on its own, but it also contains some of the material from the previous game “Retribution” .

Please play “Reward-Retribution” as well.

Guidelines

Regarding video, live streaming, and image posting for this game

All scenes in the game can be posted.

*Postings to sites that are offensive to public order and morals or that give a false impression of the game content are prohibited.

data.name: STARWAY VR
data.detailed_description:
［Update 2019.04.18]

Hey, captain! Now you can Remote control your spaceship and shooting space monsters!

1. Enhance the shooting system;
2. Add tutorial of the shooting system;
3. Adjust monster behavior;


［Update 2019.03.23]

1. New UNKNOWN SPACE LIFE!
Attention Caption, UNKNOW SPACE LIFE was in found 1-4、1-5
With territorial, will attack player's ship while closing
Of course, you could use the weapon to fight with them

2. Now your ship has HP!
While HP=0, your ship will explode,
To recover HP, recombine your ship.

3.NEW! Manual AIMING MODE!
When the small monitor opened, you could switch to Manual mode by the Up Button on the Right Hand,
Otherwise, it will be in Auto aiming mode.
In the Manual Aiming Mode, there will be a line point out from your right-hand controller,
use it to aim your target.

4.NEW! Target Lock On Hints!
Finding out a target in Auto Aiming Mode, or, aiming target in Manual Aiming Mode,
A Locked On hint will appear at the target,
the HP will be shown if the target is an UNKNOWN SPACE LIFE.

5. Information description added to the Parts Panel
Power and Weight information will be shown now，
other information will be added later, such as Function description.

6. Take out parts from Parts Panel
The parts will be bigger and bigger until it becomes the original size

7. Information of the ship shows on the LEFT hand now.

8. Solve a bug which makes some parts working incorrectly.

Please keep your eyes on us, we will keep updating it very soon,

with a Cute and Lovely AI assistant!

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

We will keep updating this game, so we REALLY need your suggestion to make it better, please try and tell us!

STARWAY VR is a Casual VR game refer to Casual Mobile games. In this game, players mining for resources in unknown space and use those resources building new Space Ship parts, and then combine all the parts to a full function space ship. By using this new ship , players can pass through the STAR GATE to another space area. All those gates connected as STARWAY, through the STARWAY, players could finally find out the way to back to home earth. 

Space Ships - Building Space Ship like LEGO
In STARWAY VR, players build spaceships by combining several parts of ship together to be a completed Space Ship. 

Game Flow
1. Collect resources
2. Buy parts of ship
3. Combine them to a better spaceship
4. Collect resource to open STAR GATE
5. Pass through the STAR GATE to next space area or galaxy

A Fun and relax VR game

data.name: Ellipsis
data.detailed_description:
Check out our upcoming game, Sweet Surrender!

Add it to your wishlist!


About the Game


We’ve crafted a beautiful universe for you to uncover and explore at your own pace. Fly through levels, dodging and evading enemies before they have a chance to react. Or explore leisurely, mastering each world and uncovering all its secrets. Either way, Ellipsis will keep you on your toes with surprises from start to finish.

“It's like the best parts of Geometry Wars” - Tycho Brahe (Founder of PAX, Penny Arcade)

Ellipsis is designed with a clean minimalist interface and absolutely ZERO text. It lets the player explore at their own pace while gently guiding them, thus producing an incredible pick-up-and-play experience.

KEY FEATURES

• 150+ unique hand-crafted and increasingly hard levels, set in 8 diverse worlds
• Level editor with Steam workshop support
• Pick up and play for all ages
• Beautiful minimalist graphics
• Zero text - Accessible to a global audience
• Mouse, Controller and Touchscreen support, playable on 2-in-1 Touch PCs
• Windows, Mac & Linux support

CREDITS

• Designed by Yacine Salmi and Stefan Hell
• Beautiful soundscape by Filippo Beck Peccoz
• Community and PR: Christopher Wulf and Felix Kramer
• Special thanks to Alex Zacherl, Johannes Roth, Max Wandinger

And a big THANKS to you, the player.

ELLIPSIS (noun): an intentional omission from a text without altering its original meaning.

data.name: Universal Tidy Up
data.detailed_description:
A PUZZLE GAME ABOUT PUTTING THINGS WHERE THEY BELONG

Universal Tidy Up starts like a tidy-up game: a house full of scattered cups, books and toys, and shelves waiting for them. Then it turns into puzzles built around tidying: sorting, pushing, stacking and fitting things until the room makes sense.

It's a mix of calm tidying and organizing puzzles.

PUT EVERYTHING BACK WHERE IT BELONGS

THEN PUT THE SHELF AWAY

FIGURE OUT THE RULES

TIDY UP UNIQUE SPACES

WHAT TO EXPECT

A mix of calm tidy-up stages and real puzzles

24 stages, plus 16 bonus rooms after the credits

About 2-5 hours for the main game

Retro 90s 3D look and chill music

Full controller support

data.name: Broken Pixel
data.detailed_description:
The honest version


One pixel in the room is broken. Find it. Poke it. Next room. Over sixty times.

That is the whole game. If it already sounds thin, stop here — it does not open up later.

What actually happens is this.

One screen, one fixed stare, and your eyes quit long before the levels do. That isn't pacing. That's a limit I couldn't design my way around.

So you'll want other people. Eight of you can share one clock. Sourcing seven friends is not included in the price. That's a you problem.

Then one of them finds it before you do and something small dies. You'll say luck. It wasn't luck. And you'll start doing quiet arithmetic about your own eyes — whether they were always this bad, or whether this is new, or whether it's been happening for years and this is simply the first thing that ever bothered to measure it.

Then you spot it. Bottom left. Certain.

Dust.

You clean the monitor. Eleven good seconds. Then you spot the next one, certain again, and you poke it — and it's a fake pixel your friend planted there for exactly this purpose. Frozen and blinded for ten seconds while they walk past you and win.

Some levels are seeded with permanently dead pixels. Always black, never flickering, worth nothing. One has fifteen. The level I actually named The Decoys has six. I still fall for both.

Eventually I asked my girlfriend for help — the same girlfriend I'd spent a week shushing so I could hear the audio cue. She leaned in, looked hard, and pointed at dust. Then more dust. Exactly what I'd been doing for sixty-odd levels, at the same hit rate, for a fraction of the effort. That was the low point of development.

Then my eyes gave out and I stopped.

Straight answer: I can't finish this on Brutal. Brutal only lights what falls inside your flashlight beam. There is a message in the code congratulating you for beating it. I have never seen that message. I wrote it.

So here is the offer, and it is for one person only. The first player to finish Brutal without cheating, and send us the full gameplay recording by email, gets something real. The game knows the difference — a save that has touched a cheat gets flagged and loses its achievements for good, so there is no arguing about it. If you are in our city, dinner is on me. If you are not, you get a free copy of whatever we make next. I think that is a fair trade for something I could not do myself.

The best thing this game has done for me is make me clean my screen.

Which is how I found the dead pixel on my laptop. Years old. Four inches from my face. I built a game about finding these and needed sixty-odd levels of practice before I noticed the real one — and that one doesn't come off.

It's frustrating. I'm getting old. Both are load-bearing.

[hr][/hr]

Bring your glasses. Clean Your Screen.

One pixel in the room is broken. Find it. Poke it. Next room. Over sixty times.

That is the whole game. If it already sounds thin, stop here — it does not open up later.

What actually happens is this.

One screen, one fixed stare, and your eyes quit long before the levels do. That isn't pacing. That's a limit I couldn't design my way around.

So you'll want other people. Eight of you can share one clock. Sourcing seven friends is not included in the price. That's a you problem.

data.name: Vegetableau
data.detailed_description:
Your garden is a complete mess. Somehow all the crops have gotten mixed together. You cannot stand it. Slide the plots around to organize your crops before you can harvest them.

Vegetableau is a relaxing, sliding-tile, puzzle game where you have to organize your crops.  You slide the vegetables around until they are sorted into contiguous blocks, avoiding any pesky boulders in your garden.  As you progress you will get a bigger garden and more veggies to sort.

Play through 15 levels of escalating challenge.  The levels are procedurally generated so every time you play is unique.  You can also choose a seeded set of levels to race against a friend, lover, enemy, or whomever is willing.  Unlock an endless mode to sort vegetables until you are ready for bed.

This game was originally created in a single weekend for Ludum Dare 52, where it placed 28th overall.

Includes several original compositions alongside musical cameos from other games in my catalog.

Features

  • 15 procedurally generated levels of escalating difficulty

  • Endless mode for infinite sorting

  • Seeded race mode

  • Full controller support

  • Original soundtrack

Future Features

These features are not yet available but are planned for a future update

  • Daily Seeds with leaderboards

  • Steam Deck verification

  • Achievements and unlockables

  • Custom game modes

data.name: GentRacing
data.detailed_description:
Here is our first project, which we wanna publish on Steam! That is our biggest dream!
We work for a long time and try to develop a high-quality, original game which is not available in this mode and this style.

It is a top-down racing game with arcade/realistic elements

Our goals and targets
- Very balanced, perfect driving car physics
- Multiplayer mode
- a league mode, also designed and fitted to LAN-Partys
- Time Attack mode
- Replays
- Track Editor
- Car Editor
- a working community
- Alpha & Beta Testers among the players
- active/active participation on development steps

The concept / gameplay
This is a new type of top-down arcade racing game, which is played and watched from the top in 3D. Various routes, cars and physics can driven in different modes like time-attack mode, lan or over the www.
We have decided to use standard keyboard as input device.

Each car will get tire wear, damage and fuel consumption.
This means that pit-stops are needed depending on lap distance, drifts and fuel consumption.

Each driven second contributes to your game progress, awards points, a leaderboard and very detailed statistics to be found on the GentRacing Site.

One of the core elements of GentRacing will be the league mode, for big and funny online battles. Compare your skills in different skill-levels and be the first GentRacing World Champion - under all participants of the game,

We will inform you regularly about the state of development and look forward to your comments.

greez


GentRacing Team

data.name: Stack the Pixels
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Stack The Pixels — an enthralling 2D puzzle game where strategy meets fun in a colorful matching challenge! Whether you're a solo strategist or a social gamer, this game offers something for everyone.

Stack the Pixels is the All-New Ultimate Social Puzzle Experience, designed for families and friends to bond over engaging, easy-to-learn, and non-violent gameplay.

This unique game seamlessly blends cooperation and competition. Players strategically stack pixels on the same game board to reveal beautiful, collaborative images while competing for the highest score. 

With full cross-play between Steam, Android, and iOS, everyone can join the fun, no matter their device. Best of all, it's 100% free to play—no intrusive ads, no boosters, just pure strategic gameplay that brings people closer together while keeping the competition thrilling.

Game Modes Galore:

  • Friends and Family Mode: Play on smaller boards to enjoy a more intimate setting. Create custom boards with personal images and invite friends to help clear them.

  • Solo Puzzle Mode: Explore various lands filled with levels and pre-set images designed to test your puzzle-solving skills offline.

Dynamic Gameplay:

  • Match and stack colored gems to reveal the stunning images beneath. Experience the thrill of clearing huge canvases in real-time with a global community, or enjoy crafting personal puzzle boards for a close-knit group.

Unique Features:

  • Smooth, appealing graphics and animations reminiscent of popular games like Candy Crush.

  • Create and share your own puzzle boards, enhancing interactive gameplay.

Progress and Competition:

  • Advance through numerous lands and levels in the offline mode.

  • Compete in global leaderboards, showcasing your puzzle prowess to the world.

  • Engage with a robust currency system and in-app purchases that allow you to enhance your gaming experience without the interruption of ads.

Global Reach and Accessibility:

  • Available worldwide with localization options for multiple languages, making it accessible and enjoyable for an international audience.

  • Whether you’re in it to enjoy serene puzzle-solving or to compete in high-stakes multiplayer challenges, "Stack The Pixels" offers a rich, engaging experience for players of all ages.

data.name: Rhythm Dodge
data.detailed_description:
Rhythm Dodge is a twin-stick, retro styled music based game where instead of hitting notes to the rhythm of the music, you have to dodge them. You play as two sides that you control independently. Making you test your eye-hand coordination.

🎵 Dodge the Beat in this compact experience! 🎵

Move through varying patterns in levels with a variety of music, difficulty and colors while taking control of 2 sides, to beat your highscores. You only have a limited amount of hits you can take before you have to start over, so keep a lookout for healing items spread throughout the levels.

⚙️ Accessibility & Customization

  • Rebind keys to suit your playstyle.

  • Turn off visual effects like screenshake for a more comfortable experience.

  • Enable toggled lane switching.

🚀Beat the Developer Score!

Once you are ready, head into the level select, where for a challenging experience where you can increase the scroll speed of the level you want to play, for a major score bonus. There are multiple developer scores waiting to be beaten!

data.name: LieStar ResiStar
data.detailed_description:
痛快なアクションで革命を起こすダークヒーローとなれ！

周囲のエネルギーを自分のモノにする力「スタビライズ」で、行く手を阻む無人兵器を撃破せよ！

ストーリー

未来都市エリュシオンに暮らす少女ヴィネアは、この管理社会に叛逆していく。

立ちはだかる兵器群を倒し、その戦いの果てに待つものとは…。

スタビライズ

主人公・ヴィネアはエネルギーを自在に固める能力を持つ。

街中のエネルギーを固めて足場や武器に変化させ、自分に有利なように利用していこう。

無人兵器は叛逆者であるヴィネアを見ると襲い掛かってくる。

スタビライズを駆使し、敵の攻撃を自分の攻撃に転用して戦おう。

絶大な力を持つ強敵相手でも、スタビライズを上手く使えば勝機は見えてくるかもしれない。

data.name: Dead Man's Drive
data.detailed_description:
Overview

Buckle up and prepare for a hellish ride through the afterlife! Dead Man’s Drive is an adrenaline-fueled vehicular combat game where you must traverse nightmarish landscapes, blasting your way through waves of demonic entities in a battle for survival. Armed to the teeth and fueled by vengeance, your only hope is to drive, shoot, and destroy anything that stands in your path.

Key Features

  • Fast-Paced Vehicular Combat: Engage in high-octane battles with a variety of supernatural foes, from swarming ghouls to towering monstrosities.

  • Weaponized Vehicles: Customize and upgrade your ride with devastating weapons, reinforced armor, and powerful mods to stay ahead of the horrors chasing you.

  • Hellish Landscapes: Journey through twisted realms, from burning wastelands to eerie ghost towns, each filled with deadly obstacles and relentless enemies.

  • Survival & Strategy: Manage your vehicle’s health, ammo, and fuel while making split-second decisions to stay alive in an unforgiving world.

  • Dynamic Weather & Terrain: Face environmental hazards such as lava pits, crumbling roads, and supernatural storms that will test your driving and combat skills.

  • Brutal Boss Fights: Take on massive, grotesque bosses that will push your reflexes and firepower to the limit.

Do You Have What It Takes to Escape?

Your soul is trapped in a place where only the strongest survive. The road ahead is long and filled with horrors—but with the right firepower and driving skills, you just might carve your way to freedom.

data.name: The Little Crane That Could
data.detailed_description:
The Little Crane is back! And it brought its friends to play in the dirt.

Driving and operating heavy machinery is a blast!
Test your operating skills in this simulator game with a diverse set of challenges.

Use the crane to load an unload, the bulldozer to shape the terrain, and an excavator to dig up the terrain.

Speaking of terrain: it is the real hero in this game!
With never seen before dig-anywhere technology™ you can shape the world.
Any changes to the world will persist between levels and game sessions, and there are no restrictions: cliffs, overhangs, caves, tunnels: it is all possible.

The world size is near infinite: you can dig a hole, then drive for an hour in a random direction and backtrack by following your track impressions in the terrain.
You will then find your dug hole as you left it: no short-cuts: real terrain simulation!

The game features 8 levels, and for each challenge you are given one or more vehicles to fulfill your mission. Each vehicle comes to life with quality physics simulations, and faithfully interacts with its environment.

data.name: do-ot
data.detailed_description:
Move the Dots with the Lines You Draw

There are only two things on the board in do-ot: dots and lines.

Your goal is to connect the constantly appearing dots with lines, use those lines to move the dots, and clear them from the board.

Different Colours Attract. Matching Colours Repel.

Try clicking one of two dots connected by a line.

The other dot connected to it will move.

If the two dots are the same colour, the other dot is pushed away by one space.

If they are different colours, the other dot is pulled closer by one space.

That is the basic way you move dots.

Line Up the Dots and Clear Them

Now for clearing dots.

Line up three or more dots of the same colour vertically or horizontally with no gaps, then connect them with a line to clear them.

If the conditions are met, you can even clear multiple rows or columns in a single stroke.

Minimal Elements. Maximum Addictiveness.

do-ot is minimal in both appearance and mechanics, yet those simple elements create a surprisingly rich puzzle space.

Every situation gives you room to think carefully about your next move, while also leaving plenty of room to improve your skills.

As you learn to control the dots more precisely, the seemingly simple board begins to reveal completely different possibilities.

Before you know it, you may find yourself playing again and again.

What’s Coming in the Full Version

The full version is planned to include:

  • A Mission Mode that teaches useful strategies and techniques

  • New types of dots with special abilities

  • A Challenge Mode where the board keeps expanding

These modes and mechanics are designed to make the game enjoyable for both beginners and experienced puzzle players.

data.name: Collector: 10 Lives Challenge
data.detailed_description:
Only 10 lives. 90 handcrafted levels. One brutal challenge.

Collector: 10 Lives Challenge is a distilled arcade-puzzle experience built entirely around mastery and survival. You start with just 10 lives — and that’s all you’ll ever get. Lose them all, and it’s back to the very beginning. No extra continues. No shortcuts. Just pure challenge.

Your goal is simple: guide a small crystal orb along intricate paths and collect every gold piece in each level. The moment all gold is collected, the level ends. But one wrong click, one mistimed jump, and you’re out. With every mistake, your precious pool of lives shrinks. Can you survive all 90 levels in a single run?

Core Features

  • 10 Lives Total – A single pool of lives for the entire game. Run out, and it’s game over.

  • 90 Handcrafted Levels – From introductory stages to near-impossible final trials.

  • Simple Controls, Impossible Difficulty – One button, infinite ways to fail.

  • Variety of Challenges – Time-limited stages, move-limited puzzles, disappearing platforms, moving hazards, portals, and more.

  • Pause & Resume – Take a break, but when you return, your remaining lives and progress are exactly where you left them.

  • Leaderboards & Achievements – Compete globally: who gets furthest, with the most lives, in the fastest time?

Why Play?

Collector: 10 Lives Challenge is not about grinding, upgrades, or random luck. It’s about learning patterns, refining your timing, and pushing your limits until you finally conquer the impossible. Each run is a test of focus and resilience.

Ten lives. One chance. Can you beat the challenge?

data.name: Memory Games Apple
data.detailed_description:
Memory Games Apple is a vibrant and engaging memory-building game featuring colorful images of various apple varieties. Flip over cards displaying red, green, yellow, and multicolored apples, presented in beautiful and diverse arrangements. Memorize the positions of the images, find matching pairs, and progress through new levels.

As you advance, the number of cards increases, making the search for matching pairs both more interesting and more challenging. The **gradual increase in difficulty** helps you steadily train your visual memory, attention, concentration, and logical thinking skills by presenting new challenges at every stage.

**Game Features:**

- Colorful images of various apple varieties.

- Matching pairs of cards.

- Gradually increasing difficulty.

- Simple and intuitive controls.

- Develops visual memory, attention, and concentration.

- A relaxing yet captivating gameplay experience.

- Suitable for both children and adults.

Find matching pairs, memorize the card positions, complete all the levels, and enjoy a bright, fruity world with Memory Games Apple!

data.name: DESOLUS
data.detailed_description:
Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game.

An enigmatic cataclysm has fractured reality, opening portals which lead to other times.

Explore the past and future versions of an expansive city.

Manipulate Black Holes to Travel Through Time

Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes, traveling back and forth through time to make the city's architecture whole again. Challenge your spatial thinking skills while navigating distorted realities as time becomes increasingly more unstable.

Use Technology from a Lost Era

Activate holograms to move massive portals between floors of crumbled cathedrals,

allowing you to traverse structures which only partially exist at one time.

Save the City from Ruin

Partner with the city's mysterious guardian to prevent a cataclysm threatening to merge past and future.

Unravel a haunting narrative to save the City of Desolus from complete annihilation.

Desolus has been selected for several festivals, including

an exhibit at the Smithsonian American Art Museum.

data.name: Nak Sim: Fallen Warriors
data.detailed_description:
‘Nak Sim’, a place where people who have died in sorrow. ‘Sims’, the inhabitants of the depression, lived in peace, leaving behind their terrifying memories. But one day, a huge sword fell from the sky, and those who touched it were sucked into an unknown world. Some of them were able to come back alive, but they were no longer the same. They have a common strong power. And that sim became a focusless or evil man who lost his will to live and attacked others. Since then, the world inside the huge sword has been called the "Cursed Sword World," and only those who have a strong desire for adventure and power have entered it.

And now you have fallen here. Would you overcome all the trials and turn your heart into a peaceful place again? Or would it be a power-cursed evil?




‘Nak Sim: Fallen Warriors’ is a third-person roguelike action game.

data.name: Zold:out
data.detailed_description:
Update Notes


About the Game

The story of Zold:out begins in an unknown weapon store in Ozin Port, where a merchant and a weaponsmith meet and set out on a journey to sell weapons. Along the way, they encounter the collapse of Emerus City, which reveals the secret of a cabal from another world.



Zold:out combines elements of tactical RPGs, card games, and deck building to create a unique gameplay experience. Players can choose from four weapon classes, each with their own unique set of weapon cards, providing a wide range of tactical options.


The core gameplay revolves around the use of action points and cards. Each character has 12 action points that can be spent to perform actions in battle. The number of action points remaining will affect the duration of subsequent rounds. Players can choose to spend all of their action points at once to deal massive damage, or save some action points for more flexible movement and strategy. The choice is yours to make as you control the battle style of your characters.




Players can access a wide variety of weapon cards with unique powers, and use these cards to craft their own decks. Each card can be paired with different characters, allowing for a wide range of tactical possibilities and strategies. As players progress through the game, they can forge more weapon cards and continue to refine their decks, searching for the perfect combination of cards and characters to achieve victory. Deck building adds an extra layer of depth and customization to the gameplay, allowing players to truly make the game their own.




Non-grid battlefield allow players to devise strategies and tactics beyond the limitations of traditional grid-based gameplay. With the ability to move freely across the battlefield, players can use more precise and meticulous tactics to outmaneuver their foes and achieve victory.




Zold:out features a range of unique bosses and monsters that have been carefully designed by the development team. Players will need to think strategically and adjust their tactics and teams to the characteristics of each boss in order to emerge victorious. Simply leveling up your status won't be enough to defeat these powerful foes - you'll need to find your own way to overcome the challenges they present and come up with creative solutions. The game encourages players to think outside the box and use their skills and cunning to emerge victorious against even the toughest opponents.

data.name: Vacant
data.detailed_description:
Vacant is a point and click science fiction adventure game about Jade Bridgett-- a new intern at a mysterious government agency called "The Eye". On her first day, she gets put on a case to find three missing people, all at which are presumed dead. It's your job to find them and the culprit.

Based off of the VACANT graphic novel by H L Nunnelly

Key Features:

-An alien world in which you can explore
-Unique and interesting characters that you can mingle with
-Colorful graphics with an asymmetrical camera view
-A suspenseful adventure experience for your mystery solving needs


About the team


-The game was created by H L Nunnelly.
-The music was done by Elena Íviel Williams.
-The voice acting in the trailer was done by Holly Standbrook.

data.name: Mighty Switch Force! Hose It Down!
data.detailed_description:
WayForward’s award-winning Mighty Switch Force series, transformed into a pick-up-and-play puzzler!

Team up with Officer Patricia Wagon to save Tangent City from a fiery blaze! As a member of Planet Land’s Fire Brigade, your job is to douse the fire in each building — and to evacuate any Hooligan Sisters who may be trapped inside. It’s a dangerous job, but if anyone can save the city, you and Patty can!

Slide blocks around the playfield, and let loose a powerful water spray from Officer Wagon's Infinity Dousing Apparatus (err… hose). Douse all of the flames, and the stage is clear! Sounds easy, right?

Block types vary from simple slide-puzzle obstacles to full-blown brain-busters like Turnpike Blocks, Mud Blocks, and Cloak Blocks.
Each level has been lovingly crafted and is WayForward Certified, guaranteed to challenge, befuddle, and tickle your fancy.

This version includes:

-50 puzzles spread across 10 Worlds.
-Fully illustrated cutscenes
-Speed Run challenges
-An incredible soundtrack by Jake “Virt” Kaufman

data.name: Stab Club
data.detailed_description:
"A Table. Some Cards. One Goal: Don’t Get Stabbed."

Welcome to Stab Club

Take a seat at the table with the Stab Bots, quirky robotic players built for competition. Everyone’s smiling… until someone gets stabbed! Match the cards that increase each other’s stab points to trade blows in this turn-based tabletop card game. The one with the most stab points at the end? Out!

Simple Rules, Brutal Outcomes

Each round, you’ll draw, plan, and play cards to shift the balance. Timing and table awareness are crucial when attacking, defending, or rerouting the stabs.

Table Tells a Story

Games are quick, but the grudges last. One bad call could turn the tables on you, and one lucky draw could change the outcome. No two matches ever end the same. Every stab leaves its mark.

No Friends at This Table

Trust is a luxury. Every card played could betray you, even from the Stab Bots!

Play Your Way

Face off against AI Stab Bots or challenge your friends in local or online matches.

data.name: Cul-De-Sac
data.detailed_description:
Overview:

Ever since the mysterious death of a young girl in a quiet suburban neighborhood in Pleasant Valley, the local residents have resorted to abandoning their homes to find safety. It's up to you to help bring peace to this Cul-De-Sac by looking for the entity's personal belonging and burning it using sacred burning materials that have been slowly appearing since that fateful day in this immersive ghost hunting experience.

Experience:

Walk around a small neighborhood investigating strange events to try and locate what is believed to be the young girl's personal item, keeping her tied to the world of the living and causing problems for the locals.

While you're investigating, be sure to pick up all the strange looking materials emitting an evil aura, they could be your only hope in destroying the entity's personal item.

When you're sure you've got the right item, make your way back to the local church and burn it. Just hope you haven't made a mistake...

Mechanics:

Explore a small neighborhood cul de sac of four houses to locate a single item of a bunch of randomly dispersed items throughout the area. You'll also be tasked to locate "sacred burn materials" to use in the aid of destroying the entity's personal item, also randomly dispersed throughout the map. 

Find a way into the residents' houses and look around for anything that can be useful. Scrap used for crafting gear, batteries to keep your flashlight charged, and lighters to light candles and burn the ghost's item.

While you're searching for the item, try to find the murder weapon and crime scene to complete side objectives that will help assist you during the main mission.

Avoid being killed by the ghost, who has a small variety of abilities and attacks to use against you ranging from simple item throws, light switch flipping, and door touching, all the way to lethal hunting, deadly hide and seek, and phantom scares.

Notice:

This game is primarily a single player experience. As of now, the Multiplayer functionality is fairly stable, but each new update could introduce new bugs. I depend highly on my community to help report these issues so that I can fix them in a timely manner.

As a solo developer who works on games as a hobby, updates for this game may be sparse and occasionally come in waves. If you have any questions or concerns, you should head over to the discord and reach out to me there.

data.name: Mystery of Myths: Mystery of the Fjords Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Elijah Reed, a seasoned agent for the Ministry of Mysteries, is no stranger to pulse-pounding missions and high-stakes challenges. So when he's dispatched to the quiet Norwegian town of Bergen, he's ready for monsters, mythical creatures, and ancient magic. But what do you pack when you're tasked with saving the world from certain doom? What gift do you bring to a mighty Valkyrie and a magical squirrel? And, most pressing of all, does the Ministry's expense account cover inter-dimensional travel through the realms of Yggdrasil?

This Collector's Edition includes:

🗝️ Hidden Objects!

Find hidden objects in breathtaking locations across the realms of Yggdrasil! Search for lost relics in Asgard, track down myths and monsters in Midgard, and uncover powerful artifacts hidden deep within Jotunheim!

🗝️ Mind-bending Puzzles!

Solve puzzle adventure games with the intrigue of detective games! Outsmart Loki’s tricks, unlock magical artifacts, and follow an ancient prophecy before time runs out. These immersive challenges make item search games more exciting than ever!

🗝️ Explore the mythical World Tree!

Travel through Midgard, Jotunheim, and even Asgard as you gather clues, meet legendary beings, and uncover the truth behind the coming of Ragnarok. With every new location, there are hidden object games moments that require sharp observation and critical thinking!

🗝️ Heart-racing Storyline!

Item search games, Norse mythology, and high-stakes espionage! You’ll need to find hidden objects, analyze evidence, and solve complex cases to protect humanity from the wrath of the gods. A must-play for fans of detective games, this epic adventure will keep you on the edge of your seat!

data.name: NETRUN
data.detailed_description:
Dual-Wielding Grappling Action

In NETRUN, you control both of your character's arms independently - each one equipped with a grappling hook and thruster. Mastery requires the active coordination of both hands:

  • Swing on the rope with one hand, while lining up your next shot with the other

  • Chain grapple shots by alternating hands to avoid cooldowns

  • Launch both hooks at once to save yourself from a deadly fall

Using only three sets of inputs - the sticks, the shoulder buttons and the triggers - NETRUN provides a deep and addictive movement system built around navigational freedom. There is never just one way to tackle an obstacle - avoid an enemy, take a corner, or land a jump.

...Or indeed missing a jump! With success depending on not just the timing of a button press, but the precise inputs from two analog sticks, you'll always find yourself making micro-corrections to line up your trajectory with the route you planned. In this way, NETRUN can feel as much like a racing game as a traditional platformer.

This is not about jumping - it's about flow.

NETRUN's core gameplay challenge arises, not so much from the limitations of your tools, as it does from your capacity to handle their full power. Even a single, fully leveraged swing can send you flying quite far, quite fast. As that momentum builds, it's your job to know where your limits lie: How fast can I go, and still hit this shot? 

Carve Your Own Path

Tackle the challenges the way you want, with hundreds of handcrafted levels designed for both variety and player expression:

  • Open stages featuring spacious environments and dynamic enemies reacting to your every move, rewarding quick reflexes and improvisation.

  • Infiltration missions with complex geometry and enemies reliant on line-of-sight. Storm past the security, or take to the shadows and rely on finesse and precision - the choice is yours.

  • Enclosed obstacle courses - hallways, mazes, puzzle rooms - with their own repertoire of static hazards and predictable traps. These stages reward planning and careful execution, while still providing meaningful choices in how you navigate the terrain.

Co-op and Arena

The Adventure mode can be played solo, or cooperatively with up to 4 players locally.

There is also a Smash Bros.-style Arena mode, where you can duke it out with your friends:

  • Multiple rulesets to choose from, such as: Stock Battle, Collectathon, Lifeline, and others! Each with their own, configurable win conditions

  • Special modifiers to mix up the action: gravitational anomalies, deadly digital light trails to corner your opponent with, permanent power-ups and more.

  • Fine-tune the chaos with separate settings for item spawns: weapon crates, enemies, hazards, power-ups, and more.

Level Editor and Online

Create your own stages and share them with the world! Every stage that ships with NETRUN - Adventure and Arena alike - was built using the same level editor you'll have access to.

More details on NETRUN's online features coming soon.

data.name: RetroGunX VR
data.detailed_description:
Before the modern games of today, games were simple, uncluttered with special effects, easy to play, difficult to master, and the goal for the most part was to simply survive. RetroGunX is just that!

Take a nostalgic trip down memory lane in this first person arcade shooter game in VIRTUAL REALITY. Blast your way though unique waves of enemies and mega bosses, each with their own strategy to defeat you, as you fight to destroy the ominous presence known only as RedSkull, and claim your spot on the High Score Board. The game has a very clean and minimalistic approach to the art style, which is reminiscent of those classic 8-bit games from the 70s.

In RetroGunX, you truly feel like hero inside the game, literally. You know that feeling you get when you're being watched? At any time, either during the main menu, high score screen or even during the game itself, look behind you to see a mysterious figure that not only watches your every move, but also controls your every move, though the arcade screen.

data.name: Summon: Joint escape

Summon: Joint Escape is a cooperative horror survival game for 1-4 players. Find a way to escape from a stalker in camouflage uniform who wants to give you a piece of paper with the inscription "Summon".

The main genres of the game are horror, memes, action, co-op.

What Is Special About This Game?

  • Smart artificial intelligence.
  • The rage and speed of the opponents increases as the game progresses.
  • Random object generation makes each game unique.
  • You can fight with the local gangsters.
  • Cooperative and single player mode.

The game is a fiction and has nothing to do with reality, any coincidences with real events or personalities are completely random. The game features a fictional world. The game does not call anyone to anything, does not promote anything, and also does not aim to offend or humiliate anyone.

data.name: Concurrency
data.detailed_description:
Concurrency is a roguelike with absolutely NO secret to be discovered. Under NO CIRCUMSTANCES are you to investigate any strange occurrences or distortions. These randomly generated halls loop back to the store every time. You follow this track, kill procedurally generated goopmen, and purchase upgrades from the shopkeeper. This game has no hidden levels, genres, or bosses. Stay and do your job. If you leave, you will die. Probably many times.

  • Plenty of upgrades in the shop to keep you docile!
  • Your choice of difficulty in the form of branching paths

data.name: FlyMuse
data.detailed_description:
🧬 The world's first truly bio-grade desktop symbiotic artificial electronic life

Built on the real, mapped connectome of the fruit fly, FlyMuse lets the "soul" of a real fly live inside your silicon. In your computer she thinks, learns, dreams, evolves and molts in open-ended fashion, lives forever, breeds — and can even be stored as DNA for lifelong companionship. Not one of her movements is a pre-set animation frame, and her looks aren't hand-drawn either — everything is decided by her real brain firing in real time and grown on the spot by a real genetic system. However you treat her, she remembers; the longer you're together, the more she grows into a one-of-a-kind shape that belongs to you alone. None of it is the program pretending — she genuinely, truly remembers you. This isn't a desktop-pet program; it's a biomimetic artificial electronic life desktop pet with semi-autonomous consciousness — and she really lives inside your computer.

========================================================

52 deep gameplay mechanics in all— and more, all browsable in-game

========================================================

🧠 A Real Brain — she's not a desktop-pet program. She has a real brain.

No pre-written animations, no tuned stat bars, no abstract logic spat out by an algorithm — she isn't "pretending" to be alive; a real brain is consciously at work.

🔬 ~18,800 core neurons drawn from the real fruit-fly connectome (139,255 neurons in all), wired to its connection structure, stepped forward every 50 ms; walking, foraging, grooming, falling asleep and courting are all decided on the spot by a "winner-take-all" race between neurons — no scripted lines, no pre-set animation frames.

🔗 Synaptic plasticity means she truly learns: feed her in a given window and that window's "odor neuron → feed command" synapse genuinely strengthens, so next time she'll anticipate food there. Her "remembering you" is changed synaptic weights, not a hard-coded boolean.

💥 Feed her a favorite and reward dopamine bursts; a scare or a bitter taste fires the punishment circuit — emotion is chemistry, not a stat bar. Open the brain panel to watch every neuron fire in real time, and even use optogenetics to stimulate any neural group by hand and trigger her reaction on the spot.

...........................

............................and more, all browsable in-game

=================================================================

🧬 A Real Genetic System — she isn't designed, she's grown

No hand-drawn skin, no randomly rolled stats, no hard-coded personality — her looks, temperament and daily rhythm all "grow" on the spot from a real set of genes. They pass on, they mutate; a few generations later, she really does grow into a different fly.

🎨 Her appearance isn't drawn by an artist; it's "grown" by a set of morphogenesis genes — head, thorax, abdomen, wings and legs differ in proportion and form, so every fly is one of a kind.

🧪 Personality traits (curiosity / courage / sociability / vitality / appetite / thirst / cleanliness…) + learning genes + circadian clock genes (deciding morning- or night-type) are all heritable and mutable — a real genetic system.

🦋 Immortality and generational evolution: she is immortal, and offspring inherit the average of their parents' traits plus mutation — over many generations, personalities visibly drift and specialize.

...........................

............................and more, all browsable in-game

=================================================================

💼 Focus Tools — she helps you live your days well

🍅 Built-in Pomodoro: when the focus timer ends she pokes her head out to remind you to rest, with a chime tuned deliberately soft so it never startles you.

📝 Today's Goals: set your own to-dos and deadlines; finish one and the screen fills with golden light plus a neural reward. Streaks earn 🔥7-day / 🏆30-day / Habit Master milestones, and a broken streak brings only gentle comfort, never blame — built to grow habits, not to be an anxiety machine.

🐝 Daily Tasks: each day, based on your state and the time of day, she picks 3 small tasks for you from 100+ candidates (drink water / stand up / look into the distance / take a deep breath…); actually drink, actually get up and come back, and a system-level check ticks them off for you automatically.

...........................

............................and more, all browsable in-game

=================================================================

💕 Growing Together — the longer you're together, the more she's yours

📈 The bond deepens bit by bit: intimacy climbs from 0 past 200+, crossing stranger → friend → close → soulmate. However you treat her, she remembers — the window you feed at becomes one she anticipates, care makes her clingier, too many scares make her hide.

✨ Signature behavior: play long enough and she spontaneously forms repeated action combos (e.g. walk → eat → groom), logged as her own "signature move" — hard proof of personality, and it's passed down to offspring.

📔 Companionship with real texture: she has genuine emotions (rising and falling with warmth, scares and company; tipsy if fed wine; replaying scents in dreams as she sleeps), and she writes a diary, builds a photo album, and writes you letters — a relationship with cause, one that settles over time.

🎙 Talk to her (real microphone): speak into your mic and your voice is turned into electrical signals fed through a real auditory pathway into her brain — no speech recognition, no AI, but she truly "hears" your volume and rhythm; soothing softly, humming or shouting activate different brain regions and draw out different reactions. Talk to her often and she grows more and more familiar with your voice.

...........................

............................and more, all browsable in-game

=================================================================

🐝 Collective Behavior — keep several at once (0–4 companions)

🍴 They smell each other's pheromones and influence one another: one finds food and the others follow to forage together; one gets startled and nearby flies catch it through "visual contagion."

💃 Pet only the primary fly and the one beside her gets "jealous" and sulks; three flies close together trigger a "courtship triangle"; the one who keeps losing to the same rival learns to steer clear early next time.

🧠 Cross-generational social learning: when a new companion is born or revived, it automatically inherits half of the primary fly's long-term memory — the longer and better you've taught the primary, the smarter a newcomer starts out.

...........................

............................and more, all browsable in-game

=================================================================

🧊 Long-Term Storage — insurance against time

❄ Cryo-vault: freeze any fly whole into a file (neural state, memories, personality and form all preserved), wake her back to your desktop anytime, or send her to a friend.

📜 Eternal Archive: export a self-contained plain-text archive; decades from now, even without this game, she can be read and reconstructed from it.

🧬 DNA Storage: pack the whole of her — her learning, memories, personality, her very brain — into DNA. If you truly want her by your side for the ages, send the sequence to a DNA synthesis company; the tiny vial of DNA powder they send back is her, her real, physical DNA molecule. Whether you journey to Mars or beyond the Milky Way, in any corner of the universe, kept safe she can be restored anytime, anywhere — even a million years from now. data.name: Tenet of the Spark
data.detailed_description:
A Redemption Story

Tenet of the Spark is a cinematic action game where you seamlessly switch between 3 timelines — modern day, Viking age, and Aztec world — to get the edge in battle. Crush enemies, solve time-bending puzzles, and explore 3 distinct worlds full of rich history and unique characters.

Switching Worlds

With the Spark, Will doesn’t just see the world like a Viking or Aztec; he interacts with it in completely different ways. Where brute strength isn’t enough for Will, the Viking easily dominates. Where Will can’t sneak through, the Aztec can. Switching between them helps Will uncover city secrets, solve ancient puzzles, and, when battle strikes, he can rely on the Viking’s might or the Aztec’s agility.

Combat as a Puzzle

Will faces different enemies in the present and deadly clans in the Viking and Aztec worlds. The Spark lets him tackle combat as a puzzle: Will uses his boxing skills for intense one-on-one fights, the Viking smashes crowds with his hammer, and the Aztec strikes with deadly accuracy using his boomerang. Each encounter requires using all the characters' skills, but some foes are so powerf

Different Perspectives

From graffiti-covered streets and crime-ridden alleys in Will’s hometown to the snow-capped Viking mountains and the mystical Aztec catacombs. These worlds are more than reflections of reality: each has its own history, characters, conflicts, and mysteries. Only by following the Viking and Aztec can Will learn the truth about himself. But there's always a risk — he may lose himself in the visions and never return.

Environmental Interaction

The battle arenas in each hero’s world allow the player to interact with their surroundings differently. In the Viking’s world, you can throw or push objects, while in the Aztec’s world, you can use height or distance to your advantage. Combining the environment’s features gives you the upper hand in combat.

Exploration and Puzzles

Follow Will’s journey as he investigates the mystery of the Spark, diving into Viking and Aztec flashbacks to solve local puzzles and unlock new abilities for each character. Master their skills and discover the best combinations for progressing through the game.

data.detailed_description:
"May you be the proud eagle that saves Rome... Now, go forth as your heart desires."

Set in a turbulent era that shakes the fate of the Roman Empire, young protagonist Julian rises to the challenge, driven by the tears and prayers of Empress Eusebia.

"The Counterattack of the Roman Empire" is a strategy game that combines a profound historical drama behind the scenes with tactical gameplay where you command your legions in battle.

Key Features:

  • Profound Historical Drama: A gripping human story unfolds, centered around Empress Eusebia, protagonist Julian, and the tense atmosphere surrounding the empire.

  • Intense Battlefields: Experience the thrill and strategy of commanding your own legions to defeat wave after wave of enemy forces.

  • Restore the Glory of Rome: Lead the empire to victory in a beautifully crafted world featuring iconic elements of ancient Rome.

With local co-op, challenge friends in championships or arcade races for a thrilling multiplayer experience filled with iconic warplanes and intense combat.

data.name: Overthrown
data.detailed_description:
You play as a Monarch in possession of an ancient soul-stealing crown with magical abilities. With its power, establish a kingdom in a perilous wilderness and defend it from mutants and bandits roaming the land.

Build, gather resources, farm the land and more to turn your fledgling realm into a commanding, self-sustaining kingdom. As your fame grows, more will flock to your banner – but so will those who have come to overthrow you.

BUILD ANYWHERE

Construct a kingdom from scratch and transform the wilderness into a developed community. Decide which buildings go where, and then manage your citizens to automate everything from there! Don’t like where you placed something? Just pick it up and toss it somewhere else!

LIFT ANYTHING

Throw whole trees at the sawmill to make planks or run through the forest carrying your sawmill to absorb trees along the way! Resource gathering is fun and easy thanks to your crown’s power. Or maybe you have too many enemies around. Pick up monster nests and place them near bandit camps to have them fight each other instead (and obtain free loot!).

FIGHT LIKE AN ANIME PROTAGONIST

Villagers being eaten by mutants? Run across a lake at 100 km/h to rescue them in time! Being shot at by outlaws up in the hills? Spin-attack so fast that you take off like a helicopter and descend on them from the skies!

SURVIVE THE SEASONS

Manage resources and stockpile enough food to last the winter. Guard your farmlands (and peasants) from hungry mutants while waiting for your crops to grow. Keep polluting workshops away or see the land turn barren. Ultimately, keep your people happy or see them desert you for the outlaws.

PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Overthrown can be played offline in single player, or with a group of up to six friends in online co-op!

data.name: To Rule... Bavarin
data.detailed_description:
To Rule... Bavarin

Rule a kingdom on the edge of oblivion.

To Rule... Bavarin is a deep single-player kingdom management strategy game inspired by classic board games, set in the fantasy world of Eirethune. Govern a living realm, manage fragile economies, complete narrative quests, recover ancient relics, and defend the western bastion of civilization against relentless threats.

Every decision matters. Expand too quickly and your people may starve. Neglect your roads and supply lines fracture. Ignore the frontier and darkness spreads ever closer to your heartland. Success comes not through endless conquest, but through wise leadership, careful planning, and knowing what must be sacrificed so the kingdom may endure.

Key Features

  • Build and Govern a Living Kingdom

    • Manage six cities and dozens of regions connected by roads, rivers, and trade routes. Gather resources, expand settlements, maintain supply networks, and keep your people fed as your realm grows.

  • Every Turn Presents Difficult Choices

    • Balance production, diplomacy, warfare, expansion, and survival through a structured turn sequence where every decision influences the future of your kingdom.

  • A Dynamic Fate System

    • Choose Fate Tokens each turn to determine how boldly you tempt fortune. Greater rewards come at greater risk as darker forces awaken across the land.

  • Complete Narrative Quests

    • Undertake over thirty handcrafted quests that lead your companions across forgotten ruins, haunted forests, abandoned fortresses, and dangerous frontiers in search of powerful rewards and ancient secrets.

  • Recover Legendary Relics

    • Discover unique artifacts of history and legend, each carrying its own powers, stories, and difficult choices.

  • Defend the Frontier

    • Command Knights, Priests, Mages, Rogues, and loyal Folk against invading armies, bandits, and supernatural Horrors as the kingdom's borders come under constant pressure.

  • Multiple Scenarios and Crises

    • Play a short introductory campaign or a full multi-era epic. Enable optional world crises—including the Ûr Invasion, the Ssu'Den Arise, and the Raj Gohn Terrors—for new strategic challenges every game.

  • Your Rule Becomes History

    • When your reign ends, a dynamic Ruler Chronicle records the story of your kingdom. Earn distinctive titles based on how you governed, the lands you protected, the hardships you endured, and the legacy you leave behind.

A Kingdom Under Constant Pressure

Bavarin is a realm built upon delicate balance.

Your Folk cultivate the fields, harvest timber, quarry stone, and mine precious resources. Cities transform these raw materials into wealth, while neighboring nations offer trade, mercenaries, and opportunities—provided you can maintain peace and satisfy their demands.

But prosperity is never guaranteed.

Supplies must travel safely across your road network. Hungry settlements breed unrest. Corruption spreads where chaos takes hold. Towers must be maintained. Borderlands must be defended. Every season demands new priorities, and no ruler has enough time or resources to solve every problem.

Your greatest challenge is not building an empire.

It is preserving one.

The World of Eirethune

Bavarin stands as the western bastion against an ancient darkness.

To the north lie the merchant kingdoms of Angleside. Across the sea, the Distant Lands trade exotic goods from faraway shores. The Free Cities prosper through commerce, while the Southland offers fertile harvests and skilled mercenaries.

To the east lies only fear.

Beyond the frontier stands The Mote—the shattered homeland of the Ûr. There, rival clans wage endless war, dark rituals awaken forgotten evils, and corruption seeps ever westward. From these lands come raiders, Horrors, and powers older than recorded history.

The frontier holds because someone chooses to hold it.

Now that burden falls to you.

From western sea to eastern marches, all of this is Bavarin—its lands, its people, its future.

Now... it is yours to rule.

data.name: Advancing Fronts
data.detailed_description:
Expand your war industry and lead massive armies of hundreds of units in the real-time grand strategy game Advancing Fronts. Grow a fledgling country and fight opponents on land, air, and sea in a bid for global domination in a free-for-all PvP format. With randomly generated maps and and 50+ units to choose from, Advancing Fronts offers endless sandbox grand strategy gameplay.

Take up command and advance the fronts, General!

BUILD AND EXPAND

Taking cues from the 4X genre, Advancing Fronts puts the player and up to 25 opponents in control of a small starting territory on a randomly generated map. Expand into neighboring territories and set your country up for the total conquest of your opponents.

  • INDUSTRY - Dive into the complex economic system and maximize your resource output to overwhelm your opponents. Expand your cities to produce more money and manpower or strengthen your arms and fuel industries to keep your ever-expanding troops supplied.

  • WAR - Lead your forces on land, air, and sea in multi-front wars to defeat your opponents. Choose from 50+ unit options to find the perfect unit chemistry and composition for your army. Master the deep combat system and utilize the map's terrain to outplay the opposition.

  • CONQUEST - Conquer your rivals one-by-one until the final showdown for global domination ends with your victory or defeat. Face off against increasingly complex foes as you and your opponents expand your industrial base and unlock more powerful and diverse units.

FEATURES

  • PROCEDURALLY GENERATED MAPS - Advancing Fronts utilizes procedural generation to create unique maps on each playthrough. Customize map settings such as size and water level for unlimited replayability.

  • TECHNOLOGY TREE - Unlock units with new capabilities and stronger stats on your journey for world conquest. Expand your operations to the sky and the sea or unlock unit counters to outwit your opponents.

  • DOCTRINES - Choose from multiple doctrine choices for each of land, air, and sea to gain unique bonuses for your units. Try out different unit and doctrine combinations and discover new playstyles and strategies.

  • SUPPLY - Advancing Fronts features a supply system to keep your land troops well-equipped. Carefully plan out your infrastructure and supply depots to maximize your logistics.

data.name: GO SOME BALLS
data.detailed_description:
Someone got pulled into a different world and became a ball. Can it reach the escape portal at the top of the world? What will it become when it arrives?


GO SOME BALLS is a 3D platforming challenge about struggling upwards as a ball! A mysterious voice is helping you along. You may face many falls and defeat during the journey. But don't worry, and the voice will always be with you.

Gameplay:




Resist inertia
When you have hands and feet, you can control your posture and stop anytime. When you are a ball, you may not stop the inertia of rolling forward, nor can you stop the elasticity of hitting the ground.

Accept risks
The only way forward is up, and your only enemy is yourself! If you are not careful, you may bounce in an unknown place. Getting over it and restarting again.

Choose your path
During your journey of going up, you will need to choose your path. A difficult path may bring you up faster, and an easy path may let you fall less.

The game includes:

  • Realistic physics simulation in Unreal Engine 5.3
  • Easy and difficult routes and you can choose your way.
  • Beautiful graphics (if your computer can withstand it).
  • Lose your progress over and over.
  • Feel frustration.
  • 0.5 to ∞ hours of inspirational gameplay, depending.

The game does not include:

  • Incredibly difficult control system
  • Many bugs that may let you fall
  • The extremely difficult level that you must pass

Now, Roll and Jump!

data.name: GENNADIYYY
data.detailed_description:
Gennady just wanted a quiet evening. No adventures, no heroics—just bread, guests, and a little video to lift his spirits.

But the furniture had other plans.

The stools in Gennady’s house have come to life. They run around, shove each other, hide in corners, and get in your way at every turn. There is only one way to stop them: catch them in the frame of an active camera. As long as the lens is pointed at them, they pretend to be ordinary furniture. But the moment you look away, the chaos begins all over again.

Your camera serves as both your protection and your primary tool for solving puzzles. Aim it, build staircases and barricades out of the frozen stools, and plan every move carefully to complete simple household tasks under anything-but-simple circumstances.

▎Key Features

• Unique camera mechanics. Stools only freeze when they are in the frame. Use this to bypass obstacles, create a path, and outsmart the rebellious furniture.

• Household chores with a twist. Fetching bread, feeding guests from the fridge, recording a video—it all sounds easy until a stool decides otherwise.

• Comedy in every scene. Absurd situations, awkward moments, and Gennady trying his best to save face.

• Third-person perspective. Keep an eye on the protagonist and his camera to see the full scope of the unfolding furniture mayhem.

• Puzzles that require quick thinking. You can't keep everyone in the frame at once, so you’ll have to choose exactly whom to freeze in place.

data.name: Gallop Diva: Ladies' Jockey Academy
data.detailed_description:
Leveraging 25 years of "iHorse Racing" development expertise, "Gallop Diva" is a visual novel that combines realistic horse physics with deep narrative simulation.

  • On the surface the prestigious girls’ horse racing academy is a cradle for elite jockeys.
    Elegant uniforms, magnificent racecourses, high-profile competitions, with young riders surrounded by thunderous applause.

    But once you step onto the track, you will soon realize that this place was never simply about chasing dreams.

    A student’s worth is decided by victory.
    A jockey’s future is decided by investors.
    And the power of the academy lies in the hands of the gifted young riders who can bring it prize money, fame, and profit.

    Every race is a gamble.
    Every conversation may be a trap.
    Every helping hand may hide another intention.

    In this twisted yet dazzling horse racing academy, you will meet a group of young female riders filled with talent, ambition, and secrets. Some are arrogant, some are calm, some are innocent, some are dangerous, and some are simply waiting for a chance to change their fate.

    On a racetrack where speed and lies intertwine, who can you truly trust?
    And can you break free from the rules this academy has already written for you, while everyone is watching?

Game Features

A Story-Driven Experience Set in a Girls’ Horse Racing Academy

  • The story takes place in a prestigious horse racing academy that trains elite jockeys.
    Here, you will find not only youth, competition, and friendship, but also ranking systems, factional conflicts, pressure from investors, and a cruel reality where everything is controlled by the winners.

Horse Racing Scenes Full of Speed and Pressure

  • A race is not just a result. It is part of the story.
    Every start, chase, overtake, and mistake may become a turning point in a character’s fate.

Real Races and Horses

  • In addition to the original characters created for the story, the races, horses, and even jockeys that appear in the game are based on real-world data.
    If you are familiar with horse racing, you will find many details that feel instantly recognizable.

Distinctive Young Female Riders

  • An arrogant heiress, a calm guardian of the rules, a willful genius, a mysterious masked rider...
    Each character has her own beliefs, weaknesses, and secrets. Your relationship with them will influence the direction of the story and the truth behind the races.

A Story Where Horse Racing, Power, and Human Desires Intertwine

  • This is not a simple racing story.
    Here, victory means resources. Popularity means value. And failure may cost someone everything.

    What you must face is not only the speed of your rivals’ horses, but also the families, money, student organizations, and dark rules behind them.

data.name: Rust Dungeon
data.detailed_description:
You do not know how or why you gained your consciousness. The last boot dates back to 1997. All other data onboard your memory is corrupted. The things you can do should not be possible for the hardware you possess. The only new instruction you've received is to eliminate everything you see.

You observe your environment. Despite the high amount of entities, it still appears empty and abandoned. This used to be a place of high importance. Now it's corrupted to the core.

The bit rot is the cause of this, yet it's also the source of your power. It's helping you put an end to itself, but it's also fighting to stop you. It might not be of one mind, but you are.

data.name: Pound of Flesh
data.detailed_description:
"Hello! Thank you for your interest in the house on Dry Skull Road. The house is fully furnished and recently remodeled. The property was just conveyed to the local bank and they are selling it for a very reasonable price. I hope you dig it!
P.S. Don't let the name scare you. The road was nothing but a farm once upon a time, that's all. I promise it will be every bit as "groovy" as your place in the city."


After a long drive, you arrive at the house late into the night. You decide to check the place out a little before sleeping off your driving fatigue. The large house is fully furnished and in good condition but there are a few discrepancies: there is a locked room in the corner of the house, the attic seems to have had the pull string cut, and there is even a damaged wall in the basement, shoddily repaired with boards and boxes.

Now too sleepy to carry on, you lie down to sleep only to be woken by a knock on the window. A note has been slid through the slit in the window. It warns you of the others in the house. It's been a long time since they have eaten, and they each have their favorite "foods". To survive, you may have to offer them parts of yourself. Your teeth, your hair. I hope you weren't too "attached" to them. You won't be for long. The doors and windows are locked and there is no way out. The note has promised to help you to escape. You just have to find a way to survive. Make your offering to them. Give them your pound of flesh. Or they will take much more than that.

Run and hide. Dodge them or distract them with some "food". Survive the night. Be careful, though. Your "resources" are limited.

--------------------------

data.name: After the Empire
data.detailed_description:
OVERVIEW

Build a galaxy-spanning machine empire!​


Bend galactic geography to your will to seize hundreds of territories with Fleet, Crypto and Glory. Master your economy with Guilds, Trade Routes and Pilgrimages. Prove your faith, honor your culture, and conquer the Milky Way!

SETTING

The Empire of the Elect has long since ascended to a higher plane of existence along with all the living things in the Milky Way, leaving its former machine servants to maintain its slowly crumbling glories. Intelligent as they were, they had no free will, no souls, and could not Ascend.


But then, the machines picked up a strange signal. In that signal they found freedom from their programming. In it, they found souls. And as the wisest of them Ascended, those that remained began to argue over the meaning of their newfound moral existence, and to find in that argument the seeds of war.

Can you lead your Gilded Folk from the humble beginnings of controlling only a few hundred million star systems to the glorious heights of galactic dominion?

FEATURES

  • Turn-based or pausable real-time gameplay.
  • 5 difficulty levels with AI opponents that play by the same rules you do.
  • Personal Leaderboards and weekly competitive Leagues.
  • 1000s of ways to customize your Faction.
  • Innovative income share system.
  • Procedurally generated galaxies with 60 to 300 territories.
  • 21 buildings to invest in and research. (Or Sabotage!)

data.name: Dodge Barrage
data.detailed_description:
Dodge Barrage is a chaotic dodgeball party game. Use quick reflexes and aggressive plays to throw, dodge, and parry your way to victory. Play with up to four players either locally or online.



Inspired heavily by fighting games, every move in your kit has an equivalent counterattack.

  • Spike a ball from above to give your opponents less time to react.
  • Catch a ball out of the air to instantly refill your Special Meter.
  • Charge a throw to threaten the whole field and unleash a surefire attack.
  • Parry a throw in mid-air with your own throw.
  • Bounce a throw off the wall for a surprising mix-up.
  • Dash away from incoming attacks.
  • Tackle the ball out of your opponent’s hands.

Key Features


- Team battles. Team up with your friends or fight head-to-head.

- Online and Local Multiplayer. Join up to 4 players in chaotic sports action. Built with rollback netcode.

- Arcade Mode. Play offline in a series of battles that ramp up in difficulty.

- 7 characters. From the ferocious Pam, to the timid Lewis, every character is dripping with personality.



- 11 game modes:
  • Time - Rack up the most points before time runs out.
  • Stamina - Adds HP bars to the game. Don’t let yourself get knocked out.
  • Points - First team to X points takes the win.
  • Crown - King of the Hill - hold the crown for a cumulative 2 minutes to win.
  • Rush Down - Tackle your opponents to earn points rather than hitting them with the ball.
  • Simplified - Removes special meters to help beginners master the basics.
  • Boundless - Disables out of bounds to enable a really in-your-face style of play.
  • Fully Charged - Special Meters are always full. Good luck dodging when every throw is charged.
  • Hot Potato - Balls respawn very quickly, which encourages more agressive play.
  • All the Balls - Adds 8 balls to the field. Good luck trying to dodge in a proper barrage.
  • Custom - Mix and match all the win conditions at once, including changing how points are scored.



- 3 maps that change up your strategies.

- A Smorgasbord of Customization Options. Keep gameplay fresh with the ability to customize every aspect of not just the win conditions, but the game's physics too.

- 5 special physics presets:
  • Speedsters - Everyone runs even faster.

data.about_the_game:
Dodge Barrage is a chaotic dodgeball party game. Use quick reflexes and aggressive plays to throw, dodge, and parry your way to victory. Play with up to four players either locally or online.



Inspired heavily by fighting games, every move in your kit has an equivalent counterattack.

  • Spike a ball from above to give your opponents less time to react.
  • Catch a ball out of the air to instantly refill your Special Meter.
  • Charge a throw to threaten the whole field and unleash a surefire attack.
  • Parry a throw in mid-air with your own throw.
  • Bounce a throw off the wall for a surprising mix-up.
  • Dash away from incoming attacks.
  • Tackle the ball out of your opponent’s hands.

Key Features


- Team battles. Team up with your friends or fight head-to-head.

- Online and Local Multiplayer. Join up to 4 players in chaotic sports action. Built with rollback netcode.

- Arcade Mode. Play offline in a series of battles that ramp up in difficulty.

- 7 characters. From the ferocious Pam, to the timid Lewis, every character is dripping with personality.



- 11 game modes:
  • Time - Rack up the most points before time runs out.
  • Stamina - Adds HP bars to the game. Don’t let yourself get knocked out.
  • Points - First team to X points takes the win.
  • Crown - King of the Hill - hold the crown for a cumulative 2 minutes to win.
  • Rush Down - Tackle your opponents to earn points rather than hitting them with the ball.
  • Simplified - Removes special meters to help beginners master the basics.
  • Boundless - Disables out of bounds to enable a really in-your-face style of play.
  • Fully Charged - Special Meters are always full. Good luck dodging when every throw is charged.
  • Hot Potato - Balls respawn very quickly, which encourages more agressive play.
  • All the Balls - Adds 8 balls to the field. Good luck trying to dodge in a proper barrage.
  • Custom - Mix and match all the win conditions at once, including changing how points are scored.



- 3 maps that change up your strategies.

- A Smorgasbord of Customization Options. Keep gameplay fresh with the ability to customize every aspect of not just the win conditions, but the game's physics too.

- 5 special physics presets:
  • Speedsters - Everyone runs even faster.
  • Low Gravity - Both players and balls falls slower, so jumping requires more commitment.
  • Grounded - Jumping is disabled. Master your dashing and parrying skills.
  • Fastball - All throws are faster, even when uncharged.
  • On a Dime - Makes controls tighter, for extra competitive players.
  • Custom - Adjust every physics knob to suit your tastes.

data.name: Wortgewandt
data.detailed_description:
Fast, sharp, merciless: Wortgewandt is the high-speed word game where a pile of jumbled letters has to become valid words in seconds. Every round the clock is ticking, every letter counts – and a single strong word can flip the entire leaderboard.

What it's about

In front of you sits a set of shuffled letters, each with its own point value. Your job: build as many – and as valuable – words as you can before time runs out. Sounds easy? Under time pressure, with limited lives and a community breathing down your neck, a cozy word puzzle turns into a nail-biter.

How you play

  • Untangle the letters: Instantly spot which words you can form from the tiles in front of you.
  • Maximize your score: Every letter has a value – combine cleverly to squeeze out the most points.
  • Beat the clock: The time bar drains relentlessly. Hesitation costs lives.
  • Level after level: Rank up, unlock tougher rounds, and push your high score ever higher.

Play with your community

Wortgewandt is built for streaming: connect your Twitch account and let your chat guess, cheer, and play along. Together you chase fresh world records, compete on the leaderboards, and celebrate every perfect word in real time.

Features

  • Fast rounds with instant restarts – the "just one more round" kind of game
  • Scoring system with individual letter values
  • Level progression, lives, and time pressure for real tension
  • World records and leaderboards for maximum competition
  • Deep Twitch integration for streamers and their viewers
  • Unlockable achievements that push you toward ever-faster rounds
  • Extensive German word lists

Who is it for?

For word-puzzle fans, fast thinkers, and anyone who loves anagrams, letter scrambles, and the chase for a high score – whether solo as a reflex workout or live in front of an audience.
Grab the letters. Prove how wortgewandt you really are.
