data.name: DOM RUSALOK
data.detailed_description:
Russia in the ‘90s. A provincial town on the outskirts of the crumbling Soviet Empire. A big yard where many kids hang out. They make friends, fight and reconcile, love and hate, but mostly just play. Life goes on as usual until one kid mysteriously goes missing, and the rest of the group has to face the horror they are unable to comprehend – the DØM RUSALOK. This is a place where the worst nightmares come true.

DØM RUSALOK – is a story that follows the traditions of great works by Stephen King and Robert Stine. It is a story about children who have to face a disturbing horror. Only this time action does not take place in cozy suburban America but at cellars, basements and yards of provincial 90’s Russia. The post-soviet russian setting gives the game a unique atmosphere like no other. It creates a space where no one can hear your scream.

A number of challenges awaits the children who are about to discover the deepest darkest secrets hidden away in a human soul. A homicidal maniac is on the loose, while the street gangs thrive under the police protection. A cult with a TV psychic medium leader grows in popularity among the people. However, most importantly, at the heart of an abandoned research institute, which the town was originally built around, a somewhat chthonic power is about to awaken.

WARNING: DOM RUSALOK contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition

data.name: Pikapo
data.detailed_description:
Push back against marine creatures, restore the maritime ecosystem!

Pikapo is an incremental game. Using your wave emitters, chase away the foreign creatures attracted to this ecosystem. Make your way to the deepest parts of the abyss and find out the source of the environmental disorder!

You will be equipped with tools, such as Emitters, that will allow you to manipulate the elements to your advantage on your expeditions.

Each creature leaves resources before fleeing. You can use them to explore the skill tree and perfect your strategies!

The company will send you a Pikapo unit to help in your excursions. Upgrade it to unleash its full potential! 

Each Emitter can be customized thanks to the resources found in the depths, to better adapt to your play style.

The signal gets stronger and stronger in the abyss, and creatures increase in numbers to prevent you from progressing!

Warning

This game contains flashing lights that can make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other visual impairments.

Thank you for your vigilance!

data.name: Destination: Pluto The VR Experience
data.detailed_description:
The New Horizons probe to Pluto, a spacecraft that traveled almost a million miles per day for a decade, is one of the most celebrated missions in the history of space exploration. It is by far the longest journey in human history, and you can join us at the destination in immersive virtual reality. Imagery and topographical data sent from the probe have revealed for the first time an astonishing planet filled with the wonders of new, previously unknown geological processes.

What if you could stand on the surface of Pluto and behold some of these wonders up close, as though you were actually there? Using real imagery and data from 3 billion miles away, Destination Pluto: The VR Experience harnesses the power of virtual reality to give you mankind’s first self-guided tour of the surface of Pluto.

Destination Pluto: The VR Experience showcases three different locations based on their unusual geological processes—from the dark canyon lands of Krun Macula in the south; to the glacier spill way of Sputnik Planum’s north shore at the al-Idrisi Mountains; to the pitted high plains of the central Sputnik Planum. Tour these locations from the safety of your own personal space pod, or, if you dare, fly among the hills and canyons yourself. You can even walk around, and heft huge boulders as each location is calibrated with the physics of Pluto’s gravity in mind. Jet-pack across an entire hemisphere of Pluto and even visit the New Horizons spacecraft as it makes its way through the Plutonian System. Descriptive placards highlight points of interest around the landscape.

To learn more about the furthest point of exploration in human history and the incredible technology, precision, and ingenuity that led us to the outer reaches of our solar system, watch Destination: Pluto on CuriosityStream.

data.name: Comical Sara
data.detailed_description:
Comical Sara is a roguelite FPS where you can shoot enemies without reloading.

Play as the energetic engineer Sara and blast away evil aliens in a thrilling, over-the-top firefight!

Key Features

  • No reloads, no ammo pickups. Just shoot!

    Forget about reloading - your ammo is infinite! Enjoy pure, uninterrupted action as you mow down hordes of enemies with non-stop gunfire.

  • Dual-wield for double the firepower.

    Sara can equip a different gun in each hand. Choose your favorite combos and unleash overwhelming firepower to dominate the battlefield in your own style!

  • Randomly generated levels.

    Every run is different: level layouts, enemy spawns, and item drops are all randomized. Sometimes you'll get lucky. Sometimes you'll be cornered. How you survive is up to your skills and decisions.

  • Get stronger, run after run.

    When Sara falls, your progress resets - but the money you've earned can be used to unlock permanent upgrades. With every run, you'll get a little stronger. Take on the challenge, experiment, and enjoy the sweet feeling of progress.

  • Can you beat Hell Mode?

    Choose from five difficulty levels. Start off with the light-hearted Comical Mode - even a baby could clear it (probably). But the ultimate challenge awaits in Hell Mode, where only the toughest players survive. Are you ready to push your limits?

data.name: 汽车帝国
data.detailed_description:
1. Introduction to the game
"Car Empire" is a high-degree-of-freedom simulation business game based on car building. Here you will play the role of the CEO of a start-up car company, through continuous efforts to make your company bigger and stronger, and compete with major well-known cars for the global market. Car building is the core gameplay of this game. You can build gasoline cars, pure electric, hybrid, and even hydrogen energy cars. The game has built-in more than 150 different vehicle blueprints, and those cars that made you fascinated. , Today you finally have the opportunity to make it yourself! In addition, the technology tree of this game is also very rich. You can develop various engines, three-electric systems and even unmanned driving technology. The leading technology will help you defeat strong opponents. Finally, this work introduces the factory production module. You will soon experience the psychological pressure brought by the huge expenditure of the factory, and you will also experience the great sense of accomplishment brought about by the increase in production capacity!
2. game introduction
(1)Automotive research and development
You can develop cars, SUVs and even sports cars. In terms of power, you can also choose gasoline, hybrid, pure electric, and hydrogen energy. Set your own price and selling point, choose the cutting-edge technology to be equipped, and start research and development! Arrange the most suitable personnel for each project, adjust the energy and cost input of each project, complete the design and pass the quality inspection, and your first car will be developed!
(2)Car release
After the car development is completed, you can hold your new car launch conference! You need to do some preparatory work before the conference, such as adjusting the price of the new car, choosing a marketing strategy, inviting stars, etc. After these tasks are completed, your new car can be unveiled at the conference! When the press conference is held, you can also see the barrage of netizens and the media. From these barrage, you can roughly see the popularity of the new car.
(3)Automobile production
After the press conference is over, mass production will begin as soon as possible! Your initial funds will be relatively short, and it is not realistic to build your own factory, so you can outsource production, but outsourcing production requires a certain amount of OEM fees for each car. After the new car is delivered, you can quickly see the global sales ranking of the new car. Don't be discouraged if the initial sales are not good.
(4)Technology upgrade
Every time you develop a car, you will get a certain amount of scientific and technological points, and you can use these accumulated scientific and technological points to improve your technological level. For example, develop better design drawings, more powerful engines, more powerful new energy technologies, smarter driverless systems, etc. The higher your level of science and technology, the more choices you have when developing cars. The odds of getting a superb car will also be higher.
(5)Team management
A "Lianliankan" game will be triggered during the car development process. If the connection is successful, it will randomly increase motivation for some employees. When employees are full of motivation, they can "explode" during the car development process to improve Various attributes of employees. In addition, daily employee incidents will also affect the motivation of employees. If you handle them properly, you will fill up the motivation of employees more quickly. You can also train your favorite employees so that she can grow faster. For some employees who are really incompetent, you can only replace them. Every time you successfully develop a new car, you will also randomly acquire some employee skills. You can equip your favorite employees with these skills to make her more powerful.
(6)Global hegemony
After you have accumulated a certain amount of car-making experience, you can compete for the global market. The world is divided into eight markets. China, the United States, and the European Union are the largest three, and the remaining five are small markets. At the beginning, you can start from the small market and challenge the local best-selling models. Once the challenge is successful, you will quickly get local Market recognition, thereby increasing car sales. Your ultimate goal is to defeat all competitors in the world and build a global automotive empire.
(7)Factory construction
After you get sufficient funds, you can build your own factory! First of all, you have to select locations around the world, including Beijing, Shanghai, New York, Moscow, etc. Each place will have its own unique preferential policies. You can choose a suitable city as the construction site of the factory according to your needs. After the site selection is completed, the engineering team will quickly build the factory, and then you can use your own factory to produce cars! You do not need to pay OEM fees to the OEM at this time, but the factory will incur a certain amount of operating expenses every month. The larger the scale, the more the cost. As your car becomes more and more popular, there may be insufficient production capacity, and then you need to upgrade the factory. In the process of upgrading the factory, you can play a small game similar to "Tetris". The more squares you put in, the more successful the factory upgrade will be.
(8)Market intelligence
If you want your car to sell well in the world, it is also necessary to pay attention to the market intelligence of various countries. You can obtain the selling points that consumers in various countries pay attention to through intelligence investigation, thereby increasing the probability of new cars becoming popular all over the world. In addition, you can also obtain the current market capacity and changing trends of various countries by understanding global market trends, so as to more effectively target the target market.
(9)Capital market
When the initial funds are insufficient, equity financing can be carried out through the capital market. The higher the sales of the car, the higher the company's valuation. When funds are abundant in the middle and later stages, you can also repurchase shares, thereby increasing your control over the company and reducing annual shareholder dividends.

data.name: Twin Horizons
data.detailed_description:
A simple rhythm action game with the simple controls of tapping and holding the keyboard, but what on earth is that above?
Yes, you need to pay attention to those as well!
Can you handle the 8-lane madness?

Enjoy the music of various genres included


Music from various genres awaits with a maximum of 8 unique stages for each tune to play!
More tunes are to come through updates!

Basic 4 lane gameplay and Not-for-faint-hearted 4x2 lane gameplay


Test your rhythm and sight with the intense floor-and-ceiling 4x2-lane gameplay!



Don't worry if it looks daunting; We also offer the basic 4-lane gameplay.



Familiarize yourself with this game mode, and you'll be ready to tackle the 4x2!
An autoplay feature is also available.

Did you say that is too easy?

Challenge yourself with the Risky Play Options, these ones won't go easy on you!

Statistics are your friends!


Analyze your gameplay with in-depth statistics in the Result Screen!


Challenge your friends with your Player Rate, which is calculated from your best scores!

The Unlock System

Playing a song will reward you with "Creds" and "XP."
Collecting XP levels you up, and leveling up sometimes unlocks a new song.
To play the song, you spend the 'Creds' to unlock them on a difficulty-by-difficulty basis!

Whoops, you're out of Creds? How about the Risky Play Options where you bet some of your Creds and play under the risk of getting your gameplay cut short?
Fail and lose the Creds, but complete the stage, and you'll get bigger rewards PLUS a special clear medal!

data.name: The Customer is Always Right!
data.detailed_description:
It's your first day at the job, just like any other week!

Enter the immersive town known as Neverquit, as you follow your protagonist (and optional feline companion!) through a journey as a customer service cashier at the local Shop n' Stuff!



Features:
  • Dynamic gameplay of various elements involving action/quick-time events!
  • Old-school style RPG elements, to give you that nostalgic feeling!
  • With special gear, you can make the game into a resettable rogue-like that "remembers" your previous reset!
  • Unique RPG classes, such as "Schrodinger" -- a class that learns new abilities on game resets, and "Tactician," requiring stance changes for techniques!
  • Events and scenes in the game feel like it's old school goodness, complete with retro sound effects and music!
  • An incredible soundtrack, awesome pixel-style graphics and animations!
  • A story that blossoms every time you reset or get an ending in the game, with a dynamic day-to-day system!
  • ... And more!



Hurry up, clock on in, what do you have to lose?! Maybe you'll learn a thing or two about the trick of the trade. Buy The Customer Is Always Right! today!

You can edit in-game options with F1, such as window mode, controller support, hotkeys, and other settings such as music/sound disabling.

data.name: Exo Digger
data.detailed_description:
Earth, 2147. The planet is overpopulated and polluted. Billions of people live in poverty and unemployment. Only a select few the lucky winners of a lottery manage to secure jobs. CONGRATULATIONS!

You have won the Galactic Labor Reserve lottery!

XenoMining Inc. is sending you to Planet PX-173, where you will work in the mines.

• Contract duration: 6 months

• Job description: Mineral extraction

• Payment: Based on your mining performance

Exo Digger is a relaxing mining simulator set on a distant planet. Dig deep, extract rare minerals, upgrade your equipment, and expand your inventory. Explore the depths, but beware some areas of the mines may be dangerous. Who knows what secrets this planet holds beneath its surface? Keep digging, and perhaps fortune will smile upon you.

Welcome to a new world. Good luck!

data.name: 超将棋
data.detailed_description:
はじめに

「ゲームはもっと、シンプルでいい。」
この理念のもと、物理演算と将棋を掛け合わせた超将棋は制作されました。
あなたが友人や世界の強敵たちと切磋琢磨しながら、この懐かしい、それでいて
未知のボードゲームを楽しんで頂ければそれ以上の喜びはありません。

ゲームのルール

　このゲームでは世界中のプレイヤーと戦うことができる対戦モードと、1人で遊ぶ
詰将棋モードの二つが用意されています。

　対戦モードでは、互いのプレイヤーは自分の駒を物理的に動かすことができ、相手の
王将を盤外に落とせば勝ちとなります。ここでいう「物理的に動かす」というのは、
駒をデコピンで吹っ飛ばす感覚に近いです。

　詰将棋モードは、それぞれの課題において指定された手数内で全ての敵の駒を
落とすことが目的のゲームです。課題によっては、王以外を落としてしまうと失格となる
ものもあります。

data.name: Bloody Handy
data.detailed_description:
Get BLOODY HANDY with friends in this comedy-horror co-op for up to 6 players. Search for a list of objects, but each one is dangerous to hold for too long. Pass the parcel along to the exit before they poison, zap or explode you. Don't drop any items, as monsters are also on the hunt!

ESCAPE THE HAUNTED PURGATORY

Bow to the almighty gate! You are one fortunate soul picked to provide the gate with certain items that will unlock it to freedom!

PASS THE PARCEL

Find different items through the haunted purgatory. Electric items will zap you, hot items burn the longer you hold it, explosive items will explode in your very hands. The smartest move is to toss it to a friend, then run ahead and catch it back. Walking it there yourself is a bad idea.

DON'T DROP ITEMS ON THE FLOOR

Don't miss your shot and drop items on the floor. Every item is fragile and will eventually break if dropped enough times. 

SOMETHING IS HUNTING YOU

Monsters lurk around every corner, and they go for whoever is holding the parcel. We currently have three iconic monsters, See for yourself! (Or run for your life!)

BEST WITH HEADPHONES

3D audio lets you hear whether the hungry beast is in front, behind, above or below you. Proximity voice chat means a shout carries further than a whisper, and walls muffle voices.

A NEW MANSION EVERY RUN

Procedurally generated halls and junctions in multiple visual styles. As the difficulty rises, so do the monsters and the list of items the gate demands. If everyone dies, the run resets to the lobby.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op: join through the Steam lobby browser or a lobby code [tested player count]

  • Pass the parcel: hot, cold and heavy items you can't hold for long

  • Monsters that hunt whoever holds the item

  • Proximity voice chat and 3D audio (best with headphones)

  • Ghost spectator mode

  • Save slots for hosted runs

  • Customisable character colours and faces, plus an emote wheel

  • Text chat

ACCESSIBILITY

  • Camera shake, particle effects and light flicker can be turned off

  • Full key rebinding, FOV, UI scale and separate volume sliders

  • Text chat

Monsters lurk around every corner, and they go for whoever is holding the parcel. We currently have three iconic monsters, See for yourself! (Or run for your life!)

BEST WITH HEADPHONES

3D audio lets you hear whether the hungry beast is in front, behind, above or below you. Proximity voice chat means a shout carries further than a whisper, and walls muffle voices.

A NEW MANSION EVERY RUN

Procedurally generated halls and junctions in multiple visual styles. As the difficulty rises, so do the monsters and the list of items the gate demands. If everyone dies, the run resets to the lobby.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op: join through the Steam lobby browser or a lobby code [tested player count]

  • Pass the parcel: hot, cold and heavy items you can't hold for long

  • Monsters that hunt whoever holds the item

  • Proximity voice chat and 3D audio (best with headphones)

  • Ghost spectator mode

  • Save slots for hosted runs

  • Customisable character colours and faces, plus an emote wheel

  • Text chat

ACCESSIBILITY

  • Camera shake, particle effects and light flicker can be turned off

  • Full key rebinding, FOV, UI scale and separate volume sliders

  • Text chat
data.short_description: Get BLOODY HANDY with friends in this comedy-horror co-op for up to 6 players. Search for a list of objects, but each one is dangerous to hold for too long. Pass the parcel along to the exit before they poison, zap or explode you. Don't drop any items, as monsters are also on the hunt!

data.name: The Home
data.detailed_description:
The Home: Story Mode

Guilt has led you to break back into your old, abandoned care home. As you tread through the overgrown hallways, memories of your days as a child appear as if you are still there. You know something is following you. But the question is... is it just in your head? Trek through your trauma as you discover the fate of Mr Blackwood, the abusive manager of the home. As you progress, your childhood invades the present while you relive those traumatic memories.

The Home: Recollections

Work 5 nightshifts and perform 4 different tasks, to complete your trial week at Willow Wood Children's Care Home.

You will have to crawl through the attic, hide the truth from inspectors and face your Guilt head on.

You will retrace your first week as a carer at Willow Wood. The most important thing to remember is never go into the basement!

What do you want to remember?

Play all 'The Home' games free on Steam via the DLCs.

data.name: Reapers
data.detailed_description:
Reapers is an online trading card game set in a dystopian future.

Collect cards and packs, build custom decks, and win games against other players. All current season cards are shared so you can jump right into the action. Get rewarded for winning games and grow your own private collection. Currently in the Beta Season, cards and packs are limited, so gather them now, boost their visuals for added value and trade them later!

I originally wanted to create a table top card game for my kids, but figured out it would be easier to make a computer sandbox. The project eventually turned into a fully online game, packed with features and interesting mechanics. The first release of the game with 300+ Alpha Season cards came out in January 2022. The Beta Season cards were released in September 2022. Looking forward to create the Third Season cards with the help of the community!

Looking forward to challenge you on the battlefield!

data.name: Stardash
data.detailed_description:
A modern platformer mimicking the good old days of classic platformers that require twitchy fingers and fast reflexes! Warning: this game is NOT EASY !

You have an endless amount of lives, so you can quickly restart a level when you miss a jump, get hit by an enemy, get bitten by a plant, get hit by a spiky-ball, crushed by big statues, run onto spikes, get hit by a wasp, or any of the other many ways you'll get stopped in your run.

BUT when you do complete a level, the rush you get will keep you coming back for more, and more, and more, and..

Unlock the special Temple levels by finding hidden keys in every level of every world, and unlock a flip-mode by completing a level both within the time set, and also by collecting all the coins in a level.

Stardash is all about the gameplay thrown at you in awesome retro graphics and original chiptunes.

Game features:

  • Classic vibes thanks to the monochrome pixelart graphics

  • Fully designed levels (NOT procedural and NOT random)

  • Fast and very challenging platform action

  • A thumping and memorable chip-tune soundtrack - a true earworm!

  • Secret unlockable Temple levels

data.name: Elysian Echoes
data.detailed_description:
Explore a world teeming with subtle mysticism

Witness the shattering of Gaia, a world on the brink of destruction and war, through the eyes of an Elysian - a member of an ascended species of higher-dimensional beings -, sent to restore balance before it is too late.

A curse befell him on his path to incarnation; now, he is stuck between realms - a disincarnate essence, a mere shadow on the wind, tasked with redeeming the destiny of an entire world. His powers are spent, and now he must become one with the very essence of the world he lives on by witnessing the Echoes of heroes long past, and learning their ways, if he has any hope to succeed. Will you grant him the chance to try?

Featuring many mystical motifs and rich lore, the game puts an emphasis on subtle plot hints, which are carefully hidden in the nooks and crannies of the world, waiting to be discovered by both yourself and the main character, as you trek along the winding paths of Gaia.

Game features

  • Traditional side-scrolling action gameplay.
  • RPG looting with a twist - instead of better gear, you get to possess fallen enemies and use their weapons and abilities. Master your enemies' movesets to defeat them, then claim them as your own to spell the doom of those who oppose you.
  • Traditional souls-like gameplay loop: you may choose to return to a safe Shrine to restore your health and energy, and it will be safe so long as you backtrack. Expect your foes to do the same when you do so, however!
  • Explore 7 unique environments: The Swamp, home of Lizardkin; The Plateau, home of the Aviankin; The Depths, home of Insectkin; Mushroomland, home of all things funky and lethal; Redwood, beautiful pristine forest, where the elements find themselves at home; Deepwood Forest, home of the wise and ascended Elvenkin; Evercrest Castle, shattered symbol of unity, deserted, but not bereft of dangers.
  • Witness your powers growing as you commune with Echoes of Elysians long past and find ways to use your ascended abilities in this lesser form. Gain new mystical abilities. Learn to dash through the enemies' shadows. Control their bodies without ever touching them, from a distance.
  • Talent trees as trinkets - defeat bosses and acquire talent points. Unlock talents which facilitate more diverse approaches to combat, such as remote possession, synchronized spirit attacks, summoning conquered bosses as minions to deliver a heavy blow and many more!
  • Beautiful, hand drawn and composed landscapes, featuring tight parallax, which give the world an exquisite sense of depth.
  • Fully grass roots, and built out of passion and a desire for expression. Everything, from the drawings to the haunting musical scores, has been hand crafted with love by no more than 3 indie devs.

Player skill reigns supreme

Elysian Echoes is a metroidvania game, born out of passion, emphasizing exploration through atmospheric vistas, skillful platforming, and learning enemy skills and movesets.

The game features a unique gameplay mechanic called "possession", through which the main character assumes the physical body of defeated enemies, allowing you to take control of their skillsets and abilities. The game takes the classical progression formula and adds a twist; unlocks are now split between upgrading the main character, his possession powers, and the strength of the bodies he takes control of, instead of searching for better weapons and armor to utilize.

The game follows the souls-like pattern of harsh and unforgiving enemies, with clear telegraphed movesets that can be learned and exploited, and punishing bosses. Player skill reigns supreme - great emphasis has been placed on the ability to play the game as you like, even without utilizing the core "possession" mechanic, or getting upgrades. If you know the paths, are an able platformer, and can learn the enemy patterns, nothing can stop you!

data.name: Caxtilteca
data.detailed_description:
Play as Tlaxcalan dukes defending their land from former friends and allies

An action real time strategy game set in a Mexican colonial city who allied with the Caxtilteca. Originally promised tax free status as a reward for defeating the Triple Alliance; the Caxtilteca broke their promise. Now, you and up to 4 other players must go out in the countryside and protect your city tactfully- collect tribute before the end of harvest season as you prepare a secret conspiracy to save your people from further destruction!

Holy Warriors

Use your status as Mayordomo de Maize to recruit hapless peasants and build a holy army to resist the embodiments of evil. 

Legal Battles

Follow the Caxtilteca's law as you fight their land grabbing- play through the most consequential battles of the 16th century and prove your city was earned through sacrifice. 

Theatre of Faith

Star in local 1-4 cooperative or competitive matchups set in the Holy Crusades and the Conquest to convince the viceroy to give you lower taxes. Customize your loadouts and win conditions to your hearts content!

data.name: A stupid game about pouring drinks for the P.T.A.
data.detailed_description:
The P.T.A. is meeting again and discussing the next event to put on. It's May and that means one thing, the legendary Summer Fete is coming up, the most important event of the year. Yet, so far, you've only accumulated £22.45 towards hiring things and that will barely cover the cost of the Tombola. It's time to take matters into your own hands and make the P.T.A. put their money where their mouths are and make them pay for it, in exchange for some tap water. 

It's heroic, and you're a shining beacon for taking action, but secretly you just want to spend a day with Rowdy Dave, Hatchback, Chicken-Wing Jeff and Colin, smashing burgers into your gob in the sunshine.

With your hand on the tap, pour water to fill the glass between the lines before serving it out and receiving some cash in return.

Be bold and fill the glass in one go for bonus but go too far and Mrs Peters will be claiming damages.

Putting together a Summer Fete is pretty expensive so perhaps invest some cash into some upgrades. Get a bigger glass, fix that dang tap so it pours faster or even pick up some little umbrellas and choccie biccies to sell at an extreme markup.

Game Features:

  • Multiple glasses to fill with water

  • A series of extras to keep on top of to make your drinks worth the most they can be

  • Lots of upgrades to buy to get more money and get it faster

  • A bunch of voicelines for the immersive PTA experience

  • Finish the game to get a little song!

data.name: Is This Farming?
data.detailed_description:
Your crops have woken up. They want a word.

Till the soil, plant your seeds, water them, and wait for the harvest. Then the harvest climbs out of the ground and headbutts you.

Is This Farming? is a first-person co-op farming game where every crop you grow is a fight you chose. Play alone or with up to three friends.

Farm what you fight

  • Grow your own enemies. Taters charge you head first, Carrot Stabbers dash at you, Pea Pods fire volleys of peas. The more you plant, the bigger the brawl.
  • Wake them when you're ready. Ripe crops wait in the soil until you wake them, so you decide when the fight starts. Just don't leave them too long.
  • Every hit lands. Hoes, sticks, a slingshot, the Pea Revolver and bombs, with comic BONK!s and WHACK!s to match.
  • Beat them, then ship them. What you knock down goes in the Shipping Bin and pays out at dawn.

Better together

  • Invite friends to your farm through Steam. One plants, one waters, everyone fights.
  • Revive a friend who's been flattened by a potato.
  • Summon King Tater, Lord of the Patch, at his altar, and take him down together.

A farm that fights back

  • Keep the weeds, beetles and crows off your field, or the weeds come for you at night.
  • Craft Wake Bells and Pea Turrets to fight for you while you farm.
  • Grow stronger in three skill trees: Green Thumb, Brawler and Tinkerer.
  • Take jobs from the board, buy seeds, and grow your farm one plot at a time.

Explore the Meadow

  • Hunt for Old Crow's lost buttons and the missing pages of the Meadow Almanac.
  • Find the island's secrets, and a few things nobody told you about.

Make your farmer

data.about_the_game:
Your crops have woken up. They want a word.

Till the soil, plant your seeds, water them, and wait for the harvest. Then the harvest climbs out of the ground and headbutts you.

Is This Farming? is a first-person co-op farming game where every crop you grow is a fight you chose. Play alone or with up to three friends.

Farm what you fight

  • Grow your own enemies. Taters charge you head first, Carrot Stabbers dash at you, Pea Pods fire volleys of peas. The more you plant, the bigger the brawl.
  • Wake them when you're ready. Ripe crops wait in the soil until you wake them, so you decide when the fight starts. Just don't leave them too long.
  • Every hit lands. Hoes, sticks, a slingshot, the Pea Revolver and bombs, with comic BONK!s and WHACK!s to match.
  • Beat them, then ship them. What you knock down goes in the Shipping Bin and pays out at dawn.

Better together

  • Invite friends to your farm through Steam. One plants, one waters, everyone fights.
  • Revive a friend who's been flattened by a potato.
  • Summon King Tater, Lord of the Patch, at his altar, and take him down together.

A farm that fights back

  • Keep the weeds, beetles and crows off your field, or the weeds come for you at night.
  • Craft Wake Bells and Pea Turrets to fight for you while you farm.
  • Grow stronger in three skill trees: Green Thumb, Brawler and Tinkerer.
  • Take jobs from the board, buy seeds, and grow your farm one plot at a time.

Explore the Meadow

  • Hunt for Old Crow's lost buttons and the missing pages of the Meadow Almanac.
  • Find the island's secrets, and a few things nobody told you about.

Make your farmer

Pick your hat, hair, face, clothes and gloves, and unlock more looks as you play. Change any of it at the closet in your farmhouse.

In development

The Meadow is just the first part of the island. More zones, crops and bosses are on the way.

data.name: Gökbörü
data.detailed_description:
Draw the Line. Claim the Land. Cleanse the Darkness.

Gökbörü is a 3D territory-capture action roguelite rooted in Turkish and Central Asian (Turkic) mythology. Leave safe ground, sweep a line across the arena and close it to claim the land for yourself. But every open line is a gamble: Erlik's demons are hunting, and one touch can end your run.

The Story

Erlik Han, Lord of the Underworld, has broken through to the surface. His shadow demons, the Körmös, crawl across the earth and corrupt everything they touch.

You fight back as Kızagan, the legendary hero of the prologue, and as Baybörü, commander of the Gökbörü — the Celestial Wolf's army. Bürküt, messenger of the sky god Ülgen, guides your way. Every chapter is framed by cinematic story cutscenes told in the spirit of the Dede Korkut epics, which you can rewatch anytime from the Story Gallery.

How It Plays

  • Draw to claim. Sweep a line through the arena and close it back onto your territory. Everything you enclose is cleansed. Claim enough of the arena (90% in the opening chapter) to win.
  • Risk versus reward. Small captures are safe and steady. Big captures score far more and spike your multiplier, but the longer your line stays open, the more exposed you are.
  • Open lines ignite. When an enemy touches your unfinished line, lethal energy races along the trail toward you. Close the loop in time, Dash to safety, or trigger a well-timed Deflect to survive.
  • Crush the horde. Seal the ground beneath a Körmös minion and it is destroyed. You can also pick minions off from afar with arrows and spears.
  • Beat the countdown. When the level timer runs out, mortar fire rains down from the sky. From that moment on, even safe ground is no longer fully safe.
  • Bosses fight back. The more land you take, the angrier the boss gets. Capture half the arena and the boss unleashes a relentless dash phase.

Divine Boons (Kut) & Arena Power-Ups

Shape your playstyle with Divine Boons (Kut) that alter how you move, survive and control the arena:
  • Dash: Burst across the arena to finish a risky capture or dodge a boss charge at the last second.
  • Deflect: Parries the burning shockwave racing down an ignited line, turning certain death into a clutch save.
  • Blizzard Mastery (+10% Freeze Time): Extends freeze windows so you can carve massive territory captures while enemies are locked in ice.
(3 Boons playable in the current Prologue Demo, expanding to 15 behavior-changing Boons across Common, Rare and Mythic tiers.)



During battle, seal the ground around Power Boxes to grab immediate tactical edges:
  • Speed Boost (Wolf Spirit) — cross the arena at blistering speed
  • Freeze (Breath of Ülgen) — lock every enemy in their tracks
  • Bow & Arrows (Sky Arrows) — snipe minions from a distance
  • Spear (Kızagan's Lance) — a piercing throw that cuts through multiple enemies
  • Clear Minions — wipe out every minion in the arena at once
  • Extra Life and Bonus Points

10 Mythic Bosses

Every realm ends with a boss from Turkic myth, and each one punishes a different bad habit:
  • Peri Kılıcı — punishes greedy, overextended lines across the arena
  • Tepegöz — the one-eyed giant shatters the ground and steals back your territory
  • Alkarısı — the crimson crone punishes impatience: abandon a capture halfway and her Albastı minions spawn
  • Karabasan — the dark night-terror clouds your vision and teleports onto your active line
  • Yel Büke — the storm dragon sweeps wind corridors that push and disrupt your path
  • Abra & Yutpa — twin underworld serpents poison the safe land you have already claimed
  • Kara Şaman — the dark shaman locks sections of the arena behind ritual totems
  • Erlik Kızları — punish slow, passive play by spreading fire across the arena
  • Temir Han & His Eight Sons — shielded by a protection chain; the boss takes no damage until his sons fall
  • Erlik Han — the multi-phase final showdown that combines every lesson you have learned

Score, Combos and Replayability

  • Bigger captures score exponentially more points, with extra bonuses for crushed minions.
  • Chain large captures to build your combo multiplier — get hit or hesitate too long and the chain breaks.
  • End-of-level bonuses reward remaining lives and total percentage of land cleansed.
  • High scores are tracked per level and across full runs, built for fast retries and arcade mastery.

Presentation

Fight across handcrafted top-down 3D arenas — starting with Erlik's Prologue Gate in the free demo and expanding to haunted trade roads, ruined cities and Erlik's throne room — backed by a dark, atmospheric soundtrack. Play with keyboard or full controller support (DualShock / DualSense / Xbox).

data.name: Treasure Stack
data.detailed_description:
Treasure Stack is AVAILABLE NOW



Good news everyone! Treasure Stack is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam and has a nice 10% launch week discount to take advantage of!


About the Game

Fusing the pulse-pounding pressure of a falling block puzzle game with grapple-powered platforming, Treasure Stack offers up a fast-paced party game experience like no other. As treasure chests and keys fall from the sky and threaten to fill the screen, take direct control of a pixelated hero as you run, jump, grab, climb, grapple and stack matching colors to keep the blocky deluge at bay. But don't go in unprepared! Unlock over 100 items to customize your hero and grapple with, featuring everything from slimes with chainsaws, to avian boxing glove grapplers.

Catering to solo and multiplayer puzzle fans, Treasure Stack features a wide variety of modes, whether you're testing your skills in Solo Mode, partying up with friends in 4-Player Local Multiplayer, or taking on the rest of the world in Online Multiplayer. From casual and private lobbies where players can hone their stacking skills with friends, to ranked matchmaking that sees the world's best competing to climb the online ladder and earn exclusive, season-specific rewards, there's a mode for every skill level. Stack how you want with approachable and simple-to-grasp gameplay that hides a high skill ceiling to master!

- The age-old "easy to learn, difficult to master" party game formula!
- Cross-platform ranked multiplayer matchmaking with exclusive seasonal
rewards!
- Frantic 4-player multiplayer
- Over 100 hero and grapple customization items to unlock and equip,
featuring more than a few familiar faces!

data.name: Crowns & Tiles
data.detailed_description:
Crowns & Tiles is a relaxing hex tile placement game where every tile helps shape your growing medieval kingdom.

Start with a single tile and expand your realm across a beautiful hex-based board. Place new tiles next to your kingdom, plan your layout, and watch a peaceful world of grasslands, forests, houses, and royal lands come together piece by piece.

Build Your Kingdom Tile by Tile

Every placement matters. Grow from a small starting point into a wide medieval landscape filled with charm and character.

Simple to Play, Satisfying to Master

Crowns & Tiles is easy to understand: choose where to place your next hex tile and expand your kingdom. Smart placement rewards careful planning and creates a more beautiful realm.

A Calm Medieval World

Enjoy a cozy low-poly art style, peaceful tile placement, and a clean strategy experience made for players who love relaxing building games, hex grids, and kingdom creation.

Features

  • Relaxing hex tile placement gameplay

  • Medieval kingdom-building atmosphere

  • Simple rules with strategic choices

  • Beautiful grass, forest, house, and kingdom tiles

  • Expandable board that grows with every move

  • Cozy low-poly visuals

Shape the land, expand your realm, and build a kingdom worthy of the crown in Crowns & Tiles.

data.name: CyberIdle
data.detailed_description:
CyberIdle is a pixel-art idle RPG where a handful of coins becomes your first upgrade, your first equipment set and your next boss hunt.

Follow the overgrown routes of the Green Zone, where wildlife and mutated creatures roam among abandoned park benches and fences. Your character runs, collects coins and fights automatically. You decide what to buy, which equipment to wear and what to craft next.

Start small and build at your own pace. Buy affordable starter gear, unlock a steady coin income and improve the rewards from your journey. As new encounters introduce materials and blueprints, turn your collected loot into more specialized equipment.

  • Shape your build. Mix and match armor, weapons and accessories across 11 equipment slots. Improve damage, critical hits, movement speed, coin income and more.

  • Hunt for blueprints. Defeat the Thicket brute and Parkwarden for random equipment blueprints. Return for more encounters to complete your collection.

  • Craft and enhance. Spend materials on new equipment or strengthen your favorite pieces. Equip a complete jewelry set to gain its shared bonus.

  • Prepare a boss hunt. Gather ingredients, craft a Parkwarden lure and use it to summon your next encounter.

  • Take an active role. Unlock Active Slaying and tap the attack button to speed up combat, or let your character fight automatically.

  • Follow your progress. Complete zone objectives, earn achievements, claim collection capes and explore your unlocks through a connected upgrade tree.

The current beta features the Green Zone, including its opening progression, crafting, equipment and repeatable encounters.

  • Craft and enhance. Spend materials on new equipment or strengthen your favorite pieces. Equip a complete jewelry set to gain its shared bonus.

  • Prepare a boss hunt. Gather ingredients, craft a Parkwarden lure and use it to summon your next encounter.

  • Take an active role. Unlock Active Slaying and tap the attack button to speed up combat, or let your character fight automatically.

  • Follow your progress. Complete zone objectives, earn achievements, claim collection capes and explore your unlocks through a connected upgrade tree.

The current beta features the Green Zone, including its opening progression, crafting, equipment and repeatable encounters.

data.name: Ninja Express
data.detailed_description:
▲You are a ninja
But in daily life, you will act as a courier,
Responsible for delivering the items entrusted by the customer to the shipper.
This not only protects your identity, but also collects information that is essential for ninjas.

This is a simple task, but there are still some troubles to be solved and some rules to be followed.

● Don't provoke the police. If you run a red light, the police will notice you.
Stay away from the police car, your unique ninja temperament is fascinating.
But if a policeman is fascinated by you, that is a bad thing.

● Take care to avoid dangerous objects, such as burning gas canisters.
Although you are a great ninja, the gas tank also hides dangerous strength.

● Don’t be distracted by electronic billboards, these things will waste your precious time.

Okay, let's go, the customer has something important to entrust to you.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Here are some rules you need to know:
You can switch lanes of different heights by simply jumping, or avoid dangerous objects in the game, such as traffic lights.
If you hit the traffic light more than 10 times, the mission will fail
If you hit a gas tank, you will be sent to the hospital for rescue, causing the mission to fail
If you hit a police car, you will be arrested by the police, causing the mission to fail
If you hit an electronic billboard, you will be fined, resulting in extended mission time

data.name: Talescape: Write. Branch. Play.
data.detailed_description:
Talescape is a platform for playing and creating interactive stories. From visual novels and branching narratives to point-and-click adventures and experimental story games, Talescape supports a wide range of interactive experiences. Players explore stories shaped by choice and emotional tone, while creators build scenes, dialogue, logic and releases with visual tools. No coding required.

  • Play visual stories where choices reveal new paths and outcomes

  • Find stories by emotional tone, theme and creator

  • Create your own visual novels, point-and-click stories and narrative games

  • Preview, debug and validate branches before release

Find the Story You Want to Feel

Talescape is built around stories with intent. Every story is crafted with player choice at the center of the experience.

Players can browse by genre, theme and emotional tone. Talescape calls these emotional categories Dream Types:

  • Daydream — warm, hopeful and light

  • Nightmare — tense, unsettling and dark

  • Vision — surreal, strange and experimental

  • Echo — quiet, reflective and memory-driven

In Talescape, players are called Dreamers, and playable stories are called Tales.

Dreamers can:

  • Discover Tales by Dream Type, theme and creator

  • Make choices that reveal new scenes and outcomes

  • Explore with visual novel pacing and point-and-click interaction

  • Follow Bards and return to favorite voices and worlds

  • Review, collect and revisit Tales as the library grows

Create Stories Without Building an Engine

Creators get a visual workflow for turning ideas into playable stories: build scenes, write dialogue, add logic, test the result and prepare releases from one place. In Talescape, creators are called Bards.

Bards can:

  • Build scenes with backgrounds, characters, objects, exits and detail views

  • Write branching dialogue with choices and multiple presentation styles

  • Add logic with variables, conditions, items, timers and achievements

  • Preview scenes, chapters, dialogue or the full story

  • Use debug tools and checks to catch missing media, broken paths and release blockers

  • Prepare releases through guided checks, review and marketplace publishing

Build, Test, Publish

Talescape supports stories that mix visual novel pacing, point-and-click exploration, puzzle logic and emotional discovery.

Testing is part of the workflow. Preview what players will see, inspect story state while debugging and run checks before review, so creators can fix problems before Dreamers reach them.

Creator Beta

Talescape is currently in Creator Beta. Early creators are using the completed platform to build and publish the first Tales, populate the story library, and prepare the marketplace for its wider public launch.

The Road to Release

Talescape is opening in stages so that its first stories, creators and player community can grow together.

  • Closed Beta (Completed) The editor, player and core platform workflows were tested and refined with early users.

  • Creator Beta (Current Phase) Early Bards are creating and publishing the first Tales, building the initial library and preparing the marketplace.

  • Public Beta (Steam Release) Talescape opens to players on Steam, with the first published Tales available to discover and play.

  • Full Release The platform, publishing workflow and marketplace move beyond beta as the library and community continue to mature.

  • Ongoing Development Talescape will continue to expand with new creator tools, player features and platform improvements after release.

Join the Creator Community

Join the official Talescape Discord to meet other Bards, share your work, follow Creator Beta updates and learn how to help build the first generation of Tales.

Publish and Grow

When a story is ready, Talescape guides it through release preparation, pricing choices, automated checks and review. As the platform opens beyond Creator Beta, published stories can appear in the Talescape library or marketplace with creator profiles, story details, emotional tones and reviews.

You stay the author of your work while Talescape handles the path from draft to playable release.

Write the world. Branch the path. Play the story.

story

What await you in your destination is the truth.
The unbearable truth about yourself that will never change.

data.name: MADFALL
data.detailed_description:
“Don’t fall.” — The last words from the friend who pushed you.

Madfall is a physics-based, first-person multiplayer chaos game. Punch your friends, blast them off floating arenas, jetpack across lava, acid, and oceans, and crown yourself king — at least until someone knocks you off in the next round.

Start bare-handed. Weapons crash from the sky. Grab one. Fire it. Watch your friends go flying. You’ll laugh, you’ll scream — usually both.

🚀 What’s Inside?

⚔️ Physics-Based FPS Combat → Bullets and punches don’t just hurt — they launch you.
🌍 No Health Bars. Only Gravity. → Get shoved? Fall off? You’re out.
🚀 Jetpack Freedom → Soar through the chaos, then regret your choices.
🎲 Varied Handcrafted Arenas → Lava, acid, oceans, collapsing platforms — every round feels unique.
🎁 Mid-Fight Weapon Drops → Baseball bats, revolvers, and ridiculous tools drop right into the mayhem.
💬 Voice & Text Chat → Team up, trash talk, or both… just before you fall.
👑 The Crown Awaits → Win a round, wear the crown. Keep it… if you can.

This isn’t a tactical shooter.
This isn’t a co-op adventure.

🔥 This is Madfall — pure, unfiltered, multiplayer physics chaos.

🛒 Wishlist now and join the fall !!

data.name: Ace Academy
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Ace Academy. Place your bet.

Tsukasa Kurenai has just transferred to Ace Academy, a private college where standing is decided at the gambling table. The student council, the House, holds every student's debts in the Ledger. Win, and you rise. Lose too much, and you risk expulsion.

Win or lose. Tsukasa plans to enjoy every second of it.

Read The Table

Every opponent has a face that tells, habits they cannot help and a cheat they think you will never notice. Watch for the twitch, the pause, the change of voice. Keep notes in your Notebook. Raise when they are bluffing, fold when they are not, and push them all in when the moment is right.

Catch Them Cheating

When something feels wrong, call it. Name the cheat correctly and they pay double. Get it wrong and you pay instead. Or set a trap, let them cheat into it, and watch their own trick turn against them.

Cheat Back

Peek, palm, a loaded die, a mirror at just the right angle. Your own tricks can win a hand outright, but every opponent is watching too, and getting caught has a price.

Ride the Thrill

Big stakes build Thrill. Fill it and you tip into Frenzy: your reads become exact and no cheat can hide from you, for as long as it lasts.

Fourteen Ways to Gamble, Twenty Rivals

Blind Card, Twenty-One Duel, Liar's Dice, Sealed Bid, Knife and Ribbon and more: fourteen games of nerve, each with a Highfold twist. Each rival plays their own signature game, from the Library Committee Chair's dice to the Head of the House's gauntlet of every game you have survived so far.

Your Choices, Your Ending

Seven chapters, two routes that split when the House makes you an offer, and six endings, plus the one where the Ledger takes your name. What you take from each defeated rival, what you forgive and who you stake it all for decides how the story ends.

Features

  • A full story campaign across seven chapters and two routes, with twenty opponents, each with their own game, tells, habits and cheat

  • Fourteen gambling games, from card duels and dice to sealed bids and counting games

  • Read tells, call out cheats by name, set traps and use tricks of your own

  • Thrill and Frenzy: push your luck for perfect reads

  • The Ledger: borrow to stay at the table, pay it back or sink into debt

  • Two story routes and six endings, shaped by the choices you make between tables

  • Rematches and practice tables for every rival you have beaten

  • Keyboard and mouse play, reduced motion, a four-colour deck and adjustable text size

data.detailed_description: Icosagon is a unique deck builder tower defense game. Survive against many waves of enemies which create a randomly generated path each wave. Place a variety of different shapes in order to stop the enemies. There are many different shapes to choose from, all having their own unique strengths and abilities. Some shapes generate lines, some are used for attacking enemies, some are used for defending against enemies, and some just give you a quick boost. You can strategically build a deck of cards that will be used in each game, combining shapes that work well together. In order to progress through the game, you have to complete campaigns, which are a series of levels each with different difficulty, gamemode, and restrictions. You can earn more cards by opening packs that you get from either beating a level or buying them from the shop.

In the global farm town, the villagers lived in harmony with the animals.
With the arrival of a group of exotic mysterious circuses, breaking the original harmony and peace in the farm village, the quiet animals suddenly became violent, crazy and unable to control. They offered a reward to summon various bounty hunters to catch the animals while secretly investigating who controlled and changed the animals and what their purpose are.

data.name: Road to Millionaire – Investing
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Road to Millionaire – Investing is an investment simulation game. You start with $10,000 and have 480 in-game days to grow your total wealth to $1,000,000 through investing. Reach the target before the end of the game to win.

You can invest in several fictional companies with different characteristics. Decide when to buy, hold, or sell stocks, and determine how to allocate your limited cash. The game supports fractional shares, allowing you to continue investing even when you do not have enough cash to purchase a full share.

Adapt to Different Market Conditions

The market moves through bull, sideways, and bear market phases. Each phase influences the overall direction of stock prices, while individual prices fluctuate from day to day.

You must decide when to invest more, when to keep cash available, and whether to hold your positions or adjust your portfolio during market declines.

Dividends and Reinvestment

Different companies have different dividend yields, and some companies pay dividends periodically.

When you receive dividends, you can keep them as cash or enable dividend reinvestment, automatically using the income to purchase additional fractional shares. Over time, collecting and reinvesting dividends can help you build a larger portfolio.

Manage Your Portfolio

The game tracks your number of shares, average purchase price, portfolio cost, market value, unrealized profit or loss, and investment return, helping you understand how each investment is performing.

You can also review company details and fundamental information and use this information as part of your investment decisions.

Company Fundamentals Change Over Time

As game time progresses, company fundamentals receive quarterly updates. Some operating and valuation indicators may change, requiring you to reassess your investments rather than relying only on past performance.

From $10,000 to $1,000,000

Your total wealth consists of cash plus the market value of your investments.

You can build wealth through rising stock prices, dividends, dividend reinvestment, and investment decisions made under different market conditions.

Your ultimate goal is to grow your total wealth from $10,000 to $1,000,000 within 480 in-game days.

data.detailed_description:
City Life is an open-world life simulation and vehicle-building sandbox set in a modern British town. Start with nothing, take jobs, earn money, buy garages and homes, build and modify vehicles, and work your way into the proper city lifestyle.

🛠 Core Gameplay

  • Begin living in a small trailer community

  • Take paid jobs: parcel delivery, bin collection, post service, taxi runs, bus routes, hydrant maintenance and more

  • Earn wages and daily allowances from the Job Centre

  • Buy vehicles, maintain them, and customise parts

  • Upgrade from a small shed to full auto garage ownership

🚗 Vehicles & Building

  • Find, buy, repair, and assemble vehicles part-by-part

  • Tyres, engines, batteries, panels, interiors and tuning upgrades

  • Authentic car physics and handling

  • Tow, scrap, sell, and rebuild

🏙 Open-World Living

  • Explore shops, petrol stations, garages, housing districts

  • Purchase apartments, garages, work bays

  • Pay rent, maintain property, and keep them before eviction timers expire

👥 Multiplayer

  • Dedicated multiplayer server support

  • Every player has individual missions, wages, garages, and home waypoints

🌧 Simulation Systems

  • Economy with shops, repairs, property rental and resale

data.name: LIMEN Company
data.detailed_description:
LIMEN COMPANY — a co-op horror game for 1–4 players

You are a LIMEN agent. Your job is to walk through doors that lead where they shouldn't, complete the expedition's tasks and make it back alive. Not every team before you did.

Pick a door

Every run starts in the lobby: you're offered two doors and the team votes on where to go. The gate rolls down, the siren wails — there's no way back until the job is done.

Three sites — three different rules of survival

         The Flooded Library. The Listener is nearly blind and hunts by sound. Every step through the water, every splash and every word on your mic draws it in. Move quietly — or lure it away with noise.

         The Abandoned Office. The Inspector walks the floors and checks who is working. Carry papers and look busy, answer his phone when it rings, hide in the cubicles. Three reprimands and an agent is out.

         The Mycelium. A vast cave where something sleeps in its nest. Restore the power, finish the last expedition's research and don't wake the Sleeper. Once awake, it feels everyone who steps on the pale mycelium.

Your voice is a sound too

Proximity voice chat: you hear your teammates from where they stand — and so do the entities. A whisper in the dark can save you; a scream gives the whole team away.

Survival and gear

         Watch your energy, stamina and flashlight charge.

         Four inventory slots: a flask of tea, a food carrier, torch batteries and glass bottles.

         A thrown bottle smashes with a loud crash and pulls the entity away. The shards crunch underfoot — under everyone's feet.

        A tape recorder, an anomaly detector, the expedition map and other tools for your tasks.

Every run is new

Levels are built procedurally: rooms, passages and items change from one expedition to the next. You can't memorize the route — you'll have to explore again.

If you get caught

Fallen agents keep watching through the eyes of the living and can still hear the team. The expedition goes on as long as one agent is left standing.

Features

         Co-op for 1–4 players, solo play supported

         Proximity voice chat that the entities can hear

         Three sites with unique entities and mechanics

         Procedurally generated levels

         Expedition tasks, puzzles and exploration

         Field-recording atmosphere: the LIMEN FIELD CAM interface

data.name: Fish Battle Champion
data.detailed_description:
Catch Fish. Build Your Team. Become the Champion!

Fish Battle Champion is a strategic fishing roguelite autobattler where every catch shapes your build.

Catch strange fish, discover rare bonuses, combine powerful abilities and collect unexpected items. Build your team during the day, prepare for battle in the evening and put your strategy to the test in the nightly tournament.

Every run brings new choices, unusual combinations and opportunities to create something ridiculously powerful.

Every Catch Is a Choice

Go fishing and discover all kinds of bizarre creatures and mysterious items.

Keep the fish that fit your strategy, search for better catches and discover rare bonuses that can turn even an ordinary fish into a valuable member of your team.

Will you build around a few powerful fighters or combine different abilities into something unexpected?

Create Powerful Synergies

The right combination can turn a strange collection of fish into a winning team.

Build around poison, fire, healing, protection, reflected damage and other unusual abilities.

Combine fish, items and bonus effects to strengthen your strategy. Experiment with different combinations and discover which abilities work best together.

The strongest fish isn't always the most useful one.

Trade, Upgrade and Adapt

Between fishing and fighting, visit the village to trade with the locals and prepare for the next tournament battle.

Buy new fish, discover useful items and strengthen your team with permanent bonuses.

Every coin matters. Spend wisely, take a chance on something unusual or save your resources for whatever comes next.

Build Your Team. Let Them Fight!

When night falls, it's time for the Fish Battle Tournament.

Place your fish on the battlefield and watch them fight automatically against increasingly challenging opponents.

- Character Progression: Level up your character, unlock powerful new abilities, and become the ultimate feline champion!

- Gear Hunting: Collect loot to enhance your stats and abilities.

data.name: CRYENGINE - Sample Assets
data.detailed_description:
The CRYENGINE Sample Assets is a Free DLC package containing several example source files in either Max or Maya format which can be used for learning how to get the most out of your assets and utilize the built-in tech and tools in CRYENGINE.

CRYENGINE subscribers can use these Sample Assets for their own game projects, though we encourage you to create your own assets to give your game a unique look all of its own!

DCC denotes the Digital Content Creation tool for which there are source files included.

Included Assets (June 2014)

Objects

Characters:
  • Objects\characters\animals\amphibians oad: Example Boid asset setup. DCC: Maya
  • Objects\characters\human\generic: SDK Skeleton rig setup. DCC: Max
  • Objects\characters\human\sdk_player: SDK Character model setup. DCC: Max

Natural Objects:
  • Objects atural ushes\hangingvegetation: Merged mesh vegetation (brush). DCC: Max/Maya
  • Objects atural\ground ield_grass: Merged mesh vegetation. DCC: Maya
  • Objects atural\ground orestgrass: Merged mesh vegetation. DCC: Max/Maya
  • Objects atural rees\aspen: Breakable trees. DCC: Max
  • Objects atural rees\pine: Trees of varied styles. DCC: Maya

  • Objects\props\misc\wind_turbine: Animated static object. DCC: Max

  • Objects\vehicles\hmmwv: HMMWV 4-wheel vehicle. DCC: Max/Maya

data.name: ニコニコさん | Niconico-san
data.detailed_description:
"Niconico-san" is a first-person, fast-paced horror game set in a Japanese residential area. Your goal is to escape from the terrifying otherworld, evading the smiling man of urban legend, "Niconico-san."

Story

A creepy rumor has been spreading around school recently.
“There’s a smiling man who beckons you over at a warehouse down a certain alley.”
Those who see him are drawn to the warehouse and go missing.

One day, you find yourself needing to take that very alley on your way home.
As you approach the warehouse, the door suddenly swings open, and a hand reaches out. The moment it pulls you in, you lose consciousness. When you wake up, you find yourself in a terrifying otherworld…

Trapped in this otherworld, you must find the items necessary to escape and return to the real world.
Can you find a way out of this horrifying place?

Gameplay

This game is an "action-adventure."
Players explore a hidden otherworld within a Japanese residential area from a first-person perspective, searching for essential items to escape while evading the smiling man, "Niconico-san," from the urban legend.

Number of Endings: 2

Estimated Playtime: About 30 minutes, depending on your play style.

Controls

Move: WASD
Look: Mouse
Action: E
Options: ESC
Use Drink: SPACE

About Streaming and Let's Play Videos

They are very welcome! No prior contact is needed.
We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the store page in the description.

data.name: Couch PVP
data.detailed_description:
2 to 8 players, one screen

COUCH PVP is a local split-screen arena shooter. Pick a mode, grab a controller each (keyboard welcome), and the match begins. Games are short, timed, and always end the same way: a podium, a stats board, and a rematch one button away.

Easy to pick up — even for people who never play

  • Every mode is explained in one sentence, shown before kickoff.
  • Per-player aim assist: magnetic aiming and more forgiving shots. Beginners turn it on, veterans leave it off — and the match stays close.
  • The controls fit on a single screen shown at launch: move, jump, shoot.
  • Someone running late? A free controller is all it takes to join mid-game.

11 modes, from simple to devious

  • Team vs Team, King of the Hill, Football: rules that fit in one sentence.
  • Sticky Bomb: an explosive hot potato passed on contact.
  • Juggernaut: one overpowered boss against everyone — take them down, take their place.
  • Paintball: painted territory is the score.
  • Zone Capture, Heist!, TYCOON WAR: control, plunder and sabotage for the strategists.
  • Infection: every victim joins the pack.
  • Zombie Co-op: the cooperative mode — everyone together against the zombie waves.
Tournament chains rounds together with mode and map votes, wagers and point multipliers.

10 maps with signature events

A train barrels through the station, the tide redraws the island, a rocket lifts off mid-match, a bull charges across the farm. Every map has its signature event, ready to shuffle the deck at the worst possible moment — taking the lead is not enough, you have to last.

The end of the match is part of the game

A 3D podium, a stats wall, and a badge for everyone — from ON FIRE to PUNCHING BAG. The match history keeps your last 20 podiums, viewable from the menu: the scores stay, the arguments do not.

For every living room

  • 30 languages.
  • Accessibility options: colorblind modes, reduced flashes and screen shake, adjustable rumble and interface, remappable keys, per-player sensitivity.
  • Designed with the Steam Deck in mind.
  • Remote Play Together: one copy of the game is enough to play online with friends.

Ready when you are

Add COUCH PVP to your wishlist — and when game night comes, count controllers, not explanations.

data.name: Beyond Silence
data.detailed_description: Beyond Silence is an atmospheric first-person horror game with elements of puzzles and survival. The player must explore an abandoned house tied to the dark past of the main character, collect items, find notes, solve mysteries, and hide from an unknown threat. You play as James, a former surgeon who once took part in secret experiments in an attempt to save his terminally ill daughter. After a tragic failure, he disappeared — but now, a mysterious letter brings him back to the very place where it all went wrong. The house has long been abandoned, but something still lingers within its walls — whispers, shadows, and what he once created. Use your flashlight and batteries, hide in closets, manage a limited inventory, and uncover the truth step by step. Jump scares, a tense atmosphere, and a story that will fully unfold in the second part await you.
data.about_the_game: Beyond Silence is an atmospheric first-person horror game with elements of puzzles and survival. The player must explore an abandoned house tied to the dark past of the main character, collect items, find notes, solve mysteries, and hide from an unknown threat. You play as James, a former surgeon who once took part in secret experiments in an attempt to save his terminally ill daughter. After a tragic failure, he disappeared — but now, a mysterious letter brings him back to the very place where it all went wrong. The house has long been abandoned, but something still lingers within its walls — whispers, shadows, and what he once created. Use your flashlight and batteries, hide in closets, manage a limited inventory, and uncover the truth step by step. Jump scares, a tense atmosphere, and a story that will fully unfold in the second part await you.
data.short_description: Beyond Silence is a first-person psychological horror where you play as James, a former surgeon who returns to the house of his past. The dark rooms, creaking floors, and forgotten notes hide the horrors he himself had a hand in. But the past won't let him go and it speaks to him through the silence

data.name: Total War: ATTILA
data.detailed_description:
Against a darkening background of famine, disease and war, a new power is rising in the great steppes of the East. With a million horsemen at his back, the ultimate warrior king approaches, and his sights are set on Rome…

The next instalment in the multi award-winning PC series that combines turn-based strategy with real-time tactics, Total War: ATTILA casts players back to 395 AD. A time of apocalyptic turmoil at the very dawn of the Dark Ages.

How far will you go to survive? Will you sweep oppression from the world and carve out a barbarian or Eastern kingdom of your own? Or will you brace against the coming storm as the last remnants of the Roman Empire, in the ultimate survival-strategy challenge?

The Scourge of God is coming. Your world will burn.

Apocalyptic destruction mechanics
Wield the ferocious power of fire in battle to set buildings ablaze and terrify defenders, or wipe entire cities and regions from the face of the campaign map with the new raze mechanic.

Legendary start position
Playing as the Western Roman Empire you will begin with vast territories under your control, but weakened by political in-fighting and threatened on all sides by enemies, your dominance will quickly become a struggle to survive.

Overhauled game mechanics
Improved core gameplay and UI through the latest optimised and modified Total War game mechanics, including politics, family tree, civic management and technological progression.

Incredible period detail
With new period-specific technologies, arms and armaments, religion, cultures and social upheaval, Total War: ATTILA delivers an authentic experience of this ominous chapter of our history.

Outstanding visual fidelity
Improvements and optimisations to both campaign and battle visuals create a chilling vision of a looming apocalypse and the ruin of the civilized world. With breath-taking scale, atmosphere and improved graphical performance, witness the end of days and the rise of a legend.

data.name: Rustwalker Legends
data.detailed_description:
Deep Space, 4099AR

Fill the shoes of the last known Rustwalker, an age old robotic bounty hunter. After an unknown enemy performs the largest prison break in history releasing bounties all across the galaxy, it's your job to travel to each planet to find, stop and capture them all. Explore regions of different planets to acquire resources vital to restore your home, Guild Ship Beta. Working as a hub and your home, this station will be a base of operations from which you'll take jobs, upgrade your gear and use fuel earned from jobs to unlock new areas of the hub. Once planet-side, it'll be up to you to how you take down your foes. Will you sneak in and get your bounty stealthily, or will you go in a flurry of hot steel and gunpowder to take down your target? Bounty hunting is a dangerous job, but so are you.

Deadly Combat


Use a mixture of melee weapons, ranged firearms and your metal fists to bring down some the ugliest bounties in the galaxy, dead or alive.

Explore the Galaxy


Brave hazardous locations looking for bounties, resources and loot. Be careful though, as most wildlife planet side is gonna want to eat your face. Take missions or just explore different regions across the galaxy at will using the solar map.

Forge Your Gear


Upgrade yourself with a variety of weapons, armor and items to help take down your foes.

Bounties are King


Your main source of income is from bounties, so make sure to at least consider bringing them alive for extra cash.

data.name: Ravel: Golden Thread
data.detailed_description:
In the halls of the North, every knot hides one living Golden Thread. Study the weave, find the strand that lies on top, and pull it free. Move by move, the tangle opens until the gold runs free.




Ravel has one rule you can feel. Strands cross over and under one another, and only a strand with nothing across it can leave the loom. Pull a held strand and it snags, and you can see exactly why. Read, pull, and watch the weave change.




Follow the Golden Thread through a Norse saga in eight chapters. Each one changes the scenery, the materials and the way the weave behaves.
  • Fjord Shores: dawn on a Nordic fjord, where you learn to read the crossings.
  • Ironwake Forge: a cliffside smithy over molten currents, where rope gives way to steel cable and iron chain.
  • Runestone Vale: basalt and red fissures, where Rune Bonds lock the loom until you free them in order.
  • Frostmere: a frozen lake under pale aurora, where one weave runs across two faces of the loom.
  • Stormwake Harbor: a tidal village whose living anchors shift the loom as you play.
  • Worldroot Grove: an ancient forest where new strands and anchors grow into the weave.
  • Twinfall Pass: twin waterfalls and a suspended bridge, with paired strands that answer each other.
  • The Deep Loom: a star-lit well where everything you have learned comes together.




The rule never changes; the looms do.
  • Twisted pairs bind strands together.
  • Clockstep looms turn after every pull.
  • Lanterns light the weave at nightfall.
  • Mirror Weaves hide a second face.
  • Living anchors move, and tangles grow.
Every board is handcrafted and solvable.




Every chapter closes with the Mastery Knot: three trials in one run, 8, 16, then 24 strands, each set over a living stage. You'll face a signal fire, a molten crucible, a tidal maelstrom and a well of aurora. Clear all three without a snag to awaken the chapter's Master Rune, or return for a stricter Legend run.




3 Daily Knots every day · 1,000+ a year.
  • Easy, Medium and Hard: three ranked tries at each.
  • Flawless only: no snags and no hints, or the solve won't climb the anonymous standings.
  • Streaks: keep your Daily Thread streak alive.
The Daily Knot plays online; the campaign plays fully offline.




  • Three stars on every level, each for something different: free the Golden Thread, solve without a snag, and meet the level's own mastery goal. Replays add the stars you missed and never take one away.
  • 44 Golden Runes mark real discoveries and feats. They are collectibles, never currency.
  • Your Tapestry: every knot you free is woven into it as a string-art medallion drawn from its own board.



  • A complete premium game: no ads, no in-game purchases, no energy meters or waiting.
  • Help when you want it: free hints, and an Unwind when a knot gets the better of you.
  • Comfort settings: Reduced Motion support, a High contrast mode, and separate music and effects volume.
  • Built for the mouse: click a free strand or pull it out of the weave.
  • 23 languages: the whole game, from English and Finnish to Japanese and Korean.



Wishlist Ravel: Golden Thread, and be there when the first strand comes free.

data.name: Batoo
data.detailed_description:
Based on a dismissed police report, BATOO is a story-driven psychological horror FPS set in the remote forests of Parbat, Nepal during 1958 BS—an era before electricity reached these isolated villages.

Key Features

Atmospheric First-Person Horror
Story Driven Gameplay
Psychological Horror Mechanics
Immersive Exploration
Survival Elements

What Makes It Unique

  • Authentic Cultural Setting: Experience rural Nepal in 1958 BS, capturing the isolation and superstitions of the era.

  • Ambiguous Reality: Question whether the character's account is reliable testimony or the ravings of a traumatized mind.

  • Framed Narrative: The story unfolds through police documents being read in present day, adding layers of mystery.

Atmospheric Tension: Focus on dread and psychological horror over cheap jump scares.

Content Warning

This game contains themes of psychological distress, isolation, and disturbing imagery that may not be suitable for all players.
