data.name: A Game About Achieving Stuff
data.detailed_description:
Let’s be honest. You don’t play games to "have fun" or "experience a gripping narrative." You play games to check boxes, fill progress bars, and get a tiny hit of dopamine every time a notification tells you you're a good boy.

A GAME ABOUT ACHIEVING STUFF respects your time by stripping away complex combat and replacing it with the most realistic simulation of modern employment ever created: walking in circles and doing what you're told for digital validation.

Your Daily Responsibilities:

  • Locomotive Asset Relocation: Holding the 'W' key to walk down endless, asset-flipped corridors.

  • Fiscal Synergizing: Looting every single money pouch you find so you can buy items you absolutely do not need.

  • Workplace Hazard Testing: Jumping into bottomless wells just to see if the developers put an invisible wall there. (We didn't).

  • Middle Management Appeasement: Bribing the ancient, exhausted Janitor with a 999,999 Gold Femur so he can finally retire.

Employee Benefits (Key Features):

  • 200 Meaningless KPIs (Achievements): Get rewarded for everything from opening your inventory too many times, to standing perfectly still for 5 minutes, to actively trying to break the game engine

  • A "Robust" Economy: Why fight a boss when you can just buy his missing body parts and perform a hostile takeover of his job?

  • State-of-the-Art Auto-Run: A revolutionary feature for when you want to play the game while watching your favorite show.

Are you ready to climb the corporate ladder? Stop reading this and get back to work. Those 200 achievements aren't going to unlock themselves.

data.name: Space Kettle
data.detailed_description:
Wishlist the new game!


About the Game

“The flying kettle powered by tea fuel is the future of humanity.”

Space Kettle is a challenging game where your main and only task is to reach the top of a surreal mountain using the power of the recently developed “Tea engine”. Select the direction of flight, hold the left mouse button, and start conquering new heights. Remember: despite the fact that the tea fuel is constantly replenished, its amount is limited, so use your opportunities wisely. Otherwise, you will feel the bitterness of falling down and constant loss of progress, as well as utter hopelessness. The game is made in the “Over It” genre, which became popular after the release of “Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy” back in 2017.



  • Challenge yourself to reach the top of the unyielding mountain.
  • Journey through the unique map with different locations.
  • Prepare your mental health for constant falls.
  • Fall over and over again, losing all your hope.
  • Accept your fate or keep struggling.
  • And finally, feel like a real Flying Kettle.

data.name: Lost Legions
data.detailed_description:
"The Eagles Are Lost"

Three Roman Legions have been destroyed

In the aftermath of the Battle of Teutoburg Forest, you are among the few who remain, stranded in a hostile wilderness that feels familiar, yet deeply wrong. Hunted by enemy tribes and stripped of your gear, survival alone will not be enough.

Gather what you can, raise fortified camps, and rally scattered legionaries to your side. From crude tools and bare skin to iron and mail, rely on your Roman training to endure, adapt, and uncover the truth behind your destiny.

The lost eagle standards must be found. More than honor demands it.

Play alone or with up to 3 friends as you survive and push deeper into enemy territory.

A Tale of Fate and Deception

Experience a unique blend of narrative-driven adventure and open-world survival crafting. Climb the ranks and journey through six distinct biomes, each advancing the story as you uncover a world that feels like an ancient Roman fairy tale, dark, mysterious, and full of hidden truths.

Meet over 20 enigmatic characters, including Legate Publius Quinctilius Varus. Form alliances, question loyalties, and navigate a story shaped by twists, revelations, and shifting motives. In this world, few are what they seem.


Rally Your Fellow Legionaries

You won’t survive alone for long.

As you explore the wilderness, you’ll encounter scattered survivors of the fallen legions. Free them, earn their trust, and uncover their stories through dedicated questlines.

Some will fight alongside you in battle or offer valuable knowledge, while others find refuge in your camp. Each brings their own perspective on the world, and the fate that awaits you.

Fight to Survive

The land is unforgiving and never under Roman control.

Hunt, gather, craft, and endure. Face hostile tribes, the Cherusci, Marsi, and Chatti, each with distinct gear and combat styles.

Defeat them to claim their equipment, complete your collection, and unlock improved versions through your progression.

Adapt or fall

Explore a World Shaped by War and Mystery

Venture through six distinct biomes, from quiet meadows and dense forests to treacherous swamps, towering mountains, and war-torn fields. The land bears the scars of a lost campaign, yet not everything belongs where it should.

Discover abandoned camps, hidden landmarks, and places that defy explanation. Track wildlife, gather rare resources, and solve environmental riddles to uncover powerful artifacts and secret paths.

Every journey beyond your camp is a risk, but those who explore will find the knowledge and strength needed to face what lies ahead.

Fortify and Defend Your Camps

Build strongholds across the land.

Construct Roman fortifications, set up specialized workstations, and craft increasingly advanced gear. When warbands signal their approach, prepare your defenses.

They will come for your camp - stand your ground!

Alone or in Brotherhood

Play solo or with up to 3 others in co-op multiplayer.

Choose from distinct characters including members of the civilian convoy who marched with the legions and face the unknown together.

Join a shared, host-led campaign where progression and decisions shape the journey for the entire group.

KEY FEATURES

  • Rally Lost Legionaries: Free survivors, complete their quests, and bring them back to your camp. Some will fight beside you, others share vital knowledge.

  • Build and Defend Roman Camps: Construct fortifications, place workstations, and craft better gear. Prepare for incoming raids and defend what you’ve built.

  • Fight Distinct Enemy Tribes: Face the Cherusci, Marsi, and Chatti. Learn their tactics, claim their gear, and unlock stronger equipment through progression.

  • Explore a World Full of Secrets: Six biomes, hidden landmarks, rare resources, environmental riddles and more reward those who explore beyond the obvious.

  • Story-Driven Survival: A narrative unfolds through exploration, characters, and discoveries full of twists, shifting loyalties, and hidden truths.

  • Solo or Co-op Survival: Play alone or with up to 3 players in a shared campaign. Choose your character and face the world together.

data.name: KyouKi
data.detailed_description:
[Story]

I attended my younger sister Mio's birthday party. I found she was possessed by a demon. Should I run away, or risk my life to save her...

[Gameplay]

Throughout the game, players will encounter a steady stream of puzzles. Meanwhile, they need to collect scattered clues, advance the storyline, and uncover the truth behind the eerie incidents involving Mio.

[Game Features]

This game takes thriller anime and two-dimensional style as its theme, incorporates real-life events, and faithfully restores highly stylized visuals. It allows players to experience different cultures and customs, delivering a unique horrifying sensory experience.

Adventure

Freely explore multiple scenarios, collect fragments of information scattered everywhere, find your way forward, and strive to restore the truth of the incident.

Puzzle Solving

The game features exquisitely designed puzzles blended with a wealth of traditional folk custom elements. Discover connections through various clues, advance step by step, and unravel the mysteries.

Enemies

Facing eerie enemies, you will realize your own insignificance. Evade their pursuit while trying every means to survive; it will be a battle of wits and courage.

data.name: Guild Adventures
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Guild Adventures!

Recruit adventurers, send them into monster-infested lands, and watch them battle their way through waves of enemies. There's no need to micromanage every swing or spell.
Your job is to build the party, equip your heroes, use your gold to increase their skills, and make sure there's always another hunt waiting.

⚔️ Send Your Heroes on the Hunt

Your heroes march across the battlefield, fighting monsters and collecting coin, experience, and equipment along the way. Choose your stage, assemble your party, and let them do what they do best.

Every new stage brings new enemies, tougher challenges, and greater rewards.

🛡️ Build Your Roster

Start with Warriors, Archers, and Wizards, then develop your heroes into powerful advanced classes:

 Warrior →  Berserker

A front-line fighter who charges into the fray. Berserkers unleash devastating whirlwinds after a series of attacks, while stealing life from their enemies with every strike.

 Archer →  Marksman

A ranged specialist who focuses on the biggest threats. Marksmen prioritize enemies with the most health remaining, delivering devastating damage where it matters most.

 Wizard →  Necromancer

A master of the undead.. Necromancers summon zombies and skeletons to fight your enemies, commanding an army of minions with their own distinct strengths.

🔨 Forge, Merge, and Grow

The spoils of battle are just the beginning. Collect equipment, combine matching pieces in the Forge, and create gear of higher quality.  Each rarity increase on equipment will bring a new stat.  Rare heroes can be ascended to their advance classes with much better abilities.

Merge three heroes or equipment pieces of the same class and quality to create a stronger version:

🏰 Manage Your Guild

A successful guild needs more than strong heroes. Every hunt costs stamina, and exhausted adventurers need time to recover.

Build and upgrade your guild hall, expand its resting beds, and keep your roster ready for the next expedition. Invest your hard-earned coin in Guild Doctrines to improve the entire roster and expand the number of heroes fighting together.

And when your heroes need a change of pace, put your guild farm to work earning extra coin and experience.

🗺️ Explore New Lands

Six regions stand between your guild and the deepest reaches of the unknown. Each contains ten stages filled with monsters, new challenges, and increasingly valuable rewards.

Fight through Greenwood and beyond, conquer each chapter's final boss, and see how far your guild can go.

Features

  • Idle Side-Scrolling Combat: Heroes move, attack, and use their class abilities automatically. Build your party and watch the battle unfold.

  • A Growing Hero Roster: Recruit and develop named heroes, each with six stats, individual levels, and six equipment slots.

  • Three Base Classes: Warriors, Archers, and Wizards each bring a different approach to combat.

  • Advanced Classes: Ascend Rare heroes into specialized classes with unique abilities and fighting styles.

  • Stamina and Resting: Hunts consume stamina. Manage your roster and guild hall beds to keep adventurers in rotation.

  • Guild Doctrines: Invest in permanent upgrades that strengthen your entire roster and increase your party size to ten heroes.

  • Hero Merging: Combine three matching heroes to improve their quality, progressing from Common to Rare.

  • The Forge: Combine three matching pieces of equipment to create a higher-quality item.

  • Guild Farm: Earn additional coin and massive experience for your entire roster.

  • Six Regions to Explore: Fight through ten stages in each region, with a powerful boss waiting at the end of every chapter.

  • Soulbound Heroes: Advanced heroes are soulbound, but a Golden Finger obtained through events can make them tradable with other players.

The Adventure Never Stops

  • Deploy: Send fully rested heroes into battle.

  • Hunt: Watch your heroes battle through waves of monsters and collect their rewards.

  • Recover: Return exhausted or fallen heroes to the guild hall to heal and recover stamina.

  • Improve: Upgrade your Guild Skill Tree, forge equipment, merge heroes, and develop your roster.

  • Explore: Push into the next stage, conquer new regions, and take on greater challenges.

Build your guild. Prepare your heroes. The next adventure awaits!

data.name: Ten Kingdoms Courier
data.detailed_description:
One courier. A land torn by war. Every letter you carry could be your last.

In 912, twelve-year-old Zhou Ping'an takes his first errand at Chenqiao Post Station: carry one letter thirty li. Sixty-seven years later he is still carrying them. Five dynasties come and go — Later Liang, Later Tang, Later Jin, Later Han, Later Zhou, and one more called Song. The roads do not change. The seals, the ledgers and the bronze bells do not change. What changes is the flag, the magistrate, and the terms of surrender and live.

A text-driven historical visual novel — no voice acting — built on the historical record of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms, a violent age of civil war after the fall of the Tang. Every chapter stands on a real year: the end of the Liang, Wang the Iron Spear, the gates of Shu, Zhongdu, Chenqiao. Each one is traceable in the notes.

How it plays

  • Choices cost something. 143 choice points, 428 options. A wrong turn can kill you — courts-martial, floods, cliff roads, arrows, routed soldiers: thirty ways to die.
  • Four endings. Read all twenty-four chapters and arrive at Delivered, The Road Home, A Lifetime Late, or the coda No Kingdom to Serve.
  • 242 historical notes. Each gives only the source and the necessary original text — never an explanation of the setting.
  • 126 paintings and stills, collected in a gallery you can revisit.

Features

  • Six volumes, twenty-four chapters, over 230,000 characters, about eight hours per run
  • Historical nodes from the Five Dynasties record: Old History of the Five Dynasties, New History of the Five Dynasties, Zizhi Tongjian, Ten States Spring and Autumn and others
  • Hand-painted ink-and-colour visuals
  • Music and sound effects — no voice acting (a text-driven read)

The flags changed a good many times. All his life he carried official letters.

data.name: Grim Siege
data.detailed_description:
GRIM SIEGE

Grim Siege is a 1v1 strategic card duel set in a dark fantasy world.

Raise your own tower to the skies — or crush your enemy's into dust. Every turn is a choice between defense, growth, and merciless assault.

⚔️ The Art of Siege


A wall stands before your tower - the enemy has to break through it first. The whole economy of the game revolves around three resources:
🪨 Stone — defense, walls, shields
🩸 Blood — magic, statuses, and your tower
⛓️ Slaves — aggression and swift strikes

Manage your income, hoard resources and decide where to invest — but beware inflation: you can't hoard forever, tempo is king.

🛡️ Six Classes — Six Strategies
six strategies Each class has strengths and weaknesses that a well-built deck can and should bring out.

  • Siege Master - the benchmark besieger with no bonuses and no weaknesses

  • Plague Lord - rot and slow decay, but weak direct damage

  • Zealot Cultist - damages itself to boost the power of its attacks

  • Warlord - swift onslaught and the first strike

  • Architect - defense that turns into tower growth

  • Dusk Baron - a predator who robs the enemy blind

🃏 Build Your Deck
Build a deck around your class and playstyle - from an impenetrable defense to a merciless rush. Hundreds of decisions, dozens of combinations. Stuff the enemy's deck with all sorts of junk, spam them with rot or madness, or simply bring brute force down on them.

🔥 Statuses & Combos
A deep effect system turns every turn into a puzzle: Rot, Veil, Silence, Chains, Shield, Spikes, Cleanse, Madness, Ward - apply, combine and wreck the enemy's plans with counterplay.

🌐 Game Modes

  • Versus AI - several difficulty levels for solo play, a story mode (coming soon), Saga (roguelite)

  • Quick matches and ranked PvP - online duels against real players

  • Private lobbies - invite a friend to a duel with an invite code

data.name: Fairy Tale Requiem
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Fairy Tale Requiem Behind the beauty of a seemingly idyllic fairy-tale world lies a hidden secret—and a growing danger.

The story takes place in “Paradise,” a specialized psychiatric facility dedicated to treating patients suffering from “Fairy Tale Syndrome.”

A young man with no memories awakens inside Paradise.

He has no idea who he is or why he is there. He has no identity, no purpose, and no story of his own.

Alice chases an invisible rabbit. A girl from Hansel and Gretel searches endlessly for her brother... Six girls are each trapped within their own fairy tales. Their fantasies may seem comforting, but the roles they cling to have become their chains.

As he searches for his lost memories, the young man begins to interact with the girls and explore the twisted fairy-tale worlds they inhabit. But as the line between reality and fantasy begins to blur, he discovers a mysterious sketchbook.

Inside is a single sentence:

“There is a sinner among the girls.”

Who is the true “sinner”?

Are the fairy tales the girls believe in truly real?

And why did this young man appear in Paradise?

As the truth slowly comes to light, the gentle yet cruel fairy-tale world begins to reveal its true face.

Game Features

🕯️ Dark Fairy Tale × Psychological Mystery

👧 Six Girls × Six Unique Fairy Tales

🔀 Multiple Endings — Your Choices Shape Their Fates

🎨 A Large Collection of Beautiful CGs

🧩 Reality and Fantasy Intertwine — Uncover the Truth Hidden Within the Fairy Tales

data.name: Mythmatch
data.detailed_description:
Mythmatch is a town-building merge game with an anti-capitalist story. You play as aspiring goddess Artemis trying to find her place in Olympus. But when she is rejected and sent down to the mortal realm, she learns how her billionaire family negatively impacts the mortals. Instead of fighting for her place among the gods, she discovers the joys of working within a community and building relationships.

Play as Artemis and help the women of Ithaca rebuild while the men take their sweet time returning from the Trojan War.

Building a Community

The Mortal Realm isn't where you expected to be, but it might be where you belong. Get to know the mortals and learn what community can look like and how you can be part of it.

A Family to Un-Find

Artemis was born to be a Goddess, but in Olympus, the elitist gatekeeping runs rampant. Use your spite to fuel you and show them that you deserve a place in the pantheon.

Challenge the Gods 

Mythmatch features unique and replayable challenges with four of the Olympian gods. From clear-the-board puzzles to turn-based auto-battlers, these minigames will keep you on your toes.

Perform well and you'll earn their favor, which will provide benefits back down in the Mortal Realm.

data.name: EraTurn
data.detailed_description:
Shape your civilization’s destiny in this epic turn-based strategy game. Manage resources, advance technology, and conquer through the ages. Every choice transforms history—will your empire rise to greatness or fall to obscurity?

Key Features:

Dynamic Historical Progression

Start from ancient times and guide your people through key historical epochs—medieval, industrial, and modern. Your civilization’s future is shaped by your choices.

Character Customization

Design your leader with complete control over their appearance. Customize facial features, skin tone, and age to create a unique character that reflects your vision for your civilization's ruler. Express your creativity and make your mark with a distinctive protagonist.

Turn-Based and Real-Time Battles

Seamlessly switch between turn-based strategy and real-time action. Plan your conquests carefully, or dive into the heat of battle for fast-paced tactical gameplay.

Third-Person Unit Control: Take full control of your units in third-person mode. Lead them directly into battle, using special abilities and split-second decisions to turn the tide of war.

Immersive Combat: Experience the thrill of large-scale warfare, from ancient warriors to modern soldiers. Command diverse armies on both land and sea, each with unique abilities that bring epic battles to life.

Advanced Diplomacy

Forge alliances, negotiate treaties, and manipulate international relations. Your diplomatic skills will determine the stability and success of your empire.

Research and Technology

Unlock new units, technologies, and advancements to strengthen your civilization’s military, economy, and cultural influence.

Dynamic Campaigns

Every decision impacts the course of history. Engage in branching campaigns where your choices create a unique and ever-evolving story.

data.name: Sea of Dreams Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Survive the Nightmare. Shape the Chaos.

Welcome aboard the Sea of Dreams—a haunted vessel adrift in a nightmare realm. In this intense action rogue-lite, you'll battle through endless waves of twisted enemies in a fight for survival. Will you make it out alive—or become just another lost soul?

Slay. Adapt. Overcome.

Choose from 9 unique survivors, each with distinct abilities. Blast through hundreds of nightmarish foes with an arsenal of 17 powerful weapons—from flamethrowers to throwing tantos. Gain XP, unlock devastating perks, and build unstoppable combos as the chaos ramps up.

A Rogue-lite with Relentless Momentum

Every run is a chance to grow stronger. Earn permanent upgrades, climb 20 ranks, and craft the perfect build with 15+ game-changing perks. Fail or succeed—progression is always yours.

KEY FEATURES

  • 17 Unique Weapons – Flamethrowers, rocket launchers, sniper rifles, and more. Build your perfect loadout.

  • 9 Playable Characters – Each with their own traits. Find your favorite survivor.

  • 20 Ranks to Climb – Unlock rewards, perks, and upgrades with every level gained.

  • 15+ Perks – Mix and match to create devastating builds: offensive, defensive, and everything in between.

  • 16+ Enemy Types – Face horrors from The Other World with deadly attack patterns and evolving behaviors.

  • 10 Distinct Levels – Battle through terrifying environments aboard the Sea of Dreams.

Custom Game Mode

Beat the campaign to unlock a fully tweakable experience. Adjust everything—from difficulty to weapon count, enemy scaling, and more. Create your own challenge or total chaos. Your nightmare, your rules.

Difficulty Settings

Whether you're here for the story or the pain, choose from multiple difficulty levels—Easy to Legendary. Higher risk, greater rewards.

The nightmare begins. Will you survive the Sea of Dreams?

data.name: 7 Days Blood Moons
data.detailed_description:
Embark on an adrenaline-fueled 4v1 survivor (PVP) or go against AI Zombie Master (PVE) experience in 7 Days Blood Moons, published by The Fun Pimps, creators of 7 Days to Die, and developed by iLLOGIKA. The game brings a unique combination of FPS, survival horror, RTS, tower defense and a robust progression system.

Will you become a brave survivor or will you crush all humanity’s hopes?

Game Features

  • Choose: Be one of the brave survivors and fight for what remains of humanity or be the dominating Zombie Hive Master and purge all humanity on earth.

Survivors

As survivors you’ll survive, scavenge, build, progress, craft, and customize to live another day.

  • Survive: Work with other survivors to mow down hordes of zombies, repair your defenses and heal your fallen teammates to last until morning.

  • Scavenge: Search your surroundings for useful building supplies, ammunition and health kits to prepare for the night. Find rare resources to craft, unlock better gear for your next match.

  • Build: Locate and fortify a nearby structure with the resources you scavenged. Lay down traps and bolster your defenses as waves of the undead come for you in this destructible voxel world.

  • Progress: Pick your loadout from a large arsenal of unlockable unique weapons and perks to prepare for your next match.

  • Craft: Get more firepower and hit harder by crafting and unlocking new weapons. Craft and unlock new constructibles to bolster your defenses for your next match.

  • Customize: Pick and choose your unique look from a wide variety of character customization options. Dress your character to show your style choosing unique outfit pieces from a wide variety of clothing options.

Zombie Hive Master

As the Zombie Hive Master, you’ll strategize, command, possess, harvest, and progress in this thrilling genre mash-up.

  • Strategize: From the sky in command view, search and find the survivors' base. Plan where your horde will be summoned from and dominate the field by giving them orders during the bloodmoon.

  • Command: Give orders to your horde to strategize a coordinated attack.

  • Possess: Take possession of zombies in third person to fight the survivors on the field.

  • Harvest: Harvest human remains to unlock new zombie minions to unleash in your next match.

  • Progress: Choose from a wide variety of unlockable zombie archetypes with unique special abilities to help crush the survivors in your next match.

data.name: BIER RUSH!
data.detailed_description:
How many can you carry at once?

It's the height of Oktoberfest and the Festhalle is packed. You're the waitress.

Pour at the taps, stack the mugs up your arms, weave through dancing guests and runaway barrels, and serve the tables. PROST!

Carry more, earn more. Carry more, fall harder.

  • Pour — hold Space and let go on the golden line for a PERFECT POUR.
  • Stack — every extra mug pushes your multiplier up to x5.0, while the tower clinks, sloshes and hides your face.
  • Balance — sharp turns tip the stack. Steer against the lean to save it. Miss it and… CRASH. The whole hall goes silent — then "OOOOH".
  • Serve — just walk past a table that ordered and the mugs go down one after another.
  • Combo — chain deliveries and the band adds an instrument each step, all the way to "HEY! HEY!"

Five minutes, one hall getting wilder

It starts as a cosy evening. Then the guests pour into the aisles to dance, drunks come in for a hug, the kitchen door slams open, barrels roll loose, pretzels and puddles hit the floor. The last minute is the OKTOBERFEST RUSH!

Up to 4 players online

  • DUELL (PvP) — whoever delivers the most beer wins. Your rival is carrying twelve mugs? One shoulder check.
  • TEAM SCHICHT (Co-op) — hit the team target together. Bumping a teammate still spills their beer. Who gets the Troll Award?
  • Quick match, create a room, invite by code.

Features

  • Physics-driven mug towers and sloshing beer
  • Original polka soundtrack that grows with your combo
  • Solo progression: pick 1 of 3 perks after every shift
  • Silly shift stats: litres spilled, glasses broken, drunk hugs, pretzels stepped on…
  • 3–5 minute rounds, no game over — straight back in

data.name: Square Jump
data.detailed_description:
Have you been looking for a simple game where you are a cube and want to jump on different things? Square Jump is perfect!

You are a square that must get as far as possible from the destination, or the finish line, without dying or falling into traps.

There are 2 types of enemies, the black square and the red square. The black square has no gravity and you can't kill it, but the red square has gravity and you can kill it if you jump on it.

The buttons are colored according to the doors, and if you press them, the doors will open. Just like the boxes, if you put them in the colored areas according to the same color, you will be able to open other doors.

There are a lot of levels, but also achievements waiting for you to complete them all!

Enjoy!

data.name: Lord Of The Ants
data.detailed_description:
A top-down tower defence where you dig the map.

Thousands of ants march on your queen, always by the shortest path. Dig new tunnels and raise walls to change that path, and lead them into your turrets.

Reshape the cave between waves.

  • Dig. Paint over rock and your workers dig it out, or spend stone to drill it instantly.

  • Wall. Drag a wall across a tunnel. It goes up the moment you let go.

  • Reroute. The swarm always takes the shortest open path, so every wall sends it somewhere new.

  • Walls break. Big ants chew through stone. Click a wall to reinforce it.

Five turrets. Two upgrade paths each, and you can only finish one.

  • ARBOR – long range. Each shot pierces the whole line.

  • MAW – fast bites. Every fifth bite knocks the ant back up the tunnel.

  • FOXFIRE – a spark that jumps from ant to ant. The only turret that hits fliers.

  • ACID – burns its target, then leaves a pool that burns whatever walks through.

  • BOMBARDIER – kills one ant, and that ant explodes on the ones around it.

Every colour of ant has a turret that counters it.

  • Six colours. Five have a matching turret that deals extra damage to them; every other turret deals less.

  • Red ants have no counter. No turret hits them harder.

  • Every nest is marked with the turret that beats it, so you can read a level at a glance.

For when the turrets are not enough.

  • Four traps: a buried mine that waits for a crowd, sticky ground, a burning pool, and a trap that throws the swarm back the way it came.

  • Three abilities: drop a meteor, set the floor on fire, or call in nine of your own ants.

  • Your own army: soldiers, spitters and workers. Send them to destroy enemy nests, and bring them back before they are overrun.

Each one breaks a different strategy.

  • THE TIDE – a shielded boss at the head of a flood of escorts.

  • THE DRIFT – brings drones that fly over your walls.

  • THE SHEPHERD – weak on its own, guarded by eighteen fast runners.

  • And nine more.

A 120-node upgrade tree.

  • Every level pays out, even the ones you lose. Spend it on turret, ant and income upgrades that last the whole campaign.

  • You can see them. The top upgrades change how things look: turrets grow spurs, the queen grows a crown.

56 levels down, then endless.

  • Choose your route down a branching map. Each win shows what the paths below it pay.

  • Some levels change the rules: all your money up front and no more, a set of abandoned turrets, or thirty waves on a floor that collapses.

  • Endless mode after the finale, with a depth record.

  • Optional permadeath: if your queen dies, the save is gone. The thirty-wave levels and endless mode are the exceptions.

Single-player. No microtransactions.

data.name: Moving Forward with Cat
data.detailed_description:
Moving Forward with Cat

Galileo said
"And yet it moves."

I thought
"Perhaps the same applies to cats?"

"Moving Forward with Cat" is a physics-based platformer about gravity and pendulum mechanics. Understand the laws of physics and aim for new heights together with a cat.

Key Features

- Unique pendulum mechanics

- Gravity-defying gameplay

- Carefully crafted stages

- Minimalist art style

Game Experience

In "Moving Forward with Cat," you cannot fully control the cat. Instead, you need to think ahead and plan the timing of jumps, swings, and launches to overcome each challenge.

As you play, you'll develop an intuitive understanding of the game's physics and begin to feel the growth of your own playing skills.

Discovery

Discover stages that change as the game progresses, new mechanisms, and increasingly difficult challenges.

Challenge

Without direct control, prediction and adaptation are necessary. Each level requires thoughtful planning and execution while utilizing momentum, inertia, and gravity.

Growth

While playing the game, you'll realize
"Wait... am I getting better at this game?"

Experience the joy of growth that you discover yourself, not joy given by someone else.

If everything goes smoothly, you can complete the main story in about 3 hours.

data.name: New Yankee 6: In Pharaoh's Court
data.detailed_description:
Travel back in time to the land of the pharaohs to stop an imposter from seizing the throne!

When John and Mary step through the Mirror Between the Worlds to tour ancient Egypt, they find themselves wrapped up in their most astonishing adventure yet! As they help a hapless ruler try to regain his throne from a phony pharaoh, they'll come face to face with mummies, scorpions and the dark magic of a land long ago buried under the sands of time.

As their tour guide through this amazing world, you'll control their actions as they race against the clock to remove daunting obstacles, gather vital resources and overcome dangerous traps! Before the ultimate showdown arrives, you'll command them to build pyramids, the Sphinx and more, using your best strategies to complete each level as quickly as possible.

Before the adventure is over, you'll soar above the dunes on the wings of a dragon to collect scarabs, solve matching puzzles to unearth hidden treasure and earn dozens of achievements. It's all in a day's work for Sir John and Lady Mary – the Yankees who travel through time to save the world!

Key features:
• Adventurous, fun-filled story!
• Colorful worlds and amusing characters!
• Simple but challenging gameplay!
• Mini-games, hidden puzzle pieces and more!
• An untimed mode for kids and casual players!

data.name: Perfect Universe - Play with Gravity
data.detailed_description:
Follow the stories of 3 lonely characters as they strive to fulfil their potential in an absurd world. Compete against friends in 6 sporting events set in gravity defying arenas. The unique art style, surreal levels and eclectic music blend harmoniously to create an experience unlike any other. Played solo, Perfect Universe is a chilled-out and relaxing experience. Played with up to 4 people, it will have you at the edge of your seat, as your skill is tested to the limit.

- Perfect Moon: Classic platforming in a non-classical universe.
- Moon Life: Control the feet of an alien creature directly in this QWOP-like.
- Star Light: Fly your rocket ship through the galaxy in this Thrust-like.
- Moon Golf: An interplanetary game of golf.
- Gravity Dodge: A 4-player game of alternative gravity dodgeball.
- Balloon Pop: Scramble to pop more balloons than your opponents.
- Rocket Ball: Play football, with rockets!
- Moon Volley: A game of volleyball around a little planet.
- Space Race: Race rockets against friends.

data.name: Umbral Coterie
data.detailed_description:
Open Beta

Note that the game is still under active development. I think that there is enough to start letting players see what I've been working on, however I have lots of features that I'm still eager implement. My hope is that this game will gradually turn into a very complex ecosystem and generate some very interesting stories. 

Join me on Discord to let me know what you think I should be working on. My goal is to have regular updates every other week or so. 

Thank you for supporting independant developers. 

Premise

You arrive in a living medieval city on the cusp of a new century. Somewhere in its alleys and almshouses, older powers are moving.

Umbral Coterie is a dark, character-driven city simulation built on procedural generation and emergent storytelling. Every citizen — from the drunken thatcher to the cardinal's bastard son — has a name, a family, a faith, four humors balanced uneasily in their blood, and a daily routine that unfolds whether you watch or not. Befriend them. Bleed them. Bury them. The city remembers.

There are no scripted quests. There is only the city, the shadow it casts, and the consequences of standing in it.

Key Features

  • A Living Medieval City: Hundreds of citizens with full personalities, occupations, relationships, faiths, and schedules. They wake, work, drink, pray, gossip, fall in love, fall ill, and die.

  • Emergent Storytelling: No two playthroughs tell the same tale. Every marriage, murder, plague, and betrayal is generated from the simulation itself. The chronicle of your city is written as you play.

  • Procedural Generation: Streets, families, bloodlines, and histories are forged anew each game. A different city. A different rot. A different ruin.

  • Rivaling Factions: In addition to the forces of the church and the city, sinister forces move beneath the surface, and the deeper you look, the more they look back. Discover them on your own terms — or stumble into them at the worst possible moment.

  • The Four Humors: Personality is not a stat sheet. Each soul is shaped by sanguine, choleric, melancholic, and phlegmatic humors, inherited from parents and shifted by trauma. Compatibility, ambition, and madness all emerge from the blood.

  • Consequence That Lingers: Citizens remember. Families remember. The town's chronicle remembers. A sin committed in winter may not be repaid until a generation has died.

The Long Game

This is not a game about winning. It is about building a coterie that can rival existing powers and reach a place of honor. A bloodline. A legend.

Something is waiting.

Play as a vampire and observe, befriend, manipulate, and betray hundreds of fully simulated citizens as they live, work, scheme, and die around you. Shape bloodlines and uncover the forces moving beneath the city.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 20H2 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 2300X or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ulkan 1.0 compatible GPU — NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD RX 460 / Intel UHD 630 (1 GB VRAM; integrated graphics supported)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: At minimum spec, keep city population below 60 citizens for smooth performance. CPU single-core speed is the dominant factor — faster cores matter more than more cores. A dedicated GPU is not required as long as your integrated graphics supports Vulkan 1.0.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended spec supports a full medieval city with an active population of 200+ citizens, active relationship simulation, GOAP-driven AI, and full historical event tracking running simultaneously. No ray tracing, HDR, or shader-heavy effects — GPU quality above the minimum threshold has no measurable impact on performance.

data.name: Wretch: Divine Ascent
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap（New）


About the Game

Wretch: Divine Ascent is a 1v1 tactical auto battler game in a dark medieval style that was inspired by Backpack Battles and developed with Unreal Engine. Mix and match items in your backpack to create powerful combos. Purchase a variety of helpful items such as equipment, accessories, and moves from the shop, and fuse them to obtain special items that cannot be bought. Be careful—some moves can counter each other! Getting the right combination of moves and equipment will be your key to victory.

A New Challenger Steps onto the Ascent — The Executioner

Wielding a massive hammer, the Executioner channels raw power through charged strikes, bringing the heaviest despair upon their opponents.

You dive into backpack management right from the first match. Purchase moves, items, and equipment from the shop and formulate your best strategy. Your items can be combined to give powerful effects, and you can even fuse items to gain unique creations that no shop can provide off the rack. Choose your combinations carefully to give yourself the sharpest edge in your battles!

In the game, multiple characters are available for you to choose from: Knight, Plague Doctor, Ronin, Wujiang, and the latest to ascend the Long Stairs—Pirate.

The characters have distinct features and cool styles that are further emphasized in the strategies and moves employed in battle. Use your backpack items to give your attacks unique buffs such as critical hits, speed boosts, and block enhancements. Connecting moves well will be crucial for victory—avoid moves that might counter each other, and build combos to allow you to quickly launch follow-up attacks after breaking through your opponent's guard.

You undergo up to 10 battles per game, each against real players. Slash and slice your opponents in a bloody 1v1 fight to the finish. Players can battle at any time with no need to wait for an opponent to be online. After you win 10 battles in a game, you gain the chance to challenge the best players on the global leaderboard. The current demo version includes a 10-Win Honor leaderboard, where you can keep an eye on the enemy and make plans to rise to the top in Divine Ascent. Stay sharp—they're watching too.

About the Version

Currently, there are 5 playable classes available, along with nearly 300 diverse items, gear, and attacks to choose from and combine.. We will continue improving and updating it as we progress in our game development.

data.name: Drag Racing Kaos - "One More Run"
data.detailed_description:
After many failed attempts from other companies at an online drag racing game since the early 2000's, I gave it a try myself. Using things learned over the last 20 years from other coding ventures, I have came up with Drag Racing Kaos. The Kaos part will be the inclusion of almost everything drag racing. From Top Fuel and Funny Cars to Doorslammers and Fuel Altereds. Drag Racing Kaos will have something for everyone. The "One More Run" tagline comes from an old saying describing the addictive nature of gaining the extra hundredth of a second. "I'm on my way, just one more run."

Current Features Include:

  • 6 different chassis to choose.

  • 150+ different vehicles to choose.

  • 12+ different engine combinations.

  • 30+ different tracks between both street and strip.

  • Ability to design paint schemes with an external paint editor..

  • Weather conditions that effect tuning.

  • Custom part choices for many racecars.

  • Both Multiplayer and Sandbox mode.

data.name: Ocean Cleaner Idle
data.detailed_description:
Ocean Cleaner Idle is an incremental solarpunk game. Use your mouse to pick up plastic and other trash from the ocean. Recycle trash into materials to upgrade your ship.

When Meerlinda rose to the surface, she was greeted with an awful sight! To her disgust there was a huge mass of waste polluting the waters. She found out that humans have been using the oceans as a garbage dump for all of their history. Furious about the mess, but not discouraged by it, she decides to fix the problem. She embarks on a mission to clean it all up!

Meerlinda’s ship Gentle Breeze combines Atlantean shipbuilding traditions with their latest technology. Its biomimetic hull is streamlined like a fish and built from sustainable materials. It is not reliant on fossil fuels as it is propelled by sails and powered by solar energy. It uses nets, traps and filters to collect seaborne trash.

Meerlinda uses recycled materials to upgrade her ship. The materials are split into four Tiers: plastic, cellulose, glass and metal. Upgrades help you clean the ocean faster. Some upgrades will collect trash automatically for the idle play experience.

  • Manual and automatic trash collection

  • Multiple ship upgrades

  • 10 levels for each upgrade

  • 4 different material tiers

  • Waves of trash

Our Motivation

We were inspired to make our game by a real world problem that afflicts sea life around the world. It hurts and kills animals trapped in it. Microplastics carry toxic chemicals and accumulate in the food chain. There are already millions of tons of trash in the oceans and millions more are added every year. The size of the trash varies from microscopic pieces to whole ships abandoned to the ocean bottom. Most of the trash is plastic, but any material produced can end up there. Unfortunately cleaning up the oceans is not easy in real life. The best way to tackle the problem is to reduce the amount of trash that ends up in the ocean. 

What Can I Do?

  • Reduce consumption of single-use products

  • Choose products packaged in re-usable or biodegradable materials

  • Instead of buying fast fashion, consider drift shopping

  • Don’t buy products with microbeads in them

  • Recycle your trash and dispose of it properly 

  • Avoid seafood, and if you do eat it buy only from MSC certified producers to reduce trash from abandoned fishing nets

  • Support sustainable businesses, organizations and governments

  • Demonstrate your opinion

  • Demand laws to protect the oceans

  • Participate in coast cleanups and other local pro-environmental activities

Global Ocean Conservation Organizations:

  • Plastic Soup Foundation

  • Oceana

  • The Ocean Project

  • Ocean Conservancy

  • Oceanic Preservation Society

  • Oceanic Society

  • ProtectedSeas

  • Marine Stewardship Council

  • Marine Conservation Institute

  • Ocean Wise Conservation Association

  • International Programme on the State of the Ocean

  • Waitt Institute

  • The World Wildlife Fund

  • Greenpeace

Baltic Sea Conservation Organizations:

  • Baltic Sea Action Group

  • The John Nurminen Foundation

  • The Baltic Sea Conservation Foundation

  • The Baltic Marine Environment Protection Commission aka. the Helsinki Commission (HELCOM)

Help us to find a charity to donate part of our earnings to help in this cause. Write to us in “murmuringgrove (at) ” or join our Discord.

data.name: Shadow Of the Groundhog
data.detailed_description:
Every year, on the 2nd of February, in the USA, Canada and some other countries people celebrate the Groundhog Day. It is conventional to keep watch over groundhogs. If a groundhog steps out from its hole and sees its shadow, then it hides in the hole, the spring will come not earlier than in 6 weeks. If a groundhog doesn’t notice its shadow and calmly steps out from its hole, the spring is coming.

…Freddy the Groundhog have been sleeping in his hole. He has hoped to sleep as long as possible, but precisely on the 2nd of February he has been awaked by people who desire to know when the spring comes. Viciously yawning, Freddy rushes outside at the highest possible speed (considering his tubby figure, of course) to hunt away troublemakers and… also unintentionally predict the upcoming weather.

However, even the groundhog’s hole may have too much light. Help the rodent reach the exit without seeing its shadow and scaring of it! Pass over light sources or move so that light falls on the groundhog in the front.

  • Light sources may be moving and motionless - find a way to successfully pass over both types.
  • Use the cunning, solve puzzles
  • Complete all levels and prove that your groundhog is the smartest here!

data.name: On The Ramp
data.detailed_description:
Your rival is right there – you're racing side-by-side, fighting for the next jump, the next corner. You've barely regained control after a landing, and you're neck-and-neck again. A ramp. A flight spanning dozens of meters. Suspension pushed to its absolute limit. Touching down at 140 km/h. Another corner. Another jump. And the speed just keeps climbing.

You can't drive through them

Your rivals are physical machines. Not ghosts, not lap times. They dive into the same corner and land on the same ramp, half a meter away. One bad landing and they're gone.

You start with nothing

The local league. Under 100 hp and a bare tube frame. It's a fight for survival. Every race earns points for the standings and progress you turn into upgrades. More power. A fight for every kilogram. Body panels that change how the car cuts through the air.

Until you're ready for more: the regional league, then the national. And 600 hp under your foot.

Inspired by Stunt Car Racer — back when suspension was something you could see.

Your rivals are physical machines. Not ghosts, not lap times. They dive into the same corner and land on the same ramp, half a meter away. One bad landing and they're gone.

You start with nothing

The local league. Under 100 hp and a bare tube frame. It's a fight for survival. Every race earns points for the standings and progress you turn into upgrades. More power. A fight for every kilogram. Body panels that change how the car cuts through the air.

Until you're ready for more: the regional league, then the national. And 600 hp under your foot.

Inspired by Stunt Car Racer — back when suspension was something you could see.
data.short_description: Your rival is right there. A ramp. Dozens of meters of air. Suspension at its limit. Touching down at 140. You started with 120 horses and a cheap frame. Race to get noticed. Build the rest.

data.name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
data.detailed_description:
Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is a gamified focus tool, set to a soothing lofi soundtrack.

With regular updates — Expect new features and content throughout 2026!

Discover and collect Spirits, customize your cozy virtual space, and facilitate your real-life tasks with a collection of handy features designed to improve concentration and ease stress.


CHILL LOFI BEATS AND SOUNDS

Soft, soothing lofi music and dynamic soundscapes such as pattering rain and crackling fire provide the perfect background ambiance to relieve stress and unwind. All music in game is fully stream-friendly, perfect for featuring on Youtube or Twitch as a pleasing background.

  • Homework Radio music will be available until August 2028 (license period)

SHOW OFF YOUR STYLE

Customize both your character and your bedroom to suit your mood, selecting from a multitude of fashion, hairstyle, color, and room decor options. From hoodies to horns, bookshelves to boba teas, fairy lights to fireplaces, there’s dozens of options available for you to flex your unique personality and style.

ADORABLE SPIRIT COMPANIONS

Explore different combinations of room activities, soundscapes, and decor options to lure out the mischievous Spirits that populate the world. Discover and collect them as you focus on your tasks. You'll never be alone with a Spirit companion by your side. And yes, every Spirit can be petted too!

BEGIN YOUR PRODUCTIVITY JOURNEY

Utilize built-in productivity tools, including a to-do list for organization, a timer for focused work sessions, and a habit tracker and journal to foster a healthy routine. Earn XP for practicing good habits, unlocking more goodies over time - from new character & room cosmetics, to hints to help discover more Spirits, being productive has never been so rewarding!

KEY FEATURES

  • Listen along to a carefully curated catalog of chill lofi beats, with a selection of themed playlists for every mood and occasion;

  • Stay organized using integrated productivity tools, including a to-do list, session timer, habit tracker and journal;

  • Create your own avatar. Choose from a variety of hairstyles, outfits, color options, and more to bring to life your own unique Spirit City persona;

  • Spruce up your room to design your ideal cozy retreat, swapping between different wallpapers, flooring, furniture and wall decor;

  • Immerse yourself with interactive soundscapes that change the world in real-time to suit your preferred vibe, from the pitter-patter of rain on a window to the crackling of a toasty fireplace;

  • Decipher hints to lure curious spirits out into the open with the right combination of game settings, unlocking them as your future companions;

  • Earn XP and level up over time, and by using the game’s features to their fullest. Unlock new cosmetics and customization choices as you progress;

  • Stream your sessions worry-free thanks to the game’s fully stream-friendly music library - perfect for co-working streams or as a background on Twitch or Youtube;

  • Expand your song catalog with the built-in web player, providing even more options for the musically adventurous;

  • Enhance your everyday activities. Spirit City: Lofi Sessions offers a pleasing and distraction-free space for you to better enjoy and concentrate on your work and hobbies.

data.name: 8-Bit Invaders!
data.detailed_description:
The Invasion Has Begun!

8-Bit Invaders! is a fast-paced, retro Real-Time Strategy game for the PC. Control the military might of the GALACTIC MARINE CORPS or invade with the devastating power of the alien CRANIOIDS! No matter which side you choose, everything in 8-Bit Invaders! is easy to understand for beginners and hardcore gamers alike. Collect resources, build your army, and then crush your opponent!

Conquering the Multiverse was never so easy.

A 24 mission single-player campaign comes with achievements and technology that grow your destructive power with every victory. Fight alone or find a buddy and take on the enemy together in 10 additional co-op missions. Or, test your skills against the AI in a variety of 2, 4, 6 or 8-player maps in skirmish battles.

8-Bit Invaders! includes all of this, and more…

  • 24 offline campaign missions.
  • New 'Conquer The Multiverse' real-time strategic metagame scenarios providing for opportunities to invade new worlds
  • Classic Base-Building mechanics let you construct the ultimate HQ from which to launch attacks against your foes.
  • Easy to understand advanced military and alien units and structures lets RTS beginners jump right in.
  • 10 co-op missions to play with your friends.
  • Destructible environments on maps ranging from small to very large.
  • 2-8 player battles against Human and AI opponents of varying skill levels.
  • A rocking soundtrack from composer Frank Klepacki.
  • Full cross-play with 8-Bit Armies and 8-Bit Hordes for those epic MEGA BATTLES between factions across games, and the Multiverse!
  • From the same team that brought you RTS classics such as Star Wars: Empire at War, Universe at War, and Grey Goo.

data.name: Looking Glass
data.detailed_description:
Don’t stand still. Don’t turn back. And don’t trust your eyes. Step into Looking Glass, a PC horror VR game set in the darkness of a hedge labyrinth. Peer through the blackness—and keep tabs on the strange figures surrounding you—using nothing but a hand mirror.

There’s no map. No walkthrough. And no two mazes are the same. Looking Glass takes cues from the golden era of mouse-and-keyboard horror—but it's built for virtual reality. Discover strange landmarks, vaulted passages, and a landscape both suspenseful and serene. Grab your Index, Rift, or Vive and try one of the best VR horror games on Steam.

data.name: Nine Lives to Immortality: Did Kitty Break Through Today?
data.detailed_description:
Build Your Cat Sect

In this world, cats are not pets—they are disciples of your sect. Manage your own cat sect, train disciples, send them into secluded cultivation, help them break through to higher realms, and gradually expand your sect.

Breeding and Bloodline Inheritance

Cats can breed the next generation. Offspring inherit part of their parents’ appearance and talents, and stronger parents give their kittens a better chance of higher potential. Through generations of training and inheritance, find the feline disciples best suited for battle and growth.

Enter Dungeons, Loot Gear and Skill Stones

Sect disciples can enter dungeons and fight. Defeat enemies to obtain gear, skill stones, and training resources. Combine different gear attributes and skills to build combat styles for your feline disciples, then challenge enemies of higher realms.

Manage, Train, Battle, and Break Through Again

This is a game about raising cats, cultivation, breeding, loot hunting, and build crafting. Gather resources through sect management, discover new possibilities as your cats grow, then take stronger cats into dungeons in search of the next breakthrough.

data.name: ChessDeck
data.detailed_description:
Familiar pieces. A whole new game.

ChessDeck is a roguelike deckbuilder built on chess. You don't play a full game of chess. Instead, every turn you draw a hand of cards that spawn pieces onto your back row and move them up a small board using the movement rules of chess. Pawns are cheap and slow. Knights jump. Rooks and queens cross the board in one move, at a price.

Reach the enemy's row and your piece strikes the garrison holding that column. Clear the garrison to win the fight.

Every threat is on the board

Enemies show what they'll do a full turn ahead. You know which column gets hit and how hard. What you don't know is what you'll draw. The first piece in a threatened column takes the hit, so every turn you have to choose: push your strongest piece forward to attack, or keep it home as a wall.

Pieces protect each other

Real chess captures matter here too. A piece standing on a square another of your pieces covers gains guard and survives longer. A pawn chain is a shield. A lone queen is a target.

Losses are never free

When a piece falls, it leaves a Fallen card in your discard pile, and you'll have to draw it. Throw pieces away and your deck fills with the dead. Build a deck that turns that cost into strength, or one that never has to pay it.

Features

  • 90+ cards: spawns, moves, tactics and powers, each with an upgraded version

  • 80+ relics that bend the rules of the board

  • Six starting decks, each changing how a run plays

  • Six difficulty levels, unlocked one at a time by winning

  • A branching map of fights, elites, shops, camps and random events

  • A board that grows each act, up to a final boss

  • Short runs you can finish in one sitting

data.name: Kandi Chaos
data.detailed_description:
Kandi Chaos is a cozy sorting game featuring hundreds of thousands of pony beads scattered around your bedroom. The goal is simple: sort the beads into bins by color. 

The Bead Pile

Tackle a small pile of ten thousand beads or an insurmountable mound of 1.5 million beads. The choice is yours (and your computer’s).
You can even change the bead colors at any time with 10 color palettes and over 100 colors. Find what works for you.

Sort Your Way

Sit by your bins and toss beads one at a time or stand across the room hurling scoopfuls of beads into the bins. Sort how you want. It is just you and the pile.

ASMR 

Featuring real recorded pony beads. Every swish, clink, and clatter of the beads fills the room.  Relax with over a dozen lo-fi tracks.

Shop

Bukit Labs has provided your living space with access to our exclusive shop. We make sorting beads easy. You click, we ship. Right to your door. Inside your room, actually. But only when you aren’t looking. Featuring sorting upgrades, room customization options, and even entertainment. Bukit, the only friend you need.

Dig Deeper

Sort, relax, check your in-game email, or waste time playing games. Just try not to lose any beads under the bed. You’ll never 100% the game that way.

Comfort & Settings 

  • Rebindable keys

  • Motion blur, bloom, and brightness controls

  • Audio mix controls

  • Color blind mode featuring the Okabe-Ito palette

Coming Soon

  • Kandi making - it would not be right to call the game ‘kandi’ if you couldn’t make kandi. 

  • More time wasters - Why tackle that massive pile of beads when you can play games, browse the ‘internet’ and draw?

  • Controller support

Coming with the Arts and Crafts update!

AI Disclosure

Kandi Chaos was made by a solo developer and his kids. In the interest of transparency, here’s how AI was and wasn’t used.

Used:

  • AI helped with a portion of the heavy engineering work, the GPU instancing system that lets the game render and manage up to 1,000,000 beads. The code was reviewed, tested, and integrated by the developer.

Not used:

  • No AI-generated art. 3D models and some UI elements come from purchased asset packs made by human artists, and in-game artwork was created by the developer and the developer’s kids.

  • No AI-generated audio, music, or voice.

  • No AI-generated in-game text, dialogue, or lore.

  • No AI generates content during gameplay.

data.detailed_description:
You were just minding your business when suddenly, a bunch of portals opened up all over the world.

Just like many other ducks, you fell into the portal and were left stranded in another world. But a lone duck traversed the portals and saved you and everyone else.

Explore a set of challenging levels across different worlds

  • Leaderboards

data.name: Missing Translation
data.detailed_description:
Lost in a weird city in the middle of the desert and surrounded by strange creatures that keep staring at you. This is a game about exploring the unknown and solving puzzles... lots of them! Don't be fooled by the looks, this isn't your typical point & click adventure, you'll spend your time solving them.

Key Features

  • No tutorials, hints or even text to be found here. This wasn't made to increase difficulty but to let the player do everything on his own, "Missing Translation" isn't a hard game, but we don't like hand-holding.

  • REPEAT, NO TEXT. Everyone can enjoy it regardless of the language they speak :D

  • Three different puzzle mechanics, each of those features 25 levels to complete.

  • Beautiful black and white pixel art... ... did I already say we have cats?

  • Two different characters to choose from.

  • Additional challenges involving a drawn language that can be learned up to some point.

  • Great soundtrack that has evolved with the rest of the game over development.

  • FREE! No ads, cash shop or any of those modern things.

data.reviews:
“Missing Translation is a pixel art puzzle adventure about an abductee who must complete a series of puzzles to earn the items required to get home”
7/10 – Pocket Gamer

“Traditionally, adventure games are supposed to give players a clear understanding of the plot by using a clear language. But what if one of the player’s goals in such a game was also to decrypt a secret language, where only then they could really understand what was going on? This is the premise of Missing Translation, a puzzle adventure game made by the Spanish studio AlPixel Games.”
Indie Game Magazine

“Missing Translation plans to teach its own language that’s far simpler, a visual language based on drawing lines across a nine-node grid. That’s not the main focus of the game – it’s a puzzler at heart – but if we want to, hey, we’ll get to converse with the locals in our strange new home.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

data.name: My Grandparents' Christmas Mystery
data.detailed_description:
My Grandparents' Christmas Mystery is a first-person psychological horror game in the walking simulator genre. The average time to complete the game is 20-25 minutes.

Story:

You are playing as Michael whose Grandparents' (Mary and James) wanted to celebrate christmas alone without me and my parents this year. So instead we all agreed on meeting up the day after christmas, but after christmas was over my grandpa came to visit our home without grandma and looked in shock. We asked where grandma was but he just said she would come over later, 3 days passes and grandpa would never tell us what happened, all he said was to not go back to that cabin ever again. Then he passed away with heartfailure without telling us what actually happened and this left me with anger, confusion, sadness and a mission...to go find out what really happened that christmas and where grandma is...

Features:

Memories:

With the help of grandpa's memories that you find scattered throughout the environment you will progress the story and figure out bit by bit what really happened that christmas.

Hide:

Be careful so it doesn't find you.

Stamina

Use your stamina wisely, you never know what's around the corner...

Interaction:

Interact with different objects that you find scattered around the environment.

Immersive Graphics:

High quality graphics making the game more terrifying and atmospheric to explore.

Warning: game contains jumpscares.

data.name: 幽都酒馆
data.detailed_description:
本游戏主旨绿色健康阳光积极向上充满正能量，无不良导向。
这是一个发生在名为幽都的地方发生的日常故事，在这里我们都是一个短暂停留的过客，在这短暂的时间里，感受一下这周围不一样的日常。
游戏流程很短，可能就20分钟的样子，分为四个小故事。每个一小故事都十分的简短。
游戏本身十分的简单，通过再一个地图里简单的移动和探索，来了解一些小故事，你可以和场景中一些物品反复的互动，除此之外只有一些简单的选择选项，并不会影响结局或者分支。
因为不太会画画，所以从cg到立绘还有行走图可能都比较粗糙和丑陋，地图也很小，不过里面的东西我还是尽量做的丰富一点。
因为不太会程序，所以游戏本身机制简单，基本上只用点点点就行了，不过还是有些地方可以互动的。
因为是弱智，所以剧情上可能让您感到难受或者不解，我表示非常抱歉，但是也没办法了，我尽力了，实在不爽就骂我吧。
希望大家还是抱着一个休闲和快乐的心态来看这个小故事，同时也希望您能从我的游戏中收获快乐。

data.name: Dark Tales from México: Prelude. Just a Dream... with The Sack Man
data.detailed_description:
DARK TALES FROM MÉXICO
Is a saga of 10 short games in a 3D Survival Horror style, based on tales from the real Mexican folklore in which every monster it´s originally a physical sculpture made and painted by hand and then 3D scanned using photogrammetry. This game is the Prelude of the saga.

"JUST A DREAM... WITH THE SACK MAN" (THIS EPISODE)
Dreams and meanings. Meanings and nightmares. What does it mean to die in a nightmare?

Alma is asleep, she believes that what she sees, hears and feels is just a dream, a nightmare in which she must go through a labyrinth and where she must escape from the SACK MAN, a monster from a story that her grandmother told her when she was little and with which she had not dreamed since then. What Alma does not know is that this time, if she does not manage to get out of the labyrinth, she will never be able to wake up again.

Walk with Alma through this labyrinth of progressive assembly (it is different each time you go through it) capable of entering the subconscious to make you face your deepest memories and traumas.

- Multiple Gamemodes: Normal, Deathbound, and Endless mode that changes how you approach the game
- Score System for each mode

data.name: Teddy Collector
data.detailed_description:
JOIN US ON DISCORD!


About the Game

A New Day, New Teddies

Each day brings a fresh set of teddies. Their appearance and rarity change over time, pushing you to come back, adapt your strategy, and decide when to play, collect, or sell.

Not Just Luck. Skill-Based Clawing

Grabbing a teddy isn’t pure chance. Timing, positioning, and control matter—master the claw, improve your precision, and turn skill into better rewards.

Collect Teddies. Collect Trophies.

Every teddy you collect becomes a trophy. Watch them appear in your collection, track your progress, and build a display that proves how far you’ve gone.

Upgrade and Unlock New Machines

Upgrade your setup to unlock new machines. Slots, roulette, and basketball open new ways to play, earn, and push your collection further.

Sell Your Teddies

Sell single teddies or bulk batches at once. Turn your collection into cash, manage your inventory, and decide when it’s worth holding… or selling everything.

Welcome to Teddy Collector

A cozy, atmospheric arcade experience focused on skill-based claw machines, classic minigames, and collecting unique teddies.

Step into a small arcade filled with glowing machines, foggy lights, and the familiar sound of prizes waiting to be won. Every play costs money, every attempt matters, and every teddy has real weight and physics.

Skill-Based Claw Machine

This is not RNG-only.

  • Real claw movement and inertia

  • Different teddy sizes and weights

  • Rare teddies are harder to grab

  • Precision and timing make the difference

Master the claw and learn how each prize behaves.

Arcade Minigames

Earn money and tickets through classic arcade machines:

  • Basketball challenges

  • Fortune wheel

  • Slot machine

  • Simple “work” minigames to stabilize income

Each one feeds back into the core loop:

play → earn → collect → upgrade

Collect & Display

  • Dozens of teddies to discover

  • Multiple rarities: common, rare, epic, legendary

  • Persistent collection and achievements

  • Display your collection on shelves

You can sell teddies for profit… or keep them forever.

Cozy, Mysterious Atmosphere

  • Stylized 3D visuals

  • Soft lighting, fog, and arcade ambience

  • Relaxing gameplay with a subtle dark tone

  • Designed to be played at your own pace

Features

  • Singleplayer

  • First-person arcade gameplay

  • Achievements

Teddy Collector is about patience, skill, and the simple joy of winning a prize.

data.name: Hero Siege
data.detailed_description:
Step into Tarethiel, a world under siege by the Forces of Hell.
Face Demon Lords, ancient monstrosities and fallen angels as you hack and slash your path through endless hordes of the undead. Hero Siege is a fast paced Pixel Art ARPG featuring an expansive roster of unique classes, deep build experimentation, and a player driven economy.

Craft your hero through two main skill trees and individual sub-skill trees that reshape how every active ability works. Combined with a massive item pool and powerful crafting options, the game offers limitless build possibilities; from blood hungry melee bruisers and bow wielding archers to gun slinging demon slayers, sentry engineers, summoners, spell casting mages and everything in between.

Hero Siege evolves in seasonal cycles every four months, delivering fresh content, new systems, items, events, and quality of life improvements. As a small, experienced team, we work closely with our community to improve the game based directly on valuable player feedback.

Key Features

  • 23 Playable Character classes  Every class offers its own unique play style and skill set. Sub-skills and item based modifiers allow you to push your build in unique and creative directions.

  • 1000+ Unique Items  Loot ranges from randomized magic items all the way to handcrafted Satanic, Set, Heroic, Angelic and Unholy items. Runewords can be created using white bases with sockets. Items can be buffed, crafted and modified in various ways through the crafting system.

  • Tarethiel Market  Travel to Village of Mos'Arathim to List your items for sale or buy gear from other players in real time. Trading is a core part of character progression and build crafting.

  • Adventure Journal  A fully integrated in game encyclopedia containing mechanics, unique items, runewords, prospecting recipes, crafting recipes and augments.

  • Endless Replayablity  Designed for seasonal play. Each season adds new content such as: items, bosses, gimmicks and surprises from our development team.

  • Wormholes  Push your character as high as possible and earn seasonal cosmetic rewards such as skins, wings, portraits and more.

  • BIG NO-NO for Pay to Win  We never sell game play advantages. Fair competition is a core value for us.

data.name: HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails
data.detailed_description:
Hunt Without Leaving What You're Doing

HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is a compact idle hunting game whose adventure unfolds along the bottom of your screen. While you work, watch videos, or take care of something else, your hunter keeps following wild trails, tracking beasts, and bringing home rewards.

Every hunt earns you gold and loot. Use them to improve your weapons and equipment, unlock useful skills, and prepare for more dangerous territory. If a stage proves too difficult, return to earlier hunting grounds, build your strength, adjust your setup, and come back for another attempt.

Explore, Improve, and Keep Moving

  • Made for the edge of your desktop: Watch the adventure without giving up your whole screen, and step in whenever you want.

  • Discover distinct biomes: Travel through varied hunting grounds, encounter new animals, and face steadily rising challenges.

  • Build your hunter your way: Upgrade weapons, equipment, and skills to create the setup that works for you.

  • Face formidable prey: Challenge dangerous elite animals and imposing bosses.

  • Chase better rewards: Open chests, find rarer equipment, and make every upgrade feel meaningful.

  • Play at your own pace: Optimize every decision or simply let the hunt continue quietly at the bottom of your screen.

A Small Window for a Growing Journey

The heart of HUNTKEEPER: Idle Trails is watching your hunter grow stronger and finally overcome beasts that once seemed impossible. Choose meaningful upgrades, refine your setup, and conquer one wild trail after another—all from the edge of your desktop.

data.name: Alcatraz: Zombie Outbreak
data.detailed_description:
Alcatraz has a zombie problem. Your answer can be a shotgun, a fire axe, or a garden gnome.

Alcatraz: Zombie Outbreak is a single-player 2D action game about surviving crowded prison corridors with guns, melee weapons, traps, and unlikely tools.

An unusual arsenal

Shotguns and crossbows are only the start. Try a machete, a rolling pin, a beehive, or an explosive microwave. Set traps along the corridors, switch weapons as the fight changes, and make your ammo last.

Choose your targets

Face zombie boxers, butchers, police officers, and infected animals. Different movement speeds, attack ranges, and toughness make each enemy a different problem. Pick your targets, watch both sides, and use the stairs to reposition before the crowd closes in.

Survive the campaign

Fight through the campaign and return to earlier missions to improve your results. Collect coins during each fight to earn up to three stars. Your first three-star clear of each campaign mission earns a bonus crystal.

Go below for supplies

Short on gold for your next weapon? Take optional, repeatable supply runs in the basement and caves. Start with a free random weapon, fight for loot, and search for caches. Spend the gold you bring back on equipment for the campaign.

  • Single-player

  • 15 interface languages

  • Keyboard and mouse controls

  • Partial controller support

data.name: Prospect Renegade
data.detailed_description:
Step into the boots of Silas, a visionary gunslinger on the brink of forging his legacy, in "Prospect Renegade" – a tale of ambition, conflict, and survival on the desert planet of Urdin. In this groundbreaking sci-fi Western, your cunning will chart the course of your journey, blending the thrill of exploration, the intensity of combat, and the intricacy of corporate empire-building into a seamless, immersive experience.

About This Game:

In a universe where power is everything, and the frontier is vast, "Prospect Renegade" offers you the reins to shape your destiny. With retro-inspired graphics electrified by modern visual effects and a soundtrack that's nothing short of auditory excellence, nostalgia meets innovation at every turn. Here, your choices aren't just part of the story; they are the story, affecting gameplay and leading to a multitude of paths and endings.

Your Mission:

As Silas, alongside the astute and benevolent businesswoman Li Wei, embark on a quest not just for wealth but for worthiness. The love of your life, Evelyn, awaits, symbolizing your deepest ambitions and moral dilemmas. Will you rise as Urdin's savior, uplifting the downtrodden and challenging the status quo, or will you seize power at any cost, becoming the very embodiment of the corporate tyranny you despised?

Gameplay Highlights:

Empower Your Empire: From dusty outposts to bustling metropolises, stake your claim on Urdin. Build, expand, and dominate through strategic alliances, resource management, and technological supremacy.

Strategize & Embark: Choose your path through a complex web of factional alliances and rivalries. Every mission, from exploration to combat, shapes the future of your empire and the planet.

Engage & Conquer: Master the art of negotiation, combat, and diplomacy. Your choices in these arenas will either cement your legacy or be your downfall.

Adapt & Overcome: In a world where the only constant is change, adapt your strategies to outwit competitors and secure your place at the top of the food chain.

Key Features:

Nostalgic Yet Modern: A unique blend of retro graphics and modern effects paired with AAA-quality sound design.

Deep Narrative Choices: Story choices that directly impact character development, gameplay dynamics, and the intricate politics of Urdin.

Complex Progression System: Grow your wealth, clout, and reputation to unlock new opportunities, technologies, and allies.

A World Alive: Urdin is a planet teeming with life, conflicts, and stories. Your actions will either uplift it or plunge it further into despair.

"Prospect Renegade" is not just a game; it's an odyssey for the ambitious, a challenge for the strategic mind, and a home for those who seek to rewrite the rules of power and redemption. Will you be the hero Urdin needs, or its ultimate conqueror?

Designed for players who cherish the challenge of yesteryears' games and despise modern exploitative practices, "Prospect Renegade" promises a polished, profound experience that respects its audience as much as it challenges them. Join us on this epic journey to redefine what it means to be a legend.

data.name: Beyond Dawn
data.detailed_description:
The city sleeps. Scavenge it before it wakes.

Leave your shelter after dark, search abandoned buildings and rooftops, and bring something home before sunrise. Bank salvage, improve your equipment, and decide how much farther you can afford to go. Beyond Dawn is a single-player exploration game set in the world of Liminal Protocol, with a city above you and an increasingly unfamiliar network of caverns below.

Look beneath the surface

The world is rendered in three-dimensional ASCII, with real lighting, depth and movement. Your Lattice implant lets you tune that view: shallow levels reveal navigation, while deeper levels expose disturbances and hidden records. Decode what you find, pin a route, and keep recovered clues in your archive.

Make it home before dawn

Climb through the city, cross rooftops with a winch or Vector Jets, avoid patrols, and search for salvage. Extract to keep what you have found, or push into another district. Back underground, use the Foundry to upgrade your equipment and choose your movement rig. Practice rooms let you learn the controls without risking your supplies.

A place to return

Your lair is a workshop and a home. Arrange its living space, expand into the caves, and prepare for your next departure. A lower hatch leads to four connected depths, through service galleries and freight fissures to an entrance beneath Liminal Corp. Return alive with evidence and specimens to open further investigations.

Work across the timeline

The Observation Station connects the city, the Research Lab and Wasteland. In the lab, work with physical instruments: restore a receiver circuit, study a mineral core, and reconstruct a signal through fragments of glass.

Wasteland explores a possible future of the same world. Follow a survivor's radio requests, recover supplies and face threats in the ruined streets and lower facility. Repair equipment in an earlier era, then select an altered future to see its consequences: an emergency locker, a drained storeroom, or a working underground return lift.

In active development

The current game includes repeatable city expeditions, shelter upgrades and decorating, connected cavern missions, Wasteland missions, laboratory activities, and an archive of the story you have recovered. These systems and their pacing are still being developed. The complete story is not finished.

Beyond Dawn is a standalone game in the Liminal Protocol setting. The separate Liminal Protocol campaign is not included.
