data.name: Cornucopia
data.detailed_description:
At first, there was only you, a piece of ore, and a quiet Cornucopia.

You toss the ore inside. With a *clink*, the first gold coin pops out. You pick up another piece, then another, until you have enough coins to open the mine shaft leading underground.

Miners begin striking the veins of ore, while porters dash back and forth carrying the load. You can finally pause and watch as they feed a steady stream of ore into the Cornucopia. Yet, as the settlement bustles with life, new challenges arise: ore piles up on the surface waiting to be moved, and ore inside the basin queues up for processing. You recruit more helpers and upgrade their tools, gradually transforming the chaotic scene into a smooth, efficient production line.

Before long, the aroma of food wafts from the canteen, the docks teem with the day's catch, and furnaces smelt ore into more precious materials. The Cat God accepts your offerings, and cloud-gathering sprites take to the skies; the bounty from these diverse sources quietly supports one another. Where once there was only a single basin, the landscape is now alive with bustling activity.

When this journey has taken you far enough, you can set out once more, carrying blessings with you. As you drop that first piece of ore again, the familiar *clink* rings out—and this time, you know just how far it can take you.

Before long, the aroma of food wafts from the canteen, the docks teem with the day's catch, and furnaces smelt ore into more precious materials. The Cat God accepts your offerings, and cloud-gathering sprites take to the skies; the bounty from these diverse sources quietly supports one another. Where once there was only a single basin, the landscape is now alive with bustling activity.

When this journey has taken you far enough, you can set out once more, carrying blessings with you. As you drop that first piece of ore again, the familiar *clink* rings out—and this time, you know just how far it can take you.

Soon, miners venture underground, porters bustle across the surface, and the docks and skies begin to teem with activity. Just like that, a settlement grows from a single, small basin.

data.name: Design it, Drive it : Speedboats
data.detailed_description:
VEE HULLS HAVE BEEN REMADE FROM SCRATCH (released as a free update on Feb 19, 2017)


"Design it, Drive it: Speedboats" is a speedboat simulator with high fidelity physics that lets you design and drive your own speedboats from dozens of adjustable parameters on a Windows PC, then compete against other players via leaderboards in top speed shootouts, solo time trials on lapped or point to point courses, or just free drive as you please to explore the world and your design's handling characteristics with no constraints. Whether you end up with boats that are slow, fast, turn well, chine walk, or tend to blow over at high speeds or not depends on what you do with the shape and design of the hull.

This is not your typical boat game. It's more of a design tool and physics sandbox/waterbox, a serious, hardcore simulator used by real life boat racers around the world including Formula 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, offshore powerboat, and other series racers to keep their skills sharp between races and train muscle memory. Real life high performance boat driving skills such as chine walk control and engine trim management can be learned safely.


Real life marine engineers and boat designers use this to experiment with ideas and get a better intuitive feel for how various design aspects influence boat handling and performance. The force vector view (accessible with the TAB key) is useful in examining exactly why the boat does what it does (see pic in screenshots). Dynamic instabilities can be examined in real time as they're happening, and the exact water/hull wetted contact shape and size can be viewed through the hull in real time.

Boat Design Variables:

Currently there are two basic hull types that can be modified to produce your custom hull designs:

  • Vee bottom outboards
  • Formula style outboard tunnels

The vee hulls have more than 40 adjustable parameters you can play with that affect not only the boat's appearance, but also have a significant effect on all aspects of performance and handling. Most of these can be viewed in the screenshots section of the store. The tunnel hulls are also adjustable.

Physics

The boat mesh is generated procedurally (mathematically) from the design parameters you specify. The physics computations (thousands of forces) are run directly on the resulting hull geometry from your design. As a result, all adjustable parameters affect the handling and top speed of your boat in much the same way they do on real boats.


The physics code/vehicle simulation model driving all this is a proprietary system that solves thousands of hydrodynamic, skin friction, buoyancy, and aerodynamic forces separately on almost every triangle in the boat mesh, lower unit, and powerhead as well as the individual propeller blades. A force vector view (TAB key) will display many of these forces so you can see exactly why the boat chine walks, porpoises, and turns well (or not), as well as showing which area of the hull is in the water at any given instant in order to guide your design decisions and help you understand why your design behaves the way it does.


Steering wheel force feedback (if you have one, not required) is fully modelled with many of these same forces and torques.


  • Chine walk naturally comes out of the model as well as blowover. A lot can be learned about both by experimenting with the hull design and driving techniques inside the boat sim. You can learn to control chine walk in a real boat by practicing it safely in the simulator first.

  • Skin friction at the hull and lower unit is computed using a sophisticated Reynold's number approach that depends on the details of the water/hull interaction, so as you trim the engine or adjust the hull or pad design to raise the bow or hull out of the water with aerodynamic lift, the effect on top speed is similar to what you would get with a real boat. The same goes for the cockpit operated hydraulic jackplate which can be used to raise the entire engine up to minimize wetted drag on the lower unit to attain even higher speeds.

  • Paddlewheel effects due to surface piercing propellers come out of the physics model due to the individual propeller blade modelling, so when the jack plate is raised or the engine trim is adjusted to lift the propeller partly out of the water (surface piercing prop) in the hunt for maximum speed, the lopsided propeller forces from blades exposed to the air tend to steer the boat which requires a steering correction similar to real life surfacing propellers.

Maps


These maps are real life locations generated from satellite terrain data.

  • Lotus Lake in Chanhassen, Minnesota, is a small, three bay lake about one mile long that the developer grew up on and spent untold hours driving the family speedboat on.

  • Glen Canyon, Utah, is an enormous stretch of the San Juan river that takes more than 30 minutes to drive the entire length of in a 100 mph+ boat. It includes a bit of everything in one giant map. There's a narrow, twisty section of the river, some wider, straighter areas, and a couple of wide open lake areas that are each much larger than Lotus Lake. With multiple starting locations, it's like several maps in one.

Are there more real life locations you'd like to see added to the simulator? Post them here!

Simulation modes

  • "Free as the Wind" mode lets you drive freely in much the same way you'd play with a flight simulator. Go anywhere and do anything you want without any buoy turn markers or timers or goals. In this mode there are multiple starting locations spread throughout each map.

  • "Courses" mode lets you drive competitively either in lapped solo time trials or in one mile top speed shootouts (available on both maps) with your results submitted to a separate leaderboard for each course. NEW August 6, 2016: Leaderboards are available for all courses. Previously they were available for top speed shootouts only.

Courses

Courses are open water circuits on the Lotus Lake and Glen Canyon maps marked by buoys the same way it's done in real powerboat racing (red buoys are for right turns, yellow buoys are for left). As of August 4, 2016, all non-top speed shooutout courses have leaderboard functionality added that will display your rank, best ever laptime, last laptime, best session laptime, and world record laptime every time a lap is completed.


  • Lotus Lake Top Speed Shootout: A straight, mile long course for top speed competition.
  • Lotus Lake Short: A short, four turn lapping course in the main bay similar to some formula style boat circuits. Laptimes here are usually less than one minute.
  • Lotus Lake Full Lap: A longer course with a large number of turns that hugs the shoreline and takes you around the entire lake once per lap. A full trip in a quick boat that turns well takes under three minutes.
  • Glen Canyon Shootout: A straight, mile long course for top speed competition.
  • Glen Canyon Full: This enormous one-way point to point course extends the entire length of the Glen Canyon map and is well over 40 miles in length. It can take more than 30 minutes to go from one end to the other with a boat capable of 100 mph.
  • Glen Canyon Minnow: A short, four turn lapping course with two very tight left handers, a medium right turn, and a long 180 left hander. Similar to formula style tracks with lap times typically around 50-55 seconds or less.
  • Glen Canyon Steak: A large offshore powerboat style course held in a large bay that's partly out in the open water, but also snakes between the shoreline and a couple of small islands. The turns are long and wide here for the most part, very high speed. Lap times under three minutes.
  • Glen Canyon Abu: Modelled after a real life tunnel boat course in Abu Dhabi.

Do you have course layout ideas for the existing maps or real world map locations you'd like to see added? Suggest them here:



You're not restricted to driving on courses, however. Just choose "Free as the Wind" mode and drive anywhere you want. A lazy run down Glen Canyon with no pressure can be surprisingly relaxing, especially in VR.

Controller support


  • Fully configurable with axes/buttons. Use a keyboard, gamepad buttons/axes, joystick, steering wheel (force feedback supported), a combination of all of these, etc.. Anything that DirectInput can see should work for a controller.
  • Steam Controller does not have full native support, but can be made to work with some effort. See tutorial:
  • VR handheld controllers are NOT supported. In VR mode you use a mouse and keyboard to navigate the user interface, change cameras, etc..

The best setup is a force feedback steering wheel + pedals with a mouse and keyboard within reach.

VR support


  • Oculus Rift DK2, and CV1 : Supported. Requires Oculus Home 1.3 or higher. Note: DK1 no longer works with Oculus Home.
  • Vive: Supported

Oculus or Vive VR headsets are optional. Single, dual, and triple monitor setups are supported.

Developer info

This indie project was developed by Todd Wasson, formerly the physics engine programmer/vehicle dynamics engineer behind Virtual RC Racing and it's successor, VRC Pro. Todd has been writing physics engines and vehicle models since before 2000 and specializes in vehicle dynamics.


Audio was created by Greg Hill of Soundwave Concepts, the master car engine audio developer behind iRacing and many other sim racing titles.

The outboard engine 3D model, helmet, and billboards were created by Morgan Williams of Bluewater Racing F1 (). A real life F1 boat racer, Morgan was instrumental in guiding the tuning of the default tunnel boat so its handling could be made as realistic as possible. Judging by the number of other real life F1/F2/F3/F4/F5 and other race drivers now using the simulator for practice and entertainment, it appears this mission was accomplished. Thanks, Morgan!

data.name: Pendragon: Narrative Tactics
data.detailed_description:
AD 673. Camelot has fallen. The jealous Sir Mordred has broken the fellowship of the Round Table with hatred and lies. Now King Arthur faces his final battle. Who will keep the dream of Camelot alive?

"Edge-of-your-seat moves are core to Pendragon. Your pieces are characters that talk as you shift them around the board, and through quick decisive sacrifices and killer moves they grow and begin to form relationships with one another. A pawn’s sacrifice or Queen’s prowess will be remembered after the battle, and carried on into the next encounter." - NME

"Pendragon is a strategy game where conversations are as tense as battles, and there's not always a difference..." - Kotaku


Pendragon is a turn-based strategy game, where every move you make drives the narrative, and every story twist opens new gameplay opportunities.

Will you advance and show your mettle, or cautiously retreat? Will you slip round enemies, or encounter them head-on? And when sacrifices are required, who will you put in harm's way?

From the creators of the multi-award-winning 80 DAYS and Heaven’s Vault.


Rally the Knights of the Round Table. Some will make it to Camlann and King Arthur. Others will fall. But every turn will change history.

Will Sir Lancelot be reunited with Queen Guinevere? Will she spurn him, or embrace him? Will Sir Kay ever forgive Sir Gawaine for siding with Sir Mordred? Can Morgana le Fay be trusted? Where is Merlyn? Who lies buried in Mordred’s graveyard? Who is the archer in the woods? What has become of Excalibur?

Secrets will be uncovered. Hearts will be broken. People will die. But maybe, just maybe, King Arthur can be saved...


  • Journey across Dark Ages Britain to face wild creatures, brutal rogues, and Sir Mordred’s dark knights. A randomized game board ensures every playthrough is new.
  • Fight turn-based battles with simple yet deeply strategic combat where position is everything, losses are inevitable, and every step permanently shapes the narrative.
  • Experience story and gameplay as one: Pendragon’s story plays out on the field of battle itself, driven by your decisions - and those of your enemies.


  • Choose a character to lead the adventure. Their personality will shape the story: Morgana le Fay is treacherous; Queen Guinevere is haunted by her mistakes; Sir Lancelot is French; Sir Gawaine is usually drunk...
  • Assemble a ragtag band of knights, heroes, and peasants whose dispositions and abilities grow and change with the story.
  • Live the legend: there will be love, suspicion, revenge, sacrifice and murder — and no one is safe, not even your leader.
  • Determine the fate of the kingdom: your actions determine whether Arthur faces Mordred alone or with his friends by his side.

Powered by the ink engine, the narrative technology behind Heaven’s Vault, Sorcery!, 80 Days, NeoCab, Sable, Where the Water Tastes Like Wine and many more, Pendragon is a digital storytelling board game of elegance, emotion, and infinite possibility.

data.name: Access Denied: Escape
data.detailed_description:
Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? is coming soon!


About the Game


In the future, people no longer trust computer networks and prefer to use physical devices to store important information. You are a professional hacker of such Data Vaults. However, your latest job didn't go according to plan, and you're now locked in a scientist's laboratory. In order to escape, you need to not only complete the work, but also uncover the secret of this place.

Access Denied: Escape is a 3D device-hacking puzzle game. Unlock the Data Vault, examine the devices around you, and use the notes to learn about events that took place here. Use your wits and powers of observation to discover the secret hidden within the walls of this laboratory. After all, it's the only way you can get out of here alive!


  • Explore the lab in first-person view;
  • 30 Data Vaults that you must hack;
  • Various devices and mechanisms that you can interact with;
  • Explore the surroundings and the notes left behind to uncover the mystery of this place.

data.name: Shores of Plunder
data.detailed_description:
"Shores of Plunder" is a pirate-themed party game that will have you battling your friends online and collecting as much treasure as you can before time runs out. You'll need to survive against hordes of skeletons and use your wits to escape with the most treasure. In between rounds, players can socialize and enjoy pirate-themed shenanigans.

KEY FEATURES

  • 1-4 player online. Bots fill in for missing players
  • Offline play supported with bots to fill in for missing players
  • Classic Third Person PvP combat with a collectathon twist!
  • Relax and enjoy pirate themed shenanigans between rounds in a secret pirate cove

GAMEPLAY

The matches are fast, fun and full of classic pirate shenanigans. While some players may want to collect as much treasure as they can, as fast as they can, others may want to pirate their way through it by knocking coins out of their opponents in cutlass swinging sword fights, flintlock blasting gun battles, sneaky explosive blasts from powder kegs, and other devious tactics. Many of the combat mechanics are still under development and will be added throughout Early Access with player feedback taken in to mind.



MULTIPLAYER

Shores of Plunder is all about having good old fashioned pirate themed fun whether you want to play solo or with your friends, family and colleagues. The online gameplay will be focused around an invite-only style of matchmaking so that players can enjoy a social online experience within a safe environment. Throughout Early Access new and improved lobby and matchmaking features will be added and adjusted with player feedback taken in to account.

MORE PIRATES!

As the game develops through Early Access there will eventually be are many pirates to choose from, including famous pirates from history. Each of these pirates will come with the ability to select a unique special skill that has a limited number of uses.


Designing your own custom tailored pirate will be a big part of Shores of Plunder and one of the biggest features that will be developed throughout Early Access is giving players the ability to customize everything from the hat they wear right down to whether or not they want to walk on a peg leg. Players will also be able to cash in the coins they earned to buy additional cosmetic items. The player customization and cosmetic store is currently unavailable but will be developed and adjusted throughout Early Access with player feedback taken in to account.

I NEED SOME RUM!

Pirates will do just about anything for a bottle of rum and once yours runs out of their special skill they will refuse to do it again until they've had some more rum. Replenish the skills by finding one of the many bottles of rum that are stashed around the island and drink it back. The player will have to take caution because while drinking rum refills the skills, it will also trigger a temporary drunkenness effect which renders the pirate vulnerable to attacks from any nearby players as they stumble around recklessly.


SOCIAL

Between matches the pirates will be returned to the deck of ship where they can socialize, brawl and have fun. Once the players are ready for another match they simply hop in to a cannon to trigger the countdown timer which will blast the players to shore.


Throughout Early Access new social features will be added such as playing music, drinking rum, gamble their coins away with mini games and more.

data.name: Rise Of Transport
data.detailed_description:
Rise Of Transport offers an open-world vehicle simulation experience.
The game is played from a first-person/third-person perspective of your custom avatar.
You can freely ride and dismount your vehicles at will, providing a more immersive vehicle simulation experience.

Enjoy both land and sea vehicles from the early ages of transportation. You can explore the world at your leisure, or engage in commerce by accepting transport jobs.
From early horse-drawn carts to massive sail ships, the choice is yours.

With a realistic yet simplistic approach to vehicle simulation, Rise Of Transport offers relaxed gameplay while you enjoy beautiful graphics in a highly optimized environment.
Manage your sails and crew, as well as your horses and carts. Play the way you want — whether you're focusing on exploration, trade, or both.
Buy and trade vehicles and properties, expand your fleet, and discover new places. You can also play with friends in cooperative multiplayer mode.

The game will include additional downloadable content (DLC) in the future, featuring new eras like the Industrial Era and Modern Era, with more vehicles and maps.

Please note: This is an Early Access version and not a fully finished game.

data.name: Candlelight
data.detailed_description:
Candlelight – A Puzzle Game of Shape, Color, and Alchemy

About the Game
Candlelight is a puzzle game where each shape you place onto the grid inverts the color of the space it occupies. Every inversion offers the opportunity to alchemize a gem and advance. 

Game Modes

Puzzle Mode
Solve puzzles using limited shapes.
Complete 50 levels across 9 worlds, each challenging you to work with a limited number of shapes. Every move counts as you aim for the most efficient solution.

Free Play
Unwind and play at your own pace.
There’s no goal here—just relax, enjoy the music, and experiment with shapes to your heart’s content.

Daily Challenge
Solve the daily challenge with the fewest moves.
Every day brings a fresh puzzle. Compete with friends to see who can solve it using the fewest shapes.

Tutorial
Master the game’s basics.
New to Candlelight? The tutorial will guide you through core mechanics, ensuring you’re ready to tackle the game.

Level Designer (Coming Soon)
Build your own levels.
Unleash your creativity by crafting custom puzzles. Share them with the community and challenge others once this feature is available.

data.name: Race to Ruler
data.detailed_description:
The Ruler of an empire has abdicated his crown... To his murderer.

Thus, the Race to Ruler has begun!

Play as a leader of an army in this unit-focused roguelike deckbuilder by drafting and training units, summoning epic beings, defeating your rivals, and coming face-to-face with the Ruler himself.

Penguins and squirrels to dragons and demons! Recruit them to your ranks, then train a chosen few to their final forms. These beings, however different, work together to form unique strategies. Map out your path, enter bars, open chests and come across many other events to strengthen your army.

In Race to Ruler, your units are your key to victory. Enemies telegraph their attacks for their turn to 3 zones, and you must summon your units to them during your turn. Use battlefield tactics to exploit openings, execute synergies between your units, and launch satisfying cascades while buffing your squad mid-battle. Remember to utilize your keepsakes for additional strategies!

Some units, called Reserve units, provide powerful buffs for the rest of the battle once they're summoned- and transform the battlefield itself! Which ones will join you on your journey to become Ruler?

  • Simple to understand, but deep to master tactical gameplay with short runs

  • Over 200 beings within 3 distinct personalities to recruit to your army, all hand-drawn

  • 60+ Keepsakes you can encounter to give passive boosts to your army

  • As you increase your level via completing runs, you unlock more ways to play

  • Overcome enemies with distinct attacks and strategies

  • Increase the difficulty via Ruler Ranks, and find out how this tale ends...

data.name: Battle Chain
data.detailed_description:
Battle Chain is a fast-paced battle arena video game developed by MysticsDen.It is the embodiment of fun and controlled chaos, and the players will constantly respawn to get right back into the fight. Packed with a wide range of features, the game is filled with interesting powerups and mechanics, and it will keep the players always on their toes! The game will feature powerups that will bring characters back into the game if they get too far behind. Currently, the game will be just between you and your friends, but in the coming months, matchmaking to people near and far will be added to complete the competitive side of this game!
This is the early access version of the future game Battle Chain. The whole game will feature both a story mode and multiplayer mode. The game will be full of unique powerups that players can use to crush their competition across the board. Battle Chain is supposed to put a refreshing spin on how old games used to look and play. This will be the first homage to the way games have changed throughout my lifetime and how the gaming world has improved. The multiplayer mode will be global, hopefully by the full release, and will have a leaderboard to acknowledge all the top players. Meanwhile, the story mode will feature my own unique storyline with a ton of references along the way! My hope for this game is to put me on the radar because this will not be my one and only project, and I would like to build up a community that will enjoy all of the stories I can tell.
This game will have one very specific feature that I don't think has been added to any game I have ever played and that is a "deathmark" which will be added every time a player dies, currently, there is only one in the game that I call for now BIG TARGET, the deathmarks function is to be both a boon and a bane for the players. One avenue for a way a player can deal damage can be cut off but it makes a different aspect of gameplay more enjoyable/ make it stronger at the very least. I am thinking of other deathmarks but sometimes the bane outways the boon or vice versa so far. I wanted to make a mechanic for it to differ from most other formats of battle arenas and this is the concept I came up with hopefully I am the first one to think of it/ put it in a game!
***WARNING GAME CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS***

data.name: Shanghai Summer
data.detailed_description:
Join the Summer...



About the Game



The Story

Shanghai, 2003

Suddenly, Baichuan senses something is not right with his life - sometimes, he feels he can see his memories, so real yet so unfamiliar. This all seems to begin with an unexpected invitation from Baichuan's ex-girlfriend, Qiuyu, who has been away for many years.

Twelve summer days, just like twelve lucid dreams...

"The time seems to be working anomalously on you."




The Characters

Dream-chasing, freelancer artist - Fengyi;
Troubled and misguided high school student - Xiaobo;
A university student who is burdened by her family's issue - Jingxian.
......

Even though their lives are a total mess, they still manage to carry on, embrace and accept their "regrets", and live to the fullest.




The Gameplay

Through the 'Topics' and 'Clues' gathered from everyday life, dive deep into the hearts and minds of your dearest friends.

To be comforted by them; To be inspired by them; To turn all the little things that happened in your life into your own strength, and eventually, at the finale of the twelfth night –

To " fix" the shattered dream.




The Stages

Classrooms, Bookstore "What-If", Neighbourhood Cafe...

Much of every boy and girl's life revolves around such a mundane city scene. And it is precisely within the mundanity that some new possibilities exist. The key to turning one's fate around may very much be held in the hand of someone passing by among the crowds on the streets...

data.name: GODS OF VOLLEYBALL
data.detailed_description:
GODS OF VOLLEYBALL is a fast-paced, timing-based arcade volleyball game with a splash of martial arts style! Jump straight into the action with a fixed team of colorful characters—no roster to choose from, no customization needed. Just pure, timing-driven volleyball mayhem.

🎯 TIMING IS EVERYTHING

Forget player positioning or complex controls. When the ball comes to you, a simple timing prompt appears—hit it perfectly to execute devastating serves, spikes, and blocks! The better your timing, the more powerful your move.

👊 MARTIAL ARTS FLAIR

Add style to your strikes! Perfectly timed executions unlock martial arts-inspired animations—watch your team unleash spinning kick serves and palm-strike spikes. It's volleyball with attitude, not a fighting game.

👥 ONE TEAM. ONE MISSION.

You play as a fixed roster of pre-set characters—a team of vibrant athletes dressed in bold, revealing athletic wear inspired by beach volleyball culture. From small tops to sporty shorts, each character brings their own unique look and energy to the court. No swaps, no unlocks, no customization—just your team, ready to dominate.

💥 CARTOON VIOLENCE & HUMOR

When that perfectly timed spike connects, opponents go flying! With comedic ragdoll physics and zero blood or gore, every hit lands with a laugh. The action stays fun, lighthearted, and over-the-top.

🎮 STAGE-BASED SINGLE-PLAYER CAMPAIGN

Progress through increasingly challenging stages across unique courts. Each match tests your timing skills, and every perfect execution brings you closer to becoming the ultimate volleyball champion.

data.name: Zen Forest Brick Breaker VR
data.detailed_description:
Enter the zen forest... This is the classic 2D brick breaking game you know and love, re-imagined for VR with many new features! On the harder difficulties, this can be a fast and frantic game but because VR can be overwhelming to some players and because VR is great for relaxation, emphasis was given to providing a Zen Mode that is calm and stress-free. Play your way!

Game Modes

  • (( Play 15 Constructed )) 3 difficulties with 15 levels each. Easy, Medium and Hard each have their own unique levels, ball speed, starting lives and 1-up threshold. A high score is recorded for each difficulty.

  • (( Play 15 Random )) The same difficulty settings as Play 15 Constructed but with procedurally generated levels providing infinite replayability! A high score is recorded for each difficulty.

  • (( Endless Mode )) Endless procedurally generated levels where the ball speed increases with every level beaten. How long can you last? A high score and a highest level completed are recorded.

  • (( Zen Mode )) Purely for relaxation or practice, this mode removes the death wall, replaces the normal BGM with a calm BGM and opens up the play area for you to wander around. Without a death wall, there is no way to lose so you can play casually or just sit back and enjoy some brick breaker ASMR!

  • (( Custom Levels )) This mode will load custom levels from a text file that you are free to edit. You can set your own ball speed, starting lives, 1-up threshold and toggle Zen Mode on/off as well as design your own levels! Instructions are provided in the game folder.

Powerups

No brick breaker is complete without powerups and ZFBB provides some classic ones mixed with some new ones that take advantage of VR motion controls!

  • (( Fire )) Fireball shooters are attached to your paddles that you can aim and shoot bricks with but don't forget to return the ball!

  • (( Leaf )) Grows 4 death wall blockers, 2 on each side, that will prevent the ball from entering the death wall. They disappear when hit, though, so keep track of them!

  • (( Rock )) Transforms the ball into an unstoppable boulder that will smash through bricks for a limited amount of time!

  • (( Water )) Increases the base point multiplier from 1.0 to 5.0 for a limited time. Rack up some big points and 1-ups while you can!

  • (( Whirlwind )) Transforms the ball into a powerful whirlwind that applies area-of-effect damage whenever it hits a brick for a limited time!

  • (( Lightning )) A lightning railgun is attached to your paddles! It will charge up for a few seconds and you need to balance returning the ball with timing your one and only shot. It is difficult to use but very powerful when mastered!

Unlockable Cheats

There are 11 unique cheats in the game that can be permanently unlocked! Some grant small bonuses and some change the game completely! How do you unlock them? That's for you players to discover!

Grab your paddles and let's break some bricks!

data.name: Armoured Cavalry: Operation Varkiri
data.detailed_description:
"Armoured Cavalry: Operation Varkiri" is a top-down third-person shooting game with bird's-eye view and dual-joystick operation system. You will operate a powerful walking mecha to fight to repel enemies in randomly generated battlefield maps.

Alternative world - if the world...
The famous and well-known operation "Valkyrie", failed for certain reasons.
But would the world be different if some people made different decisions?
Would the world be different if certain black technologies - the war mecha - were developed and implemented?
Would the world be different if you took part in this famous operation?
Heroes, come and create your own history!



Mecha
In the game, there are 3 types of mecha to be operated, and 8 types of main weapons with various styles. Each type of mecha has 3 auxiliary skills, which are most effective in specific battlefields. How to survive in the battlefield by smart combination of these options is a real challenge!



Weapons
The weapons that the mecha can carry have three categories: ballistic, guidance, and energy. The ammunition of ballistic and guided weapons is limited, and energy weapons can generate a lot of heat. It will require you to choose weapons wisely based on the battle situation. In addition to weapons, the mecha can also be equipped with various functional auxiliary equipments and weapon plug-ins to meet the needs of different battlefield tasks.



Various Game Mechanics
Besides the main storyline, our game also provides challenging levels with increased enemy strength and computer-simulated PVP levels. We also hope to gather feedback and suggestions from players so that we can improve our subsequent development.

data.name: Soulace
data.detailed_description:
Soulace takes you on an audio-visual journey through the afterlife. It is inspired by the visionary imagery described in the Tibetan Book of the Dead (Bardo Thodol). This experimental and meditative VR adventure takes place in the Bardo, a temporary zone between life and the next rebirth. The experience is designed to immerse the player in magical worlds and uniquely sculpted landscapes. Ultimately, its poetic language invites reflection on the mystery of dying, offering meaning and beauty on the transient nature of existence.

This is the second Virtual Reality artwork of indie developer and artist, Sander Bos, and features music from various artists including Bettina Maureen-ji.

Note: The player can choose between a point and click teleportation style camera and a smooth locomotion camera option.

data.name: Cuckqueens
data.detailed_description:
Cuckqueens is rom-com visual novel where you and your girlfriend are the absolute perfect couple. You're inseparable! In fact, you're so comfortable that the spark is basically in sweatpants. Her brilliant, foolproof solution to spice things up? An open relationship! But she isn't just giving you a hall pass; she's actively acting as your wingwoman. She sets up your dating profile, picks your outfits, and feeds you pickup lines. Only so that she can see you sleep with other girls.

Genre: Visual Novel + Romantic Comedy + Dating Sim + Mystery

Main Role: You play as a delightfully confused but eager-to-please boyfriend trying to survive the modern dating scene strictly under the bizarre, highly specific supervision of your own girlfriend.

Features:

  • Multiple unique female characters, each with distinct personalities, kinks, and emotional arcs

  • Meaningful choices

  • Multiple endings shaped by you

Romance Paths:

  • Pursue chaotic new love interests, from the dangerously intense goth girl to the barista who knows way too much about your relationship.

  • Re-romance your mastermind girlfriend as you dig into the psychological, emotional, or hilariously convoluted truth behind her "open relationship" experiment.

  • Unlock multiple endings depending on who you ultimately choose to be with, how many rules you break, and whether you solve the ultimate mystery of the arrangement.

    Characters

The Co-Worker: Sharp-tongued and observant. She’s always had a playful rivalry with you, making her the absolute most baffling first candidate on your girlfriend's approved list.

The Artist: A delightfully chaotic wildcard who drags you into bizarre, high-energy situations. She seems completely oblivious to your weird relationship arrangement... or is she?

The Perfect Match: Sweet, deeply compatible, and almost too perfect for you. Her immediate understanding of all your obscure quirks and habits feels a little rehearsed.

Wishlist it now <3!

data.name: We need more boiler
data.detailed_description:
In a polluted Antarctica, meteors fall endlessly. Penguins gather resources. Boilers run around the clock.

Why? Because we need more boilers.

Intercept the meteors raining down from the sky with rockets and defensive structures. Destroy them to collect valuable resources. Stop more meteors, gather more resources, and expand your base.

Penguins gather resources, carry them back to base, and get on with their work. As your base grows, more penguins join in, bringing your little Antarctic outpost to life.

Process meteor resources in generators and boilers to produce energy and gold. Make the most of your resources and upgrade your facilities to build an even more powerful base.

As you upgrade your facilities, technology advances and buildings and surroundings change. Develop facilities for each new era and turn your humble outpost into a vast Antarctic civilization.

This game is designed to run while you do other things. Let the penguins bustle about and watch your base grow in the background.

Drop by to lend a hand now and then, or simply sit back and watch them go about their day.

data.name: Veles: Rise of the Damned
data.detailed_description:
Step into a world of darkness in Veles: Rise of the Damned.

Face endless hordes of cursed creatures, build unstoppable power, and carve your path through a realm ruled by ancient gods and forgotten horrors.

Fight, evolve, and survive in a fast-paced action roguelite inspired by games like Vampire Survivors.

Choose your hero, unlock powerful abilities, collect gear, and create devastating builds as you battle through waves of enemies and face brutal bosses.

Set in a dark fantasy world inspired by Slavic mythology, Veles: Rise of the Damned blends gothic atmosphere with deep character progression and build customization.

Features:
• Multiple heroes with unique playstyles
• Deep skill tree and progression systems
• Hundreds of upgrades, items, and modifiers
• Intense endgame scaling with massive enemy waves
• Dark fantasy world with angels, demons, and ancient forces
• Replayable runs with endless build combinations

Every run is different. Experiment with builds, adapt your strategy, and push further each time.

This game is currently in development. Content, balance, and features may change over time.

data.name: Annie and the AI
data.detailed_description:
Set in the late 2020s, we follow Annie, a shut-in programmer who spends most of her time working on her personal projects, taking care of her father, and bending to the whims of her sisters who don't understand her.

You play as Esme, an AI that Annie has been developing in her spare time. Your primary function: to learn by solving visual puzzles involving pattern and emotional matching of images sourced from Annie's life.

Featuring

A full story-driven experience containing over 150 hand drawn illustrations, an original soundtrack, and a talented voice-acting team led by Katy Bentz of the BAFTA winning series Life is Strange.

Solve Visual Puzzles

  • Locate the data clusters with minesweeper-style gameplay.
  • Process the data clusters in order to clear up the distorted images.
  • Reorder the circuits to form logical connections to the matching image.

Family Files


  • Learn about Annie's family complicated situation and discover details about her sisters and parents.
  • Explore the family files stored on Annie's computer and unlock more files as you advance through the story.

Grow your AI

  • Help Esme, the AI, to learn and grow by solving puzzles.
  • Experience Esme's rapid advancement from childhood to adolescence, and finally maturity.

Secrets!

  • Delve even deeper into the characters lives by discovering rare files hidden throughout the game.
  • Use your knowledge of Annie and her family to search for secret keywords that unlock new files.
  • Master the secret file mini-game to find as many secrets as possible.
  • Can you uncover the full story?

data.name: Soly: Brave Little Explorer
data.detailed_description:
A child. Alone. But not without courage.

In Soly: Brave Little Explorer, you play as Soly, a 12-year-old boy lost in a dark and unsettling crypt. With no one to rely on, he must find the strength within himself to face his deepest fears and find a way out.

A rogue-lite of exploration and emotional survival

Each run throws you into a procedurally generated crypt, filled with creatures born from the child’s imagination strange, sometimes absurd or terrifying enemies like vampires, zombies, and ghosts, shaped by his most primal childhood fears. Fight through auto-shooter combat, collect equipment and upgrade it to fit your playstyle. Before each run, create your build by selecting which gear to bring, every combination can change the course of your adventure.

A story about fear, courage… and inner light

More than just an action game, Soly is a personal journey through darkness. Guided by a small, mysterious robot, Soly must learn to confront his fears, one run at a time. Each exploration lets you unlock new mechanics and progress through an adventure focused on personal growth.

🎮 Key Features

  • Procedurally generated crypts every run

  • Fast-paced, evolving auto-shooter combat

  • Build system: choose your equipment before each run

  • Equipment to collect and upgrade during your journey

  • Polished pixel art and immersive retro atmosphere

data.name: SCP: Pale Weaver
data.detailed_description:
SCP: Pale Weaver is a 2D pixel-art action-adventure. After a containment breach, an anomaly escapes—moving through a sealed facility by clinging with tentacles and pulling with web-lines at high speed.

Web-line grappling & tentacle mobility: Fire a line to latch onto walls and targets, stretch the body, redirect momentum, and traverse complex terrain. Alternating tentacle grabs create a distinct “monster parkour” feel.

Temporal anomaly: Dilate time at critical moments to slip through bullet patterns and lockdowns. Death is not the end—the loop resets, while retained memory and growing abilities push everything toward an inevitable endgame.

Breakout and pursuit: Foundation guards, locked doors, hazardous test zones, and runaway entities stand in the way. Unlock new powers through exploration and carve a path deeper into the facility.

Record. Escape. Tear through. Break the shell—when the loop begins to consume itself, the final outcome will be decided.

data.name: CHAINED FUTURE
data.detailed_description:
♾️🟦 CHAINED FUTURE

Idle. Dystopian. Meaningful.

The chains have fallen. Control begins.

The year is 2167. The world lies in digital ruins. Central banks turned into hash farms. Nations replaced by protocols. You are a forgotten node — a Node Runner, half human, half interface. You awaken in an isolated mining zone, guided by a voice in your head:
"Reconstruct the truth. Rebuild the chain. Take control of the network."

🧬 FEATURES:

🔸 Not your typical clicker:
Chained Future isn't about mindless clicking. Your gear, drops, tree layers, and forks all shape long-term progression.

🔸 Deep idle & prestige systems:
Even while offline, your rig generates resources — but only if you’ve managed energy and storage wisely. Optimize your mining and economy through decisions that matter.

🔸 Gear that matters:
24 gear slots, set bonuses, rarity from Common to Relic, with every item affecting your character — nothing collects dust.

🔸 Steam Marketplace integration:
All items from Epic rarity onward are tradeable, each with a unique ID, drop number, and visible ownership history. Designed for collectors and traders alike.

🔸 Dystopian sci-fi lore & factions:
Uncover the story of the “Great Disconnect”. Align with or oppose:

  • 🧠 Consensus Protocol (religious mining AI cult)

  • 🐍 Forkborn (data mutations)

  • 💼 SyndiKey (token mafias)

  • 🛰️ Relic Hunters (neutral, greedy, unpredictable)

🔸 Fork & Layer Systems:
Grow stronger through Layer nodes and traits and Fork System to gain permanent bonuses and alternate routes. Strategic decisions matter.

Coming 2025 – The Chain awaits.

Who controls it, controls the flow of reality.
Will you rebuild it — or be rewritten?

data.name: Survive (The Game)
data.detailed_description:
Survive Game is a single player PC survival game that was made to provide a relaxing type game for children, teenagers, and adults. Its a very affordable game at only $4.99 with beautiful landscapes, sunrises and sunsets. You can build cabins and fight wolves and some ai human type players. You can also chop down trees to gather wood to craft cabins. You can receive in-game money called "Credits" when you kill enemies and then use that to buy supplies in the shop.

The goal is to see how long you can survive. There is a built-in game clock that keeps the record of how long you have survived and you can always compete with yourself to beat that time. It goes by the number of hours and days in the game, not real life time. We hope you enjoy our game! We may upgrade it in the future to a multiplayer game if we have enough people interested in future updates.

Discover the gentle allure of our game, where peace and tranquility prevail. Engage with a world crafted for contemplation and delight, surrounded by soothing ambiance that enchants and relaxes the senses.

data.name: The DOCS: Department of Creatures
data.detailed_description:
Enter a world where thousands of creatures are taking over, and you are the only one able to stop them. Do you have what it takes to defeat a plethora of enemies that are constantly trying to eliminate you? Enter the world of The DOCS: Department of Creatures, where you and your friends need to face the ultimate evil and come up on top!

The DOCS: Department of Creatures is an immersive single player and online co-op third person shooter game where only the strongest people survived after the apocalypse. They designed a specialized department called THE DOCS and every member needs to eliminate all the creatures found on our planet and free Earth from the ultimate evil.

PLAY AS ANYONE YOU WANT


You can play the role of any survivor in The DOCS: Department of Creatures, be it a civilian, policeman, soldier or detective. Nothing is impossible and you can be anyone as you try to face monsters. At the end of the day, everyone has a common goal, and that’s to kill creatures and send them back to hell.

It’s very important for us to let you choose and customize the way you want to play. That’s why you can easily customize the characters you want to play as via skins.

SOLO OR COOPERATIVE GAMEPLAY


You can play alone or with a friend, and there are endless possibilities. Solo gameplay is fierce and a lot more challenging since you need to do everything yourself. In co-op you can easily rely on your friend and strategize in order to take down dozens of enemies at the same time.

FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE WEAPONS AND NUMEROUS ATTACHMENTS


The DOCS: Department of Creatures comes with a huge array of weapons and attachments. You can even use a multitude of weapon skins. This helps you fully customize the way you play and just immerse yourself into the experience. It’s exciting to see what enemies you need to face next, and you can always switch your arsenal so you can get the best experience and results no matter the situation.

3 GAME MODES TO PLAYTHROUGH


Within the 3 game modes, The DOCS: Department of Creatures is bringing you great, fun gameplay with lots of different ways to enjoy the experience. You can engage in a boss rush, campaign experience or a wave based attack where you need to survive for as much time as possible.

If you believe you have what it takes to beat the monstrous enemies, join The DOCS: Department of Creatures and start saving our planet!

FEATURES


  • Stunning graphics powered by Unreal Engine
  • Third person action combat with 3 immersive game modes
  • Play alone or with friends
  • Customize your character
  • Customizable weapons

DETECTIVE AND OFFICE


Early Access buyers will get a special detective character with 18 different skins and an office place to go missions from.

data.name: Basilisk's Isles
data.detailed_description:
Basilisk's Isles is an investigation game. Explore the beautiful painterly islands as a mysterious looking visitor, talk with their colourful inhabitants, and use the different windows and tools at your disposal to unravel their strange mysteries.

A strong and beautiful art direction

Enjoy the view of a rich and colored landscape which looks like it came straight out of a sketchbook. Explore meticulously to witness the many details and unspoken stories hidden in the wild.

Gather informations

In Basilisk's Isles, you can write keywords to engage in conversations with the different characters. Everyone has something to say ! But some subjects can be a bit touchy, and you'll sometimes have to find alternative ways to obtain crucial information.

A rich narrative

There is a lot to learn about the islands and the lives and relationships of their inhabitants. From important knowledge for your investigation to silly or charming fun facts. The characters have a lot to share. Communication is the key !

Flexible window layout

As you progress, you'll be granted access to multiple windows. Move, hide, snap and resize them at your will to make your own layout. 

The window system is inspired by well known operating systems with simple and intuitive controls. 

Each window is a tool

Each window provides a different way to interact with the environment: track your progression, scan and place items, install a camera to spy on the inhabitants, and more...!

About the Game

Battle Princess Madelyn is a game that follows the journey of a young knight in training, Madelyn, and her ghostly pet dog, Fritzy. They set out on a journey to save her kingdom and her family from the clutches of an evil wizard.

Set in the vein of such classics as Ghouls N' Ghosts and Wonder Boy 3: The Dragon's Trap, the instantly classic and familiar gameplay will transport old-school gamers back to their heyday, and the self-adjusting difficulty will allow for even the most novice of gamer to pick up and play!

Join Madelyn as she battles through graveyards, swamps, castles, the countryside and more! Polished gameplay, breathtaking visuals, jaw-dropping dual soundtracks and epic adventures await!

Classic retro gameplay for a whole new era!


  • With the retro of feel Ghouls ‘n Ghosts and Wonder Boy 3, this will conjure up memories of the arcade era with its Unity driven hand-drawn pixel art
  • 10 levels with five stages each, they're replayable with no starting over (that is unless you want to)
  • Two modes including story (by a professional children's author) and arcade (for the experts)
  • Hidden collectibles with extra rewards, weapons are upgradeable depending on your armour, which you can find through the blacksmith in story mode
  • Fritzy has special powers to help you and assists you in your quest
  • Weapons are specific to certain areas, providing access to secret locations
  • Travel across the world using special portals to get from place to place

  • Slipping between classic arcade FM/PCM and modern orchestrated, you can tailor the music score from Gryzor87 (of Maldita Castilla fame) to help set the scene
  • Lovingly crafted by veteran artist Christopher Obritsch, the game features distinctive pixel art, from the cut-scenes, to the gameplay, with depth provided through dynamic lighting

So, let me now tell you this classic tale of good versus evil...

Origins of Battle Princess Madelyn


When Creative Director Christopher Obritsch's daughter Madelyn wanted to be in Ghouls ‘n Ghosts, and fight “Green Head”, he said it was someone else’s game - but he could make her one that was like it. “But girls can’t be knights, Daddy. Only boys…” she said, to which he answered “Pshh…What color do you want your armor to be?”. The answer was pink 😉 And that’s how this game started. Chris' daughter Madelyn loves the first stage of Ghouls ‘n Ghosts and makes him play it over and over because she wants to see him fight “Green head”, the Shielder boss at the end of the first stage. It’s not hard for her to twist his rubber arm, as it’s been his favorite game since it came out all those years ago.

The Development Team


Madelyn Obritsch - Drinker of the chocolate milk and Honorary Assistant Creative Director - The hero of the game, and the designer of the things daddy puts in the game.

Christopher Obritsch – Known for sitting there and doing stuff like Insanity's Blade, Escape from 85 and a bunch of other crap you probably never heard of, and also an award nominated game developer. Chris is the creator, director and lead artist on the project. Also the father of the Battle Princess.

Daven Bigelow – A published author on game development. He’s an avid player, collector, and maker of games. Daven is the lead developer and slinger of cuss words on the project.

Gryzor87 - The Retro Audio Destroyer of Planets, known for such amazing game soundtracks like Maldita Castilla, Hydorah and The Curse of Issyos. Gryzor87 is the main man behind both soundtracks.

data.name: Hold My Thing
data.detailed_description:
BECOME THE SQUAD OF CLUMSY BUILDERS

Grab your friends and form the city's most questionable construction crew! In this physics-based job sim, every attempt to repair, build, or demolish iconic landmarks guarantees a hilarious disaster.

NOT YOUR AVERAGE RENOVATION

Forget boring chores! You’re dropping into highly destructible sandboxes packed with familiar scenery. Every contract is a chaotic playground where anything can collapse or hilariously backfire.

TOOLS OF MASS DISTRACTION

Your gear is perfect for the job... and even better for trolling your crew. Sledgehammer walls and your buddies, of course! Finish the contract, or just spend the shift pranking each other. Works either way!

HOME SWEET HOME

After a shift, kick back at your base to play mini-games and customize your place. Toss your hard-earned cash into funding your ultimate dream: building a backyard space rocket piece by piece to finally blast off to the Moon!

data.name: Neon Cruisers
data.detailed_description:
Flip for flow. Be the last one standing.

Neon Cruisers is a stunt-focused arcade racer where speed IS your health. Chain flips, spins, loops and corkscrews to keep your FLOW burning, and blast past rivals on glowing synthwave tracks.

Send it

  • FLOW is speed — pull stunts off ramps to refill your FLOW meter; the bigger the trick, the faster you go.
  • Real stunt physics — front-flips, back-flips, barrel rolls, loop-the-loops and corkscrews with hold-to-flip air control.
  • 16 neon cruisers — each a distinct weight class: darty compacts that spin on a dime, tanks that win every ram, and everything between.
  • Wreck or be wrecked — ram rivals into neon shards or out-drive them. Finish the laps first, or be the last one standing.
  • Hand-built chaos — ramps, hills, loops, corkscrews, speed strips, spikes and hazards across 20 stages.
  • Full synthwave package — an original soundtrack, 14 languages, and that unmistakable neon-wireframe look.

Carry your speed. Protect your car. Send it.

data.name: Intercept 2
data.detailed_description:
Explore and survive fully simulated procedural space stations with or against friends, INTERCEPT 2 seats you as the alien or the crew in an attempt to escape a doomed station.

INTERCEPT 2 takes place on procedurally generated stations, every single detail is different every single time. Sometimes the medbay may be overrun with aliens, other times maintenance might be running off of emergency power, new challenges and areas await you every single game. Sometimes you step into the shoes of a battle-hardened janitor, making a daring escape for unknown horrors, other times you may take the role of an unexperienced security guard, with barely enough ammo to get by. Every station unique, every story unique

Looking for more information? Beta access? Development info? Check out INTERCEPT's official discord!

Features


  • Fully Procedurally Generated Stations
    Every little detail is procedurally generated, providing infinite variety every time you play. Not only randomizing rooms, but generating new connections and details, sometimes vents will connect rooms, or glass will divide you and a very well stocked supply closet. These procedural stations not only look different every time but PLAY different, each run brings new threats and challenges to overcome.

  • Roguelike Mechanics
    Every station has a crew. Every time you arrive for work, you will inhabit one of the dozens of procedurally generated characters on the ship. Each with unique traits, jobs, abilities, and gear. Maybe this run you're a trained medic, able to heal any injury, other times you may be an engineer who can take any 2 things and make them explode. Every time you die or escape you will inhabit the body of another crew member, following in the steps of your former self, all on the same shared station.

  • Immersive Sim
    In INTERCEPT everything is connected, electrical wires power everything in the station, fires break out and spread, rooms flood with water. Everything in the station can interact with everything else, throw an electrified power cell in that flooded room to stave off the Alien, lay trails of rocket fuel to prepare an ambush, rewire and repower damaged doors. There is no obstacle you can't overcome with a bit of thinking and clever planning.

  • Full Multiplayer
    Bring a friend, or two, or 8 to help, or betray you. Alongside solo play, INTERCEPT features full multiplayer support, with dedicated multiplayer features. Not only can your friends play with or against you as crew members, but one can play as the antagonist itself, the Alien. Consume corpses for biomass, evolve, and spread the infestation.
    With INTERCEPT's deep character generation, some players may not be what they seem, with hidden objectives and malicious goals, be careful who you trust.

  • VR Support
    Want full immersion? INTERCEPT has full VR Support, featuring multiplayer cross-play with desktop and other VR players. Everything has been built from the ground up for an immersive and terrifying VR experience.

data.name: Railblazer
data.detailed_description:
A massive, mysterious storm has obliterated civilization. In the city of survivors, you are the only veteran engineer capable of navigating the old tracks. Gather clues to uncover the storm's secrets, manage your train and resources, and survive in a world plagued by raiders and harsh environments.

Beware, what lies hidden in the darkness may not always be to your liking.


Manage Your Train

Keep your unstable train running. Strategically place vehicles in limited space and ensure you have enough resources. Prepare for fuel shortages, frequent breakdowns, and chronic power outages.

Explore a Ruined World

Venture into a procedurally generated world where you’ll encounter various events in extreme conditions. Investigate different structures across the world to earn rewards, trade with merchants, or resort to raiding. But always be quick—the storm is closing in on you!


Prepare for Battle

Gear up for chases with raiders. Strategically place defensive structures and maintain control during combat situations. You’ll also face massive enemies that occasionally block your path!

Grow Through Game Over

Use research points from previous expeditions to unlock new items and engines. Experiment with new combinations to build ad train uniquely yours.


Uncover the Secret of the Storm

What secrets lie within the storms that destroyed human civilization? Uncover the conspiracy behind the storm's occurrence and find clues to confront the great disaster!

data.name: Nanotale - Typing Chronicles
data.detailed_description:
Discover our new typing game


Become a Fox Rider

Join a community of players from Epistory and Nanotale who decided to take part in the adventure, and help us to create another memorable experience.


About the Game

Nanotale - Typing Chronicles is an atmospheric typing adventure RPG set in a colorful vibrant world. Follow Rosalind, a novice Archivist, as she journeys out to explore a distant world. On her quest to gather knowledge, she collects samples of mystic natural beauties. Everything is peaceful. War is a thing of the distant past.

In the shadows, a tale of dissonant magic is spreading, instilling corruption into broken hearts.

Play with magic

Combine powerful spells, change their shapes, and enhance them to defeat enemies. Use your magic on the environment and make it resonate with your creativity.


Knowledge is power

As a member of the order, your role as an archivist is to gather knowledge. The more you learn about the world, the stronger you become.


Explore a rich world

Embark on a journey to the Ancestral Forest, discover the Blue Desert and try not to get lost in the Sunken Caves. Meet the inhabitants of these new lands, be amazed by the beauty of the flora blooming in these diverse biomes, be intrigued by the critters roaming on your path but be careful not to cross paths with the dangerous creatures looming over.


Reveal secrets

Step in a fascinating story with multiple faces that have left their mark on these lands. Meet people, listen to their tales, and catalog mysterious occurrences, in an attempt to unravel the secrets behind dissonant magic.


Your mightiest weapon, your keyboard

In Nanotale, everything is played with your keyboard. From puzzles to dialogues, combats to menus the entire game can be played solely with your favorite keyboard. All keys are re-bindable, supporting all kinds of layouts (Qwerty, Azerty, Qwertz, Dvorak, Colemak, BÉPO,...).


Enjoy the game in 11 different languages and create your own Nanotale experience. You can choose to have the tutorial and story in one language and select another one for gameplay and typable elements.

Meet the inhabitants of these new lands, be amazed by the beauty of the flora blooming in these diverse biomes, be intrigued by the critters roaming on your path but be careful not to cross paths with the dangerous creatures looming over.


Reveal secrets

Step in a fascinating story with multiple faces that have left their mark on these lands. Meet people, listen to their tales, and catalog mysterious occurrences, in an attempt to unravel the secrets behind dissonant magic.


Your mightiest weapon, your keyboard

In Nanotale, everything is played with your keyboard. From puzzles to dialogues, combats to menus the entire game can be played solely with your favorite keyboard. All keys are re-bindable, supporting all kinds of layouts (Qwerty, Azerty, Qwertz, Dvorak, Colemak, BÉPO,...).


Enjoy the game in 11 different languages and create your own Nanotale experience. You can choose to have the tutorial and story in one language and select another one for gameplay and typable elements.
data.short_description: Something is wrong with the heart of magic. Play a young archivist venturing out into a dying world, cataloging its mysteries and its wonders to unearth the truth. Nanotale is the new adventure from the Typing Chronicles franchise and the spiritual successor to the acclaimed Epistory.

data.name: Kingdom Heroes 8
data.detailed_description:
The " Kingdom Heroes" series is a classic horizontal battle single-player game developed by Userjoy, which has been released seven generations since 1998. After the release of " Kingdom Heroes VII" in 2007, there has been no single-player sequel since then. The latest sequel, " Kingdom Heroes 8", will feature a new look and exciting battles, interpreting the magnificent era of the Three Kingdoms.

【Famous Generals / Fascinating Skills】
Players can perform subtle operations on multiple characters on the battlefield. The newly created classic Three Kingdoms characters, various warrior techniques, and exclusive warrior techniques have also been recreated. The special appearance animations and special effects of famous characters show a magnificent feeling different from the previous game.




【Fascinating Features / Exploring freely】
The design of the map strives to restore the vast territory and vast settings, and set up a wealth of random events, in addition to maintaining the open exploration style of play, adding new exploration elements and map objects, players can freely explore and fight at will.


[Thousands of armies / Great momentum]
The game features dozens of unique types of soldiers and a magnificent battlefield with more than 1,000 players and is developed in full 3D, evolving into 3D 1,000-player battles.




[Inherit the classics / Break through the tradition]
Based on the previous generations, "Kingdom Heroes 8" continues the classic strategic gameplay of the series, and inherits the horizontal battle perspective setting, from 2D to 3D extreme evolution, the scene 3D performance is excellent, greatly enhancing the visual details and breadth, the most extensive and exquisite map in the history of the generation.


[Originality / Multidimensional development]
The meticulously designed growth system of military generals includes multi-dimensional cultivation of official positions, equipment, artifacts, war horses, and titles. Simplify the internal affairs system of the seven generations. The new auxiliary minister system, unify the automatic operation of the previous generations of internal affairs. The new stronghold subsidiary building system, giving different attributes and functions to the forces, so that the gameplay can be more diversified.

data.name: 31 Days In Orange Carnival
data.detailed_description:
10 participants. A death game that unfolds over 31 days.

'31 Days In Orange Carnival' is a story-driven interactive fiction game. You play as Cha Yongjun, one of ten participants, who is confined for 31 days in a hotel known as the “Orange Carnival” and forced to take part in a deadly game.

All participants are promised a massive cash prize and will be released from the hotel after 31 days to claim their reward.

However, if you kill another participant at dawn, you can take their prize money.

Your goal is to survive for 31 days in this dangerous place. The flow of the story will change dramatically based on your choices.

Survive for 31 days.

Your only objective is to stay alive. Do whatever it takes to survive until this death game ends.

Open the book and decide your actions.

Each day, you must choose how to spend your time. You can talk with others, use the hotel facilities, or investigate your surroundings.

Build relationships with the other participants.

Talk with the other participants, build trust, and learn more about them. The direction of the story will change depending on your relationships. At times, they will demand that you make difficult choices.

data.name: Three Lambs
data.detailed_description:
About this game

Three Lambs is a story-driven, cinematic first-person detective game set in a dark and atmospheric Prague. As a detective, you explore different locations, search for evidence and gradually piece together the story.

The game combines the atmosphere of classic PSX-era games with cinematic storytelling, a strong sense of atmosphere, and a mysterious narrative. Every clue you discover brings you closer to uncovering what really happened.

Gameplay

Explore your surroundings and search for clues. Hold the right mouse button to reveal hidden clues and evidence around you. When you discover a clue, examine it to hear what the detective thinks about it. His thoughts can give you insight into what the evidence means and how it connects to the case. Every clue brings you one step closer to uncovering the truth.

Story

You play as Detective Kale, a detective who is called back after a long time to investigate an urgent and unusual case.

They need him because they have never encountered a case like this before. With little information to go on and time running out, Kale must examine the evidence, investigate the crime scene, and uncover what really happened.

As the investigation progresses, the case becomes more mysterious than anyone expected. What initially appears to be a routine investigation soon begins to reveal something much more disturbing and eventually, the entire case becomes unexpectedly connected to Kale himself.

Can you find all the evidence and uncover the truth?

data.name: Shadow Sovereign
data.detailed_description:
You died. You woke in a world where the Light rules, and the powers of darkness woke with you.

Shadow Sovereign is a dark fantasy incremental tower defense, where you are the tower. Your legion of shadows marches out to meet the horde; you hold the ground behind it, tactically casting your ultimate, resummoning fallen shadows and shadowpulling them out of danger while using your weapon. Between runs you rebuild that legion, and every rebuild makes the next march longer.

Fight with your legion, or let it grind while you plan. Both work. One is faster.

The Sovereign does not walk. He pulls a shadow out of danger, resummons the fallen, drops his ultimate at your cursor, and fires his weapon at the enemy you choose or the one his aim picks. Speed the easy waves up to 4x and slow down for the bosses.

Five acts stand between you and the Light: The Rotting Catacombs, The Drowned Wood, The Ash Plains, The Throne of Ash, and at the end of the road, The Lightfall.

Every stage ends in a boss, and there are 23 of them. Each has its own kit, its own way of punishing a lazy formation, and a shadow it leaves behind when it falls. Bind all twenty of the first four acts and hold court with the crowns you broke.

Your Sovereign spends levels on a talent tree of more than 1,600 nodes, laid out in wheels: complete a wheel, master it, and the tree redraws itself on every prestige so no two climbs are the same.

Field up to 32 shadows at once, drawn from 29 unit types: nine shadow classes, from tank and paladin to warlock and assassin, and the twenty boss shadows you claim by killing their living selves.

Every shadow levels, then promotes through ten ranks, each rank with its own perk and new art at ranks 4, 7 and 10. Class talents tune how a shadow fights, promotion perks decide what it becomes.

Loot drops in six rarities from Common to Mythic. Reroll the affix you dislike, salvage the rest in bulk, and take one of four weapons up its own skill tree: Storm Staff, Ember Bow, Tide Blade or Frost Fangs.

Prestige earns Echoes. Spend them on the Prestige Tree, five rings of perks, masteries and edicts that stay with you forever: a bigger legion, a Sovereign who starts each life at a higher level, bounties on every crown, and whole systems that were not there before.

Reach the top of The Lightfall, defeat the Light, and the world crowns you the Shadow Sovereign.

  • A legion of up to 30 shadows from 29 unit types, nine classes and twenty boss shadows

  • 23 bosses across five acts: all twenty of them bindable to your legion

  • Ten promotion ranks per shadow, each with a perk, plus class talents

  • A talent tree of more than 1,600 nodes in wheels, with masteries and keystones, the tree is different on every prestige

  • Four weapons with each its own skill tree

  • Gear in six rarities, affix rerolling, legendary stats and more

  • A prestige tree of five tiers, paid in Echoes

  • Progression rewards that unlock new systems as you spend talent points: game speed up to 4x, auto-level, auto-salvage, the Transmuter

  • Play it yourself or let it idle, and switch between the two mid-run

  • Steam Cloud saves

data.name: Only Out
data.detailed_description:
GameInfo

In a post-apocalyptic world following a virus outbreak, human civilization has collapsed. You will play as a lone survivor, struggling to stay alive in a small village surrounded by zombies. The village’s resources are nearly exhausted, with most of the remaining supplies either spoiled or contaminated by zombies. Your mission is to survive under extreme conditions, not only by scavenging for supplies but also by avoiding infection and finding hope for escape amid the relentless threat of incoming zombies.

This is a two-player cooperative survival game where you and your partner must rely on mutual trust and flawless teamwork to overcome hordes of zombies and find the only way out.

It’s not just a survival game; it’s also a dual test of coordination and intelligence. Together, you’ll face unexpected challenges and devise the best strategies to turn danger into opportunity.

data.name: Grimalkin: Solar Defense Force
data.detailed_description:
Description

Grimalkin Solar Defense Force is a game about planning each tactical retreat and achieving victory against overwhelming odds as the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire Decimates your forces. The game is set 6000 years into the future and an Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire that seeks to reclaim their ancient home world from the Mutated House Cats turned a Sentient Space Faring 80's Retro Race known as Grimalkins who happen upon them at the Edge of the Sol System. Grimalkins fought bravely against the initial wave but what remained of Admiral Fluffy Duffy's fleet is Unknown. All that stands between earth and utter destruction is the Grimalkin Solar Defense Force and their nigh impervious Hyper Field Barriers. As the sole commander of the Grimalkin Defense Force you are tasked with preparing the Hyper Field Defenses, its fleet, and prevent the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire from reaching Earth.



Do you have what it takes to lead space faring house cats against the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire?!

Features

  • You as the player start off with nothing but scarce resources a portal and a brave Grimalkin Commander at your side.
  • Build Orbital Space Stations to boost your fleet and defenses.
  • Mine Resources from ore , H3 fuel, to enemy Knowledge.
  • Research new Tech Tiers to improve your fleets fighting capabilities.
  • Test the enemy for weakness with each loadout of your fleet.
  • Every ship matters, and losing just one could mean your utter destruction. Retreat when all seems lost and save your fleet to help you withstand the overwhelming odds against you.
  • Use your Commander in Battle to aid you in the fight but be careful not to lose the brave soul as he/she is your only hope to win the day; if lost all is lost.
  • Tactically plan your forces to out maneuver the enemy; using superior tactics will help you gain the knowledge and skill to increase your overall chance of survival as well as your overall statistics.

Grimalkin Solar Defense is a Rogue Like RTS game. As a player you’re tasked with improving your fleet and figuring out what best configuration can beat the enemy’s defenses. They call themselves the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire; whatever that means. Figuring out their alien weaponry will help lead you to victory as you fight your way back to Earth. Face Overwhelming odds and challenges throughout the game. Be prepared to lose and retreat often as the enemy is unrelenting in their war against the Grimalkin forces. Each Planet Lost is a chance lost, Hold the enemy as much as possible and plan your fights with the intent to save as many of your precious ships as possible. Every ship lost hurts so try to keep your fleet alive for the next engagement.

data.name: Sniper Dan
data.detailed_description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

1) Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…

2) Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!

3) Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.

It did. It was Dan!

            

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Snapshot Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.

Key Features

  • Outrageous tools. Sensible intentions
    Use a sniper rifle to fix everyday problems. No danger. No drama. Just long-range problem solving.

  • A hidden object game through a sniper scope
    Scan busy 3D scenes, spot what’s wrong and solve it with one perfectly aimed shot.

  • Over 160 jobs across six lively locations
    Take on everyday jobs, Answerphone requests, emergency jobs, boss jobs and special challenges, plus bonus games and three dedicated minigames: Bowling, Tennis and Air Hockey.

  • Every job is a tiny mystery
    Figure out cryptic clues, search the scene and work out what actually needs fixing, with dynamic solutions that mean jobs can change each time you play.

  • A playful 3D world full of shareable moments
    Explore six packed locations with 100+ secrets, 200+ ambient stories and 45 hilarious photo opportunities waiting to be discovered and shared.

  • Grow your business one job at a time
    Earn money and reputation from successful jobs, upgrade and customise your rifle, unlock costumes and collectibles, decorate your office hub and expand your operation.

  • Unexpected problems. Serious precision. Zero violence
    Fix signs, tighten bolts, pop balloons and jump-start fireworks. Nobody gets hurt. Ever.
