data.name: The Chronicles of Ilseera: Tarrowmorr
data.detailed_description:
Long forgotten, and isolated from the rest of Ilseera, delve into the isolated fantastical island of Tarrowmorr.

On this adventure, you play as Kayleigh, a pirate trying to escape from her past who winds up marooned on a strange island not found on the maps. While searching for your crew-mates, you find yourself becoming entwined in the very fate of the residents of Tarrowmorr. 

Will Kayleigh continue to run, or will she discover what it means to truly become a Hero...

Designed to look and feel like a video game that could have come out in the late 1990s, Tarrowmorr embraces the design ethos present in a lot of video games from that time. Low-poly models with low-res textures and smaller, handcrafted level spaces to explore.

In Tarrowmorr, you spend your time exploring the strange island and helping the people you find along the way. The core game-play loop involves:

  • Questing and Helping the People you encounter

  • Delving into dungeons

  • Fighting various Monsters and Enemies

  • Using the items you find to progress further in your journey

  • Discovering Secrets and finding collectables throughout the island

As you delve deeper into the island, the stakes increase and the story gets darker. A linear and story driven adventure awaits you on the Island of Tarrowmorr...

data.name: Slime Buddy Time
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to SlimeBuddyTime, your cozy haven of cuteness and relaxation!

Adopt an adorable slime and share everyday moments as you grow together. In this charming idle game with Tamagotchi vibes, you'll care for, play with, and pamper your fluffy friend while customizing their world to your liking.

✨ Key Features

  • Care for and pamper your slime: feed it, bathe it, pet it, and keep it happy.

  • Play relaxing and fun minigames like catching frisbees, going on walks, or chasing flying snacks.

  • Level up and unlock a collection of cute items to personalize your slime and decorate its home.

  • Collect medals and show off your achievements as your pet grows.

  • Live with up to 3 slimes at once—perfect companions while you study, work, or simply unwind.

With its soft visuals and comforting vibe, SlimeBuddyTime is perfect for anyone seeking a calm, tender, and heartwarming experience. You’ll never be alone again—your slimes will be by your side every step of the way.

data.name: Deephold
data.detailed_description:
Command the dwarven defense in a fast-paced tower defense built on tactical depth and brutal fantasy atmosphere. Place towers, forge runes, and unlock commander skills to repel goblin hordes, raised dead, and the Lich King himself across 12 campaign levels and an endless gauntlet that scales without limit.

KEY FEATURES

- 7 distinct tower types — Crossbow, Cannon, Frost, Fire, Tesla, Mine, and War Horn, each with two specialist upgrade paths across three tiers.

- The Forge — slot magical runes into your towers for elemental damage, armor piercing, lifesteal, and dozens of synergies.

- Commander Skills — choose your class and unlock passive bonuses tailored to your strategy.

- Campaign of 12 levels across 4 acts, narrated by Brom the Royal Chronicler.

- Boss encounters — face Grarg the Unbroken, Nightshade, the Iron Twins, and the Lich King, each with unique abilities you must learn to counter.

- Endless Mode — survive escalating waves with random modifiers (Swarm, Ironclad, Phantom, Regen) and chase the local high score.

- Map Editor — design and play your own custom levels.

- Three difficulty modes — Stoneguard, Ironclad, and Dragonfire.

No ads. No micro-transactions. No always-online. Buy once, play forever.

The Deephold remembers every commander who held its gates. Will it remember yours

Deephold is downloadable software. Upon completion of purchase, the game becomes available to download and install via the Steam client.

data.name: Still Space
data.detailed_description:
Survive the Swarm

Trapped in the ruins of a dead world, you fight through endless waves of aliens and rogue machines. Every shot, dodge, and second of hesitation decides your fate. Still Space is a fast and unforgiving 2.5D twin-stick shooter built for players who crave precision under pressure.

A Brutal Dance of Survival

Combat is quick, loud, and merciless. You move, shoot, and react in tight arenas where death can come from any direction. Each level is a test of control and instinct, designed to keep you in motion and on edge until the very last moment.

Indie Spirit, Hardcore Heart

Fans of Dead Space, Butcher, Void Prison, and Ultrakill will feel right at home. Still Space captures the aggression and tension of classic sci-fi horror while delivering the immediacy and flow of modern indie shooters.

Face the Horror

In the dark beyond the stars, something ancient stirs. The deeper you fight, the closer you come to the thing that watches from the void. You came here to survive, but survival may not be the end.

data.name: Blossoms of Eternity
data.detailed_description:
A linear visual novel with choices from the perspective of high school student Kobayashi Kuro, who is torn between two girls and unwittingly becomes the focus of powerful beings who abuse his life and world as a stage for their own cruel game.

Kobayashi Kuro returns to his old home and tries to get through his last year of school with Miyu and Aihara—two girls who fight at every opportunity. But the closer he gets to them, the more he senses that there is something hidden behind their rivalry that none of them understands.

When his life is suddenly turned upside down, Kuro is drawn into events that shake time, memory, and reality. He must face powerful forces to save Miyu, Aihara, and himself from a repeating spiral of death.

Along the way, he encounters ancient legends of his hometown—and answers that lie only in the hearts of those closest to him.

What begins as an ordinary love story becomes a battle against forces that challenge time, cause, and identity itself.

  • High-quality 1080p assets in anime style

  • Characters move their mouths when speaking

  • Visual effects such as rain and magical particle effect transitions for magical creatures

  • Backgrounds with multiple layers

  • Many great soundtracks for every situation

data.name: Rubber Messiah: 18+ Lust Bunker Simulator
data.detailed_description:
"Just get the signature and leave. How hard could it be?"

Welcome to the most absurd, filthy, and hysterically funny shift in the history of the courier service. Your task is painfully simple: deliver a massive, highly specific cargo down into a sealed underground bunker, find the local deity—the mysterious Supreme Mother Womb—get a single signature on your invoice, and go home.

But there's a catch. This bunker belongs to a cult that has elevated physiological cringe, toilet humor, and 18+ absurdity to an absolute religion.

📦 A LOGISTICAL NIGHTMARE

There are no tips here. Everything is soaked in sticky fanaticism, ridiculous sermons, and completely unhinged industrial mechanisms. You'll have to push through this parade of madness while maintaining the stone-cold deadpan of a logistics worker who just needs to clock out, even as everything around them is literally going insane with lust.

💦 KEY FEATURES OF THE SHIFT:

  • Total Cringe & 18+ Absurdity Explore a grotesque underground complex where every room is a new joke that crosses the line. From greenhouses with an aggressively intimate atmosphere to giant, abandoned "toys" proudly displayed on pedestals in the middle of the hallways.

  • In Search of the Supreme Mother Womb To legally end your shift, you must make your way to the cult's main Oracle. The cultists tremble at her name, promising an encounter with pure ecstasy. But who is actually hiding behind this majestic title? The answer will have you laughing hysterically and cursing the day you ever took a job in delivery.

  • Inevitable Contact You dream of getting in and out quickly with zero consequences, but in this bunker, no task ends without a grand, ridiculous, and unbearably sticky finale. Face it, you’re not leaving here clean—every encounter spirals into absolute chaos.

  • Weapons of Mass Sarcasm Your main defense against the sweaty local fanatics is a bulletproof apathy, biting commentary, and an overwhelming desire to get the hell out of there. The Courier just wants a scribble on their paperwork!

  • Industrial Sex Hazards Take in the sights of giant mechanized contraptions that the locals clearly aren't using to mine ore. One wrong move, and your logistics operation will be subjected to some brutal mechanical penetration.

Can you survive this parade of wet madness, uncover the secret of the Supreme Mother, avoid dying of cringe, and get that coveted stamp on your documents?

Grab your invoice—this delivery isn't going to process itself!

data.name: Recursive Riftfall
data.detailed_description:
Recursive Riftfall is a co-op looter where you explore exotic dungeons in search of data cartridges to retrieve and process into valuable data. Those who collect enough data are brought before the benefactors to present it for acclimation, while those who don’t are left stranded between dimensions. Your resources are limited – as you collect data, you will be rewarded with credits which you can spend on tools like teleporters, cloaking devices, and radios to make your job easier or funnier.

 

 

Recursive Riftfall has no player cap. Play by yourself or with 4, 6, or more people until the host can’t handle it. The game has an adaptive difficulty system which tailors the challenge to the number of players, and supports a seamless drop-in/drop-out system that allows players to join and leave at any time without needing to restart the lobby.

After an interdimensional calamity consumed our reality, entities from beyond saved what refugees they could and have tasked them with exploring rifts once inhabited by unknown peoples who studied the calamitous reality devourer. Their data in mass aggregate could prove vital in preventing the destruction of other realities. You are one of those refugees, left with nothing but to go where your benefactors allow as they undertake their own search to save other dimensions and beyond.

data.name: Sports: Renovations
data.detailed_description:
• Renovate dilapidated sports facilities;
  • Immerse yourself in a wholesome storyline and complete side quests;
  • Buy new tools and upgrade the equipment you already own;
  • Earn money for your renovation jobs and use it to expand your base of operations – each room unlocked will add some perks;
  • Buy cosmetic items you can place around your office;
  • Collect memorabilia in your Trophy Showcase and discover the history of sports.

THE STORY BEGINS


Your hometown basketball court is in danger – once home to a top-tier league team fostering many new talents in the field, now covered in cobwebs and dust. And now a big developer is only waiting to get his grubby hands on the place, tear it down and build a new shopping mall instead. But you won’t accept that.

How do you save the place? Do what you do best! Grab your tools, roll up your sleeves and breathe some life into other old sports facilities to earn money. See the spaces normally unavailable to normal visitors. Learn the inner workings of sports and listen to fascinating tales about their history.

And when you’ve earned enough, step up and renovate your hometown’s court for a rewarding endgame.

LEVELING UP


Collect trash, clean up the dirt from walls and floors, give the place a fresh coat of paint, fix broken fixtures, furnish and decorate the place. Remember to take a photo before and after to prove how good a job you did!

Use the money you earn to upgrade your equipment and expand your headquarters – each unlocked room comes with its perks and sometimes a little side quest...

GET THE PERFECT ENDING


Leave no corner undusted and no wall unpainted. You have all the time in the world so use it to polish your skills and plan out the space – some designs are better than others so be creative!

And when the time is right, prove to the city’s mayor that your beloved basketball court still has the potential for greatness!

data.name: Blasted Road Terror
data.detailed_description:
Blasted Road Terror is real-time tactical looter in post apocalyptic setting. Command mighty warcrawler and manage squadron of vehicles in order to get unseen riches of the world and reach immortal glory. You will collect mighty arctifacts during your journey, enlarge your vehicle fleet, rebuild your home base, make new friends and discover terrible enemies.

What to expect?

  • Small scale rts like tactical combat.
  • 5 - 10 minutes long missions or 30 minutes long adventures (Patrols) - the choice is yours.
  • 5 mission types, each with unique needs for group composition and tactics.
  • Interceptor/Marauder/Attack vehicle - classes. All with its specific traits and passive abilites.
  • Tons of weapons and accessories, all with its purpose and specific way to use.
  • NPC factions to gain reputations with and obtain unique rewards.
  • Permanent main vehicle and base upgrades.
  • 3 environments to explore - Wasteland/Highland/Tundra - all with its unique set of enemies.
  • Working Day/Night cycle with weather system to enrich your visual experience.

This game is NOT:

  • Action game
  • Open world exploration experience
  • Story based
  • Rogue like
  • Forgiving & hand-holding

Gameplay


Dont expect fast action, Blasted Road Terror is about tactical decisions and wise usage of limited resources. You have to consider group compositon and weapon distribution as each environment have different enemies which require different approach. Are you going to face enemies with strong armor? You are going to need flamers as they ignore enemy armor. Are you heading straight in to Riders teritory who are know to use a lot of bikers with high dodge chance? You better bring tesla weapon or two as they ignore enemy dodge. Are you going to run Patrol mission? You will probably need to rearm completely as you ll need to free up space in your main vehicle for extra consumables like vehicle spare parts, extra fuel to intercept bonus objectives or supply of purified water to refresh your warriors during mission.

All your vehicles gain experience and gets stronger with each mission they survive, if you lose your vehicle, its lost forever along with its equipment. But dont worry replacement is allready waiting in vehicle workshop if you can afford it. Lacking screws? You can hire one or two wasteland heroes for a day and run easy missions till you will be able to rebuild your favourite squad again.

Your main vehicle is the pumping heart of your squadron. In the begining its just a little more than armored brick but with each upgrade, you can shape to suit your needs. Do you want it to fill support role? No problem, equip it with additional ammo boxes for more carrying capacity, add spikes and giant buzzsaw crane to boost damage of all your vehicles. Attack role? Fit machine guns, explosive spearthrowers and dreaded missile launcher. Want it to tank for your your party? No problem, we ve got armor plates too!;-)

data.name: Isekai Lord: Desktop Realm
data.detailed_description:
Thrown into a strange new world, all you have is a small realm—and the title of its lord.

Produce resources, develop facilities, and manage your realm from a widget in the corner of your screen. Recruit and deploy new heroes, and watch as your once-quiet territory gradually comes to life.

A Widget-Based Realm That Grows on Your Desktop

Keep an eye on your realm and collect resources from a small widget while doing other things on your PC. Open the widget whenever you need to manage facilities and heroes, and grow your realm at your own pace.

Two Ways to Play: Desktop Widget and Full-Screen Battle

Manage your realm through the desktop widget during times of peace. When monsters invade, switch to a full-screen battlefield, deploy your heroes strategically, and command the defense of your realm.

Recruit and Strategically Deploy Diverse Heroes

Recruit and develop heroes gathered from different worlds. Consider their unique roles and abilities to create your own battle formation.

Unpredictable Events Across Your Realm

Merchants may visit, residents may submit petitions, new resources may be discovered, and monsters may invade. Assess each situation and make the decisions your realm needs as its lord.

A Growth Cycle Connecting Management and Battle

Use resources produced in your realm to develop heroes and facilities, then reinvest the rewards earned in battle to expand your territory. Realm management and combat feed into one another, creating a continuous cycle of growth.

data.name: The Night of Escape
data.detailed_description:
The Night of Escape

It is an indie game designed with themes of fear, horror, and escape.

The main perspective is a 3D first-person view, striving to replicate the unsettling and terrifying scenes within the game.

The story unfolds in an abandoned academy set in the 1970s.

The desolate environment, damp and gloomy atmosphere, and bloodstains on the walls seem to tell a horrifying tale that once transpired here.

Players take on the role of an outdoor enthusiast who, while passing by this remote academy in the wilderness, was attacked by an unknown assailant and knocked unconscious.

Upon awakening, you find yourself lying at the gate of this abandoned academy, with the exit just behind you, but it's blocked by obstacles. With no other choice, you must venture into the depths of the academy to uncover the mystery and find a way out.

Unbeknownst to you, danger lurks within the academy. It's said that the students here once disappeared overnight, leading to the place's abandonment.

In the darkness, it feels as if a pair of eyes are watching you, sending chills down your spine.

As you proceed, keep a close eye on your surroundings for any items or switches that could aid your escape, while also dodging unknown dangers.

Remember, you only have four chances.

If you fail to escape after four attempts, death will consume you.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

                                                             Game Features

  • "First-Person" - The player adopts a first-person perspective.

  • Face fear and horror head-on in an immersive experience.

  • Distant footsteps and eerie laughter, sudden hallucinations.

  • If you accidentally touch something or step into an enemy's trap, even the slightest noise can put you in danger of being pursued. You cannot fight back with anything other than the limited items at your disposal. Your only options are to run or hide.

  • Footsteps: Similarly, your footsteps can give you away, but if you're far enough away, you're safe. Of course, crouching makes less noise, but whatever you do, never look back. And it likes to hide behind doors. Pay attention to your heartbeat. It might just save your life.

  • Lighting: The game uses a cool color palette to emphasize the horror elements. Players will find everything they can use in cramped, enclosed spaces to ultimately escape. Of course, it likes to turn off the lights, so you must always keep your flashlight fully charged, or you'll be left helpless in the darkness. Because even if it can't see, it can hear...

  • Items: Usable items are very limited and can only help you escape temporarily. So use them wisely.

  • Mechanics: Pay attention to the clues and hints in the scene. They are crucial for you.

  • Danger: If you feel your heartbeat quicken or a sense of unease, don't doubt it – it's nearby.

                                                             Special Notice

The game contains exaggerated sound effects and horror elements that may appear suddenly or be quite terrifying. If you are sensitive to such content, please play with caution. Playing with headphones will help you better judge the sounds in the game. At least... you'll know when it's behind you.

Wish you have fun playing.

data.name: Magical Princess
data.detailed_description:
Raise the cutest daughter in all of the land in the ultimate parenting simulation!

In Magical Princess, step into the shoes of a single, widowed father as he brings up his only beloved daughter from early childhood all the way to graduation at the magical academy.

With her whole life ahead of her across a variety of different paths, how she grows up and matures is entirely your responsibility. Steer her towards an upright academic career as an ace student, a life of excitement on the stage as an idol, the way of the mighty warrior who takes up the sword, or even pure villainy as the demon queen. With every choice and decision you make, her future changes dramatically!

Gameplay Features

  • Complete freedom to raise your daughter however you see fit. Whether that means letting her attend classes, do part-time jobs, go out on dates, sneak out at night, or even indulge in the occasional thievery and other such "odd" jobs, the choice is yours!

  • An enormous amount of story content including over 170 date scenes and over 50 endings. Interact with a colorful cast of more than 30 characters brimming with personality as your daughter leads her life at the magical academy.

  • Uncover deep mysteries lurking beneath the surface. On nights when the full moon turns crimson in the strange phenomenon known as the Crimson Moon, monsters strike in a world seemingly chained to its fate. The key to unlocking everything just might rest in the hands of your daughter...

A character raising game fit for a princess!

Magical Princess is a character raising game where players get to experience the joys of raising a daughter full of potential, bonding with her the more that she grows. What life has in store for her is up to you as you piece together a story of epic proportions! The only question is: are you ready to be a father?

data.name: The Totemist
data.detailed_description:
Run an occult shop where complex crafting systems meet supernatural mystery. Gather materials, perform cleansing rituals, craft totems, and imbue them with power in this narrative-driven experience. 

You run a small occult shop in a town that feels just a little off. Customers come to you with the quiet weight of everyday life, and you help them carry it a little easier.



Gather materials from the world around you. Cleanse and prepare them with rituals drawn from real modern witchcraft.


Craft totems and talismans, then imbue them with intention to give them something extra. Unique effects, deeper power, a little more of yourself in every piece you sell.


Your crow keeps you company in the workshop.  Your frog minds the storefront. And the town slowly reveals itself through a cast of characters whose lives are messier, warmer, and stranger than they first appear.

Something is happening here. You can feel it in the energy. And you might be the only one who can see it coming.


The Totemist is a narrative-driven cozy shop simulator with an occult heart. Crafting, characters, and a mystery that gets under your skin.

  • Gather and cleanse raw materials for your craft.

  • Craft totems and talismans using rituals inspired by real modern witchcraft.

  • Imbue items with unique effects and increased power.

  • Manage and expand your shop inventory.

  • See the world through soul energy rather than physical appearance.

  • A character-driven narrative with a small, handcrafted cast.

  • Uncover a growing mystery hidden beneath a quiet town.

  • Companion crow in the workshop, companion frog in the store.

  • Average playtime is 5-8 hours.

Psst... This game is narrative driven, there's a lot of reading.

data.name: Tattered Sails
data.detailed_description:
The Golden Age of Piracy, a time when legends are made or torn down. No trip over the seas is safe and every voyage could be your last. Or... You could find riches, power, and become legend!

Welcome to the dangerous waters of Tattered Sails, an open world piracy survival MMO set during the early 18th century. Here you have a choice; will your story see you rise as a hero of the guard or a dread captain of ruthless pirates?

Explore a world full of resources, sailing from one island to the next, gathering all that you need to build your own haven. Whether a simple home or an outpost, you can let creativity lead you.

Weigh anchor, loose the sails, and set out from your berth with a cargo hold full of goods you've crafted to make your fortune or... Load your ship with cannonballs and gunpowder, ready to hoist the colors and take down those merchant ships! The choices you make and the transactions you conduct matter with an economy that is driven entirely by player actions. Will the world see glorious riches or will it all crumble only to become a ghost story?

Join your friends, create a pirate crew or a company of guards, and let history remember you all as legends. Leave nothing but the Tattered Sails of enemies in your wake!

Features


Crafting: Tattered Sails allows players to achieve prominence not through combat, but by mastering crafting, enabling them to ascend to the top by creating essential and valuable items.

Open-World Exploration: Travel from island to island scavenging for the right materials or trading with the locals to secure the resources you need.

Reputation: Your choices affect how the surroundings in the world perceives you. If you are a ruthless murderer you won’t be allowed into certain towns. If you are a protector of the people, you will be rewarded with access to certain goods.

Sailing: Sailing is the main mode of transportation. You’ll be able to sail a ship on your own but later down the road, you’ll need more than just yourself unless you are a skilled sailor.

Conquest: Capture islands for certain buffs for you and your crew. Will expand further on a later road map post.

Become a legend: Leave your mark on the world by being either a ruthless pirate or a guard.

Regular Updates: Continuous updates to further add more content based on player feedback while also fixing bugs.


I am a solo developer and I do hire out with a small budget to help with elements of the game. My main focus is hiring for coding and some UI elements.

A roguelike action platformer set in a sun scorched Egyptian fantasy world.

Game Features

  • Boss Battles: Each area has a unique boss guarding the way down.

  • Gold: Spend it at the merchant, or gamble it on the mystery box, the slot machine and the wheel.

data.name: Funguys Swarm
data.detailed_description:
Development Roadmap


About the Game

Funguys Swarm is a survivor-style roguelite where you play as forest weirdos fighting the Fire King’s flaming minions. Level up, unlock new heroes, pets, skills—even mechas—and rescue creatures to grow your Forest Sanctuary for permanent upgrades. Perfect for both newcomers and seasoned survivors!

Choose from a cast of silly funguys, each with their quirky charm and unique abilities. Whether you like getting up close and personal or prefer to keep things tactical from afar, there’s a funguy for every playstyle.

Face off against never-ending waves of flaming minions, mutated veggies, and things that probably shouldn’t be on fire. The longer you last, the weirder—and wilder—it gets.

Grab upgrades mid-run and stack chaotic, over-the-top powers that turn your goofy forest friend into a full-blown nature-powered menace.

A weapon to surpass the m.... menace of the fire king! Powered by the forest and questionable engineering. It probably shouldn’t work, but it does.

Every now and then, the swarm throws a tantrum and sends in a giant boss. They're huge, unpredictable, and almost always on fire. Oh yeah, did I mention that there's even a bigger baddie at the end of each arena?

Fret not, you have the forest backing you up in the Sanctuary, a place where you can upgrade your powers to be more ridiculous than it is right now... for the right price of course!

Initial early access release includes:

  • 2 Biomes

  • 2 Characters

  • 50 Upgrades

  • 3 weapons

  • and many more we lost count

data.name: LUNATHREN
data.detailed_description:
“In a castle without moonlight, longing is born.”

LUNATHREN is a 3D Soulslike Action RPG with gothic and ethereal visuals, offering dense exploration and combat within a single, massive castle.

You awaken as an outsider in a sealed room, seeking to bring the white moon—a symbol of freedom and hope—into the castle by breaking its seals. Along the way, you face warnings, betrayal, and traces of longing that challenge your resolve, as the boundaries between dream and reality, light and darkness, begin to crumble.

When the moonlight finally reaches the castle,
what will you see?

Key Features

  • Soulslike Combat
    Precise stamina-based combat focused on dodging, parrying, and striking.
    Unleash the power of moonlight to acquire and enhance silver-lit abilities.

  • Metroidvania-Inspired Exploration
    Progress by unlocking previously sealed areas within the interconnected castle.
    Experience the thrill of discovering new areas and hidden secrets as you expand your path.

  • Dreamlike Storytelling and Visuals
    Short vision-like cutscenes appear as you break seals, blending dreams with reality.
    Gradually uncover the forgotten truths and the meaning behind the white moon.

“When the silver moonlight touches your fingertips,

data.about_the_game:
“In a castle without moonlight, longing is born.”

LUNATHREN is a 3D Soulslike Action RPG with gothic and ethereal visuals, offering dense exploration and combat within a single, massive castle.

You awaken as an outsider in a sealed room, seeking to bring the white moon—a symbol of freedom and hope—into the castle by breaking its seals. Along the way, you face warnings, betrayal, and traces of longing that challenge your resolve, as the boundaries between dream and reality, light and darkness, begin to crumble.

When the moonlight finally reaches the castle,
what will you see?

Key Features

  • Soulslike Combat
    Precise stamina-based combat focused on dodging, parrying, and striking.
    Unleash the power of moonlight to acquire and enhance silver-lit abilities.

  • Metroidvania-Inspired Exploration
    Progress by unlocking previously sealed areas within the interconnected castle.
    Experience the thrill of discovering new areas and hidden secrets as you expand your path.

  • Dreamlike Storytelling and Visuals
    Short vision-like cutscenes appear as you break seals, blending dreams with reality.
    Gradually uncover the forgotten truths and the meaning behind the white moon.

“When the silver moonlight touches your fingertips,
what shadow will this castle leave within you?”

Prove your longing in LUNATHREN.

data.name: United Skies FlightSimulator
data.detailed_description:
Experience the land of opportunity from a whole new perspective!

 

Take the pilot's seat and explore the United States from coast to coast. Race low through the Grand Canyon, pull off spectacular aerobatic maneuvers over Los Angeles, or simply glide along at your own pace as the country drifts by beneath your wings. The sky is yours!

 

Three Game Modes

 

Free Flight – Explore the entire country at your own pace. Plan a route from airport to airport or take off from anywhere in the USA.

 

Fly4Fun – Once again, you explore the country however you like, but now every maneuver counts: score points with aerobatic stunts and combos. Exciting missions are waiting to be completed everywhere – helping you climb the ranks one by one.

 

Challenges – This is where your piloting skills are put to the test. Tricky challenges await you at locations all across the USA, from slalom courses to low-level flying. Collect stars and unlock new locations where you can prove your skills.

 

Built on the Real World

 

United Skies FlightSimulator uses real elevation data and satellite imagery – every ridge, every bend in the river and every canyon wall is exactly where it belongs. Our unique art style transforms it all into something you've never seen before.

 

And the best part? Everything works offline.

 

Just you, your plane and the entire country – a game like they used to make.

 

Blue skies ahead. Welcome to United Skies FlightSimulator!

data.name: Poglings
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Sunscrest Island!

Poglings is a creature raising and racing adventure set on the vibrant shores of Suncrest Island, a place where ancient magic sleeps beneath sun drenched canopies and forgotten ruins. Hatch mysterious eggs, nurture whimsical creatures called Poglings, train them to become champions, and uncover a sweeping story about the bond between humans and the magical beings they once called friends.

Part creature collector, part racing game, and part island exploration, Poglings blends cozy gameplay with an epic, story driven quest that takes you from peaceful beaches to cosmic realms and shadowy valleys.

Hatch, Raise, and Bond

Every journey begins with a single egg washed ashore. Pick it up, build a nest, and watch your first Pogling hatch. From there, it's on you to take care of them. Feed them, bathe them, let them rest, and show them some love. Happy Poglings grow stronger and leave you little gifts. Neglect them, and they'll let you know.

As you explore Suncrest Island, you'll find more eggs hiding in unexpected places. Each Pogling is different. Some are fast, some can fly, and others are built for strength or swimming. Train them using equipment you build around your villa, or catch critters and forage berries across the island to boost their abilities. When a Pogling masters a skill, you can take them to an ancient shrine and watch them transform into something incredible.

Once they're ready, it's time to race. The island is home to forgotten racing grounds, each with its own track designed around a different skill. Start small, get better, rank up, and eventually take on opponents that will push your best Poglings to their limits.

But there's more going on beneath the surface. The island holds secrets, ancient ruins, and a story about a lost bond between humans and Poglings that you're meant to restore. Along the way you'll meet a cast of characters who'll help you, and challenge you.

The story takes you from sunny beaches to cosmic realms and into the shadow of an ancient villain who isn't going to go quietly.

data.name: WITCHHUNTER.exe
data.detailed_description:
WITCHHUNTER.exe is an interactive fiction horror game set in a small, rural town besieged by madness, magic, and murder. Only you, the local priest, can exorcise this evil from your town - investigate the five suspected women, put them on trial, then send the guilty back to the Devil.

Choose your own path

Only you can decide who is innocent, and who will be put to the pyre. Explore branching paths and discover the root of evil as you interrogate the residents of your village and decide their fates. Not all of them still have souls.

ACQUIT or CONDEMN

Fear, distrust, and paranoia run rampant and few will submit to your interrogation willingly. Talk peacefully to people to earn their cooperation, or beat them into submission. Non-violence is an option, but the inquisition has always had quicker ways of extracting confessions.

Retro horror

Inspired by the text-based dungeon crawlers of the 80's, navigate through the world by entering commands into your terminal. Type them directly for a retro experience, or simply select the action you want using the UI.

All possible options are displayed to you - no need to memorize or guess the commands! Beware any prompts offered to you by the Devil. He means to lead you astray.

data.name: Super Gorilla Quest 2: A Space Chimpanzee
data.detailed_description:
Super Gorilla Quest 2: A Space Chimpanzee is the newest RPG sensation (that is, if you're reading this a few minutes after release). It follows a team of four primates (a gorilla, an orangutan, a chimpanzee, and a bonobo) traveling through many distant lands, mostly space-related, attempting to stop the evil Mayor from destroying all non-human life. It is a direct sequel to the original Super Gorilla Quest. However, if you don't wish to play the original first, a recap is available in-game.

Four apes, Gorilla (a stoic and driven gorilla), Orangutan (an orangutan who is incapable of speech), Chimpanzee (an intelligent but incredibly violent chimpanzee), and Bonobo (a kind-hearted and helpful bonobo), are stranded on the Moon. This is occurring because of the events of the previous game, wherein they chased the evil Mayor of City 1 (a prominent city on Earth) to the Moon to stop her from destroying all non-human life on Earth. Shortly after this, they discover an even greater conspiracy, possibly involving others they've met previously: a scheme to destroy all non-human life in the universe. To stop this, they must go on a crazy journey through space, time, and even beyond the universe itself. Along their way, they meet many other (mostly insane) individuals and experience more difficult trials than they hoped they would. There is also a severe dose of absurdist and black comedy added into the mix.

Super Gorilla Quest 2 is a relatively traditional RPG, with all the trappings you'd come to expect (except for random encounters, as those are terrible. this game doesn't have any). The majority of the game is spent traversing various (often surreal) environments, fighting enemies, solving puzzles, and exploring. There are also often small minigames and the like to shake up gameplay. There is a large degree of customizability to how you approach battles, as despite each character having a small number of moves, you can string them together in numerous ways to defeat the enemies with relative ease. There are also countless "trinkets" scattered throughout the game that give you interesting gameplay buffs/debuffs, which you need to use strategically.

  • 7-8 hours of thrilling space gorilla gameplay

  • Challenging but fun turn-based combat

  • An eclectic and entertaining soundtrack

  • Large amounts of quality absurdist comedy

  • Humorous and surreal sprites and artwork

  • Several primates, I'm pretty sure

  • And much more!

So give it a shot if any of this sounds entertaining to you! And if it doesn't, then get out, we don't want you here!! (just kidding, please stay, i'm sorry)

data.name: The Battle for Vega
data.detailed_description:
What is The Battle for Vega?

Inspired by the classics like Space Invaders, Galaga and Galaxian The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting take on the old games.

In The Battle for Vega, you'll face off against waves of enemies and bosses across more than 100 levels. Each enemy type has a unique weapon, so you'll need to strategize and adapt to their attacks if you want to survive. But don't worry – you'll have plenty of weapons and ships of your own to choose from.

Ship Types

Play through the game, collect credits, and you can upgrade your ship. The bigger the ship, the bigger the potential firepower and endurance. The higher end ships can equip exotic weapon types, and even have an energy shield by default.

Weapons and Hardpoint types

Every player ship has specific hardpoints which you can equip with different weapons. Each hardpoint it’s in a few energy classes, which determine how big of a weapon you can equip there.

Choose from a wide range of options, including projectiles, lasers, plasma, missiles, and much, much more. As you progress through the game, you'll be able to upgrade your ships and weapons for better stats and performance. Will you focus on firepower or fire speed?

The choice is yours.

Enemies

But be careful – the enemies in The Battle for Vega are relentless, and they won't give up without a fight! You'll need to be quick on your feet and even quicker with your trigger finger if you want to make it through to the end.

The game will face you with many types of both the basic enemies, and their mini-boss variants, and at the end of each major story Act you will engage one of the major bosses.

Every enemy type have different attack type, some slower, some faster, and maybe even attacks with a status element!

With its classic gameplay, modern upgrades, and challenging levels, The Battle for Vega is a must-play for fans of retro shooters. Get ready to blast your way through the galaxy and emerge victorious in the ultimate battle for Vega!

Steam Deck Support

The game it’s fully playable via the Proton layer at full resolution and 60FPS. The Steam Deck version it's made to be as readable as possible. We have a full gamepad support both for Steam Deck, and any standard controller type on PC.

Collect & Build a Deck of Over 400+ unique cards

The world of Delicards offers a vast spectrum of recipes, ingredients, seeds and special cards for you to collect and use while cooking. There are various vendors that sell card packs of rare spices and historical recipes for you to meet your customers' demand or help you win contests.

Participate in special events, contests and cooking shows

Cook for army generals, feed the homeless, become the #1 contestant in Kard Kitchen show and impress the food critics that randomly show up in your restaurant in order to gain popularity and fame for your cooking skills.

Explore the international cuisine

There are more than 100+ unique recipe cards from all over the world. Each one comes with a real-world recipe, together with in-game rewards, combos and bonuses. Enrich your experience with unique taste combinations and impress your customers.

Grow fresh ingredients on the spot

Using fresh parsley or tomatoes is incomparable to frozen alternatives - make use of the Seed cards and plan your cooking accordingly in order to give your customer's taste buds that UMAMI taste.
Customise your restaurant, grow your card collection and level up your skills in order to earn the 3 Michelin Stars award, together with the in-game 80+ achievements.

data.name: LAT The Punk World of Tentacled Monsters
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

《 LAT The Punk World of Tentacled Monsters 》is a hardcore tentacle-themed RPG. Players take on the role of a low-ranking tentacle dweller (Tentacle kun), embarking on a fantastical and heartwarming tentacle-filled life as you encounter a variety of women.

Story

data.name: Zeppelin Rush
data.detailed_description:
Zeppelin Rush is a reverse tower defense game where you lead a crew of furious goblins in an explosive assault aerial assault against a heavily fortified dwarf stronghold. The dwarves stole your gold, now it’s payback time.

Build and pilot a fleet of goblin-engineered war zeppelins, smashing through enemy towers while collecting loot to upgrade your fleet and multiply your forces. Choose your path across lanes of combat, with varying tower layouts and rewards. Adapt your strategy mid-flight by upgrading engines, armor, and weapons as you make your way further into enemy territory!

Each run is a fast-paced mix of strategy, destruction, and resource management, challenging you to balance risk and reward on the fly. With chaotic goblin tech, real-time destruction, explosive visuals, and strategic lane selection, Zeppelin Rush delivers an action-packed twist on the tower defense formula from the sky, with vengeance.

Take flight. Break towers. Reclaim your gold. The goblins are coming - and nothing is safe...



  • Fast paced gameplay requiring rapid decision making
  • Intense layout of enemy towers that foster intense combat
  • Economy based deployment and upgrade system

data.name: The Cubic and Their Supporters
data.detailed_description:
Select available color character cubic, and then fight other cubics with other color than you've selected. Buy weapons like sword, elemental magic staff, gun, missile launcher, or other available weapons, recruit more ally and set their strategy, and/or upgrade your stuffs to help you to fight your enemies, but make sure you have the money for those things, while also save some money (if you wanted to) so that you'll get money bonus based on interest rates after the next battle is finished.

Different Weapons and Different Ammo Type

Each weapon has its own ammo type, which can either Unlimited, Limited, Mana, or Energy.

Different Difficulty Means Different Total Waves

First difficulty contains a total of 30 waves (including challenge missions/waves). Harder difficulties with more waves becomes available after you clear the first difficulty. Clearing each difficulty will also unlock things like more available weapons and more available color character cubic to be selected.

Challenge Mission/Waves

Every main stage has 1 wave that has its mission is different than usual.

Manage Money Carefully

Plan your money use carefully. You can spent a lot of money to strengthen your team each wave, but without any saving, upgrading bounty, or etc, may lead you to struggle in later waves.

Credits

  • In game Credits on the main menu can be unlocked once the first difficulty is cleared.

  • Trailer music: Drum Or Bass - Ryan Stasik by BASSLOOM

data.name: Spektr
data.detailed_description:
Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

HUNT

You and up to 3 other hunters are contracted by WDD, and must carefully navigate a mansion with a... higher than usual amount of paranormal activity, and work together to expel the entity which is causing the issue. You can weaken the specter by searching for and destroying three items that attach it to the physical realm.

HAUNT

You are being hunted, but you operate on a plane of existence the others can't comprehend. Move through walls, hide and protect your precious treasures, use your spectral sight to find the intruders, and use your powers to manipulate the world to your advantage. Your power increases throughout the night, use it to weaken their minds, foil their plans, then kill them one by one.

Ethereal Abilities

Slam and lock doors, jam equipment, put out lights, project images and sound, manipulate gravity, manipulate objects, and much much more!

Equipment

EMF readers, magnetic spray paint, flashlights, DOT projectors, resonant suspension traps, WDD standard edition Disperser, and more. You must use all of the tools at your disposal to track and, of course, eliminate the entity altogether.

FEATURES

  • Engage in asymmetrical horror multiplayer fun with a total of 5 friends. 

  • Communicate through proximity chat 

  • Lots of equipment, tools, and upgrades for hunters. 

  • Fun ghost abilities like gravity manipulation and human possession. 

  • Ghost ability upgrades, unlocks, and customizable layouts.

  • Victorian style haunted mansion environment.

  • Win matches to unlock upgrades for ghosts and humans.

data.name: Formula Evolution 2025
data.detailed_description:
I have been creating this game since high school and have worked hard through my studies at Charles University in Prague. My aim for this year is to carry over my Ph.D. research about procedurally generated nature into my game. I aim to capture 150 years of racing in a game one day.


Formula Evolution is a multiplayer racing game that uses principles similar to those of World of Tanks. With each race against 39 other players, you gain experience and credits, for which you can buy various upgrades for your vehicle or unlock newer vehicles. You start with machines from the 1950s. Can you get to the very top and ride on modern machinery?


Controls are simplified enough to give you still the passion of riding but not too complex to take you hours to learn. It mainly focuses on providing players with the best enjoyment from racing fights. The game's core is short, dynamic races with a high action density. The feeling from the ride is very reminiscent of older games; do not expect a hardcore simulator. On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 25 formulas from 70 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your formula with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

On the other hand, it's not a mario kart racing game - there are physics, and you need to keep that in mind.


- 25 formulas from 70 years of history
- 50 real and custom tracks
- 1000+ various vehicle setups
- 30+ vehicle patterns, each customizable
- 10 different biomes


Using a simple yet rich customization system, you can customize your vehicle and rider as much as you want. For example, you can paint your formula with any combination of colors or use any of the available patterns to customize them!


The game is based on custom cloud-saving technology. As part of that, it contains many classic MMO features like cloud save, leaderboards, daily missions, achievements, and stats! Compare yourself to other racers!

data.name: Frontier Hunter: Erza’s Wheel of Fortune
data.detailed_description:
If you have not purchased “Frontier hunter”

This game’s development began in late 2019. Its modeling quality is based on pre-2020 toon shading techniques, and it cannot match the standards of today’s major mainstream studios. In addition, the game includes many traditional RPG elements such as character progression and equipment modification, and it is not entirely focused on action or platforming.

We recommend trying the free demo before purchasing (you can click the “Download” button above the “Add to Cart” button). The demo offers about 40–50 minutes of gameplay, allowing you to check whether the various elements are within your acceptable range. Lastly, we hope everyone finds a game they truly enjoy and avoids unnecessary financial loss.

  • Twitter


About the Game

Introduction

Frontier Hunter is a genuine Metroidvania game. Compared to our last work, Frontier Hunter has fuller stories, content, monsters, more exquisite scenes, smoother actions, and a more diversified, personalized cultivation system. We’ll do our best to make the game construction more thorough and stable. Also, we’ll add more featured experience, gameplay, and content in future updates.
Two years ago, Erza obtained the legendary hunter license and became a rising star in the imperial force. Under the rule of the wise and able emperor, the empire grows steadily. As one of the core forces in the expansion, Erza has won many military exploits.
In this fantasy world of swords and magic, Erza will lead an exploration team and start an epic adventure. She will fight unknown monsters and solve mysteries of the world. Why would the fiend become a hair clip? You’ll find the answer in the game.

Features

  • Classic side-scrolling levels with steadier, smoother gameplay. Jump and dash can interrupt other actions’ recovery to get smoother responses.

  • During your exploration in the game world, you may find secret passages between the two main areas or accidentally enter unknown chambers with hidden stories.
  • Improved cartoon rendering makes the characters more lifelike.

  • Real beat 'em up combat system. Enemies have more ways to act after hit.

  • You’ll depend more on tactics when it comes to BOSS fights—learn their routines and act swiftly. Seize the chance to hit while keeping a distance.
  • With the character change and support system, Erza won’t be fighting alone.

  • 2.5D exquisite scenes will surely make an impression on you. The ultimate skills are made in 3D, which enables cool shows that 2D can’t do.
  • With a more diversified, personalized cultivation system, you can choose your favorite way to raise characters and find more possibilities.

data.name: Realms of Chaos
data.detailed_description:
The story of the darkness is revealed as you finish each of the three game chapters. Each chapter, or episode, has three unique realms. Each realm has new enemies, new graphics, new traps and new challenges - all in 26 killer levels!

Play as two different characters: A male warrior with a devastating sword attack and extra stamina, and a female sorceress with a long-range fireball attack and leap ability. Switch characters at the stroke of a key and decide which character is best to handle each challenge.

Features


A World of its Own: Vibrant, realistic VGA graphics with a high-speed, 360-degree scrolling playfield, viewed at a tilted perspective.

Boss Battles: Five bosses: four incredible bosses and a final super boss!

Brilliant Bobby: MIDI music and digital sound effects by Bobby Prince, known for his award-winning work in Wolfenstein 3D, DOOM I & II, and Duke Nukem 3D.

Dare to be Dangerous: Five difficulty levels: "Super Easy" to "Psycho Warrior." Higher levels introduces new hazards and challenges.

Save Your Game: Save and restore as you play (save anywhere) - plus convenient quick save and restore buttons

Controller Support: Partial Xbox 360 Controller support.

data.name: Nooodles: Brutalism Edition
data.detailed_description:
RoRoKaii's magnum opus, renowned across the entire RoRoKaii Discord: an incremental game unlike anything you've ever seen.

Design Your Own Transport Network

Lay lines between procedurally generated archipelagos to connect different types of nodes.

The gameplay is simple:

  • Place nodes

  • Then connect them

Simple is possible, but simple is unlikely: you'll need to leverage island shapes, relic effects, and legendary character abilities to build your node empire:

Shorter paths? Or more merges?

I don't know.

Expand Your Automated Empire

Unlock increasingly advanced nodes.

Research various upgrades and discover synergies between different nodes.

Continuously optimize your layout to keep your network growing — transport won't stop even when you're away.

Every Island Is a New Challenge

Each run generates a brand new archipelago map.

Different island biomes offer unique bonuses. Reset islands to gain new power-ups, and use relics and legendary characters to forge different development paths.

Relax and Watch the Network Run

No frantic clicking, no stressful countdowns!

Just watch thousands of tokens race through your network, converging and merging into an endless stream of revenue!

Game Features

  • Truly relaxed idle gameplay

  • Procedurally generated archipelago maps — a different layout every run

  • Multiple nodes, upgrades, and synergies waiting to be discovered

  • Island reset, permanent progression, relic and legendary character systems

  • Continuously optimize your network for higher efficiency and greater returns

The game has 5 node types — doesn't sound like much. But combined with relics, legendary characters, and various upgrades, it's more than enough to build complex networks. Math, kid. Do some math!

So it must be a deeply strategic game, right?

Answer: it's debatable.

This minimalist game is also steeped in zen aesthetics, with a soundtrack that reacts to your network!

In short: this is an incremental game like nothing you've ever played!

data.name: Oscillon
data.detailed_description:
DEFEND THE CORE. BUILD THE BEAT

Oscillon is a hypnotic arcade survival game with a built in music track editor. Build your own beat, hear your music rise and fall as you play. 

BE THE COMPOSER

Want to curate your own vibe? Oscillon features built-in music track editor. Author your own chord progressions, program the drums, bass, and synth lines, and map out exactly how your bounce-triggers will sound.

Save your custom tracks, export them as WAV files to listen anywhere, or load them straight into your next run and defend the core to your own masterpiece.

CHOOSE YOUR FREQUENCY (FOUR MODES)

Whether you're looking for a punishing challenge or a zen audio-visualizer, Oscillon has a mode for your mood:

Survival: Pure, endless arcade defense. Earn credits, unlock persistent upgrades, and chase the top spot on the global leaderboards.

Vibe: No damage. No fail state. Just pure audio-visual zen. Sit back, spin the paddle, and lose yourself in the music.

Wave: A grueling 30-wave gauntlet. Draft cards between rounds. Survive to every fifth wave to face down brutal Boss waves that twist the rules of the game.

Challenge: Eight hand-crafted, masochistic skill tests. Tiny paddles, invisible balls, a one-HP core, and constant health drain. Prove your mastery.

CUSTOMIZE THE CHAOS

Upgrades: Seven upgrade branches to empower your future runs.

Push Your Luck: Equip Survival Mutator cards to trade higher difficulty for massive credit multipliers.

Visual Flair: Eight unlockable cosmetic skins that completely re-tint and shift the game's visualizer.

Accessibility First: Per-effect visual toggles, and a distinct three-channel audio mix so you can play your way.

data.name: Salaryman Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Dodge crowds by rotating your body and get on your train in time inside Japanese subway stations.

GAMEPLAY

  • Sprint through absurdly crowded subway stations

  • Rotate your body to fit tiny gaps

  • Optimize your path to get faster clear time

  • Compete in speedrun leaderboards

SPEEDRUN

Salaryman Simulator is built for speedrunning, with built-in timer and leaderboards.

Compete with friends and the world for the best time.

Can you be the fastest to run to the train?

MODIFIERS

  • Night Shift. Your eyes will be closing often, reducing vision.

  • Nomikai. Your screen will get wobbly because you are drunk.

OVERVIEW

You are an office worker who commutes to work by train every day.

You also like to sleep (who doesn't?)

Since you get up late, your last chance to get to work in time is the train departing in 60 seconds!

You don't want to be late, do you? You know the boss wouldn't like it...

There is a problem though... You are not the only office worker in town.

Stations are full of people, and if you bump into one, you need to stop and apologize, losing precious time.

Only the best salarymen know the art of running and evading other people.

data.name: Judgment
data.detailed_description:
RGG Studio proudly presents Judgment, an action-adventure detective game that follows twisted crime running deep beneath the surface of Tokyo. Play as Takayuki Yagami, a disgraced defense attorney turned detective, as you claw your way through Kamurocho’s underground crime network and uncover the truth behind a string of grisly murders. In this legal thriller, the balance between justice and mercy teeters on the edge.

Take advantage of two unique battle styles to take down adversaries in electrifying encounters. Packed with Hollywood-worthy combat sequences and cinematic twists and turns, this twisted tale will keep your mind racing for answers until the very end.

data.name: The last tank fight
data.detailed_description:
The game was made with strong subjective emotions and is generally not very fun, so purchase is not recommended.

The game has 30 levels.

There are six boss battle levels, and some strange mechanic levels and story levels.

You can choose 3 combinations of 5 active skill parts and 4 passive skill parts to complete the battle before each level. When passive parts reach a certain number, new features will be generated.

Active accessories include stealth, shields, rapid fire, bombs, and mines.

Passive components include increased health cap, increased damage, increased movement speed, and decreased active skill cooldown.

There is a certain storyline and a written description of the stream of consciousness (the memory fragments obtained after each level).

data.name: Domineering Mediator's Forbidden Surrender
data.detailed_description:
Domineering Mediator's Forbidden Surrender - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: Axel, a former running coach in London and a cold-chain logistics coordinator, was reborn after being taken over by the consciousness fragments of a photon soul refiner after his unexpected death. With his new powers, he vowed to investigate the criminal network of the FX Group. Lena, the guardian of the inheritance, formed a forbidden bond with him due to the secret clauses in the family charter. In their complex relationship, the two faced the threats from killers and the evil group together.
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world where the surreal and the real are intertwined. Superpower elements such as photon soul refining and fate tampering are integrated into urban life. There is both the oppressive industrial atmosphere of the cold-chain warehouses in London and the natural scenery of Hyde Park, creating a mysterious, tense and fantasy - filled atmosphere.
Highlights of female character interaction: As a mature and charming mediator, Lena appears strong and rational on the outside, but inside she suppresses her forbidden desires for Axel. In her interactions with Axel, her emotions are complex and changeable, from shock and fear to the release of desire, showing a highly intense emotional conflict.
Tension in character relationships: Axel and Lena have an inescapable bond due to the secret clauses in the family charter. The relationship between the guardian of the inheritance and the beneficiary is full of moral and ethical conflicts. At the same time, Axel is also struggling with the moral dilemma of "being dead but being reborn in someone else's body", making his emotional interaction with Lena even more delicate.
Scene features: The game scenes are rich and diverse, from the - 25 - degree cold - chain logistics warehouse in London, to the mist - covered Hyde Park, and then to the Notting Hill apartment and the transnational inheritance law firm. Each scene has a unique atmosphere and details, adding a sense of realism and immersion to the story.
Immersive experience: Players will follow Axel's perspective, feel the impact of death and rebirth, experience the shock brought by superpowers, and the complex emotional entanglement with Lena. In the exciting plot, they will seem to be in that world full of fantasy and danger.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the appearance, expressions and actions of the characters, as well as the details and atmosphere of the scenes. Whether it's Axel's grey - blue eyes or Lena's charming posture, they can bring visual enjoyment to players.
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the automatic playback function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function can quickly locate the chapters of interest, and the high - definition CG shows the wonderful moments, bringing players a high - quality reading experience.

data.name: Tiny House Finds
data.detailed_description:
Search inside and around cozy 3D houses, floor by floor, in a relaxing hidden object game full of tiny details.

Peek into tiny homes scattered across different locations, each house built like a little 3D diorama. Rotate the camera, zoom in close, and peel back the floors to see what’s going on inside every room. From rooftops and balconies to gardens and backyards, there are tiny objects tucked away everywhere just waiting to be found in every house.

No timers, no pressure! Just a cute, stylized world to slowly explore at your own pace. Perfect for a quiet evening, a short break, or a cozy session with a hot drink. All focused on each house and tiny finds in it!

  • 🏡 Cozy multi-story houses

    Explore tiny 3D homes, layer by layer. Check every floor, rooftop, and yard to spot hidden objects.

  • 🔎 Relaxing hidden object gameplay

    Search for different items inside and outside the houses. Take your time - there’s no rush.

  • 🎨 Stylized, 3D, cute art style

    Clean, colorful lowpoly visuals with a focus on clarity and cozy atmosphere in 3D.

  • 🖱️ Simple, accessible controls

    Just use your mouse: rotate, zoom, and click on objects to collect them.

  • ↻ Rotate and slice open houses

    Spin the scene around and reveal each floor to discover what’s hiding behind walls and roofs.

  • ✨ Light interactive elements

    Trigger small animations and playful details as you explore each tiny scene.

  • 💾 Automatic saving

    Your progress is saved for you, so you can hop in and out whenever you like.

  • 🔁 Replay or share with others

    Reset your progress so you—or your friends and family—can start the hunt all over again.

  • ☕😌 Chill, cozy vibes

    Designed as a calm, pick-up-and-play experience with zero stress and plenty of charm.

data.name: Football Mogul 2014
data.detailed_description:
Want to Review Football Mogul 2014?

Would you like to review this game for free?


Are you a video game reviewer? Do you have your own video game channel/website/blog/etc.?

If you're interested in reviewing Football Mogul 2014, just contact us via support@sportsmogul.com or e-mail connor@sportsmogul.com! We're happy to give reviewers a key(s) when requested. All you need to show us, is that you have a following or a working website/blog that you have previously reviewed games on.

If you'd also like to become a curator for this game, please be sure to let us know after your review and we'd be happy to accommodate.

Additionally; we have 3 other games coming to Steam as well, including our Baseball series (Baseball Mogul), so be sure to ask about those as well when they become available on the Steam store!


About the Game

Football Mogul lets you begin in any year you choose, from 1970 to 2013 with the full roster of your favorite team -- or an entirely fictional team of your own creation. Your involvement as GM does not stop in the team's front office. Football Mogul gives you complete control over your team on the field. You start by setting the starting lineups for your team. On game day, you choose your level of involvement. You can retire to the luxury box and make calls to the field as needed or you can take control of each player, choosing what plays to run in each situation.

A powerful game engine simulates each play of the game based on customized player ratings and over 40 years of historical data, assuring you the maximum realism possible! Football Mogul is designed to help you manage your team over many simulated years. Manage your team one day at a time, or let the computer simulate weeks or months at a stretch so you can play for virtual years or decades. As your players age, their abilities mature and decline realistically. Don't forget to build your team for the long term, rather than spending all your money on free agents this season. Watch your team rise and fall in the standings, watch your bank statement, and read the news stories to stay on top of what's happening with all the teams in both leagues. If you pick the right players, manage your finances well, and stick to a winning strategy, your team may win the Super Bowl, and you too may become a Football Mogul!

Features

  • Start in any season from 1970 to 2013
  • Rosters for every year since the AFL-NFL merger
  • Play-by-play describes each play as it happens
  • Box scores and play-by-play files created for each game
  • Detailed play designer
  • 22 offensive formations: 3rd down packages, wildcat, etc.
  • 17 defensive formations: nickel, dime, prevent, 33 stack, 52, etc.
  • View detailed results for each play in your playbook: Versus each type of defense, In each down-and-distance situation
  • Realistic player development and aging
  • Play up to 100 seasons into the future
  • Automatically loads files from previous versions

New Features

  • Updated team rosters for 2013-2014 season
  • Accurate 65-man rosters, updated for week 4 of the pre-season
  • More realistic simulation
  • "Targets" and "Yards After Catch" incorporated into ratings (and recorded during simulation)
  • "Hands", "Power", "Quickness" and "Visions" updated and calibrated for every player
  • More accurate tackling, according to player skill and defensive play-calling
  • New stats and ratings for over 2,800 active players
  • Updated year-by-year stats for every player
  • Hand-edited ratings for over 340 offensive linemen and 500 skill positions (including 80 QBs)
  • Updated ratings for over 900 defensive players and 170+ special teams specialists
  • More than 400 new players
  • Includes all 2013 draftees, plus undrafted free agents
  • More than 800 new player photos
  • Exact season schedule for every season from 2001 through 2013
  • Accurate scheduling algorithm for all future seasons (2014 and beyond):
  • Includes correct interdivision and interleague matchups according to NFL rules
  • Plus realistic schedule options going back to 1972
  • Improved play designer and playbook editor
  • More control over play action and option plays
  • Improved Play-By-Play interface
  • Let the computer choose your defensive plays while your control your offense (or vice versa)
  • At any time, click "Playbook" to have the computer pick a play for you

Additional Features

Forty years of historical accuracy
  • Historical rookies loaded for each college draft class
  • Correct schedule and playoff format for each season
  • Enable or disable overtime (which was added in 1974)
  • Additional league editing options, like the number of wild card teams

Hotseat play
  • Two players can compete head-to-head using the same computer
  • Keyboard shortcuts for in-game playcalling (so you don't have to fight over the mouse)

Support for online play
  • Schedule generation for shorter seasons (as few as 4 games)
  • Schedule generation for custom league configuration -- even for an odd number of teams
  • Fantasy drafts with more than one human-controlled team
  • "Import Playbooks" feature lets you quickly load playbooks designed by each team's owner

Strategic options
  • Set your team to run a '3-4' or '4-3' defense
  • Build your offense with or without a fullback
  • Adjust the run/pass balance of your offense
  • Fine tune your game plan by customing your playbook
  • Advanced playbook editor
  • Easy interface lets you quickly edit existing plays or build a playbook from scratch
  • Editable folder names and play names
  • Load and save playbooks for use against different opponents, or to share online
  • Playbook tracks the success of each play in a variety of offensive and defensive situations
  • Supports custom offensive and defensive playbooks for every single historical team
  • You can even redesign plays in the middle of a game

data.name: Another Head
data.detailed_description:
It is with great pleasure that I present to you Another Head! The first game by Looting Dreams, created by Eric Sorrentino (yours truly). You’ll be transported to a small town in Colorado, Havenbrook, where you’ll control Tom as he faces one of the most intriguing events of late: there’s a new neighbor in town.

It’s hard to pin Another Head to a single genre. The story can take wildly different directions and tones depending on your choices.

No missions, live the story as the protagonist

Don’t expect senseless quests or triggers! The story progresses according to your decisions, whether you like it or not.

Feeling lost? Don’t worry—you can always consult the thoughts swirling around in Tom’s mind. Draw inspiration from his needs and ideas to navigate the game and make important decisions.

Meaningful dialogues

Interactions with people are key, so never miss a chance to chat with your neighbors. The choices you make during dialogues will always have weight. Think carefully about what to say, or you might regret it.

Multiple endings

Through different choices and actions, you can unlock up to 10 unique endings. If you manage to find them all, you can participate in the ultimate poll to decide which ending becomes the definitive one—good or bad!

A race against time

Another Head spans one full week in Tom’s life. Each day, you’ll have specific time windows to act freely. Don’t rush—savor the adventure—but remember, time is precious!

A mortgage to be paid by flipping burgers

What indie game would be complete without a burger joint? You might feel a sense of déjà vu as you assemble sandwiches and watch your bank account grow, but I promise it will be a fresh experience in its own way.

Developed in Italy, with love

I’ve always wanted to bring my ideas to life—since I was a kid, playing in the backyard with friends, crafting role-playing games, or sketching countless concepts that never saw the light of day. But here we are! I hope you enjoy this small game born from a part of my mind. I hope you’ll appreciate the care and love I poured into it and remember it fondly in the future. If not, let me know—I still have so much to learn, and I’m sure each of you has something to teach me.

Mysteries to uncover

What are you waiting for? There’s more happening in Havenbrook than meets the eye. It’s up to you to find out what.

data.name: DungeonBox
data.detailed_description:
DungeonBox is a party RPG for up to 8 players. Everyone plays from their own phone: submit your funniest ideas, vote for the best one, and watch the story bend around whatever your party decides.

Your Dungeon Master (run by your choice of a player or computer DM) sets the scene and everyone answers at once: heroic, clever or completely unhinged. Players join from their phone's browser with a room code. No app, no account, no extra controllers.

Every answer lands on the big screen. The party votes, the best idea scores, and the winning move becomes the story, consequences and all.

Pick a lock, spot a trap, slap a gnome. Risky moves call for a skill check rolled right from your phone, and your class, stats and items tip the odds. A natural 20 is legendary. So is a natural 1.

Descend into the Lion's Labyrinth, a papercraft dungeon crawl where every player steers their own hero. Search chests, sniff out hidden keys, outwit trolls and mimics, and fight turn-based battles on the way to the Gilded Serpent's hoard.

When a quest turns violent, the whole party votes on cards: back your heroes' attacks and block the enemy's nastiest moves. Loot a million gold, survive a Super Blast, or simply stand there looking cool.

  • Up to 8 players, one phone each – join with a room code, or fill empty seats with CPU players.

  • A Dungeon Master who never runs out of ideas – every answer changes the story, narrated aloud.

  • Draw it into existence – sketch magic items and monsters on your phone and watch them come to life in the dungeon.

  • Build your character – choose from 12 heroes, earn XP, raise your stats and unlock abilities like Fireball, Pickpocket and Diss Track.

  • Hand-written quests, endless outcomes – from tavern brawls to pirate-ship escapes, with 100 random events waiting to shake things up.

  • Your table, your rules – set the Content Rating anywhere from “Family Friendly” to “Anything Goes”.

  • Made for streaming – extra viewers join as the audience and vote, and the room code can be hidden on stream. Remote Play Together supported.

  • 12 languages – menus, quests and narration fully localized.

data.name: Cursed
data.detailed_description:
Our latest games!

Join our Steam group to learn more about our games, events and giveaways


About the Game


“Cursed” is a new mystic, intriguing and fascinating classic horror adventure game developed by JetDogs Studios that is familiar to many gamers. The game has a number of specific advantages as an intriguing plot full of enigmas, mysticism and great twists, luxurious graphics, innovative puzzles etc. If you are not afraid of going deep down into the world of the cursed realty and if you are ready to save the world from the evil or just want to pass a pleasant evening, then “Cursed” is the best choice.


The life of the main female character and her fiancé Albert was wonderful and full of happiness. Indeed, it was… Until Albert received a strange letter with a proposal of a profitable job far away from his home. Albert went away to work and there was no news for a long time. So the main female character (i.e. you, the player) put off on a long journey to look for her love-mate without knowing what had happened to him and what kind of peril and danger waited for her. Dragons, phantoms, demons and other creatures of beyond will be on your way. Will the true love overcome different difficulties and obstacles during the journey?



The plot of the game “Cursed” is full of unexpected turns and surprises. You will learn an ancient wizard secret, contact different creatures of beyond, learn your real name and meet people from your past which is so far away that it is impossible to call it to memory. And the most important thing is that it’s only you who can set free your love-mate and not let the evil to capture the whole world. Will you dare to undertake the responsibility for the entire mankind?


In “Cursed” you will need to realize all your true potential to find and use correctly ambient objects, open all the masked locks and doors, go round obstacles escaping from danger and to glean the necessary information about the fiancé of the main female character as well as about the history of this cursed place.


The stunning graphics and transcendental music of the game “Cursed” are worthy of special mention. The vividness of monsters, ambient objects and the environment as a whole provoke ineffable feelings during playing the game. All this will make the hair stand up on the back of the neck of any fearless and cool-headed gamers. Do you want to feel the thrill? Then start playing “Cursed” in the dead on night.


Thus, “Cursed” is an outstanding game for all sorts of gamers which has all the makings to become a real hit.

P.S.
For all game players we'll offer a bunch of adorable collection of collectible items - 15 trading cards, 10 backgrounds and 10 amazing emoticons!

data.name: Shapeshooter
data.detailed_description:
WISHLIST BURNING SKIES


About the Game

GAMEPLAY
SHAPESHOOTER is literally an on-rail shooter, you'll have to clear colonies across 4 planets from a little creatures infestation called polygoneers. But that's not important, you'll not get a story here. You'll get frenetic action, insane music and a super hard challenge!



WEAPONS
In SHAPESHOOTER you'll have 5 different weapons, all of them have 3 levels. Gatter OCTARINGS to upgrade them, and trust me, you'll need it.



TRAPS
Besides a the polygoneers, you must watch out for traps, A LOT OF THEM. Look at the size of this saw, I bet it has at least 200px wide.



UPGRADES
Improve your tank to survive, there are weapons, shield, magnet, wheels and of course skins, because you need to be shining while destroying everything in front of you.
