data.name: Tale of Darkness
data.detailed_description:
Traverse the once flourishing Kingdom of Malvora, now a twisted decrepit shadow of itself teeming with its corrupted former inhabitants, deadly traps and punishing curses.

Whether deciding to focus on speed, strength, magic or a combination of your choosing, Malvora’s challenges are many but so are the methods of overcoming them.

Take vengeance on your former allies who have betrayed and left you for dead. With each of the betrayers having different strengths and weaknesses the path to retake the throne is all but simple. 

Save characters that will help you on your journey and unlock items that will be key to traversing the harsh road to the throne. But each game presents a possibility of those characters being taken away or the precious items stolen. 

The Oblivion continually twists and mutates the realm, making each run different from the last. In an unpredictable world taking back the throne can be achieved only through skill and perseverance.

data.name: Franchise Wars
data.detailed_description:
The year is 20XX. Social media clapbacks by sassy corporate stooges have escalated from mere marketing campaigns to full-blown military campaigns.

Frothing fans of funny fast food have fractured former families into fried-in-the-wool factions, friends facing off in a fatty fracas of the fates.

Pledge your undying loyalty to... eh, one of them. Duel all challengers until met with sweet, supersized victory or cruel, congealed defeat.

  • Control various units in a turn-based isometric puzzle strategy game, where each unit has a unique gameplay mechanic!
  • Push your enemies off a cliff with your adoring Fans, ram into a Fry Cook with your Taco Truck, or snipe them from afar with a T-Shirt Cannon!
  • Solve 26 levels cleverly designed to make it easier for the very smart AI to win!
  • Enjoy pixel art and music inspired by the good ol' days of GBA games.

Franchise Wars is a puzzle-strategy game, or puzzegy game, developed by the folks at Jolly Crouton Media and Tiny Warrior Games. The game was made game-jam style in one month filled to the brim with passionate pixel pushin' and code cobblin'.

data.name: Guazu: The Rescue
data.detailed_description:
Rogue hunters interested in the animals of the Brazilian Cerrado captured the animals of this forest. Guazu, a young Guará Wolf, managed to escape. An accident with the truck carrying the caged animals caused this cargo to fall into the forest. Guazu intends to rescue his friends and will face various dangers through the wild forest, which is full of traps and enemies. Guazu must collect the keys of the cages scattered throughout the vegetation and the coins left by the hunters, so he will be able to rescue his friends.





- Guazu: The Rescue is a 2D platform game where you must collect the keys to rescue your friends.
- A single-player adventure.
- The game has 20 stages. In each Stage you must rescue a friend.

Controls are simple: Run, Jump and Double Jump. The game can be played on keyboard or controller. With support for Xbox One and Xbox Series controllers.

data.name: Sidewards
data.detailed_description:
Sidewards is a first-of-its-kind stone skipping simulator. Collect and skip dozens of unique stones to unlock new gear, achievements, and levels. Experiment to achieve "the perfect skip": adjust throw force, launch angle, and more to change how the stone skips. You'll need to factor in wind, waves, and other environmental effects, too - if you want to top the leaderboards!

Explore gorgeous, natural landscapes based on real-world locations. Hang out with your friends in casual and competitive multiplayer modes. Enjoy the beauty and tranquility of nature with Sidewards!

Key Features:

  • Realistic water and stone-skipping physics

  • Lush, waterfront environments based on real-world locations

  • Casual and competitive multiplayer modes

  • All the accessibility options

  • Photo mode

Core Gameplay:

In Sidewards, you collect stones and then skip them to earn points and complete challenges. You can find stones by exploring areas near water - some stones can only be found in specific locations, so you'll need to explore to find them all! Once you've got a stone, you're ready to throw! Pick your spot, adjust your aim, then dial in the launch force, angle, and spin. Release your stone and watch it skip... or not! Sidewards uses realistic stone-skipping physics, so you'll need to get creative to make some throws work.

Online Features

NOTE: The online features in Sidewards are optional. You can play completely offline, if you want.

  • Friends list

  • Create parties and invite friends

  • Casual mode with emotes, pick-up games, and... whistling?

  • Exhibition and tournament competitive modes

  • Leaderboards

  • Cloud save and stats

data.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon
data.detailed_description:
The prophesied end of the Zemurian continent draws near, and so does the launch of humanity's first foray into space. A sudden invitation from Marduk to cooperate in a high-tech training exercise sets Van Arkride, Ashen Chevalier Rean Schwarzer, and Father Kevin Graham on a collision course with the secrets that lay at the very core of Zemuria.

Their paths may diverge, but the ultimate question remains the same: Just what lies beyond the edge of the horizon?

Gameplay Mechanics

Explore detailed locations across the Calvard Republic, strengthen your connections with your allies, and uncover what lies beyond the horizon of Zemuria across three intertwining story paths. Plus, Trails beyond the Horizon introduces new gameplay mechanics to the beloved battle system introduced in Trails through Daybreak, giving you an unprecedented amount of options in both Field and Command Battles. Battle it out in the action-packed Field Battle mode, then swap to the turn-based Command Battle mode to strategically plan out your attacks!

New features include:

Wield more power in battle than ever before with Shard Commands! Utilize S-Boosts to give your party a range of benefits during battle. Each character and holo core comes with their own unique Shard Commands, so be sure to take advantage of them!

Certain characters, such as Van with his ability to transform into the Grendel, can surge with extra strength using Awakening during Field Battles to temporarily increase their power.

Take control of time itself with Z.O.C. to slow the speed of enemies to a crawl, allowing characters to perform multiple attacks in quick succession. Not only that, but while Z.O.C. is activated, your attack power and stun damage will dramatically increase, making stunning enemies with high defense a breeze!

Plus, gather allies from all over Calvard and beyond and put a stop to Ouroboros' machinations in the Grim Garten, a dungeon that you can take on with your own custom party!

data.name: Cryptid
data.detailed_description:
You are a veteran hunter.

When you return home, things are not going well and you realize that there is no one left in your town. You realize from the shadows that a mysterious creature is following you. You dive deep into the town and forest to track it down.


A lot of things in town are broken or out of power.

You must try to fix them in order to solve various mysteries and gain an advantage against the creature.


Don't forget that when you come face to face with the creature.

It can kill you in one strike. You can use objects like traps and guns to scare the it.


There are multiple endings in the game.

Each time you start a game, the creature's behavior changes according to your actions. You can have a different experience every time you play.

data.name: Jörmungandrs Journey
data.detailed_description:
Eat. Grow. Survive.

In Jörmungandrs Journey, guide a sea serpent through an underwater world full of prey and danger. Choose your targets, gather biomass and grow stronger. The creature that threatens you now could become your next meal.

Make every attack count

Hunt smaller creatures, keep your distance from larger predators and use your dash to attack or escape. Growth, power-ups and careful movement help you survive longer and push your score higher.

Play solo, together or against each other

Play on your own or join matches with up to eight players in total over the internet or LAN. Survive together in co-op, battle everyone in free-for-all or compete in team matches. Find online rooms through the room browser or join with a room code.

Your serpent, your style

Mix heads, bodies, tails and colors. Complete permanent unlock goals to earn more cosmetic options for your character.

  • Top-down action built around hunting, growth and dangerous predators.
  • Four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard and Drengr.
  • Single-player plus online and LAN multiplayer for up to eight players.
  • Co-op, free-for-all and team matches.
  • Character customization and cosmetic unlock goals.

Help shape Early Access

During Early Access, our focus is balancing, bug fixes and community feedback. See the Early Access section of this page for the current state of the game and our plans.

data.name: Way of the Red
data.detailed_description:
THE GAME

Way of the Red is a 2d action platformer with a focus on fun, satisfying combat. Splatter blood across the land through four massive zones, each with their own unique environments, characters, and secrets. Use satisfying and versatile sword techniques to shred enemies to pieces. Mutate your character with the mysterious red seeds, and learn new abilities from hidden characters.

You take the role of a downtrodden swordsman of a nearly extinct race known as the birdmen. Years of training and battle leave you unfulfilled and without purpose, so one day, you leave home to discover the fate of your lost childhood love. Your quest for perspective is abruptly cut short when you are shot from the sky by a group of human warriors who specialize in trapping birdmen for use as slaves.

You wake up with your wings clipped and sword confiscated, in a land ruled by a sadistic king who posesses a strange obsession with harvesting the mysterious "red seeds". You come to realize that the fate of the one you've been searching for is intertwined with the king's nefarious ambitions. In order to meet her again, you must get your hands on a sword, escape enslavement, and carve a path of blood to the ominous Spire City.

FEATURES

COMBAT

The movement is fluid and intuitive. The kills are satisfying and bloody. The swordfighting allows for many different fighting styles. You are fast, can strike in any direction and can interact with the environment while fighting. String together moves quickly to form elegant and bloody combos, all while smoothly conquering the hazardous terrain as you travel through the gorgeous pixel art environment.

WORLD

You start your quest deep in the center of a secluded forest, and eventually make your way to a city in the sky. This journey brings you through four massive zones filled with intricate and attractive pixel art, hidden paths and secrets, and a host of characters who would like nothing more than to describe to you all their woes, or in some lucky cases, teach you new skills.

MUSIC

Way of the Red has an exciting and varied score composed by a very talented chiptune musician, Daniel "Zigauche" Stoker. The fast paced music perfectly matches the pace and aesthetic of the action-packed game to give you an incredible, atmospheric experience.

ART

Way of the Red is a very visually pleasing game, with many different atmospheres each with their own unique and immersive palettes. The pixel art is colorful, simple, and endearing, with extra care given to creating attractive color ramps and smooth, fluid animations.

STORY

Way of the Red is a simple story that can be applied to your own life. It is a story of a powerful warrior who is beset on all sides by strife and judgement. The weak fear you, and the strong want you to fail. To keep moving towards your goals requires an infallible attitude, but what if you go too far? The pursuit of strength can take its toll on a man's soul, and at the end of it all, will you still be capable of happiness, and love?

This is a story of perserverence. Hope has evaporated from the land. Even those who do not directly oppose you will cast doubt upon your intentions... but with every opponent mercilessly cut down, your will hardens and the voices of doubt grow more faint.

...but in the pursuit of greatness, will you remember why you started?

data.name: STELLABITS
data.detailed_description:
It is a puzzle game that aims to clear levels by capturing various gimmicks while operating 4 characters.
At first, the level is very simple, but gradually the types of characters and gimmicks that can be controlled increase, and eventually it becomes quite difficult.
Each character has different performance, and the key is which character to move in which scene.
Collect all the stars in the field to clear the level, and clear a certain number of levels to advance to the next area.
With over 100 stages awaiting, only those with exceptional thinking skills will be able to reach the ending.

data.name: BIG DRUG
data.detailed_description:
Greetings, my friend.
Reading this, you show that you care about this game. Which is very important for us.
I ask you to go through it completely imbued with it.
Yes, it does not have an overly rich plot, but it will leave you and your friends with only positive and vivid emotions.
We, Sour Sugar, have tried our best to make this particular game a new breakthrough in cooperative games.
All you will see is a project being built in stages, which each of you can complement with your own brick.
Around the penetrating plot, you will see many features, thanks to which BIGDRUM will forever remain in your heart.
Install it soon and have fun!
Will you be able to find the culprit? It all depends on you and the support of your friends.

GAMEPLAY


In the game "BIG DRUG" you have to wander through the streets of your city, hoping to find the lost drugs of the gang. As you progress, you will communicate with bandits where you will need to choose the right words and expressions so that you are not revealed as a rat.

KEY FEATURE


* Online co-op up to 4 players *
Play with friends or go alone

* Unique treasure hunt system *
You have to search for treasures with friends or alone, as in childhood, focusing on buildings and places.

* Communicate with characters *
Communicate with them and find out information that will help you in passing.

* Run away from the cops *
Run away from the cops so that you and your friends are not imprisoned.

* The game is funny *
The game is designed for you to have fun and have a good rest.

As the God of Love who governs human affection beyond time and space, you — Padmeyah, the Fifth G.o.L — bear the responsibility of guiding humanity toward love. This time, you will help five couples across five different eras find their way to one another. However, as unexplained fainting spells, bewildering connections between lovers, and strangely named missions begin to challenge the limits of your abilities, something hidden in the shadows seems to be pulling you into a long-buried conspiracy…

        For the first time, even a Goddess of Love standing high above the world must step directly into the tangled emotions of humanity. Together with your companion, the twin-headed bird “Chirchee”, you are tasked not only with bringing fulfillment to lovers trapped in challengers, misunderstandings, and emotional distance, but also with fulfilling a prophecy passed down through generations of G.o.L: “You are the one destined to end that existence.”

        If you have ever believed that “Every life has its own sky and freedom, and the true mission of a G.o.L is to let two people walk side by side beneath the same sky,” and if you still feel that “Pure idealism is always the most moving. ”; then this time, become the moon hanging high in the dark night, record every longing and memory of humanity, illuminate the deepest hours of midnight, and shatter the prejudices and barriers looming above the world.

About This Game

"You are the God of Love... yet you are also part of the game."

Incinera: The Fifth Reincarnation is a story-driven visual novel that blends exploration, puzzle-solving, and a variety of interactive mini-games. Investigate clues scattered across different corners of the world, accompany people through defining moments of their lives, and shape the course of the story through your observations and choices. A single forgotten sentence, an old keepsake, or a fleeting encounter may return hours later in ways you never expected.

Spanning over one million Chinese characters, this is an epic narrative about love, memory, and humanity. Although romance lies at its heart, every major character passes the Bechdel Test. No one exists solely to serve another person's love story. Each has their own dreams, burdens, and reasons to keep moving forward. Even you, the God of Love, are caught within a conflict where there are no absolute heroes or villains, only different choices made across an endless cycle of reincarnation.

Unlike conventional visual novels, the people in The Fifth Reincarnation are not always honest. They lie. They hide the truth. As your journey unfolds, you'll discover that every character is driven by an obsession of their own, and every relationship carries its own regrets. Some choose to wait. Some choose to let go. Some struggle against fate, while others willingly surrender to it. They are not defined by romance alone, but by a lifelong search for someone who can truly understand them.

Eventually, you'll realize that these seemingly independent stories, set across different eras and worlds, are all connected. Together, they draw you into a reincarnation that spans thousands of years. As every fragment falls into place and unfamiliar names become threads of the same destiny, you'll begin to see everyone you met in a new light, and you'll find yourself questioning what love truly is, what defines a soul, and whether free will can ever exist.

We hope Incinera: The Fifth Reincarnation becomes more than just a game. We hope it feels like a novel you can step inside, a long journey through human relationships, social identities, and the roles people perform throughout their lives. There are no absolute answers here, no simple divide between good and evil. There are only ordinary people doing their best to live. They laugh, they argue, they lose, and even in their darkest moments, they continue to believe in one another.

World Background

"If the sky is nothing more than the reflection upon a lake, then let love be the force that brings me to its shore."

The Gods of Love are nothing like the legends humanity has imagined. They do not make people fall in love with bows, red strings, or supernatural will alone. In fact, among the countless gods and demigods worshipped by mortals, the minds of nearly all of them are themselves overseen by the Gods of Love.

The true Gods of Love reside beyond space and time in a transcendent realm known as Avatamsaka, the Void Realm. It is a place beyond the comprehension of any intelligent civilization, the eternal sanctuary where souls ultimately belong.

At the heart of this realm stands Incinera, a device capable of infiltrating thought itself. Resting silently within the magnificent Office of the Gods of Love, it is surrounded by the totems, records, and teachings left behind by generations of its predecessors, guiding each new God of Love in understanding the complexities of the human heart.

By channeling Incinera's immense power, you are able to briefly descend into the human world. Ironically, this ability also gave birth to one of humanity's oldest misunderstandings. Long ago, several Gods of Love accidentally left behind the bows and red strings that were never meant to symbolize romance at all, but merely served as safety tools for traveling between dimensions. Humanity mistook them for instruments of love, creating countless myths and names for beings they never truly understood.

Incinera possesses the ability to collect the quantum information of every substance within the human world. Ignoring the boundaries of time, space, and consciousness, it can instantly implant that information into the neural system of any chosen individual. As a result, people suddenly "think of" ideas they never expected. Nearly every moment of inspiration humanity has ever experienced has, in one way or another, been quietly guided by the Gods of Love.

The machine can also manipulate weather by releasing enormous amounts of energy, creating sudden rainstorms and lightning to subtly influence the direction of human thought. Strange phenomena such as sunshowers are merely side effects of this invisible intervention.

Powering Incinera is an extraordinary lifeform known as the Potaras Blossom.

Native only to the Void Realm, Potaras somehow found their way into lower-dimensional worlds, including both the realm of humanity and the domains inhabited by the so-called gods worshipped by mortals.

The energy released by only a handful of Potaras is enough to propel an entire civilization through exponential technological advancement. Every advanced civilization that has ever succeeded in constructing a Dyson Sphere owes part of its history to the brief appearance of these miraculous flowers.

Yet Potaras are unlike any ordinary plant.They can germinate only through continuous quantum entanglement. Because humanity lacks genuine longing and uncompromising idealism, Potaras should never be able to bloom in the human world.

And yet, at the very beginning of your mission, something impossible catches your attention.

A destitute street musician possesses a guitar crafted from Potaras wood.

Even more unsettling, nobody seems to notice.

People pass by as though this unimaginably precious source of life and energy has always existed among them.

How could a civilization so technologically primitive come into possession of a plant that can only bloom through pure, uncorrupted longing?

It seems that on Earth in the 38th century, something far more mysterious than your mission as the God of Love is already waiting for you.

A Message from the Developers

By the time your journey comes to an end, you may have forgotten the solution to a puzzle, the mechanics of a mini-game, or even a line of dialogue. But we hope one sentence will remain with you long after the credits roll:

"Even if the world pushes us toward different paths again and again, even if memories fade and our names are erased by time, some things endure far longer than time itself. And somewhere, in the next reincarnation, someone will recognize you once again."

Welcome to The Fifth Reincarnation, the opening chapter of the Incinera series and the first entry in the 12.8 million-character shared universe, Snowbird 2280.

We hope that, somewhere along this journey, you'll find the one willing to cross time itself... and meet you again.


 Key Features

  • Nonlinear, parallel narrative: Six chapters, five lives, all bound by a single thread of fate. The story breaks free from linear time, translating the contrapuntal art of musical fugue into narrative form.

  • Expansive story universe: Over 1 million words of script and 6–10 hours of gameplay. The story unfolds episodically with depth and lasting impact. It is not purely romance-driven, offering space for deduction and interpretation across vastly different eras and characters.

  • Visual Novel × Puzzle gameplay: Reading alone is not enough. Use logic, exploration, and investigation to “facilitate” destined relationships. Multiple side quests expand the themes beyond love into diverse narrative territories.

  • Diversed mini-games: Performance, painting, assembly, cognitive phantoms, and more interactive experiences bring ritualistic weight to story progression.

  • Distinctive art style: A fusion of realistic oil painting and dreamlike lighting, creating an emotional atmosphere where reality and illusion intertwine.

  • Soulful original soundtrack: Original soundtracks and two theme songs blending classical and electronic composition accompany every encounter and farewell.

  • Intangible Cultural Heritage Integration: Jiangyong Nüshu(Chinese Gynoglyph), Menglian Kinnari Dance, Chinese Seal Script, and Ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs are woven into the narrative, encouraging awareness of intangible cultural heritage.

  • Multilingual support: Available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English (with more to come).

data.name: The Highest School: Don’t Look Down
data.detailed_description:
Getting to school should be easy. Not when your school is at the top of the world.

The Highest School: Don’t Look Down is a vertical climbing adventure where a simple trip to school becomes an insane journey through time.

Your destination is waiting somewhere far above. There are no shortcuts, no elevators, and no easy way up.

You just have to keep climbing.

Begin your journey in the Ancient World and climb your way through different eras of human history. The higher you go, the more the world changes around you — new architecture, environments, characters, obstacles, and challenges await in every era.

Scale ancient ruins, cross pirate wrecks, climb through the Wild West, conquer the modern world, and push even higher toward the future.

Anything can become your next step.

Jump across buildings, vehicles, ruins, machines, floating structures, and whatever else you can find to gain a little more height.

But be careful.

There are no checkpoints waiting to save you after every difficult jump. One mistake can send you falling hundreds of meters — through places and entire eras you already conquered.

The school is waiting at the top.

The only question is...

Can you reach it?

CLIMB THROUGH TIME.

REACH THE SCHOOL.

DON’T LOOK DOWN.

data.name: NEVER SAFE IN DELAWARE
data.detailed_description:
Take control of three of America’s most dangerous fugitives in a breakneck, intense battle against the scum and criminals infesting the city. 

NEVER SAFE IN DELAWARE is built on a kinetic combat system inspired by the best games in the action genre to achieve precise gunplay and satisfying melee combat. 

Fight your way through crank-pushing gangsters, men in black, and secret paramilitary death squads. Swap between each of the three characters on the fly, each with a unique arsenal and skill set, as they fight to make a daring escape from the worst city in America. 

More guns than the Army. Wield flamethrowers, nailguns, Saturday Night Specials, and RPGs to dispatch, melt, and pulverize your enemies. With 20+ weapons divided between the three characters, combat stays varied and unpredictable. 

A CITY UNDER THE BLADE: A NATION DIVIDED 

In the aftermath of a country-wide civil war, Delaware has been transformed into a prison state. Criminals from every neighboring power are sent there, ruled by a heavily militarized city-state government. Declared one of the worst cities in the Western Hemisphere, Delaware becomes the battleground for three lowlifes: a vagabond, a rat, and a pastor, who are pulled into a deadly conspiracy. Against all odds, they become America’s most unlikely heroes as they fight to escape the prison city. 

The story of NEVER SAFE IN DELAWARE is brought to life with full voice acting and expressive sprite animation.

data.name: BattleMore
data.detailed_description:
Classic Strategy. Classic Fun.
Tension, gripping story lines, and highly competitive ladder are all things you WON'T find here. Instead, join the random escapades of a bloated military faction as they try to uphold peace through brute force.
​
This Real Time Strategy Game lets you command armies in a single player campaign with a variety of missions ranging from the insane to the merely absurd. A callback to both old and new strategy games alike, lovers of the genre will have a blast.

Game Features:

- 15 Mission Campaign
- Army customization hub between missions
- Over 30 unique units across 5 factions
- Super Weapons to alter the tide of any battle
- A Healthy helping of parody of the RTS genre.

New Content - SwapOut! Play campaign style missions with/against any playable faction (beta)

Upcoming Features:

- More Swap Out Missions
- More Swap Out Factions


Brought to you by Heat Wave Games, a one man studio hellbent on creating wacky stuff.

data.name: Evoplasm
data.detailed_description:
Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike/Autobattler. Grow a microorganism by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

Build Your Creature

Add new cells to your creature to grow. Cells can be surrounded by cell walls which add defense, but constrain your growth in the future, so you'll need to strategically balance how your creature grows and where your creature is defended.

Mutate to gain powerful synergies. Add a cryostalk to add a chance to freeze enemies to your attacks, then boost the freeze duration by mutating your cells into cryolymphs. Or add some leaves to your cells to add some local healing, boost your healing potential by mutating your cells into chloroplasts, then convert your healing into damage by mutating another cell with exotoxins. There are a staggering amount of possibilities.

Fight Tactical Battles

Fight weird creatures in real-time tactical battles. Many attacks are automatic but you can use special abilities to neutralize your enemy's key cells. Or target the cells that are holding a creature together to literally break them apart from their neural core. Pause the battle mid-combat to evaluate your strategy and decide if you need to keep fighting or flee instead.

Make Your Own Path

Choose a Strategic Path Across Three Campaign Acts. Adding strategy-layer mutations like eyes can help you reveal the encounters on the map so you can pick a path that allows you to avoid battles and find helpful events instead. Or you can challenge extra elite enemies or raid cellular graveyards for extra rewards, if you dare to defeat the bones of former failed runs. You're running out of time though, each move you make takes you closer to a challenging and intense boss fight! Will you be strong enough to survive or will you go extinct?

Choose Your Fighter

Unlock a Multitude of Creatures and Mutations. You can start the game as a variety of different creatures, and build them any way you want, or choose a wild start, and build your dream organism from scratch. As you take on harder enemies, you'll unlock their mutations too. Complete your Evopedia! Or if you hate the notion of unlocking stuff, you'll love our "unlock all" button.

Please add Evoplasm to your wishlist, or click the follow button to keep track of development, and any surprises along the way!

Evoplasm sends anonymous gameplay data to help balance the game. No personally identifiable information is collected. You can turn it off any time in Settings → Share Anonymous Data.

data.name: Mimic Busters
data.detailed_description:
MODEL. PAINT. MIMIC. HIDE FROM THE BUSTERS!


Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a sentient cube or a hunter with no mercy.

Mimics build their disguise with simple 3D modeling tools, and Busters hunt them before the time runs out!

YOU ARE WHAT YOU HIDE IN


Use a simple, intuitive set of 3D modeling tools to model and paint yourself into the environment.

Pick any prop you see and turn yourself from a walking cube into whatever helps you blend in.

NO MODELING SKILLS REQUIRED


If the Busters buy it, it's good enough.

BE BIG OR GO HOME


Mimics earn double points when hiding near MBI agents. The bigger your model is, the more points you get.

LISTEN. SEARCH. HUNT! BUST THE MIMICS!


Mimics squeak every 30 seconds. Keep your ears open to pinpoint their location. But don't spray the room to hope for a stray bullet to find its target. Because every bullet costs you health.

"Mimics don't hide behind stuff, they become...the stuff."
MBI AGENT #77 (DECEASED)

ASSUME THE SHELF IS LYING

IT'S YOUR AGENT, YOUR GUN, AND YOUR MODEL

CUSTOMIZE YOUR LOOK


The same 3D tools also let you build your character's head, body, arms, and legs. Your weapon gets a skin you painted yourself. Save your models and characters to the library for later revisions. It's all your work!

GAME MODE: GUESS THE MIMIC!


This is where you step onto the stage as a proud Mimic ready to showcase their talents instead of hiding. One player is crowned the Mimic and secretly picks a word to model from different categories.

Their job is to model that word for the lobby while everyone races to guess it first. Think of it as a training scenario for MBI agents. Gotta know thy enemy!

GAME MODE: MIMIC DEATHMATCH!


Bring stealth and tactical ambushes together in our wildest mode yet. Sculpt your own custom disguise, blend into the room, and ambush unsuspecting players to knock them out cold before they even know what hit them!

Not in the mood for mind games? If you just want pure action, we also have standard Solo and Team Deathmatch. Jump into fast-paced, absurd shootouts with a wacky arsenal, playable in both FPS and TPS views.

WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM

data.name: Coin Treasures
data.detailed_description:
Join our Discord, YARR!


About the Game





Coin Treasures is a Coin Pusher/Coin Dozer on Steroids including incremental progress, realistic physics, numerous upgrades & unlocks and stunning graphics.

Unlock artifact spawning. This enables artifacts to drop which will stay in the world after you've won the item. Collect your own treasures in the room filled with the treasure you find.

Unlock the Museum to keep track of your valuable Normal, Rare, Epic, Legendary or Mythic Artifacts.

Unlock powerful powerups, but be careful this also unlocks powerdowns. Try to get them off the play area to avoid temporary penalties. Collecting the powerups will give you temporary benefits.

Use synergies between Powerups to use their combined effects to earn more Treasure.

Unlock fun quests, finish them to get awesome rewards to speed up unlocking more!

Unlock the Auto Dropper to help you in your clicking journey.

Unlock the Power Deck to create your own combination of Powerups and Powerdowns.

Unlock The Leaderboard to compete with other player for the highest score.

Unlock the Black Flag Jackpot to win high Coin amounts.

Play in Marathon Mode to prolong your journey and have a more challenging game and collect a lot more Artifacts in the process.

The aim of the game is to keep upgrading everything and have a lot of fun doing so.

If you like incremental clicker/idle/upgrade games you will have a lot of fun playing this game.

data.name: Dark Legion VR
data.detailed_description:
Dark Legion VR is a first person shooter (FPS) and magic game. The player plays a chief officer on a space mission. The spaceship breaks down on the way back to earth, causing a forced landing onto a mysterious planet. In order to return back to earth, the player starts an expedition to search for energy source, only to find a huge conspiracy that a military troop on this planet is making mutant creatures in secret, that will be a catastrophe for human race. To protect your own race and your own planet, load your weapons and go destroy the dark legion!

You can move freely using HTC Vive (if you have enough space) and teleport yourself. All the scenes are open and free.
Huge battle scenes, advanced game level design, and smart AI, making you indulged in the game for a dozen hours (which we wouldn’t suggest you to go for that long, that’s why we have archives).

Features
a. Combination of Shooting and Spells
The character can release the spells and the enemy also gets similar power. There are also magicla traps In the stages.

b. Weapon System
You can use Pistols, Machine Guns, Shotguns, Rifles, RPGs, Grenades, TNTs, Bows and Shields. You can feel it as reality when you reload, release the bold, aim and fire.

c. AI Smart enemies
The enemy is built with high-level AI system. They could dodge, duck and aim at the player.

d. The Collection System
You could find the treasure in the stages to archive supplies including Health, Weapons and Ammo. You will also need the clues to find the password and open the door to the next area.

e. The Real Shooting Practice
Get familiar with every weapon you use. Score and locations will be displayed. You could also invite your friend to compete with.

data.name: Rogue Circuit
data.detailed_description:
Build the strategy. Let your driver race, or take control yourself.

Rogue Circuit is a racing roguelite about building a strategy while drivers fight for every position. Choose a car and driver, earn experience during the race, and assemble a five-card loadout that changes how your machine behaves. Trust your driver or take manual control whenever the race demands it.

Equip tuning that changes the car itself. Teach it techniques that react to the race. Trigger powerups on the right section of track. Turn collisions into revenge. Every rival develops a loadout too, so the field becomes more chaotic and capable as the championship continues.

Make The Decisions

  • Build across five card types: Driver, Tuning, Technique, Powerup, and Revenge.
  • Choose upgrades as levels arrive and replace cards when a stronger option is worth the trade.
  • Combine effects naturally. There are no prescribed synergy bonuses telling you what to build.

Watch The Race Evolve

  • Let your driver race autonomously, or take direct control when you want it.
  • Rivals choose their own cards and compete with different racing behavior.

Rogue Circuit is a racing roguelite about building a strategy while drivers fight for every position. Choose a car and driver, earn experience during the race, and assemble a five-card loadout that changes how your machine behaves. Trust your driver or take manual control whenever the race demands it.

Equip tuning that changes the car itself. Teach it techniques that react to the race. Trigger powerups on the right section of track. Turn collisions into revenge. Every rival develops a loadout too, so the field becomes more chaotic and capable as the championship continues.

  • Follow any driver or let the TV camera find overtakes, impacts, and revenge moments.

Experiment

  • Use Custom mode to choose maps, weather, card categories, tiers, lap count, and experience rules.
  • Use Sandbox to equip specific cards and inspect combinations immediately.

data.name: Monstaurant
data.detailed_description:
Running a diner is hard enough. Keep the grill going, get the orders out before anybody loses patience, keep the place clean, and count the till at the end of the night.

Oh - and every customer is a monster. Most of them just want a burger and a coffee, and they will pay for it. Some of them walked in for something else, and you will not know which is which until one comes up out of the kitchen floor behind you.

There is a shotgun on the prep counter. Try not to need it.

Cook the food

Six dishes and a coffee machine, and every one of them goes wrong differently. A burger is six taps and a stove you have to watch. A pizza is twenty seconds of nothing, so start it early. Fries punish you for not lifting the basket. Coffee is the one thing nobody can ruin - press it, watch the cup fill, and pour whatever you like into the foam. And leave anything on the heat long enough and the kitchen catches fire, after which you have thirty seconds to find the extinguisher.

Serve the monsters

Eighteen of them, and the front door is a coin toss. Most of them sit down, order, eat, use the toilet and pay on the way out. Some are only here for you. On the third night, three garden gnomes walk in together, and they are not hungry.

Two cooks, one shift

All of it is co-op. Proximity voice chat, so a voice comes out of the mouth that said it and fades on the walk to the storeroom. One shotgun between you. When something has your friend off the floor, you are the only thing that puts it down - and when he goes down anyway, you have fifteen seconds to reach him.

...and one bottle of ketchup

Hold the button and it sprays where you are looking. That is how you finish a hot dog. It is also how you cover your friend, the wall behind them, and most of their screen.

Twelve nights

Each one longer and busier than the last. Buy an oven, a deep fryer, a hot dog roller - and until you can afford one it stands in your kitchen as a padlocked ghost of itself, so you always know what you are saving for. The third night does not end when the doors shut. Something is already waiting in the car park.

Monstaurant is a PS1-era diner shot through a camcorder: flat textures, tape grain and a lot of dark corners. Two players, one join code, nothing to forward.

data.name: Game Dev Masters
data.detailed_description:
Community Driven



As a full time solo developer I highly value player feedback and suggestions. Come join a growing community and leave your mark on this game and all my future games by joining the games discord. Links found on the store page as well as in game.

Basic Info



In Game Dev Masters you play as a brand new solo developer in a modern 3D office. Train, Research, Acquire Skills, and create best selling games using over 4,000 Topic + Genre Combinations.

In Game Dev Masters all the data you have gathered is made available to you during game development. You will need to make critical decisions on how to spend your time, as well as meet all the minimum requirements that dynamically change as time passes based on your audience's expectations.

Advanced Info



After you have released a few successful games, you can progress to additional offices which lets you forge your own world class development team. Every team member has their own stats, skills, and specialties. Improve and use your team as you see fit.



When you are ready for the big time. You can acquire subsidiary companies from the 15 dynamically generated AI competitors. Form your own conglomerate, and use your studios to make games for you, or work with them on AAA projects. Each of your acquisitions can be trained, invested in, and specialized.

Competitive Replayability



Many elements of the game are being generated for you on each new game. You cannot rely on guides or previous results to create your games. You will need to think logically, and engage with the many in game systems to overcome the challenges that come with each game you create, and these challenges will increase as you progress.

Every new game is different, and you will always have to make good decisions if you want to climb to the top of the Global Leader Boards, and earn a spot in the permanent Hall of Fame.

Game Seeds



In Game Dev Masters you can make a choice between a completely procedural generated world or, one based on our reality.

In a procedural world, you can not predict what game types will match well with what genre's. Instead, you will need to use in game tools to learn what works, then design games within these rules unique to your play through.

In a realistic world, matches attempt to mimic our real world gaming industry. Using your knowledge of the real world, you can make decisions as to what topics will match with the genres and targets. Or make use of in game tools.

No matter what Seed you choose, the requirements for some aspects are randomized, and you will need to make good choices during game design, as well as properly manage your team.

A Challenge Awaits



As you continue to grow your company, and progress to larger sizes of games. They will each come with their own additional levels of complexity, difficulty, and additional features. Leading up to the most elaborate and engaging AAA game design experience ever created in a tycoon game.

You will need to make use of everything available to create masterpiece 10 / 10 AAA Games. With a focus on an engaging end game combined with multiple scoring systems, and global leader boards. You will truly be able to stake your claim as the worlds greatest Game developer.

As the years go by your video game audience expectations will increase. You will need to keep your custom engines up-to-date, and your workers well trained if you plan to take over the gaming industry, and have the entire planet as your fan base.

What You Can Expect



  • Create games of various sizes
  • Customize your manager and choose a one time manager perk
  • 160+ topics, 24+ genres
  • Create DLC, Console Ports, Remakes, Remasters, Sequels
  • Hire, train, slot skills, and specialize each unique worker
  • Huge array of research options regarding engine features for custom engine creations
  • Commercially license your engines for AI's to use
  • Negotiate and publish games for smaller studios
  • Buy / Sell Stock and even Acquire Ai as Subsidiary companies
  • Invest, train, and specialize your acquisitions and put them to work for you
  • Conventions, yearly awards, and other dynamic events
  • Use loans or long term investments, even read detailed revenue reports
  • Compete for top scores on Global Leader Boards and Hall of Fame events
  • Multiple offices that can be customized in color / lighting / mood
  • Offices have upgrades that can boost stats or give buffs
  • Beautiful 3D environments, including particle effects
  • Adopt, train, and specialize your own company pet mascot that provides stat perks
  • Deep Dive Research topics, or learn about genres, and even platforms
  • Game changing skills for workers such as "Slow Time" or "Crunch"
  • Delay games to hit the perfect balance, and set prices for each game
  • Real Review Lines from known Reviewers

Plus so much more, but stop reading this and go try the DEMO for yourself.

data.name: Underboard
data.detailed_description:
Find all the Cameos!


About the Game

Tactical team-building roguelike auto-battler with active and passive playstyles. Draft a team, level them up, equip loot, and stack Traits to maximize your synergies. Fight through randomized maps, using your spells and Masteries to support and refine your builds. Explore multiple Zones to conquer challenging bosses and help your team escape the Underboard.

Tactical Roguelike Auto Battler

  • Characters battle on their own based on positioning and aggression. Look out for enemy threats and position your team accordingly.

  • Build a team of characters with traits, items and spells to create the best synergies you can.

  • Cast spells to actively support your team in battles, or reserve your Mana to grant them passive bonuses. Upgrade your best spells or go for more tactical flexibility.

Team Building

  • Draft a team of characters, each enhanced with random Traits. Matching Traits between characters grants further bonuses to your team.

  • Level up your characters by killing monsters, then kill bosses to unlock their evolutions.

  • Loot and craft items to equip characters with stat bonuses, extra traits or unique effects.

  • There are countless combinations of characters, traits, items, spells and hundreds of unique stats!

Deep Progression

  • Explore randomized maps shrouded in fog of war, full of monsters and treasures.

  • Unlock harder Zones to explore by killing Pinnacle bosses at the end of your explorations.

  • Each Zone has its own distinct theme, with its own enemies and bosses to conquer.

  • Unlock Masteries as you play, allowing you to further specialize your teams for future explorations!

data.name: CoGaWan
data.detailed_description:
CoGaWan is a retro puzzle game inspired by the DOS era, where you take control of a furry creature and your goal is to paint the world around you.

Collect colors from fountains, combine them, and think carefully about every move. Each step changes the game board, and one wrong decision can cost you the entire level.

The game is built on simple rules, but gradually challenges you with increasingly complex puzzles where you must mix colors (cyan, magenta, yellow) and use them strategically.

Key Features:

• Unique color-mixing mechanic (CMY system)

• Dozens of puzzle levels

• Level editor with random map generation

• Easy mode suitable for children – toggle painting on/off and focus only on the tiles that matter

• Retro visuals inspired by classic DOS games

• Low hardware requirements

• Perfect for both short sessions and longer play

Can you find the right path and paint the entire world?

Note: The game runs via an included DOSBox Staging emulator.

data.name: Mythfall
data.detailed_description:
Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg. Face deadly bosses, forge alliances, and carve your legacy in a world where every fight could be your last.

We currently have a pre-alpha demo on our website. You can play directly in your browser!

Face Relentless Bosses

Every boss fight is a high-stakes showdown where survival is never guaranteed. Dodge waves of relentless projectiles, exploit attack patterns, and unleash your best abilities in a test of pure skill. One mistake could end your journey for good. Will you rise above the chaos, or will you fall like so many before you?

Hunt, Gather, Craft, Conquer

Every battle earns you resources: Rare materials, essences, and legendary drops. Forge powerful gear, enhance your abilities, and shape your character to survive this unforgiving world. The stronger you become, the deadlier your enemies - but every victory brings you one step closer to mastery.

Rise Stronger with Every Fall

Death isn’t the end - it’s a step toward greatness. Every time you fall, you earn Honor Points, unlocking account-wide progression that makes your next journey even stronger. Level up your legacy, unlock powerful bonuses, and prove your resilience. True strength isn’t measured by how long you last, but by how much you grow with every rebirth.

Other Features

  • Cooperative Multiplayer: Team up with friends or meet fellow adventurers in a world where cooperation is key.

  • Diverse Skills: Complete quests to earn skill points and refine your build for ultimate power.

  • Character Customization: Personalize your character with a variety of haircuts, colors, and cosmetics to stand out in the world.

  • Complete Achievements: Earn achievements and unlock exclusive chat badges to showcase your victories.

  • Openly Developed: Mythfall is actively developed with frequent developer livestreams and regular devlog updates, giving you an inside look at the game’s progress. Join the community, share your feedback, and watch as we shape the world together!

data.name: Command or Engage
data.detailed_description:
Command or Engage is a modern Action Combat / Role Playing game set in various terrain styles and settings, Build units from buildings, fight along side your troops to take control points, build gold mines and farms and maybe help them gather resources to support more troops, or wander off from the battle and engage various monsters and enemies for a chance at some good loot while you level up and get stronger, challenge people to a 2.5D street fight if you're game.

Play as a Soldier with an arsenal and command units.

Build Farmers, bakers and more

SOLDIERS POINT OF VIEW

The game takes place in the year 2050, where governments are fighting over control of an unstable worm hole, the first side to discover the right frequency to use it, will have access to a time portal, armies will fight to control sections of the map, and also fight the mysterious rumoured magic users, engaging both sides for an unknown reason.

Play as a Shape Shifting Mage Shooting Energy Balls, Fire Balls and More.

MAGIC USERS POINT OF VIEW

The year for us is 4500, we are no longer the dominant species of the planet, instead we fight to maintain what little of the planet we occupy, we have finally decided to use our forbidden time portal and go back to where it all started, we will do anything to stop our former selves from activating the worm hole, some thing have already entered their world, but once they have access to it completely, that's when the bigger ones start coming through.

Play as a Powerful Shapeshifting Vampire, watching and selecting your victims.

Use Unique abilities to Destroy your opponents.

Humans are weak prey.

Kill Challenging AI for loot.

Or Come and watch the fights and do some trading.

Try your luck and win some cash

data.name: HoverRider
data.detailed_description:
This is a racing game set in the year 2090. In this world where cities and nature are adjacent to each other, players will race to achieve faster times. This game will give you a new feeling of control that you will never get from other games of the same genre.
Graphics
One of the features of this game is its graphics, which are as good as those of games sold by other companies. There are two courses, one with daylight and the other with night, each with a bright atmosphere, and one with a somewhat cold atmosphere in pitch-darkness, partially illuminated by the lights of the streets and buildings.
Both stages can be changed according to the player's preference, allowing the player to enjoy the scenery while driving.
Time Attack
Players compete for the fastest time to complete one lap of the course. The game is a different kind of hovercraft from conventional games, and players can use it to drive through the course at super speeds. You will be able to get an unprecedented feeling of control as you run across the course at speeds of 300 kilometers per hour.
Online Ranking
You can send your time recorded in Time Attack to the online ranking system to compete with other users around the world. The game is a great way to improve your hovercraft operation skills and to race faster than other players from around the world.

translator : DeepL

data.name: ROMPICHE-8
data.detailed_description:
Planet Zionx, Year 2068, its inhabitants are threatened by an emperor, come to their rescue by offering them food or sleep for example...


Discover ROMPICHE-8 in full version ! Initially developed for the Gamejam Advance, ROMPICHE-8 is an action-adventure game with an absurd sense of humor in which you play as a robot in charge of bringing peace and rest to the planet Zionx.


In a gameplay inspired by the FPS of the 90s, you are over-equipped with rest material :
  • Pillows (for sleeping)
  • Sandwiches (to eat)
  • And many other weapons ...

Great for a good night of sleep !


Create your own levels with the MIAMO editor, for increased replayability, then share them with the world on Steam Workshop!


Ready for the sandwich race? Discover the different online cooperative and versus modes of ROMPICHE-8!

Modes Planned For Launch


  • Playing the campaign in online coop
  • Race in a competitive game mode !

data.name: Kaetram
data.detailed_description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD


About the Game

Kaetram is a free-to-play pixel art MMORPG built for players who love classic adventure, meaningful progression, and a rewarding grind.

Step into an online world where there are explorations to be had. Your character growth comes from time, effort, and determination. Whether you’re chasing rare drops, leveling skills, or simply wandering the world looking for secrets; Kaetram embraces the core MMORPG experience.

Kaetram's charming pixel art visuals are inspired by classic RPGs, that blend nostalgia with modern multiplayer design. Clean visuals help to keep the focus on gameplay, progression, and the community.

Trade with other players using our global auction house system, The Stonk Exchange. Place either a buy or a sell order, and once a match has been found, both parties receive their items!

In this world; you'll find all your favorite classic skills. Gather resources from the world, refine them, and turn your efforts into useful gear and upgrades. Every skill contributes to your journey and supports multiple playstyles.

data.name: KIBAKI !
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Welcome to the world of KIBAKI!

KIBAKI! is a strategic card game where every match becomes a battle of prediction, anticipation, and collection.

Start with the eight classic cards, build your deck, and discover a growing universe filled with creatures known as Virtuamon.

BUILD YOUR STRATEGY

Every decision can turn the tide of a match.

  • Play with the 8 classic cards.

  • Challenge the computer or other players.

  • Anticipate your opponent's choices.

  • Use Instant cards to turn a match around.

  • Develop new strategies with every game.

EXPAND YOUR COLLECTION

The Virtuamon Laboratory allows you to build an ever-growing collection.

Open packs, discover new Virtuamon, collect Potions, and unlock powerful evolutions. Experiment with different combinations and build decks that match your playstyle.

MASTER KIBAKI!

KIBAKI! combines simple rules with prediction, deck building, collection, and progression.

Learn the basics in minutes, develop your own strategies, expand your collection, and challenge your opponents as you explore everything the KIBAKI! universe has to offer.

data.detailed_description:
Defend the Tower Against Enemy Invasions!

Your mission: protect the tower and its battle flag from relentless enemies. If the enemy reaches the top of the tower where the flag is located, the tower is considered captured.

Use your heavenly magic sword to eliminate groups of enemies of the same color with precise strikes. Take advantage of powerful bonuses to enhance your combat efficiency, but beware of negative effects that can hinder your progress.

Manage your resources wisely, as they might be limited, and ensure every shot counts.

The game includes three difficulty modes: easy, medium, hard.

The full game features an action-packed journey with 60 challenging levels!

Completing levels doesn't always depend on your skills, you also need luck.

Are you ready to defend your tower and claim victory? The battle awaits!

data.name: Wonderway
data.detailed_description:
Wonderway is a puzzle game where the direction of gravity can be changed. Every element in this game interacts with gravity in its own way. You can change the position of items by arrows and portals, utilize cores of energy doors to create passages or blocks, use arrow-shifters to control the direction of arrows, and even separate the gravity of character from the space. Explore many more mechanics and get to the goal by moving and manipulating every items in the levels.

The game has over 170 hand-crafted puzzles which experiment with the game's mechanics in a multitude of ways. Each puzzle contains at least one new idea, which showcases the wonder of the way to the goal. Hope you enjoy exploring and solving these puzzles.

data.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in this exhilarating new adventure from Panache Digital Games.

Embark on the most incredible odyssey known to humankind: human evolution. Spanning from 10 million to 2 million years ago, begin your journey, before us, in Neogene period Africa. Explore a beautiful yet ruthless world, from swinging through tree branches in the jungle to stalking prey across the golden savannah grasslands. Decide what attributes to learn and hone in order to pass down knowledge to future generations, from crafting tools to enhancing evasive tactics against predators. Just like real life, make sure to eat, drink, and sleep to stay alive and have the energy to face any danger that may come your way.

Grow your clan and find strength in numbers as you progress through critical evolutionary stages of human evolution. Your choices will write your clan’s story and determine if you can survive your evolution.

Explore Ruthless Africa

Explore the never-before-experienced world of Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago at the dawn of humankind. From the tops of tree canopies overlooking lush jungles to the golden grasslands of the savannah, traverse a beautiful yet unforgiving landscape. For every breath-taking view, beware of the weather, predators, and other dangers that threaten your survival.

Expand Your Territory and Grow Your Clan

Increase your chances of survival by uniting new members of your species and giving birth to future generations. Control different clan members, form bonds to create families, and work together to intimidate predators during expeditions. Conquer fear as you explore unknown locations in order to expand your territory.

Evolve Through Multiple Generations

See the physical and intellectual evolution of the first hominids as you explore, learn, and survive. Spanning from 10 million to 2 million years ago, play as one of the first hominids and evolve over the course of millions of years during key stages in human evolution. Make crucial discoveries and hone physical abilities that will be passed down to future generations such as Ardipithecus ramidus and Australopithecus.

Choose How You Survive

Evolution was not written in stone. Your decisions shape how you will overcome obstacles, increase your species, and what knowledge will pass on to future generations. Focus on specific attributes or choose a more balanced approach to survival. Your clan’s ability to survive will be directly impacted by your choices, making each player’s experience unique.

data.name: Reigns Beyond
data.detailed_description:
As an intergalactic indie rock band, plot your rise to stardom, traveling from planet to planet and gig to gig on your quest for fame and fortune. Play local (and not-so-local) clubs throughout the galaxy, recruiting alien band members along the way, and rock out across the cosmos! But make sure you're managing your ship's resources and keeping your crew in check while on this stellar tour because one wrong decision may leave you dead in space!

FEATURES

  • Unlock the legendary Galactic Guitars and rock out in front of your adoring fans.
  • Fight pirates, overzealous tax collectors and more in swiping dogfights.
  • Hang out on your ship for band practice and offer directions to lost space travellers
  • Meet 60+ curious characters, including your manager, Lord Shark, Strombo the scholarly mollusc, Gron the space bear, ... and of course your crew and your ship's know-it-all AI
  • 1400+ decision cards. Infinite possibilities!
  • Original soundtrack by Sam Webster

data.name: Board of the Kings: A Chess RPG
data.detailed_description:
Board of the Kings is a tactical roguelike role-playing game based in the original thousand-year classic, Chess. You play as the Ice King in the Kingdom of Caturess, vying over for control of the throne against your other seven sinister siblings. Each expedition into the lands will be unique, offering different Pieces, different events, different augments and powers, and different outcomes.

  • Build your Army: Conscript a variety of unique characters among the main Chess piece types. Level them up and enhance their powers and abilities beyond the confines of Chess!

  • Conquer your Enemies: Rally your troops against the unique foes and rivals in unpredictable battles and environments. However, beware! Death is permanent in the Kingdom of Caturess. Losing a piece means it'll be gone forever!

  • Prepare for Anything!: Strengthen your kingdom through the use of powerful augments and expect the unexpected when traversing the Kingdom of Caturess! Random encounters and quirky individuals are plentiful within the realm and you'll need everything you can offer to conquer the Kingdom and take the throne!

Key Features:

  • Grow a large, persistent army through your playthrough, managing and creating unique piece placements for each battle for each situation.

  • Customize your pieces, unlock new abilities, and prepare for any encounter.

  • Pieces lost in battle do not return, you'll need proper management and tactics to ensure victory.

  • Random battle and non-hostile encounters keeps every run different and offers a new experience for each playthrough.

  • Kingdom progression to make each expedition into the Kingdom of Caturess easier than the last until you achieve total victory.

  • Some basic chess knowledge may be required, but no advanced tactics will be required to enjoy your experience!

  • Designed for both chess purists and strategy and tactics fans alike.

data.name: Bastion Of Beginnings
data.detailed_description:
Bastion of Beginnings is a tower defense game that seamlessly blends roguelite elements and rich replayability.

Key Features:


Foundational Upgrade System: Start with a simplified upgrade system designed as a precursor to our comprehensive tech tree. This initial system allows us to build out the necessary elements, and will evolve into a more complex and branching tech tree system in the future, adding depth and richness to your progression.



Procedurally Generated Maps


Every game presents a new map, featuring unique terrain generated by our procedural algorithms. Our path generation system, which is tweakable, allows for both crazy and simple paths, perfectly tuned for tower defense.

Scaling/Varied Enemy Types: Face off against enemies that scale and grow tougher with each wave. Anticipate a boss wave every 10th wave, offering not just a challenge but also rewards that enhance your gameplay.

Adaptable Tower Upgrades: Embrace a versatile "attribute" system for tower customization, allowing you to fine-tune stats such as RPM for cannons or firing rate for snipers. Your strategy shapes their evolution. As bosses fall, you're offered a roll on the upgrade system, granting the choice to select enhancements for your towers. This system fosters numerous synergies, stacking effects, and unique special abilities.

Early Access Roadmap:

  • Driven by the Community: Your insights and input are crucial. Engage with us, share your thoughts on features, pinpoint bugs, and help direct the game’s progress.

  • Refinement and Enhancement: Expect ongoing enhancements that polish gameplay, graphics, and performance, delivering a seamless experience across a range of devices.

  • Fresh Threats and Defenses: Stay on the lookout for inventive tower options and new enemy variants that will join the fray.

  • Expanding Tech Tree: Delve into an intricate tech tree with diverse pathways, ensuring each choice has a significant impact on your play style.

  • Dynamic Landscapes: Look forward to more sophisticated world generation, including multiple enemy paths, alongside general improvements and optimizations.

Performance Improvements on the Horizon:
  • Behind-the-scenes work is set to majorly advance performance, paving the way for larger-than-life battles and a smoother gaming experience. Our future plans include transitioning to Unreal Engine’s Mass framework for unparalleled performance enhancements.

    We are currently maximizing what we can achieve with UE’s standard actor system. The shift to Mass is planned as our next big leap forward after we lay the foundation with our community’s support.

Join us in the world of Bastion of Beginnings and help us craft a game that’s as engaging to strategize as it is exhilarating to play.

data.name: The Hunt In Sanity
data.detailed_description:
About the game

The Hunt In Sanity (T.H.I.S) is a psychological atmospheric horror game that plunges players into a haunting descent through trauma, grief, and madness. Drawing inspiration from old classic horror games. T.H.I.S combines chilling exploration, cryptic storytelling, and visceral fear to deliver a deeply immersive experience.

Story Introduction:

After a crash returning home your wife vanishes.

You step out desperate to find her. You discovered that she's tied to a god’s awakening ritual and now you must not only save her, but also stop the ritual.

Your path is perilous and dangerous!

This is The Hunt In Sanity, Time is running out!

data.name: OAOA - Off And On Again
data.detailed_description:
Off And On Again tells the story of a hero tasked with rebooting time. The game world is created and destroyed during play, with the hero having the ability to turn parts of the world off and on again. You will be required to use both brains and skill to overcome the enemies and obstacles in your path.

Features

- A story about a dying world inside a computer system where you are the hero tasked with rebooting time
- A world that is created as you explore it
- Engaging puzzles using the ability of the player to turn parts of the world off and on in order to progress
- Lasers, because everything is better with lasers

Local Multiplayer features 4 game modes for 2-4 players. In each game mode players only have one shot, that they must recall and catch before being able to fire again.

Deathmatch
Elimination
Invasion
Break it

*** Please note that controllers are required to play the multiplayer modes ***

data.name: Into Oblivion
data.detailed_description:
Our Newest Game


About the Game

Into Oblivion is a drinking contest of ridiculous proportion. Each player is dealt five item cards per round and attempts to make one of many mixed drinks for themselves or their opponents. Some drinks have additional status effects, some will make you puke instantly, while others just leave a funny taste in your mouth. Mix, swap, and serve drinks to chip away at, or boost, each other's precious health, liver, and drunkenness to win.

In this game, it is all about how you drink. Into Oblivion features three main modes: normal, Top Shelf, and The Sobering. Half-way through all modes, there is a half-time, dice rolling mini-game called Midnight. Keeping at least one die per round, you will try to score a 1 and 4 then all other dice are your points. You'll net a fancy trophy and bonus points for your final score by winning.

In normal mode, you will compete to get the highest drunk score you can without going overboard. Of course you can always tank your opponent's liver to double the amount of drunk points they accumulate per drink, pushing them over the limit. Or you can reduce their health to zero and end the match fast. Use your accumulated drinks list, various status effects, or brutal mixology to win. If there is a tie, don't worry; everything is scored during a match so the points will decide in the end.

In Top Shelf, you can only use special mixed drinks. Generic sludge drinks won't have any affect but will, however, count towards your end score. Learn new drinks on the fly or buy the Bartender's Book from the Shady Merchant to get the upper-hand. Utilize status effects to your advantage and slang one of 209 drinks to win. Beyond that, same rules apply as in normal mode: higher drunk score the better, reduce health to zero, or score decides the winner.

In The Sobering, you are trying to keep your wits about you and your drunk score to a minimum. Ideally zero, or at least lower than your opponent. Keep an eye on your liver though, if it hits zero then you start taking double the drunk points per drink. Just like the previous two modes, knocking out the health score can instantly win the match and the score breaks all ties.

The game has the following features best laid out in list format with snappy phrases like:

  • Face off against eight different characters in single-player mode

  • Various outfits, hair styles, and accessories

  • Soundtrack by Macabre Gandhi and David Totten

  • Personal and global statistics on debauchery

  • Our favorite half-time mini-game Midnight

  • Steamworks multiplayer with invites

  • A leaderboard system of true alcoholics

  • 55 item cards to mix, match, and drink

  • 215 mixed drink recipes

  • 30 temporary buffs to save your hide or sabotage you

  • Drink in various locations around Starkham

  • Bet against friends and foes to acquire coins

  • Upgrade and unlock gear at the Shady Merchant's shop

  • 40 achievements to obtain

  • Halloween, X-Mas, St. Patrick's Day, and Easter Event modes

The game features online and LAN cross-platform multiplayer for Linux, Mac, and Windows so you can drink your buddies under the table no matter what operating system they use. Steamworks is now integrated so you can invite folks to your lobby through Steam or just browse for an open game.

Can't find a game? Don't like multiplayer? Face off against eight different "special" bots or a series of randomly generated generic ones in single-player.

data.name: Mecha Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Cleanse worlds. Survive the swarm. Upgrade your mech.

Mecha Survivors is a Survivors-like action roguelite where you take control of an advanced combat mech sent to purge hostile planets overrun by alien machines.

Dropped into endless warzones, you must face overwhelming waves of enemies, collect powerful upgrades, and adapt your build in real time. Choose from multiple mech classes, each with unique abilities and playstyles, and fight for survival on a planetary scale.

Key Features

  • Planetary purge missions: Deploy into procedurally generated battlefields to cleanse entire regions of enemy forces.

  • Top-down mech combat: Pilot heavy war machines in fast-paced, bullet-dodging action against massive enemy swarms.

  • Dynamic roguelite progression: Combine randomized skills and passive upgrades to create devastating builds.

  • Multiple mech classes: Unlock and master unique mechs with specialized skills and ultimate abilities.

  • Stylized sci-fi visuals: Vibrant low-poly environments filled with chaos, explosions, and reactive effects.

  • Replayable survival challenges: Every run is different. How long can you hold the line?

Survive. Adapt. Cleanse.

data.name: Ashes of Holloway Bay
data.detailed_description:
CASE FILE HB-2023-041

STATUS: ACTIVE INVESTIGATION

On the night of April 15th, 2023, a deliberate fire tore through 17 Seacliff Road, Holloway Bay. Three lives lost. One survivor was pulled from the flames.

You have been granted full access to the Holloway Bay Police Department’s restricted evidence system.

Examine police reports, fire department logs, witness interviews, digital messages, post-mortem findings, and a partially recovered hard drive containing archived footage that may rewrite the entire case.

Navigate an interactive case file interface: open folders, zoom into photographs, listen to interview recordings, crack password-protected partitions, and cross-reference evidence in the comparison viewer.

Every piece of media is real evidence. Every decision builds your theory.

At the end, submit your official report naming the individual responsible. One correct conclusion closes the case. The wrong one leaves it open.

Ashes of Holloway Bay is a single-player narrative mystery built like a real investigation. No hand-holding. No timers. Just you, the files, and the truth hidden in the details.

  • Fully interactive evidence system with zoomable images, playable videos, audio transcripts, and a functional password-protected HDD

  • Multiple paths through the case, review evidence in any order

  • Final report system with official resolution

  • Atmospheric dark police UI with authentic case-file presentation

  • Rich original writing and real-feeling documentation

“Truth is in the details.”

From Cold Case Inc.

content_descriptors.notes:
Ashes of Holloway Bay is a mature narrative mystery investigation game that deals with the realistic aftermath of a fatal house fire in which three people lost their lives.

The game contains references to death, smoke inhalation, and a deliberate arson incident. These themes are presented through official police reports, post-mortem documents, news footage, witness interviews, and digital evidence, all in a documentary-style case-file interface.

There is no graphic violence, blood, gore, sexual content, or nudity. The tone is dark and atmospheric, focusing on investigation, evidence analysis, and logical deduction rather than sensationalism.

Players should be comfortable with themes of loss, tragedy, and criminal investigation. The game is intended for a mature audience interested in realistic detective storytelling.

data.name: Martial Art’s History
data.detailed_description:
Martial Art’s History is a 1v1 traditional side-scrolling kung fu fighter shaped by classic Hong Kong martial arts films. Set in early Republican Shanghai, it depicts rival warriors settling grudges and competing for glory on arena stages. Take control of fighters mastering exclusive traditional kung fu to duel friends or strangers.

[h2] Gameplay Intro [/h2]

School Martial Arts: Characters master authentic styles including Hung Gar, Wing Chun, Tai Chi and Drunken Fist. A full system of strikes, grabs, counters and parries delivers weighty, grounded combat based on vintage fight choreography.

Offense & Defense: Light jabs, heavy crushing blows and finishing moves form your toolkit. Matches rely on spacing, reading enemy openings and tactical parrying, with zero over-the-top fantasy effects for pure realistic melee feel.

Arena Stages: Explore period-accurate maps: martial arts halls, open street arenas and old city alleys, built to support hit-and-run and close-quarters brawling tactics.

Battle Modes: Play single-player story or local two-player versus. Combos, blocks and counters create a complete fighting loop accessible for beginners and deep enough for competitive combo players.

[h2] Playable Warriors [/h2]

Unlock 11 original fighters, drawing inspiration from the diverse cast of Republican-era masters seen in classic kung fu cinema.

The roster covers hardened veteran dojo masters and hidden street experts: graceful lounge performers, skilled schoolgirls and quick-witted street youths. Every fighter carries unique backstories and signature moves, with totally distinct fighting styles and personalities.

[h2] Local Versus [/h2]

Duel friends offline to perfect custom combos and fight for supremacy on retro Republican fighting stages.

data.name: Tuition
data.detailed_description:
This is an incomplete project that was released for "early access" before ceasing development:

Placed in an abandoned university plagued by undead, you need to be creative and resourceful to have a chance of surviving. Your goal is to escape the building, but the hordes of zombies have other plans.

Everything in the environment is intractable and can be used to increase your odds of survival. Starting out with just a knife, pistol, and flashlight, you'll have to find better means of survival to make it through the night.

key Features
  • Zombies surge with increasingly challenging waves
  • Place wooden boards in doorways to barricade zombies
  • Use ladders, chairs, and anything you find to discover new powerful tools for survival
  • Try to escape while you can - a church bell will ring when you can expect another wave of zombies
  • Always keep an eye out - zombies like to trickle in
