data.name: ECHO OF FEAR: Vol.1 Night Visit
data.detailed_description:
THE FIRST EPISODE IS FREE TO PLAY

ECHO OF FEAR is a psychological horror game where you play as a detective who receives a box containing 3 mysterious videotapes. Each tape represents a separate story connected by a common plot. The plot is based on the Cthulhu myths by H.P. Lovecraft.

You are watching the first part of the ECHO OF FEAR anthology.

ECHO OF FEAR: Vol.1 Night Visit

In the first episode of "ECHO OF FEAR," the detective watches a videotape titled "Night Visit." You play as Louis Langridge, who decides to take a shortcut to the city of Arkham via a country road. But when a rainstorm begins, he seeks shelter in a lonely house. What could go wrong?

Gameplay

This game is a first-person narrative walking simulator with item carrying and exploration mechanics.

Key Features

[]Atmospheric environment and photorealistic graphics.
[]Each episode's story is part of a larger puzzle.
[]VHS movie and old film atmosphere.
[]Spatial puzzles.

data.name: Panic Heist
data.detailed_description:
Panic Heist is a physics-based co-op heist game where you and your fellow chicken thieves raid a museum for treasure! Dodge the security, grab the loot, and see who can rake in the most cash. You’re a team… until the scoreboard comes out.

SECURITY MEANS BUSINESS

Turrets and Claymores stand between you and the loot. Dodge the incoming fire, watch where you step, and try not to get yourself fired… out of the museum.

CASH IN YOUR LOOT

Haul your treasure to the museum’s Trash Chute and toss it in to get paid.

data.name: Yousei Daisensou ~ Touhou Sangetsusei
data.detailed_description:
ゲームの進め方


・ストーリー
　いつものようにせわしくなく暮らしていた氷の妖精チルノ。
　なんと、留守にした間に何者かに家を破壊されてしまった。
　破壊された家の上には謎の旗が立ててあった。
　その旗には見覚えのある妖精達の絵が……
　怒り狂ったチルノはその旗の持ち主に宣戦布告を出す。
　そう、これが妖精大戦争の始まりだった。
　（詳しくは
　　　　「東方三月精　～ Strange and Bright Nature Deity」
　　　　　　第二巻の読み切り「妖精大戦争」を参照）

・ルール
　チルノを操作し、三妖精（サニーミルク、ルナチャイルド、
　スターサファイア）を撃破します。

　チルノは敵弾を凍らせる能力を持ちます。
　これをうまく駆使して妖精最強を名乗りましょう！

チルノを操作する


・上下左右 　　 チルノの操作
・SHOTキー（Zキー)　　　　　　　　 ショット
　　溜撃ち　　　　　　　　　　　　　 アイスバリア
　　＊今作はSHOTキーではオート連射になりません
・RAPIDキー（Cキー か Ctrlキー）　　 ショット連射
・BOMBキー（Xキー） 　 パーフェクトフリーズ
・SLOWキー（Shiftキー）　　　　　　 低速移動
　　＊SHOTキー押しっぱなしでも低速移動になります
・PAUSEキー（Escキー）　　　　　　 ポーズ

画面を見る

・やる気
　　チルノの根性ゲージです。
　　ミスすると１００％減ります。
　　９９％以下の状態でミスをするとゲームオーバーです。

・こおりパワー
　アイスバリアをはるためのパワーです。
　常時自機の上に表示されている数字と同じ物です。

・パーフェクトフリーズ
　１００％以上の時、パーフェクトフリーズが使用できます。

・こおらせた面積
　敵弾を凍らせた総面積（累計）です。
　ショットの強さと直結しています。
　沢山凍らせれば凍らせるほどショットが強くなります。

・レベル表示
　ショットのレベルです。
　凍らせた総面積が増えるとレベルが上がります。

敵弾を凍らせる！

　　「ちょっと敵が妖精の癖に弾幕濃すぎなんじゃない？」
　　そうですね。
　　　＊弱いチルノの主観ですので、いつもより多めの弾幕に見えています。


　　しかし！　チルノはそんな事に臆しません。
　　チルノには秘密兵器があるのです。
　　それが「アイスバリア」　ショットの溜撃ちで発動します。

　　アイスアタックは自機のすぐ近くしか攻撃できませんが、
　　何と、触れた敵弾を凍らせる事が出来るのです。
　　しかも凍らせた敵弾に当たっても大丈夫。
　　氷が砕けると敵弾も消滅してすっきり！
　　さらに凍った敵弾は新たに別の近くの敵弾を凍らせます。
　　
　　弾幕の濃い場所を狙ってアイスバリアを当てれば連鎖的に
　　敵弾を凍らせて、敵の弾幕を壊滅させる事が出来るのです。
　　
　　どうしても避けられない場合、チルノの代わりにあなたが
　　頭を使って、効率よく凍らせるパターンを見つけましょう！

こおりパワー！


　　アイスバリアはいつでもフルパワーで出せる訳では
　　ございません。馬鹿だって疲れます。
　　
　　こおりパワー（自機の上に表示されている％）が
　　３０％以上無いと出せません。
　　
　　１００％に近いほど、氷の持続時間が長くなります。
　　３０％では一瞬で氷は砕けてしまいます。
　　
　　こおりパワーはアイスバリアを貼ると０％になります。
　　
　　こおりパワーを回復させる方法。
　　　・時間と共に徐々に自然回復（ゆっくり）
　　　・ショットを敵に当てる（かなり高速、ボス戦では基本）
　　　・ザコ敵を倒す（一瞬で回復）
　　　・敵弾にかする（上級者向けだが、高次面では必須）
　　　・溜め続ける（通常より若干速く回復）

特殊な敵弾に注意！

　　「連続してアイスバリアを張り続ければ楽勝じゃん？」
　　
　　いえいえ、敵も馬鹿ですが少しは対策します。
　　以下の攻撃に注意！
　　
　　・燃えている炎弾
　　　この敵弾は凍りません。氷の上を貫通して飛んでいきますので
　　　注意してください。
　　　
　　・レーザー
　　　氷を破壊して貫通します！
　　　破壊時に破片が飛び散るので、それに当たるとミスと
　　　なります。
　　　自機の近くでレーザーに氷を破壊されないように注意！

氷は面積！

　　チルノは纏まったたくさんの敵弾を凍らせるよりも、

　　広く散らばった敵弾を凍らせる方が好みです。
　　
　　ゲーム画面を１００％としたとき、
　　凍らせた部分の割合がボーナスとなります。
　　敵弾の発射地点を狙って凍らせるより、十分広がってから
　　凍らせた方が面積は広がります。
　　
　　凍らせた総面積は、ステージ１からの累計です。
　　これが一定数を超えるとショットレベルが上がります。
　　
　　ボスが硬くて倒せない場合、積極的に面積が増えるように
　　凍らせていきましょう！

その他の仕様！

　　やる気が増える条件

　　　・敵弾を凍らせる
　　　・敵にダメージを与える
　　　　（ショットより氷のダメージの方がやる気増加率が高い）
　　１００％単位で自機が一つ増えたと同じ効果です。
　　最大１０００％です。
　　
　　パーフェクトフリーズが増える条件
　　　・敵弾を凍らせる
　　１００％以上増えないのでバンバン使っていこう！
　　
　　パーフェクトフリーズは全画面凍らせます。
　　アイスバリアでは凍らない炎弾も凍ります。
　　まさにパーフェクト！

よくわかんない

　　なんかこのゲーム、難しすぎるし、操作も難解だし、

　　会話も支離滅裂だし、よくわかんない。
　　
　　どういう感じで攻略すればいいのか？
　　ピンと来なかった場合はデモプレイを見てみましょう。
　　タイトル画面で放おって置くとデモプレイが見られます。
　　
　　なお、この操作説明はゲームプレイ中のポーズ画面
　　からも見る事が出来ます。
　　
　　会話が支離滅裂なのは妖精だからです。
　　戦争が終わったら何を言ったのかすっかり
　　忘れている事でしょう。

data.name: Monster Ops 22
data.detailed_description:
MO Merch!

Visit our website (linked on the right column) to grab some Monster Ops Merchandise!


About the Game

​A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim Put out in Monthly Episodes!

Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. 

Binge the Entire Season 1 and The First Half of Season 2! Click on any Episode from 2-6 for Bundle One, 7-12 for Bundle Two, or 14-18 for Bundle Three!
The Bundles are Linked on the Tops of the Store Pages

Episode 1 and Episode 13 are Free

We are barreling toward the final conclusion of Monster Ops!  Evil Wraith is hunting his lover Tide in the woods.  Balasque has switched sides AGAIN.  What hope does Tide have to stop Denise when he's all alone and everyone is against him?!

Maybe it's better to just give up?

Find out in the 3rd to the last episode!  (And the best one of the series!)

Loaded with twists, multiple endings, CG art, and even animations--season two of Monster Ops is continuing with a bang!

data.name: Roll N' Rage
data.detailed_description:
Roll your way through a physics-based platformer filled with dozens of challenging obstacles to test your skills. Remember not to fall though, because you may need to start your journey all over again. 

Features:

  • Timed Runs:

data.name: STEEL WING: WEAVEBREAKER
data.detailed_description:
STEEL WING: WEAVEBREAKER is a vertical bullet-hell shooter: half romance and daily life aboard your carrier, half three-lane bullet-hell combat happening all at once.

Decades ago, humanity sent a satellite into deep space. It received an answer.

In 2091, humanity handed its entire defense to a military network called Weave. Then Weave turned its guns on its makers. The sky is lost, the cities have fallen, and all that remains is one flying fortress and three pilots.

Three-Lane Joint Operations

In every story stage, three separate lanes may open up as the story unfolds. Switch lanes freely mid-battle, or stay on a single lane the whole way. How you play can make the fight easier — or a lot harder.

Story Campaign

From a storm-lashed coastline through a rail junction, a canyon waterfall, a cliffside factory and a rocket launch site. Every stage ends with a multi-phase boss. In the first campaign you chase down Weave; in the second you go behind enemy lines to rescue the trapped scientists and rebuild your carrier’s six departments.

Between Sorties: Life Aboard the Carrier

After every stage you return to the carrier. Talk with your crew, spend time with them away from the war, and answer as squadron leader Lu Zheng. Affection is never shown on screen, and every choice has a cost.

Base Building

Light up your carrier’s six departments one by one and research upgrades you can take into every sortie.

Tower Defense Nights

Weave’s fleet strikes the carrier at night. Place turrets against ever-escalating raids and fly out to join the defense yourself.

Roguelike Expeditions

Every door leads to a different world. Choose your route, pick upgrades from cards of four rarities, and face a different boss in every world.

Features

  • A fully voiced bullet-hell shooter: Chinese, Japanese and English voice acting for every line, from the cockpit to the carrier.

  • They talk to you mid-battle: three lanes in play at once, with your crew calling in and covering each other in real time.

  • Half romance, half bullet hell: come back from each sortie to the hours you spend together. Every word you say quietly changes your relationship.

  • Three lanes, your call: lanes open up as the story unfolds. Switch or stay — the same stage can play out completely differently.

  • Hardcore bosses: mid-bosses fire fast aimed shots, stage bosses fill the screen. When the finisher comes, only the safe circle keeps you alive.

  • Three pilots, nine weapons: normal shot, charge attack and hidden firepower — a full charge gives you the chance to turn a boss fight around.

  • More than sorties: base building, tower defense, roguelike expeditions — and a round of mahjong with your crew.

  • For everyone who grew up with arcades, the Sega Saturn and the original PlayStation.

  • Interface in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. Full controller support; keyboard also supported.

Trailer Music Credits

Music: Thunderbolt by ArcticFoxMusic

The world, characters, story, stages and game systems of STEEL WING: WEAVEBREAKER were all originally created by our development team.

Generative AI was used as an assistive tool in producing some of the artwork, the character voices and some of the music. All such content was generated from the team’s own design documents and creative intent, then individually selected, edited and refined by the team before being included in the game, to keep the style consistent and true to the game’s world.

data.name: Bloat
data.detailed_description:
As the adorable and squishy Bloat, solve puzzles while gliding through a psychedelic world inspired by African beadwork.

Bloat is a calming puzzle game with no action, enemies or death; only puzzles.
It has satisfying movement, with simple and intuitive controls, making puzzles easy to complete once you have solved them.

Manipulate circuits, colors and shapes to solve puzzles, progressing through the 6 reliquaries.
Each reliquary has its own unique environment and challenges.

This game is family-friendly and should take an average of 2-5 hours to complete.
Fully localized into 15 languages, including Afrikaans.

data.name: HEROES' BATTLE HYMN：Demonfire Era
data.detailed_description:
The old world order has crumbled. Otherworldly fiends break through the rift and ravage the land. Ordinary soldiers must fight grotesque monsters, while heroes rise one after another. An epic Three Kingdoms tale filled with bloodshed, intrigue and demonic power begins.

Talent & Skill System

Every general features a dual-branched skill tree for unique growth paths. Specialize one branch for devastating ultimate attacks, or distribute points evenly to craft an all-round warrior for totally distinct combat styles.

Combat System

Recruit iconic Three Kingdoms heroes with exclusive skills. Different general combinations trigger varied effects, keeping every battle fresh and unpredictable.

General System

Pick from a roster of generals with unique talents to build your custom team. Form powerful hero combinations, venture across the Three Kingdoms map and conquer formidable foes.

Combat Gameplay

The game features diverse combat gameplay: use catapults to breach enemy city defenses, hold the city against waves of invaders; escort military provisions to secure logistics supplies, defend battle flags to stabilize our position, and rescue hostages. Varied objectives test your team‑work and strategy for chaotic war‑era conquests.

Original World Setting

This original alternate-history world is filled with human troops, bizarre monsters and mighty fiend lords. Diverse enemy combat mechanics constantly test your team-building strategies.

Recruit heroes of the Three Kingdoms to stand united against the demonfire plague. Wield your weapons and devise clever tactics to banish darkness, and let your battle hymn echo across the land.

Game Features

  • Retro pixel art revives classic RPG gameplay

  • Dual-branched skill trees for fully customizable generals

  • Varied objectives test your team‑work and strategy for chaotic war‑era conquests.

  • Enjoy character growth, team building and adventurous journeys

  • Original fantasy world filled with spirits, monsters and diverse challenging foes

data.name: CyberCon: Cybersecurity Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
Build your own cybersecurity empire

CyberCon: Cybersecurity Tycoon is a deep business simulation where you found and run a cybersecurity company. Hire specialists and grow them into a dedicated team, design your office, bid on government tenders, deliver high-quality work on time, and develop security products of your own. Starting in January 1990, you will guide your company through five distinct technological eras up to 2039.

Build Your Company

Start at a single desk with a few skills and a little savings. Hire the right people, form specialist teams, and land your first clients.

Run a Consultancy

Bid on contracts. Staff each job with the right specialists and build a reputation to unlock massive government tenders.

Manage Your Team

Every specialist has one real domain — there is no miracle hire. Train your people, earn them certifications, and deepen their expertise with badges. Keep them happy and rested, because a burned-out expert makes a mistake at the most critical moment.

The industry doesn't stand still, and neither can you

In 1990 there are no "pentesters" yet; banks and telecoms hire you for security drills and virus response. By the 2000s the web arrives, worms spread, and your antivirus that sold on floppy disks now needs a CD, a web presence and a version 3. By the 2010s it's APTs and cloud; by the 2020s zero trust, IoT and AI; by the 2030s AI-vs-AI warfare and quantum. Every era changes what clients ask for, what skills your staff need, what your office looks like and whether your products are still relevant.

Build Software Products

Develop across 8 product lines with ~100 modules. Sell boxed copies to home users or enterprise licenses to corporations.

Deep Market Mechanics

Set pricing bands, run marketing campaigns, compare your modules against rival firms on the live industry rankings, and license technology to or from competitors.

Choose Your Path

Become the state’s most trusted contractor, or dive into the gray market—cracking copy protection in 1990, phreaking, or selling zero-days. Scandals and bribes scale with the era.

Full Economy

Take loans with era-accurate interest rates, manage fixed inflation, run a 1990-scale payroll, pay taxes, and analyze quarterly financial reports inside a fictional retro desktop OS.

Manage your budget, payroll, taxes, lawsuits, severance, and loan rates that shift with inflation. Lose control of cash flow and your people walk; miss your debts and the company folds. Survive in a ruthless economy. Build legal and marketing teams to keep your company standing.

A Realistic Cybersecurity Management Simulation

Your skills determine the quality of the work you deliver, but they are not enough to win the work on their own. Landing a job or winning a tender depends on the price you offer, whether you meet the requirements, who you know, and sometimes on activities that cross ethical lines. In this grounded scenario, every decision you make carries a consequence.

data.name: Survivors
data.detailed_description:
You are the commander of the Time Tank, a formidable vehicle that ensures the fight is never truly over, stranded on an alien planet with nothing but your wits, heavy weaponry, and the allies you rescue along the way.

Battle through hordes of eldritch monsters to rescue your friends, upgrade your arsenal, and claw your way into the future.

Through rescuing your allies and completing their quests, you unlock their tower, a bastion of defense or offense that aids you in all future battles. Through further quests, you unlock unique weapons, such as the railgun and deadly mist, in addition to your tank's trusty automatic turret system.

If you're brave enough and give a valiant effort, you may be able to escape this alien planet and venture back home.

Don't worry, if the zombies get you, your trust Time Tank has the ability to travel back in time whenever it is put in grave danger; You will simply travel back to the last know safe timeline.

data.name: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road
data.detailed_description:
Inspired by the classics of horror gaming, The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road is a blend of psychological horror, atmospheric horror and creature horror that is certain to give you chills.

The tunnels under Saint Mercy road are known for many things. Paranormal encounters... Mysterious cults... Monsters galore... The legends around town spread like a game of telephone. They can't all be true... can they?

What if I told you that the truth can be revealed, but it would be a journey you have to take... ALONE

The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road is an immersive horror experience that spans 8 unique areas, each providing a sense of unease and a new mystery to unravel. Armed with only a lantern, you will descend into the tunnels under Saint Mercy road and explore it's depths and find clues to uncover the truth behind the local legends.

Do you have the courage to descend into darkness?

I. Dare. You.

FEATURES:

  • An immersive, single player atmospheric experience (headphones suggested).

  • 8 unique areas that will give you a different sense of dread the further you delve.

  • Solve puzzles and complete objectives to descend further into the dark tunnels.

  • Stylized graphics - Re-experience classic horror with a modern first person take.

  • Short Story - Can be completed in under two hours.

  • Inspired by classic horror games and literature.

  • Gamepad Support - Play with your gamepad, keyboard and mouse or accessibility device.

data.name: Mars Base Alley
data.detailed_description:
Mars Base Alley is a cozy city-builder about creating the perfect little corner of humanity on the red planet.

After a bumpy landing on Mars, you arrive at a quiet crater with a simple request from Mayor Roark: help turn this empty stretch of dust into a place people can truly call home. Instead of one grand city plan, the Mayor invites a handful of designers to each build and care for their own alley, slowly shaping Mars Base City together.

Each alley grows at its own pace. You’ll place buildings, manage resources, keep settlers comfortable, and gently respond to Martian challenges like dust storms, power hiccups, and changing needs. There’s no rush—just thoughtful decisions, small optimizations, and watching your alley come to life.

As the colony fills with warmth and activity, your alley is quietly evaluated alongside the others. Happy settlers, smooth resource flow, and a well-designed space all matter. With care and creativity, you may earn Mayor Roark’s special recognition and be crowned Champion Designer of Mars Base Alley.

On a once-lonely world, you’ll build a cozy future for humanity—one alley at a time.

  • 🏗️ Design Your Own Martian Alley
    Build your homepod to add colonists to your alley, then improve their comfort by upgrading and building a variety of shops & attractions. These inlcude markets, restaurant, pub, sauna, animal ranch and more!

  • 🌱 Cozy City-Building on Mars
    A relaxed, low-pressure take on city building with 13 buildings, focused on creativity, care, and gentle optimization for each building that offer goodies.

  • 🧑‍🚀 Full Campaign with 13 Levels
    Play through a complete 2-4 hour campaign where each level introduces new challenges, layouts, and design opportunities.

  • 🌪️ Dynamic Martian Challenges
    Respond to shifting daily demands without punishing failure or high stress.

  • 🎨 Creative Freedom & Customization
    Experiment with layouts, decorations, and small optimizations to express your personal design style.

  • 🧘 Play at Your Own Pace
    No strict timers—progress thoughtfully and enjoy watching your alley grow and come to life.

data.name: Mina the Hollower
data.detailed_description:
Descend into a frightful world of action-adventure in Mina the Hollower. Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Burrow beneath hazards and monsters, whip foes into oblivion, and gear up with an arsenal of sidearms and trinkets.

Explore a vast world filled with pixel-perfect graphics, masterful gameplay, beastly bosses, and infectious music. Encounter a cast of bizarre characters, search out secrets in an array of exotic locales, and illuminate the omnipresent darkness in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

Features

  • Hauntingly authentic 8-bit visuals in the style of Game Boy Color, refined for the modern era.

Modern touches abound: detailed animation, widescreen visuals, and rock-solid controls!

  • Leap, dodge, and burrow through the ground to battle monsters or navigate the world.

  • Lash at foes with your trusty whip, Nightstar- or choose from an arsenal of weapons, each with a totally different move set.

  • Discover and utilize a reliquary's worth of unusual Sidearms to gain the advantage in combat.

  • Collect and equip Trinkets to acquire a variety of exotic effects. Level Mina up to suit your unique playstyle.

  • Electrifying soundtrack by chiptune virtuoso, Jake Kaufman.

  • Descend into the depths of madness with a bone-chilling, yet heartwarming tale inspired by Victorian Gothic horror.

  • Explore a huge, dark world brimming with secrets, challenging battles, and interconnected level design.

data.name: Island Treasure Chase
data.detailed_description:
Island Treasure Chase is an exciting adventure game set on a pirate-themed island. In the game, you explore the mysterious Island in search of hidden treasures while trying to escape from skeletons that guard the land. As you navigate through the island's dark jungles, eerie caves, and dangerous cliffs, each treasure you find brings you closer to victory, but also increases the number of skeletons chasing you.

The game’s atmosphere draws you into the cursed pirate island, testing your strategy and quick thinking skills. Will you manage to find the treasures and escape the island, or will you become one of the lost souls?

In Island Treasure Chase, explore the island, gather treasures, and escape the skeletons!

data.name: Reignbreaker
data.detailed_description:
Rise. Rebel. Ruin.


Reignbreaker is a high-octane action rogue-like set in a dystopian medievalpunk world. Step into the boots of Clef, a fearless rebel determined to rid the world of the Kingdom’s oppression as she lays siege to the Queen’s grand Bastion.



Smash, dash, and battle through hordes of hostile high-tech medieval machines to breach the heart of the fortress. Explore hand-crafted levels brimming with traps, secrets, and an embarrassment of hoarded wealth. Even parley with feisty loyalists, jaded soldiers, self-serving mercenaries, and haughty aristocrats as you penetrate the Bastion’s depths and lay bare the arcane truths hidden within.



Rise – stronger and more unrelenting – from every defeat and feel the punk spirit roar within your veins as you gain access to a growing arsenal of motorized javelins to experiment with. Smash the Kingdom, paint its walls with rebellion, and turn the Queen’s lands into a battlefield as you become The Reignbreaker.

Features

  • Explosive, customizable combat with a growing arsenal of motorized javelins and power-ups.
  • Fast-paced and thrilling gameplay that rewards flashy combos, counters, and heavy hits.
  • A gripping story of rebellion and resilience set in a high-tech medieval dystopia.
  • Beautifully hand-crafted levels filled with enemies, traps, and hidden treasures.

data.name: Blackjack 2D: Dealer's Gambit
data.detailed_description:
Blackjack 2D: Dealer's Gambit is a casual, stylized, semi-story driven Blackjack "casino-esque" 2D simulator. A place where you can jump in and out of Blackjack whenever you want. The dealer is also there with you from start to finish. Keep playing to find out exactly what they have to say.

Key Features:

In-depth beginner's guide for those new to the game or who need a refresher

3 dealer tables with increasing stakes

  • Low Stakes - Play at a relaxed pace, learn the ropes and define your strategy

  • Mid Stakes - Min bets are a bit higher, but so is the earning potential

  • High Stakes - Brutal minimum bets, much easier to lose everything

Realistic Blackjack mechanics*

  • Dealer follows same the basic rule set used in real casinos

  • Can choose either 1-deck or 2-deck simulation option

  • Advanced Moves:

    • Insurance

    • Double Down

    • Split

  • Cards are shuffled using pseudo-random algorithm

  • Can even practice card counting if desired! (counter not included)

Quick!

  • Fast paced rounds with auto-saving. Jump in and out of games whenever you have the time, want to practice, or are just bored.

  • Keyboard shortcuts for each move

  • Small file size and quick loading let you fly into the game

*The game play mechanics were intended to be as close to real Blackjack as possible; however, it is not guaranteed to replicate it exactly.

data.name: Koko, the Last Leaf
data.detailed_description:
Koko, the Last Leaf, is a fantastical adventure and fighting game where you play as the last of the Leaf kind, seeking revenge against the evil Gods.

Explore a vast magical world

Dive deep into the lush lands of the children of the Gods. Magical enemies and peculiar friends await you in this colorful and surprising world.

Fight for revenge

Battle, outwit, and defeat the bosses and unique enemies that lay scattered throughout the world. Seek out those who have destroyed your kin and deliver vengeance with a swift hand.

Use the power of the Gods

Discover magical abilities that allow you to draw upon the power of the Gods. These abilities will allow you to explore deeper, learn secrets, and grow stronger.

Unravel the mysteries of the past

As you explore, discover hints to unfold the story of the Leaf kind’s destruction. The secrets you unearth will guide you in your journey and reveal disturbing truths about the Gods.

Features:

  • Precise 2D platforming
  • Satisfying and challenging combat with skills and abilities that will aid your fighting
  • Hand-drawn pixel art animation
  • Metroidvania qualities that reward exploration
  • A large world with magical secrets, friends and foes

data.name: MyDream
data.detailed_description:
MyDream is a sandbox game that combines grid-based building with organic and fully-deformable voxel terrain. Build, terraform, quest, and explore your way across various environments in beautiful and expansive worlds!

MyDream Interactive Inc. set out on a bold journey to build a new voxel sandbox game to encourage creativity, courage, and collaboration among players. MyDream was built in Unity using the in-house VoxelForm engine, which allowed for high performance and exceptional deformation quality when altering the world.

Over time, many features became deprecated, and rebuilding them became increasingly difficult. When the team started moving forward into the space of VR, a premium on performance and stability began to take precedence over open-world interaction and deformation, which caused the team to shift away from the voxel tech and ultimately MyDream itself in 2016.

Instead of taking down the game from the store, the team decided to release it as-is so users can still check out and enjoy what was developed. Online mode is no longer possible, so offline play is all that is available. Some of what would later become Siege Hammer is available in the vr_towerdefense branch, however lack of VR SDK updates has left it inoperable for VR and unplayable without VR due to locked pitch.

Thank you to all of our fans, supporters, and backers, for giving us the opportunity to work on MyDream!

data.name: My Creepy Motel
data.detailed_description:
My Creepy Motel, a first-person detective mystery where every room hides a secret and every guest has something to fear.
By day, you run a quiet roadside motel on the edge of nowhere. By night, you investigate the strange events your guests whisper about: objects moving on their own, figures seen through peepholes, and rooms that seem to breathe when the lights go out.

🕵️ Investigate Paranormal Cases Across the Motel

Each chapter presents a self-contained mystery, centered on a guest complaint or an unexplained disturbance. Search rooms for clues, question the people involved, and piece together the truth behind each case.

You will uncover:

  • Footprints where no one could have walked

  • Distorted audio logs hidden inside old appliances

  • Ripped pages from guest ledgers

  • Cryptic symbols left behind on walls and mirrors

  • Inconsistent statements from staff and travelers

📝 Use Your Detective Notebook

Collect evidence in an interactive notebook where clues automatically sort by suspicion, location, and time of day.
Use your notes to deduce motives, reconstruct timelines, identify contradictions, and reveal what’s real—and what only pretends to be.

🔍 Multiple Paths to Every Clue

Every case can be investigated from different angles:

  • Interview guests, staff, and travelers

  • Revisit rooms at day and night to catch environmental changes

  • Examine appliances, locks, vents, and furniture

  • Decode scribbles, symbols, and hidden messages

  • Reconstruct events through small logic puzzles and spatial deductions

🌗 Day/Night Dual Gameplay

Daytime is about running the motel: checking guests in, taking complaints, cleaning rooms, and gathering casual observations.
Nighttime is the real work: sneak into locked rooms, follow trails of evidence, analyze disturbances, and document what shouldn’t exist.

🕯️ A Mystery-First Paranormal Detective Game

While the motel’s paranormal edge drives each case, the core loop is pure detective work: gather clues, test hypotheses, connect evidence, and solve the case.
Each mystery ends with a deduction sequence where you determine what actually happened and who, or what, is responsible.

If you’re here for puzzles, logic, case files, and quiet investigation…
Check in. The truth always stays the night.

data.name: Tell Me Everything
data.detailed_description:
Everybody lies. But what makes you a good detective, is to know which lies to bite into, and which to ignore.

Because the murderer is among these people, and you are the lucky detective assigned to this mess of a case.

It's about the satisfaction of catching someone telling a lie, and getting every little detail out of a conversation.

Gameplay

Tell Me Everything is a text-based short-story adventure game, with a word-puzzle on top. It's a game about pushing your luck and gathering information to catch the killer.

Features

  • The game currently contains the first episode with three variations.
  • Simple point-and-click action. Can be played solely using the mouse.
  • Hint system available if you are ever stuck.
  • Mood-meter to track the suspects four breaking-points.
  • 11 calm jazz soundtracks.
  • New episodes in the works.

Episodes

  • Episode 1 : The Porcelain Paradox
    The storekeeper of an antique store is found murdered.
  • Episode 2 : The Horrors of Hospitality
    A hospital is shocked when a body turns up.
  • Episode 3 : The Fiscal Freefall
    Another murder strikes at a local bank.
  • More episodes in the work

Expectations

The murder mysteries are written to be around 30 minutes each, and since the game has a huge amount of dialogue, it is sadly not fully voiced.

Currently, the three case variations stack around 1-2 hours if you push through, and around 4-5 hours if you like exploring all the possibilities.

The graphics are crude, and the gameplay is simple. It is meant as a thin-mint of an interesting story, not a massive game.

Is it niche? Yes. Might this game not be for you? Maybe.

But for those who love unraveling mysteries, I hope you are up for a challenge or two.

Spoilers

Since this game is a murder mystery, we politely ask all streamers and YouTubers to either not reveal who the killer is in each case, or at least let your audience know that there are spoilers ahead.

Ayame, a beautiful young woman from Ryuugai (Japan) is living a carefree life in search of happiness. One fateful day, she met Robert, a CIA agent who was stationed in Ryuugai during a mission. How will Ayame's life unfold? Those decisions are in your hands in this slice of life RPG!

  • Interactive map with a variety of places to visit
  • English language option

data.name: Headpunk: The Comic-Style Battle Chaos
data.detailed_description:
Headpunk: The Comic-Style Battle Chaos, or Headpunk for short, is a 3D comic-style fantastic player vs. player deathmatch game.

  • 6 different types of weapons

    Pistol, Assault Rifle, Pump Gun, Sniper, Sub Machine and Rocket Launcher. - Most of these weapons are powerful. Kill players in a region in an area with a rocket launcher, or pierce your enemy's head with a sniper.

  • Character Customization

    Skin Color, Top and Bottom outfit color. - In most deathmatch games, you're stuck with one model or appearance, but Headpunk isn't like that. Better wearables will be added with future updates to the game.

  • 4 different Maps

    Training, Apocalyptic City, Midnight City and Industrial. - Play on well optimized maps. More maps will be added in the future.

  • Battle with real gamers

    There are no bots so, everyone in the game is real.

The Gameplay

This game has a simple gameplay. Shoot enemy players (everybody is your enemy) or find new tactics or improve them for even more fun.

data.detailed_description:
Agent in Depth is a daring action-platformer featuring fast-paced action and instant-death combat. You’ll run, jump, aim, and deflect bullets with your katana to blow up your enemies. No checkpoints, no upgrades: just pure skills. Deflect, die, learn, repeat. Be better, be faster.

In Agent in Depth, you’ll play as agent Randy: the security specialist of this underground facility. Just like any cool agent, you wear a fancy black trench coat and pair of red sneakers. You also ditched firearms and suited yourself with a shiny katana.

Unconventional Combat:

Your katana can’t damage the corporation's belongings directly. Overcome your enemies by deflecting their bullets towards them. Watch your enemies explode as you deflect their bullets in the air. Be stylish, fast, and cool!

Hand-Crafted Levels:

Each level is uniquely designed for you to experience a different sequence of gameplay through its 15 levels. Can you finish the game in split seconds and see your name displayed to everyone inside the game?

Daring Gameplay:

You get hit, you die. Your enemies get hit, and they die. You also can’t save the game, you have to finish in one sitting. No power-ups and upgrades. It’s the ultimate skill test for your reflexes. Do you have what it takes to finish it?

data.name: Corner Miner
data.detailed_description:
Corner Miner is a tiny mine that lives on your desktop while you work, study, watch videos or do anything else.

Keep it running in the background, check in whenever you feel like it, or take control and mine everything yourself.

Break Blocks and Dig Deeper

Click blocks to damage and destroy them, earn money, gain experience, and uncover increasingly valuable resources.

The deeper you go, the tougher and more rewarding—the mine becomes.

Build Your Team of Miner Chicks

You do not have to do all the work alone. Unlock miner chicks that automatically attack blocks and keep the mine moving while you focus on something else.

Grow your team and turn a tiny manual operation into an automated mining machine.

Shape Your Progress Through the Skill Tree

Spend your upgrades across a branching skill tree filled with new mechanics, stronger mining tools, automation, special blocks, and powerful improvements.

Choose the upgrades you want first and build the mine around your preferred way to play.

Discover Special Blocks and Collectibles

Find valuable ores, treasure, explosive blocks, multipliers, and unusual discoveries as you continue digging.









Collect rare items, fill your journal, and see what is waiting farther beneath the surface.

Play at Your Own Pace

• Runs transparently in the corner of your desktop 
• Mine manually or let your chicks handle the work
• Unlock upgrades through a branching skill tree 
• Discover valuable ores, special blocks, and collectibles
• Progress while working, studying, watching videos, or playing other games 
• Move and position the game wherever it fits your setup

data.name: The Last Night of Olivia Harrow
data.detailed_description:
Step into the shoes of a private investigator in this classic murder mystery game.

Olivia Harrow was found dead in her Harborview Tower apartment. The police ruled it an accident. A slip, a fall, a tragic head injury. Case closed. But not everyone is convinced...

Her boss and close friend, Marlene Duvall, hired local P.I. firm Sterling Investigations to look further into the matter. Due to an overwhelming workload, they have reached out to you for assistance with this case. Peggy Hanson will be your contact if you choose to accept. Can you crack the case?

This visual novel case gives you everything you need to investigate:

• Full‑size case documents including police reports, witness statements, and internal records

• Clues to examine about Olivia’s life, routines, and relationships

• Difficulty: Medium

• 60+ Documents

• 80+ Pages

Perfect For

• Murder mystery party nights

• True crime fans and puzzle lovers

• Solo players who enjoy immersive storytelling

• Couples or friends looking for a unique date night activity

• Interactive gameplay designed for solo sleuths or group mystery nights

Download The Last Night of Olivia Harrow today and begin your investigation

data.name: Boundary of Reason -Iris-
data.detailed_description:
Iris, a former female knight stripped of everything, turns to cursed magic that erodes her mind to exact revenge on the nobles.

Facing bloodthirsty bandits and lust-driven monsters, her only guide is the emotionless, mechanical voice of the System Monolith.

Follow its cold navigation, cross the boundaries of reason, and carve a blood-soaked path of vengeance.

The "Corruption Level" builds through the toll of magic and enemy attacks.

It reshapes not only Iris's abilities but her body, mind, and very fate.

As it rises, her combat animations, her posture at base, and even the system messages from the Monolith transform seamlessly.

Most importantly, key story dialogues and taunts from bosses change based on her current state.

Will you uphold the pride of a noble knight, or surrender to your twisting desires?

Every facet of her transformation is dictated by your choices.

Discover 11 distinct weapons, each with its own unique properties.

Defeat enemies and upgrade your arsenal in battle to unlock up to three stages of "Awakening Skills."

Will you choose wide-range area attacks to ravage the battlefield, or concentrated, devastating strikes? Craft the ultimate build with powerful synergies and annihilate the endless swarms of enemies filling the screen!

The Tentacle Shrine, Slime Shrine, Succubus Shrine... The magic obtained from these is powerful, but every cast relentlessly spikes your Corruption Level.

Furthermore, scattered across the battlefield are Cursed Relics, offering tremendous buffs in exchange for crippling curses like reduced max HP or continuous damage.

Sacrifice your life force and your sanity to claim devastating power.

After surviving fierce battles, return to the base where your emotionless partner, the System Monolith, awaits.

Offer the Souls gathered on the battlefield to permanently enhance your stats and unlock new weapons.

Heal your wounds, confront your increasingly twisted desires, gear up, and march back into the deadly fray.

data.name: AGIS
data.detailed_description:
FIGHT. DIE. UPGRADE. FIGHT AGAIN.


AGIS is a rouge-lite 2D action space shooter. You'll die often, you'll die soon, but you will get better with each run. You'll fight big and small enemies with many weapons and tactics. Protect the mothership and fight against thousands of enemies to find a way out of a trap.

Playable with Mouse/Keyboard and Twin-Stick-Controller.

The features are fast-paced, intense combat against challenging boss battles, a unique art style, and an electronic music soundtrack. The game also includes a mix of melee and ranged combat, with players having to learn and master the patterns of each boss to defeat them. Additionally, the game has a high replay value as the player will have to improve skills to progress in the game.

data.name: Super Toaster X: Learn Japanese RPG
data.detailed_description:
A Toasterific Adventure:

Finally fulfill your lifelong dream of taking the role of Pan, a sentient japanophile slice of bread and full time bounty hunter. Chase down the most dangerous cybercriminals in a destructive toaster power armor and become the richest (and only) living bread that ever existed.

The Game Features:

Super Toaster X is a roleplaying game which objective is to learn Japanese vocabulary while having fun. The goal is to have dynamic, interactive combat inspired by the Super Mario RPG by Nintendo mixed in with the exploration of the Darkest Dungeon by Red Hook Studios.

It features:
*Randomly generated dungeons

*A unique character progression system based on mastering Japanese vocabulary

*Strategic battles where your survival depends on correctly guessing vocabulary cards.

*Dozens of offensive and defensive abilities each with their own, unique features and effects

*Dozens of various foes with their own strategies and abilities

*A vocabulary card collecting aspect (gotta catch them all!)

A Playable Build

There are currently a few prototypes floating around the web but we're currently working on polishing our newest build for Greenlight. Keep your eyes peeled!

data.name: CLAWPUNK
data.detailed_description:
Prepare yourself for the ultimate adrenaline rush with CLAWPUNK, a pulse-pounding, melee-focused 2D action game infused with roguelite elements and an array of badass cat characters. Tear through a fully destructible environment, where every smash and bash rewards your reactive and aggressive play style. Aim for the highest score possible by laying to waste everything in your path!

Embrace the non-stop, "push-forward" gameplay that CLAWPUNK thrives on. Aggressive players are handsomely rewarded with devastating abilities, and while melee combat is at the heart of the game, you'll also find an arsenal of ranged weapons to annihilate your foes and flaunt your power!

Choose from nine fierce cat characters, each boasting unique base stats, primary weapons, and powerful special attacks that recharge based on your performance (tracked by a combo counter). Roam through five distinct zones, the first four of which you can conquer in any order, each designed to challenge you with specific enemy types, from wide-open arenas for ranged combat to tight quarters for intense melee brawls.

KEY FEATURES:

SEMI-NON-LINEAR PROGRESSION: Battle through five level zones, with the freedom to tackle the first four in any order, all starting from a central hub level.

CHARACTER MANAGEMENT: Master nine unique cat characters, each with their own weapons and stats, to tailor your play style.

COLLECTABLE CARDS: Discover and collect special cards throughout your journey, permanently saving them to mutate and enhance your cats' abilities.

AGGRESSIVE GAMEPLAY: Dive into non-stop, push-forward combat that rewards daring players with powerful rage attacks for diving headfirst into the fray.

DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENT: Explore and defeat enemies creatively, or simply indulge in the sheer joy of destroying everything in sight!

CHALLENGING, YET ACCESSIBLE DIFFICULTY: Enjoy a scalable difficulty system that caters to both rookies and seasoned players seeking a formidable challenge.

80/90s RETRO THEME: Immerse yourself in a 1980/90s cyberpunk-inspired world, complete with a hard synth soundtrack, along with a pinch of metal, and gritty industrial/ambient soundscapes.

data.name: The Gigglebone Gang: Infinity City
data.detailed_description:
Count Yourself In!

Welcome to Infinity City, the mix-and-match capital of the world. Hop in Zack's taxicab and let the Gigglebone Gang take you on a personal tour of 10 “math concept” neighborhoods featuring  50 early math activities, puzzles and games. Kids see all the angles: they match big and small to build custom cars with Bunji the frog, use their gray matter to help Monkie-Sue sum up her "Furry Tales," and sing along to tunes about shapes, numbers and time. They'll be so busy playing, they won't notice they're learning how the world adds up.

Tour the City

Every area of Infinity City is built around one math concept, with five different approaches for learning it. A few stops on the tour:

  • Counter Stadium. Games and songs that get kids counting and keeping score.

  • Jumble Jungle. Get constructive with shapes where anything can go with anything.

  • Sizemobile Shop. A custom automotive garage and vehicle workshop that teaches children about size comparisons, measurement scales, and dimensions

  • Junk Junction. Sequencing, ordering and patterns, one piece at a time.

  • 123 Fourth Street. A multi-story apartment building where kids find their way left and right, up and down, and floor by floor: first, second, third.

More Ways to Play

  • Sing along with Zack as he describes shapes, counting, time and more.

  • Build with shapes. Turn squares, triangles and circles into cars, boats and other creations.

  • Keep Monkie-Sue afloat by putting together the right parts for her boat.

  • Play at your level. Choose a difficulty that fits, or race the clock for an extra challenge.

Learning by Doing

Drills are not the focus here. Kids learn through taking actions, singing songs, making choices, and open-ended puzzle solving and play, so they can experiment, try again and discover the answer for themselves.

  • Counting, numbers and keeping score

  • Shapes, sizes and matching

  • Sequencing, ordering and patterns

  • Left and right, up and down, and ordinal numbers (first, second, third)

  • Time and money

  • Cause and effect, problem-solving and decision-making

A Headbone Classic Returns

Infinity City was first released by Headbone Interactive in 1996]. Now the Gigglebone Gang is back on modern Mac and PC platforms for a new generation of kids, and for the grown-ups who remember them.

data.name: The Waiting Room
data.detailed_description:
If you could have a conversation with yourself as a child, what would you say?

"The Waiting Room" is a short story visual novel about a man, only known as the "Adult", who has a conversation with his childhood self, who in turn is only known as the "Child". The Adult describes to the Child the many struggles and successes life will bring. He looks back with deep emotion on factors that were both in and out of his control, and how these events shaped him into the person he became.

This is an emotional story exploring a range of themes and feelings such as:

  • Happiness

  • Love

  • Sorrow

  • Anger

  • Loss

  • Regret

  • Acceptance

  • Laughter

Game Features

  • 3D Renders

  • 3D Animation

  • Music Soundtrack

  • Sound Effects

Game Length

Please take into consideration that this is a short story and will take an average of 20 to 30 minutes to complete, depending on the players reading speed.

data.name: Revengeful Ghost
data.detailed_description:
●Story

The main character “Keiichi Tsujisawa,” a second-year high school student attending a local school, and his twin sister “Akane Tsujisawa.

One day, the younger sister Akane disappears after a line message of “Flip phone, video”.

Soon after, a girl jumps off the roof of the school.

The protagonist heads to the school to find out the truth.

A mysterious video is left behind on her flip phone, and the incident from 25 years ago comes back to life.

She is told that if she doesn't find the location of the video, she will die.

Fear, a curse, and a horrifying truth are gradually revealed...

●System

This title is a first-person horror adventure game.

The story unfolds mainly through line messages on smartphones.

Just like real time, the in-game time is also ticking away, and messages arrive in real time.

And new incidents are triggered.

The player must use mysterious videos and messages as clues to unravel the mystery of the incidents.

data.name: Schooled
data.detailed_description:
Fight Smart, Not Hard.

You're a nerd. And quite proud of it. They're not nerds. Let's settle it.

SCHOOLED is a bullet-heaven survivors-like where a nerd takes on swarms of all types of jocks and wins with his brain, not his brawn. No guns. No blood. Just superior intellect, a lot of chemistry, and pure ingenuity.

The Periodic Table of Elements isn't just Educational... It's Weaponized.

You collect real chemical elements, convert them to Periodic Table Element placards, and combine those symbols to spell words. The words you spell are the weapons you then acquire.

B · Er · S · Er · K spells BERSERK. Spell it, and you've got an appropriate berserk power. The deeper your science goes, the rarer and stronger the words (and powers) you can make.

Key Features:

  • Survive the Swarm: Take on escalating waves of footballers, wrestlers, hockey goons, and cheerleaders.

  • Spell Your Arsenal: Discover and equip an auto-firing loadout, transitioning from kitbashed school supplies to devastating Elemental word powers.

  • Expand Your Knowledge: Bank elements, build your mind, and unlock what no one's spelled yet (there's a massive table to find).

  • Fund the Rebellion: Collect jocks' championship rings, gamble them on a crypto-slot-machine you definitely didn't hack, and blow your winnings on the finest school supplies at the Canteen.

Get Schooled.

data.name: reaktron
data.detailed_description:
reaktron is a snake game. Minimalist. Fast-paced. Multiplayer. Online. Couch. Powerups. EVERYTHING!

Sometimes, you need to reinvent the wheel

reaktron is much more than an ordinary snake game! According to one of the developers - a slightly confused German neuroscientist - you could call it a psychophysical experiment that completely simulates the so-called broesel-physics. But then again, who cares?



With reaktron we tried to improve on a widely unknown minimalistic C64 game, which has been described as "one of the best multiplayer games of all times on all formats!" (Lagerfeldt, 2003-06-21). Easy-peasy. So we

  • slightly extended the game mechanics.
  • made it a couch-online-multiplayer game - quite a rare type of game.
  • added the option to easily join and play via smartphone (no app required!).
  • added power-ups, including the infamous and technically challenging REVERSER (it's time-warp mechanism makes reaktron probably the most complex snake game ever).
  • and suddenly started to call power-ups reaktrons (WTF?!).

Early access features

Currently, a combined local and online multiplayer mode (there should be an established word for this. We propose the term "remocal" multiplayer game) lets you experience the game mechanics as follows:

  • play with up to 12 (remote or local) players per match.
  • play two types of levels: battle royale (survive or escape) and puzzle (unlock reaktrons).
  • play a match of 48 rounds and collect the highest score to win.
  • occasional puzzles spice-up the game and let you unlock up to 9 reaktrons (we could just say "power-ups" - but we don't!).
  • unlock various Steam achievements.

Our mutual vision

Even though we have this plan of how the game might look like in the future, we'd be thrilled to get more people involved in the development of reaktron. Be a part of our community on discord, report bugs, tell us your wishes about the game and suggest extraordinary effects for new reaktrons (our way to say "power-up" - did we mention this already?).

data.name: WARSHIFT 2
data.detailed_description:
WARSHIFT 2 is a unique mix of Action, Strategy and Role-playing gameplay elements. You can build bases, manage troops, and then come down to keep your enemy at gunpoint in the dynamic battle and customize your main characters. Created by a solo indie developer, this project set out to bring a fresh take to the RTS genre by combining strategic command with direct action gameplay.

ACTION-RTS GAMEPLAY

  • Toggle between Third Person Action and Strategy modes in real-time on the battlefield

  • Real-Time Strategy gameplay: manage troops, Aircraft Carriers, Battleships

  • Dynamic battles army against hordes of enemies

CUSTOMIZATION

  • Customize, upgrade and evolve systems for the Heroes (combat avatars)

  • Dozens of weapons, support drones, turrets and other upgrades

  • Each Hero has unique super-ability and it's own weapons

HEAVY UNITS TACTICS

  • Create and command your army, buildings and defensive towers

  • Economic component: extraction of resources and creating energy is critical for success

  • Tactical component: manage heavy units, aircraft carriers and flying battleships for massive destruction

  • Order an orbital mass destruction weapons

ENVIRONMENT

  • Ground, Air, Water, Volcanic, Underwater and Outer Space environments

  • Single player campaigns including interactive training missions

  • Custom skirmishes vs AI - near-infinite combination and replayability

BACKGROUND

 In the near future, humanity faces an aggressive biomechanical civilization determined to consume all forms of life. Frontier planets turn into battlegrounds where war cyborgs, heavy machinery, and bio-engineered beasts clash for every meter of territory.

Players take the role of commanders who can both lead armies from above and personally enter the fight by controlling hero-units in real time. Your mission is to hold the invasion, build your defenses, and turn the tide of the conflict across large-scale ground and space operations.

Worlds fall. Armies evolve. The future is decided in WARSHIFT 2.

ABOUT

WARSHIFT 2 is a sequel to the original WARSHIFT game, that is developed entirely by a solo developer - Cyril Megem, who is both game designer, artist and programmer in this project. He worked hard for many years to implement a lot of his and the game community's ideas.

data.name: KARDS - The WW2 Card Game
data.detailed_description:
Living Roadmap


About the Game

Card Game meets WWII

KARDS, The World War II Card Game, combines traditional CCG gameplay with innovative mechanics inspired by classic strategy games and real battlefield tactics. Take command and challenge other players in grand-scale warfare on the ground, air, or seas.

KARDS is completely free to play with all features available from the start. You can earn all cards through regular gameplay, daily missions and an extensive achievement system.

Why should you play KARDS?

KARDS blends familiar trading card gameplay that make it easy to learn and are combined with innovative mechanics that provide strategic depth and tactical diversity.

The innovative frontline mechanics allows you to better protect your support assets and take the battle to your enemy. Rush your enemies with Blitzkrieg tactics, gain air superiority or dig in for bitter defensive warfare until you outproduce and outgun your enemies.



Managing your forces is an important part of any military campaign. In KARDS you need to carefully manage your resources (Kredits) between deploying new units, operating units already deployed on the battlefield and disseminating orders to support your battle plans.

Strategy

Your deck is constructed around one of the five major powers of WW2 and competes head to head with other players. Each deck is allowed one ally nation, where you can draw support from to create an edge against the opposition.

Depending on what you believe to be a winning strategy, players craft their deck on a combination of units and supporting orders.
  • Infantry: Try to overrun your opponent with lighter and often less costly units
  • Tanks: Blitz your opponent with heavily armored units
  • Artillery: Blast your opponent from the safety of your support line
  • Aircraft: Achieve air superiority and wreak havoc from the sky

Move up through the ranks via gameplay from Private to Field Marshall and earn your place in the officer's club while reaping monthly rewards for your rank.

Authentic atmosphere

All the cards are beautifully illustrated to match the unique WW2-style. Weapons and units have been diligently researched and behave exactly as one would expect based on official documentation, specifications and operational history.

Regular updates and events

Thanks to a vibrant community and active developers, KARDS regularly receives new features and improvements. Meanwhile, several expansions have been released for free. We also conduct regularly tournaments which are suitable for players of all experience levels. Winning prizes in the tournaments range from game items to real money of up to $10,000 USD.

About 1939 Games

1939 Games is a creative indie studio located in Iceland. Founded by ex-CCP veterans famous for creating EVE Online, 1939 Games is out to boost the market with KARDS, the unique and groundbreaking WWII CCG.

data.name: This Time - Part Two: Chapter 4
data.detailed_description:
THIS TIME – Part Two: Chapter 4 is the highly anticipated continuation of the dark, story-rich adult visual novel that blends a gripping supernatural mystery with an intense erotic thriller. The stopwatch gave you control over time, but time is no longer on your side.

You started out looking for a missing girl, armed with an impossible power and a fractured moral compass. Now, the ashes of that investigation have revealed a conspiracy far more dangerous than you could have imagined. As you dig deeper into the city’s rotting core, you begin to realize that you are not the only player on the board.

There are whispers of other forces hidden in the shadows. Breadcrumbs that suggest abilities capable of twisting minds and altering reality itself. The powers that once made you feel like a god might just make you a target.

Seamlessly import your choices from Part One to see your past decisions shape the narrative, or—if you want to dive straight into the action—jump right into Chapter 4 with a fresh start. Either way, your alliances, romances, and moral alignment will be put to the ultimate test. Will you uncover the truth behind the hidden forces, or will you become consumed by the very corruption you set out to destroy?

🔥 Core Features

  • Seamless Save Carryover (Or Start Fresh!) – Import your save from Part One so your past choices, relationship statuses, and moral alignment directly impact the narrative from the very first frame—or dive straight into Chapter 4 with a clean slate to begin your investigation immediately.

  • Stunning High-End Visuals & Animations – Immerse yourself in beautifully crafted stills and dynamic animations that have leveled up from Part One. Utilizing realistic physics, fluid simulations, and advanced rendering tools, every thrilling and intimate moment is brought to life.

  • Deep Choice-Driven AVN Mechanics – Navigate an intricate web of trust and betrayal where your decisions dictate romance routes and the escalating plot.

  • Expanding Supernatural Mystery – Time-freezing was just the beginning. Uncover hidden forces that hint at terrifying new reality-bending powers.

  • Erotic Thriller & Romance – High-quality, naturally integrated adult scenes that reflect the shifting dynamics of your relationships, driven by trust, dark temptation, or absolute dominance.

  • The Weight of Corruption – A psychological narrative focused on morality. The game tracks your descent into corruption or your struggle to remain a hero.

🕒 About the Experience

THIS TIME remains an unapologetically dark, character-driven erotic thriller. It explores the psychological toll of possessing impossible power in a world where everyone has a hidden agenda.

As the stakes rise and the mystery deepens, trusting your own judgment becomes your greatest challenge. The clock is still ticking. What will you become?

📅 Episodic Release Structure

THIS TIME – Part Two is a complex undertaking by an indie dev. To ensure the highest quality of storytelling and high-end animations, the story is being released episodically:

  • The Base Game (This product): Your purchase today secures your access to Chapter 4, delivering a massive drop of new story content, escalating mystery, and deep romance routes right out of the gate.

  • Future Chapters (Paid DLC): The overarching story of Part Two will continue in Chapter 5 and subsequently Chapter 6. It's not yet known how many chapters there will be in total.

  • Development Timeline: Due to the extreme care put into the high-end visual renders and animations, please expect a development cycle of approximately 1 to 2 years between each chapter release.

data.name: Inkshade
data.detailed_description:
The creature behind the desk insists that you play their wooden board game. And in this game, you are a captain looking for the mysterious realm known only as the abyss. To reach such a place, you’ll need to conquer a continent, acquire an airship, and sail into cursed skies. Or rather, assemble a crew and have them do it for you.

It will take more than one attempt to defeat the game master and achieve victory, and every run will be different from the last. However, with strategy, tactics, and tenacity, you will be destined to reach your goal.

  • Refine and upgrade a collection of distinct pieces and deploy them in a turn-based strategy board game. These pieces are your crew, and they will do as you say.

  • Find new classes of pieces as you solve puzzles and explore the murky chambers beyond the desk. Please ignore the dark stains on the carpet.

  • Add new pieces to your collection in the middle of each run by recruiting fallen foes. Whether or not they joined voluntarily is irrelevant, since they will bleed for you all the same.

data.name: Question Mark 2
data.detailed_description: Question Mark 2 is a first/third person walking simulator style game, the character is you, you can walk, run, jump, go up and down stairs, pick up objects and interact in various ways with these objects, you will also have various interactions with mechanisms present in the levels to solve the puzzles. In addition to the items acquired in the first game (Crowbar, Magic Wand, Electric Racket), you will now also receive new items throughout the game. Third-person mode is now present and is essential for progressing in the game. The puzzles are obviously still present in this sequel, and are now more diverse than those in the first game. Unlike the first game, which only had a single enemy, Question Mark 2 has several different enemies that must be defeated to progress in the game. The game now has a HUB level (a level that gives access to the other levels), with each completed level you will receive a key to open the next one, an operation similar to games such as Turok Dinosaur Hunter and Turok 2 Seeds of Evil.

data.name: Left 4 Dead
data.detailed_description:
From Valve (the creators of Counter-Strike, Half-Life and more) comes Left 4 Dead, a co-op action horror game for the PC and Xbox 360 that casts up to four players in an epic struggle for survival against swarming zombie hordes and terrifying mutant monsters.

Set in the immediate aftermath of the zombie apocalypse, L4D's survival co-op mode lets you blast a path through the infected in four unique “movies,” guiding your survivors across the rooftops of an abandoned metropolis, through rural ghost towns and pitch-black forests in your quest to escape a devastated Ground Zero crawling with infected enemies. Each "movie" is comprised of five large maps, and can be played by one to four human players, with an emphasis on team-based strategy and objectives.

New technology dubbed "the AI Director" is used to generate a unique gameplay experience every time you play. The Director tailors the frequency and ferocity of the zombie attacks to your performance, putting you in the middle of a fast-paced, but not overwhelming, Hollywood horror movie.

  • Addictive single player, co-op, and multiplayer action gameplay from the makers of Counter-Strike and Half-Life
  • Versus Mode lets you compete four-on-four with friends, playing as a human trying to get rescued, or as a zombie boss monster that will stop at nothing to destroy them.
  • See how long you and your friends can hold out against the infected horde in the new Survival Mode
  • An advanced AI director dynamically creates intense and unique experiences every time the game is played
  • 20 maps, 10 weapons and unlimited possibilities in four sprawling "movies"
  • Matchmaking, stats, rankings, and awards system drive collaborative play
  • Designer's Commentary allows gamers to go "behind the scenes" of the game
  • Powered by Source and Steam

THE SACRIFICE

"The Sacrifice” is the new add-on for Left 4 Dead.

"The Sacrifice" is the prequel to "The Passing," and takes place from the L4D Survivors' perspective as they make their way South. In addition to advancing the story, "The Sacrifice" introduces a new style finale featuring "Sacrificial Gameplay" where players get to decide who will give their life so the others may live.

In The Sacrifice for Left 4 Dead owners receive "The Sacrifice" campaign playable in Campaign, Versus, and Survival modes.

data.name: Neon One-Man Army
data.detailed_description:
PURE MOMENTUM, HIGH AUTONOMY, UNSTOPPABLE ACTION

It’s time to get off the ground. Immerse yourself in a futuristic, vertical world drenched in vibrant neon lights. You command two distinct forces: a high-velocity Grappling Gun in one hand to swing through the skyline like an apex predator, and a devastating arsenal of weapons in the other to turn rogue robots into scrap metal. If you stop moving, you die. Keep your momentum, stay airborne, and find your flow!

Key Features:

* Infinite Momentum & Fluid Movement: Master physics-based grappling mechanics to soar between platforms without losing speed. The ground is merely a pit stop-touch down for a split second to recharge your stamina, then launch yourself straight back into the stratosphere.

* Hypnotic Neon Aesthetics & Stress Relief: Visually striking, non-intrusive neon environments combined with a rhythmic gameplay loop create the ultimate "flow state." It's intense, fast-paced action designed to let you blow off steam and shred enemies effortlessly.

* Elite Skill Chests: Pulling the trigger isn't enough; you need to dominate. Reach specific kill milestones to unlock high-tier chests packed with game-changing active skills that will melt through enemy ranks.

* Dynamic Card Draft System: Adapt and evolve on the fly. Choose from specialized upgrade cards every time you level up to boost your firepower, extend your grappling reach, or push your mobility past its limits. Craft the perfect build for every run!

The Gameplay Loop

  • Swing & Shoot: Staying airborne is your best defense. Line up your shots and blast mechanical threats while swinging mid-air.

  • Adapt & Evolve: Select strategic upgrade cards as you level up, combining passive traits into powerful combat combos.

  • Unleash the Chests: Fill your kill counter, unlock tactical skill chests, and watch the arena dissolve into neon sparks.

data.name: Indie GameDev Sim
data.detailed_description:
Turn client ideas into tiny playable games.

In Indie GameDev Sim, you run a small game development studio from your desktop. Clients send you game ideas and requirements — your job is to turn them into working games using a simple visual editor.

Take an order
Read your client's request and decide what kind of game to build. Some want something cute and peaceful. Others want enemies, traps or a real challenge.

Build the game
Buy new assets from the store and place platforms, characters, enemies, traps, decorations and items into your level. Assign characters different roles and combine simple pre-made behaviors to create something that fits the brief.

Play your own creation
Switch instantly from the editor into Play Mode and actually play the game you just made. Test the level, find problems and go back to the editor if something needs changing.

Ship it and get paid
Build the finished game, send it to your client and see what they think. Clients judge your work based on what you created — including how well you followed their request.

Earn money, expand your asset library and take on new projects as your tiny indie studio grows.

Features:
– Build playable 2D games with a simple drag-and-drop editor
– Take on different client requests and decide how to fulfill them
– Buy new assets and keep them permanently for future projects
– Mix characters, platforms, enemies, traps, items and decorations
– Playtest the games you create directly inside the editor
– Receive client feedback, ratings and payment for your work
– Experiment freely — mistakes can hurt your rating, but they won't end your career

No programming knowledge required. Just make games.

We think you'll love Indie GameDev Sim if you enjoy...

Game Dev Tycoon, Good Pizza Great Pizza, Do not feed the monkeys, Dreams, Garry's Mod, Do not buy this game, Mad Games Tycoon, s&box, Smack Studio, Game Dev Studio, Super Mario Maker, Roblox, Gamefroot, Ultimate Chicken Horse, Software Inc.

data.name: Astra
data.detailed_description:
Your ticket to the stars.

🚀 TURN YOUR HOME INTO A SPACESHIP

Embark on a mixed reality journey that transforms your room into a spaceship for a mission to the deepest corners of the cosmos. Following the research of your late astrobiologist mother, travel in space and visit planets and their dark moons in the search for life. You'll try to uncover the mystery of life in the universe and make sense of your loss and grief. ASTRA blends storytelling, virtual reality and interactive design with stunning environments, guiding you through a deeply personal yet universal adventure.

🪐 DISCOVER STUNNING LANDSCAPES & SEARCH FOR LIFE IN THE UNIVERSE

Discover stunning landscapes on Jupiter, Titan, Europa and more, all from the comfort of your room. Visit planets & moons and analyze their chemical signature to find the key ingredient for life in the universe.

⭐Enjoy the fusion of storytelling, interactive design and beautiful cinematic sequences.

🏆SXSW World Premiere

Directed by the visionary Eliza McNitt behind the acclaimed virtual experience "Spheres", produced by the creative studio behind the Emmy-winning "Madrid Noir", and featuring the voice of Taylour Paige, ASTRA will open a breathtaking window to the cosmos right from your own home.

data.name: Failing Witch Iris and the Philosopher's Stone
data.detailed_description:
【Story】

This is Quo Vadis Magic Academy. 
It's the study temple where future wizards study day and night, tirelessly.

One day, Iris Galtung, is suddenly called out by the headmaster of the academy. 
Iris is surprised by the sudden summons, and the Headmaster informs her...
“You failed your promotion exam a few days ago.” She was shocked. 
Iris is an excellent student, competing for first and second place in the school year, and there is no way she could have failed the promotion exam. 
Confident in her performance on the test, Iris asks the headmaster if something is wrong,

But the headmaster completely dismissed this possibility.
...Hence, a merciless choice of one or the other was given in front of Iris. 
“Do you want to be my sex slave, or do you want to repeat the year?”

Unwilling to do so, Iris decides to go on a trip to find the crafting materials for the “Philosopher's Stone” to prove her ability.
So she went on a journey with her childhood best friend Noel, and her slutty schoolmate Lynn.

Will Iris be able to overcome the many hardships awaiting her on her journey and advance to be able to promote? Encounters new companions, disgusting men with dirty cocks, and monster sexual abuses await Iris and her companions...

【About the Game】

▲This is a classic RPG that uses the skill tree system. 
In standard mode, you will encounter a situation where you can't rely on brute force, 
so you need to cooperate with your companions to beat the game. 

▲Basic Event CG x34. 
In addition to the events triggered by basic conversations, 
events can also be triggered by meeting conditions when fighting demons. 

 

▲Includes Side Characters, all of whom have erotic values. 

▲After beating the game, Recollection Room will be available to revisit all the events in the story!

▲There are two levels of difficulty to choose from. 
You can enjoy the corresponding challenge in the standard mode! 
In casual mode, you can easily advance in the game.

▲In the playtest with all dialog skipped, it takes about 4 hours to beat the game. 
The actual play time for players is estimated to be around 6 hours.

▲The system in dialog skipping and automatic proceed is optimized. 
Automated conversations are great for playing while doing other things!

【Main Characters】

▲ Iris
Female Protaganist

▲ Noel
Iris's childhood friend and best friend

▲ Lynn
Iris's junior

data.name: Secret of Harrow Manor
data.detailed_description:
Secret of Harrow Manor was created because I wanted to make a VR game in the survival horror genre that put you up against zombies and monsters in a creepy abandoned mansion setting similar to the games that inspired me so deeply when I was growing up. One where even an individual zombie was to be feared, and you needed to search the area for ammo and keys in order to make it out. Along the way you'll also find many documents to read that will slowly reveal the story of what happened at this mansion and what created the monsters in the first place.


Note to VR users! : The game was built to be played with just ONE tracked controller (because it was designed with mobile in mind) so just pick the left or the right controller. The selections are either done with double tapping or with swiping gestures, no picking things up like in a proper VR pc game here, sorry.

data.name: The Last Train
data.detailed_description:
Your sister has recently gone missing at the nearby metro station. After several more reports of weird occurrences, it is agreed to abandon and close the platform. From hearing the news of losing your sister, every night you have been searching the platform for any clues on her disappearance.

After spending nights at the platform, you start undergoing strange hallucinations and non-stop nightmares, all involving a strange figure. The last nightmare you remember takes you to The Last Train crashed onto the platform, with one door open and the light on. With no escape or exit you decide to try board the train.

After your final nightmare, you wake up in a room that is not your own. Can you solve the mystery of your sister and escape The Conductor?

Features:
  • Steam Achievements
  • Singleplayer Story Mode
  • Co-op multiplayer
  • Steam Cloud
  • VHS-style shaders and post-processing
  • Puzzles
  • Subtitles

data.name: The Confinement
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for an intense experience in The Confinement, an FP4 (First Person Paced Precision Platformer) game that will challenge your skills to the maximum. Find your way out of a confined environment full of deadly traps, herege every move is crucial. Dash's precise movement and mechanics are key to tackling the brutal obstacles that await him.

Game Highlights:

  • Precision Movement: Master every jump and sprint as you navigate meticulously designed levels.

  • Dash Mechanics: Use Dash and its variations to overcome challenges and reach new levels of speed, completing courses in a dynamic and strategic way.

  • Brutalist Neon Environment: Confinement features a striking, brutalist-inspired visual style with neon accents that create a uniquely immersive atmosphere, underscoring the game’s dark, oppressive setting.

  • Intense Challenge: Take on around 40 challenging, carefully designed levels that require speed and accuracy. Completing each level in the shortest time possible increases the challenge and offers high replay value, making the game ideal for those looking for an intense and stimulating experience.


  • Competition and Ranking: Confinement also brings a ranking system to ramp up the competition. Players can battle for top spots and high scores, testing themselves and others to claim the leaderboard’s highest ranks. This feature amps up the excitement, pushing gamers to their limits and rewarding the most skilled, quickest players out there.

If you're ready to put your precision and agility to the test in a fierce, challenging environment, The Confinement is the game for you!

data.name: Bitburner
data.detailed_description:
After 5 years of development, contributions from hundreds of developers, the critically acclaimed open source programming hacking sim is available on Steam.

Inspired by games like Else Heart.break(), Hacknet, Uplink, and Deus Ex, Bitburner is a programming-based idle incremental RPG where you, the player, take the role of an unknown hacker in a dark, dystopian world. The game provides a variety of mechanics and systems that can be changed through coding and solved or automated in whatever way you find suitable.

While a very basic programming background is recommended, it is not required to play the game!

  • Write scripts in JavaScript to automate your gameplay

  • Hack through a network of servers to train your abilities and earn money

  • Solve real programming questions to hone your skills and earn rewards

  • Improve your character with 100+ Augmentations

  • Trade in the stock market and write automated trading scripts

  • Interact with various gameplay mechanics to increase your stats and earn money

  • Explore the world and discover different companies, locations, and factions

  • Mini-games

  • Unlock secret perma-upgrades

  • Continuing development!

You can play the web version at
