data.name: Granule
data.detailed_description:
Granule is a physics sandbox built around a ragdoll who won't stay dead. Break, bleed, burn, and dismember him with a growing set of tools, powers, and more.

It all starts with Murray, a man who, on a particularly bad day, did not let a certain driver merge onto the highway. That driver was a witch. In her rage, she sent Murray to The Granule: a dimension beyond death, but not beyond torment. Unknown to the witch and Murray, something already lives there. You.

Everything in the room is simulated, and the fun is in what happens when the systems meet. Water fills the room and drains out. Fire spreads along anything that burns. Ice forms in the cold and melts near the heat. Lightning runs through water and through whoever is standing in it. Portals pass anything through, limbs included. It all runs at once, so things happen that were never built on purpose.

Some of what you can do to him is simple: a blade, a bat, a gun. The rest goes further. You can flood the room, turn off gravity, open holes in the walls, split him into smaller copies of himself, or reach into his head. There is far more than any list here could cover, and it keeps growing.

Murray has a working body under the skin. He bleeds, chokes, burns, freezes, and blacks out, and the diagram shows all of it as it happens. There is no game over. There's just whatever state you left him in.

The room is where you keep him. It is not all there is. The Granule is more vast than he could ever imagine, and you are not its only occupant. Some of the others have already taken notice.

Granule is in Early Access, with lots more items, mod support, building, saving rooms, and more creatures and places still to come.

data.name: Kissrim
data.detailed_description:
“Kissrim” is a choice-based visual novel.

Story

One late night, on his way home from the station to his apartment,

the protagonist hears the sound of a girl crying under the bridge.

Although the area isn’t particularly unsafe,
it’s certainly not a safe place for a girl to be alone at such an hour.

Unable to ignore it, the protagonist makes his way down beneath the bridge.

There, he finds a succubus curled up inside a cardboard box, hugging her knees.

Through her tears, she begs him to let her perform an energy drain (life-force absorption).

The protagonist reaches out his hand and says:
"If you don’t mind me, I’ll help you however I can."

And so begins the two of them’s shared life together.

Character

▶Lily Azura Kisquil Lira

CV: Yui Misono

A succubus striving to carry out energy-draining activities in the human world.

However, she is far too afraid of men to do so, and as a result has been unable to drain anyone at all.
Because of this, she’s on the verge of being cast out from the succubus group she belongs to.

Though she tells herself, “I have to try my best…!”,

whenever she actually approaches a man, she panics and ends up running away.

Her personality is gentle and caring, the type to devote herself wholeheartedly to others.

But perhaps due to her succubus instincts,
when she does drain energy she unexpectedly slips into a provocative tone, revealing a hidden teasing side.

Her favorite drink is milk.

Feature

  • Smooth character animations powered by E-mote

  • High-quality event CG

Staff

  • Character Design: 天音るり

  • Scenario: K.baggio

data.name: Dice with the Devil: Rerolled
data.detailed_description:
Dice with the Devil: Rerolled is a deckbuilder autobattler about scoring the best out of three dice rolls.

Win souls from your opponents and design your hand of three dice to out-luck your opponents and advance through the areas of the casino.

NOT A ROGUELIKE!

Losing battles only loses the souls you wager, so don't be afraid to experiment and try new strategies!

Complete fun challenges to unlock new dice

From drawing with your opponent, to rolling over 100 with three dice, overcoming them is key to success!

Buy dice for your hand and customise them with stickers

Stickers add new abilities to dice that enhance your roll and help you win.
With thousands of possible combinations, you control if luck will be on your side.

Battle unique opponents in different arenas

The further you progress, the more advanced their strategies become. Synergies and counters are key to beating them all.

data.name: TICKTICKBOOM!
data.detailed_description:
Two Games. One Goal: Don’t Explode.

Welcome to a chaotic, turn-based party game where every decision inches you closer to disaster. Choose between Hot Potato, a tense bomb-passing showdown, or Draw 31, a strategic card game where going over means going boom. Easy to learn, hard to survive.

Game Modes:

Hot Potato:
A live C4 is in play. Each turn, the bomb ticks closer to detonation. You can pass it, try to disarm it, or hold on and bluff your way through. Fail too many times and you earn strikes—three strikes and you're toast.
Successfully defuse the bomb? You’ll earn abilities to use in future rounds, giving you an edge when the heat is on.

Draw 31:
Play cards in a tense race to hit exactly 31. Go over and take a strike. Hit 31 perfectly? Everyone else gets one. With three strikes, you're out. A clever mix of luck, math, and sabotage makes every hand count.

data.name: Maskared
data.detailed_description:
Maskared is an exciting 2D game where you take control of a mask representing one of the Chinese zodiac signs. Each mask has unique abilities that influence your gameplay, allowing for different strategies in every run.

Prepare to dodge treacherous shurikens as you strive to achieve the highest survival score possible. With each successful maneuver, you accumulate points that can be used to unlock new masks and abilities, becoming more powerful with each challenge overcome.

Featuring a vibrant and colorful visual style, Maskared offers a dynamic and engaging experience where agility and precision are key. In every game, you’ll have the opportunity to refine your skills and discover which mask best suits your playstyle.

Dive into this action-packed and strategic world, and prove that you can conquer the challenges of Maskared!

Corner Streamer is a relaxing idle/incremental game where your virtual streamer hangs out in the corner of your screen, quietly building views, donations and sponsorships while you do your own thing. Whether you're working, gaming, or just chilling, your streamer is always live and growing.

Your Stream

Start with a humble  setup and a handful of viewers. Watch your numbers climb as your streamer broadcasts from the corner, earning bits and attracting more viewers over time. 

Customise your avatar

data.name: Bible Puzzle: Christian Game
data.detailed_description:
Bible Puzzle is an educational and relaxing game, perfect for all ages, from children to adults. Designed as an excellent option for family leisure, the game offers difficulty levels starting from just 4 pieces, allowing even the youngest players to have fun and learn while assembling biblical scenes.

As you start the game, players are invited to select a biblical image to assemble. Each image represents a significant passage from the Scriptures, and upon completing the puzzle, short clips are shown to tell the story behind the image, providing an educational and uplifting experience.

STORYTELLING:

Each puzzle pack includes video stories that provide context about the images in the pack.

CLICK & SWAP:

Click on one piece, then click on a second piece to swap their positions.

DRAG & DROP:

Simply drag a piece to swap it with any other piece.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Unlock achievements by completing specific challenges, enhancing engagement and fun.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Various difficulty levels: Choose the ideal challenge level for yourself or your children, with options ranging from just 4 pieces to many more, adapting to the player’s skill level.

  • Global and friend rankings: Engage in healthy competition with friends and players worldwide. Each image has its own ranking, encouraging repeat play and improvement.

  • Inspiring background music: Enjoy melodies inspired by the poetic books of the Bible, such as Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, and Song of Songs, creating a calm and introspective atmosphere while you play.

  • Regular content updates: New additional content will be released periodically as DLCs, offering new images and biblical stories to explore and assemble.

  • Educational experience: Beyond being fun, the game also offers a learning opportunity about biblical stories, making screen time more meaningful.

Bible Puzzle is more than just a game; it’s a fun and educational way to explore the Scriptures as a family, ensuring that both you and your children are engaged in a safe and enriching activity. Download now and start assembling these beautiful biblical stories!

data.name: Belt Nine
data.detailed_description:
Cross the Belt. See how far you get.

You used to work for the corps. Now you're running from them, in a ship that isn't yours, down a wormhole chain everyone calls the Belt. Belt Nine is a forward-scrolling arcade shooter in the spirit of Zanac, drawn entirely in lines of neon light on black.

The ship flies on rails. You slide it across the lane, push it forward or ease it back, and shoot whatever comes down at you. There are no menus to get through, no tutorial and no cutscenes. You press a button and the run starts.

One run, no end

  • Endless. Each stage leads straight into the next, with no loading screens and no last stage. The run lasts until your hull gives out.

  • One life. There are no checkpoints. When you die you start again from the very beginning with no points and no power-ups.

  • It keeps getting harder. The deeper you go, the more fighters, bigger squadrons and stranger wildlife come at you, and the heat never stops rising.

  • Speed pays. Your score is multiplied by how fast you're flying. Hold the turbo, thread the gaps and watch the multiplier climb.

Power-ups that stack

Twin guns, spread shot, ricochet, homing, piercer, chain lightning, shield, sidestep, magnet, rapid fire, double points, greed, and a bunch more... Pick up the same one again and it stacks. Every level you add shows on your hull, so a lucky ship ends up covered in cannon pods, orbiting sparks, halos and ghost copies of itself.

Things that should not live in space

The Belt has its own ecology. Whale pods swim through the lane. Leviathans big enough to swallow them come in at an angle, mouths open. Hullhuggers (baby krakens) leap onto your ship and eat your power-ups until you swerve hard enough to shake them off. Krakens, elder krakens, mimics and angels that don't like eye contact are out there too.

Something big at the end of every level

At the end of every level the scroll brakes to a halt and something comes for you: a cruiser and its escort, a destroyer, a kraken, an elder kraken, a mimic that chews, a moon-sized battle station, or seraphims.

Nobody goes anywhere until one of you is gone.

data.name: Soul Passage
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated

The Soul Passage team is dedicated to creating the best game possible. We are currently reworking the environment and mechanics to enhance the user experience for our players. During this process, we identified some flaws in the game and storyline, prompting us to redesign the narrative with more thoughtful logic.

As previously promised, we plan to release Soul Passage in late 2025, assuming everything goes smoothly. We also intend to launch a Kickstarter campaign 3-4 months prior to our launch to support our marketing efforts.

Please add Soul Passage to your wishlist and follow us for more updates. We appreciate your interest and support!


About the Game

Fight, solve, craft, travel, explore, and progress!

Soul Passage is an action-packed 2D hand-drawn Metroidvania game that offers a unique experience for players. With features such as Fast-paced combat, solving puzzles, crafting, travelling, exploring, and progression, this game breaks the mould of traditional Metroidvania titles. Players are given control of the skill tree and the fate of the main character, Obligor, as they embark on an extraordinary journey through the Soul Passage, a soul realm filled with diverse planets, creatures, and an abundance of magical items and weapons to discover.

The story of Soul Passage begins with Obligor, a warrior who has lost his family and village. Desperate for a chance to bring them back, he makes a deal with the Heartless Soul Keeper. In exchange for their resurrection, Obligor is given an impossible task: to gather the souls of his enemies and pass them through the Soul Passage. With the player in control, Obligor must navigate the diverse and treacherous realm of the Soul Passage to fulfil his obligation and bring his loved ones back to life.

Soul Passage is a unique blend of RPG and Metroidvania elements, designed to immerse players in an in-depth gameplay experience. You need to travel to different worlds and fight with foes to gather new masks to craft your own unique mask. You will have to deal with different physics while navigating different worlds & you will enjoy the challenging areas of the game more.

As in most Metroidvania games, you will be able to follow different paths to develop the main character in Soul Passage. There are special abilities that you can reach by exploring the Soul Universe and planets, and abilities that you can reach by levelling up are waiting for you in the Soul Passage story.

You will be able to equip 3 different special skills with the weapon you have on Obligor. Also, you will able to customize your gameplay with ranged or close combat by selecting different weapons.

Soul Passage offers you a different crafting feature. The more bosses you encounter and defeat, the more masks you will have the chance to collect.

The Soul Universe is a realm of countless planets and creatures. Obligor's story coincides with some of the planets in a corner of this universe, at the Soul Collector's hand. Some went to look for those doors but never returned, and sometimes unknown monsters appeared from unknown places.

data.name: Card Pack Dungeon
data.detailed_description:
Card Pack Dungeon is a deck-building roguelike where you draw card packs with limited funds, collect monsters, and defeat bosses as you climb toward the 100th floor.

Lose once, and everything is gone—back to Floor 1.
A tense adventure where luck and strategy collide awaits.

■ Card Packs × Roguelike

Each round, spend your limited funds to purchase card packs.

Use Monster Cards and Cash Cards wisely to progress to the next floor.

■ 100 Unique Bosses

Every floor features a distinct boss with unique appearances and abilities.

Defeat powerful enemies and push deeper into the dungeon.

■ Diverse Card System

Monster Cards: 100+ types

  • Common / Rare / Super Rare / Ultra Rare / Secret Rare

  • Higher rarity cards grant powerful and unique abilities

Cash Cards: 5 types

  • Spade / Heart / Diamond / Club / Wild

  • Earn money based on poker hands (Pair, Three of a Kind, etc.)

■ Figurines: Powerful Enhancements

“Figurines” can be obtained from boss defeats and events.
They provide powerful effects that can drastically change your run:

  • Strengthen battles

  • Reduce pack costs

  • Increase cash efficiency, and more

Over 100 figurines available, each with its own rarity.

■ Random Events

Each floor features random events such as:

  • Merchant Events

  • Treasure Chests

  • Casino Events

Your choices will shape your fate.

■ Simple Controls × Deep Strategy

Battles are fully automated.
All actions are performed with simple clicks.

Easy to play, yet strategically deep through card choices.

■ Grow Stronger with Every Run

Even in defeat, progress is not lost.
Earn bonuses based on how far you reached to gain an advantage in your next run.

Improve gradually and conquer new depths.

data.name: Salt & Schooners
data.detailed_description:
You wash ashore in 1789 with nothing but the clothes on your back and the salt in your lungs. The Pacific stretches out in every direction, a chain of more than thirty islands, each one a gamble between salvation and another slow death.

Forage. Hunt. Scavenge the wrecks. Build a boat from whatever the islands give you. Then watch it fall apart the moment the waves decide they're tired of your company. Every voyage is a risk. Every repair is a race against hunger, weather, and the next hull breach.

Explore caves that haven't seen daylight in decades. Dive for underwater loot. Raid shipwrecks. Trade with the few merchants willing to deal with a half drowned stranger. Fight or flee the tribes who don't want you on their shores. And if you finally reach civilisation, don't expect a free ride home.

FEATURES

  • Single player survival — a solo journey across a hand crafted archipelago of islands, each with its own resources and dangers

  • Boat building and repair - scavenge materials to construct vessels, then keep them seaworthy

  • Deep resource gathering - forage, hunt and dive for loot both above and below the waterline

  • Shipwreck and cave exploration - raid sunken wrecks and delve into caves untouched for decades, hunting for gear and story fragments

  • Dynamic NPC factions - trade with wandering merchants or navigate tense encounters with island tribes, through diplomacy or combat

  • Forgiving survival systems - manage hunger, thirst and health without the fear of permanent death, so every mistake is a lesson, not a wipe

  • A handcrafted world - every island is designed by hand, not generated, so exploration always has intent behind it

data.name: ISKRA
data.detailed_description:
Enter the ruthless world of intense space management! Your primary goal is to survive, optimize your base's resources, keep your crew alive, and fight your way to the top of the global player rankings. Every decision comes at a cost, and any mistake can prove fatal. Do you have enough energy and patience to endure?

SURVIVAL AND COLONY MANAGEMENT

Every colonist on your base is your most valuable, yet incredibly fragile resource.

  • Endurance Limit: Human stamina is not infinite. Continuous work for more than 59 seconds is guaranteed to result in exhaustion and the character's painful death.

  • Energy and Rest: Send your personnel on a mandatory 60-second break at the right time. During this period, they will be unavailable, so plan your energy reserves in advance!

  • Emergency Measures: Need to urgently send someone to an event or heal them? Use the simplified management menu at the cost of energy for an immediate response.

  • Medical Care: Keep an eye on your colonists' health indicators. Optimize the Core manually and, under no circumstances, cut power to the Medbay*!*

RESOURCES, CRAFTING, AND CORE CONTROL

Your survival depends on technology and the proper allocation of materials.

  • Analyzer: Research and extract valuable resources. Upgrade the search area using in-game currency. This upgrade only needs to be purchased once and remains with you permanently!

  • Workshop: Raw ore is worthless on its own. First process the extracted materials using the crane, then use them to craft vital items.

  • Core Balancing: Use crafted equipment to manually control the reactor. But be careful with unstable technologies: while the Spark Stabilizer helps keep the systems balanced, the Anti-Drone Module causes severe destabilization, which is why its effect is limited to just 15 seconds!

GLOBAL RANKINGS AND SEASONS

Compete against players from around the world for the title of the best colony manager!

  • KLL System: After each game, your results are calculated and sent to the server, contributing to your ranking.

  • Seasonal Competition: Fight your way into the top rankings and hold your position until the end of the month.

  • Exclusive Rewards: Earn in-game currency, calculated using a secret formula based on your performance, and compete for unique rewards awarded to the highest-ranking players!

CUSTOMIZATION AND ACHIEVEMENTS

Keep your colonists alive until the very end to permanently unlock their unique avatars and hats for your account. Collect dozens of achievements, ranging from story-based challenges to ultra-rare accomplishments, purchase new items from the market, and create your perfect playstyle.

data.name: Moss Dwellers
data.detailed_description:
Moss Dwellers is a relaxing strategy game in which you place tiles to grow lush landscapes. In this turn based game you will place tiles and watch the world expand before you. Take your time and find the best path forward. If you are looking for a challenge, go for the high score or scale increasingly difficult challenges.

In Moss Dwellers you start with a hand of cards, where each card allows you to place a tile in the world. Some tiles have abilities that can be triggered to get extra rewards. Plan ahead, and activate them at the correct time to score large amounts of points in one go.

When your hand runs out, you draw new cards until your deck runs out. If you run out of cards, the game is over. In order to get more cards you need to score points, reaching thresholds to get bundles of new cards shuffled into your deck.

As you play new biomes, tiles and cards will be unlocked that gives you more options to tailor the experience to your liking.

What Moss Dwellers offers

  • Build lush landscapes

  • Unique mix of strategy and puzzle mechanics

  • Relaxing and calming gameplay

  • Strategic placement to trigger chain reactions

  • High replay value - every session is different

  • Many unlockable tiles, biomes, relics and more...

What Moss Dwellers does not offer

  • 4X Strategy

  • Trading

  • Resource Management

  • Combat & Violence

  • Multiplayer

Moss Dwellers was developed by two game designers from Göteborg, Sweden. Together we formed Vredesmood with the goal to develop small, original and high-quality indie games.

We love to hear constructive feedback, so feel free to contact us! We will do our best to respond to messages quickly and fix any problems that may arise.

data.name: Celestian Tales: Old North
data.detailed_description:
Celestian Tales: Old North is a refreshing take on the classic turn-based Japanese style RPG. Scrapping away the cliché of a destined person or a boy/girl-saving-the-world, the story is tailored for a mature audience and questions the bare morals of a human being. Will you do anything to survive? Will you be steadfast in defending your faith and beliefs? Or will you let yourself be corrupted, little by little, in the name of greater good?

The First of the Celestian Tales 3 Part Series, Old North is full of lush hand-painted environments, emotive portraits, memorable characters and a sprawling engaging moralistic storyline that is told through the eyes of six protagonists. The actions you perform and the decisions you make in Celestian Tales: Old North will carry over to the next installment of the series.

Experience what it's truly like to bear the responsibilities of a hero in the beautifully hand-drawn Old North. Take on the role of one among six young nobles, learning your way of knighthood and assisting the lords you serve. When an external force threatens the land, you find yourself swept in the tides of war where the deadliest enemies are those among your own ranks.

Featuring a turn-based combat system with plenty of character and party customization options, Celestian Tales allows you to play the game at your own pace in your own style. Enter the first decade of this epic three-game series and see for yourself what sets it apart.

Features

  • Moral Confrontations - Situations are presented to the player throughout the game that force players to face moral questions and beliefs.
  • Unique Story – By avoiding genre cliches, the story brings a fresh approach to RPG storytelling by allowing players feel the weight of their character’s actions.
  • Multiple Story Arcs - 6 Selectable Characters allow you to play the game from 6 different perspectives. Play through the game as all 6 characters for a full experience.
  • Traditional RPG Gameplay - Inspired by classic JRPGs with a turn-based RPG battle system, players can develop a personal combat style.
  • Beautiful Art - Lush hand-painted background visuals and environments with detailed emotive character portraits and animated pixel-art characters create a full and complete world experience.
  • Epic Music - A sweeping score that captures the pace and emotion of the story as it unfolds.
  • More to Come - Old North is the First episode of a planned trilogy of games and your actions in this game will have impact in the next episode of the series.

data.name: Don't Die, Dummy!
data.detailed_description:
Don’t Die, Dummy! (DDD) is an over-the-top action game where you control a crash-test dummy who’s sick of getting thrown around—so now it’s time to throw down! Armed with breakdance moves that double as deadly combat techniques, you’ll take on hordes of corporate robots in the ultimate battle for dummy dignity.

Why Play DDD?

  • Dance Like Nobody’s Watching: Unless you count the army of robots you’re spinning into scrap metal.

  • Physics Gone Wild: Every punch, spin, and kick takes on a life of its own with chaotic ragdoll physics.

  • Eye-Popping Style: Bright visuals, goofy animations, and enemies that are as absurd as they are challenging.

  • Laugh Out Loud Combat: Because why shouldn’t a windmill spin-kick be your deadliest move?

It’s silly, stylish, and packed with enough chaos to keep you grooving and smashing your way through a robot apocalypse.

data.name: Your Train 2
data.detailed_description:
"Your Train 2" is a very simple brain game! Customers who love trains, customers who love games, everyone can enjoy it. No expertise required.
We have prepared a total of more than 50 railway lines in Japan and Taiwan!
(You can enjoy this game even if you haven't played the previous work, "Tokyo Densha" and "Your Train".)

・To everyone who will be a train dispatcher
Dear train dispatchers, let's transport customers by starting various trains, such as local trains and limited express trains.
In the previous work, commuter routes in urban areas were the main ones, but in this work, we have prepared many railway routes throughout Japan and Taiwan. In addition, some of the commuter routes that appeared in the previous work have been completely remade and reappeared.

- Goal of the game
Let's aim for high operating profits by receiving fares from customers waiting at the station!
The fare in this game is a bit different from both reality and its predecessor. The fares you charge will decrease over time.

income
Fixed fare - waiting time before boarding - boarding time to the right end of the screen = fare income

Customers at any station will receive a fixed fare, but the fare will be less due to the time it takes for the train to arrive at the station and the time it takes for the train to run to the right end of the screen.

cost
To depart a train, a "departure fee" will be charged according to the number of vehicles.
Example: 30 for a 2-car train, 35 for a 3-car train, 40 for a 4-car train

Operating profit is the difference between fare revenue and departure cost.
Let's quickly provide trains to customers who are waiting at the station and quickly carry them to the right edge of the screen.

In particular, the game features a large number of express trains and bullet trains. In addition to the fare for these trains, customers can also receive a "express fee". In pursuing operating profit, the method of operating the limited express is very important. Please play a lot and grab the tricks.


・Method of operation
Operation is very easy.
All you have to do is decide the number of train cars to depart and let the train depart at the best timing.

・Volume is plentiful
We have over 50 train lines for you!
In addition, rules that were not in the previous game will appear in the middle of the game, so please enjoy them.

・Railway to play
JR Hokkaido, JR East, JR Tokai, JR West, JR Shikoku, JR Kyushu
Tobu, Seibu, Keikyu, Keio, Kintetsu, Meitetsu, Odakyu, Nankai, Keisei, Taiwan Railway, Taiwan High Speed Rail
Hokuso Railway Izukyu

・New features in this game
In the Information Center, we have added a "Layout" function that allows you to change the layout of the buttons according to how you hold your smartphone. You can choose from three types: right-handed, left-handed, and how to hold the game console.

・Changes from the previous game
In the previous game, the timing to receive the fare was the moment the customer boarded the car, but in this game, it is when the customer is brought to the right edge of the screen.

In the previous work, the departure cost for limited express trains and bullet trains was slightly higher, but in this work, all trains are the same.

"The effect of some buttons has been changed." Also new rules are coming. Instructions are provided in-game.


・Capacity is about 130MB
The storage burden is also small. There is no heavy processing at all, so there is no problem with relatively old models.
One game takes less than 3 minutes, so you can enjoy it easily.

- No ads, no in-app purchases
No in-app purchases. No ads.
There is nothing to disturb the operation of the train. Please concentrate on the game.
You can also choose the difficulty level from "Difficult/Normal/Easy". Children can enjoy themselves with peace of mind.
Let's share the results of driving on Twitter etc.

The fare in this game is a bit different from both reality and its predecessor. The fares you charge will decrease over time.

income
Fixed fare - waiting time before boarding - boarding time to the right end of the screen = fare income

Customers at any station will receive a fixed fare, but the fare will be less due to the time it takes for the train to arrive at the station and the time it takes for the train to run to the right end of the screen.

cost
To depart a train, a "departure fee" will be charged according to the number of vehicles.
Example: 30 for a 2-car train, 35 for a 3-car train, 40 for a 4-car train

Operating profit is the difference between fare revenue and departure cost.
Let's quickly provide trains to customers who are waiting at the station and quickly carry them to the right edge of the screen.

In particular, the game features a large number of express trains and bullet trains. In addition to the fare for these trains, customers can also receive a "express fee". In pursuing operating profit, the method of operating the limited express is very important. Please play a lot and grab the tricks.


・Method of operation
Operation is very easy.
All you have to do is decide the number of train cars to depart and let the train depart at the best timing.

・Volume is plentiful
We have over 50 train lines for you!
In addition, rules that were not in the previous game will appear in the middle of the game, so please enjoy them.

・Railway to play
JR Hokkaido, JR East, JR Tokai, JR West, JR Shikoku, JR Kyushu
Tobu, Seibu, Keikyu, Keio, Kintetsu, Meitetsu, Odakyu, Nankai, Keisei, Taiwan Railway, Taiwan High Speed Rail
Hokuso Railway Izukyu

・New features in this game
In the Information Center, we have added a "Layout" function that allows you to change the layout of the buttons according to how you hold your smartphone. You can choose from three types: right-handed, left-handed, and how to hold the game console.

・Changes from the previous game
In the previous game, the timing to receive the fare was the moment the customer boarded the car, but in this game, it is when the customer is brought to the right edge of the screen.

In the previous work, the departure cost for limited express trains and bullet trains was slightly higher, but in this work, all trains are the same.

"The effect of some buttons has been changed." Also new rules are coming. Instructions are provided in-game.


・Capacity is about 130MB
The storage burden is also small. There is no heavy processing at all, so there is no problem with relatively old models.
One game takes less than 3 minutes, so you can enjoy it easily.

- No ads, no in-app purchases
No in-app purchases. No ads.
There is nothing to disturb the operation of the train. Please concentrate on the game.
You can also choose the difficulty level from "Difficult/Normal/Easy". Children can enjoy themselves with peace of mind.
Let's share the results of driving on Twitter etc.

data.name: Kill The Frog
data.detailed_description:
One frog. Four rooms. A growing army.


The frog was just sitting there. The Bugivugis took it personally.

Kill The Frog! is a playful pixel-art incremental/idle game about growing an army, turning resources into upgrades, and dealing with frog bosses. Progress through Gold → Gems → Honey → Cheese: each of the four rooms brings a different gameplay loop.

Gold room — Build your army




Recruit more archers and improve your towers and gold mine. Collect gold as you attack the frog, then turn your earnings into a stronger army and new upgrades.

Gem room — Bring in the magic




Add mages, ballistas, a mage tower and a zeppelin to your offensive. Earn gems, develop this room’s skills and strengthen your magical units.

Honey room — Defend your hive




Improve your bees and queen bee, gather pollen, fill your hive and produce honey. Use pollen turrets against the frog’s flower rocks. Hold your cursor over flowers in the sky to trigger a shockwave and clear incoming rocks.

Cheese room — Follow every bounce




Watch cheese balls bounce through the pins and reach the baskets to earn cheese. Develop golden balls, target pins and explosive pins to explore this room’s different earning opportunities.

Skill trees — Choose your next power




Every room brings its own skill tree and upgrade priorities. Choose between attacks, production, speed and special mechanics, and decide where your resources will make a difference.

BugiVugi King — One king, your build




Your king fights beside you in the Gold, Gem and Honey rooms. Discover nine pieces of boss loot: gold-, gem- and honey-themed staffs, capes and amulets. Equip one item in each slot to combine resource income, attack timing and special hit effects. Click his crown to switch between Helmet, Wanderer and Robed appearances.

What awaits you?


  • Four rooms with different combat and resource systems
  • A dedicated skill tree for each room
  • A special king unit customized through boss equipment
  • Animated pixel-art characters and a short, humorous opening cinematic

6 supported languages
English, Turkish, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese.

data.name: Arcana Academy
data.detailed_description:
⭐ Features ⭐

🎴 300+ Collectible Buildings or Cards

📜 120+ Researchable BPs.

📅 200+ Mainline and Random Events

🧙 100+ Different Wizard Classes

✨ 200+ Random Apprentice Traits


About the Game

Arcana Academy is a magic-themed card simulation management game filled with many mysteries waiting to be discovered. In the game, you play as a mage headmaster, freely constructing your magic academy, summoning human, elf, and even dangerous vampire and werewolf students to support the reconstruction of the empire.

If you could freely Construct and develop your Magic Academy, would you choose to teach Students or nurture Monsters?

Use over 300 collectible buildings or cards to freely construct your own magic academy, from Regular Classrooms to Mage Spires, from manual Workshops to automated Production—upgrade Facilities and Buildings step by step, improve Production lines, and boost Production efficiency. Summon different Races, handle sudden Events, and explore over 200 unique Mainline or random Events.

What happens when the mysterious Summon Student ritual circle is tainted with Demon blood? Where will the Ritual lead?

With over 40 mysterious and special summon rituals, add your favorite materials to the ritual—offerings can be souls, money, or even living beings. The correct execution of a ritual usually requires fixed offerings, and the results are generally consistent; but if you break the rules, the outcome may lead to terrifying unknowns...

Customize every aspect of your academy, from its name to its teaching philosophy—will you pursue all-around development or focus on specialization?

Every academy's name and emblem can be freely defined. analyze each apprentice's unique trait combination (randomly generated from over 200 traits), select and admit them to your academy, teach according to their abilities, and enforce discipline with over 40 different academy rules for those lacking self-control. With over 100 different magic books, help them unravel the mysteries of the elements, Select their future class paths, and complete assessments. There are over 100 different wizard class selection assessments, leading them to become geniuses... or fall into mediocrity.

When facing fearsome monsters and demons, will you select to fight together, or offer some "offerings" to temporarily ease the crisis?

During your academy's construction, monsters will constantly eye you with hostility. To ensure peace and stability for your academy, you can send people to deal with them, or pay some "protection fees" in exchange for more development opportunities.

Will the ever-unlocking new magic and technology help you create a Legend, or bring more disasters and crises?

With over 120 researchable blueprints, as you expand your academy, you will encounter new knowledge and magic, master more technology, and fully automate production to rapidly develop your academy. But continuous development is a double-edged sword—more crises may follow, so be sure to prepare accordingly.

If you enjoy any of the following titles, we think you’ll love Arcana Academy:

Hogwarts Legacy, Harry Potter, Mind Over Magic, Stacklands, Cultist Simulator, Cardboard Town, Ways of Alchemy, Spellcaster University, Stack to Ascension, Card Cultivation, WitchHand, Witchbrook...

data.name: Diamo XL
data.detailed_description:
Diamo XL is a fast-paced, arcade-style score chaser where survival means constantly moving and adapting. Navigate all zones around the diamond, collect points before enemies destroy them, and don't stop moving to maintain your multiplier for high scores. Fill in all four triangles to complete the diamond and earn bonus points!

  • Simple & Intuitive Controls – Play using keyboard (Arrow Keys/WASD), controller (D-Pad/Joystick), or mouse clicks.

  • Fast-Paced Arcade Gameplay – Endless action that ramps up in difficulty.

  • Unlockable Characters – Complete challenges to play as unique characters with different stats.

  • Score Tracking & Multipliers – Improve and perfect your high score strategy.

  • Steam Integration – Achievements, Leaderboards, Trading Cards, Cloud Saves.

  • Bite-Sized & Addictive – Perfect for quick sessions between other games.

  • Uniquely Crafted Audio – Sound effects made using my own voice and royalty-free audio and Royalty Free Music from Bensound called "Moose"

Diamo XL is a simple yet rewarding arcade game focused on high scores and replayability. I appreciate all feedback and will continue supporting the game. Feel free to reach out via Discord or my website if you have suggestions or want to say hi.

Thanks for checking it out, I hope you enjoy playing!

Adam Nickerson – Adamvision Studios

data.name: BuzztteVTuber: Go Viral in 2018?!
data.detailed_description:
2018. Time-leap to the dawn of VTubing.

2018 was the year VTubing took off — a few pioneers sparked a boom, and in Japan "VTuber" even won an internet buzzword of the year award.

No agencies. No playbook. Nothing was settled yet.

Time rewinds, and you begin again as a VTuber nobody has heard of.

One year to go from zero subscribers to viral.

2018. Time-leap to the dawn of VTubing.

No agencies. No playbook. Nothing was settled yet.

Time rewinds, and you begin again as a VTuber nobody has heard of.

One year to go from zero subscribers to viral.

Train, stream, go viral

Talk, Editing, Gaming, Art, Singing — raise five stats and keep streaming.

That's the whole loop, and it's a simple one.

Read the week's trend, put in the prep work, and your odds of a BUZZ go up.

One spike changes everything.

Your own avatar streams inside the game

The core hook: capture a window or a virtual camera directly.

OBS, VTube Studio, or whatever you already stream with — bring it straight in.

Your model stands in the in-game stream window and in your room.

Not a streamer? Bundled silhouette art works out of the box.

Fall short, and time rewinds

Miss your goal and you time-leap. Subscribers and money are gone, but

your skills stay in your muscle memory. No limit on rewinds. Come back stronger.

And then there's Reality Mode

Normal mode is a game where hard work pays off.

Reality Mode is not. You don't grow. It doesn't pay off.

It's here so you can feel the weight that real streamers actually carry.

Before you play

  • Do not install into a folder path containing non-ASCII characters — the game will fail to launch

  • Virtual camera capture requires OBS, VTube Studio, or similar (not included)

Streaming & Video Policy

Feel free to stream and post videos of this game — individuals and companies alike.

No prior notice or permission request is needed. Monetization is fine (ads, memberships, tips).

Spoilers and endings are entirely up to you.

All music and sound effects in this game are cleared for streaming, so you can leave the audio on.

The only ask: please don't use the game for unlawful purposes, or to harass or defame

anyone — including us. That's it.

Your own stream layout shows up inside the game. Give it a try.

data.name: Spellsphere
data.detailed_description:
---Overview---


Spellsphere is a fast-paced action roguelike set in the far future where society has reverted to an era similar to the medieval ages. You play as a mage locked up in a dungeon while an evil sorcerer has taken over the island. Can you escape the dungeon, travel the island, and defeat the sorcerer?

---Gameplay---


Using two powerful magic orbs, battle your way through hordes of enemies in multiple unique zones such as a dungeon, a village, a castle, and more! Aside from combat, Spellsphere offers a unique combo-based currency to upgrade yourself in several ways.

---Variety---


Spellsphere offers various upgrades, orbs, enemies, paths to take, and rooms to battle your way through. Explore 12 different areas of the island, and fight many unique enemies. Collect over 50 different orbs to mix and match with, and get more and more powerful.

---FAQ---


Q - What kind of game is Spellsphere?
A - Spellsphere is a difficult, fast-paced, reaction-based, roguelike take on a sidescroller shoot 'em up filled with a bullet hell of enemies.

Q - When will it release?
A - Spellsphere is planned to release sometime in either late 2023 or early 2024.

Q - Is Spellsphere fun?
A - Fun is subjective, but I personally find it to be fun.

Q - What can I do after my first playthrough?
A - After the first playthrough of the game, the game is still replayable with harder difficulty and can be played a couple more times to get a true ending. After achieving the true ending, there are planned to be special features to customize any future runs.

Q - Is there a story?
A - There is a story in the game that can be learned through interacting with objects such as notes and signs, as well as NPCs.

Q - Is the game done?
A - No, the game is not completed yet. However, progress is steadily being made and you can expect updates on the release date, pricing, and more in the following months.

Using two powerful magic orbs, battle your way through hordes of enemies in multiple unique zones such as a dungeon, a village, a castle, and more! Aside from combat, Spellsphere offers a unique combo-based currency to upgrade yourself in several ways.

---Variety---


Spellsphere offers various upgrades, orbs, enemies, paths to take, and rooms to battle your way through. Explore 12 different areas of the island, and fight many unique enemies. Collect over 50 different orbs to mix and match with, and get more and more powerful.

---FAQ---


Q - What kind of game is Spellsphere?
A - Spellsphere is a difficult, fast-paced, reaction-based, roguelike take on a sidescroller shoot 'em up filled with a bullet hell of enemies.

Q - When will it release?
A - Spellsphere is planned to release sometime in either late 2023 or early 2024.

Q - Is Spellsphere fun?
A - Fun is subjective, but I personally find it to be fun.

Q - What can I do after my first playthrough?
A - After the first playthrough of the game, the game is still replayable with harder difficulty and can be played a couple more times to get a true ending. After achieving the true ending, there are planned to be special features to customize any future runs.

Q - Is there a story?
A - There is a story in the game that can be learned through interacting with objects such as notes and signs, as well as NPCs.

Q - Is the game done?
A - No, the game is not completed yet. However, progress is steadily being made and you can expect updates on the release date, pricing, and more in the following months.

data.name: Monster Girl Therapy
data.detailed_description:
Monster Girl Therapy is an interactive narrative with minigames & puzzles.

This game is safe for work—and safe to stream!

That old game you obsessed over, so many years ago? It’s dying. Only one day remains to explore the crumbling fantasy world, to mingle with its monstrous inhabitants... which is what got you playing in the first place!

Now, it’s finally time to do something nice for them—go get them out of here!

Of course, you’ll have to earn their trust first: Talk to them. Make a tough choice or two. Overcome their weird challenges. Do whatever is necessary!

After all, you’re their only chance… and helping feels good, doesn’t it?

  • six monster girls, each in their own habitat

  • a handful of minigames and secrets to mix things up

  • snappy lines with sincere feelings

  • a sweet little story—about 3 to 5 hours

  • charming pixel art to tickle your nostalgia

  • depth and stuff

data.name: Confrontation
data.detailed_description:
Will you survive the Ragn'Narok?

Thrilling action role playing game, Confrontation, lets you lead a Griffin Elite Squad in missions through the territory of the fearsome Scorpion creatures, the terrible Wolfen packs, or the brutal Bran-Ô-Kor Orcs.

Along with a perilous solo campaign and numerous secondary missions, recruit Elite warriors that will fight by your side and build the best squad to complete your mission objectives! Each of your warriors has its own unique characteristics. Earn experience, level up after battles and improve the weapons, armor and spells of your team. Get to know your enemy, anticipate his actions and exploit his weaknesses!

Good management of your units and of their spells will be paramount to your success. A video game adaptation of the famous Board Game, Confrontation is a tactical role-playing-game, that showcases intense and strategic combat.

In multiplayer mode, take the command of one of the four factions, and challenge players from all around the world in bloody online combats. Climb the worldwide rankings and become the master of Aarklash!

data.name: Laser Attraction
data.detailed_description:
Laser Attraction is a puzzle game where you manipulate laser beams to reach their destination. With accurate light physics, make use of reflection and refraction to control the path of light.

The laser beams are created with red, green and blue lasers that blend together. As the different wavelengths refract at different angles you can use dispersion to separate them into individual beams of light. Or you can pass the beam through a filter to reflect a single colour.

Use the tools provided to direct one or more laser beams, to mix and separate colours, open doors, hit targets and solve the puzzles, many with multiple solutions.

Featuring 60 puzzles, original music, no timer or locked puzzles, complete the game at your own pace.

data.name: Mad Ever After
data.detailed_description:
• Happily Ever After? Not Anymore!

    Team up in 1-4 player co-op and fight your way through a fairytale world gone completely mad. Wield powerful shapeshifting magical staffs, battle hordes of bizarre creatures and face twisted versions of familiar fairytale characters as you try to survive the chaos.

    Control the Cube, Unleash Your Magic

    Magic in Mad Ever After isn't cast with the press of a button. Control your magical cube in the heat of battle to unleash powerful spells while fighting off the chaos around you. Combine different upgrades, discover powerful synergies and master the cube to turn every run into a unique magical arsenal.

    Shape Your Staff, Build Your Magic

    Discover legendary magical weapons that can turn the tide of battle. Wield a venomous Excalibur, breathe fire through a dragon-headed staff, freeze your enemies with the Ice Age Revolver or unleash chaos with a magical trombone. Combine them with your spells and upgrades to create unexpected synergies and a different magical arsenal every run.

    Fairytales, But Not As You Remember Them

    Journey through corrupted realms where familiar stories have taken a very wrong turn. Help some tales find their way back on track, like returning the Bremen Musicians to the stage. Others may be beyond saving, leaving you to face a once-beloved princess transformed into a towering monster by an irreversible apple curse. Fight through the madness and discover which stories can still be saved and which must come to an end.

    Magic in Mad Ever After isn't cast with the press of a button. Control your magical cube in the heat of battle to unleash powerful spells while fighting off the chaos around you. Combine different upgrades, discover powerful synergies and master the cube to turn every run into a unique magical arsenal.

    Shape Your Staff, Build Your Magic

    Discover legendary magical weapons that can turn the tide of battle. Wield a venomous Excalibur, breathe fire through a dragon-headed staff, freeze your enemies with the Ice Age Revolver or unleash chaos with a magical trombone. Combine them with your spells and upgrades to create unexpected synergies and a different magical arsenal every run.

    Fairytales, But Not As You Remember Them

    Journey through corrupted realms where familiar stories have taken a very wrong turn. Help some tales find their way back on track, like returning the Bremen Musicians to the stage. Others may be beyond saving, leaving you to face a once-beloved princess transformed into a towering monster by an irreversible apple curse. Fight through the madness and discover which stories can still be saved and which must come to an end.

Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

data.name: Solar Shifter EX
data.detailed_description:
Warp into action with Solar Shifter EX. Man your ship and dive into fierce combat situations in space and over beautiful and distant planet surfaces. Solar Shifter EX is a sci-fi shoot 'em up with the unique ability to 'shift'.
Your only weapon is your ship: The Phase Shifter has been outfitted with a one-of-a-kind jump drive that lets you warp out of tough situations at will, a technique which will challenge you of to your limits when surviving the masses of enemies coming at you from all sides in this true bullet hell.

In good old shmup fashion you will face uncountable formations of enemies that'll try to stop you. Be clever and use the Phase Shifter's jump drive to your advantage or you will get shot.

STORY
Shortly after mankind left the solar system to colonize new worlds, we had to face a powerful alien race. The war has passed, the losses were devastating and the enemy has defeated us. As the final strike, they are about to destroy the sun that gives life to the system that we now call home.
Chaos erupted, and pirate raiders are scavenging fellow human colonies on the outer rim. Their only goal is to collect enough resources to be able to leave the solar system.

FEATURES
• Unique 'shifting' mechanic to bring a completely new level of depth into a shmup
• 18 tough missions
• 8 beautiful environments
• Over 40 enemy types encountered throughout the game
• Upgrade your ship
• 4 controllable ships: One main ship and three alien ships. Control all-powerful alien vessels that decimate allied forces with ease.

data.name: Plop - A Battle Royale Bowel Movement
data.detailed_description:
A Battle Royale Bowel Movement

Plop is a fast, silly, third-person battle royale. You are a small hero with a big problem: the whole desert wants you dead, and your best weapons come from inside. Fart to launch a poison cloud, burp to stun anyone in your face, puke to leave a slick that sends chasers sliding. Then finish them with whatever you pulled out of the last supply chest.

Every match is a race between you, the other players, the robots, and the gas.

How a match goes

  • Drop in. Up to 50 combatants land on one of three desert maps. Humans fill the lobby first; bots take every empty seat, so there is always a full match.

  • Loot. Supply chests fall from the sky through the whole match. Crack one open for a random weapon and a power-up, from health and shields to super speed and super strength.

  • Fight. Eleven weapons: knife, pistol, SMG, shotgun, assault rifle, heavy machine gun, minigun, sniper rifle, bazooka, flamethrower and the chem gun. Each handles differently and each has its own kill ranks.

  • Move. Sprint, dash, dodge roll with invulnerability, slide, and a jetpack with a glide when the fuel runs dry.

  • Survive the gas. The zone closes in phases with a ten-second warning before each one. When the 15-minute clock runs out it closes from every side at once: sudden death until one player is left.

Features

  • Online battle royale for up to 50 combatants (players plus bots), hosted peer to peer. If the host leaves, the match carries on with a new host.

  • Three maps: Gassy Gulch, Gastro Crater and Ploppin' Good Time, each with its own gas behavior.

  • Three body-based abilities (fart, burp, puke) on top of eleven guns and melee.

  • Bots with three skill tiers that loot, flank, dodge, retreat when hurt and flee the gas. Pick the difficulty when you host.

  • Match scoring: 10 points per kill, 5 per assist, shown on the in-game player list.

  • Persistent stats: kills per weapon, wins and games played are saved to your profile and feed the leaderboard.

  • Leaderboard divisions from Wood to Platinum, ranked by wins.

  • Unlockable skins earned with your stats, plus body and helmet colors.

  • 37 Steam achievements: five kill ranks for each weapon class, win milestones and the four leaderboard divisions.

  • Spectate the rest of the match after you go down.

  • Cartoon 3D art, positional sound and a soundtrack that plays from the camp radios.

Early Access

Plop is in active development and played with the community. Matches need an internet connection; there is no offline mode. Balance, maps, weapons and abilities will change between updates. Found something broken or have an idea? Tell us on the community hub.

data.name: Shutter 2
data.detailed_description:
Lockdown.

Take control of the RC2, the most powerful remote spectral surveillance tool in the industry, while you try to piece together the horrific tale plaguing the halls of Kent Island Prison.

Your buyers are waiting.

Defeat and photograph the fallen spirits of the hallowed Kent Island Prison, cash in on the evidence and then upgrade your RC's defensive systems as you delve deeper into the crumbling halls of the abandoned prison.

Can you survive the night?

It's just you and your RC and you'll need to protect it with your life. Upgrade your RC's health and weapons before it gets destroyed, or face the spirits in person.


Key Features:
- Go old school and view your environments through classic static cameras from the early days of 3D survival horror or switch to the over-the-shoulder cam to get right into the horror!

- New RC combat! Use new defensive tools to dispatch the spectral entities of Kent Island.

- New RC abilities for greater puzzle depth. Use different camera filters and the new RC Arm Mode to solve more intricate puzzles.

- Upgrade your RC's abilities and defensive systems as the horror increases throughout the night.

- Multiple narrative threads to find, with a scoring system that tracks the evidence you've found.

data.name: Solarise
data.detailed_description:
Energy is the critical resource of the 21st century. Use solar as a path to underpin your country's energy needs and reach self-sufficiency. Work your way up to manage a factory, power needs, politics, and just ordinary people to lower costs and outcompete your global rivals. Win the modern market.

Europe

In most automation games, you land on a green alien planet or crashland on an orange alien planet, hoping to mine and automate mineral extraction. This game takes a different approach and instead starts you off in 2026, in modern Europe with a little capital and a small space to build. You must work your way up from repairing broken panels, to setting up your own lamination machines, and eventually fighting local laws to establish mines and vertically integrate your production. You are faced with real machines, laws, problems, and people.

Production chain

This game aims to tackle the 6 stages of solar panel production, starting you off at the final step in the process, and allowing you to invest capital further down the production to vertically integrate over time:

  • Panels - start by assembling together multiple cells and electronics to produce a roof-ready solar panel

  • Cells - turn silicon slices into electricity-producing cells

  • Wafers - slice up blocks of silicon into thin slices

  • Ingot - pull molten silicon into crystals and cut them into blocks

  • Polysilicon - purify crude silicon to solar-grade

  • Rock - establish mining operations and smelt quartz-rich rock to forge silicon
    Accept contracts at various stages of the process and customise your factory to fit the market demand as well as your future ambitions.

People

Hire the right workers, assign them to their stations, and make sure they stay productive. Invest into managers and HR departments to find better skilled candidates and improve your efficiency. People might come with unique traits and quirks, whether that's being a fast-learner, or a hidden thief who steals the occasional cell that slips through their fingers. Should you deem right or struggle with cash-flow, lay off certain employees to rescue the balance sheet.

Power

As your production ramps up, handle power needs by hooking up to the grid and importing cheap electricity, but deal with connectivity delays and the price that comes with affecting the locals. Or, re-purpose your own stockpiled panels to go net-neutral, but accustom yourself to working alongside weather conditions.

Politics and long-term investments

As you turn profit and look into further expansion, you'll have to consider direct capital expenditure or spending on political influence or marketing campaigns. Invest into lobbying for various strategical benefits such as tariffs or lower taxes to better ease expansion. Alternatively, invest into ads like "Buy European" to increase local demand. Use your wit to find the right timing and approach that scales the most effectively.

data.name: Time Enforcers
data.detailed_description:
The maniacal Chronolith, Imperial Ruler of the Trans-Dimensional Realm, is rewriting the past, and only you can stop his evil minions of doom from unraveling time itself!

Time Enforcers is an action-packed role-playing adventure blended with an interactive digital comic designed to make learning history exciting and fun.

As a Galactic Space-Time Continuum (GSTC) recruit, you’ll work under the guidance of HG Wells, Executive Director of the GSTC, and Professor CT Huygens, Director of Temporal Dynamics, to find a way to stop this madness.

Alongside the enigmatic Time Enforcer Agent, Samurai Warrior Kaizen, you must:

• Travel through time to a pivotal moment in Japan’s history.

• Engage in turn-based battles against Chronolith’s minions who seek to alter the past.

• Solve historical puzzles posed by Chronolith’s lieutenant, the Inquisitor, to continue your mission.

• Experience fully animated cutscenes with voice-overs and narrations, timed word balloons, and thought bubbles to engage players of all ages.

• Meet a mix of real and fictional characters inspired by history, each with a role in the unfolding adventure.

Designed for kids and the young at heart, Time Enforcers transforms real-world history into a thrilling adventure.

Can you stop Chronolith before the past—and the future—are lost forever?

data.name: Cave Of Treats
data.detailed_description:
Inside a haunted old arcade game, dig, find the doors, and trick-or-treat to collect as many candies as you can. Swap them for power-ups or use them to build defenses, but watch out for enemies… don't let them enter the doors or it's game over for you!

Let’s see how long you can survive! 🍬👻

But above all…

                           !!!how many points can you get in a single match!!!

Game description

Dig into your cave to discover hidden doors and go trick-or-treating. You will be able to exchange your candy for power-ups and more.

But beware of enemies: what could he want? Perhaps your sweets?
Repel them, barricade your cave and protect it at all costs, they must not enter


Just a quick warning if you decide to dig very deep into the cave:

Be careful not to fall from too high up!

   Otherwise…

 ...you might find your bones...           

...slightly mixed together...

Game mechanics

  • If enemies enter the cave or kill you, it's Game Over.

  • Not everyone is kind to those who ask for candy, especially old people who have turned off the light and gone to sleep.. Be careful.

  • Build defenses to block enemies.

  • Prepare to face a variety of enemies, each with their own abilities.

  • Halloween brings with it many mysteries, will you be able to find them?

is a realistic and authentic simulation of a ski resort with all its exciting technical facilities and vehicles. Experience the various everyday life of the ski resort manager!

Prepare the steepest slopes with originally licensed snowcats and operate various types of ropeways. Earn money and invest in new facilities to make your own ski resort the very best!



Thanks to the new multiplayer mode, you can finally grab your friends and enjoy the game together! Split the work and operate cable cars, prepare slopes and handle snow cannons. Or just join your friends’ vehicles on the passenger seat and throw a snowball!


Invite your friends to your map and operate the resort together in the multiplayer. Customize your character and vehicles to fit them better in your overall ski resort theme! To top it all off, the overall performance of the game has been improved. The enhanced, more realistic snow system and improved vehicle controls make the game experience even more exciting than before.

Multiplayer mode enjoy with friends and manage the daily challenges of the ski resort life!
Improved snow system with high resolution and more realistic snow behaviour
Increased overall performance
Detailed ropeways and vehicles, officially licensed by real-world manufacturers
Comprehensive Modding support
Dynamic environment system with changing weather










Operate various different ropeway types and master the challenges of ropeway operators. Learn more about the technical background of ropeways and take a closer look at the highly complex and detailed representation of technical processes of the cable cars. Interactive tutorials explain the handling and the processes in detail step by step. All ropeways have been created with the official license of .

Realistic recreation of different ropeways
Officially licensed by

Authentic Connect ropeway control system

Build your own ropeway in the world editor mode!
More ropeways available via modding or DLCs!


You can use different types of vehicles for your daily tasks in the ski resort. Snowcats, Snowmobiles and SUVs are waiting for you. Prepare the slopes with one of three snowcats. Enjoy riding a snowmobile and transport goods with the pickup. When the weather is not playing along, make use of the TR-10 snow cannon and produce fresh snow for your ski guests! All vehicles are designed with special attention to detail and provide an insight into the complex technology behind. data.name: Trench Run
data.detailed_description:
Trench Run is a 4-PLAYER local couch multiplayer game (with optional bots play and Steam Remote Play Together). It is easy to pick up and fun to play on gamepads. The price is low and in return for buying it you'll spend a hilarious couple of evenings blasting your friends. Enjoy!



Make friends, then blow them to bits!



Blow your enemies to bits in muddy trenches, then sip wine with them at the bar in the first multiplayer shooter with no death.



Listen to a relaxing feel-good gypsy jazz soundtrack as you watch your screaming enemies ride rockets and explode crashing into walls. Howl with laughter. Repeat.



Turn into a shrub. Have a dance off. Buy a pet crocodile.

See you at the bar!

Features:
  • Local couch-based multiplayer (or singleplayer with bots)
  • 5 classes with special skills to choose from (Assault, Sniper, Demolitions, Commando and Medic)
  • Semi-random destructible maps
  • Down on the ground? Grab a medikit and continue fighting!
  • Play basketball and meet new friends between rounds
  • Spend coins on drinks and cigarettes from the VIP bar
  • Buy customized costumes and pet animals
  • Online multiplayer available
  • Designed to be easy to pick up and play, but deep enough to play seriously

data.name: Puzzle Quest 3
data.detailed_description:
The original Match-3 RPG returns with an all-new adventure, bringing the classic combination of strategic puzzle battles with epic monsters, unique hero classes, and rich fantasy stories.

Explore mythical dungeons, uncover valuable loot, and unlock epic gear as you embark on a brand-new epic storyline to become the next Puzzle Quest legend!



Discover Evolved Puzzle Combat

Match gems in any direction to charge up your spells and unleash powerful attacks in action-packed 1-on-1 battles. A lot can happen in a single turn - planning ahead is the key to victory.



Embark on a Hero’s Journey

Choose the hero you want to be! Play as a Paladin, Berserker, Shaman, Assassin, Mercenary, Warlock, or Necromancer, and discover a variety of storylines as you level up, build your hero’s skills, and acquire new weapons, armor, and more!



PVP Action and Real-Time Multiplayer Coop

Battle fellow heroes in PVP and climb the leaderboards, or form an alliance with up to three friends and traverse the deepest dungeons together in real-time!




Signature Deep RPG Gameplay

Become the hero of your own making by gaining experience and loot from your quests. Select from hundreds of different weapons and armor to sharpen your combat skills and take on increasingly powerful foes.



Beautiful 3D Graphics

Experience fully animated battles with true 3D graphics never-before-seen in a match-3 game!


Epic Loot and Rewards

Defeat your enemies and complete quests to obtain valuable loot, then upgrade your gear and prepare for the next battle.

Regular Updates, Daily Quests, and Weekly Bounties

Stay tuned for regular updates and new events, including new quests to complete and bounties to claim.

data.name: Warhammer Quest (Classic)
data.detailed_description:
Based on the classic tabletop game, Warhammer Quest is an addictive mix of role-playing and strategy.

Lead your group of brave adventurers through the perilous dungeons of the Warhammer World in the search for wealth and glory!

Level up your party of heroes. Loot weapons, armour and mysterious artefacts from fallen enemies. Crush Orcs, Goblins, Trolls and more ferocious enemies!

What perils lurk in the darkness? Only the mightiest warriors will survive.

The standard edition includes 4 heroes, 3 game areas and a special Vampires and Zombies tileset & enemies pack. There are additional in game options to buy up to 7 more heroes, 5 extra weapons and a Skeletons & Necromancers enemy pack. The Warhammer Quest Deluxe pack includes all of these extras.

Warhammer Classics

Warhammer Classics is a collection of the greatest titles from the annals of Warhammer video game history, spanning the last 30 years, brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. 

Because of their classic nature, some of the content may not accurately reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the current Warhammer universes and settings

data.name: They Come In Boxes
data.detailed_description:
THEY COME IN BOXES

In the year 2084 an unknown cataclysm swept across the Earth leaving some cities in ruins and shrouding the atmosphere in a dense, toxic fog.

This event changed the world forever.

📦 YOUR JOB

Your task is simple:

  • Look at the boxes coming in.

  • Verify if the boxes are safe.

  • Input your choice.

  • Get the next box.

Remember: YOU ARE ALONE.

📦 THE PACKAGES ARE ALIVE

Every box is a risk. Use the console in front of you to look for the subtle signs of infestation. You have to decide if it's safe to ship or if it needs to be immediately eliminated.

📦 KEY MECHANICS

  • OBSERVE: Look for tell-tale signs on the boxes, along with the descriptions inside the dossier on your right.

  • MANAGE: Decide if you want to immediately check the next box or flip the server switch on as this decision could be your last one...

📦 KEEP THE POWER ON. PLEASE.

You can't just check boxes. Your server is unstable, and constantly crashing.

📦 FIGHT FOR SURVIVAL

  • CHAOS: Lights flicker, networks get out of order.

  • You must constantly tear your eyes away from the packages to run to the server panel and fix Networking, Switches and other failures...

Can you maintain your focus, keep the lights on, and survive your shift? Or will the job finally break you?

data.name: Sagger
data.detailed_description:
Sagger is a historical strategy simulator where you stand in the position of the commander-in-chief during the Yom Kippur War.
Your decisions will lead you to victory and glory of Israel or significant loss and nuclear catastrophe!!

In Sagger, you can decide and play the "WHAT IF.." game
No more guessing is needed!

Sagger is first a kind decision-making simulator based on historical facts, which allows you to check how a single decision would impact war results.

You will struggle with time, incomplete information from the battlefield, and a tremendous sense of responsibility for the country's future.

Will you prove to be a great leader like Golda Meir? Now it's your turn!!
Will you be able to make good decisions based on the knowledge you receive?

PROVE YOURSELF!!
Take the lead and command the Israeli army through the actual historical events of the Yom Kippur War in our interactive strategy simulator system.

Sagger allows you to walk trough historical path of Yom Kippur War, but test alternative decisions that were considered during the war.

It starts September 13th and goes through all battle decisions made during Yom Kippur War, and all "WHAT IF..." scenarios.
This simulator will show you how your decisions impact the war and diplomatic arena.


The exploration of Sagger's HUGE historical database will show you all the events from Yom Kippur War as well as other topics from 1973 such as cold war politics and oil as a weapon.


The knowledge database contains 5 categories that you can explore:
*People
*Military
*History
*Tactics
*Geopolitics


Report Database

While things change on the battlefield and in diplomacy, you will receive reports from generals on all fronts as well as other major world leaders such as Henry Kissinger

You will learn how to use acquired information and make good decisions based on it.

Due to Sagger's historical accuracy and its entertaining form, this is the best way to learn about the history of the Yom Kippur War.

You can check your progress with a detailed map of the Israeli military movements during the Yom Kippur War, based on actual staff maps!

• Unit movements are based on your decisions
After making a decision, the units follow your orders.
You will see the consequences of your leadership in real time.

Make Your own decisions and lead Israel to victory or defeat in the Yom Kippur War.

Our focus is on fun to play but also on historical accuracy. We strive for this game to faithfully present and follow the actual events, battles, politics and real historical characters. The game will let you make decisions the way actual Israeli high command had to make them.

It's BETA version

data.name: 2064: Read Only Memories
data.detailed_description:
2064: Read Only Memories is a cyberpunk point-and-click adventure set in the colorful future metropolis of Neo-San Francisco. Meet a huge cast of fascinating characters, solve a far-reaching mystery, and think carefully about your choices — you never know how they will affect this dynamic, branching narrative further down the line.

The world is changing.

Genetic alteration of humans is now commonplace, with many choosing to radically alter their bodies to express their individuality. Virtual intelligences called ROMs (Relationship and Organizational Managers), created as simple digital assistants, are exerting greater control over people's lives. Some are terrified by this rapid change, and they are willing to go to extreme lengths to prevent it.

A lost ROM named Turing breaks into the apartment of a struggling journalist to ask for help. They claim to be the first sapient machine — not a simulation of life but a genuinely self-aware artificial being — and the technical genius who created them has gone missing. Can you unravel the shocking conspiracy that threatens to rock an entire society? Or will the darkness that lies behind the bright neon lights of Neo-SF consume you?

  • Old-school, cutting-edge — Classic point-and-click adventuring inspired by the likes of Gabriel Knight and Snatcher is melded with modern branching storytelling that delves into identity, individuality, and what it means to be human.

  • People of the future - Get to know a diverse cross-section of Neo-SF's population, brought to life by some of the best voice talent working in games today, including Melissa Hutchison and Dave Fennoy (The Walking Dead), Erin Yvette (Oxenfree), Austin Creed (WWE's Xavier Woods), and SungWon Cho (ProZD).

  • High tech nostalgia — The city of Neo-San Francisco is rendered in beautiful pixel art, and your adventure is accompanied by a catchy lo-fi electronic synth soundtrack.

  • Solve the mystery — Over ten hours of adventure across exploration, dynamic branching conversations, multiple endings, and plenty of challenges to overcome.

  • The complete edition — Packed with years of improvements and additions including new characters and voice performers, additional facial animations, Japanese language support, and the "Endless Christmas" extended epilogue that lets you hang out with your favorite Neo-SF locals.

Note: Steam cloud saves currently only work on the same platform (i.e. Windows, Mac, etc.)

data.name: Berserkers
data.detailed_description:
TWO ROPES

Left hand and right hand, fired independently. Hold both and you are on a

pendulum; drop one and you are on an arc; drop the other and you are falling.

Reeling is a zip rather than a nudge, so the line pulls you straight to what

you hooked. Everything else in the game sits on top of that.

ONE AXE, AND THE HEART

A clean cut on the heart kills anything, whatever its size. The window is

small and the difficulty lives in reaching it, not in surviving long enough to

grind something down. Miss the heart and you land a body blow worth a third of

the creature; hacking works and takes three times as long.

BLESSINGS

More than sixty of them, drafted two at a time as a match runs. Every one is a

trade. Lose the ability to reel in and carry double the tank. Throw your shield

like a frisbee and give up the bubble that was keeping you alive. Shrink to a

third of your size and become genuinely hard to hit, including by the aim

assist. Nothing here is a permanent upgrade; the run ends and so does the

blessing.

THE MODES

Holmgang · one against one, first to five rounds, no shelter

Warbands · four a side, Aesir against Jotnar, five minutes

Gjallarhorn · carry the horn and score while you hold it. Everyone in the hall comes for you

The Hunt · up to four, holding a ward against endless waves

Bosses · Jormungandr under the frozen mere, and Fenrir on Lyngvi

Fridr · Alfheim, with nothing hunting you. Eighteen rings and a long way down

SEVEN REALMS

A black forest in Vanaheim. The inside of a mountain in Muspelheim. The rainbow

bridge over the void in Asgard, with the island and Odin's seat at the end of

it. A frozen mere in Niflheim. The bound wolf on Lyngvi. The holm in Midgard.

The long light of Alfheim, where nothing wants anything from you.

WHAT YOU EARN

Titles, ropes, winds, cloaks and crests. Twenty-four titles and forty-one

cosmetics, and not one of them makes you stronger. The rule has held since the

first line of the progression system: rewards are what you wear, never what you

hit with.

HONESTLY

This is my first game made from start to finish as a solo dev. I hope it's worth your time, but if reviews and feedback call for it, I'll continue putting time into the project to make it a game you want to play!
