data.name: Florence Mirror
data.detailed_description:
Florence Mirror is a dark fantasy Action RPG set in a modern-day Florence on the brink of collapse. Beneath its historic beauty lies a hidden mirror dimension, an ancient reflection where humanity’s sins and fears have taken monstrous form.

You play as Leonardo Tornabuoni, the last descendant of a forgotten noble bloodline sworn to protect the seal between worlds. As the barrier weakens and creatures begin to spill into reality, you must reclaim your family’s lost power, confront the echoes of history, and restore balance before both realms are consumed.

Engage in intense, skill-based combat against over 30 unique bosses, each representing twisted aspects of human nature and society. Explore a city where past and present intertwine, encountering legendary historical figures and uncovering a deep, lore-rich narrative inspired by real events and hidden histories.

Choose your path:

  • The Blessed Path – a more accessible, story-driven experience

  • The Cursed Path – a brutal Souls-like mode demanding precision, mastery, and resilience

Master arcane abilities, adapt your combat style, and survive in a world where every reflection could be a gateway to something far more dangerous.

  • Dark fantasy Action RPG with optional Souls-like difficulty

  • 30+ challenging bosses across main story, dungeons, and side missions

  • A unique setting blending modern Florence with a supernatural mirror dimension

  • Story-rich experience inspired by real historical figures and events

  • Deep combat system focused on timing, positioning, and skill

The mirror is breaking. What waits on the other side is already watching.

data.name: Fashioning Little Miss Lonesome
data.detailed_description:
When two handsome young men spot the perfect girl to be their first model and help make a name for themselves, they're determined to go for broke and make her shine—but first they'll have to get her out of her house! Can these two really give such an anti-social recluse the makeover she needs to be a star? Or will she be the one to change them in this off-beat romantic comedy?

Ema Tachibana is a tall, gloomy and unsociable girl with a bad case of resting bitch-face. With all that working against her, she's never really had any friends. At school, everyone's too scared to approach her.

But Ema herself is quite content with that state of affairs. In fact, she was all set to spend the rest of her time until graduation invisible as ever...

That is, until two men turned her life upside down!

"It's you... I've finally found you! You are, without a doubt, MY MUSE!"

Miki Hiraizumi—recently returned to Japan from abroad, he's loved making clothes ever since he was a little kid. He has a strong desire to help make charming, unusual women shine. (He's also a bit of a masochist.)

"Listen up, twerp! You're no good the way you are now. But even you have some potential to shine... I'll just have to polish you up!"

And Saito Shinjou—he frequently finds himself bored because things have always come easy to him. He aspires to accomplish something so big, it'll change the world. (He's also a bit of a sadist.)

These two ambitious and attractive fellows decide to give Ema Tachibana a makeover!

But Ema has other ideas.

"Yeah, well... Who asked you?!”

Ema Tachibana is a tall, gloomy and unsociable girl with a bad case of resting bitch-face. With all that working against her, she's never really had any friends. At school, everyone's too scared to approach her.

But Ema herself is quite content with that state of affairs. In fact, she was all set to spend the rest of her time until graduation invisible as ever...

That is, until two men turned her life upside down!

"It's you... I've finally found you! You are, without a doubt, MY MUSE!"

Miki Hiraizumi—recently returned to Japan from abroad, he's loved making clothes ever since he was a little kid. He has a strong desire to help make charming, unusual women shine. (He's also a bit of a masochist.)

"Listen up, twerp! You're no good the way you are now. But even you have some potential to shine... I'll just have to polish you up!"

And Saito Shinjou—he frequently finds himself bored because things have always come easy to him. He aspires to accomplish something so big, it'll change the world. (He's also a bit of a sadist.)

These two ambitious and attractive fellows decide to give Ema Tachibana a makeover!

But Ema has other ideas.

"Yeah, well... Who asked you?!”

data.name: EscapeVR: The Basement
data.detailed_description:
EscapeVR: The Basement is an 'Escape The Room' genre game which was inspired by real-life escape games and designed from the ground up as a room-scale virtual reality experience for the HTC Vive, Oculus Rift+Touch (360° setup), and Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) headsets.

Your Mission

You find yourself locked in the cell of an unknown basement with nothing else than a bed, a toilet, and some dishes. Can you escape? Explore the environment, solve puzzles, discover useful items, investigate clues, and find your way through a total of seven rooms in three areas to -hopefully- escape the basement of this VR escape room game!

A Gamer's Review

"… I loved this game. So far this is my favorite VR escape the room game. Easily forgot I was in my living room and found myself avoiding tables and items in the game as if they were real. It's short but sweet. For that reason do not look up any walkthroughs! Save the satisfaction for yourself!! …"

Features


  • Solve over a dozen puzzles, which includes smaller ones like finding keys or codes up to large ones which involve complex interactions with daunting machinery. Look, feel, and ambiance are based on corresponding real-life environments.
  • Explore three distinct areas with seven rooms, a total of 130 square meters, and more than 200 items to interact with. The game is designed for room scale and features a teleporting system similar to “The Lab”.
  • In case you get stuck, a built-in hint system provides you with clues. You’ll also get in-game statistics about your performance, and there are Steam achievements to unlock!

Will you take on the challenge?
Will you manage to escape the basement?

Requirements


  • You can play standing (teleport only) or room-scale (move and teleport).
  • You need to be able to reach up to 1.9m.
  • You need to be able to duck (headset below 1m).


Also available for VR Arcades via SpringboardVR.

data.name: Mage Arena
data.detailed_description:
Choose your side in an up to 4v4 voice controlled battle between the sorcerers and warlocks or challenge your rival to a 1v1 in the Mage Colosseum

Channel your voice to cast fireballs, shoot frostbolts, conjure wormholes, and fire arcane blasts to vanquish your foes by speaking the correct words.

For thousands of years sorcerers and warlocks have waged war for the title of supremacy in the arcane arts. Now, it is your turn to enter the fray.

Overseen by The Goblin Archmagus, this battle will take place inside of the Mage Arena. The Mage Arena is an ever changing island, filled with fantastical landscapes to explore.

Utilize the resources of the land to craft useful items to gain an edge over your opponents.

In order to claim victory, you must infiltrate your opponents base and capture their flag pole. Once captured the Goblin Archmagus will deem them unworthy of resurrection, meaning once you eliminate each member of the opposing team, victory is yours.

data.name: Ultimate Booster Experience
data.detailed_description:
Few words to community

We wanted to thank VR community and everyone who was buying our game for last few months for your support and interest!
We've made a long way in VR development to get here and are happy to bring Ultimate Booster and other our vr experiences to SteamVR!

Ultimate party starter, oculus top seller, the tits that separates the men from the boys — these are all your words. That's a wonderfull time to be a VR developer with such a greate public.

If you already have bought Ultimate Booster from TheRiftArcade or WearVR — just send us (hello@gex1.ru) your payment info to get a free key for Steam and Oculus Home.


About the Game


Take a ride on a huge 200m (600ft) swing with breathtaking views of a high-detailed city or try other height challenges. Big open city and various extreme adventures will take you on new fantastic height.



  • Giant Swing — That's gonna be a crazy ride with lots of twists, speedups and unexpected ending. Ride till the end or eject yourself at any time! If you are going to try it on your feet (we know you will) — it's better to have someone around you for more safety.
  • Bungee Jump — First VR Rope jump. As simple as that.
  • Rocket Mode — Grab your own Shuttle-Rocket and spend your time in our Open City location!
  • Air Balloon — Have a chill ride over modern megapolis. If it looks boring for you — just pull that lever and see what will happen!
  • Canyon Ride — Another swing ride location with stunning canyon atmosphere and a new ending.
  • Eagle Flight — Mighty bold eagle will take you to a journey through the vast canyon.
  • Atmosphere — Just standing on the balcony you can spend your time listening to city sounds, watching birds flying around and big city living it's life or feel magnificent canyon atmosphere.
  • Soundtrack — Awesome soundtrack is provided by Totemlost. Feel their energy while having fun.
  • Party Starter — Show this game to your friends and family to spend fun time together. It's ultimate party starter and reactions you'll see are priceless! New launch screen will allow you to control the ride from your PC.
  • Free updates — We are going to add minor and large features so you can try this experience again and again for more fun! See Updates section below for more info!



«The city looks good, cars look good… Everything looks so good! Really high-quality job and no lag at all» — VRViking

«Wow, check out the city! I love it! That feels greate! Awesome!» — GameHard 4.0

«This is probably one of the craziest rides released on the Oculus Rift. Virtual reality roller coasters are nothing compared to this!» — Omar Sebali



This game supports Vive controllers (showed in game), but you also can use your keyboard, X-Box 360 controller or Oculus remote.

  • Calibration: R\Enter or B button
  • Start game: Space or A button
  • Back to roof (full restart): M or Start
  • Exit: Esc or Back



Big Vive version update in January:

  • New height challenges: rocket and bungee mode.
  • Remastered graphics and updated sound and lights system.
  • Now you can eject yourself from the seat and go to free fall (just press Trigger or Space again).
  • Added menu and fast launch buttons to mirror screen — now you can easily control the game while your friends are playing.
  • Air Balloon Experience with a surprise.

Roadmap for next Updates:
  • Add some city sports challenges, like street basketball to spend your time.
  • New extreme rides.
  • Make a better city scene with realistic cars.
  • Make new screens for Steam Store page. Oh, I cry every time I visit it.

data.name: Divine Legacy: Neo Amburia
data.detailed_description:
Divine Legacy: Neo Amburia is a medieval-fantasy RPG where a young woman must save her childhood friend, who’s been pulled toward a dark fate.

With little more than determination, she'll battle powerful foes, form unexpected alliances, and uncover secrets that could reshape the world.

FEATURES

  • A New Story, A New Path
    Discover what happens when the villains win. This is the direct sequel to Divine Legacy, following the "bad end" of the original game and exploring how the world would have turned out if the antagonists succeeded.

  • Story-rich experience: While the focus is on gameplay, the narrative is woven into the experience. If you're all about action, you might find yourself skipping some dialogues—but the story’s there to enrich the journey.

  • Character-driven world: The world was crafted with the characters in mind, not the other way around. Their personalities and backstories are at the heart of the world’s design, making every corner feel connected to who they are.

  • Fast-Paced, Real-Time Combat
    Engage in high-octane, action-packed battles with a unique Bullet-Hell combat feel. Fight enemies with precision and speed as you dodge and weave through intense encounters.

  • Multiple Playable Characters
    Play as three distinct characters, each with a unique combat style. Choose the right one for the situation and swap them out on the fly for even more tactical options!

  • Crafting, Potions, and Time Management
    Master combat tool crafting, potion brewing, and time-based shopping. Strategy and preparation are key to surviving the hardest fights.

  • Element-Based Magic System
    Harness the power of elemental magic to dominate your enemies. Swap characters and use your arsenal of combat tools to exploit weaknesses for maximum damage.

  • Post-Story Content
    The adventure doesn’t end after the credits roll. Unlock additional content and challenges that keep the game fresh even after completing the main storyline.

  • Silly Easter Eggs & References
    Expect plenty of inside jokes and nods to games, movies, and pop culture. It's serious when it needs to be... and hilarious when it doesn't!

  • The Developer’s Journey
    Developed by One Person – Made with a lot of caffeine, some sleep deprivation, and a healthy dose of stubbornness. It’s a labor of love — raw, imperfect, but filled with passion. If you appreciate indie games that wear their heart on their sleeve, this one’s for you.

NOTES

  • You might need to disable Steam Input for controllers to work properly, or try another template.

data.name: Artifact Conquest
data.detailed_description:
Artifact Conquest is a deep and tactical turn-based strategy game set in a rich fantasy world teetering on the brink of chaos. An ancient artifact has resurfaced. Bestowing its wielder with tactical brilliance, it also corrupts the soul. Now, sinister forces seek to claim its power, and only you can stop them.

Assemble and lead a party of heroes, each of whom you can train and customize to suit your strategy. Explore vast lands, solve intricate puzzles to uncover hidden paths, and engage in strategic battles against monstrous foes. Visit shops and barter with merchants for rare gear, and forge alliances through dialogue with NPCs.

Master Tactical Combat

Engage in strategic battles where every decision matters. Wield a diverse arsenal of weapons, from enchanted swords and powerful bows to devastating magic. Customize your party’s abilities, exploit enemy weaknesses, and adapt your strategy to overcome ruthless foes and formidable bosses.

Leveling & Progression

Recruit allies to aid you on your journey and shape them into powerful warriors. As they grow, unlock new abilities and specialize them into distinct classes: Fighter, Archer, or Wizard, each with unique subclasses. Customize their skills or blend disciplines to create adaptable, hybrid combatants. Discover and equip stronger gear to push your party’s strength even further, preparing them for the challenges ahead.

Lore & Discovery

Unravel the history of the world by speaking with NPCs, uncovering ancient scrolls, and exploring forgotten ruins. Every conversation and relic holds a piece of the past. Stop by shops to trade for weapons, potions, and armor, or hear the latest rumors that may guide your journey.

Key features

  • Engage in deep tactical combat.

  • Unravel a rich world of lore.

  • Face formidable bosses.

  • Level and shape your party.

  • Shop system to upgrade your equipment.

UldreVoid is an action game with RPG elements created by a solo South African developer.

Explore the Kaldavsil Valleys and fight a legion of soldiers and monsters using various combat abilities while using powerful Void elements to upgrade your skills.

Set out alone in a chaotic world to discover what lies in the Void, a monumental orb-like energy growth that changes the world around it. Use your host of abilities and discover dark truths on the way while battling monsters and empires controlled by greed. Expand your skillset through practice and experience on the battle-field.

data.name: Autumn with the Shiba Inu
data.detailed_description:
Freelance hacker Quei-Li is given a new job: uncover information from the Allocated Reality Institute (ARI) about a high-profile corruption case. While she typically avoids high-risk jobs like this, her curiosity about the secret files and her wish to bring on positive change to Shiba Island convinces her to accept.

The job leads to Quei-Li bluffing her way into the ARI as an undercover programmer. She builds up a rapport with her coworkers while seeking the information her client needs. The more she digs around, the more secrets Quei-Li discovers, leading her to question her own existence.

Choose wisely - help Quei-Li navigate her undercover job. Will she succeed in retrieving the classified data?

Multiple endings - what seems like a good outcome might cause someone else to suffer. Your choices impact the endings!

Original character artwork - Alicia García Ochoa's dog illustrations make the inhabitants of Shiba Inu Island come to life.

Hacking mini-game - step into Quei-Li's role with a brain-twisting hacking mini-game! (The mini-game is completely optional)

Accessibility options - tune your experience and comfort while enjoying the game. Toggle between 4k resolution and full HD resolution.

Autumn with the Shiba Inu is set in the same universe as the first game in the Shiba Inu series, A Summer with the Shiba Inu. "Autumn" is a standalone story, so reading "Summer" is not required to enjoy Autumn with the Shiba Inu!

data.name: Abyssal Fall
data.detailed_description:
Hello there oh so terrible gladiator, and welcome to the ultimate tournament organised by the gods!

ABYSSAL FAAAaaall!...


*couch* sorry, you will have to fight in some of the most dangerous places in the world, battling against your peers on top of crumbling arenas in order to be the last one standing, be a champion and avoid being an abyssal fail!

Take control of 4 distinct heroes from across time and try to win the most incredible of prizes,
A full week-end in the outback of Australia with all costs covered... (*conditions may apply **only available to dead people)

Prepare to lose most of your remaining friends in a fast paced action game where every tile of the map will fall one second after you step on it,
Trap, bait & pressure your opponents in order to make them do a mistake and punish them with your special ability.


Abyssal fall is the first game made by a young and (very) tiny team of french developers mainly composed by students, so every bit of feedback is appreciated.
For the little story, this project was created in an GameWeek in IsartDigital School. Abyssal Fall won the " Best Gameplay Price " and the " Big Price of the Jury ".

The game contains :
  • Local or online multiplayer
  • 3 game modes (Classic, Deathmatch, Relic)
  • 3 maps with crumbling ground
  • 4 characters

After the release, we intend to evolve the game in a totally free way. We want to add a lot of things like:
  • Environment interactions (Storms, water geysers...)
  • New game modes (Zombie, Hardcore...)
  • New maps
  • New characters
  • And why not some bots too?

Do not hesitate to propose your ideas, we will see what we can put in place,
Share this game around and help us bring more content to this little adventure.

Thank you for your support :)

data.name: Legends of Hearts
data.detailed_description:
The Hook

Legends of Hearts (LOH) is a cooperative 2.5D platformer designed for two players. Step into the shoes of Delmo and Dala—two unlikely legends on a mission to restore harmony to the mystical Candy Valley. The villain Sharshoor has stolen the land's emotions, trapping them in his Cage of Despair. Only by working together can you purify the darkness and ring the bell to bring love back to the world.

True Co-op Gameplay

Every level is built around true cooperation. You cannot play alone. Push boxes together, swing across crocodile-infested ponds, solve intricate puzzles, and convert corrupted emotions into light. Each character has unique abilities: Delmo purifies with his Love Bow, while Dala freezes enemies with her Flower Bazooka. Teamwork is not optional—it's the only way forward.

Unlock the Adventure

Explore vibrant, hand-crafted 2.5D worlds filled with secrets, traps, and challenges. Collect heart tokens to upgrade your weapons and unlock exclusive skins. Share your victories with friends and family by sending digital gifts directly through social media—no wallets, no complexity, just pure celebration.

Family-Friendly

Legends of Hearts is designed for players of all ages. The weapon system is built for conversion, not combat—turn dark emotions into light, monsters into cute creatures. Solve family-friendly co-op puzzles in a fantasy world full of charming environments and heartwarming interactions. Wholesome fun for families and friends.

Key Features

-True Co-op Gameplay: Designed exclusively for two players.

-Unique Dual Heroes: Delmo (purification) and Dala (freezing).

-Vibrant 2.5D Worlds: Beautifully crafted levels with secrets to uncover.

-Non-Violent Weapons: Convert corrupted emotions—no violence, no gore.

-Social Gifting: Send digital gifts to loved ones via social media.

-Family-Friendly Fun: Safe for all ages.

Solve family-friendly co-op puzzles in a fantasy world full of charming environments and heartwarming interactions. Wholesome fun for families and friends.

Key Features

-True Co-op Gameplay: Designed exclusively for two players.

-Unique Dual Heroes: Delmo (purification) and Dala (freezing).

-Vibrant 2.5D Worlds: Beautifully crafted levels with secrets to uncover.

-Non-Violent Weapons: Convert corrupted emotions—no violence, no gore.

-Social Gifting: Send digital gifts to loved ones via social media.

-Family-Friendly Fun: Safe for all ages.

data.name: Touhou Iyuushou ~ What the Bullet Hell?!
data.detailed_description:
Touhou Iyuushou ~ What the Bullet Hell?! is a Touhou Project fan-made bullet hell game that pays homage to Impossible Spell Card. It features a collection of short, self-contained danmaku stages—each one a standalone, visually striking bullet pattern designed to challenge your reflexes and puzzle-solving skills.

"Iyuushou" means "Testimony of Strange Encounters".

You play as Marisa Kirisame, reimagined as a danmaku researcher, investigating mysterious spell cards appearing across Gensokyo. Armed with a variety of tools, you'll analyze, survive, and outwit increasingly bizarre bullet patterns!

🧪 Core Features

🔸 Danmaku Challenge Collection
A large set of short, carefully crafted stages. Each stage is an individual bullet hell "exhibit", offering unique gameplay, aesthetics, and logic to decipher.

🔸 Strategic Item System
Bring helpful items into battle to turn the tide—but be warned, using them affects your final reward! Go in raw for greater glory.

🔸 Multiple Difficulty Levels & Challenge Styles
Tackle each stage at Easy / Normal / Hard / Lunatic difficulty. Want to prove your skill? Try clearing stages without items for maximum bragging rights!

🔸 Stamp Collection System
Clearing a stage earns you collectible stamps. Higher difficulties award more stamps, and clearing a stage without items earns you a rare, shining Gold Stamp!

🔸 Scene EX: Long-form challenges included!

Each game day features a "Scene EX", where all bosses of that day appear in succession, taking turns unleashing their bullet patterns. This provides players who enjoy longer gameplay sessions with a more complete and intense danmaku rhythm experience.

🔸 DIY Mode: Create Your Own Challenge Runs
Use levels as "cards" to freely combine and arrange them, building your own long-form bullet hell challenges. Save and share presets, and compete with friends for high points!

🔸 Daily Challenge: Fresh Danmaku Combos Every Day!
The game randomly selects different bosses to appear together each day, creating unprecedented mixed battles. Every day brings a brand-new experience!

🎯 Game Identity & Style

  • A Touhou Project fan game made with love for danmaku and its creative potential

  • Inspired by Impossible Spell Card, but expands with more solutions and player freedom

  • Light on story, heavy on gameplay—perfect for pick-up-and-play or long challenge runs

  • Catering to both quick-stage runs and marathon STG experiences

    Functions both as a "danmaku art gallery" and a technical proving ground for STG fans

⚠️ Warning: This game contains flashing lights and rapid patterns that may trigger seizures in players with photosensitive epilepsy.

data.name: O.U.T.T.
data.detailed_description:
Sao Paulo, 22nd century, technology has merged with concepts that would be considered magic in our time. This breakthrough could greatly increase quality of life and the lifespan of the population. However, after starting the human trials a few people starting developing strange and severe side effects from an unknown source that can even be responsible for their deaths. Is there someone behind it? What is their agenda? Will you be able to uncover what is behind this? Can you stop it?

O.U.T.T. is a 3D turn-based puzzle-adventure game with a deep narrative, multiple endings, challenging puzzles with a retro futuristic cyber soulpunk aesthetic in a pre-dystopic future.

Beware the enemies

Defeat or escape several enemies with different behaviors including extra planar entities.

Challenging puzzles

Use lever, buttons, light emitters, mirrors and sensor, and even hack computers with a 3D tetris-like game to get your way around the levels.

Deep narrative with multiple endings

All interactions are meaningful and can change a future outcome in the game that unfolds each level and on the comic-style cutscenes. 

Key features:

  • Multilayered puzzle for challenging yet fair levels;,

  • Rich narrative with multiple endings;,

  • Several kinds of enemies, including extra planar entities;,

  • Highlight mode to help the player understand the puzzle easier that que be tuned on and off with one button.,

  • Play at your own pace.

data.name: Aurora Heights
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a journey with Hoshi, a fallen star determined to ascend back to the heavens. Aurora Heights is a precision platformer that will test your skills as you jump, climb, and dash through intricate and mysterious landscapes where other stars have failed. Unlock new movement abilities, collect keys, discover secrets, and explore a world filled with wonders and challenges.

Game Features

  • Ascend the Challenging Aurora Heights - Guide Hoshi through increasingly difficult terrains— the higher you climb, the tougher it gets

  • Master new skills to reach new heights and hidden areas.

  • Assist Fellow Fallen Stars - Meet other stars along your journey. Help them, and they might return the favor, unlocking new paths and secrets.

  • Explore and Collect - Find keys to unlock new regions and advance further up Aurora Heights.

  • Pure Platforming Experience - No combat—focus entirely on exploration and precision platforming.

  • Embrace the Journey, Even in Setbacks - Don't fear falling; it might lead you to undiscovered areas and intriguing characters.

  • Unveil the Mystery - Try to discover why other stars couldn't reach the summit of Aurora Heights.

data.name: Ultimate Dream
data.detailed_description:
Ultimate Dream is a combination of a realistic tactical FPS with adventure and exploration elements in a psychological and psychedelic world. Intense gunfights meet with a heavenly realm the player hopes to return while he is bound to a bleak social security supported reality in our mundane world.

DEMO IS OUT NOW!

  • Realistic tactical shooter combined with psychedelic and psychologic plot development. Solve light puzzles, explore a strange realm higher than ours and converse with its strange fellow enlightened beings and blast your way through various deadly encounters. Will you eventually compherend the nature of reality?

  • The combat of UT emphasises the hectic nature of firefights. One hit can kill and will at least limit the player’s abilities depending on the point of impact. The player fights against lowlives, out-of-their-mind cultists and rifle wielding island tribals but as the game progresses, the enemies become increasingly ferocious and technological.

  • In between the realms. There are sections in the bleak mundane reality of ours. In this mortal and destitute realm, the player is an unemployed man, reliant on social security, who has learned of the existence of a higher plane than ours and thus found a greater purpose to his life.

  • A great variety of levels with vastly different environments, scale and gameplay approaches. Levels vary from a wasteland to large free to roam verdant jungle island, a dubious warehouse, an eerie neon-lit mall to a realm of nightmares. Some levels require exploring, others call for close combat prowess that favors tactical approach.

  • The player has a varied arsenal, special abilities and technologies including remote controllable sniper rifle, holo-mines, various grenades, a radar and combat meditation ability. The levels themselves feature environmental variables the player can use against the enemies.

  • More fun. The game features an unlockable hardcore campaign and special game modes.

May the power of love and justice protect you!

data.name: NEX EVO
data.detailed_description:
The city is changing. So are you.

A rain-soaked megacity stopped mid-construction. An alien infection called the Pulse spreading through concrete and steel. And you.

Momentum-Based Traversal

Chain wall-runs, slides, and climbs across towering megastructures. Anchor your grapple to swinging infrastructure, coil it around rotating machinery, and sling yourself across the skyline at speeds the city wasn't built to handle. Velocity is your greatest weapon — lose it and the city wins.

No Safety Net. No Dead Ends.

Misjudge a leap from a skyscraper? You fall into the hazard-filled lower districts — not a dead end. Every mistake opens a new route. Claw your way back up through shortcuts, transit stations, and unlocked infrastructure. The city punishes hesitation, not failure.

Two Forms. Two Philosophies.

The Pulse didn't just infect you — it gave you a choice. Human form offers precision, agility, and full vertical mobility across the city's towering architecture. Monster form trades finesse for raw power — faster, harder hitting, but grounded. Master both or favor one at a cost.

A City That Remembers

Events leave marks. Factions shift. The Pulse spreads into new districts. Every action you take shapes what the city becomes — and who you encounter inside it. Trust your instincts about the people you meet. Not everyone offering guidance has your survival in mind.

There is something else. You'll find it yourself.

data.name: Russian Subway Dogs
data.detailed_description:
Welcome, comrades! Meet Russian Subway Dogs! We have done extensive, totally legal research in order to fine tune this chaotic arcade-simulation for what it's like to scavenge for food from Russian commuters. Surviving isn't easy when you are dodging volatile vodka, rival dogs, and the rare and dangerous Subway Bear!

  • A new game from the creators of They Bleed Pixels.
  • Inspired by real life stray dogs who’ve learned to navigate Moscow’s subway system!
  • Take on Campaign Mode with dozens of levels and over 100 unique challenges from your boss kitty: The Proletaricat.
  • Highly replayable Endless Mode with online leaderboards and a score-driven difficulty algorithm that keeps each round fresh!
  • Featuring detailed pixel art of Moscow’s world famous, ornately decorated subway stations.
  • Play as your favourite animals from other indie games and comics (full list below!)
  • From fire and ice to toxic chocolate and cooking wildlife for food, Russian Subway Dogs is full of simulated systems to discover and exploit!
  • Original Soundtrack by Peter Chapman aka COINS (Guacamelee!, LittleBigPlanet Karting, Modnation Racers)



Whether you’re a dog person or more of the feline persuasion, Russian Subway Dogs has you covered. Play as a range of unlockable critters with a whole pack of special guests including:

  • Question Hound from KC Green's Gunshow
  • Fidel from Fidel Dungeon Rescue
  • Nacho & Rad Shiba from VA-11 HALL-A
  • Ratcoon from Ruin of the Reckless
  • Uay Chivo from Guacamelee!
  • Nidhogg from Nidhogg 2
  • They Bleed Pixels inspired Clawed Kitty!



Simple enough for a puppy to pick up, but still packed with challenge! Run and jump along subway platforms. Bark behind people to scare up food and bounce vodka around the stage. Soon you’ll be discovering high-level strategies, such as cooking and eating rival wildlife with vodka explosions.




Travel the Moscow subway in Campaign Mode! Survive and thrive through dozens of levels and over 100 unique challenges from your feline leader, the Proletaricat and the mischievous Kittens!

Can you finish the level with a vegetarian diet? While protecting a bear? What about preventing the pigeons from cannibalizing each other? Complete enough levels and challenges and you'll discover the secret station at the end of the line!

Feeling competitive? Climb the online leaderboards in Endless Mode. Random Proletaricat mini-challenges and our special score driven difficulty algorithm keep each play through fresh!




From fire and ice, to cooking food and toxic chocolate, Russian Subway Dogs is full of simulated systems, allowing lots of freedom in how you earn points and deal with rival wildlife.

Will you eat the tasty but toxic chocolate for major points, or feed it to that pesky poodle that keeps stealing your shawarma? Drink hot sauce to gain powerful fire barks or feed it to a pigeon for some fire pooping air support?

In Russian Subway Dogs it’s up to you to use your knowledge and abilities to stuff your stomach and inflict as much mayhem as possible!




Musician Peter Chapman (Guacamelee!, LittleBigPlanet Karting, Modnation Racers) has created a banging original soundtrack packed with Slavic sounds and Baltic beats combined with electronic dance music.

data.name: Faunamorph
data.detailed_description:
Unleash your Animal Instincts!!!

Faunamorph is a 2D metroidvania set in an abandoned underground lab, where you can recombine your own DNA to transform parts of your body into animals limbs. Use the brute strength of a rhino’s horn to break walls, glide over pits with bird wings, and dig tunnels on the ground with mole claws to travel through the laboratory and uncover it’s dark secrets.

Shape-Shifting Mastery

Harness the power of animal genetics as you transform your body into incredible animal forms, acquiring new abilities to overcome obstacles and uncover the truth.

Change your DNA

Adapt on the fly by equipping and swapping abilities, strategically selecting your arsenal of animal powers to suit each challenge and unlock new paths.

Uncover your Origins

Embark on an immersive journey through the dark corridors and hidden chambers of the abandoned lab, piecing together the puzzle of Project H.A.G.E.N's mysterious experiments and your own forgotten past.

  • Master your Helix Space by recombining your DNA, switching out your animal abilities on the fly for different combat and exploration scenarios.

  • Transform your body with unique animal abilities, from rolling like an armadillo to swimming like a dolphin, each tailored to overcome new challenges and explore deeper into the lab.

  • Face off against twisted hulking hybrids, failed experiments and self-defense systems, while testing your skills and powers in creative, intense encounters.

  • Discover lore-rich data logs scattered throughout the abandoned lab, revealing the purpose of Project H.A.G.E.N. and the origins of the terrifying hybrid creatures.

  • Enjoy a dynamic soundtrack that adapts to your journey, with moods shifting from intense combat to ominous exploration and frenetic survival in near-death moments.

  • Unlock a sprawling, interconnected world with rooms to discover and hidden upgrades, adding replayability as you uncover every corner of the lab.

data.name: Call Center Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
Every action costs you time (a turn). You make the decision, do you hire more workers?

  • Each worker will have traits that can either complement or clash with others.

  • Employees will also form friendships that can lead to something more. Or maybe they'll just hate each other's guts?

  • Each interaction affects their stress levels. Higher the stress the less productive they are.

How about firing the underperforming employee?

  • People will react to firings too, sometimes it can be the catalyst to make a profit

  • But firing a beloved employee can have negative consequences

Or maybe tell your top performer to take a break before they have a breakdown?

Or try to poach a new customer from one of your competitors

The key is in balancing your actions to get the best out of your employees, fail here and everything will fall apart

data.name: BEWBEWBEW
data.detailed_description:
BEWBEWBEW is a lovingly crafted, unique, and colorful action-arcade game!

  • Completely original fighting system! Charge spawns before releasing them in one big wave. Fights are all about optimizing your move usage to hit as many spawns as possible.

  • A ton of playable characters and abilities! 50+ characters, each with their own set of abilities from a pool of 150+ unique moves of different types, elements, and usage. No two characters play the exact same!

  • Partake in intense 1-vs-1 and whole party fights! Each side can have up to 3 party members. Hectically switching between your party members to burn through all your Energy and cooldowns is key!

  • Hand-drawn graphics! Nearly every sprite and background in this game was drawn on paper first before being digitally colored, all done to make the art pop out.

  • Combine different attacks for devastating effects! Set embers ablaze to start a fire! Place down a lightning rod before using a shock attack to do massive damage! Plant seeds and grow spiky roses!

  • Play through 70+ fun levels, including a challenging Adventure mode! Some levels have unique twists and conditions. Be ready for anything!

  • Endless Classic mode! Unlock characters and play through an endless gauntlet of levels as your power up your party!

data.name: Geminum
data.detailed_description:
The sun is fading. Earth is freezing. Humanity must choose: remain in deep underground ANCHORS for generations… or escape into the unknown-MINMEI planet.

In Geminum, a sci-fi narrative anthology, players explore the consequences of survival, memory, and sacrifice in a dying solar system. Each chapter is a standalone interactive story, lasting 30–45 minutes, with branching choices, immersive dialogue, and emotionally charged moments.

🌍 Two paths of humanity

  • HOME: Shelter underground, wait for salvation.

  • AWAY: Sleep in cryostasis, awaken to the burden of colonizing distant stars.
    Both are valid. Neither is easy.

🚀 Key Features

  • Self-contained, replayable episodes with deep emotional storytelling

  • Sci-fi worldbuilding rooted in existential choice and sacrifice

  • Minimalist gameplay – no puzzles, just decisions that matter

  • Multiple timelines allow players to revisit what they missed

  • Optional side stories, flashbacks, and player co-creation

“To reach the far shore, we must first build a solid bridge.”

Geminum is a quiet epic. A journey not of action, but of introspection—where your legacy is written not in victory, but in what you choose to preserve.

data.name: Corner Shop: NightShift
data.detailed_description:
Corner Shop: Nightshift is a first-person narrative horror sim set in a failing convenience store.
You play as Adam Callahan, trying to put your life back together.

  • Story Mode: ~15 hours at an average pace, with 4 endings based on player choices.

  • Endless Mode: Infinite gameplay focused on growing and managing the store, with ongoing horror elements.

  • Streamer Mode: Twitch integration where viewers can trigger actions on the map, including customers and horror events.

A night shift and a broken life. Blackouts, alarms, and unsettling customers pull you into a puzzle you can’t escape. Find the truth, manage your stress, and don’t let paranoia win. Take your meds. Keep going.

Stock shelves, clean up, take deliveries, scan items, and serve customers with snacks, sandwiches, and kebabs. Upgrade the store with cameras, alarms, and stronger locks. Manage your time, your money, and your sanity. Meds don’t pay for themselves.

You play as Adam Callahan. His wife is gone, his daughter was taken, and his life is falling apart. He works the night shift to prove he can start over, but the store keeps dragging his past back to the surface, out of order and out of his control. Your choices shape what you uncover and which ending you reach.

data.name: Mischkalon
data.detailed_description:
One god, one tribe, ten thousand years

Mischkalon is a city builder in which you are not a mayor but a god. Your settlers are real people: they fell trees, gather berries, carry every stone to the building site themselves, have children and grow old. When they are well, they believe in you – and their faith is your power.

From the Old Stone Age to the castle

  • Nine eras from 10,000 BC to the High Middle Ages – from fire through bronze and iron to cathedral and castle

  • More than 90 discoveries in eight research branches that build on each other

  • Fields, gardens, orchards and vineyards; sheep, goats, pigs, cows and horses

  • Long production chains: from grain via the mill to bread, from ore via the smelter to the sword

  • Health, contentment and faith – shoes, books and bathhouses make your people stronger

  • Wonders that only a city can build

  • Land in three dimensions: hills, flowing rivers, reeds along the shore and forest to the horizon – the camera turns and tilts

Divine powers

Bless your settlement, make rain fall, heal the wounded, call game animals or hurl lightning at your enemies – eight powers, paid for with the faith of your people.

Raiders, tribes and sieges

Foreign tribes live around your valley. Give them gifts, pay peace money – or clear their camps. Raiders roam the map, guards stand up to them, walls, towers and gates hold them back, and later catapults roll against fortifications.

Battle

Lead your troops yourself: stances, fixed squads on the number keys, formations with spears in front and bows behind. Against warriors, archers and shield bearers the morale of both sides decides – lose too many and a side flees. Siege ladders go up against the wall, fire arrows set gates alight, defenders push the ladders over. Pause and slow motion let you give orders in peace.

A campaign across 27 regions

Cartography opens the region map – a relief landscape with mountains, forests and sea. Free province after province from foreign peoples, lead several armies with waypoints, keep them supplied or let them plunder. You can also talk to the other peoples: peace, alliance, trade, tribute and gifts – each one remembers where it stands with you. Three difficulty levels.

Multiplayer

Play together on the same region map – over the network or through a Steam lobby with invitations. Armies march against the other players' provinces, and whoever conquers a province takes over the opponent's actual town.

Easy to get into

A tutorial in five chapters guides you through your first game. All graphics and the music are created by the game itself. In English and German.

Bless your settlement, make rain fall, heal the wounded, call game animals or hurl lightning at your enemies – eight powers, paid for with the faith of your people.

Raiders, tribes and sieges

Foreign tribes live around your valley. Give them gifts, pay peace money – or clear their camps. Raiders roam the map, guards stand up to them, walls, towers and gates hold them back, and later catapults roll against fortifications.

Battle

Lead your troops yourself: stances, fixed squads on the number keys, formations with spears in front and bows behind. Against warriors, archers and shield bearers the morale of both sides decides – lose too many and a side flees. Siege ladders go up against the wall, fire arrows set gates alight, defenders push the ladders over. Pause and slow motion let you give orders in peace.

A campaign across 27 regions

Cartography opens the region map – a relief landscape with mountains, forests and sea. Free province after province from foreign peoples, lead several armies with waypoints, keep them supplied or let them plunder. You can also talk to the other peoples: peace, alliance, trade, tribute and gifts – each one remembers where it stands with you. Three difficulty levels.

Multiplayer

Play together on the same region map – over the network or through a Steam lobby with invitations. Armies march against the other players' provinces, and whoever conquers a province takes over the opponent's actual town.

Easy to get into

A tutorial in five chapters guides you through your first game. All graphics and the music are created by the game itself. In English and German.
data.short_description: You are the god of a small tribe. Lead your settlers from the Old Stone Age to the High Middle Ages: they gather, carry and build on their own - you provide food, faith and protection from raiders. Free 27 regions on your own or compete against friends.

data.name: Fable Hospital
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Fable Hospital! Enter a world of hospital management like you've never seen before. In this hilarious and satirical medieval simulation, you'll run your own hospital filled with eccentric characters, implausible diseases, and unique challenges.




Manage your medieval hospital and ensure it runs like a well-oiled machine, or at least well enough for patients to survive… most of the time.




Recruit and manage a cast of colorful characters, from the sinister Plague Doctor to the absent-minded Mad Engineer. Each employee has their own set of skills and... quirks.




Treat patients with diseases that defy all logic, from "Lycanthropy" to "Unicorn Syndrome." Each diagnosis is more absurd than the last!




Step outside the hospital and venture into the countryside to gather herbs, minerals, and other essential resources. Your hospital won't stock itself!




Use alchemy and magic to research new cures and technologies. Unlock upgrades that make your hospital more efficient and hopefully less prone to fires.




Enjoy dialogues and situations filled with satirical humor. From employees who prefer to have a beer instead of working, to nuns who secretly adore parties, every moment is full of laughs.




With detailed graphics and an art style that captures the essence of the medieval era, Fable Hospital is a visual delight that complements its clever gameplay.




In Fable Hospital, each day brings new challenges and surprises. Can you manage the chaos of a medieval hospital and keep your patients alive? Or will you find yourself caught in a sea of laughs and disasters?

data.name: DUALITY
data.detailed_description:
A fractured memory. A mysterious weapon. A strange land. Join a young warrior on an epic journey to recover what he’s lost—and find himself.

DUALITY is a 2.5D Action RPG that blends intense, skill-based combat with a rich story set in a high-fantasy world. Players engage in thrilling battles and unravel deep, intricate mysteries in the role of an amnesiac warrior searching for meaning and self-understanding. The game challenges players’ perceptions and skills in a realm filled with nuanced characters, deadly adversaries, and unforgettable adventures, while it explores the nature of good and evil.

Gameplay
Challenging, skill-based combat — Real-time, action-oriented combat that rewards strategy and precision. DUALITY’s combat emphasizes deliberation and finesse through intricate interactions, elemental damage, and more, enabling precise, engaging tactics for each unique encounter.
Focused, story-driven campaign — A tightly focused campaign with no filler side quests. Events and progression happen in a streamlined, integrated way driven by the main storyline.
Puzzles and trials — Encounter environmental puzzles, cryptic trials, and other interesting challenges.
Meaningful character builds — No traditional gear, skill trees, or leveling. Instead, you shape your build by equipping Styggens, Vestas, their cores, and consumables. Each choice tangibly changes your abilities and actions—altering movement, ability behavior, and other combat options—so every change is felt rather than granting small stat boosts.
Progression without levels or repetitive gameplay — Progression comes from overcoming combat challenges, solving puzzles, and advancing the story. Playable characters acquire new abilities and magic through in-game events and gameplay experiences rather than leveling up and earning points.
Exploration and discovery — Hidden areas and secrets to uncover across diverse environments including deserts, caves, forests, ancient ruins and much more.

Story
Ren, a young warrior, sets out on a quest for self-discovery in a world torn between light and dark forces. Along the way, he encounters allies and enemies, uncovering secrets that challenge his beliefs about himself, life, and good versus evil.

Players guide Ren through a realm filled with diverse civilizations, elemental magic, and moral dilemmas. The game explores themes of duality and enlightenment, the struggles and gray moral area one must navigate to survive.

World
The gods ruling over the universe of Cora observe a fragile peace while they constantly experiment with their creations. As rivalries emerge, the mortal inhabitants within Cora endure—but also enjoy—the consequences. The gods curse them with monstrous beings and moral ambiguity, while blessing the mortals with magic, specifically the ability to manipulate the elements. This all leads to a universe in flux, one a young warrior must explore and master to survive.
The world of Cora is in constant battle between what its inhabitants call good and evil.

data.name: Beyond Your Wall
data.detailed_description:
Beyond Your Wall is a meditative wall-breaking experience where you tap through emotional blocks and reveal short quotes of insight, clarity, and strength.

With each tap, you crack the surface of the wall and a little more of yourself. Whether you’re feeling happy, gloomy, angry, or just curious, the game responds to your mood with a personalized moment of reflection.

Watch the wall crumble and let powerful words shine through.

Capture your favorite breakthrough messages with the in-game camera feature and return to them anytime.

No scores, no stress—just a few mindful minutes to breathe, reset, and feel a little more whole.

Key Features

  • Choose your mood and break your wall with purpose.

  • Tap to release tension and feel the wall give way.

  • Get inspired by encouraging and original quotes.

  • Save your favorites with one tap.

  • Designed to soothe with clean visuals and calming sound.

Break the wall. Feel lighter. Break the wall. Discover what’s behind it.

This is your space to pause, reflect, and become.

Sometimes a small crack is all you need to move forward.

data.name: Blocks;
data.detailed_description:
Blocks; is a game that i made upon the foundation of every late 70's / early 80's arcade cabinets logic and style that we all loved. When i thought about Blocks; as a concept i decided to build it with only one purpose in mind..

A not so chill game that everyone would play solely as a "timekiller" or a hardcore HIGHSCORE marathon.

It's up to you to decide..

Blocks; is a 2D, Obstacle avoidance game that contains some Tools (Power Ups) to achieve the best HighScore and compete against yourself in each run (!! - Global Scoreboard not included - !!).

Your Tools (PowerUps) to Victory consists of:

  • Speed (Avoid blocks in the speed of light with ease)

  • Invisibility (Take a break, chill for a while and let the blocks pass right through you)

  • Slow-Motion (Inspired by a famous film, be the one that is one step ahead of gravity and momentum itself)

Power Ups fall in random sequence and without a patern except the first drops so every run is not the same.

Also beware the Power-0-Meter cause it can't hold the Power Ups quantum energy for too long so make every minute count.

data.name: Bore Bore
data.detailed_description:
Dig deeper and deeper into a living, hostile underground world.

Manage oxygen, water, and food while building giant driller vehicles.

Automate entire bases and survive creatures fighting each other in the dark.

LIVING UNDERGROUND

The underground reacts to everything.

Creatures hunt each other.

Fire keeps predators away.

The darkness gets more intense the deeper you dig.

Every expedition is a constant struggle for resources and survival.

CREATE MACHINES, DIG!

Build your own driller vehicle block by block.

Turn scrap into mobile fortresses capable of traversing entire caves.

Add: Drills, Doors, Flashlights, Cameras, Automated systems, Defenses...

Everything can grow without limits.

AUTOMATE EVERYTHING

Use the "Bang" circuit system to create: Automatic doors, Sensors, Traps, Elevators, Conveyor belts, Industrial systems, Smart defenses...

Build fully automated underground bases.

Grow underground potatoes, purify caves using living fungi and expand your survival deeper and deeper.

TAME THE CRITTERS

Tame any creature in the world, feed them what they like a few times and they will follow you.

Have scorpions or any other critter defend you.

Or even an aggressive and powerful caecilian!

FIND YOUR WEALTH

Fresh air and water are limited.

Without them, you die.

But the deeper you go… the more valuable — and dangerous — the resources become.

EVOLVE YOUR EQUIPMENT

Evolve: Helmets, Weapons, Drills, Tools, Doors, Explosives, Circuits...

From makeshift scrap to advanced diamond technology.

EXPLORE. CREATE. SURVIVE.

Bore Bore blends: Survival, Mining, Automation, Sandbox Building, and a Dynamic Ecosystem.

Everything connected in a single living underground world.

ADD TO WISHLIST

data.name: Barbarians: The Free Tribes
data.detailed_description:
No more civilization!

Tired of your goody hut getting raided? Sick of so-called "civilizations" showing up and settling on your land? Now you can fight back! Lead a small band of warriors through a warm, mischievous strategy adventure that combines real-time tactics with paused command planning, stealthy raids and a seasonal campaign map.

Small band. Big ideas.

Watch patrols, slip through cover and creep directly behind a guard for a quiet knockout. Hide sleeping guards, recover supplies and get your people home. When subtlety takes the afternoon off, pause the action, give orders and face the alarm together.

Five stories of standing together

Play 31 chapters across five independent campaigns facing Rome, China, Spain, Greece and England. Meet stubborn companions, outwit pompous foes and make choices your tribe remembers. Each story keeps its own progress.

Make a home worth coming back to

Choose your tribe’s name, colours and wolf, bear, raven, boar or stag totem. Build a longhouse, smithy and shrine, forge weapons and train your warriors. Your camp grows alongside your people.

Let the seasons change your plans

Spring blossoms, autumn leaves and winter snow bring a living frontier to life. Rain muffles footsteps, guards follow tracks in snow, and frozen rivers open new routes. Weather is more than scenery.

Keep the adventures coming

Explore a free campaign, quick raids, camp defence, daily challenges and the five-raid Five Winds journey. Try a gentler wolf-cub adventure, or create your own raids with the included map editor.

  • Single-player adventures with local saves and offline play.

  • Adjustable difficulty, tactical pause, interface scaling and reduced-motion options.

  • Interface and dialogue translated into 17 languages.

  • Distinctive, soft muffled character hums, with dialogue shown as text.

9th Dawn III: Shadow of Erthil is a huge 2D open world RPG and collectathon dungeon crawler packed full of adventure! When asked to investigate mysterious, ghostly sightings around the lake of Elmson, you trek through the lands of Cedaltia to uncover the truth. Upon arrival, you catch rumors of an untrustworthy king and become the chosen one to journey to Lorwyck Castle and confront him – a journey that will guide you through ancient fortresses, dark dungeons, perilous swamps, and more!

Soon, you find yourself at the heart of a foreboding prophecy. Equip your best gear and experience a journey across the fields of Ashwick, the snowy regions of Halstom, dense forests of Vlak, the sprawling depths of huge dungeons, and the perilous Hollow Mountains of Scorn on an epic quest to uncover the secrets of a mysterious evil force that threatens the lands.

Can you become the savior of Cadaltia?

Key Features:

  • Explore a huge, seamless open world full of crypts, fortresses, villages, and more.

  • Find your way across deadly dungeons, fight over 270 unique monsters, and acquire loot, treasures, and rare materials.

  • Become the ultimate warrior as you unlock spells and abilities, fine-tune your attributes, and level-up your crafting abilities!

  • Recruit monsters! Turn them into powerful allies with care and combat skill training.

  • Collect 1,400 uniquely drawn items – including more than 300 weapons and 550 pieces of armor and accessories.

  • Customize weapons and armour, go fishing, cook food, collect rare power-ups, and more!

  • Kick back and play Fyued, an original card game played throughout the region with 180 collectable cards!

  • Enjoy an original orchestral soundtrack.

  • Help the townsfolk to prosper with sidequests that range from silly to dangerous!

data.name: Emergency Warp
data.detailed_description:
Tactical Space Defense & Extraction Roguelite

Emergency Warp is a tactical space defense roguelite where your shields are your only lifeline and greed is your greatest enemy.

Take helm of an orbital fortress equipped with customizable turrets, autonomous fighter squadrons, and tactical utility modules. Venture into hostile sectors, clear incoming debris, shoot down incoming enemy volleys, and stand your ground against demanding boss encounters. Gather scrap, plasma, and hypercrystals—but know when to cut and run before your shields collapse.


Configure your hardpoints: Equip your ship with a variety of specialized turrets and weapon systems to counter incoming threats.

THE "EMERGENCY WARP" DILEMMA: GREED VS. SURVIVAL

Every run is a calculated extraction gamble: With each wave, both the rewards and the danger escalate—culminating in challenging sector bosses. Will you risk one more wave for extra resources, or initiate the 3-second Emergency Warp retreat while hostile fire closes in around you? Retreating safely secures your haul; getting destroyed means losing your cargo.

High-stakes tactical combat: Intercept torpedoes, coordinate defense systems, and survive the crossfire.

KEY FEATURES

  • Shields Are Everything: There is no hull buffer. Your energy shields are your sole survival barrier. When shields collapse to zero, the next hit obliterates the ship.

  • Full Point-Defense Tactical Combat: Don't just target enemies—shoot down incoming torpedoes, rockets, and debris using automated Point-Defense Lasers and deployable Flak screens.

  • Modular Turret Hardpoints: Mount Heavy Cannons, Piercing Railguns, Plasma Batteries, Swarm Missiles, and High-Yield Torpedoes to suit your playstyle.

  • Autonomous Drone Carrier Ops: Command swarms of Strike Fighters, defensive patrol interceptors, and automated resource salvage drones.

  • Expansive Meta-Progression: Invest recovered Scrap, Plasma Cells, Nano-Alloys, and Hypercrystals in a massive branching hangar tech tree to unlock new weapons, shield capacitors, and carrier capabilities.

  • Strategic Active Utilities: Deploy tactical counter-measures including orbital flak fields, emergency shield overchargers, and automated mineral refineries.

Face a group of enemies where each type has its own behavior, trying to either destroy you or the blue cube that you have to protect.
Eliminate all enemies in the stage, then move to the next stage



- Destroy all enemies to move to a new stage
- Protect yourself and the blue cube
- Take advantage of the tools that fall from the enemies to continue
- AI of the enemies is varied, each type of enemy has a specific goal that they strive towards, some of them continue to pursue you and some of them head directly to the blue cube.
- The game stages are divided into several chapters, and each chapter will present a new type of challenge.
If you lose, you will have to come back from the first stage
- If you close the game, you can start from the last stage you reached

data.name: Sloth Quest
data.detailed_description:
Control the true king of the jungle as you navigate treacherous vines, battle predators, scale trees and travel to the great beyond. Can you master the precise timing honed by all sloths in the jungle? Impaired by lethargic motions, you must patiently complete your quest, and avoid predators at all costs.

Inspired by challenging games such as GIRP and Sexy Hiking, Sloth Quest takes a twist on the typical platformer by giving you control of a climbing sloth.

Features
  • Swing, swim and grab your way through over 30 levels
  • Collect lost treasures and wearable items scattered throughout the world
  • Fight and defeat tough bosses
  • Customize your sloth with wearables and complete outfits you discover

Controls

Sloth Quest supports both keyboard and game controller (xbox or equivalent). The game has an unusual control scheme. You control each of the sloth arms with a single key or button. A short tap starts the arm raising and a press-and-hold will grab anything in reach. Two more keys control the swing of the legs left and right.

The arms and legs move slowly--this is a sloth. You will need to predict motions and carefully time your grabs to make progress. Oh, and you must hold down the key or the sloth will let go!

History

Sloth Quest was conceived around 2013. In 2014, a short version of the game was green lit by Valve under the old Steam Greenlight program. That game was never published for various reasons. In 2019 we decided to remake the game. We kept the basic controls, but expanded the game's scope, duration and mechanics of the sloth.

Requirements

If you use a keyboard, it must be capable of detecting 3 nearby keys at once. Many modern keyboards and all gaming keyboards typically support this feature. If you are unsure, try the web demo. Go to our website using the links box on this page. Full game controller support is always a second option.

data.name: Star Raiders
data.detailed_description:
Star Raiders features a fresh new take on the seminal classic, letting you engage in epic dogfights and aerial assaults against the onslaught of the evil Zylons. Utilize radical ship transformations and robot co-pilots in the heat of battle as you fight to save humanity. Explore the galaxy as you utilize galactic warps and sector tactical maps that let you set your own path to liberation!

  • Epic Space Battles – Defend humanity against the onslaught of the Zylon fleet, as you pilot your ship amongst huge capital ships and take part in treacherous dogfights.
  • Battle Transformations – Players can transform their ship in the heat of battle into different specialized configurations that have their own flight and combat characteristics.
  • Robot Co-pilots – You are never alone in combat! Known as K0-Pi these tactical robot co-pilots will enhance and monitor ship systems performing repairs and provide real time tactical information to the player.
  • Explore the Galaxy – Galactic warps and sector tactical maps let you choose your missions and set your own path to liberation.

data.name: Hannah
data.detailed_description:
Hannah is a surreal 3D platformer about childhood trauma, 80s-inspired horror, and broken memories. Explore, feel, and choose your path across a VHS-styled dreamworld with multiple endings.

A journey through childhood nightmares

Hannah has lost her favorite doll and now has to face a surreal and enigmatic world shaped by her own mind and her memories of the 1980s, a world where every shadow hides a secret.

In this atmospheric 3D puzzle-platformer, you must explore mysterious settings, solve intriguing challenges, and confront your worst childhood fears in an immersive and unforgettable experience where every decision determines the ending of the story.

Explore the dark side of your mind

From narrow paths to vast surreal landscapes, each environment tells a visually stunning story.

An ever-changing environment

The game adapts to player's choice, altering the environment and influencing the ending.

Solve challenging puzzles

Use logic and creativity to overcome obstacles and unravel the path ahead bringing you closer to understanding yourself.

A deep and interpretive narrative

Find objects that tell your story, clues that reveal fragments of your past. A story of self-discovery that unfolds as you explore.

Soundtrack composed by a Grammy winner

The music and sound effects created especially for the game completely envelop you, creating an extraordinary, immersive, and emotional experience.

data.name: Record of Chaos - Korean Chapter
data.detailed_description:
Short Description

A turn-based deckbuilding roguelike where the rules of the world become increasingly distorted as Chaos deepens. Journey through a world inspired by Korean folklore and traditional culture, build your deck with the distinct combat styles of the Hwarang, Namsadang, and Shaman, collect relics and talismans, and uncover the secrets of an ever-changing world.

About This Game

Record of Chaos -Korea- is a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike based on Korean folklore and traditional culture.

The power of chaos has begun to shake both the human world and the realm of the gods. Choose one of three characters—the Hwarang, Namsadang, or Mudang—and navigate an ever-changing path as you face monsters and divine beings from Korean folklore.

Collect Cards, Relics, and Talismans, choose your routes and events, and advance toward the source of chaos with a deck and strategy of your own.

Discover 253 Cards, 116 Relics, and 38 Talismans to shape a strategy of your own. Face 78 monster types inspired by Korean folklore and find new paths to victory with every journey.

Each battle unfolds in turns, with you playing cards using the Energy available to you. Check the enemy's intent first, then decide the order in which to play Attack, Defense, and Ritual Cards.

Victory earns you card rewards and Yeopjeon coins. From there, choose your next path among nodes such as normal battles, elite battles, rest sites, events, treasure, and traveling merchants. Greater rewards come with greater risks, while safer paths may offer fewer opportunities to grow.

Add, upgrade, and remove cards, acquire Relics, and use Talismans to build a deck unique to each journey. Even with the same character, your combat style changes depending on the cards you choose and the paths you take.

Even the same choice can produce a random effect when Chaos takes hold. Whether the result helps or hinders your journey is something you will have to discover for yourself.

Chaos Cards combine powerful effects with dangerous drawbacks. Defeat bosses or pass through certain events to transform them into Purified Cards with no drawbacks.

At critical moments, Ultimate Techniques and the Chronicle of Great Figures can open a new path forward.

Ultimate Techniques are powerful tools that can turn the tide of battle. Before a boss fight, the Chronicle of Great Figures lets you choose a historical figure; fulfill their condition to activate a special effect.

These systems help newcomers keep their journey going, while giving experienced deckbuilding players more strategic options.

Character — Hwarang

The Hwarang starts with strong basic cards. Alternate between attack and defense to build Momentum, then spend it on a powerful strike or use it to strengthen your basic cards.

Character — Namsadang

The Namsadang builds the flows of Salpan, Beona, and Pungmul by playing Attack, Defense, and Ritual Cards. Completing a flow grants an effect that strengthens the next action, so success depends on deciding which card should receive the boost.

Character — Mudang

The Mudang's basic cards are less powerful, but Sal curses steadily wear enemies down while Divine Power unleashes potent effects. Because the Mudang must manage both Energy and Divine Power, this character demands the most careful resource management of the three.

We have carried the defining qualities of Korean folklore and traditional culture beyond names and appearances, embedding them throughout the game's systems.

From the look and combat patterns of monsters to the Cards, Relics, events, motifs, music, and interface, every element has been designed to connect naturally within a Korean-inspired world.

Discover a familiar yet freshly reimagined world of Korean folklore through restrained visuals inspired by bright hanji paper and ink wash painting. Journey deeper and uncover the truth hidden at the end of chaos.

Key Features

  • A deckbuilding roguelike inspired by Korean folklore and traditional culture

  • Three characters with distinct combat styles and resources

  • Strategic turn-based battles built around reading enemy intents

  • A wide range of builds combining Cards, Relics, and Talismans

  • Chaos and Purification systems that introduce new variables to cards and choices

  • Routes and events that change with your decisions

  • Ultimate Techniques and the Chronicle of Great Figures to create breakthroughs in critical moments

  • Monsters and boss battles inspired by Korean folklore

  • Restrained Korean-style visuals inspired by hanji paper and ink wash painting

data.name: Burning Dead Reloaded
data.detailed_description:
Background:
La Montaña, once a hub of scientific excellence, has transformed into a nightmare landscape following a catastrophic failure at the "CRISPR Advance Research Center" (CARC). Accused of orchestrating this disaster, Mike Pacheco is driven by two goals: saving his daughter from the heart of chaos and revealing the true architects behind the calamity.

Part 1 - The Descent:
As Mike Pacheco, players will venture into the eerie, zombie-infested corridors of La Montaña. The unfolding narrative reveals a tale of corporate irresponsibility and betrayal, setting the stage for an intense journey of survival, truth-seeking, and paternal responsibility.

Part 2 - Burning Dead Reloaded:
The gameplay intensifies across +30 thrilling levels. Each stage presents unique challenges, ranging from stealth missions in devastated labs to intense shootouts against a variety of Crispers and mutated creatures.

Game Objectives:
Father's Mission: Central to the game is Mike's desperate search for his daughter, proving her innocence in the process.
Survival Combat: Engage in combat against a range of Crispers and genetically altered beasts with a diverse arsenal of weapons that includes shotguns, pistols, assault rifles and even grenades.
Unravel the Conspiracy: Collect evidence to expose the conspiracy behind the outbreak and redeem Mike's reputation.
Strategic Navigation: Skillfully navigate through the dangerous environments of La Montaña, balancing stealth and combat through huge storms and forest fires.
Climactic Confrontation: Confront and bring to justice those responsible, securing a safe future for Mike and his daughter.

Game Features:
Emotionally Charged Storyline: A narrative blending action, survival, and a father’s relentless quest to save his daughter.
Diverse Gameplay Mechanics: A mix of shooting, stealth, and puzzle-solving.
Expansive Arsenal: An array of weapons to combat different enemy types.
Dynamic Environments: Explore the intricately designed labs and containment areas of La Montaña.
Character Evolution: Witness Mike Pacheco's transformation from a security chief to a determined father on a mission.

In "Burning Dead Reloaded," players are invited into a world where personal stakes are high and danger lurks around every corner. Can you navigate the horrors of La Montaña, rescue your daughter, and restore your tarnished name?

data.name: BACKBITE
data.detailed_description:
The Snake you know is a single-player high-score game. This is a duel.


Two snakes on one board, five powers to ruin each other's run, and one rule that changes everything: the one who ate more wins, not the one who survived.

When Snake grew into a multiplayer game, it grew massive: hundreds of snakes on one map, not a duel between two. And of the Snake games on Steam, none has an online mode. Most "Snake for two" games are also two runs side by side: each player on their own board, unable to touch the other. Here there is one board, and the snakes get in each other's way, cut each other off, and collide. That gap is where BACKBITE sits.

Dying isn't always losing


When a snake crashes, the match doesn't end there. If you were ahead on points — or if you were tied — your rival gets 15 seconds to beat your score racing the clock alone. If they fail, you win, even though you died first. No stars and no powers during the chase: the apple, the clock and nothing else.

Five powers


  • SWAP — swaps both snakes' positions. At the worst possible moment.
  • PORTAL — two teleporters on the board for 15 seconds.
  • SPEED — double speed for 5 seconds.
  • SLOW — freezes your rival to half speed for 5 seconds.
  • STEAL — takes a point and a segment from them, and that point becomes yours. A two-point swing, instantly.
Powers come from stars that appear on the board, and which one you get is drawn by a roulette when you pick it up. There's only ever one star at a time: whoever reaches it first takes it.

The golden apple


Every so often a golden apple appears: it's worth 3 points but only grows you by one segment. It lasts a few seconds — a ring shows how much time is left — and then turns back into a normal apple. It's the one that turns a scoreboard around in a single bite, and the one that sends both snakes to the same place at the same time.

Four ways to play


  • 2 Players local — two people, one keyboard.
  • Online — a direct match between both machines with a 5-character room code.
  • VS Bot — four difficulties. The fourth one is called IMPOSSIBLE and it means it.
  • 1 Player — you against your own record.

18 snakes to unlock

Each skin opens by doing something concrete: reaching a certain score against a certain difficulty, winning online matches, beating the Impossible bot more than once. Locked ones show as silhouettes from day one, so you always know what's left.

No coins, no crates, no microtransactions. They unlock by playing.

Also


  • Gamepad support (Xbox, PlayStation, generic USB): movement, powers, pause and menu navigation. The online room code is typed on the keyboard.
  • Rebindable controls for both players.
  • Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian and Simplified Chinese.
  • Records kept separately by mode and by difficulty.

data.name: INKQUISITION
data.detailed_description:
A dystopian document-stamping game

Read the papers, cross them against rules that change overnight, sometimes retroactively, and decide who gets through. The quota is not negotiable. It is a formality. It is also the rest of your life.

You are a newly posted clerk at a document-control counter of a crumbling 1980s ministry. Ring the bell, call the next applicant, and decide who passes and who is turned away — one stamp at a time. Every day the rules change, the queue grows, and the paperwork gets harder to trust.

What you do

Each shift plays out at your desk. An applicant steps to the window and slides their papers across. Your job is to cross-check everything against the regulations currently in force and reach a verdict before the day runs out.

  • Read the papers— a request form and an identity card, with names, dates, sectors, registry numbers, photographs and signatures that must all agree.

  • Check the rules — open the Memoranda drawer to see the directives in force today. They contradict yesterday's, single out new sectors, and add conditions that turn a valid file into a rejection.

  • Investigate — reach for the tools on your desk: a magnifier, an ultraviolet lamp for hidden microprint, a signature comparator, a stature gauge, and the registry terminal.

  • Question them — put questions to the applicant and weigh their answers against what the documents say.

  • Pass judgement — pick up the APPROVE or REJECT stamp and press it onto the form. Later, harder verdicts open up: refer, detain, denounce, file.

The paper fights back

Documents don't always arrive neat. Sheets come torn in half and must be pieced together, crumpled and smoothed, stapled shut, or soaked by the rain so the stamp won't take. Ink runs low and must be recharged; a long shift leaves your hand unsteady, so the impression lands where it will, not where you aimed.

Consequences

Meet the daily quota or answer for it. Every mistake earns a citation and eats into your pay; the balance you carry home decides whether your household makes it through the night. Timed files, bribes, denunciations and a supervisor who is always reading over your shoulder all pull you in different directions.

A different shift every time

  • Every run rolls a fresh seed: a new calendar, new weather, new rule-books.

  • Draw perks and curses that reshape how you work — for better and worse.

  • A Random Rules mode derives the entire regulation set from the seed.

  • See a run through to an ending to unlock more for the next one.

Atmosphere

Hand-drawn film-noir art, a rain-blown skyline through the office window, a flickering fluorescent tube, and a desk radio you can tune between stations.

Features

  • Rules that change daily and reward careful reading over speed.

  • A deskful of inspection tools and diegetic controls.

  • Roguelike replayability: seeds, perks, curses, random rules, multiple endings.

  • An branching intro and a grim bureaucratic story that unfolds day by day.

Stamp carefully. The Ministry is watching.
