data.name: MINDHACK
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT

MINDHACK is a text adventure game where you change evildoers into happy-go-lucky saints.

You are the “Doctor”, a genius hacker who can destroy minds with the power of programming.
Meet unique evildoers and hack their minds to rewrite them into happy people.
No matter how heinous they are, they’ll turn into docile sheep once they’ve been in your hands!
Enjoy the pleasure of destroying minds.

WORLD

The story of MINDHACK is set in a world based on both fantasy and our modern society. Meet characters with unique appearances and backgrounds, like a sea urchin who also happens to be a gang leader, a fanatic of a cult religion who believes that he’s a cabinet, a monster from outer space, and even a fatal glitch plotting the end of the world…!?
Hack such evildoers, rewrite their minds, and reform them into benign citizens!

STORY

You are the Doctor, whose duty is to remove BUGs: destructive impulses that hide within people’s souls. Along with a supercomputer and a security force, you fight day and night at an institution created solely to deal with these BUGs!
Will you be able to defeat the catastrophic BUG, the “FATAL ERROR”, before it destroys the world…!?

FEATURES


Interact with a unique cast of characters!
During the adventure portion, you will meet and interact with various evildoers in a dystopian world. All of the characters have unique and tricky personalities. The main character’s hands are always displayed on the game screen, embellishing your conversations with vibrant animation.

Type to change evildoers for good!
During the hacking portion, you will type out code to unlock an evildoer’s memories and explore their past. As you read through their memories, you may find that people aren’t as they seem…? After you understand who they really are, a typing sequence will begin in order to rewrite their mind. Type out keywords connected to their souls and turn them into flowers, changing the evildoer into a harmless and benign person!

data.name: Winds Of Trade
data.detailed_description:
Winds Of Trade is a strategy game about running an ocean trading company in the 18th and 19th centuries. Building your trading empire will not be your only goal! Ruthless pirates, shady smugglers, wartime and fierce competitors will make the way to the top a long and hard road for you!

Main Features


  • Procedurally generated worlds: You will face different challenges and you will have to learn how the cities’ production chains interact every time you start a new game.
  • Realistic economic simulation: All prices respond to the basic laws of supply and demand. Every raw material comes from somewhere and every final product goes somewhere to be bought. No arbitrary game rules set, just the will of the free market.
  • Smuggling: Some goods that can be freely bought in one city may be illegal someplace else... Are you willing to take risks for some extra profit?
  • Smart Artificial Intelligence opponents that will make your way to the top even more challenging!
  • Dynamic world economy: Events such as forest fires, bad harvests or war alter the supply, demand and prices of the different commodities.
  • Contracts system: You can accept contracts from governments, private companies and even shady smugglers in order to make some extra money transporting goods. But don't forget, failing comes with a price.
  • Turn based battle system: Pirates may attack you if your cargo is valuable enough... Do you have what it takes to defend yourself? Also, be very careful during wartime, especially if you are transporting weaponry or troops.
  • Your very own colonies: Once you are powerful enough you can found your own colonies in order to exploit natural resources and play with the rules of the market.
  • Own warehouses to accumulate goods and manipulate the market.
  • 11 different ship types from the Age of Sailing, including brigs, galleons, fluyts, frigates and schooners.
  • Automatic Trade Routes: Once your fleet is big enough you can make scripts for your ships to follow and they will trade according to your rules automatically.
  • Improve your ships' stats by hiring experienced captains or purchasing upgrades.
  • Stock market: Invest in companies, help them sell their goods worldwide and collect the profits.
  • Corruption simulation system: Obtain an advantage over your opponents by bribing corrupt governments.
  • Dynamic weather simulation.
  • A rich and immersive soundtrack.

data.name: The Viriditas Chapel of Perpetual Adoration
data.detailed_description:
The Viriditas Chapel of Perpetual Adoration is a virtual reality inspired by visions and music of Saint Hildegard von Bingen, a 14th century abbess and Doctor of the Catholic Church. It is situated in the northern apsidal chapel of Cathedral-in-the-Clouds, an ongoing collection of digital dioramas for contemplation.

When the player kneels down to pray, an audio-visual spectacle unfolds, expressing the beauty of creation and the love of God. Only to end in silent contemplation of the Most Holy Eucharist. What was visible and audible before has now been internalized in your heart, aflame in adoration, awe and endless gratitude.

Hildegard Von Bingen



Hildegard von Bingen was an 12th century abbess in the valley of the Rhine in present day Germany. She was a mystic, a scientist, a composer and a writer. In 2012 she was declared Doctor of the Church, among luminaries such as Theresa of Avila, Thomas Aquinas and Augustine of Hippo. Viriditas is a guiding concept in her thinking. It expresses the vital power of nature, specifically of plants. Within this context, she imagined Jesus Christ to be a flower that blooms on the branch that is the Holy Virgin. It is this idea, combined with her vision of the cosmos in an eternal embrace of the divine, that inspired the Viriditas Chapel.

O greenest branch whose breath inspires the wonder of saints. Hail!
When you bloom in your branches the heat of the sun flows from you like ointment.
In you a beautiful flower blossomed whose fragrance awakened all that was withered.
And all emerged in full vigor!

Design


The structure of The Viriditas Chapel of Perpetual Adoration is based on Hildegard’s visions of the cosmos. In these she would see a geocentric universe embraced by the love of God and animated by the winds of faith and trust. In the Viriditas Chapel this embrace is performed by the Holy Virgin. We find the sphere of fire in the two outer columns and the sphere of water in the inner columns. The central altar piece represents the earth.



In another vision, as expressed in multiple poems, Hildegard saw Jesus as a flower on the branch that is the virgin Mary, His mother. This is a variation on the more conventional notion of Jesus being the fruit of her womb. Here both images are combined. The altar bulges slightly forward to represent to belly of the virgin in which the son of God grows. In the opening of what started as a dark niche, ornamental leaves appear in ever greater numbers. This to illustrate what Hildegard referred to as viridity, or the abundant greening power of life on earth. Within that green oasis, a magical flower blooms, the heart of creation, the promise of redemption, love itself.

Credits

  • art By Michaël Samyn
  • music By Hildegard Von Bingen
  • Hildegard Von Bingen’s “O viridissima virga ave” as sung by Stevie Wishart’s ensemble Sinfonye in Douai Abbey, England. Recorded by Jim Denley. Producer: Stevie Wishart. Digital Remastering Engineer: Simon Heyworth 2022. copyright © stevie wishart
  • Viola da gamba by Michaël Samyn
  • Additional sounds by Kris Force and mediapaja2009
  • 3D modeling by Michaël Samyn
  • Patrons are Maja Kuzmanovic & Nik Gaffney

data.name: Trainpunk Run
data.detailed_description:
Fun “fly and shoot” videogame in a steampunk environment. Guide Ryana, military pilot, through five different worlds, to save them from the evil Lord Blackname. Collect coins to buy different Traninpunks, power-ups and customize Ryana's outfit.

Enjoy an emotional story of a woman who wants to save the world.
This is a game made in memory and commemoration of pioneer female pilots: Amelia Earhart, Jane Trefusis Forbes, Jacqueline Cochran or Harriet Quimby.

The player will fly and fight against the enemies to collect and send flying letters to prevent the evil plans of Lord Blackname, the military leader of the Black Brigade.



In this new version you will find:

- Five different levels with original steampunk settings.
- Fun and entertaining challenges: Steampunk elements to pick up!
- Follow the story through the entertaining dialogues of our protagonist Ryana with the evil Lord Blackname.
- An emotional tale told through letters that are unlocked as the player advances in the game.
- Powerups and nitro options that add more excitement to the game.
- New Trainpunks and clothes to buy with the coins that the player can collect in the game.
- A fun and emotional story about a female pilot who decided to fight to achieve her dream of flying and fighting.

Contents added in the version:

- New Clothes to buy in the store
- New Trainpunks to buy in the store
- New Power-Ups: Missile, Health, Big Health, Absorb Coins and Absorb Messages.



And with the rise of levels also appears the history and a brief biography of the pioneering pilot women as Amelia Earhart, Jane Trefusis Forbes, Jacqueline Cochran or Harriet Quimby.



10% in grants for women's associations

data.name: Knights of Grayfang
data.detailed_description:
The land of Eldraad is in the midst of a war between the humans, born from the Twilight Deity, and the monsters, born from the Nightfall Deity, to control all nine temples. King Edwahl wields twilight's might, turning humans into vampires via a ritual. Yet, a sinister force awakens among monsters. Will nightfall or twilight triumph?



One of the main characters, Thoma, wields a unique Blood Gauge, replacing HP and MP. Using this gauge, characters can activate Bloodthirst, granting new skills and appearances. Equip bats found in dungeons for passive effects like protection from ailments and boosted attack power. Seize victory by claiming all nine temples. Unravel the mysteries and battle the monsters within to conquer them!

- Unleash Bloodthirst skills in turn-based battles
- Equip mystical bats for tactical advantage
- Shape destiny with unique Blood Gauge
- Conquer Temples for ultimate victory
- Discover power hidden in dungeons
- Master the art of vampire supremacy
- Unravel mysteries, vanquish monsters

data.name: No Room for Swords
data.detailed_description:
The unearthing of the first Mana Crystal brought Aliad a century of prosperity, and its people flourished on magic. Yet in the distant sky, a crack quietly appeared, and it has since grown into the World Rift. But the ancient pacts have long been buried beneath the profits at hand. Swarming monsters are seen as nothing more than a gold mine for adventurers, and the mounting corpses as a fortune for necromancers.

You are only a commoner, with neither power nor title. But you know this: if the magic of money can blind the eyes of nobles, it can also drive people to stand together.

data.name: Seinarukana -The Spirit of Eternity Sword 2-
data.detailed_description:
Story

A journey across infinite worlds.

The Time Tree. Countless branches extending through space, each a world of its own.

In one such world, a boy holds within him the soul of an ancient god yearning to break free. He tries to live a normal life, but must constantly struggle against the destructive urges threatening to overwhelm him. Little does he know that his closest friends also carry the burdens of an age long forgotten. data.name: Base Wars
data.detailed_description:
THE TURN BASED RTS


Base Wars goes where no other game has gone before and melds the big picture strategy of RTS games with the thoughtful pacing of TBS games. The result? Tactical perfection!
Build up your territory, create a brand new army composition, take control of the land, and strike down whoever stands in your way! This game feels familiar, yet entirely novel through its boundary breaking landscape and fluid chess-like combat.

FIGHT YOUR FRIENDS

Base Wars is balanced around multiplayer gameplay. Queue up for some casual Unranked matches online, or play against your friends directly!
Do you like to test out new builds? The Singleplayer AI will put up a fight.
Want a more serious experience? A Ranked Ladder system is on the way right now!

EXPRESS YOURSELF

Don't like the default look? That's okay! Base Wars includes a Unit Skin system letting you completely change how your units appear to you and your friends. Alongside this, we've also included a Map Editor to help get the creative juices flowing. Community made maps are even considered for base-game inclusion with future updates!

FIND A COMMUNITY

Since Base Wars just released, the community is still small and tight-knit. We like to hang out in the Discord server and discuss build variants or possible balance changes for the next patch. Want to see more of something specific ingame? The Dev team is active and very receptive to your ideas!

DEVELOP THE META

Several years of playtesting with friends have lead to an extremely well balanced game. Even still, there's always interesting new builds and tactics discovered that provide opportunity for improvement! Crush the opponent with an early aggression, or defend and win by technological development- How will you choose to play?

data.name: Wall Street Donkey
data.detailed_description:
🫏 BRING A LITTLE DONKEY-FUELED CHAOS TO WALL STREET!

MAKE MONEY. MAKE MORE MONEY. THEN MAKE MONEY AGAIN.

Use your wits to survive the blood-soaked markets of Wall Street—or stack 20× leverage and launch yourself directly into the stratosphere!

Wall Street Donkey is a beautifully unhinged stock-market deckbuilding roguelite. And no, it was absolutely NOT created after the developer blew up their portfolio. Definitely not. Hee... haw... sob...

Read the news, predict the market, trade stocks, and use Bullish, Bearish, Leverage, and Utility cards to bend prices to your will. Preserve your capital as one historical disaster after another tears through the market.

⏳ RELIVE A CENTURY OF FINANCIAL DISASTERS!

From the dot-com bubble and the global financial crisis to the COVID-19 pandemic and tariff wars—return to the moments that shook the world.

Watch greed inflate bubbles, fear erase fortunes, and red and green candlesticks chart a century of human triumph and disaster.

This time, you are not merely watching history unfold.

You are trying to make money from it.

$ SURVIVE THE MADNESS!

Every trading day hides both opportunity and disaster.

The news may send your stocks to the moon—or vaporize your entire portfolio before lunch.

Manage your positions, predict the market, and decide when to take a sensible profit... and when to bet the farm, the barn, and the donkey.

↑↓ BUILD YOUR SPECULATION DECK!

Collect and combine different cards to manipulate stock prices, alter the outcome of events, peek at future news, or add yet another layer of leverage to an already terrible decision.

Construct new strategies every run and discover increasingly irresponsible ways to become rich.

⚠ SURVIVE SUPER BLACK SWAN EVENTS!

Pandemics, financial crises, tariff wars, and bursting bubbles will reshape the market over multiple trading days.

News will break, entire sectors will convulse, and yesterday’s unstoppable stock may collapse overnight.

Study how each crisis unfolds, exploit the opportunities hidden inside the chaos, and survive until the closing bell—or pour gasoline on the fire and send the candlesticks straight to the moon!

★ RISE FROM RETAIL NOBODY TO WALL STREET LEGEND!

Buy relics, unlock new cards, and build increasingly deranged strategies.

You may invest carefully and grow rich one sensible trade at a time.

Or you may stack 20× leverage and challenge fate itself.

After all, Wall Street may not remember its losers—but it might remember the donkey that flew the highest.

data.name: Udonge in Interspecies Cave
data.detailed_description:
Dreadful monsters were stirring in the cave where Udonge had fallen into.
Low-class monsters starving for females creep up, one after another.
Can she escape the violence of sexual desire, or will she be trapped and have everything destroyed by sheer pleasure and humiliation?
This is a derivative work, a fan work of Touhou Project.

Action Game

Control Udonge to break through the caves.

"Udonge in Interspecies Cave" is a simple action game. Move, jump, shoot! Use these actions to break through the dungeon teeming with monsters.
Defeat the three stages and their bosses.

If your health reaches zero...

You'd better recover quickly, or something unbelievable will happen...

When your health reaches 0, Udonge becomes immobile. By pressing the move keys left or right, you can charge a gauge to get back up... but if you're caught by a monster during this time...

Something unbelievable...


Unthinkable consequences! Various monsters each have their own dot motions on the map. You can still escape in this state, but if a certain event happens, it's game over...

Numerous game-over screens.

When you transition to the game-over screen, you can view large-size motions.

With each stage cleared, a gallery is unlocked, allowing you to view scenes at any time.


Will Udonge be able to safely escape this cave swarming with monsters...?

data.name: Dawn of Mages
data.detailed_description:
Attest your supremacy in this new PvP Battle Arena. Make use of your skills, strategies and cunning in this magical world with uniquely intricate maps, a free targeting system and over 100 different builds.

Lay down the classical guns, the sword&board and join the fight in this world of reality shaping spells.

OS: Windows + Linux



Server type for EARLY ACCESS: Host-Client.
We are planning on dedicated servers for version 1.0 or even sooner.

After early access launch:
ROADMAP
- in somewhat chronological order -

1. Host migration - if the host leaves match, another client will become host and the session will not close
2. Host can change session duration (currently 15min)
3. Team Deathmatch, Friends, Party
4. New Map
5. Pets
6. New Mages and Weapons
7. Account Level and Steam Achievements
8. Ranked Play
9. New Spell Class
10. New map
11. Dedicated servers
12. Battle Royale (current game mode is Battle Arena, NOT Battle Royale)
13. New Mages and Weapons
14. New Spell Class
15. New Pets
16. New Map
17. New game mode(s)
18. ...to be continued...

Dawn of Mages is a 3rd person multiplayer PvP arena with unique, yet familiar features:
● Complex and detailed maps (learn the features and plan along)
● Free targeting system (skills and training beat luck)
● Over 100 different builds (chosen before the game starts)
● Each spell is different (in terms of damage, debuffs or buffs on enemies)

There are 5 types of spells and 5 classes of spells (at launch), making every player you meet (and yourself) a different challenge.

Your build will consist of choosing 1 spell from each class for each type before the game starts.

Each player will have 5 types of spells:
● Main: Long range bolt with low damage and mana cost
● Close: Short range spell with high damage and mana cost
● AoE: Medium Range spell, low to medium damage and mana cost
● Deadeye: Unlimited range, with high damage and mana cost (usable only with “magical scope” - no “no scope snipe”)
● Ultimate: Unique range to each class, highest damage and mana cost

For each type, there will be 5 available choices (5 classes of spells):
● Fire: Lower damage, ignores shield
● Ice: Lower damage, debuffs enemies (burns stamina)
● Lightning: Highest damage, buffs enemies (refills stamina)
● Poison: Average damage, part of the damage is over time and stacks
● Void: Lowest Damage, heals your character (lifesteal)

Besides these, there are 2 actions universal to all characters:
● Melee attack - punch: High damage, ignores shield, restores mana
● Breach: Creates a gateway through most walls and props, with no mana cost, insta-kill and 30 seconds cooldown. Use it wisely, to escape, to ambush, to confuse, or anything you might think of, it’s your choice

Map features:
● Realistic props (if you can see through it, you can shoot through it)
● Scattered Power-Ups: Shards - Health, Mana, Shield, Speed and Damage
● Jumping Platforms - giving you a boost up in the air to kill your enemies from above

Game modes. Dawn of Mages will launch with Free For All mode and soon after, Team Deathmatch mode. As the game evolves, there will be new ones introduced as per the roadmap and the community feedback and wishes - Battle Royale, Capture the Flag, Last Man Standing, First Blood Wins. Or crazy ones, like Football. Ours and your imagination will be the limit.

Eyes to the future.

There will be account level, ranked play, stats and more. See Roadmap above.

NOTE: Dawn of Mages will NEVER become pay-to-win. The in-game marketplace will feature COSMETIC only items.

More information here:

Download it, play it and tell us what you want to see, what you want changed and what you like and dislike about it.

data.name: Twilight Struggle
data.detailed_description:
Twilight Struggle is a strategy game set in the Cold War that presents new and different challenges with every game session. The game map is a world map of the period, whereon players move units and exert influence in attempts to gain allies and control for their superpower. The playable events in the game cover a vast array of historical happenings, from the Arab-Israeli conflicts of 1948 and 1967, to Vietnam and the U.S. peace movement, to the Cuban Missile Crisis and other such incidents that brought the world to the brink of nuclear annihilation.

Play as the US or USSR during the Cold War and change the course of history.

Highlights
• Events found in the game are actual events that occurred during the Cold War.
• Full asynchronous support for multiplayer online games.

data.name: THE LEGEND OF HEROES: HAJIMARI NO KISEKI
data.detailed_description:
The Kiseki series, which marks the story RPG's 15th anniversary, is now on Steam!

The empires of Zemuria have narrowly managed to escape the Great Twilight, a curse that threatened to end the world, thanks to the valiant efforts of those known as heroes. This has resulted in a ripple effect of events that hurtles the series toward its thrilling conclusion.
Following the Great Twilight calamity, the three protagonists across the Zemurian continent find themselves drawn together by the thread of fate.

Some are heroes, others are liberators, and yet others live as hermits. The cross-story gameplay system allows players to switch between three different characters, depicting the story from separate perspectives within the same timeline.

What will the people of Crossbell think of their newfound independence? What will become of an empire which has lost one of its mighty limbs? And what of Ouroboros’ leader, the Grandmaster, and his ominous Eternal Regression Plan?

The Steam version of the game includes over 30 pieces of additional content from the start, including costumes and attachment items!
A variety of attachment items that can be worn on each character's head, arms, and back for decoration, as well as original costumes, are included, as well as the major DLC Support Section Summer Vacation.

data.name: Hollow Frontier
data.detailed_description:
🌌 An Uncharted Sci-Fi World
Dive into a visually stunning, story-rich universe where every corner tells a story. From the wreckage of abandoned stations to mysterious laser fields and crumbling industrial landscapes, each scene reveals new clues about humanity's downfall.

🕹️ Unique Gameplay Perspectives
Experience seamless transitions between gameplay styles:

  • 3rd Person 2D Exploration: Navigate intricate environments and uncover hidden pathways.

  • First-Person 3D Action: Engage in immersive, high-stakes moments where you are face-to-face with the unknown.

  • ⚙️ Survival Through Innovation
    The odds are stacked against you, but you're not powerless. Utilize an intuitive skill-equipping system to adapt to every scenario. Toggle through abilities, fight off threats, and solve puzzles—all with a single press of the TAB key.

🔥 Dynamic Challenges
Encounter environmental hazards like laser fields that ignite your ship, pushing you to think quickly and strategize under pressure. Enable and disable effects like burning VFX seamlessly to maintain immersion.

🎮 Engaging Combat and Exploration
Control your spaceship with precision as the mouse guides your horizontal and vertical movements. Explore vast and intricate levels while managing resources and upgrading your ship to survive the hostile environment.

🎨 Atmospheric Design
Start in eerie darkness, with only emergency power guiding your way. The game’s ambiance reflects the broken world around you, immersing players in its haunting beauty.

🔧 For Fans of Indie Gaming
Crafted with passion by a dedicated indie developer, Hollow Frontier combines creative mechanics, storytelling, and rich environments to deliver a unique gaming experience.

data.name: Dominus Gladiatus
data.detailed_description:
Rise as a Dominus

Rome thirsts for blood.

Take control of a gladiator school, recruit men from the markets, forge them into gladiators, and prepare them for the brutal arenas of Rome. Build your Ludus, manage your roster, and make decisions that can mean life or death on your road to becoming Rome’s greatest Dominus.

Will your gladiators become champions… or die forgotten before the crowds of Rome?

Blood in the Arena

Watch savage duels and team battles unfold in brutal auto-battler combat.

Train, equip and prepare your gladiators before they enter the arena, then watch your decisions play out in blood. One mistake can cost a gladiator his life.

Choose Your Dominus

Six Domini compete for prestige, power, and survival.

Choose one to lead, then face the others one by one through a deadly tournament. Each rival Dominus has their own strengths, methods, and ways of disrupting your Ludus as you fight your way toward the grand final.

In Rome, only one name will be remembered.

Build Your Ludus

Your Ludus is the heart of your gladiator school.

Expand it with new facilities, train your gladiators and develop their skills. Manage morale, injuries and fatigue as you decide who needs rest, who is ready to fight, and who can be pushed further.

A well-run Ludus creates champions. A careless one buries them.

The Slave Market

The markets of Rome are filled with desperate men and future champions.

Recruit new gladiators, spot hidden potential, and strengthen your roster as the battles grow deadlier. Every gladiator brings different strengths, weaknesses, and possibilities.

Arm Your Gladiators

Equip your gladiators with weapons and armor suited to their role in the arena. The right gear can mean the difference between victory and death.

Win the Crowd

The crowd is ruthless, and Rome remembers spectacle.

Win their favor and they may turn the arena to your advantage. Turn them against you and the crowd can become another enemy. In Rome, survival is not decided by steel alone.

Become a Legend

Only the greatest schools will produce champions worthy of Rome.

Build your Ludus, prepare your gladiators, overcome rival Domini, and survive the bloody road to the final championship.

Glory awaits in the arena.

data.name: Hell Deck
data.detailed_description:
You wake up in the depths of Hell, but it isn’t the demons you should fear. Holy angels are descending from the heavens to purge the abyss, and you are their prey. To survive, you must take command of Hell’s denizens and rewrite the laws of nature.

Hell Deck is a dark, twisted roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Here, the battlefield is a living, breathing, and volatile ecosystem where survival is bought with flesh. Force your units into a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, engineer a grotesque food chain, and repel the holy onslaught.

"WHY DO YOU DOUBT THIS PARADISE?"

Forget everything you know about good and evil. In this world, angels are the apex predators hunting you down. Lead the demons of the abyss, adapt to the harsh reality of the underworld, and turn the holy invasion into a crimson feast.

Your units don’t just stand in formation—they hunt each other. Master a unique "Ecosystem Deckbuilding" mechanic where power is consolidated through cannibalism. Accidental placements and deliberate sacrifices trigger grotesque biological mutations, turning weak grunts into god-like apex predators.

Space is your most precious resource. On a strictly limited tile grid, every single placement can trigger an uncontrollable chain reaction. Manage your hand, monitor your inventory bag, and orchestrate the perfect biological synergy to decimate hundreds of oncoming enemies at once.

Death is merely part of the experiment. As a mysterious, omniscient voice watches over your failures—promising to "fix you" each time you break—you will unlock permanent upgrades upon returning to the lobby.

data.name: Scare: Fatal Picture - The Other Side
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis:

Scare: Fatal Picture – The Other Side is a psychological horror game in which you

must take pictures of ghosts to destroy them.

Description:

Scare: Fatal Picture - The Other Side is a psychological horror game where you

play as Saori, a young woman trapped in a ghostly prison to be eaten by the Ghost Queen.

Armed with a camera, you must take pictures of ghosts to destroy them. Every photo

taken can make you stronger.

Earn ghostly points by taking pictures of ghosts and use them to upgrade your camera.

Not all ghosts are enemies. some will work with you in your journey.

After finishing a chapter, test your memory by answering story questions to unlock the

next chapter.

Features:

- Use your camera to destroy ghosts by taking pictures of them

- Collect ghostly points by taking pictures to upgrade your camera

- Experience a deep narrative

- Unlock chapters by answering story questions that test your memory

- Immerse yourself in a horror atmosphere inspired by japanese ghost stories

data.name: Random Raiders
data.detailed_description:
Random Raiders is a Guild Manager Simulator that puts you in charge of a newly-started raiding guild in the fictional MMORPG 'World of Guild Quest'. Recruit the best players you can find - balance their classes, volatile personalities and overcome the inevitable drama in order to become the best guild on the server.

Create a Guild


Design a bitchin' banner by choosing a shape, icon, and colors in our banner editor. Name your guild Backstreet Boys. Change the name to something sensible. Hit the random button by mistake while letting out an audible puff of air in frustration. These are all features we provide.

Recruit your Members


Sift through the applications to find what you need to take your guild to the next level. Need a patient priest that can dispel, played by some guy named Alejandro who lives in Burgos in Spain? We got you covered. Maybe recruit that loot-hungry tank, played by some girl named Frida from Svendborg in Denmark? Whatever floats your boat.

Go Raid!

Send your team on raids to improve their skills and gear. Watch in horror as your team brutally fails against an obviously inferior boss because the main tanks' potato PC gave out in a critical moment.

Compete against the NPC Guilds


Improve your standing on the leaderboards by killing more raid bosses. Kill enough bosses and you may even find yourself at the top, beating legendary guilds like Agitation Later, Aragon and Swahilum.

Credits

Random Raiders created by Max Kvelland and Benny Samuelsson, Solid Core.

Icons made by Lorc, . Available on

data.name: Pax Germanica
data.detailed_description:
Take control of one of seven great powers of the late 19th century and build the most profitable empire on Earth: colonise unclaimed territories, or establish economic control over minor countries and decaying empires such as China and the Ottoman Empire. Choose carefully between the diplomatic path and the iron fist — but remember: the Great War will put an end to everyone's imperial dreams.

Build your empire

How the game plays

The game in played in  turns. Every turn follows the same structure:

• Random events shake the world: elections, crises, nationalist agitation and colonial uprisings.

• Administration: your territories pay income, your garrisons and fleets cost upkeep.

• Minor powers such as Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain expand on their own.

• Movement and expansion: all players plan their moves at the same time, then the round is carried out together.

• Colonial combat, negotiations and the Congress of Europe settle the disputes the turn has created.

Every turn, the money left in your treasury earns Victory Points — and each power values its money differently, so no two powers play the same game. At the end, bonuses reward the empire you built: a land route from Cairo to the Cape, a grip on China, the income of your territories. The game ends after the first player earns 100 Victory Points or earlier if the Great War breaks out; the player with the most Victory Points wins.

Build your empire

The map covers 117 areas across Africa, Asia, the Americas, Oceania and Europe. Each area has an economic value and a native population that can resist you.

• Six levels of presence, from a simple economic Interest to Influence, Protectorate and Colony, up to Dominion and Statehood for a few special territories.

• Some levels can be shared with rival powers to split the revenue; others must be held by your own garrisons.

• An area only pays if it is connected to your homeland, by land or by sea through your merchant fleets.

• Rebellions can break out anywhere: a threat where you rule, an opportunity where others do.

Diplomacy and betrayal

Any kinds of disputes between nations could create a casus belli wich if unresolved can end up in an armed conflict raising the european tension and risking to end the game. the main tool that players have to avoid conflict is diplomacy. trough a dedicated phase during the turn players can discuss and write custom treaties to try to accomodate their needs and others one regarding the movment and placement phases.

• Write your own treaties: binding clauses — money, territories, fleets, peace terms — are enforced by the game.

• Anything else is written down on your word of honour: keeping it is up to whoever signed.

• Defensive alliances earn Victory Points every turn, but drag you into your ally's wars.

Decaying empires

China and the Ottoman Empire cannot be conquered like Africa: you enter them through economic influence. Every foreign presence in China raises Chinese Resentment — push too hard and China will try to drive the foreigners out.

War

When diplomacy fails, colonial wars erupt. these wars are fought far from home so you'll need to manage the supply line with your motherland and carefully organize your forces and garrisons as the immense distances will slow down ypur reactions. Colonial wars do not involve Europe as a theatre. Non-belligerent powers watch from a distance and can decide at the end of every war sequence to actively intervene in the conflict, to start a negotiation between the belligerent powers as a mediator writing down the agreement o to grant/deny passage on Their territory for the belligerant armies, ships and supplies. However if more than 4 European powers get involved in the same armed conflict the game ends because of the start of the Great War

Features

• 2 to 7 players: hotseat on one computer.

• Seven playable great powers, plus China, the Ottoman Empire and four minor powers driven by the game.

• Scenarios: switch off whole continents to play a shorter, tighter game with fewer players.

• Simultaneous planning: everyone plans at the same time, so turns move quickly even with many players.

• Save and resume at any moment.

• Fully playable in English and Italian.

data.name: Chaos Budz
data.detailed_description:
Team Physics, Zero Coordination

Join the world’s most unstable task force.. which is.. exactly you and your buddies!

 

Experimental Training Program

Complete special obstacle stations designed to prepare you for deep-space missions.. while your teammates accidentally make everything worse.

 

Features

· Grab objects, walls, your budz

· Swing, Dash, Climb, Jump

· Jetpacks

· Voice chat

· Online Co-Op (1-8 Players)

· Tether gun

· Punch aliens

· Punch obstacles

· Punch your friends..

· Kick them too

· Obstacles.. A lot

· Experimental items

 

Find creative (certainly not annoying) ways to do even the simplest stuff.

  

 

Timing is everything.. as long as your teammates don't intercept.

 

 

You can catch your breath too, while making an Olympic jump.

 

 

Space tech glasses.. guaranteed fall.

 

Oh and yes, you can grab your friends and accidentally “lose” them to open space in more ways than we probably should admit. Built-in voice chat will make those moments unforgettable.

data.name: 明天照常营业
data.detailed_description:
To survive in the warzone, it’s not your conscience that counts, but your ability to read the situation. On this street, which is under the watchful eye of the military police and undercover agents, your shop’s business depends entirely on those familiar faces of “dubious origin.” You used to be a courier; with funds allocated by the organization and through certain circumstances best left unsaid, you managed to take over this shop. Now, inspections are growing increasingly strict, and various factions are watching you closely—yet your most valuable “merchandise” has never been on the counter.

You can never know for sure who’s standing across the counter. Today’s customer might be an undercover agent who came to buy cigarettes while keeping tabs on you, a guerrilla fighter in desperate need of medicine, or just a neighbor driven to the brink by the war. Every transaction is a high-stakes gamble. Whether you’re taking payment openly, passing goods discreetly, pretending not to recognize someone, or deliberately leaving a clue—there’s always someone in the shadows watching your every move. Your connections on the street can shield you from some trouble, but they can also draw unwanted attention. On this street, everyone who walks through the door could be either a windfall or a disaster.

No matter how well your business is doing this week, the “protection money” keeps rising over time. Once you fall behind on payments, the consequences are very real: your store will lose the support of the neighborhood, foot traffic will drop, normal revenue will decline, and your cash shortfall will grow ever larger. To turn things around, you’ll often have to take on riskier “delivery” jobs, just to keep your cash flow afloat. You can choose to play it safe, or you can pour money into stockpiling scarce goods to reap huge profits. But if that shipment is seized, fails to clear customs, or simply ends up sitting on your hands, you might not have enough money left to grease the wheels for the next round. Every purchase must be carefully calculated, and every risky move comes with a heavy price. How long your partners in this line of work will wait for you depends on how much longer your shop can hold out.

data.name: I tried to rob a bank, sexy cops and now are after me.
data.detailed_description:
In I tried to rob a bank, sexy cops and now are after me you assume the role of a professional thief who plans to break into a bank and pull off the biggest heist of your career. Each mission is a game of strategy and risk where quick decisions and well-calculated bluffs determine your fate. Combat is resolved through a turn-based card-battle system that blends tactics, resource management, and RPG elements.

The forces of law won't make it easy. A special unit of female officers, charismatic and dangerous, hunts you with unique abilities and distinct combat styles. data.detailed_description:
"Feng Shen Bang 2022" is a traditional large-scale turn-based role-playing game, the game tells the legendary story of Nezha and others helping Zhou Fachang.

In this work, an orthodox script with eight chapters is included:
Stage1 "Nezha Naps the Sea"
Stage2 "Hell Adventure"
Stage3 "Four Wicked Men"
Stage4 "Four Generals of the Magic House"
Stage5 "Rescue Nishiki"
Stage6 "Seven Monsters of Meishan"
Stage7 "The War News"
Stage8 "Offensive Chaoge"

Turn-based system and special gameplay

In this work, thousands of enemy monsters are on the stage, and the enemy monsters will release special skills as their levels increase.
In this work, a variety of items can be collected through plots and hiding, and they can be used in battle to strengthen our army's combat capabilities.
In this work, the number of hidden objects that can be found is close to hundreds.
In this work, a variety of treasures can be obtained through scripts and hiding. These treasures can be used to improve our combat ability.
In this work, the skills of each character are unique, and each character can perform its own functions.
In this work, the equipment can be upgraded through specific props, and the upgraded equipment may have new hidden effects.
In this work, battle data statistics are provided, and you can see the benefits of players in the battle.

Chapter One Nezha’s Trouble in the Sea

Nezha was born with supernatural power, set off huge waves in the sea, stirred the Dragon Palace, and offended the Sihailongwang. The dragon kings cast a spell to drop heavy rain and Chentangguan was flooded. In order to calm the flood, Nezha made a big disturbance in the Sihailong Palace...

Chapter Two: Adventures in Hell

The real Nezha Taiyi gave instructions to go to hell to practice. In the hell, Nezha needs to defeat ten palace kings to return to the world.

Chapter Three The Four Wicked Men

Nezha got the help of good friends Xiaolongnv and Yang Jian along the way, and the three of them worked together to defeat the four evil men who harmed one party and eliminated harm for the people.

Chapter Four The Four Generals of the Magic Family

Nezha and his party came to Jiadong Town, where they eliminated the human-eating monster Flower Fox Mink, and then they moved on and came to the daughter country, defeated the monster Pipa Jing, rescued Huang Tianhua, and got it from Huang Tianhua After that, Nezha and the others defeated the four demon generals who guarded Jia Mengguan with the drill, and they were able to move on.

Chapter Five Rescue Xiqi

Nezha and his party came to Xiqi City and found that there was a plague in Xiqi City. In a dream, Yang Jian got the guidance of Master Yuquan, and learned that the immortals in Huoyun Cave had medicine for the plague, so they went to Huoyun Cave. The immortals in China asked for medicine, and finally they succeeded in asking for medicine and successfully cured the plague in Xiqi City.

Chapter Six The Seven Monsters of Meishan

After Nezha and his party went on to destroy the two magical monsters Taojing and Liugui next to Qipanshan, they came to Meishan Town and learned that there were seven human-shaped monsters in the town that were harming people, so they found the end. The fairy Yun Zhongzi on Nanshan borrowed a mirror to take the magic mirror and finally wiped out the monsters in Meishan Town.

Chapter Seven The Great Master Wen Wen

Nezha and others came to Qinglong Pass. Unexpectedly, there was a strong wind at Qinglong Pass, which made it impossible to get close to Qinglong Pass. Nezha and others went on to arrive at Wansha Village. They did not expect to be ambushed by Master Wen. Jiang Ziya caught the sound. Taishi’s soul-locking curse fell, and everyone ran around and finally learned the way to save Jiang Ziya. After that, they found the grass man and saved Jiang Ziya. Jiang Ziya was in a coma under the guidance of Master Yuanshi Tianzun and learned of the strong wind at Qinglong Pass. They needed to use the Ding Fengzhu to stay there before they could get close to Qinglong Pass. Finally, they borrowed the Ding Fengzhu to settle the gale, and fought a fierce battle with Master Wen, and finally defeated Master Wen.

Chapter eight Attacking Chaoge

After all the hardships, everyone finally came to Chaoge City. They learned that the blood gourd was Daji’s nemesis in Baishi Village. After that, they found the blood gourd in the maelstrom and began to advance towards Chaoge City when they were ready. After destroying Da Ji’s two younger sisters, Pipa Jing and Pheasant Jing, Da Ji fled back to her old nest Xuanyuan Tomb, after which everyone went to Xuanyuan Tomb and destroyed Da Ji, and found a large number of magic weapons from her lair. After getting on the magic weapon, everyone went to the Star Picking Tower and defeated King Zhou. King Zhou had a magical body and could not destroy him directly. Everyone had to go to the fairy for help. The fairy gave Nezha and the others an ancient artifact Nine Dragons cover, and everyone finally The Nine Dragon Mask successfully eliminated King Zhou and saved the people of the world. Since then, the world is peaceful and the people live and work in peace and contentment. After success, Nezha and others continued their practice.

-----------------------

NO.1 Weihe Dragon King

When Nezha and others came to the Weihe Dragon Palace, they encountered constant provocations by the arrogant Weihe Dragon King. They had no choice but to compete with the Weihe Dragon King and defeat the Weihe Dragon Queen. The Weihe Dragon King gifted him with a dragon ball and asked Nezha and others to help find the Moonlight Treasure. Box, Nezha and others came to the sea cave to find the Moonlight Treasure Box, but they encountered the deep sea giant shark. After a hard fight, they finally defeated the deep sea giant shark. Finally, Nezha and others found the Moonlight Treasure Box in the sea cave. It was handed over to the Weihe Dragon King. The Weihe Dragon King obeyed the agreement and gifted the dragon ball to Nezha. After that, Nezha and others left Weihe and continued on.

NO.2 Humming two generals

The second general of Erlongshan was invited by Shen Gongbao, the national teacher of the Shang Dynasty, to stop Nezha and others. The second general of Humha trained the impervious body of King Kong. In order to defeat the second general, Nezha and others came to the vicinity of Erlong Mountain. Xianshan looked for ways to restrain the two generals of Huo Ha, and happened to encounter a Taoist with a profound knowledge of the truth of the two generals. In order to defeat the second general, Nezha and others paid a lot of money to ask the Taoist for help. Yuan Wu Lei Dafa was given to Nezha, and then Nezha and others used this spell to defeat the second general, Huo Ha, and then Nezha and others continued on their way.

NO.3 Ten Definite Array

Nezha and others broke into Jin'ao Island, and happened to see the ten immortals of Jin'ao Island finishing the ten perfect array. The two sides did not speculate and provoke each other. The ten immortals of Jin'ao Island asked Nezha and others to break the formation, and Nezha was full of blood. , I didn't know the murderous intent in the formation, and directly agreed to break the formation, and finally, after hard work and paid a huge price, finally broke the Shijue formation and defeated the Ten Immortals of Jin'ao Island.

NO.4 Jiuqu Yellow River Array

The big disciple Zhao Gongming of Biyou Palace was invited by Taishi Wen to come to Qinglongguan to help out. With the help of Taoist Lu Ya, Nezha and others killed Zhao Gongming with the nail-headed seven arrows. The fairy of Sanxian Island is In order to help Zhao Gongming get revenge, Zhao Gongming’s younger sister set up the Jiuqu Yellow River Array. Finally, with the help of the Weihe Dragon King, Nezha and others broke the Jiuqu Yellow River Array and defeated Fairy Sanxiao. March towards Chaoge.

NO.5 Zhuxian Formation

Nezha and others came near Chaoge, who knew that Shen Gongbao laid down the Zhuxian formation, preparing to destroy Nezha and others. The Zhuxian formation is infinitely powerful, and the four swords in the formation are unstoppable. Fortunately, Nezha and others are highly skilled. After breaking through various obstacles, he finally drew out the four swords of Zhuxian and broke the Zhuxian formation. Shen Gongbao saw this and made chaos with the magic treasure and took the opportunity to escape.

NO.6 Ten Thousand Immortals

Nezha and the rest of the army pressed the realm, Shen Gongbao invited the masters of the Biyou Palace to join forces to set up the Ten Thousand Immortal Array, ready to fight with Nezha and the others. The ten thousand immortal formations are full of murderous intent, and there are many masters, Nezha and others pass by. Fighting hard, paying a huge price, finally defeated the master in the formation, broke the Wanxian formation, and finally Shen Gongbao was rescued by a mysterious force. After Nezha and others broke the Wanxian formation, the last barrier of Chaoge City was Breaking, in order to eliminate King Zhou as soon as possible, Nezha and the others struck the iron while it was hot and launched an attack on Chaoge City.

data.name: Unilife
data.detailed_description:
Unilife est un jeu de survie et de RPG passionnant qui vous plonge dans un monde post-apocalyptique où vous devez affronter des vagues d'ennemis impitoyables et survivre pour protéger votre base. Dans ce monde dévasté, les ressources sont rares et les dangers sont omniprésents. À chaque étape, vous devez rassembler des matériaux, crafter des équipements et améliorer vos compétences pour devenir plus fort et repousser les forces ennemies.

Caractéristiques principales :

Un mélange unique de survie et de RPG : Survivez dans un monde brutal tout en développant votre personnage et en améliorant vos compétences pour vaincre des ennemis de plus en plus redoutables.

Affrontez des vagues d'ennemis : Les hordes d'ennemis se renforcent à chaque vague, vous obligeant à adapter votre stratégie et à améliorer constamment votre équipement pour survivre.

Système de progression profond : Commencez au niveau 1 et gagnez de l'expérience pour monter de niveau, débloquer de nouvelles compétences, améliorer votre équipement et augmenter vos chances de survie.

Crafting et gestion des ressources : Explorez le monde dévasté pour collecter des ressources, fabriquer des armes, des armures et des objets utiles pour vous aider dans votre quête de survie.

Une base à protéger et à améliorer : Retournez à votre base entre les vagues d'ennemis pour déposer votre butin, améliorer vos défenses et préparer la prochaine bataille.

Un monde post-apocalyptique immersif : Découvrez un univers sombre et dévasté avec des environnements variés, des ennemis uniques et une histoire captivante.

Rejoignez Unilife et relevez le défi ultime de la survie dans un monde où chaque décision compte. Saurez-vous vaincre les vagues d'ennemis et protéger votre base jusqu'à la fin ?

data.name: 12 MONTHS TO LAUNCH
data.detailed_description:
🎲 A lighthearted resource-management game of running an indie game studio!

Experience 12 intense months in-game, and a spectacular masterpiece will launch! You are that producer!

 

🎲 Key Features

• Manage and grow your own indie game studio as a rookie entrepreneur out to prove your worth!

• Unlock and expand your empire: from a cramped studio to meeting rooms, game expos, and publisher deals!

• Tackle crises that threaten your project during both development and publishing!

• Recruit a team of partners — there's strength in numbers!

• Experience five distinct endings!

 

🎲 ——Will you end up a meme among players, or a legend in the gaming world?

data.name: Orcish Inn
data.detailed_description:
Orcish inn is a tavern simulation game in which you take the role of an innkeeper starting out in unsettled lands. You gather resources, farm all sorts of crops like hops and oat, brew your own beers, construct a tavern piece by piece and welcome various orcish clans to your very own place. The game interweaves aspects of management and simulation with those of survival and exploration.

  • FARMING: Plant and harvest various types of crops like hops, oat, sugar-beets, tomatoes and many more, which are then sold, eaten or used as beer flavor.
  • BREWING: Brew your own types of beer and influence your guests by defining the beers' taste, tint brightness, full body, bitterness, alcoholic strength and flavor.
  • PRODUCING: Gather and process resources, like chopping trees for logs and process them into lumber planks and decorative planks spent in building and crafting.
  • CONSTRUCTING: Construct buildings like brewing facilities, taverns or dorm rooms by putting down walls and floors and decorate the created rooms with crafted furniture.
  • SERVING: Serve the visiting orcish clans by fulfilling their wishes, fine-tune prices or the beer's taste or risk getting battered in a huge pub brawl.
  • AND MORE: Raise and breed animals like pigeons, which swirl around and bring back useful items, or wrest valuable treasures from the ocean with your fishing rod.

The game is in development since 2014 and the unfinished pre-alpha is currently available for free.

data.name: BeatWordz
data.detailed_description:
See it. Say it. Stay on beat

BeatWordz is the loud, high-energy party game your microphone was made for. It’s a race against the rhythm where your brain and mouth battle for control. From literal images to random words, you have to hit every syllable perfectly on the beat. It sounds easy until the room is watching and the music kicks into high gear.

Hear the chaos

Nothing beats hearing your friends trip over their own tongues under pressure. Our Recap Mode brings the group's actual voice recordings to life through their custom avatars, making every round a hilariously honest breakdown of who kept the beat and who just made weird noises.

Choose your stage

Whether you’re looking for a personal challenge or a loud party night, there is a mode for every vibe.

  • Single Player: Sharpen your vocal timing and master the high-energy tracks in private.

  • Online with Friends: Host private rooms and bring the vocal chaos to your remote party nights.

  • Couch Mode: The classic "Pass the Mic" experience. Take turns and see who survives the rhythm in person.

Note: A microphone is required to play.

data.name: Robin's Island Adventure
data.detailed_description:
There is an island in the ocean that's lost in the fog and absent from all geography maps. The seafarer suffers a shipwreck and gets washed ashore an island. He attempts to find a way out, as he develops a relationship with the natives.
The ultimate objective is to build a ship and leave the island. But first the player must build a house, a boat, and other strategic objects, all the while helping the natives with their problems. The final task is to build a vessel and sail away.
The point of the game is to complete the levels Match 3 and receive access to Hidden Objects and Puzzles, at which point the player can begin to build objects.

Key features:

  • Incredible locations
  • Awesome gameplay
  • Original game world
  • 18 building structures
  • 123 diverse levels
  • 2 game modes: Normal & Time Challenge

  • Diverse Enemies: Face a variety of enemies, each with unique abilities and strengths, requiring different strategies to defeat.
  • Epic Boss Battles: Prepare to face formidable bosses with challenging mechanics and tactics, testing your strategic skills.
  • Drag and drop system to create the perfect defense.

data.name: Heidentum
data.detailed_description:
In Heidentum you play against up to 3 other players in online matches, strategy is the focus point of the game, the way the game flows makes sure you always use different strategies, some reasons down below.

- The landscape and environment are totally randomized every game, its procedural generated so the combinations are basically infinite.

- The neutral creatures have all base stats plus a random value that make's them sometimes stronger and other times weaker.

- Your unit's speciality are randomized, so you have to adapt your strategy to fit what you get.

- Each Paganism have different Strength's and Weakness, so the gameplay differ's from each other.


Mixing those you get infinite possibilities in games, that's done to let players use their wisdom at full capacity, not blocking them to certain strategies.

data.name: OSCILLARIS
data.detailed_description:
OSCILLARIS is a text-command RPG that takes place inside of an oscilloscope. Type your way through its wireframe streets, talk to programs who live there, use your words to defeat rouge signals! The game wanted to be found, now its up to you.

SOMETHING WAS HERE BEFORE YOU

OSCILLARIS is built on the ruins of its predecessor. It's programs don't remember what came before, but the world does. If you know where to look.

FEATURES

  • Type commands to walk, examine and interact with the world

  • Explore the wireframe world and find secrets within it's glowing vector lines

  • Meet programs with their own personalities and story to unfold

  • Survive incoming signals with their own agendas with your spelling skills and letter play

  • Discover fragments of a past that remembers more about you than yourself

NOT EVERY SIGNAL IS FRIENDLY

An echo remains from the past, running somewhere in the code. Explore the BOOT sector, but don't go looking for something you won't want to find.

Good luck!

data.name: Mawgate
data.detailed_description:
MAWGATE

Mawgate is a short narrative-driven survival horror game set in the 19th century.

Maria Moore, a young woman deemed “hysterical” under mysterious circumstances, awakens inside Mawgate Asylum, alone, disoriented, and abandoned. Her husband, William, is nowhere to be found.

Something has gone terribly wrong.

The asylum is no longer a place of treatment, but of terror. Twisted creatures roam its halls, and whatever happened the night Maria was taken has turned Mawgate into a waking nightmare.

Born into poverty and thrust into aristocratic life through marriage, Maria never belonged in the world she was forced into. Independent, strong-willed, and unwilling to conform, she dreamt of freedom, travel, art, a life beyond expectation.

data.name: Infest
data.detailed_description:
Infest is a roguelike deckbuilder where every pixel on the battlefield can burn, freeze, corrode, shock, and melt. Carefully craft your deck and deploy cards to alter the environment, buff your stats, and unleash stunning pixel-by-pixel damage upon your enemies!

Turn-based battle combined with realtime physics.

Fire, Oil, Ice, Poison Gas, Water, Seeds and Growing Plants are just a few of the elements you'll have to strategically navigate.

(A pixel chain reaction after deploying a LightningCard)

Customize your deck and upgrade cards along the way. Make sure it is well balanced to handle a variety of environmental effects. Can you melt ice? Can you stop mutant plants? Foresight is key.

Deal damage card by card, when your stack is exhausted the enemies get their chance to attack! They will create defensive barriers, throw damage cards at you, buff themselves and heal others! Anticipating their moves and playing the right card is key.

Choose your path through the alien universe. Each run is different so you can replay many times without getting bored. Besides the playable levels, you'll encounter shops, hospitals, and dozens of different bonus challenges. Picking the right path is key to survival.

Features

Pixel by pixel simulated physics

Roguelite style permadeath

Dozens of side-rooms, shops, hospitals, mini-challenges

Dozens of playable cards, perks, and items

Dozens of playable levels with procedural generation

Advanced tech tree for leveling up cards

Achievements and Steam Cloud

data.name: BREACH IT
data.detailed_description:
BREACH IT is a team based shooter with focus on tactics and DESTRUCTIBILITY!
If you are attacking and you know that an enemy is behind a wall then just make a hole in that wall with explosives or a hammer and shoot the unsuspecting enemy! As a defender you have ability to reinforce walls or board the doors to create a "castle" which will be harder for the attackers to breach. With time game will be getting more and more special abilities for attackers and defenders. So far special abilities for attackers: explosives, hammer and shield. For defenders: ability to reinforce walls and board doors.

MULTIPLAYER UP TO 6 PEOPLE:

Use communication and tactics to win in close quarters 3vs3 matches.

TWO GAME MODES:

"BREACH" objective is to eliminate enemy team.

"BOMB" objective is to defuse the bomb or if you're defending - protect the bomb.

BOT SUPPORT:

Choose the "BREACH" game mode and if after 30 seconds no one connects, bots will spawn in automatically.

OCULUS RIFT SUPPORT:

Run the game in compatibility mode to play "BREACH IT" on Oculus Rift + Touch.

SCHEDULED PLAY TIMES:

NORTH AMERICA: every Tuesday and Thursday 9PM EST, Saturdays 1PM EST.

EUROPE: every Tuesday and Thursday 6PM BST, Saturdays 1PM BST.

Once a prominent streamer, you're now unemployed and drowning in financial troubles—until a lifeline suddenly appears: Akari, the youngest daughter of a prestigious local family, has one goal—getting into a top-tier university—and she's in desperate need of a private tutor.

- A simple and intuitive interface, to help you focus on your lessons!

data.name: KeepFighting
data.detailed_description:
KeepFighting! is an incremental RPG built around charming SD pixel art, auto-battle action, and satisfying long-term progression.
Send your tiny hero into battle, collect resources after each fight, and invest them into upgrades that push your next run even further.

What begins as a small adventure gradually opens into a larger battlefield filled with stronger enemies, tougher bosses, and more upgrade choices.
Each decision improves your efficiency, and every layer of growth feeds into the next, creating the rewarding loop that makes incremental games so compelling.

Key features:

  • Charming SD-style pixel art

  • Incremental progression with a strong sense of momentum

  • Post-battle upgrades that keep every run meaningful

  • Multiple growth paths through skill trees, shops, and relics

  • Easy to enjoy casually, with plenty of room for optimization

Watch a small, adorable hero grow into a force capable of conquering an ever-expanding battlefield.

data.name: Summer Mission
data.detailed_description:
[Story outline]
A story about going back to the past and trying to make up with "Sayuri," who broke up a week ago.

The stage begins in December 2021 with Sayuri's funeral.

Towa, the main character, received a "ticket that allows him to go back to the past for only three days" from a mysterious woman wearing Gothic Lolita.

However, the destination of the time slip was the summer of 1980. Sayuri was still 15 years old, the same as Towa.


In addition, Sayuri loves "Student Organization Inside School (Rei)" instead of "Grandpa (Seige)" .



"I wouldn't be born as it is !?"


~~~~~~~
[3D animation]
This game consists of 3 parts.

・ 3D animation
・ 3D exploration
・ 2D novel


Above all, the 3D animation part is a must-see.
Motion capture is used for face and hand movements.
Please enjoy the production as if the character is actually speaking and the small changes in facial expressions.

Don't miss the voices of the four voice actors and the last impression.

~~~~~~~
[Sub-event with townspeople]

Apart from the main story, there will be submissions to help people in need.

There are 12 submissions in all, and you can enjoy interacting with all 30 townspeople.

(example)
Events with the theme of "disco" and "song programs" that are conscious of the historical background of 1980, etc.

~~~~~~~

[Three endings]
On the night of the first day, the story changes greatly depending on "who will stay" among "Sayuri", "Seige", and "Rei".

The story ends in three ways.

Can Towa really make up with Sayuri ...?


Play time: 2-3 hours

data.name: Purr Box
data.detailed_description:
A little box, plenty of purrs and a cozy corner to call your own.

In Purr Box, every new kitten brings more life to a cozy little pixel art room. Click the box, collect purrs, welcome new friends and turn little moments of affection into a collection full of whiskers.

MORE PAWS, MORE LOVE

From Ginger to Rainbow Cloud, discover kittens of different breeds and rarities. Pet them, answer their requests for playtime and treats, and join in at snack time. With every little heart, your feline family keeps growing.

Spend your purrs in the shop to unlock upgrades, boost production and welcome even more kittens. When it's time for the Big Nap, start again with Golden Yarn Balls and bonuses to continue your journey.

CUTE COMPANY FOR YOUR DAY

In pet mode, your kittens wander around your desktop while you study, work or go about your day. The little box stays close by, with access to the shop, minigames and your memories.

Want to plan a focus session? The Pomodoro timer keeps you company through periods of concentration and rest, with a little meow to remind you to take a break.

A BREAK TO PLAY

Find matching pairs in the memory game, jump over obstacles in Ginger's Run or uncover safe squares in Cat Sweeper. Three ways to spend a little more time with your companions, both in the room and in pet mode.

LITTLE MOMENTS, BIG MEMORIES

Complete diary tasks, discover new breeds and unlock photos to fill your album. Each memory tells a little piece of your story with the kittens, and a few surprises are waiting to be found.

YOUR CORNER, YOUR PACE

Care for your collection in short sessions or stay a little longer to watch your purrs grow. Once passive production is unlocked, your kittens also collect purrs while the game is closed, up to the offline progress limit.

Open the little box. A new friend is waiting for you.

data.name: Olympia Rising
data.detailed_description:
Olympia Rising is a 2-D action platformer starring Iola - a young warrior who has been cast into the Underworld after meeting an untimely end. She must navigate through the various twisted regions of Hades' domain, fighting through hoards of deadly creatures as she attempts her escape, making her way to Mount Olympus. Lush pixel graphics and fluid animation bring this stylized world to life as you jump, climb, slash, and incinerate your way through each stage.Taking inspiration from beloved titles such as Castlevania, Sonic the Hedgehog, and Kid Icarus, Olympia Rising delivers an exciting, action-filled experience.

- Fight your way through the Underworld, battling creatures of all shapes and sizes. Fast-paced aerial combat propels you upward as you slash enemies to bits with your blade or incinerate them with powerful magic.

- Navigate through deadly environments with fluid maneuverability. Make your own paths as you traverse through each stage looking for the most efficient way to climb to the top.

- Fierce boss encounters await Iola at the end of each Underworldy region - from gargantuan crabs to bone-crunching cyclops'.

-Chain enemy kills as you jump through the air - build up a big combo to earn even more coins to pay Charon the Ferryman and pass through the many gates of the Underworld.

- Simple to pick-up but difficult to master, Olympia Rising awards those willing to challenge themselves as they climb through the Underworld. Collect coins and other treasures scattered throughout the levels as you race through each stage.

- Explore 6 unique, twisted environments of the Underworld - each offering different challenges and creatures to overcome.

data.name: Gardens Of Celestial Globes
data.detailed_description:
LOCATIONS:
Cursed Lands,
Enchanted Valley,
Abandoned Arboretum,
Ice Canyon,
Dark Dungeons,
Mushroom Gorges,
Coral Desert,
Putrid Catacombs.
RACES:
CRAB WARRIORS are crab-like creatures covered with durable armor. They activated during a long battle, becoming more aggressive. Crab Warriors excel in defense.
ELEMENTALS are the creations generated by magical energy. A special magical attraction allows their bodies to maintain their shape. Elementals excel at manipulating magic.
KEEPERS OF TIME are the embodiments of periods of eternity formed by mixing time and space. They are superior to everyone else in the control of time.
PARASITES are the countless clusters of endoparasitic worms. They live in the ducts of their secretion. Parasites excel in antagonism.
ALCHEMISTS are the creatures who have devoted themselves to the study of the nature of magical matter. They heal wounds by the universal composition, which they concentrate from disintegrated fragments of hypermaterial clouds. Alchemists excel in the ability to regenerate.
MYCELIUM are the vegetative bodies of highly developed fungi. They feed on electricity, which they need to maintain the higher functions of the mind. They can grow wherever there is a source of electricity. Mycelium excels in possession of lightning.
DRAGONFLY is the materialized hallucinations caused by the fumes of dangerous bromine compounds, known for their ability to ignite other elements quickly. They cause a dangerous state of "bad trip," from which there is no way back. Dragonfly excels in possession of fire.
SOUL ABSORBERS are the primitive creatures that mutated by feeding on the arcane. Astral mystical energy, permeating their bodies, complements their primitive instincts, creating a most dangerous combination. Soul Absorbers excel in possession of the arcane.
WAR OS is the bio-robots in high-tech suits. They are under the control of a combat operating system while using high technologies to calculate and destroy enemies. War OS surpass everyone else in speed.
SHADOW SPINNERS are the arachnid insects predators that once have entirely fused with their shadow. Their spider webs are very durable, and their wool practically does not reflect light. Shadow Spinners excel at stealth.
each has more than ten abilities, five buildings and three satellites that open up access to unique weapons in keeping with the effect of a special aura.

† 3 game modes: ARENA, QUEST, TOWER
† random world generator working with 30 level templates
† 77 identified creatures that inhabit the game world
† 103 (simple) items and 23 crafted artifacts
† many kinds of structures and map objects (181)

data.name: Driftfort: The Drowned World
data.detailed_description:
Four planks. Endless water. Whatever you pull from the sea becomes your home.

Driftfort: The Drowned World combines survival, raft building and resource management on the open sea. Hook drifting supplies, catch fish, and turn a tiny platform into a base with workshops, gardens and machines. By day, your home grows. At night, you defend it.

From driftwood to a floating home

Expand your raft with permanent upgrades for up to 128 deck tiles. Plan workshops and storage, secure the edges, and leave room for your next idea.

Make the deck your own with different floor finishes, flags, writable signs, plants, furniture and display cases for your finds. Take a seat on a deck bench or let your character rest in a hammock.

Build supplies that keep working

A sip of drinking water becomes a supply system: purify seawater, grow crops, and organize your stores.

Progress to solar panels, batteries, irrigation and automatic fishing. Manufacturing stations process orders while you focus on salvage, exploration or your next expansion.

When the deep reaches your deck

Night changes your priorities. Light your raft, prepare your weapons, and defend your platforms against creatures from the deep.

Weather, changing sea regions and encounters along the way make preparation matter. What you build by day must hold up after dark.

A coast beyond the horizon

Travel through five sea regions with different resources, weather and dangers. Recover supplies and explore encounters along your route.

Go ashore to discover beaches, forest paths and supply locations, then restore the lighthouse in three repair stages. After reaching the campaign goal, you can keep building and maintaining your base.

Your pace, your choices

Choose from eight characters, customize their equipment, and shape your journey with three difficulty settings and six travel speeds. Building and crafting recommendations help you get started; search and filters support your larger projects.

Features

  • Single-player survival with raft building, salvage, fishing and crafting
  • Gardening, water purification, energy and automatic production
  • Personal deck layouts with furniture, flags, signs and display cases
  • Day and night, weather, five sea regions and attacks from the deep
  • An explorable coast and a campaign goal at the lighthouse
  • Eight characters, three difficulty settings and six travel speeds
  • Eight supported text languages and multiple local campaigns with backups

Upon arrival, you find an abandoned pier and realize that you lost fuel on the way due to a leak...

data.name: Numina
data.detailed_description:
Step through the 4th Wall…


…into the world of NUMINA. You get in contact with Shawn who is able to hear your voice through the 4th wall! You meet in a very critical moment where Shawn loses someone very close to him while being swept up in a conspiracy that involves your mutual bond. A plot threatening to shake the foundations of the world.

The world of Alterna is filled with a mysterious power called Life's Breath. It enables magic, fueled technological advances, and brought great prosperity to many. Ships no longer needed to solely depend on wind, perishable food could be refrigerated, and barren soil brought bountiful harvests with Life's Breath.

This was all done under the supervision of the Ecclesia, an omnipresent organization representing the teachings of Proserpina: a goddess who once walked Alterna like a normal human and brought the gift of Life's Breath to all. In Alterna, no one doubts Proserpina's existence, as her body is freely displayed to all in Ecclesia's center of power, Cor. In her favor temples are erected everywhere, which allow Life's Breath to flow into the world. But is it really that simple?

Shawn and you slowly uncover the dark secret of Ecclesia and together you will experience a captivating adventure that combines many classic RPG aspects: A character-driven story in which your relationships change the course of the story, a dynamic battle system, challenging puzzles, towns waiting to be explored and other exciting locations!

✨ Play the full story now!! ✨
Numina released in two parts. The base game was released in July '22 and Part II released as DLC in March '23.

Key Features

  • Breaking the 4th Wall
    The 4th wall is a concept from theater where the actors on stage directly interact with the audience. In the same fashion, you partake in the story of Numina as a character in the form of a bodiless voice that only Shawn can hear - a guardian spirit. You can interact with Shawn and influence his decisions through dialogue choices in the game.

  • Branching Decisions
    The decisions you make influences the relationship Shawn has with the other characters you'll meet in the game. Having good relationships with your party members unlocks powerful combo-attacks in battle and may open up the opportunity to take your relationship to the next level ♥ Your decisions also influence the overall course of the story to conclude into one of the four possible endings.

  • Battle with the Elements
    Engage in a round-based combat system with action inputs for some attacks that require you to make timed inputs for maximum damage! Each character also has unique elemental abilities to exploit enemy weaknesses. Incorporate this into your strategy to quickly win battles.

  • Explore the World of Alterna
    Most side quests in NUMINA allow you to dive deeper into the backstory and lore of the world. But you can also explore the beautiful scenery with your grappling hook to reach higher places and find new gear, spell scrolls or rare items.

This was all done under the supervision of the Ecclesia, an omnipresent organization representing the teachings of Proserpina: a goddess who once walked Alterna like a normal human and brought the gift of Life's Breath to all. In Alterna, no one doubts Proserpina's existence, as her body is freely displayed to all in Ecclesia's center of power, Cor. In her favor temples are erected everywhere, which allow Life's Breath to flow into the world. But is it really that simple?

Shawn and you slowly uncover the dark secret of Ecclesia and together you will experience a captivating adventure that combines many classic RPG aspects: A character-driven story in which your relationships change the course of the story, a dynamic battle system, challenging puzzles, towns waiting to be explored and other exciting locations!

✨ Play the full story now!! ✨
Numina released in two parts. The base game was released in July '22 and Part II released as DLC in March '23.

Key Features

  • Breaking the 4th Wall
    The 4th wall is a concept from theater where the actors on stage directly interact with the audience. In the same fashion, you partake in the story of Numina as a character in the form of a bodiless voice that only Shawn can hear - a guardian spirit. You can interact with Shawn and influence his decisions through dialogue choices in the game.

  • Branching Decisions
    The decisions you make influences the relationship Shawn has with the other characters you'll meet in the game. Having good relationships with your party members unlocks powerful combo-attacks in battle and may open up the opportunity to take your relationship to the next level ♥ Your decisions also influence the overall course of the story to conclude into one of the four possible endings.

  • Battle with the Elements
    Engage in a round-based combat system with action inputs for some attacks that require you to make timed inputs for maximum damage! Each character also has unique elemental abilities to exploit enemy weaknesses. Incorporate this into your strategy to quickly win battles.

  • Explore the World of Alterna
    Most side quests in NUMINA allow you to dive deeper into the backstory and lore of the world. But you can also explore the beautiful scenery with your grappling hook to reach higher places and find new gear, spell scrolls or rare items.
