data.name: 覇県を握れ ～47都道府県大戦～
data.detailed_description:
日本最強の都道府県を決める戦いが幕を開ける！
最強の経済力を持つ東京都か、最強の軍事力を持つ北海道か、最強の工業力を持つ愛知県か、それとも……。
統計データをもとに再現した47都道府県。果たして、覇県を握るのはどこだ！？

◆ゲーム概要

47の都道府県から１つ選び、内政、外交、軍事をフル活用して、天下一の都道府県を目指すのが目的。
財政難と戦争の波に飲まれて消えていくか、それとも日本を制するかは、県知事である君の手にかかっている！

◆財政

本作は実際の都道府県の財政状況を再現しているため、ほぼ全ての勢力が赤字だ。地方交付税交付金は降ってこないので、自らの手で財源を確保する必要がある。

経済発展に力を入れるのはもちろんの事、地方債を発行したり、税率を調整しなければ生き残る事はできない。しかし地方債を乱発すれば財政再建は遠のき、税率を上げれば人口が流出するだろう。

タックスヘイブンを実施して他県から人を呼び込んでみるか？
それとも、預金封鎖で県民から搾り取りながら軍拡に励むか？
様々な戦略が考えられる。

◆電力

電力は重要な戦略資源だ。不足すると経済が麻痺し、財政破綻に直結する。
東京都のように規模に見合った発電所を備えていない県は、他県から融通してもらうか、併合するなりして電力を確保しなければならない。

◆外交

どの県と仲良くするべきか、どこを滅ぼすつもりか、脅威になりそうな県はどこか。
生き残るには、自身の戦略と日本の情勢をもとに外交を展開しなければならない。
都道府県の実力差は大きく、外交ミスは即滅亡に繋がる。
しかし巧みな外交を展開すれば、弱小県でも覇県を握るチャンスはある。

◆合併

他の戦略SLGではまず見かけられない要素として、都道府県間の合併があげられる。
合併を繰り返せば、武力に訴えなくても勢力を拡大できる。
しかしながら、合併相手の債務残高も引き継ぐので、財政再建は困難になってしまう。
また平和的な合併でも、領土の拡張は他県を警戒させてしまうだろう。
もちろんAI同士の合併にも目を光らせておくべきだ。戦争相手が合併により突如巨大化……なんて事になったら目も当てられない。外交関係に介入して、合併を阻止しよう。

◆戦争

戦争が最善手とは限らない。
他県を占領しても、悲しいことに赤字県が多く財政改善には結びつきにくい(特に地方)。また戦争状態の県に住みたいと思う住人はおらず、人口の流出を招く危険もある。
しかし他県を占領すれば県勢が強まり外交をより有利に運べるようになり、産業設備などもごっそり手に入る。うまく仕掛ければ、覇県を握る近道になるだろう。
もちろん望まない戦争に巻き込まれる事も多々ある。どんな場合でも戦争に備えなければならない。

◆陸軍

陸軍は工業力で生産するため、愛知のような工業県は陸軍大国になりうる。また初期戦力なら北海道がダントツで一位である。
いかに海軍力と空軍力が高くても、首都エリアを落とされると負けなので、最も重要な戦力と言える。
歩兵、砲兵、高射、戦車、ヘリ部隊を運用して敵を打ち負かそう。

◆海軍

軍港を持つ青森、神奈川、京都、広島、長崎は、ゲーム開始時から広範囲の制海権を握っている。
制海権をとっていると、外交上の影響力を発揮しやすくなる。
また無慈悲な海上封鎖も行える。敵のあらゆる産業を停止に追い込み、その末路は財政破綻による滅亡である。

◆空軍

実態が航空自衛隊のため、対艦攻撃を得意としているが、必要であれば航空阻止や産業基盤に対する爆撃もこなす。
海軍にも言えることだが、効果的な運用にはレーダーサイトなどによる電子支援が必須だ。

◆謀略戦

直接的な武力攻撃以外にも、謀略戦が可能。
  • ふるさと納税をしかけて、相手の税収を奪う。
  • サイバー攻撃により敵の経済を破壊。
  • 企業誘致で産業を奪う。
  • クーデーターを扇動し、内政が脆弱な敵を滅亡させる。

陸空海と謀略戦を組み合わせて他県を打ち負かそう。

◆イデオロギー

  • 軍事に特化した「覇権」
  • 経済発展を追求する「繁栄」
  • 外交に特化した「平和」

平和憲法破棄、県境封鎖、経済特区、社会保障改革、平和都市宣言……。イデオロギーによって個性豊かな政策スキルが採用可能。
またどのイデオロギーを採用するかによって、外交関係が大きく変化する。

◆多様な勝利条件

覇県(勝利)とは、武力で天下統一を果たす事とは限らない。
  • 初期エリアを巨大都市にする首都勝利。
  • 財政健全化による財政再建勝利。
  • 占領や合併で領土を広げて領土勝利。
  • 自分以外のイデオロギーを全て滅ぼす、イデオロギー勝利。
  • 大国を築くか、他県を弱体化させて総合力勝利。

どの手段で覇県を握るのが向いているかは、県によって異なる。
例えば東京都で首都勝利を収めるのは簡単だが、鳥取県ではとてつもなく難しい。
沖縄県は陸路で繋がっていないため領土の拡張が絶望的に難しいが、引きこもって財政再建を目指すのにはうってつけ。
北海道は膨大な初期軍備で、一気に南下して領土勝利を掴むのに向いている。
都道府県の性質と戦略を見極め、覇県を握れ！

県勢再現へのこだわり

各県のパラメーターは、様々な統計データを元に設定している。

  • 人口
  • 経済力 → 県内総生産(内閣府)
  • 地方債を除いた赤字率 → 財政力指数(総務省)
  • 食糧生産量 → 食料自給率(農林水産省)
  • 発電量 → 都道府県別発電実績(資源エネルギー庁)など
  • 工業力 → 製造品出荷額等(経済産業省)
  • 造船力 → ドックサイズ推定合計値(独自調査)、造船業の現状(国土交通省)
  • 製油 → 製油所の所在地と原油処理能力(石油連盟)
  • 初期石油量 → 国家石油備蓄基地の規模(独立行政法人石油天然ガス・金属鉱物資源機構)
  • 魅力度 → 転出入者の割合(総務省統計局)など
  • 初期軍備 → 自衛隊の推定配備量(Wikipedia等)
  • 兵站設備 → 自衛隊の司令部や補給施設の有無(Wikipedia等)
  • レーダー → 自衛隊のレーダーの施設の有無(Wikipedia等)

造船力のような統計が存在しない項目に関しても、できる限り調査して再現を試みている。
具体的には日本全国の造船所の公式ページを片っ端から見る。ドックの数や容積を公表している会社はその数値を拾う。情報がない場合は衛星写真でドックを探し出し、縦横の長さから推定容積を算出し、都道府県ごとに合算。これを47都道府県分繰り返す。


本作を遊べば、ゲームを通じて都道府県の実力を知る事ができるだろう。

体験版(Demo)について

高価かつ複雑なゲームなので、まずは体験版で動作テストや、肌に合うかをお確かめください。
体験版は3年目の冒頭まで、全ての県で遊べます。またセーブデータは、同じパソコンなら自動で製品版に引き継がれます。

------------------------勢力例---------------------------

北海道

「手元には最強の軍隊がある。他県を"開拓"してやろうではないか！」

かつての対ソ防衛の関係で、最も分厚く自衛隊が配備されている。本作ではロシアと不可侵条約でも結んだのか、全戦力を南下に使えるようになっている。
ゲーム開始時の陸上戦力は、推定で東京都の17倍、島根県の290倍。さらに強力な空軍も擁する。もちろん食糧生産力も日本一。

その一方で財政赤字の金額は日本最悪。だだっ広い北の大地は、除雪費、空調費、インフラ維持費等でもりもり税金を溶かす。さすが「試される大地」と言われるだけの事はある。

日本を制するか、それとも財政赤字に呑み込まれて破産するかは、知事の腕次第だ。


東京都

「東京都の血税が、地方交付税交付金として田舎にばらまかれる事はもうない。」

巨大な人口と県内総生産を擁する日本の首都。その経済力は圧倒的で鳥取県のおよそ50倍。
ただし食料自給率は驚異の1%。さらに致命的な事に、電力は他県に頼っており、単独ではその力を発揮する事ができない。
そして高い魅力度により、他県から人口が流入するため、ただでさえ足りない電力がますます足りなくなる。
食糧不足と電力不足で機能不全を起こしたまま財政破綻を迎えるか、それとも首都としての貫禄を見せて覇県を握るかは、都知事である君の手にかかっている。


奈良県

「鹿せんべい食うか？」

全国で唯一陸上自衛隊の駐屯地がない県。航空自衛隊も実戦部隊はなく、内陸県なので当然海上自衛隊もいない。
さらに言うと、一人あたりの県内総生産は日本最下位(2016年基準)。
工業力も軍備も経済もないうえに、隣には強豪の大阪府がいる。
果たして古都の復活なるか……？


沖縄県

「今こそ、その苦汁をナイチャーにも味わわせるのだ！シマンチュよ立ち上がれ！」

当たり前だが、陸路で何県とも繋がっていない。
敵陸上部隊に攻められる心配は一切ないが、こちらも攻めれない。
この状況からどう覇県を握るかが、県知事の腕の見せどころ。




愛知県

「他県に自動車をもっと買ってもらわなければ。」

織田信長、豊臣秀吉、徳川家康。戦国三大武将を生み出した愛知県は、現代でも強力だ。
圧倒的１位の工業力を活かして、もりもり軍備が増強できる。
さらに経済力、電力等も高いレベルでまとまっており、何よりも周りは自分より弱い県ばかり。
織田信長のごとく、勢力を拡大していこう。

 

愛媛県

「願わくは、全国あまねく家庭の蛇口を捻ればポ○ジュースである。」

よく愛知県と間違えられる。
前作「四国志シリーズ」では、四国最強の県として君臨していたが、あくまで強いのは四国の中だけ。そもそも四国四県を足した所で、大阪どころか兵庫県の工業力や県内総生産にも届かないのでしかたない。
香川県と四国のリーダーを争うだけで終わるのか、それとも本土に進出できるかは県知事である君の手にかかっている。

  • 大国を築くか、他県を弱体化させて総合力勝利。

どの手段で覇県を握るのが向いているかは、県によって異なる。
例えば東京都で首都勝利を収めるのは簡単だが、鳥取県ではとてつもなく難しい。
沖縄県は陸路で繋がっていないため領土の拡張が絶望的に難しいが、引きこもって財政再建を目指すのにはうってつけ。
北海道は膨大な初期軍備で、一気に南下して領土勝利を掴むのに向いている。
都道府県の性質と戦略を見極め、覇県を握れ！

県勢再現へのこだわり

各県のパラメーターは、様々な統計データを元に設定している。

  • 人口
  • 経済力 → 県内総生産(内閣府)
  • 地方債を除いた赤字率 → 財政力指数(総務省)
  • 食糧生産量 → 食料自給率(農林水産省)
  • 発電量 → 都道府県別発電実績(資源エネルギー庁)など
  • 工業力 → 製造品出荷額等(経済産業省)
  • 造船力 → ドックサイズ推定合計値(独自調査)、造船業の現状(国土交通省)
  • 製油 → 製油所の所在地と原油処理能力(石油連盟)
  • 初期石油量 → 国家石油備蓄基地の規模(独立行政法人石油天然ガス・金属鉱物資源機構)
  • 魅力度 → 転出入者の割合(総務省統計局)など
  • 初期軍備 → 自衛隊の推定配備量(Wikipedia等)
  • 兵站設備 → 自衛隊の司令部や補給施設の有無(Wikipedia等)
  • レーダー → 自衛隊のレーダーの施設の有無(Wikipedia等)

造船力のような統計が存在しない項目に関しても、できる限り調査して再現を試みている。
具体的には日本全国の造船所の公式ページを片っ端から見る。ドックの数や容積を公表している会社はその数値を拾う。情報がない場合は衛星写真でドックを探し出し、縦横の長さから推定容積を算出し、都道府県ごとに合算。これを47都道府県分繰り返す。


本作を遊べば、ゲームを通じて都道府県の実力を知る事ができるだろう。

体験版(Demo)について

高価かつ複雑なゲームなので、まずは体験版で動作テストや、肌に合うかをお確かめください。
体験版は3年目の冒頭まで、全ての県で遊べます。またセーブデータは、同じパソコンなら自動で製品版に引き継がれます。

------------------------勢力例---------------------------

北海道

「手元には最強の軍隊がある。他県を"開拓"してやろうではないか！」

かつての対ソ防衛の関係で、最も分厚く自衛隊が配備されている。本作ではロシアと不可侵条約でも結んだのか、全戦力を南下に使えるようになっている。
ゲーム開始時の陸上戦力は、推定で東京都の17倍、島根県の290倍。さらに強力な空軍も擁する。もちろん食糧生産力も日本一。

その一方で財政赤字の金額は日本最悪。だだっ広い北の大地は、除雪費、空調費、インフラ維持費等でもりもり税金を溶かす。さすが「試される大地」と言われるだけの事はある。

日本を制するか、それとも財政赤字に呑み込まれて破産するかは、知事の腕次第だ。


東京都

「東京都の血税が、地方交付税交付金として田舎にばらまかれる事はもうない。」

巨大な人口と県内総生産を擁する日本の首都。その経済力は圧倒的で鳥取県のおよそ50倍。
ただし食料自給率は驚異の1%。さらに致命的な事に、電力は他県に頼っており、単独ではその力を発揮する事ができない。
そして高い魅力度により、他県から人口が流入するため、ただでさえ足りない電力がますます足りなくなる。
食糧不足と電力不足で機能不全を起こしたまま財政破綻を迎えるか、それとも首都としての貫禄を見せて覇県を握るかは、都知事である君の手にかかっている。


奈良県

「鹿せんべい食うか？」

全国で唯一陸上自衛隊の駐屯地がない県。航空自衛隊も実戦部隊はなく、内陸県なので当然海上自衛隊もいない。
さらに言うと、一人あたりの県内総生産は日本最下位(2016年基準)。
工業力も軍備も経済もないうえに、隣には強豪の大阪府がいる。
果たして古都の復活なるか……？


沖縄県

「今こそ、その苦汁をナイチャーにも味わわせるのだ！シマンチュよ立ち上がれ！」

当たり前だが、陸路で何県とも繋がっていない。
敵陸上部隊に攻められる心配は一切ないが、こちらも攻めれない。
この状況からどう覇県を握るかが、県知事の腕の見せどころ。




愛知県

「他県に自動車をもっと買ってもらわなければ。」

織田信長、豊臣秀吉、徳川家康。戦国三大武将を生み出した愛知県は、現代でも強力だ。
圧倒的１位の工業力を活かして、もりもり軍備が増強できる。
さらに経済力、電力等も高いレベルでまとまっており、何よりも周りは自分より弱い県ばかり。
織田信長のごとく、勢力を拡大していこう。

 

愛媛県

「願わくは、全国あまねく家庭の蛇口を捻ればポ○ジュースである。」

よく愛知県と間違えられる。
前作「四国志シリーズ」では、四国最強の県として君臨していたが、あくまで強いのは四国の中だけ。そもそも四国四県を足した所で、大阪どころか兵庫県の工業力や県内総生産にも届かないのでしかたない。
香川県と四国のリーダーを争うだけで終わるのか、それとも本土に進出できるかは県知事である君の手にかかっている。

data.name: Traverse Colour Space
data.detailed_description:
Traverse Colour Space is a maze game where as the player you navigate though a level collecting paint to increase your score as you move. The path taken though the level can make a large difference to the end score.

A Hamiltonian Path is a path though a complexly connected set of nodes where each node is visited once and only once. Traverse Colour Space follows a similar logic usually known as a path of best fit (but that's not as catchy). As you move you will paint visited tiles however, painted tiles cannot be revisited so you will need to plan your way carefully.

Collect paint from around the levels to increase your 3 colour values each time you move you gain points based on these 3 values. However to maximise points you will need to make use of the colour bonus zones in each map that grant additional points for being painted the correct colour.

data.name: My Wife is a Spy?!
data.detailed_description:
Life was never fair not before the accident, and certainly not after. You expected magic, adventure, maybe a crown. Instead, you awaken in a foreign body, forced into an arranged marriage with Zachary, the cold and distant Duke of the North.

Born to the sunlit luxury of the South, you're sent to a frozen, war-torn land plagued by monsters, famine, and unrest. Your new husband is a man of duty, not affection, bound by loyalty to a crumbling crown and now, bound to you.

But even pawns can learn to move.

Will you earn Zachary’s trust and fight beside him to save his people? Or seize your own fate, rise as a villainess, and bring the North under your heel?

What will you become in a world where loyalty is dangerous, and love might just be the ultimate betrayal?

SOFIA

Brought up in a strict home, sheltered by harsh traditions, she has always been told who to be. But despite all, her unwavering strength and determination push her to find her own place, whether in this world or the fantasy one.

ZACHARY

Duke of the North, guardian of kingdom besieged by monsters, brutal winters, and dark conspiracies. Duty has made him brave yet cold and wary of trust. Beneath the ice, a heart may still beat... Will you be the one to thaw it?

Every choice you make shapes your destiny. Navigate a delicate balance between gaining Zachary’s affection and raising his suspicion. Earn his trust to unlock romance, or let doubt fester and carve a path toward power and rebellion. Will you play the dutiful duchess, or manipulate the game from the shadows as a true villainess? Your actions determine not just relationships, but the future of the North itself. In this world, loyalty is tested and betrayal has a price.

  • Two Diverging Routes: Shape your destiny through two distinct narrative paths: Romance or Villainess. Will you fight for love and loyalty, or seize power on your own terms? Each route offers different challenges, choices, and emotional stakes.

  • 8–10 Hours of Gameplay: Experience a tightly woven narrative full of political intrigue, emotional tension, and personal growth. Every scene is crafted for replayability, with meaningful branches and impactful decisions.

  • Five Unique Endings: Your choices matter, from quiet moments of trust to bold acts of rebellion. Unlock one of five possible endings, including both heartwarming resolutions and darker, more treacherous outcomes.

  • Affection & Suspicion Systems: Your actions affect how Zachary sees you. Gain affection to grow closer and reveal his true self, or raise suspicion and risk pushing him and the North toward chaos.

  • 10 Gorgeous CGs: Relive unforgettable moments through beautifully illustrated scenes that highlight turning points in your journey.

  • Nameable Protagonist: Step into the story as yourself with a protagonist you can name, shaping her morals, choices, and legacy.

  • Mature, Emotional Storytelling (17+): Explore themes of arranged marriage, power, and survival. Includes content warnings for family abuse and emotional manipulation.

  • Rich Fantasy Setting: Inspired by Renaissance Italy and medieval Sweden, navigate a world divided: sun-drenched, decadent South vs. frostbitten, crumbling North rife with tension, mystery, and rebellion.

data.name: 恋语星缘
data.detailed_description:
BACKGROUND

During the Three Kingdoms period, Zhuge Liang created the Rokuyo and used it in military tactics and strategy.

On his campaigns, Zhuge Liang feared that the Rokuyo would have no successor. So he used a secret technique to split the Rokuyo into six stars (six special energy entities) and granted them mystical powers.

He gave four of them to the Jiang, Ma, Wei, and Zhang families. The remaining two stayed with him and his descendants to safeguard.

To make sure the Rokuyo Stars wouldn't fall into the wrong hands, Zhuge Liang set up an inheritance system: only those who carry the family bloodline AND pass the trials can inherit a Rokuyo Star.

Time flies, years pass in the blink of an eye. The inheritance of the Rokuyo Stars continues to this day.

But beneath the calm waters, dark currents are moving.

After thousands of years, outsiders have finally cracked the secret of the Rokuyo Stars.

The battle for the Rokuyo Stars has begun.

STORY

Zhu Yuxin, an "ordinary" student, lives a carefree life day by day.

Carving, fortune-telling, fooling around with friends—these make up his everyday routine.

One day, a transfer student arrives in his class.

She captures everyone's attention, including Zhu Yuxin's.

"This new girl... there's something about her..."

She greets everyone with a smile, no matter who they are.

But anemia, weakness, depleted vitality—these ailments seem to plague her constantly.

"There's something strange about her, something that draws me in... like a resonance?"

"Are you and I... the same kind of people?"

The living don masks and wield their scythes, vowing to offer blood as tribute to the spirits above.

This is her story.

And the beginning of ours.

CHARACTER

Male Protagonist: Zhu Yuxin

Height: 175cm, Weight: 59kg

Class Monitor

Easy-going and helpful, though he can be a bit mischievous (with close friends). Responsible and dependable.

Skills: Carving, fortune-telling, cooking, basketball

Supporting Character: Liu Yihao (Male protagonist's friend)

Height: 178cm, Athletic build

Former Student Council President with exceptional leadership and organizational skills. Academic performance is consistently high.

Reliable and always there to help the male protagonist at critical moments.

Skills: Ball sports

GAMEPLAY INTRODUCTION

This is a text-based adventure game.

You will play as Zhu Yuxin, influencing the plot by clicking on choices.

The fate of Zhu Yuxin and Jiang Lingli will be decided by you.

data.name: Willie's Nightfall
data.detailed_description:
Willie's Nightfall is a first-person horror game. Explore the eerie offices of Willie's Company in search of secret documents. But you're not alone. The sinister company mascot, Willie—a distorted, murderous mouse—is hunting you down.

GAMEPLAY


As you explore, you'll need to solve puzzles, find keys and access cards to unlock restricted areas. These areas may hold the secret documents you’re searching for—files that reveal the truth about the creation of Willie.

Willie is aware of your presence, and his twisted grin hides a malevolent intent. He stalks the darkened corridors, listening for every sound you make. You'll need to stay sharp, move cautiously, and use the environment to your advantage to avoid his relentless pursuit.
The flickering lights, the creaking doors, or his sickly whistling all warn of Willie’s approach. Stay vigilant and don't get caught by the murderous mouse.

KEY FEATURES

  • Puzzles - Solve challenges involving keys, passwords, and access cards to unlock restricted areas and uncover secrets
  • Stealth - Hide behind objects and stay alert to sounds
  • Replayability - Enjoy a fresh experience each time you play, with keys, passwords, documents, and other items randomly placed in different locations
  • AI - he’s always in a different place and can access any room by opening doors, making each encounter unpredictable and tense

data.name: Branchbound
data.detailed_description:
Grow one shared tree

Branchbound is a compact abstract strategy duel about a luminous tree both players are trying to keep alive.

One simple rule. Sharp decisions.

Each turn, choose an open node, extend a branch in one of eight directions, and set the new signal's colour. It may not repeat the colour of any neighbour. Verify a legal move to pass the turn; verify an echo and the branch breaks immediately.

A small field, a mathematical core

At its core, Branchbound combines a growing rooted tree with local graph colouring: every legal move extends the tree while preserving the neighbourhood colour constraint. It is inspired by finite-tree and graph-colouring problems; it does not compute Busy Beaver or TREE(3).

Play your way

  • A local hotseat duel or practice against Moss, a deterministic bot.
  • Two, three, or four colours on compact 9×9 or wide 11×11 fields.
  • Mouse, touch, and keyboard controls with a collapsible turn panel.
  • The final tree and best results saved only on your device.
  • Fully offline, with no account, server, or in-game purchases.

Language support

The game interface and controls are available in 14 languages; see the Steam language table for the current list.

data.name: The Last Light
data.detailed_description:
"The Last Light" is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer set in the early 1980s Pacific Northwest. Combining visual storytelling with childhood nostalgia, players embark on a journey to reunite an 11-year old boy with his family.

You step into the shoes of an 11-year-old, and find yourself in a world forever changed by the arrival of supernatural creatures. After the invasion, you are separated from your family, and must summon every ounce of courage to reunite with them in this dangerous, post-apocalyptic landscape.

Puzzles
Encounter a series of challenges that test your wit, reflexes, and problem-solving skills.

Environments
Explore treacherous caves, mist-filled forests, and abandoned towns.

Nostalgic Setting
The game takes place in the early 1980’s rural suburbs, creating a strong sense of nostalgia for players who remember that era and offers a unique historical setting for those who don’t.

data.name: Idle Factory
data.detailed_description:
This game is a science fiction sandbox resource management game that integrates elements such as space and automatic chemical plants.

In the future, while exploring space, mankind will also face unknown dangers.

In the game, players will manage factory resources from the perspective of God.

You may encounter many difficulties, but pay attention to the management and utilization of resources. These problems will be solved soon.



Game features:

1. You can constantly unlock technology to produce more products. Build your own industrial empire step by step, so as to enter the space age.

2. Each product requires different raw materials and time, so you need to allocate resources reasonably.

3. There is a detailed data system in the game. You can browse these data to feel your real estate exhibition direction.

4. You don't need to spend a lot of time to build various factories. Simply click a few buttons to collect and produce.

5. When you unlock space technology, you may face unknown dangers. Please do a good job in defense.

data.name: Caeldovar Online
data.detailed_description:
We're building Caeldovar around what we loved about early MMOs: earning your levels, finding gear worth keeping, and getting to know the people you play with. It brings that old-school feel together with modern controls, weapon abilities, and quality-of-life features, keeping progression and community at the heart of the game. Caeldovar is a sandbox MMO that allows you to go and do what you want when you want and will be completely Free-To-Play.

Explore grasslands, forests, deserts, snowy regions, jungles, and the Firelands. Different areas offer monsters and resources for overlapping level ranges, giving you choices about where to train and gather.

Towns have their own shops, workshops, and reasons to visit. Discover mounts, sail between ports, and use player-created city portals as your travel options grow. A shared day-and-night cycle changes the atmosphere—and some of the creatures you encounter.

Develop Melee, Magic, and Archery on the same character. Your equipped weapon determines your abilities, while shields add defensive options. Switch equipment to explore different ways to fight, from close-range pressure and ranged attacks to healing, control, and summons.

Train the skills that support your chosen equipment, then put them to work through positioning, ability timing, and resource management. Hunt creature-themed gear, collect distinctive capes, combine matching armor sets, and improve weapons, armor, and jewelry with upgrade materials. Food, potions, and Spirit blessings give you more ways to prepare for a difficult fight.


Take on quests, repeatable daily challenges, wilderness creatures, and shared dungeons where other adventurers can cross your path. Push into tougher chambers and face bosses with their own attacks, ground warnings, and dangerous casts.

Bring damage, protection, and support together: hold an enemy’s attention, interrupt a dangerous ability, or keep an ally standing. Preparation matters outside battlegrounds, where death can cost carried items—bank your valuables before a risky trip.

Battlegrounds: compete without risking your normal equipment. Fight in Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, or Hard Point, with team matches and separate 1v1 formats. Loaned equipment and equalized skills put the focus on the match. Earn Battleground Points and exchange them for Scrolls of Battle to advance a skill.

Open-world PvP: opt in to full-loot fights. Both players must have PvP enabled and be within 20 levels of each other. Change your setting near a bank while out of combat, then venture beyond protected areas. A PvP death drops your carried and equipped items, including collection-bag contents; banked items and trained skills remain yours.

Stay with your party for friendly-fire protection, plan your route, and decide what you’re willing to carry into a fight.

Develop Woodworking, Metalworking, Herbalism, Alchemy, Hunting, Fishing, and Cooking. Gather across the world, bring materials to the right workstation, and turn them into equipment, tools, furniture, bags, meals, and potions.

Gathering and production are connected: cutting wood and working it both train Woodworking; mining, smelting, and smithing build Metalworking. Follow a favorite profession or develop the whole supply chain. Collection bags can automatically gather matching resources and loot into their stored stacks, helping you make more of each trip.

Collect higher quality resources to produce a higher quality weapon or armor. Further improve your equipment through upgrading which is only capable by a skilled artisan.


Demon Invasions open portals in the wilderness, bringing escalating waves and a Demon Lord to confront. Join other players, contribute through combat or healing, and earn personal rewards—including equipment found through these events.

Wandering Caravans offer another kind of shared task. Donate requested resources, talk to travelers for clues, and recover missing supplies. Contributions help the same camp prepare, while eligible participants claim their own rewards.

Many more Events to experience!

Buy supplies from town merchants or set your own prices at the Auction House. Search for equipment and materials, sell your surplus, and keep listings available while you’re offline. Sale proceeds go to your bank.

For a riskier route, package gathered resources into cargo and deliver it between towns for gold and Vanguard. Cargo runs require PvP to stay enabled, and your crate can be lost on death. Compare destinations, organize protection, and make the journey on foot or along supported sea routes.

Claim a home, manor, or castle plot and shape its building and furnishings. Arrange walls, doors, floors, and furniture; larger properties support upper stories. Add useful facilities such as cooking equipment, crafting stations, banks, and a mailbox for messages and gifts.

Your home stays in the world while you’re offline. Choose who can visit—friends, party members, guildmates, or other players—and let permitted guests use its available facilities. Bind your own bed as a respawn point, or turn the property into a place for your guild to gather.

Form parties of up to eight, keep in touch through friends lists and chat, and build a guild with ranks and shared storage. Design a guild flag, wear matching guild capes, and bring that identity into your home’s furnishings.

There is room for quieter moments, too. Play instruments that nearby players can hear, gather for an informal performance, trade emotes, or sit together between adventures. A familiar face in town can become tomorrow’s dungeon companion.


Caeldovar Online is still being built. Features, balance, and gameplay may change as development continues and player feedback helps shape the world.

Visit our website to create a Caeldovar Account and Begin your journey!

data.name: MoonMiners
data.detailed_description:
On this moon, survival depends on teamwork...

but you can't trust anyone. While you fight alien monsters back-to-back, someone on your team is already plotting against you.

MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator that transports you to a bleak sci-fi future on the Moon. Imagine: you and your team manage to deliver the last box of ore when suddenly the power goes out, bugs crawl into the base, and someone blocks the airlock from the inside — and you realize that there is a traitor among you. You play as a team of space miners working for a ruthless megacorporation far from Earth. Doing your job here can be even harder than just surviving... and that's no exaggeration.

What awaits you? In MoonMiners, you are part of a mining crew tasked with meeting the corporate mining quota at all costs. Each game is a separate mission on a dangerous lunar base.

Restore the base, assign responsibilities, scan and analyze deposits, and follow strict corporate protocols for resource extraction. Process and deliver materials while facing increasing threats, from aggressive alien life forms to a hidden traitor with personal goals: sabotage, disorganization, or even murder.

Players load ore into crates, one quietly steals it and throws it into a crater — an example of a traitor's work, where the team works together to repair damaged infrastructure, extract the necessary resources, and ultimately try to fulfill the corporation's strict plan.

Basic mechanics. Restore base systems, assign roles, and scan the ground for valuable deposits. Follow strict protocols: extract and process ore, prepare cargo for shipment — all under constant pressure from external and internal threats. Predatory alien creatures are creeping in from all sides, and somewhere among you, a secret saboteur may be lurking with their own agenda — to sabotage or quietly eliminate their colleagues.

Unique features. The game throws up unpredictable situations that make each session special. Friendly fire is always on — your mistakes or chaotic shootouts can be just as dangerous as the monsters themselves. Use any equipment at the base, including lunar rovers, to move faster across the surface and transport your loot.

Ready to take on the treacherous Moon? Gather a team (or go solo), add MoonMiners to your wish list, and get ready to prove you can survive this shift to the end! Survive, meet your quota... or become the next name on the corporation's casualty list.

data.name: Control Freak
data.detailed_description:
Control Freak is an action strategy game where you work together with your team mates to escape the clutches of the all powerful Controller. Set in a dungeon full of traps and weird paintings with eyes that follow you around you better think fast if you want to get out.

So how does it work?


At the start of each round one player is randomly selected as the "Controller". This player has control of all the traps around the map such as trap doors, gates and laser walls. They compete against the remaining players who have to work together to complete the steps that will allow them to escape before the times runs out! So if you enjoy working as a team to achieve a goal or outsmarting your friends by being in charge of the traps then this game will have something for you.

Notes:


- Supports up to five players online in formats of either 4v1, 3v1, 2v1 or 1v1 although the maximum number of players is recommended for the best experience.

data.name: Persevere
data.detailed_description:
Persevere is a turn-based survival RPG set on a grim island on which you will manage a small team of exiles.

Survive

Take control over exiles and manage their physical and mental well-being. Craft, buy, or find equipment by exploring to help you survive until the light of a new day.

Fight

Make full use of the unique mechanics of the new health and psyche system based on grid. Discover different weapons with their unique attacks. Choose from four different attack types: firearm, melee, throwable and placeable.

Explore

Embark on quests, trade with wandering merchants, master new skills and listen to your characters stories, thoughts and fears - and at day's end, set up camp to rest and prepare for tomorrow.

Key features:

  • unique turn-based combat system built upon grids

  • fight against bosses and different kinds of Affects - physical manifestations of emotions

  • experience a captivating story and encounter NPCs in side quests

  • build a team from the selection of 9 different characters

  • explore an open world island with places to uncover ancient secrets and find treasures

  • find and use a great variety of different items and weapons

  • discover each character's personality and skills

  • collect ingredients and craft various items

  • listen to your characters' stories through a huge amount of lines of dialogues and monologues

data.name: Deckmancers
data.detailed_description:
Deckmancers, an action roguelite, fuses melee combat with card-based spellcasting, challenging you to think fast and cast faster. Duel with magic cards and clash with cold steel as you journey through shattered realms. Go solo or team up with your buddies to battle through fantastic beasts and rival mages on your way to conquer the arcane tournament.

Arcane Deckbuilding

When played, each card casts one spell, be it a blazing fireball, sheep-turning curse, or resurrection and summon sorcery.
Experiment with card combinations to build an unstoppable deck, obliterating any confrontation you encounter on your journey.
Equip Joker cards with rule-bending effects, offering a new twist on casting spells, and create powerful combos, utilizing unique cards from slain towering bosses or bought from traveling traders.

Spellblade Mayhem

Master the art of magical combat by combining spellcasting and melee attacks. Wield your deck as a weapon, casting spells to devastate foes from afar, then close in with your blade to finish the job. Stay in constant motion to survive the onslaught of enemies and environmental hazards that test your reflexes, tactical thinking, and deckbuilding skills.
All in a handcrafted environment with procedurally generated threats, across lands shattered by magic cataclysm.

The Arcane Tournament

Your journey culminates in the arcane tournament, where your collected deck of cards and hard-earned skills face the ultimate gauntlet, to prove your mastery of magic and combat.
And if you fail, defeat serves as a stepping stone to greater power.
Unlock new cards and deckmancers with each attempt, gradually expanding your magical collection with more effects to combine, for even more surprising and varied synergies.

data.name: RAMEN RUSH
data.detailed_description:
RAMEN RUSH is a ramen shop simulation with a fun arcade twist. In the “15-Day Mode”, you manage your own shop and build strategies each day to reach a specific income goal.

Each day, you must build your menu with a new product: 1 ramen, 1 drink, and optionally 1 side dish. But be careful! Compatibility between items is critical for customer satisfaction and sales success. As time goes on, product variety increases, making it harder to choose the right combinations. Careful planning and quick decisions are essential for success!

Every 5 days, you unlock a new skill for your character. These abilities are chosen based on your playstyle and give unique advantages. Over time, your choices will shape you into a true ramen master.

Prepare the ingredients, boil the ramen, and serve customers on time! There’s no inventory limit, but you are racing against the clock – if you’re too slow, customers will lose patience and leave!

In this fast-paced mode, your reflexes will be tested. The quick gameplay loop and replayability will help you improve day by day.

RAMEN RUSH features a rich soundtrack with both energetic tracks to keep you motivated and calm melodies for more peaceful moments. You'll stay immersed while enjoying both the action and the atmosphere.

data.name: Cats of the Yuan Dynasty
data.detailed_description:
Set against the backdrop of the 700-year-old painting Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty, this game features 200 meticulously drawn cats, bringing whimsical interactions between felines and the grand historical scene.

The original scroll of Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty measures 59 cm by 1240 cm and vividly depicts the royal hunt, encampment, and banquet of Yuan Dynasty emperors. The composition is epic in scale, with dynamic character portrayals that reflect the distinct features of Mongolian nobility. A highlight of the painting is the scene where the crown prince and warriors gallop on horseback to hunt deer, a moment rich with symbolic meaning.

Game Features

  • Relax and enjoy a journey through ancient artwork

  • 200 uniquely illustrated cats

  • Calming, traditional-style ancient music

  • Adorable cat sound effects

  • 100 carefully designed achievement icons

Gameplay Tips

  • Click the cover logo to view a high-resolution version of Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty

  • Press the ESC key to show or hide in-game buttons

  • Click the hint button to reveal the location of one cat—usable once every 60 seconds

Embark on a relaxing search for hidden cats in the majestic ancient scroll Autumn Hunting in the Plains of the Yuan Dynasty!

data.name: DmC: Devil May Cry
data.detailed_description:
In this retelling of Dante's origin story which is set against a contemporary backdrop, DmC Devil May Cry™ retains the stylish action, fluid combat and self-assured protagonist that have defined the iconic series but inject a more brutal and visceral edge.

The Dante of DmC is a young man who has no respect for authority or indeed society in general. Dante knows that he is not human, but also that he is not like the demons that have tormented him throughout his life. Caught between worlds, he feels like an outcast.
Thanks to his twin brother Vergil, leader of the anti-establishment group called “The Order”, Dante is now discovering and coming to terms with what it means to be the child of a demon and an angel. This split personality has a real impact on gameplay with Dante being able to call upon angel and demon abilities at will, transforming his Rebellion sword on the fly to dramatically affect both combat and movement.

For DmC Capcom has teamed up with UK development studio, Ninja Theory, renown for delivering action titles with compelling characters and narrative coupled with high production values. The combination of Ninja Theory’s expertise and Capcom’s unrivalled heritage in producing combat focused action titles will ensure that this latest addition to the over 11-million selling series will remain true to the Devil May Cry DNA so cherished by the fans, while bringing a new level of cinematic quality to the title.

Key Features

  • Survive Limbo - The world of Limbo is a living and breathing entity, out to kill Dante. The world will transform in real-time and try to block off and even kill our hero. Our protagonist will have to master demonic powers to shape Limbo the way he sees fit, while perfecting his angelic skills to traverse this hazardous, twisted world.
  • Who is Dante? – Explore a retelling of Dante’s origin story in a gripping narrative featuring familiar faces from the series alongside all new characters, including Vergil, Dante’s twin brother.
  • Unbridled action – The intense and iconic sword and gun based combat returns with the addition of new Angel and Demon weapons and abilities, all designed to dispatch the demonic spawn back to hell with style and panache. Weapons include:
    • “Rebellion”: Dante’s trusted sword, given by his father Sparda, provides a great mix of combos and attacks, great for sending enemies skyward.
    • “Ebony & Ivory”: These guns are good for keeping enemies at bay, maintaining combos and juggling enemies in the air.
    • “Arbiter”: a demonic axe that can deliver massive blows and break through enemy shields.
    • “Osiris”: an angelic scythe with fast attacks and great for crowd control.
    • “Eryx”: powerful demonic gauntlets that pack enough punch to parry even the strongest attacks and juggle the heaviest enemies.
  • Retaining the Devil May Cry DNA – Capcom staff, including team members from previous Devil May Cry titles, have been assigned to the project from the outset to ensure DmC is a true addition to the Devil May Cry franchise.
  • Unrivalled production values - Ninja Theory will take advantage of the latest performance capture technology to deliver a level of character design, story-telling and cinematics that perfectly complements DmC’s high-octane combat.

data.name: SLUP
data.detailed_description:
SLUP is a strategic arcade score-attack game where you race to collect Gems and keep your combo alive.

But every path you take comes back as a Past.

As you collect more Gems, your previous movements begin to replay across the map, turning your own decisions into increasingly dangerous obstacles.

Plan your route, maintain your combo, use Defense wisely, and take advantage of special bonuses to push your score as high as possible.

Each run begins on a tiny 3x3 board. As you collect Gems, the map expands, more Past echoes appear, and the arena becomes increasingly chaotic.

Different stages introduce their own hazards, from rocks blocking your route in the Desert to Quicksand trapping you on the Beach. The Bonus Stage challenges you with two Gems at once.

Survive for 10 minutes in Normal Mode to clear each stage, or enter Endless Mode and keep going until your run finally ends. Compete against your own best scores and the Steam leaderboards.

Choose from five different Slimes, each with its own unique strengths, and upgrade them using currency earned through play.

data.name: Juna - The Dreamwalker
data.detailed_description:
Embark on an extraordinary journey in "Juna - The Dreamwalker", a captivating retro-style adventure game set in a mystical land plagued by menacing monsters. Step into the shoes of a courageous young woman determined to uncover the truth behind the invasion and put an end to the sinister forces threatening her world.

In this enchanting tale, you will navigate through a beautifully pixelated foreign land, embracing a low-resolution bird's-eye view perspective. Prepare to be immersed in a mesmerizing world as you explore its diverse regions, each teeming with treacherous creatures and hidden secrets.

But fear not, for you possess a remarkable tool – a mysterious rod capable of transforming you into any monster or object. This unique ability proves to be your greatest ally, allowing you to adapt to your surroundings and overcome numerous challenges. Harness the rod's power to unravel mind-bending puzzles, traverse dangerous landscapes, and deceive formidable foes.

The fate of the land rests upon your shoulders as you delve into forgotten temples, navigate treacherous dungeons, and interact with intriguing characters. Uncover the dark origins of the monstrous invasion, by reconstructing an ancient portal and eventually stepping through it.

With approximately 30 hours of captivating gameplay, "Juna - The Dreamwalker" delivers an unforgettable adventure brimming with nostalgia and discovery. Traverse lush forests, desolate deserts, and haunted ruins as you piece together the puzzle of the invasion. Engage in thrilling real-time combat, honing your skills to overcome hordes of fearsome creatures standing in your way.

Will you have the courage to face the unknown, unlock the truth, and save the land from impending doom? Prepare yourself for an immersive journey where your wits, transformation abilities, and determination will be tested. Unleash the power of the rod and shape your destiny in "Juna - The Dreamwalker", a retro-style epic that will leave a lasting mark on your gaming experience.

Key Features:

- Immerse yourself in a captivating retro-style adventure.

- Utilize the transformative power of the rod to take on the appearance and abilities of monsters and objects.

- Explore a beautifully pixelated world, rich in diverse environments and secrets waiting to be discovered.

- Unravel the dark origins of the monstrous invasion and discover the secrets behind the ancient portal.

- Engage in real-time combat against formidable creatures, honing your skills to become a true heroine.

- Experience approximately 30 hours of immersive gameplay, filled with exploration, puzzle-solving, and thrilling encounters.

Embark on an unforgettable journey in "Juna - The Dreamwalker" and become the heroine the land needs. Your destiny awaits!

data.name: Escape from the Tutorial
data.detailed_description:
Escape from the Tutorial is a strategic turn-based role-playing game. You will play as Lazar, a young man dreaming of becoming a hero, starting his adventure in Tutorial Village, a place riddled with scams, debt, and despair. Through combat and strategy, escape hardships, meet reliable and unique companions, and uncover the secrets hidden behind this world.

Combat System

The game combines classic Japanese turn-based RPGs with strategic battle chess. Each round, players must carefully choose their characters' actions and positions to maximize their abilities and tactical coordination. You can set traps to lure enemies, use weather and terrain effects to torment them, and boost morale to unleash powerful ultimate moves!

Character Development

The game features 16 companions, each with their own professions and skills. You can explore, fight, and have heartfelt conversations by the campfire with them, helping fulfill their wishes. As the game progresses, you can upgrade and customize the skills and equipment of Lazar and his companions to create a unique combat style.

Art

The game features beautiful character portraits by the seasoned artist Wareyon and exquisite pixel art by Guan Muzi. In combat, we have combined pixel characters with 3D effects to create fast-paced, dynamic, and visually stunning battles.

Exploration and Homestead

Beyond combat, you can explore the vast corners of the New Continent: forests, snow mountains, canyons, and towers. Each area has its own characteristics and offers different resources and treasures. The game also includes a small homestead system where you can use resources to upgrade your base and carriage, aiding your next adventure.

Gaming Experience

We place great importance on the player's gaming experience. Thus, you can save your game at any time, including making one-time interim saves on random maps. Additionally, you can reset skill points and talents unlimited times. All team members, including those who died in battle or did not participate, receive equal experience points, allowing you to freely try different character and skill combinations.

data.name: Angry Mother Earth
data.detailed_description:
She's angry at you for messing with her curvy figure! Now do something useful: help her wipe out humanity. Dive into Angry Mother Earth, a strategy game where you combine powers and use various tactics in a fully simulated world to end humanity. A game experience that's truly one of a kind.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master! You use abilities like tornadoes, earthquakes, hurricanes, and more to eliminate humanity before they end you with pollution. However, mastering the game is an entirely different challenge! While you might unleash a tornado to destroy industrial districts that damages you and affects your health bar, you must proceed with caution. The tornado could destroy trees in its path, which mitigate the damage you sustain over time.



In "Angry Mother Earth," you face the agony of choice on how to destroy humanity. Here are just a few scenarios to consider: What if you targeted only the farms, cutting off the food supply? Or disrupted the power grid? Could such actions bring a nation to its knees? However, if annihilation isn't to your taste, why not opt for a peaceful approach? Persuade humanity to come to the green side!



Dive into a dynamically simulated world that evolves with every passing moment. As the wheels of change turn, they are driven by technological progress, global events, fluctuating national policies, and most importantly, your decisions. This complex simulation seamlessly interlinks the threads of food, power, services, and essential goods supply chains. A disruption in one can cascade through an entire nation which you can use to your advantage.



Play as Mother Earth, Father Earth, Gaia, or Midgard — each character has their own unique abilities and playstyles! While Mother Earth aims to win the game through peaceful means, Father Earth prefers to obliterate everything in his path. Gaia is centered around ending humanity with diseases, viruses, and plagues, whereas Midgard is inclined to thrust humanity into the next ice age.



Explore Diverse Maps! Dive into strategic gameplay across two distinct maps: a spherical layout and a flat terrain. Each terrain presents its own set of challenges to conquer. Even the enemies vary between maps, challenging you in unique ways. Adaptability is key!

Impressive! Not many humans scroll this far. Let's see what else is in store for you:



Challenge Yourself!
Pick from a range of difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Nightmare. And a secret level? Here's a hint: don't get on Santa's naughty list.

Expansive Skill Trees!
Every character boasts three talent trees, each laden with 13 unique skills. This ensures a rich strategic experience that keeps you engaged.

Humanity's Response?
Don't underestimate them. Seriously, don't! They'll respond to every move you make, doing what humans do best: adapt and destroy!

Dynamic Events, (almost) Endless Possibilities!
With over 300 events, every game is a new challenge. When humans threaten the Amazon, will you redirect resources to protect it, or let them fell the trees? Beware, trees curb pollution, and letting them disappear might hasten your defeat.

data.name: 我的美味丈夫 My Tasty Husband
data.detailed_description:
"Do you believe in monsters?" ”

If the person closest to you, the person you trust most, the person you can't be separated from, the person you share a bed with, the person most important to you, the person most beloved to you, the person fused into your very bones and blood, the person most reliable, the person most indispensable, the person as essential as lips to teeth—were replaced.

...

One stormy night, May watches her soaked husband at the door. Rainwater seeps in from under his feet. He smiles, same as ever.

But something is different. A black cat back from the dead, surveillance cameras appearing from nowhere, birds gathering everywhere... This sudden wave of strangeness makes it harder and harder to tell reality from hallucination. Meanwhile, the courier who keeps showing up and the female officer investigating alone each bring their own secrets into her life.

In this light horror narrative adventure of food, love, and death, players will see through May's eyes, unmask the one who shares her bed, and reach different relationships and endings through their choices.

Main Characters

[Labyrinth of the Heart] May

Her naturally curly hair is the only memento her mother left her. She once wore it long, but perhaps it was too hard to manage, so she took scissors and cut it short herself. She has cut away many things, including memories she wanted to forget completely. But leaving didn't help, and alcohol only offered fleeting blankness in her mind, followed by side effects she couldn't withstand. She has lost far more than she ever bargained for. Her whole life has been a flight, yet she never gets anywhere.

[Bones of Love] August

He started wearing glasses in sixth grade. They became like an external organ, helping him see the world more clearly. But seeing too clearly isn't always a good thing, so August chose silence, chose to follow blindly. He shut down his senses, refused to solve the obvious problems, and what he got was rot—even his bones became flower food.

August (?)

Who am I? Where did I come from? Where am I going? He hasn't figured out any of life's three ultimate questions, so He wants a name, a home, a future. Eat a piece of love, and you gain eternal love—or so He believes.

[The King Bows, The King Kills] Victor

A simple, single-minded, always-smiling rookie courier. He looks like he might be hiding dog ears under his cap. So straightforward he has no filter. A little blood won't leave a mark on his innocent heart—it never has. That heart has always been an open book. Cherish that heart, and be just as honest with him.

[Song of the Ivory Tower] Thelma

No one knows how Thelma went from state trooper to neighborhood patrol, and no one cares. She tried to start a new life here, but things veered off course the moment she picked up that ID badge. Perhaps she shouldn't have been so stubborn, shouldn't have chased every thread, shouldn't have knocked on that yellow door.

Game Features

- 240,000+ words of text, approximately 5-6 hours per playthrough.

- 3 story branches, 12 endings in total, including 6 character-specific endings.

- Over 50 character portrait variations, 40+ storyboard CGs (excluding variations), and 6 story CGs.

- Explore the stories of her husband August, Victor the courier, and Thelma the police officer, gradually uncovering their hidden secrets.

- Shape May's attitude through dialogue and action choices, alter relationships, and drive the story forward.

- Navigate between romance and dread toward May's ending (some of which count as good endings, depending on who defines "good").

Mature Content Description

This work contains horror, death, violence, psychological distress, and depictions of eating that may cause discomfort. Please proceed according to your own comfort level.

This story is purely fictional. Any resemblance to real persons, events, groups, or organizations is purely coincidental.

data.name: Caves of Madness
data.detailed_description:
You’ve entered a mysterious cave — the source of powerful crystals used to heal the sick, fuel deadly weapons, and even grant magical abilities. But beware: ancient evils lurk in the shadows, hungry for your soul. Will you risk your sanity and your life to claim the power within, or will the darkness consume you before you reach your goal?

Cooperative Roguelike Adventure

Team up with friends — or meet new allies in-game — in this 3-player cooperative roguelike experience. Every run is different, and survival depends on teamwork, strategy, and courage.

                                                                                                              

Choose Your Champion

Pick from three unique starting classes, each with their own playstyle and powers:


  • Seraphin: A mighty warrior who channels lunar energy to strike enemies and shield allies.

data.detailed_description:
Important note about this Trial version

This version of Hacker Simulator is a trial version and will give you access to the tutorial and the first contracts. To access the rest of the content, please go to the full version available here:


Important note: Please note that Hacker Simulator is not a realistic 1:1 hacking simulation and that the mechanics are only inspired by real-life hacking methods.

With Hacker Simulator, I wanted to bring a fun and immersive experience on the theme of hacking so that you can have a better vision of some of its aspects (being alone, I certainly can't cover all of them).



In order to keep your business running, you need to stay anonymous regularly by hiding behind various wifi networks. To do this, you will learn how to use the famous suite of tools called Aircrack-ng!



A lot of research has been done to bring you a simplified and enjoyable version of real-life hacking methods such as bruteforce, exploits, phishing and more!



You will learn a lot during your adventure, but you will also learn that hacking is not without risk. The networks you will explore will be secured and the wifi connections will be monitored, requiring a high level of attention.

data.name: Busy Bar - World Tour
data.detailed_description:
Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

Survive Ridiculous Guests

Your customers are more than walking orders.

Some leave generous tips. Some steal your coins. Some fall asleep on the counter and block your lane. Some jump onto the bar and dance until every incoming drink shatters. Others may drop suspicious gifts, change their order mid-shift, or even kidnap the bartender and throw them out the door.

Learn each guest’s behavior, react to their abilities, and turn unpredictable bar chaos into profit.

Hire Barbacks from Your Guests

Some guests are more than customers — they might become your next barback. Spot promising regulars during a shift and hire them for a one-time fee to help out at that specific bar.

Barbacks come with different accuracy, speed and skill stats, plus specialties like cleaning spills, collecting glasses, gathering tips or helping with orders. Some are common helpers, others are rare finds that can completely change how a busy shift feels. It is completely optional, but adds an extra layer of strategy for players who want it. Play solo, bring friends or mix local players and barbacks in any setup that fits your bar.

Build your Bars, One Chaotic Shift at a Time.

Busy Bar is a chill arcade-management game about serving drinks, handling ridiculous guests, upgrading unique bars and buying out rival moguls across the world.

Every shift ends in progress. There are no harsh fail states or game-over days — you always earn something, improve something, and move one step closer to owning the next bar. The challenge is not whether you survive the day, but how well you handle the chaos.

Build a Global Bar Empire

Start small, then expand across the world. Travel between cities on the world map, discover new bars, and decide where to work next.

Each bar has its own layout, style, guest mix, upgrade path, and owner. Some are cheap starter pubs, others are expensive premium venues controlled by powerful rivals. Earn money, buy them out, and grow your empire one property at a time.

Upgrade and Personalize your Bars

Spend your earnings between shifts to improve each bar. Unlock new equipment, activate extra counters, change walls and floors, place decorations, and watch your venue visibly transform as it levels up. Each levels increase your profit in shifts.

Your upgrades are not just numbers in a menu — bought items appear directly inside the bar. A rough little pub can slowly become a stylish, profitable venue that feels like your own.

Defeat Rival Bar Moguls

You are not the only one building an empire.

The Mogul Rankings track rival bar tycoons, their wealth, their bars, and their position on the leaderboard. As you buy their properties and increase your own wealth, you climb the rankings and push them down.

Take a mogul’s last bar, and they disappear from the leaderboard completely. One less rival. One step closer to the top.

Play Solo or in Local Co-op

Run the bar alone or bring a friend in local 4-player co-op on one shared screen. Choose different bartenders, split the work, rescue each other from trouble, or accidentally make everything worse.

Co-op adds coordination, chaos, and plenty of funny moments — especially when guests start blocking lanes, breaking drinks, or dragging bartenders across the room.

Run Chaotic Bar Shifts

Step behind the counter, charge your throw, and slide drinks down the lane to waiting customers. Recall empty glasses, collect tips, clean up spills, and keep the bar moving as orders pile up.

The controls are simple to learn, but each shift becomes a satisfying mix of timing, positioning, and optimization. Pick a short, normal, or long shift, then try to earn as much as you can before the day ends.

Fully Playable with Keyboard and Mouse or a Controller

A controller is recommended for the smoothest experience, but all gameplay features are fully playable with keyboard and mouse as well.

Key Features

  • Chill, shift-based arcade-management gameplay

  • No harsh fail states — every shift ends in progress

  • Drink throwing, glass recalling, tip collecting, and cleanup

  • 25 different type of ridiculous guests with 15+ different abilities including sleepers, dancers, thieves, bombs, reorders, and kidnappers

  • Local 1-4 player co-op on one shared screen

  • Unique bars with different layouts, styles, guests, and upgrades

  • Visible bar progression with new counters, items, walls, floors, and decorations

  • World map travel between cities and bars

  • Rival Mogul leaderboard with buyouts and empire progression

  • Multiple bartenders with different looks and animations

Busy Bar is a cozy-chaotic bar game about relaxed optimization, funny accidents, and the satisfaction of turning one small pub into a worldwide bar empire.

data.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me
data.detailed_description:
A series of stand-alone branching cinematic horror games from the studio behind Until Dawn. Easy to pick-up and play in short sessions, alone or with friends. The Devil in Me is the fourth game in the series and the Season One finale.

A group of documentary film makers receive a mysterious call inviting them to a modern-day replica of serial killer H.H. Holmes’ ‘Murder Castle’. It’s an opportunity that’s too good to pass up and could be just the thing they’re looking for to win some much-needed public interest.

The hotel is the perfect set for their new episode, but things aren’t quite as they seem. The crew discover they’re being watched and even manipulated, and suddenly there’s much more at stake than just their ratings!





Nothing is as it seems here, and the amenities are to die for! Explore every nook of the World’s Fair Hotel using the all-new season finale features including character inventory, tool-based puzzles, and expanded movement actions such as run, jump, and climb.


Escape the torturous creations of an evil monster who is hellbent on becoming America’s deadliest serial killer & survive elaborate ‘killing rooms’ where your own death is by the killer’s design.





Endure terrifying tests of loyalty – will you risk your own life for someone you care for? The two critically acclaimed multiplayer modes are back: share your story online with a friend or aim for safety in numbers through the offline 5-player pass-the-pad mode.

Can you outsmart the killer and checkout all your cast? All playable characters can live or die in your version of the story.

The Curator's Cut
The Curator's cut features new scenes playable from the other characters' perspective with brand new choices and decisions to make.

The Curator's cut is only available once you have completed the main story.

data.name: Disc Creatures
data.detailed_description:
Disc Creatures is a retro-inspired monster-collecting RPG that celebrates the golden age of portable adventures. Choose your three starter creatures, become a licensed Disc Ranger, and embark on a journey to collect over 200 unique monsters, unravel hidden mysteries, and restore peace to a vibrant world.

In a world where humans and creatures live side by side, every creature has its own personality, abilities, and way of life. As a newly licensed Disc Ranger, you'll travel across a charming world, tame powerful creatures, help those in need, and uncover a mystery that threatens the balance between humans and monsters...

  • Collect, train, and battle with 200+ unique creatures

  • Bolster your team with skill trees and customizable abilities

  • Explore a colorful world filled with a huge cast of memorable characters, secrets, and side quests

  • Experience 20+ hours of classic monster-collecting RPG gameplay

  • Enjoy a nostalgic chiptune soundtrack inspired by the golden era of handheld gaming

  • Lovingly crafted by solo Japanese indie developer SATTO

"As a kid, I loved games filled with unique monsters. I was always sketching my own creatures in the margins of my notebooks and imagining the adventures they could have. Disc Creatures is my chance to bring those childhood ideas to life. I hope it rekindles the same sense of wonder and nostalgia for players that inspired me to create it."

— SATTO

"Disc Creatures captures everything we loved about classic monster-collecting RPGs while feeling fresh and full of heart. The fact that SATTO created this entire adventure as a solo developer is an incredible achievement, and we're thrilled to help share it with players around the world. We hope you enjoy exploring its world as much as we have."

— DANGEN Entertainment

data.name: 催眠スクールデイズ - Hypnotic School Days -
data.detailed_description:
"Hypnotic School Days" is a novel game in which a lame protagonist uses a hypnosis app he acquires to rapidly get close to the heroines.
A Bishojo Game released in 2018 under the "Noirsoft" brand has been reworked for the "PandaShojo" platform for players of all ages worldwide to enjoy.



◆Introduction
"Don't remember installing this app..."
An app that was suddenly installed on the smartphone.
It was an app that can hypnotize any girl listed in the app!


◆Synopsis
The protagonist, Kyoichi Hata is a lame male highschool student.
As usual, he was killing time with some free apps on his phone.
There, he noticed an installed app he was not familiar with.

"Hypnosis App"

Although he thought it was ridiculous at first,
he discovers it's a "legitimate" app that can hypnotize others by showing them the screen.

It was an extreme stimulation that came to his ordinary life.
That stimulation begins to change Kyoichi's boring school life....



◆Characters
・Yuna Kashiwagi
"Why are you so nervous?"

A pure looking girl with long black hair, she is in the same class as Kyoichi.
She is popular amongst both men and women, and someone who Kyoichi has a crush on her.
She is smart but not very good at sports.
When it comes to romance, she is the timid type who cannot make a move without an opportunity.


・Izumi Nakakaze
"Are you ignoring me, senpai? Pay attention to your cute junior a little!"

A junior gal with affection towards Kyoichi.
Despite her flashy looks, she is surprisingly smart and good at housework.
She is a gal with a strong will to enjoy life, without being swept by the influence of others.
Being full of curiosity, she is willing and eager to be hynoptized.


・Akari Shinozaki
"D... Don't call me cute... I'm your senpai"

A genius girl who is smart enough to skip a grade. She is one grade above Kyoichi, but a year younger.
She is quite a picky eater and has an extreme craving for sweet foods.
From her complex about having a petite and childish appearance,

data.name: Prison Ball: Full Blown
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever played a brick breaking arcade action game against another player?

Have you ever had to make a split second decision on whether to use your paddle to reflect a ball or drop to your knees to blow attack your opponent?

Have you ever had to make a choice between choosing a huge "P size" at the cost of slowed mobility?

Welcome to "Prison Ball: Full Blown" where the objective is simply to score more points than your opponent when the timer expires!

Players on each side of the screen fight for control of three balls which score points when they break the bricks in the middle and the balls only score points for the player who last reflected the ball with their paddle. If your opponent is doing a good job at controlling the balls, you can drop to your knees and do a blow attack towards your opponent and if you are successful, they will be stunned in a block of ice giving you the opportunity to steal control of the balls!

Prison Ball: Full Blown is an indie game made from the heart that offers both lots of laughs and barrels of fun!

This game features Full Local Player Convenience! Both local players can play at a single keyboard (WASD and Arrow keys) OR One player can use the keyboard and the other can use a controller, OR Both players can use controllers! The choice is completely up to you and what works best for you!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CONTROLS: (Keyboard)

Player 1: W = UP // S = DOWN // D = launch blow attack when bar is full (bottom left) // WASD controls your blow attack once launched
If Playing as DLC character Vast Shadows, pressing the SPACE BAR when you get the "Balls Out!" indicator will split your ball into 3 additional balls in your opponents face!

Player 2: ^ = UP // V = DOWN // < = launch blow attack when bar is full (bottom right) // arrow keys controls your blow attack once launched
If Playing as DLC character Vast Shadows, pressing the RIGHT SHIFT when you get the "Balls Out!" indicator will split your ball into 3 additional balls in your opponents face!


CONTROLS: (Controller)

Left stick or direction pad to move player up and down to hit ball or dodge blow attacks // A Button launches your blow attack, left stick controls it after launched

If Playing as DLC character Vast Shadows: Pressing the X button when you get a "Balls Out!" indicator on screen will split your ball into 3 additional balls in the face of your opponent!


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Counter to playing DLC character Deborah Fire:

Deborah Fire can ignite balls with her flaming paddle and these fire balls can in turn ignite bricks. Bricks on fire will slowly burn up and if destroyed by fire will give Deborah points that can turn the game in her favor very quickly. To counter this, try to hit her burning bricks with your own ball which on impact will cause a massive explosion, giving YOU all the points destroyed in that explosion! You'll easily see all the points you get in these counter explosions because the points floating from the destroyed bricks will be double in size as they float upwards.


Counter to playing DLC character Vast Shadows:

Vast Shadows can turn a lost ball of his color into his advantage by timing his active ability button press well, which will split his ball into three additional balls in your face! They will all be his color and almost impossible for you to deflect them all! They will score points for him as any other ball his color, but if you can change these Vast shadow balls your color by deflecting them, they will score points for you instead. Also if a Vast ball that you've changed to your color hits an interior pink brick, you'll instantly destroy his shadow ball and this will cause a blinding search light to shine on him for several seconds. While this light may not seem like much, it can blind his ability to see and deflect balls near him and might just turn things back in your favor!

data.name: First Light
data.detailed_description:
PRESENTATION


This is a 2D old-school RPG in the vein of Black Home and A Plunge into Darkness.

After a devastating Plague purged most of humanity, the few who survived escaped to the underground, in an attempt to survive the disease. After a decade of living in the dark, away from the world. Bahar, and his wife Guidry, believe the Plague has ceased to be and are on the pursuit of a way out, a way back to the world they once knew.

The path is long and perilous, but they will walk it bravely so their children, Dan and Ava, can finally start living instead of just surviving.

FEATURES


A touching storyline that will resonate with all of us given the latest circumstances
An adventurous pace that will keep you on your toes
Explore the underground world, a place full of mystery and dangers
Auto-save feature to keep you from meaningless repetition

data.name: Marked
data.detailed_description:
What is Marked?

Dust, blood, and lies. Salvation’s Edge, 1899 — a dying town where you’re a killer, a thief, and a fraud — handed a dead man’s badge and told to solve a murder. Do they deserve redemption? Do you? Or will everyone forever be MARKED?

Inspired by classic Click-and-Point adventures, Marked combines a riveting narrative with a realistic visual style. Immerse yourself in the gritty, raw main street and the majestic wilds of the American West as you uncover the darkness that lurks within Salvation Edge.

Features

Experience the classic feel of point-and-click adventure games, where every clue matters. Navigate Salvation’s Edge with intuitive interactions—examine crime scenes, collect key evidence, and piece together the mystery one click at a time.

Your choices shape Ben Mercer’s journey. Decisions, from interrogations to moral dilemmas, impact the story’s outcome. Will you uphold justice or let your past dictate your actions? Multiple endings ensure no two direct playthroughs are the same.

Beyond dialogue and deduction, put your wits to the test with hands-on environmental puzzles. Pick locks, reassemble torn documents, manipulate old safes, and uncover hidden compartments to expose Salvation’s darkest secrets.

Forge alliances or make enemies in this frontier town. Gain trust through dialogue and actions, unlocking unique character-driven side stories. Your relationship with the town will determine who stands by you when the truth comes to light.

Piece together evidence through an in-depth detective system. Compare clues, analyze crime scenes, and reconstruct events to uncover hidden motives. Choose how to confront suspects—coerce, manipulate, or outsmart them to get to the truth.

data.name: Immortal Love: Stone Beauty Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Friendly Fox Studios, formerly 4 Friends Games, presents a Valentine’s Day treat with the 9th installment in the Immortal Love series!
You’re finally returning to your beloved! After a life spent at sea as a naval captain, it’s time to settle down with the woman of your dreams. But your excitement is overshadowed when you return to find her missing! No one’s seen her since she won a famous sculptor’s beauty contest, and your investigation quickly leads you to a string of disappearances and people turned to stone! Can you stop a dangerous man bent on perfection before it’s too late? Find out in this sensational Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

• Find who’s using magic to bring Golems to life in the bonus game!
• Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games to earn achievements!
• Complete your animal collection to unlock a bonus Hidden-Object Puzzle!
• Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, concept art, movies, and more!
• Never get lost with the strategy guide!


This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

data.name: The Lightnwatchers 1：海城（The Sea City）
data.detailed_description:
Summary

One day in the future, the city is flooded, and the humans inadvertently open the portal connecting to the other world, from the other end of the door out of countless creatures from the other world, and the giant elder guardian also woke up and launched an attack on the humans. Exhausted by the attack, the survivors built a city under the sea along the coastline, Haicheng. In order to deal with the threat of alien creatures, the humans rebuilt their army to defend the city against the powerful Ancient guardians, and created the Lightn organization to fight dangerous creatures and rebels in The city. Under the guidance of fate, the protagonist joins Lightn and begins to protect the city as "J" against the dark forces from another world.

Start

The player will take the role of the hero and embark on a dangerous journey. More secrets of the world can be discovered through dialogue and exploration.

Fight

The game is divided into melee combat, ranged shooting and medium range gun fighting, in the face of different types of enemies, players can switch between different attack modes, to achieve better results. In the face of massive damage, the player can use dodge to dodge. Collect ground items and guns during combat to increase your chances of survival against powerful enemies, and improve your stats and skills by gaining experience from killing enemies.

Story items

In the development of the story, there will be a special story props, players can use the exclusive story props to open the hidden map.

Game progress

The game will be updated in phases.

data.name: One in a Thousand: Clover Book
data.detailed_description:
Somewhere in this patch of clovers hides an elusive four-leaf clover.

One in a Thousand is a minimalistic and cozy hidden-object game about the quiet joy of searching for four-leaf clover, just like you did when you were younger and carefree. Take a moment to slow down, look closely, and train your eye to recognize the subtle patterns that will lead to your lucky find.

What awaits you

data.name: Yakiniku!!!
data.detailed_description:
Smoke rises from the grill. Customers are lining up outside. And the whole shopping street is waiting to see what kind of restaurant you'll build.

Manage the Restaurant

Stock the fridge, set your menu, prepare the shop, and open the doors. Take orders, prep ingredients, serve dishes, clean tables, and keep everything moving through the dinner rush.

Serve the right cuts and keep an eye on every table. Cook the meat just right, respond to customer requests, and make sure nothing stays on the grill for too long.

Upgrade your equipment, expand your menu, improve the restaurant, and hire extra help. Start with a small neighborhood shop and build it into one of the best-known restaurants on the shopping street.

Run the Restaurant Together

Play Career Mode solo or with up to three friends.

There are no fixed roles. One moment you're working the grill, the next you're serving a table, restocking the fridge, or jumping in to help wherever the restaurant is falling behind.

Rival Mode

Co-op not working out? Kick the slackers out of your restaurant, split into two teams, and settle things properly.

Compete against your friends in 1v1, 2v1 or 2v2 matches. Both restaurants are fighting for the same customers, so every decision matters.

Offer better food, better service, and better prices—but keep an eye out for whatever sabotage your friends are planning across the street.

Go All In

About to go bankrupt? Don't worry.

Somewhere on the shopping street is a mysterious machine that might just turn things around. Grab some money from the restaurant, pull the lever, and put your comeback on the line.

Sneak away, keep it quiet, and come back a winner.

data.detailed_description:
Story:

Earth: the Millennium of humans has approached its end. History has come to a halt. Demons, angelic Kells, and human Cybers are in a three way conflict with no end in sight. Weary of fighting, people have placed their hopes on the Infinita Sacrament, said to have the power to change the world. An independent organization, “The Agency”, was created to search for it.

Who will obtain the Infinita Sacrament and take command of the next Millennium? The future is shrouded in dark mystery. You are the new Agent.

  • Dungeon mode: explore dungeons, level up, and obtain rare cards
  • Collect unique cards inspired by famous myths, legends, and H.P. Lovecraft
  • Pick sides and choose your favorite faction
  • Play and unlock exclusive art

data.name: Brief Karate Foolish
data.detailed_description:
Online match records and privacy

To show match records and rankings in online play (Brief Karate Online), the results of online matches are stored on a server run by the publisher.

  • Stored: your Steam account ID (SteamID), your Steam display name, the date and time of each match, the opponent's SteamID, the result and rounds won, your rating, the number of matches you left or lost the connection in, and whether you play a copy borrowed through Steam Family Sharing (with the owner's SteamID)
  • To stop abuse, the IP address a request comes from is kept for up to 5 minutes
  • Sign-in uses Steam's authentication. We never receive passwords, email addresses or similar details
  • Your record (grade, rating, wins and losses) is shown to other players in the online lobby. The ratings of ranked players are also shown on the game's Steam leaderboard (community hub)
  • Matches in "Unrated" rooms are not recorded
  • Records are kept while the service runs; backups are kept for 14 days

data.name: Heartbreak High: A Break-Up Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Imagine you're the most popular kid in school. So popular, in fact, that you're dating every single person in your class. The only problem? You've decided to break up with all of them, one by one.

Heartbreak High is an arcade-style spin on visual novels and dating simulators that asks you to break up with all of your high school sweethearts instead of woo them. A single play-through can be completed in one 20-40 minute sitting, with each break-up featuring a unique branching story path and lovable (or unlovable?) characters for you to crush beneath your feet over and over again.

If you couldn't already guess, it won't be easy. There's only 40 minutes until the end of the school day, and on top of that you must be careful not to act too cruel, too sexy, too selfish, and more... sometimes you'll have to stay tactful and sympathetic, while other break-ups will call for a somewhat firmer approach. It's as stressful as the real thing, baby!!!! And that's not even mentioning the various surprises and obstacles that'll get in your way!!!!

features

  • over 15 unique choose-your-own-adventure-style break-up encounters (any less than that wouldn't have been stressful enough)
  • multiple playthroughs encouraged - try saying something different next time because there's some wild stuff in there
  • nearly everything on screen is hand-drawn (including the typeface and menus even!) which i think is very impressive don't you??
  • an extensive original soundtrack by Ronnie Dezsi that brings every character (and menu screen) to life
  • very funny writing (i know that's subjective but it's also definitely true in this case, sorry)
  • there's a bunch of mini-games!!! they're like little tiny games inside of the bigger game, if you can believe it
  • lots of fun characters that are cute and might make you sad to break up with
  • it's a cheap quick game that doesn't take very long to play!!! it respects your time!!! isn't that nice!!!
  • i made this game almost entirely by myself! my name's Alec Robbins! hello!
  • there's a FREE PLAY mode where you can't lose but you also can't get to the final level. it's also good for role-playing without penalty!
  • you can get chocolate in the game but you can't use it for anything. i should have taken that out of the game actually
  • a surprise ending... not allowed to say more... my apologies for even bringing it up in the first place...
  • maybe you can even choose NOT to break up with them??? would that give you a different ending??? maybe??? hmm???
