data.name: cheesequest
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to cheesequest, a game where you have one objective, and one objective only - eat the cheese. But to eat the cheese, you first will need to earn it.



Do you understand?

Survival Card Gameplay


Inspired by games such as Inscryption or Slay the Spire, cheesequest pits the player against an unknown opponent in a series of card battles. The objective is to stockpile food by growing crops or raising livestock, while fending off your supplies from any hostile creature that may be lurking.

Fill your food gauge to win. Be careful - slip up, and you could easily starve.

Gain cards, augment them, and fuse new ones.

Survive. Thrive.

Features

  • Rogue-like deckbuilding
  • Card based battling
  • Creating new cards to aid in future runs
  • More than 8 modifiers that define how a card behaves in battle, with more on the way
  • More than 13 unique cards, with more on the way
  • Farming and sacrifice
  • A dark pixel-based aesthetic
  • Uncovering the mystery of the cheese

data.name: Deadlight: A Zombie Chronicle
data.detailed_description:
Deadlight is a survival management game about a small group of strangers holed up in a suburban house after the dead took the city. Each day has a morning, an afternoon and a night. You decide who cooks, who stands watch, who nails boards over the windows and who walks out the front door to look for supplies. Then the sun goes down and you find out if it was enough.


Every survivor has a job from their old life, a few quirks and an opinion about everyone else in the house. They get hungry, thirsty, tired, sick and scared. Push someone too hard and they may break. Put two people who can't stand each other on the same shift and you will hear about it. Open the door to a stranger and you might gain a doctor. Or a problem.


  • Hand out shifts across three phases a day: stand watch, rest, cook, fortify, scavenge, heal, repair the vehicle or head out on an expedition
  • Scout ten places on the neighborhood map, from the corner store to the county hospital, each with its own risk and loot
  • Read the raid forecast and decide whether tonight's defense will hold
  • Make hard calls in more than 170 events, many of them with lasting consequences
  • Chase each survivor's personal goals alongside the main objective
  • Build up the house: rain catcher, garden, watchtower and more


Fix the old car and drive out, flag down a helicopter, reach a bunker, join a convoy, turn the house into a fortress, or answer a radio broadcast. Most routes don't have room for everyone. Choosing who goes is part of the game.


A run lasts about three weeks of in-game time, or twice that on a long run. When it ends, the Ledger remembers it: who made it, who didn't, and how they died. Earn perks that carry into your next attempt.


  • A wide command board: your survivors, the house and your objectives on one screen
  • Full keyboard shortcuts and full controller support, with button prompts that follow whatever you're holding
  • Adjustable interface size, fullscreen and a reduce-motion option
  • 23 Steam achievements and Steam Cloud saves
  • Playable in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Arabic
  • One purchase. No ads, no microtransactions

data.name: Relief
data.detailed_description:
Relief is a deckbuilding roguelike set in a post–Journey to the West world. As the awakened heir of the Green Bull Demon (Azure Ox), you'll fight alongside five unique spirits, collect cards and artifacts, and craft powerful builds to carve out your own legend.

Each features its own cards and brings a distinct combat style to the fight.

  • Lu Wei: Transforms troublesome status cards into cards with random special modifiers.

  • Cui Beibei: Summons all manner of lovely feline spirits with a variety of abilities to aid in battle.

  • Chechi Rocket Team: Seamlessly switch between the tiger, deer, and goat captains to adapt your strategy mid-battle.

  • A.Lian: Features a unique Tribute card fusion mechanic. Cards with Blessing gain additional effects when placed at the far left or right of your hand.

  • Mrs.Luo: Wields three elemental forces that combine into devastating chain reactions and intricate builds.

The Roc presents a choice midway through each of the first three acts, each powerful enough to alter your strategy and deck direction. Play it safe with reliable boosts, or go all-in on high-risk, high-reward effects to create game-breaking builds with the potential to steamroll everything in your path.

Roc's Aid Powers (24 total):

  • Rebuild: Remove every card from your deck. Gain that many choices.

  • Glass Cannon: You have only 10% Max HP and gain only 10% of any Max HP increases, but deal 250% damage.

  • Less is More: Card removal costs 50 less gold. +1 card removal at the Black Market.

  • ... ...

Complete quests from the Roc to earn Incense, then offer it at shrines to grant your cards random powerful affixes (12 total). The right affix can turn even the most unremarkable card into a force to be reckoned with, while strong cards can become downright broken, unlocking wild new build paths.

Blessings (14 total):

  • Combo: Play all copies of this card in your hand and draw pile.

  • Overdraw: Play this card for free. At the start of the next X turns, lose 1 Energy (X = its cost).

  • ... ...

  • Over 1,000 cards and 300 artifacts: Character-specific cards, general cards, and Black Market options combine with a massive pool of artifacts to create near-endless build variety! No two runs ever feel the same.

  • Unique 14-day cycle: The game unfolds across five acts, built around a repeating 14-day cycle. While in town, strengthen your build at the Shop, Hot Springs, and Shrine, then venture beyond its gates to explore the unknown. Plan your days wisely and work your way toward the final boss.

  • Curious encounters: Over 50 random events steeped in Chinese folklore and urban legends await. Will you accept an offering in a dim, shadowy corner, or awaken something... unknown? Every choice shapes what comes next.

If you enjoy roguelike deckbuilders, deep strategy, and game-breaking synergistic combos, or if you love any of the following titles:

Slay the Spire | Monster Train | Griftlands | Inscryption | Chrono Ark

...then you will definitely love Relief! Step into a post-Journey to the West urban legend world, and experience the same highly addictive card battles, insane card modifiers, and limitless deckbuilding possibilities!

data.name: XILOST
data.detailed_description:
XILOST is a CO-OP first-person shooter game that focuses on cooperative gameplay. Players must work together to complete missions and take on intense firefights on various assignments.

Set into the future, technological advancements have bloomed exponentially, creating different tools and inventions marveled by humans.

In a secret institution, brilliant scientists and chemists are working on a controversial project: genetic alteration. Using a mysterious chemical, they can break down and rearrange DNA strains. However, Before they can fully research the chemical's effects, their work is interrupted when uninvited individuals enter the facility. Scientists and chemists have been missing since then, and the chemical's true potential remains a mystery.

XILOST is packed with satisfying gunplay and lets you play with your friends in a cooperative environment. You can play with up to 3 players in a single game. The game features a variety of missions, each with its unique objectives and challenges.

0.1.x :

- Initial release

- Core Gameplay

- 1 Game Mode (4-Player PVE)

- 1 Map

- 4 Weapons (Pistol, Shotgun, SMG, Assault Rifle)

- 1 Enemy Type

0.2.x :

- Additional new enemy

- Additional new weapon

- Additional new map

0.3.x :

- Additional mechanics to the core gameplay

- Additional new weapon

- Additional new map

0.4.x :

- Additional New Game Mode (4-Player PVE)

- Additional new weapon

- Weapon Customization

- Weapon Progression

0.5.x :

- Additional new enemy type

- Additional new weapon

- Additional new map

More content will come as the game progresses.

Intended game features:

  • 4-Player PVE Co-op

  • Campaign Mode (up to 4 player Coop Linear Story, with fixed levels, random objectives items)

  • Weapon Loadout

  • Weapon Progression

  • Character Customization

  • Character Progression

  • Game mode with randomly generated levels

  • Multiple Enemy Types

  • Multiple Weapons

  • Operation (Raid)

I hope this roadmap gives a good idea of what to expect from Xilost in the future,

and it's not set in stone, as we are 2 developers working on this project,

Community is also a huge part of the development process,

many things may change as the development progresses.
Our vision for Xilost is to provide strong gameplay as the fundamentals before we progress into the lore and universe of Xilost.

The game will be in Early Access until we ensure all core features and intended gameplay mechanics are implemented and polished.

data.name: Infinite Alliance
data.detailed_description:
Featuring characters from Chained Echoes, Quartet, CrossCode, Jack Move, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, and many more!

Pulled from their homes and stranded on a dead world, a disparate group of champions must face their past, redeem a failed hero, and slay a dark force which threatens all creation...

Engage in stylish turn-based battles with a party of 9 unique heroes, and encounter familiar friends, foes, and environments re-imagined. Plus, test your mettle against warriors from CrossCode, Seed of Nostalgia, Cosmic Star Heroine, and Geo Mythica in over-the-top superboss battles!

Infinite Alliance showcases the creative variety of the Indie JRPG scene, and we hope you'll discover your next favorite game through this epic FREE adventure! 

Heroes

  • Glenn from Chained Echoes

  • Dustin from Kingdoms of the Dump

  • Noa from Jack Move

  • The Warrior (named by the player) from 8-Bit Adventures 2

  • Alexandra from Quartet

  • Rio from Shrine’s Legacy

  • Chel from For a Vast Future 

  • Whoopis from My Familiar

  • Vera & Arin from Eternal Remnant

  • Gio from Geo Mythica

Villains

  • Drago from Beloved Rapture

  • Montam from Venaitura

  • The Fateshifter from Ephemeral Tale

  • Qliphoth - an original villain.

Guest Battles

  • Lea from CrossCode

  • Alyssa & Chahn from Cosmic Star Heroine

  • Atilla from Seed of Nostalgia

  • Gio, Liliana, and Drake from Geo Mythica

Cameos

  • Blitz from Godless Avalon

data.name: Got More?
data.detailed_description:
Got More? is a bullet heaven roguelite about turning a handful of weapons into a build that can take on the horde. Your attacks fire automatically. You choose the upgrades, collect XP and keep moving when the enemies close in.

Build your own loadout

Mix guns, melee weapons, mines and energy attacks with support skills. Pick upgrades as you level up and work towards weapon evolutions. Cover the ground with fire, fight up close or fill the screen with energy attacks. Try a different combination next run.



Each level gives you upgrades to choose from. Reroll a card to look for a better fit, then add your pick to the build.

Fight 18 bosses

Charging beasts, burrowing worms, dragons and stone giants each have attacks to learn. Watch the warning areas, dodge the hit and use the opening to fight back. A strong build helps, but you still need to move.



Defeat bosses, collect their treasure and roll for skill upgrades and coins.

Get stronger between runs

Collect equipment, upgrade your gear and spend earned resources on the evolution tree. Build up permanent upgrades and prepare your loadout before heading into the next chapter.

More to unlock

  • 15 campaign chapters across forests, deserts, snowfields and more.
  • Six unlockable companions with different combat and support abilities.
  • Equipment to collect and upgrade, weapon evolutions and permanent upgrades.
  • Single-player combat with automatic attacks and keyboard or controller movement.

Connection requirement: An internet connection and Steam sign-in are required for player progression.

data.name: Cannonball Crew
data.detailed_description:
Multiplayer Pirate Party Mayhem With Friends

Cannonball Crew is a chaotic online party game where two teams face off in intense matches full of treasure hunting, sword showdowns, and cannon-fueled mayhem.

Perfect for online play with friends!

Recommended for 2 to 20 players, with support for up to 40. AI can fill in any empty spots.

Pick Your Path to Victory With Different Game Modes

Mix and match game modes to create the perfect chaotic pirate showdown for you and your friends. The team with the highest score when time runs out wins the match.

  • Team Deathmatch – Take out enemies to earn points for your team. Win fights, win points.

  • Bounty Hunt – Random players become high-value targets for a limited time. Take them out to receive bonus points before the opportunity vanishes.

  • Treasure Hunt – Search the map for treasure, hide it on your team's side to score, and defend it from rival pirates.

Weapons and Combat Mechanics

  • Capture – Send enemies to prison and earn clues about their hidden treasures — but beware, they’ll escape after a while or if a teammate sets them free.

  • Sword – Wield your sword to fend off enemies trying to capture or attack you.

  • Harpoon – Use the harpoon to pull yourself forward, drag enemies closer, or grab distant crates and treasures.

  • Cannon – Fire explosive cannonballs to clear your path and send foes flying!

Join the Cannonball Crew Now

From last-second treasure thefts to explosive battles, Cannonball Crew is packed with action, strategy, and laughs.

Gather your pirate friends!

data.name: Super Good Boy Adventure
data.detailed_description:
In Super Good Boy Adventure, you play as Igor trying to rescue his human, who was captured by the cats Eric and Kenny. Igor goes in a journey through fields and mountains, lakes and cities, to find the cats and bring back his loved one.

This is an old school style, silly but adorable, dog-based platform game where you can control everything through a couple of buttons and the directional pad.

Journey through several stages looking for secret bonus areas, hidden golden bones and a lot of orange balls to add to your overall score.

Explore a world map with dozens of stages scatered through the entire land.

data.name: Titanium Court
data.detailed_description:
Well what do we have here? Streetwise tough looking for answers, huh. Well, answers we got, assuming you've got the second half of our agreement? Excellent. Love the satisfying click of an opening briefcase. Come on in, pal. Here's all the "dirt" we uncovered on this "Titanium Court":

So, lotta people have heard of this game, but not a lot are coming clean about what it actually is. Most of the witnesses we "interviewed" just said it was "a fanciful rabbit-hole of unending delights" or some crap like that. Real coy operation they got going on over there, I'll tell ya what. Don't worry, we did manage to shake a few facts out of them. Here you go!

Title: Titanium Court

Developer: AP Thomson

Publisher: Fellow Traveller

Number of players: 1

Play time: 6-30 hours.

Now as for the genre we were having a lot of trouble pinning that down from testimony alone, so we "acquired" a copy to see what was up. (Hey what's a private investigation without a little bit of larceny, right?) Anyway, we sent it down to forensics. Let's look at what they have to say.


Forensics Report:

Titanium Court appears to be some kind of match-3 tower-defense roguelike. Or maybe it's a tower-defense puzzle strategy card roguelite? I hesitate to call it a deck-builder because you don't really build a deck but you do sometimes draft a variety of upgrades. Oh, there's also a lot of text but we skipped all of that. Not our department.

End Forensics Report

Yeah, I don't know what to make of that either. Maybe this is something the kids are into nowadays? I asked my cocky teenage son but he just rolled his eyes and made some kinda inscrutable hand gesture I can only assume he learned after getting too much screen time. Takes after his old man too much, little punk.

Oh, one more thing. Now I'm not trying to scare you, pal, but during the course of our investigation some clown delivered this box of unmarked bullets directly to our doorstep. Maybe they thought they were sending some kinda message, but it'll take more n' that to scare off our crew. My bet is this is just an unrelated prank, but I've included the bullets anyway, here at the end. 

Bullets:

  • Puzzling Battles: Swap and match the battlefield terrain so it falls in your favor, or against it.

  • Puzzling Narrative: While you’re here, could you help the Court’s residents search for their missing queen? And could you help their queen search for her missing keys? And could you help the audience search for the Point? You can? Great!

  • Diverse and fulfilling career options: Warlord, Arsonist, Celebrity, Insurance Fraudster. Your time within the Court will qualify you for many of these exalted and lucrative positions.

  • Fully interactive shower: for certain definitions of "interactive" and certain definitions of "shower."

Anyway, that's all the info our investigation turned up. Can’t imagine what you’ll do with it, hehehe, but next time you need some dirt on an inscrutable critically-acclaimed independent videogame, you know who to call.

data.name: Silent Castle
data.detailed_description:
■Story

“My dad was killed by the hero.”

After the hero’s assault, the Demon Castle was left completely deserted.

Now, the Demon Lord’s son begins the lonely task of cleaning up the ruined castle—by himself.

■Overview

This game is a short “clean-up” push-puzzle.

You can push one statue or rock at a time—

but you cannot pull them.

Clear each stage by moving all demon statues onto the glowing tiles.

It’s a tough, thoughtful puzzle where the order you push things truly matters.

■Stages

Includes over 30 handcrafted puzzles to challenge your wits.

■If You Get Stuck

In the Pause menu, select “Skip to Next Floor” to move past the current floor.

Skipped floors can be challenged again later.

By selecting “Official Solutions Page” from the Options menu, you can access a website that contains solution videos for puzzles up to the late stages of the game.

Please use this if you need hints or want to check the solutions.

■Streaming & Video Guidelines

You are free to record and share gameplay videos of this game, including livestreams, without needing prior permission—whether as an individual or a company. Please follow these guidelines:

  • Include a link to this page in the video description or equivalent section.

  • Monetization is only allowed when using the official features provided by each video platform.

  • Any content that violates laws or public order and morals is strictly prohibited.

  • The developer assumes no responsibility for any damages arising from the posting or streaming of videos.

These guidelines are subject to change without prior notice.

data.name: 30 DAYS. ALONE. ADRIFT.
data.detailed_description:
Alone on board

You are the only engineer on an autonomous cargo ship 🚢 drifting through the South China Sea 🌊 after a system failure ⚡. Engines are silent, communication is lost, and you are left alone, trying to survive and maybe laugh at your situation.

Exploration and adventure

Every day is a challenge, and every container may hold something useful, strange, or hilariously unexpected. Food, tools, weapons, and bizarre items all await discovery.

Crafting and base building

Gather resources to craft tools, weapons, and shelters. Furnish your cabin 🛏️ and create safe spaces for rest and storing your loot. Broken parts of the ship can also be repurposed for repairs and experiments.

Puzzles and system repair

Repair malfunctioning mechanisms, solve logic puzzles, and try to regain control of the ship. Attention, ingenuity, and engineering skills are required.

Movement and transport

Find vehicles like small boats and trolleys to explore the ship faster and access hard-to-reach areas.

Health and threats

Monitor hunger, thirst, fatigue, seasickness, and injuries. First aid kits and medicine help recovery, but dangers like wildlife attacks and accidents lurk on board.

Mental state and self-irony

Loneliness affects your sanity. Hallucinations and strange sounds can make ordinary objects appear terrifying or comical. Every decision is both a risk and an opportunity for self-irony.

Survival and legend

Repair the ship or embrace the drift and enjoy the adventure. Will you survive and become the legend of a ship full of strange finds, puzzles, and unexpected humor? Add 30 Days. Alone. Adrift. to your wishlist and show the ocean 🌊 that an engineer can survive… with style and humor.

data.name: The Final Exhibit
data.detailed_description:
You’ve been called to inspect a mysterious museum. Its owner claims that a strange aura surrounds some of the exhibits. Restore the works of art, uncover the truth behind the presence lurking within its halls, and discover whether some secrets were meant to remain hidden.

But something is watching you.

The further you progress, the more the museum seems to change around you… And the more this presence reacts to your actions.

🎨 Restore what was corrupted

Explore the museum and find the missing fragments of mysterious statues and paintings. Restore the corrupted works to cleanse them of the corruption surrounding them and unlock new galleries.

👁️ Something is watching

The museum is never truly silent. As you progress, a presence begins to react to your actions. The more you restore, the more determined it seems to become to stop you.

🏛️ Explore a living museum

Discover galleries filled with statues, paintings and forgotten relics. As you restore the museum, the world around you begins to change. Observe your surroundings, uncover clues, and piece together the story hidden within these walls.

The deeper you venture, the more the museum seems to respond to your presence. There are no weapons to rely on. Instead, you must observe, investigate, and understand what is happening around you.

Restore what was corrupted. Discover what should have stayed hidden.

Will you uncover the truth... or set it free?

data.name: Nanzou: The Divine Court
data.detailed_description:
CHECK OUT OUR OTHER GAMES


About the Game




Welcome to Nanzou, Exceptional Soul!
Nanzou: The Divine Court is a genre-mixing city builder set in a living and ever-changing world inspired by Chinese myths and legends.

Summoned by the Emperor of the Divine Court, You, the Exceptional Soul arrive on Nanzou – a mystical floating island, drifting somewhere in an unknown time and space. Your task is simple. Command souls to fulfill the Emperor’s Will.

Magnificent genre mix!
While being a city builder at its very core, the game features elements of other strategy subgenres, with diplomacy and trading with other cities, as well as wuxia hero-focused turn-based combat!

Across Valleys, Mountaintops and Floating Isles
Expand your City across multiple levels of height with unique features, resources, pros and cons. Connect them with roads, bridges, and lifts to create efficient supply chains throughout your city.

The Mysterious Living World
Explore and interact with the living world of Nanzou with procedurally generated cities, characters, and events! Learn about your surroundings, send heroes on adventures, engage in diplomatic talks, or plan trading routes for caravans around the world!

Cities as Battlefields
Throughout the game, your city will face many dangers. During sieges, it will turn into an interactive battlefield, with destructible buildings, defensive structures, and siege weaponry. Train your mythical heroes to defend your city at all costs. You’re not limited to defense though - retaliate and attack the cities of your enemies or fight them in the open world in dynamic turn-based combat!

Simple Rules, Complex Interactions
Every core mechanic in the game is set on an easy to understand foundation with complexity rising over time, to create an experience accessible to everyone. Ultimately, the player will control how challenging they want their experience to be.

We want to hear your voice!
Let us know what you think about the changes via Steam Discussions in the game’s Community section!
Soon we will launch an official Discord server for Nanzou: The Divine Court where you will be able to share your thoughts and suggestions, as well as ask the developers questions about the game!

We will plan and host playtests there too so keep an eye out for future updates!

More cards will be revealed soon…

data.name: Not A Safe Place
data.detailed_description:
You awaken in darkness. No daylight. No exit. Only cold rock, the echo of your footsteps – and the rustle of paper.

Deep within a labyrinthine cave system, you come across the abandoned notes of Zac, a missing person who fell into the same abyss years ago. His words become your map, and you follow his fate step by step – and the closer you get to him, the blurrier the line between truth and madness becomes.

Find paths where none should exist. Explore branching tunnels, solve environmental puzzles, and open hidden passages. Listen to every sound – something lives down here, and it hunts in the dark. Without weapons, you only have your wits, caution, and the faint glow of your light source.

Will you escape? Or will you become the next echo wave in the depths?

data.name: Position
data.detailed_description:
The real world lied to us.


For many years, the old hermit has been quietly living in his house on the edge of the lake, doing his daily business.
At one point, his life is completely divided into before and after.
Compelled reasons incite him to adventures in various famous or even fabulous places, trying to understand why he was thrown there and whether everything happening around is real. The denouement will solve this dilemma, perhaps.

A tangled tangle of plot.
The situation is constantly changing. Fates of places, crazy turns and interesting solutions to problems will keep you in the spotlight.

Progressive gameplay.
The gameplay of the game tends from slow to fast in parallel, providing new opportunities for the passage of certain paths.

A variety of tasks.
We are not fans of games with 2-3 mechanics for the whole game. All quests are as different as possible by submission and execution method.

High-quality graphics and solicitude to detail.
A detailed world created manually on the Unity game engine shows a combination of excellent performance and graphics.

data.name: Cannon Foundry Simulator
data.detailed_description:
• Decide what size of cannon you want to cast (light, field, heavy or even bigger)
  • Shape its barrel (mortar, howitzer, long-barrel)
  • Choose decorations and inscriptions
  • Decide what material - (bronze, brass, iron?)
  • Cast off the cannon, keeping an eye on the melt and temperature (make no mistake because the casting will come out brittle)
  • Choose the caliber of the barrel and drill it (the thinner the walls, the larger the ball but also higher the risk of explosion of the gun)
  • Polish the finished barrel
  • Build a gun carriage for it (for ships, field, fortress, siege)
  • Test your cannon on fortresses, buildings and ships.
  • Kings and generals will want to buy cannons if they are good.

You set up a cannon foundry. You have to go through the entire process of creating an old cannon from the very beginning. Build your workshop and start production. You start with the most primitive medieval guns. But you're still developing. You improve the workshop and discover new technologies. You build both light, field and heavy guns. After selecting the size of the gun, you set the shape of the barrel and its length. You also decide whether it will be a cannon or a mortar. Once you have made the cannon mold, you go into a risky casting process. If the casting succeeds, you can drill the barrel (the best guns had the barrel drilled only after casting!). Be careful not to overdo it with the size of the barrel in relation to the thickness of the barrel walls! Later you decide on which carriage to mount the gun. Heavy guns require a strong carriage, so their mobility will be reduced. Then test your gun - is it accurate? how is the range? does the cannonball fly flat or steep? how much gunpowder can you load (velocity of the cannonball)? how effective is it in destroying various targets?
This all affects the price your guns will get on the arms market.

data.name: Fun with Ragdolls: The Game
data.detailed_description:
Objective

You're a Ragdoll! What's the point of the game? Do what a Ragdoll is meant to do and flop, fall, or crash on to things! Don't be nervous!

Sandbox

Build worlds for you and your ragdolls! Choose from a collection of Cannons, Black Holes, giant Fans, Ragdolls (obviously), Mines, Lasers, Cars, Jump Pads, Telepads, glass, destructible Pillars, Lasers, and more! I can't name everything cause it'd take up too many characters...

World Sharing

Share your creations and download maps created by others from across the world!

Ragdoll AI

Choose from a selection of different Ragdoll AI! Attackers, Defenders, Seekers (hide & seek), Followers, Explorers, and more! They can also traverse the worlds you build autonomously!

Items

Every item in the game has properties you can adjust! Want to change how powerful the Mines are? Go for it! Want to make a Ragdoll giant!? Do it! You can use items and adjust their properties to make mazes, stunt courses, mini-games, art, at this point I'm sure you get the idea.

Customization

Change the look of your Ragdoll from an assortment of skins and faces! You can also choose from a selection of skyboxes/environments!

This game truly gives you the ultimate ragdoll experience like no other!

data.name: Worms Revolution
data.detailed_description:
Worms™ Revolution is the latest game in the classic turn-based strategy series to come to the PC,  featuring exciting new features and beautiful 3D graphics whilst retaining the classic 2D gameplay that fans love. Choose to play the extensive single player mode which features both campaign and puzzle missions or dive straight into multiplayer warfare via online or local play. For the first time ever see the inclusion of dynamic water, physics objects and worm classes! Customise your experience by choosing what classes you play with, what they look like and even how they speak!
 
Worms™ Revolution sticks an exploding sheep under worm-on-worm conflict and blasts it squarely into the 21st century.

Key Features

 
  • Class Acts! Choose from 4 different classes: Soldier, Scout, Scientist and Heavy. Players can unlock a total of 16 worms (4 of each class) to form their teams. It’s possible to take any combination of classes into a match.
  • Customize Your Worms! Customize your worms using a variety of hats, glasses, moustaches, gravestones, victory dances, soundbanks, and for the first time ever, trinkets!
  • Extensive Single Player Mode. Battle your way through 32 single player campaign missions. Fancy exercising your brain as well as your brawn? There are 20 puzzle missions waiting for you!
  • Includes a Level Editor. Create new environments for you worms to battle in and destroy.
  • Stunning New Landscapes. Fight to the death across 4 unique environments: Beach, Sewer, Farmyard and Spooky.
  • Multiplayer Battles! Experience local or online battles with up to 4 players. Choose from 3 different game modes: Deathmatch, Forts or Classic mode.
  • Dynamic Water. Dynamic water features in an array of new weapons and utilities and it can also appear already on the landscape in matches.
  • Exploding Physics Objects! Physics objects are destructible items that possess devastating effects as some have different properties when they explode. Watch out as they release fire, poison and water!
  • New Weapons. Wash those worms away using the new water weapons: Water Bomb, Water Pistol and Water Strike. Dynamic water can be drained away with the addition of the new Plug Hole utility. There’s also Stick Up, which is used to steal from your opponent’s inventory and the Wrench, which can repair damaged Sentry Guns and physics objects.
  • Hilarious Script and Voice Over Talent.  Worms™ Revolution brings together two comedy legends, who between them bring alive the humorous world of Worms. Multi-BAFTA award winning writer Dean Wilkinson provides the script, which is hilariously brought to life by the accomplished Matt Berry as the unseen narrator of the game, Don Keystone, a wildlife documentary maker.

data.name: SHEEP.IO
data.detailed_description:
Can you create the biggest flock?



Collect sheep from across the farm, steal followers from other sheep and gather the biggest flock possible!

• Collect followers from across the farm
• Steal followers from other sheep
• Gather the biggest flock possible
• Unlock new hats and skins

Use the mouse, the keyboard or a gamepad to control your sheep. Run up to unclaimed sheep to have them follow you, or run up to sheep following others with less followers than you to steal them. The sheep with the most followers at the end of the round wins. Winning rounds allows you to earn gems in order to unlock new skins, colours and clothing to customise your sheep.

Experience steadily increasing puzzle complexity

No timers or pressure—just play and unwind

data.name: Brutal Fate
data.detailed_description:
Brutal Fate is a fast-paced ultra-violent retro first-person shooter inspired by 80's and 90's sci-fi movies. As a marine from the Global Order Alliance sent to Callisto to take over the local corporate government, you find yourself surrounded by legions of demonic alien invaders and you must fight for your survival.
It blends the best features of classic shooters such as non-linear level design, a huge arsenal and large enemy variety with some modern aspects, making it a unique mix that does not try to hang on nostalgia, but be something of it's own.



This game is a finely crafted first-person experience designed to be the most satisfying and detailed possible. Enemies that can be dismembered and exploded into pieces, destroyable environments including lamps, cars and even trees. All many details that makes you really feel like you are in a real living world.

Do you want to know more?


  • This game features a huge arsenal of weapons that may require the use of all your keyboard numbers to scroll through. We got battle rifles, shotguns, grenade launchers, smart missiles, laser rifles, you name it.

  • Immerse yourself in a 3 episode campaign, with branching patches, multiple endings, and a story full of twists.

  • Fight an entire circus of monstrosities, carnivorous demons, zombie-like cultists, shuffling supernatural incomprehensible abominations from beyond, and corporate henchmen that want to make sure you won't leave this haunted colony alive after seeing everything you just did. Just like in classic fps style, each enemy type acts like a piece of chess made to compensate the weakness of another. Gib them into delicious meat pieces, burn them to ashes, almost every enemy features locational damage and dozens of death animations, including different deaths for different weapons used.

  • Explore huge non-linear levels, look for secrets to find special rare alternative ammo types for your weapons, health and armor upgrades, and much more. No "procedural generated levels", no faux-retro arena level design, just handcrafted levels by someone with over 10 years of experience in classic game level design. Get the feeling of exploring believable highly interactive locations, fight enemies in many different scenarios, scripted or not, pick them alone or in small groups and sometimes try to come up with a strategy to fight up to 50 enemies at once.

  • Command your fellow marines out of this hell. Your character's rank as a Staff Sergeant isn't only for show. Find any survivors of this disastrous operation and they will follow you. They have an acceptable AI that will actually follow your commands, won't block your movement, and will kill enemies for you. Magnificent, isn't it?

  • Mod it until it breaks. Running on the highly reliable GZDoom engine, this game is extremely easy to be modified. You can make mods, add custom weapons, enemies, levels, and entire new user-made campaigns.

Plot

In the end of the 21th century, after a catastrophic nuclear war followed by a famine that wiped out half of Earth, the remaining governments united their military under the same banner in a vow to prevent another disaster, and so the Global Order Alliance was born.
Later the G.O.A. united with corporations in an effort to terraform and colonize other planets in the solar system, by using a method that allowed artificial black holes to be created at the center of the planets to imitate Earth's gravity. 60 years later when the terraforming of Mars and Jupiter's moons were completed and mass migration started, the corporations betrayed the Terran governments and decided to declare independency and not use their newfound resources to help Earth get back on it's feet. Their moto was "We terraformed these planets and now everything on them belongs to us. If you want these resources, come and take it."

Betrayed and left for dead, the peoples from all around the world vowed to invade the colonies and take back what belongs to Earth. The armies of the G.O.A. which were once considered heroes and peacekeepers of mankind, became a violent, fanatic, imperialistic military legion. They launched military campaigns against Mars and Io that lasted for decades. Now the year is 2297 and the people of Callisto started rebelling against the corporate rule due to recent strange phenomena caused by the planet's artificial black hole, all the interplanetary communications are shut down by the regime, and the G.O.A. sees this as a perfect opportunity to invade the planet and "liberate" it with the local population's support. The corporate conglomerates warns that the situation in Callisto is "complicated" and warns Earth to stay away from it.

You are part of a special international battalion of the Space Division of the G.O.A. Marine Corps sent to intermediate the situation. After a four month journey, you arrive at the planet with orders to destroy the corporate government forces and secure their industrial facilities. Drone scans shows literally hundreds of thousands of dead bodies littering the streets, apparently they genocided the local populace which saves you from the work of having to watch your targets... Your orders are clear: Descend into the planet with companies of battle-hardened Marines, combat androids, tanks, mechs, gunships and orbital artillery, and eliminate any colonial military forces you may find. They are considered dangerous irregular war criminals and you have no legal requirement to grant them any human rights, engage on contact. All weapons are clear... Exterminate with extreme prejudice, just the way the Marines likes to operate.

The Marines quickly find out that something is wrong. The planet is dead. Non-combatants and colonial guard alike were slaughtered, women and children included. No signs that a war happened here, some bodies defiled in unspeakable macabre religious rituals.

You realize that what killed these people weren't humans, it weren't using guns, and it's still here. An unfathomable evil from beyond lurks these dead streets, its hungry eyes are gazing upon you. Do you have what it takes to survive?

data.name: Follow My Steps
data.detailed_description:
AN EMOTIONAL AND DREAMLIKE ADVENTURE

Follow My Steps is a narrative open world RPG blending exploration, stealth, magical combat, and impactful moral choices.
Play as Sova, protect and raise Lou, your wolf pup. Together, forge a unique bond that will shape your journey and lead to one of its many endings. Sova is neither a chosen one nor a warrior. She is a mother. And her world is falling apart. When faced with the unknown, you’ll need to learn how to survive, guide, love… and sometimes sacrifice. Lou watches everything, and each choice will leave a mark on him.

The open world waiting for you won’t let you rest. Creatures prowl, ruins whisper forgotten truths, and the shadow of the Midnight Pack grows. You’ll have to run, fight, or hide. The choice is yours.
Will you follow your heart, your instincts… or your emotions? Will you protect Lou from danger or teach him how to face it?

MAGIC AND COMBAT

• Master up to six elemental powers.
• Strengthen your abilities with an alchemy system offering permanent bonuses.
• Embrace balance or chaos by walking the path of Dawn or Dusk.
• Adapt your strategies to protect Lou the best you can.

"She hated magic because of that secret buried deep inside her for years. Every lie she told her child was another bar in the prison of her denial."

EXPLORATION

• Roam a rich open world full of atmosphere: haunted forests, forgotten ruins, silent clearings, snowy steppes, caves filled with buried secrets…
• Forget minimaps and rediscover the joy of observing your environment.
• Dig into the ground to uncover rare items, clues, leads, and hidden areas.
• The path is never marked: it’s buried in the landscapes and encounters. Every place you visit shapes your own interpretation of the world’s story… and of Sova’s past.

"Suddenly, the world opened up to Lou. A world Sova had abandoned, but that never forgot her."

STEALTH AND SURVIVAL

• Activate your wolf senses to detect threats, track scents, and mark enemies.
• Watch where the wind carries your scent and be mindful of the noises you make to stay unseen or lay an ambush.
• Choose your approach: silent infiltration, tactical retreat, or direct confrontation.
• In the silence of the hunt, every step is a decision, every breath a risk when Lou follows in your footsteps…

"Haunted by her past, she runs. The ground rushes beneath her paws, the frightened breath of her child right behind her. She flees the Midnight Pack. She flees her demons."

NARRATIVE AND CHOICES

• The world doesn’t explain its past. Feel, interpret, and uncover its story woven from ancient legends, forgotten beliefs, and hidden secrets.
• Build relationships with others: a single word can save a life, a broken promise can turn an ally into an enemy.
• Make meaningful, moral, emotional, or strategic decisions, and face the consequences to the end.
• The results of your choices, sometimes obvious, sometimes invisible, will lead you to one of 27 different endings… Which one awaits you?

"In Follow My Steps, you don’t play a powerful hero. You play a parent, a friend, a mother, a wolf. You feel fear, pride, love, doubt. You raise a soul."

KEY FEATURES

• Play as a wolf in an emotional narrative RPG where every choice shapes a rich story where decisions matter.
• Discover 27 different endings, shaped by your decisions.
• Freely explore an Open World filled with mysteries, varied environments, and the raw beauty of nature.
• Take action! Use six elemental magics to fight creatures and epic bosses.
• Feel the world like a wolf. Use your senses to track scents, mark enemy presence, or dig up the most hidden treasures.
• Build a strong, evolving bond with your wolf pup, whose reactions impact both gameplay and narrative.
• Immerse yourself in a dreamlike artistic direction enhanced by an original soundtrack that echoes every emotion.
• Experience a journey filled with emotion, at the crossroads of action, contemplation, and survival, puzzle, crafted by an indie studio.
• A fully voice-acted adventure featuring a stellar cast: Brigitte Lecordier (Dragon Ball Z, The Witcher…), Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Warcraft, Hearthstone…), Dominique Vallée (Charmed, Batman…).
• Let yourself be carried away by an original soundtrack that follows every beat of the story for a deeply atmospheric immersion.

“A game about all of us.”

data.name: Hnefatafl
data.detailed_description: Experience Hnefatafl, the ancient Viking board game of strategy and unequal warfare. Test your wits in tactical matches against a computer opponent. Core Gameplay Features: • Asymmetrical Warfare: One side controls the King and his defenders, attempting to escape to the safety of the corner squares. The other side controls an invading army of attackers, outnumbering the defenders two-to-one, tasked with trapping and capturing the King. • Strategic Capture: Pieces move orthogonally (like rooks in chess). Capture enemy pieces by surrounding them on two opposite sides—sandwiching them between your pieces, or between a piece and a hostile corner or throne square. • Single-Player AI Mode: Challenge a computer opponent designed to test your positioning, defensive wall building, and offensive flanking maneuvers.

data.name: Lionheart: The Spirit Within
data.detailed_description:
Two Worlds. Two Heroes. One Goal.

Lionheart: The Spirit Within is an atmospheric 2.5D metroidvania about a boy trying to rescue his parents by traveling through two interconnected worlds.

Switch between the real world, where you play as a vulnerable boy, and the spirit world, where you become a powerful lion.

The same locations exist in both worlds, but they can look, feel, and play completely differently. Paths, enemies, obstacles and opportunities change depending on which world you are in.

Survive in the Real World

The boy cannot fight his enemies directly. Hide, avoid danger, use stealth, interact with the environment and find another way forward.

The abandoned hospital is only the beginning. The full journey will take you through different locations in the real world, each with its own reflection in the spirit world.

Fight in the Spirit World

As the lion, face corrupted creatures using powerful movement abilities and close-range combat.

Defeating an enemy is not always the end. Cleanse corrupted spirits and save the souls trapped within them.

Solve Puzzles Across Two Worlds

Many obstacles cannot be solved from only one side.

Switch between the boy and the lion, study both versions of the environment and use the differences between the real and spirit worlds to find the solution.

Actions and discoveries in one world can help you progress through the other.

Two Heroes, Two Ways to Play

The boy relies on stealth, intelligence and interaction with the environment.

The lion relies on combat, mobility and supernatural abilities.

Progress requires learning how to use both of them together.

Save Your Parents

The boy's journey begins with one goal: find and rescue his parents.

Their fate is connected to the spirit world and the forces hidden within it. As the journey continues, the boy will discover what happened to them, why they were taken, and what his connection to the lion truly means.

Explore Two Versions of One World

Travel through different real-world locations and discover their transformed counterparts in the spirit world.

Every new place reveals another part of the mystery and new ways in which the two worlds interact.

Progress requires learning how to use both of them together.

Save Your Parents

The boy's journey begins with one goal: find and rescue his parents.

Their fate is connected to the spirit world and the forces hidden within it. As the journey continues, the boy will discover what happened to them, why they were taken, and what his connection to the lion truly means.

Explore Two Versions of One World

Travel through different real-world locations and discover their transformed counterparts in the spirit world.

Every new place reveals another part of the mystery and new ways in which the two worlds interact.
data.short_description: Play as a boy who cannot fight and a lion who can. Switch instantly between two interconnected worlds in a hand-painted 2.5D metroidvania where stealth, combat and exploration work together to help you rescue your parents.

data.name: The Adventure of Popo
data.detailed_description:
Become Popo and go on an adventure! Escape from the constant enemies, escape from the zoo, head to the polar bear village. The beautiful Christmas background and the quirky and cute Popo appearance will give you an enjoyable experience.

[Shake]

Collect protein shakes to buy useful tools and try the skills. The tools allow you to get into places you couldn't get into, or to break things you couldn't destroy. With the skills, the gun will wake up and run at high speeds, and even attack NPCs!

[Quest]

Help citizens by receiving quests from various characters. If you fulfill their needs, you will get useful items to escape or ways to get to your destination. Follow the quests they give you one by one and reach your next destination. If you don't know what to do, try talking to the other citizens!

[Body painting]

Bring together a bunch of body paintings to decorate the four. When you wear a specific body painting, it has a hidden effect, which can help you complete the quest. If the NPC is unresponsive, try on the right body painting!

data.name: Royal Wedding Quest!
data.detailed_description:
Royal wedding Quest! is a fantasy otome game where your character goes on a quest to find a husband and claim the throne of her country.


Your character, the current queen's daughter, has to follow traditions; When the Queen is ready to pass down the power, all the single noble young ladies in the country are sent out on a quest. Taking along a representative of each of the four guilds, a mage, a healer, a warrior and a rogue, they have to go on an adventure to find noble young men to marry. The big quest is full of dangers as they compete to become the new queen.

While on her quest your character will have to deal with bandits, rivals, but also self-doubt and a sudden need to grow up and become an adult. You follow her as she discovers the world and does her best to find what makes her happy- and perhaps fall in love on the way. Her fate is in your hands.

The game has some fairly unique features:

  • There is no "True ending"; while some endings are more complete your main goal is to achieve your character's happiness.
  • Your character is defined early on in the game and will influence your chances at a romance with some love interests, unlock or lock certain choices and change your reactions to some situations.
  • You have two potential rivals, both with their own story arc you will get involved in.
  • You may now customise your character's appearance as well; there's 48 possible different looks for the MC.
  • There's a total of 7 love interests, including one lady and one leading you down an alternative lifestyle path if you're not into vanilla stuff.
  • The game is still in developpment so more features may appear, and some content in the demo might be subject to change.

data.name: Lanky Looters
data.detailed_description:
Run! A hide-and-sneak heist game of Officers vs. Thieves, for you and your most poorly behaved friends.

Spooky Season is here! Update 1.1 creeps onto the store with:

  • HorrorVille, a brand-new map. Slip through a moonlit hedge maze and loot a haunted mansion... if you dare.
  • Masks, a new lobby setting that slaps a Halloween mask on every player. Plague doctors, demons, LED masks... and one very suspicious alpaca.

The rules are simple. Thieves win by snatching the goods before time runs out. Officers make sure they don't.

Thieves are cloaked and nearly invisible... until they break into a sprint. Officers: watch for the shimmer, listen for footsteps, and keep your wits about you as Thieves sneak n' swipe through varied environments.

Rob your way around the world and through time in 5 different maps! Ransack the military depot of Juketown, scale the medieval walls of Robblestone, plunder an Egyptian locale in Sandbag, raid a modern-day shopping plaza in Mallhalla, and now brave the haunted halls of HorrorVille. More maps and features are planned, as well as Workshop support for custom maps.

Play with friends, or make new ones with our customizable lobbies. Play alone with bots as well, if that's more your thing!

  • Officers vs. Thieves hide-and-sneak heists
  • Cloaked Thieves that only reveal themselves when they sprint
  • 5 maps across time: Juketown, Robblestone, Sandbag, Mallhalla and HorrorVille
  • Customizable lobbies: round length, number of Officers, bots, Masks and more
  • Online play with friends, or fill the lobby with bots
  • Full controller support

data.name: Chess Remix - Chess variants
data.detailed_description:
A new way to play the world's oldest game

Love chess but tired of memorising openings? Our competitive online play is focused on thinking fast not learning patterns. Challenge yourself to overcome opponents in a randomly selected Chess Remix. The games all use the standard chess pieces with alternate rules. Can you think quickly and find new ways to win?


The whole world's Chess in one place
Chess Remix contains Chess games from around the world. You can try Shogi (Japanese Chess), Xiangqui (Chinese Chess), Janggi (Korean Chess), Makruk (Thai Chess) and more. These games have all been styled to look like the Chess you are used to, making it easier to learn for beginners.


A journey through the history of Chess

Travel back to where it all began, 6th century India, and try Chaturanga, the original Chess. See the games it developed into as it spread across the globe. Play Courier Chess like a 12th century European or test your skills at Tamerlane Chess.

Delve into ancient Shogi and experience the progression through different eras of Japanese history. Enjoy a marathon game of the massive Dai Shogi or a quick game of Mini-Shogi.

You can even play Hnefatafl, the Chess of the Vikings.


Chess 2.0

Chess Remix lets you change the rules and make your own game. Will you invent the next Chess?

It's your game play by your rules. You could win by losing the game,
start in random places or just have En Passant be a forced move. Don't like casting? You can turn it off. Want a Rook that also moves like a Knight? You got it. There are limitless possibilities (okay technically there is a limit, but there are so many options you could never play all of them).


Not just Chess

We have so many options to customise your Chess game you can even play Checkers. The app comes pre loaded with a variety of Checkers games from around the world and some ancient versions of the game. You can even play some other abstract board games like Three Men's Morris or even Tic-Tac-Toe.


Become more than a Chess Master

A standard Chess game has 6 pieces. Chess Remix starts with more than 100. To help you learn them we have hand designed levels to help you understand and use every piece in Chess history and the new rules you might encounter.


Unleash your creativity

Have you created the next great board game? Or just something cool you would like to show off. Share your creations with the Remix community.

Want to play unique games? Need some inspiration? Check out our discover section to see what other players have made.


Features:
- Competitive online play
- Create your own original board games
- Levels to help you learn and master Chess
- Play against ai
- Highly customisable app that reflects your style
- Share your creations or play other people games

It's your game play by your rules. You could win by losing the game,
start in random places or just have En Passant be a forced move. Don't like casting? You can turn it off. Want a Rook that also moves like a Knight? You got it. There are limitless possibilities (okay technically there is a limit, but there are so many options you could never play all of them).


Not just Chess

We have so many options to customise your Chess game you can even play Checkers. The app comes pre loaded with a variety of Checkers games from around the world and some ancient versions of the game. You can even play some other abstract board games like Three Men's Morris or even Tic-Tac-Toe.


Become more than a Chess Master

A standard Chess game has 6 pieces. Chess Remix starts with more than 100. To help you learn them we have hand designed levels to help you understand and use every piece in Chess history and the new rules you might encounter.


Unleash your creativity

Have you created the next great board game? Or just something cool you would like to show off. Share your creations with the Remix community.

Want to play unique games? Need some inspiration? Check out our discover section to see what other players have made.


Features:
- Competitive online play
- Create your own original board games
- Levels to help you learn and master Chess
- Play against ai
- Highly customisable app that reflects your style
- Share your creations or play other people games

data.name: Railway Empire 2
data.detailed_description:
Digital Deluxe Edition


Feature List

  • History in the making: In 1830 at the dawn of the age of railways, build a grand railway empire from scratch and choose from 60 detailed, historic locomotives that you can customize with your preferred colors and company initials.
  • A sprawling landscape: Huge and detailed game world covering the whole of the USA and Europe in one single map each, as well as more detailed regional maps spread all over the US and Europe.
  • Endless Possibilities: Choose how you want to play from the 5 chapter campaign set across iconic regions of Europe and the US, 14 scenarios, the customizable free play mode, the relaxing construction mode and co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players controlling the same railway company.
  • Improved track construction: Laying Tracks is easier than ever with automatically placed signals, bridges that can hold up to 4 tracks, train stations with up to 8 tracks and new train station attachments to customize your stations. The land also adapts to your track layout as your tracks cross mountains, valley and plains.
  • Enjoy the view: Ride along your train and see the landscape rush by from the inside of the wagons or from the front seat in the driver’s compartment of the steam engine.


About the Game

All aboard the express train to riches and fame in Railway Empire 2! Don the coat of a clever entrepreneur, take over a small railway company in the early 1800s and turn your steam engines into the workhorses of the economy. Grow your company into the largest railway company of the continent and outsmart your competitors as you connect cities and companies with an ever-expanding network of rail lines, bridges, and tunnels. 60 famous locomotives are at your disposal, all pulling freight and passenger cars as they usher in an era of historic importance during the Industrial Revolution.




Railway Empire 2 features bigger, more detailed and lively maps than ever before. The whole of the US and continental Europe are covered in two huge, sprawling maps, whilst more detailed maps put the focus on specific regions of each continent. Improved track construction helps you focus on the important decisions as you drive the economy and help the growth of the cities. Signals are placed automatically, bridges can hold up to 4 tracks and the expandable train stations can now have up to 8 tracks.




Choose from 6 different characters to lead your railway company, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Play the 5-chapter campaign or choose any of the 14 different scenarios. Set your own difficulty in the fully customisable Free Play mode or build the perfect rail network in construction mode. Tackle the competition of your railway empire together with friends in Co-op Multiplayer. You can also board one of your trains and gaze upon the scenery passing by as the iron horse speeds along the tracks while you sit back and enjoy the view.

data.name: TankOre Mining
data.detailed_description:
Four Tank Types

Buy new mining tanks for faster mining: Driller for close-range mining; Blaster for mid-range explosive blast; Detonator for long-range explosion; and Ravager for massive, long-range explosion.

Tank Upgrades

Upgrade your mining tank by purchasing enhancements to increase durability, heat levels, reduce incoming damage, and improve ore collection efficiency.

Challenging Hazards and Traps

Avoid deadly environmental traps, such as corrosive gas, explosive rocks, shockwaves, falling boulders, and waves of fire explosions. Adapt your strategy to survive as you delve deeper into dangerous floors.

Strategic Resource Management

Balance heat buildup and durability to extend your mining expeditions. Collect valuable components to boost your tank’s regeneration capabilities.

Dynamic Mining Gameplay

Explore layered floors filled with valuable ores, components, and rare artifacts. Artifacts, which sell for a high price, may spawn on every 5th floor.

Universal Detector

A reliable tool that detects surrounding ores and components. Artifacts, however, are undetectable, inspiring deeper exploration and rewarding keen discovery skills.

data.name: Tale of Alamar
data.detailed_description:
In a world where the Leylines of Magic and Planes of Existence converge, follow the adventures of Hiro as you face dangerous beasts, meet fantastical allies, sail the open ocean, and traverse dangerous dungeons filled with puzzles, traps, and hoards of treasure. You begin your story as Hiro, a Paladin traveling the world of Alamar in search of work and purpose. Uncover the plots of the devilish Hell Knights, and forge partnerships with fellow aspiring heroes such as Alotta Fagina the elven ranger, Rhaza the satyr Rogue, and Liri the daughter of ancient druidic clan. Embark on a quest that will take you through several continents and even other Planes as you fight to repel the forces of Darkness that threaten to engulf Alamar. These are the Tales of Alamar.


Features:

Hidden away in forgotten parts of the land exist demons of an ancient order guarding secret magical relics, can you find them all and kill them?

data.name: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer
data.detailed_description:
Tales from the Watchtower – The Sorcerer

Everyone knows La Mancha as the land of Don Quixote...
But what if we told you that beneath its oak trees and dusty trails lie far darker secrets?

Tales from the Watchtower is a psychological horror series inspired by urban legends and real-life events that took place in the iconic La Atalaya Forest Park in Ciudad Real, Spain. Dive into Manchegan culture from a chilling new perspective — its hidden, disturbing, and mysterious side.



What’s This Chapter About?

You play as Prado Calatrava, a young woman from Ciudad Real and an avid soft-combat enthusiast. After a training session in La Atalaya, you realize you left your bow in the woods. You return with your best friend, Agustín, to retrieve it before sunset.

But what starts as a simple errand quickly spirals into a nightmare when you stumble upon a shadowy figure…
burying a jar with your full name on it.

Who is that person?
What’s in the jar?
And why are things starting to happen that defy all logic?

Key Features

🜃 First-person psychological horror
The threat isn’t always visible, but it’s always there. Feel the tension build with every step.

🜃 Narrative-driven and immersive gameplay
Explore, solve, and survive as you uncover the dark secrets hidden in the park.

🜃 Retro PSX-inspired visuals
Low-poly graphics that pay tribute to the golden era of survival horror.

🜃 A real location faithfully recreated
Roam a digital twin of La Atalaya park — full of creepy corners, forgotten paths, and subtle nods to regional folklore.

🜃 Based on real events and local legends
Each chapter draws from documented stories whispered through generations.

🜃 Short, intense experience
Perfect for a night of horror — designed for focused sessions that deliver maximum chills.

Discover a La Mancha you've never seen before.

Tales from the Watchtower is calling.
But beware...
Not everything buried in the earth is dead.

data.detailed_description:
Enemy Territory: Terrorists Takedown

Dive deep into enemy territory and become a messenger of justice! Enemy Territory Terrorists Takedown offers an immersive FPS experience that puts you in the shoes of a brave soldier assigned to save civilians from cruel terrorists. Set your strategy, act in harmony with your team and strike at the heart of the enemy.

Story

Innocent people who have been oppressed by terrorists for years are waiting to be rescued. Your mission is to end this oppression and bring back hope. As you advance through dangerous areas, you will face challenging enemies, escape insidious traps and ensure the safety of civilians by making smart decisions.

Features

- Immersive Atmosphere: You will find yourself in enemy territory with realistic environmental designs and sound effects.

- Rich Weapon: Choose the weapons appropriate for the situation and neutralize your enemies.

- Thrilling Story: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you fight to change people's destiny.

Join this daring mission and shatter the enemy's darkness. Shine a light on the world with your courage in Enemy Territory Terrorists Takedown!

Are you ready, soldier? The enemy is waiting for you!

data.name: Blast
data.detailed_description:
BUILD YOUR DECK, DOMINATE YOUR OPPONENTS

Blast is a free-to-play strategic collectible card game that redefines the genre with its tactical gameplay on a 4×4 board. Designed to be accessible to new players while offering strategic depth to veterans, each game lasts about 5 minutes, perfect for quick sessions or competitive marathons.

STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY ON A 4×4 BOARD

Place your cards on a 16-square board and capture your opponent's cards. Unlike traditional card games, positioning is crucial in Blast. Use your opponent's strengths and weaknesses through Blasts, create synergies with affinities, and deploy field cards to turn the tide.

Every decision counts : positioning, timing, energy management, and strategic use of Blasts will determine your victory.

Dynamic Energy System : Start with 1,000 energy points and gain 500 each turn. Manage your resources to play your cards at the right moment. A card's power corresponds to its cost AND its attack strength. Strategically sacrifice cards to recover energy and keep the pressure on your opponent.

Chain capture system : Capture adjacent opponent cards if your power is greater. Captures can trigger devastating chain reactions! Master this domino effect to turn a desperate situation into a resounding victory.

7 ELEMENTS, INFINITE POSSIBILITIES

Master the 7 elements of the heptagram: Water, Fire, Life, Air, Shadow, Light, and Earth. Each element has unique strengths, weaknesses, and affinities that define strategic interactions:

Strengths and Weaknesses: +/- 200 power during attacks Exploit your opponent's elemental weaknesses to maximize your damage. Fire dominates Life, but fears Water.

Affinity: +100 power for adjacent allied linked cards Place linked cards side by side to create powerful synergies. Elements connected on the heptagram reinforce each other.

Terrain Cards: Temporarily boost all your cards of one element. Deploy a terrain card at the right moment to amplify the power of all your cards of the corresponding element during your turn.

Create devastating combos by exploiting these interactions to gain the upper hand and dominate the board.

SPECIAL ABILITIES: BLASTS

Blasts are your ultimate strategic assets. Each Blast has three power levels:

Level 1: Unlimited uses depending on your available energy Versatile abilities that you can use throughout the game to maintain your tactical advantage.

Level 2: Maximum of 2 uses per game More powerful effects that can change the course of a duel. Use them at the right moment to create decisive opportunities.

Level 3: Single use (game changer) Your ultimate weapon. One use per game for a devastating effect that can completely turn the tide.

UNIQUE RUNE SYSTEM

Grade S cards unlock powerful Runes based on their collection:

  • Deal targeted damage to any card on the board

  • Boost the power of your allied cards

  • Amplify your affinities for even greater bonuses

  • Strike all adjacent enemy cards

  • Accumulate charges to draw cards for free

Combine multiple Runes on the same combo card to create devastating synergistic effects!

COLLECT AND PERFECT

Over 800 unique cards to discover, divided into 5 themed collections: Arkhante, Mantris, Rift, Dawn of War, and exclusive collaborations such as our Watch Dogs collection!

Upgrade your cards, create legendary combos, awaken and fuse their potential to reach Grade S, and customize your strategy to suit your play style. Complete your collection to unlock exclusive rewards and show off your mastery.

VARIED GAME MODES

Ranked PvP Duels : Take on players from around the world and climb the global rankings. Prove your strategic mastery and reach the highest ranks.

Friendly Duels Practice : against your friends, test new strategies, and refine your decks without risking your ranking.

Limited Events : Participate in tournaments with special rules, such as Heroes' Legacy. Unique challenges, exclusive rewards, and the chance to compete against the best.

Daily Quests : Earn rewards by completing various challenges. Progress every day and expand your collection for free.

Adventure Mode : Discover the captivating story of the world of Cross The Ages through a single-player campaign. Explore the conflict between Arkhante and Mantris in an immersive experience through the cards.

MULTIPLE CONDITIONS FOR VICTORY

Victory can be achieved in several ways, offering strategic flexibility and opportunities for spectacular comebacks:

  • Reduce your opponent's HP to 0 (each player starts with 10,000 HP)

  • Deplete your opponent's deck for a victory by exhaustion

  • Full board: If all spaces are occupied, the player with the most HP wins the game

FAIR FREE-TO-PLAY

Progress without spending a penny. All players have access to the same game mechanics, the same cards, and the same opportunities for progression. Earn cards through game rewards, daily quests, and regular events.

Your success depends solely on your strategy, mastery of the game, and tactical skills.

CROSS-PLAY PC & MOBILE

Play wherever you want, whenever you want. Your progress is automatically synchronized between PC (Windows, Mac) and mobile (iOS, Android).

Challenge any player, regardless of their platform.

A RICH NARRATIVE UNIVERSE

Immerse yourself in Appologium, a fascinating post-apocalyptic world where two diametrically opposed civilizations clash:

Arkhante, a magical superpower heir to ancient mystical traditions, masters the occult arts and elemental energies.

Mantris, a kingdom of advanced technology, pushes the boundaries of science with its cybernetic innovations and mechanized armies.

Discover the secrets of this divided world through Adventure Mode. Each card tells a story, each collection reveals a piece of the Cross The Ages universe.

  • Deal targeted damage to any card on the board

  • Boost the power of your allied cards

  • Amplify your affinities for even greater bonuses

  • Strike all adjacent enemy cards

  • Accumulate charges to draw cards for free

Combine multiple Runes on the same combo card to create devastating synergistic effects!

COLLECT AND PERFECT

Over 800 unique cards to discover, divided into 5 themed collections: Arkhante, Mantris, Rift, Dawn of War, and exclusive collaborations such as our Watch Dogs collection!

Upgrade your cards, create legendary combos, awaken and fuse their potential to reach Grade S, and customize your strategy to suit your play style. Complete your collection to unlock exclusive rewards and show off your mastery.

VARIED GAME MODES

Ranked PvP Duels : Take on players from around the world and climb the global rankings. Prove your strategic mastery and reach the highest ranks.

Friendly Duels Practice : against your friends, test new strategies, and refine your decks without risking your ranking.

Limited Events : Participate in tournaments with special rules, such as Heroes' Legacy. Unique challenges, exclusive rewards, and the chance to compete against the best.

Daily Quests : Earn rewards by completing various challenges. Progress every day and expand your collection for free.

Adventure Mode : Discover the captivating story of the world of Cross The Ages through a single-player campaign. Explore the conflict between Arkhante and Mantris in an immersive experience through the cards.

MULTIPLE CONDITIONS FOR VICTORY

Victory can be achieved in several ways, offering strategic flexibility and opportunities for spectacular comebacks:

  • Reduce your opponent's HP to 0 (each player starts with 10,000 HP)

  • Deplete your opponent's deck for a victory by exhaustion

  • Full board: If all spaces are occupied, the player with the most HP wins the game

FAIR FREE-TO-PLAY

Progress without spending a penny. All players have access to the same game mechanics, the same cards, and the same opportunities for progression. Earn cards through game rewards, daily quests, and regular events.

Your success depends solely on your strategy, mastery of the game, and tactical skills.

CROSS-PLAY PC & MOBILE

Play wherever you want, whenever you want. Your progress is automatically synchronized between PC (Windows, Mac) and mobile (iOS, Android).

Challenge any player, regardless of their platform.

A RICH NARRATIVE UNIVERSE

Immerse yourself in Appologium, a fascinating post-apocalyptic world where two diametrically opposed civilizations clash:

Arkhante, a magical superpower heir to ancient mystical traditions, masters the occult arts and elemental energies.

Mantris, a kingdom of advanced technology, pushes the boundaries of science with its cybernetic innovations and mechanized armies.

Discover the secrets of this divided world through Adventure Mode. Each card tells a story, each collection reveals a piece of the Cross The Ages universe.

data.name: Stone Tribes
data.detailed_description:
STONE TRIBES

An Automation-Driven Real-Time Strategy Game (RTS + Automation)

Context

The game takes place in Zyndoria. In this mystical place, tribes are fighting as automated agents that you design, using magical abilities, weapons and crafting to get decisive advantage on the battle.

Concept

Stone Tribes is a Real-Time Strategy (RTS) game with a strong RPG dimension, where the player does not directly micro-manage units, but instead designs their behaviour using an automation system that the user can design with UI. 

Rather than controlling every action, the player acts as a strategic architect, defining behaviors in advance and dynamically adapting strategies through Macros during battle.

You don’t control units.

Victory comes from preparation, coherent automation design, and the ability to adapt tactics in real time, not from high APM or constant micro-management.

GamePlay Phases

  • Team Design Phase

  • Game Phase

  • Game Design Phase ( Work in Progress ) 

-------------------

Core Pillars

1. Automation-Driven Gameplay

Each character operates using an Automation Flow:
a permanent, condition-based behavior that defines how the unit acts by default.

  • Automations represent the unit’s intrinsic intelligence

  • Autonomous, readable, and consistent behaviors

  • A combat fallback ensures units always remain functional

2. Tactical Macros (Player Command)

Macros are temporary tactical orders that override individual automations.

  • The player commands intent, not execution

  • Instant strategy switching

  • Simple predefined Macros or fully customizable ones

3. Group-Based Strategy  

The tribe can be divided into groups, each receiving different Macros simultaneously.

  • One army, multiple strategies

  • High-level coordination without micro-management

  • Clear battlefield intent and readability

4. RTS + RPG Hybrid

Each unit is a persistent character, not a disposable pawn:

  • Classes: Warrior, Hunter, Craftsman, Shaman, Druid, Necromancer

  • Levels, experience, equipment, and spells

  • Defined roles within the tribe

Core Systems Overview

Automation vs Macro

  • Automation
    → Permanent individual behavior

  • Macro
    → Temporary tactical order issued by the player

Team Design Phase

Before entering a match, the player prepares a team:

  • Composition of 30 characters - Each actor can receive a specific automation flow as "default flow"

  • Class distribution and balance - ( Work in Progress ) 

  • Equipment and spells

  • Individual automation flows

  • Custom Macro definitions

Players can either:

  • jump straight into battle using pre-built teams, or

  • dive deep into automation design to optimize their strategy

Game Modes (Beta Focus)

  • PvP Nexus vs Nexus
    Two teams compete to destroy the enemy’s core.

  • Solo vs AI
    Practice and strategy experimentation.

Additional modes (PvE, multi-objective scenarios) are planned for later development.

What Makes Stone Tribes Different

  • No frantic micro-management

  • No APM as the primary skill

  • Strategy based on design and anticipation, not mechanical execution

  • A system-driven RTS focused on emergent behavior

Target Audience

  • RTS players looking for something new

  • Fans of deep, systemic gameplay

  • Players who enjoy optimization, automation, and experimentation

  • Strategy players who prefer thinking over clicking

data.name: Potion Drop
data.detailed_description:
Potion Drop is an arcade puzzle game where you match sets of crates containing colorful potion bottles. The higher the level you reach, the higher your multiplier, but the less time you have before the next crate of potions drops. Can you keep up and score high before the board overflows?

FEATURES

  • Fast-paced matching in Arcade mode, with a high score leaderboard.

  • Relax and match at your own pace in Zen mode.

  • Enjoy original music as you match.

  • No generative AI was used in any part of this game’s development. Hand crafted by real people.

A REFRESHING TWIST ON MATCH 3

  • There are 3 different ways to make a match:

Set of crates with 1 difference (different fill levels)

Set of crates with 2 differences (different fill, and different number of bottles)

Set of crates with completely different potions

  • Many different combinations can work, so long as there isn’t an odd one out.

If 2 of the crates have full bottles, the 3rd must have full bottles too or it’s not a match

If 2 of the crates have triangle bottles, the 3rd must have triangles too or it’s not a match

HARVESTING

Before you can make anything, you'll need to gather the raw materials. Or, if you are fortunate enough, you'll come across a lovely stash left behind by some poor unfortunate soul.

CRAFTING

Now that you have the means, you can make things to improve your lot. Tools and weapons, clothing and gear to aid you in your further adventures.

ADVENTURING

The world is vast with plenty to explore, creatures to hunt and tame and people both good and bad to test your mettle as you travel throughout the land.

Some scenes may contain some secrets, so pay close attention.
