data.detailed_description:
join our discord


About the Game

Looking for Aliens is a hidden object game that lets you see the world through an alien TV show. Hunt for items in 25 vibrant and detailed locations, including Area 51, the dream world, and outer space!



Meet charming galactic TV hosts and an earthling called Zhaun. Whoops, that should be Shaun! Find anything that helps Shaun to prove the existence of alien life and return to Earth.



What do humans look like through alien eyes? Who really landed on the moon? Where are the spaceships hidden? What's the most dangerous thing in the galaxy? Play Looking for Aliens to find out!

Special game features


  • Find over 250 items hidden in 25 colorful levels
  • Follow the adventures of earthling Shaun as he struggles to prove the existence of aliens
  • Enjoy a hidden object mechanic based on fun text hints
  • Explore a highly interactive environment — turn off cloaking holograms, glimpse the characters' dreams or just eat all the food!
  • Don't strain your eyes — you can zoom in on all locations
  • Take a break after a difficult day on Earth by enjoying light humor, music, and pop culture references

data.name: Nightwalker 2
data.detailed_description:
Nightwalker 2 is a horror adventure game that tells the story of Nightwalker and Sally's most memorable adventure. In search for a treasure mentioned in a local legend, the two find themselves deep in more than what they have bargained for. Events that separate them will push the Nightwalker to his limits as he needs to do more than before to survive and reunite with Sally.

You play as the Nightwalker once again while trying to uncover the mysteries that surround the lost village. The new crafting feature will help you on your path of solving puzzles, getting over obstacles and surviving. Aside from the main story, Nightwalker 2 features 4 different side quests that enhance your exploration experience in the game.

The cinematic experience supported with cutscenes is making the adventure more immersive than before. In addition, Nightwalker 2 is hosting much more and versatile horror elements that you will get exactly what you want if you want to feel the suspense and be disturbed.



Right after the two set foot in the lost village, they soon discover that there is something sinister going on. But before they find the chance to work together, Nightwalker and Sally get separated due to some supernatural events. After that, Nightwalker's attempts to find Sally will only get him deeper in the mysteries of the lost village.



There are 4 different side quests in Nightwalker 2. One of them is focusing on a specific mystery about the village. It is hosting a series of events that are not connected to the progress of the main story. Two of the other side quests focus on the exploration. They reward the player with some upgrades to Nightwalker's equipment. Lastly, one of the side quests is for the collectible lovers.



Crafting and combat is hand in hand in Nightwalker 2. Unlike the previous game, you will be able to defend yourself and get in combat using small rocks. Crafting system will let you enhance the power of your throwable rocks with the use of fabric, fuel and glass shards to deal more damage. Not only that, in order to solve some of the puzzles and skip some of the obstacles, you need specific types of crafted rocks. So, exploration is a huge part of the game as you need supplies for crafting.



You will encounter puzzles during your adventure in and around the village. While some are necessary to progress in the story, most of them are a part of the exploration.

data.name: Knight of the Forgotten Realm
data.detailed_description:
Knight of the Forgotten Realm is a 2.5D side-scroller action-adventure soulslike set in a war-torn land ravaged by demonic beings known as the Ancient Ones. After an unprecedented attack on a critical outpost, a god-like being named Lucian saves your life. In return, the Eternal orders you to head east, to venture into forbidden territory to uncover lost knowledge crucial to the realm. Will you survive the Eternal's call?

Thirty-four years ago, the Great Burning shattered the peaceful realm of Austeria.

Led by the traitorous royal guard Typherius, a brutal coup plunged the land into chaos. Cities that refused to bend the knee or destroy their knowledge of the Eternals were bathed in fire. For decades, humanity paid the ultimate price under Typherius’s bloody crusade, until the sudden arrival of the Ancient Ones in eastern Elemore forced a desperate shift from conquest to pure survival.

Inspired by the soulslike genre, master a visceral, combo-based combat system that is easy to learn, but hard to master.

Journey through a war-torn realm to unearth long-lost ancient relics, unlock a vast arsenal of dynamic abilities, and face relentless bosses designed to test even the most decorated knight.

  • Soul Overcharge: Build combat momentum to tap into Lucian’s power, drastically increasing Vali’s strength and resistance when you need it most.

  • Momentum-Driven Power: High performance in combat earns greater assistance from Lucian, rewarding aggressive, skillful play. 

  • Deepening Bond: Harvest the soul power of fallen Ancient Ones to strengthen your connection with Lucian, unlocking advanced game-changing combos and passive abilities.

  • A Single-Session Journey: Experience a complete story in 1 hour with no filler, built to keep you engrossed from start to finish.

  • The First Chapter: As the premiere entry in an expanding universe, Knight of the Forgotten Realm lays the foundation for future titles that will explore a diverse number of genres and themes. Support a solo indie developer and experience the very first release under the Helthurius Games banner.

  • Playable on Steam Deck: Fully playable at 40+ FPS on Steam Deck! Planned for from the beginning, you'll experience smooth framerates and gorgeous visuals on the go.

data.name: Beneath Oresa
data.detailed_description:
Choose your hero. Choose your companion. Choose your cards.
Dive into Oresa and face its many perils in fast-paced missions.

Beneath Oresa is a fighting roguelike deckbuilder. Deep within the city, confront your foes in real tactical arenas. As a strategist, choose your cards, upgrades, and artifacts wisely, but as a fighter, keep your distances with your foes, engage them at the right moment and turn their positioning to your advantage. With several factions, many heroes with unique abilities, daily missions, unique game mechanics and more, this furious combination of roguelike and tactics elements will lead you deep beneath Oresa.




Each time you dive into the depths, you choose a second hero to accompany you. As a companion, each hero brings eight unique powers. With dozens of possible duos you can develop your own playstyle or try improbable duos.
Do you need an expert against boss fights or a proto-blacksmith that enhances your card upgrades?




Position on the battlefield has never been more important! Line up enemies for super attacks, move to a different zone to avoid being hit, or position enemies to knock into each other.




Cards don’t just get better. Each card upgrade comes with a difficult strategic choice between two upgrades. Choose wisely, depending on your deck and playstyle.

A powerful bonus but only for the round? Or the same bonus but for the whole fight? Two different paths...

data.name: ALL IN VAIN
data.detailed_description:
Description:


Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world teeming with zombies and hostile gangs in the game "All in Vain." Explore a vast open world, engage in diverse quests, and develop your survival strategy. Utilize an advanced crafting system and weapon customization to create unique items and enhance your combat prowess. Your decisions will determine your fate in this harsh and captivating adventure. Survive at all costs and prove that hope is not in vain!

Key Features:


Crafting:
Gather resources, explore the world, and create everything from simple tools to complex and deadly weapons. Your ingenuity is the key to survival.

Weapon Customization:
Upgrade and modify your weapons to suit your playstyle. Each part has its own significance, and the right choice can be crucial in battle.

Survival:
Fight for your life against bloodthirsty zombies and ruthless bandits. Manage hunger, thirst, and fatigue to stay battle-ready.

Open World:
Explore a vast world filled with diverse landscapes—from dense forests and majestic mountains to raging rivers and tranquil lakes. From small settlements to a sprawling metropolis, each location is meticulously detailed and full of dangers and opportunities. Find shelters, gather valuable resources, and uncover hidden spots to survive and thrive in this harsh world.

Enemies:
In your world, zombies vary in their abilities and characteristics. Some zombies are slow and weak, posing a smaller threat, while others are incredibly strong and powerful. Additionally, there are mutants—extremely powerful and dangerous creatures that require special strategies to defeat. Besides zombies, you'll encounter various factions, each with its own goals and motives. These groups will also be your enemies, creating additional obstacles and conflicts in your fight for survival.

Quests:
Complete a variety of tasks that will help you survive, find allies, and uncover the mysteries of the post-apocalyptic world. Quests range from resource gathering to complex missions requiring strategy and skill. Dive into intricate quests where you need to think through every step and find creative solutions to overcome dangerous traps and solve challenging puzzles.

Additional Features:

data.name: ArrowBall
data.detailed_description:
ArrowBall is a Local Multiplayer Sports game where players use explosive arrows and acrobatics to outmaneuver their opponents and control THE BALL on a variety of unique Stages.

Overview

Challenge your friends in 1v1 or 2v2 competitions where both teams try to get THE BALL into the opposing team's goal to score points. Run, jump, fire explosive arrows, activate Clutch Mode to set up the perfect shot, or launch a devastating Super Arrow. Charge your Super Bar by defending your goal and spend it to activate Clutch Mode or your Super Arrow.

Stages


Each match takes place on one of 6 different stages with unique layouts and features
  • HighRise - A no-frills stage in the ritzy part of town
  • Arena - A simple, fast-paced stage with a large crowd to cheer you on
  • Laser Dome - A stage that takes place in a swanky night-club, features disappearing blocks and a randomized layout
  • HyperLoop - Play on top of a speeding train as hazards shift the play field around you
  • Factory - Give the workers some entertainment on their lunch break in this stage with conveyor belts and a shrinking goal zone
  • ClockTower - Play on the inside of a clock-tower as the stage rotates around you

Super Arrows


There are 8 Super Arrows all with unique effects and characteristics. Super Arrows consume a large chunk of your Super Bar so make sure to use them wisely.
  • Warhead - Send THE BALL flying at max speed with a huge explosion
  • Slicer - Cut THE BALL into 2 THE BALLs
  • Repulsor - Create a protective force-field to repel THE BALL
  • Grapple - Hook THE BALL and yank it towards you
  • Smash - Become an arrow and send your body hurling towards THE BALL
  • Volley - Shoot 9 small explosive arrows in an arc
  • Rocket - Control a small rocket-powered arrow
  • Laser - Shoot an arrow that bounces off of walls

Clutch Mode


You can activate Clutch Mode at any moment to slow down time and line up the perfect shot or make a last-minute save. Clutch Mode consumes your Super Bar as you use it so it won't last forever.

Features:

  • Engage in thrilling local multiplayer matches with 2-4 Friends/Enemies
  • Master 8 different Super Arrows with devastating and tricky effects
  • Play Across 6 Stages with unique layouts and mechanics
  • Send THE BALL on the trip of a lifetime into your opponent's goal

data.name: Lifeless Planet Premier Edition
data.detailed_description:
PREMIER EDITION

While seeking life on a distant planet, an astronaut discovers an abandoned Russian town. He suspects his mission is a hoax until a mysterious young woman saves him from a strange and deadly phenomenon... Lifeless Planet is a third-person action-adventure that features an old-school sci-fi story and spectacular environments in the spirit of classic action-adventures.

After a hard landing on the planet, the astronaut discovers the planet that was reported to be rich with life is instead a barren wasteland. When he goes searching for his crew, he makes a more startling discovery: evidence that humans have already been to this planet years ago! When he comes upon a deserted Soviet-era Russian town, he struggles to make sense of his mission. Did his light-speed travel to the planet send him back in time? Or is this all some strange Cold War hoax?

Along the way, the astronaut meets a Russian woman, Aelita, who is somehow able to survive the hostile atmosphere of the planet. Through an unusual natural phenomenon, her skin causes the soil to glow green under her feet. The player must use these glowing tracks as a guide across the planet past treacherous and deadly threats. Is she leading him to safety... or an untimely death?

Lifeless Planet was inspired by Cold War era science fiction stories, posing questions about humankind's desire for space travel. What if you journeyed across the galaxy to another planet, only to find humans had already been there? What kind of person would sign up for a one-way mission, leaving behind planet Earth and everyone they've ever known and love... to go in search of an Earth-like planet?

Equipped with a limited-use jet-pack and a mobile robotic arm, the player must use wits and skill to solve puzzles, unravel the mystery, and survive the Lifeless Planet!

Key Features:

  • Explore 20 unique and atmospheric environments on a vast and treacherous planet.

  • Follow a mysterious young woman as she guides you past dangerous terrain and deadly life-forms.

  • Investigate the startling discovery of an abandoned Russian town.

  • Experience an exciting and intriguing story through rich graphics and cinematic cut-scenes.

data.name: Mockbuster Video
data.detailed_description:
Mockbuster is a first-person psychological horror set inside a late-night 1990s video rental store.

What begins as a routine closing shift slowly unravels into something far more sinister. The tapes on the shelves aren’t the only things being watched.

The hum of fluorescent lights becomes oppressive. The store no longer feels empty.

As strange calls come in and disturbing tapes begin to surface, the store grows increasingly distorted. You must piece together what is real — and what is watching you back.

Your decisions shape how the night unfolds, pulling you deeper into a mystery rooted in obsession, illusion — and something that refuses to stay buried.

What to Expect

  • A tense, story-driven horror experience

  • Psychological scares over cheap jump tactics

  • A fully explorable 1990s video store setting

  • Multiple endings shaped by your choices

  • An atmosphere inspired by analog-era horror

The lights flicker.
The aisles stretch longer than they should.
The tapes begin to change.

You’re not closing alone.

data.name: Sansagari
data.detailed_description:
Sansagari is a tranquil, casual, minimal puzzle game, combining simplicity with unique gameplay.

The goal of Sansagari is to switch on all tiles by plucking strings they're attached to. Strings are plucked by picks, each pick has it's vertical range, determining how many rows of tiles it'll affect. Whenever pick is used to pluck a string it's vertical range increases.

Features

  • Relaxing and soothing gameplay, perfectly fit for casual players of all ages.
  • Flowing gameplay and steady learning curve allowing for more and more complex puzzles to be approached almost intuitively.
  • One button, mouse only controls.

data.name: Joyville
data.detailed_description:
Joyville: Horror-Puzzle Adventure


Joyville is a horror-puzzle adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. Brace yourself for a gripping journey through the shadows, solving puzzles, and trying to survive amidst the hidden horrors that await you.

Unravel the Mystery: How did you end up here?


Decades after Joyville closure, you return to unravel the enigmatic past of this eerie place, but once you step foot inside, there's no turning back.

As a child, you experienced Joyville's delights, but now you seek the truth behind its haunting history. What sinister secrets lie buried in the camp's darkness? You must confront your fears and delve into the long-forgotten horrors that await you.

Tools for Survival: The Teddy Bear


To survive the nightmarish trials that await you, you'll need to solve numerous puzzles and outwit the malevolent entities haunting Joyville. Your most trusted companion? A teddy bear, ready to help you out in the most challenging moments and even save you from imminent death.

Explore the Darkest Corners: Stay Alive at All Costs


Venture deep into Joyville's desolate corners. But beware of those who still linger in the shadows. Your ultimate goal is to stay alive; your every move must be deliberate and cautious. Good luck, for the path to truth is paved with terror!

data.name: KONBOYS
data.detailed_description:
An island, a catastrophe, and a job nobody wants

After a catastrophe in the Mycel™ laboratories, the island was left uninhabited, but not empty. The mycelium has spread and given rise to monsters unlike anything that has ever existed. Explore in the dark, uncover what happened, and complete your mission... in co-op for up to 4 players.

Cloned mechanics: on payroll and disposable

You are a crew of mechanics cloned by Mycel™, sent to find the damaged facilities and repair them. It won’t be a walk in the park: you are made of mycelium yourselves, just like the monsters roaming the island. Keep your stability under control, or you’ll end up becoming one of them.

Corporate contracts

Accept Mycel™ contracts that will take you to the island’s most anomalous corners, places where the company would rather not send anyone it cares about, in search of items of interest to the corporation.

A different path every run

Procedural world generation makes every run different. Repair stations across the island to restore the signal and clear your way to the damaged facilities, and use your vehicle and analog tools to find your bearings.

Shred, recycle, upgrade

Shred and recycle everything you find to upgrade your gear and your vehicle. And if a teammate falls, Mycel™ is a responsible company: shred them and their regeneration will cost you 90% less.

Features

  • Co-op for up to 4 players.

  • Horror and dark humor: a hostile island, a ruthless corporation, and a tone that mixes tension with satire.

data.about_the_game:
An island, a catastrophe, and a job nobody wants

After a catastrophe in the Mycel™ laboratories, the island was left uninhabited, but not empty. The mycelium has spread and given rise to monsters unlike anything that has ever existed. Explore in the dark, uncover what happened, and complete your mission... in co-op for up to 4 players.

Cloned mechanics: on payroll and disposable

You are a crew of mechanics cloned by Mycel™, sent to find the damaged facilities and repair them. It won’t be a walk in the park: you are made of mycelium yourselves, just like the monsters roaming the island. Keep your stability under control, or you’ll end up becoming one of them.

Corporate contracts

Accept Mycel™ contracts that will take you to the island’s most anomalous corners, places where the company would rather not send anyone it cares about, in search of items of interest to the corporation.

A different path every run

Procedural world generation makes every run different. Repair stations across the island to restore the signal and clear your way to the damaged facilities, and use your vehicle and analog tools to find your bearings.

Shred and recycle everything you find to upgrade your gear and your vehicle. And if a teammate falls, Mycel™ is a responsible company: shred them and their regeneration will cost you 90% less.

Jeff is a bored security officer who watches over a stylish boutique through security cameras. He thinks it’s just another dull day at work, but things quickly change.
Sabrina, a young and attractive woman, enters the store hoping to find something to surprise her boyfriend.

data.name: Heat Death
data.detailed_description:
This ancient galaxy is under attack by the mysterious "Apparitions". They are huge star-like monstrosities which threaten to consume the world. Your planet is controlled using cards which you collect while playing. Creativity and resourcefulness will be the keys to your victory!

Rewrite your cards!

Improve your deck even further by re-writing your cards! The game's unique crafting system is used to fuse cards into each other, allowing you to create insane synergies that feel like cheating. And yet, even with such powerful tools on your side, the enemy still puts up a fight!

Heat Death is in early access, but is almost ready for release - with 5 Planets, nearly 500 cards, and a crazy amount of depth and replayability.

  • The Human planet can swarm its opponents with drones, play defensively by buffing its allies, or stand on its own with versatile weapons and defenses.
  • The Radioactive planet focuses on fierce bursts of nuclear damage, and lays traps which detonate when opponents make their attack.
  • 'Storm' is a desert planet which can recover from almost any attack with its powerful heals and repairs, while steadily growing stronger with every passing turn.
  • 'Ablaze' is a volcanic planet, dishing out vast elemental damage while protecting itself in a veil of ash.
  • 'Sanguine' is a planet of witchcraft. A Sigils and blood moons forebode the end of its enemies.



The game world consists of procedurally generated maps of stars and clusters. Death is permanent – you start from scratch each play session, but you expand your knowledge and unlock higher tiers of difficulties. The powerful deckbuilding and card crafting in Heat Death allows you to explore new strategies with every new attempt. And if you still want more, then there are also cheats and challenges, to make the game even crazier.

data.name: Whisper Books
data.detailed_description:
Can't concentrate on reading? Movies are getting boring? Not even happy with new anime? Try a visual novel game!
Whisper Books tactfully embeds stunning plot and artistic presentation in the simplest play. Here, you will embark on an unparalleled journey! Come and immerse in our unique story and storytelling! Developers also hope that Whisper Books can serve as a stage on which authors demonstrate themselves, so we roll out a feature called the Audition of New Stories.

Prompt: The content of Whisper Books can be regarded as an upgraded version of e-book, like a movie with hand-painted illustrations in series, so gameplay is weak relative to storytelling. To fully experience the story, players need to have leisure and mood to watch a movie. The writing style of story copywriting is in tune with the narrative rhythm of dubbing, so too much fast forward will affect the story experience. You may also watch it as a Chinese movie with English subtitles.

--Story List--

The Bee Effect

Genre: Fantasy, time travel, ancient China.
A righteous but depressed young man fancifully strayed into the world of bees and led his soul to salvation for lifetime. The principle of karma is illustrated deftly from ecological equilibrium. The story carries forward Chinese culture and advocates weight to science and environmental protection.

Circle of Nightmare

Genre: Fantasy, Viking, Transmyths.
A group of Vikings and a group of Chinese monks sailed to Vinland. While spreading knowledge to aborigines, they inadvertently impeded the devil’s plan to manipulate aborigines. So they were spotted by the devil. A war staged on, and a hell of cognitive disruption followed...

data.name: 楚漢女子
data.detailed_description:
A new kind of historical novel adventure. Your choices will be the guideposts of this story.

The story is a unique one. The story is unique to "Chuhan Girls"!
What if the two main characters leading the Chu-Han War were women?
What if the two protagonists leading the Chu-Han War were women? In "Chu-Han Girls", which depicts the Chu-Han War from a new perspective, you can enjoy the stories of the warrior warrior Han Yu and the wise warrior Liu Bang.
You can also change the fate of the main character, whichever you choose in the early chapters of the story, by making choices.
You can also change the fate of the main character by making choices that differ from the historical facts, and sometimes you will encounter unexpected developments!
You can change the fate of the main character with your guidance!

Your opponent's behavior patterns will change! The game features a thrilling "Virtual Mode" that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
If you turn on "Virtual Mode", the protagonist you didn't choose in the beginning of the story will become an AI, and the choices will be chosen randomly. (When "Virtual Mode" is turned off, the game will follow the historical facts.
Even if you make a choice to grab the fate you want, you may be thwarted by the other AI-ized protagonist. ・・・・・・!
In this game, you'll find a story that can only be found when coincidence and inevitability are mixed together.

The first chapter of the story.
This is a story about a man and his family.

Qin Shi Huang, or Ying Zheng, the first emperor of the Qin Dynasty, was suspicious of Hu when he heard the ominous news.
He suspected that the word "hu" referred to the four barbarians who lived in the four corners of China.

---Where is this Ebisu?

The most powerful of the four barbarians, the northern barbarians, had already been defeated by the Great Wall of China.
If the barbarians to the east, the barbarians to the west, and the barbarians to the south threatened the Qin Dynasty, it would be necessary to prepare for them.

However, the first emperor who asked was told none of these things.

The Qin Dynasty destroyed the country of Chuxing.
When the Qin Dynasty destroyed the country of Chuxia, there was a girl named Cui among the wanderers fleeing their pursuers.
She had a large body with a heavy left eye, and her father did not love her because of an unfortunate incident in her birth, and her mother was persecuted as well.
However, she had an uncle, Han Liang, whom she respected very much, and under his guidance, she was able to train herself to be a warrior, and people naturally followed her.

Under the leadership of her uncle, Kuang Liang, who was trained in martial arts, people naturally followed her.

She was praised as a black panther for her abilities.
Will her bravery be enough to level the world or not?
It's a great way to get to know the people in your life.

Liu Bang's route.
During the Qin Dynasty, in a deep-rooted farming village called Feng, there was a girl named Qi.
She had blue eyes and red hair, and due to an unfortunate incident in her birth, her father did not love her, and her mother-in-law treated her as if she were a servant.
However, her sincere character of serving her family well and not being desperate despite the bad circumstances naturally attracted people around her, and she steadily gained allies.

Then, an old man, Mr. Lu, takes an interest in her and invites her to a banquet, where her fate begins to take a big turn.

She was told that her personality was that of a speckled cow.
She is later called Liu Bang, but is her horn really worthy?
She had no way of knowing that the time would come when her true worth would be tested.

This is the first book in the series that I've read where the reader is able to read the entire story.
This is the first time I've ever seen such a thing.
There are a number of features in "Chuhan Girls" that will help you get rid of your worries!

A flowchart that shows the timeline of the story
You can leave notes with the text.
A flowchart that shows the timeline of the story
A "dictionary" that allows you to quickly look up unfamiliar words
A "map" that shows the main character's current location and destination at a glance
Animal motifs that make it easy to remember the many characters
A dictionary of people's names to help you remember even if you forget.

In addition, you can set the font size, vertical/horizontal writing, margins, text display speed, and more!
Customize it to your liking, and immerse yourself in the world of "Chuhan Girls" to your heart's content!

Then, an old man, Mr. Lu, takes an interest in her and invites her to a banquet, where her fate begins to take a big turn.

She was told that her personality was that of a speckled cow.
She is later called Liu Bang, but is her horn really worthy?
She had no way of knowing that the time would come when her true worth would be tested.

This is the first book in the series that I've read where the reader is able to read the entire story.
This is the first time I've ever seen such a thing.
There are a number of features in "Chuhan Girls" that will help you get rid of your worries!

A flowchart that shows the timeline of the story
You can leave notes with the text.
A flowchart that shows the timeline of the story
A "dictionary" that allows you to quickly look up unfamiliar words
A "map" that shows the main character's current location and destination at a glance
Animal motifs that make it easy to remember the many characters
A dictionary of people's names to help you remember even if you forget.

In addition, you can set the font size, vertical/horizontal writing, margins, text display speed, and more!
Customize it to your liking, and immerse yourself in the world of "Chuhan Girls" to your heart's content!
data.short_description: Ancient China, the era of the Chu-Han War. This is a historical novel adventure that depicts the "what ifs" of the two leaders of the Chu-Han War, Han Yu and Liu Bang. ---Your choice will be the guidepost of this story.

If you want to win, never give up and enjoy your victory!

data.name: Tiny Life
data.detailed_description:
Tiny Life is a fun simulation game that aims to capture the essence of games like The Sims series, but in an isometric pixelart style.

In the game, you control a set of people that live together in a household. You take care of their daily needs, build their skills, forge new relationships... or just mess up their entire life in whatever way you can think of!

Create


  • Create your own characters with unique personalities and skills
  • With over 100 clothing items and thousands of colors available, create your Tinies exactly how you want
  • Choose from different age groups, each with their own unique interactions and gameplay

Build


  • Build houses and community spaces like parks and cafés and watch households inhabit them
  • Pick from hundreds of furniture items, wallpapers, tiles, roofs and more to make each building unique
  • Choose items wisely to maximize skill and need gain for your Tinies, but minimize the lot's final price

Interact


  • Control your household and tell your characters what to do
  • Choose from many complex skills, like cooking, painting, programming, woodworking and more
  • With multiple members in your household, let the AI manage your unattended Tinies for you

Build Relationships


  • Have your characters interact, build relationships, grow families and live unique lives
  • Explore multiple public and residential lots in the vast open world
  • Control multiple households in one save file to play out your own story

Share


  • Share your creations with the community by exporting lots and households from your game
  • Use the Steam Workshop integration to easily upload and download custom content
  • Integrate your own story into your content by writing descriptions for your Tinies and lots

Add Content


  • Create additional content through the game's built-in C# modding API
  • Share your mods using the game's Steam Workshop integration
  • Install mods from community members to enhance your gameplay

data.name: Deadland Garden
data.detailed_description:
Fallen Apartment is a bizarre building controlled by the Clown Evil God. It contains an almost endless space, a variety of strange rooms, and an unceasing stream of monsters.

Legend has it that a way to fulfill any wish can be found in Fallen Apartment. However, most people who enter this mansion lose their souls and become the Evil God's playthings for all eternity.

Fortunately, our heroines have not easily surrendered to the Evil God. They still have the chance to face the Evil God directly and defeat him.

○ A bizarre and fantastical storyline with over 25 exquisite, fully animated CG sequences

○ Three fully animated character portraits featuring multiple layers of clothing

○ Dozens of relics and weapons with unique abilities

○ Six branching endings and New Game Plus functionality

○Play as a charming heroine and immerse yourself in the top-down shooter world.

○Light roguelike random levels—each run offers a brand-new experience, letting you easily enjoy the adventure intertwined with strategy and gunfire.

○Dozens of bizarre events await your discovery.

○Purchase and upgrade your weapons at the mysterious shop.

○ Challenge a variety of powerful bosses.

data.name: Dung Battles
data.detailed_description:
In Dung Battles, what you see is either yours or your opponent's to roll up! Roll over any object, and add it to your dung ball's mass. Be smart about what you pick up, and use it to your advantage.

In Battle Mode, face off against CPU or Online foes in timed collectathon battles! You will have only a limited time to roll over whatever you can find. Be careful though, enemy beetles may pick up sharp objects to pry chunks off your ball! 

May the biggest dung ball win!

In Story Mode, play as Skootle, a lost little beetle who, with the help of a variety of bugs, must find his way through a perilous forest to get home.

data.name: Chiklet's Human Products
data.detailed_description:
Return to your grandpa’s farm and restore it to its former glory in Chiklet's Human Products that uniquely blends farming and survival. Begin your journey on a wild, overgrown island with only a few coins and the guidance of your grandpa’s old buddy, Hacklet. As you explore, capture and harvest wild humans of all rarities, transforming them into a myriad of bizarre recipes that challenge conventional farming.

Encounter not only feeble, wild humans but also formidable monsters as you venture into uncharted territories. Hone your combat skills and strategically upgrade your arsenal to overcome these threats.

Build, upgrade, and expand your farm to achieve unparalleled profits. Transition from manual labor to automated processes, and master the art of crafting unique human-based recipes.


Walk or Ride your TukTuk cart throughout Homo Haven to hunt humans and monsters and gather resources. Upgrade your cart to automate the labor and improve logistics.

Equip your Shovel, Fishing rod, Axe, PickAxe, Sword, Club, Sickle etc and embark on daring adventures across the wildest islands. 

Will you revive your grandpa’s legacy and defy the tyranny of a king obsessed with human life, or will the challenges of the islands prove too daunting? The choice is yours in this quirky, darkly humorous farming adventure!

data.name: BUZZ QUIZ
data.detailed_description:
🎉 What is Buzz Quiz?

Buzz Quiz is your personal quiz world: play, create, share, and host the most exciting intellectual parties!

🎮 Play alone or with friends!

  • SOLO - Want to flex your brain muscles? Launch any quiz and play alone. Perfect when you want to chill and take on an easy challenge.

  • MULTIPLAYER - Invite your friends or connect with random players — the atmosphere of a real quiz show is guaranteed. It will be noisy, fun, and very competitive.

  • BLITZ - No time? Take a short quiz with one question selected by the recommendation system. It's fast, sharp, and more invigorating than coffee.

✏️ Create your own quizzes!

  • EDITOR - Create cool quizzes with photos, videos, music, and your own style. Customise the design, choose the sound, add mood — make quizzes the way you want them.

  • PUBLISH — Ready? Publish to Steam Workshop and watch people around the world play your quiz.

🎥 Export your quiz to video format!

  • HORIZONTAL - Play video quizzes on your TV and gather your friends — your home show is about to begin! You can also upload to YouTube and share your content with the world.

  • VERTICAL - Short videos for one question — perfect for TikTok, Reels, and Stories. Fast, stylish and very shareable.

  • BLANK QUIZ SHEETS - Playing offline? Export the answer sheet, print it out and hand it out to your guests. Collect, check, choose the winner — the full effect of a real quiz party.

🧨 Play with your subscribers!

Get your subscribers involved in the game! Stream mode picks up comments from the chat and adds viewers to the leaderboard — the perfect way to liven up your stream and host a real live quiz show!

This game engages in themes including the postmodern pastiche, artistic intent, and the presence of virtual spaces.

  • Esoteric and silly characters who talk about things!

  • Items which shed light on the world and its formation.

  • Strong emphasis on narrative and atmosphere.

  • A fairly short experience (1-2 hours).

  • Worlds that will not last.

data.name: Hunt 'n Sneak
data.detailed_description:
LIGHT IS BOTH FRIEND AND FOE

Light is both friend and foe in Hunt ‘n Sneak – a manic party game set in a world where mystical creatures dwell. Threatened by the fearsome Gobblers, the Pixies’ struggle for survival has begun. Will you use your wit to sneak past the Gobblers, or use your cunning to hunt the elusive Pixies?


Players controlling the Pixies must use spatial memory to navigate the maps; all the while anticipating the enemies moves to avoid the clutches of the Gobbler! Fortunately, Pixies are able to emit a Ping, which briefly reveals them by illuminating their surroundings. But be careful, you never know who might be watching, and a Gobbler may soon be hot on your trail! Players controlling the Gobbler must hunt down the Pixies, capturing them all to successfully absorb their power.

Thrilling chases will soon have you sitting on the edge of your seat. Questions will fill the gap between friends. Where am I? Is the Gobbler nearby? Am I safe? Am I walking continually into a wall? Am I even alive??

FEATURES:

  • Online and local multiplayer supporting 2 to 4 players.
  • Travelling across the Pixie kingdoms you will:
    - Traverse the depths of the Glittering Caverns
    - Become enchanted within an Amethyst Forest
    - Roam the House of Horrors
    - Explore the Citadel of Shadows
    - Sneak through the Infernal Wastes
  • Game modes:
    Ping - Pixies must survive long enough so that the Gobbler exhausts its power.
    Stockpile - Gather up all the Moon Drop essence before the Gobbler has a chance to pounce!
    Cursed - The Gobbler curse is passed from Pixie-to-Pixie. Spend the least amount of time under its evil influence to win!
  • Each character possesses a unique ability, these include: wormhole teleportation, autonomous familiars, disguise and many more.
  • Play with whatever is comfortable; controller or keyboard.

data.name: Kongfusion
data.detailed_description:
KONGFUSION: KUNG FU MADNESS IN VIRTUAL REALITY!

Kongfusion is an action packed kung fu rhythm experience where the player takes on a horde of space kung fu masters. Slam into your opponents on the beat and show everyone who's boss with a variety of weapons.


  • Battle with your fists, the kung fu staff or cut through your enemies with daggers.
  • Fight alien kung fu masters while dodging projectiles.
  • Beat all high scores in arcade mode or test your luck and stamina in infinite mode.
  • Fight in multiple futuristic settings designed to fit the music.
  • A young trainee starts all maps on easy and leaves a master at hardcore.
  • Kung fu is a serious sport, Kongfusion builds actual stamina.

MASTER THE ART OF KUNG FU:

Begin Kongfusion on easy mode and grow into a master on hardcore mode. Leave a sea of alien bodies as you complete your path to glory.

A VARIETY OF WEAPONS

A true kung fu artist can wield a variety of weapons. You shall do so as well; your bare hands will help you unlock multiple weapons to obliviate your foes.

A MUSIC WORKOUT

Slam, punch and cut your enemies to the rhythm of the music. Dance and martial have never been so closely linked. Make it a morning routine and watch those pounds fly away.

data.name: 灰烬军团 命运协奏曲
data.detailed_description:
【游戏简介】

本游戏以《露娜传》人物为主角，构建了一个庞大的平行世界幻想故事，可以看做是《露娜传》的精神续作。

一群童年时期的小伙伴，偶然的一次经历，前往鬼屋探险，却意外揭开了神秘的封印，导致未知力量蔓延整个世界！数年以后，这群少年已经变得与童年判若两人，为了消灭肆虐全世界的暗黑军团，在命运的引导下，开始了奇妙的冒险之旅。

然而，这群被烙印灰烬纹章的少年，以所谓的正义的名义对全世界展开了讨伐。

最终是拯救世界？还是将世界化为灰烬！？

【游戏特色】

①收录众多高清人物写真，同时伴有数百张神态各异的人物肖像。

游戏画面丰富多彩，特色十足！内含大量美少女、帅哥写真！萝莉型、御姐型、性感型、魔物型……绅士们的最爱！

②知名声优倾情配音，主要角色均有专属CV。

无论是普通技能，还是炫酷的必杀技都有专属声优激情配音演绎！

加上精选的各种好听的BGM，主题曲，濒危时还会改变BGM，战斗临场感拉满！

经典回合制RPG游戏！

③庞大的世界观。走遍整个世界的地图容量，村镇、迷宫、场景极为丰富！

遇敌率不高，且100%逃跑率！

迷宫不多，且经过合理优化简单好走！

丰富的天气特效，配合环环相扣的剧情，沉浸感拉满！

④简单爽快的战斗系统。

可选一键自动战斗，丰富击杀特效。

各类动态敌人，炫酷魔法、强力奥义、终极合体技。

大量必杀技CG动画，配合声优激情演绎，战斗爽快感爆棚！

不仅是主角们，敌人也会使用各类炫酷必杀技哦！

⑤全新的怪物图鉴系统。

分类了各种敌人，普通敌人，精英敌人，BOSS敌人……，想看谁的资料都能快速进行查找。

全新的辨识度系统，让敌人的资料一览无余。只要打败敌人的次数越多，它的资料就越发清晰明朗。

大部分敌人拥有不同的形态，在战斗中达到某些条件他们就会变身，同时属性和携带宝物也会随之变化！各类BOSS每位都拥有超过数种形态，在战场上更加变化多端。

⑥全新的游戏玩法，体验驾驶战车的乐趣。

游戏中根据剧情，会提供不同种类的战车供玩家驾驶体验！

是使用主炮或者S-E狠狠地轰炸敌人？还是下车进行白兵战？您可以根据战场随时做出决定！

⑦大量的CG动画，精美图片贯穿游戏始终。

配合引人入胜的剧情，各种反转，各种出人意料的情节。

让您的游戏体验与观感丰富多彩，沉浸其中。

⑧丰富的成就系统，多达上百条各类成就。

有的随剧情获得，有的根据您的游戏表现获得，还有的靠您发现隐藏的秘密才能获得……

⑨引人入胜的武器升级系统！

通过普通战斗获得的资源，玩家可以随时进入神秘空间升级武器，让属性和战斗力大大加强！

多达上百把属性各异的武器供您升级！每个角色都有专属的不同武器！

升级不但可以提升属性，还有可能获得额外附加属性，甚至可以学会专属技能！

升级资源非常容易爆出，并且还可以挂机获得！

您甚至还可以将数把高级武器合成一把终极武器！

⑩丰富的武器和首饰装备，让RPG战斗充满各种各种的玩法和乐趣。

上百种武器搭配各类属性功能不同的首饰，同时配合人物的属性，技能的特点，每个人都可以搭配出适合自己的玩法！再加上战斗中随时更换装备的功能，让战斗充满各式各样的打法和乐趣！

此外，游戏还内置了任务提示系统。

任何时候，屏幕上方都会随着剧情的发展，提示您现在该去做什么。

无须任何攻略，只要看看任务提示，一目了然。

当然，同艾露比工作室以往的游戏一样，您依然可以通过进入Steam游戏库，点击[手册]查看攻略！

【经过反复测试的游戏】

游戏在制作时尽力优化，几乎没有卡顿！

只要您的电脑符合推荐的最低配置以上，基本都可以全程流畅地运行游戏！

【艾露比工作室的制作理念】

我一直在努力探寻既能让传统RPG老玩家回味经典，

又能适应现在游戏的节奏和方式，让现代RPG爱好者易于接受的各种游戏设定。

游戏有着传统RPG的韵味，又尽量融合现代RPG的便利设置。

希望这款游戏能够带给你一些感动和快乐！

回味传统RPG经典！快来加入《灰烬军团 命运协奏曲》的世界吧！

【作者的话】

艾露比工作室的游戏，都是带着曾经的童年回忆，去怀旧、去做细节的用心之作。

不搞好评换礼包，也不搞中途收费，更没有需要另外花钱购买某某道具，才能继续游戏的套路。

在发售前都经过无数次反复测试，发售后只要有问题我会积极更新，只为给玩家最好的游戏体验。

希望大家能多多支持，有问题请您善意提出，我将会在第一时间更新修复。

遇敌率不高，且100%逃跑率！

迷宫不多，且经过合理优化简单好走！

丰富的天气特效，配合环环相扣的剧情，沉浸感拉满！

④简单爽快的战斗系统。

可选一键自动战斗，丰富击杀特效。

各类动态敌人，炫酷魔法、强力奥义、终极合体技。

大量必杀技CG动画，配合声优激情演绎，战斗爽快感爆棚！

不仅是主角们，敌人也会使用各类炫酷必杀技哦！

⑤全新的怪物图鉴系统。

分类了各种敌人，普通敌人，精英敌人，BOSS敌人……，想看谁的资料都能快速进行查找。

全新的辨识度系统，让敌人的资料一览无余。只要打败敌人的次数越多，它的资料就越发清晰明朗。

大部分敌人拥有不同的形态，在战斗中达到某些条件他们就会变身，同时属性和携带宝物也会随之变化！各类BOSS每位都拥有超过数种形态，在战场上更加变化多端。

⑥全新的游戏玩法，体验驾驶战车的乐趣。

游戏中根据剧情，会提供不同种类的战车供玩家驾驶体验！

是使用主炮或者S-E狠狠地轰炸敌人？还是下车进行白兵战？您可以根据战场随时做出决定！

⑦大量的CG动画，精美图片贯穿游戏始终。

配合引人入胜的剧情，各种反转，各种出人意料的情节。

让您的游戏体验与观感丰富多彩，沉浸其中。

⑧丰富的成就系统，多达上百条各类成就。

有的随剧情获得，有的根据您的游戏表现获得，还有的靠您发现隐藏的秘密才能获得……

⑨引人入胜的武器升级系统！

通过普通战斗获得的资源，玩家可以随时进入神秘空间升级武器，让属性和战斗力大大加强！

多达上百把属性各异的武器供您升级！每个角色都有专属的不同武器！

升级不但可以提升属性，还有可能获得额外附加属性，甚至可以学会专属技能！

升级资源非常容易爆出，并且还可以挂机获得！

您甚至还可以将数把高级武器合成一把终极武器！

⑩丰富的武器和首饰装备，让RPG战斗充满各种各种的玩法和乐趣。

上百种武器搭配各类属性功能不同的首饰，同时配合人物的属性，技能的特点，每个人都可以搭配出适合自己的玩法！再加上战斗中随时更换装备的功能，让战斗充满各式各样的打法和乐趣！

此外，游戏还内置了任务提示系统。

任何时候，屏幕上方都会随着剧情的发展，提示您现在该去做什么。

无须任何攻略，只要看看任务提示，一目了然。

当然，同艾露比工作室以往的游戏一样，您依然可以通过进入Steam游戏库，点击[手册]查看攻略！

【经过反复测试的游戏】

游戏在制作时尽力优化，几乎没有卡顿！

只要您的电脑符合推荐的最低配置以上，基本都可以全程流畅地运行游戏！

【艾露比工作室的制作理念】

我一直在努力探寻既能让传统RPG老玩家回味经典，

又能适应现在游戏的节奏和方式，让现代RPG爱好者易于接受的各种游戏设定。

游戏有着传统RPG的韵味，又尽量融合现代RPG的便利设置。

希望这款游戏能够带给你一些感动和快乐！

回味传统RPG经典！快来加入《灰烬军团 命运协奏曲》的世界吧！

【作者的话】

艾露比工作室的游戏，都是带着曾经的童年回忆，去怀旧、去做细节的用心之作。

不搞好评换礼包，也不搞中途收费，更没有需要另外花钱购买某某道具，才能继续游戏的套路。

在发售前都经过无数次反复测试，发售后只要有问题我会积极更新，只为给玩家最好的游戏体验。

希望大家能多多支持，有问题请您善意提出，我将会在第一时间更新修复。

data.name: Charter To Paradise
data.detailed_description:
[SHORT STORY]

You play from a third person perspective as a young man whom inherited the family’s wealth, you chose to use some of that money to start a cruise business that mostly caters to engagement parties or bridal parties. However, on this trip you're hosting the event for a bachelorette party. You can choose to interact with the guests while they're aboard your yacht. Or you can simply be the curious host and keep the interaction purely professional. As soon as the guests arrive you'll embark on out to sea and head for paradise island. With both night and day interactions you can choose where to go and whom to talk to: spontaneous connections, and unforgettable nights. It’s a place where grown-ups let go, unwind, and write their own stories—luxurious, intimate, and just a little bit wild.

  • Choose your own route through one playthrough or multiple!

  • Decide which route you would like to take with any of these lovely women.

  • Enjoy an easy-to-click navigational map throughout the story.

  • Speed through your route by following your chosen's marker or take your time to experience it all! The choice is yours.

data.name: Off Tape: Welcome
data.detailed_description:
OFF-TAPE: Welcome

My job application has been accepted, hooray! 

The Tobacconists cult has finally decided to evaluate me for the job; I am exactly where everyone tries to get to throughout their entire lives. In this wonderful vinyl and cassette shop, I will be making sales to incoming customers. But around here, not everyone is a customer. Some only appear to be. Fortunately, our supreme cult knows an excellent way to tell them apart and has distributed tools of their own divine technology to all employees to use in this situation. Using these, I can do my job safely. Well, every job has its challenges, and if it were easy, everyone would do it, wouldn't they?

MANIFEST EMOTIONS

Fill cassettes and vinyl records with human emotions using the divine technology of The Tobacconists.

  • Tune the frequencies.

  • Repair jammed machines.

  • Keep the shelves fully stocked.

  • Check incoming customers through the cameras.

  • Reward good customers with your products full of emotion.

  • Tear bad customers to pieces with your shotgun or camera. It's just that easy. The more production increases, the more your earnings grow. With your earnings, you can place orders from The Tobacconist computer to increase your security, or expand our shop to earn more tokens. The Tobacconists love industrious people.

OBSERVE CUSTOMERS

Customers do not come directly to your door. Before they reach you, they wander between the rooms of the building. Track them using your nine-camera security system. Watch out for signs indicating that something is wrong:

  • Abnormal temperatures

  • Unidentified sounds

  • Strange marks and residues

  • Room skipping

  • Reality distortions

  • Eye reactions

  • Sourceless whispers

  • Environmental anomalies Everyone makes a mistake eventually, if you watch them long enough.

DETERMINE THE TYPE

Try to understand what the incoming visitor is by using the clues you have gathered. Wrong decisions are fatal. Some of the incoming customers are just customers. Some are from creatures of the physical dimension, but they are harmless. Some are in a spiritual dimension, but they are still harmless. Some spiritual and physical ones want to kill us. But Tobacconist products protect us. For some, there is nothing to do but hide. Perhaps for now.

To our malevolent physical friends:

  • Open the door nicely.

  • Raise your weapon.

  • Pull the trigger right in the middle of their mouths.

To our malevolent spiritual friends:

  • Weapons are useless.

  • Prepare your special Camera.

  • Look at the frame, and the moment it says "Cheese," tear it to pieces.

Unfortunately, some are superior. They cannot be fought. Enter the high-level Tobacconist hiding cabin, hide, and pray...

UPGRADE YOUR SHOP

You will start your shift in an almost empty room. Over time, you will be able to purchase new equipment and transform your workspace into an advanced observation center.

  • Security cameras

  • Fingerprint readers

  • Detection systems

  • Production upgrades

  • Survival equipment

  • Emergency devices Every new device makes your job a little easier. At least, that's what we are told.

EVERYTHING IS NORMAL

Monitor the customers. Fill the cassettes. Prepare the vinyl records. Open the door. Let the right people in. Stop the wrong ones. Do not cause trouble. Keep working.

FEATURES

  • First-person horror experience

  • Customer and creature detection system

  • Cassette and vinyl production mechanics

  • Nine-camera security network

  • Equipment upgrade system

  • Story-driven progression

  • Numerous different creature types

  • Analog technology inspired by the 1960s and 1970s

  • CRT monitors, occult machines, and an industrial horror atmosphere

  • Approximately 5-6 hours of story experience

Finally, the next customer has arrived. Excuse me, are you going to open the door?

data.name: Alone in Space (by RetroVem)
data.detailed_description:
INTRO

Explore this short sci-fi adventure game with lots of interactivity, interesting plot, a score system and (at least) two endings ;)

STORY

You are Alexander, the captain of the ship Santa Maria being sent out on a mission to explore the Proxima Centaury planetary system, specifically the Proxima Centauri b exoplanet. But before you would reach your destination, something goes wrong and you have to gather information about what happened while discovering more about yourself, your crew and your ship.

SENSE POINTS (SP)

Try to keep your mind calm and healthy: the more sense points you have, the better, if it reaches zero, you lose your sanity and the game is over.

SCORE

For certain actions, you gain scores and in the end, you will see how many more you could have got. Aim for the highest and check everything!

CONTROLS AND OPTIONS

Arrow keys or left click to move, space bar or left click to interact. Press Esc for the inventory and character screen and to save your game! To always run, press Esc and enable Always Dash in the Options! You can also set volume for sound effects, music etc. under Options. Controllers should be OK but I could only do limited testing, therefore the partial support only.

MESSAGE FROM THE CREATOR

This is an old project of mine, created entirely by me and now released it here. I wish I had more resources and money to make it better and prettier - please accept the game as is, expect no further updates. Originally planned to make a much larger game but quickly realized I would never finish it. So let me offer you this short but complete game, I hope despite its shortcomings, you will enjoy playing it.

data.name: The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker
data.detailed_description:
Brought to life by a professional team with experience in Hollywood film and television, The Fame Game II is crafted to feature-film standards across direction, cinematography, lighting, costume, makeup, and production design.

Filmed on location at landmarks across Los Angeles, the city's unmistakable light and atmosphere become part of the story.

More than 200,000 player votes helped shape the cast, led by Zhong Chenyao as Ayaka. Five actresses bring every relationship, secret, and emotional turning point to life through live-action performances.

You are He Shuhan, an ordinary international student—until a deal lands you at the gates of a Los Angeles mansion.

You put on a tailored three-piece suit. You learn how to hold a champagne flute. You step into the life of someone born to wealth.

This city respects only winners.

And winners never ask where you came from.

A mask you cannot remove. Designer clothes you must learn to wear. Lies delivered at exactly the right moment. Five dangerous relationships balanced on a knife’s edge.

Before long, you have almost everyone fooled.

Almost.

She has already decided that you are her fiancé. She says it with the sweetest innocence—and the certainty of someone who will not take no for an answer.

Her love is less a romance than a kidnapping, and there is no way out.

She is the only person who sees straight through your disguise—and the only one who has never tried to expose you.

Every tender moment comes with a price.

She is not falling for you. She is falling for the wealthy heir she believes you are.

She knows every secret that could destroy you, threatening you one moment and protecting you the next.

No one understands what it means to live as an impostor better than she does—and no one is harder to read.

She is the first to notice the cracks in your story—and still chooses to cover for you.

But you can never tell: does she see a younger brother who needs protecting… or a man she cannot afford to let too close?

HUNDREDS OF CHOICES. COUNTLESS CONSEQUENCES.

Every lie demands another lie to protect it.

Throw money around like a real heir, or tear off the mask with a single choice and face the consequences.

Some keep the performance going until the very end. Some are crushed by debt and left on the streets. Some are killed when the underworld turns against them.

And some, after every disguise is gone, find someone waiting to catch them—someone who knew the truth all along and never said a word.

The greatest danger is not being exposed.

It is playing the role so well that even you can no longer tell which self is real.

Identity is the game. Your heart is on the line.

It is playing the role so well that even you can no longer tell which self is real.

Identity is the game. Your heart is on the line.

data.name: 重装无限·Metal Infinite
data.detailed_description:
Perhaps in another timeline, he has already been defeated.

But here, everything can be rewritten. The legendary strongest bounty hunter!

That unfinished story—

how will it begin, and how will it end...

● Bullet Hell Shooter — defeat enemies by dodging attacks with skillful movement.

● Free Exploration — a vast game world where you can drive your tank through unknown wastelands. Unlock fast travel points each time you reach a new town.

● Bounty Hunts — face various powerful enemies, including mutant creatures and mechanical monsters.

● Tank & On-Foot Combat — different playstyles for each: tanks offer high survival and heavy firepower, while on-foot combat is agile and flexible.

● Recruit Companions — as the story unfolds, you'll meet different characters, some of whom can join your party and fight alongside you.

● Customizable Controls — fully remappable keybindings in-game.

Contact:

  • Official QQ Group: 1081498264 (guides and tips from veteran players!)

  • BiliBili: 路过的骑士皇

Ps: This game was made to fulfill a childhood dream of the developer. Updates are slow—this is a "lifetime" project that will be improved and expanded over the long term, and it comes with all kinds of bugs along the way.

data.name: ATOMIC LANCE
data.detailed_description:
Early Access:

As of update v0.5.1:

  • There are 40 parts out of 100 planned.

  • The Arena mode is not yet implemented

  • Various objects are placeholders.

ATOMIC LANCE is a first person action game where you obliterate your foes, buy new parts to tune your build, then lose to the hardest enemy - Bankruptcy

> You are a Black Project, a cybernetic monster. With 4 weapon slots and jet engines, you are the apex predator of warfare. Choose from an arsenal of devastating weapons and parts from the humble Twinlong twin cannons to the Volcano Cannon.

> Take part in dangerous missions against corporate drones and more human forces, and test your limits in the arena for money and new parts.

> Take offers you can’t refuse. The world is a corporate playground, and you are an employee. Choose between your ideals or your survival, or throw it all out for more power.

In ATOMIC LANCE, you pay to win or you lose. 

Mightier weapons are granted to bigger spenders, and the poor can't keep up. But, better parts cost more, and demand more money in ammo and maintenance. Some may say it's unfair, but clearly they don't own an AIRFRYER Nuclear Missile System.

You'll need big guns to go far.

After several nuclear wars, the world was sold to the 6 mega-corporations. You are V1 Hope, a Black Project - a nuclear -powered super-soldier with an 8 digit price tag.

Hope is an independent mercenary in W&W Corporation territory, fighting rebels to pay for food, ammo, and her found family. Her moral compass is strong, but she needs to put food on the table. Her work involves gathering parts and fighting rebels for various clients.

Dark technology such as the White Projects lurk in the shadows, concocting their nightmares through unsuspecting victims...

data.name: Pineapple Defense
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the most unusual farm in the world - the pineapple farm, which has attracted the attention not only of true connoisseurs of fresh tropical fruits, but also of various flies and meme characters, seeking to destroy the harvest and leave the farmer without means of existence. In "Pineapple Defense," your task is to protect the pineapples at any cost! The game is an exciting tower defense with elements of arcade action. You will command the farm's defense, building defensive structures and placing cannons to fend off attacks from flies and hostile characters.
Game Features:
Variety of plots: In your arsenal, you'll have different types of fruits to grow, each with unique characteristics and abilities. Choose between classic pineapples, golden pineapples, and even watermelons or mushrooms!
Strategic planning: Before each wave of attack, you can strategically place defensive towers and cannons in key locations on the farm. Choose wisely - your success depends on proper planning and tactics!
Epic boss battles: Epic battles await you with mighty bosses like the Flying Fly King. Prepare for the toughest challenges!
Upgrades and enhancements: Upgrade your defensive structures to make them stronger and more effective. Unlock new types of cannons and upgrades to fend off all enemies!
Captivating graphics and atmosphere: Immerse yourself in the colorful world of the pineapple farm with vibrant graphics and fun animations. An excellent soundtrack will uplift your mood during battles!
Take up the challenge and become the defender of pineapples in "Pineapple Defense"! Your farm and the entire world of pineapples will be in your hands.

data.name: Tails Noir
data.detailed_description:
You’re not special. You’re not a hero. Thrust into unfortunate circumstances, you find yourself with no other option than to unravel what might be your biggest case yet.

There is no choice. We change, but we change nothing. Get to work, detective.


Tails Noir is a post-noir narrative adventure. Become raccoon private eye Howard Lotor and explore dystopian Vancouver inhabited by animals as you uncover a deeply personal story of change and transformation.

Tails Noir is inspired by film noir, weird sci-fi, post-soviet aesthetics, modern political regimes, the works of Lynch and Kaufman, and existential philosophy of Sartre. It is a linear, cinematic narrative experience that subverts genre and challenges your perception of what it means to be a person.




Tails Noir’s gameplay is focused on storytelling and emotional expression, featuring rich and elaborate dialogues inspired by old school CRPGs, as well as exploration of the lush environments. The end of all things is inevitable, but defining which version of Howard Lotor reaches the conclusion is up to you.

As Howard, you will:
• Make meaningful connections with a diverse cast of characters in pursuit of truth
• Shape and express your identity through dialogue choices - decide what kind of person you want to be
• Explore and experience both downtrodden and flourishing districts of a strange, yet familiar version of Vancouver
• Come to terms with the universal pain of existence and loss
• Be a raccoon





Post-noir dystopia
Tails Noir's Vancouver is a dangerous place, bleak and dreary, but not entirely without hope. It’s a tale of a cold and uncaring world, interspersed with genuine connections and a bruised but undying drive to make a difference. Everyone wants to change the world, but not always for the better.



Stunning visuals
The breathtaking combination of high-resolution pixel art and 3D effects like dynamic lighting, pouring rain, volumetric fog and neon lights bring the sprawling City to life. Visit iconic Vancouver locations like Gastown, Granville and Fairmont Hotel, reimagined in a world now inhabited by anthropomorphic animals.



Evocative and unforgettable soundtrack
Original doom jazz soundtrack by Danshin and Arooj Aftab features an innovative combination of classic jazz and electronic music. Tails Noir’s OST is expertly crafted to create a cinematic, atmospheric, and simply jaw-dropping soundscape that serves and enhances storytelling.

data.name: Warlords Battle Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Looking for a Roguelike Strategy Auto Battler? You're in the right place!

Challenge yourself as a commander in this tactical game, where you must choose the right units to defeat enemy forces. Experiment with different unit combinations as you lead the armies of the Kingdom, Greenskins, Undead, or Barbarians. Select your Commander and guide your troops through a randomly generated map, culminating in a final clash with the BOSS! Is your army strong enough to defeat him?

If you prefer a more classic approach to strategy and tactics, test your skills in over 100 challenging missions! Use your resources wisely to triumph in increasingly difficult battles!

data.name: Jumping Challenge
data.detailed_description:
This is a manipulation game where players control a character using the left and right movement keys, continuously jumping downwards. Each step on a board earns a certain number of points, avoiding touching the ceiling or a nail board to maintain health. Over time, the speed at which the boards rise gradually increases, testing the player's reaction speed and skills.

Types of boards:
1. Normal boards: basic boards, standing on which prevents the loss of health.
2. Conveyor belt boards: allow the character to move horizontally on the board, increasing the game's difficulty.
3. Nail boards: touching them results in the loss of health, unless a protective shield item is used.

Health and game over:
The character hits the ceiling or a nail board, losing health, and when health reaches zero, the game ends. In the air, when stepping into empty space, the character falls straight to the bottom, and the game ends.

Items:
1. Health items: restore one health point, providing additional survival opportunities.
2. Shield items: prevent the loss of health when touching a nail board.
3. Slow-down items: slow down the speed at which the boards rise for 10 seconds.
4. Bonus items: provide extra points, increasing the overall score.
5. Wing items: the character grows wings, and pressing the up key allows them to fly for 10 seconds.

Game features:
1. Continuous challenges, with the increase in levels, the speed at which the boards rise gradually increases.
2. Flexible use of items, increasing the player's survival ability and score.
3. This game combines reaction speed and strategy, providing players with an exciting and engaging gaming experience. In the process of continuous challenges, players can fully explore the effects of various items, challenge higher levels, and use game scores to unlock exquisite CG images in the gallery.

data.name: Blotch
data.detailed_description:
Blotch is a stealth adventure where you paint yourself to match the world around you.

The best hiding spot might be right under a guard's feet. Hold still, hold your nerve, and let it walk straight over you.

Steal the scenery. Copy colors and patterns from grass, cobbles or a gallery masterpiece. Move onto a new surface and it's time for a new disguise.

Watch your step after painting. Your wet coat leaves a trail for guards to follow.

Sneak past searchlights and cameras, dodge sprinklers, and find shelter before rain washes off your paint.

Some guards need more than a good paint job to fool. Hounds follow your tracks, profilers spot your shape, and listeners hear you coming.

Paint your way out of trouble. Stun a guard with a rock, splatter it with a paint bomb, or use your hose to make a hiding place where you need one.

Distract a patrol with a plush decoy, then slip into the Understreet through drains and vents.

Carry the loot. A crate on your back slows you down and gives you away, unless you painted it to match the floor first. Lift the wrong thing and the doors seal behind you.

Explore a world inside every painting. Thirty-two hand-made levels take you from sunlit gardens to glowing caves.

Get to know the sixteen people who call this island home. Help your neighbors save their homes by uncovering the clues the island's old owner left in his paintings.

Bring friends. Hide from them. Hunt or be hunted in Hide and Seek. Turn every catch into another pursuer in Infection, or race the rival team in Head to Head.

Be the furniture. Turn into a crate, barrel or suit of armor in Prop Hunt. Paint your disguise and try not to move while your friends walk past.

Paint your own camouflage. Match the colors and patterns around you to stay hidden.

Sneak past the guards. Watch their patrols and pick your moment.

Explore after dark. Find your way by lamplight and glowing mushrooms.

Mind the wildlife. Startled birds can give you away.

Get creative with a rock, a paint bomb, a hose and a plush decoy.

Take the Understreet. Crawl through drains and vents, but watch out for rust and floodwater.

Thirty-two hand-made levels, plenty of reasons to return. Hunt for secrets, chase three-star runs, and climb the Steam leaderboards.

Six ways to play online. Hide and Seek, Infection, Head to Head and Heist, plus Hide and Seek (Prop Hunt) and Infection (Prop Hunt).

Build the next great hiding spot. Design your own maps and tiles, then share your creations on Steam Workshop.

Play with keyboard and mouse or a controller. Remap your controls, read warnings by shape, or turn on sound to help match colors.

data.name: Star Hearts: Launch Point
data.detailed_description:
Pre-Purchase Offer

We are thrilled to announce the reLAUNCH of our Kisktarter campaign for our freshman project, Star Hearts: Launch Point! Whether you supported us last time, didn’t get the chance, or are just now learning about the project, PLEASE head over to now to learn more about what we’ve been up to and check out our awesome backer rewards! Of course, any assistance with spreading the word by sharing on social media, playing our demo on a live stream, or just telling your retro loving friends and content creators is invaluable and deeply appreciated. Use #ArcapCreative on all social media.


About the Game


Every Ending Has a Beginning
Meet Prin, a budding intergalactic rebel conscripted into performing the remarkably dangerous boots-on-the-ground work of eliminating the hostile infestations standing between the Manifest Company and their interplanetary investments. Train and battle your way through unknown perils across alien worlds to complete your missions, earn your keep, and awaken deep powers within…

Features

  • Activate Heart Links - Rescue and befriend colorful critters across new worlds to activate your Heart Link System and acquire up to four unique power suites: dash, float, grapple, and slide.
  • Master Movesets - Race against the clock to medal in over 25 increasingly challenging trials designed to hone your abilities to the extreme. Demonstrate those skills on the battlefield and Prin might just earn Employee of the Month!



  • Strategize Your Respawn Beacons - Use your limited number of self-placed respawn beacons to mark your own checkpoints. Ride the delicate balance of respawn pod economy and distance traveled.
  • Explore Never-Before-Seen Worlds - With the Manifest Company poised at the edge of a galaxy ripe for exploration and exploitation, the fate of 6 uncharted planetoids is in your hands.



  • Fight Off Alien Bosses - Guide Prin deeper into unknown territory as you vaporize apex alien predators and blast away the persistent varmints rampantly infesting every crevice of the star system!
  • Unravel the Manifest Company’s Motivations - Interact with Unkle Boss, Gene, and the rest of the crew back at the Company’s hub ship to brush up on your skillset mastery, scope out new missions, and get to the bottom of the Company’s rapid expansion.
  • Experience Modern Gameplay with an Arcade Feel - Easy to pick up but difficult to master, Star Hearts: Launch Point pairs vibrant, 8-bit nostalgia with intense action at up to 144 frames per second!



A Pixel-Perfect Love Letter to NES
Visually reminiscent of classic titles like Mega Man and Super Mario Bros., Star Hearts: Launch Point is an entirely handcrafted experience, featuring the vibrant color palette of the Nintendo Entertainment System, completely hand drawn animation and level design, and zero rotation, scaling, or bone rigging.

data.name: Spirit Guardians
data.detailed_description:
Spirit Guardians is a pixel-art, roguelike game that blends elements of role-playing, strategy, tower defense, real-time strategy, and shooting. Farming gears, upgrading skills, unlocking new talents…the game offers a continuous journey of empowerment, challenging relentless foes to protect the peace of the Spirit Realm!

Guardian


To safeguard the Spirit Realm, you must repel invading evil spirits and defend the spiritual energy crystals. Utilize traps, activate sigils, cast spells, and fight alongside allies to preserve the last hope.

Endless Powerup


Defeat swarms of enemies, absorb soul orbs, level up, and choose skills. Collect soul stones, unlock talents, and gain permanent enhancements. Spend coins to strengthen your unlocked skills. Only through constant growth can you stand against the onslaught of the evil spirit army.

Gear Up


Defeat elite enemies, open chests, choose the desired gears, and upgrade through synthesis. Dress in equipment according to your combat style to craft the strongest warrior uniquely yours!！

Legion of Evil Spirits


In the Spirit Realm, justice and evil are intertwined. Incarnate as an evil spirit, defeat guardians, corrupt spiritual energy crystals—various gameplay experiences await.

Formidable Foes


Within the legion of evil spirits, powerful individuals exist. You must give your all or face defeat. Death is not the end; you can utilize mysterious powers to resurrect, but miracles come at a cost…

Challenge enemies, collect gears, and upgrade skills in gradually unlocked campaigns, or conquer opponents in the arena to prove you might. Are you ready to delve into the Spirit Realm? Your battle begins now in Spirit Guardians!

data.name: Trench Run
data.detailed_description:
16 trench-runners. 1 winner. How many will survive ? How many will turn to stardust ?

Feel adrenaline surge while you fly through the trench at more than 1000 km/h, dodging treacherous obstacles and countless hot plasma shots which try to turn you shining racing spaceship into molten scrap. Fight with everything you’ve got to cross the finish line alive and, with a bit of luck, you might just climb to the top of leaderboard.

The trench is generated randomly at each game, offering different race lengths and a sequence of obstacles to the victory totally unpredictable.

data.name: Chasing Light
data.detailed_description:
2021 IGF Nuovo Award Finalist
2021 Korea Game Awards Indie Game Award, Good Game Award Finalist
2020 BIC Awards Excellence In Experimental
2020 GIGDC Bronze Prize
2020 Seoul Government G-RANK Challenge Seoul Prize
2020 SOTAESAN FILM FESTIVAL Official Selection
2020 IGN JAPAN INDIE GAME WEEK Official Selection
2020 BIGS Official Selection

Chasing Light is a game that sets out to deconstruct and revolutionize games, and a work that seeks to prove that games are great art.

What is a game? What should a game be made of? What should a game be? Chasing Light is the process of asking those questions: the story of a seven-day journey that explores the materiality of games and digs into the inner workings of people and society.

Chase the light. Until your wings melt.

Chasing Light is an 'Icarus Simulation' where you weave wings out of a game and soar toward the sun.

The game you make is called Chasing Light, too.

Within the budget you're given, pick the music, lay in the sound effects, and set the number and speed of enemies.

Fail to reach 100% on the box-office forecast, and there won't be a next time.

Every decision you make becomes a feather in your wings.

The developer will lend a hand too, so don't worry too much. Oh, I'm not speaking figuratively. I mean the real developer's hands.

Of course, those aren't the only hands on your wings.

The Investor shoves the market in your face, and the Critic trots out identity.

And the Senior? He warns you that calling a game a work of art is dangerous, and that you must never forget it's a product.

The closer you get to the sun, the more your wax melts away.

Your name is Director. Your job is director, too. After all, in this world, a name is a job title.

But the Judge of the court you end up in doesn't ask about anything as petty as your job.

All he does is bellow at you to tell him what you "do."

You make games. So what on earth is it that you do?

You will spend seven days answering that.

The Judge isn't the only one you'll meet in those seven days.

A child who talks like an old man, and a ferry that calls you son.

Recruits presenting business cards instead of arms.

And a Pope who looks like a piece of plumbing.

What happens once your wings have melted away, you ask?

Don't worry. According to the Judge, falling from the sky is a perfectly legitimate kind of "doing."

Fall.

For there will be light.

data.name: Xon
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the world of Xon, a god game where you can create and control your own world!

With powerful miracles at your fingertips, you'll guide your people as they build structures and develop their society. But be warned: other gods are also vying for control, and you'll need to defend your land while also forging alliances with others.

As you play, you'll gain points for your accomplishments, and the winner will be decided at the end of a set time period. Will you be the one to guide your people to victory, or will your rivals outsmart you?

Key Features:
  • Create and control your own world
  • Use powerful miracles to shape the land and influence your people
  • Play solo or with/against other players in real-time
  • Build structures, develop society, and defend your land
  • Gain points for your accomplishments and compete for your self or others
  • Global Online score board and post game tracking

Are you ready to become a god and lead your people to victory?

Gameplay - Multiplayer
In this game, every player has their own world where they can command soldiers and gather resources. By using gates, they can also send soldiers and resources to other players.

The game was inspired by multiplayer Tetris, where players have their own game but can affect others by throwing special blocks into their game.

In this game, if you're not one of the top ten players, you can't be targeted by others. However, there's no limit to the number of players who can join the game.

Development process
I created this game together with my four-year-old son. He contributed some of the graphics using Paint and came up with all the prompts for the Midjourney images.

We spent a lot of time brainstorming ideas on our living room floor, using crayons and toys, and his input was invaluable.

He has also been my most honest tester, providing feedback on what features were becoming too complex or frustrating.

It has been an amazing process, and I am proud to say that I could not have made this game without him.

data.name: YAZAN: Lost Child
data.detailed_description:
YAZAN: Lost child is a short, 2D psychological anomaly game.

Trapped in a valley that repeats forever.

Study every turn of the loop.

If you spot an anomaly, turn back. If not, keep going.

Ten correct calls and you escape.

One wrong call and the valley starts over.

Features

  • Psychological Anomaly Gameplay focused on observation and attention to detail

  • 30+ Anomalies to discover and identify

  • 2D Stylized Art inspired by Arabic traditions and environments

  • A Looping Valley where familiar places may not always be what they seem

  • Story-Rich Experience with mysteries hidden throughout the journey

  • A Complete Experience in One Sitting focused, dense, no filler

    Look closely. Trust your instincts. Find your way out.

data.name: EMITIME
data.detailed_description:
EMITIME is a RHYTHM-based DECKBUILDER - where MUSIC is your STRATEGY!

Combing multiple genres together, EMITIME creates a stylish and unique gameplay that makes you bop to the beat!

Match your Attack and Movement to the RHYTHM on the Grid, and activate your SKILL CARDS to defeat the enemies!

Build your deck and customize your characters with frequencies (power ups!) during each run with various possibilities!

Characters from the Past... and Future...

Play as one of the characters from the Past, or the Future - each of them is equipped with the power of "EMITIME", the power to synchronize with Time and Rhythm!

...

Unique Gameplay Mechanics!

By attacking and moving on the BEAT, you can charge up your cards, and activate them to deal great damage to the enemies!

Each card has different abilities and attack patterns... Sync Yourself to the Music, and use them to your advantage to defeat the enemies!

Pick new cards as you encounter enemies during the battles, and equip yourself with Powerful Skills to Defeat them all!

You can also charge up your Ultimate Attack by synchronizing your action to the beat! Unleash it to deal great damage to the Enemy!

Roguelike Elements with Different Possibilities!

EMITIME is a Roguelike Deckbuilder that allows you to Replay the game more than one... if not many times! Expand your deck as you meet new enemies on the Procedurally Generated map, and create a unique deck every run!

You can also equip powerful frequencies by levelling up, or by purchasing new upgrades from the shop! - Mix and match different frequencies and power ups to build your character each run!
