data.name: Remyadry
data.detailed_description:
This is a derivative work inspired by
Touhou Project from "Team Shanghai Alice".

[Story]

Gensokyo is connected with 'a certain world' and eventually a huge dungeon by the name of 'Mazes of the Week' appears.
The mansion that protagonist Remilia was living in is trapped within this dungeon.
Cooperating with companions, Remilia and co. end up having to clear that dungeon.

[Game Overview]

Compose your party from a maximum of 20 units and fight your way through the dungeon.
A mouse controlled RPG with character creation and dungeon crawling.
Play the game using selfmade images, if you want.
1280x720 game window resolution.
Synthesize and equip items, invest in the shop and make money.

[Basic Controls]

This game requires a mouse to play.

Left Click: Select, Confirm
Right Click: Cancel, Return, Skip
Mouse Scroll: Move List Up/Down, +/- Parameters, etc
Esc: Reset the game
F6: Mute
F12: Reset the game
Ctrl: Skip already read text
M: Force an encounter when inside a dungeon

data.name: Wish You All The Best
data.detailed_description:
**Game Overview**

This work is a short third-person perspective visual novel.

Players will read the story through mouse clicks, while enjoying the illustrations and music.

**Story Introduction**

On this winter noon, the protagonist Su Mingxin meets her childhood friend Zhou Ying again.

Some indescribable emotions are rekindled in her heart.

She wants to see him, to have him stay by her side.

Though she knows this is ultimately impossible.

**Plot Summary**

"Mingxin, I'm back."

After two years, she finally sees that familiar face again.

Of course she knows - he didn't return for her sake.

Rather, this might be the last chance for them to sit and talk together.

She has no intention of changing anything. If such an opportunity truly existed, she would have probably turned this possibility into reality long ago.

"Be sure to invite me to your wedding next year."

She doesn't want to bid farewell like this, as if all their past was just meaningless events.

"It doesn't matter. As long as he can be happy, that's enough."

**Operation Guide**

In dialogue interface:

- Swipe mouse upward to top to open dropdown list

- Right-click to enter menu interface

**Feedback**

Bilibili: @灵虚之幽

QQ Group: 901140212

data.name: Aisle of Shadows
data.detailed_description:
Do not forget. It remembers more than it should.

Aisle of Shadows is a first-person psychological horror game set inside a shopping mall that feels strangely familiar—yet deeply wrong. What begins as a simple task slowly unravels into an unsettling journey through distorted memories, forgotten stories, and a world where reality becomes increasingly uncertain.

Explore a maze of empty storefronts, silent corridors, and impossible spaces where reality bends in subtle and unexpected ways. A place once full of life now feels eerily empty. Yet something still lingers.

Developed by a team of three, Aisle of Shadows is our first project—a short yet intense horror experience inspired by liminal spaces, forgotten memories, and the unsettling side of familiar places.

Features

  • First-person psychological horror

  • Explore a surreal and ever-changing shopping mall

  • Dynamic environmental changes

  • Fragmented stories revealed through environmental details

  • Atmospheric sound design

  • Short and focused experience (approximately 1–2 hours)

  • No combat, no jump-scare spam—tension built through atmosphere and uncertainty

data.name: Forsworn
data.detailed_description:
Build powerful party synergies and fight through unforgiving battles as you explore and save a realm torn apart by divine war. When one run ends in death, resurrection begins the next. 

Embrace scaling difficulties that add new layers of challenges, from random modifiers added to enemies to map-wide trials that affect the entire encounter. Each run and encounter will be fresh as you try out different party builds.

Victory depends on how you combine your heroes: chain their powers and create devastating synergies. With 150+ Items to build around and 200+ Abilities, each with its own upgrade path, the build options are limitless. Theorycraft your way to broken, game-breaking combos.

Lead your champions alone or rally up to three friends in fast-paced co-op play. With simultaneous turns for all players, battles remain fast and tactical, as you fight for the realm’s survival together.

Earn Ultimate Charge from every move, whether attacking, casting spells, or defending. Each hero wields a unique Ultimate Ability to turn the tide—breaking enemy ranks, empowering allies, or unleashing overwhelming force.

Upgrades don’t just raise stats; they evolve abilities, unlock new mechanics, and deepen hero playstyles. Assemble your party from 6 unique heroes, each with their own 3 distinct subclasses to that alter their playstyle.

data.name: Dinner Date
data.detailed_description:
Julian Luxemburg has prepared a dinner for two at his place – but things go awry when the date does not show up and he is left waiting at his dinner table, the clock’s ticking growing unbearably loud.

„Dinner Date” is the character portrait of Julian: by becoming his subconsciousness you gain a clear vantage point on the worries which take a hold of him. As the wait for the beautiful girl grows longer it becomes evident that Julian’s real problems may not even begin originate the girl: what of his work and his boss? And what of the headhunter, his fascination with Byron and his friendship with Jerry who, all things considered, was ultimately the person who pushed Julian to go on this date?

You are not merely listening – in the unprecedented role as his subconsciousness you tap the table, look at the clock and, as Julian bares more of his mind, reluctantly start to eat, your actions resonating with Julian’s thoughts to form an absolutely singular form of intimacy.

In this manner you will experience „Dinner Date”: with some glasses of wine, some bread, some soup - and with a clock which slowly mocks the constant wait for when she comes, this elusive girl who will solve everything.

Key features:

  • Julian’s story lasts a fully voiced 25 minutes and is told through various unique animations, set in a real-time 3d environment with the unique interface of playing as a subconsciousness, the first of its kind.
  • The game is complimented by an original score, written by Than van Nispen tot Pannerden.
  • At the Independent Game Festival 2011, „Dinner Date” has been nominated for the Nuovo award, an award which ‘honors abstract, shortform, and unconventional game development which advances the medium and the way we think about games.’

data.name: Delta 78: The Passenger
data.detailed_description:
Delta 78: The Passenger is a pixel art narrative experience set aboard a drifting spaceship. You play as Miller, a crew member who wakes up disoriented and alone — in a place where everything seems dead... except for something watching from the darkness.

Explore the silent corridors, investigate old terminals, and uncover what happened to the missing crew. Featuring a choice-based internal monologue system, every interaction might reveal the truth — or lead to your downfall.

Features:

  • Narrative with interactive dialogue.

  • Dark, pixelated visual style inspired by sci-fi horror classics.

  • Immersive setting.

  • Ideal for those who enjoy introspective and tense games.

data.name: Bootblade: Co-op Samurai Roguelike
data.detailed_description:
Thirty years ago, the Lich King stole the Holy Sword and cursed the Kingdom of Blackstone. Your master descended into the dungeon to take it back — and never returned.

Now it's your turn. Eighteen floors down, one blade in hand.

SLASH. PARRY. KICK.

Chain 5-hit sword combos, hold your strike to unleash a lightning-fast [b]Iai[/b] draw, and parry at the perfect moment to stagger any foe.

Your boot is a weapon too. Kick enemies into walls, spikes and each other — or punt an explosive barrel straight into the horde.

19 BOSSES. NO TWO FIGHT ALIKE.

Chain sweeps, arrow rain, mirror clones, sweeping beams, meteor storms, seal totems that make bosses immortal, counter stances that punish the greedy — learn every pattern, or fall.

A STORY WORTH DESCENDING FOR

Six acts. Bone crypts, poison swamps, cursed libraries, lava forges, frozen halls and the Abyss itself. Somewhere below, your master is waiting — but not the way you remember.

BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Team up with [b]up to 4 players online[/b] through Steam, or play [b]2-player co-op on one keyboard[/b]. Every hero gets 3 lives — fall, and rise again.

RAGE UNLEASHED

Fill your rage and go into [b]Rampage[/b] — double-speed carnage that turns the tide of any fight.

[img]

FEATURES

  • [*] Fast, weighty melee combat: combos, Iai draws, perfect parries and wall-splat kicks

  • [*] 18 floors across 6 acts, each with its own hazards and enemies

  • [*] 30+ enemy types and 19 bosses with unique mechanics

  • [*] Breakable, throwable and explosive environments

  • [*] Relics, weapons, shops, shrines and challenge rooms every run

  • [*] Permanent upgrades at the Soul Forge — unlock later acts and start deeper

  • [*] Online co-op for 1–4 players, local co-op for 2

  • [*] Fully playable in 10 languages

data.name: Bear Defence Situation
data.detailed_description:
Bear Defence Situation is a roguelike deckbuilding tower defence that lets you bend its rules as much as it bends its genre.  Play your cards right and you'll be knocking out enemies with satisfying shots in search of killer strategies and wild combinations.  Use the powers of the elements within your cards and your towers to protect this little bear and their den.

The bear's den is special.  It's not just a shop or a place for bear to sleep - there's a magical wishing well that will give you unbelievable power (if you have enough gold to make the right wish, that is).  You can cast spells to modify your deck.  Find treasure, valuable cards, and supplies to upgrade your towers.  The bear has a few items laying around they'd be willing to sell, too!

You're going to need all of those things to handle the enemies coming down the path.  With inherent abilities and random modifiers, these enemies will test whether your strategy is strong enough to handle anything.  Hope you have time to prepare before the boss waves start!

Bear Defence Situation is a game that rewards success.  Show off your prowess with unlockable hats and alternate tower models earned by various in-game achievements.  And this game will give you some time to show off - multiple difficulties and maps are available, along with a set of unique challenge runs.

Key Features

  • Elemental towers with upgradeable stats and abilities

  • Several layers of card upgrades, including materials and runes

  • Multiple difficulties, maps, and challenge runs

  • Unlockable starter decks with individual benefits

  • Varied enemies and bosses with unique abilities to counter

  • Cosmetics earned through in-game achievements

data.name: Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG
data.detailed_description:
This is a turn-based RPG made for players who no longer have time (or patience) for endless grinding or for trying to understand overcomplicated plots about a group of students trying to save their rural city from a evil multiversal being.

You’re just an adventurer looking for treasure. No twists. No world-ending stakes. That’s it.

Features:

  • Pixel art graphics, just like the good old days.

  • A short adventure, because your treasure isn’t always waiting in the next castle.

  • Every turn matters: you control only one character, so every action counts.

  • Cast spells through enchantments: miss the input and… well, something will happen.

  • Combos: create your combo sequences but pay attention to dont miss!

  • Parry: You can parry special attacks but you got only one chance.

At the end of the day… This is Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG.

data.name: The Great Tournament
data.detailed_description:
Play a young peasant boy who becomes squire to a legendary knight. Travel the realm competing in jousts, archery, and melee competitions. Train hard in order to become a powerful knight and eventually compete in The Great Tournament to decide the fate of the realm in this medieval story.

The Great Tournament is a 190,000 word interactive fantasy novel by Philip Kempton, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

  • Enjoy the story of a young boy’s rise from lowly squire to powerful knight in this epic story that takes place in medieval times.
  • Choose your attributes and train your skills in order to win in tournaments.
  • Become a hero of the realm or use your power to take control over the kingdom.
  • Unique combat and character generation ensures no one game is the same.
  • Fight for glory, love, or power in the Great Tournament.
  • Multiple endings with different story lines.

Play a young peasant boy who becomes squire to a legendary knight. Travel the realm competing in jousts, archery, and melee competitions. Train hard in order to become a powerful knight and eventually compete in The Great Tournament to decide the fate of the realm in this medieval story.

The Great Tournament is a 190,000 word interactive fantasy novel by Philip Kempton, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

  • Enjoy the story of a young boy’s rise from lowly squire to powerful knight in this epic story that takes place in medieval times.
  • Choose your attributes and train your skills in order to win in tournaments.
  • Become a hero of the realm or use your power to take control over the kingdom.
  • Unique combat and character generation ensures no one game is the same.
  • Fight for glory, love, or power in the Great Tournament.
  • Multiple endings with different story lines.

data.name: Island Way Too Nice
data.detailed_description:
A Cinematic Experience That Takes You to a Desert Island

Filmed entirely on location, the production team ventured across mountains and seas, using natural materials to handcraft props and sets—bringing to life an island that once existed only in imagination. From costumes and set design to cinematography and lighting, every detail is the result of countless refinements and heartfelt dedication, all to create a work that truly stands the test of pride.

The game features diverse natural landscapes—beaches, caves, valleys, rocky shores, forests, ruins, and lakes—designed to immerse players in an authentic adventure. Some scenes even shift between day and night, creating breathtaking atmosphere and visual depth.

Rich Stories and Multiple Endings Await Your Choices

Life on the island isn’t just about survival—it’s a deeply crafted narrative full of surprises and emotional turns. Each heroine has her own story route and multiple endings. Your choices and interactions will gradually uncover the island’s mysteries. Every completed route reveals fragments of the truth, and only by completing them all can you grasp the full picture. This is not just a romantic adventure—it’s a journey of memory, choice, and truth.

Meet the Four Heroines

Xu Dong — Gentle and mature, she’s caring and graceful, her irresistible charm often leaves players defenseless.

Wang Xiaofan — Cheerful, athletic, and action-driven, a survival expert whose occasional clumsiness makes her even more endearing.

Xiao Lingjun — Smart, calm, and independent, she hides her warmth behind sharp words and a cool demeanor.

Tang Yaya — Innocent and timid, she seems dependent but can be surprisingly brave and comforting when it matters most.

A New Immersive Companion System — Turning Moments Into Memories

As the story unfolds, players will gradually unlock multiple immersive companion systems. In these special interactions, the heroines will join you by the campfire, share meals, and even sleep by your side—adding warmth and intimacy to life on the island. And as for what other experiences await… we’ll keep that a secret for now. Come explore it yourself on the island!

data.name: Skillsworn
data.detailed_description:
"Hail, party leader! So, you wish to test your mettle against the dangers of the world? Riches, glory, and power can all be yours...if you survive." - Vardok, Party Leader Extraordinaire

Skillsworn is a low-poly, party-based, turn based adventure game. Take on the role of a fresh party leader and embark on a journey through the wilds of Thera to stabilize the lands in the name of the King! Build and adapt your party members skills in order to defeat terrifying foes. Craft powerful weapons, armor, and artifacts to grow your fame. Defeat a variety of dangerous foes and prove that you are not just another bored peasant seeking a thrill.

Adventure awaits!

Discover New Locations


Embark on adventures through a multitude of different hand-crafted maps. Lead your party across arid deserts, snowy peaks, goblin infested forests, and putrid swamps. Each area provides a unique experience and challenge to you and your party. Choose your destination wisely, as a variety of unique and challenging encounters lie ahead!

Discover New Skills


Diversify and adapt your party members by risking their lives to capture 125+ skills. Skills can be acquired by defeating monsters, but most powerful skills can only be obtained by defeating the most powerful enemies. An endless variety of skill and equipment combinations ensure the maximum amount of pleasure for those who enjoy discovering new and innovative ways of eradicating the enemies of the King!

Discover New Equipment


Collect materials from slain foes and use them to craft new equipment and weapons. Choose from 25+ armors and weapons that provide unique benefits rather than just an increase in numbers. The type of skills your party members can equip are based on the weapons they wield. Will you choose a defensive sword to deal damage to your attackers when you block their attacks, or a fire wand to set your enemies ablaze whenever you hit with an attack or projectile spell? Perhaps you will chance upon the legendary Flameblade of Ignus, allowing you to equip both fire and sword skills with a single weapon slot.

The choice is yours!

Discover New Foes


The world is a dangerous place, and it is filled with those who would cause unpleasantness to the King. From the dastardly Boglins whom pour from the darkened depths of the Endless Bog, vile undead born of a mysterious magic, and the mind warping aberrations which exist only in nightmares, throughout your adventures you will encounter a variety of enemies each with their own set of skills and challenges.

Only the brave or foolish will survive!

Discover New Allies


A party leader is nothing without party members. Recruit and equip your party members and face ever increasingly dangerous enemies. Whether you throw your party members into the fray with reckless abandon, or utilize protective skills to embolden your party members is up to you. Beware, however, that death is permanent in the barbarous lands of Thera!

data.name: FOOD FIGHT!
data.detailed_description:
Check please? More like Check? No thank you!

FOOD FIGHT! is an arcade style party game the last thing you want to do is pay the check. Throw food and make a mess of your opponents. The messiest player is chased by the waiter to pick up the tab, and whoever the waiter finds first foots the bill. It's like dodgeball meets Overcooked with a Pacman ghost desperately trying to hold someone, anyone accountable for all the chaos.

Throw Food: You'll find yourself in a restaurant surrounded by tables full of delicious meals. Pick up any of them and huck it at your nearest friend. The meal will splat, the check will increase by the price of the meal, and the waiter will not be happy. The more expensive the food, the messier the mess, and the waiter doesn't like being left with either.

Dodge Food: Turns out food isn't just for throwing. You can also eat the food for a quick dash without adding to the bill. More expensive food launches you further and faster giving you a chance to dodge incoming projectiles and that pesky waiter. 

Dodge the Check: Once the first player is struck by a meal, the waiter will chase them. He'll pursue the messiest player to pay the tab.  So redirect his attention by throwing more food at your opponent or cleaning off your mess with a few napkins. If he catches you, you'll pay the check for that round, and it comes out of your budget.

When your budget reaches zero, you go broke and lose the food fight.

It's silly. It's competitive. It's a tug-of-war. And it's the most fun when played the old fashioned way: on a couch with your friends.

data.name: Spectral Synergy
data.detailed_description:
Spectral Synergy

General Info:

Spectral Synergy : Realms Entwined (SSRE) is formerly a Dungeon Crawler Jam 2023 contestant.

The entry may be played here:


This steam release is reflective of the time spent thus far improving the game, as opposed to the 7 day window in which it was initially made.  This steam release ships with an integrated development kit.

Features:

Procedurally generated dungeon levels, with a variety of biomes and monsters.

  • This is done in a 'traditional roguelike' manner, generating an ASCII map

  • An additional system translates these maps into 3d geometry and entities

  • Additional elements placed in a 'greebling' pass

Procedurally generated items, with character equipment system. 

  • Items range from hats to potions, great care has been taken to ensure that item generation rules are as loose as possible. Items can affect almost any stat, which may or may not be beneficial. Potions confer a permanent malus or bonus. 

  • On reaching the blacksmith, you may combine items for a fee. There are no restrictions with this system. You may for instance combine a sword with a potion and then drink the result to gain a permanent attack bonus. 

Hybrid 3D Active Time Battle Combat.

  • The combat system is largely deterministic, with the exception of critical results. 

  • Combatant statistics are very important and weigh heavily on the outcome of battles. 

  • The order of turns or actions is determined by a race, every lap of the race grants a turn. 

  • Status effects occur during the race and not per turn, some abilities can confer a bonus for the next turn. 

  • Modular ability / spell system, largely inspired by morrowind.

Revised Graphics and Audio

  • Brand new, professionally made soundtrack for each area, combat and special scenes.

    • Uncompressed audio

  • Revised enemy sprites, textures and UI elements

  • Normal mapped sprites and textures

  • New shaders, view-port optimisation and more

data.name: Cat Me If You Can
data.detailed_description:
BE PART OF OUR COMMUNITY


About the Game

Cat Me If You Can takes you into black-and-white comic style 3D worlds filled with countless feline friends and charming secrets to discover and get lost in.

Immerse yourself in cozy, handcrafted worlds teeming with charm. Seek out hidden cats and capture their adorable moments with your camera.
Stay sharp - only the keenest observers can uncover the most cleverly concealed fluffballs!

Not every cat is easy to spot! Some are hiding behind riddles, locked doors, or curious contraptions just waiting to be figured out.

Solve clever puzzles, decode clues, and uncover hidden pathways to reveal even more elusive feline friends. Every puzzle you crack brings you one paw closer to completing your collection!

Unwind as you take a peaceful journey through atmospheric locations filled with charm and mystery, and, of course, cats. From the sun-soaked sands of Ancient Egypt to the intimate streets of modern Japan, and the quiet corners of majestic medieval castles, each destination invites you to slow down, look closer, and discover every hidden furball.

Packed with content:

data.name: Highway Formosa
data.detailed_description:
Take the wheel of a red convertible and race along sunny coastlines, wind through mountain roads, and drive into the glow of night markets and neon streets. Highway Formosa brings Taiwan-inspired scenery to retro arcade racing in a road trip against the clock.

Hit the Gas. Make the Next Checkpoint.

Find gaps in traffic, time your acceleration and braking, and grab nitro pickups for a burst of speed. The countdown keeps ticking: reach the next checkpoint before time runs out to keep your journey going.

Choose Your Route. Discover Your Next Stop.

Race along coastal highways, wind through mountain passes, and dive into bustling cities and neon-lit streets. Each destination brings its own scenery, traffic, and music. Pick your starting point, then choose your next route at checkpoint forks as your journey across Formosa unfolds.

Face a New Boss at Every Stop.

Every destination has a boss of its own. Keep your rhythm, dodge traffic, and seize your chance to boost through each chase.

Save Seconds. Chase Higher Scores.

Each stage tracks your score and driving time, with an extra bonus for time remaining when you complete the journey. Revisit your favorite routes, sharpen your overtaking and acceleration skills, and beat your personal best.

data.name: Decollate Decoration
data.detailed_description:
One day, all of a sudden, you find yourself becoming a ghost.

You've never committed any evil. Your soul would surely be judged favorably. ...Right?

It no longer mattered how great of a place it was.

The thought of being separated from him sounded more terrifying than abyss.

You know what you need to do...

If you can't visit him anymore...

Then you have to bring him with you!

You're sure he would understand.

You need to bring him to your side before your soul passes on.

You have to XXXX your beloved...

This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost.

The objective is to fulfill her desires by talking to her beloved "Him", causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.

However, as a ghost, you cannot easily communicate with "Him", who has no spiritual inspiration.

Through trial and error, try to bring about the desired outcome.

[Estimated Playtime]

Main Story: Approx. 1–2 hours (Approx. 15 minutes per ending, with 6 endings in total.)

Playtime may vary depending on your choices and pace.

Side Stories: Approx. 1 hour (Includes the prequel "Prologue" and the sequel "Epilogue".)

A Prologue; the story of your life before becoming a ghost,

and an Epilogue; the story after the main story, have been added.

Save function and ending list have been added, making the game even easier to play

Illustration gallery and ending list are included as a reward for completing the game.

[Streaming Guidelines]

Permissible Recording Area: The main story and all side stories

are permitted for streaming and recording.

However, please refrain from the following:

- Using spoiler scenes as video thumbnails.

- Posting spoilers on social media.

- Streaming or sharing the Gallery.

For specific details and the latest information regarding streaming

restrictions, please refer to our Fan Content Guidelines.

data.name: When I Was Young
data.detailed_description:
Check more games:

Check this games from Art Games Studio:




About the Game

Welcome to the jungle!
The 1960s are calling and it's not Flower Power! During his tour in Vietnam, your brother went missing in action and you have decided to enlist so you can discover the truth behind his disappearance at all cost. However, will you be able to survive one of the most brutal conflicts in the history of the modern world?



Engaging Gameplay
Conquer the trials of the Vietnam War in hardcore and exciting 2D combat experience, including numerous types of enemies, highly detailed shooting mechanics and unique gameplay challenges. Do you have what it takes?

Thrilling Storyline
Discover the fate of your brother and find your place in the enchanting storyline inspired by many of the best depictions of the Vietnam War on the big screen. Enjoy nine full chapters of the story!

Stylish Presentation
Immerse yourself in the great entourage of the 1960s, accompanied by an excellent soundtrack and eye-pleasing pixel graphics. Push through the lush jungles, war-torn streets and underground tunnels!

data.name: After the first station
data.detailed_description:
About this game
After the first station is where the protagonist can embark on a peaceful voyage through a wonderful and magical environment. Along the way, the stories narrate about an ordinary life and the different stages of life. There could be happy moments in life, there could be disappointments and realizations in this world. It’s we who decide our own life. So cheer up, everything will work out in the end.

🚂 • • • • • • • •




Life is like a train embarking on a journey，there will be an ending towards the journey. However, it doesn’t matter, what matters the most is the things you went through, every tiny little precious memory accumulated can make your life whole.

Every different station narrates about different stages of life.




KEY FEATURES
• After the first station is developed by a one-man team.
• First-Person Gameplay
• Atmospheric and appealing graphics
• Light Puzzles
• Amazing and magical landscape to explore

You can disable the effects (Bloom, Motion Blur, Ambient Occlusion) in the setting. It would be highly recommended to enable the settings to enhance the game experience. However, It will slow down the fps at the same time. It's best only when it fits your computer graphics setting.

data.name: The Frontier
data.detailed_description:
[Important: Please read before purchasing] Due to financial constraints, I'm currently unable to work on The Frontier full-time. I have no plans to cancel or stop working on the game; however, this will result in much slower and more inconsistent progress. If you're thinking about buying The Frontier, please bear this in mind and base your decision on how much you think you will enjoy the game in its current state.


The Frontier is a blend between business simulation and survival, exploration games. Starting from nothing: explore, gather resources, craft items, and try to survive your world — all while building up your business empire and great fortune.

Current Features



Business Simulation:
  • Foreign trade markets — buy/sell bundles, manage warehouses, and make shipments
  • Town populations affect supply, demand, and prices
  • Workshops — hire workers to help scale your production
  • Harvester Huts — hire Harvesters to automatically gather resources
  • Hire Couriers to transport items in your production chain
  • Specialists offer helpful services and item crafting

Survival and Exploration:
  • Character experience and leveling system
  • Character skill points and acquired skills
  • Large, randomly generated maps to explore
  • 5 different biomes to gather resources from
  • Survival — the player must secure food to survive
  • Permanent Death — running out of money will also result in game over
  • Farming and fishing
  • Resource surveys, growth and decay

data.name: The Ballad Singer: Knights Templar
data.detailed_description:
In the first part of the campaign, you will follow in the footsteps of Hugues de Payns, searching for supporters throughout several European regions.

Depending on the resources you will manage to acquire in the first part of the campaign, you will have a fortune to spend in the second and main part of the campaign, set in the Holy Land.

Once you have created your Templar Master, you will be immediately sent to a newborn Templar chapter. In your quest, you will meet several friends, but most importantly Saracens and Bandits from whom you and your brothers must defend yourselves, if you wish to survive.

Features:

  • The main story is fully narrated and illustrated, every situation will require you to make a choice.
  • You will have the chance to completely change the course of time through three completely different ramifications.

  • Ora et labora: warriors will play a fundamental role carrying out daily activities as well, use them wisely!
  • Manage a Templar from the moment of his admission to the chapter, up to his likely death as a hero in combat.

  • An innovative combat system based on the single blows dealt by warriors.
  • Original medieval choirs and music specifically recorded for the game.

data.name: Gay Sex Adventures - Episode 1
data.detailed_description:
A steamy Visual Novel featuring HD graphics and realistic-looking characters, set in beautiful decor.
Meet Tony and embark on his wild Sex Adventure as he rediscovers life as a single guy. Episode 1 brings him to the local gay bar, to check it out and maybe make some friends, only to end up taking the cute bartender home after messing with him in the bar’s toilet.

GAME DESCRIPTION

Meet Tony and embark on his wild Sex Adventure as he rediscovers life as a single guy.

EPISODE 1
Feeling lonely in his new apartment, Tony goes to the local gay bar to check it out and maybe make some friends. The few he had in this town left him along with his ex-husband after their ugly divorce.

data.name: 9-nine-:Episode 4
data.detailed_description:
Spoilers from the previous games contained below, read with caution.

Concept

9-nine- Episode 4 is the fourth volume in a series of supernatural mystery games, with Episode 4 telling a story centered around Noa Yuuki. The entries in the the 9-nine- series share the same setting and world, but each entry focuses on a different heroine. The villainous mastermind is revealed, friends are at odds, the mystery of the Artifacts uncovered, and bonds are tightened through mutual trust. What lies in store for this young man and woman with the power of justice at their fingertips in this installment?


This game differs from the other games in that the story structure assumes that you have already played the past titles (9-nine- Episodes 1-3.) You will be able to enjoy this as a standalone title as well, but we highly suggest that you play this game after playing the other titles in the series. Each game has an independent story that can be enjoyed on its own. We hope you enjoy the experience that is the 9-nine- series.


9-nine- takes place in the run-of-the-mill college town of Shiromitsugawa where an earthquake breaks a sacred artifact from the Shrine of the White Serpent, unleashing jewelry-like items that bestow their holder's special powers called "Artifacts" from a parallel world. When an incident involving a power that transcends human comprehension, Kakeru Niimi, our protagonist, investigates several branches (parallel worlds) in order to settle the matter.

With the mastermind finally revealed, Sophitia, otherworldly entity set to reclaim the Artifacts, tells him to defeat this person pulling the strings. The first day, the day that the festival was cancelled due to the earthquake back at the shrine—Kakeru is now equipped with memories from every branch and is on the move to solve this conflict.

Amidst this, a girl with a strong sense of justice from Kuho Girls Academy, Noa Yuuki, has an ability that seems to be the key to defeating the mastermind. Knowing this, Kakeru divulges about the events in other branches to her. All the while uncovering the secrets behind why the Artifacts come to this world, settling the scores with the Evil Eye's User, what will be the fate of these young men and women with otherworldly power at the fingertips?


  • Gorgeous art from Izumi Tsubasu (Artist of SakuSaku:Love Blooms with the Cherry Blossoms)
  • Gripping story written by scenario writer, Kazuki Fumi
  • Multi part series with independent stories per episode
  • CG gallery
  • Music gallery
  • Movie gallery
  • FULL Japanese voice acting (Including the main character!)
  • Japanese, English, and Chinese text. Dual-lang display options

data.name: SHAWA
data.detailed_description:
A typical shawarma stand. But…

Hey.

Did I just see a shadow in the corner?

SHAWA is a psychological horror simulator set in a shawarma van where routine gradually turns into paranoia.

The game watches how you play.

What you notice. What you ignore. What your habits are.

And it takes advantage of this, very brazenly.

Do you keep turning towards the same corner?


There will never be anyone there.

But there will be someone there, somewhere you've never looked before.

PHYSICAL COOKING🌯

You make shawarma with your own hands. Every ingredient is an object that obeys the laws of physics.

THE GAME READS YOUR NOTES📄

To order a delivery of ingredients, you write manually your words and take it out into the yard. The game will try to figure out what you meant—it all depends on how legible your handwriting is.

But… are you sure the supplier will respond, and not someone else?

YOU'RE NOT ALONE IN THIS VAN❓👁️

A huge number of paranormal events. Events will become increasingly difficult. It will all begin with the simple flickering of a light bulb and end with the complete destruction of your world, from which the only salvation will be through performing a shawarma ritual. Die in a thousand ways.

The game sets the rules...

and then breaks them right before your eyes.

♾️ Endless shifts

SHAWA is an endless, nonlinear sandbox horror simulator. Each shift brings a new set of oddities, inexplicable details, and subtle shifts in reality.

You can play as long as you like.

The scariest thing isn't that you're alone here.

The scariest thing is that you're not alone here.

data.name: Forsaken Spire
data.detailed_description:
For decades stories have been told of a castle perched atop an island with no known inhabitants. All who have visited the castle have not returned. Those who have seen the castle at a distance describe a fantastic spire protruding up from it, though no two descriptions of this spire are alike. Some even claim the spire does not exist at all. You have resolved to find the truth of this place, and set out for this mysterious island...

FEATURES

  • PHYSICS

    Our physics simulation allows any climbing techniques you can think of! You're not limited to predefined holds that we have placed in the world; instead the physical shape and surface material of an object will define how your hands interact with it.

  • RANDOM GENERATION

    A custom built tower generator allows for almost unlimited combinations of towers to climb, with many more pieces to come.

  • MOVEMENT

    No teleporting or standing still. Your hands are your primary tools of movement. Use them like feet or, of course, to climb the Spire! If you’re new to VR this might be slightly uncomfortable.

data.name: A.S.C: RAVENRIDGE
data.detailed_description:
You are being watched. You are being tested.

In RAVENRIDGE, step into the decaying halls of a forgotten prison turned secret facility. Play as Ethan Ward, a troubled private investigator drawn to the ruins of Ravenridge Penitentiary in search of a missing federal agent—and haunted echoes of his own past.

Once a high-security prison, Ravenridge was shut down in 1994 after a supposed riot. But the truth was buried. Behind its sealed doors, the Promethix Research Group continued its experiments: breaking minds, erasing memories, and reprogramming identity—all in the name of obedience.

As Ethan delves deeper, surveillance intensifies, reality fractures, and strange figures begin to emerge from the shadows—watching, always watching. Each floor brings new psychological trials, cryptic messages, and traces of Ethan’s father, a doctor who vanished here decades ago.

Who is running the experiment now?

Are you the subject—or the observer?

Will you shut it all down… or ensure it never ends?

RAVENRIDGE is a psychological horror experience where every choice leaves a trace—on the system, and on you.

data.name: Into The Mountain
data.detailed_description:
Into The Mountain is a narrative-driven psychological horror experience that begins as a cozy 2D platformer and slowly turns into something far more unsettling.

The game moves between genres and viewpoints, expanding into 3D atmospheric horror as the sense of familiarity begins to crack.

You explore the Peak of Tauema through the eyes of Ed, a 12-year-old boy drawn toward events far beyond his comprehension. As the adventure unfolds the world shifts. Rules change. Spaces transform. What once felt simple becomes ambiguous.

Into The Mountain is built around tension and discovery. The experience unfolds in layers, blending platforming, environmental storytelling, and shifting perspectives to create unease.

The game also uses subtle personalization. Small elements of the world respond to how you play, creating moments that feel intimate and unpredictable without breaking immersion.
data.about_the_game:
Into The Mountain is a narrative-driven psychological horror experience that begins as a cozy 2D platformer and slowly turns into something far more unsettling.

The game moves between genres and viewpoints, expanding into 3D atmospheric horror as the sense of familiarity begins to crack.

You explore the Peak of Tauema through the eyes of Ed, a 12-year-old boy drawn toward events far beyond his comprehension. As the adventure unfolds the world shifts. Rules change. Spaces transform. What once felt simple becomes ambiguous.

Into The Mountain is built around tension and discovery. The experience unfolds in layers, blending platforming, environmental storytelling, and shifting perspectives to create unease.

The game also uses subtle personalization. Small elements of the world respond to how you play, creating moments that feel intimate and unpredictable without breaking immersion.
data.short_description: A psychological horror game disguised as a 2D platformer. The game shifts between genres, dimensions, and camera angles to create a nightmare that knows you a bit too well.

data.name: Nympho Wonderland: Darkness Rises
data.detailed_description:
“Nymphos! Nymphos! Nymphos everywhere! There are way too many nymphos—AAAAAAAA!!!!!!!!!!!!”

Burdened by a curse that has haunted your family for generations, you stopped loving others and gave up on ever being loved.

You thought you would spend the rest of your life alone—until one day, the legendary Dark Witch returned from the dead.

The world is plunged into crisis once more, but with it, a glimmer of hope for breaking your curse finally appears before you.

And so, you resolutely set out on a journey.

For love, for freedom, and to break the tragic fate that has repeated itself through generations. Find a way to survive the ever-growing hordes of Nymphos and make it to the end alive!

Thus begins an epic journey of love, adventure, curses, the Dark Witch, and a whole lot of Nymphos!

Lia

“Wait, I’m not a Nympho!”

Your childhood friend, and the strongest member of one of today’s wealthy families of exorcists.

She once worked up the courage to confess her feelings to you. However, afraid that your curse might affect her, you ultimately chose to reject her.

She loves bickering with you and always calls you “Big Brother.”

Incidentally, she adamantly denies being a Nympho herself.

Seriously. If she says she isn’t, then she isn’t. Probably.

Hienn

“What the hell are these things...?”

The CEO of the amusement park, as well as Lia’s childhood friend.

Mature and composed, she exudes a sophisticated feminine charm completely different from Lia’s.

Yet when the “Nympho Curse” suddenly sweeps across the entire amusement park, her reaction seems almost too calm.

As if... she somehow knew this day was coming all along.

Hennie

“U-Um... I’d like to keep a little air of mystery, so I went ahead and censored it with a mosaic for now.”

(The person depicted has consented to the upload of this edited image.)

A mysterious woman about whom very little is currently known.

What is known is that she serves the Dark Witch, and that her series of actions directly triggered the outbreak of the “Nympho Barrier.”

Vanya

“At last, I can once again engrave the sight of your eyes upon my heart, forevermore.”

A mysterious woman whose allegiance and motives remain unknown.

She meets you in a dream and guides you toward the cursed amusement park, setting the entire incident in motion.

Always wearing a melancholic yet elegant expression, she speaks to you in an almost poetic manner.

Does she truly wish to help you, or is she leading you step by step toward an ending that has already been prepared for you?

Game Features

Weapons automatically aim by default, but the protagonist must remain stationary in order to lock onto a target and fire.
A story-rich adventure: Enter an amusement park surrounded by the Nympho Barrier, rescue the innocent people trapped inside, and uncover the secrets behind the curse from years ago.
Choose from a variety of items and 4 special blessings. Each enemy wave unleashes dozens of perverted women—defeat the required number and survive the onslaught.
Collect materials to earn experience points, then choose items between enemy waves to strengthen yourself!

data.name: FryDay
data.detailed_description:
You're not the chef. You're the food.

Possess ingredients. Get hurled across a kitchen that's actively trying to catch you. Outrun a Chef with a very short temper. Repeat, faster, with a friend yelling at you the whole time.

  • Possess it. You're not holding the cheese. You are the cheese.

  • Call it. One player reads the order, the other executes — or it falls apart.

  • Nail it. Chop and cook by keeping your cursor locked inside a moving bar. Miss it, and the order's ruined.

  • Risk it. Seesaws, chutes, conveyor belts. Every shortcut is a gamble.

  • Outrun it. Hazards, rival sabotage and a Chef on the hunt can wreck your run fast.

New kitchens. New recipes. New ways for teamwork to fall apart in record time.

Grab a friend. Start cooking.

data.name: RadioWave
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to RadioWorld, a brand new robotics attraction aimed for families and people of all ages. Step into a unique world and experience the showcase of brand new, highly trained and powered AI robotics with bright and wonderful colours to entice your eye and advanced robot movement! What are you waiting for? Come to RadioWorld!

RadioWave is a semi-realistic indie horror first person game set in the 2000s featuring killer robotics, an enticing three-part story in Campaign Mode, murderous fun in Multiplayer Mode, and challenges to await in Custom Mode. Can you survive the RadioWave?

The ULTIMATE Mascot Horror Game!

RadioWave is the definitive game for mascot horror fans featuring:

  • Semi-realistic environments and beautiful lighting

  • Fun Maze Action that utilizes your stealth skills to sneak past robots.

  • Use items like the radio to find the location of where RadioWave and his friends are!

  • Play with friends in Multiplayer Mode!

Campaign Mode

Play as Detective Robbie, as you've been assigned to investigate and find out what happened at RadioWorld involving the robots going awry and murdering patrons, controlled by an evil and murderous hacker who once worked at the company seeking out revenge. Escape evil forces, use strategy to avoid RadioWave and his friends and arrest the hacker while uncovering the mystery. But be careful: don't trust ANYONE. Will you make it out alive?

Custom Mode

Want some more enticing action? Enter Custom Mode, a free sandbox mode featuring maps from the Campaign aswell as exclusive mazes for that mode. Choose which robots you want to activate, how aggressive they are and escape the map! Earn more points the more difficult the map is, and get a new highscore or speedrun! Use points and see how you rack up against your friends!

Multiplayer Mode

Salvage scrap in RadioWorld and extract as a Scavenger with others, or kill all the scavengers as a robot of your choice. Communicate with your friends with proximity voice chat! Fun and fast-paced, evade the robots and chase players in large mazes! An active internet connection is required to use this mode.

data.name: Prop Hunt
data.detailed_description:
PropHunt is a game in which you have to become a prop or a hunter.
The props are disguised as objects around the map and merge with the environment. The props are trying to hide from the hunters and avoid death. Hunters win the round if all props are killed, and props win if the time runs out or all hunters die.

If you Prop: you should hide from hunters. To do this, take the form of any item that is present on the map.

If you are a Hunter: you must search and kill props. For this you have a weapon. But hurry up - you have limited time!

data.name: Mycelium
data.detailed_description:
A fungus, a forest and all the time in the world

You are a spore that has landed deep in the forest floor. Grow into the soil next to your network, one tile at a time. Every step costs a little energy; fallen leaves, water and the trees you meet give it back. Reach the surface, wake the barren ground and bloom mushrooms in the grass until the whole forest is in flower.

There are no timers: the forest only moves when you do.

Features

  • Six forests to grow in: Autumn Woods, Spring Meadow, Frozen Pines, Sunbaked Dunes, Misty Bog and Ashen Slopes, each with its own soil, weather and trees.
  • A living underground: 41 kinds of fallen leaves with their own powers, water to drink, poison to avoid and rock to dissolve, with vaults hiding 60 ores and gems.
  • 82 critters sleep in the soil, 47 of them in one forest only. Find them all for your Collection.
  • Link with the trees: reach a tree's roots and its canopy wakes the ground beneath it.
  • Adapt as you grow: every few mushrooms, choose one of three adaptations from a pool of 17.
  • The Grove: every finished season earns mulch for lasting upgrades. Fill your field notes with 36 goals, win 13 trophies and unlock 30 mushroom caps.
  • Five difficulties, from a small, gentle Cozy floor to a Colossal forest with twenty trees.
  • Days and nights with stars and fireflies, falling leaves, petals, snow and embers, and calm music.
  • Mouse or gamepad, on PC or Steam Deck.

data.name: Robot Space Frenzy
data.detailed_description:
All the robots on Space Station 451 have gone berserk! Only one human is left! Can she survive the onslaught and escape?

Robot Space Frenzy is a lightning-paced casual boomer shooter with a focus on fast fun and simple, yet responsive controls.

Blast your way through 10 levels, utilizing 5 powerful weapons against 6 deadly enemy types!

Hunt for keys, ammo, and health amongst the carnage!

Groove to the sick beats of DavidKBD while the gorgeous palette of Petricake's tile work gets splattered with oil and robot viscera!

---

NEW EPISODE!

In celebration of the Steam release, Robot Space Frenzy has been updated with an entirely new Second Campaign! You can access this second episode by selecting New Game in the Main Menu, then choosing the new content in the Chapter Select level.

This chapter adds five challenging new levels, plus a new weapon and completely new enemy type, in addition to the common variant of the original game's Armored Cargo Loader Boss!

With a focus on open areas and massive encounters, this episode is sure to provide a challenge for anyone looking for more Robot Space Frenzy fun!

data.name: Rusty Lines Remastered
data.detailed_description:
Description

We'd like to introduce to you yet another re-make of a widely known "Color Lines" game which we called "Rusty Lines" (hereinafter just "RL"). Unlike classic "Color Lines" our game contains six game modes. I.e. besides lines, as the game's name implies, you''ll be able to compose various figures (squares, blocks, rings, crosses and lines of alternating colors). You'll be able to choose preferable game mode by clicking appropriate buttons to the right of the game-field. More detailed info is available at the "Game Modes" section.

Game modes

There are 6 game modes in the game:
  • Line
  • Square
  • Ring
  • Cross
  • Block
  • Line2

    The basic idea of every game mode is similar. You need to move chips on table for matching figure. When it's done - it's disappear and give you points. Every game mode have diffefent figure to build.

    Features

  • The postapocaliptic spirit and graphics inspired by Fallout series
  • 6 different game modes
  • Hall of fame for every mode
  • Ingame help for every gamemode
  • Free to play

You'll be able to choose preferable game mode by clicking appropriate buttons to the right of the game-field. More detailed info is available at the "Game Modes" section.

Game modes

There are 6 game modes in the game:

  • Square
  • Ring
  • Cross
  • Block
  • Line2

    The basic idea of every game mode is similar. You need to move chips on table for matching figure. When it's done - it's disappear and give you points. Every game mode have diffefent figure to build.

data.name: 浮空秘境
data.detailed_description:
一秒踏入秘境，你便置身一个有关剑与魔法的像素世界。

记忆复苏意味着封印的松动，浮空大陆的沉浮命运再次交到了你的手中。面对即将来临的风雨，身处风暴中心的你将做出怎样的抉择……

【游戏玩法】

作为一款标准的放置类卡牌游戏，《浮空秘境》主打“轻松养肝+超高福利+差异化内容”。抽卡获得角色、挂机获得资源收益、通过副本刷装备和更多资源，再对角色进行升级、进阶、升星等趣味养成，从而轻松提升战力，一路高歌猛进，推掉层层关卡，这就是游戏的主要玩法内容。

游戏战斗采用半回合半即时的行动条机制，战斗过程则全权交给系统托管自动进行。无需研究技能施放的门道，降低新手的门槛，而同时策略性并没有减少，各种有趣玩法的加持也让老玩家持续保持游戏激情。

【游戏特色】

◆复古像素，精美立绘

游戏整体采用了复古像素风，在当今放置类游戏中别具一格，体验酣畅淋漓的战斗，一秒梦回童年！在大部分像素画面之外，每个角色均有二次元画风的精致立绘。在剧情对话中，立绘会以Live2D的形式呈现出，精美画面与像素画风相结合，更显视觉冲击力与吸引力。

◆丰富玩法，能佛能肝

融合传统放置玩法，战斗、收集、养成！内置挂机经验收集，即使下线也可以持续为您收集经验材料与装备。而追求深度体验的玩家，也可以在遗忘之河、永恒王座、无尽之海等各种丰富玩法的系统和趣味小游戏中找到不断更迭的乐趣！总之，各类玩法一应俱全，轻松畅玩不逼氪，随心快乐自由行~

◆热血角斗，巅峰竞技

Boss战、跨服战、各种竞技副本与荣誉榜单，在这里，你可以组建属于自己的公会，结识来自五湖四海的朋友，在埃蒙大陆留下你们的足迹！

◆超高福利，零氪福音

升级即送vip，五星英雄登陆送，零氪也能拥有豪华阵容。开局一时爽，一直挂机一直爽！高爆率，高福利，每周兑换码羊毛薅不停，邀请好友的逆天奖励更可让你直接躺平。

◆深度剧情，顶级声优

顶级声优团队倾情配音，完美呈现游戏人物个性与弘大剧情。300000字主线剧情书写浮空大陆的兴衰沉浮，更拥有同名连载小说，从第三者的视角，见证“你”从无名之辈到盖世英雄的传奇！超强的代入感，让你无论线上线下都能爽翻天！

data.name: Meduziak
data.detailed_description:
A blue jellyfish embarks on an epic journey to pick up his kid from kindergarten to come home for dinner. The journey, however, proves to be full of surprises and unexpected obstacles. The bus to the city breaks down in the middle of the "desert" (we are still under water mind you) and only you can figure out the way to make it operational again... just to discover that you don't have the money for the subway ticket... Maybe working part time in a restaurant will help? Maybe, but this is just the beginning. What other adventures await you in this underwater world of fun riddles and abstract humor? Nobody really knows... well, maybe except the Old Ones...

Meduziak is a laid back point-and-click adventure game inspired by the classics of the genre, especially the Gobliiins series. The game is mainly focused on solving puzzles to overcome the obstacles and weird problems of this deep sea realm. The game features:

  • "no dead ends" puzzle design: if you break an egg that you need, there will be a way to get another egg,

  • unusual inventory system: Meduziak puts on himself all the items he collects,

  • hand drawn animation: a major part of animations is made the classical way, with each frame being drawn individually,

  • original music and sound: all of the sound samples are “mouth made”, we do not use any objects to record them,

  • fun minigames: sometimes necessary for game progression, sometimes not at all,

  • no language: since the creatures of the sea do not speak any human language, all of the dialogue is symbolic,

  • friendly and cheerful atmosphere: kids like it very much, although, they will probably need help with the puzzles – we recommend playing the game together.

If you would like to immerse yourself in this epic journey, feel free to download the free demo of the game (about 60 min of gameplay).  Saves from the demo will work in the full game.

data.name: Dodo Duckie
data.detailed_description:
Quack the code of reality as the clumsy yet courageous duck Dodo and traverse bizarre yet charming planets to rescue your kidnapped chicken kin and master impossible new abilities with every waddle to solve puzzles. 

What begins as a lighthearted rescue mission unfurls into a profound, heartfelt journey of self-discovery, where perhaps even a clumsy duck can find a home.

Key Features

It was a peaceful day on the farm… until a giant alien beam yoinked your chicken family into the sky. With nothing but his waddle, his will, and a very special cap, Dodo dives into a glitched dimension to bring them back.

Two dimensions, one adventure. With Capie the Capybara's magical cap, you can flip between side-scrolling and 3rd Person view whenever you like. Swap perspectives to reveal hidden paths and surprise platforms, and use them to crack every puzzle and peek into every corner of the world.

Dodo does a lot more than waddle. Glide over gaps, splash through water, float, flop, and improvise your way through each puzzle. Every move fits into the way you explore, experiment and solve weird little alien puzzles. And yes, there is a dedicated quack button. Hit Q to QUACK, scare some aliens, and calm your own brain at the same time.

Hop from one odd and adorable planet to the next, each stranger and cuter than the last. Collect shiny stardust, uncover secret routes, and meet Capie, the chill shopkeeper who sells very good caps. Don’t forget to take advantage of every very silly photo opportunity.

Dodo wobbles, trips, and occasionally face-plants, but never gives up on its chicken family. Underneath the clumsy feet is a very determined little heart. Ready to accompany this adorable little duckie? This adventure is full of quacks, caps, and chaos, so grab the hat and jump in. Your next adventure (and your next cute screenshot) is waiting.

data.name: Blood Reaver
data.detailed_description:
Early Access Roadmap


About the Game

A dark-fantasy, round-based FPS for 1-4 players featuring tight gunplay, hordes of demonic enemies, and an arsenal of spells and abilities.

Reignite an ancient conflict between earth and hell as one of the Blood Reavers - cursed warriors wielding guns, magic and more. Rediscover the forgotten history of your order, delving into secrets that will help you end the demonic invasion.

Gather your friends and take on the forces of hell. Play solo or in a squad of up to 4, driving back the demons and uncovering mysteries left by the ancient Blood Reavers.

  • Harvest your enemies: Harvest the blood of demons to fuel your abilities. Grab increasingly powerful weapons and upgrade them with Blood Infusions to ensure you aren't overwhelmed.

  • Create devastating synergies: Combine utility spells, lethal abilities and powerful ultimates to blast, burn and slice your way through the endless horde. Switch out your spells on the fly and never be caught off guard.

  • Master forgotten magic: Get up close and personal with Blood Magic, warp time and space with Ethereal Arts, or tap into into the realm of the Forbidden - twisting foul demonic energies against their own masters.

  • Everything you love about wave shooters: Tight gunplay and movement mechanics, unlockable in-wave upgrades - now expanded with magical abilities, upgrade crafting, and long-term progression.

  • In-wave progression: Reveal cards from the Deck of Fates to bolster your body and mind. Offer your weapons to the Blood Infuser to enhance them with special powers. Grow in power and hope to outlast the horde.

  • Discoverable content: Hunt for secrets and easter eggs to uncover the dark, rich lore behind the world of Blood Reaver. Delve into mysteries that will take you deep beyond the gates of hell... and perhaps ever deeper.

Use the materials wrested from your demonic foes to upgrade your spells and equipment. Create formidable variants of your abilities, and carry newly crafted relics into battle to turn the tides against the minions of the apocalypse.

Fight your way across a dark fantasy world as you search for the secrets to halting the demonic invasion. Each map features unique mechanics and challenges, blood magic abilities, legendary weapons, and special enemy types.

data.name: Rusted Sea
data.detailed_description:
1963. The bombs fell. The ice caps melted. The Bots won. Humanity’s last stand isn't on the surface—it’s in the crushing depths below the sea. You are Cade Callahan, a fresh recruit for the Rusted Retaliators. Your mission: complete the R.U.S.T.E.D. protocol and turn the tide of the war against the mechanical SeaBot legion.

THE SURVIVAL LOOP Rusted Sea combines underwater exploration with a satisfying extraction economy:

  • Feed The Replicator: You are a scavenger at heart. Collect scrap metal and debris floating in the wreckage of the old world. Feed it into your Replicator to instantly print ammunition, batteries, and essential survival consumables.

  • The Pressure Point Economy: The Retaliators don't work for free. Locate volatile Nukelium deposits and extract them. Send the payload back to command to earn Pressure Points.

  • The Oceanic Industries Armory: Spend your hard-earned Pressure Points at the SHELL.E Terminal. Unlock guns,s gear, and vehicles that you can’t craft in the field.

ARSENAL & VEHICLES You won't be swimming alone.

  • Pilot the Deep: Tired of swimming? Purchase and deploy a variety of underwater vehicles, from the agile Rusted Riptide to the sidekick SCWID.

  • Tools of the Trade: Wield a vast array of 1960s gadgets. Use your Welder for repairs, the Drill for mining, and high-caliber Torpedo Gun for when the SeaBots get too close.


    The SeaBots are evolving. They are learning. Load your weapon, check your oxygen, and get to work, Callahan.

data.name: Perfection.
data.detailed_description:
Perfection. is a simple, soothing puzzle game about cutting shapes to fit into outlines. There are an infinite number of puzzles, each randomly generated to be unique and interesting.

Its gameplay is very minimalistic and very forgiving; there is no time limit, and you can cut as many times as you want and undo as many times as you want until you get each shape right. Or, you can challenge yourself to clear the shape in front of you in as few cuts as possible. Whether you get it perfect or not, once a shape is completed, it's gone forever. There's no commitment to replay any level, because there will always be a new one for you to try.

The game's soundtrack is a beautiful synthesized soundscape, composed by Omni-Psyence and available on Bandcamp for free.

data.name: Ski Survival
data.detailed_description:
Get down the mountain. When it goes wrong, something comes to get you, and it is never the same thing twice.

EVERY WIPEOUT SUMMONS SOMETHING RIDICULOUS

Most games punish a crash. This one answers it. Go down hard and the mountain sends help, and help is having a strange day. A giant hand reaching all the way down into the chasm. A marching band nobody asked for. You do not pick which one arrives. That is the point. Players compare notes about which ones they have seen, and there are ones you have not seen yet.

DISTANCE IS THE GOAL. FLOW IS THE REASON TO TAKE THE BAD LINE.

Each level gives you a target and a rescue line to clear. Then the hill starts offering reasons to leave your line. Coins where you should not be. An animal that needs help. A UFO with a tractor beam and a countdown, which a thrown pole can settle if your timing is right. Keep it clean and the flow multiplier climbs. Take the greedy line and it can climb faster, right up until it does not.

FOUR SKIERS. ONE OF THEM IS NOT A PERSON.

Each rider handles differently, and the Yeti has to be earned. He is heavier, he carries a first aid kit, and he clears things the others should not attempt.

EASY MODE IS NOT THE SAME HILL MADE SLOWER.

It is a hill built so a kid and the person who taught them can both finish a run and mean it.

One person makes this game. A bug report gets read by the person who wrote the bug, and a good idea can be in the next build.

data.name: VRNinja
data.detailed_description:
Breathe, Focus… But Don’t Forget To Duck!


Enter the world of VRNinja, a fast-paced virtual reality game that challenges you to dodge and duck your way past flurries of flying weapons. With three scenic Japanese environments to experience and two challenging modes of play, VRNinja will put your reflexes to the test as you train to become the ultimate ninja master.

Which Weapon Will Be Your Undoing?


Each weapon in the ninja’s arsenal serves a different purpose, whether it is to trick you into letting your guard down or to overwhelm you with bombastic force. You’ll need to keep your wits about you and your body moving to outlast the ninja’s deadly onslaught.

Simple Controls, Yet Difficult To Master.


Playing VRNinja is as simple as plugging in your VR headset, booting up the game, and dodging your way to victory. No extra controllers or peripherals required.

About


VRNinja is a fast-paced virtual reality game that challenges players to dodge their way past flurries of deadly weapons as they train to become the ultimate ninja master. Set in the scenic landscapes and locales of Japan, VRNinja transports players into a fully immersive virtual world where quick reflexes and razor-sharp focus are paramount to survival.

Feeling competitive? Invite your friends and family over to compete against you in VRNinja’s challenging Arcade Mode! Will you outlast your rivals? Or will you fall flat in your attempt to perform a sick Matrix-inspired backbend? VRNinja is a perfect party game for all-ages. Go ahead and try not to crack a smile as you watch your friends contort, crouch, and cringe their way past waves of invisible projectiles.

Powered by Unreal Engine 4, VRNinja makes full use of the latest in VR technology, integrating 3D positional audio and head-tracking to craft a gameplay experience welcoming to newcomers and experienced VR gamers alike.

Features


  • Pick Up And Play Controls: There are few movements as natural to humans as the instinct to dodge when something is flying at your face. VRNinja makes the most of this by only requiring a VR headset to play; no additional peripherals or controllers required!
  • Two Modes of Play: In Campaign Mode, you will be pitted against increasingly difficult waves of projectiles as you advance through the game’s three unique environments. Complete each area to unlock it in the tremendously challenging and endless Arcade Mode!
  • Three Beautiful Japanese-Inspired Levels: Explore the peaceful Dojo, the steamy Hot Springs, and the spooky Nighttime levels! Each new area you discover introduces a new distraction that will test your observational skills and focus.
  • Four Ninjutsu Weapons To Avoid: Quickly identify the patterns of incoming projectiles to survive! Each weapon has its own trajectory, whether it’s the straight-flying Kunai, the swirling and twirling Rockets, or the curving Shuriken. On top of the basic projectiles, you’ll also have to contend with the deadly Kunai Bombs. When their timer hits zero, they’ll explode and shower you with Kunai!
  • Super Slow-Mo Ramen Power: Feeling overwhelmed? Take a break and slow down time by catching a flying bowl of ramen! This power-up is only temporary though -- make sure you’re ready once the knives start flying!

Notes


VRNinja is compatible with the Oculus Rift DK2 as well as the CV1.

data.detailed_description:
Co-op horror on the radio night shift

It's the 1980s. You and up to three friends work the night shift for Station 9, a backwoods radio station that pays for strange recordings. Drive a battered news van into the woods, find signals that shouldn't exist and get them on tape before the woods find you.

Hunt the signal

  • Sweep the forest with a scanner and a direction finder.

  • Plant tripod mics around the source to lock onto the signal.

  • One of you runs the van: tune the frequency, watch the radar and record to tape.

Stay close. Stay quiet.

Proximity voice and walkie-talkies. Wander too far and your crew turns to static. And something is listening: the Mimic copies your friends' voices, and sometimes their faces.

Something is out there

Every creature plays by its own rules. Learn them or don't come back.

  • The Mire rises from the tar behind whoever wanders off alone and drags them into a maze beneath the ground. Your crew has to find your body and wake you up.

  • The Mimic calls from the woods in your friend's voice.

  • The Watcher only moves when nobody is looking.

  • Pale Deer stands on the treeline. Don't move while it's watching.

  • The Listener is never seen. It hunts whoever makes the most noise.

  • ...and more waiting in the dark.

Flares and a camera flash buy you time. Not much.

No two nights are the same

Storms, dead fog and blood moons. Generators that cut out, consoles that break and antennas that need fixing in the dark, with something watching from the trees.

Back at Station 9

Sell your tapes, take work orders and earn the station's trust to unlock new clearance and better gear.

Photograph what you find out there to fill the station's field archive.

Features

  • 1–4 player online co-op, or take the night shift alone

  • Proximity voice chat and walkie-talkies

  • A field archive of creatures to document

  • Changing night conditions and van breakdowns

  • A retro 1980s look, recorded to tape

data.name: The Dead Roam Free - Episode 1
data.detailed_description:
Play Snake as you’ve never played it before.

In The Dead Roam Free, you slither, shoot, and snack your way through a twisted military experiment gone wrong. Blood, betrayal, and bad jokes are all part of the package.

You are Bob Segatti, private eye and fixer for those who can pay. When a mysterious dame walks into his office, Bob bites off more than he can chew — literally. One betrayal and a concrete floor later, he wakes up undead and hungry for answers.

Crawl through labs, streets, and sewers in a top-down action-puzzle adventure where every meal makes you longer, stronger, and dumber. Uncover the truth behind the army’s secret zombie program, rescue the girl, and get revenge — one bite at a time.

Features

• A twisted blend of Snake, noir, and B-movie horror

• Eat humans to grow your horde — and yourself

• Solve devious puzzles and destroy military experiments

• Pixel-art gore meets dark, absurd humor

• Original retro soundtrack full of grit and groove

• A story of love, loss, and limb-eating revenge

Bob Segatti might be falling apart, but nothing will stop him from solving this case — dead or alive.

The Dead Roam Free is launching in Early Access so we can build it together with the community. The core game is ready — zombie-snake action, blood, betrayal, and bad decisions — but new episodes, puzzles, and features will rise from the grave as we go. We’re a small team and your feedback helps shape what comes next. Join the horde and help us make this monster even better.

data.name: ELS Saga: Episode I
data.detailed_description:
[The Origin of the Classic JRPG Series with Over 800,000 Mobile DLs Finally Arrives on Steam!]

Experience the golden era of gaming with this traditional turn-based command-battle JRPG, featuring nostalgic pixel art. The first installment of the highly acclaimed mobile series is now fully optimized for Steam, offering complete controller and keyboard support for a seamless experience on the big screen.

◆ Recruit and Train: Turn Almost Any Enemy into an Ally!

The core highlight of this game is the recruitment system that allows you to turn the monsters blocking your path into reliable allies. With almost every enemy capturable, the possibilities for your party composition are endless. Train your favorite monsters and build your ultimate dream team!

◆ Adapt and Conquer: Mid-Battle Party Swapping

While the game features familiar turn-based encounter battles, the strategic depth goes much deeper. You can freely swap your party members in the middle of combat! Adapt to enemy weaknesses or rescue allies in a pinch, delivering a gripping and deeply tactical battle experience.

◆ Optimized Features for the Steam Version

  • Play Your Way: Fully supports both controller and keyboard controls. Immerse yourself in the world of JRPG with zero stress.

  • Dual Language Support: Fully playable in both Japanese and English.

data.name: The Leopard Catgirl in Miaoli
data.detailed_description:
Story


In the year 201X, Hualian county held a mockery of a referendum to become the Kingdom of Hualian. After the Kingdom of Hualian is established, it had a domino effect where all 22 counties in Taiwan held a similar referendum. Surprisingly, all of them were successful, leading to chaos in Taiwan.

The protagonist Wang Cheng-En was a pharmacist who worked in Taipei. When he was barred from working there, he returned to his hometown Miaoli Empire. Along the way, he didn't expect to come across a wounded leopard catgirl Pisuka Riya. By taking care of her, a story on the romance between the two of them in Miaoli Empire begins.

Game Features

1.Stander virtual novel play style.
2.With saving and loading feature.
3.Support three different languages.
4.Contain many original musics and songs.

data.name: Swingularity
data.detailed_description:
Swingularity is a space golf game set across an infinite multiverse brimming with 2.5D planets, stars, and celestial hazards. Bogey, par, or birdie your way through both tailored and procedurally generated courses. Let the cosmos become your fairway…

Harness the gravitational forces of Newtonian mechanics to slingshot around planets and stars. With a sophisticated space-time overlay, you can estimate the perfect angle and power for that elusive hole-in-one.

Forget mundane sand-traps and lakes. In Swingularity, you’ll evade the fiery heat of stars, weave through the deadly beams of quasars, and even send your ball flying through black holes. Each galaxy offers a unique combination of hazards and obstacles that challenge you to master the art of cosmic golf.

The main campaign is just the beginning! Complete the handcrafted story levels to unlock a limitless multiverse filled with procedurally generated courses. Enter any seed and discover a brand-new experience, ensuring that no two holes are ever the same.

Classic JRPG gameplay and turn-based combat system with many classes.

(All characters and events are fictional)

data.name: Plant Nursery Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Run a relaxing plant nursery, manage inventory, and turn a small shop into a thriving business at your own pace.

Run your own cozy plant shop! Order plants, seeds, tools, and decorations from your computer. Stock the shelves, set up displays, and keep your nursery looking its best for customers.

Take a break from the shop floor to get your hands dirty. Tend to your greenhouses, grow a wide variety of crops, and nurture your plants from seedlings to beautiful blooms.

Help customers find the perfect plants and supplies. Work the register, manage rushes, and keep your customers happy to grow your profits.

Reinvest your hard-earned money back into the business. Expand your shop, add new greenhouses and storage rooms, hire cashiers and stockers, and decorate to make your nursery truly your own. Unlock special trinkets that grant powerful bonuses as your business blossoms.

Get started with Staff Runner and unlock the world of sheet music with the joy and excitement of gaming.

data.name: Last Block Standing
data.detailed_description:
Hold this street. Survive the next wave.

Last Block Standing is a top-down zombie shooter for solo play or online co-op with up to three friends. Keep moving and firing while you shape your defenses with barricades, mines and explosives. As more entrances open, the horde attacks from new directions and bosses force you to rethink your position. Clear the final wave: 130.

Make room with gunfire and defenses

Fight with pistols, SMGs, shotguns and rocket launchers. Place barrels and barricades, set mines, and throw grenades or splitting explosives. Draw the horde into a blast, concentrate fire at a corner, and leave yourself a way out. Combine ten weapons and defensive tools to suit the fight.

Six arenas change how you hold the line

Keep moving across an open street, switch firing lanes at a crossroads, or retreat through a winding alley. Circle a parking garage, defend a courtyard entrance, and move between the divided areas of the final arena. Each layout asks you to reconsider where to stand and where to fall back. Choose from four difficulty settings.

Bring each run's rewards into the next fight

When a run ends normally, spend the zombie heads earned from kills on permanent upgrades for weapons, explosives, barricades and armor. Defeat each boss for the first time to earn a dedicated core for special modifications, including extra shots, lingering fire and splitting explosives. Your upgrades carry into the next run.

Face thirteen boss encounters

A boss arrives every ten waves. Read the warnings before charges, area attacks and projectile patterns, then find a chance to strike back through the horde. Defeating bosses reveals their stories and battle records in the codex. Practice encounters in boss training before taking them on in survival.

Keep the team in the fight

Form a squad of up to four through Steam lobbies and friend invites, with in-game voice chat to coordinate. Fallen players can return after a wait while a teammate remains alive. Cover each other, plan your defenses and keep a retreat route open.

Play with keyboard and mouse or a controller. Adjust key bindings, camera shake and screen flashes, switch blood effects to green, and choose from 16 interface languages.

data.name: LenscraftCube 相机方块
data.detailed_description:
‌Lenscraft Cube‌ is a minimalist platformer puzzle game. In this game, you play as a small cube, starting with boundary-designed mechanisms to solve puzzles. Each mechanism in the game is simple and easy to understand, allowing you to fully utilize your imagination to find the path to the destination.

‌Game Features:‌

  • Minimalist Aesthetics: Build challenging puzzle worlds with simple geometric shapes, where each scene is simple yet beautiful

  • Boundary Puzzles: Unique "Camera View" mechanism that manipulates objects or changes gravity direction by adjusting perspective

  • Progressive Difficulty: From basic jumps to compound mechanisms, 100+ levels with gradually increasing difficulty

  • Workshop: Supports Steam Workshop for custom level creation
