data.name: Venus in Furs: Sensual Pleasure
data.detailed_description:
Wanda Kurtz, also known as Venus of the Furs, built a sexual empire along the legendary River of Pleasure. For years, she was the most influential figure of the High Libido Command in that region. However, after discovering a psychotronic technology capable of converting explicit sex into energy, Venus decided to abandon her position and create her own business model. During her spectacular escape, she attracted the attention of sexual addicts with the bioenergetic potential of this new technology.

With this innovation, sexual pleasure is not only intensified; users can now manipulate human nature in unprecedented ways. Venus discovered that the human body, at the height of sexual climax, releases a vast amount of bioelectric and psychic energy. This energy not only affects the body but also influences surrounding energetic fields, such as electromagnetic waves and quantum fields. Thus, a new technology called Sexual Psychotronics was born, where futuristic devices capture the bioenergy generated during sexual acts and amplify it for various purposes, from creating powerful psychic weapons to enhancing mental abilities.

The devices, connected to the partners’ bodies, channel this energy for diverse purposes, converting excitement and climax into psychokinetic or telepathic power. Among Venus’s inventions, the most impressive was a teleportation machine activated by sex, which transported her to the headwaters of the River of Pleasure, beyond the reach of the High Command. However, the machine malfunctioned upon arrival, causing Venus’s ethereal fragments to be scattered across the Valley of Pleasure.

Now, her loyal lover must use the same psychotronic technology to reassemble Venus’s fragmented body, which remains trapped in a quantum limbo. The Valley is saturated with traces of her presence, and only psychotronic sex can bring her back. Sexual Psychotronics have amplified Venus of the Furs’ powers, allowing her to manipulate reality itself – even foreseeing her nemesis in the not-too-distant future.

This is a first-person game with URP quality, where the player assumes the role of the extraordinary Lingam, the skilled lover of Venus of the Furs. Your mission is to recover the fragments of Venus scattered throughout the Valley of Pleasure, using the technology of Psychotronic Sex. In addition to his own knowledge, Lingam will rely on Venus's psychic guidance to lead him on his journey. He must also search the valley for retro-technological relics, created during the failed attempt to reintegrate Venus's body.

Explore every corner of the Valley in search of artifacts, using a psychotronic tracking device. The collection of fragments will be manual, and the player must gather everything at the teleportation machine, which still needs repair. Store items in your inventory and collect as many clues as possible. Listen to Venus through various means: she has become omnipresent, even without her body fully restored. To progress, it will be necessary to interact with spectral projections of Venus, which appear in brief bursts of psychotronic manifestation.

The game features an inventory system and quality settings, FPS options, and other resources that enhance the experience in this quantum event.🤩

data.name: Inferno Cafe
data.detailed_description:
🍰 "I want to be devoured by the one I love" 🍰

Let monster maids "devour" you, and fall in love —

a short ADV with roguelite elements.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ Monster Maids, Every One a Handful

Devils, werewolves, slimes, zombies, dolls, vampires —

wildly different species and personalities, each with her own troubles.

Rendered in pop-style art, it's a dark and cute romantic comedy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ The World of Inferno Cafe

The Demon World's No. 1 maid café chain, "Infelis", run by the Demon Lord CEO himself...

...and its lowest-selling location: "Branch 0."

An isolated facility where troublemaking maids serve out their penal posting.

Guide these girls toward the No. 1 spot in sales —

your strange new life in the Demon World begins.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ The Maids of Branch 0

🩷 The Klutzy Devil Princess

Zatahnia

The Demon King's daughter — sky-high ambition, rock-bottom results.

Word is she got banished to Branch 0 for constantly causing catastrophic screwups.

The Rabid Wolf Girl

💜 Rachel

A werewolf with a strong sense of justice who can't help nearly killing troublesome Masters.

Too feral to play the maid, she was shipped off to Branch 0.

The Melty Slime Idol

💚 Gelatina

A corrosive slime maid who keeps throwing guerrilla idol concerts at the café.

Her bodily fluids go flying mid-performance, causing chaos every time — so she was banished to Branch 0.

💛 The Tongue-Tied Zombie Chef

Hibana

A shy, teary-eyed zombie who runs the kitchen.

Panic around new people sends her into an eating frenzy — devouring anything and everything — so she was banished to Branch 0.

🤍 The Doll in Love with Love

Simone

The assistant manager — a bisque doll with an unhealthy obsession with other people's love lives.

She collects couples' sweet nothings with a wireless bug hidden inside her own body — and was banished to Branch 0.

💙 The Mad Chemist Vampire

Virginia

A genius of food chemistry — and a vampire who, by some cruel twist, can't drink blood.

She put a drink that turns your whole body rainbow on the menu, and was banished to Branch 0.

🖤 The Manager Who Stans Her Staff

Belle

The branch manager — surrounded by her maids, she forgets she's their boss and starts acting like their customer instead. She calls them "my little stars."

After one branch too many, even she was banished to Branch 0.

A true education professional... when she bothers to show up.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ To Get Closer, Let Them Eat You

You're a mysterious cake that grants small wishes to whoever eats you.

Let the maids "devour" you, and they'll grow — and so will their affection.

Bake yourself sweeter for the one you're falling for —

she's bound to notice...

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ But If the Café Goes Under, There's No Tomorrow

To keep spending your days with them, the café has to survive first.

Raise your maids to hit the sales Quota while building affection along the way.

Balancing both is the core cycle of the game.

  • Raise your maids and hit the sales Quota!

  • Choose ingredients and items to earn affection and stats!

  • Once a day, feed yourself to a maid with EAT ME for a big growth boost!

  • Keep the café alive AND win her heart! Go for both the Quota and her personal ending!

How you combine a limited hand is the key to winning.

The smarter your combos, the more the maids grow ― and the closer you'll get to them.

Every run reveals a new side of the maids —

a character game you'll love more the more you play.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ Streaming & Content Creation

Streaming and making videos of Inferno Cafe is welcome — please include a link to this store page in your video or stream description.

Monetization is totally fine!

Note: Game content is subject to change without notice.

Panic around new people sends her into an eating frenzy — devouring anything and everything — so she was banished to Branch 0.

🤍 The Doll in Love with Love

Simone

The assistant manager — a bisque doll with an unhealthy obsession with other people's love lives.

She collects couples' sweet nothings with a wireless bug hidden inside her own body — and was banished to Branch 0.

💙 The Mad Chemist Vampire

Virginia

A genius of food chemistry — and a vampire who, by some cruel twist, can't drink blood.

She put a drink that turns your whole body rainbow on the menu, and was banished to Branch 0.

🖤 The Manager Who Stans Her Staff

Belle

The branch manager — surrounded by her maids, she forgets she's their boss and starts acting like their customer instead. She calls them "my little stars."

After one branch too many, even she was banished to Branch 0.

A true education professional... when she bothers to show up.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ To Get Closer, Let Them Eat You

You're a mysterious cake that grants small wishes to whoever eats you.

Let the maids "devour" you, and they'll grow — and so will their affection.

Bake yourself sweeter for the one you're falling for —

she's bound to notice...

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ But If the Café Goes Under, There's No Tomorrow

To keep spending your days with them, the café has to survive first.

Raise your maids to hit the sales Quota while building affection along the way.

Balancing both is the core cycle of the game.

  • Raise your maids and hit the sales Quota!

  • Choose ingredients and items to earn affection and stats!

  • Once a day, feed yourself to a maid with EAT ME for a big growth boost!

  • Keep the café alive AND win her heart! Go for both the Quota and her personal ending!

How you combine a limited hand is the key to winning.

The smarter your combos, the more the maids grow ― and the closer you'll get to them.

Every run reveals a new side of the maids —

a character game you'll love more the more you play.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ Streaming & Content Creation

Streaming and making videos of Inferno Cafe is welcome — please include a link to this store page in your video or stream description.

Monetization is totally fine!

Note: Game content is subject to change without notice.

data.name: RTX Sweeper
data.detailed_description:
RTX Sweeper

Welcome to the captivating world of RTX Sweeper! Get ready for a fresh and exhilarating gameplay experience that will put your logical prowess to the ultimate test. In this modern twist on the classic game of Minesweeper, you'll embark on a thrilling adventure with innovative gameplay that feels entirely new.


In RTX Sweeper, your mission is to navigate a dynamic virtual landscape and conquer mind-boggling puzzles. Armed with your sharp intellect and keen problem-solving skills, you'll uncover hidden secrets and overcome challenging obstacles within the game's captivating design.

Plenty of difficulties

Prepare to encounter a variety of complex puzzles, each more intriguing than the last. As you explore the grid of tiles, your objective is to strategically unveil safe zones while avoiding hidden hazards. Each calculated move will provide valuable information to aid you in your mission, but be cautious, as a single misstep could lead to failure.


RTX Sweeper offers a range of difficulty levels, catering to both puzzle enthusiasts and newcomers alike. With each triumph, you'll unlock increasingly demanding levels, pushing the limits of your logical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Unleash your analytical skills as you navigate through the game's captivating labyrinth.

Innovative gameplay modes

Get ready to be captivated by the fresh and innovative gameplay of RTX Sweeper. With its engaging puzzles and thrilling mechanics, it offers a whole new perspective on the classic Minesweeper concept, ensuring an exciting and immersive gaming experience.

What RTX Sweeper has to offer

  • A full free to play experience
  • Multiple environments
  • Puzzles with plenty of difficulties
  • Unique minesweeper mechanics
  • Boss battles
  • Unlocks based on progress
  • An official starting guide
  • An official speedruns category
  • Plenty of big free updates in the future
  • Steam Achievements
  • Steam Leaderboards
  • Ray tracing (although it is very minimal and experimental)
  • ... and more!

Free to play

Do you have what it takes to conquer the perplexing puzzles of RTX Sweeper? Only those with razor-sharp intellects and unwavering determination will emerge victorious. Step into a world of fresh and new gameplay, and embrace the challenge that awaits in RTX Sweeper!

Join our Discord for more!

data.name: Trippy Tavern
data.detailed_description:
FEATURES

  • Colorful, unique drinks -- the more you progress, the more recipes you will learn.
  • After each round, spin for a random mod or event that will always keep the game unique and challenging.
  • Avoid permadeath! If you fail to pay your rent, you will lose the run and have to start over!
  • Save your progress and track your run history.
  • As you play through and earn more run victories, you will unlock new unique mods that will be added to your pool.

SUMMARY

  • Work your way through rounds by serving customers to earn gold.
  • You must earn enough each round to pay your rent -- or else you're done for!
  • Save your extra gold to purchase new recipes and level up.
  • Reach the ultimate rank before you miss rent... or die :D
  • Every round will be affected by a random game mod. Tons of unique mods keep every round interesting! Some are good, some are bad, and some are just plain weird.

data.name: I Have an Item
data.detailed_description:
THE HEART-POUNDING DRAW

On your turn, draw items one by one. After each draw, face the choice: keep your loot or draw more and risk losing everything.

  • The pool is a dynamic mix of valuable and dangerous items:

    • Resources: The foundation for crafting powerful items.

    • Blueprints: Unlock new, game-changing crafting recipes.

    • Junk: Drawing two identical Junk items in a row interrupts your turn!

    • Unstable Core: Drawing two of these interrupts your turn and deals damage!

CONTROL THE CHAOS

Use your loot to buy or craft special items that let you manipulate the pool, protect yourself, or sabotage your opponents.

SURVIVE

Play against friends and remember: this isn't about getting the most resources — it's about survival. 

The last surviving player wins.



NEW FALLING ITEMS GAME MODE

Take turns tossing items onto the table. Drop yours on the floor, and you're out.

data.name: The Good Life
data.detailed_description:
Like so many, Derek Hales is fed up and is dreaming about ditching the nine-to-five lifestyle. When he learns that his late uncle made him the sole heir of Carpe Diem Boats, a boating company on the tropical complex of the Jo Jo islands, he does not hesitate for a second. A new life awaits! After a long voyage, he and his striking girlfriend Michelle Joyce finally arrive at their destination, enjoying the beautiful sunrise, with a Boating Company of their own. Compared to the dull office life, this new life looks much better. Finally but suddenly, life is good!

Features:

  • With an array of luxury vessels at your disposal, take on various missions across ultra-realistic tropical waters, in order to make your fortune.
  • Experience vast, beautiful tropical locations, with more than 50 harbors and dozens of diverse places to explore.
  • Become an adept skipper and progress across 6 different ship types.
  • Realistic weather conditions and 24hr day/night cycle.
  • Seek treasures in the deep, rescue people from drowning, avoid pirate attacks and become rich and famous!
  • Use your earnings to build your commercial empire, buy and sell properties in this tropical paradise, progress from sun beds, beach houses and bungalows, to restaurants, villas and even hotels.
  • Play against 9 other NPC Skippers who compete for business against you, become the best skipper, earn more money and become the ultimate tycoon of the JoJo Islands!

data.name: Fatebound: Blood of Shtriga
data.detailed_description:
FATEBOUND: BLOOD OF SHTRIGA

You are Eldina, a "Shtriga" (Witch), hated by her own people for blood she did not choose.

Fatebound: Blood of Shtriga is a narrative-driven, third-person, action RPG set in a reimagined medieval South-East Europe, where folklore is not decoration but law. Oaths bind, curses carry weight and power is never free.

A WORLD SHAPED BY BELIEF

Play as Eldina, a young woman marked by the bloodline of the Shtriga. Hunted by villagers who fear her, pursued by soldiers who would burn her, she survives by moving through the shadows, reading her enemies and paying the cost of forbidden magic. She carries one inheritance worn against her skin, an amulet older than her memory. It is the only thing her mother left her and it may be the only thing keeping her alive.

You are more than a warrior. You are something older, far more dangerous.

KEY FEATURES

Asymmetric survival combat: You are physically outmatched. Trained soldiers, armored guards and sworn hunters can kill you easily. But you are smaller, faster and willing to go where they cannot follow. Observe, position and outthink, or die.

Curse rituals: Perform ritual minigames to lay curses upon your enemies: weaken them, blind them, bend them to fear. The more powerful the curse, the higher the stakes and failure does not leave you untouched.

Steal what binds them: The strongest curses require something personal: a lock of hair, a pendant, a token worn close to the skin. Slip past your target, take what ties them to themselves and turn it against them.

Backlash: A broken ritual does not simply fail. The curse recoils. Vision blurs, strength fails, the body betrays you. Power has a price and Eldina pays it first.

The Illyrian "sica": A curved blade built to bypass shields. Strike from the flank. Finish what your curses began.

Witch Sight: See what the world hides form you. Detect serpent sigils, ritual residue, the trails of oaths kept and broken. Folklore becomes a perception system.

Oaths that bind: "Besa", the sacred word. Keep it and doors open. Break it and entire regions turn against you. Your choices are not measured in good and evil. Instead, they are measured in blood, promise and memory.

THE BALKANS YOU HAVEN'T SEEN

Fatebound draws from the oral traditions of Albania and the wider Balkans, a folklore of moral ambiguity, communal dread and survival by wit rather than heroism. Real medieval locations, researched alongside cultural historians, become the backdrop for a world where magic is feared because it is real and where every protective charm hangs on a door for a reason.

Curse rituals: Perform ritual minigames to lay curses upon your enemies: weaken them, blind them, bend them to fear. The more powerful the curse, the higher the stakes and failure does not leave you untouched.

Steal what binds them: The strongest curses require something personal: a lock of hair, a pendant, a token worn close to the skin. Slip past your target, take what ties them to themselves and turn it against them.

Backlash: A broken ritual does not simply fail. The curse recoils. Vision blurs, strength fails, the body betrays you. Power has a price and Eldina pays it first.

The Illyrian "sica": A curved blade built to bypass shields. Strike from the flank. Finish what your curses began.

Witch Sight: See what the world hides form you. Detect serpent sigils, ritual residue, the trails of oaths kept and broken. Folklore becomes a perception system.

Oaths that bind: "Besa", the sacred word. Keep it and doors open. Break it and entire regions turn against you. Your choices are not measured in good and evil. Instead, they are measured in blood, promise and memory.

THE BALKANS YOU HAVEN'T SEEN

Fatebound draws from the oral traditions of Albania and the wider Balkans, a folklore of moral ambiguity, communal dread and survival by wit rather than heroism. Real medieval locations, researched alongside cultural historians, become the backdrop for a world where magic is feared because it is real and where every protective charm hangs on a door for a reason.
data.short_description: Fatebound: Blood of Shtriga is a narrative-driven, third-person, action RPG inspired by South-Eastern European folklore and culture. The story follows Eldina, a hunted "Shtriga" caught between the fate she was born into and the one she might yet claim, through stealth, ritual and consequence.

data.name: Marble Combat
data.detailed_description:
Marble combat is a physics based multiplayer game for 2 - 8 people. Players compete as magical marbles racing and fighting to dominate capture points and collect power ups. Spin, velocity, bounce, and torque control the players movement with a little added air control for big jumps and falls.

Compete in teams of 4v4 to score points over three rounds. Points are scored through dominating a single capture zone per round with each zone providing a unique challenge to the teams.
Players can pick up to 4 abilities which can be used to throw opponents, save allies or beat enemies out of the capture zone. Picking the right combination of abilities with your team can be the difference between victory and defeat.

The environment features different types of interactive and animated elements that can launch, carry, fire, bounce your marble for better or for worse.
Learn the environment through single player time attack challenges .

The rough road map for Marble Combat will be to go to Steam Early Access with the main map and game mode. Periodically new maps, powers, cosmetics and other game modes will be added throughout early access.

Overall Marble Combat aims to offer a competitive multiplayer with a focus on slapstick comedy and retro nostalgia.

data.name: Crown Chaos
data.detailed_description:
Crown Chaos is a chaotic 3D multiplayer king of the hill game where players fight to control a moving zone using physics-based pushing and ragdoll combat.

In each match, players compete to stay inside the active hill. If you are the only player inside the zone, you gain score. If multiple players are inside, the hill becomes contested and no one earns points.

Players can push, collide, and knock each other off balance to take control. The physics-based movement creates unpredictable and often chaotic fights where positioning and timing matter.

As the match progresses, the hill will move to new locations. When this happens, the game briefly slows down and players choose from a set of random upgrade cards. These upgrades can improve movement, increase push strength, or add new abilities that change how you play.

Each round builds on the last, with players stacking upgrades and creating different playstyles. No two matches play the same way.

Be the only one in the Zone and Standing to Gain Points.

Features:

- Multiplayer king of the hill gameplay

- Physics-based pushing and ragdoll interactions

- Moving zones that force constant repositioning

- Random upgrade cards that change each match

- Stackable abilities and stat upgrades

- Fast-paced, replayable matches

- Normal and Procedural Generated Maps

data.name: Zoocard
data.detailed_description:
Gameplay

Zoocard is a zoo-themed board roguelike deck-building game. Place animals on a hexagonal board and trigger synergies between species to earn coin rewards. You can also earn additional rewards by feeding your animals, providing them with toys, and collecting stamps. Build a unique deck and play your cards strategically to maximize your zoo’s income.

Build a Powerful Animal Deck

  • Every animal has a unique ability. Discover new species, choose your cards, and refine your deck.

  • Place animals in your zoo and watch them interact with one another: rabbits fear predators, wolves enjoy living in groups, while tigers prefer to be alone. Find the right placements to trigger combos and earn more coins.

  • The terrain is randomly generated for each board, and every animal has its own cost and space requirements. Adapt to the situation, play your animal cards wisely, and place them where they can make the biggest impact.

Enjoy Running Your Zoo

  • Food: Once an animal is well-fed, you’ll receive an additional coin reward.

  • Toys: Place toys in empty spaces inside animal enclosures to provide extra rewards.

  • Buildings: Buildings provide unique effects when placed. For example, the Keeper’s Hut automatically feeds nearby animals each turn.

  • Stamps: Gain various bonuses or introduce new twists to the way you play.

With a cozy, relaxing art style and lively animal sounds, Zoocard is easy to pick up while offering plenty of strategic depth. Come build your zoo, play your cards, and enjoy the fun of running a zoo!

data.name: Ecchi Sketch: Draw Cute Girls Every Day!
data.detailed_description:
Story description

Ecchi Sketch: Draw Cute Girls Every Day follows the story of Yume Akiyama, a girl in her mid twenties who works at a real 'dead-end' job - at a funeral company. Her real passion, however, is anything girl x girl - manga, anime, videogames; if it has cute girls romancing other cute girls, then she's a fan.

A talented amateur artist, Yume is suddenly given the opportunity of a lifetime - to be a mangaka at a manga studio! But with so many other attractive girls at the office... will she be able to concentrate?


Characters

Yume Akiyama
Yume Akiyama, the heroine of our story, is a graphic designer at a funeral company. She’s also a highly talented manga artist and is a superfan of anything girl x girl, be it manga, anime or video games.

Yume’s mother died while she was young, so now she lives with her Dad, a high powered executive at Miyuhara Industries.


Kyoko Miyuhara
Kyoko Miyuhara is heir to the Miyuhara fortune. Her father is the president of Miyuhara Industries, a national company on the Nikkei stock exchange.

After a chance meeting with Yume, Kyoko reveals she runs her own company - Shirayuri Media who create girl x girl manga and doujinshi.


Rin
Rin is the jack of all trades at Shirayuri Media. From shading, to cleaning and colouring, Rin handles the odd jobs. Obsessed with pink, magical girls, and all things cute, Rin often comes across bratty and immature. Underneath, however, she hides a heart of gold.


Megumi
Megumi is a talented storyteller, a hobbyist musician and deep thinker. She often loses herself in her own thoughts... sometimes in the midst of conversation.

She often questions her place in the world, and can come across a little abrasive. Her personal life is a closely guarded secret.

Features
Partial voice acting across 3 major routes.
An original soundtrack.
20+ unique CGs

data.name: AI Pals
data.detailed_description:
AI Pals is your sandbox for endless adventure and role-playing. Empower your creativity and skills by inhabiting roles that challenge and inspire you, while experiencing the thrill of dynamic AI conversations that adapt to your choices and evolve as you interact.
Plus, you don't have to worry about paying for another subscription service. AI Pals is developed with offline first in mind. You can run it completely offline, giving you complete control over your data and AI.

What can I do with AI Pals? - Let your creativity run wild!

Dive into text-based adventures using easy-to-use interfaces or customize your own to interact with AI!
Will you solve a shadowy murder alongside a hard-boiled detective, their words dripping with noir intrigue? Or perhaps journey through enchanted forests guided by a powerful mage? Imagine confiding secrets with a wise AI mentor, their words offering solace, guidance and motivation. The possibilities are as limitless as your imagination.

Select from a diverse cast of AI personalities/roles – friendly characters, storytellers, to even not-so-helpful ones – or be the master of your own universe. Build your OWN Pal from scratch, sculpting their every quirk and characteristic. The creation tools allow you to build characters with completely unique personalities and backstories for truly authentic and immersive experiences.

And what is an AI Pal exactly?

Go beyond personality and craft truly unique companions that reflect YOUR vision. Customize every aspect of your Pal:
  • Face: Bring them to life with images, videos, or even dynamic audio-reactive shaders.
  • Voice: Give them a distinct voice using Text-To-Speech models.
  • Brain: Change their behavior by assigning different Text AI Models to each Pal.
  • Creativity: Tune their personality with preset configurations for your chosen AI model.
And there's so much more to discover about this concept! (see planned features in the Early Access description)

AI Pals are meant to be used in AI Spaces - AI SPACES?!

Imagine personalized interfaces tailored to your every need. Customize backgrounds, colors, panels, ... – make each space unique! Position them anywhere on your desktop for instant access to the right Pal at the right time.

Think of it like this: one AI Space dedicated to immersive text adventures with a storytelling Pal, another for brainstorming character backstories or finding inspiration - all seamlessly switchable from your desktop!


And there's more:
  • Group Chat: Engage with multiple Pals in dynamic group conversations
  • Session Based Memory: Add entire documents to a Pal's limited memory so they can look up information during conversations
  • Function Calling: Experts can expand their Pal's capabilities with custom Python functions

This powerful combination opens up a world of possibilities, and we're just getting started! Explore more feature ideas and support for complex game scenarios in the Early Access description!

Key Feature Summary

AI Interaction
  • AI Pals!
  • Full Instruction, Chat and Group Chat based Text Generation
  • Helpful predefined Personalities - also some maybe not so helpful ones :) - and other examples
Customization and Control
  • Enjoy easy-to-use and customizable interfaces (AI Spaces)
  • Create unique Personalities, Pals and Spaces with powerful editors
  • AI Model Parameter Preset support
  • Full Chat Context Control: Add/Delete/Change entries in the running conversation
  • Session History with Chat resume support
Advanced AI Capabilities
  • AI Model Library: Easily manage and organize AI models (GGUF model support)
  • Get more immersed with voice synthesis - Text-To-Speech Support: System Voices + 4 AI model voices
  • Interact with your voice - Speech-To-Text Support (With different AI model sizes)
  • Personality Feature - For Experts: Create AI Pals that can call your own Python functions
  • Personality Feature - Optional Session Based Memory: Allows to expand the limited AI Memory by using e.g. Lorebook Documents and more

Additional Notes for your consideration

Designed for desktop PCs, AI Pals unlocks powerful offline AI experiences. There are quite large models out there, so in other words, the more powerful your PC, the more capable models you can run in terms of output quality and understanding your intent. Modern GPUs are partially supported, with the fastest performance coming from the CUDA 12.1 runtime (NVIDIA RTX cards), and broader but slower support from the Vulkan runtime.

Let AI Pals empower and entertain you. Create, explore and immerse yourself in any realm you can imagine. Don't forget to add AI Pals to your Wishlist to be notified when it launches.

data.name: 8bit Salvage
data.detailed_description:
The shop. A tiny three-person salvage operation. Bob owns it — supremely confident, and reliably wrong about how everything works. Randy invented every machine on the floor, and quietly slides Bob a correction note whenever he explains one. You're the new hire. You do the actual work.

The work. Retired game sprites drift in and pile up against the magnet in the middle of the floor. Hold the spinning brush over one and the pixels come off. The vacuum inside the magnet pulls them up the hose, and at the end of the shift you sell the salvage. It is genuinely calm and oddly satisfying — every pass leaves the sprite visibly cleaner, and watching the mess disappear is its own reward.

Then Randy invents something. Acidic goo splashes onto a pile and soaks through it while you're working the other side of the floor. Roller brushes bulldoze whole stacks. You stop cleaning one sprite at a time and start running a shop that cleans for you.

Then it gets away from you. Mutation waves sweep the floor and turn sprites radiant — or electric. Chain lightning jumps between them and even sets some on fire. By the final shifts the screen is a storm of sparks and flying pixels, and it is still, technically, cleaning.

All of it is bought. Every machine comes out of a sprawling upgrade tree you fund with your own pay. Early on a single purchase is a whole shift's work and a real decision. Later the tree stops being sensible. Shifts run on a real workweek, too — earn overtime, unlock Saturdays, get your raise.

Some of it is hidden. Randy acquired an abandoned storage unit and came back with eight runes and the broken contraption they were sitting in. He told Bob to keep them apart for safety. Bob hid them around the shop — very well, it turns out — and now they're scattered through the upgrade tree. Find all eight and Randy has a brand-new magnet core built to harness them. He's very excited about it. Bob thinks that's a good sign.

Bob's Odds. Bob has a game show now, and you are the only contestant. Every round has a number to hit. Hit it and Bob deals the cards — take your pick of the upgrades on the table, or flip a hidden card to find out what you got after it's yours. Miss the number and the season is over. The Odd Balls you earn along the way buy Randy's inventions forever, so every season starts stronger than the last. No two seasons play alike.

The scale. Every round runs on Randy's scale. Fill it and you pass. Fill it again and it reloads with a bigger number and a better prize, and your Odd Balls keep counting for as long as the pixels keep coming. Bob calls the round live from the corner. Bob is not always right, but he's usually entertaining.

Two ways to play. The Early Years is where the shop began: a deliberately compressed campaign with a story all its own, finishable in a sitting. Bob's Odds is the show. The free demo has all of The Early Years and the first three episodes of the show.

Certified by the American Sprite Humane Association: No sprites are harmed in this shop. We only take the pixels off.

data.name: Alongside
data.detailed_description:
Brief introduction: The kingdom is under the threat of attack by hordes of evil. You and your units need to protect it from orcs, goblins and other monsters. Use a tactical approach to survive and win.

Gameplay: The Tower Defense Strategy game invites players to place fighters on the field, each of which has unique attacking or defensive abilities. You will be attacked by waves of enemies and the further you advance in the game, the greater the wave and the level of their strength. In later levels, players can acquire stronger units to counter armored enemies.
Each unit can only attack or defend on the track it is on. Gather food and use it to buy new units while maintaining game balance. Use the hero and his abilities to save the day in difficult times. If the monster reaches the end of the track a second time in a level, you will lose.

Visual style: The game is made in a 2D hand-drawn style. The world of the game is fabulous, inhabited by various animals. Weapons and other elements used in the game will be created in the same atmosphere, which will give the game a unique visual look.
The game is suitable for fans of the genre of strategy and tower defense. Also, the game will be interesting for those who love games in a fairy tale and fantasy world.

Game Ending: To complete the game, you need to defeat the final boss, which is located in the last level of the game.

Conclusion: Alongside is a fun game in which players must use their tactical skills to defend the kingdom from the consequences of horrific attacks. As you progress in the game, players will gain new levels and unique heroes with unique abilities.

data.name: Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus
data.detailed_description:
Join the community!


About the Game

Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus is a first person action-puzzle game set in physics based worlds.
This new enhanced edition includes lots of improvements plus extra contents.

You'll assume the role of a nice Big Guy that will need to wake up in order to save the most important thing in his life.

Features



- 31 Crazy levels set in Suicide Guy's mind

- Absurd creatures to annoy

- Physics based levels

- You will: pick up items, throw them, activate mechanisms and even burp!

- Collectible items to find

- A very important mission to accomplish

What does the new Deluxe Edition include?



- 3 new exclusive levels

- Cloud saves

- Performance improvements

- Graphics enhancements

- Highly polished physics interactions

- New languages support (Korean, Arabic, Dutch, Swedish and Norwegian)

- Options for completely customizable button mappings

- Exclusive levels will be added as a Free update for all players in the next months after the initial release, so stay tuned!



Players will be challenged with the most complex and original brain teasers.

The game includes mature content, in particular violence, alcohol abuse and self-harm.
Despite the title the game is NOT about suicide or depression.

data.name: JULPAE
data.detailed_description:
JULPAE is a free online strategy card game with a Korean-inspired atmosphere.

Players take turns playing cards or passing while reading the flow of the table. Victory is not decided simply by playing the strongest cards. The core of JULPAE is making better decisions based on your opponent’s choices, pass timing, hidden information, and team deduction.

4-Player Online Card Battles

JULPAE’s main mode is a 4-player online card battle. Each player uses their hand to take part in the round, observes the choices of other players, and reacts to the changing flow of the table.

In 4-player mode, the game is not only about playing stronger cards. You must also deduce who may be on your team and decide when to take the lead, when to hold back, and how to help your team reach victory.

1v1 Duel Mode

JULPAE is built around 4-player online card battles, but it also includes a 1v1 Duel Mode for faster matches and easier entry into the game.

In 1v1 Duel Mode, you face your opponent directly and make quick decisions about when to play, when to pass, and when to take control of the table. It is a fast way to learn JULPAE’s core rules and timing-based mind games before moving into deeper 4-player team battles.

Team Deduction and Mind Games

JULPAE includes hidden information. You must observe what happens during the match, read the behavior of other players, and make better decisions with incomplete information.

Reading who is trying to take control, who may be passing on purpose, and when to make your move is a key part of the game.

Fast Decisions and Pass Timing

Having strong cards does not always mean you should play them immediately. Sometimes you need to save a strong hand, and sometimes you need to take control of the table before your opponent does.

Knowing when to play, when to pass, and when to interrupt the opponent’s flow is one of JULPAE’s core strategic elements.

Basic Play, Advanced Play, and Ranked Matches

New players can start with Basic Play to learn the rules and flow of the game. Players who want faster decisions and more competitive matches can move on to Advanced Play and Ranked Matches.

1v1 Duel Mode is suited for quick matches and learning the rules, while 4-player mode offers JULPAE’s main experience with team deduction, timing, and deeper mind games.

Free to Play

JULPAE is free to play. The game may include in-game currency, passes, or optional systems, but it does not include real-money gambling, cash-out features, or rewards with real-world value.

Season 0 Test Operation Notice

JULPAE is preparing for Season 0 test operation. During the test period, balance, rewards, rankings, items, progression records, and other data may be adjusted, reset, deleted, or changed according to service stabilization and operation policies.

Server-Based Multiplayer

Game judgment and major data are processed based on the server. A stable internet connection is required for online play.

data.name: THE LAST BLADE 2
data.detailed_description:
THE LAST BLADE 2 is SNK’s legendary weapons-based fighting game which was originally released in 1998 on SNK’s NEOGEO game system as a sequel to its predecessor THE LAST BLADE.

This widely revered NEOGEO masterpiece is finally available on STEAM! Not only a port of the original game, the STEAM version of THE LAST BLADE 2 will allow players from across the globe to fight against each other online / locally in epic battles in online Multiplayer Mode.

Discover (or rediscover) THE LAST BLADE 2, which is still considered as the pinnacle of weapons-based fighting games around the world!

GAME FEATURES:

◆An epic storyline during the twilight period of the SAMURAI!

“Hell’s Gate”, the boundary between life and death. Four “Mythological Symbols" are about to fight to the death against an ultimate spirit

awakened from the netherworld, in order to send him straight to "Hell's Gate"! Taking place during the end of the Edo-period, a truly

mystical and spectacular story is about to unfold…

◆18 characters who are directed by their destiny cross swords!

In addition to 12 combatants (including boss character “Kagami” from the series’ predecessor), 4 new characters and 2 hidden ones join the gorgeous roster of 18 playable characters. Choose the character and fighting style which suits you the most, and prepare for an epic battle to seal “Hell’s Gate”!

◆Enjoyable strategies and a unique game system / game mechanics!

Select your favorite sword attack type among the “POWER”, “SPEED”, and “EXTREME” modes. Master the ”REPEL” mechanic to counter your opponent’s attacks, and when the right time comes, activate the “SUPER SECRET SLASH”, “HIDDEN SECRET SLASH” and “ENIGMA FRENZY-ATTACK” ultimate techniques in order to change the outcome of the battle!

data.detailed_description:
FEATURES:

  • A unique mechanic powered by your webcam

  • Microphone-based puzzles that react to your voice and presence

  • Environmental puzzles built on awareness and observation

  • Psychological horror focused on tension, not repetition

  • Multiple possible outcomes shaped by your experience

A BIG MYSTERY FOR LITTLE LILY

One night, Lily suddenly wakes up — unaware that what lies hidden within that night will change everything.

At first, everything seems normal.

But slowly…


she begins to notice that something isn’t quite right.

As the darkness deepens, Lily discovers that she possesses a strange ability.

When we’re afraid, we close our eyes.

But what if… your eyes could actually protect you?

A UNIQUE INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCE

In this experience, you don’t just control Lily.

Sometimes… you help her.

With your eyes.
With your voice.
With what you choose to notice.

As puzzles draw you deeper into the experience,
you’ll begin to uncover the secret Lily carries.

But be careful.

Sometimes…
a single blink can change reality.

data.name: Beat Bots
data.detailed_description:
Beat Bots is a casual musical puzzle game. Your goal is to make beats!

Includes 40 diverse and engaging puzzles, with a varied roster of tile types and increasingly complex target sequences.

1. Listen 👂

First, listen to the target beat.

2. Replicate 🛠

Then, solve how to correctly replicate the beat by using a variety of tile types to manipulate bots that each represent a different drum sound.

3. Win! 🎉

Now, set the bots running. If the bots correctly play the target sequence, you win!

While Beat Bots is a musical game, comprehensive visual cues are available which allow the game to be fully playable for people with hearing difficulties. No prior musical experience is required!

data.name: Cast Iron Flowers
data.detailed_description:
This game is a VR experience of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program - Cast Iron Flowers. You can experience the process of Cast Iron Flowers in the game!

You move and manipulate objects through the use of the VR grip, experiencing each process of Cast Iron Flowers and ultimately realizing it by gripping the willow sticks (Hua Bang)! You can feel the stunning immersion effect far beyond the normal video.

The optimized process is presented in the game as the following parts:
- Pick up the basket with broken iron pieces and pour the iron pieces in the basket into the designated furnace.
- Pick up the willow sticks (Hua Bang) used for Molten Iron Firework and go to the furnace to get liquid iron.
- Go to the bottom of the trellis (Hua Peng) and hit the willow sticks (Hua Bang) to complete the flower making process and enjoy the beautiful scenery.

As long as you follow the guidance in the scene to operate, you can feel the unique charm of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program of Cast Iron Flowers, come and try!

data.name: Papi's Playhouse
data.detailed_description:
A first-person multiplayer card game of hidden roles, bluffing, and real-time shootouts.
Set inside a gritty bar, players sit face-to-face at the table, but no one knows whom to trust.
Play your cards, pick up your weapons, and stay alive. It's not just about winning… It’s about surviving the table.

🔹 First-person multiplayer with up to 7 players

🔹 Hidden roles and unique win conditions

🔹Distance-based combat: shoot players within range

🔹 Different weapons: grab, aim, and shoot

🔹Different types of cards: action, passive, trap

🔹 Voice chat deception

🔹 Set in a fully immersive bar

At the start of every match, you’re assigned a role:

  • Mafia Boss – eliminate threats and lead your team

  • Goon – protect the Boss at all costs

  • Cop – take down the mafia, no matter what

  • Rat – play both sides and be the last one standing

Each role has a unique win condition, but you’ll have to bluff, lie, and improvise to survive.

Alliances shift every second. Some players will have your back, until they don’t. Use voice chat, read the room, and figure out who’s lying before it’s too late. Games are intense and full of backstabbing. Victory only comes to those who observe, adapt, and survive.

data.name: Mozi
data.detailed_description:
In the distant Milky Way galaxy, there hides a mysterious planet named Mozi Planet. This planet has a vast and boundless ocean, and every drop of seawater is shining with a mysterious light, as if telling the ancient interstellar secrets. As an elite engineer of the Galaxy Exploration Team, you shoulder the heavy responsibility of building a base on the Mozi Planet, taking a solid step forward for the interstellar exploration of mankind.
The core gameplay of this game is building and managing the base. Players will personally design and build their own interstellar base, from site selection, planning to construction, and every step requires careful planning and meticulous execution. During the construction process of the base, players need to rationally utilize resources and solve various challenges and problems to ensure the stability and development of the base.
As the base continues to expand, players will unlock more technologies and research projects, develop more advanced facilities and equipment, and provide stronger support and guarantee for the base. At the same time, players also need to cooperate and compete with other players or NPCs to jointly explore the mysteries of Mozi Planet and contribute to the interstellar future of mankind.
In the game, players will experience the hardships and joys of establishing an interstellar base from scratch, feel the harmonious coexistence of technology and nature, as well as the courage and wisdom of human exploration of the unknown. Mozi Planet is waiting for the arrival of the brave. Let's start this interstellar adventure journey together!

data.name: Emberville
data.detailed_description:
Tired and confused, you awake engulfed in darkness, in a prison that appears to have no end, known as the Vitromotus. Your memories are clouded, but your desire for freedom allows you to endure.

With nothing but your wits and might, you carve your way out with determination, eager to embrace the light of the sun. Yet, as despair slowly consumes your spirit, a ray of hope shines forward. Imprisoned like countless others, the denizens of a once thriving town, now ravaged by vicious forces, await your aid.

As you rescue them from various, terrible fates, they will lend their skills and help you rebuild their homes. You will learn their trades, secrets, and dreams while assisting them in their many quests. And perhaps, in time, become a legend in the chronicles of their land: Emberville.

Rebuild the town of Emberville

  • Meet and rescue an array of quaint characters along your way. They will show you their gratitude with amazing rewards and useful teachings.

  • Get to know the denizens of Emberville, hear their stories, and, if you dare, read their diaries while they are not looking; Fulfill quests, engage with townsfolk, unlock mechanics, and more. 

  • Aid the villagers in rebuilding their town through a large variety of gathering and crafting professions. As Emberville restores itself, it will become a living hub shaped by your deeds.

Venture into the eternal prison

  • Intended as a magical confinement for the unwanted elements of a once great society, the Vitromotus stands instead as a testament to their arrogance and corruption. Find a way to escape it and, if you so desire, aid those unfortunate enough to have been left behind.

  • Explore the knowledge hidden in its forgotten tunnels, ruins, survivors settlements and threatening environments, and unlock the secrets behind this energy known as kymia, a mysterious power born from emotions that brings those trapped within the Vitromotus back to life.

  • Over the years, the influence of kymia reshaped the world inside the prison, bringing about strange biomes and bizarre monsters. Brave its depths and learn what hides beneath; you may discover that, perhaps, not all of these creatures are as terrible as you imagine.


Develop your own fighting style

  • From sinister creatures to fearsome bosses, face enemies in action-focused combat that rewards positioning, timing, and knowledge.

  • Unlock unique weapon-bound combos for a variety of weapons and chain different types of attacks to unleash devastating strikes on enemies.

  • Learn, choose and use different skills from a big range of combat classes that can inherit passive and active skills from other learnt classes. 

Customize and improve your character

  • Enhance your character with an ample collection of skills and weapons that can be improved through leveling, items, and the help of villagers you rescue.

  • As you gain experience in battle and complete quests, choose from a wide selection of classes that can be changed at any time, each with its own distinctive gameplay and abilities.

  • The deeper you venture, the stronger your foes will be. You will have abundant opportunities to experiment with various fighting techniques to find the build and weapon category that better suits your playstyle.

  • Create and customize your character with dozens of options of hair styles, beards, facial features, colors, and more.


Build your Estate

  • Customize your personal space within Emberville where you will be able to craft anything needed to help your journey through the Vitromotous and transform your homestead into a comfortable place to relax, from buildings to furniture, plants, and decorations.

  • Gather a myriad of unique materials to forge not only your combat equipment, but also useful potions, food, tools, and trinkets.

  • Progress not only through combat, but also exploration, rebuilding, and the various choices you will have to make through your adventure.

data.name: Empire: Sound of the North
data.detailed_description:
Empire: Sound of the North, a swipe em up cards game. Swipe the cards, Manage your Town, go on Adventures, solve puzzles and mysteries, make everyone happy and create your own Kingdom.

Once upon a time, your father, one of the most famous blacksmiths in the north, was known for his skill and strong character. His swords and armors were renowned not only for their beauty but also for their durability. As he worked by the hot fire of his forge, your father hoped to pass on to you that same fire and determination. 


However, time is relentless; one day, while working on his final masterpiece, your father lost his life. His loss plunged not only you but the entire village and surrounding lands into deep sorrow. What your father left behind was not just those sturdy and shining armors, but also a legacy that would keep his memory alive: this small but potentially rich piece of land. 

Just after your father's funeral, a messenger delivered a letter to you. It was King Bjorn, wanted to talk with you about the land you own now... So will you run this land with peace, or you will make the people suffer... Now the fate of a village was in your hands.

Swipe em cards up! Get ready to be the new King of the North.

Build!

Build your kingdom one by one with the new buildings system.

Progress!

Complete the missions and dungeons, be a better and powerful King!

Be Careful about your subjects!

With the new systems, you are not only responsible of the happiness of your subjects, you are also responsible of your towns well being. This is also a medieval town simulation and you are expected to need their meets while defending them against the raids!

We moved our game into Unity!

Our surprise to you is we are improving our game and moving into the Unity Engine. While we are replaced all the pictures with amazing Unreal Engine videos*; we also have improved the game mechanics. Added mechanics like Population, Army, Food, Building, Missions, Sieges and Raids, and of course Glory.

Now, while you are making your soldiers, Nobles, Clergy and People happy, you will also need to keep the balance between needs of your town and protect yourself against the coming raids. This update makes the game virtually endless while you are playing the main story.

Our Plans:

We are working on two different systems, one of them is Politics and the other is Important people. Details later.

Deepen the game with a system that you can exchange your coins with mana points. Maybe while building new buildings or taxing, lowering taxes etc.

Adding new cards and videos to the game.

data.name: She Hunts
data.detailed_description:
She Hunts is a compact third person action-adventure game blending tense combat with atmospheric storytelling. Battle corrupted creatures with your trusty crossbow and lay clever traps for your foes. Explore an enchanted autumn forest, discover its hidden truths, and face the dangers roaming within. However, when night falls, the Beast appears, and the hunter becomes the hunted. And though death may seem inevitable, it is not the end...

 

She Hunts features:

  • An atmospheric mystery driven narrative.

  • A handcrafted compact open world with lots of secrets and mysteries to uncover.

  • No objective markers or light trails to guide you down a predefined path, your discoveries are your own.

  • Hunting inspired crossbow-centric combat with lots of options to spice encounters up from traps to consumables to different power-ups.

  • The Beast, a fearsome foe that turns night time adventures into a battle for survival.

Unveil the mystery

You are the Huntress, a young woman who's lost her past on journey of self-discovery. Hunted by the mysterious Beast, you explore a cursed forest where once peaceful animals are turning into monsters and where trees weep purple tears. Only you can solve the mystery behind the curse and bring peace where there is none.

Battle cursed creatures

A horde of vicious abominations stands between you and your destiny, and barging in without a solid plan is sure to result in your untimely demise. To bolster your chances of survival, you can also acquire and make use of a slew of different traps, tools and power-ups. Lure enemies into ambushes, pick them off one by one from afar, create kill zones with cleverly placed explosives, or conserve resources for future fights by sneaking past the threats altogether. As you advance, you'll discover more and more tools to use in dispatching those trying to stop you from lifting the curse.

Explore colorful environments

Explore a hand-crafted world full of detail and color. Find your own way, with no objective markers, mini-maps or light trails to force you down a single path. Piece together the story behind the forest and the Northern Kingdom by finding secrets, unearthing lore and by treading where no one else dares.

data.name: Space Rats
data.detailed_description:
OVERVIEW
Space Rats is a family-friendly, combat racing platformer where cute, sci-fi animals compete on dynamic, enclosed courses with variable gravity. Players race in dynamic enclosed courses with the ability to run on any interior surface (up, down, and all around) while utilizing gravity to their competitive advantage. The gravity in Space Rats radiates out from the Artifical Gravity Line (AGL) in all directions. The further a player gets from the AGL, the heavier gravity becomes. But if they are near or in the center of the AGL, they will soar in Zero-G!

MULTIPLAYER COMPETITION
Race against friends or strangers online! Space Rats can be enjoyed by both casual and competitive gamers thanks to our matchmaking system that ensures you race against players of similar skill level. Climb your way up through the ranks and leaderboards of the Artificial Gravity Racing Organization (A.G.R.O. for short)!


ARTIFICIAL/VARIABLE GRAVITY
The gravity system in Space Rats is unique because it is based on the concept of centripetal force. The race courses are all housed within long, cylindrical space stations that rotate around a central axis of rotation. Because of the rotation, ‘gravity’ flows out from the center of the course in every direction. This means that no matter where a character stands inside the course, they can always look “up” and see the center of the course, represented by a glowing Artificial Gravity Line (or A.G.L. for short).

Within the AGL, characters will experience zero gravity. But the farther they get from the AGL, the heavier ‘gravity’ will become. In other words, characters can experience 0 - 3 Gs depending on how far they are from the AGL at any given moment.

CHARACTER CLASSES
Unlike traditional racing games with vehicles, the racers in Space Rats run on two (or four) legs. That means they can jump, do parkour, and fly around with jet packs. Different animals have different strengths and weaknesses because of their innate, class-based abilities.

Toda (crawler class): Toda is the fastest runner in the game. What’s more, he can stick to and run on some surfaces that other characters cannot. Because he is such a fast runner, his jumping and thruster abilities are not as developed as some other characters’.

Hopper (leaper class): Just as the name implies, Hopper is strongest while jumping. Her powerful legs grant her a speed boost whenever she jumps, and while her thruster may not have much fuel, it grants her a powerful blast forward if used while airborne.

G-Rat (thruster class): G-Rat is by far the slowest runner and weakest jumper in the game. But what he lacks in muscle, he more than makes up with his powerful jetpack. Take to the skies and use zero-g to your advantage!

POWERUPS
In Space Rats, racers do battle with one another while racing to the finish line. The league isn’t called the A.G.R.O. for nothing!

Gravity Well: aim and fire this powerup to freeze your opponents in space with an expansive field of sustained heavy gravity.

Sentient Goo: just pull the trigger and let the goo do the rest! The sentient goo powerup will chase down the nearest opponent in front of you and significantly slow their movement.

Boost Boots: activate this powerup to run at top speed. Be careful not to SPLAT!

Dark Matter: you’re untouchable…and fast! Get a speed boost and knock your opponents to the side as you are enveloped in a sphere of dark matter.

data.name: Year 2031
data.detailed_description:
Special Edition

Physical game box

comes with real Gameboy cartridge, detailed game manual booklet called Player’s Guide, where you can find answers to all of your questions about the game. It also comes with a game poster that is like a newspaper page and includes more information about the in-game world.


About the Game

Can you survive in a post-apocalyptic world?

The year 2021 started like every other year. Soon, messages about a new virus started coming.
It started on the other side of the world, but in a few months, the virus reached Europe.
Soon, no one was safe.
Governments started closing their borders, closing factories, everything to stop the virus.
People started losing their jobs and then their houses…the economy collapsed.
That led to hunger, problems with food supplies appeared, and people started to rebel.

Then, All Of Society Collapsed…

Discover the world 10 years later: A world full of new adventures, puzzles, and locations.

The ultimate early 90’s handheld gaming experience
coming from Gameboy to your PC!


Survive a devastated world, uncover a gripping story, and shape your fate through endless side quests in our epic post-apocalyptic adventure

In the game you need to collect basic resources to help you survive.
Tools and equipment will help you with various tasks.
Achievements provide in-game evaluation and let you know your progress.

The rich and detailed world full of unique locations is based on Eastern Europe.
You can walk freely and find locations such as mountains, caves, villages, and cities.
In this world, you always know where to go, or you can find something worth discovering.

Because the game is made for all Gameboy generations and PC, it runs with the 4 basic colors on older Gameboys,
but with a clever use of color pallets, you can enjoy up to 11 colors on devices with color-supported screens and PC.




I am a solo developer, and I am developing every aspect of the game alone.

It has been a challenging process. For the last 2 years, I have worked on the game’s story and graphic design, creating whole new, living world from nothing.
I’ve also designed the documentation as a physical manual, poster and the box to package it all, while regularly running up against the hardware boundaries of the 30 year-old GAMEBOY.
And now the game is coming to your PC!

data.name: Hamster Scramble
data.detailed_description:
Help twins Kaden and Quinn rescue their hamster friends in this wholesome puzzle adventure. Enjoy a cast of colorful characters, mess with your friends in competitive mode, and have hours of fun with delightful platform-hopping, bubble-popping action!

Hamster Scramble takes the versus puzzle game genre to the next level. A fusion between the puzzle and platformer genres, Hamster Scramble gives players the ability to swap into their opponent's area to attack their puzzle board directly!



➤ A Fusion of Familiarity

  • Puzzle and platforming meet to create a brand new style of versus game!
  • Chase down colored hamsters as they run about the stage, catch them, then throw them at the board to make matches!


  • Play on 8 unique stages, each with different themes, layouts, and hazards.

➤ Swapping, a new level of interactivity

  • The Swap ability introduces a level of interactivity never before seen in the versus puzzle genre.
  • By swapping, players can invade their opponent's space to interfere with them directly!


  • Steal the hamsters you need, mess up their board, or attack them to slow them down!

➤ A Wholesome Hamster Adventure

  • Watch the hamster village grow and evolve as hamsters return.
  • Overcome 60+ levels of unique platforming and matching gameplay, either solo or coop!


Join us on Discord for monthly playtest builds, developer updates, community events, and more!

data.name: The Midnight Garden: Amy's Flower
data.detailed_description:
LET ME TELL YOU A STORY...

data.name: Drident
data.detailed_description:
DRIDENT is a first-person survival horror experience set in a remote, fog-drowned forest in Argentina.

You play as Gabriel, an agent sent to investigate the disappearance of several young women. What begins as a search through abandoned cabins, old notes, and forgotten paths soon turns into something far more disturbing. The forest is hiding a secret, and the deeper you go, the less human the truth becomes.

Explore dark environments, manage limited resources, solve environmental puzzles, and survive encounters against infected creatures and malformed horrors. Every note, cassette, and clue reveals another piece of a story buried beneath fear, guilt, and experimentation.

The atmosphere is oppressive, the visibility is low, and danger rarely announces itself twice.

Features:

- First-person survival horror gameplay

- Dark forest, cabins, caves, labyrinths, and coastal areas

- Resource management with firearms and melee combat

- Notes, cassettes, and environmental storytelling

- Puzzles, locked doors, keys, and exploration-based progression

- Grotesque enemies and boss encounters

- Optional retro/low-poly visual mode

- A grim story inspired by classic horror pacing and atmosphere

You came looking for the missing.

Now something is looking back.

data.name: The Joust
data.detailed_description:
Prepare... for... The Joust!

Hark ye!  Hark ye!  Gather ye 'round for the tournament is about to begin!


The Joust is a highspeed, physics-rich simulation game with a specialty for freeform control.  Swing swords, sweep axes, and sling fireballs as you follow your path to become Champion of The Joust!  Competitive Online Multiplayer is available on numerous continents!

But ye, that is not all!

The Joust delivers a variety of singleplayer experiences including:


    1. Online Competitive Multiplayer

    2. a neverending, Roguelike gauntlet Heromaster mode,

    3. two Campaign Modes available on launch: Medieval and Space Age

    4. Multiplayer Physics Soccer, Multiplayer Physics Ice Hockey, and Multiplayer Physics Field Hockey 

    4. Baseball, Basketball, Golf, Boxing, and Pole Vault simulations

    5. a cinematic studio mode capable of exporting 60 FPS video in 4K resolution

    6. Stage Editor

    7. Campaign Editor

    8. Weapon Editor

    9. Roguelite Mode w/ metaprogression and unlocks

    9. an infinite Adventure Mode with gathering and crafting!

  and MANY MORE! 

Make it your own!

The Joust can be customized in every which way!  Control gravity, movement speed, armor strength, projectile sizes... and just about everything else you can think of, for real!

Create a Class feature is also available for use in many game modes, including Online Multiplayer.

Endless possibilities for invention! 

The Joust will eventually ship lucrative modding tooling for generating ingame weapons, stages, and additional modded content.  In fact... nearly everything can be modded!

Made for community:

From day one, The Joust has been driven by community feedback.  For a while, this community meant a few people that listened to a pipedream idea of a game where cartoony simple geometry characters fight one another with swords... but it has grown into a wonderful array of hundreds of playtesters and a whole production team.

We have a Discord Community Server and a subreddit where players can go to help drive the development direction of the game!

Transparency / Development Tooling Notice:

The Joust and its promotional material are the product of countless hours of human love and labor by a small, but passionate team of technology experts.  Yes, even our lead composer is a software professional by day.

With that in mind, in today's world it is important to tell the rest of the story!




The Joust appreciates transparency and forthcomingly discloses the use of modern LLM-driven tools to assist with code generation, code review, and performance optimization.  Aside from our handmade logos, skybox imagery, and our HD materials, The Joust does not ship traditional graphical assets and relies on mathematical generation of simple geometry to achieve its graphics.

The Joust is committed to NOT using any sort of AI-generated content in our generation of marketing material.

All music for The Joust is composed, arranged, and performed by humans to the greatest extent feasible.

The Joust does NOT currently ship with localization features, but pledges to source its localization from real humans to the greatest extent practically verifiable by our team.

Most importantly, The Joust pledges to continue forward with its pro-human approach to art and design!


So long as it is allowed, The Joust is committed to retaining its $1 pricetag.






Most gratefully,

The Joust

data.name: Puzzling Places - 3D Jigsaw Sim
data.detailed_description:
In Puzzling Places you piece together 3D jigsaw miniatures of locations from around the world. There are no scores or timers — just the simple, relaxing joy of connecting pieces and discovering small details along the way.

Would you like to attend a medieval wedding in the Spanish royal palace?  Explore Mont-Saint-Michel, a French abbey perched on a small tidal island in Normandy?  Or wander a cozy Alsace street corner with flowers and playful cats? 

The game features 18 unique locations from around the world, each rich in detail, accompanied by distinctive soundscapes, with some featuring small story moments and subtle animations.

Whether you’re a dedicated jigsaw enthusiast who enjoys long sessions with hundreds of pieces, or you just want to unwind by snapping together a few, every puzzle is available in multiple piece counts and two game modes—so you can choose the playstyle and level of challenge that suits you:

  • Classic Mode: You get all pieces at once and sort and assemble freely, just like a traditional jigsaw

  • Journey Mode: Start from a single piece and puzzle in small batches for a calmer, more guided experience. Ideal for casual play, short sessions, or when you just don’t want to deal with “the big pile.”

  • Multiple Piececounts: Each puzzle is available in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400 pieces - and some even 800 or 1000 pieces! 

Puzzle comfortably on your desktop PC, on the go with Steam Deck, or fully immersed in a VR Headset, including the Steam Frame — Puzzling Places has been optimized across all three platforms.

Playing in VR? Team up with a friend in 2-player online co-op and solve puzzles together (VR platforms only).

Feature Summary:

  • Puzzle intricate 3D miniature dioramas from around the world - each coming to life with a handcrafted soundscape and little stories to discover

  • 18 unique locations to puzzle

  • Classic Mode: Sort and assemble freely, just like a traditional jigsaw puzzles

  • Journey Mode: Connect small sets of pieces one after the other in a more guided, relaxed experience

  • Adjustable difficulty: each puzzle comes in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400 - and some up to 1000 pieces

  • Cross-Device: puzzle on your desktop, your Steamdeck or in your Steam Frame or other VR headset

  • 2-player Online Co-op (VR only): Puzzle together with a friend in a shared virtual space

  • Included Puzzle Maker Tool: Create your own 2D and 3D puzzles using your own images, 3D scans, and models, then share them with the community through Steam Workshop with the included Puzzle Maker Tool

About the developers

Puzzling Places is being developed by Realities.io, a small indie team based out of Berlin that came together to explore what happens when you combine 3D scanning and game engines. We love making cool places from around the globe digitally discoverable and have been channeling that passion into Puzzling Places since 2020.

We’re always happy about your feedback - reach out to us via Discord, Social Media or email!

data.name: Broken Sword 4 - the Angel of Death (2006)
data.detailed_description:
After reluctantly battling dragons, Mayan gods, and becoming a knight of a long lost Holy Order, unwitting hero George Stobbart determines to settle down to a life of mundane 9-5 office work. Who would have thought that a mysterious and beautiful woman would enter his life; a woman whose sudden disappearance draws him into a desperate search for a nefarious artefact of great and terrible power?

As forces of ancient worlds and past forgotten myths clash, current emotions will conflict with past regrets. Emotion, humor, and puzzling combine to draw the player into a dark world of conspiracy theories, daring adventures, and ancient societies. For George, it looks like the world needs saving. Again.

Key Features:
  • The fourth installment of the legendary series – available in stunning 3D
  • Features a rich, evocative soundtrack and top quality voice acting
  • The atmosphere of mystery and danger will accompany you throughout the whole adventure
  • The engrossing story-line and witty dialogue will keep you hooked throughout

data.name: DualVerse86
data.detailed_description:
Switch worlds. Dodge traps. Collect disks. Beat the clock.

Add DualVerse86 to your wishlist now!

DualVerse86 is a 2D retro-futuristic parkour game where every level is a race against time.

Switch in real-time between two virtual worlds to dodge traps, clear platforms, and find the perfect path.

Grab floppy disks, unlock new levels, and beat the clock to earn medals.

With fast and precise gameplay, a visual style inspired by the 90s, and a driving synthwave soundtrack, DualVerse86 is your next obsession if you love speedrunning, technical challenges, and unforgiving games.

Key gameplay features:

  • Precise 2D platforming mixed with fast-paced parkour, set in a retro atmosphere.

  • Quickly switch between two worlds to overcome obstacles and traps.

  • Collect floppy disks to unlock new levels.

  • Time-based challenges with medals to earn.

  • Hidden secrets to discover in every level.

  • Gameplay focused on movement, timing, and precision, no combat involved.

  • Synthwave soundtrack for full immersion in the 80s vibe.

The clock is ticking. Get ready. Add it to your wishlist!

data.name: Aether Oblivion
data.detailed_description:
Story:

It has been 214 years since the end of the AI War and 11 years since the end of the Corporatist War. The Stellconian Empire is at peace, but the Emperor is dying. 

Sensing danger to the Empire at a critical juncture, Emperor Takeda has ordered High Admiral Caelus out of retirement for reasons as yet unknown. You are High Admiral Caelus. You must do the Emperor’s bidding. 

May the Creator’s Blessings be upon you, Admiral.

Gameplay:

-Aether Oblivion is inspired by the titles Battle for Wesnoth, Stratego Waterloo, Battlestar Galactica Deadlock, and XCOM Enemy Unknown / Enemy Within. 

-Players will recognize tactical gameplay similar to Wesnoth with the meta strategy elements of XCOM.

-Make tactical and strategic decisions based on imperfect information - all in a sci-fi capital-ship setting.

-Explore a branching campaign of up to 30 possible missions and 12 different endings based on player decisions and performance.

-Manage funds and fleet purchases from a roster of over 30 units.

-Keep yourself and the crew of your Corvette, The Antoinesse alive. (Or don’t and find out what happens)

-Your choices can affect personal relationships. Do try not to get assassinated…

-Balance pragmatism and ethics while facing various moral dilemmas and unraveling nefarious plots within the Empire.

-Enjoy a deep storyline with visual novel style mission briefings as well as voice-acted journal entries inspired by the likes of Myth 2: Soulblighter. 

-Single player skirmish mode vs the AI or human via 1v1 hotseat.

-Tug of War mode vs AI or human opponent. Compete across a series of connected battles where each victory shifts momentum toward ultimate victory in the war.

data.name: Varketh’s Prison
data.detailed_description:
Varketh's Prison

Varketh's Prison is a dark fantasy isometric action RPG dungeon crawler inspired by classic RPGs.

Descend into the depths with procedurally generated dungeons, dangerous creatures, and handcrafted boss encounters. Discover powerful equipment, develop your character, and uncover the dark secrets buried beneath the mountain.

Choose Your Path

Three classes each with unique talent trees! Offering different approaches to surviving the horrors below.

  • Warrior – Stand your ground against overwhelming odds, wielding devastating melee attacks and powerful defensive abilities.

  • Ranger – Strike from a distance, outmaneuver dangerous enemies, and command loyal animal companions.

  • Mage – Harness destructive magic, unleash devastating elemental attacks, and summon magical familiars to aid you in battle.

Four Races to choose from!

  • Human

  • Elf

  • Dwarf

  • Gnome 


Deadly Boss Encounters

Face powerful, handcrafted bosses. Each encounter brings unique mechanics, devastating abilities, and new challenges that demand more than brute force.

  • Unique Boss Mechanics – Every major boss features distinct abilities, attack patterns, and combat mechanics that challenge your skills.

  • Adapt – Dodge devastating attacks, take advantage of your surroundings, and learn enemy patterns to survive.

  • Multiple Phase Battles – Face increasingly dangerous attacks and changing mechanics as powerful bosses grow desperate.

  • Test Your Build – Put your equipment, talents, and combat abilities to the test against the prison's most formidable inhabitants.

No Two Descents Are the Same

Explore 25 procedurally generated dungeon floors where the layout and rewards keep each expedition unpredictable.

Travel through distinct dungeon environments, from the Ancient Crypt, Corrupted Catacombs, Hollow Depths, Ashen Foundry, and the Infernal Depths. Face increasingly dangerous enemies as you venture deeper into the mountain.

Fight. Loot. Grow Stronger.

Survival demands more than simply defeating your enemies.

  • Real Time Combat – Dodge attacks and manage your ability resource.

  • Character Progression – Level up, unlock new talents, and experiment with different character builds.

  • Loot and Equipment – Discover equipment that strengthen your character and influences your build.

  • Challenging Boss Encounters – Confront powerful dungeon bosses with unique attacks and dangerous abilities.

  • Dynamic Dungeon Exploration – Navigate unpredictable layouts, discover new chambers, and prepare for the dangers ahead.

  • Atmospheric Dark Fantasy – Explore torchlit corridors, shadowy chambers, and unsettling environments brought to life through dynamic lighting and ambient sound.

Lore Tracker

Secrets fill the chambers below the mountain, exploring each floor grants knowledge into what awaits you at the bottom! Use the lore panel to see what floors secrets are hidden on, and gain extra experience and gold to aid you in your journey to the bottom!

What Lies at the Bottom?

Beyond the monsters and forgotten chambers, something darker awaits.

Every floor brings you closer to uncovering the mysteries of Varketh's Prison.
