data.name: Diner Together
data.detailed_description:
Diner Together VR is a multiplayer co-op diner management simulator, you can play with up to 4 friends!

Own your own diner! cook, serve, clean, manage your finances, achieve good ratings and make your diner the best in the area!

Features

  • Diner and Drive Thru
    There are two places where customers can arrive from, inside the diner and the drive thru, in the drive thru you will need to pack the order before giving it to the customer.
    If the flow of customers is too much to handle you can close the drive thru.



  • Several Types of Food
    There are many types of meats, fruits, vegetables, snacks, drinks, etc. All of which you can combine however you like!

  • Randomly Generated Orders
    All of the orders ingredients and drinks are randomly generated.



  • Different Meals Per Day
    There are three meals per day: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner. The customers orders change depending on which time of the day it is.

  • Economy and Market
    Your ingredients will run out, so you will need to make sure to have enough money to buy more from the market!
    Customers pay you according to order size, accuracy and how well it was cooked.



  • Cleaning
    After a few orders and with time you diner can start to become a little dirty, make sure to clean it once in a while so that more customer can enjoy the experience!

data.name: Summer Camp
data.detailed_description:
Ten students arrive on the island. Only nine names are called.

What should have been a graduation getaway feels wrong from the moment you reach Egret Bay: a deserted resort, ten keys laid out in advance, and an old group photograph with one face cut away. The last ferry departs. A violent storm cuts off all contact with the mainland.

At 10:17 p.m., the old school PA system crackles to life. A voice that should have fallen silent begins calling names.

Play as transfer student Lin Cheng. Search for overlooked details through your camera lens, piece together fragments of audio, and weigh conflicting accounts to uncover the truth behind a death one year earlier. As a classmate goes missing, familiar faces begin to reveal unfamiliar sides. Some are eager to explain. Others refuse to speak. And someone wants you to stop asking questions.

Time is limited, and trust is fragile. Follow a lead, persuade someone to talk, or reach out when another life is in danger. Your decisions shape the evidence you preserve, the people who survive, and how the story ends.

When the storm passes, what truth will you take with you?

data.detailed_description:
Horror School Story is an immersive realistic horror game that combines atmospheric storytelling with heart-pounding encounters. Players take on the role of an ordinary teacher whose life takes a terrifying turn when he unintentionally fell asleep inside an art school. Unbeknownst to him, the once-familiar corridors and classrooms transform into a nightmare realm after dark, teeming with supernatural entities and unsettling paranormal activity.

Immerse yourself in the foreboding atmosphere of Enspire School of Digital Art, brought to life with realistic graphics and spine-chilling sound design. Solve intricate puzzles and face psychological challenges to progress through the nightmarish school environment. Can you survive and escape the night?

data.name: Potventure
data.detailed_description:
🍲 Your Culinary Empire Starts With One Pot

Potventure is a turn-based fantasy restaurant management strategy game. You're a fledgling restaurateur with nothing but a pot and ambition, arriving on a continent shared by ten very different peoples — Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Halflings, Goblins, Orcs, the Undead etc. Each with their own tastes and unique talents.

Send out explorers to clear the fog of war. Build farms, ranches, and fishing ports on fertile land. Turn raw ingredients into signature dishes that win over an entire town's palate. As your restaurant empire grows, so do six rival empires — some expand aggressively, some grow quietly and compound their power, some come to sabotage you in the night. One of them, a mysterious Oracle, might even warn you what crisis is coming next.

🍳 A Cooking System With Real Depth

  • 22 ingredients + 12 seasonings, 7 cooking methods (fried, boiled, steamed, deep-fried, roasted, braised, mixed)

  • Three dish tiers (Lv1–Lv3) — higher tiers are harder to research, but far more rewarding

  • Over 50 hidden "ingredient synergy rules" to discover — what happens when beef meets red wine? Or seafood meets olive oil and vinegar?

  • Choose plating styles for every dish, and build a Google-Maps-style reputation for your restaurants over time

🧝 Ten Races, Ten Ways to Play

  • Elves' Forest Blessing steadily boosts vegetable yields

  • Dwarves' Underground Workshop lets you build and rebuild fearlessly, at -20% cost

  • Halflings' Second Lunch doubles population growth outright [] Goblins' Scrap Recycling means you rarely run out of ingredients

  • The Undead's Sleepless Kitchen makes corruption and unrest simply irrelevant

    Every town is governed by a named, distinctly-personalitied — and possibly corrupt — lord. Choose your allies wisely.

⚔ Six Rivals, Six Empires With Their Own Ambitions

Ten distinct rival archetypes exist in the game, with three randomly selected each playthrough: the research-focused Hatted Gourmet, the aggressively expanding Street King, the slow-but-unstoppable Golden Tycoon, the harassment-focused Shadow Chef, and more. Learn each rival's rhythm before they carve up the world without you.

🌪 Crises Test You. Opportunities Reward You.

Famine, plague, recession, inflation — a crisis strikes roughly every 50 turns. But so do festivals, golden ages, and bountiful harvests, giving you breathing room to rebuild and expand. The four seasons reshape your strategy too: vegetables thrive in spring, seafood rules the summer, autumn brings a windfall harvest, and winter demands careful rationing.

🏬 Three Business Models, Three Philosophies of Growth

  • Independent Restaurants: Every town researches its own menu — maximum freedom

  • Franchise Mode: Centralized R&D, boosted footfall and turnover

  • Chain Mode: Scale up fast and cheap — but at a cost

🎯 14 Endgame Paths to Victory, No Two Playthroughs Alike

Amass a legendary fortune, build a chain empire, become a master of every cuisine, win duel after duel, conquer every rival, or simply survive the harshest difficulty to the end — any single endgame goal wins the game. Dozens of additional achievements track your journey along the way. Combine that with 4 difficulty levels, randomized rivals, races, and lords, and every new game is a genuinely different challenge.

📼 Turn-by-Turn Replay

After each game ends, revisit the entire campaign turn by turn — territory shifts, key events, every swing of fortune — all preserved so you can study your run and come back stronger.

Every dish you serve leaves a mark on this world. Build your culinary dynasty — and let every town smell of your kitchen.

Send out explorers to clear the fog of war. Build farms, ranches, and fishing ports on fertile land. Turn raw ingredients into signature dishes that win over an entire town's palate. As your restaurant empire grows, so do six rival empires — some expand aggressively, some grow quietly and compound their power, some come to sabotage you in the night. One of them, a mysterious Oracle, might even warn you what crisis is coming next.

🍳 A Cooking System With Real Depth

  • 22 ingredients + 12 seasonings, 7 cooking methods (fried, boiled, steamed, deep-fried, roasted, braised, mixed)

  • Three dish tiers (Lv1–Lv3) — higher tiers are harder to research, but far more rewarding

  • Over 50 hidden "ingredient synergy rules" to discover — what happens when beef meets red wine? Or seafood meets olive oil and vinegar?

  • Choose plating styles for every dish, and build a Google-Maps-style reputation for your restaurants over time

🧝 Ten Races, Ten Ways to Play

  • Elves' Forest Blessing steadily boosts vegetable yields

  • Dwarves' Underground Workshop lets you build and rebuild fearlessly, at -20% cost

  • Halflings' Second Lunch doubles population growth outright [] Goblins' Scrap Recycling means you rarely run out of ingredients

  • The Undead's Sleepless Kitchen makes corruption and unrest simply irrelevant

    Every town is governed by a named, distinctly-personalitied — and possibly corrupt — lord. Choose your allies wisely.

⚔ Six Rivals, Six Empires With Their Own Ambitions

Ten distinct rival archetypes exist in the game, with three randomly selected each playthrough: the research-focused Hatted Gourmet, the aggressively expanding Street King, the slow-but-unstoppable Golden Tycoon, the harassment-focused Shadow Chef, and more. Learn each rival's rhythm before they carve up the world without you.

🌪 Crises Test You. Opportunities Reward You.

Famine, plague, recession, inflation — a crisis strikes roughly every 50 turns. But so do festivals, golden ages, and bountiful harvests, giving you breathing room to rebuild and expand. The four seasons reshape your strategy too: vegetables thrive in spring, seafood rules the summer, autumn brings a windfall harvest, and winter demands careful rationing.

🏬 Three Business Models, Three Philosophies of Growth

  • Independent Restaurants: Every town researches its own menu — maximum freedom

  • Franchise Mode: Centralized R&D, boosted footfall and turnover

  • Chain Mode: Scale up fast and cheap — but at a cost

🎯 14 Endgame Paths to Victory, No Two Playthroughs Alike

Amass a legendary fortune, build a chain empire, become a master of every cuisine, win duel after duel, conquer every rival, or simply survive the harshest difficulty to the end — any single endgame goal wins the game. Dozens of additional achievements track your journey along the way. Combine that with 4 difficulty levels, randomized rivals, races, and lords, and every new game is a genuinely different challenge.

📼 Turn-by-Turn Replay

After each game ends, revisit the entire campaign turn by turn — territory shifts, key events, every swing of fortune — all preserved so you can study your run and come back stronger.

Every dish you serve leaves a mark on this world. Build your culinary dynasty — and let every town smell of your kitchen.
data.short_description: Open a restaurant on a fantasy continent and build a culinary empire, one dish at a time. Explore, gather, cook, and expand — while six rival empires plot their own rise. Survive crises, seize opportunities, and carve your own path to victory.

data.name: Prison Alone
data.detailed_description:
Prison Alone is a psychological horror game set up in an empty prison. Some strange things started happening in this place, including disappearance of some people. While trying to investigate this further, the authorities ordered that all the prisoners should be transferred, but you bribed one of the guards to be left behind and use this opportunity to escape from the prison. But it won't be that easy.



Prison Alone focuses on exploration with a tense environment. you must find ways to enter places you usually wouldn't have access to, solve puzzles to unlock new areas, find access keys left behind, all while the atmosphere of suspense and tension dominate you.



The game does not contain jumpscare! But that doesn't mean that you won't feel afraid, or be scared by something while playing, everything was designed to leave you frightened and tense.

Avarage gameplay time: 40 min

data.name: Space Bandit
data.detailed_description:
You are the infamous Space Bandit, one of the solar system's most wanted gun smugglers. Having been ripped off by a client, you and your professional business partner are now on a space rampage for revenge and profit!

Gunfights are brutal and fast! Sometimes it's a surgical operation sweeping behind the enemy flank. Sometimes it's SPRAY AND PRAY.

The environment & physics are your weapon! Blow a window and vent your enemies into the void of space!

Reflect bullets and chop up enemies with your sword.

Blow up enemies with grenades and then hide in the smoke while you shoot more enemies!

All this and more if only you were good enough to beat the first zone.

Features:

  • Brutal twin stick shooter gameplay.

  • Fun AI that doesn't just run at you like an idiot.

  • Teleporting through people.

  • Tons of crazy mutations.

  • 4 Proceduraly generated zones.

  • 4 unique no bullet sponge bosses.

  • Crazy weapons like the Rail Gun that shots through walls.

  • Full mouse, keyboard and controller support.

  • Kicking enemies when they're already dead because they could always be deader.

  • A fine professional business colleague that chain smokes and spouts conspiracy theories.

  • Shooting people out windows into the void of space.

A game made with ❤️

data.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
data.detailed_description:
Dark Eyes: Super Soldier 2 returns to the Dark Eyes universe, continuing the story of the Super Soldier and his fight for humanity's survival.

After the events of the first game, the war is far from over. The Dark Eyes — known as the Delma — have returned, stronger and more dangerous than ever. Standing above them is the Alpha, an elite Dark Eyes commander whose presence threatens the future of Earth itself.

But the enemy isn't the only battle ahead.

The Super Soldier continues to struggle with the consequences of the Super Soldier Program. Due to the unusually high concentration of Delma blood flowing through his body, he remains caught between human and something else. Because of his condition, he is forced to serve within a secretive division of the Earth Space Defense Force: Shadow Force, the ESDF's classified special operations unit.

As war spreads across the battlefield, hidden truths, dangerous missions, and inner conflicts begin to surface. The fight against the Delma becomes more personal than ever.

Fast-paced and chaotic combat

Fight through intense missions filled with overwhelming enemy forces and large-scale battles alongside the ESDF army.

Experience a mix of gameplay styles:

  • Fast and brutal combat encounters against massive enemy groups

  • Large-scale battlefield missions alongside allied troops

  • Optional stealth sections for tactical approaches

  • Platforming and environmental challenges involving lasers, hazards, and traversal sequences

Customize your combat style with a massive arsenal:

  • Pistols

  • Assault rifles

  • Shotguns

  • Grenade launchers

  • Silenced weapons

  • Experimental prototypes

  • Captured Delma weaponry

Unlock powerful abilities and suit technology:

  • Boost packs

  • Automatic laser cannons

  • Energy shields

  • Rocket packs

Use tactical equipment:

  • Explosive grenades

  • EMP grenades

  • Smoke grenades

Upgrade your weapons, suit systems, and abilities to create a build that matches your playstyle. Invest in speed, firepower, defense, stealth, or advanced technology and shape your own Super Soldier.

Fight the Delma. Face the Alpha. Confront what the Super Soldier Program turned you into.

data.name: The Chains Of Yme
data.detailed_description:
You were woken below the surface given only one command: Seize Yme, the Titan that chose treachery when they were needed the most. Recruit the expendable weirdos you come across to carry out your will, and do anything in your power to get just a little further in this grid-based strategy game. 

- Delve into the Ever-Changing Ruins - 

Levels are randomly assembled and filled with treasure, traps, and monsters.

Your decisions about how to explore will have grave consequences. Do you attempt to dig straight to the exit? Do you fight your way through some monster or lure them away? Do you have enough time to loot? And should you split the party? (Trick question. Always split the party)

- Defeat Monsters using the Perfect Synergy...? -

Unfortunately, your favorite adventurer who had a really powerful combination of power-ups was eaten by a worm.

Throughout your run you have little control over what power-ups you find and each adventurer will probably not last for a long time. To survive you will need to take whatever you can get and be ready to change your strategy at any moment.

Make it work. Somehow.

- Expand Your Mind -

Knowledge of the world increases your chances of surviving and lets you uncover secrets! 

Find ancient texts written in the time prior to Ymes betrayal. Interact with monsters, power-ups, and challenges to gain unfamiliar memories. Search through an old transport system, a magical forge, and a mutated extraction site. Learn about the failed project which would have warded off disaster.

- Brutal and Forgiving -

Death is waiting behind every corner, and many adventurers will be impaled, burnt, thrown into pits, eaten, or transmuted. Sometimes, the dying adventurer was your last and your run will end, but often there will be others left. Don't lose hope! There is almost always a way forward, no matter how dire the situation.

data.name: FALCO AXE
data.detailed_description:
"Falco AXE" is an immersive and thrilling fantasy action-adventure game that plunges players into a world besieged by an ancient malevolence. As the courageous main protagonist, you stand as the final bastion of hope in the face of utter subjugation. The game's narrative unfolds within a kingdom that has been ruthlessly dominated by an awakened and insidious evil force, leaving only you untouched by its oppressive grasp.


Prepare to embark on an epic quest of unparalleled proportions, armed with a versatile and engaging combat system that ensures hours of captivating gameplay. Not only will you master the art of visceral melee attacks, but you will also harness the power of a trusty bow, allowing you to unleash swift and precise attacks from a secure distance. However, the apex of your arsenal lies in the enigmatic and potent Falco axe – a weapon of undeniable might that emerges to turn the tides in the direst of moments. With this legendary instrument of devastation in your hands, you shall surmount even the most daunting challenges, carving your path through the heart of darkness towards ultimate victory.

Game Features
  • Epic Heroic Journey: Embark on a grand and heroic quest as the last hope for a kingdom ensnared by an ancient malevolence. Your journey unfolds through a richly woven narrative, driving you to confront powerful enemies and uncover the mysteries that shroud the realm.
  • Dynamic Combat System: Engage in thrilling battles with an intuitive combat system that seamlessly blends melee prowess and ranged precision. Master the art of both close-quarter combat and bowmanship to overcome a diverse array of adversaries and challenges.
  • Legendary Falco Axe: Wield the legendary Falco axe, a weapon of unparalleled might that emerges in critical moments to turn the tide of battle. Unleash devastating attacks and harness its unique abilities to triumph over insurmountable odds.
  • Varied Environments and Foes: Traverse meticulously designed landscapes, each teeming with its own dangers and secrets. Confront a range of foes, from cunning minions to colossal bosses, testing your skills and strategy in every encounter.
  • Immersive Audiovisual Experience: Immerse yourself in a captivating world brought to life through stunning visuals and a meticulously crafted audio landscape. The game's atmosphere draws you deeper into the unfolding epic, enhancing the sense of adventure and urgency.

data.name: Records of Searching for Gods in Mountains and Seas
data.detailed_description:
在这个充满危机的修仙世界，你将体验真正的"搜·打·撤"生存循环：深入秘境探索古宝奇遇，面对强敌时做出战或逃的艰难抉择，在洞府中炼丹布阵积蓄实力。

🔄 搜·打·撤 生存循环

探索阶段 - 搜

  • 每次进入秘境宝物、敌人完全不同

  • 寻找天材地宝、功法秘籍、远古传承

  • 面对选择分支：走安全路线还是冒险探索隐藏区域？

  • 寿元的流逝：每一次的探索寿元都在消耗

战斗阶段 - 打

  • 策略回合制战斗：不是无脑砍杀，而是术法克制

  • 战或逃的抉择：打不过就跑，保住小命才能继续修炼

  • 指挥灵宠战队：利用属性克制与战术配合

撤退阶段 - 撤

  • 及时止损：感知危险时果断逃离，贪婪是修士第一大敌

  • 秘境死亡会掉落全部物品，要时刻规划自己的逃生路线

  • 风险和收益成正比例，该如何抉择？

🐉 灵宠收集培养

打造你的妖兽军团

捕获系统

  • 在野外遭遇妖兽幼崽或击败成年妖兽后捕获

  • 使用炼妖壶法器强制契约

  • 稀有妖兽需要特殊条件才能遇到（如血月之夜、特定秘境）

培养机制

  • 资质系统：力量型、敏捷型、术法型、防御型、特殊型

  • 血脉觉醒：普通狼妖喂食真龙血→ 觉醒龙狼血脉 → 进化为银月天狼

  • 妖丹培育：喂食丹药加速成长，提升属性上限

  • 化形之路：达到一定境界后，妖兽可化为人形，解锁新能力

🏠 洞府系统

你的永久基地

功能

  • 炼丹房：自主炼制丹药，突破瓶颈、疗伤、增强属性

  • 炼器室：强化法器、修复损坏装备、尝试炼制新法器

  • 灵田：种植灵草，自给自足降低成本

data.name: Sort Sneakers & Socks
data.detailed_description:
A limited-sneaker outlet has just opened, and there is plenty of organizing to do! Over 2,000 sneakers are waiting to be paired, packed into 1,000 boxes, and placed neatly on the shelves. And don’t forget the 96 socks that need to find their proper racks.Take your time, find every match, and watch the store slowly come together around you.

Every unique sneaker you need to sort can be found in your catalog. Browse the collection, discover all the different designs, and use the catalog to keep track of the sneakers waiting to find their place in the store.

Find the Pair, Pack the Box

Pick up a sneaker and search for its matching shoe. Same brand, same color, same size, one left and one right.

Once you have the pair, find the box they belong in, pack them up, and place the box on the correct shelf. Along the way, collect the socks and hang them on their matching racks.

Every item you put in the right place earns you XP and brings the outlet one step closer to being perfectly organized.

Sorting Skills

Earn skill points as you organize the store and spend them on helpful abilities that make sorting even more satisfying.

Highlight matching sneakers, socks, and boxes. Track down the other shoe in a pair. Reveal the correct box and shelf. Pull nearby matches toward you and carry more items at once.

As you grow stronger, move through the outlet faster, sprint between shelves, leap up to the second floor, and even walk across the sneaker pile as you work your way through thousands of items.

Start with a pile. Find every pair. Fill every shelf. Make everything fit perfectly.

data.name: Love or Lust Beach Stories
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Love or Last Beach Stories — a sun-drenched, adult story adventure set on a tropical beach.

You're a college student looking for a summer gig and maybe a little flirt. When you land a job at a trendy beach bar, things heat up fast. Beautiful strangers, secret rituals, ancient myths, and choices that matter.

But when the sunsets get stranger and the cocktails start whispering secrets... You realize this summer might change more than your life. It might change the world.

Key Features:

🍸A Sultry, Story-Rich Experience
Dive into a branching adult narrative where your choices lead to different endings, steamy scenes, or broken hearts.

🍸A Bar With Secrets
Discover ancient artifacts, lost rituals, and a hidden conflict beneath the sand. Can love really save the world?

🍸Bartend Your Way to Their Hearts
Master cocktail recipes and minigames and charm your guests, unlock hidden stories, and shake things up.

🍸Insight Mode
Use collected “energy” to activate special dialogue options and reveal hidden desires or secret paths.

🍸Light vs. Lust
Will you chase pleasure at any cost — or protect those you love, even at your own expense?

🍸Slide Into DMs
Build relationships through texts, selfies, and emotional confessions or flirty nudes.

For fans of Summer Memories, Leisure Suit Larry, College Kings, and spicy visual novels with a twist.

data.name: GRIT
data.detailed_description:
Every gun you pick up in GRIT is also a playing card. Match the suits across your four weapon slots and you stop being one more gunslinger in a duster — you become the Tracker, the Chaplain, the Merchant, or the Cavalry, and most of what you gain, your posse gains with you.

A third-person Wild West battle royale for 100 players. Ride hard, shoot straight, and hold your ground as the Calamity swallows the map.

Your Inventory Is Your Hand

  • Four weapon slots. Every gun that goes into one carries a rank and suit. The higher the rank, the better the gun.

  • Get two of the same suit and a perk turns on. Four of the same suit makes you something the rest of the lobby has to plan around.

  • So looting a body is a question every time: the better gun, or the one that completes the hand?

Play the Hand You're Dealt

  • Diamonds — The Tracker. Nobody gets to hide. Put a round in someone and he stays lit up for your whole posse; commit all the way and anyone who shoots at you gives himself away doing it.

  • Hearts — The Chaplain. Everything that keeps people alive happens quicker around you. Go all in and your remedies carry to whoever's standing close, and the men you revive come back stronger.

  • Spades — The Merchant. Armor is a suggestion. Your lead goes through what other men are counting on, and a full hand cuts the whole posse in on the trade.

  • Clubs — The Cavalry. The horse isn't how you get to the fight, it's how you win it. Faster, tougher, and eventually something nobody can put down — while you haul teammates back up at a gallop and shoot straighter from the saddle than most men manage on foot.

Duel Your Way Back

  • Getting gunned down isn't the end of your match. It's a Second Chance — a 1v1 quick-draw showdown for the right to ride back in.

  • Win it and you're back in the fight. Lose it and you had your shot.

  • Second chances are earned on the trigger, not handed out by whoever reaches your body first.

Ride Like You Stole It

  • Multiple speeds, shooting on the move, and saddlebags for everything you can't carry yourself.

  • Cut a rival loose from his horse and leave him walking into the storm.

Every Bullet Has to Travel

  • Nothing here is hitscan. Lead your target, read the drop, respect the distance.

  • The long shots you land are yours.

Ride the Rails

  • The Calamity is the storm that eats the map, and it closes whether you're ready or not.

  • The train keeps rolling through it. Board it for the loot, stay aboard to hold position inside the ring, and throw off everyone else who had the same idea.

  • Everyone else is running. You're riding.

No Two Matches Deal the Same Hand

  • Every match deals three Wildcards off a deck of twenty before a shot is fired.

  • The Calamity might chase the train instead of closing on a circle. Second Chances might be off the table entirely. The Deathcart might be stocked with something it has no business selling.

  • You find out what you're playing the moment the cards hit the table.

Solo, Duos, and Posses

  • 100 players a match, around 25 minutes a round.

  • Suit perks spill onto your teammates, so a posse that coordinates its hands beats one that doesn't. It's still every posse for itself.

The CattlePass

  • A hundred levels of weapon skins, horse skins, parachutes, outfits, flare, and titles — and the first CattlePass comes with the game.

  • Eight themed Logbooks with their own missions and rewards, plus a daily Mission for bonus XP.

data.name: Invisible Wings: Chapter One
data.detailed_description:
Invisible Wings: Chapter One is a visual novel that takes the player on a journey in a dystopian fantasy setting. Follow Dawn, a young woman of faerie descent, as she tries to find answers to her own identity in a modern world where faeries and humans were supposed to live in harmony. Being bullied and harassed most of her life because of her appearance, she wants nothing more than just being an ordinary human. Although she blames her magical ancestors for all her problems, she meets a faerie herself, who grows more than a friend to her and complicates her quest even further.

Explore the vibrant and diverse city of Ceylynn and help Dawn with her first steps into loving and accepting who she is in this first chapter of Invisible Wings, which is a proof-of-concept for the story and world that can be played through in 45 minutes.

Content warning: This game contains implicit references to murder and self-harm, which may be content not suited for everyone. Player discretion is advised.

Created by


Danae Dekker · creative director, game development, audio design, music
Maricu Mana · character and environment design
Eva van der Meer · script writing

With the voice talents of

data.name: Puppet Seed
data.detailed_description:
Puppet Seed is a Sandbox CRPG created by a Solo Developer using Unreal Engine 5.

The minimum requirement for GPU Vram is 6gb. Demo available below.

Puppet Seed combines two game features which are rarely seen together. Permanent, customizable AI Companions and a seamless, non level-gated, 3D Open World. Collect, train and upgrade unique party members with modular armor, weapons and skills as well as summoning powerful combat monsters. Explore the frozen surface of Echora on foot as well as using your player owned vehicle, defeating opponents in a non-linear, sandbox world. Be mindful that your reputation matters, the conflicts you chose will determine which groups will hunt you and which ones will open new trade opportunities!

data.name: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
data.detailed_description:
This edition collects all 11 cases from the cult, award-winning investigative adventure series Dead Detective, originally released during the golden age of browser games, now brought together in a definitive version featuring improved graphics, an updated interface, and a refined deduction system.

WARNING: You do not need to be dead to play this game. But it might help.

We all knew it would happen eventually: zombies have taken over the planet, and their victory has been absolute.

But zombie society still has its problems.
First among them: crime.

Play as Margh, an undead private detective, and solve bizarre and unconventional mysteries with the help of his loyal but constantly hungry assistant Ghvnn, in this hilarious and offbeat point-and-click adventure featuring an elaborate “deaduction” system.

Visit crime scenes, interrogate rotting suspects and eccentric witnesses, solve puzzles, gather clues, and use your brain (or what remains of it) to piece everything together and reach the conclusion of each case. Hopefully the right one.

Between shady neuron dealers, the zombie mafia, gentleman thieves, and mysterious robberies, Margh will certainly have his hands full.

But who knows, between one case and another, he might even uncover the greatest mystery of zombie society: the one that lies behind its very rise to power.

And perhaps Ghvnn will finally manage to satiate his hunger for brains…though that might be asking a bit too much.

One thing is certain:

FEATURES

  • 11 cases to solve, each stranger than the last

  • at least 3 different endings for each case

  • An intuitive “deaduction” system that will really make you use your brain

  • A simple and modern point-and-click interface

  • Instant translation from “Zombiesh” to English (be warned: zombies tend to say “brains” quite often)

  • In-game hint system

data.name: SUNSOFT is Back! レトロゲームセレクション
data.detailed_description:
Celebrating SUNSOFT's return, we present to you this deluxe collection of three SUNSOFT classics: "The Wing of Madoola", "53 Stations of the Tokaido(Toukaido Gojusan-tsugi)", and "Ripple Island".
Play comfortably with the added save and rewind functions.
Great for anyone who couldn't clear them back in the day...

★★ Introduction of Games Included ★★
The Wing of Madoola
[Story]
In the land of Badham, there was once a statue of a bird, called "The Wing of Madoola",
The wing granted power to rule the world to the one who possessed it, and so the people warred over its control for a long time.
During one era, the Wing of Madoola came into the possession of the kindhearted king of the Rameru family. The king sealed it away to cease the wars. However, Darutos, a descendant of the Rameru line, betrayed his family and took the wing.
Darutos built himself a demonic fortress and attempted to take over the world.
Darutos and the Rameru clan fought fiercely, until only the warrior Lucia remained of the clan.
As the sole magic-user of the Rameru clan, Lucia heads to Alex Castle where Darutos resides, refusing to retreat.
[Gameplay]
Control Lucia in this side-scrolling action game.
Defeat the boss waiting at the end of each diverse stage to progress.
Fierce monsters roam the stages, but scattered and dropped throughout are also power-up items and new spells.
Finally, you must defeat Darutos who waits at the end of the final stage...if you dare!

Firework Thrower Kantaro's 53 Stations of the Toukaido
[Story]
Kantaro, a fireworks maker, wants to return to Edo to show the new fireworks he learned to make in Kyoto, and begins to travel the Tokaido road.
However, the evil secret gun merchant "Inokuniya Gozaemon" schemes to steal Kantaro's firework formulas and use them to make guns.
Kantaro must fight back against the assassins sent by the evil merchant by throwing firework grenades at them.
Will Kantaro manage to launch his new fireworks above the Sumida River in Edo?
And will he finally be reunited with his one love, Momoko?
[Gameplay]
This side-scrolling action games features unique and quirky gameplay that's addictive once you get it.
Hit enemies with firework grenades to defeat them.
Hitting seemingly empty areas with the grenades sometimes reveal hidden items!
Collect items to gain advantages against certain enemies.
Keep trucking along that Tokaido road to finally show everyone your beautiful fireworks upon Sumida River!

Ripple Island
[Story]
Somewhere on the sea was a small island called Ripple Island, where the residents lived peacefully surrounded by bountiful nature.
But one day, a monster calling himself Emperor Gerogale kidnaps Princess Nasareru and starts invading Ripple Island!
Compelled to stop him, King Dotella issues a call to the residents.
"To the brave hero who defeats Gerogale, a fitting reward and Princess Nasareru's hand in marriage."
A young boy named Kail, who lived in the outskirts of the island and always dreamed of becoming rich someday, jumps on this opportunity and begins to make his way to the fortress where Gerogale lurked.

[Gameplay]
Ripple Island is an adventure game where you play as Kail.
Use the 9 different commands to work through the many different challenges you will face, and defeat Gerogeil.
The fate of Ripple Island rests on your decisions.

★★ Gallery Mode ★★
Includes various art and materials that were invaluable to creating the games "The Wing of Madoola", "53 Stations of the Tokaido", and "Ripple Island".
We've compiled everything we could find left in the SUNSOFT office, from concept art, design documents, unpublished illustrations, and more!

★★ Acknowledgements ★★
This work was made possible by the support of many backers through crowdfunding, allowing us to take a big step towards SUNSOFT's revival.
We sincerely thank you all for your support.
We have more revival projects planned going forward, so please keep supporting us.

🎓 Welcome to University

A college experience you'll never forget. Unless someone makes sure you do.

Step into the chaotic life of a new university student navigating lust, secrets, and power plays at one of the most twisted institutions you’ve ever enrolled in.

You're not just here to study.

You're here to survive emotionally charged roommates, manipulative teachers, seductive strangers, and a growing conspiracy led by someone only known as X — a puppet master who seems to know everything about you.

As the term progresses, you'll make choices that shape your relationships — and determine who you can trust.

Because at this university, everyone is watching… and some of them want to own you.

Story-rich, fully illustrated NSFW scenes that blend tension, humor, and desire.

🎭 Cinematic Storytelling

Over 5000+ renders and 100+ animations deliver a high-quality, immersive experience from start to finish.

🖼️ Extensive Image Gallery

Relive your favorite moments, poses, and scenes with over 100 unlockable images in the gallery system.

🎁 Bonus Scenes

Enjoy 12 bonus scenes available as DLC - optional content beyond the main storyline.

🧩 Multi-Layered Characters

Each character has their own motivations, secrets, and desires. Peel back the layers… or get lost in them.

Ferrina, who has occupied half of the continent’s trade, has made the peace lasted for 100 years. Finally the emergence of a young girl broke this peace... Of course, this is something to come. Now, let this girl go to school first.

Alchemy system and battle system are two characteristics of this game.

Abandoning the brainless and non-strategic fighting methods, we have adopted a half-turn system of battle. Often the choice of the player determines the direction of the battle.

100% success rate with more than 100 formulas. Equipment, attacking props, recovery props, etc. all require their own refinement. Running in more than 60 game maps to collect material is fun.
In addition, the game rejected the traditional way of escalating Daguai. The characters had no rank, and some of them created special items to open up the corresponding attributes.

data.name: Rift Drift
data.detailed_description:
Rift Drift is an infinite drifting game where you pilot customizable rockets through procedurally generated tracks and biomes.

Built around momentum, flow, and minimalism, it’s a game about mastering movement, chasing records, or simply enjoying the ride.

Choose between infinite runs or focused time trials. Drift fast, drift smooth, and find your rhythm across a variety of level biomes with unique shapes and obstacles.

Features

  • Momentum based drifting

  • No speed cap

  • Infinite mode

  • A galaxy of levels

Rift Drift invites you to master the art of momentum-based drifting as you pilot customizable rockets through a universe of procedurally generated tracks. Whether you're chasing a zen-like flow or an adrenaline-fueled race, each run offers new challenges and infinite replayability. Drift, boost, and discover diverse landscapes, upgrade your craft, and set new records!

data.name: Grave Danger
data.detailed_description:
Buy'n'Large Pharmaceuticals promised its evacuation shuttle would take you somewhere safe. It did not specify that the somewhere would be a ditch, or that the apocalypse it was fleeing was a product the company shipped on purpose. You wake up beside the wreck with two fists, one bad attitude, and a one-mile walk to the last camp of the living.

Grave Danger is a single-player comedy RPG inspired by the turn-limited adventuring mechanics of Kingdom of Loathing (2003), rebuilt as a zombie apocalypse where the real monster is a wellness brand. It is turn-based, text-forward, absurd on purpose, and stuffed with more jokes than are strictly advisable.

Your day has a turn limit

You get so many things done per day, and then the sun goes down and the shambling gets worse. Every fight, search, and questionable roadside decision costs a turn. Eat food and drink questionable beverages to squeeze out more, but mind your Fullness and your Buzz: overdo the booze and you black out and lose the rest of the day. Sleep to reset, then resume making poor choices tomorrow.

Six survivors, six flavors of poor judgment

Play a Wasteland Bruiser who solves problems with follow-through, a Junkyard Knight with a code of honor and severe tetanus risk, a Mad Chemist who read the warning label as a recipe, a Radio Priest broadcasting salvation at 101.5 FM, a Scavenger for whom everything is inventory, or a Smooth Talker who once got a horde to form an orderly queue. Each class brings its own weapons, skills, and voice.

Fight 380+ things that should not exist

Every monster is written specifically for the game, categorized, and funny, from the confused zombie tourist to a stock ticker serpent that blames you for the crash. Combat actually reads differently depending on how you fight: a caustic squirt gun does not narrate like a chainsaw, and neither of them narrates like your bare fists. Five elements (Fire, Toxic, Electric, Psychic, and Gross) inflict conditions worth planning around.

Dress for the apocalypse you want

Craft weapons and armor out of duct tape, scrap, and spite. Complete synergy armor sets for bonus protection, chase down class signature weapons, and watch it all appear on your survivor's paper doll. If it is not nailed down it is a crafting material, and if it is nailed down, the nails are also a crafting material.

A full campaign with a very fireable final boss

Thirteen comedic quests take you from the roadside ditch through the suburbs, downtown, the wasteland, and finally to an island boardroom to have a frank conversation with Patient Zero, the CEO of Buy'n'Large, about his product roadmap. Beat him and unlock New Game Plus, with permanent legacy perks that carry into the next cycle.

Made with obsessive, low-budget care

Each location has its own background track, while the interface keeps sound effects to one unobtrusive button click. Zone scenes and character art are built for the game, while item and monster icons use properly attributed CC BY artwork from . There is a full settings menu with text scaling, reduced motion, high contrast, and separate music and button-click volume controls, plus a field guide that actually explains the rules instead of hiding them in tooltips.

Features

  • 380+ original monsters, each with unique combat dialogue
  • Weapon-aware combat narration: every weapon fights, and reads, its own way
  • 24 zones across 5 regions, from a retirement-community fortress to a corporate penthouse
  • 6 classes, a 13-quest campaign, and a boss who ended the world for shareholder value
  • Craft gear from garbage and complete armor synergy sets
  • Turn-limited days, a food-and-booze economy, and Salt for currency
  • Location-specific background music with restrained interface audio
  • Accessibility built in: text scaling, reduced motion, high contrast, full volume control
  • New Game Plus with permanent legacy progression
  • A joke on every item, monster, and skill. This is not negotiable.

Salt, by the way, is the currency because refrigeration died with everything else and preservation became survival. Also because it is the root of the word salary. The economists were eaten first.

data.name: Stellar Commanders
data.detailed_description:
Space Colonialisation has just begun, Commander!:



Conquer the stars in this simple but catchy multiplayer real-time strategy game from the creators of First Strike and become a Stellar Commander!





Stellar Commanders is a fast-paced multiplayer real-time strategy game that pits player against player in a bid to take control of distant planets as part of an inter-galactic war for precious resources.

The speedy 1 vs 1 battles will see each player align with a different faction and choose units based on a deep roster of unlockable futuristic troops; from rockets, tanks and stealth generators to bombastic orbital satellites, all of which will help determine tactical decisions.


Choose your faction:



Select your faction, but choose wisely. Will it be the radicalised bright minds of the Sons and Daughters of Barovia, the land grabbing old guard of the United Coalition of the World or the technologically advanced, traditionalist mega-corporation that is the Jin Guo Empire?

Each faction comes with their own unique units and strategies and their own tech trees of new units to unlock! Custimize your arsenal and become the best commander of your faction!





This is our first multiplayer strategy game and one that we’ve been excited about for some time – it seemed like a perfect next step after the huge success of First Strike. Combining the First Strike community’s feedback about making a multiplayer strategy title with our own love of ‘90s RTS games has resulted in Stellar Commanders, which will have all the fast-paced fun of a modern, tactical RTS as well as a touch of nostalgia.




You will get the original First Strike experience in Multiplayer. Play against your friends in this stellar real-time strategy game!

Features:



  • Real Time Multiplayer: Play strategy matches against real opponents or the AI.
  • Fast paced and Quick: A round of Stellar Commanders is 7 minutes max.
  • Planet Battle Maps: Play on tiny planets for supremacy.
  • Multiple factions: Join a faction with their own exclusive units and strategies.
  • Over 40 units: Unlock new units as you fulfill small micro missions for your faction.

Select your faction, but choose wisely. Will it be the radicalised bright minds of the Sons and Daughters of Barovia, the land grabbing old guard of the United Coalition of the World or the technologically advanced, traditionalist mega-corporation that is the Jin Guo Empire?

Each faction comes with their own unique units and strategies and their own tech trees of new units to unlock! Custimize your arsenal and become the best commander of your faction!





This is our first multiplayer strategy game and one that we’ve been excited about for some time – it seemed like a perfect next step after the huge success of First Strike. Combining the First Strike community’s feedback about making a multiplayer strategy title with our own love of ‘90s RTS games has resulted in Stellar Commanders, which will have all the fast-paced fun of a modern, tactical RTS as well as a touch of nostalgia.




You will get the original First Strike experience in Multiplayer. Play against your friends in this stellar real-time strategy game!

Features:



  • Real Time Multiplayer: Play strategy matches against real opponents or the AI.
  • Fast paced and Quick: A round of Stellar Commanders is 7 minutes max.
  • Planet Battle Maps: Play on tiny planets for supremacy.
  • Multiple factions: Join a faction with their own exclusive units and strategies.
  • Over 40 units: Unlock new units as you fulfill small micro missions for your faction.

Clitie is the Love Fairy and responsible for the player being able to date all the girls.


Naruuy is an alien who is on our planet researching human DNA, more specifically male. Her species no longer reproduces and now she seeks to find salvation through human male DNA.

data.name: Project Nosferatu
data.detailed_description:
A fast-paced Action RPG with a fully customizable arsenal combo battle system.

250 years ago, humanity was forced to the orbital space colony Pangaea by the subterranean beings known as "Umbrakhs." Following a crisis in Pangaea, your group is stranded on the conquered planet Tatenia. As Regal, Second Prince of the Empire of Elysium and wielder of the cybernetic materialization implant "Nosferatu," survive the varied dangers and landscapes surrounding the abandoned capital Tartarus and uncover the mysteries of the Umbrakhs!

  • Fast-paced combat against challenging enemies.
  • Varied landscapes bring unique dangers in each area.
  • Choose from up to 16 different attacks, to chain into a six-hit combo!
  • A complex story about the mystery of the nocturnal, subterranean species known as "Umbrakhs."

Warning: this game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

data.name: Tall Poppy 2
data.detailed_description:
About the game


In Tall Poppy 2, the tense exploration, action and puzzle-solving gameplay will keep players on their toes! Players join John and Emma Goldberg, a married couple who are forced to face the mischievous Tall Poppy and his new lackeys together!

With the sinister spirit unleashed, the island city of Boots Bay's population is slowly being possessed! Players will navigate through the city carefully so that they can avoid capture or possession all while trying to escape Tall Poppy's terror!

Both John and Emma have their own separate playable campaigns, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives. The fate of these two characters is in the players' hands as they work together to survive and get to the bottom of what is behind the terrifying attack on the city. Will they make it out alive?

  • Exciting gameplay – Engage in frantic combat with enemies, explore frightening corridors, solve puzzles to access areas and collect and use items discovered around the environment in a terrifying comedic fight for survival
    • Shooting - If players find the taser gun, they can shoot taser rounds and the Boots Bay citizens! With enough rounds, they can zap the possession out of them! Be careful though, rounds are hard to come by!
    • Climbing - Players can climb hard-to-reach areas!
    • Talking to characters - The world has some interesting characters to converse with!
    • Collecting objects - There are different objects in the world that will need to be collected and used for various reasons!
    • Inspecting - Players can inspect items for secret details, codes and lore!
    • Push/Pull - Moving objects out of the way or to help climb up a hard-to-reach place!

  • A whole new perspective – Over-the-shoulder camera with a third-person control scheme which creates a more cinematic take on the comedy horror experience as well as a first-person mode

  • Terrifying realistic visuals – Built with Unreal Engine 5, Tall Poppy 2 delivers breathtakingly photorealistic visuals while stunning lighting creates an up-close, intense and atmospheric experience as players roam Boots Bay city

  • Step into the shoes of both heroes - Enjoy separately playable campaigns for both John and Emma, allowing players to see the story from both characters’ perspectives

  • Face the possessed hordes – Citizens of Boots Bay are brought to life with a horrifying effect. Make every taser shot count!

World Setting


Welcome to the island of Boots Bay! The island is located in the middle of the pristine freshwater of Lake Huron. It was founded and built by French settlers in the year 1666 after a military conflict. It was a military outpost that later converted into a successful trading outpost. The indigenous population and French had trading relations that were very historic and highly regarded! Speaking of history, historians claim the island is named after the arc angel Bootelbub. However, some speculate it was named after the trading post's popular bever pelt boots!

Legend has it that there's a deeply hidden secret about the island's past. Some say they feel like they're being pulled...or...drawn to the island. City marketers jumped on this conspiracy theory and made the Boots Bay city motto "The island that you won't want to leave!"

The city is widely known for its European look and it's one of the city's main tourist attractions! You can visit some of the local attractions, such as, but not limited to...

Boots Bay City streets

  • Navigate through Boots Bay city on foot through Eurocentric architecture!
  • Enjoy the sights & sounds of the Canadian island atmosphere
  • Find your way to a few points of interest places like the famous supermarket, burger joint and bank!

Visit the historic Mansion / Nun-house

  • Explore the city's first mansion, built right beside the world-famous church!
  • Known for its humble beginnings as the first home of Lord Goldberg, the infamous knight who settled on the island in 1777
  • Some historians believe the mansion was built on top of the, then village's old French prison. When asked about it, the Goldberg family has always brushed it off as radical folklore

Explore the city underground!

  • Boots Bay City build the subway system in the late 1990s with remarkable speed and accuracy
  • There is strict security in the subways, ensuring the locals feel secure and safe

Experience the world renown Bootelbub Church!

  • Visitors are enthralled with the Bootelbub Church which houses some of the best craftsmanship ever to be displayed
  • The church provides the town's local funeral services such as wakes, celebrations of life and burials.
  • The graveyard continues its legacy with French, Goth-inspired burial sites

Characters


John Goldberg, husband to Emma and nephew to Lawrence Goldberg. John is a successful video game critic on a video-sharing website. He's known for his harsh criticisms, especially for horror games (ironically).


Emma Goldberg, wife to John. She's a live streamer who plays games and has a social media following. She's known for taking peace sign selfies mixed with the "duck face" expression in various locations.


Tall Poppy, who's abnormally tall. His real name is Poppy Ericson. Due to his height, he often got picked on for being tall. His nickname was given to him by his old high school bully... John Goldberg. He was a grave digger for the city church until he got fired for "pranking distraught widowers as they grieved". He's known for being very curious and likes to explore places he shouldn't be exploring...

data.name: War Trigger Classic
data.detailed_description:
War Trigger Classic takes place during the epic struggles of World War 3 where a fictional Cold War has erupted. Compete with friends or players from around the globe using some of the world's deadliest modern weapons and vehicles in this intense First Person Shooter. Play in unique environments designed for infantry, vehicle, and air combat.

All arenas and items are included in this purchase and may be unlocked as you progress and rank up.

Features:
- Combined arms combat: infantry, vehicle and air
- Progression: Unlock content and arenas as you progress through the game
- Customizable character and loadouts
- 15 unique arenas designed for infantry, vehicle, and air combat

Gameplay
- Mechanics: Jump, Sprint, Crouch, Knife attack/melee and shooting
- Boosts: Armor, Gun, XP and Speed
- Consumables: Rocket Camera, Air Strikes, Artillery Strike, Medkit, Grenades and Mines

Classes:
- Assault: Light assault combat rifle
- Support: Squad suppressing machine gun
- Sniper: Light or heavy sniper rifle
- Demolitions: Light or heavy anti tank and anti-air weapon

Game Modes:
- Free For All
- Last Man Standing
- Team Deathmatch
- Attack & Defend
- Demolition

Maps/Arenas
- Frankfurt: City arena with infantry and ground vehicle combat.
- A7 Autobahn: West Germany arena with infantry, ground vehicle and air combat.
- Frostbite: Winter West/East German boarder arena with infantry and ground vehicle combat.
- Kiev: Soviet aircraft carrier arena with infantry combat.
- Red Dawn: Airport arena with infantry combat.
- The Trace: Stormy night West/East German boarder arena with infantry and ground vehicle combat.
- Sand Storm: Desert arena with infantry, ground vehicle and air combat.
- Maelstrom: Stormy night ocean oil rig arena with infantry and air combat.
- Island X: Large volcano island with infantry, ground vehicle and air combat.
- Favela: Rio de Janeiro city arena with infantry combat.
- Bosporus: Night Bridge arena with infantry combat.
- 73 Easting: Large Desert arena with infantry, ground vehicle and air combat.
- Lighthouse: Large Iceland arena with infantry, ground vehicle and air combat.
- 73 Easting Night: Refinery arena with infantry combat.
- Sledgehammer: Large West Germany arena with infantry, ground vehicle and air combat.

data.name: Charles Haunted Mansion
data.detailed_description:
Charles Haunted Mansion is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of a mansion, haunted by the vengeful spirit of a woman and demons.

Charles Mansion was built in 1956 in Ohio which was owned by a rich businessman called Charles, who used to live in that mansion with his family. However, there have been some tragic incidents occurred inside the mansion one after another. It was said that the son of the businessman died by falling down the stairs of the mansion. His spirit was often observed in the hallway area. Charles's younger sister, Anna, was in a relationship with a guy called Henry, who was originally from the downtown of Ohio. He used to visit her from time to time. But the relationship between them worsened as the time went by. Consequently, Anna decided to end the relationship. Henry could not accept that and wanted to take a revenge. On the following day, he entered the mansion impersonating a servant and murdered her in cold blood by dragging her to the attic area of the mansion.

Her spirit is often seen in the attic area and the crying sounds can be heard from time to time. Her restless spirit is looking for revenge even today. The tragic incidents attracted other Evil creatures which is said to reside in the basement area of the mansion. It is also said that there is a portal somewhere in the mansion which is acting as a gateway for the various other spirits.

You play as David, a paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the mansion for experiencing the paranormal. Will you be able to escape the mansion alive?

Are you ready to accept the challenge? You have to survive at any cost!

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire mansion!
  • Collect items like red gems, keys etc.
  • Come face to face with the unrest souls and the demons!
  • Explore the spirit world and avoid traps like spikes, fire, lava etc.
  • Discover the secret areas of the spirit world!
  • About half an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.


Note: I am a solo indie game developer and I have done all of the graphics, artwork, animation, programming, character designing except for the music. I hope you will enjoy the game.

data.name: STARWEAVE
data.detailed_description:
STARWEAVE is more than a narrative-focused tactics game – it’s a tapestry of intertwined fates, a journey marked by camaraderie, laughter, loss, and defiance against the inescapable. Set against the backdrop of a world held hostage by prophecy, you will navigate the treacherous landscapes of destiny and grapple with the chains that bind you to an oppressive cycle.

Developer Note: This game is a thesis project created by a group of students and freelance collaborators. Starweave should take around 3 hours to complete. Please note that the game will likely not receive any additional updates. All purchases go directly to the developers. For more information on the game's development and release, please refer to our devlogs/Steam updates above.

Features:

✦ Squad-Based, Turn-Based Combat: Engage in tactically demanding encounters where every decision counts, and the balance of power can shift in the blink of an eye.

✦ Refusal Mechanic: Refuse to be bound by destiny. Characters may resist their prescribed roles, altering the course of what they've been told to do. It's up to you to come to grips with your errant actions.

✦ Rich Storytelling: Immerse yourself in a richly woven narrative where bonds are tested, friendships are forged, and every victory is a step towards breaking the cycle.

✦ Character Bonding: Experience heartwarming bonding moments with your teammates. Their lives are intertwined with yours, and their struggles, their laughter, and their sacrifices will resonate with you long after you’ve put the game down.

✦ A Stellar Team: Created by a team of over sixty students and collaborators, and including a phenomenal party comprised of the voice talents of Heather Gonzalez (Monster Hunter Rise, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment), Anjali Kunapaneni (Monster Hunter Wilds, The Outer Worlds 2), Marissa Lenti (Octopath Traveler 0, Borderlands 3), and Brian Timothy Anderson (Fire Emblem Engage, Infinity Nikki).

In STARWEAVE, every decision, every interaction, every step taken can tip the scale of destiny. With every choice, you will come closer to the truth - the truth of who you are, who you were meant to be, and who you choose to become. Stand strong against the tides of fate and weave your own starry path. Your journey awaits.

data.name: Age Of Privateer
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the World of Exploration and Combat on the High Seas!

Age Of Privateer is a real-time card battle, roguelike deck-building game. Combine various cards to create powerful decks and explore the vast oceans. Use your courage and wit to defeat pirates, uncover hidden secrets, and embark on a quest to find ancient treasures.

Among the crowd, the herald of Emperor Albertross III reads a proclamation loudly: rewards of wealth and honor await those who find the legendary treasure. Hearing this, you decide to embark on an adventure to find the legendary treasure. Sail the vast seas, uncover hidden secrets, and claim ancient treasures.

real-time Card Battles


Age Of Privateer boasts a fast-paced and thrilling real-time card battle system. Make immediate strategic decisions and use powerful combos to defeat your enemies.

battles With Various Sea Monsters


As you navigate the vast oceans, you will encounter various sea monsters. Face enemies with unique abilities and patterns, and experience the thrill of battle.

collecting Cards and Treasures


During your voyage, collect various cards to strengthen your deck. Discover treasures and rare items to become an even more powerful warrior. Utilize diverse strategies to find the legendary treasure and claim the Emperor's rewards of wealth and honor.

data.name: Haggle Saga
data.detailed_description:
You inherit your grandfather's "Wanbao" banner and become the owner of a small shop.
Buy items brought in by customers, fill your shelves with goods, and sell them when someone shows interest—but that's just the beginning.
Repair damaged items, enhance equipment, and infuse them with "Star Power"… Each step can greatly increase an item's value—but watch both your wallet and your customers' purses.
Raise the name of "Wanbao" high, open chain stores across this fantasy world, and become a true business legend.

Use Suits & Ranks – Play the Psychological Game of Haggling

Real trading is never about the numbers on an abacus—it's a battle of hearts and minds! In this never‑ending "Merchant's Poker Game", you must find your own way.

  • Playing cards represent different negotiation attitudes:
    ♥️ Hearts = Emotion
    ♠️ Spades = Reason
    ♦️ Diamonds = Transaction
    ♣️ Clubs = Toughness
    The higher the number, the stronger the attitude – and they counter each other in a unique system.

  • 4 types of customers, each following their own logic of play.

  • Over 100 card skills to enhance your trading techniques.

  • 50+ banners that provide extra stat bonuses.

 Endless Management – Find Your Path to Prosperity

Identify, repair, strengthen, infuse Star Power, replicate… Don't limit yourself to simple buy‑low‑sell‑high. This game offers a wealth of management simulation features to broaden your road to riches.
But be warned: our shop's principle has always been "100% genuine goods – pay triple for fakes". Don't let the customers catch you.

data.name: Sip Or Die
data.detailed_description:
Four strangers. One table. Only one walks out.

You wake up strapped into an electric chair in a sealed red room. Three strangers sit around the same table. A face in the wall opens its eyes. This is The Overseer, and this is his ritual. His servant, The Pigman, carries it out.

Each round, a wheel decides how many of the vials hold poison. The Pigman fills them and sets them on the table. Some are water. Some are not. Everyone starts with two lives.

On your turn, you pick a number and the arrow spins. Guess right and the power is yours: spin the Wheel of Fate, or put a rival in the electric chair. Guess wrong, and you choose: drink your vial, or face The Pigman's revolver.

Play online with up to three friends and talk with in-game voice chat, or fill the empty seats with bots. Turn on Live Bot Voices and the bots talk out loud. They argue, beg, accuse, and answer you, all running on your own PC.

One spin can change the whole room.

  • Poison gas fills the chamber.

  • The Overseer floods the room, and something is swimming in the water.

  • A rift tears you out into space.

  • You race across the ocean floor with a shark behind you.

  • The Overseer judges you with his beam.

  • Or you get a gun and choose who to shoot.

Sometimes the wheel sends you out of the room altogether. The Overseer spits you out of the night sky onto a farm. Find the toolbox and the fuel, fix the tractor and get everyone out, while The Pigman hunts you through the burning buildings.

Good plays earn the Overseer's Satisfaction. When The Pigman comes to your seat, spend it in the Overseer's shop on a gas mask, a shield against the next bullet, a calmer heartbeat, or making every rival fat. Or bet on who loses next. Lose the bet, and the Overseer eats you.

Play online with up to three friends and talk with in-game voice chat, or fill the empty seats with bots. Turn on Live Bot Voices and the bots talk out loud. They argue, beg, accuse and answer you, all running on your own PC.

Build your survivor before you take a seat. Drag on the body to shape it, then choose hair, clothes, piercings, and more. Everything you unlock in the Overseer's Pass shows up here, and everyone at the table sees it. Gamble your life with 4 other poor souls and see who's going to be the last one standing in the deadly trials.

And if you ever see "1337" on the table, look closer...

data.name: Mr. Hoob!
data.detailed_description:
Mr. Hoob! is a 3D platformer based on the fake lost media post by Alan Wagner that went semi-viral in 2025. Players control a cheerful, pink character who is born in space after thousands of pink particles come together to form him. He lands on his home planet only to find there is only one other being that lives there. He goes to find other life forms and travels to a planet that is nothing but water, platforms, and not so friendly aliens.


On arrival his way of transportation falls into the water, only then does he find out the planets aliens aren't friendly. he leaps across floating platforms and squirts golden rings from his eyes to evade and capture enemies. As the game unfolds, its playful tone slowly shifts into something far more ominous.

Set in a fictional remaster of a mysterious 2006 game, Mr. Hoob invites players to uncover secrets about the game's publishers while appearing to be a normal family game.

HOOB-BORN

Mr. Hoob is birthed from thousands of pink particles that come together to form him.


CONTROLS

Use WASD to Walk, SPACEBAR to Jump, LMB to squirt a ring out of your left eye, and RMB to squirt a ring out of your right eye!

AQUATIC PRISON

The player eventually finds themself trapped on a planet that is nothing but water, platforms, and not so friendly aliens.

FALLING

Don’t worry! If you fall you WILL respawn!

ENDINGS

Mr. Hoob! has two endings. One ending, Space Junk, which is honestly pretty confusing, and Paramount, which explores a lot of game lore.

LORE

On April 17, 2006, Abern Veni (played by Chad Hersh) released the game Mr. Hoob!. Abern promises to visit players if they beat his game, but he unfortunately passed away due to an ailment. 20+ years later, an indie game developer made a remastered version of the game that supposedly holds secrets related to Abern and the publishing company (Krimsoft).

WHY WE THINK OUR GAME IS UNIQUE





We truly believe our game is unique because it started when a young teenage boy decided to take on a concept that was surely difficult to work with and turn it into a reality.







CHARACTERS

ABERN VENI

data.name: BLACK SHEEP TOWN
data.detailed_description:
BLACK SHEEP TOWN is a digital novel set in a fictional city.

An exciting setting.
　The setting of this work is "District Y".
　It is a cosmopolitan downtown area where immigrants from all over the world live, and it is full of energy with visitors who enjoy its unique atmosphere, but the other side of the city is a dangerous area where gangs rule and the police have no power.　

Diverse characters.
　This title features a wide variety of characters with different standpoints and perspectives, including a glittering clan of gangsters who rule the city, a psychic who lives in a corner of the slums, and a person who works for the discriminated mutants.
　Users will experience the world of the story from the perspective of several of them.

-Stories that can be viewed from what you want to see.
　The user chooses which scenario to read next in this work.
　After finishing the first few scenarios, multiple scenarios will be released, from which the user can read the scenarios of particular interest.
　Scenarios related to favorite characters or cases of interest can be read first or put off until later.

System to help you.
　This title is equipped with a glossary of terms.
　By clicking on a term in the text, you can see the name of the person or the meaning of the term at any time during the story.
　By opening the configuration screen, you can change the color of terms with explanations or not.
　Also, once you have read a scenario, you can reread it from the scenario selection screen and recheck the episodes you are interested in.
　These features will make it easier for you to understand this story with its many people and incidents.

DEPARTMENT 98 is an idle game set entirely inside a 1990s office terminal. You process forms for

a government department. Nobody will tell you what the forms are for.

Tick the boxes, press the stamp, sign at the bottom. Do it well and you can hire someone to do it

for you. Do it very well and you won't need the desk at all. Then a reorganisation takes it all

back, and you start again. Faster, every time.

There is a whole computer under the work, and things in it nobody mentions. The memos get

stranger. The praise gets warmer. There is no procedure for leaving. There is a procedure for

everything.

data.name: Haven
data.detailed_description:
Haven is a co-op fantasy RPG built for playing together. Bring your family, bring your friends, bring anyone who has ever wanted to swing a sword at something enormous. The world is gorgeous. It is also actively trying to eat you.

Fight: Nobody Solos This

Group battles where the plan matters as much as the reflexes. Learn what a creature does before it does it to you. Stack your abilities with your team's, gear up for what's coming, and go in together. Show up prepared or show up again.

Explore: Everything Is Hiding Something

Map the wild places. Crack open dungeons. Trade gear, swap builds, and argue about which way is north. Every run reshuffles what's out there, so the rare finds stay rare and the bragging rights stay earned.

Build: It Takes A Village

Raise a village from nothing. Clear the ground, put up the buildings, and expand it as your group grows into it. Gather recipes, loot, and materials to craft the gear and tools that make the next build possible. Repair it, upgrade it, and watch a pile of lumber turn into somewhere that feels like home.

Haven is a place to build things and make memories with people you actually like. Pull up a chair. Let's go.

data.name: Need to Know
data.detailed_description:
Watch the World.


Welcome to Need to Know, the surveillance thriller sim that tests your ability and integrity within the shadowy, cutthroat world of a modern intelligence agency - the Department of Liberty. You must spy on people’s deepest secrets, pick apart their private lives, and determine how dangerous they are. You can also resist these suffocating privacy invasions by aiding underground groups in leaking data to the media. Or, you can just use all of that juicy classified information for your own personal gain. Your call.

Need to Know emphasises story, and will sculpt the crushing growth of our real-world surveillance society into a meaningful, gripping journey. It critiques the system by passing the uncomfortable (or too comfortable?) mantle of power onto your shoulders, and testing which choices you’ll make. You’ll laugh, you’ll cry, you’ll sweat bullets under the searing blaze of an interrogation lamp.

Features


Assignments - To move through the game - and upwards in the Department - you must complete assignments, which require detecting or solving crimes. In each assignment, you spy on people, determine their guilt, and decide how best to deal with them. Missions are investigative puzzles, founded upon story, character and moral choices.

Evidence - Each profile will contain a person’s digital footprints, from private emails to even more private text messages. Early Clearance Levels only allow you to access a target’s metadata or browsing history. As you progress, you bore deeper into their lives, with geo-tracking, shopping purchases, and even psychological analysis.

Profiles - The Department doesn’t discriminate in its abuse of privacy, so you’ll encounter people from all economic backgrounds, locations, ages, and cultures. The DoL database, CodeX, is packed with citizens’ profiles, with colourful biographies, human flaws, and realistic dilemmas.

Powers - Profile investigations will almost inevitably result in dual-choice decisions. Is the person suspicious or a model citizen? Guilty or innocent? As your Clearance Level increases, so does your authority and the breadth of your powers. Will you fuel your rise to power with searches, wiretaps, smear campaigns and abductions? Exonerate people you want to help? Or covertly undermine the Department from the inside?

Outcomes – Your actions lead to in-game consequences, and at the end of every mission you’ll discover how your decisions affected each suspect.

Clearance Levels – Everything hinges upon your Clearance Level. Impress your superiors, and they will promote you to a higher level, unlocking cooler (and creepier) powers, classified information, a higher salary and prestige.

Personal life – Using a software backdoor, you can also access the CodeX database at home. Steal a corporation’s financial data to make a stock market killing, impress matches in online dating, or help underground groups subvert the Department of Liberty. Be as altruistic or as selfish as you want.

Chapter-based storytelling – Gameplay intertwines with plots and subplots that extend throughout the game. Experience dystopian surveillance, but with the moral complexity of the modern world.

Main plot - Above all else, your primary goal at the Department of Liberty is to find the mysterious figures responsible for the initial terrorist attack. Clues for this central case are buried throughout the story, and are mapped out in your Gray Day chart.

Assets & Prestige – As your salary grows, impress and intimidate peers with new homes, purchases, and more.

Design – A more clinical, traditional surveillance design is eschewed for colour and imagery. You should feel the fun and temptation associated with absolute power.



A catastrophic terrorist infiltration of nuclear power plants leads to the formation of a new and immense intelligence agency – the Department of Liberty. Its primary goals are to hunt down those responsible, and prevent further attacks. It will carry these out with unprecedented access to people’s daily lives.

In Washington, the DoL grapples with rival agencies for political supremacy, combats domestic threats, and ruthlessly silences its opponents.



Join the DoL as a broke, directionless graduate. Every day you spy on people, collect their data, and determine their threat level. You have no intention of being sucked into the vortex of surveillance culture, but the deeper you go, the harder it is to escape…

data.name: Skatesterre
data.detailed_description:
Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

Link together huge combos, land stylish tricks, and shred through levels designed for speed, flow, and creativity.

Ride as Sterre Meijer a.k.a. Surfsterre, Dutch skateboarder and rising figure in the global skate scene, and carve your way through streets, parks, and urban playgrounds packed with rails, ramps, and hidden lines.

Complete missions, chase high scores, and unlock new fashion pieces as you progress - building your own unique skate style along the way.

Classic Arcade Skateboarding

  • Easy to learn. Hard to master: Experience gameplay inspired by the legendary skateboarding games of the early 2000s. Tight controls, fluid movement, and a deep combo system make every run fast, satisfying, and rewarding.

  • Skate Your Own Style: Kickflips, grabs, manuals, grinds, and more -Skatesterre features tons of sick tricks you can combine into massive score multipliers. Discover creative lines and push your runs further every time.

  • All killers, no fillers: Skate to a killer soundtrack packed with underground skate punk and skate rock tracks that channel the energy of the golden era of skateboarding games.

  • Unlock Fashion & Style: Completing mission objectives unlocks a wide variety of fashion items for Sterre. Build your own skate look with different outfits and gear as you progress through the game.

  • Diverse Levels: Explore a variety of levels filled with rails, ramps, gaps, and hidden routes. Each environment encourages experimentation and rewards players who master the flow of the map.

  • Chase the Perfect Run: Link tricks together and chase the ultimate high score. Every trick matters when you're building the perfect combo.

Features

  • Fast-paced arcade skateboarding gameplay

  • Hundreds of tricks to master and combine

  • Shred to a high-energy soundtrack packed with underground skate punk

  • Mission-based objectives across multiple levels

  • Unlockable fashion items and outfits

  • Large environments full of rails, ramps, and secrets

  • Play as Dutch skateboarder Sterre Meijer a.k.a. Surfsterre

  • Inspired by the golden era of skateboarding games

data.name: Anomaly Grid
data.detailed_description:
Anomaly Grid is a turn-based strategy puzzle game built around numerical pressure, color control, and tactical decisions.

Every unit has a value. Every tile matters. To expand, you must capture weaker tiles, defeat enemy units, merge your own forces, and spend score wisely on upgrades and abilities. The board keeps growing stronger over time, forcing you to plan ahead instead of simply reacting.

Control colors to unlock powerful score milestones, push deeper into enemy territory to improve your long-term economy, and decide when to invest in upgrades or deploy abilities that can shift the entire match.

Abilities allow you to boost captures, grow units over time, drain enemy color groups, pressure all enemy units, or instantly strengthen a key unit. Each choice changes the rhythm of the board.

The enemy is not passive. It upgrades, captures, merges, uses abilities, and adapts through different difficulty levels and AI behavior settings. Optional mutators can dramatically change the rules of a match, creating more aggressive, unstable, or chaotic games.

Key Features:

- Turn-based tactical grid gameplay

- Score-based economy and upgrades

- Color control and milestone bonuses

- Unit capturing, merging, and long-term growth

- Five distinct ability types

- Multiple game modes and difficulty levels

- Optional mutators that alter the match rules

- Clear end-screen statistics showing score, captures, upgrades, abilities, and outcome reason

- A focused demo version built around the core 5v5 experience

Anomaly Grid is designed for players who enjoy strategic planning, puzzle-like positioning, resource management, and watching small numerical decisions grow into massive consequences.
