data.name: Before Nightfall: Summertime
data.detailed_description:
In this game you will walk through a beautiful summer forest in search for firewood. There are no action, shooting, silly screamers here. This game is all about relaxation, peace, enjoying the nature, its sounds and realistic environment. The game uses the latest Unreal Engine 4, which makes graphics and lightning look super realistic.

The main gameplay is based on a simple task – to collect the necessary amount of firewood before the nightfall, while keeping the fire from going out. All these conditions are pushing you to manage the time correctly. Each time the firewood will be located in different places, that brings some variety to every attempt.

data.name: Dishonored
data.detailed_description:
Dishonored is an immersive first-person action game that casts you as a supernatural assassin driven by revenge. With Dishonored’s flexible combat system, creatively eliminate your targets as you combine the supernatural abilities, weapons and unusual gadgets at your disposal. Pursue your enemies under the cover of darkness or ruthlessly attack them head on with weapons drawn. The outcome of each mission plays out based on the choices you make.

Story:

Dishonored is set in Dunwall, an industrial whaling city where strange steampunk- inspired technology and otherworldly forces coexist in the shadows. You are the once-trusted bodyguard of the beloved Empress. Framed for her murder, you become an infamous assassin, known only by the disturbing mask that has become your calling card. In a time of uncertainty, when the city is besieged by plague and ruled by a corrupt government armed with industrial technologies, dark forces conspire to bestow upon you abilities beyond those of any common man – but at what cost? The truth behind your betrayal is as murky as the waters surrounding the city, and the life you once had is gone forever.

Key features:

  • Improvise and Innovate

    Approach each assassination with your own style of play. Use shadow and sound to your advantage to make your way silently through levels unseen by foes, or attack enemies head-on as they respond to your aggression. The flexible combat system allows you to creatively combine your abilities, supernatural powers and gadgets as you make your way through the levels and dispatch your targets. Improvise and innovate to define your play style.
  • Action with Meaning

    The world of Dishonored reacts to how you play. Move like a ghost and resist corruption, or show no mercy and leave a path of destruction in your wake. Decide your approach for each mission, and the outcomes will change as a result.
  • Supernatural Abilities

    Teleport for stealth approaches, possess any living creature, or stop time itself to orchestrate unearthly executions! Combining your suite of supernatural abilities and weapons opens up even more ways to overcome obstacles and eliminate targets. The game’s upgrade system allows for the mastery of deadly new abilities and devious gadgets.
  • A City Unlike Any Other

    Enter an original world envisioned by Half-Life 2 art director Viktor Antonov. Arkane and Bethesda bring you a steampunk city where industry and the supernatural collide, creating an atmosphere thick with intrigue. The world is yours to discover.

data.name: 怪奇幻想夢物語 怪獣綺譚 桜蛇伝
data.detailed_description:
―散ってしまうのなら、出会わなければよかった―

　人と人ならざるもの、惹かれ合う二人の運命は……。
　グラフィックとムービーで演出するストーリーノベル。
　表題作「桜蛇伝」他、外伝短編「蜘蛛の糸、吊り人形」を収録。
　

■「桜蛇伝」あらすじ


　幼い頃落ちた古井戸の底で、アキヒコは白い大蛇と出会った。
　恐怖のあまり傍に落ちていた釘でその右目を抉ると、裂けた肉が桜色に咲く。
　それからアキヒコは桜が怖い。
　
　秋の終わりに母が死に、山の屋敷で一人ひっそりと暮らすアキヒコのもとに、ツユクサと名乗る女が訪ねてくる。
　はじめは幽霊めいた印象の奇妙な女と思うが、その健気さにほだされてゆく。
　惹かれ合う二人。
　しかし、女には秘密があった……。

■「蜘蛛の糸、吊り人形」あらすじ


　先祖が恐ろしい化け物を封じたと伝わる塚が崩れたと聞き、これをあらために向かう明けの夢守・皇アキヒコ。
　そこで待ち受けていたのは、死して尚動き茶を淹れる遺体と暮らす一人の男だった。

data.name: Climb or Meow
data.detailed_description:
Climb, fall, meow, repeat! Team up as tiny cats in a giant house full of magic, with a unique twist - every fall becomes a mini rescue adventure! Leap across magical platforms to save your stranded friend, unlock cute cosmetics, and brave the climb together.

Every fall is a rescue adventure.

Missed a jump? Hang in there - literally! A fallen cat freezes in mid-air, and a new trail of magical platforms appears for their friends to cross.

Jump to the rescue, give your stranded friend a few paw taps, and send them floating back to safety in a bubble. Every slip turns into a little co-op challenge - and next time, you might be the one who needs a helping paw!

Stick together. Literally.

Tiny cats, a giant magical house, and one big climb to tackle together! Leap across floating furniture and explore familiar rooms from a whole new perspective.

But don’t wander off! A magical bond pulls you back together whenever you stray too far apart. Time your jumps, wait for your friends, and watch where those little paws are heading.

Small cats. Big style.

data.name: Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow
data.detailed_description:
The mystical Egyptian underworld beckons you in Duat: Shadows of Light & Dark! Foil the plans of Set and Apep using your powers of light. Explore the varied environments of the underworld and battle your way through in this epic pixel art style platformer.

Play as Asher, a boy with the divine powers of light, and his sentient hood, Bastet, bestowed with the corrupted powers of the dark, as you jump, dash, push and attack your way through the Egyptian underworld to defeat Set and Apep.

The stakes are high, for if you don’t succeed in your mission, the world will be overrun with corruption and darkness. It’s for you to save this world and restore balance.

Game Features

  • Classic side-scrolling platformer that combines intricate puzzles with intense action

  • Up to 14 areas and 8 bosses for you to test your prowess

  • 20 hours of game time for you to relish in this unique Egyptian mythology inspired universe

  • Combine the light and the dark powers of your sentient hood to navigate the treacherous environments

  • Use your portal powers to move around the levels and solve their puzzles

  • Evolve to the changing powers of the dangerous Peplobs

data.detailed_description:
An otome visual novel where you choose your romance with an attractive boy in culinary school. A perfectly delectable romance for foodies.

You’re the newest transfer student at Lincoln Culinary Academy, a private culinary school to find your culinary calling and an unforgettable romance. Immerse yourself in your school adventures as you interact with four gorgeous guys with culinary skills of their own. - Immersive MC experience – select as a female, male, or non-binary MC
- Unlockable in-game social media content with the characters
- Original Soundtrack- 8 different endings

data.name: Senior Sunset
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME BACK TO SCHOOL

35 of your classmates were murdered. Law enforcement's response was to cover everything up. Not a single living soul could tell you the whole story, so you decide to find out for yourself.

Take on the role of Amanda, an aspiring podcaster who yearns for a good story- something to really get some people tuning in. You break into your own high school to investigate, finding the truth behind the murders and uncovering that the truth is far more sinister than you could've ever imagined.

Be aware at all times. With limited movement options, you'll have to decide when's best to make your move. It will hear you.

Plan ahead. Unlock various shortcuts and hidden pathways in the school to assist you in navigating throughout. Be sure of your route in order to avoid any unwanted encounters.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Dive into a full, fleshed out psychological horror experience. Senior Sunset offers a linear story with gameplay that can vary between cautious, slow, and calculated & intense and fast-paced.

Beware of him. A constant, looming threat is ever-present throughout your descent into the school. It will do everything in its power to hunt you down. With its advanced detection & reactive capabilities, nowhere is safe for long.

The school is a dark, detailed location packed full of places to explore. Slowly unlock different rooms and halls as you journey through with little to no navigational assistance.

The game features a variety of different tracks, each with its own set of challenges and obstacles, and players can customize their cars with different engine specs to improve their performance.

In addition to the single-player campaign, there is multiplayer where players can team up with friends to simply enjoy the thrill of racing together. With fast-paced gameplay, silly visuals, and a strong emphasis on skillful driving, lowpoly drift offer a unique and thrilling racing experience that is sure to keep players engaged and entertained.

data.name: ROBO SHAM BORO
data.detailed_description:
ROBO SHAM BORO is a rock paper scissors deckbuilder card battler JRPG. 

You play as this guy named Dillinger, a spry young man caught up in the biggest conspiracy this side of the Old Road. People found dead in dumpsters and house parties, killer robots on the loose, talks of summoning a beast in the woods..?

That's right, there's murder afoot.

Well, it might have been a murder. We're not totally sure. It could have just been a heart attack, or like a bear or something. But it could have also been a murder.

Anyways, smart guy, I know that it's December 25th and all, but could you on a wacky adventure full of personal growth and rock and paper and scissors to figure this one out for us? I'm sure you've got nothing else going on. It's not like anything else happens today.

Features of ROBO SHAM BORO:

  • ✊ Rock

  • 🖐️ Paper

  • ✌️ Scissors

    Yeah, you heard me right, bitch.

    We've got ✊ Rock, 🖐️ Paper, AND ✌️ Scissors. Play your cards right, because every time you do your sign changes to match it. You'll have to play smart and manage your resources to avoid opening yourself up to deadly crits and dish out some of your own.

    But I'm not done yet! More features of ROBO SHAM BORO:

  • 🃏 DECKBUILDING

Whether your deck's full of random shit or something resembling an actual build, it's on you to collect the right cards and stack the deck in your favor to come out on top. The game's got a good deal of depth to it, and the right answer won't always come down to rock beating scissors.

(Nothing is stopping you from bringing 30 🖐️Mysteries, though. Do it. Don't be a coward.)

But get this, there's even more to this game! Like:

  •   

  •   

  •   

  •  

    Sorry that's all I got.

    Look, man, the screenshots speak for themself. If this doesn't look like the kind of game you'd enjoy, you probably won't.

data.name: Save the Llama
data.detailed_description:
Assemble advanced towers from old farm equipment, mechanize the landscape, and erect an impenetrable perimeter to defend your herd. Construct your towers on moving platforms and orchestrate their position and timing to defeat waves of alien UFOs. Craft the perfect defense and save your llamas from the alien menace!

Features

  • An assortment of moving mechanisms for you to experiment with to your strategic delight.
  • Six unique upgrade-able towers to build your defenses from.
  • 10 enemy types with different abilities to defeat.
  • Perks to improve and specialize your play style.
  • 16 unique levels to master.
  • Playful acapella sound effects and voice acting.
  • Full save and load, never lose progress when you need to step away.
  • Fast forward, slow, and pause time as you see fit.

Deliver pizza to your customers in a pizza shop on your own or with your friends. Start with Pizza Dough and place the ingredients.

The best pizza is made with teamwork.

While one makes the pizzas, another boxes the pizzas. Another delivers the pizzas.

Remember, this is a fast food pizza shop! If you make pizza slowly, your customers will leave unhappy.

You should prepare your pizzas quickly and put them in the oven. Get the missing ingredients. Fill your refrigerators.

data.name: 相亲对象竟然是女鬼？
data.detailed_description:
This is a text-based adventure game that tells a horror comedy story with a new twist on urban legends. You were just enjoying your coffee and singing along when you were looking forward to a romantic encounter with a charming lady. However, your date seems a bit off, and the entire romance becomes twisted and tainted with an unsettling shade of crimson.





· Sharing the same worldview with "Myth of Rules", this story unfolds in Earth 173, where demons roam freely and bizarre tales are rampant. As an ordinary person, it's quite reasonable to accidentally stumble into a trap. If you wish to pursue romance, please use legitimate dating websites instead of opening some automatically downloaded blind date site on your computer.
· The probability of a haunted location for blind dates has increased, and the glitch where your date is a normal person has been fixed.
· Even if your blind date is human, you shouldn't let your guard down, for they might be murderers possessed by bizarre tales within their bodies, driven insane by the influence of demons.





· As a hardcore internet surfer, it seems like you, as a player, has no merits other than reckless bravery, and you've consumed countless absurd horror comedies.
· Fortunately, your date isn't normal too, perhaps you two can resonate on the same frequency.
· Even if it's a demon, what of it? As long as you've got guts, even Sadako takes maternity leave.




· Don't let her love you too much, or she'll devour you.
· Don't make her hate you too much, or she'll shred you to pieces.
· My closet's moving, I don't want to play anymore!"" No, you need to confront your fears, break through her defenses, and make her fall in love with you. That's the only way to survive.




· A suave doctor traversing through dreams, striving to harness the power of nightmares.
· A headless maiden adorned with exotic heads, yearning to regain her own.
· A cursed doll named Alice, eager to play a game with you.

  • Highscore System: optimize your run either for fastest time, most coins collected or overall Highscore

data.name: Isekai-ya
data.detailed_description:
You don't remember how you were transported here, but this was your world now, your restaurant in another world, Isekai-ya.

Your dreams to become a chef took a strange turn, reality seemed to have warped before your eyes and what you see before you just seemed so odd. The buzz of unfamiliar languages, yet weirdly comprehensible.

People of all shapes, colour and sizes; pointy ears and even fluffy warmth..

Yet, in front of you, were unmistakably: A kitchen countertop, stoves, and shelves and larders stocked with colorful ingredients.

Visit different worlds, meet the unique inhabitants

Who would you meet? The cast includes:

  • outgoing, flamboyant Day Elves

  • seductive, sultry Demonkin

  • burly, disgruntled Orcs

  • and so much more!

Not to mention, even in these fantasy worlds, comes a wide variety of flora and fauna at your disposal.

Discover unique ingredients, whip up mouth watering dishes

With a wide variety of ingredients, comes the scrumptious meals that you can make from them.

data.name: Idling to Rule the Gods
data.detailed_description:
Idling to Rule the Gods is a free to play idle game with a lot of content and some minigames.

Depending on your playstyle, you can play it fast or slow.

It is mostly text based and offers lots of content, but please don't expect overly good graphics and animations. Idling to Rule the Gods can provide lots of fun for years if you delve into it, but might also not be as easy to understand as some other games.

If there is something unclear or you have trouble to progress efficiently, feel free to join our Discord Community which can help you, or check the feedback button ingame.

Unleash your inner god in Idling to Rule the Gods, the ultimate idle game where incremental progress reigns supreme!

In the year 9001, humanity's folly led to the destruction of countless worlds. You are the last survivor, escaped to a dimension ruled by powerful deities. Now, armed with the unique ability to create shadow clones, you must embark on an epic idle quest for ultimate power.

Begin your journey by creating an army of shadow clones. Watch as they tirelessly train, learn powerful skills, and battle fearsome monsters, all while you effortlessly absorb their strength. Your first target: Hyperion, the god who decimated your people. Overcome him and unlock a universe teeming with even stronger deities, each a new challenge to conquer.

Idling to Rule the Gods offers a deeply rewarding idle experience:

  • Passive Progression: Sit back and watch your power grow exponentially, even when you're offline. Perfect for busy gamers!

  • Strategic Depth: Manage your shadow clones, upgrade their skills, and optimize your idle gains to become an unstoppable force.

  • Endless Content: Confront a pantheon of gods, discover new worlds, and unlock powerful upgrades in your quest for divine dominance.

  • Rebirth and Ascend: Prestige your progress to unlock powerful bonuses and accelerate your idle climb to the top.

  • Collect and Train: Discover loyal pets and build magnificent monuments to further enhance your power.

Are you ready to ascend from lone survivor to supreme deity? Download Idling to Rule the Gods and experience the addictive thrill of idle gaming today!

data.name: To The Grave: The Battle for Faenora
data.detailed_description:
Experience the Ultimate Strategy RPG

A Modern Take on Classic Strategy RPGs with a Nostalgic Touch
Join the revolution against tyranny in Faenora in our upcoming real-time strategy role-playing game, To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora. Drawing inspiration from timeless classics like Final Fantasy Tactics and Ogre Battle, we're modernizing the elements that made these games unforgettable while staying true to their roots. Our multiplayer approach to this tactical RPG gameplay will provide a gaming experience as deep and engaging as it is unique.
​
Join the Revolution
In the Kingdom of Faenora, eons of worsening oppression have sparked a revolution against tyranny. The monarchy rules with ruthless self-interest, pillaging his subjects to add to the royalty's immense wealth and that of his nobles. While the people of Faenora scrounge, scratch and claw for their survival, those brave enough are joining the fight for freedom and justice. Will you join the revolution and alter the destiny of Faenora?

Try it Today
Try our Proof of Concept demo, which is a one map single-player experience that showcases the art style and basic gameplay mechanics. In the final game, you will be able to experience the full thrill of building your army and playing with friends. In its final form, you will engage in cinematic battles where your use of skills, items and reinforcements will be critical to your squads' success and failure. Your strategic cunning will be put to the test as you build your squads, develop and equip your soldiers and control your troops in each mission pushing back the Faenoran oppressors.

data.name: Suit Up
data.detailed_description:
The flagship title from Awkward Wolf Studios!

Suit Up is an exciting combination of RPG, rogue-like and twin stick shooters!
Immersive yourself into fun filled combat and explore handcrafted interactive environments set in a Sci-Fi futuristic universe!

BATTLE THE CRAWLER INVASION!

The planet is under attack! “Crawlers” ™ have begun a galactic invasion and have opened up strange portals all over the planet and are invading!

As a retired mech pilot, you will Suit Up! with an arsenal of weapons, ready to shoot, burn, freeze, electrocute the incoming threat. Be prepared to venture out into different and hostile environments, to eradicate the relentless alien bugs threatening to overwhelm your planet.

UPGRADE YOUR WEAPONS!

Unlock and upgrade your weapons to face even stronger enemies and rid the planet of the infestation.

Improve after every run, getting stronger by collecting Credits and Tech to build your ultimate battle mech.

EQUIP POWERFUL MODS!

Alongside improving your weapons, during each run you will be able to gather unique modifications which will change the effects of your weapons making them even more powerful! Play around with different builds to try all the unique modifiers and find the one that “Suits” you the most.

EVERY GAME IS UNIQUE

With a variety of content and a unique procedural level generation, every time you embark on your mission it will be a little different. This makes every run fun and enjoyable (although some might be harder than anticipated 😉 )

Upgrade systems, locations, modifications and unique enemies await you as you battle to free our planet!

DISCOVER SECRETS OF THE PAST!

As you battle across the planet you will uncover hidden secrets found in old data logs and ancient ruins. Learn more about the planet, the invasion and the events that led up to it in this compelling narrative.

GAMEPAD RECOMMENDED

Being a twin-stick in nature, a gamepad is recommended to play this game, however keyboard and mouse are supported as well.

data.name: Love And Order
data.detailed_description:
In the smallest district of Montreal, the Crown Attorney relies on the legal expertise of its lawyers; backed up by the support of a single hard-working secretary.

This is the story of Dana Larose, a young woman starting her career as a secretary in the Crown Attorney's office. The office is both overworked and understaffed, so you'll have to work out whose projects you help with accordingly.

Will you be able to unravel the mystery being covered up, balance the stress of juggling overtime for everyone, and still manage to find love...?

FEATURES

  • Four dateable characters: Jonathan, Pierre, Ross and Dorothy
  • Deal with many different kinds of work to help everyone out around the office
  • Put in overtime for extra money, but be careful to balance work and pleasure or you'll crack under stress!
  • What secret is being covered up by the Crown Attorney's office? Follow the clues...

data.name: Lightning: D-Day
data.detailed_description:
This 1 on 1 card game recreates the drama of the day Allied soldiers went ashore in occupied France, 6 June 1944. Each of the historic landing beaches - Sword, Juno, Gold, Omaha and Utah - is represented by its own card, as are the defending German divisions and attacking Allied units. The Allies must marshal their resources to gain and secure control of as many beaches as they can by day's end: a run-through of the 110-card deck.

However, the Axis has the starting advantage; the Allies need to avoid being caught dead in the water. Although most units are preassigned to a beach, each game is won or lost by the placement of cards that provide additional forces or support. Not only is the state of each beach important to consider for these decisions, but also the geography of the coastline - after a beach has been won, the victorious forces can flank adjacent beaches. Both players must always be thinking ahead, looking for ways to best utilise their cards down the line.

Key Features
  • Play as the Axis or Allies.
  • Cross-platform online play. 
  • Play solo vs AI.
  • 2 player hot seat multiplayer.
  • A faithful conversion of the original card game.

data.name: PEAK
data.detailed_description:
PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?

WORK TOGETHER

Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes every single day. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.

CLIMB

The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb.

SURVIVE

Prepare For the Worst: Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you.

A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY

The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.

EARN BADGES

A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock.

CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Multiplayer in PEAK is friends-only - invite up to three other scouts online to climb together, or face the mountain alone if you're really brave!

FEATURES

  • Online, cross-platform co-op and offline single player

  • Climb with a total of 4 friends

  • Communicate through proximity chat 

  • A variety of biomes to ascend through

  • A bunch of questionable foods

  • Lots of different climbing items

  • Campfires and marshmallows

  • Character customization

  • Ghosts

Need a Hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes every single day. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.

CLIMB

The Mountain Takes no Prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb.

SURVIVE

Prepare For the Worst: Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you.

A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY

The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.

EARN BADGES

A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock.

CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Multiplayer in PEAK is friends-only - invite up to three other scouts online to climb together, or face the mountain alone if you're really brave!

FEATURES

  • Online, cross-platform co-op and offline single player

  • Climb with a total of 4 friends

  • Communicate through proximity chat 

  • A variety of biomes to ascend through

  • A bunch of questionable foods

  • Lots of different climbing items

  • Campfires and marshmallows

  • Character customization

  • Ghosts

data.name: Long Carnage
data.detailed_description:
🔥 Long Carnage – Terror doesn’t give you a choice. Only the next step.

You just wanted a peaceful trip.

Arriving at a rented house in the isolated town of Ravenwood, everything seemed normal: bags scattered around, a fireplace to light, cameras to set up, and a long night ahead.

Then the sun goes down.

And the carnage begins.

Long Carnage is a first-person cooperative horror game where up to 4 players must survive deadly entities while exploring dark environments, restoring power, searching for resources, and facing unpredictable horrors.

👥 INTENSE COOPERATIVE MULTIPLAYER

Play with up to 3 friends and try to survive the night.

Each match features dynamic events, varied objectives, and moments of pure tension where a single mistake can put the entire group at risk.

☠️ KILLERS WITH UNIQUE MECHANICS

Each killer has different behaviors, abilities, and hunting methods.

The Intruder — silent, brutal, and always watching.

Hush — hates music... and you will need to use it against him.

Boogeyman — a creature of the shadows that thrives in darkness.

Whisper — a disturbing clown that only attacks when not being watched.

Viktor Graves — a possessing spirit that turns the house itself into a trap.

Peekaboo — a murderous doll that plays hide-and-seek with deadly consequences.

🧠 SURVIVE HOWEVER YOU CAN

Find items, complete tasks, restore electrical systems, and discover how to stop each threat.

Survival depends on cooperation, strategy, and staying calm under pressure.

💀 DYNAMIC HORROR AND REPLAYABILITY

Random events, unpredictable scares, power failures, and different objectives ensure that no two matches are ever the same.

In Ravenwood, fear never follows a script.

Are you ready to survive the night?

Ravenwood is waiting.

data.name: The Rule Of SHE
data.detailed_description:
The Rule of SHE is a role-playing game that delves into the enigmatic character of SHE. In this ever-shifting world, reality and time are constantly in flux, and each scenario introduces a different set of rules that must be followed.

Any violation of these rules will bring misfortune upon yourself. Adhere to them to uncover the truth and delve into the deepest secrets of SHE. Only when you have gained enough understanding of this eerie world will the time for successful reincarnation arrive.

1, A poetic, short narrative-driven puzzle game.

2, A bizarre and slightly eerie worldview accompanied by up to 20 original BGMs.

3, A carefully designed puzzle gameplay where switching between multiple characters can trigger different storylines.

4, The game includes boss battles and chase mechanics.

1, This is not a game with a single storyline. Please, explore all branching narratives.

2, Do not trust me; trust the rules established in each room of the game.

3, Remember to turn on the lights during your gameplay.

4, The game’s rules do not apply to your real-world life.

5, If you’re caught in a dilemma, trust your instincts.

If rules open pathways to the deeper layers of this world, what happens when they’re broken?  Between reality and illusion, will you still remember who you are?

data.name: SuperHookGirl Ultra Challenge!!
data.detailed_description:
Soar through the skies with dazzling grappling action! "SuperHookGirl Ultra Challenge!!" – High-speed hook-swinging action with simple mouse controls!

[Features]

  • A 2D platformer built around hook-swinging action

  • Simple mouse controls for exhilarating movement

  • Deep speedrun potential — master momentum and discover new routes

  • Featuring Pick-chan, your cheerful little sister and biggest supporter

■Simple, intuitive mouse-only controls

❶Walk in the direction of the mouse cursor, right-click to jump

❷ Left-click to perform a hook shot

❸ Dash using walls or floors

That’s all three!

Simple to learn, but incredibly challenging to master. The thrill when you finally conquer a stage is unmatched.

Dash through obstacles and soar through each stage with style!

■Two sisters embark on an adventure journey toward the stars

The heroine Hook and her younger sister Pick were trained by their beloved Master.

One day, the Master vanished without a trace.

To find her, the sisters set off on an adventure beyond the skies — a journey toward the stars.

Another highlight is the charming radio messages you’ll receive from Pick-chan during your journey!

■Deeply Engaging Time Attack

Hookshot can latch onto all sorts of places!

You might discover unexpected routes or insane shortcuts...!?

After clearing the game, challenge yourself in Time Attack mode!

data.name: Melia Keys In... Quantum Decade
data.detailed_description:
"I, Kelsey Burton, am on a mission to finally grow up and forget my embarrassing adolescent alter-ego - but it's gonna be tough while still navigating friendships with clueless childhood pals & a goofy alien fangirling over my old made-up persona." ...Hey now, I take offense to this. I am grown up - and what is this about a made-up alter ego? I have no idea what that's talking about... Should I just keep reading these off? Alright.

Features


  • 55K+ Words : "Six content-packed Episodes make for 6+ hours of gameplay on a first playthrough!"
  • 4th Wall Breaks : "I'm narrating to YOU..." I guess? "Answer choices your own way to unlock three possible endings!" ...Just don't tick me off.
  • Animation/CGs : "Sprites blink and speak! CGs and animations for key scenes make the story really pop!"
  • CG Gallery : "40 images and other items to unlock in the Gallery!"
  • Bonus Content : "Join Moonie for some 'Out Of This World' content at the end of every episode!"
  • Original Soundtrack : "Poppy, toe-tapping music courtesy of acclaimed VN composer Melia Keys!" ...Yes, that Melia Keys. I don't get it either.

There. That's it. I read the whole thing. Yes, I purposely skipped the part about Melia Keys being "best girl" and the "real star of the game." No, I'm not going back and saying that. I'm going home. Bye.

data.name: Wanderlust: Travel Stories
data.detailed_description:
Buzz


More from our friends


About the Game

In a bar, on the world's most remote island, a group of strangers share their stories. Step into their shoes and experience travel from distinct perspectives. This collection of playable novels is inspired by real events and places—but the course of each journey depends on your choices.

A bridge between literature and gaming

Wanderlust: Travel Stories is a book that you shape. If you’re seeking something a little bit different it is for you—and if you can read this, you have all you need to get started.

An anthology of travel stories

Four long stories and five short ones, each written by its own team of authors. Every journey offers a unique playstyle as you experience travel through the eyes of distinct individuals. Like an idealistic student, a jaded reporter, or a man who’s simply a terrible planner.

Authentic, grounded and well researched

Inspired by true stories and set in real places. Travel to the mysterious statues of Rapa Nui, bustling streets of Bangkok, pristine expanses of the Antarctic, grasslands of the Serengeti, and more. Dive into tales created by passionate travelers and experienced reporters, see the world they saw throughout their journeys.

Emotions color perception

Your choices shape the characters’ mood. This, in turn, changes how you see the world. All emotions are valid: happiness or enthusiasm aren’t everything, feeling sad or fatigued is perfectly natural.

Minimalism

Tasteful aesthetic, bespoke photography, and immersive soundscapes set the tone. Just enough to stir your own memories or feed the imagination.

Introducing Slow Gaming

Like a peaceful afternoon with a cup of tea and a novel, it’s a slow-paced and meditative experience. You don’t have to rush or fight, you can take in every moment at your own pace. If this is what you seek, check out our Slow Gaming Manifesto.

From the creators of The Witcher, Dying Light and Hitman

We sail into uncharted waters with this experimental playable travel documentary. We would love you to join us on the journey.

Follow us

For more travel stories, follow our social media channels:
Facebook, Twitter, Instagram

data.reviews:
“A variety of engrossing “choose-your-own” quests based on real-life travel memoirs, Wanderlust: Travel Stories’ vividly written text will have you longing to start your own exotic adventure.”
4/5 – Adventure Gamers

“Wanderlust: Travel Stories is a different experience from your run-of-the-mill video game, and should appeal to anyone who is an avid traveler or wants to explore some unknown parts of the world from home. The stories are engaging and presented nicely, having enough of an impact on me to start downloading travel apps and plan trips. It may have the same effect on you.”
8/10 – TheSixthAxis

“Wanderlust is an unusual and bold concept of a game based on the literature of the road. The courage of the artists, who created a game consisting mostly of text, deserves admiration. And recognition, too, because Wanderlust is simply a really good game.”

data.name: Bullet Rain
data.detailed_description:
Bullet Rain is a competitive shooter where the objective is to capture objectives on the map or eliminate the opposing team. Players can expect thrilling firefights and tactical challenges against other players.

In a grim future, the skies unleashed a torrent of destruction as a colossal battleship bombarded the planet, earning its fearsome moniker “Bullet Rain” and alien life forms revealed themselves to humanity. Peaceful negotiations were never an option for them. Even the dragons fought among themselves to acquire resources. Earth became the battlefield of an unprecedented scale. Though the planet had to be evacuated, many remained behind to defend it. Welcome to the year 2102, three decades after the first appearance of dragons, where the face of Earth has forever changed. Humanity confronts the relentless reality that it is not alone in the universe. Dragons and other extraterrestrial species have revealed themselves and claim resources that once belonged exclusively to humans. Earth finds itself in an end-time scenario, marked by destruction and desolation. Cities have crumbled into ruins, once bustling streets now lay deserted and overgrown with vegetation. The remnants of human civilization serve only as a reminder of past grandeur and loss. Despite the apocalyptic landscape, humanity has not given up. With a mix of advanced technology, they wage a desperate battle against the overwhelming invaders. Each day is a struggle for survival, and the boundaries between good and evil blur in this endless conflict for resources and power. Amidst this chaos, clans and factions have formed, fighting for the remaining resources. Loyalty to a group can determine life and death as humanity strives to stand against the looming extinction. Yet even in times of darkness, there are glimmers of hope that keep faith in a better future alive. Welcome to "Bullet Rain”.

In Bullet Rain, all players stand on an equal footing, without any additional abilities or special skills. The focus is entirely on skill, teamwork, and strategic thinking. Each player can contribute their individual skills and experiences to lead the team to victory. With a variety of weapons and equipment at your disposal, there are numerous options to develop your own playstyle and compete in the 5-versus-5 battles. Showcase your shooting skills, collaborate closely with your teammates, and defeat the invaders in this action-packed competition for the fate of humanity.

data.name: Afternoon Affairs & Helpless Housewives
data.detailed_description:
Set in the early nineties, Takumi Nakama doesn't know what to do with his life. He failed his college entrance exams and lacks the willpower to retake them. What's worse, he doesn't even want to go job hunting. Out of options, his parents give him an old apartment building both as a job and a place to live.

There, he meets two young housewives, Akemi Ushio and Shino Kumagaya. Although they seem easy enough to get along with at first, it isn't long before Takumi learns more about them. Both of them feel trapped in this run-down building, and their troubles are gradually breaking them down.

Now their sole ally is the inexperienced, awkward, and kind landlord...

Follow Takumi's story as he unveils the truth behind Akemi and Shino's backgrounds. What's been troubling the two ladies, and how can Takumi help them? Read through this drama-filled visual novel about meetings, trust, and the fragile balance between right and wrong.

Secrets Revealed

Follow Takumi's story to learn more about these two friendly residents and the complicated relationship that blooms between the three of them.

An Immersive Visual Novel

Featuring beautiful art and stunning music, enjoy the full visual novel experience as you take a stroll in Takumi's shoes.

A Future That's Yours to Make

Your choices will determine the ending. How will your decisions affect your gorgeous new acquaintances?

data.name: Graphite in the Hospital
data.detailed_description:
-Some secrets were buried here for a reason-

For months, the Hartwell Psychiatric Hospital has been completely silent.

No staff. No communications. No explanation.

Henry Carter investigative journalist went in to find out why.

Armed with nothing but his camera and a story he can't let go of, Henry enters Hartwell alone, determined to find out why an entire psychiatric hospital went dark.

Avoid what's hunting you. Document what you find.

  • Linear, twist-driven story told through first-person cinematics

  • Roughly 2 hours of dense, high-intensity gameplay

  • Deep lore uncovered through documents, recordings, and evidence

  • AAA-quality graphics and immersive first-person presentation

Hartwell's wards aren't empty. Insane patients and worse things roam the halls, and Henry has no weapon but his instincts. Stay hidden, stay quiet, and stay ready to run! because when Hartwell's AI-driven enemies catch your scent, the chase doesn't stop until one of you is caught.

  • Stealth-based survival,  avoid patients and enemies or don't survive the encounter

  • Smart AI enemies that drive dynamic, high-tension chase sequences

  • Puzzle-solving required to progress through condemned sections of the hospital

  • Occasional descents into a disorienting dream world, where the only way out is to solve your way through it

Henry Carter came to Hartwell for a byline. What he finds instead will change everything ... starting with him.

4 hours of relentless, intense horror

data.name: Survive the Blackout
data.detailed_description:
This is the way the world ends

Not with a bang but a whimper.

-- T.S. Eliot

SURVIVE THE BLACKOUT is a narrative survival game set in a dark post-apocalyptic world where a mysterious global power outage sends civilization spiraling into chaos. In this modern-day tribute to the classic Oregon Trail, the player becomes the reluctant leader of a small group of survivors and tries to lead them to a safe haven. On their journey, every step is a choice, and none of them are simple.

  • Manage a small team of survivors

  • Carefully make your choices as a branching narrative unfolds

  • Scavenge for supplies and manage your resources

  • Explore the world after the fall of civilization across multiple unique playthroughs

Be the relentless leader the survivors need in the harsh reality of a world in ruins, make all the dramatic choices, and face their consequences. Experience the story unfolding differently each time you play. Find out what YOU are willing to sacrifice to Survive the Blackout!

The world of Survive the Blackout isn’t your average extravagantly stylized, far-fetched post-apo setting. The game presents a plausible scenario of the fall of human civilization. A global power outage caused by factors unknown to the general public is enough for much of the modern world to crumble and for society to collapse. The dire consequences of such an event are powerful enough, without the need to include any supernatural or fantastical elements.

How did the Blackout affect the world? The survivors will travel through different regions, each with its own flavor, local storylines, unique risks, and opportunities. Through their eyes, the player will experience a familiar world reduced to ruin and filled with desperation.

The apocalypse doesn’t make people more interesting than they already are. But it tends to bring out the best, the worst, and the weirdest in people. The story of the post-apocalypse is best told from many different personal perspectives. Anyone who has ever played games like Fallout or other RPG or adventure titles will remember how the world came alive with NPCs telling their stories and adding their own colorful presence to the overall experience.

Preppers. Looters. Orphans. Healers. Murderers. Psychos. Beggars. Loners. Heroes. Opportunists. Thieves. Everyone you meet on the road is a person with their own story, motivation, and personality. Each encounter lets you experience the story of humanity’s fall a little more deeply.

With all the rules gone, without the safety that civilization provides, each decision you make becomes a matter of life and death. Survive the Blackout is a narrative game where you make choices in response to the circumstances your group of survivors faces. It is up to you if you want to base them on morals, a desperate will to survive, or some other ideals. Whatever you decide, you must consider not only the immediate but also the long-term consequences of your actions.

Managing supplies, issuing orders, moving forward, protecting your group, maintaining morale, and giving everyone a sense of purpose is the daily burden of a leader. The group will offer their opinions, but will you listen to them, or try to impose your own ideas? It’s all up to you.

Survive the Blackout is an open-ended, non-linear experience, because we want it to mimic life as well as a small indie game can. But we also want it to be finite and satisfying. Playing the game from start to finish will always provide a full story. A different story in every playthrough, shaped by your decisions and luck, but a complete story nonetheless.

While we hope that the sales of our title provide us with the means and motivation to develop its world and the story even further through future content updates, our main goal is to stay true to how we believe games should be made and sold: as complete products, and not as a “service”.

data.name: Sawad | سواد
data.detailed_description:
In SAWAD, you and up to 6 of your friends are broke content creators absolutely desperate for FAME. Launch your own channel, customize your character to build that crucial personal brand, and execute your master plan: break into terrifying, haunted locations, eliminate whatever nightmare is haunting the place, and escape in one piece. The best part? Hidden CCTVs are rolling the whole time to capture every hilarious, panic-induced mistake you and your friends make. Make the clips go viral and get filthy rich. The only catch? You have to survive long enough to hit upload.

Do Anything for the Views Go in solo if you are crazy enough to face the dark alone or drag your friends into the chaos in co-op. Work together to survive the traps, complete your objectives to take out the entity, and try not to use your best friend as monster bait when things go wrong.

Three Viral Death Traps Your desperate grab for subscribers takes you to three locations, all crawling with things that really want you dead:

  • The Hospital: Dark, creepy, and extremely hostile. You're crashing some twisted family bonding time with an obsessively violent mother and her terrifying baby. To capture the ultimate footage and actually escape, your final objective is ruthless: use the baby as bait to lure the mother into a trap and eliminate them both for good.

  • The Prison: A rusted maze of cell blocks overrun by highly unstable psychopaths. They stay surprisingly docile—as long as the music keeps playing. Your job is to desperately keep the facility's electricity running to prevent the inmates from going into an angry frenzy, all while setting up traps to electrify as many of them as you can before they corner you.

  • The School: A classic late-night exploration video. Your target is a grotesque, demonic boy who relies on an ancient idol for his strength. Keep your camera pointed at the ceiling, because he uses the school's vents to quietly travel from room to room. Destroy his power source to capture the perfect clip, or you won't be leaving at all.

Key Features:

  • CCTV Replays & Live Voice Recording: You face the chaos; the hidden cameras do the filming. Survive the mission and sit back with your squad to watch the hilarious CCTV replays at the end of the run. The system actually records your live in-game voice chat directly into the video replays, capturing every genuine scream, argument, and panicked betrayal to create the absolute perfect viral clip.

  • Custom Movement & Animations: Bring your unique personality to life! Express your terror and style by picking your own walking, running, and scared movement styles, alongside funny dances and emotes to show off on camera.

  • The Algorithm Judges You: At the end of the game, your overall performance determines your channel's fate. But a "good run" doesn't just mean staying alive—your success is based on how many awesome, terrifying, and hilarious events actually happened while you were recording. Produce top-tier, chaotic content to gain massive subscribers and cash, or deliver a boring video and watch your hard-earned subscriber count plummet.

  • Unpredictable Chaos & Random Effects: No two runs are the same. The maps are packed with unpredictable events and hilarious random status effects that alter individual players. Your friends will be pointing and laughing over the voice chat at whatever ridiculous state you get stuck in while you are running for your life.

  • Hunt or Be Hunted: You aren't just running away—you have specific objectives to complete in order to actually eliminate the ghosts and monsters haunting these places.

  • Hilarious Hazards: The traps scattered around the maps won't actually kill you, but they will absolutely ruin your escape. Stumbling blindly into an obstacle while running in a panic is basically guaranteed, making for top-tier comedy when your friends watch you faceplant on the security cameras.

data.name: Toñita
data.detailed_description:
Toñita wants to fulfill her dream of participating in the most important cycling tournament in the world and becoming a true professional cyclist, but it's only 7 days away, she has zero money to travel and her bike has no brakes.

In this frantic arcade-style delivery game, step into the shoes of Toñita as she begins her new job as a delivery girl in her hometown, where she must deliver various items to her friendly neighbors.

Dodge obstacles, jump off ramps, ride your bike across rooftops and discover the most optimal routes to complete as many deliveries as possible in the shortest amount of time. Your neighbors won't wait forever!

Will you be able to get enough money and fulfill Toñita's dream?

Story Mode

Help Toñita fulfill her dream in the game's main mode.

  • Seven playable days.

  • Various events that will change the way you get around the town.

  • Side-missions that can help you with extra money (if you need it).

  • Substories that will help you get to know your neighbors better.

  • A story with Latine flavor, featuring elements of southern Chile and Latin American wildlife.

Arcade Mode

Get the highest score and become the best Toñita in this chaotic endless mode where every delivery gives you extra time. Don't let the time run out!

Free Roam Mode

Looking for something more relaxing? No time limit, no deliveries to make, no worries. Practice your biking skills, discover shortcuts and enjoy a chill ride through Toñita's hometown in the Free Roam mode.

data.name: D3AD HAND
data.detailed_description:
D3AD HAND now includes R3D STAR - a full new bonus and more challenging adventure featuring hours of new content!

Crack the code, feed the cat, save the world.

D3AD HAND is a darkly comedic point-and-click adventure set in a crumbling Cold War missile base deep in Siberia. You are Yuri Spraytyvich, freshly appointed Junior Strategic Missile Force Manager, tasked with holding together the decaying Čerëmuški Command Post.

But when PERIMETER-the Soviet automatic defense system-mistakenly initiates a nuclear launch, it’s up to Yuri (and your wits) to stop the end of the world. Navigate sabotage, radiation, worker strikes, and absurd bureaucracy in a race against doomsday.

R3D STAR: Uncover the fate of Sputnik and thwart the devious plans of Major Perestrova in your continued quest to prevent global annihilation.

◉ Unique alternative history setting and pixel art style. 

◉ Tongue-in-cheek humour.

◉ Elegant point 'n' click control of character.

◉ Ideal for newcomers to the genre, familiar and nostalgic for veterans.

◉ Multiple different endings to discover.

◉ Play as Stalin (the cat) in R3D STAR to help Yuri using your feline skills!

data.name: Jupiter Junkworks
data.detailed_description:
Set in a high-tech future among Jupiter’s moons, the story follows Ryla, Grant, and Jun—a misfit trio from vastly different corners of the solar system. After an unexpected twist of fate leaves them broke and stuck with a run-down spaceship salvage yard, they’ll have to work through their differences and pool their skills to turn Jupiter Junkworks into something worth fighting for.

As you progress, you’ll uncover secrets about their pasts, their motivations, and maybe even why the junkyard’s last owner vanished without a trace.

Fast, strategic, and satisfyingly crunchy—Jupiter Junkworks brings classic arcade puzzle vibes with a fresh sci-fi twist. Complete contracts to earn resources and unlock upgrades in both gameplay and story.

SLAM

Slamming blocks is at the heart of Jupiter Junkworks’ arcade puzzle action. Every slam lets you shear off parts of existing blocks or compress gaps beneath them—essential techniques you’ll need to master to succeed. It’s also how you recharge your power-ups, so keep slamming and keep the momentum going!

MATCH

Match colored bits to collect valuable resources and trigger block tumbles! In many challenges, collecting these bits is your primary objective—often more important than simply clearing rows. They also carry over into the campaign, so going above and beyond your contract goals means extra resources to invest in upgrades and progress.

CRUSH

Strategic placement and timing are key, as building massive rows and chaining combos together will earn you greater rewards and help you complete contracts faster. But there’s a twist: every crushed row fuels your heat meter, gradually ramping up the pace and intensity. As your heat rises, so does the speed of incoming blocks, pushing your reflexes and decision-making to the limit.

SMASH

Unlock a growing arsenal of tools designed to obliterate blocks and boost your strategy. One of the first at your disposal is the Rail Driver which compresses everything in a block-wide column, clearing space and setting up massive plays. Each powerup can be used to create a unique loadout tailored to your playstyle, whether you prefer calculated combos, brute force, or chaos-fueled improvisation.

Join Ryla, Grant, and Jun as they band together to make the most of their unexpected new life at Jupiter Junkworks. Hailing from wildly different corners of the solar system—a Mars orbital workyard, Earth’s sprawling megacities, and a commercial pilot training fleet—they’ll need to overcome their differences to have any hope of success.

As your team grows closer, so does the mystery behind Jupiter Junkworks. What really happened to the last owner? And what will you do when you finally uncover the truth?

data.name: Stream Skate
data.detailed_description:
StreamSkate is a third person platformer with multiple ways to travel through the facility.

You play as Ellie whose home planet was invaded by alien robots who for some reason desire to transform all life into mechanical slaves. Ellie was captured by the robots along with bunch of animals. However, they underestimated Ellies capabilities and now face a prison break.

In StreamSkate you traverse through neon lit facility by utilizing special gear assigned to you. These include magnetic rollerblades designed to be used for wall sliding and gauntlets that give an ability to grapple on to certain objects. With these tools you can access different areas where all animals have scattered. Sometimes it is not tech but instead agility that is required to move forward and a quick ground slide is all that is required. All interactable surfaces are recognizable by their green coloring. Once you have discovered all animals and escorted them to their next destination, you can escape together through the white hallway.

This game was produced by a small student group from Ahlman Institute within 8 weeks. Development used students from both game technology and visual game design.

data.name: Capsize
data.detailed_description:
Capsize is a single player card game, take the place of a pirate captain heading for the most precious treasure of all times: the Cap of the Seas. Each pirate is represented by a card, starting with a base deck of 10 improvised pirates.

The combat is turn-based, for each enemy you will choose which is the best combination of pirates to send boarding the ship. Based on the combat result you will be able to promote your crew or recruit new pirates from the 5 different factions in the game: Krakens, Undeads, Dragons, Marines and Shamans, but be careful, if one of the pirates dies during the combat it will be removed permanently from your deck!
Build your deck following your personal strategy and try to become the new Pirate King.

Key Features:

  • Build Your Deck Of Pirates
  • 60 Different Pirates and more of 300 Cards
  • 5 Factions (for now): Krakens, Undeads, Dragons, Marines and Wilds each featuring a captain and a mascotte.
  • Recruit new pirates
  • Promote your crew members to unlock new powers
  • Turn-based combat
  • Roguelike structure
  • Single player

Embark on an epic fantasy adventure in SideQuest Hunters, an innovative Idle RPG Roguelite that plays in the corner of your screen. Designed for those who enjoy constant progression and wealth accumulation, this game allows you to venture into a magical world without interrupting your other activities.

- Multitasking: Enjoy the thrill of an RPG without having to dedicate long hours. Ideal for playing while doing other tasks in front of your computer.

- b]Hunt them all[/b]:Advance through the different areas defeating all kinds of enemies. Complete your record of monsters to be the best hunter.

- Sublime pixel art: Enjoy throughout your adventure amazing characters and environments with fantastic pixel-art by the great Rafael Matos.

- b]Automatic Battles[/b]: Engage in strategic battles that unfold automatically, allowing you to concentrate on managing and progressing your heroes.

- Infinity of items: Discover and purchase different items that will make every game feel unique. Build the perfect build to go where no one else has gone before.

- b]Continuous Progression[/b]: Close the game at any time and pick up your adventure where you left off.

data.name: Who Inked Me?
data.detailed_description:
Drink. Pass out. Get inked. Guess who did it.


The Sumo Association forbids tattoos. The yakuza on TV have gorgeous ones. So a few wrestlers sit down in the dojo with a bottle of sake...

Before he drinks, the next sleeper says what tattoo he wants ("a roaring tiger head", "a koi leaping through the waves"...). Then he falls asleep in the middle of the tatami, and everyone else grabs a tattoo machine and draws it on his sleeping body. Most of them can't draw.

How a round goes

  • The auction. Shake cards come up one at a time and the price keeps falling. The prize pot takes the money. Use a card later to shake the sleeper's dream and everyone who is still drawing.
  • The sleeper dreams. Trace a drunken dream with your needle without slipping off the line. Finish it and you wake up silently. Nobody is told.
  • The others draw. Lean in with a stencil marker, then a liner and a shader in ten ink colors. Keep an eye on his face. Is he still asleep?
  • He might be watching. Awake, he can quietly look around on a neck that stretches, or shut his eyes and pretend he's still out.
  • The tour. He moves the camera and everyone looks at each piece together. The game scores how well each piece matches the theme.
  • The accusation. The game picks the piece that looks least like the theme, unless he plays his catch card and picks one himself. He points at a face. Right: he tattoos that piece onto its artist, and the artist drinks next. Wrong: it stays on him, and he drinks again.
  • Two cups in a row and you're out. A match lasts four rounds at most. When someone goes down, the prize pot goes to everyone else by their points.

Features

  • Online party game for 4–6 players. Invite friends with a 4-letter room code, or meet strangers at a festival.
  • Shrine festival lobbies for up to 40 players, opened by players: wander around in a mask or show your face, sit down at a sake stall, toast, and head into a room together.
  • Your face on a big sumo body: upload a selfie once. It is processed on your own PC and becomes your wrestler's face. You can also play with the creator's face.
  • Shake cards: win them at the auction, then shake the dream and the hands of everyone still drawing.
  • 64 classic tattoo themes: tigers, dragons, koi, swallows, anchors, skulls and more.
  • Your skin keeps the score: every tattoo that stays on you is permanent and follows you from match to match.
  • Every match starts with a stake of in-game money. It can't be bought with real money or cashed out.
  • Voice chat with everyone in the room.
  • 13 languages.

Content note

Players draw freely on each other's characters, and drawings are not moderated. Faces made from selfies are visible to the other players in your room; in the festival lobby your face is only shown if you choose to, otherwise you wear a festival mask. Voice chat is available in rooms and in the festival, where you can hear players near you. Your microphone stays off until you agree to turn it on. Characters wear a traditional sumo loincloth.

data.name: Another World Series -Slit Mouth Woman VS AOONI-
data.detailed_description:
The first in the “Another World Series”, in which the protagonist solves a mystery while moving between different worlds.

A legendary modern ghost story vs. a legendary horror game!

Solve the mystery of the abandoned hospital without bein

Akashi Asanagi, a university student, wakes up on the 10th floor of an abandoned hospital.

While exploring the hospital, he encounters a blue monster called “Aooni”, and when he touches the mask that Aooni dropped, the hospital transforms into an alley, where he encounters a mysterious woman wielding a kitchen knife called “Slit Mouth Woman”.

Akashi is attacked by the two beings, but for some reason a battle breaks out between the Slit Mouth Woman and Aooni...?

School, cemetery, house...

Explore the various different worlds on each floor and use items and gimmicks to solve the mystery of the abandoned hospital.

Multi-endings are unlocked depending on the results of your play, and each floor also has fully voiced event scenes.

Why are the Slit Mouth Moman and Aooni fighting? Who will win? Who is Akashi himself?

Conquer all 10 stages and escape from the abandoned hospital.

■Main Characters

・Akashi Asanagi

A cheerful and slightly airheaded first year university student.

He finds himself in an abandoned hospital.

He has good reflexes.

・Ray Yuyami

Despite being in the fifth grade, she has a level of thinking and knowledge that puts adults to shame.

Build, expand and evolve your deck to explore an ever-changing world!

  • 40+ Spell cards.

data.name: Artemed
data.detailed_description:
Game World

  • The Black Echo: A global infection transmitted when supernatural whispers are heard. These whispers have a limited range of about 2 meters, creating constant tension in tight spaces or when encountering infected crowds.

  • Atmosphere: The game is set primarily at night, under moderate rain, adding a heavy and melancholic tone. The setting is dark and realistic, reflecting the despair of a collapsing world.

Story

The player takes on the role of Alex, a modest man living in an old apartment. After a tragic car accident that killed his family, Alex has been taking care of his niece, Lily, as her only guardian.

Gameplay

The player is immersed in an experience focused on:

  • Survival: Exploring hostile terrain and carefully managing limited resources.

  • Proximity and tension: The limited range of the Black Echo requires players to be vigilant about sounds and surroundings. Spatial awareness is critical to avoid getting too close to the infected.

  • Emotion: The game leans heavily on a poignant story, delving into themes like loss, guilt, and fragile hope.

Atmosphere

Constant rain, ominous shadows, and sinister whispers create a psychologically oppressive and immersive experience. The game draws from a somber and melancholic aesthetic, emphasizing the collapse of a once-familiar world.

The concept blends elements of horror, survival, and human drama, offering a rich, emotional, and tense experience.

data.name: Max Cross
data.detailed_description:
Half Man. Half Albatross. All Trouble.

Race through a hand-drawn world inspired by the golden age of arcade run-and-guns. Blast your way through relentless enemies, leap over deadly hazards, and see how far you can push your luck in a fast-paced endless adventure where no two runs are ever the same.

Every run throws new procedurally generated terrain, new opportunities, and new ways to become ridiculously overpowered. Mix and match 10 unique power-ups with 5 game-changing modifiers, creating over 50 possible combinations that can completely transform how you play.

Master the movement, learn enemy patterns, and keep your combo alive as you fight through three distinct worlds, each ramping up the chaos and difficulty. The further you make it, the bigger the score—and the harder the game hits back.

Whether you're chasing the perfect build or trying to top the leaderboard, there's always one more run waiting.

Features

  • Fast-paced arcade-inspired run-and-gun action

  • Hand-drawn visuals with a silly, over-the-top style

  • Procedurally generated levels—every run is unique

  • 10 unique power-ups to discover

  • 5 gameplay modifiers creating 50+ build combinations

  • Three worlds with escalating difficulty

  • Challenging gameplay that rewards skill and quick reflexes

  • Endless high-score chasing with massive replayability

UDO brings a familiar pixel art roguelike style with a unique easy to learn, hard to master gameplay mechanic.



Make each run unique by choosing between different suits and upgrades to shape your playstyle.

TepuLink is a 2D online creature RPG where you become a Summoner: a person capable of forming spiritual bonds with creatures called Tepus.

data.name: La Sima: The Blind Beacon
data.detailed_description:
A town on the edge. A beacon at the bottom.

La Sima: The Blind Beacon is an idle RPG of skills, equipment, and expeditions. Above ground, a frontier town lives on the work of its workshops and the discoveries of its adventurers. Below, a hundred floors of darkness hide creatures, settlements, and a beacon that went out a thousand years ago.

Prepare your descent

Chop wood, mine ore, fish, and turn your resources into food, weapons, and elixirs. Train 13 connected skills: what you produce on the surface determines how far you can travel underground.

Choose your gear, depth, and provisions before setting out. Your plan is fixed when the expedition begins; combat resolves automatically, and the chronicle reveals the journey floor by floor. Your decisions lie in preparation, the risks you accept, and what you learn for your next attempt.

Learn a chasm that remembers

Explore 100 floors across 10 biomes, eight side branches, and four elemental Maw dungeons with their own rules. Find three settlements in the depths and learn a fixed map, with routes and obstacles you can understand and share.

Discover 111 creatures in the bestiary. Their materials connect to recipes, upgrades, and quests: every discovery can offer a new way to prepare your hero.

Build something that lasts beyond each expedition

Grow the town, help its residents through 111 quests, and collect 628 items. Fill the Museum's displays, experiment with your equipment, and turn each prestige into a lasting inheritance through the Lineage Altar.

  • 13 idle skills linked through crafting, preparation, and equipment.
  • Automatic combat expeditions into a 100-floor chasm.
  • 100 floors, 10 biomes, eight side branches, and four elemental Maw dungeons.
  • 111 creatures, 111 quests, and 628 items.
  • A growing town, Museum, relics, and Lineage progression.
  • Offline progress, three save profiles, and full Spanish and English text.
  • One purchase, no microtransactions.

data.name: Fusion Cuisine Survivor
data.detailed_description:
Sōsaku Ryōri is Neo-Tokyo 3’s most prestigious culinary institute, drawing in thousands of the world’s best aspiring chefs every year. The secret of the school lies in its hidden methods of fusion cuisine, its graduates leaving with a prowess so formidable that some call it magic.

Now that will be put to the ultimate test, as the witch Lost Yolanda has assaulted the school. Students and instructors have been turned into sentient ingredients, obeying her every will ans Yolanda scours the institute for its secrets.

You are one of the last human students inside school grounds. Defeat Yolanda and her hench ingredients, save your classmates and the school!

Now we’re cooking

Your weapons are the cuisines of the world. Japanese fires a single precise shot. Italian orbits you with pasta wheels. Turkish is a shaving cone that never stops. Peruvian leaves acid pools that make everything standing in them take more damage. Moroccan… opens a gravity well and drags the room into it?

You can carry five. Choosing which five is the game.

Fusion makes everything better

Get two cuisines to level three and the right pair can be fused. Japanese and Peruvian make Nikkei. Chinese and Peruvian make Chifa. American and Mexican make Tex-Mex. Real culinary fusions meets new combinations.

Ten kitchens, ten sets of rules.

Every level fights you differently. Burners flare on a rhythm in the Sauté station. The Butchery floor is slick with grease. In the walk-in, standing still freezes you. On the last level the witch’s baleful eye is cast on you.

Each kitchen has its own surface, its own floor boss, and two minibosses of its own.

And more!

Meta-progression unlocks upgrades, new characters, new cuisines, new levels and more! Bring your cooking face, the witch won’t accept anything less.

data.name: VESSOUL
data.detailed_description:
Disclaimer: No AI has been used in the creation of this game, or its associated promotional materials.

Made from the clay of the Abyss, to reach the stars above

  • When the light inside you awakens, you find yourself in a dark abyss, surrounded by untended graves. Explore the narrow halls of the damp caves to reveal large underground labyrinths, all lined with mysterious specks of white light. Use the resources available to you to defeat the dark presence looming over the Abyss, and escape the dark underground, for even greater challenges await you on the surface...

  • A story-driven game with an arcade-style flair, with numerous NPCs to speak to, items to collect, areas and sub-areas to explore, and multiple possible endings.

A tightly-packed bundle of Action, Adventure, and Suspense

  • Hypnotic, high-stakes, and fast-paced game-play that blends puzzle and action elements.

data.name: みすずの国
data.detailed_description:
Misuzu no Kuni is a linear visual novel with no branching choices.

The story is presented through visuals and sound, and progresses by clicking through the scenes.

Estimated playtime is around 2 to 3 hours.

A replay gallery feature is included, allowing players to revisit visuals and listen to the original soundtrack experienced in the game.

The story is set in an alternate version of late 20th century Japan, where an imaginary autonomous region called the “Land of the Tengu” exists.

There, a girl named Misuzu enters the country and joins the training of the Tengu, leading to a fantasy school drama.

Various fantasy elements appear throughout the story, including divine beast-like spirits called “Bake,” a Tengu princess, and magical powers known as “Jintsuuriki.”

The game is available in Japanese only.

data.name: Bull3000VRTS
data.detailed_description:
Command armies in VR. Fight with your own aim. Win through strategy.

Bull3000VRTS is a competitive VR RTS-shooter where strategy meets direct combat. Command units in real time, move freely across the battlefield in VR, and personally influence fights with your own aim.

Built for 1v1 and 2v2 PvP, the game rewards both macro decisions and execution. Timing, positioning, map control, and mechanical skill all matter — not just army size.

Instead of traditional base building, battles revolve around contested building slots across the map. Secure territory with logistics units and deploy the structures you need where control has been earned.

The economy is built around three resources:

- Money – units and buildings

- Oil – vehicle movement

- Ammo – sustained combat

VR is not a gimmick. You control the battlefield physically: reposition yourself, change perspective instantly, and command from any angle.

The Ghost system enables precise unit control in VR — grab, move, and place commands directly in space while keeping combat readable.

Former allies. Identical forces. No faction advantage. Victory comes down to skill.

Features:

- Competitive VR RTS-shooter gameplay

- Tactical 1v1 and 2v2 PvP

- Contested building slots instead of base building

- Three-resource economy: Money, Oil, Ammo

- Full spatial control in VR

- Ghost-based unit control

- Tanks, robots, and alien forces

Development Note:

Bull3000VRTS is a long-term project focused on competitive PvP. Updates may include balance changes, maps, and system improvements. Solo features and AI opponents are exploratory.

data.name: Soul Stalker
data.detailed_description:
Soul Stalker is a bullet heaven roguelike where you assume the role of the steward of ghosts bound to eternal life on earth.

Wield 4 to 6 weapons simultaneously to fend off waves of apparitions determined to defeat your spirited friends. Choose from a diverse pool of 21 characters, 35 weapons, 84 trinkets, and 21 pets to craft your ultimate build!

Slay spooky souls, evolve your weapons, and progress through the Soul Stalker Society's hub to become an unstoppable force of nature.

Key Features:

  • Fast & Unique Runs: Each run in Soul Stalker offers distinct locales, ensuring no two ~25-minute runs are alike!

  • Metaprogression: Power up by completing quests in the overworld, purchasing starting equipment, and absorbing wisdom from the ghosts in the Soul Stalker Society's hub.

  • A Papery World: Immerse yourself in a visually striking papery art style, featuring 2D characters in a 3D cel-shaded world.

  • Survive: Each wave lasts between 30 and 60 seconds. Survive and gather as many resources as possible to upgrade your character at shops and campfires!

data.name: Between Empires
data.detailed_description:
Two centuries. One state. Every decision leaves a scar.

   Between Empires is a historical grand strategy game about governing a state through more than two centuries of upheaval from the dynastic world of 1700 to the fractured international order of 1936.

   You will not simply move armies and paint the map. Appoint ministers, balance competing interests, finance institutions, reshape the law, direct trade and industry, negotiate with rival powers, and decide which crises your government can survive.

   A concession made to save the treasury in 1700 may empower an elite faction in 1780, reshape a revolution in 1848, and determine your alliances in 1914.

   Ministers are not decorative portraits. Their ability, loyalty, office, and political position determine what your government can accomplish. Fill the great offices of state, manage rival personalities, and build a cabinet capable of carrying your plans through reform, war, and succession.

   The strongest policy on paper can still fail when the people responsible for it trust neither you nor one another.

   The National Fate system treats major decisions as part of your state's memory not as disposable bonuses. Reforms empower institutions. Compromises create factions. Emergency measures outlive the emergency. Their consequences may return years or generations later in new political, economic, and diplomatic forms.

   Alternative history is possible, but never free. To change the course of an empire, you must build the capacity, coalition, and legitimacy to survive the reaction that follows.

   Guide your country through five historical ages, from dynastic courts and mercantile rivalry to industrial power, mass politics, and total war. Develop technology, reorganize taxation, reform the law, expand production, and decide who benefits from modernization.

   Every gain creates pressure elsewhere. A richer state may become harder to govern. A stronger army may acquire political power. A reform that pacifies one province may set another ablaze.

   Compete across 2,000 provinces with 133 starting powers. Forge alliances and dynastic marriages, issue guarantees, create subject relationships, bargain over trade and territory, deploy spies, and wage war on land and at sea.

   Rulers, ministers, political movements, and rival states pursue interests of their own. History will not follow a script simply because you recognize the date.

  • Lead a continuous campaign from 1700 to 1936.

  • Govern through ministers, cabinet offices, laws, reforms, and institutions.

  • Balance taxation, production, trade, technology, and the competing demands of modernization.

  • Conduct diplomacy through alliances, guarantees, influence, subjects, negotiation, and espionage.

  • Raise armies, command fleets, and fight wars shaped by manpower, terrain, fortifications, logistics, and political endurance.

  • Follow the delayed consequences of your choices through events, cabinet meetings, and the world gazette.

  • Preserve the old order, reform it from within or build a state history never recorded.

About the Game

《东方：平野孤鸿》是一款休闲、轻度的“国风造景”游戏。

 

与《纪元1800》、《天际线》以及《庄园领主》等诸多优秀的模拟经营游戏不同，我们并没有设计非常严谨的经营逻辑与物流机制，而是将主要精力集中在造景方面，为此，我们制作了大量细节精美的国风建筑，并在场景中还原了许多祖国的大好河山和人文景观，此外，我们还加入了一点点轻度的经营玩法，请不要担心，它们的存在仅仅是为了让你的世界看起来更加生动鲜活。王小波先生曾在万寿寺一书中写道：“一个人只拥有此生此世是不够的，他还应该拥有诗意的世界。”，说得真好，而这也正是我们的初衷，希望大家可以凭借这些元素，在平野孤鸿的世界中打造出自己心中独一无二的、充满东方韵味的古代盛世。

 

亲爱的朋友，欢迎你来到鸿野县。

聚宝模式：

你需要通过合理经营获得更充裕的资金，以此来购买新地块扩大建造面积，在这个过程中，你可以抛开一些不必要的生存压力，安心地享受建造城市的快乐。

桃花源模式：

你将前往神奇的桃花源，这里没有任何生存顾虑，你完全可以安心地享受建造城市带来的快乐。同时，你还可以移山填海、劈地开河，打造独属于你的世外盛景，山川万物、镜花水月皆由你来掌控。
