data.name: Hellgate VR
data.detailed_description:
Right after the Halloween Battle
Due to invasion of demons the sky and the earth blackened in London, trees disappeared, buildings collapsed badly, and rivers dried up to the bottom.
Survivors begin a community life under the command of Templar Maxine to find ways to survive.
Years later, community life, which began to escape the eyes of demons, began to reach its limit due to insufficient resources. Dreaming of a counterattack against demons, people made many anti-aircraft guns, but the first enemy of the Salvation Army was the survival of humanity, not the demons.
After much consideration, the Salvation Army leadership will carry out ‘Operation CLAPHAM’ to air-deliver food and water stored in London underground shelters to the Templar base.
Since the London underground shelter is located in the northwest and southwest regions far from Templar Base, there is a high risk of being spotted by demons during the operation.

However, there is now no place to hide anymore.
For the survival of mankind, at the risk of their own lives, someone has to go out of the shelter.



Hellgate VR is a VR Shooting game based on Hellgate:London IP, and provides a high level of immersion to players through a sophisticated virtual world.
> You can experience the post-apocalyptic atmosphere of Hellgate:London more vividly in a sophisticated virtual world.
> Experience the battle against demons by boarding a vehicle, train, or helicopter.
> Experience dangerous cliff roads and dynamic water slides.
> Experience realistic battles with giant bosses.



Experience endless action in the Hellgate VR world full of dynamic stories that take place for the survival of mankind in the battle against the devil.

data.name: Mindscorn
data.detailed_description:
A psychological survival horror where you play as disgraced journalist Oswald Weeby, who has lost his job and his wife after a lifetime of chasing fame and people’s approval. As a result, he believes he can fix his life by uncovering the mystery behind the disappearances at the Royal Veil Hotel — a famous ongoing conspiracy case with no answers. Even the police have failed to solve it, with many officers disappearing during their investigations.

Experience the Horror

Encounter strange creatures and carefully navigate the hotel, as these creatures will chase you down and devour you.

Combat & Ammunition

Keep count of your bullets and fire only when necessary, as you will have to manually insert each bullet yourself.

Exploration

Explore your surroundings and search for loot across the map. You will need every resource you can find to fight off the horror.

Inventory Management

Manage your inventory and resources carefully, as there are only limited supplies to survive.

data.name: EdgeLords
data.detailed_description:
Teetering on the brink of existance lies the realm called the 'Edge'. Inhabited by only the hardiest of sorceresses. But there's only room for one EdgeLord!

EdgeLords is a boss-rush strategy card game with card battler and deck-building elements, where two sorceresses fling spells at one another and summon minions to fight for dominance.

A totally unique take on the deck-building genre, with hundreds of cards to discover and play! As well as climax powers that unleash devastating abilities!

Enjoy a fully voiced and animated hentai animation for every opponent you defeat on your path to total supremacy as you harvest their 'essence' and seduce them into subservient thralls draped around the Edge Lord throne.

Death. Doom. Destruction. All will fall before her Dark Legion as she instigates the apocalypse and ends the world. Deathgrip is a gothic duluhan and her signature attack Reaper's Blade, which gains a Soul Gem card each time its played.

Under the hidden grove, deep within the tree of life lies the fountain where Melonie, the love fairy can be found. Her volumptious body is irresistable, giving her opponent's decks Temptation cards that are often too good to turn down.

The most powerful warlock in the realm. Ashka is an arrogant, smug brat. Her spells are devastating, especially Concussive Blast - each time its played, its damage increases!

Emerging from the flaming portal in the forbidden woods, Lilith is an assassin sent from the demon realm to claim the title of Lord. What she lacks in magic, she makes up for in action economy. Brace yourself for Hedonic Rush, which usually precedes another attack straight away.

Features

  • 300+ playable cards

  • 100+ summonable glyphs, allies and minions

  • 4 playable characters, each with 4 erotic outfits that change their deck archtype

  • 12 unlockable fully animated, multi-stage, interactive hentai loops

  • 40+ Full Screen Still CGs with alts

  • Steam Achievements

  • Three game modes (Classic, Gauntlet and Puzzle) and a fourth (Pro-Create) in beta!

  • Multiple languages supported

  • Custom full illustration by DankoDeadZone

  • Full voice acting from Vexoria The Sun Eater (Deathgrip), GinnyFantasy (Melonie), Wubcake (Ashka) and GinaGalore (Lilith)

data.name: Mystery Box VR: Hidden Secrets
data.detailed_description:
Interact with objects, handles, buttons, and wheels on each side. Crack enigmas and collect hidden puzzle tiles on a random side of the boxes.

You won't be able to compare reality with fiction!

Once you unlock all 8 boxes of a Level Pack, you can compose a puzzle and discover a brief history of an invention.

It's not always easy to escape the room, so use all your IQ to crack the riddles. There's a logic behind all of them, even where it seems it's not!

Play the game with your headphones to get immersed in this amazing adventure.

Got stuck on some enigma? No worries, you can still get a helpful hint! You can also get in touch with me in case you really can't make it through a riddle, I'll be glad to help ;)

Available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, and Japanese.*

*The game language will change automatically based on the language settings of your device

If you like my works, consider leaving a review here on Steam, your support will be greatly appreciated!

data.name: Pourhouse: Last Call Is Your Call
data.detailed_description:
Last call is your call.

Behind the bar, you're the only thing standing between a good night and a total disaster. Customers seat themselves and place their orders, and it's on you to keep them happy, keep them served, and keep them from tipping over the edge. Keep an eye on the intoxication meter and decide when a customer has had enough, or deal with the consequences.

Pourhouse is a fast-paced time-management sim where every shift gets a little more chaotic than the last. Serve your customers before they wander off annoyed, keep their drinks coming, watch their intoxication climb, and cut them off before it's too late.

There's no other bar game quite like it: most bar sims on Steam go for a slow, first-person 3D experience. Pourhouse is a 2D pixel-art time-management game through and through. This is pure old-school arcade energy, sometimes dressed up in a neon-purple glow.

Key Features

  • Serve, cut off, repeat. Fast, escalating time-management gameplay built around one simple rule: don't let anyone hit the floor.

  • 40 levels of mounting chaos, each one busier and less forgiving than the last.

  • 4 unlockable bars, each with its own look, crowd, and curveballs.

  • Upgrade your bar with a jukebox, an arcade machine, and more to keep waiting customers happy instead of storming out.

  • Power-ups when you need them most. An energy drink helps you zip faster for a while, a multiplier helps you strategize so you can get more points from each customer for some time, and more.

  • A pixel-art world built to feel like your favorite late-night dive, minus the real hangover.

data.name: Super Mutant Alien Assault
data.detailed_description:
Three fleets of spaceships flee a doomed Earth carrying the last humans in cryostasis. Pursued by aliens, it’s up to the lowly security droids to save humanity. Taking up arms solo or with a friend, you must dance with death in a brutal and addictive arcade platformer shooter inspired by Super Crate Box and stuffed to the brim with unlockables.

Fight through rapid fire single screen levels each with a random combination of platform layout, objective, vending machines and enemies. Dodge and weave amongst the aliens to stay alive but don’t leave them standing too long or the ship’s radiation will mutate them into bigger, nastier versions.

Only by unlocking and mastering the wild variety of weapons, explosives, special abilities, defense moves and perks can you hope to survive across all three galaxies, rid your ship of the mutant menace and save the oblivious humans.

Features

- rapid fire levels give you no rest as hordes of enemies arrive, hell-bent on your destruction. Clear the objective quickly and be sure to kill each enemy before it has the chance to mutate into a bigger, nastier version of itself. Take a tiny breather and then it’s on to the next room.

- in the tight confines of the space freighter, standing still is not an option. Your ability to dodge around enemies is as important as your aim. Survival requires quick thinking and rapid reflexes and a true master of the dance is a beautiful thing to behold.

- each single screen level is randomised, drawing on a pool of platform layouts, objective types and enemies as well as which vending machines will be present. You’ll never know which weapons or grenades will spawn in the vending machines whilst crate drops containing special abilities, sidearms, perks and defense moves are also random, adding further to the mind-boggling possible combinations.

- a wealth of weapons, sidearms, special abilities, perks, explosives, defense moves and character skins awaits you. Each new unlockable joins the melting pot of random ingredients, increasing your options but also the need to master each individual element and the way they combine with each other.

- take on the mutant hordes by yourself or team up in local co-op. Two player adds further complications to master as you must be careful to avoid friendly fire from explosives and will have to share/fight over item and health pack drops.

data.name: Mysterious House
data.detailed_description:
Mysterious House is a captivating logic platformer where you solve puzzles, navigate obstacles, and use teleporters to progress through levels. Your main goal is to reach the teleporter, but the path is filled with challenges like closed doors, pits, and destructible blocks. You'll be assisted by helpers who can open doors and mimic your actions, but they need protection as they aren't very bright. With colorful graphics, engaging gameplay, and a variety of levels, this game offers a blend of strategy and platforming that keeps you on your toes.

Key Features:

  • Challenging Puzzles:

    Solve intricate puzzles to navigate through each level.

  • Unique Helpers:

    Helpers can open doors and mimic actions but require careful protection.

  • Vibrant Graphics:

    Enjoy colorful and detailed environments that enhance the gaming experience.

  • Engaging Gameplay:

    A mix of platforming and logic challenges keeps the gameplay fresh and exciting.

  • Varied Levels:

    Each level presents new challenges and requires creative solutions to progress.

data.name: Bad Football
data.detailed_description:
A football game for people who hate football games

Bad Football is a super fast arcade football game with no rules. Boot the referee to kick off, then do whatever you want on the pitch. Land brutal tackles, roam beyond the touchline, and demolish the goal with overpowered shots. The game has simple controls but a high skill ceiling.

Game modes in early access

Online PvP

Play 1v1 against strangers or invite a friend, with public invite links they can play for free directly in their browser.

Quick Match

Take on the CPU across 3 difficulty levels, or face a friend in local 1v1. Share a keyboard or plug in two controllers.

Worst Cup

Pick one of the 48 national teams, battle through the group stage and knockout rounds, and lift the trophy as the best team in the world.

 

Upcoming features

  • Training: Learn some tricks at your own pace.

  • More game mechanics with items and power-ups

  • Create and share your own teams

  • Refined gameplay based on your feedback!

data.name: A Week Before Autumn
data.detailed_description:
JOIN THE PARTY

Home to abandoned buildings, bowling alleys stuck in time, and overflowing thrift stores downtown, Pine Hill is a quiet Midwestern college town. Quiet enough that nobody seemed to hear Ginny Nicholson die. The fine arts students at Pine Grove University felt it the most, but, to you, that isn't enough. You want to know why.

At Halloween party turned night of awkward conversation and mournful drinking, Alex searches for answers in the memories of Ginny's friends, unraveling things about themselves, their hometown, and Ginny that they never knew.

A Week Before Autumn is an interactive narrative game about grief, queerness, and rediscovering the people and places we call home. Featuring a cast of 15 queer characters with hundreds of lines of dialogue to explore, choose your path to uncover more about Ginny and her friends. Make your way through 70 locations across Pine Hill and find a little something to do, whether it be skateboard racing, baking, or recording an indie film. Hop through the memoires of Ginny's friends and collect photos and trinkets to remember not just her, but what she did for you.

After all, you were her friend too. The memories of others can only distract you from the pain of your own for so long.

SIT AND STAY A WHILE

  • Join the party: explore the stories of 15 unique characters

  • Choose your path: learn about characters through hundreds of choices

  • Much to do: from bowling to taking photos to fighting with foam swords, Pine Hill has minigames galore

  • Visual novel-like gameplay

  • Collect photos and trinkets

data.name: GAMES Duel（ガメスデュエル）
data.detailed_description:
『GAMES Duel（ガメスデュエル）』は、9×9マスの盤上で個性豊かなガメスを率いて戦う

ターン制ストラテジーゲームです。

ガメスを錬成し、自分だけの編成を作り、相手の王を討ち取りましょう。

【ゲームタイトルからガメスを錬成】

Steamにインストールされているゲームタイトルをもとに、そのタイトル固有のガメスを錬成できます。

どんな姿で、どんな能力やスキルを持ったガメスが生まれるのかは、錬成してからのお楽しみ。

お気に入りのゲームタイトルから生まれたガメスを集め、自分だけの編成を作り上げましょう。

【同じ種族でも異なる個体】

ウルフ、コボルト、スケルトン、ゴーレム、ケットシー、ドラゴンなど、さまざまなガメスが登場します。

同じ種族でも、能力やスキルの組み合わせによって個体ごとの特徴は異なります。

新たなガメスを錬成し、それぞれの長所を活かした編成を考えてみてください。

【9×9マスのターン制バトル】

ガメスは盤上を移動し、攻撃可能な相手がいれば自動で攻撃します。

どこへ進むか。

どのガメスを召喚するか。

どの敵を優先して倒すか。

移動範囲、攻撃範囲、種族ごとの特徴、さまざまなスキルを組み合わせ、盤面を有利に進めましょう。

相手の王を倒せば勝利です。

【ストーリーモード】

王立環境調査団の戦闘調査員となり、各地で発生する異変を調査します。

過去に消えたはずの呪い。

再び現れた場所。

かつて失われた国。

一見すると無関係な異変を追ううちに、それらはやがて一つの大きな事件へと繋がっていきます。

物語を進めながら、さまざまな特殊ルールや敵との戦闘に挑みましょう。

【CPU戦・オンライン対戦】

編成したガメスを使ってCPUとの対戦を楽しめます。

オンライン対戦では、他のプレイヤーとそれぞれの編成を持ち寄って対戦できます。

お気に入りのガメスを集め、自分だけの戦い方を見つけてください。

data.name: REINCARNAGE
data.detailed_description:
A RABID GUN-GAME...
There is no reloading - Juggle between stolen weaponry and discard empty guns straight into enemy faces! Execute powerful kill animations to regain health and dash across the arena! Combat in REINCARNAGE is a dance of balance where enemies can be both your ammunition, your lifeline and your demise.

...AT THE END OF EARTH.

data.name: Lance A Lot: Enhanced Edition
data.detailed_description:
Grab your couch and your friends and get ready to lance a lot. Lance A Lot® is a fast-paced local multiplayer game about jousting. Except you’re on rockets. Because let’s face it, knights on rockets are way cooler. And if anyone says otherwise, then challenge them to a duel and prove them wrong!

Glorious Features

  • Lance A Lot! You have a rocket lance that you can poke your friends with to cause a one hit kill. Or fire it from your hands to skewer them to the wall. We're pretty sure your friend deserved it.
  • SMASH. EVERYTHING. You have a Rocket Hammer to bash each other with. Smack them into things, take out all that internal aggression on the controller.
  • Interact with your environment. Bash rockets for an excessive amount of explosions. Don't like trees? Yeah, no one does, so break them with your hammer. You also have Holy Hand Grenades. Throw them. Throw all of them.
  • Change your playstyle with 4 different game modes and 6 different rulesets. You can fight over territory in King of the Hill until everyone is yelling at each other, or smack each other out of the arena in Sumo. We're pretty sure that's how rockets work.
  • Play solo against AI. They're pretty smart. A little too smart. Suspiciously smart.

data.name: Dead Soul TowerDefense:Shadow Labyrinth
data.detailed_description:
This is a pixel-style classic tower defense game that incorporates roguelike elements. You need to summon souls to fend off enemy attacks, and each type of soul has its unique skill tree, with skills randomly selected upon upgrading. The game features an endless mode where you must achieve the highest score possible to unlock more skill trees.

You can build your own unique maze.

8 unique defense towers, each with their own specialized skills: Steal, Slow, Stun, Critical Hit, Multi-Arrows, Bloodthirst, Poison Arrows, Armor Reduction...

Killing monsters increases your experience level. When you level up, you can randomly choose unique skills to build your own playstyle.

You can adjust the difficulty of the levels to achieve higher scores.

Upgrade your skill tree for permanent boosts!

Achievement system: Unlock more Soul Artifacts and challenge higher difficulties!

If you're interested, add it to your wishlist! That way, I'll be more motivated to release more updates!

If you have a better idea, please contact me by email! My

data.name: Geko: In Search Of The Big Fly
data.detailed_description:
Geko: In Search of the Big Fly is a 2D platform game where you take on the role of Geko, an adventurous lizard who always finds himself in grand journeys. This time, Geko spots a succulent fly that catches his attention and decides to pursue it, facing all the obstacles that come his way. Your mission is to help Geko dodge enemies and obstacles, such as cockroaches, rats, scorpions, wasps, spiders, and steam jets, encountered along the path. To achieve this, you'll need to climb walls and skillfully jump over enemies and obstacles until you reach the grand fly.

Features:

  • Simple Mechanics: Run, jump over enemies, and climb platforms until you find the big fly!



  • Many Levels: There are 40 unique, handcrafted levels for a fun and challenging experience.



  • Colorful Pixel Art Graphics: If you enjoy Retro-style graphics, you're in the right place! You'll be enchanted by the challenges presented through the game's level design.



  • Immersive Soundtrack: An exciting soundtrack that will awaken a sense of adventure in you!

  • Unlock Achievements: Achievement hunters will love unlocking the most challenging achievements in this game. There are a total of 18 achievements to earn.

data.name: Unplanned Love: Building Dreams Together
data.detailed_description:
A single night changes your life forever—after your graduation party, you’re shocked to find out you’re pregnant! This unexpected twist brings choices about love, responsibility, and the future.
The father? A stunningly handsome young star! From classmates to lovers, from pregnancy to parenting together—what kind of sparks will fly between you two?
In this adventure, you hold the reins of destiny. Raise your child from birth to 18, and grow from a novice writer to a renowned film director. What kind of child will you nurture? What kind of movies will you create?
Get ready for a sweet marriage, hilarious parenting moments, and building your career in the film industry as a power couple!

Game Features：

1.Novel Storyline
Ever experienced a marriage between a celebrity and an ordinary person? The plot is light-hearted and humorous, with elements like jealousy, pampering, and mutual growth, offering you a unique new experience!
2.Main + Side Storyline Setup
Main storyline: Romance a fresh young celebrity, side storyline: Romance a top detective. Which one do you prefer? You can choose your path according to your preference, and different choices will lead to different endings.
3.Collection of Illustrations
Complete different tasks in each stage, and for every challenge you conquer, you will collect a beautiful illustration.

Game Rules：

1.Three Development Gameplay Modes
Marriage Management: Interact with the characters you can romance, increase affection, and unlock sweet storylines.
Raising Children System: From pregnancy to your son turning 18, you control your child's personality and academic development, and can even choose a girlfriend for him!
Career Growth: You can choose to become a stay-at-home mom or a career-driven woman, even becoming a film director!
2.Four Special System Gameplay Modes
Banking System: Manage household finances and make smart investments.
Stock Market System: Earn funds by trading stocks to support the development of your family and career.
Outfit System: You need to choose different outfits for yourself to showcase your personality and enhance your attributes.
Gift System: Buy gifts to improve character affection, and also nurture friendships with your besties.

This game has a relatively fast pace completion time. It's my first game put onto the store and for a cheap price too. I hope you can enjoy it for what it is. Hence the name "Shambled Spiral" Its design is in first person and you will be expected to acquire weapons off enemies or in allocated areas to progress. It is currently only singleplayer with "possible" local hosting co-op in the future. I have implemented a couple of different image, sound and text triggers for a distinct immersion. The setting of the game is predominantly gloomy and medieval. There will be some difficulty, in a sense of slight puzzle solving.
If you buy this version, you will have access to the new and improved version on the new and improved engine, when I can get around to do it.
Don't expect anything crazy. All feedback is greatly appreciated. I wish for you to enjoy! Thank you

data.name: Dig Night
data.detailed_description:
【Story】

In a world plagued by Schizosoma—a flesh-splitting disease that turns people into ghosts—it's become normal for society to leave the cleanup to professional ghost sweepers.

Ricardo, a washed-up temp cleaner, takes a job scraping ghost flesh off the streets. It’s grim work... but it pays.

【About the Game】

  • Dig Night is an RPG made in RPG Maker VX Ace, blending dark comedy and surreal exploration with retro flavor.

  • A Strange World:

    Welcome to a city where ghostification is just another part of daily life. The atmosphere is both bleak and absurd.

  • Puzzle-Solving & Mental Realms:

    Ghosts linger not just in flesh—but in mind. Solve puzzles and dive into their inner worlds to uncover their pasts.

  • Narrative-Driven:

data.name: Misadventures of Laura Silver
data.detailed_description:
Pilsen, Czechoslovakia, 1935.

During the interwar period, detective and gun enthusiast extraordinaire Laura Silver and her companion, former police officer Orewell Cooper, are sent to Czechoslovakia to a rather peculiar investigation.

.

Their target? A mysterious creature lurking in the murky waters of Pilsen.

After their arrival, they are ready to investigate, disguised as two journalists. However, following a suspicious death in the hotel, their plans are interrupted.

Also, who is this lost child sitting out in the cold?

.

Features


  • 70.000+ words.
  • Eight hours of total gameplay.
  • Over 100 decisions.
  • Multiple endings.
  • Visual novel with minigame elements.
  • Available for Windows, Mac & Linux.

.

data.name: Jiaobei: Ask the Divine
data.detailed_description:
About Jiaobei:

Jiaobei is a traditional Chinese method of divination, also known as “casting jiao” or “casting beijiao.” It is mainly used to seek guidance from and communicate with deities. It consists of two crescent-shaped wooden or bamboo pieces, each with a flat side (yang) and a rounded side (yin). After they are cast onto the ground, the result is interpreted according to how they land:

One flat side and one rounded side is a “Sacred Cup,” which means the deity permits, agrees, or confirms, or that the situation will proceed smoothly.

Two flat sides is a “Laughing Cup,” which means the question was not asked clearly enough, or the deity is not giving a definite answer. The question should be reorganized and asked again.

Two rounded sides is a “Yin Cup,” which means the deity does not agree, it is not permitted, or the timing is not right.

In some regions, three consecutive Sacred Cups are regarded as a clear sign from the deity.

This desktop software uses a real physics engine to simulate the actual Jiaobei casting process, and the result obtained is the user’s real physical throwing result.

Notes for Casting Jiaobei:

  • Do not show disrespect toward the deities.

  • Before casting the Jiaobei blocks, please wash your hands and keep your body and clothing clean as a sign of respect for the deities.

  • Ask only one question at a time. Do not greedily ask several questions at once or ask questions that are vague or unclear.

  • Stay focused while casting the Jiaobei blocks. Do not talk to others, watch television, or think about unrelated matters.

  • Do not cast the Jiaobei blocks before you have finished stating your request or question.

  • Remember not to be suspicious, greedy, or fearful.

  • Make your question as clear as possible. A “yes or no” question is recommended.

  • Do not repeatedly cast the Jiaobei blocks for the same question or ask the same question again within a short period of time.

  • Jiaobei customs and confirmation rules may vary by region. You may follow local traditions and choose the method of consultation that is most appropriate for you.

Other Features:

Rich Jiaobei skins

Scalable Jiaobei

History record feature

data.name: The Undergrowth
data.detailed_description:
The Undergrowth is an online multiplayer survival experience where you begin life as a tiny, vulnerable creature in a massive ecosystem filled with danger, opportunity, and other players. Hunt, scavenge, grow, evolve, and carve your place in a brutal world where survival is never guaranteed.

Explore dense forests, dark underground tunnels, wetlands, cliffsides, rivers, and hidden nests as you battle both the environment and other players in intense PvP and PvE encounters. Every choice matters, whether you become a stealthy ambush predator, a territorial brute, or a fast-moving scavenger trying to stay alive another day.

Grow from hatchling to apex creature by managing hunger, thirst, stamina, injuries, and shelter while navigating a constantly changing ecosystem driven by real players and AI wildlife.

Survival in The Undergrowth is unforgiving.

Manage hunger, thirst, stamina, injuries, temperature, and exhaustion as you navigate a dangerous world where even smaller creatures can become deadly in the right situation. Search for safe water sources, protect your shelter, and avoid becoming prey while exploring a constantly evolving environment.

Weather, time of day, environmental hazards, and creature behavior all affect how you survive. Heavy rain may expose hidden tunnels while droughts can force predators and prey into the same shrinking water sources.

Death carries consequences, making every encounter meaningful.

Begin life as a weak juvenile and slowly grow into a powerful adult creature.

As you survive, hunt, and explore, your creature matures physically over time, unlocking improved abilities, increased strength, new behaviors, and expanded survival options. Your journey from vulnerable hatchling to apex predator is shaped by the choices you make and the dangers you overcome.

Every stage of life changes gameplay:

  • Juveniles focus on stealth and survival

  • Adolescents begin competing for territory and food

  • Adults dominate through strength, speed, or intelligence

Staying alive long enough to fully mature is an achievement on its own.

The world of The Undergrowth is filled with danger from both players and AI creatures.

Engage in brutal PvP encounters over territory, nests, food sources, and survival. Ambush unsuspecting prey, defend your group, or stalk enemies through dense vegetation and underground tunnel systems.

AI wildlife creates additional threats and opportunities throughout the world. Some creatures may flee at the first sign of danger, while others aggressively defend territory or hunt in packs.

Combat is immersive and grounded, rewarding positioning, timing, awareness, and strategy over mindless attacks.

The ecosystem is alive and constantly changing.

Creature populations shift based on player activity, migration patterns, hunting pressure, and environmental conditions. Predators influence prey behavior while scavengers benefit from the aftermath of battles and hunts.

Players naturally shape the world around them:

  • Overhunting can reduce prey populations

  • Territorial creatures can dominate entire regions

  • Group behavior changes how areas of the map evolve

  • Migration and nesting patterns create unpredictable encounters

No two play sessions feel exactly the same.

Explore a massive world built around verticality, danger, and discovery.

Travel through:

  • Dense forests

  • Underground cave systems

  • Rocky cliffsides

  • Rivers and wetlands

  • Abandoned burrows

  • Hidden nesting grounds

  • Dangerous open fields

Different environments support different creature behaviors and playstyles. Some creatures thrive in darkness and tight tunnels, while others rely on open terrain and speed to survive.

Secrets, hidden pathways, and environmental storytelling reward players willing to explore deeper into the world.

Customize your creature with detailed skin and appearance options.

Unlock and create unique skin patterns, colors, markings, and visual traits that allow you to stand out within the ecosystem. Blend into your environment with natural camouflage or create intimidating appearances that make your presence known.

Customization allows players to create creatures that feel personal while still fitting naturally into the world of The Undergrowth.

Future updates may expand customization with:

  • Rare skin variants

  • Seasonal cosmetics

  • Pattern editors

  • Creature-specific customization options

Survive alone or form groups with other players.

Create packs, colonies, hunting groups, or territorial alliances to increase your chances of survival. Cooperative gameplay allows players to coordinate hunts, defend nests, protect juveniles, and dominate territory together.

But trust is never guaranteed.

Betrayal, competition, and territorial conflict are always part of the ecosystem.

Every creature you encounter has its own goals and not all of them are friendly.

In The Undergrowth, you are not the hero.

You are simply another creature trying to survive in a world where everything is hunting something.

data.name: Soulstack
data.detailed_description:
Soulstack is a card-stacking RPG where everything happens by dragging one card onto another. You wake up in an unknown world and slowly start to explore the game like your character explores the world.

 

Drop your hero on a tree for wood or on a rock for stone, and feed spare cards to the Soulstone for XP. Put two parts on the workbench and see what comes out: 300+ weapons, from a stone on a stick to a hand-held ballista.

 

Drop your hero on a dungeon and the fight plays out on its own. Your weapon, your class and your pet decide how it goes, floor after floor of randomized enemy factions.

 

Find a strange creature, name it and pick its evolution path: 140 forms in all.

 

At each level cap you awaken into a new class. There are 48, and 9 of them are cursed.

 

In the City, the enchanting table turns a +5 weapon into a named artifact. You need the right one to evolve your class further.

 

Take quests from the village, then leave the Wilds for the City and the Monster-Lands and face the final boss.

 

Then step through the portal into a reshuffled world. Every class and pet form you discover unlocks a legacy perk, and you pick which ones to start the next world with. Your researched recipes come with you too.

 

A free demo covers the first act, the Wilds.

My next game - Keep Making Games

Now that Soulstack is out, Keep Making Games is what I'm working on next.

data.detailed_description:
A coastal town is overrun by horrors, and only YOU can save it!

YOU are a hunter; a man or woman of wealth and leisure who has turned their time to fighting the fiendish monsters that assail humanity. Approached by the poor villagers of Pale Harbour, and informed that a terrible evil has arisen from the sea, can YOU unravel the mystery and drive back the beasts?

A choose your own adventure novel in which your choices and actions can lead you to glorious victory...or ignoble defeat. Explore an original story with three challenging game difficulties, unlock hidden lore to better understand the world you enter, and enjoy the artwork you discover in the gallery.

This independently produced novel features a dark soundtrack (with optional atmospherics), as well as over 40 unique page images to unlock. The text of the game has also been recorded by a professional musician and story-teller, making it into an interactive audiobook. With no adverts, microtransactions or loot-crates, this is an old-fashioned, spine-chilling steampunk tale you can enjoy time and time again.

content_descriptors.notes:
The Hunter's Journals - Pale Harbour contains frequent references to violence throughout the content in the form of descriptive text.  The page images avoid directly referencing topics and content that would disturb younger players but cannot be considered suitable for viewers of all ages, even if they are presented without context in the gallery.  The voice over directly follows the text on screen and so should be turned off when at work or in the presence of sensitive individuals.

Overall the game contains mature themes and is not suitable for children.  However, all of this content is provided in the form of a dark fantasy novel with vivid descriptions of combat and it's effects on the human (and inhuman) body.  There are no cutscenes or animated violence, and the images have been selected and edited to keep them from being too extreme.  The game should be suitable for anyone who enjoys horror novels and Lovecraftian fiction.

data.name: Kill the horde
data.detailed_description:
Sir, times have changed—ninjas need gun licenses now. You’re a modern ninja. Ancient ninjutsu? You’ve got it. But who says a ninja can’t love shotguns? In this world, shurikens are too slow, and throwing knives need picking up; a full-auto rifle just makes sense. Welcome to “Senbonzakura” turned “Metal Storm”—honoring the most traditional identity with the fiercest firepower.

Two modes, double the fun (and double the reasons to retry).

Mission Mode: Sneak in, complete the objective, then—let’s be real—mostly you “accidentally” set off the alarm and shoot your way out. Stealth is a skill, but killing every witness is also perfect stealth, right?

Wave Survival: Enemies arrive like takeout, wave after wave—only they deliver a beating combo. You only breathe after clearing them all. Don’t ask how many are left; the answer is “until your finger goes numb.”

Kill enemies, get loot—makes total sense. Why do zombies drop coins? Why do soldiers carry brand-new shotguns? Doesn’t matter. What matters is every kill has a chance to drop gold and weapons—we call it “fallen comrades’ inheritance.” Take this windfall and enjoy a shopping spree—more addictive than payday.

Your arsenal dwarfs any ninja tool bag. From suppressed pistols to burst rifles, from one-shot sniper rifles to “great equalizer” explosives, your weapon choice is wildly free. Feel like a quiet assassin today? No problem. Want to shoulder a rocket launcher tomorrow and give zombies a little fireworks show? Absolutely. Your ninja path is decided by the bullets in your chamber.

Enemies do crossovers too? You face not only classic slow zombies but also soldiers who shoot and take cover. Picture this: you’re gracefully dodging bullets when a drooling zombie gives you a passionate hug from behind. This mixed tag-team of robot apocalypse and zombie outbreak keeps combat anything but boring.

Ready to inherit the ninja way? If traditional ninjas feel too hard and pure shooting too dull, this game—a forced fusion of assassination art and explosion art—is for you. Jump in, write a haiku with bullets, paint an ukiyo‑e with explosions. Remember our motto: a ninja’s ultimate secret techniques are cash power and heavy firepower.

data.name: Ulna Online
data.detailed_description:
Ulna Online is a free multiplayer electronic game (MMORPG) developed by Moscano. It started to be created in 2017. In it, players can develop the skills of their characters, search for treasures, solve puzzles and explore areas such as cities, dungeons, forests, deserts, islands, beaches, mines, etc. The characters can fight fights with each other or with creatures, such as monsters, dragons, demons, using weapons and spells.
When starting the game, your avatar starts on the island of Corbie, an island where every player must pass until he develops skills necessary for progress and survival on the other maps in the game. When the player reaches Corbie's last map, he can optionally choose his vocation and leave the island. In Cayman, the player becomes familiar with the game and learns many things about the world of Ulna Online, such as magic, equipment and etc.

Welcome to Pineside! 

• A Combination of Life Sim Adventure, RPG and Management

Build up an old Hotel to bring joy to your future guest´s and bring back it´s past success. On your Break you can explore Pineside, an modern town filled with residents to meet, story´s to experience and secret´s to uncover.

• Collecting, Customization and Management Gameplay

Collect new furniture and combine them to customize and improve the hotel guest room´s. Meet your guest´s expectations to earn money or try to gain happy point´s by starting your day with a vacuum cleaner to keep your hotel nice and tidy. Use your earning´s later to upgrade your hotel and tools.

• Live your Life and meet Characters with unique Story´s

Meet and befriend Pineside´s residents, each one with their own handcrafted story and questline. Make little presents or help them in their daily life to get closer and learn more about them.

• Get distracted by the many activities in Pineside

Next to building up your hotel you can easily get distracted by Pineside many activities like sidequest´s, the arcade, bug hunting, hotel gardening and much more.

data.name: Noir Syndrome
data.detailed_description:
Noir Syndrome is a procedurally generated Detective Murder-Mystery with a new story every time! Featuring slick pixel art animations and a jazzy soundtrack, the player is thrown right in to a highly stylized vision of film noir. Visit locations, interrogate suspects, search for clues, and eventually solve the case before the killer escapes - or you wind up dead yourself.

Features:

  • Procedural generation: Murder mystery scenarios with a new culprit and clues each time, every play-through is unique.
  • Permanent choices: NPCs, interactions, death, and a slew of other features will all persist until a new game is started. Every action counts!
  • Notebook: Collect vital clues in the detective's notebook to help narrow down suspects and solve the case.
  • Investigation: Interact with and examine numerous objects and characters in a number of environments in the search for more information on the killer.
  • Countdown: Given a set number of days to solve the mystery, each area visited will decrement the time left, adding to the urgency of every case.
  • Freedom of choice: Attempt to solve the case, or live out your remaining time doing as you please - be it fighting the law, going after gang members, or just seeing the city.
  • Gunplay: Combat is generally to be avoided as a single bullet will take down the player. However, when necessary, the revolver is always available for use.
  • Badges: Complete a variety of challenges to earn unique badges which directly influence future playthroughs.
  • Statistics and Scores: Statistics and high scores for a wide variety of topics will persist through every game.
  • Costumes: Multiple unlockable costumes can be earned in game. Play as the default male or female detective, or unlock a variety of new outfits.
  • Challenges: Optional challenges unrelated to the main case are generated each game. Every challenge completed provides permanent bonuses to all playthroughs.

data.name: Tokyo Tattoo Girls
data.detailed_description:
About the Game:
After a calamity befalls Tokyo, some of the city’s survivors find themselves with powerful abilities bestowed on them by colorful tattoos. The city is cordoned off from the world, its inhabitants isolated. To create peace, each of the city’s 23 Wards is controlled by a powerful group known as a “Clan.” Together, these Clans form the “Syndicate.” It’s rumored that escape from the devastated city is possible, but only for the person who manages to defeat all 23 Clans...

Key Features:
The Power of Tattoos - Choose your companion character to help you escape from Tokyo, and develop her abilities by giving her powerful tattoos.

A City to Conquer - Battle against the Syndicate to conquer all of Tokyo’s 23 Wards in the hope of escaping the city!

Gorgeous Tattoo Designs - Enjoy unique designs inspired by traditional Japanese tattoo art created by tattoo artist Koji Tanaka.

data.name: Sveta
data.detailed_description: Sveta is a satirical single-player narrative adventure set in the contemporary Serbian city of Novi Sad. The game follows a superstitious unemployed lad, Svetislav, nicknamed “Sveta”, as he investigates a mysterious sewage overflow and a sudden infestation of Neon Slimes. Along the way, he joins Jehovah’s Witnesses and embarks on a bizarre quest to find the legendary Pot of Greed, a myth that may hold the key to the source of the madness slowly consuming the city. Players explore stylized urban locations inspired by Novi Sad, including pizzerias, betting shops, apartment blocks, clinics, parks, cemeteries, and sewer tunnels. Gameplay focuses on quest solving, dialogue choices, item collection, environmental interaction, and meeting eccentric NPCs with their own agendas, stereotypes, rumors, and side stories.

data.name: Joker & Teacher
data.detailed_description:
“今天你们体育老师生病了！这节课测验！”
“没带？没带就是没写！”
“总有同学上课说话，连累整个班集体！”

《王牌班主任》是由刘祯浩先生主创的【您真内向工作室】（Introverted Studio)的新作品，延续了以往作品的现实主义与扮演感，并大胆设计角色反转，邀请你成为年少那个又爱又怕的老班，管理整个鸡飞狗跳的班级。

翻身上讲台，选择即转折

叫家长、占课、作业山和说明书……这些当年再常见不过的“被支配”式恐惧，却在游戏里变成你的主动权。
游戏里每天课程满满，学生状态随时变化，上一秒是学霸，下一秒就可能走神。你可以通过给学生「传授」学习技巧，提高学生能力。每周开「班会」，整顿学生风气。
你可能要应对领导的突击检查、关心学生之间的小团体关系。而最重要的是，你的关心和辅导，甚至课外活动都会影响学生一学期甚至一生的转折。

学生养成，多种结局

每个学生的属性都大相径庭，擅长的科目和能力点也都各有差异。李雷上课传纸条，韩梅梅测验爱睡觉？你可以把学生叫到办公室耳提面命，也可以主持班聚，和学生打成一片。

data.name: Whispers Between Worlds
data.detailed_description:
I can't let you die... there's still so much we have to do together...

 About

Whispers Between Worlds is a story-driven puzzle JRPG that follows Yui, a young boy born with the ability to see spirits. After being banished to the Spirit Realm for reasons yet unknown, Yui must return to the living world and reunite with his loved ones, all while confronting and resolving his past.

A story of hope, responsibility, and repentance, the Spirit Realm is interwoven with a myriad of lifetimes and stories. And once Yui reaches his fated encounter with the one lying at the bleeding heart of this realm, will he prevail, or despair?

 Features

  • Defeat powerful foes wielding unique alchemy, with an engaging turn-based QTE combat system!

  • Befriend dozens of peculiar spirits, and record their entries in your sketchbook!

  • Unlock powerful blessings, and stockpile alchemy to mix-and-match creative play-styles.

  • Cross-dressing! Wait what?

  • Explore a mysterious and magical world, with puzzles and traps strewn along the way.

...

You can only hide the truth for so long.

data.name: The Cruciball
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to The Cruciball

The Cruciball is a physically controlled action roguelike played by throwing balls at enemies that are projected onto a wall in the real world! You journey across many magical stages and unique environments, collecting powerful upgrades to suit your play style. Use your strength and upgrades to defeat challenging and unique boss fights! You'll solve puzzles and unlock secret stages where peril and prize await. Grow your strength with powerful upgrades, refine yourself in The Cruciball, and save your pet from the nefarious Warlock!

IMPORTANT: Requires a projector and 2 web cameras. The Cruciball is controlled by physically throwing balls in the real world at targets that are projected onto a wall using the projector. The thrown balls are then tracked by the cameras to create 'hits' in game.

Features:

  • 9 unique stages to explore, all with their own special challenges, enemies, and boss fights to face.

  • 11 exhilarating boss fights, and over 30 different enemies to defeat.

  • Over 40 unique and powerful upgrades to obtain, collect and stack them together to suit your play style and achieve ultimate power!

  • A fun, exciting, and challenging way to exercise and improve your health.

  • Balanced for both singleplayer and multiplayer.

  • Cooperative and competitive multiplayer modes.

  • Just as fun for kids birthday parties as it is for elite athletes looking to improve their skills!

  • An innovative physical "beyond virtual reality" game-play experience.

The Cruciball is capable of tracking multiple balls at once from multiple throwers, allowing for unlimited group fun! It uses a pair of high speed cameras to detect throws and track where the balls hits the wall. The Cruciball works best with a dedicated arcade set-up, ceiling mounted projector, and recessed cameras; but it can be brought anywhere with just a laptop, projector, and a pair of tripods for the camera. It's an amazing addition to any arcade, video bar, day-care, elite gym, or even or your own basement!

Experience the thrill of one class with three playstyles. Switch at any time between three forms: Werewolf, Wereraptor, and Human Arcanist. Enjoy a whole new kind of fun!

[Seamless Across Three Devices, Take the World with You]
- Switch seamlessly between your phone, tablet, and PC anytime, with your progress perfectly synced—sneak in a session at work, kick back and play at home, or tackle new content late into the night. One world has it all.
- Enjoy PC-grade visuals with performance fully unleashed and support for an ultra-smooth 120 FPS experience! No delays in open-world PVP, no stutters during dungeon combos, skills always at your command, and the entire world just a tap away!

-Free stat resets forever! Free resource retrievals! Say goodbye to grinding and spending. Enjoy the world stress-free!
-Refine Safely without Breaking: With no level loss on failure, your gear stays intact! Reach +15 with confidence. No more hitting that Refine button in fear!
-Earn Resources While Offline: While you sleep, your character continues the hunt! While you work, resources quietly pile up. Idling automatically accumulates resources, making you stronger even when you're resting!

[Change Jobs Anytime]
-Be a tank and get chased by a boss today, heal your teammates tomorrow—play however you like! Your adventurer will never need a do-over!

data.name: 群魔死欲之山
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Death Mountain

In this game, you’ll follow the perspective of May, a battlefield nurse trapped in a medical camp deep within a snowbound mountain range on the brink of collapse.
In the desperate cold and dwindling supplies, a mysterious letter presented by a prisoner of war becomes the last thread of hope for everyone.

On this path to survival, former enemies may become allies, and trusted friends may harbor secrets.
You’ll need to gather information to gradually uncover each character’s past and inner thoughts.
Your choices will shape the fates of everyone involved.

Gameplay Features

● A 2D adventure game focused on map exploration and narrative puzzles.
● Investigate items scattered across the map and converse with those around you.
● The clues you uncover will be added to each character’s profile, slowly revealing the truth behind their relationships and past events.
● If you wish to unravel the mountain’s dark secrets, talk more with those around you—
after all, they may know far more than they’re willing to say.

Art Style

● The game combines traditional 2D hand-drawn art with pixel-style graphics.
● Chibi characters move through flat maps, offering a distinct experience from the character portraits.
● Our team has hidden various material elements as Easter eggs within CG cutscenes.
Every decision you make may unlock different visual styles—feel free to explore and discover them all!

Characters

● Name: May
Age: 19
Role: Battlefield Nurse

● Name: Solia
Age: 16 (self-proclaimed)
Role: Battlefield Nurse

● Name: Andre
Age: 17
Role: Captured Youth

● Name: Edmond
Age: ??
Role: Deranged Soldier

data.name: Super 10 Pin
data.detailed_description:
Strike your way through a wild world of bowling in Super 10 Pin! Explore a diverse range of 64-bit styled bowling lanes, filled with curves, jumps, traps, obstacles and surprises! Make your ball grow, fly through the air, and even explode as you master unique ball abilities to overcome any obstacle thrown your way.

Features

  • Control is Key
    Master Super 10 Pin's unique bowling mechanics to steer your ball into the perfect position! Timing a perfect throw will fill up your invaluable "Spin" meter, used to control your ball as it speeds down the lane!

  • Over 50 Wild Lanes
    Bowl on lanes that defy gravity, challenge your skills in obstacle-filled gauntlets, and roll your way through unexpected surprises in locations you've never imagined!

  • The Right Ball for the Job
    Keep an eye out for special ball pickups as you head for a strike, they have powerful abilities that will help you surmount any obstacle on your quest for the perfect game.

  • Collectables and Unlockables
    Aim for perfect scores to unlock new worlds and lanes. Collect challenging bonus stars to score an immediate strike, and unlock stylish new bowling balls!

  • Local Hotseat Multiplayer

    Play with up to 8 local players and compete for the perfect game!

data.name: Another Round
data.detailed_description:
Overview

Welcome to The Old Fashioned, the local spot for off-the-books biz. We’re neutral ground for folks from all walks - pink mohawks, black trenchcoats, mirrorshades, even corpo suits. If you've got money & intel to share, you've got a seat here. Can I get you another round?

Set in a dystopian near-future which - a few years earlier - experienced a cataclysmic, global system crash, Another Round is a deckbuilder / slots-style game, where you work to grow your cyberpunk clientele and attract unique and interesting personalities to your cause.

How to Play

Each night, your customers arrive to do biz, play, chat, and get sloshed.

Customers are happiest when they are seated correctly. After the first round of folks arrive and seat themselves, you pick who sits where in the second and third rounds.

At the end of the night, you gather resources from every customer seated. If you have made any combos - 3 of a Kind, Straight, Flush, or Straight Flush - then you can generate and update the customer cards in your deck.

Every two nights, you will face a random event... many of which require you to make tough choices. And at the end of a month, if you survive, you win!

Features

  • Each night is a three-round, tactical experience with a focus on finding poker-based combos to progress.

  • Add, remove, and upgrade/downgrade cards strategically: include too many cards or change your deck too often, and you'll break your combo-making ability!

  • Over fifty unique Events and a dozen interesting Characters, all housed in a rich narrative background filled with cyberpunk-inspired references.

  • We've brought you our absolute best puns, jokes, and other ridiculous cultural callbacks throughout the game.

  • This is classic roguelike gameplay with no game-by-game metaprogression... You're always welcome, though, so keep coming back as long as it takes!

data.name: Wind Tunnel Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Unleash your inner engineer and artist in Wind Tunnel Simulator! Have you ever wondered how a Formula 1 car slices through the air, or what makes an airplane fly? Now you can discover it for yourself!

In our game, you get to be the designer. Using intuitive, clay-like sculpting tools, you can craft anything you can imagine - from sleek sports cars to futuristic aircraft, or even just delightfully weird shapes. There are no limits to your creativity.

Once your design is ready, take it to the state-of-the-art wind tunnel. With the press of a button, you can watch a beautiful, real-time simulation of the airflow around your creation. See how the air bends and swirls, and get instant feedback on its aerodynamic performance. Is your design a champion of speed, or a master of flight?

Key Features:

  • Intuitive 3D Sculpting: Mold, shape, and combine objects with ease. It's like playing with digital clay!

  • Realistic Physics: Our advanced physics engine shows you exactly how your designs will behave in a wind tunnel.

  • Stunning Visualizations: See the invisible! Watch airflow, pressure, and velocity in real-time with beautiful, easy-to-understand visual effects.

  • Challenging Levels: Test your skills with a series of puzzles that will push your design abilities to the limit.

  • Sandbox Mode: Don't like rules? Jump into the sandbox and build whatever you want, with no objectives to worry about.

  • Share Your Creations: Save your favorite designs and show them off.

Whether you're a curious gamer, a budding designer, or a physics enthusiast, **Wind Tunnel Simulator** offers a unique and satisfying experience of creation, testing, and discovery.

data.name: Novice Dungeon Master
data.detailed_description:
Novice Dungeon Master is a turn-based strategy simulation management game.

It's a game where the protagonist, who used to explore beginner dungeons, becomes the master of a dungeon due to a contract and manages the dungeon for 30 days, set in a fantasy world with dungeons, adventures, monsters, and guilds.

Various types of adventurers visit the dungeon.

And they visit the dungeon for different purposes.

Herbs and minerals, battles and treasures, dreams and hopes...

Anything is possible in the dungeon.

So how do you send them back?

There are various methods. For example,

you can place facilities they desire...

Or set up traps...

Or you can place monsters.

If they are satisfied in the dungeon, word will spread and the dungeon's popularity will increase, which means more adventurers will come!

If they face danger in the dungeon, word will get out that the dungeon is dangerous, but that also becomes a reason for adventurers to visit.

However, if they fail to obtain what they want, they will leave disappointed.

This will directly lead to a decline in the dungeon's popularity.

You must try to prevent this from happening. Because according to the contract, you must defend the dungeon while also increasing its rank!

No matter what method you use, just grow and defend the dungeon!

If you safely complete the 30-day contract...

An ending based on your actions will await you!

Head into the dungeon to find out what ending awaits you!

data.name: Slender Threads
data.detailed_description:
"Every night it's the same dream: my own head, mounted on a wall."

While wandering an unfamiliar town, Harvey Green follows a string of paranormal events to a grim realization: his recurring nightmare may foretell an inescapable fate.

In this point-and-click thriller adventure, guide Harvey through the peculiar streets, shops, and surroundings of Villa Ventana as he seeks to prevent his visions from becoming reality.

Features:

  • A timeless point-and-click blend of exploration, dialogue, and puzzle-solving

  • A curious tale that melds shocking twists with absurd humor

  • Dozens of strange, memorable characters brought to life by a cast of celebrated voice actors

  • Hand-drawn art that combines 2D and 3D to create striking, "diorama-like" visuals

  • An original, haunting score

data.name: Tomb Raider V: Chronicles (2000)

Afterwards, the friends sit quietly together in the study of the Croft Mansion and reminisce about Lara's past exploits; exploits that have until now remained a secret..

data.name: Sheriff Rage
data.detailed_description:
The Sheriff of SobIim City, while at his post, is trying to prevent the invasion of alien forces and save the inhabitants of the city from attacks by alien forces. As the sheriff of the city, destroy many waves of creepy opponents without dodging bosses or dodging their projectiles. Only the weapons of the wild west are offered to your arsenal, as opposed to the latest technologies and alien invaders. Clear the city and become a hero

Features:
-Beautiful drawing
- interesting gameplay;
-Many enemies

data.name: Tales of War
data.detailed_description:
Tales of War is a highly dynamic multiplayer voxel medieval experience featuring large scale castle siege maps and many classes to choose from.

Features:


  • 20+ classes
 5 classes of each role: Frontline, Ranged, Support and Mobile.


  • Siege [2-100 players]
 Engage in large-scale battles and conquer all flags to win.


  • Arena[1vs1 2vs2 3vs3]
 Fight in close quarters and defeat each enemy 3 times to win. An Arena server contains 4 arenas (up to 24 players) and 12+ randomly selected map


  • Legends
 Make a significant impact on the battlefield by selecting real life Legends with unique abilities.

data.name: Twilight Explorers
data.detailed_description:
Step into the world of Adva, a planet shattered into countless pieces by a cataclysmic event. In "Twilight Explorers," you are a young Explorer from Orangewood, competing in a grand tournament for a place in the prestigious Academy to train as a Guardian—a Celestial protector of realms and a master of Kairos. Use ancient Celtic-Atlantean teleportation gates to explore 1 billion procedurally generated shattered world zones by combining hidden keywords. If you find a world you like, or discover a rare secret, tell your friends about it by giving them the keyword combination in the form of a GRID:// URL.

Key Features:


Procedurally Generated Worlds
Explore 1 billion procedurally generated shard worlds using a combination of keywords at an uncovered ancient Celtic-Atlantean teleportation gate.
Discover rare items hidden deep within certain keyword combinations zones and uncover hand-crafted secret locations to hang out or unravel story mysteries in.

Each shattered world zone will feature a small field, a dungeon with multiple floors, and a variety of secrets, items, and other unique points of interest.
Journey through various biomes, each tied to a unique Kairos shard that rests there. Forests, frozen tundras, caves, volcanic lands, haunted mansions buried deep in spooky forests and more!

Solve puzzles and face challenges to retrieve the powerful Kairos Orbs and unlock new areas.
Hint at the greater implications of combining Kairos Orbs and the potentially sinister intentions of Kairos Corp.
Collect Kairos sparks as XP and shards from procedurally generated dungeons. Each shattered world zone has a field and a dungeon.
Assemble the shards to form Kairos Orbs, which allow you to unleash powerful attacks in combat. Quick swap orbs in battle to maximize type advantages and do more damage.

Epic Tournament Arc


Compete in thrilling non-lethal action combat using bokken (training swords) that come in many styles and can be modified with the Swordsmith system.
Climb the tournament ranking ladder, facing rivals and uncovering the dangers of unchecked ambition. Will you use your Kairos to help others, or will you harness it for pure dominance?
Experience a dynamic day/night cycle and calendar system tracking events and tournament progress.

Non-Lethal Dynamic Combat



Engage in non-lethal sparring against NPCs using bokken (training swords) that come in many styles.
Modify your bokken with the Swordsmith system to enhance your combat abilities.
Unleash powerful elemental Kairos attacks at range, heal with a Stamina Draft, or go in close and beat your opponent into submission.
Don’t just spar with other trainers for rank, battle cute or gruesome Shells to cleanse Adva of their presence and protect the town from invasion.

Be a Hometown Hero


Help your neighbors by delivering food, completing tasks, exploring back yards, and competing in minigames all around the large town of Orangewood.
Engage in mini-games and daily training activities to improve your stats. Speed, Strength, Stamina, Defense, Bravery, Faith, and Focus - what kind of Guardian will you be?
Rescue a pet dog or cat that can then join you as you explore the town. Take your pet on adventures and let it attack enemies for you!
Build relationships with your NPC friends, and unlock their homes as a place to hangout and explore, or take up to two friends on your adventures with you as you jump between shattered world zones. Each friend has their own personality and chats dynamically as you run around.
Trade with your NPC friends, discover rare items and weapons by checking everyone’s bag and deciding for yourself what loadout you will take into the unknown.
Claim a “Secret Base” and decorate it with plushies, furniture, new wallpaper, and other goodies that show off your achievements.
While there are many NPCs you can befriend and fight alongside, there are a few key characters who have story quests of their own. With each one you uncover, you can increase your friendship by completing these challenges, and get unique items as a result.

Introducing the ‘Soulstream’



Your ‘Soulstream’ is the very DNA of your soul. Your thoughts, emotions, experiences, relationships, and decisions make you who you are. Soulstream is a popular Kinetic Alignment and Introspective Reflection Operating System (K.A.I.R.O.S.) provided to you by Kairos Corp. that maps each of your soul nodes to a unique GRID:// URL for your convenience. Rest, reflect, and manipulate your Soulstream to become the most powerful Guardian in training.
Soulstream is a real journal desktop operating system (also available on Android and iOS) that you can use to improve your real self while gaining stats and XP in the game! Essentially, it’s a gamified journal, calendar, and task management system you can use daily to become a better trainer in real life! It also features powerful filters, search and rapid logging.

Personal Growth & Revelation



Journal through Soulstream on your phone or on the web or sit in game and do so while taking in the beautiful world of Adva and its shattered skies.
Make decisions, reflect on your experiences, and uncover mysteries to shape your destiny.
Write in your journal to unlock powerful abilities, weapons, items, and loot that can then be used in the 3D game world to advance your playthrough.
Soulstream is gamified beyond stats and XP, as you can interact with your NPC friends, receive messages with hidden keywords, and read gamified message boards where NPCs discuss the world of Adva, its secrets, and even gameplay tactics.
IMPORTANT! - You can play Twilight Explorers without the Soulstream app. Soulstream is a fictional self-contained in-game UI as well! You can also convert your XP between play modes at will if you’d like to switch it up.
DISCLAIMER - Soulstream will remain in ongoing development before, during and after the release of Twilight Explorer, so please leave feedback and be gracious if you find bugs :)

Intriguing Narrative and World-Building



Unravel the mysteries of Adva through encounters with a spectral weeping boy, a mysterious poem, and a terrible omniscient and eternal force that watches your every move…
Discover ancient Celtic and Atlantean-inspired artifacts, environmental puzzles, and lore.
Gradually discover your connection to the enigmatic power of Kairos and the Soulstream. Does Kairos Corp. have your best interest at heart, or will they use your soul data for more nefarious purposes?
Navigate encounters and visions that reveal hidden truths about Adva and your role within it.

data.name: Project Teddy
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Project Teddy, the ultimate multiplayer game that promises endless fun and thrilling shootouts with your friends. Get ready to explore a game that was partially inspired by the popular games Garry’s Mod and Half-Life. Project Teddy offers a unique gameplay experience where you can move around using the standard "WASD" keys or a controller and engage in action-packed battles using the left-click button.

Project Teddy has multiple gamemodes that cater to different playstyles. The first one is Deathmatch, where the player with the highest score at the end of each round wins. Runner is the second mode where one player is selected as the "Runner," and the objective is to kill them while the Runner gets buffed health and unlimited fatigue. Finally, there's Trouble in Teddy Town, which is inspired by Trouble in Terrorist Town, where one player is selected to be the "traitor," and everyone's goal is to figure out who the traitor is and kill them. The timer is adjustable, but the default is set to 5 minutes, and the player with the most kills at the end of the round is the winner.

Project Teddy should run smoothly on any computer that supports Vulkan, offering an optimized and seamless gaming experience. So, what are you waiting for? Grab your friends and dive into the exciting world of Project Teddy for a gaming adventure like no other!

data.name: Catch Up
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of "Catch Up"!

Get ready to embark on an exciting precision platforming adventure like you've never seen before! Join an epic journey with a brave cat where skill and precision will be your best allies.

"Catch Up" is a challenging 2D game with high-quality pixelated graphics that will transport you to three unique and stunning biomes. Explore vibrant and detailed landscapes, from lush forests to Dark Places and Ancient Ruins.

Your mission is to help our courageous feline find the way back home. However, it won't be an easy task! Face cleverly designed obstacles in every corner of the biomes. Enjoy the evolution of your movements and jumps, improving your skills throughout the journey.

The original soundtrack will immerse you even further into this captivating world. Each melody has been carefully composed to accompany your journey, creating an engaging and thrilling atmosphere.

Challenge yourself to push the platforming boundaries in "Catch Up"! Prepare for a unique gaming experience where precision and dexterity are essential for success. Master the control of our adorable feline protagonist and pave the way back home in this immersive and addictive game.

Accept the challenge and prove your skills in "Catch Up" - a game that will test your reflexes, patience, and determination, all within a charming pixelated universe.

Are you ready to help this little kitten get back home? The fate of our cat is in your hands!

Gameplay:

-Get ready for the perils of platforms!

The only way is up, and your only enemy is yourself! Tension builds with every jump, as a simple mistake results in a long fall - and you have to climb it all again...

-Hold to charge, release to jump!

The seemingly simple act of jumping will take a long time to master.

-Use your mind before jumping!

The obvious path is not always the best, and once you're in the air, there's no turning back...

The higher you jump, the harder the fall.

All progress and each fall are automatically saved.

Challenging but addictive gameplay.

Challenge your friends to master this test of determination.

Hours of frustration await.

data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Doodle World!


The award winning NES homebrew, now available for the PC. No emulator required! Play as Doodle and travel across the world to defeat King Eraser and his minions. This Deluxe edition includes the never before released, Doodle World Redrawn! Two games in one amazing package!

The evil King Eraser and his office supply minions had stolen the magical crayon used to create Doodle's amazing world! Play as Doodle and travel across the world to defeat King Eraser and his minions.

Doodle World Deluxe Includes
  • Doodle World
  • Doodle World Redrawn
  • Music Player
  • Art Viewer
  • Digital Manual

Doodle World

Gameplay Features
  • 5 Worlds
  • 15 levels of platforming action
  • 5 Exciting boss battles
  • Innovative "Kids Mode" for younger players

Doodle World features an innovative "Kids Mode". This mode allows younger players can enjoy the game with more lives, less levels, easier enemies and easier bosses!

Doodle World Redrawn

Gameplay Features
  • 5 Worlds
  • 15 New levels of platforming action
  • 5 Even tougher boss battles
  • All new double jump ability
  • Innovative "Kids Mode" for younger players

Doodle World Redrawn is new, never before released, re-imagining of Doodle World with tougher levels, enemies, and bosses! Use the new double jump ability to navigate through these tougher levels. "Kids Mode" is still avalible in this new version, so even younger players can enjoy this new game!

Music


The music and sound design for Doodle World Deluxe was created by the extremely talented chiptune artist Takumi Grainger!

Design


A child's doodles have been brought to life in this highly stylized NES game! Embracing the limitations of the NES hardware, we created an entire game with the look of a hand drawn world on notebook paper.

data.name: Chain of Command
data.detailed_description:
The joint enemy armies of the demons and orcs have teamed up to invade the kingdom. Pick from a variety of Commanders and build a chain of up to 15 additional fighters to protect the realm. You'll need to tactically build your chain if you're going to be victorious!

Features

  • Classic, snake-like controls. Be careful not to collide into your own fighters!

  • 25 playable Commanders that heavily customise how you play and build your chain.

  • Allies in the chain fight and use their skills automatically.

  • Survive rounds of 20-60 seconds, acquiring gold for taking down enemies, but powering up the next boss for any undefeated ones.

  • Take your gold to the shop to buy from over 30 unique allies, 100+ different equipment, and 100+ different relics. What super synergies will you create?

  • Combine duplicate allies to level them up, making them even more powerful, and sometimes even unlocking new abilities for them!

  • Each ally has a unique, powerful spell you can acquire. You can use up to two during battles and you have full control over when to use these by spending mana.

  • Fast runs (30-45 mins).

data.name: Red Frozen
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever wanted to see what Russia would look like if all the stereotypes about it were true?

Red Frozen is a game that embodies all the stereotypes about Russia and even a little more.
Only here you can ask a neighbor for a Kalashnikov assault rifle, go hunting with him and launch an intercontinental ballistic missile.


  • Maximum Of Cranberries !!!
  • Unique style of stereotypes and anecdotes about Russia;
  • Nice graphics;
  • Sophisticated shooting mechanics;
  • Lots of Easter eggs;
  • Possibility to play the balalaika![/]

    The action takes place in the village "Vatnikovo". A simple Russian peasant, Ivan, is being nailed by his wife, because by the age of 40 he had not tamed a bear. Help him in this difficult case!
    Drink vodka, play a balalaika and tame a real Russian bear!

    Even in summer it is cold enough in Russia, so do not forget to put on a quilted jacket and start a nuclear reactor so as not to freeze!


    The game is developed by 1.5 people (if you count by man-hours), or 3.25 (if you count by weight).

data.name: Among the Strangers
data.detailed_description:
You shouldn’t have clicked.

Now you’re caught in their web of madness.

Among the Strangers is a first-person cyber-horror game focused on the dark side of cybersecurity, where an unknown group is watching you, hunting you, and whispering truths no one should know. The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes: this isn’t random. You were chosen to follow this trail.

Story:

You wake up in a prison cell, unsure how you got there. The door opens automatically. A faint vibration draws your attention — your phone. You pick it up, its flashlight cutting through the darkness. The warehouse around you is abandoned, its corridors twisted with shadows and flickering monitors.

A voice comes through your phone, calling for help and warning you to run — someone is coming for you. Suddenly, you are ambushed by a twisted, masked figure, muttering about your judgment day.

Features:

Cyber-horror atmosphere – Investigate unknown, abandoned environments where technology and darkness create constant unease.

Survive with your smartphone – Your phone is more than a tool: use it as a flashlight, map, or even bait to escape the unknown.

Cyber traps and tricks – Detect and overcome deceptive systems and hidden traps designed to mislead or eliminate you.

Tech puzzles and mind games – Decipher encrypted challenges and interactive digital games that test your wit and security instincts.

Hunters who play first – Intelligent stalkers track your every move, testing and tormenting you before you can escape.

Please note: Among the Strangers is currently in development. Features, visuals, and gameplay elements described here may change as the game evolves.

data.name: Space Slurpies
data.detailed_description:
Snake, slither, SLURRPP!
How long can you grow your Space Slurpie? In this relaxing multiplayer game, control a colorful space snake with your hand. Chill out with your friends while collecting as much food as possible. The more you eat, the more the snake grows. Try not to run into other players or all kinds of playful baddies! With a calming Zen mode, multiplayer modifiers, and over 30 solo maps, there is a game mode for everyone to enjoy.



  • Players control a snake that follows your hand
  • It grows in length as you eat food
  • Evolve and cover yourself in armor as it grows
  • Survive the longest without colliding with yourself or other players
  • Competitive players can sabotage each other to win the game
  • Avoid the Jazzeroids and other enemy obstacles on your quest to be the longest slurp!



  • Enjoy over 30 unique and vibrant maps
  • Cross platform multiplayer, both matchmaking and games with friends
  • Customize your snake and make uniquely yours

data.name: The Cat in Yellow
data.detailed_description:
You wanted a pet.
But this is not a normal cat.

It watches you.
It follows you.
And something is very wrong with it.

One day you receive a strange package. Inside is a small, cute cat dressed in yellow. Now it lives in your house.

At first, everything feels normal.
You feed it. You play with it. You put it to sleep.

But the longer you stay, the more things start to feel off.

The cat behaves in ways you can’t explain.
It reacts when it shouldn’t.
It appears where it shouldn’t be.
Sometimes it feels like it’s always watching you.

You need to figure out what’s going on.

Explore the house. Open locked doors, find keys, and uncover what’s hidden inside.
Pay attention to small details. They matter more than you think.

Features:

  • Take care of a pet that doesn’t act like one

  • Watch the cat change over time

  • Explore a house full of secrets

  • Find keys, unlock doors, and progress through the story

  • A mix of horror, dark humor, and unexpected moments

  • Discover what the cat really is

Take care of the cat.
Survive the night.
Trust nothing.

Wishlist&Follow Dungeon and Craft!



In this adventure with a total of 6 weapons, you will produce your own weapons and turn the mushrooms you collect from the forest into pots that you can sell. In the dungeons, you will fight against challenging creatures for 16 waves and improve your character.

Features :
* Rogue-lite type progression.
* 6 different types of character improvement classes
* 8 different weapons you can craft (4 melee, 4 ranged)
* 10 levels of enhancements for each weapon
* A total of 6 weapons you can equip
* Forest where you can collect mushrooms
* A laboratory where you can produce pot
* A Town Hall where you can sell the weapons and pots you produce
* A total of 5 tier dungeons where you can progress 16 waves
* You can improve your character's stats with Skillpoints
* 30 Different enemy creatures
* 4 different attacking enemy types
* 5 Different Big Bosses

data.name: Reset 1-1
data.detailed_description:
The world has ended, Demons have risen to conquer the uninhabited and flourishing nature outside. 
It's your turn, with your unknown identity, to find your path for a new beginning. 

Reset 1-1 is a good ol' fashioned frantic action RPG platformer! Battle your way through demon hordes and gigantic bosses! 

Let's not beat about the bush here. Reset 1-1 is everything you loved about the late 80's/early 90's. It's a blast from the past, with a fresh spin. It's a great little fun game. Remember when games used to be fun and challenging? Reset 1-1 is just that. Enjoy! 

Game Manual:
-------------------------
Left/Right keys : move
Enter: start
Escape : pause/menu
X : Roll
C/Up Key: Jump
V: Attack
SPACE: Heal
Down Key: Action

Controller:
START: pause/ start
LB / RB : Attack
LT / RT : Change Weapon
A: Jump B: Roll Y:Action X: Heal
Arrows/sticks: Move
