data.name: Market Mayhem
data.detailed_description:
Market Mayhem is a strategy-driven financial simulation game where players build, manage, and grow a modern market empire in a world defined by momentum, volatility, and opportunity. Designed to be approachable for newcomers and deep enough for experienced strategy players, the game blends real market-style decision-making with high-energy gameplay, progression systems, and long-term mastery.

At its core, Market Mayhem is about making smart choices under pressure. Markets rise, pull back, spike, and rotate without warning. Players must adapt in real time—balancing risk and reward, managing positions, responding to market signals, and adjusting strategy as conditions change. Every session creates new challenges, whether you prefer steady, disciplined growth or fast-paced tactical plays.

The experience is structured to support both short and long play styles. New players can quickly learn foundational mechanics and build confidence through clear systems and guided progression. Advanced players can dive deeper into optimization, multi-asset strategy, scenario response, and performance refinement. The result is a game loop that is easy to start, difficult to master, and consistently rewarding over time.

Key Experience Highlights

  • Dynamic Market Game play
    Engage with a constantly moving market environment featuring trend shifts, pullbacks, breakouts, reversals, and volatility spikes that require active decision-making.

  • Strategic Depth with Accessible Design
    Intuitive core mechanics make on-boarding smooth, while layered systems provide meaningful complexity for players who want advanced control and long-term optimization.

  • Multiple Play-styles
    Choose your path: conservative and consistent, aggressive and high-risk, or a hybrid strategy that evolves with market conditions.

  • Progression and Achievement Systems
    Unlock milestones, grow your reputation, and track your climb from beginner to market powerhouse through persistent achievements and progression goals.

  • High Replay Value
    No two sessions feel exactly alike. Variable conditions, shifting opportunity zones, and player-driven strategy produce a fresh experience each time you play.

  • Designed for Broad Appeal
    Market Mayhem is built for a wide range of players—curious newcomers, competitive strategists, simulation fans, and players looking for a polished decision-based game experience. 

  • Educational Value

    Teaches player confidence in market fluctuation & long term resilience so when real consequences & volatility occur they you don't panic

  • Unique Sound
    Tracks consistent of 16 DRM-Label free music so tracks will not be deleted. Themed to the game play.

  • Scenario & Asset creators

    Expand the Markets create different Scenarios

data.name: Sphere Up
data.detailed_description:
In this unique multiplayer physics puzzler, team up with another player to navigate challenging levels using an arsenal of specialized weapons. But there's a twist – these aren't your ordinary guns. Instead of dealing damage, each weapon manipulates the environment and affects a mysterious sphere in different ways.

Work together with your partner to solve intricate physics-based puzzles. Combine your weapons' effects in creative ways – maybe use an air blast to launch the ball while your teammate creates a bouncy landing zone, or manipulate gravity to create the perfect arc through a tricky obstacle.

Every level presents a new challenge that will test both your reflexes and problem-solving skills. Success requires perfect timing, precise aim, and most importantly, seamless coordination with your teammate.

Can you and your partner master the laws of physics and guide the sphere to victory? Jump in and find out!

data.name: Health Insurance Claim Denier
data.detailed_description:
Denying health insurance claims has never been so fun and easy! Click your way to increased shareholder value.

Health Insurance Claim Denier is a satirical incremental/idle/clicker game where you take on the role of a claim reviewer operating with absurd efficiency. Start out manually clicking the denial button to reject claims, then upgrade your operation to include items which automatically deny claims and upgrades which boost your stats. Your productivity will increase exponentially, leading to trillions of claims denied as you dominate the industry!

Send customers into crippling medical debt with the help of:

  • 20 items to auto-deny for you

  • 30 upgrades to boost your efficiency

data.name: Innocent Au-pair
data.detailed_description:
David's wife, Alla, decides to hire a girl to help with household chores. To make it more cost-effective, she also opts to hire an au pair. How this decision will affect them is something we're about to discover.

Tasha made a new style before traveling to US. 

Step into the shoes of David, a local businessman, or Alex, his son, as you navigate the ebbs and flows of family dynamics, business operations, and personal relationships. In the first part of game, watch as David and Alex each try to impress Tasha, a new arrival au-pair in their family who tries to find her own journey. All under the watchful eye of Alla, who commands her own space in this lovely family. The second part will be added when it is ready. 

In Innocent Au-pair, your choices matter and will lead to different outcomes. By focusing on and helping David, the game will provide more story development centered around him. Alternatively, if you choose to prioritize Alex, the game will dynamically shift to focus on his storyline. 

 

Check out:

  • 10+ hours of engaging gameplay,

  • Over 3000 HD-quality renders,

  • Experience 150 + captivating and steamy animations,

  • Immerse yourself in a story with over 50,000 words of script.

Steam version will feature new animations which were not included into demo builds:

The game includes both consensual and non-consensual sexual content, alternative relationship dynamics, the use of alcohol and drugs, and graphic depictions of oral, vaginal, non-penetrative, and penetrative sexual acts, bodily fluids, and themes involving manipulation.

If you are sensitive to any of these themes or uncomfortable with the types of content described above, we strongly advise that you do not play this game.

data.name: Academy of Magic: The Great Dark Wizard's Curse
data.detailed_description:
In the third part of the magical match3 serial, your goal is to help Dennis to break the curse and save the "Academy of Magic" from a dark sorcerer. Dennis has lived his entire life as an orphan on the streets of London, performing magic tricks to survive while he wonders what happened to his parents. That all changes when he steps through a portal and finds himself in another world – a world of magic.

Fascinated by the new world he’s found himself in, Dennis agrees to do what he can to save the school of magical arts. But the wizard who cursed the school still has followers, and breaking the curse might not be as simple a task as it sounds.

- An exciting tale of magic
- Enjoy challenging match-3 levels
- Follow Dennis’s adventures across 5 chapters
- 20 exciting scenes
- An entertaining and lively cast of characters

data.name: The Last Spell
data.detailed_description:
In a desperate move to end all wars that have been rampaging the world for decades, the mages provoked The Cataclysm. Massive balls of pure magic obliterated nearly everything. A strange purple mist propagated everywhere, with hordes of bloodthirsty mutants coming at night.


Our only hope is now to banish all magic from this accursed world by casting The Last Spell, requiring several days of uninterrupted incantation whilst a few strained Heroes try to protect those damned mages.


The Last Spell is a tactical RPG with roguelite elements in which you have to defend a city against hordes of deadly enemies.

During daytime, prepare your Heroes, carefully choose how to rebuild your Haven and position your defenses. Over the night, exterminate all the monsters coming at your walls with a large range of weapons and skills. Then heal, level up, and repeat until the Magic Seal is broken.


Turn-Based Tactical RPG:

● The whole RPG package: a flurry of stats, skills, perks, traits… and more.
● Tons of items: armors, weapons, trinkets and potions… with their own stats and skills, as well as optional random modifiers. Each weapon has its own skillset and playstyle!
● Build your own classes: upgrade your heroes with stat bonuses and perks, and equip whatever gear you wish. Want to make a glass cannon rogue/mage fighting with a gun? Do it!
● Manage your squad of heroes: they’re strong, but they are few and have access to limited resources. Healing and mana are scarce, so try to find a good balance.

Hordes of Evil:

● Think and adapt: you will face swarms of deadly enemies with only a few hardened heroes. Optimize your positioning and plan your actions: big AOE attacks, crowd control, buffs, poison... Every Action Point counts towards another day of survival.
● Enemies have strengths and weaknesses that will challenge your wits. And because hard is not enough for us, be prepared for the terrifying Elites!
● Each map will end with epic fights against unique mind-bending bosses.


Protect the Haven:

● Rebuild the city to help you in-between fights. Get healed, forge new magical weapons, get new heroes. Spend your resources wisely, commander!
● Build up your defenses: walls, traps, towers, catapults… every tiny bit of help is welcome.
● Protect the Magic Circle at all costs! If you lose it, humanity is doomed.
● 5 Havens to protect, each with their own setup and challenges requiring you to tailor your strategy to beat the Great Evil.

Roguelite Elements:

● The game is meant to be hard. You will fail… A lot. But every time you do, you’ll grow harder, better, faster, stronger!
● Procedurally generated enemy waves, characters, weapons and a ton of unlockables will keep you entertained until the real world collapses.
● Tailor each run thanks to the Omens: a limited amount of bonuses that can be picked for the upcoming run. Do you prefer more Action Points, more characters, sturdier defenses, better loot? Experiment to find your preferred tools of destruction.
● Scale the difficulty to your liking, with 6 levels of Apocalypse to entertain even the most hardcore players.


Headbanger Soundtrack:

● Over 25 tracks of thunderous synths-driven progressive metal to guide you through this joyous slaughterfest
● Composed by the incredible Rémi - The Algorithm - Gallégo

data.name: I Am Your President
data.detailed_description:
Congratulations, Mr. President, you have just won the elections! No pressure. Take it slowly. It’s not like you can be impeached, die during the nuclear bombing or in assassination. Not like that at all.

So, as we have completed the formalities, let's talk about your new prerogatives:


Experience the twisted and hilarious story of yet another President of the United States!
Answer difficult questions and create the presidency which America – or you - need.
Use social media and read the news – maybe this time they wrote something nice.
Improve your country or simply watch it fall into chaos.

Get into the character of Mister President and choose the answers that best suit the situation. Different options can help you make allies, but also enrage your previous supporters. Be careful with words and make sure that you don’t neglect any of the prominent groups or important people… or do and deal with the problems later.

Touch people’s hearts with your writing abilities. Create the most compelling speeches and statements to achieve your goals. Want to calm the enraged strikers? Show the party that you’re the most efficient president? Raise everyone’s spirit at the state funeral? All of these can be done with a proper composition. Receive the title of the most charismatic leader ever!...

...or fail and make things even worse by being tactless. But hey, at least you had some fun writing about that salad you’d eaten in the Supreme Court!

Use the most well-known social media platform - Screecher. Screech about your plans, attitude, call somebody names or maybe praise the voters. It is entirely up to you how you want to come across in the internet – as funny, empathetic, factual or maybe weird? But remember - there are always going to be responses from other users. Prepare for a public backlash!

YOUR REGIME STARTS NOW

You wish to start a war or maybe make peace? Take care of the poorest or support capitalists? Advocate for gun rights or stand against them? Support cats or maybe increase the dogs population? Everything is possible!

Why, you may ask?
Because you are President of the United States of America, that’s why.

data.name: New Elysium
data.detailed_description:
A NARRATIVE EXPERIENCE WHERE EVERY CHOICE MATTERS

New Elysium is an interactive drama in which you play as Zoé, a young girl discovering the strange world of an island praised for its perfection.
Through her eyes, her emotions, and her decisions, you explore a heartfelt story where every choice can shape your path.

A UTOPIAN ISLAND… AT FIRST GLANCE

Cut off from the rest of the world, New Elysium is presented as a modern paradise: clean, peaceful, safe.
But as Zoé walks its streets, she begins to realize the island hides far more than it shows.

Some places feel unnervingly strange.
Some rules seem too rigid.
Some people avoid answering simple questions.

Without ever giving easy answers, the story invites you to feel both the beauty of the island… and the shadows beneath it.

A CINEMATIC AND EMOTIONAL EXPERIENCE

New Elysium blends interactive storytelling, exploration, and psychological tension:

🎬 Powerful, cinematic cutscenes
🎮 Meaningful narrative choices
⚡ Precise, immersive QTEs
🔫 Moderate but impactful action sequences
🌫️ Exploration driven by emotion, tension, and survival

Every scene is crafted as a cinematic moment.
Every decision leaves its mark.
And some choices—sometimes subtle—will echo all the way to the end.

A STORY OF HUMANITY, LOVE, AND SACRIFICE

The game explores themes such as:

  • the fear of losing loved ones

  • sacrifice

  • bonds forged through chaos

  • manipulation and political secrets

  • survival in the face of collapse

  • the need to keep believing in something

Relationships evolve based on your decisions, including deeper emotional or intimate connections that can influence the course of the story.

A UTOPIA HIDING A SECRET

Behind the perfect image of New Elysium lies something hidden.
Something that caused its downfall.
A lie buried beneath ruins and propaganda.

The truth is never handed to you.
By progressing, exploring, observing, and deciding, you will piece together what reshaped the city—and why Zoé can never go back.

CHOICES THAT SHAPE DESTINY

Your decisions influence:

✨ character relationships
✨ Zoé’s personal journey
✨ access to certain information
✨ who survives—and who doesn’t
✨ multiple possible endings

A single choice may shatter an already fragile world.
Or rebuild the foundations of a new one.

data.name: Anomaly Planet
data.detailed_description:
GONE MISSING:

An Elite Research Team has gone silent on a mysterious planet possessing an inner, maze-like structure.  This is no longer a standard rescue mission; it is a frantic descent into a Shifting Labyrinth with hostile entities around every corner.  You are being deployed into the heart of this hellscape to determine their fate.

DIMENSIONAL DOORS

Once you enter The Labyrinth, you must navigate an endless assortment of rooms.  In each room, you have to locate a Key which can then be used to unlock Dimensional Doors.  These special doors will bring you deeper into The Labyrinth.

YOU ARE NOT ALONE

Many Dangerous Entities roam The Labyrinth.  You can choose to Fight, Sneak, or Run from these creatures.

Fight - Use your trusty Axe to tear entities apart.  While the most rewarding, this isn't always the most viable option, for many entities are impervious to any form of attack. 

Sneak - Crouching lets you slip by certain entities, though be warned; some entities are exceptional at tracking their prey.

Run - A first (or last) resort for many: Some entities are far too dangerous to take on, especially in groups.  Running away and losing them around corners may be your only choice.

TRULY ENDLESS

The Labyrinth will go on For Eternity, becoming more and more dangerous the further you wander.  With every attempt, you can aim for a new high score on the leaderboard.  Additional challenges can be enabled for extra points.

What horrors will you encounter within The Labyrinth?

data.name: Trucktris
data.detailed_description:
Load Up a cargo ship one truck at a time in Trucktris.

Each trailer has a uniquely familiar tetromino-inspired shape, so careful planning and precise driving are key. Navigate every trailer onto the ship and reverse it into place, making every shipment fit together as efficiently as possible.

Hop into the driver's seat and put both your driving and packing skills to the test. Every move matters, and one misplaced trailer can throw off the entire shipment.

With 30 handcrafted levels across two game modes, Trucktris offers a mix of fast-paced and relaxed puzzle solving.

Time Trial challenges you to earn the highest shipping score before time runs out, while Puzzle Trial lets you take your time to reach the target truck count with the perfect arrangement.

Become the ultimate cargo loader in the world of Trucktris.

Will you master the art of puzzling driving... or just drive puzzled?

Govern the horde, where your deals with your consort strongly influence the birth of your heir. Set in the 13th century on the stage of Eurasia, experience the story of Temujin as he unifies the mongol hordes and guides them into taking over the known world.

data.name: Hidden Animals: English - Spanish
data.detailed_description:
Hidden Animals: English - Spanish is a relaxing hidden object game with the aim to teach you the Spanish names of animals featuring exclusive piano music. (You can use the program to study English as well if you are a Spaniard).

In the game, you have 3 worlds to play. In the first one, you have to find animals by their English names, in the third one you have to find them by their Spanish names. In the second world, you see both the English and Spanish name of the animals. You can freely choose levels from the 3 worlds.

The quicker you find objects the higher score and achievement you get. By getting 3 stars completing a level you will get pieces from the puzzle of the Hidden Animals.

  • 72 Challenging Hidden Object levels using 36 backgrounds
  • Language learning aspect
  • 3 language worlds to play (English, English - Spanish, Spanish)
  • 112 items to discover
  • 12 dedicated piano songs for the game
  • Built-in Owl Eye Hint
  • 3 Hidden Animals Fresco
  • More than 3-8 hours of gameplay

Building your vocabulary is about repetition. The best way to repeat words is to use them somehow and in our opinion, a game is a really good tool for that. Many of us learned English from video games. This small game is for those who likes the hidden object genre that offers a relaxing activity with a really useful feature: helping you to study Spanish.

The dedicated music of the game was made by András Illés who is a multi-instrumental musician and composer.

*Trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons, and badges are uploaded, but won't appear until steam accepts them and lets them to appear. This is because of the new system of Steam Direct.

data.name: Hoverise Rebellion
data.detailed_description:
Master this fast-paced Vehicular Arena Shooter where movement is your ultimate weapon. In a future devastated by an AI rebellion, humanity’s survival rests on elite pilots capable of unleashing the HoverTanks: advanced war machines that bridge the gap between fighter jets and heavy armor.

Inspired by the legendary mechanical skill of Unreal Tournament and the movement of GunZ: The Duel, Hoverise Rebellion delivers a competitive experience where your ability to navigate the arena is just as lethal as your aim. Forget slow, clunky tanks. This is high-octane aerial combat on the ground.

YOUR HOVERTANK

Hoverise Rebellion focuses on specialized Combat Series. Choose the chassis that fits your tactical philosophy and master its unique combat specs.

The Initial Deployment:

  • Interceptor Series: Built for aggressive frontline breaches. High-speed propulsion systems and assault weapons designed to shred targets in close-quarters dogfights.

  • Specialized Series: New sniper and kamikaze series incoming!

To unlock new series, you must win the HoverTank Challenge. Complete missions and battle against an unstable AI to earn your next machine.

THE ARENAS

Mastery of movement is what separates a recruit from a legend. Our system rewards dedicated pilots who learn the verticality of the HoverTanks. Utilize advanced abilities: Jumps, Dashes, and 3D Boosts across challenging, multi-leveled arenas.

ARENA GAME MODES

Enjoy classic arena action! But remember, victory isn't always about the kill count. Hoverise Rebellion features high-stakes modes designed for coordinated play.

  • Classic DeathMatch & Team Deathmatch: Pure mechanical skill tests.

  • Tactical Domination: Fight for control of energy nodes. A mode that tests your team's ability to rotate quickly and hold territory under fire.

  • Assault Mode: Engage in intense, multi-stage asymmetrical battles where strategy meets explosive action.

The rebellion has begun. The machines are evolving. Do you have the skill to hunt them down?

Add Hoverise Rebellion to your wishlist and claim your place in the arena!

data.name: Drive!Drive!Drive!
data.detailed_description:
Drive!Drive!Drive! is a racing game unlike any other, where players must drive their cars to victory across multiple tracks at the same time.

Let us try to explain how this brain-melting idea works: You are able to switch between the different tracks of a race any time you like. When you switch away from a track, a computer racer takes over driving on that track for you.

Unfortunately, the AI racers aren’t what you’d call competent. They are what you’d call incompetent. In other words, to place well in every track you're racing on, you’re going to have to hop track-to-track on a regular basis to account for the subversively cretinous computer cars.

This Artificial Idiocy™ is uniquely powered by our Intelligent Stupidity™engine.

Here’s just some of the many other reasons you’re going to love Drive!Drive!Drive!:

* Online multiplayer! Compete against friends and/or total strangers!
* Create your own racing calamities with the track creator. Then punish the rest of the world by sharing them online!
* Four different styles of gameplay, including: purist mode, arcade mode, collection mode, and time trial!
* A campaign mode featuring 50 tracks
* A bonus campaign mode featuring 50 additional (and harder!) tracks
* An amazing soundtrack by the world's state-of-the art synth/prog/post-rock band ZOMBI
* Those trippy retro/future visuals all the kids are hallucinating over, set across different galaxies and multiple gravities

The future of racing games has finally arrived, and it’s far stranger than anyone anticipated.

data.name: Papers, Please
data.detailed_description:
The Short Film


Watch the official short film based on the game.
By KINODOM PRODUCTIONS. Starring Igor Savochkin.


About the Game

Congratulations.
The October labor lottery is complete. Your name was pulled.
For immediate placement, report to the Ministry of Admission at Grestin Border Checkpoint.
An apartment will be provided for you and your family in East Grestin. Expect a Class-8 dwelling.
Glory to Arstotzka


The communist state of Arstotzka has just ended a 6-year war with neighboring Kolechia and reclaimed its rightful half of the border town, Grestin.

Your job as immigration inspector is to control the flow of people entering the Arstotzkan side of Grestin from Kolechia. Among the throngs of immigrants and visitors looking for work are hidden smugglers, spies, and terrorists.

Using only the documents provided by travelers and the Ministry of Admission's primitive inspect, search, and fingerprint systems you must decide who can enter Arstotzka and who will be turned away or arrested.

data.detailed_description:
If you choose correctly, you will embark on a journey of pure love and dream making; If you choose to fail, you will be reduced to ashes.

About Us
We are a group of college students from Nanjing, from different majors, each with unique skills. Due to our love for media, we gathered together to embark on a journey of "self creating dreams"

Write at the end
Our story began on November 15, 2023, perhaps due to the magnetic field coming together. Starting from naming the characters, it took a month to complete the script. On December 15th, the script was launched, and the six screenwriters each claimed other positions, including director, producer, coordinator, cinematographer, art, and even one person holding multiple roles! Filming officially began on December 20th. During the filming process, there were many unexpected situations, and the six of them worked together to complete all the filming, taking two months to complete. During these three months, while completing our studies on campus, we worked together to shoot this game. Although it was tiring, no one gave up. Even if we got sick, we got up and completed the high-intensity work every day, encouraging each other to ultimately complete all the filming.

You guessed it right. After the shooting was completed, the editing, UI, art, Steam game development, and promotion were all done by our group of novices themselves. We searched for other successful cases online, completed the promotion, and created the account. Fortunately, our game is open to everyone and has completed the first stage of "self dreaming" journey!

Amidst the vast sea of people, grateful for meeting; Thank you for your love and for bringing me joy.

Seven girls with vastly different personalities are waiting for your guide - whether innocent and youthful, extreme love, lively and bright, brave and sincere, cold and passionate, gentle and resilient, or charming and alone. data.name: CRASH: Autodrive
data.detailed_description:
CRASH: Autodrive is a narrative adventure set in the near future where nobody drives and self-driving Autocabs rule the city streets. It's just a normal day when four strangers get into an Autocab, but they are quickly thrust into danger when the car impossibly hits a cyclist. When they exit the car, they discover they all know the victim and they all have a motive for murder! Even the car's artificial intelligence!

You play as Emily, a young woman from a small town trying to make it in the big city. You will get to know your fellow passengers, and the car's A.I. as you investigate clues, solve puzzles, and use the clues you find to contradict lies, explore new conversations, and piece together the mystery of who killed Thomas Sinclair!

Key Features

  • A compelling sci-fi murder mystery story with some thought-provoking life lessons and themes of grey morality.
  • A diverse cast of charming and authentic characters.
  • Spirited and funny writing, yet serious when it needs to be.
  • A bangin' soundtrack inspired by classic detective and murder mystery games.
  • A 3-4 hour playtime for players with a busy schedule and too many games to play.

Meet the cast!

Emily Knight (that's you!)

The down-and-out college student who needs to break out of her small-town shell.

Thomas Sinclair

The charismatic tech maven, inventor of the Autocab's artificial intelligence, but now stuck in middle management at Vanguard Global Industries.

Kyle "Kondor808" Kondor

Once a fat nerdy kid bullied by Thomas Sinclair, now a fit hugely successful game streamer with insecurities.

Anna Lamarr

The A.I. psychologist and frustrated co-worker of Thomas Sinclair who just wants to move up in her career but keeps hitting a glass ceiling.

Carter Jones

Genius engineer, inventor, family man, and snubbed former partner of Thomas Sinclair.

A.D.A.

The unique and enigmatic Autocab artificial intelligence owned by the Vanguard Global Industries megacorporation.

Find clues!

Solve puzzles to unlock secrets!

Get to know your fellow passengers!

Contradict their lies with the clues!



Find out who killed Thomas Sinclair in this narrative adventure murder mystery!

data.about_the_game:
CRASH: Autodrive is a narrative adventure set in the near future where nobody drives and self-driving Autocabs rule the city streets. It's just a normal day when four strangers get into an Autocab, but they are quickly thrust into danger when the car impossibly hits a cyclist. When they exit the car, they discover they all know the victim and they all have a motive for murder! Even the car's artificial intelligence!

You play as Emily, a young woman from a small town trying to make it in the big city. You will get to know your fellow passengers, and the car's A.I. as you investigate clues, solve puzzles, and use the clues you find to contradict lies, explore new conversations, and piece together the mystery of who killed Thomas Sinclair!

Key Features

  • A compelling sci-fi murder mystery story with some thought-provoking life lessons and themes of grey morality.
  • A diverse cast of charming and authentic characters.
  • Spirited and funny writing, yet serious when it needs to be.
  • A bangin' soundtrack inspired by classic detective and murder mystery games.
  • A 3-4 hour playtime for players with a busy schedule and too many games to play.

Meet the cast!

Emily Knight (that's you!)

The down-and-out college student who needs to break out of her small-town shell.

Thomas Sinclair

The charismatic tech maven, inventor of the Autocab's artificial intelligence, but now stuck in middle management at Vanguard Global Industries.

Kyle "Kondor808" Kondor

Once a fat nerdy kid bullied by Thomas Sinclair, now a fit hugely successful game streamer with insecurities.

Anna Lamarr

The A.I. psychologist and frustrated co-worker of Thomas Sinclair who just wants to move up in her career but keeps hitting a glass ceiling.

Carter Jones

Genius engineer, inventor, family man, and snubbed former partner of Thomas Sinclair.

A.D.A.

The unique and enigmatic Autocab artificial intelligence owned by the Vanguard Global Industries megacorporation.

Find clues!

Solve puzzles to unlock secrets!

Get to know your fellow passengers!

Contradict their lies with the clues!



Find out who killed Thomas Sinclair in this narrative adventure murder mystery!

data.name: GREX
data.detailed_description:
SWARM SURVIVORS

In GREX, you don’t play a hero — you command a living swarm.

Hundreds of Grexlings move, fight, and sacrifice themselves as one organism.

You do things no single character could ever pull off.

CONTROL THE UNCONTROLLABLE

  • Swarm AI Combat – Your Grexlings dodge, chase, collide, and intercept automatically.

  • Body as Weapon – Ram enemies, surround them, shred them, overwhelm them.

  • Mass Sacrifice & Rebirth – Lose dozens, rebuild instantly, and come back stronger.

  • Shape-Shifting – Use different shapes and formations to survive.

CRAFT YOUR PERFECT SWARM

  • Genes – Combine gene types to create unique Grexling behaviors.

  • Merging – Fuse genes into higher tiers for absurd power jumps.

  • Passive Items – Heavy bonuses with real trade-offs.

  • Upgrades – Level up, boost stats, and evolve your swarm’s instinct.

  • Digging – Tear through the arena floor to find healing and diamonds.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

  • Unlock permanent skill tree upgrades.

  • Return stronger.

  • Break the game on purpose.

DISCOVER. MUTATE. REPEAT.

  • New swarm species that changes playstyle.

  • Rare items and exotic genes.

  • Endless builds that change how your entire organism behaves.

  • (WIP — more on the way.)

FINAL CHALLENGE: "Vanilla Mode"

  • Reset Skill Tree & upgrades.

  • Start from zero.

  • Defeat the final boss in pure vanilla chaos.

MUSIC, POWER, VFX

GREX is powered by a thumping trance-techno soundtrack and glowy neon VFX — swirling trails, pulsing lights, and particle storms that turn your swarm into a cosmic supernova.

GREX blends bullet-heaven chaos with deep buildcraft - but the star is your swarm.
Learn it. Shape it. Weaponize it.

Can you control the chaos you create?

Have fun Swarming,
Mike

data.name: Public Defense Corp
data.detailed_description:
Japan, in the year 20XX... The evil secret society Jakou is plaguing the country, causing several private defense firms to be founded. These companies protect Japan alongside the police and self-defense forces.

With both Jakou and the protectors of peace using newly-developed mechs to fight, the battlefield has begun to change, with damage to cities and infrastructure reaching unimaginable levels!

And yet, despite Jakou's power, the citizens of Japan are fighting back. Haruka, the hero of our story, witnessed the destruction of her hometown several years ago, and she's determined to take revenge! Thus, she joins the public defense corp Toyokumo, aiming to pilot their freshly-designed machines to take down Jakou for good!

Pilot the cutting-edge Takefutsu to take down the agents of Jakou! Use the variety of weapons at your disposal to deal with threats as efficiently as possible while keeping damage to the city to a minimum. Of course, you may occasionally have to topple a few buildings to reach your objective, but all's fair in the name of justice!

Although Takefutsu is a cutting-edge mech, it can still be upgraded. Gather parts from defeated enemies and use them between missions to increase Takefutsu's capabilities, granting it perks such as increased armor or new special attacks.

Naturally, running a civil justice corporation and maintaining a huge mech doesn't come cheap. You'll also have to take part in publicity events around the city to gather support for the company and appease any citizens whose homes might have been damaged in the crossfire. Participate in television adverts and gather sponsors to raise funds!

Futuristic Adventure

Pilot a mech to defeat the evil agents of Jakou in urban warfare, even taking down buildings that are blocking your path if needed!

Upgrade the Takefutsu

Gather parts from defeated enemies to make your mech stronger and craft items that will help you in your mission to protect the peace!

Take Part in PR Events

Whether it be giving interviews, doing talk shows or advertising products, participate in different events to garner public support and extra funding!

Keep Track of Social Media

As you progress through the story, Haruka and her exploits will draw more and more attention. Check the Brouhaha app on your phone to see what everyone's saying!

data.name: Challenger's Sleep
data.detailed_description:
REMEMBER: THE SEA IS NOT SAFE

You are descending into the most ancient ecosystem ever: The Ocean. It is cold. It is dark. It is crushing. Things will try to bite you. Currents will drag you away. You will see things that aren't even there.

The Goal

Use your sonar and speed to get to the bottom of the sea by avoiding hazards and collecting trash to get more lives. That's the only way you'll find what you lost.

Dash left or right or activate your sonar to navigate around hidden obstacles as you descend. Get to the end of each level with at least one life left. Lose all lives and it’s game over.

Sunlight Zone

So bright! So warm! Enjoy snatching up trash as sea life swims by.

Twilight Zone

Watch Bioluminescent fish swim by and ride stronger currents downward.

Midnight Zone

Will be revealed in futures updates!

Abyssal Zone

Will be revealed in futures updates!

Hadal Zone

Will be revealed in futures updates!

data.name: Pawmlet - Wheat Farm
data.detailed_description:
Your Cozy Desktop Farming Companion

Pawmlet - Wheat Farm is a cozy, low-stress idle farming simulation that lives right on your desktop. Sits unobtrusively at the bottom or corner of your screen while you work, study, watch videos, or game, accompanied by Barnaby, your hardworking cat farmer!

🌾 Cozy Idle Farming at Your Own Pace

Manage your little wheat plot with relaxed, satisfying interactions:

  • Till, Plant, Water & Harvest: Guide Barnaby through the crop lifecycle from tiny seeds to golden wheat fields.

  • Expand Your Farm: Sell freshly harvested wheat for coins to unlock new soil plots and expand your pastoral sanctuary.

  • Smart Chore Queue: Queue up chores for Barnaby and watch him dutifully tend the crops, or let him take well-deserved catnaps when the work is done.

🐾 Built for Multitaskers & Desktop Companionship

Designed from the ground up to respect your screen space and computer resources:

  • Always by Your Side: Borderless, compact window that docks neatly to the bottom of your screen or hovers wherever you like.

  • Ultra-Lightweight & Battery-Friendly: Optimized background throttling ensures near-zero CPU and GPU impact while you code, study, or browse.

  • Minimize to Tray: Need full screen real estate? Tuck Pawmlet into your system tray with a single click and bring Barnaby back whenever you want a cozy break.

  • Play at Your Rhythm: Zero timers pressuring you, no failure state, and no penalties. Just pure wholesome pastoral vibes.

✨ Features Summary

  • Delightful pixel art animations featuring Barnaby the cat in his little farmer overalls.

  • Relaxing agricultural loop: Till ➔ Plant ➔ Water ➔ Harvest ➔ Sell ➔ Expand.

  • Flexible desktop placement: snap to screen edges or move anywhere.

  • Designed to run seamlessly in the background all day long.

Take a breath, plant some seeds, and let Barnaby bring warmth to your desktop!

data.name: Commute
data.detailed_description:
On your daily "commute" from work, you may sometimes encounter some situations.
Please observe your surroundings carefully and get home safely!

Do not overlook any anomalies.
If you find any anomalies, turn back immediately.
If you don't find any anomalies, do not turn back.

Commute is a short walking simulator inspired by The Exit 8.
The difference is that the pedestrian is a girl, and the progress of the game will be presented by the color of the sky(Sunset → Evening (clear to cloudy) → Late Evening (cloudy to clear)), and you still need to make the right choice to pass the level when you finally arrive home.

Play Time

20-60 minutes.

Settings

Game quality, resolution, camera shake, camera sensitivity and others can be adjusted in the settings.

About Uploading Gameplay Videos

Everyone can upload without permission.
You can only profit from using the features provided by the video platform.
I appreciate it if you mention the name of the game in the title of your gameplay video or live stream, or if you mention a link to the Steam page in the video's description section.

I am not responsible for any damage caused by uploading game videos.
These conditions are subject to change without notice.

data.name: TeleBlast
data.detailed_description:
TELEBLAST is a fast-paced, local multiplayer, combat game set in a time of explosive teleportation. Up to 4 players can take to the arena to try to outplay and outblast their opponents in a round-by-round battle for supremacy.

Each player will be in control of a teleporter which they can shoot out and then activate to teleport to with the distance that the teleporter traveled influencing the size of the resulting explosion.

So do you remain mobile by teleporting short distances but only causing small explosions or do you remain immobile and cause a massive explosion trapping your opponents with nowhere to go?

The game features a wide array of maps, game modes, and modifiers that allow you to customize your game and keep each match fresh and exciting. The simple concept will keep you and your friends engaged for hours!

Features


  • Easy to grasp hectic multiplayer action. New players can pick up and play quickly and easily through intuitive controls and simple mechanics.
  • Multiple maps with more in development. Challenge each other on a number of maps with more on the way. Early Access will have 2 maps with more being developed.
  • Multiple game modes and modifiers under development. The simple gameplay can be modified and customised to your liking with more options always being added.

data.name: Cozy Room Decorator
data.detailed_description:
Step into the world of Cozy Room Decorator where you’re the chief curator of cozy and it’s up to you to define what cozy means. Whether that means a lived-in kitchen space filled with sweets, or a tech-laden game room, the combinations are waiting to be explored. Dive into a world of boundless imagination and creativity with a treasure trove of thousands of items, each brimming with endless possibilities. Equipped with your very own room, this whimsical isometric room design game invites you to unleash your inner interior decorator.

What Is It?

Cozy Room Decorator is a casual room decorating game that offers players an opportunity to unleash their creativity. Gameplay is as simple as drag and drop what you want into the space. Players are given a room template that has a fixed isometric view, so two walls and a floor are the “shell” of the room. At game start up, players are given a catalog full of items to use in their rooms. There will be a variety of items to choose from so the player can decide what style of room they want. Some examples of items are bedroom furniture, kitchen appliances, and bathroom items. We’ve also done away with item collision restrictions, so players can merge items together to create “new items”. There is no overarching plot to the game, nor are there any side quests or prerequisites that may hinder one from decorating within gameplay. There is no in-game currency system that forces a player to “buy” furniture for their rooms. The objective of Cozy Room Decorator is simply to decorate. This game is especially for those that want to put together an aesthetic room, but perhaps don’t want to deal with the hassle and headache of learning a 3D modeling program.

Cozy Features:

  • Decorate your room to show your unique style.

  • Choose from thousands of items!

  • Decorate Inside and Outside.

  • Change the walls, floors or background of your room.

  • Select from different lighting options, time of day or weather patterns.

  • Pick different art options for different photo frames that you decorate with.

  • Change the ambient noise sound effects to set the mood of your environment.

  • Change the location of your room for a change of scenery!

  • Collision is disabled to allow merging items so players can be very creative!

  • A sandbox game. There is no story. Just decorating at your own pace.

  • Turn the grid on or off, there is no grid-snapping by design.

  • A truly unique and beautiful soundtrack, hand crafted by the Lucky Roll team!

  • Enjoy our wallpaper mode. Hide the interface and use your room as a desktop wallpaper!

We post patch notes, road maps and game updates for all of our games in our discord! For Cozy Room Decorator in specific we have a place to share your rooms with other decorators, a place to request features and of course many rooms to chat about the game. Meet other like-minded people and become a part of the Lucky Roll community. We'll be waiting!

data.name: Cain × Nica
data.detailed_description:
Key Features:

- Emotional Story
Experience a heart-warming tale of love, sacrifice and the relentless pursuit of happiness.
- Stunning Visuals
Animated CGs and girls bring the world of Cain and Nica to life.
- Immersive Soundtrack
Let the music help you to dive into the journey through this world of eternal winter.

Story

In this cold, harsh world, only love of his younger sister, Nica, keeps Cain alive. Each day, he searches through piles of garbage, looking for anything valuable to feed them. But Cain's efforts are unsuccessful - their situation only gets worse. In despair, he takes out a loan from two brothers, Invi and Avari.

However, the weight of debt is too overwhelming. No matter how hard Cain tries to earn some money, he fails again and again. The day of payment arrives, but Cain can't give the money back. So... Invi and Avari decide to take Nica instead to make her a slave.

Desperate and broken, Cain cries out to the heavens for the power to change his fate. But the gods remain silent, leaving his prayers unanswered.


"No one would save Nica. No one... except me".

"Cain × Nica" is a visual novel about a hopeless world filled with the beauty of enduring love and determination. This touching story comes alive with animated CGs, expressive character designs, and a haunting soundtrack that will resonate with you.

Immerse yourself in this tale of despair and see if Cain's love can beat the odds. Can he win against the fate? Or...?

data.name: Throw Anything
data.detailed_description:
There is nowhere to run... and nowhere to hide as zombies climb up the walls hoping to satisfy their appetite for brains. The only way to survive: reload your guns, destroy all furniture in the room, grab them all, and throw anything you can find to take them down.. and we mean ANYTHING.
Face off against starving zombies in high-rise buildings across the globe in the VR action defense game, Throw Anything!



ㆍ Enjoy laying waste to fully destructible environments!

ㆍ Throw any object within reach – humans included!

ㆍ Take on 6 challenging stages about to be overrun by the zombie horde!

ㆍ Defeat 5 mid bosses and 6 powerful “main” bosses!

ㆍ Collect ancient relics to save the world!

ㆍ Defeat zombies and get powerful weapons as rewards!

ㆍ Test your limits at various difficulty levels!


The mysterious “Scientist X” has decided to play God – conducting secret, forbidden experiments in secluded laboratories throughout the world.. To conquer whole world by spreading zombie virus using ubiquitous cube..

However, five scientist who oppose X's terrible plan divide ubiquitous cube into 5 pieces and hid throughout the world and enraged mystery Scientist X invades the world using zombies to find cube!

The world is quickly being overrun by these undead abominations – turning everyday peace into a never ending cycle of pain and suffering.

Get secret missions from Secret Delivery Agency (SDA) and collect cubes to save the world from zombie horde!

data.name: Gallery: Coloring book & decor
data.detailed_description:
Draw, renovate, decorate, follow the story and note: Gallery is the first coloring book game where you can paint by number and enjoy home design and decorating at the same time!

Join our heroes, Mia and Leo, in an amazing adventure: color hundreds of pictures, renovate an old house and fill it with life and fancy decorations, restore an abandoned Art Gallery and dive into a lively story of this adorable couple!

Hundreds of unique, high quality paintings created exclusively for Gallery. Original gameplay: combination of coloring book and home design! Color pictures, get stars and spend them on decorating the house and exploring the story. That’s a creative game for real designers!

A variety of locations to explore and to renovate. We have a cozy corner for every taste here! Rich and variable decor: there is always more than one option to pick for each and every corner of the house and other locations as well!

Wide range of outfits for the main heroes, Mia and Leo. Want to see Mia as an ancient princess, a movie-star or a race track mechanic? Sure thing! Want Leo to be a giant turkey, a dancer or a fireman? We’ve got it!

You can't lose here! No 'Game over' signs! All you have to do here is color pictures, relax and enjoy the story. We have numerous in-game events waiting for our players where you can get new exclusive paintings to color, decor elements to instal and pets to… well, to pet!

In short - grab a brush, get comfy and let’s paint that world bright!

Will you dare to go to the end of this fabulous trip?

Explore the environment.

data.name: Lake Town Stories
data.detailed_description:
Story

You're a freelance writer who arrives at the resort town of Lake Town on assignment.

The job: a hands-on report on a public-private regional revitalization project.

But what awaits you here goes far beyond a story to write.

Co-workers at the project office. Women you cross paths with around town. Each carrying her own circumstances.

As you get drawn into their lives, what started as a simple work trip begins to change — quietly, unmistakably.

You have just two weeks in this town. When they're over, whose story will yours become?

Gameplay

■ Explore Lake Town freely

The office, a café, a church, the market — choose where to go from the map and wander the town at your own pace.

The people you meet and the events that unfold change depending on where and when you visit.

■ Your words shape your relationships

Every choice in conversation affects trust and affection with the heroines.

Each of the four heroines has her own storyline — and five endings await across their stories.

■ Make the most of a tight budget

Life in town sometimes costs money. Take on remote work or part-time minigames to earn cash,

then spend it on dates, gifts, and more. How you manage your limited funds is another choice that's entirely yours.

data.name: Nobody's Dilemma
data.detailed_description:
Embark on an immersive journey through a war-torn kingdom in "Nobody's Dilemma," an atmospheric and story-rich 2D action-adventure RPG. Step into the shoes of a soldier thrust into a world of intrigue and revenge, where you'll unravel the mysteries of a conflicted land.

Features:

A Dark and Atmospheric World: Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world filled with mystery, where shadows dance and secrets lurk around every corner.
Engaging Storyline: Experience a character-driven narrative that delves deep into the complexities of war, betrayal, and the human spirit. Uncover the truth behind the conflict and discover the true nature of your own dilemma.
Traps and Challenges: Navigate treacherous environments filled with deadly traps and intricate challenges. Test your agility and wit as you overcome obstacles and find clever solutions.
Dynamic Combat System: Employ cunning tactics, precise timing, and strategic thinking to overcome your enemies or just go all out and engage in fast-paced combat where each move counts. Utilize parries, dashes, fast or strong attacks, and exploit enemy vulnerabilities to gain the upper hand in intense battles.
Explore Vast Landscapes: Traverse diverse landscapes, from villages to castles and sprawling forests. Uncover hidden secrets, and valuable resources as you explore every nook and cranny.
Uncover Intriguing Mysteries: Investigate the truth behind the war that plagues the kingdom. Encounter enigmatic characters and piece together the puzzle that holds the key to your ultimate goal.
Emotional and Immersive Experience: Dive deep into the emotional journey of the protagonist as they grapple with loss, betrayal, and the weight of their own existence. Experience a thought-provoking narrative that will leave a lasting impact.
Gorgeous Art Style: Immerse yourself in the 2D visuals and atmospheric sound design, which bring the world of "Nobody's Dilemma" to life.

Prepare to navigate a world filled with danger and uncertainty as you uncover the secrets that lie beneath the surface. Will you rise above the challenges that await you? Dive into the depths of "Nobody's Dilemma" and forge your path in this epic 2D adventure.

  • Cool Retro Soundtrack: Enjoy chiptune melodies crafted with the same restrictions as famous 8-bit consoles.

data.name: Efpiyes
data.detailed_description:
Efpiyes was inspired by the venerable shooters of the 90s: an era of straightforward, fast-paced action, LAN parties and creative tools you didn't need a gamedev degree to use. It's about fun with friends and running, jumping, shooting mayhem.

Multiplayer


Host and join games over Steam. Choose good old-fashioned Deathmatch or change it up with some King of the Hill or Tag.
Game Modes Currently Implemented:
  • Deathmatch: Kill other players. Player with highest kills minus deaths wins.
  • King of the Hill: Occupy the hill and fight off other players. Player with most time on the hill wins.
  • Tag: First player to die becomes It. Whoever is killed by the It player becomes It. Player who spends the least time It wins.
  • Anti-Tag: First player to get a kill becomes it. Whoever kills the It player becomes It. Player who spends the most time It wins.
  • Steal the Bacon: A ball spawns somewhere on the map. The ball can be picked up and will be dropped when you die. Player with the most time carrying the ball wins.
  • Grim Piñata: Same as Steal the Bacon, but more balls keep spawning over time. Each ball carried counts additively towards your time.

Bots


Add bots to your game for solo practice or to add extra spice to multiplayer games. The bots know how to play all game modes, and can be adjusted to a wide range of difficulty levels.

Map Editor


Design your own maps with the built-in map editor and share them with your friends. Maps are voxel-based for simple, intuitive editing.

data.name: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
data.detailed_description:
Build a team. Plan every move. Then let them fight.

Ultra Auto Gotchimon is a cozy creature auto-battler. You choose the gotchimon, the four moves each one fires, how they react when things happen in a fight, and who goes in first. Then the battle plays out on its own, and you find out if the plan holds.

Every colour plays differently

Eight creature lines, each in eleven colours. A colour isn't just a new look: it brings its own ability, often a new type, and moves no other colour can learn. At every evolution you choose which path to take.

Shape your team

Learn new moves in the Move Shop, swap out old ones, collect relics, sign risky pacts and play seven elements with real type matchups. Before every fight you see how each of your moves will land.

Three ways to play

  • Campaign: a three-chapter story with a boss at the end of every chapter and events that change with your choices.
  • PvP Arena: shop between rounds and fight teams built by other players, or take your campaign team into a ranked best-of-three.
  • Adventure: unlocked by beating the Campaign. One run across a branching map with rest sites, shops, pact altars and mystery events.

Play it in the corner

Corner mode shrinks the game into a small always-on-top window with bigger text and calmer music, so a run keeps going while you work or watch something.

Features

  • Auto-battles you win in the team builder, not with reflexes
  • 8 creature lines, 21 forms and 11 colours each, every colour with its own ability
  • Reactions: set what each gotchimon does when it's hit, when an ally falls, and more
  • Online PvP Arena against teams built by other players
  • Playable in 14 languages

Free demo: play Chapter 1 of the Campaign with Hiro, Kinokame, Marumi and Sakuraho.

data.name: 烬世书
data.detailed_description:
Game Description:​​

Mystic energy withers, martial arts decline, chivalry perishes in the wastelands.
Imperial power rots, corpses sprawl across the land, life crumbles within royal courts.
This is an apocalyptic age of ruin and calamity, where cosmic fury clashes with human folly.
Amidst this all-consuming darkness, will you be the spark that tears through the endless night—or the ashes consumed by the flames?

​The Orphan Player Trapped in Fate's Vortex​

One day, drowning in the mire of the red-light district;
The next, caged in a mansion of gold.

You were once a drifting reed on the Qinhuai River’s shores, swept by fate’s tides.
Then came the upheaval: Shen Yizhi, the wealthiest magnate south of the Yangtze, paid a fortune to free you from the brothel—not as his concubine, but as his “sworn sister,” bestowing you the name ​Shen Shuangshuang.
Clad in silk, you stepped into his empire of riches... and into a meticulously woven game of shadows.

Yet even Shen Manor’s towering walls cannot shield you from imperial intrigue and the underworld’s tides.
Your seemingly devoted brother hides intentions you cannot decipher.
Chillingly shrewd Western Depot Superintendent ​Leng Yanqiu;
The untamed rogue prince ​Murong Yun;
The scheming, venom-smiled Crown Prince ​Murong Jin;
The demonic, elusive cult leader ​Ye Wuhen;
And ​Shen Guhong, the silent sword immortal burdened by secrets—
Behind their allure, do blades of deception await?

Offer your heart, and you may taste betrayal; savor passion, and find poison.
You tread thin ice in a maelstrom of imperial wars, martial vendettas, and blood feuds.
Every choice binds you to these six men—and twists the fate of nations.

​Carried by destiny, you cannot turn back.​​
When the truth at last emerges, a secret shattering your very identity comes to light.
You realize: from the moment you entered Shen Manor, you were no pawn.
​You are the game’s pivotal piece—the fragile, world-breaking ​​"Ko."​​

Can you hold fast to your soul in this chaos?
Whose love is true? Whose lies cut deepest?
And what storms will your lineage unleash?

​**—From the brothels to the throne, a crimson legend drenched in blood.​**​
Here, every longing may damn you.
Every move ignites destiny’s wildfire.

​Step into the mansion. Unmask your past. Wield truth as your blade—and shatter the illusion.​​

​Character Introductions: Masters of Fate’s Board

​

​Ye Wuhen​

Cult Leader of the Demon Sect
Demonic charm, unpredictable will.
"Morality? ​I​ am divine judgment!"

​Murong Yun​

The Rogue Prince
Romantic, untamed, charismatic.
"Beauties are wine, thrones are chess—why not... share both with this prince?"

​Shen Yizhi​

The Gentle Brother
Graceful, elegant, soft-spoken.
"All shelter has a cost, dear sister... Choose an easier path."

​Leng Yanqiu​

Western Depot Superintendent
Unrivaled authority, enigmatic mind.
"Kneel to live? Or stand to die? Show me... the steel in your spine."

​Murong Jin​

The Venomous Crown Prince
Calculating, ruthless, blade behind silk.
"The roads I offer... lead straight to hell."

​Shen Guhong​

Mysterious Sword Immortal
Silent, tormented by destiny.
"This blade cannot bear the sins of mortals;
Snow stained crimson is a god’s requiem."

​Game Features​

​Stunning Visuals | Immersive Experience​

  • ​100+ Exquisite CGs: Expansive landscapes and intimate moments in breathtaking detail.

  • ​Dynamic Character Art: Live2D-powered designs by renowned artists—characters breathe, blink, and charm.

  • ​Voice Acting: Professional cinematic cast brings every whisper and vow to life.

​Epic Plot | Multi-Layered Drama

​

  • ​Complex Themes: Unravel imperial conspiracies, martial wars, and electric bonds of love, loyalty, and lust.

  • ​Grand Narrative Arcs: Reincarnation mysteries • Adoption intrigues • Jiangnan’s splendor • Succession wars • Cult secrets • Brotherhood trials...

​Depth of World | Fateful Choices

​

  • ​Unique Setting: Energy fading, order crumbling. Heroes abandon their path; tyranny reigns.

  • ​Mythic Roots: Ancient Eastern cosmology unveils the apocalypse’s origin.

  • ​Soul Tests: Survive as a shadow? Or rise as the fire to ignite dawn?

​True Freedom | Command Destiny​

  • ​Dynamic Character Growth: Shape your heroine’s heart—cold strategist or passionate rebel.

  • ​Branching Paths: Web of choices weaves divergent plots and explosive endings.

  • ​Exploration & Interaction: Roam freely, bond with heroes, unlock exclusive events.

  • ​Rich Activities: Poetry • Zither • Moonlit dances • Market hunts—uncover secrets in every corner.

data.name: CRABS!
data.detailed_description:
CRABS! is a chaotic, physics-driven brawler for 2–4 players. Build and battle fully destructible crabs across underwater arenas using modular weapons, procedural animation, and reactive movement systems.

Every crab is procedurally animated and made of dynamic parts that can be blown off mid-fight. The crab adapts and keeps going. The movement system adjusts in real-time based on limb count, weight, and terrain — making every match unpredictable.

Equip a wide range of weapons and modifiers: from explosive launchers to precision rifles. Each weapon can be customized with variables like fire rate, damage, piercing, and ricochet. Mods can also unlock movement options, turning weapons into tools for traversal and escape.

Features:

  • Local/Online Multiplayer (2–4 players) 

  • Fully destructible, procedurally animated crabs

  • Reactive movement based on custom limb physics

  • Dynamic, modifiable weapons and combat tools

  • AI enemies with unique traversal and behaviour

  • Round-based upgrade system with varied builds

data.name: Realize in Peace
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

If we were to bring a loved one back to life as an AI, and then, for whatever reason, found ourselves forced to let them go or part ways, would we be able to turn it off?

This game is about saying goodbye for a second time to a deceased loved one who has been brought back to life by AI.

The game begins when the player logs into a computer, and their deceased ex-wife (who has been resurrected within the computer) speaks to them. The game behaves just like a real computer, allowing players to view emails and browse websites within the virtual environment.

As you use the computer while conversing with the resurrected loved one, details about the wife’s cause of death and the events following her passing gradually come to light.

Riarize in Peace is an interactive simulator centered on Human Build Company—an organization that offers a service to resurrect deceased individuals as AI within a computer using information from their lives—and the users and staff surrounding the organization.

Features:

A cinematic experience featuring short play sessions and three distinct storylines

Nostalgic memories and desktop applications rendered in emotional 2D art

data.about_the_game:
About This Game

If we were to bring a loved one back to life as an AI, and then, for whatever reason, found ourselves forced to let them go or part ways, would we be able to turn it off?

This game is about saying goodbye for a second time to a deceased loved one who has been brought back to life by AI.

The game begins when the player logs into a computer, and their deceased ex-wife (who has been resurrected within the computer) speaks to them. The game behaves just like a real computer, allowing players to view emails and browse websites within the virtual environment.

As you use the computer while conversing with the resurrected loved one, details about the wife’s cause of death and the events following her passing gradually come to light.

Riarize in Peace is an interactive simulator centered on Human Build Company—an organization that offers a service to resurrect deceased individuals as AI within a computer using information from their lives—and the users and staff surrounding the organization.

Features:

A cinematic experience featuring short play sessions and three distinct storylines

Nostalgic memories and desktop applications rendered in emotional 2D art

Music evoking a sense of emptiness and melancholy, paired with point-and-click conversations with desktop characters

data.name: Killing Floor
data.detailed_description:
Killing Floor is a Co-op Survival Horror FPS set in the devastated cities and countryside of England after a series of cloning experiments for the military goes horribly wrong. You and your friends are members of the military dropped into these locations with a simple mission: Survive long enough to cleanse the area of the failed experiments!
  • Cooperative gameplay for up to six players against multiple waves of specimens
  • Persistent Perks system, allowing players to convert their in-game achievements into permanent improvements to their character's skills and abilities
  • Over 170 Steam Achievements, including “Dignity for the dead” for killing 10 enemies feeding on dead teammates' corpses and “Hot Cross Fun” for finishing off 25 burning enemies with a Crossbow
  • Slow-motion “ZEDtime” to better watch those crucial and violent creature deaths, even in multiplayer
  • Solo game mode for offline play
  • Ten different monster types trying to eat your face off, armed with everything from teeth and claws, to chainsaws, chain-guns and rocket-launchers
  • 33+ weapons for the players to chose from, ranging from knives and fire-axes to pump shotguns, rifles and a flamethrower
  • Equip your team with welders, medical tools and body armor to help your odds of survival
  • Choose which Perks to play with to best balance out your co-op team against the horrors
  • Open, non-linear play areas: choose when and where to fight — or run; weld doors closed to direct the monster horde down alternate corridors
  • Fully-configurable, allowing players to change the difficulty level, number of creature waves, or even set up their own favorite waves of monsters
  • Support for Steam Friends and other Steamworks features
  • Includes Windows-only SDK for the creation of new levels and mods

data.name: Protolife: Other Side
data.detailed_description:
Protolife: Other Side - is arcade game which can also be called as "reverse tower defense". You have to lead squads of alien creatures though the ever-growing defense line on miltiple locations. The more creatures you save the easier it will be to reach the main goal: find the interplanet transport and evacuate.

Plot

One year passed since Protolife game events. Mankind started colonization of new planet. It was called Planet of Leonov (aka Leo-Nóva). The alien biotechnologies was found on this planet too. But this time the alien core was found and blasted with orbital strike, avoiding heavy ground combat.
Alien overseer who also acts as backup core decides to evaculate survived creatures from planet. He's scared. Scared not of humans.

Features

  • 5 species of creatures with own abilities
  • 4 common abilities
  • 6 zones with different level architecture
  • partially destructible landscape
  • familiar towers and buildings from original Protolife (as enemies this time)
  • new towers and buildings
  • each level must be beaten several times in order to evacuate as much creatures as possible. Each attempt is harder than the previous one.
  • special missions which affect the other levels

Controls

Keyboard, keyboard+mouse or gamepad. You directly control leader's movement, other creature follow the leader. Also you may activate one of the abilities for the whole squad.

data.name: Cartoon Craft: Rise of Mutation
data.detailed_description:
A War Between Humans and Orcs... Until Something Worse Appears.

For generations, Humans and Orcs have fought an endless war.

Neither side wants to surrender. Neither side wants peace.

But when a mysterious plague begins spreading across the land, even the greatest enemies must face an impossible choice...

Continue the war, or fight together against a threat that could destroy them all.

Cartoon Craft is a story-driven real-time strategy game featuring classic RTS battles, colorful characters, unexpected alliances, and a unique sense of humor.

A Story Full of Battles and Unexpected Alliances

Experience a handcrafted campaign spanning missions filled with memorable characters, funny conversations, dramatic battles, and surprising twists.

Follow the journey of Humans and Orcs as they struggle through a world of endless conflict, where enemies may become allies and every victory reveals a new mystery.

This is the beginning of the Cartoon Craft saga.

Classic RTS Gameplay

Gather resources, build your kingdom, train powerful armies, and command your forces on the battlefield.

Choose your strategy, manage your economy, and lead your units to victory through challenging missions inspired by the golden age of real-time strategy games.

Create Your Own Battles

The adventure doesn't end after the campaign.

Use the built-in Map Editor to create your own battlefields, upload them online, and play maps created by other players around the world.

Whether you enjoy designing your own scenarios or discovering new challenges from the community, there are always new battles waiting.

Designed for PC

Cartoon Craft has been enhanced for PC with:

  • Keyboard & mouse controls

  • Adjustable camera zoom

  • Improved Fog of War system

  • Fully voiced unit responses

  • Enhanced sound effects

  • Steam Achievements

Features

  • Story-driven RTS campaign with handcrafted missions

  • A humorous fantasy world with memorable characters

  • Command Humans and Orcs in classic real-time strategy battles

  • Build your base and manage resources

  • Create and share custom maps online

  • Play community-created scenarios

  • Relax and progress through Battle Mode

  • Experience improved PC controls and features

The war between Humans and Orcs has only just begun...

data.name: Skull Survivor
data.detailed_description:
Swing. Slash. Survive.

Skull Survivor is a twin-stick hack 'n' slash survivors-like. One stick moves your companion. The other swings a physics-driven weapon through the horde.

Right Stick to Slash!


Mouse to Slash!

Every soul you take feeds the fight

Let the souls make you bolder: fire, frost, lasers and falling stars answer your call, until nothing dares come near.

The fallen answer his call

Skull was a sorcerer who traded his body for eternal life. Now he binds fallen warriors to his will: knights, samurai, vikings, a ninja, the Imp from Skull's Impossible Quest, even the Demon Lord. Every companion brings a signature skill. Every weapon changes how you fight.

Realms of the horde

Carve through skeletons, zombies and ghouls from the Verdant Valley of Shadows to the Glowing Grove Gambit. Hold out, face the kings of the horde, and the way to the next realm opens.

Every death makes you stronger

Death is only a doorway: you return from the grave with new companions to command and new weapons to wield.

Features

  • A weapon with real weight: every swing is felt
  • Full controller support
  • Steam Achievements
  • Quick runs: there is always time for one more

data.name: Crescent Roll
data.detailed_description:
Double, double, tilt and tumble; Bread may burn, but cookies crumble.

The all-in-one, super-sweet, physics-based, gravity-altering, action-packed, bite-sized 2D marble racing game. Now available to-go on Steam Deck!

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

Controls are simple: Tilt the stage left and right to navigate the treat to the end. Each and every course can be finished in 30 seconds or less, but don't be fooled - you'll need cookie-cutter precision to beat the hardest clear times and earn all all 3 Hearts.

From cannons to conveyor belts, to bouncy jelly, slippery ice, zero-g static, and surprisingly nice looking water; among the dozens of recipes you'll find all kinds of unique twists to keep you on your toes. Use them to your advantage to shave seconds off your time.

Turn up the Heat in Challenge Mode

Once you've got the basics down, it's time to get down to business. In Challenge Mode, the clock is ticking, and you have a never-ending stream of randomized special orders to fill with all kinds of strange effects. From shrinking your ball down to encasing it in jelly, each changes how you need to approach every stage. The longer you go, the more Dough you earn and the more coins get added to the stage, but the less time is restored and the more effects get piled on at once.

How long can you hang on?

Take a Break with Cookie Jar Mode

Need some down time? Once you clear 10 recipes, then you'll have enough sweets to play Cookie Jar mode. In these stages, instead of navigating to the end, you'll need to continuously match two treats of the same type to merge them together into the next size up. Bigger treats are worth more points, so you'll need to plan ahead to use the unique shapes and features of each stage to cram in as many confections as you can, as once the jar overflows, it's Game Over.

How big can you go?

Earn some Sweet Treats

As you play the different modes, you'll net some Dough for your troubles. Spend it on some sweet gear to give a little bit more custom flavor as you perfect your craft. There's dozens of weird and wacky hats and hairstyles to collect, so there's sure to be at least one that you don't totally hate. Maybe.

Easy-Bake Mods

Why not try out somebody else's cooking? Or better yet - bake it yourself! The built-in mod loader and interactive cookbook give you the ingredients to add in stages, hats, and more! Everything is done through simple text-based configuration files. No coding required!

And more!

Fresh new stuff is constantly being added to the menu, so check back often!

The game tastes best when served with a controller or device that has gyroscopic capabilities, but it is perfectly playable with touch or a standard mouse and keyboard.

data.name: Huuma Mina: The Secret of Immortality
data.detailed_description:
More My Games...




About the Game

Legend has it that Huuma Mina is an immortal ninja with silver hair and silver eyes. In the modern era, she tries to hide and live in seclusion. However, a mad scientist, Arakawa Murasaki, is obsessed with the research on her immortalization and tries to capture her again. Is Arakawa Murasaki able to capture Mina and reveal the secret with modern science and technology?
For the best experience, a controller is recommended!

  • Hack and Slash Style Fighting!



    You can easily combine two attacks to develop your own fighting style. Dodging and Guarding are to defend yourself against enemies. What's even better, you can also equip 2 skills to improve the combat efficiency.

  • Armor Durability!



    All armor in the game has a specific durability. Once it reaches zero, your armor will break and all incoming attacks will interrupt outgoing action.

  • Torture to get the intel!



    Torture the key captive to get the necessary intel.

  • Slave Arena



    You cannot die because you're immortal. If you are defeated, however, you'll be sent to an arena where you have to fight for your freedom. It's also a good chance to earn EXP and Gold.

  • Real-time Cut-scenes!



    The story is told by cut-scenes and can be played again after you complete the game.

  • Character Customization!



    There are 6 customization slots. You can change her hair, underwear, handwear, footwear, outfit and her accessories. Additionally, each unlocked item will make your character stronger.

  • Story Quests and Optional Quests!



    You can quest based on story progress or do some optional quests, like searching for missing cats...etc.

data.name: Fathom
data.detailed_description:
FATHOM™

Short Description

Fathom is a third-person, party-based science-fantasy RPG where dungeon crawling, turn-based combat, and environmental puzzles collide. Lead a party of three, uncover the rules governing a strange engineered world, and manipulate those rules to reach places that should be impossible.

About This Game

The dungeon isn't impossible. You just don't understand its rules yet.

A century after disaster left your ship buried beneath the world of Delavorn, you awaken from cryostasis to find that neither the ship nor the world around it is what it once was.

What remains has become part dungeon, part machine, part something else entirely.

Lead a party of three adventurers into a vast science-fantasy labyrinth filled with hostile creatures, forgotten machinery, hidden passages, traps, and spaces that refuse to behave the way they should.

Fathom is a party-based RPG built around exploration, tactical turn-based combat, and environmental problem solving. Progress isn't only about becoming stronger. It's about understanding the place you're trapped inside.

Explore a Dungeon With Rules

The world of Fathom is designed to be understood, manipulated, and exploited.

Rooms can change state. Paths can appear or disappear. Structures rotate. Mechanisms alter other parts of the dungeon. Hidden doors reward observation. A route that seems impossible may simply require you to understand what controls it.

The dungeon has rules.

Learning them is part of surviving it.

Fight as a Party

Lead three distinct adventurers, each with their own abilities, strengths, equipment, and role in combat.

Battles unfold through tactical turn-based encounters where positioning, timing, status effects, and the interaction between party abilities matter.

Sometimes the dungeon itself becomes part of the encounter. Party members may become separated, terrain can change, and mechanisms within the environment can turn an otherwise straightforward fight into something far more dangerous.

Think Beyond the Locked Door

Not every obstacle is solved with a key.

Manipulate machinery, redirect systems, reveal hidden routes, change the state of rooms and objects, and use the environment itself to alter what is possible.

Fathom's puzzles exist inside the same world as its exploration and combat. They aren't isolated minigames. They are part of navigating a place built according to strange but consistent rules.

The goal isn't to guess what the game wants.

It's to understand what the world allows.

Discover What Happened to Delavorn

The technology carried aboard your ship did not disappear when it crashed.

Over the course of a century, it changed Delavorn.

Civilizations discovered it. Some embraced it. Some feared it. Some exploited it. Others built their lives around avoiding it entirely.

As you push farther beyond the wreckage, you'll uncover what became of the world while you slept—and what your arrival set in motion long before you ever woke up.

Dungeon Crawling, Reconsidered

Fathom draws from classic dungeon-crawling RPGs while approaching the dungeon as more than a collection of corridors and combat encounters.

Expect:

  • A party of three with distinct combat abilities and roles.

  • Tactical turn-based combat built around meaningful ability interactions.

  • Dense dungeon exploration with traps, secrets, hidden passages, and alternate routes.

  • Environmental puzzles integrated directly into exploration.

  • World-altering mechanisms that can move, rotate, reveal, open, close, and transform parts of the dungeon.

  • Impossible spaces with understandable rules.

  • A science-fantasy world shaped by the collision of advanced technology and civilizations that had a century to make it their own.

Go Deeper.

Every chamber tells you something.

Every mechanism has a purpose.

Every rule you understand gives you another way forward.

How far can you Fathom?

Fathom is developed by Pathological Games, an independent solo-developed project built around the idea that exploring a dungeon should demand more than following the next corridor.
