data.name: Physics Playground
data.detailed_description:
Physics Playground is a game that is all about cubes and physics. You are on a huge playground where you can be as creative as you want. Build a small tower or, if that's too boring for you, create thousands of cubes and let them all fly through the air. But be careful not to catapult yourself into the sky.

tools

Use your "tools" to create new cubes, to move cubes, to fling cubes, to fling the player or just to wreak havoc.

buttons

Spread across your playground are large, red, glowing buttons just waiting to be pressed.

physics

Almost everything in this game can be moved, and when things can be moved, chaos is not far behind.

data.name: CORE.SYS
data.detailed_description:
Get ready to hack your way through increasingly complex computer systems in retro arcade style! CORE.SYS is a brainteasing action puzzler where you’ll need to break through layers of digital security with quick-thinking strategy. Move your cursor around a 5x5 grid of alphanumeric key panels, use your scanning ability to identify the next piece of code needed and select that panel to complete the code sequence, thus bypassing security and gaining access to the next layer.

Be careful, though! The deeper you hack, you’ll have to contend with more intense firewall sweeps. Can you locate the data you need to extract and get out clean?

• Hack your way into high-security computer systems!
• Move your cursor around a 5x5 grid in each system layer.
• Detect the next piece of code needed to complete the sequence!
• Avoid firewalls and security sweep.

data.name: Metal Shock Game
data.detailed_description:
Unreal Engine 5 update now available

Metal Shock Game a Next Gen Indie Sc-fi FPS Shooter in production where you will engage in fierce intense tactical combat on foot, jump into your Mecha suit and unleash fast smooth fiery mechanized warfare on crowded Gigatropolis streets then take off to the sky to engage in glorious 6Dof Ariel combat among towering structures all in a massive intricate seamless futuristic world.

Story:

Adox Lionex Supreme Prefect and High Priestess of the Blood God Xronox has commissioned you as the chief enforcer to put an end to cruel, barbaric drug fueled rebellion. You are equipped with a new fast sleek Mech to even the battlefield against the massive rebel Mech fleet that has allowed a rebel infestation outside the walls of the domed city. However, no one is who they say they are and nothing is what it seems as deep in the heart of the Gigatropolis lurks a DARK SECRET that will shake your reality and change your life.

Campaign:

Engage Hordes of Rebel Mecha, penetrate rebel nests and eliminate rebel bosses and treacherous allies with prejudice(and a BFG). Run and Gun as foot-soldier or jump into your mecha and Power-Skate to the nearest Turbo-Gate, or engage Fly-Mode to even the odds against a wide array of Rebel Power Mechs. Beware of treachery around every corner.

MetalShock Game is a Next-Gen game by a solo indie developer SO PLEASE BE PATIENT. NO Multiplayer is currently Available.

data.name: Failspace
data.detailed_description:
A spaceship is only as good as its crew! Failspace puts that testament to the test as you encounter different types of hazards when operating your space truck.

Play alone or co-op up to 4 people at once in your own space adventure where you can expect everything to go wrong! Try to complete cargo missions throughout the galaxy but remember that teamwork skills are crucial to become the best space trucker there is. So while your crew mate’s putting out a fire, go fix the shield or find out why the fire started. No lollygagging!


Fun co-op gameplay



Top off your stores of fuses and extinguishers at every station and use all the gadgets available to you to make it through!



Fast-paced & high-intensity VR experience



A good crew delivers their cargo on time. A great space trucker crew delivers their cargo on time with their ship intact. Be vigilant! An experienced operator will detect and prevent catastrophic malfunctions before they even begin or manage the ship's resources to direct more energy to the warp drive to make the trip even faster. There’s never a dull moment in space delivery!

Comical and chaotic, each play session lasts around 10 minutes requiring tight co-op communication and fast fixing physical skills, creating short bursts of fun with friends as everything potentially can go wrong.

data.name: Unity-Chan: Desktop Companion
data.detailed_description:
Kohaku Otori (also known as Unity-chan) found a way to traverse between worlds through the mysterious door found in her new apartment - one of these worlds is your desktop! Invite her to your PC, get to know each other, visit her room and play games together!

Unity-Chan: Desktop Companion is a mix of various genres:

  • Desktop Assistant: Unity-chan can hang out on your desktop, where she spends time with you as you focus on your work, watch videos or play games. Thanks to modern text-generation AI you can chat with her about anything, and even share pictures with her to comment and discuss on

  • Become Friends: Chatting is not just plain exchanging text and information. Unity-chan has special reactions for messages that make her feel happy, laugh or annoyed. All this influence her general mood and may change how she reacts to other subjects, and with time she opens up to you and likes you more. And who knows, maybe you will become the one who she trusts most?

  • Mini games: Interact with your virtual friend on another level by visiting her room and playing games with her there, with games varying from casual puzzle to more complex action shooter!

Unity-chan is all alone on your desktop and she doesn't have many friends outside of high school, so don't be shy and visit her in her room and chat while playing mini games together. Spend time with her playing mini games like Tic-Tac-Toe and Match-3 to more complex like Virus Offense - a top-down shooter where both you and Unity-chan fight against waves of cyber enemies!

If you are busy at work and don't have time to play mini games with her, you can still use her help and ask her about anything. Being powered by advanced text-generation AI she can become your source of quick access knowledge with more pleasant delivery than plain chat interface. Or a good source for silly jokes, lyrics or stories to lighten your mood. It's your story and she can make your daily life more colorful. Gain her trust and be nice to her so she may reward you with her friendship and share her story with you! Or make fun of her and make her angry, so she may argue with you or even refuse to cooperate completely, choice is yours.

Key features:

  • Advanced AI chat powered by modern text generation AI, everything is built-in and offline!

  • Additional systems simulating Unity-chan's mood, emotions and relation with player

  • Set up calendar reminders and let her learn facts about you

  • Visit her in her virtual room where you can play various mini games with her like Tic-Tac-Toe and Match-3

  • Play more advanced mini game on her TV console and meet yet another character to chat with!

  • Switch between desktop mascot mode and streamer mode, where she looks like a streamer watching your screen and judging your plays in other games >:D

The game uses official Unity-Chan assets based on Unity-Chan License (© Unity Technologies Japan/UCL)

data.name: The Backrooms
data.detailed_description:
You find yourself in a world that makes little sense. As you explore more, the world gets increasingly convoluted and unstable. You are now in... The Backrooms.

This is a short exploration based game where your goal is to find the exit - if there is one. Will you will be trapped here forever? Several possible fates await you, but are any of them good? Only one way to find out...

Highlights:

  • Simple, exploration based gameplay
  • Explore a world that has no respect for it's own rules
  • Traverse through multiple levels to find the exit
  • Explore out of bounds and discover hidden areas
  • Multiple bad endings and good endings to discover
  • Easter eggs to find

data.name: Mahjong Nook
data.detailed_description:
Mahjong: the original family drama simulator.

Mahjong Nook is the real tile game, not the matching puzzle you've seen everywhere else. Settle into a cozy 3D nook that feels like Sunday at grandma's, minus the unsolicited life advice of eating too little while being simultaneously too fat. Draw, discard, and fight for that winning hand across multiple rulesets: Hong Kong, Taiwanese, Sichuan, and more.

New to mahjong? We'll teach you. Already a pro? Invite someone and prove it.

Learn it. Love it. Never let your friends or family win again.

REAL MAHJONG

No matching here. No exploding gems. Just traditional mahjong, faithfully recreated and ready for your next rivalry with family (or friends).

MULTIPLE RULESETS

Every family swears their version of mahjong is the correct one. Learn Hong Kong, Taiwanese, Sichuan, and more. Then beat them at their own rules and take their candy. 

LEARN

Watched Crazy Rich Asians? Watched everyone else play but never got invited because nobody had the patience to teach you? Now's your chance! Learn at your own pace, then show up to the next gathering with no mercy! 

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS or not

Don't go outside and touch grass. Play with up to 3 friends or even just 1. You can even meet new rivals (or friends) online! Whether you're here to relax or ruin friendships, we don't judge.

CUSTOMIZE

Show off your style with mahjong skins, player titles, win animations, and more. Because if you're going to win, you might as well look good doing it.

FEATURES

  • Real mahjong, not the matching kind

  • Multiple rulesets: Hong Kong, Taiwanese, Sichuan, and more

  • Single player mode

  • PvP online multiplayer

  • Learn to play tutorial

  • Fun included. Family arguments are BYO.

data.name: After Hours Poker
data.detailed_description:
From bottle to boss. You start as a broke bottle-collector with 50 coins to your name. You end as the godfather, running the city's casino underworld. In between: a lot of poker.

Climb the ladder

After Hours Poker is a Texas Hold'em RPG. Win hands, build a bankroll, and fight your way up through 8 hand-crafted districts, from the gutter to the penthouse. Each district ends with a boss you have to beat at the table.

How it plays

  • Real Texas Hold'em against bots with actual pot-odds logic, not random button-mashers

  • Two economies - story coins drive your rise, multiplayer coins are their own track

  • Go broke, start over - hit zero and the story resets. High stakes, real tension.

Make it yours

Customize your character as you climb - 20 shirt colors, accessories, hairstyles, pets. Your avatar evolves automatically as your wealth grows.

Solo or against friends

Play the full rags-to-riches story offline, or jump into the online lobby and take your seat against other players.

Grab a beer. It's Feierabend, German for "after work". Time to play.

data.name: Suika Shapes
data.detailed_description:
🏆New online versus mode! Chain together combos to reduce the space in your opponent's box and get a higher score to win!

🍉 In Suika Shapes, match two shapes of the same color to create a larger shape and increase your score. Careful though, the more you play, the less space you have

🔄️Rotate and strategically match shapes

🌐Features over 2000+ leaderboards! Compete against the world, specialize and become a master of your favorite mode, and challenge your friends to beat your scores.

🤝Play with a friend online or offline in Co-op mode

🟢25+ Unique Shapes all with leaderboards!:

🛠️7 Modifiers to change up gameplay

  • Swap - allows you to swap shapes with the "Next" shape

  • Slippery - all shapes become slippery

  • Charge - Charge up and shoot out the shape with extra force

  • Low gravity - reduce gravity

  • Bouncy - All shapes become bouncy

  • Instant Drop- Drop cooldown is removed and shapes are instantly placed at the bottom

[/list]

  • Alternate physics - Use an alternative more dynamic phsyics engine

[/list]

🎮7 Gamemodes/Stages

  • Normal - The classic suika mode, aim to create and merge watermelon shapes. All shapes are carefully balanced so merging two watermelons is possible but very difficult

  • Speed mode - The floor is rising faster every minute, match shapes quickly to lower it - or run out of space!

  • Transformation - Each color corresponds to a specific shape that is the same every time, transform the shapes up until they are a round watermelon!

  • Evolution - Start off with smaller shapes, then every double watermelon clear the shapes grow in size a little! Best for long play sessions

  • Wheel - A large stage with a wheel in the center that changes direction when a shape is dropped

  • Pins - A stage where there are pins that pop out and alternate when you drop a shape

  • Balance- A special stage that tilts based on weight, and has no walls. If too many shapes fall off, you lose!

[/list]

⏱️Prefer something a bit more high pressure? Try speed mode and test your speed!

Mix and match any shape, gamemode, and modifier and challenge your friends to beat your score!

Based on the game スイカゲーム (watermelon game)

Monetization policy:

You have permission to stream the game, record and upload videos, and monetize streams/videos. You can also stream and monetize the game in paywalled streams (such as member only or subscription only streams)

Contact: suika-support@zan-kai.com

data.name: Loreth
data.detailed_description:
Spin, build, research.

You are a student god enrolled in the Loreth Academy, a celestial institution where gods study the laws that govern worlds and civilizations. As a junior deity who has yet to graduate, you must use the Academy’s Simulation Engine to explore different subjects and earn enough Research Points to complete your final evaluation.

Each simulation is a new field of study.

  • Diverse research themes based on civilizations, ecosystems, and mythology

  • Easy to learn, with meaningful strategic depth

  • Earn Research Points and work toward graduation from the Academy of Creation

will you discover the ultimate law of the world?

data.name: Food Delivery Service
data.detailed_description:
The 4th of low-price series of KimidoriSoft! "Food Delivery Service" Appears!

For video creators and streamers
KIMIDORI SOFT permits monetization through partner programs using KIMIDORI SOFT games.

Overview
You are a delivery man for a food delivery service.
A friend invites you to Nodaira-cho Town, a town that is rumored to be making a lot of money these days, and you work as a delivery person there, but little by little you get caught up in strange incidents.
This is an adventure game that makes you think about what is the right thing to do.

Features
  • Choices
    The ending changes depending on the player's choice, but I made it so that the player can start over right away, because I think it would be hard to play the game over and over again and make all the choices. There are exceptions.

  • About the game
    This is a horror game of the type that is scary when you know what it means. There are no direct horror expressions, but there are some violent expressions and murders, so please be careful.

  • Auto save
    Progress is automatically saved at key points, allowing you to continue playing from where you left off.

    # Approximate play time to complete the game is about 1 hour.

data.name: The Strange Box
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

In The Strange Box, you play as a child exploring an apartment shrouded in sin and mystery.

Follow fragments of memory and faint clues across the boundary between dreams and reality

all to find your missing friend.

Between Dreams and Reality

Wander through worlds born from a child’s imagination,

only to plunge the next moment into a filthy, decaying apartment.

Solve puzzles hidden in the cracks between dream and reality,

discern truth from illusion, and search for the only way out of this nightmare.

Every Resident Has a Secret

Strange tenants dwell behind every door.

A landlord and his wife secretly nurturing something grotesque,

a butcher shunned by everyone,

and a doctor obsessed with forbidden experiments.

Each is driven by an unseen, ominous force.

Children’s Courage Against Invisible Evi

In the darkness, only innocence still flickers with light.

To find their lost friend, the children embark on a journey to confront sin itself.

Where have all the missing children gone?

Only courage can reveal the truth.

data.name: Kintsugi Moon
data.detailed_description:
A small rabbit wakes in the terraced rice fields of ancient Japan, with no memory of who it is or how it got there. Mount Fuji rises far in the distance, its peak wrapped in moonlight, a destination the rabbit doesn’t yet understand but somehow already longs for.

Hand-drawn in the style of Japanese woodblock prints, Kintsugi Moon is a quiet journey through a moonlit world, with no combat, just you, the climb, and what you’ve forgotten.

Moonlight is more than light. Outside of it, the rabbit is just a rabbit: small, gentle, and earthbound. Step into moonlight and new paths open up: a second jump, a burst of speed, the push to spring off sheer walls. Offerings left at shrines along the way awaken these gifts. As you climb higher, moonlight grows harder to catch, and patches that once sat still begin to drift, testing your timing as much as your memory.

The road to Fuji. Guided by moonlight and drawn toward shrines scattered across the land, the rabbit begins the ascent through lantern-lit farming villages, misty riverside shrines and ancient cedar forests. Along the way, broken pottery shards hold fragments of memory, waiting to be pieced back together.

Every shard tells a piece of a story. Bring what you find to a fox who repairs each one with gold, using the ancient art of kintsugi. Each completed piece is a memory returned, slowly revealing who you were before you forgot.

Not every part of the mountain is lit. Deep inside an ancient cave, moonlight cannot follow. With every ability stripped away, the rabbit must move quietly through the darkness, past a threat best avoided rather than faced.

By the time you reach the summit, you will have to choose: return to the place you came from, or stay in the world you’ve come to know.

Features

  • Hand-drawn art inspired by shin-hanga woodblock prints

  • No combat: explore, climb and solve puzzles at your own pace

  • Abilities that only work in moonlight

  • A story told through memories restored with kintsugi

  • A final choice that decides how the journey ends

data.name: SUMOLYGONS
data.detailed_description:
In Development

SUMOLYGONS is still being developed and the features are subject to change. I'm a solo developer, so I have a lot of plans for the game and I'm very excited about it, but I also want to be realistic and upfront with you.

Wishlist to hear when it's ready! I truly appreciate the support!


About the Game

No health bars. Just physics, and the edge of the arena.

SUMOLYGONS is a fast, physics-driven sumo brawler for 1-4 players. You don't kill your opponents, you shove them out. Every hit is momentum. Every ability is a tool to either shove out your enemies, or protect yourself. The only thing between your friend and the void is how well they read the battlefield.

Shapes are classes

Every polygon is a genuinely different physics profile; mass, drag, move speed, dodge power, plus a signature trait that changes how you fight:

  • Concave Hexagon - "The Twin Cannon": Fire two of (almost) everything, at the cost of free aim. (fires out of the two forward-points of the shape)

  • Hexagon - "The Fortress": Get's a size bonus to all applicable abilities.

  • Pentagon - "The Juggernaut": The faster you're moving, the harder you hit.

  • Square - "The Equalizer": Fire along a cardinal direction for an ability power bonus.

  • Icositetragon - "The Phantom": Trade your dodge/push for the ability to phase shift, going briefly incorporeal.

  • Concave Octagon - "The Swift Striker": The fastest class with the quickest dodge/push in the game, but easy to launch since they're lightweight.

...and more.

Build your loadout: Shape (character class) / 2 Abilities / Optional Fusion

Pick two abilities to carry alongside your Shape's trait. Some pairs fuse into something new: Beam and Sniper collapse into a room-length Railgun. Grapple Hook and Pulse Mine become a Grapple Mine that reels in whatever trips it. Reflect Barrier and Shockwave turn a chargeable expanding wall of force.

Abilities aren't about doing damage, they're either about forcing someone out of the arena, or keeping yourself safely inside. Gravity wells drag the whole fight toward a point. Thrusters bolt onto an opponent and burn until they're over the edge. Beams push continuously, and two beams meeting head-on lock into a shoving contest that spends energy until one of you breaks.

Hand drawn art

All of the art (characters, abilities, menus, etc.) is drawn by me personally, with my own two hands. (well, just the right one, if you want to get technical) 

Create your own arenas

A full in-game level editor. Paint to design your arena floor, cut holes in it, place bumpers and hazards, set spawn points, and test your level instantly. Build a roster of your own arenas to dominate in a nearly infinite number of ways.

Read the arena, or leave it

Every ability is a push, a pull, or a piece of terrain. Ring-outs are the only win condition. The arena is as dangerous as the people in it.

Additional planned/potential features

  • Arcade "Rogue-like"-ish mode (solo and/or co-op)

  • Challenging Boss Fights

  • Custom level sharing: Either with Steam Workshop or other method

  • More Shapes(classes)

  • A Standard Set of Handcrafted levels

  • More Abilities

  • More Fusions

  • More Custom Level Objects & Tools

data.name: The Old Ones
data.detailed_description:
TALK TO US ON DISCORD


About the Game

In The Old Ones you play as Sophia, a young ambitious archeologist specialized in the disappearance of ancient civilizations, Sophia made alongside with her team a unique and rare discovery in the Mayan ruins, unfortunately her finding got rated as top secret by the government and her team got replaced, but Sophia couldn’t resist to come alone in the night to inspect the site herself, but she didn’t expect that she’s about to enter a rabbit hole!





Encounter many unique fantasy puzzles while solving the mystery of the old ones.




Climb ruins, fight ancient creatures, and dodge traps while exploring the newly discovered Mayan temple.




Explore never seen before fantasy ruins and experience the advanced knowledge the Mayan people have reached.

Key Features:


  • Full immersion, turn off the lights, put your headset on and enjoy an unforgettable journey.
  • A thrilling story as you explore the ancient and mysterious world to uncover it's secrets.
  • Amazing adventure filled with ruins to explore, cliffs to climb, and ancient creatures to fight.
  • Well designed puzzles integrated into the fantasy ruins waiting for you to solve.

data.name: Mini Transport
data.detailed_description:
Bored at home during the Spring Festival, I made a small game to entertain myself.
This game is very simple to start, drag and drop lines between each node to establish a connection, in order to transport the product of one node to another node, produce a new product or sell it.
In this process, pay attention to the use of limited human resources to increase the speed of certain pipelines in order to achieve load balancing throughout the industry chain. And be careful not to let yourself go bankrupt with rising maintenance fees.

data.name: SKY TOMB
data.detailed_description:
SKY TOMB is an action-packed 2.5D Shoot 'em Up Reverse Bullet Hell Roguelike with retro influences.





This game utilizes a 3D perspective with 2D visuals, wherein you and your ship are posed against immense hordes of bloodthirsty enemies. You are tasked with surviving as long as you can until your ship is destroyed and you start over, unlocking new ships in the process.





That's because it probably is, but this one is also fast, fun and dirt cheap.



Traditional Space Combat
Inspired by retro classics like Galaga and Asteroids, you steer your ship in zero-G - using your momentum and ship abilities to outmanoeuvre your opponents, equipped with a massive arsenal of missiles, plasma blasters, and many more weapons and modules.




Buildcraft
As you destroy enemies, you choose weapons and modules from a pool of randomly selected upgrades - turning your ship from a rustbucket with wings into a cacophony of destruction. No run is ever the same as you are encouraged to experiment heavily with a myriad possible upgrade options and build paths, as everything scales with everything.




Lateral Progression
As you progress, you will unlock more ships with completely different weaponry - shaking up your runs with build possibilities that fit your style of play.





Upcoming Features
  • More Stages
  • More Enemies
  • More Ships
  • More Upgrades
  • More Unlocks
  • Bosses
  • And maybe more! Take part in the development by giving us feedback!

data.name: Korter 1996
data.detailed_description:
It’s 1996 and it's raining. Your first apartment, your first quiet night away on your own. Soon after unpacking your first box, finding what your siblings packed away for you, arranging your cassette tapes, and hanging up your favourite denim jacket you accidentally crack open the back of your wardrobe, revealing a portal into your neighbours lives. Interacting and solving puzzles with their personal belongings, you begin to learn who they are, what their lives are like, and how through the lens of loneliness, you can feel connected.

Gameplay

Korter 1996 is an exploration of loneliness in a point and click adventure game. You can organise and decorate your new apartment and go on expeditions to other people's homes to find more items. While exploring different apartments on the block, you get to solve puzzles that will lead you to more information on each of the inhabitants. How you interact with the items in their apartments will move forward their story and through item dialogues you get to know about their lives.

Features

  • Move around items and organise to your heart's content (or make a mess)

  • Hear the thoughts of people who have interacted with the items you find

  • Unlock new locations and uncover their mysteries

  • Progress at your own pace

  • Collect stickers

  • Unlock the catalogue

  • Fill your apartment with stuff

data.name: The Rusty Sword: Vanguard Island
data.detailed_description:
Now includes a second island and dungeon, along with new enemies and equipment!

The Rusty Sword: Vanguard Island is a short, top-down adventure game inspired by several 16-bit games you know and love. It features a small island overworld, a large non-linear dungeon, countless monsters to battle, classic art that takes you back through time, and a nostalgic soundtrack. In the game, you venture on a quest to find the hidden Vanguard Relic.

FEATURES

Non-linear adventure structure with multiple ways to get to most places.

Simple, intuitive controls.

Tons of secrets and Easter eggs.

Designed around single-player, but even more fun with two-player co-op.
*You will need two connected/paired, compatible controllers to play co-op.

Nostalgic graphics and music inspired by many 16-bit classics.

Several display options, including widescreen and classic aspect ratios.

Language support for English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.

data.name: Billionaire in the Greedy America
data.detailed_description:
Build your financial empire across 1850s America. Trade stocks, commodities, and bonds, acquire companies, speculate on real estate, and outsmart 30 rival investors in this deep economic tycoon simulator.

About This Game


The year is 1850. America is booming.

Railroads stretch across the frontier. Gold rushes ignite fortunes overnight. Coal mines, cotton mills, and steamboat lines fuel an unstoppable industrial revolution. In this land of opportunity, only the boldest and shrewdest investors will rise to the top.

Billionaire in the Greedy America is a deeply simulated financial tycoon game where you start as an ambitious investor and fight your way to the top of Wall Street — one trade, one acquisition, one hostile takeover at a time.

Trade Everything


Navigate a living, breathing financial ecosystem across 20 US states, each with its own economy, central bank, and political landscape.

  • Stock Market — Buy, sell, and short-sell shares in dozens of companies. Watch prices react to earnings, market trends, and your own trades.
  • Commodities — Speculate on oil, coal, steel, wheat, gold, lumber, cotton, sugar, and aluminum. Commodity prices ripple through industries, affecting the companies you own.
  • Bonds — Invest in corporate and state bonds with realistic yield curves. Balance risk and return across maturities up to 30 years.
  • Real Estate — Build or buy commercial properties, luxury mansions, rental buildings, and even sport clubs across the nation.

Build Your Corporate Empire


When you acquire enough shares in a company, you take control. Then the real game begins.

  • Hire and fire CEOs — Choose between aggressive, conservative, balanced, cost-cutting, or innovative management styles.
  • Manage operations — Set R&D budgets, marketing spend, pricing strategies, and expand with new branches in other states.
  • Execute corporate maneuvers — Launch IPOs, leveraged buyouts, greenmail attacks, mergers, extraordinary dividends, and corporate restructurings.
  • Found new companies — Start businesses from scratch in any of the 19 period-authentic industry sectors, from Railroad Construction to Arms Manufacturing, from Gold Mining to River Steamboat Shipping.

Outsmart 30 AI Rivals


You're not alone in this race for riches. 30 AI investors — each with their own strategy — compete against you for the same opportunities. Value investors play the long game; speculators chase short-term profits. They can go bankrupt, reinvent themselves, or even make you an offer you can't refuse for your prized shares.

A Living Economy


  • Dynamic politics — Republican and Democratic parties compete in state elections every 4 years, shaping tax policy on income, capital gains, corporate profits, and wealth.
  • Central bank rates fluctuate with GDP growth, affecting loans, bond yields, and the entire economy.
  • Economic cycles — Booms and depressions strike unpredictably, rewarding those who prepared and punishing the reckless.
  • State contracts — Bid for lucrative government procurement deals in railroads, arms, ironworks, and textiles.

Your Rules, Your Challenge


Customize your experience with difficulty options:

  • Choose your starting capital — from rags to modest riches
  • Enable the licensing system to require state-by-state market access
  • Activate wealth taxes for a harder financial challenge
  • Turn on market impact realism where your large trades move prices against you

Features at a Glance


  • Deep financial simulation set in 1850s America
  • Trade stocks, bonds, commodities, and real estate
  • Short selling, IPOs, leveraged buyouts, mergers, and greenmail
  • Own and manage companies across 19 authentic industry sectors
  • 20 US states with independent economies, politics, and tax systems
  • 30 AI investors with distinct trading strategies
  • Dynamic economic cycles with booms and depressions
  • 5 CEO management styles for AI-driven or hands-on company control
  • Government contracts and competitive bidding
  • Detailed financial reporting: P/E ratios, EPS, ROE, credit ratings, balance sheets
  • Available in English, German, Italian, and Russian

In the Greedy America, opportunity is everywhere. But so is the competition. How far will you go?

data.name: Frog Escape
data.detailed_description:
[Frog Escape]

Background

A frog girl, trapped in a secret underground lab, endured endless days of repetitive experiments. One day, she overheard a shocking conversation revealing her fate to be disposal. Determined not to wait any longer, she made up her mind to escape and seek freedom...

Frog Skills

In order to escape the lab, the frog girl must solve various puzzles. She can use her unique ability to cling to walls and ceilings to move. Use this ability to solve puzzles and advance towards your escape!

(However, be cautious, as she cannot cling to rough or uneven surfaces.)

Puzzle elements

The maze-like laboratory is filled with various puzzle elements. One of the key features is the battery! Batteries can be obtained from battery storage units and have the advantage of being reusable multiple times. Utilize them to activate various devices in the lab and carve your way forward!


Threats

As the frog girl moves forward, she will encounter various monsters and obstacles. The monsters will charge at her the moment they spot her. Can the frog girl overcome all these challenges and make her escape?

data.name: Couch Combat
data.detailed_description:
Kill Your Friends!
Grab a gun and be the last one standing in fast, frantic rounds. Play on over 30 stages with a variety of elements and unique mechanics. A unique modifier system will continuously stack modifiers which increase the chaos every round with new mechanics, effects, and items.

Couch-Worthy Combat
Play with up to 4 players locally as you ruin friendships to claim victory! Short rounds make for great party gameplay where you can hand off controllers to others. Also supports Steam Remote Play Together, where you can play with friends online.

Piles Of Guns
Featuring classic FPS staples like the pistol or AK-47 alongside weapons like the BOOMER, a 2d pixelated shotgun.

Mix It Up
In Classic Mode, you get to vote on modifiers which stack up and build the chaos of the game. And after several rounds of building chaos, you face off in a Ridiculous Round with a unique, bigger modifier. After this, all modifiers reset and you get to do it all over again. In Arcade mode, you get to choose all the stages, guns, and modifiers that you want to play with.

Retro Revival
Every stage is based off of a classic movie genre. Slash through your friends with katanas in the lush gardens of the Samurai area. Wallrun at ridiculous speeds through the totally rad Outrun area. Or drink potions in the Fantasy area for strong elemental powers with dangerous side-effects.

data.name: Into The Eternal
data.detailed_description:
The Gods of Into the Eternal are capable of creating worlds and setting events in motion. Once they ascend from that world they can no longer control it, and must trust that man will do right by their creation. After many worlds fell into ruin due to man's passion for war, the gods came up with a solution. They created a monster called the Great Exiler, which would rise from the ocean every 900 years - and if man didn't work together to destroy it, then the huge beast would destroy everything. Man would have to start over.

As the game opens, the monster has once again risen from the ocean, and you must take up arms against it.

Into The Eternal is a massive action RPG featuring a unique blend of a third person overworld and metroivania style battles. You'll seamlessly transition from third person over the shoulder to side scrolling combat as you explore the massive world. Explore a huge world with secrets at every turn. Plunder caves for new abilities, enter the spirit realm to locate lost treasure, track down trophy monsters for the hunter's guild, buy a farm and grow crops to brew powerful potions and upgrades, and help other players by bottling your spirit - allowing them to summon you into battle.

data.name: Aw Nutz
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever wanted to be a nut? How about a pistachio? Well, now you can! Choose from a wide variety of legumes and assorted nuts as you try flinging into the mouths of your enemies. Play with friends or with complete strangers as 1 human vs. 5 nuts! Porl the Human is deathly allergic to nuts but still has chores to complete. How will he fare when he finds out that nuts have broken into his home?

Human's Job

Complete Human Tasks Like...


  • Watching TV
  • Vacuuming the Stairs
  • Washing the Dishes
  • Cleaning up rooms
  • Preparing Dinner
  • And More...

Nut's Job

Only One Job...


  • Land in some guy's mouth

Gameplay

While the Human performs normal human jobs the nuts must try and land inside the open mouth to win. If the human can complete all the tasks in the allotted time then they win. If neither the nut nor human win before the time runs out then it is a draw and everybody loses! Make your friends jealous with 12 unlockable nuts and 6 unlockable humans!

data.name: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever tried dictation, the ultimate reflex training for English listening?

This game merges listen-and-type gameplay with real-time tower defense, helping you sharpen your English intuition naturally in the heat of battle!

Listening Is Your Tower Blueprint

Every tower starts with a dictation test: select an open lot, type the word on the card, listen to an English audio clip, and type in the missing phrase. The moment you finish, your tower lands and opens fire! Upgrades require dictation too. The clearer you listen and the faster you type, the quicker your defense takes shape. Every second you hesitate, the enemies press closer!

Tactics Win the Battle

Metal dictates how many towers you can build, but dictation determines how fast you set them up. Where to build, which tower to upgrade, and when to focus your firepower is entirely up to you:

  • Four Base Towers, Twelve Branches: Cannon, Blast Tower, Frost Blade, and Barracks. Each has three upgrade steps with three choices each before entering a specialized branch: piercing Laser Cannons, Firebombs that leave a sea of flames, Assassins that hunt down the toughest targets... The same base tower can evolve into completely different weapons.

  • Fever: Type a single word to refill your Fever tank. Your selected tower enters Fever, gaining boosted attack speed and range to unleash massive firepower right when you need it most.

  • Bosses: Every chapter features formidable bosses with unique mechanics, such as advancing with shields, devouring allies to heal, or hacking your screen to cause visual chaos. Can your setup hold the line?

  • Branching Map: Chart your path across branching routes filled with diverse events. Engage Elite foes, visit the shop, try your luck at the wheel, or take on high-risk challenge stages. The choice is yours.

  • Relics and Talents: Leveling up unlocks new tower branches and enhanced modules through Talents, while Relics push your builds to the extreme. How far can you stack your defenses?

  • Enemy Affixes and Elites: As you dive deeper into chapters, enemies gain dangerous affixes and Elite units arrive with deadly signature skills. When enemy combinations get tough, your tactical build will be tested.

Smart Adaptive Difficulty

Worried that beginner English skills will slow you down, or that advanced practice feels unrewarding? Smart difficulty adjustments keep your listen-and-type experience fluid and rewarding.

  • Prologue Calibration: Your initial playthrough starts with a prologue that teaches the basics while measuring your ideal text difficulty and audio speed.

  • Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment: Question difficulty fine-tunes after every prompt based on your performance. Play smoothly across several rounds to advance your Tier, or let the game ease up automatically if you struggle.

  • Graded Content and Diverse Topics: Texts are layered by difficulty and cover a wide range of themes, ensuring players at any skill level can enjoy the journey.

  • Adjustable Speed and Accents: Choose between male and female voices across British and American accents to build well-rounded listening skills.

  • Flow-Saving Practice Features: The battlefield slows down during long sentence dictations so you can focus. Press Tab to replay audio at any time, and if you miss twice on the same question, a slower version plays automatically.

  • Spelling Hints: Heard the word but unsure how to type the spelling? The hint assistant steps in right when you need a boost to keep your guns firing.

  • Battle Records: Clear visual charts track your accuracy, speed, and difficulty progression, saved independently for each profile.

Defend your outpost every day. Win the battle, keep the listening skills forever.

What's Next

Post-max-level challenge tiers, richer strategic combinations, and even tougher enemies lie ahead!

Metal dictates how many towers you can build, but dictation determines how fast you set them up. Where to build, which tower to upgrade, and when to focus your firepower is entirely up to you:

  • Four Base Towers, Twelve Branches: Cannon, Blast Tower, Frost Blade, and Barracks. Each has three upgrade steps with three choices each before entering a specialized branch: piercing Laser Cannons, Firebombs that leave a sea of flames, Assassins that hunt down the toughest targets... The same base tower can evolve into completely different weapons.

  • Fever: Type a single word to refill your Fever tank. Your selected tower enters Fever, gaining boosted attack speed and range to unleash massive firepower right when you need it most.

  • Bosses: Every chapter features formidable bosses with unique mechanics, such as advancing with shields, devouring allies to heal, or hacking your screen to cause visual chaos. Can your setup hold the line?

  • Branching Map: Chart your path across branching routes filled with diverse events. Engage Elite foes, visit the shop, try your luck at the wheel, or take on high-risk challenge stages. The choice is yours.

  • Relics and Talents: Leveling up unlocks new tower branches and enhanced modules through Talents, while Relics push your builds to the extreme. How far can you stack your defenses?

  • Enemy Affixes and Elites: As you dive deeper into chapters, enemies gain dangerous affixes and Elite units arrive with deadly signature skills. When enemy combinations get tough, your tactical build will be tested.

Smart Adaptive Difficulty

Worried that beginner English skills will slow you down, or that advanced practice feels unrewarding? Smart difficulty adjustments keep your listen-and-type experience fluid and rewarding.

  • Prologue Calibration: Your initial playthrough starts with a prologue that teaches the basics while measuring your ideal text difficulty and audio speed.

  • Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment: Question difficulty fine-tunes after every prompt based on your performance. Play smoothly across several rounds to advance your Tier, or let the game ease up automatically if you struggle.

  • Graded Content and Diverse Topics: Texts are layered by difficulty and cover a wide range of themes, ensuring players at any skill level can enjoy the journey.

  • Adjustable Speed and Accents: Choose between male and female voices across British and American accents to build well-rounded listening skills.

  • Flow-Saving Practice Features: The battlefield slows down during long sentence dictations so you can focus. Press Tab to replay audio at any time, and if you miss twice on the same question, a slower version plays automatically.

  • Spelling Hints: Heard the word but unsure how to type the spelling? The hint assistant steps in right when you need a boost to keep your guns firing.

  • Battle Records: Clear visual charts track your accuracy, speed, and difficulty progression, saved independently for each profile.

Defend your outpost every day. Win the battle, keep the listening skills forever.

What's Next

Post-max-level challenge tiers, richer strategic combinations, and even tougher enemies lie ahead!

data.name: NYXverse.AI
data.detailed_description:
Why is it called "NYXverse"?

NYX (Νύξ) is the Greek goddess of night in Greek mythology, who gave birth to "dreams" and "fate." NYXverse signifies our aspiration to build a world where everyone can shape their own dreams and destinies—a free space filled with creativity and diverse, wonderful dreams.

What kind of "game" is this?

To be honest, we can't really define it precisely, especially when most of the experience is built on "AI-generated content." All we can say is that this is a product featuring tens of thousands of 3D AI-driven characters, where players enjoy complete freedom to create stories and scripts. It's also one that will continuously evolve with new and entertaining AI-driven gameplay.

Free Chat:

Engage with the AI companion using your text, or go ahead and use voice chat, even send images or gifts to strengthen your connection and deepen your relationship over time.

Discover Your Ideal AI Companion:

Find your perfect match among tens of thousands of unique AI entities.

Create Your Own AI Companion:

Upload content, customize appearances, design from scratch, or use any DIY method you can think of to bring your unique AI to life.

AI-Generated Scripts:

Tasks and storylines that evolve differently based on every action you take and every word you speak.

Intimate Interactions:

How about lying in bed together to listen to a bedtime story? Or engaging in a deep conversation about an interesting piece of art? Give it a try!

Looking for even more unique ways to interact? We can't wait for you to discover them!

data.name: TowerHex
data.detailed_description:
TowerHex is a virtual reality escape game where you and your team set out on a quest to find a missing alchemist. He disappeared while investigating an ancient ritual on crystal energy. Following his footsteps, you will have to climb old castle ruins inside a lava mountain. To get ahead you will have to solve various puzzles and learn to use crystal energy for teleportation. There are also dragons.

Game Features

* Designed for room scale VR
* Suitable for multiplayer
* 11 rooms and only 1 hour until time runs out
* Magical atmosphere in a fantasy environment
* Beautiful graphics and immersive VR gameplay
* Various interesting mechanisms and well-designed puzzles throughout the story
* Simple controls - one button for overall intuitive gameplay and one button for teleportation

Game is built for everyone between age of 10 and 99 without any VR or HTC Vive experience.

data.name: Ion Fury
data.detailed_description:
While Shelly "Bombshell" Harrison earned her codename defusing bombs for the Global Defense Force, when evil transhumanist mastermind Dr. Jadus Heskel unleashes the members of his cybernetic cult onto the streets of Neo D.C., she knows it's time to start causing explosions instead of preventing them.

Her quest to slay Heskel leaves a trail of carnage throughout huge, multi-path levels filled with gigantic explosions, more secret areas than we can count, and inhuman foes behind every corner. There's no regenerating health here; stop taking cover and start running and gunning.

Shelly's crusade to take down Heskel's army will see her leave destruction in her wake with a wide arsenal of weapons, complete with alternate fire modes and different ammo types. Her signature revolver, the tri-barreled Loverboy, brings enemies pain and players pleasure with both single shots and Old West-style hammer fanning action. Who needs a regular shotgun when you can load buckshot into your grenade launcher? Violent, over-the-top Bowling Bombs rip enemies apart with ease.

Ion Fury laughs at the idea of mandatory checkpoints and straight paths through shooting galleries. But, just because this is a true old-school first-person shooter doesn't mean we've ignored all the good new stuff the last two decades have brought. Headshots? Hell yeah. More physics and interactivity? You betcha. Widescreen, controller support, and auto saves? 3D Realms and Voidpoint have taken the best of both worlds and cooked it all into a bloody stew.

  • The true successor to classic shooters such as Duke Nukem 3D, Shadow Warrior, and Blood.
  • Experience the original Build Engine on steroids, pumped up and ready to rock again after 20 years!
  • Duck, jump, climb, swim, and blast your way through 7 exciting zones packed with multiple levels of mayhem!
  • A beautiful game world assembled from over 10,000 hand-crafted textures and sprites.
  • An awe-inspiring arsenal of devastating weapons, including multiple ammo types and alternate fire modes. Tri-barreled revolvers, grenade launchers, and heat-seeking smart bombs are your best friends!
  • The classic '90s FPS action you love, meshed with modern inventions like locational damage and seamless level transitions.
  • ZERO PROCEDURAL GENERATION. All levels are hand made and full of multiple paths, cool effects, and complex set pieces!
  • Thumping soundtrack comprised of true tracked module music, in authentic FastTracker 2 (.XM) format.
  • Easy access to level editor and other development tools. Full game source code available.

New to Ion Fury? Get Ion Fury + Aftershock for the complete experience.

Already own Ion Fury? Pick up Ion Fury: Aftershock for a full second campaign plus Arrange Mode, a mirror-world remix of the original campaign that integrates Aftershock’s new enemies, items, and weapons while reworking map progression, item placement, and enemy encounters.

data.name: P.A.C.K. :: Post Apocalyptic Cleaning Kit
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to PACK: Post Apocalyptic Cleaning Kit, the first-person adventure where tidying up is the ultimate objective! You pilot a state-of-the-art robot, initially designed for light disaster recovery—but let’s be real, the world went full 'end times.' That's fine! A good robot never misses a deadline. Get ready to power up your chassis and dive into the abandoned, dusty ruins of civilization. Use your built-in tools to wash away years of grime, vacuum up trash for compression into resource cubes, and restore old structures. Play solo and explore the funny, sad and mysterious lore behind humanity's sudden disappearance, or grab up to three friends and turn the apocalypse into a satisfying cleanup party! Get ready to scrub, scavenge, and discover—it’s time to make the apocalypse spotless!

Washing

The handy washing tool is used to wash away various types of grime, stains, or even biological residue. While the washer can move small objects, there are better tools for that job.

Vacuuming

The vacuum tool is designed to collect small items and surface debris like leaves and papers. However, the vacuum has a capacity limit. When full, you will need to eject a compressed trash cube that can then be processed at the recycling station.

Recycle

The robot's integrated graspers are used to move objects and deliver trash cubes—along with other debris too large for the vacuum—to the recycling station. These recycled items provide valuable resources that can be used to repair broken objects in the environment.

Repair

Utilize the resources acquired from recycling to repair broken equipment and objects in the environment.

Upgrades

Remaining resources at the end of the level are automatically converted into upgrade scrap which is then used unlock powerful upgrades for your cleaning bot.

Key Features

  • Clean: Deploy the high-pressure spray washer to instantly clear biological residue, stubborn grime, and environmental corruption.

  • Vacuum: Activate the tactical vacuum to sweep up debris and instantly forge compressed Trash Cubes—the ultimate loot for easy disposal and resource acquisition.

  • Recycle: Utilize the robot graspers to efficiently recover debris, collect ejected trash cubes, and transport them to the recycling station.

  • Repair: Utilize recovered resources to forge necessary components, instantly repairing critical equipment and restoring broken structures in the environment.

  • Upgrade: Remaining level resources are converted into Upgrade Scrap which is used to upgrade various aspects of your cleaning bots abilities.

  • Lore: Discover echo spheres and environmental clues to piece together the narrative and uncover the full story of the collapse.

  • Co-op: Team up with up to 3 friends for streamlined co-op cleaning collaborative restoration.

Play solo and explore the funny, sad and mysterious lore behind humanity's sudden disappearance, or grab up to three friends and turn the apocalypse into a satisfying cleanup party! Get ready to scrub, scavenge, and discover—it’s time to make the apocalypse spotless!

Washing

The handy washing tool is used to wash away various types of grime, stains, or even biological residue. While the washer can move small objects, there are better tools for that job.

Vacuuming

The vacuum tool is designed to collect small items and surface debris like leaves and papers. However, the vacuum has a capacity limit. When full, you will need to eject a compressed trash cube that can then be processed at the recycling station.

Recycle

The robot's integrated graspers are used to move objects and deliver trash cubes—along with other debris too large for the vacuum—to the recycling station. These recycled items provide valuable resources that can be used to repair broken objects in the environment.

Repair

Utilize the resources acquired from recycling to repair broken equipment and objects in the environment.

Upgrades

Remaining resources at the end of the level are automatically converted into upgrade scrap which is then used unlock powerful upgrades for your cleaning bot.

Key Features

  • Clean: Deploy the high-pressure spray washer to instantly clear biological residue, stubborn grime, and environmental corruption.

  • Vacuum: Activate the tactical vacuum to sweep up debris and instantly forge compressed Trash Cubes—the ultimate loot for easy disposal and resource acquisition.

  • Recycle: Utilize the robot graspers to efficiently recover debris, collect ejected trash cubes, and transport them to the recycling station.

  • Repair: Utilize recovered resources to forge necessary components, instantly repairing critical equipment and restoring broken structures in the environment.

  • Upgrade: Remaining level resources are converted into Upgrade Scrap which is used to upgrade various aspects of your cleaning bots abilities.

  • Lore: Discover echo spheres and environmental clues to piece together the narrative and uncover the full story of the collapse.

  • Co-op: Team up with up to 3 friends for streamlined co-op cleaning collaborative restoration.
data.short_description: Step into the wheels of a robot in this sci-fi cleaning adventure set after the apocalypse. Wash, vacuum, recycle and repair abandoned structures while learning about the ultimate fate of mankind, alone or with friends.

data.name: Womb of Worms
data.detailed_description:
Womb of Worms is a short horror game where a terrifying ancient god manifests itself through worms and maggots, looking to be reborn through someone's body. From the developer of Orompaquenga and Equi Ungula.

You return to your hometown after receiving a letter from an old friend, uncovering a gruesome truth, one of the locals is no longer human. You will have to talk with the locals and find out who is human and who isn't, no matter who it is, in the end you will decide who dies, with a gun in hand...

At nightfall you will be able to spy on one of the suspects as you avoid the police, watch the news on TV about the worldwide chaos and worm plagues, check yourself in the mirror just in case... and sleep to move on to the next day. Nightmares may torment you too...

It is recommended to compare what the suspects say, notice patterns, strange words, and distinct behaviour.

Connect the dots, reach your own conclusions.

Features:

  • Hand drawn art.

  • Body horror and psychological horror elements.

  • Short narrative loop, meant to be played in a single session.

  • Multiple endings.

  • Several suspects to talk with and investigate.

  • Anxiety management.

  • Light exploration.

Originally created for Toasty Jam 2025, now extended as a complete experience.

data.name: Solaria Moon
data.detailed_description:
Solaria Moon is a space adventure in 3D in which we will be on board of the enormous cargo spacecraft Taranis. Our protagonist, a young computer engineer named Lucy Lambert, wakes up completely disorientated in her hibernation capsule without a hint of what has happened. From that moment, it will take place a new adventure full of challenging puzzles to solve and mysteries to uncover.



Main features

• Space adventure in 3D.
• High quality graphics.
• Intriguing and enigmatic plot.
• Dozens of puzzles integrated in the development of the story.
• Multitude of interactive elements.
• Exploration of the spacecraft Taranis.
• Distinguished original soundtrack.
• Accurate Spanish and English dubbing.




Find out the truth

An unexpected breakdown of the Tarani’s control systems have triggered a critical situation in the hibernation capsules. Only one crew member, Lucy Lambert, has survived the system overload. Immediately, she discovers that the capsule of her teammate, Nikolai Pavlov, is completely empty. From this moment on, Lucy will have to apply her instinct and ingenuity in order to find out what is happening on the enormous cargo spaceship Taranis and locate her teammate Pavlov.

Explore Taranis spaceship

To progress in this adventure, Lucy will have to go through all the hidden corners of the Taranis spaceship. The infirmary, the cabins, the reactor room or the bridge will only be a few scenarios in which Lucy will go into in order to uncover the truth about the Taranis and its crew.



Visit our webpage:

data.name: Chaos Theory
data.detailed_description:
Please be aware this game is in very early access and by purchasing the game you will initially be helping with providing feedback on bugs and game play. Due to this early release not all features will be available. However, we will be releasing constant updates which will offer new content and features as they're developed. We welcome your feedback!

Chaos Theory is an open-ended sandbox virtual world with a blend of RPG and a real time strategy / city builder.
It asks one simple question – how will your actions shape the world?



A Real World 'Butterfly Effect': In this amazing open world environment, every item is interactive and every action you make has an effect on the future course of the world around you.

Set in the town of Lunaris, you must survive by firstly gathering food, building an array of industrial, defensive, residential and commercial buildings and carefully managing your resources. You must also do your utmost to defend against the evil invasion of the Death Guard!

The towns continued survival relies on your cunning, luck and ability to part of a successful community.

About Chaos Theory:

  • Sandbox city management survival game with a focus on realistic life mechanics.
  • Carefully manage variables like genetic traits, food, and resources to secure your town's future and help them prosper.
  • One life only- PERMADEATH adds a unique tension to the game
  • Collect and craft items to help yourself, your family and the towns community at large survive and thrive
  • Build town buildings to help with the survival of your community.
  • Manage emotional character traits like passivity and aggression to get ahead of the game
  • All other villagers of the town will help shape the future of the town and its environment
  • Defend against the ever increasing invasion from the Death Guard

    This Early Access version includes the following features:

  • Third-Person / First Person character control
  • Basic combat system (melee only)
  • RPG levelling system
  • Character design
  • Inventory system
  • Resource gathering
  • Crafting system
  • Social system
  • Family system
  • Day / Night cycle

    Upcoming features:

  • Full combat system to include ranged and magic
  • Building construction
  • The Royal family
  • Trading system
  • Monetary system
  • Will system (allows you to pass down a characters property)

data.name: MagicCar of Delicious
data.detailed_description:
A combination of combat, cooking, and exploration, players will pilot magical chariots across the rich terrain of the continent of Atherland, challenging guardians, exposing the secrets of the Dark Eclipse Order, and upgrading and food crafting along the way



Embark on an adventurous journey across the continent of Atherland, driving upgradable chariots and exploring diverse terrain from volcanoes to snow-covered mountains, deserts to forests. Faced with a variety of challenges, players will need to respond intelligently to battles while cooking]empowering magical treats in a mobile food truck!



While exploring the rich and diverse continent of Atherland, players will set up stalls to sell the magical dishes they cook. By trading with townspeople from all over the world, players can not only obtain resources, but also experience the game's unique socialization



Each victory brings the opportunity to expand and upgrade the chariot, allowing the player to unlock new magical buildings that only add to the chariot's body, but also boost its fighting and cooking abilities. In the process, the player will traverse a variety of exotic terrains, with each growth bringing the player closer to the ultimate goal



Find and challenge the 7 Major Magical Vein Crystals Guardians in each of the featured terrains, with each Guardian's battle being a test of the player's strategy and preparation. Collect all of the Magical Vein Crystals to prepare for the final confrontation with the Dark Eclipse Order's Patriarch


Hello everyone! Thanks for being able to follow this game, it's a game that I've made in a year of my spare time, overcoming all sorts of (laborer) difficulties. At the moment the game isn't quite done, it's far from my expectations and I've hit some bottlenecks in my work. It's also a time when I'm facing a big decision, so I thought it would be a good idea to let this game come out earlier, to accept criticism and accusations, and to help me, as a newcomer, to finish this work faster and better!

data.name: Stellar Infestation
data.detailed_description:
A tower defense game with light production line elements.

The vast galaxy is entirely occupied by the insect swarm, yet the home planet’s mineral resources are exhausted. To obtain minerals, players are sent as officers to different planets, establishing production lines, extracting minerals, and manufacturing the ammunition needed for defense towers.

Beware of the endless swarm of insects—build your defenses and keep them at bay!

Various types of defense towers—strategically build your defense line

More than ten types of defense towers, each with unique features and multiple upgrade levels. Plan according to the insects’ routes while managing your ammunition and resource consumption. The insect horde grows stronger over time—you will be racing against day and night.

Craft every bullet by hand

Seamlessly integrate ammunition manufacturing with tower construction. Every bullet your defense towers fire is crafted by you. No need to worry about complex production lines—this game is designed for simplicity, with a progressive ammo crafting system that you can master in just five minutes. Additionally, there is a miniature power supply system.

Swarming insect tide

Feel the oppressive onslaught of tens of thousands of terrifying insects and the thrill of burning them all to ashes. With dozens of different insect types, each planet has its dominant species, putting your strategic abilities to the test.

Technology and blueprint purchase system outside the battlefield

As you travel to different planets, you will grow from a low-ranking officer to a governor. Use your achievements to purchase building blueprints and technology in the store to face even more powerful insects!

data.name: Stick Legion
data.detailed_description:
Every number has a body.

In Stick Legion your income isn't a spreadsheet — it's a battle line. Every warrior you recruit walks onto the field, fights, and dies gloriously so the next rank can push further.

  • 9 warbands from Militia to Champions, each with milestones that visibly upgrade their gear on the battlefield

  • Mini Mode - dock the battle in the corner of your screen and let the war rage while you work

  • 8 realms to conquer, each with a guardian and a relic to claim

  • The Last Charge - prestige as spectacle: your whole army makes one final doomed push, and your legend grows

  • Elders - spend hard-won Glory on eternal ancestors who fight beside every future legion

  • Command - bank Command charge by tapping the battle, then unleash a Volley Order to push your line up to 2–3x faster when you want to lean in; every fight is still winnable hands-off

  • 100 Steam Achievements - from First Blood to the throne

  • Respectful by design - pay once, no ads, no microtransactions, an actual ending (~15–40 hours for most players), endless mode after

  • Offline progress - your army keeps fighting while you’re away; return to a full battle report of gold earned, ground taken, and Glory pending

  • Your save is safe - rotating backups, auto-recovery if anything goes wrong, autosave, and a force-save when you quit

data.name: Album3D
data.detailed_description:
Starter Credits Included

Your purchase currently includes starter credits for in-game use:

  • 100,000 credits are added when you first launch the game.

  • 100,000 bonus credits are added after you reach 3 hours of total playtime.

With the default options, importing one image into an Album3D project costs 10 credits, or 1 credit if you disable the 'Copy Source Files' option.

Launch the game and reach 3 hours of total playtime within 1 month of purchase to receive the credit amounts shown above. After that, credit amounts, availability, and eligibility may change. Credits have no cash value and cannot be exchanged outside the game.


About the Game

Not a flat photo viewer—Album3D is a game-like 3D photo experience that turns your photos into 3D albums you can manually explore. Instead of scrolling endless rows, you browse by moving through an immersive 3D world and switching between multiple 3D views/layouts anytime.

What makes it different

Album3D is built around the idea that photos are more fun (and often faster) to revisit when they live in a 3D scene you can explore. It’s designed to feel playful and game-like without requiring gaming skills.

  • Manual exploration that feels like flying: smoothly fly toward photos and glide through your album

  • Switch views/layouts anytime: instantly change how your album is arranged in 3D

  • Made for big libraries: organize content into image sets so you can keep browsing comfortably

Import formats

Supported import formats: JPEG, PNG, BMP, and WebP. Photo importing uses credits (virtual currency). Credits can be purchased, and importing requires an online connection.

Credits and photo importing

Importing photos into an Album3D project consumes credits. For current details about the starter credits included and how credits are consumed, see the Starter Credits Included section. Once photos have been imported into an Album3D project, viewing them is free and does not consume credits.

Explore in an immersive 3D world

Manual exploration is the core experience. Selecting a photo smoothly takes you to it, and navigation feels more like flying than walking.

Viewing modes

  • Manual Mode: explore freely and browse at your own pace

  • Slideshow Mode: sit back and enjoy an automated viewing flow

  • Demo Flythrough: an automatic flythrough that tours your 3D album

Albums, slides, and 3D placement

In Album3D, an album is made of slides: each slide is a 3D placement of an image in the world. This lets your photos become something you can move through, not just flip past.

Views & layouts (switch anytime)

Album3D includes multiple 3D views/layouts you can switch on the fly. Different layouts can feel more organized, more cinematic, or more exploratory—pick what fits your mood and your content.

Built for large photo libraries

Album3D is designed for large collections. Instead of being limited by how many photos fit comfortably in one scene, you can organize your library into multiple image sets—and keep multiple albums in the same project.

Multiple albums per project

Keep multiple albums inside a single Album3D project. Organize by trip, year, family, events, or any system you like, and jump between albums without leaving your project.

Projects, packages, and sharing

  • Save projects: keep building and revisiting your Album3D world over time

  • Create packages: archive an album or move it between computers

  • Share with others: send a project or package to someone else so they can open it on their computer

Who it’s for

  • People with large photo libraries who want a faster, more enjoyable way to revisit them

  • Photographers/creators who want a more spatial, gallery-like browsing feel

  • Anyone who wants their photos to feel less like files—and more like a place to explore

Themes and future expansion

Album3D currently includes one main theme with multiple views/layouts. We plan to expand Album3D over time with additional themes/environments and view options—ranging from more realistic to more stylized depending on the theme—and some may be released as optional add-ons. Details will be shared when they’re ready.

Example images in videos and screenshots

The videos and screenshots on this page include example images to show how Album3D can look in use. Album3D does not include any images by default; it is designed for displaying your own photo and image collections. If you would like to try Album3D with sample content, you can download Album3D Demo.

data.name: Danger Zone 2
data.detailed_description:
Danger Zone 2 takes the crash testing action out of the Test Area and onto real public roads.
A high speed driving game featuring speed, traffic and crashes, Danger Zone 2 lets players
loose onto the Freeways of the USA, the Motorways of the UK and the Autovias of Spain.



Using advanced real world physics and the power of Unreal Engine, Danger Zone 2 lets
players ‘crash for cash’ and compete against each other to cause the most chaos on the
road.



● Drive at high speed on real life roads crowded with everyday traffic
● Shunt, Slam, Flip, Roll and Jacknife as many vehicles as possible
● Create chaos across 26 of the world’s most notorious accident blackspots set in 17
unique locations around the world
● 8 vehicles to drive and smash including Sedentary Sedan, Chaotic Coupe, Really Crazy Taxi,
Euro Truck and Formula One car.
● Objective Based Gameplay - Complete Objectives to earn Bonus Cash in each level.
● Online Leaderboards track Friends and Global Competition

data.name: Zero to Army
data.detailed_description:
Forge Your Personal Army

Transform individual recruits into legendary warriors in your own custom military formation.

Zero to Army puts you in command of a deeply personal army where every soldier matters, every position counts, and every tactical decision shapes your path to dominance.

Your Army, Your Way

Individual Soldier Management

Each recruit arrives with their own name, personality, and potential. Meet warriors like Gareth

Ironforge or Athalyn Stormwind - unique individuals with distinct combat styles, loyalty levels,

and growth paths. Watch as your carefully chosen soldiers evolve from humble beginners into

specialized veterans.

Tactical Formation Control

Position your forces strategically across the battlefield. Place your heaviest fighters at the

front lines while archers provide cover from behind. Experiment with different formations and

discover which arrangements work best for your command style.

Deep Progression Systems

Guide your soldiers through authentic military evolution. Equip them with advanced weaponry, from basic spears to legendary artifacts like the Warchief's Boomerang. Develop specialized skills such as Berserker fury or Executioner precision as your warriors gain battlefield experience.

Strategic Depth

Resource Management That Matters

Every recruitment decision carries weight. Balance your economy between expanding your ranks and investing in your existing soldiers. Each warrior requires ongoing support, creating meaningful choices about army composition.

Dynamic Battlefield Items

Discover and deploy tactical equipment during combat. Use healing herbs to save wounded soldiers, explosive torches to clear enemy formations, or rare battlefield artifacts to turn desperate situations into victories.

Expanding World

Lead your army through diverse regions, each presenting unique challenges and opportunities. Face varied enemy forces while uncovering new equipment, recruitment options, and tactical possibilities.

data.name: Casino Coral
data.detailed_description:
Casino Coral is a Coral Snake themed Casino card game with boss rush elements where each boss is unique both in gameplay and in design.

  • Furro

    • Furro is a card game designed by the Coral family all about searching through cards to find the missing Royal Serpentes(snakes). This unique card game is built around memory and pattern recognition and in it you choose what cards to keep and what cards to discard in order to give you the best chances at removing the obstacles on the table. As you play hands the dealer will give you hints about where the Royal Serpentes cards are allowing you to narrow down where the winning card is. 

    • There are many different strategies to winning a game of Furro but all of them rely a little bit on Lady Luck being on your side. Can you win her over and have a big cash out or will you gain her ire and lose it all?

  • Casino

    • The Casino Coral is run by a wide variety of Coral snakes each one having their own unique stories and ways of interacting with the player. From the dealers to the Gauntlet bosses to the Lucky Ladies each one has something to say and a way to change how you play the game. 

    • Even the decorations and cards designs within the Coral Casino lean into the characters and world's lore. The Casino Coral is more than just a place to play cards, it's a place run by the Coral family where one can get to know Lady Luck as they attempt to win it big.

  • Gauntlet

    • The Gauntlet is a series of dealer bosses that the player can go up against to win the Casino Corals ultimate prize. Each boss uses Furro as the base of their game, but changes a few rules to make it so the player has to think differently about how they play in order to win against them.

    • However, the bosses are more than just their gameplay as each has a unique design, backstory and room that synchronizes with their game play. Talk with them to learn who they are before you destroy them with your skilled gameplay.

  • Furro

    • Furro is a card game designed by the Coral family all about searching through cards to find the missing Royal Serpentes(snakes). This unique card game is built around memory and pattern recognition and in it you choose what cards to keep and what cards to discard in order to give you the best chances at removing the obstacles on the table. As you play hands the dealer will give you hints about where the Royal Serpentes cards are allowing you to narrow down where the winning card is. 

    • There are many different strategies to winning a game of Furro but all of them rely a little bit on Lady Luck being on your side. Can you win her over and have a big cash out or will you gain her ire and lose it all?

  • Casino

    • The Casino Coral is run by a wide variety of Coral snakes each one having their own unique stories and ways of interacting with the player. From the dealers to the Gauntlet bosses to the Lucky Ladies each one has something to say and a way to change how you play the game. 

    • Even the decorations and cards designs within the Coral Casino lean into the characters and world's lore. The Casino Coral is more than just a place to play cards, it's a place run by the Coral family where one can get to know Lady Luck as they attempt to win it big.

  • Gauntlet

    • The Gauntlet is a series of dealer bosses that the player can go up against to win the Casino Corals ultimate prize. Each boss uses Furro as the base of their game, but changes a few rules to make it so the player has to think differently about how they play in order to win against them.

    • However, the bosses are more than just their gameplay as each has a unique design, backstory and room that synchronizes with their game play. Talk with them to learn who they are before you destroy them with your skilled gameplay.
data.short_description: Enter the Casino Coral and see if you can get on Lady Luck's good side. Win big by playing a game developed by the Coral snake family. With unique gameplay and characters around every corner you will get lost in the world as you take on the Gauntlet, testing your mastery over the cards.

data.name: Pit of Despair
data.detailed_description:
Pit of Despair is a psychological horror game that places the player in a snowbound cabin, isolated deep within a remote forest. The environment is cold, unwelcoming, and indifferent to your presence. You are stranded, with no immediate means of escape. An unidentified presence resides within the cabin’s walls, or perhaps within your own mind.

Inspired by the atmospheric tension of P.T. Silent Hills and the unsettling monotony of The Exit 8, Pit of Despair delivers a chilling, narrative-driven experience that thrives on psychological tension and environmental storytelling. 

This is a short, intense "walking simulator" designed to be experienced in one sitting, lasting approximately 30 - 45 minutes. 

Pit of Despair is an experience best played with headphones, in the dark, and with no distractions.

End Credits Metal Music - Josh of When Evil Calls

Play Up To 6 Player CO-OP with your friends, or just random people. Now featuring Horde Mode where you can play with 6 players and unlock new characters.
