data.name: Peaceful Soul
data.detailed_description:
Peaceful Soul is a Social Life Simulation game. It's about an arrogant young man who 'exiled' by his parents. His parents don't like his attitude thereof they decide to send their son to a village. The village they were met with each other and lived before. And now, life in the village begins for the young man.

This game set in Radish Village, where you can build friendships with villagers, take part in many engaging festivals, take a job as a full time or part-time job, spend the rest of the days to find fish that you haven't caught before or just spend hours in the mine to find ores to get additional money.

Bachelorettes


There are six Bachelorettes that can be married. They are Rika, Aulya, Dwii, Intan, Sasha, and Hosi.

Rival


To get married to one of the Bachelorettes, Main Character has to compete against one of the rivals. The rivals you have to compete with are Zen, Bangun, Noor, Eric, Yossy, and Lucky.

Current Features

  • Minigames
  • Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter Festivals
  • Fishing
  • Cooking
  • Mine with Puzzles
  • Stamina, Health, and Immunity System
  • Jobs System (part-time or full-time, currently two kinds of jobs)
  • Bank System (Saving and Loan)
  • Dynamic Weather

Upcoming Features

  • House customization System.
  • Heart Events.
  • More Minigames.
  • More Mine Floors + Puzzles.
  • Marriage
  • Village Secrets

data.name: Fit My Cat
data.detailed_description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.



Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!



KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

data.name: Tyr: Chains of Valhalla
data.detailed_description:
Tyr: Chains of Valhalla is inspired by Norse mythology, more precisely, the Ragnarök! In a technological world where humanity depends on mega-corporations like Yggdrasil, big companies know no limits, competing for the global monopoly, and foes are at the order of the day; someone has to put a balance in the city.

Tyr, creation of Professor Oswald Din, a.k.a. O.Din, has the mission to prevent Lemuz Oki, a.k.a. L.Oki, destroy the world order and create a new realm of chaos to seize the biggest technology company, as well as control the entire world. Tyr, with the help of Huginn & Muninn ("thought" and "memory") and his faithful Sleipnir, he will take the summit of Valhalla to stop the evil plans of L.Oki and his group of vikings & robots.

In a nordic cyberpunk universe where the struggle between big corporations destroys the world as we know it, a hero must bring order in this world. In Tyr: Chains of Valhalla you can meet the climax and impetus of the Ragnarök seen from a cyberpunk perspective.

Tyr: Chains of Valhalla is a 2.5D shooter/platformer full of power-ups, vikings, robots, awesome and difficult bosses. Tyr: Chains of Valhalla combines 3D scenarios and bosses with 2D characters and enemies.

The time is against you! So be quick, accurate and over all, powerful! Free the city of Midgard in this epic adventure through these amazing levels and reach the last mission... Defeat all the bosses at once!

data.name: Switchroom
data.detailed_description:
Press the button. Blame your friends.

Switchroom is a first-person online co-op comedy game with a little horror in it, for up to 8 players. The goal is simple: earn $100,000 together and buy the key out. Getting there is not.

A white room. A lot of identical buttons.

Switchroom is a first-person comedy sandbox for up to eight players. You and your friends wake up in a plain room covered in identical buttons. Nothing tells you what any of them do.

Press one and see what happens

Press a button and something happens. An object might drop from the wall, gravity might flip, the lights might go out, or the room might turn into a different place. Many buttons are used up once pressed, so every press is a small gamble.

Eat it, throw it, use it, sell it

Pick up what you find, throw it, use it, eat it, or sell it. Food fills you up, and every button press costs a little of your fullness. Sold items add to a shared pool of money. The team can spend that money on a key, or deal with the boss that comes looking for food, and then escape together by using the key at the exit.

Tools, toys and bad ideas

Along the way you will find tools you can hold and use, such as a pistol, a sword, boxing gloves, and a steering wheel that turns into a small kart. You will also find slot machines, a roulette table, and a lucky wheel that play with in-game money only. Some events are spooky, and some parody familiar games and memes.

Together, out loud

Play together with proximity voice chat and text chat. One player hosts the room and the others join by IP address.

  • Up to 8 players, online co-op (host-based)
  • First person, with an optional third-person view
  • Hundreds of different button events
  • Keyboard and mouse

data.name: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul
data.detailed_description:
You are a homunculus, created and summoned by him—the Alchemist.

He speaks of distant lands and forgotten knowledge, traces of the ingredients for the ultimate alchemical creation: the Philosopher's Stone. He promised it holds the power to grant you a soul.

And you? You’d do anything to make that happen.

Craft, cook, and brew your way to power—stir the pot just right, and unlock incredible abilities unlike any you've seen.

Driven by purpose and loyalty, you navigate through ancient castles and monasteries, where you face challenges. Use your logic and observation skills to get through the riddles.

Gather ingredients, find the right recipe and brew alchemical potions.

But as you follow the trail to complete your adventure, you sense something is wrong. A truth buried under layers of alchemical lies...

Are you willing to do whatever it takes to claim a soul of your own?

data.name: Petrifica
data.detailed_description:
Abstract
Petrifica is a 2D action-puzzle game featuring two protagonists. The main characters, Suneis and Lunamia, are cursed by a witch, causing one of them to always turn to stone. Utilize their abilities and sometimes the effects of the curse itself to navigate through the forest's traps and reach the goal.

Switching Action
Players control both Suneis and Lunamia. You can switch between the two characters at any time, with the non-active character becoming petrified due to the curse. While petrified, the character cannot move but is completely invincible, a trait that can be strategically exploited.

Each character has unique actions that only they can perform. Switching between characters as needed is key to overcoming challenges.

Curse of Miraban
The curse of Miraban cast on them transfers to the one they are most deeply bonded with if they attempt to break it, meaning one will always be cursed. Thus, the two hardly ever converse during the game. However, they can still affirm their bond. When you feel like it, use the "Talk" command to listen to their thoughts.

Others
This game is compatible with game controllers.

data.name: Nightmare Shift
data.detailed_description:
They say the walls have ears... but what if the walls have eyes—watching, waiting, seeing everything you do.

Take night shifts at a remote motel, handle unsettling guests, and navigate eerie events. Experience Emma’s unnerving apartment life, feel the unease of being watched and question what’s real as the line between reality and nightmare blurs.

Emma’s World

Step into Emma’s life, where ordinary nights unravel into extraordinary mysteries. Experience her fears, struggles, and the blurred line between her reality and nightmares.

The Fragile Routine

Navigate the daily tasks of Emma’s job and home life, only to realize that routine can be a mask for something far more sinister.


Faces of Mystery

Encounter enigmatic characters whose motives are unclear. Each interaction brings you closer to the truth—or deeper into paranoia. Who can you trust when everyone seems suspicious?

Unravel the Nightmare

Uncover the shocking truth as you explore the motel and Emma’s apartment. Each discovery peels back layers of a dark mystery that challenges everything you think you know.

Game Features:

  • This game is primarily a "walking simulator" genre with puzzle-solving elements.

  • Psychological horror: The game will drive you insane.

  • Immersive experience: An atmospheric, photo-realistic graphics intensifies the horror experience.

  • Multiple endings: The game has multiple endings based on your choices.

  • Rich story that is inspired by movies like "Door Lock 2018".

data.name: Crumbling
data.detailed_description:
Crumbling is a VR rogue-like action adventure.
★ Action-Figure-like controls. Only possible in VR!
★ Challenging rogue-like fights. Looks easy, but isn't!
★ Romping story with animated comics & narrator!
★ Detail-rich toy diorama worlds
★ Mini Games, collectibles, and much more to discover!

Talk to the devs on
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Action-Figure VR

In Crumbling, you control your character directly with your motion controller, as if it was an action figure in your hand. Unwrap your hero from its blister pack, wave it around and smash monsters with powerful attacks!

But observe your foes closely! Only if you anticipate their every move can you avoid their assault. Evade and counter at just the right moment to keep the upper hand in action-packed hack'n'slash combat.

Comics

Discover the story of Crumbling through animated and narrated comic books. Learn how the evil Böse Corp. stole all the magic from Mr. and Mrs Crumble in order to make their horrible monster toys come alive. Can you stop them and reclaim the magic? The fate of the Crumble's famous store is in your hands - quite literally!

Unlock Content

Reclaim the stolen magic and use it to revive all kinds of toys: New Crumblings, more theme worlds, comic pages, and collectible power ups! Discover the lovingly created toy worlds of Mr. and Mrs Crumble and enjoy all the details. Between the glass covers and the cardboard backdrops you set the stage and put the monsters of Böse Corp. in their place!

data.name: Doodle Adventure of Chameleon
data.detailed_description:
Official Community

Discord:


About the Game

"Doodle adventure of Chameleon" is a hand-drawn doodle-style hardcore side-scrolling platformer game. You'll play as a chameleon born from a young boy's imagination. By using your color-switching abilities, you can alter the elements of the game world as you navigate through different flat worlds, such as a sketchbook, a blackboard, and a storybook. As you tackle challenging levels, you'll gradually enter the boy's inner world and help him overcome the challenges of growing up.

Childhood hand-drawn doodle style


This game captures the brushstrokes of childhood doodles, taking you back to an imaginative time when you could savor the simple joys and dreams of your early years.

Fun gameplay mechanics centered around color-changing


You need to make clever use of the chameleon's color-switching ability by freely switching between red, yellow, and blue colors to alter the elements in the game world. You must skillfully combine wall climbing, jumping, sprinting, and other actions to solve a series of puzzles.

Unique level settings and puzzles


As you progress through the levels and shift between the different flat worlds, new scene mechanics and puzzles will emerge, creating an enjoyable synergy with the color-switching gameplay. Enjoy the thrill of precise timing and route planning!


Additionally, the game features a chalkboard-style with chalk drawings and familiar elements such as math formulas, timetables, and classroom assignments. In these entertaining scenes, the chameleon embarks on a joyful adventure.

data.name: Fishyphus
data.detailed_description:
Fishyphus is a horror fishing roguelite which rewards careful navigation, quick reflexes, and persistence. It's best experienced with a gamepad and headphones.

Sail the waves

Take command of a fishing vessel with momentum-based physics controls. Sail endlessly in any direction across abstract, colorful, and relaxing ocean waves.

Catch the fish

Track fish by their mesmerizing songs. Drop anchor and fish with a single button. The reflex-based fishing minigame is easy to learn—yet hard to perfect.

Battle the reaper

Beware the certain death which lurks beneath! Catch fish to awaken it, stun it, and strengthen its resolve. Only through death will you survive longer.

An accessible experience

Fishyphus provides a tutorial, high visual contrast, binaural audio cues, haptic feedback, adjustable difficulty settings, and screen reader support. Its graphics can be toggled off to be enjoyed with audio alone.

data.name: Bai Qu: Hundreds of Melodies
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis

Location is the ancient capital city Nanjing, China. And time is when spring turns into summer.

While visiting his sick father, college student Wei Qiuwu accidentally encountered a concertina playing little girl in the hospital.
An inharmonious pair, seemingly. But soon, Wei Qiuwu became a good friend of Li Jiayun, the little player. And both of them act as an indispensable tune in each other's life.
With the accompaniment of sedate Nurse Yang Qin and cheerful high school student He Jia, the story surrounding Li Jiayun is about to begin...

After they get familiar with each other, He Jia guides Wei Qiuwu and Li Jiayun to visit a lot of interesting places, acquaint with a variety of people and encounter with a diversity of things.
They become an inseparable trio as well as good friends, everything looks blissful. Until one day, Yang Qin unveiled to Wei Qiuwu the cruel truth under a fairy-tale cover...

Key Features

  • The official sequel of Shan Gui.
  • A storyline of 8 to 12 hours, with multiple routes and endings.
  • There is no absolute "right choice", different endings contain different meaning.
  • An unordinary story, themed with love and caring in ordinary daily life.
  • A modern story happened in an ancient country.
  • Full-voiced main characters.
  • Delicate and realistic background pictures, field recorded ambient sound to make you feel you were in the scene.
  • Over 20 wonderful background music tracks, which include varieties of music genres.
  • 2560×1440 resolution for game and 4096×2304 for CGs.

data.name: Femboy & Futa Maidmare
data.detailed_description:
Femboy & Futa Maidmare is a story-driven psychological horror visual novel set during the night shift of an old neon-lit motel.

What starts as a simple job quickly becomes something much stranger.

Meet the motel staff, complete your nightly duties, explore different parts of the building, and make choices that shape your relationships and the way events unfold.

At first, the motel seems quiet.

Then small things begin to feel wrong.

A room looks different from the way you remember it.

A conversation doesn’t match what happened before.

A familiar hallway suddenly feels unfamiliar.

The longer the night continues, the harder it becomes to decide what is real — and who you can trust.

Survive the Night Shift

Femboy & Futa Maidmare combines character-driven visual novel storytelling with psychological horror, mystery, dark humor, and mature themes.

Each shift brings new conversations, new situations, and new reasons to question what is really happening inside the motel.

Build relationships with the staff, uncover hidden sides of the people around you, and decide how far you are willing to go when the motel starts pushing back.

Your choices can influence how characters react to you, which scenes you encounter, and what parts of the story you discover.

Some decisions bring you closer to the truth.

Others may leave you wishing you had never looked.

Features

  • Story-driven psychological horror visual novel

  • Fully first-person presentation

  • Dialogue choices and branching interactions

  • Relationship-focused character routes

  • Mystery and supernatural elements

  • Multiple motel locations explored through story scenes

  • Neon-inspired 2D anime visual style

  • Dark humor mixed with psychological tension

  • Adult themes and mature character relationships

  • Different outcomes based on your decisions

Your shift starts after dark.

Choose who to trust, uncover what the motel is hiding, and try not to lose your grip on what’s real before morning comes.

data.name: Succubus Survivors
data.detailed_description:
Under orders from their mother, the Queen of the Demon Realm,

three sisters begin their invasion of the human world, recruiting fellow succubi to help them rule it all!

"Succubus Survivors" is a casual roguelike game.

Players can choose from a variety of characters, growing stronger by upgrading attributes and skills to survive while being surrounded by monsters on all sides.

data.name: Back To The Collis
data.detailed_description:
Due to the superstitions of the inhabitants of Collis, Benjamin was forced to leave his hometown. After some time, a water problem that Collis cannot solve on its own forces him to return. Explore the town together with the protagonist, get to know its residents, and help them overcome this shared trouble.

World

The town of Collis is a cozy settlement on a hill where life is steeped in rumors, old traditions, and human prejudices. Its hand-drawn streets and the surrounding forest are filled with small details and quiet beauty.

 

Story

A water supply problem arises in Collis, and the local residents cannot solve it. Because of this, the entire town suffers, and the trouble reaches Benjamin's forest home as well. In the end, the hero has to return to Collis to solve the water issue and help both himself and the townsfolk. 

Puzzles

The puzzles in the game are based on the life situations of Collis's residents. By solving them, you help the townsfolk, learn their personal secrets, and better understand how life works around here.

 

Graphics

Everything in the game is drawn by hand - from the environment to every character. All residents of Collis are unique: each has their own personality, traits, and individual animations.

 

Communication

There are no long texts or spoken dialogue in the game - characters communicate using animations and clear speech bubbles with pictures.

Music

An original soundtrack for each scene, creating a pleasant atmosphere and helping you immerse yourself in Benjamin's world and the town of Collis itself.

data.name: Ski Jump Challenge 2024
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for the 2023/24 season with Ski Jump Challenge, now available on Steam! A thrilling adventure awaits you in the world of ski jumping, infused with new challenges and incredible excitement.

Ski Jump Challenge, a game inspired by the iconic DSJ, takes you into the realistic world of ski jumping. It's simple to use, yet realistic enough for you to feel full control over your jumper.

Create a profile of your jumper and develop his skills. Gain experience, improve your takeoff and landing technique. Measure yourself on more than 100 hills in 12 countries in career mode, discover new facilities and countries. Spend the money you earn on unique suits, skis and helmets.

Prepare for each competition by training and testing yourself in different weather conditions. Fight with your friends together on one computer.

Advance in the ranking system, earn crystal ranks and discover elite outfits in Ski Jump Challenge 2024.

With meticulous graphics, an extensive physics system and realistic sounds, Ski Jump Challenge offers an experience like a real ski jumping broadcast. It's the perfect game for winter sports fans, providing hours of entertainment for winter evenings. Discover the new DSJ on your PC!

data.name: Akasha's Corridor
data.detailed_description:
✦ Story

This place is an endless library where every book acts as a combat route, with most battles set in otherworldly or medieval environments. After finishing a book, you return to the library and must find a way back to the real world within the pages. By accumulating experience, you can "awaken" your characters; once awakened, they will recover a lost memory.

✦ Game Overview

Akasha’s Corridor is a card game that combines Roguelike mechanics, card deck-building, turn-based combat, and adult content. Through the perspectives of three young girls, you will explore their memories from before they were pulled into this otherworldly realm.

✧Rogue • Card Strategy • Memory Exploration ✧

  • High-Stakes, Fast-Paced Combat: Every run is a relentless gauntlet of battles. Take precise command of three characters, each with distinct personalities and playstyles, and utilize randomly constructed decks to charge through the endless void.

  • Unlocking Multiple Memories: As your adventure progresses, strip away their emotional armor layer by layer to uncover their pasts—tales of betrayal, bullying, and despair. Only by clearing the game can you reveal the "truth" hidden deep within their memories.

  • Adult Erotic Experience: Delve into the twisted desires they awaken within this otherworld. Is it salvation, or total corruption? Everything depends on your choices.

  • Fragmented Storytelling: Choose from one of three heroines with unique roles. Through repeated cycles of reincarnation, piece together their backstories and uncover hidden plotlines that were never meant to be revealed.

The Void Chronicler is watching it all. Can you navigate the endless malice within the corridors and uncover the truth hidden in the cycles of reincarnation?

✦ Character Introduction

ʚ Sivir ɞ

The Heavy Knight : Appears noble and virtuous, yet secretly craves to unleash her repressed self through pain.

ʚ Mina ɞ

The Fallen Thief : Uses lies and beauty as weapons, refusing to place trust in anyone.

ʚ Rin ɞ

The Misanthropic Mage : Views reality as a "trash game" and manipulates magic with the precision of data.

data.name: Wizard Warrior
data.detailed_description:
Draw five cards. You have three actions, so two cards go unplayed. Choose which.

Wizard Warrior is a pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder of spells and steel. Spells spend mana, weapons and shields spend stamina, and hovering a card shows you where every blow will land before you commit.

See every blow before you throw it

Hover over a card to see its description and the game plays it out after you select it during the fight. Every body that will lose health is marked with its damage, anything that will die reads FALLS, and statuses show where they will land. It runs on the same rules as the real blow, so what you see is what happens, and it never gives away what you are about to draw.

- Foes tell you their move first. Every foe announces its next move and how hard it hits. Hover over it to read exactly what the move does and who takes the damage first.

- No targeting, on purpose. Each fight is one foe, with any pack or summons standing in front of it. Every hit lands on the front body first, and whatever that body cannot soak goes through to the leader.

- Damage alone will not get you there. Your health does not refill between fights the way your mana does, so carry Block, healing or ice alongside the sharp edges.

Ten houses: start with one, earn the rest

You begin in the Dawnguard, with Aurelianand his sword. Eight more houses open as your career adds up: deal 1,250 fire damage across your runs and the Emberguard is yours. The tenth answers only to a win on the fourth rung of Peril, the game's difficulty ladder. Each house has its own hero and fighting style, from a dwarf with two axes who lives on bleed to a tortoise with a tree on his shell who calls wolves and golems.

And each house grows its own way. Win a road with it and its Creed opens, two oaths to choose between, along with the first of its three house cards: learn them in the hall, raise them to rank III, and bring one into your opening deck. Win with it on the fourth rung of Peril or higher and the house can claim its Heirloom, a relic carried on every run.

Every fight you win pays valor, even on a run that ends badly. Spend it in the hall: on your house's mastery tree, Creed, Heirloom and house cards, or at the Road Shelf on provisions for the next road and contracts that stake valor on a harder one. Higher up Peril, the shelf stocks finer goods.

A road that turns over as you walk it

A run crosses eight realms on a honeycomb road of face-down tiles, with a guardian waiting at the end of every realm. Three times the road forks and you choose which realm to cross next, and the pairs are dealt fresh every run. Step onto a tile to find out what it holds:

- a foe, a pack that came together, or a champion, bigger and meaner, that drops a higher payout

- a merchant, a still well, or a forge

- or a bad omen that follows you out

More than 90 kinds of foe walk these realms, 11 of them guardians. Every guardian has a line when you meet and another when it falls.

"Road toll. Everything you carry, and the hands you carry it with." (Rathgar, the Bandit Chief)

Summons on both sides

Call spirit wolves, dire hounds, stone golems and harpies to stand between you and the blow, up to three at a time. They have their own health, strike every round, and soak the hits meant for you. Some foes raise their own summons, and then it is your pack against theirs. Whatever foe the effect lands on it stays on that foe: burn the wolf in front and the wolf burns, and a foe's poison can catch your summon instead of you.

Heavier or quicker

Along the road, the spoils offer three cards: take one, or none. Guardians offer legendaries. Merchants sell more, and for a price they will cut the cards you have outgrown. At a forge, Bruni Ironwright makes a card heavier (40% more damage, Block, healing or status) or quicker (one cheaper). Each card can be forged once.

"Heavier or quicker. It cannot be both, so choose." (Bruni Ironwright)

256 cards to find on the road: 168 spells and 88 weapons and shields. The 30 house cards are learned in the hall, never found.

Win the road and it climbs: eleven rungs of Peril, with tougher foes, richer valor, and new things opening on the way up: relics, The Rush (the guardians back to back, against the clock), The Endless Road (the same eight realms, over and over, harder each round), the tenth house, and more for every house.

Take up thy road.

data.name: Acatalepsy
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME, TO:

_________________

ACATALEPSY

A brand new take on the liminal space experience.

Your team is tasked with exploring and diving as deeply as possible into liminal spaces. Complete various tasks and dive deeper through several levels. With a procedural level generation system, the map is different and unique every single time.

Acatalepsy shines the most in multiplayer with friends; a small group is suggested to fully enjoy all aspects of Acatalepsy.

Your main goal is to complete the required number of tasks, open the final doors, and escape.

Simple, right?

_________________

YOU ARE NOT ALONE

You and your team are not the only ones inside these liminal spaces. Alongside completing your tasks, you'll need to avoid various entities that lurk within the level. Coming face-to-face with a creature here will mean certain death.

_________________

A BRIEF SOLACE

Once you have met the task threshold and your team has successfully exited a level, you will be presented with an interlude phase. Here, you can purchase additional lives, as well as sell and purchase equipment. All deceased team members will come back, but at the cost of a life.

_________________

TIME IS A FACTOR

In each level, you have as much time as you need to complete the required number of tasks. However, once the required number of tasks has been completed, you have a minimal amount of time to locate the exit doors and escape; otherwise, insanity will take over.

_________________

EVERY NEXT LEVEL DEEP IS HARDER

After the completion of every level, whether or not everyone lived or died, a new modifier will be applied to the next level. The map may be darker overall, the entity faster, more tasks required to escape, or plenty else. You need to adapt to the changing factors in order to progress as deeply as possible.

_________________

Important Notice:

Proximity voice chat is not currently present within Acatalepsy due to specific limitations. As the development of Acatalepsy progresses, I will work to add proximity voice chat as soon as possible.

Due to concerns about cheating, multiplayer is currently only available via Steam Friend Invite.

data.name: Cornflake Crisis
data.detailed_description:
Get a great start to your day with crispy, nutritious platforming! Embark on an a-maize-ing adventure as a team of happy-go-lucky cereal flakes on a quest to recover the legendary Cornucopia.

Be More Spoontaneous!


Swap between a wide variety of playable cornflakes with unique abilities and attributes as you traverse 2D platforming worlds bursting with colour, humour, and weird characters!

Cornquer the Grub Kingdom


Explore all sorts of food-inspired environments filled with wonder and really stupid puns, including the Broccoli Forest, the Dessert Dungeon and a Haunted Gingerbread House!

Reclaim the Cornucopia


The ancient relic that ensures the peace and tranquility of the cornflake lifestyle has been seized by a mysterious newcomer named Bandit - don’t let him get away with it!

Corny and hand-drawn-y


A painstaking, entirely hand-illustrated game made as the result of more than two years of love and dedication from a solo developer!

Cob A Load Of This


Ride a carrot rocket, prove your prowess at grillin’ sausages and help a banana build a sandcastle!

Live In Corncert


Fortified with an awesome and funky original soundtrack that will put a smile on your face!

data.name: Actors
data.detailed_description:
Step into the spotlight with Actors, a VR movie actor simulator! Every line, every move, every dramatic gesture is truly yours, captured to reveal your inner acting legend. Experience the thrill of seeing your own performance on the big screen. Gather your friends and create cinematic history together!

Actors puts you right into the shoes of a film star. Dive into the daily grind of production and feel the rush that comes when the studio lights finally go up. Master your script, walk the stage with your director, and deliver a performance that hits all the right notes. Lights, camera, action! This is your moment!

Watch the dailies of your performance on the big screen at the end of every session. You can also experience the thrill of acting with your friends in our dedicated Party mode played on a single headset. This is your big moment – become movie stars together and share your performance with the world!

The game's story unfolds during the production of the movie based on a comic book. Benedikt inherits a taxi from his grandfather that can drive all the way to Hell and back again. And just like a real actor, your experience isn't just about what happens in front of the camera, but what goes on behind it too.

data.name: 蛊道The Reverend's Path
data.detailed_description:
A roguelite real-time combat game built around crafting Killer Moves (skills).

In other words: spell programming.

Clear a round within a run and you gain semi-random Gu — the smallest component of a skill — or other rewards tied to one of dozens of Schools. The game is about the joy of combat itself.

Combine Gu into Killer Moves that are yours alone, and walk your own Path of Gu.

Combat Runs Deep — It Is Never a Numbers Race

Play is varied and the battlefield has real depth. It is never a simple stat check. Ways to win outright include:

  • Sea of Consciousness — offense and defense

  • Dao Mark refinement (the equivalent of chemical elements — the smallest unit there is)

  • Immortal Body limits

  • Immortal Essence expenditure

  • Battlefield environment

  • and more...

Together these make for a multidimensional, genuinely engaging battlefield. A Gu Immortal who pours everything into direct attack — and leaves their Sea of Consciousness undefended against the Wisdom Path — is very likely to be sunk by that one blind spot.

Every School has its own strengths and specialties, and none hard-counters another. Water quenches fire — but when the fire burns hot enough, water only feeds the flames.

Killer Moves Collide as Physical Entities

Most Killer Moves are physical entities, with a life of their own. When two offense-oriented Killer Moves collide, both are annihilated — and both casters walk away unharmed.

Two Layers of Spell Programming

The Killer Move Board — an intuitive place to edit and create Killer Moves. Pins, distinguished by type and by direction (in / out), carry signals between your moves; that signal routing is the core wiring of your Killer Move logic.

The Condition Pool — a logic pool built from the three classic gates, AND · OR · NOT, that governs how your Killer Moves cast themselves. In high-level play it doubles as a Relay Layer, letting multiple Killer Moves communicate and chain off one another.

Design

Controls — built for one-handed play, so you can unwind and enjoy yourself at any time.

Content — a low barrier to entry, with strategic and build-crafting depth underneath.

Visuals — dense, tight, dazzling combat, for instant, visceral joy — and the best possible feedback on your build.

Thank you for witnessing the Path of Gu.

data.name: Odd Jobs: On The Lot
data.detailed_description:
The Lot Crew is hiring. Flexible hours. Fully insured (except for the damage you do). Odd Jobs: On The Lot is a physics-powered co-op game for 1-4 players. Every shift is a new job, and every job goes hilariously wrong.



  • Every shift, a different job. Return the trolleys. Hose the charity car wash before the oil catches. Tow broken-down cars out of a roadworks jam. Bust ghosts on the night shift (don't cross the streams). Fill cars at the servo, tie the lot down in a storm, survive the biggest sale of the year, herd escaped zoo animals home and serve ice cream in a heatwave.
  • The wildlife has other plans. Rats steal your trolleys, the baboon throws whatever is lying around, the hyena holds you while the bull lines up, the bin chicken raids the rubbish and the rhino carries you off the lot.
  • Physics does the rest. Banana peels, oil slicks, skateboards, traffic, gusts and a pressure washer you can point at your friends.




  • Spend your wages between shifts. The shop sells fire extinguishers, leaf blowers, tow ropes, banana peels for the pests, steel toes and boxing gloves. Upgrades last the run.
  • Employee of the Shift. Every win ends in a reveal of whoever earned most, and many accolades for the moments that mattered: Matador, Houdini, Dumpster Diver, Bird Brain.
  • Play your way. Campaign through every shift, Shuffle them, or Pick each one.






Couch co-op for up to four on one screen, or Remote Play Together. Short a player? Computer teammates fill every empty seat and pull their weight, and anyone can drop in and take over mid-shift. Hit the quota before the clock runs out, keep each other on your feet, and argue about who gets the trolley magnet.




Diverse animal workers, a boss with a megaphone, and an original jazz, rock and beats score by award-winning Epoch Music.

With special thanks to Dark Half Studios for trailer and in-game audio.

data.name: The Lost Froglins
data.detailed_description:
What if Vampire Survivors was a platformer? 100 lost baby froglins are trapped in a cave. Every one you save joins your swarm and fights for you. One is cute. Ten is trouble. A hundred is unstoppable. Die, upgrade, go again.

Koko didn't sign up for this. But somebody has to get them out.

GROW YOUR SWARM

Every froglin you rescue joins your swarm and auto-attacks enemies. Four froglin types, four attack patterns. Save a few and they help. Save dozens and the screen fills with chaos. But die, and they're lost again. How many can you save in one run?

SWING BABY BONGO

Your combat companion isn't a cute sidekick. Swing him like a ball and chain to smash through anything in your path. He gets stronger as your swarm grows. Koko calls him "cutie." He is not amused.

DIE SMARTER, COME BACK STRONGER

Coins persist between runs. Spend them in the shop on power-up items. Equip three per run. Build your loadout. Every death makes the next run better.

FACE WHAT LIVES DOWN THERE

The caves aren't empty. Boss encounters guard the depths, and they don't want you taking their froglins. Rospone will eat your army if you let him.

FEATURES

• Roguelite side-scrolling platformer with auto-attack swarm mechanics

• 100 baby froglins to rescue — resets every run, how many can you save?

• 4 froglin types with distinct attack styles

• Baby Bongo: active ball-and-chain weapon that scales with your swarm

• Persistent coins, shop upgrades, equip 3 items per run

• Handcrafted cave environments with boss encounters

data.name: Mystery of Myths: Whisper of Depth Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure: a story-driven, point-and-click experience designed for players of all skill levels. You will explore detailed locations, search for carefully hidden objects from a list, and solve a variety of logic puzzles and mini-games that help move the story forward. Observation, curiosity, and attention to detail are the keys to progress.



When people begin drowning in dry rooms, investigator Elijah Reed is pulled into a case that defies logic. Sent to France to look into a series of impossible deaths, he uncovers traces of an ancient legend tied to the sea — a forgotten princess, a sunken city, and a haunting voice that lingers beneath the waves. What starts as a routine investigation quickly turns into something far more dangerous.



Enjoy a wide range of engaging challenges, from classic hidden object scenes to creative mini-games and clever puzzles. Each location offers a fresh test of your attention and reasoning, keeping the experience varied and rewarding!

🗝️ Investigate impossible deaths across eerie French landscapes

🗝️ Uncover Breton folklore and its chilling connection to a sunken city

🗝️ Solve dozens of mini-games and tricky puzzles

🗝️ Explore richly interactive locations filled with secrets

🗝️ Find hidden objects, collectibles, and optional discoveries

🗝️ Use both modern detective methods and arcane tools from Elijah’s occult training

🗝️ Piece together the legend of Dahut and face the truth beneath the waves

🗝️ Earn achievements to highlight your success

🗝️ Make choices that shape the course of the story

Step into a world where myth and investigation collide, and every clue brings you closer to the truth. The answers lie hidden — waiting for those who dare to search.

data.name: Bon Appétit
data.detailed_description:
BON APPÉTIT

No menu is ever served twice in this establishment.

Behind the scenes of an exceptional fine-dining restaurant, an entire organization works to satisfy a clientele for whom luxury is no longer enough: every experience must be unique.

BON APPÉTIT is a short narrative point-and-click horror experience, entirely hand-drawn. Abducted alongside your daughter, you wake up alone, on the wrong end of a perfectly organized chain. What you are about to uncover extends far beyond the walls of this establishment.

Your objective is simple: find your daughter, find a way out, and avoid ending up on the menu yourself.

Features

  • A fully hand-drawn world, where fine dining elegance gradually gives way to something far more unsettling.

  • Explore the restaurant’s back rooms: kitchens, storage areas, butcher room, cold storage, service corridors, and spaces closed to the public.

  • Solve environmental puzzles, search your surroundings, and figure out how to make your way deeper into the establishment.

  • Discover the restaurant through its own propaganda: advertisements, promotional videos, internal reports, and testimonies calmly reveal the methods and values of the organization.

  • A 45–60 minute horror experience, designed to be played in a single sitting.

Behind the scenes of an exceptional fine-dining restaurant, an entire organization works to satisfy a clientele for whom luxury is no longer enough: every experience must be unique.

BON APPÉTIT is a short narrative point-and-click horror experience, entirely hand-drawn. Abducted alongside your daughter, you wake up alone, on the wrong end of a perfectly organized chain. What you are about to uncover extends far beyond the walls of this establishment.

Your objective is simple: find your daughter, find a way out, and avoid ending up on the menu yourself.

Features

  • A fully hand-drawn world, where fine dining elegance gradually gives way to something far more unsettling.

  • Explore the restaurant’s back rooms: kitchens, storage areas, butcher room, cold storage, service corridors, and spaces closed to the public.

  • Solve environmental puzzles, search your surroundings, and figure out how to make your way deeper into the establishment.

  • Discover the restaurant through its own propaganda: advertisements, promotional videos, internal reports, and testimonies calmly reveal the methods and values of the organization.

  • A 45–60 minute horror experience, designed to be played in a single sitting.

data.name: Geo-Political Simulator 2026 Edition
data.detailed_description:
GPS 2026 Edition: THE ULTIMATE SIMULATION OF TODAY'S WORLD

Geopolitical Simulator 2026 Edition is a simulation of our current world, recreating its features in-depth and across a number of domains: economic, political, military, social, financial, environmental, energetic, transportation…

Every country and major multinational corporation are represented with their own variables and functions. The calculation and scenario engines include more than 150,000 facts and figures, 20,000 texts, and 12 hours of recorded dialog. An ultra-detailed and animated 3D map with vegetation, bodies of water, every border, regions, production facilities, and important strategic sites around the world become your playground.

The game combines management stages of economics, commerce, wargames, construction, espionage, simulation, and political influence and manipulation.

You can opt to control one or more countries or one or more major corporations simultaneously and devise collaborative strategies to change your own destiny or the world's. Game sessions are customizable in several ways: activity level of terrorist organizations, probability of natural disasters, reactions of the people, outbreak of wars... More than twenty contextual scenarios with current events from today's world are integrated.

The game engine of Geopolitical Simulator, includes over 600 data elements for each of the 175 playable countries and calculates their changes in real time throughout the game based on players’ actions. Some examples include popularity ratings, political relations, and economic exchanges between countries. More than 3000 major worldwide companies are included along with their real world data and several thousand others are simulated for all economic sectors and all the countries of the world. The simulator technology of Geopolitical Simulator is used by various organizations for instruction or training purposes, including NATO.

2026 EDITION NEW FEATURES

  • Simulations 2026 and 2025

    The game offers the possibility to start the campaign at the beginning of 2026 or at the beginning of 2025, as either a leader or an opponent.
    Both historical contexts are recreated with updated corresponding economic data (unemployment, inflation, budget, population, growth, currency rates…), the annual events calendar, and the specific changes for the year 2025 (conflicts, financial agency ratings, Nobel Prizes, FIFA ranking…).
    Governments and parliaments are accurately reproduced for both periods, with their political orientation and the composition of their ministerial team.

  • Tourism Simulation

    Hyper-detailed with lots of data provided from every country of the world: number of international tourists, domestic tourists, revenue, sector employment, major multinational companies, most visited cities and sites, national parks, places designated as UNESCO world heritage sites.

    Various components are taken into account in the calculation of tourist attractiveness that the player can develop as head of state or CEO of a tourism business by building, subsidizing, budgeting, or influencing...natural wealth, cultural wealth, international events, cost of living, tourism infrastructures (seaside, leisure, mountain), accommodation packages, quality of transportation, public safety, highway safety, terrorism risk, climate, cuisine, risk of natural disaster, sanitation, human rights...

    On the game map, tourism constructions are represented in 3D, and as the head of a company in that sector, the player can build more. A tourism map has been added, displaying tourism evaluations by region.

    Two themed scenarios are included: "City of Lights" where the player must become the most visited city in the world, and "Tourism Development" where the player aims to become one of the top 10 tourist destinations.

  • Regime Censures and New Political Party AI
    Various systems of censure practiced in the world are reproduced here: motion against the head of state and/or their government, constructive vote of no confidence, vote by simple or absolute majority, dissolution of Parliament, vote of confidence on a legislative bill, a case of Article 49.3 in France. As the head of state, the player must face these attacks led by the opposing party AI. Conversely, as the head of the opposition party, the player can attempt to bring down the regime to trigger new elections or take their place. Political influence and communication, the formation (or destruction) of political coalitions, are essential to emerge as the winner in these situations.

    Besides these actions, the party AI can at any time form coalitions, dissolve coalitions - including the player-head of state's - disappear, change party leaders, or create new parties.

    New settings for parties have been added, which determine the level of activity of parties managed by the AI.

  • Management of Personal Fortune
    As a politician or businessman, players can grow their fortune. Various options are available: increase wealth, buy and sell valuable items (cars, private jets, paintings, yachts, diamonds...), build luxurious properties, stock market speculation… Wealth is one means to influence power either individually or in public opinion by creating, for example, foundations dedicated to certain causes, or by financing an association, a religion, or a political party.

    The ranking of the wealthy is constantly updated, and a scenario is devoted to the champions of the "bling".

  • European Defense
    As the head of a European Union country, the player can benefit from EU aid to strengthen their defense. You can go even further by trying to create a veritable European army by encouraging other countries to join the coalition.

    The "War in Europe" scenario plunges the player into a military crisis in Europe after the US withdraws from NATO, and the Baltic countries are threatened with attack by Russia.

  • Development of AI and Robots
    The game simulates the development of artificial intelligence and robotics and their impact on society, especially in terms of employment. The player can implement a technological transition in the State and in the public sector. They can also take advantage by taxing these technologies to compensate for the loss of jobs and redistribute the economic benefits more equitably.

  • Other functions and topics
    -Increase in game speed: the passage of time has been accelerated (more than 30% for the passage of a year compared to 2024 version), more realistic speed for units moving on the map with a dynamic adaptation of military units over long distances (missiles, aircraft, ships…)

    -Economic Attractiveness: foreign companies expanding into national territory increases employment and raises the GDP, tax and social revenues. Various tools are available to the player to mix it up: advantageous taxation, public services, infrastructures, innovations or even subsidies. A worldwide ranking has been created. Companies can conduct attractiveness audits to better choose the country in which to build.

    -Universal Basic Income: this addresses an ideological vision of society and also a future context where a large number of jobs will be replaced by AI or robots. Setting the amount, the portion accorded to minors, funding, the difficulty in having it voted on in Parliament: so many challenges for the player who wants to implement it. A scenario devoted to this is included.

    -Nuclear Umbrella: this is the guarantee that a country possessing atomic weapons will defend a non-nuclear country. Nuclear umbrellas are included in alliance agreements; the play can cancel it or propose a new one. Such an accord obligates the protectors to act in the event of an attack and the protected to prioritize weapons trading with their protector.

    -Management of Military Coalitions: if the player wishes, there is the possibility of directing all armies of the coalition of countries that their nation belongs to. They can also change the way unit banners are displayed on the military map.

    -US Supreme Court: they have a role in the American legislative process. Justices can strike down legislation that goes against the US Constitution. The player as head of state can try to influence them.

    -Worldwide Laws: as a member of the G20, the player can propose new legislation applicable to every country of the world. Extensive lobbying will be required to achieve these goals.

    -Electoral Threshold: this new legislation defines the percentage below which a party will not be represented in Parliament.

    -Realistic Contexts: new American policies (tariffs, budgetary policies, immigration...) at the start of the game. A new scenario has been added in which the player takes the role of the American president and must try to be elected for a third term.

PLAY AS THE HEAD OF STATE

Over one thousand playable actions. At the country’s helm, the player/head of state can act in many areas: budget, taxation (nearly thirty types of taxes), currency, economy (over 130 economic activities), foreign and domestic affairs, defense, society, labor, health, social security, education, environment, transportation, culture, and more.

Propose bills to be voted on in Parliament, for example: setting social welfare benefit minimums, changing the retirement age, developing atomic weapons in secret, subsidizing the auto industry, hiring teachers, defining the powers of unions, setting speed limits on roads, regulating prostitution, creating an international film festival, etc.

The player can also construct elements on the world map, which will change accordingly: nuclear plants, wind farms, military bases, pipelines, high-speed train lines, airports, and many more.

PLAY AS THE OPPOSITION

At the head of a legal or illegal organization, the player can take power by force, revolution, diplomacy, or democratic election. To that end, players have many actions at their disposal: manage the budget of the party or illegal organization, intervention in the media, give voting advice to Parliament, launch protest movements, lobbying, manipulation of influential persons, funding or recruitment campaigns, creation of violent cells, purchase military equipment, raise an army, seek allies, engage in armed conflict... During elections, players must manage their campaign budget, establish their political agenda, complete their meeting itinerary, confront their adversary in televised debates…

PLAY AS THE CEO OF A MULTINATIONAL CORPORATION

As the head of one or more of these companies, you have all the tools and all the information necessary to lead and develop your companies.

Each company's data is precisely detailed: revenue, market shares, sales by product, competition, shareholders, staffing, balance sheet...

You must engage in multiple activities within the company: production, commerce, marketing, human resources, finances, taxation, research, security, legal, and politics.

You'll have advisors in various domains and you can also speak to your banker, shareholder representative, or union leader.

Reaching these goals - for example, becoming one of the largest multinational companies in the world or joining the ranks of the billionaire class - will also require resolving conflicts with the union AI, demonstrating sound strategy concerning the competition by making financial decisions (takeover bids, creation of subsidiaries, initial public offerings…), even crossing over to the dark side (along with the risks involved) by engaging in malfeasance of all kinds (paying out kickbacks, tax evasion, tax fraud, illegal price fixing, political lobbying).

LOBBYIST AND CHARACTER AI

All actions of the player as head of state or opposition have repercussions and lobbies, social groups, and important national and international figures will intervene if their artificial intelligence deems necessary (press interviews, resignations, protests, strikes, unrest, blocked roads, wars...).

To prevent tensions or forge alliances, the player can meet any figure during the meeting or intervene in the media (more than 12 hours of dialogue in the game).

REALISTIC WARGAMES AND CITY BATTLE PHASES

The world map incorporates all places of conflict down to the smallest detail: occupied territories, besieged cities, locations of military units, international military bases, personnel and equipment of terrorist groups...

As a warlord, players can direct all of their units from real bases during military conflicts. City battles are shown on precise maps with all the major buildings and intersections. The players, according to the side they represent, can direct police, hooligans, military personnel or armed extremists to these locations and construct barricades, send in snipers, loot the banks, or have armoured vehicles move in.

SECRET SERVICES

Secret services play an important role. They have an arsenal of espionage and special operations: reveal scandals about an opposing political party, dismantle terrorist networks, sabotage foreign infrastructure, assassinate an opponent, send reconnaissance drones or position satellites to locate enemy units, etc.

INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS

International organizations (over 50 organizations included) play an important role. At the UN, for example, the player can denounce a nation in order to obtain the Security Council’s authorization for a military intervention. The player can also create his or her own organization.

SIMULATION OF MAJOR GLOBAL THREATS

Geopolitical Simulator 2026 simulates all the major perils that threaten the planet and produces a comprehensive assessment for each one from the results along with specific graphics. The list of threats is substantial and many of them are interconnected: global warming, the widening of social inequality, the risk of global atomic war, overpopulation, unemployment, atmospheric pollution, terrorism, cybercrime, regional conflicts, food insecurity, world hunger, deforestation, natural disasters (storms, floods, drought, extreme heat...), rising sea levels, ocean acidity, disappearance of animal species, climate refugees, epidemics, endocrine-disrupting chemicals…

MULTIPLE OPTIONS

Single-player game in multi-country mode allows the player to play multiple countries and/or companies simultaneously

● Game settings: terrorist activities, probabilities of natural disasters, reactivity of the populations, outbreak of war

● Player ranking online and in real time

● Incorporation of your own photos, logos, names to make the game even more realistic

● Interactive tutorial and game help available at all times during the game

● Configuration options with double screen or 4K screen, choice of interface size for optimal viewing, and the option to personalize and reorganize your space.

data.name: Ashrose Manor - A Portrait of Forbidden Love
data.detailed_description:
Enter a manor where every portrait hides a secret.

In Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love, you step into a decaying family estate haunted not by monsters, but by silence. The Ashrose family has preserved its legacy in oil, wood, and dust — yet one name has been scratched away, one portrait has vanished, and one forbidden love was never meant to be remembered.

As Evelyn, you arrive at Ashrose Manor and begin piecing together the truth hidden within its halls. Examine portraits, read forgotten journal entries, investigate old guest books, and uncover the story of Julian Vale, a restorer whose presence in the manor was deliberately erased.

Investigate. Collect clues. Rebuild the past.

Explore atmospheric rooms such as the entrance hall and the artist’s studio, where the manor’s most important secret waits to be uncovered. Every object can become a clue: an overpainted nameplate, a missing frame, a guest book entry from 1954, or a torn fragment of a painting.

Your journal acts as both your memory and your investigation board. Important discoveries are automatically recorded, allowing you to connect clues and unlock new conclusions as the story unfolds. This matches the intended journal-based clue system, where evidence such as Julian Vale, the overpainted nameplate, and the missing portrait lead to a larger realization.

Restore the portrait. Reveal the forbidden love.

At the heart of the prototype is a focused mystery loop: explore the manor, find fragments, restore a painting, and uncover what the Ashrose family tried to hide. The planned mini-prototype centers on a main menu, an intro, the entrance hall, the atelier, one central puzzle, a journal, a memory scene, and a final teaser ending.

The deeper you investigate, the clearer it becomes: Julian Vale was not just a visitor. His connection to the family was dangerous enough to be erased from every wall, every record, and every memory.

Features

  • Explore an atmospheric gothic manor in first person

  • Investigate portraits, documents, and environmental clues

  • Record discoveries and connect clues through your journal

  • Solve environmental and narrative puzzles

  • Restore a mysterious portrait to uncover lost memories

  • Discover a story of forbidden love, secrecy, and loss

About the Prototype

This playable prototype offers an early look at the atmosphere, exploration, storytelling, and mystery mechanics of Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love.

The game is currently in development, so content, visuals, mechanics, and performance may change in future versions.

If you enjoy the prototype, consider wishlisting Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love on Steam.

Credits

Special thanks and credits to:

LUMI Studio, Pablo Wunderlich, artsystack, Ida Faber, Art Equilibrium

Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of selected 2D images, sprite assets, and marketing artwork, including some Steam capsule and store assets. It was also used for proofreading and editing written text. data.about_the_game:
Enter a manor where every portrait hides a secret.

In Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love, you step into a decaying family estate haunted not by monsters, but by silence. The Ashrose family has preserved its legacy in oil, wood, and dust — yet one name has been scratched away, one portrait has vanished, and one forbidden love was never meant to be remembered.

As Evelyn, you arrive at Ashrose Manor and begin piecing together the truth hidden within its halls. Examine portraits, read forgotten journal entries, investigate old guest books, and uncover the story of Julian Vale, a restorer whose presence in the manor was deliberately erased.

Investigate. Collect clues. Rebuild the past.

Explore atmospheric rooms such as the entrance hall and the artist’s studio, where the manor’s most important secret waits to be uncovered. Every object can become a clue: an overpainted nameplate, a missing frame, a guest book entry from 1954, or a torn fragment of a painting.

Your journal acts as both your memory and your investigation board. Important discoveries are automatically recorded, allowing you to connect clues and unlock new conclusions as the story unfolds. This matches the intended journal-based clue system, where evidence such as Julian Vale, the overpainted nameplate, and the missing portrait lead to a larger realization.

Restore the portrait. Reveal the forbidden love.

At the heart of the prototype is a focused mystery loop: explore the manor, find fragments, restore a painting, and uncover what the Ashrose family tried to hide. The planned mini-prototype centers on a main menu, an intro, the entrance hall, the atelier, one central puzzle, a journal, a memory scene, and a final teaser ending.

The deeper you investigate, the clearer it becomes: Julian Vale was not just a visitor. His connection to the family was dangerous enough to be erased from every wall, every record, and every memory.

Features

  • Explore an atmospheric gothic manor in first person

  • Investigate portraits, documents, and environmental clues

  • Record discoveries and connect clues through your journal

  • Solve environmental and narrative puzzles

  • Restore a mysterious portrait to uncover lost memories

  • Discover a story of forbidden love, secrecy, and loss

About the Prototype

This playable prototype offers an early look at the atmosphere, exploration, storytelling, and mystery mechanics of Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love.

The game is currently in development, so content, visuals, mechanics, and performance may change in future versions.

If you enjoy the prototype, consider wishlisting Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love on Steam.

Credits

Special thanks and credits to:

LUMI Studio, Pablo Wunderlich, artsystack, Ida Faber, Art Equilibrium

Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of selected 2D images, sprite assets, and marketing artwork, including some Steam capsule and store assets. It was also used for proofreading and editing written text. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, selected, and refined by the developer before being included in the game or official marketing materials.
data.short_description: Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love is a first-person gothic mystery about memory, loss, and a love the Ashrose family tried to erase. Explore a forgotten manor, uncover hidden clues, restore a damaged portrait, and reveal the truth behind Julian Vale’s disappearance from history.

data.name: Hazard Levels
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


JOIN OUR DISCORD


About the Game

Hidden deep below the Fox Hole Arms, a research division known only as The Family sends recruits into unstable interdimensional rifts to harvest rare and bizarre ingredients. Step into the unknown alone or with up to three friends as you explore unpredictable rift dimensions, evade the creatures within, and grab whatever strange loot you can carry.

1–4 PLAYER CO-OP HORROR WITH PROX CHAT

Play solo or with up to three friends to tackle the horrors of each rift. Coordination is key, survival is not guaranteed. Proximity voice chat enabled. Supports both third and first person play.

PROCEDURALLY GENERATED RIFT DIMENSIONS

No two expeditions are the same. Each rift generates new biomes, shifting layouts, randomised hazards, and escalating threats that force your team to adapt.

PHYSICS-BASED LOOTING

Use the Gravity Gauntlet to grab, carry, and throw multiple objects at once. Harvest bizarre rift-grown ingredients and sell them at rift stations while surviving the creatures that stalk each dimension.

BREW SPECIAL DRINKS

After a hard day’s work, bring back your otherworldly ingredients to brew at Brewdragon’s Secret Brewery. Complete orders to develop and level up the potency of your brews. Some grant powerful abilities… others cause complete chaos.

FIGHT TO SURVIVE

Terrifying creatures lurk within every dimension. Study their behaviour, learn their weaknesses, and use your weapons strategically to survive deadly encounters. Choose when to fight and when to keep your distance.

RIFT SCANNING & PORTALS

Use your state-of-the-art Rift Scanner to locate dimensional anomalies, then deploy a Rift Stabilising Device to tear open unstable portals. Step through and discover what waits on the other side.

THE FOX HOLE ARMS

Your HQ is a traditional British pub hiding the Family’s secret R&D facility. Between expeditions customise your outfit, mix perk drinks, review mission intel, or drop a coin in the jukebox. Just don’t piss off the Landlord.

data.name: Mercenaries Lament: Requiem of the Silver Wolf
data.detailed_description:
A prayer for the fallen to rise from the depths of despair—

[Game Overview]
Mercenaries Lament is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world.
Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, where character positioning in the front, back, and side of enemy units may very well determine each battle’s outcome.
Support effects depend on where allied characters in your party are positioned, allowing players to enjoy highly strategic maneuvers. Players have a high degree of freedom in character development, such as acquiring and strengthening skills and changing classes by using skill points earned in battle.
The characters are beautifully drawn with rich facial expressions by the illustrator Sakura Mochi!

・Advent Soul
When Amalie, the heroine is in your party, you can fill a gauge on the top right of the screen which will allow you to stock 1 BP when full.
（Up to 9 BP can be stocked up.）
By using BP characters can enter a state called "Advent Soul" which fortifies the character for a certain period of time.
The character can then use "Advent attacks" with other party members and "Soul Exceed" skills, which are special moves.


・Advent attacks
When a character in “Advent mode” is positioned to sandwich an enemy with another ally, a coordinated attack can be unleashed by performing a normal attack or attack skill.
The Advent attacks are unique skills for each character and provide a chance to inflict heavy damage.


・Soul Exceed skills
Units in Advent mode can use Soul Exceed skills at any time.
This special move is unique to each character, and effects vary from inflicting immense damage to the enemy to recovering HP and abnormalities of all allies.
(Once Soul Exceed is used, the character's Advent mode will be lifted.)
Utilizing Soul Exceed skills are the key to victory!


・Orbs with hidden power
There are mysterious "Orbs" that can be obtained from story progression, specific locations, and certain enemies.
There are 13 Orbs in total scattered throughout the game.
You can check the status of your collection on a dedicated screen and equip your character with them as accessories.
What will happen when all the Orbs are collected?


[Story]
Several years have passed since a mysterious disease with no cure quickly spread across the continent.
Those infected would suffer a horrible fate of turning into zombies after their death, mindlessly attacking the living. It has become the norm for hired mercenaries to spend countless days clearing the lands of the undead.
Such a mercenary is Johann, captain of the Silver Wolf Mercenary Company. He is paid a visit by the Grim Reaper, and narrowly escapes its blade of death, but the Reaper leaves him with an eerie prophecy: "In the next 100 days, your luck shall run out. That shall be the day of your fate.”
After awaking from a delirious slumber, he is met by a young woman with miraculous powers that can heal people from the disease.
Was his encounter with the Grim Reaper but a nightmare....?
Regardless, Johann offers to protect the miracle worker on her travels to save as many people as she can. They set out on a journey to travel the kingdom, curing the infected.
Soon, however, Johann must confront his mortality…

data.name: Selfie Worm
data.detailed_description:
Selfie Worm is a visually rewarding 2D physics platformer. Take control of a bouncy, elastic worm and leap through a monochrome alien world. Feel the pure joy of every collision and rebound in a stress-free environment designed for ultimate flow—no pressure, no failure, just pure relaxation.

In this world of stark black and white outlines, your camera is the only key to bringing back the warmth. By capturing photos from the worm’s unique perspective, you’ll not only repaint the environment but also unlock hidden narrative fragments. These snippets reveal touching, heartwarming moments waiting to be discovered.

Designed with a unique vertical window mode, the game mimics a mobile selfie experience while tucking neatly beside your work windows. It’s the perfect "healing" companion for your breaks. Features include:

  • 【Anti-Boss Mode】: Professional Camouflage Mode. Double-tap ESC to instantly switch to a realistic calculator interface for those "unexpected" situations.

  • 【Productivity Tools】: Built-in Focus Timer and Music Player. Let the worm keep you company during every focused work session.

  • 【Zero-Stress Micro-Breaks】: Levels are designed in 1-minute bursts—pick it up and put it down anytime to match your workflow.

Collect various worm skins and camera filters to create your own unique social-ready photos.

Don't let your computer be worm-less! Add Selfie Worm to your Wishlist now for the latest dev updates and Demo news!

Streaming & Video Monetization Policy

We warmly welcome and encourage creators to stream, create videos of Selfie Worm, and monetize their content!

Important Notice Regarding In-Game Music:

  • During Normal Gameplay: The background music is carefully screened, and we can ensure that no Content ID claims will be triggered during your standard playthrough.

  • In the Music Player: Some tracks available in the in-game Music Player may trigger YouTube Content ID "Copyright Claims" due to recent updates in third-party platform licensing policies.

Please note: A copyright claim is NOT a copyright strike; it will not harm your channel or take down your video, but it may affect that specific video's ad monetization.

Safe Streaming Solution: If you are concerned about monetization being affected, you can go to the in-game audio settings and click the speaker icon next to "Music" to mute the BGM with one click. Alternatively, please avoid playing tracks via the in-game Music Player during your live streams.

data.name: Godstone Tactics
data.detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in Godstone Tactics, a turn-based strategy game that combines tactical depth with competitive excitement. Lead your team of adorable yet fierce animal units into battle. Navigate a variety of unique and challenging arenas, each presenting its own obstacles to overcome. Outsmart your opponents, safeguard your King, and pursue victory in the mystical realm of Sangreal!

As Sangreal descends into chaos, Savroth seeks a worthy ruler. Countless battles erupt with a single goal: to crown the true King. Who knows, p that King is you!

  • Different Arenas Each arena features varied terrains and challenges, including treacherous ice fields and petrifying fireflies. Adapt your strategies to dominate every arena.

  • Setting Your Team Strategically place your animal units on your side. Each unit has distinct roles and movement patterns, making placement essential for victory.

  • Strategic Depth and Competitive Play Engage in tactical battles where every move is pivotal. Protect your King, eliminate your opponent’s, and compete in ranked matches to climb the leaderboards.

• Competitive Play: Compete in ranked matches to earn royal points and rise in the leaderboards.
• Immersive Pixel Art: Enjoy vibrant pixel art that brings Sangreal’s world to life.

• Various Play Modes: Play ranked battles, solo training, puzzles or casual matchs.

• Daily Puzzles: Solve daily challenges to earn rewards and enhance your tactics.

• Different arenas: Battle on varied terrains, each with unique gameplay effects.

• Set Your Team: Choose your animal units from your unit pool each game, focusing on strategic placement.

• Discover Sangreal: Explore the rich lore and stories behind each unit and arena.

• Cross-Platform Coming Soon: Play “Godstone Tactics” on PC (Steam) and mobile devices (Android, iOS).

Beyond the tactical arenas, Sangreal offers a wealth of adventures, locales, and animal heroes waiting to be discovered. As developers, we are excited to share our first indie game, "Godstone Tactics," and can't wait to hear your thoughts and experiences in this immersive world.

data.name: Yihongyuan
data.detailed_description:
LATEST RELEASE


About the Game

Included in the community

Click on the sidebar   > Discord <

《Yihongyuan》 is a declassified interactive novel, where there are eternal stories of talented people and beautiful women! The player will play a touching and interesting story of a scholar who went to Beijing to catch the exam and met a beautiful woman.

◆ Roll the dice, decrypt, and recite poems-super cool and diverse gameplay will keep you from stopping.

◆ Rich stories and plots.

◆ Exquisite original design.

◆ Increase the entanglement system to keep your storyline running.

Liu Xiangjun

Growing up in the Courtyard of the Elysium, she was used to seeing people's feelings and the world's conditions, but instead considered this to be the norm, believing herself to be free and unencumbered, unwilling to accept a set fate, very bold with those she liked, unconcerned with worldly views, happy above all, and even a little naive.

Mercy Snow

She was born in a famous family, but her family had fallen on hard times, she was well informed, she was not condescending, and she treated her guests as equals.

Myriad euphoric clouds

A half-breed dancer, good at moving from man to man, won't stay in front of any man for long, will pique your interest and then run away, knows the chase game well.

Nien Chien Lo

Seemingly pliant, she is in fact a provocateur of various disputes, an orphan, adopted by the Yi Hong Yuan, knows how to use her pity to gain sympathy, knows how to read people's minds and ingratiate herself with them. In short, she is an ingratiating personality + a high level of green tea.

Murong Yuzheng

He comes to the Courtyard with a special purpose, selling his art but not his body, a clean herder who looks cool but is actually arrogant and jealous.

Su Maniang

Once a head girl, now a pimp, she has a deep background and is quite spontaneous. She can refuse the dignitaries or invite the scholar to visit the kiln for free, and is a very flirtatious woman who makes it hard for men to resist.

data.name: STAR WARS™ SHADOWS OF THE EMPIRE™
data.detailed_description:
A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away…

As Luke Skywalker and the Rebel Alliance struggle to defeat Darth Vader and the Empire, a new threat arises. Dark Prince Xizor, head of the Black Sun crime syndicate, aspires to take Darth Vader's place at the Emperor's side. To do that, he must eliminate young Skywalker. As Dash Rendar, it's up to you to protect Luke and help the Alliance defeat the evil Xizor. Watch out for infamous bounty hunters and deadly stormtroopers! May the Force be with you!

- A gripping new plotline, with new characters and environments...find out what happened between Star Wars™ The Empire Strikes Back™ and Star Wars™ Return of the Jedi™.

- Five gameplay modes - in a variety of vehicles and spacecraft - from the heavily armored Outrider, to snowspeeders, hovertrains, jet packs, and speeder bikes.

- Action-packed Star Wars™ locales - including Mos Eisley and the ice planet Hoth. New locales, like the sewers of Imperial City, Xizor's palace, Gall Spaceport and the dreaded junkyards of Ord Mantel.

data.name: SanGoFate
data.detailed_description:
Three cards. One life. A kingdom's worth of consequences.

You don't pilot a hero through the Three Kingdoms. You decide who they are (three cards, three choices), and then you watch what the era does to them.

Draft Your Destiny

Three rounds. Three cards on the table each time. One choice.

A deck of 81 Destiny Cards across three rarities, and every single one states its price in red at the bottom. Ruthless Extermination cuts down rebellion and revenge, and poisons your name with the people. The Poisoner's Gambit wrecks an enemy's resources for almost nothing, and trades your reputation for cunning. Reroll if you must; the tokens are finite.

Become an Archetype

Your three cards converge on one of 15 officer archetypes, each named for a figure from the era: the Cao Cao type, the Sima Yi type, the Lü Bu type. You'll see the candidates narrowing as you draft. Then allocate Might, Intellect, Command, Politics and Charisma, and send them out into a collapsing empire.

Watch a Life Happen

Season by season, year by year, your officer's life writes itself across an illustrated chronicle: recognized by a lord, taking in refugees, wrongly accused, a friend from home riding in to join you. Every event is a full painted scene. Their portrait changes as they rise. Meanwhile six warlords contend for the realm, and their power shifts whether you act or not.

Pause it. Run it at 4x. It's your life to watch.

Take the Field

When you march, the chronicle gives way to the battlefield: six-round tactical card combat with animated pixel battle scenes. Bring a lieutenant, play your formations and stratagems, and spend the stamina you've been hoarding. Some lives are won in court. Some are won here.

Earn Your Biography

When the life ends, the game writes it down, a personal liezhuan biography assembled only from events that genuinely happened in your run. No templates. No filler.

Twenty-Two Endings

The Hall of Biographies holds 22 endings. The ones you haven't reached sit locked behind a single riddling line, graded by rarity. Die a nameless soldier. Vanish into obscurity. Take the throne. Every life you live is a permanent record, and there is always one more you haven't written.

20–30 minutes a run. Then one more.
