data.name: Solve or Die
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Step into the role of a detective whose family has been abducted. Re-join your former agency to track the culprit, only to realize the threat is far larger than a missing persons case.

The Astral Plane has begun bleeding into our world. The abductor’s failed experiments have left behind a trail of possessed humans and fanatical cultists. Track their footsteps. Collect evidence. Banish the spirits standing in your way.

No two investigations are the same. Our procedural puzzle generation ensures that puzzles shift, solutions change, and the spirits behave unexpectedly depending on your progress in the game.

Solve or Die features non-linear gameplay that lets you tackle objectives at your own speed and in any direction. Every map you pass grants a unique final clue toward solving the "Great Mystery." How you piece them together is up to you.

  • Maps: There are currently 3 maps available to play, each featuring different story and a case to solve

  • Singleplayer: Enjoy the game on your own, although it might be way harder to solve puzzle while having to watch your back

  • Multiplayer: Invite your friends. Turn the light off. Scream and have fun. Watch each other's backs. Only cooperation will get you through the whole game

As you gather evidence across multiple maps, the line between "good" and "evil" begins to blur. You aren't just hunting a former - you're uncovering his vision. When the final clue is found, the ending isn't written for you. You choose your destiny. Will you banish the Astral Plane, or help it claim our world?

Between investigations, retreat to your detective base. Here, the evil can't reach you. Use this time to study case files, piece together the history of the Astral Plane, and prepare for the next hunt. And if it gets too hard? Throw toilet paper at your co-detectives, grab a drink, or play some mini-games before heading back into the dark.

data.name: Dungeon Weiqi
data.detailed_description:
Dungeon Weiqi is a pixel-art roguelike card game primarily inspired by the ancient game of Weiqi.

Weiqi Style Card Combat

Deploy cards using Crystals that regenerate automatically each turn.

Once placed on the chessboard, cards autonomously attack adjacent enemies at round's end.

Try to occupy advantageous positions and surround the enemy to create more advantages!

Your Lord enters battle as a card. Will you use the lord's powerful abilities to charge forward, or protect them in the rear and seek victory? The choice is yours!

Diverse Factions & Card Types

Players can choose from multiple factions. You can collect unique cards, and form the most suitable deck to fight!

There are three types of cards for both the enemy and us: Warrior Cards | Skill Cards | Structure Cards.

Master their synergies to overturn desperate situations!

Enemies also possess unique cards and combat styles. Be careful to deal with them and familiarize yourself with their combat styles and weaknesses. Then victory is yours!

Explore the Map Freely

Avoiding strong enemies or engaging in direct combat? The decision is entirely yours! You can freely plan your path, choose the order of battle with enemies, or even completely ignore them (if you are willing to give up the treasure they are guarding).

Be careful with your supplies. Every step further will cost your food. If the food runs out, you will be at a huge disadvantage and even lose the entire game! Plan your path carefully to avoid the worst-case situation.

data.name: Blazing Ace
data.detailed_description:
About Blazing Ace

“I want to be stronger…”

Summer bootcamp has begun!!! Let’s make your dream come true!
Beast Fella Foundation (BFF), an organization which monitors martial arts competitions among beastmen, has sent you an invitation letter. An unforgettable summer memory ensues.

Fight all the problems along with your teammates


  • Chikara
Cheerful powerhouse of the Judo club who is always willing to solve (and create) problems, especially those that make your heart skipping a beat.

  • Arato
Advisor coach of the Judo club, who can certainly guide you into great career paths from his extensive experience, although he might need some guidance about his love life.

  • Shirogami
Junior champion of beastmen fights. Your childhood friend who shares the same dreams with you. Not a person who is good with words. Strong when becoming an ally, but even stronger when you are his enemy (!?)

  • Taiyo
Shirogami’s best friend. Kind, warm, and super approachable. Another BFF participant who is always seen tagging along with Shirogami. What kind of strength does his small body hide?

Train hard. Sleep hard. And eat good food!!

Begin the legend of you and your friends!

features

  • Visual Novel filled with sweat and dreams of young men. Appropriate for both kids and adults alike.
  • Intense fighting scenes using digital arts
  • Martial arts dark secrets!?
  • Multiple endings included.

data.name: Fear: Nightmare Citadel
data.detailed_description:
Fear: Nightmare Citadel is an immersive first-person psychological horror game set within the dark and oppressive halls of a realistic medieval castle. Plunged into total darkness, you must rely on your perception and a single flickering lighter to navigate the unknown and survive the suffocating atmosphere.

KEY FEATURES:

Photorealistic Visuals: Detailed medieval architecture, realistic lighting, and deep shadows create an intense, claustrophobic atmosphere.

Flickering Lifeline: Your lighter is your only source of light. Use it wisely to cut through the darkness and spot details in the shadows.

Immersive Exploration: Traverse abandoned halls, claustrophobic corridors, and ancient chambers as you attempt to find a way out.

Constant Psychological Tension: Every creak, sound, and shadow plays with your perception as you navigate the eerie silence of the citadel.

data.name: Alph Last Bastion
data.detailed_description:
They came out of the treeline at dusk. Armored beetles. Skittering hordes. Hornets that blot out the sky. Between them and the end of everything stands a single command post, and a commander who refuses to fall.

ALPH: Last Bastion is a tower defense game about building a fortress worth fighting for, and the rush of watching it hold when the whole swarm crashes into it at once.



Every battle begins on open ground. Plant turrets, supply depots and generators anywhere on the field, carve out kill zones, and reshape your defense between waves. Where you build matters just as much as what you build.



Chattering machine guns. Patient sniper nests. Mortar barrages, roaring flamethrowers, homing missiles and tesla coils that leap from bug to bug. Every tower plays differently, every tower has a signature specialty, and the real power lies in how you combine them.



Generators supercharge every tower in their reach and light your defenses up with raw speed. But power is a target: lose a generator and its boost goes dark until you bring it back online.



The swarm never fights the same way twice. Armored brutes shrug off small arms, healers keep the horde alive, flyers sweep straight over your ground defenses and raiders go hunting for your gold. Every wave asks a new question of your base.



Then the ground starts to shake. Monstrous beasts crawl out of the dark, time slows as they arrive, and your entire defense has one job: bring them down before they reach the heart of your bastion.



Every battle pays out medals, win or lose. Spend them in the Arsenal to unlock new towers, sharpen their stats, push their specialties further and hand-pick the loadout you carry into the next fight. Every defeat makes your next stand stronger.


  • Tower defense with real freedom: build anywhere on an open battlefield and design your own fortress.
  • A diverse arsenal of turrets, each with its own role, upgrade path and signature specialty.
  • A living economy: supply depots, generators and smart layouts reward commanders who plan ahead.
  • A relentless swarm of armored, healing, flying and raiding bugs that keeps you adapting.
  • Spectacular boss battles with slow-motion arrivals and explosive finishes.
  • Lasting progression: unlock, upgrade and build your perfect loadout, battle after battle.
  • Endless mode for commanders who never want the fight to end.
  • Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud saves.

The bastion is yours to hold, Commander. How long can you last?

data.name: GraFi Easter
data.detailed_description:
GraFi Easter is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game that combines gravity manipulation, challenging traps, moving treadmills, mysterious portals, and cheerful Easter-themed artwork. Change the direction of gravity, guide a small blue coin through tricky environments, and discover clever solutions in this festive collection of logic puzzles and brain teasers.

Step into a vibrant world of Easter-inspired physics puzzles where gravity is the key to every challenge. Instead of controlling the coin directly, manipulate gravitational forces to influence its movement. Experiment with different gravity directions, observe how the coin reacts, and use physics to overcome obstacles. Every level challenges your logical thinking, concentration, spatial reasoning, and precision.

Your objective is simple but surprisingly challenging: move the blue coin onto the blue rock and keep it there long enough to complete the level. Navigate dangerous traps, deal with moving treadmills, and overcome increasingly tricky puzzle layouts. Carefully plan each gravity change, anticipate the coin's movement, and discover the correct solution through experimentation and precise timing.

With 50 levels of gravity-based puzzle challenges, GraFi Easter offers an entertaining combination of classic physics puzzles, obstacle avoidance, and precision-based gameplay. Moving surfaces, portals, and challenging obstacles add variety to traditional gravity puzzles, encouraging creative thinking and careful planning.

Immerse yourself in a cheerful Easter and springtime atmosphere filled with colorful Easter egg artwork, festive decorations, and charming seasonal details. The minimalist 2D visuals combine bright colors with clean puzzle environments, creating a delightful holiday twist on the classic GraFi gameplay.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, Easter games, challenging physics puzzles, or clever brain teasers, GraFi Easter offers an accessible yet rewarding single-player experience. Experiment with gravity, overcome tricky obstacles, and enjoy the satisfaction of completing each level while surrounded by colorful Easter aesthetics.

With its distinctive colorful 2D minimalist art, engaging background music, and straightforward gameplay mechanics, GraFi Easter delivers a festive puzzle experience where simple controls meet challenging physics. data.name: Arena
data.detailed_description:
Multiplayer deathmatch games with drones!

Enjoy fast multiplayer action with your drone in Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch competitions in exotic arenas.

Arena is a game from the creators of Drone Fighters. Although it’s a very different kind of game, your avatars and drones will be synced across both games if you play them. Just like Drone Fighters, Arena is also supporting cross platform play between non-VR PC, Vive and Oculus players.

There are 2 types of competitions in this Early Access version, Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch. We will be adding new modes with upcoming patches. Game controls are tuned to the platform, and we’ve tried to make it fun whatever your device of choice to play Arena.

As in all Surreal powered games, you can customize your drone and avatar in great detail, and use the same configuration for all our other games.

Join the community and share your thoughts and feedback. We want you to be part of the development process.

data.name: KurunMania: Spiral Drop
data.detailed_description:
Spin, Fall, and Advance to the Next Stage

KurunMania is a challenging pachinko-inspired physics game in which you launch balls onto spinning circular stages—known as kroons—and watch them fight their way toward the winning hole.

Take on stages with 3, 6, 9, or 12 consecutive kroons.

Each kroon has only one winning hole that leads to the next stage. The deeper you go, the longer and more difficult your journey becomes. Whether a ball advances or falls short depends on its trajectory—and your luck.

Every Miss Improves Your Chances

In Normal Mode, balls that enter a losing hole remain there and block it.

At first, every losing hole is open. As you launch more balls, those holes gradually fill up, reducing the number of places where future balls can be lost. Every failed attempt can therefore improve your chances of reaching the next stage.

However, your supply of balls is limited.

Will you fill the losing holes and steadily create a path forward, or will fortune carry you through with only a few balls? The rules are simple, but every ball matters until the very end.

A Challenge That Will Not Go Easy on You

KurunMania is not designed to be an easy game.

You may conquer the 3-stage challenge, only to find that the 6-, 9-, and 12-stage versions demand far more luck and endurance. A ball may circle the winning hole for several tense moments before dropping in—or miss it at the last possible second.

The unpredictable movement of every ball creates moments of triumph, frustration, and drama.

Reverse Mode: No Holes Are Blocked

Clearing a stage in Normal Mode unlocks its more punishing Reverse Mode.

In Reverse Mode, balls that enter losing holes disappear instead of remaining inside them. The holes stay open no matter how many balls you launch, removing the advantage of gradually blocking them.

It is a pure high-difficulty challenge against the movement of the balls and the limits of your luck.

Conquer Reverse Mode to earn a special rainbow crown.

Kroon Physics Tuned for Entertainment

The movement of the balls is based on physics, but the game is not intended to be a perfect recreation of any real-world pachinko machine.

The stages have been adjusted to make the entire journey enjoyable to watch: circling the outer edge, drifting toward the center, and battling around the holes. Even when launched under similar conditions, collisions with other balls and the rotating obstacle in the center can produce a different result every time.

Made for Streaming and Commentary

With clear outcomes and unpredictable action on every launch, KurunMania is ideal for streaming and gameplay commentary.

Watch dozens of balls create total chaos.
Witness a comeback with only one ball remaining.
Experience the despair of missing the winning hole on the final stage.
Celebrate the moment an incredibly difficult challenge is finally conquered.

Invite your viewers to watch—and judge—every spin, bounce, and fall.

Key Features

  • Kroon challenges with 3, 6, 9, or 12 stages

  • Normal Mode, where losing balls remain and block holes

  • High-difficulty Reverse Mode, where losing balls disappear

  • A limited supply of balls that keeps every attempt tense

  • Unpredictable trajectories based on physics

  • The ability to launch multiple balls into play

  • Simple rules that are easy for viewers to understand
    No permission is required, so please feel free to enjoy it.

data.name: DEEPMESS
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated



The demo is now live! Drop by the and check out our Twitter >;)


About the Game

DEEPMESS is a micro-tactics descent into the mind of god. Guide the Pink Slime Mold from the walls of god's cave, where it feeds on leftover thoughts, to carve a new home directly inside the source—the big one's brain.



Armed with hammer and nail, plunge your way down through layers of flesh and bone while fighting off divine enemies. Strategize vertically layer-by-layer as you descend through intense combat and lobotomize god.

FEATURES


Lobotomize god through micro-tactics
Share one big hammer amongst your units—attack enemies and strike the Nail to destroy the current floor and fall directly into the next floor of combat!


Beef up your arsenal at the Slime Bodega
Upgrade your unit’s abilities to influence the vertical strategy. Burst open new God Thoughts that provide passive effects on your run. Build up your squad while traversing through the brain-y biomes of god's head.


Survive a drum-and-bass-filled bio-hellscape
Deadly enemies and hazards fill squishy environments themed around bone, flesh, and brains. Look before your leap as you crash through layers of combat.


Play the demo now!

DEEPMESS is ongoing development, and planned updates to the demo are coming! Wishlist and join the DEEPMESS Discord to support development!

data.name: The Devils Mirror
data.detailed_description:
What is the game about:

This exquisitely crafted first-person horror game immerses you in the journey of a desperate man trying to save his deceased wife. Awakening in a psychiatric hospital, in his quest to revive his dead lover, he is willing to follow the demon's instructions to perform a sacrificial ritual. Explore eerie wards and stay rational amidst the horror. This magic mirror may be the last hope to bring her back. But what he doesn't realize is that the cost of using demonic powers is also great...

Key features:

  • Outstanding atmosphere: Clever sound effects and scene settings recreate the eerie and oppressive environment of a psychiatric hospital.

  • Solve puzzles: Crucial clues are hidden in riddles — Can you find them?

  • Use the devil's mirror: Let its powerful forces aid you in solving the puzzles.

This game is created by @lz-ink with YAHAHA Horror Game Kit and YAHAHA assists the creator with packaging and publishing the game based on their request. Yahaha Horror Gamekit is tailored for imaginative creators and players who adore horror games, all without the need for any programming expertise.

data.name: Mist Survivor
data.detailed_description:
Mist Survivor is an action roguelite game. You take on the role of a character summoned by the Goddess, trapped in a time rift.
You need to use magical powers to fight against the monsters in the mist and survive the dangerous zone.

A follow-up of action rogulite Mist Slayer

Inherits most of the story and characters of the original game but with a different gameplay.
More refreshing experience based on the survivor roguelike genre.

Story

Chosen by the Goddess, you fight against the evil Mist invaders to save the world. However, you suddenly fall into a time rift, constantly shuttling between different strange places.
The enemies you once defeated have also been resurrected, pouring in like a tide. You see a mysterious Merchant. He tells you that if you want to return to the normal world, you must defeat these monsters and obtain clues.
You still retain the talent to control the power of the five elements, and the merchant will provide you with more powerful abilities.

Gameplay

  • Control characters with different classes to fight against enemies, automatically release various powerful skills, and survive for a certain time to pass the level.
  • Upgrade attributes, purchase powers or inscriptions after each level to match your combat style.
  • The unique WuXing (five elements) powers can be customized to produce powerful magical effects.
For example,Mutal can give power a chance to release a shadow attack, while Overcoming will extend the cooldown time of power but increase the damage.
Use your wisdom to arrange them as you like!

Highlights

  • Fight against hordes of enemies and release stress in fast-paced levels.
  • You only need to control the movement and sprint. You can enjoy the game with one hand.
  • Gorgeous and cool power effects, exciting combat scenes.
  • Many different enemies and bosses with different challenges.
  • Unique Power system - five elements of metal, fire, water, wood and earth, each with its own magical effect.
  • Hundreds of powers and inscription. Every run has its unique experience.

The game is currently in the Demo stage. There are still some features and contents under development.
If you have any good suggestions, please let us know via Discord or steam community.

data.name: Flame Cycle
data.detailed_description:
FlameCycle is a brutal, ultra-minimalist open-world soulslike where you start at the bottom of the food chain. Build and refine an infinite deck of abilities to master high-stakes combat, adapt to a volatile world that radically shifts with every death, and conquer an unforgiving ecosystem.

Procedural, Unique Worlds

This is not just a map—it is a volatile, living ecosystem. With every death, the world undergoes a radical, procedural metamorphosis:

  • Shifting Reality: The color palette, soundtrack, game speed, and rhythm of reality alter instantly.

  • New Landscapes: The environment molds into entirely new structures, and the new ecosystem fills up with unique creatures. 

Master Your Deck

True to its soulslike roots, combat is unforgiving, but your greatest weapon is your build.

  • Deck-Inspired Build Crafting: Collect a massive roster of distinct skills and build them like a deck. With endless ability combinations, you can engineer custom playstyles to counter the changing world.

  • Persistent Progress: The world breaks and remakes itself, but your soul remains intact. You retain your unlocked skills, rest points, and achievements across every shift.

  • Pure Minimalist Atmosphere: No overwhelming UI. No hand-holding or directional markers. You are dropped into the unknown and left to decipher the laws of this brutal ecosystem entirely on your own.

Early Access Demo (High Hardware Requirements)

Please read before downloading! The demo is currently in early access development:

  • Hardware Warning: Optimization is in its early stages. A high-end PC is required to run the game smoothly at this time.

  • Work-In-Progress Content: The total variety of creatures, structures, and bosses is currently limited.

  • Procedural Shifts: Generation algorithms are still evolving, so some world shifts may feel similar in early builds.

Your feedback during this early phase is invaluable as the ecosystem expands, new skills and bosses are introduced, and world-shifting mechanics are deepened!

data.name: Raid Sky
data.detailed_description:
Raid Sky is a team strategy game fought across a wraparound sky where every faction sails its own main island — a living base with a crystal at its core. Win three ways at once: keep the crystal charged, hold the rotating bonus zone, and be first to finish the shared mission. Highest score takes the match — or destroy a rival's crystal and eliminate them outright.

What's in the game

  • 3 factions, 6 playable races — League of Rediscovery, Free Coalition and Alliance of the Roots. Bioforged, Goblin, Human, Plushkin, Snailfolk and Treant each bring lore, a racial perk and a drawback.

  • Build your island — Workbench, Furnace, Collector and Chests; feed the crystal Aethelium so its charge keeps scoring.

  • Fish and craft — catch fish, gather scrap and materials, and craft every structure and consumable.

  • Cannons and the Debuff Tower — hurl stones at enemy buildings, or launch one of 6 debuffs (Slowness, Crystal Drain, Locked Chests, Junkfall, Slow Fishing, Heavy Steps) at every rival in range.

  • 8 crystal buffs — Quick Fishing, Crystal Efficiency, Resource Surge, Long Burn, Aetheric Purity, Swift Steps, Foresight and Hidden Island stealth.

  • Play your way — online co-op PvP up to 3 teams of 3, or offline solo against 1–2 bot teams on Easy, Normal or Hard.

  • Rules you control — wind, bonus zone, missions, item spawn rate and 15/20/30-minute matches.

  • Battlefield awareness — minimap with detection radius, rival shadows, stealth reveals, live match log and a step-by-step in-game guide.

  • Steam achievements, original soundtrack & SFX, full English and Portuguese localization.

data.name: Sway
data.detailed_description:
Sway is a short bullet hell game modeled after the Touhou series that can be completed in about 15 to 30 minutes. This game was developed by a 2-person team in 4 months as part of a college independent study. Additional shout-out and credit to the folks at Analgesic Productions for allowing us to use sound effects from their game Anodyne! Also, feel free to join our official discord server (link is on the right).

In Sway you play as a nameless girl who has suddenly found herself in a surreal and hostile world. With no other option, you must press forward through an onslaught of bullets in hopes of finding a way back home. This game features over 45 beautifully-drawn backgrounds paired with 4 original piano compositions. You'll fight 23 unique enemy types and face-off against 5 challenging bosses.

Gameplay is simple!

Use the ARROW KEYS to move.
Hold Z to continuously fire bullets at your foes.
Hold SHIFT to reduce your speed and narrow your cone of fire.
Press X to use a bomb and clear the screen of enemy bullets.

Gather power tokens from fallen enemies to gain additional firepower.
Defeated enemies also drop faith tokens which increase your score.
Hearts grant you an additional life, allowing you to take more hits before dying.
Stars increase your bomb count by 1.

That's really all there is to it.
We hope you enjoy our first published game and we also hope to bring you even higher quality work in the future!

data.name: Lanternbound
data.detailed_description:
Set in the medieval-like world of Elarion, Lanterbound is a low-magic fantasy RPG that will let you choose your own path. Will you follow the hero's journey with a quest line that will lead you to saving the world? Or will you choose the life of a simple farmer overcoming the struggles of a poor harvest.

Background:

It's been more than a century since the gods mysteriously fell silent. Their absence did not destroy civilization overnight. Instead, the world has suffered a long decline as kingdoms fracture, old roads and temples crumble, and a creeping corruption only known as The Blight spreads into forgotten places.

Magic still exists but it is slowly dying. Spells are less reliable, divine power is almost unheard of, and those with magical gifts often find that they weaken with use. Powerful mages can sometime still arise but the greater the power they wield, the faster that power fades. "The flame that burns the brightest burns half as long." 

Ancient relics sometimes retain fragments of impossible strength while old faiths survive mostly through ritual, memory, and stubborn devotion. Elarion is a world that has learned to live without miracles. Most believe the gods to be dead... but some say that they may not be truly gone after all.

Features:

Open World:- Rugged northern terrain featuring mountains, open plains, and hamlets.

Non-linear Story:- You are a nobody; stay that way or forge your own destiny. Not all choices will lead to victory. Not all aspiring heroes succeed.

Character Development:- Improve skills by doing, not points. Gain abilities and create a unique person.

Multiplayer:- Some choices affect the world at large. Will you join your friends in a guild to advance common goals or will you oppose them to shape the world after your vision?

PvE Focus:- PvP options available but can be disabled.

data.name: Device Doctor Simulator 2024
data.detailed_description:
Device Doctor Simulator 2024 offers an interactive and detailed simulation experience of becoming a technology repair expert. In this unique simulation, dive into the complex world of various digital devices, including smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches. Each device awaits with its unique problems and repair needs. Filled with realistic repair processes and challenges, this game will develop your skills as a device doctor, saving your customers' digital lives.

Features

Realistic Repair Scenarios: From screen replacements to battery changes, software updates to diagnosing hardware issues, a wide range of repair tasks awaits.

Various Devices: Repair a variety of devices, including smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches.

Knowledge Base and Learning Module: Each repair task is accompanied by information on how the devices work, allowing you to learn while playing.

Career Mode: Manage your own repair workshop, increase customer satisfaction, and expand your business.

Visual and Sound Effects: Enhance your repair experience with high-quality graphics and realistic sound effects.

🛠️ Want to become a master phone repair technician? Set up your own repair workshop with the wide range of equipment found in our game! 🔧📱 Discover all the tools needed to solve various malfunctions. ⚙️🔩 In our realistic simulation, you'll feel like a professional as you repair all types of phones! 🎮✨

🎨 Create your own space! Personalize your area with the customizable decorations available in our game. 🛋️✨ Decorate your repair shop or home in your own style with furniture, wall colors, and accessories that suit every player's taste. 🖼️🌿 Build your dream environment and unleash your creativity! 🏡💡

Why Device Doctor Simulator 2024?

"Device Doctor Simulator 2024" is more than just a simulation game; it's a way to explore and enhance your passion for technology. As you gain in-depth knowledge about device repair, you'll also improve your critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Experience the excitement of setting up and managing your own repair workshop. Earn your customers' trust and become a master of technology repair.

Are you ready to become a hero in the digital world with Device Doctor Simulator 2024? Get ready to test your tech repair skills and embark on a journey to become a true device doctor!

data.name: Stock Den
data.detailed_description:
Taipei, 1994. Behind a corner store, there's a den with no sign on the door.
Everyone's racing for the same stocks. Whoever makes the most wins. Anything goes.

Jealous of Someone Else's Gains?

Peek at their holdings, cut their phone line.
Plant a story in the paper, or get a TV pundit to talk their stock down.
Caught peeking? You get punched to the floor, and the whole room sees it.

Read the Market

Every price comes from real order matching. Place a big enough order and you actually move the stock.
TV news flashes keep popping up, the paper lands every morning, and monthly sales, quarterly earnings and ex-dividend dates arrive on schedule. Read K-line charts from 5-minute to monthly.

Finance TV

Twelve TV pundits take turns shouting picks: slamming the desk, trash-talking, guaranteeing it'll go up.
Some are right, some make it up, and one always gets it backwards. Figure out which one yourself.
Or pay one to go on air and pump the stock you're holding.

Brick Phone

Everyone carries a brick phone. Hot tips, pump-together deals, loans, private stock trades: it all takes one call.
Charge for a tip: they only hear which stock after they pay, and whether it's true is up to you.
Call without giving your name to spread fake news, or pose as their broker or mother-in-law and con them.

Anything Can Happen in the Den

A wife storms in to catch her husband, slaps him and drags him out the door.
A sales auntie corners you to pitch insurance, multi-level marketing and burial niches.
Casino open in the back room? Watch out for a police raid. Anyone too slow to clear out gets fined on the spot.

The Back Room

Lost it all? The host can open the casino: Little Mary, the poke board and the lotto. One more shot.

Story Mode

Relive the market's worst days: the 10,000-Point Crash (1990), the 921 Earthquake (1999), the Financial Tsunami (2008), the Pandemic Crash (2020)... 11 chapters so far, with more on the way.
Each chapter hands you that year's holdings and cash. Play through history and see if you can make money from the crash.

Daily Challenge

The whole world plays the same market. Compete on net worth on the global leaderboard.

Features

  • Up to 9 at a table with friends, or play solo with AI regulars
  • Story Mode with 11 chapters: relive historic crashes and profit from the fall
  • Host a room and invite Steam friends, or just share the room code
  • Three modes: Fixed Days, Race to Target and Margin Call (knocked-out players can still use their leftover cash to mess with others)
  • Secret missions: draw a card each day, complete it on the sly, and find out who's been up to something at the close
  • Daily Challenge with a global leaderboard
  • Margin buying, short selling, index futures, warrants, the back-room casino and random events, each switchable by the host
  • Sixteen den regulars to play with
  • Twelve finance TV pundits shouting picks every day
Investing involves risk. Please read the prospectus before entering the den.
All markets, companies and news in the game are fictional and not investment advice. The casino uses in-game money only and cannot be cashed out.

data.name: Little Merchant
data.detailed_description:
You wake up in a rented room above the square with a satchel, a handful of coins and a note from your landlady. No shop, no name, no plan. Just a town full of people who need something for a cough, a burn or a bad night's sleep, and a hillside full of herbs nobody bothers to pick.


Gather nettles, lavender and bellflowers along the paths, or in the neighbours' gardens when nobody's looking. If the guard catches you, he'll want a word, and a fine.


Back at your bench, open the recipe book, choose what to brew and how strong to make it. Time the green notch right and the potion is ready early.



Mornings fill the square with buyers, evenings belong to the tavern crowd. At night the moon thistle opens on the Belvedere, odd customers slip out of the alleys and the guards only see what's under their lanterns. Stay out too late, though, and you'll pay for it in the morning.



Sell your first herbs to Bertoldo at the Loggia, at his prices. Save up for a licence and a stall of your own, then for the boarded-up shop old Anselmo is trying to get rid of. Hire young Tonio to mind the counter while you're out gathering. Every step makes life a little easier. The big deals are still yours to make.



  • A whole town to walk through, interiors included, with no loading screens
  • Herbs that grow back, gardens you shouldn't touch, and guards who notice
  • A recipe book to fill, one discovery at a time
  • Customers with names, moods and coughs of their own
  • A slow climb from empty pockets to a shop with your name on it

data.name: Pawn
data.detailed_description:
Back in your hometown after a 10 years hiatus following the demise of your parents, you are assigned to a high school for the last week of the semester. Rumours and hearsays, strange behaviors and hidden secrets reveal a darker side of the city where the inhabitants are being preyed upon by a serial killer. What seems like an ideal job opportunity will soon become a race against the clock to prevent dramatic events to unfold.
The last week of the semester might very well be your last week. Will you manage to make the right decisions and solve the case ?
Beware, innocence might be nothing but a mere illusion.

Pawn is a hybrid kinetic novel / adventure indie game with investigation elements such as suspects interrogations and point and click crime scenes investigation.
Structured as a 7 chapters story, its intensity will take you from a dreamy clichéesque high school to a horrific killing ground, chasing down one of the most sadistic and smart serial killer to ever live.
For the sake of honesty, Pawn is a short visual novel (from 3 to 6 hours) which builds its suspense slowly but surely : The more the story progresses, the more pressure and care for its characters unravels to leave you gasping for air once the credits roll.
Warning : Pawn is a game with nudity, violence, gore and strong language.

Key Features

  • Original story divided into 7 chapters.
  • 1 good ending, 4 bad endings.
  • Investigation minigames.
  • 3 to 6 hours to beat.
  • 150+ high-quality backgrounds.
  • 30+ music tracks.
  • English and French language.
  • Supports Steam Achievements and Steam Trading Cards.

data.name: Legion Gold
data.detailed_description:
Legion Gold is a high-level strategy game that incorporates strategic and tactical elements in a unique Roman Empire adventure.

Control vast armies and attempt to carve out an Empire at the strategic level. At the tactical level, position your armies and make use of the best formations to achieve victory. Each map can be replayed a number of times in different settings, with different nations, giving you hours of gameplay.

In Legion Gold, players can command massive armies that march across the ancient world and build mighty cities that will last through the ages while also standing amid the blood and mud on the battlefield and commanding the tactical action of every battle! Well-received by gamers and critics alike, Legion Gold is the expanded and improved version of its predecessor, Legion, and includes not only the original game but a hefty expansion pack too.

The expansion brings gamers even more hours of gameplay on top of the already addicting Legion system. Improvements in Legion Gold over Legion include vastly improved diplomatic, economic, and management elements, improved strategic and tactical elements in the battle system, 3 new campaigns, new races, units, structures, and more.

Play against many unique tribes, nations and AI opponents from the Roman Empire era Detailed economy - control your cities, allocate workers, construct new buildings, build fortresses for protection and train new regiments.

data.name: VoxelCraft
data.detailed_description:
VoxelCraft is an open-world voxel sandbox game about building, mining, and surviving in a fully destructible, procedurally generated world.

Every block can be broken, placed, and rearranged. Dig deep beneath the surface to find ore and rare resources, or build upward into sprawling structures limited only by your imagination. Each world is generated fresh, with biomes, caves, and terrain that are different every time you play.

KEY FEATURES

Procedurally generated voxel worlds - no two worlds are the same

Full block-by-block building and terraforming

Mining and crafting progression from basic tools to advanced gear

Day/night cycle with survival mechanics and hostile creatures

Creative and Survival modes

Multiplayer support for building and exploring together

VoxelCraft is built for players who want a sandbox that rewards curiosity - dig somewhere new, build something ambitious, or just wander and see what the world generates next.

data.name: Industries of Titan
data.detailed_description:
PRESS QUOTES

"One of the most original and daring takes on city-building I’ve ever seen"
-Kotaku

"Terribly evil and exploitative fun"
-PCGamer

"It looks absolutely incredible"
-Rock Paper Shotgun


About the Game

Industries of Titan is an industrial city building sim/strategy game set on Saturn's moon, Titan. Create a sprawling industrial city and compete with other rival corporations to stake your claim to the industries of Titan!

As the Founder of a new city-corporation, and backed by the unforgiving and mysterious Council, you've been granted new headquarters in Titan's inhospitable atmosphere. There, you'll need to explore the ruins of a forgotten civilization while bearing the onslaught of ruthless rebels and competition from your corporate rivals. The Council expects much from you. Do you have what it takes to truly thrive?

BUILD AND MANAGE YOUR CITY

On Titan, precious construction materials and technological artifacts are locked away in ancient, massive ruins. Use these materials and artifacts to construct roads and transportation, build residences for citizens, power your city, and generate profit.

  • Design your city, and expand from just a few devices to a massive metropolis!

  • Survey and salvage the ruins of a lost civilization for ancient artifacts

  • Balance the needs of the Council, your city, your citizens, and your employees to produce a powerful, efficient economy

  • Dive inside your factories and kickstart your economy by building devices to refine resources

EXPAND ACROSS TITAN’S SURFACE

Grow your corporate empire on Titan one sector at a time via Campaign Mode. Sectors vary in terms of their environment, degree of rebel activity, Rivals you may encounter, and victory conditions, giving you a new scenario to tackle each time.

  • Conquer key locations across the surface of Titan as you seek to monopolize the entire moon

  • Face unique challenges with each new city you found, but gain powerful favors and starting bonuses from the Council as you progress

  • Plot your path to victory while sabotaging your rivals’ attempts to do the same

STRIKE DOWN YOUR ENEMIES

Your city’s success will undoubtedly draw the attention and ire of those around you. You will have to compete with rival corporations and fight off rebels to defend your corporate assets and become the dominant corporation on Titan.

  • Overcome your enemies via tactical battleship combat, technological superiority, political influence, or the wealth extracted from your citizens

  • Design the interiors of your battleships by strategically placing weapons, shields, engines, and more, reducing weak points and maximizing fighting capability

  • Explore the map to discover and exterminate hidden rebel encampments

GAME FEATURES

  • Get to know your advisors with fully voiced lines and dialogue

  • Capture Titan's natural beauty with an in-game photo mode

  • Gameplay is "real-time with pause" -- play at your preferred pace!

  • Created by the team that brought you Crypt of the NecroDancer, with art by Sir Carma and Nick Gunn, music by Danny Baranowsky, and audio by Power Up Audio

data.name: HOLD THE LINE
data.detailed_description:
After the catastrophe that destroyed the familiar world, humanity ceased to exist as a system of nations.
Capitals fell, borders vanished, megacities went dark.
Only scattered pockets of survivors remain — defense nodes bound together by the need to hold on.

In a world where resources are running out and communication lines fail one by one, people no longer judge each other by the past.
The only thing that matters is the ability to hold the line and keep the darkness from pushing through.

The Ashen

The Ashen are a product of the catastrophe.
They are not an army, and not a rational enemy.
They advance in waves, without fear or doubt, destroying everything that still works, glows, or shows any sign of life.

Every node, every fortress, every defensive line becomes a target.
If one line falls, the next one comes under attack.

Your role

You are responsible for defending a node.
You have fortifications, turrets, traps, and limited resources at your disposal.

To survive, you’ll need to analyze enemy routes, reinforce weak points, combine defensive systems, and adapt to constantly shifting pressure.

There are no universal solutions here.
Every wave is a new threat.
Every mistake is a step toward a breach.

Gameplay

Battles in HOLD THE LINE are built around endurance and calculation.
It’s not enough to deal damage — you have to hold your position.

Use different turret types, mines, napalm, and artillery. Combine defensive mechanics, manage resources, and make decisions under constant pressure.

Enemies differ in behavior, speed, and resilience, demanding a flexible approach and smart planning.

World and atmosphere

HOLD THE LINE is a harsh post-apocalyptic Eastern Europe, filled with concrete fortifications, abandoned infrastructure, and the traces of desperate last stands.

Cold colors, industrial locations, and a tense atmosphere reinforce the feeling of constant threat and the fragility of survival.

Key features

  • Tactical Tower Defense

  • Constant pressure from enemy waves, with no “breather” downtime

  • Diverse enemy types with distinct behaviors

  • Upgrade system and synergy-based combinations of defensive tools

  • Atmospheric post-apocalyptic setting

data.name: Populous™
data.detailed_description:
Move mountains, part the seas, and lead mortal armies to victory in Populous. Take on the powers of a mighty deity and battle for supremacy against an enemy god, using thoughtful strategy to shape the isometric world and the fate of its people. From the minds that brought you Black & White and Fable comes the game that defines “divine intervention.”

Key features:

  • Transform the world with your godly might. Use divine magic to create a perfect homeland for your followers, control storms, or plant a volcano right in your rival’s backyard.
  • Test your strategic skills. Winning this war takes more than numbers — you’ll have to know how to use them. Think quickly to give your armies an advantage, outsmart your rival, and become the most powerful god in all the land.
  • Experience the game that defined a genre. Black & White, Spore, Viva Piñata — Populous’ influence reaches far and wide. Play this isometric classic, and discover a game that made history.

data.name: ISEKI
data.detailed_description:
Awakened from an ancient slumber, you now venture into the depths of a 3D dungeon to unravel the mysteries of ancient ruins!

Combat unfolds automatically!
Battles are conducted based on pre-equipped action patterns (Memory Threads).
Countless Memory Threads lie dormant within the ruins, and constructing the optimal strategy is essential.
Even the same Memory Threads have diverse additional abilities, stimulating your desire to dig and collect.

Fuel is essential for exploring the ruins.
If you run out of fuel, you will be forcibly returned to the command room. Therefore, increase your fuel tank's maximum capacity, collect Memory Threads, faithfully execute given commands, and uncover the secrets of the ancient ruins!

data.name: Neon Noodles
data.detailed_description:
In a dark and dangerous cyberpunk future, food is the ultimate symbol of wealth and status. Using a revolutionary invention called Neon Noodles, the Aristocracy indulges their every culinary whim. Everyone else begs for scraps. With no memory and no name, you are just a cog in this machine. But when a mysterious message unlocks your forgotten past, it thrusts you into a daring, clandestine heist to seize control of Neon Noodles and reclaim your legacy.

Neon Noodles is inspired by the open-ended, machine-building puzzle games of Zachtronics such as Opus Magnum and Infinifactory. Take on challenging assignments from a cast of intriguing clients, design complex and beautiful automations to uncover the truth behind Neon Noodles.

Do you have what it takes to pry humanity's future from the clutches of corporate greed?

Features

  • Create automations as intricate or as simple as you like, using everything from programmable robot chefs to teleport stations.
  • Program your robot chefs through an intuitive record-and-replay system where you control a robot and have it replicate your exact inputs, and only edit later if needed.
  • Solve endlessly replayable open-ended puzzles with 250 recipes from around the world consisting of 400 unique ingredients. Jollof Rice, Clam Chowder, Spätzle, Bibimbap - so many recipes to optimize!
  • Immerse yourself in a cyberpunk story where food is a luxury and ruthless corporate greed runs unchecked.
  • Compare your scores with friends and see global leaderboards score distributions as a histogram.

Roadmap


About the Game

Mystic Warfare is an auto-battle game where players must build and develop their army of minions to become stronger while adjusting their tactics to conquer enemies across various battlefields. Discover a variety of elemental minions with unique abilities, upgrade them, and craft items to gain an advantage. Every decision and strategy is key to victory!

Find your powerful minions in various elements.

Merge two items, whether of the same type or different kinds, to create a more powerful new item. This crafting system allows you to gain a significant advantage on the battlefield while customizing equipment to perfectly fit your strategy.

Collect "Stars," a key resource in the game. Deposit them while traveling, and once you reach camp, you can withdraw twice the amount, giving you more resources to enhance your gameplay.

Develop a combat strategy that suits your playstyle, from selecting the right minions and positioning them on the battlefield to anticipating enemy movements. A well-thought-out plan is key to securing victory in every battle.

data.name: SoundTown
data.detailed_description:
An accessible one-button music game for children with complex needs.

Born out of my PhD research at the Glasgow School of Art, SoundTown is a game designed for - and with - children and young people with complex physical and cognitive needs.

The initial brief for SoundTown was developed through consultations with several appropriate organisations, including schools and charities with knowledge of accessible play. Built in the Unity game engine and powered by the Wwise audio engine, SoundTown consists of six minigames that are accessed directly through the Main Menu.

Players interact with SoundTown using a maximum of two buttons or switches. One button navigates the menus, whilst the other is used to select a minigame or play. Thus, SoundTown is explicitly accessible to players only capable of interaction with a single input device such as a switch, foot pedal, or the Xbox Adaptive Controller.

SoundTown is completely free to play and always will be. A huge thank you to:
- Menphys
- Birkett House School
- Kinnaird Primary School
- Hazelwood School

Created by Alexander Horowitz, with artwork by Carol Studzinski, and voiceover by Susannah Horowitz.

data.name: 1bitHeart
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to 1bitHeart―the latest title from Alicemare and LiEat developer △○□× (Miwashiba). In this unique and endearing adventure game, take on the role of Nanashi, a lonely, agoraphobic boy, as you solve a slew of mysteries around town while also making friends.


This is the story of a world in which pretty much everything is controlled and watched over by computer programs.
One day, Nanashi―a young boy who has been cooped up in his room―meets a mysterious girl.
“Let’s make some friends.”
“OK!”
Nanashi accepts the young girl’s sudden invitation without giving it much thought.
At that very moment, some very strange things begin to occur in town...


Detective Part (Story Mode)
Gather information and topics by exploring the town and speaking with people to progress through the story.

Conversation Part (Story Mode)
Use the topics and info you’ve gathered to piece together conversations while progressing through the story. (The game ends when your HP reaches 0.)

Free Mode (After clearing Story Mode)
Talk and mingle with the residents of the town, make friends, and play mini games in Free Mode.

*This title was originally a free game, but the Steam version includes specially added events, etc.


This was the 3rd game I made, where I first experimented with a side-scrolling system, voice over and detective elements.
I probably spent the most time working on these 3 things, including revisions.

When designing the town, I had foreign cartoons in mind and was aiming more towards a foreign audience than a Japanese one.
However, the game is set in Japan of the near future and the character design is aimed more towards the Japanese aesthetic.
I took advantage of the fact the game is set in Japan to make some cultural references here and there.

"An adventure game where you make friends". Not a typical tag-line, but if there is any aspect that takes your fancy I hope you will play my game!

Cruise upriver in this heartfelt adventure, connecting to the plants and creatures around you whilst learning to shred on your longboard.

Find your flow

Learn and experiment different ways to surf the various waves found in the river. 

Relax and explore

Discover the mysteries and magic of the river through the medium of surf.

Restore a connection

Interact with life in the river and maybe uncover a deeper connection to yourself in the process.

Prologue

After opening a gift from her grandmother and seeing the glimmer of hope and wild-recklessness in her grandmother's eyes she knew she was about to get in over her head. Inside the huge box there were 3 things, a map, a necklace and a 9ft surfboard...

data.name: 9th Sentinel Sisters
data.detailed_description:
＜Story＞

A long time ago, an unknown meteorite came to earth. The meteorite was sleeping quietly deep in the earth, waiting for the time to wake up.

10,000 years have passed, and when humans have built civilization, a change occurs in the meteorite.

Countless alien "breeds" are born from the meteorite and quickly devour the planet.

The true identity of the meteorite was the egg of an alien life form.

The land above is destroyed, and national functions disappear. Humanity is defeated.

Those left behind are forced to live in sturdy underground shelters.

The shelter was named "Ark" and became humanity's last stronghold.

In order to take back the land, humanity has gathered its wisdom and materials and developed two "anti-bleed" combat weapons.

One is the manned weapon “Father”

One is a combat clone soldier with the appearance of a girl who becomes Father's pilot.

They live in a deserted front-line base and then go off to fight.

＜Experience＞

9th Sentinel Sisters is a casual action game with roguelite elements. You can easily and easily enjoy the exhilarating feeling of wiping out aliens in a desolate near-future atmosphere.

・Create your own build with 16 types of weapons and 37 types of reinforcement parts!

You can experience the exhilarating feeling of defeating a large number of approaching aliens with powerful weapons such as lasers, drills, and missiles.

・Decide the strategy route

Whether you want to take on strong enemies, strengthen your weapons, or recover damage, assess the situation and aim to clear the game!

・The mission for each stage is simple

You can concentrate and enjoy it in a short period of time.

・Choose a hero and enjoy various strategies.

＜Game Features＞

  • Roguelite casual action

  • Side view Twin stick

  • A post-apocalyptic world destroyed by aliens and a fighting girl

  • 16 types of weapons

  • 37 types of reinforced parts

  • 6 heroes

  • Full controller

data.name: Starpoint Gemini Warlords
data.detailed_description:
Starpoint Gemini Warlords is a space sim coupled with role-playing and strategy elements. Send your mighty war fleets into combat or lead them yourself. The choice is yours. Be the Warlord!


Control your ship directly to show off your battle prowess. Aim and fire manually or command your gunners to do the job for you while you execute unique skills. Choose your companions to follow you into battle and if you need an extra hand, have your fleets join you in glorious combat. Battles in Warlords can vary from duels and small skirmishes to clashes of massive fleets in planetary orbits.


Construct ships and assemble your mighty war fleets to pitch them against the other war-mongering factions of Gemini, but be mindful of the situation you're sending them into. A seemingly weaker fleet can be accompanied by warmasters, well-trained specialists that can sway the battle in their favor, but fear not, you can have your fleet follow you so you can lead them to victory!


Upgrade your headquarters with additional modules to produce more advanced weapons and enhancements, develop new ships leading up to the station-size Proxima, unlock new structures and activate various bonuses that influence all of your territory. You are the leader of your people and a powerful leader deserves a stronghold.


Spread your influence and increase your resources by expanding your territory, but don't stretch your defenses too thin or your enemies might take advantage. Territory can be fortified and improved by building various resource and defense structures. Expand the T-Gate network to make your fleets travel across your ever-growing empire faster. A timely arrival can make all the difference.


Begin your adventure on a small, agile gunship and work your way up to a massive carrier class capable of deploying numerous fighter wings. Upgrade your chosen vessel of destruction with a plethora of weapons and enhancements. And to finish it all off, throw a coat of paint on it to get that perfect vessel you always wanted.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Massive game world, populated by over 60 diverse factions, ready to face your war fleets.
  • Campaign mode – Play through the story of the “exiles”, who settled on the barren planet of Phaeneros on the outskirts of Gemini, after escaping the alien invasion of the Sol system.
  • Five free roam scenarios with distinct start setup.
  • Choose among nearly 90 different ships, from gunships and corvettes to bulky carriers.
  • Build your own personal headquarters to boost your economic and military power.

data.about_the_game:
Starpoint Gemini Warlords is a space sim coupled with role-playing and strategy elements. Send your mighty war fleets into combat or lead them yourself. The choice is yours. Be the Warlord!


Control your ship directly to show off your battle prowess. Aim and fire manually or command your gunners to do the job for you while you execute unique skills. Choose your companions to follow you into battle and if you need an extra hand, have your fleets join you in glorious combat. Battles in Warlords can vary from duels and small skirmishes to clashes of massive fleets in planetary orbits.


Construct ships and assemble your mighty war fleets to pitch them against the other war-mongering factions of Gemini, but be mindful of the situation you're sending them into. A seemingly weaker fleet can be accompanied by warmasters, well-trained specialists that can sway the battle in their favor, but fear not, you can have your fleet follow you so you can lead them to victory!


Upgrade your headquarters with additional modules to produce more advanced weapons and enhancements, develop new ships leading up to the station-size Proxima, unlock new structures and activate various bonuses that influence all of your territory. You are the leader of your people and a powerful leader deserves a stronghold.


Spread your influence and increase your resources by expanding your territory, but don't stretch your defenses too thin or your enemies might take advantage. Territory can be fortified and improved by building various resource and defense structures. Expand the T-Gate network to make your fleets travel across your ever-growing empire faster. A timely arrival can make all the difference.


Begin your adventure on a small, agile gunship and work your way up to a massive carrier class capable of deploying numerous fighter wings. Upgrade your chosen vessel of destruction with a plethora of weapons and enhancements. And to finish it all off, throw a coat of paint on it to get that perfect vessel you always wanted.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Massive game world, populated by over 60 diverse factions, ready to face your war fleets.
  • Campaign mode – Play through the story of the “exiles”, who settled on the barren planet of Phaeneros on the outskirts of Gemini, after escaping the alien invasion of the Sol system.
  • Five free roam scenarios with distinct start setup.
  • Choose among nearly 90 different ships, from gunships and corvettes to bulky carriers.
  • Build your own personal headquarters to boost your economic and military power.
  • Procedurally generated freelance jobs offer a great way to earn Credits that you can use to pump upgrades into your ship.
  • Procedurally generated encounters can creep up on you when you least expect them.
  • Choose one of three unique character classes or whip up a hybrid class of your own.
  • Conduct research on a multitude of different tech that affects everything from your own ship to the global scheme of things.
  • Construct ships, assemble war fleets and send them in all directions to conquer for the glory of the Solari Concord.
  • Build and upgrade infrastructure across the star system to improve resource gathering and strengthen your dominion.
  • Engage in diplomatic relations and sign trade deals to get that boost you need.
  • Mod support that greatly surpasses that of its predecessor, Starpoint Gemini 2.

Short game, about 40 minutes.

data.name: Friends World
data.detailed_description:
Friends World is a single and multiplayer strategy defense game made for VR.
Friends World is a game created using Kakao Friends' IP. You can experience everything in virtual reality, including various characters, game battles, and various stages and backgrounds.

Save the 'FRIENDS' who are stained with evil! Rescue the hero stained with evil, rescue the hero, and use that hero to attack all stages!

1. Deck Setting
- Users can create a deck by selecting 'FRIENDS' characters. You can challenge single and multiplayer using your own deck.


2. Single game
- 20 different stages are available. There are 4 bosses in 20 stages, and we plan to continuously add stages through future updates.
- You can play a mini-game by throwing gifts and coins before selecting a stage. Gifts can acquire items with a low probability, and coins can acquire CON.



3. Multi game
- You can play invite friends, random 1:1, and Battlefield (1:1:1:1 to be updated later). You can compete in rankings with points earned through the game.

4. Ranking
- The ranking is selected using the multi-ranking ranking and the time attack when each boss is cleared. Raise your ranking by clearing many multiplayer and strategic bosses.

5. Shop
- You can draw FRIENDS set skins, individual skins, and skins, and you can purchase items necessary for in-game.
- Skins will be added through updates.

data.name: DROSS
data.detailed_description:
You wake up, crashed onto a barren planet. Around you there is nothing but hostile wasteland, battered by wicked wind and storm. There is a lone outpost barely visible nearby. Crawling slowly, with oxygen low, you finally reach the open entrance. Within the doorway a ramp seems to lead down into an underground facility. You decide you must enter this facility and hope to find a way to escape this wretched place but you aren't alone...The Dross are here with you.

Sneak around your enemies to minimize contact with stealth and subterfuge utilizing traps or door access or fight head on and aggressively utilizing heavy weapons and explosives to purge the infestation at its root. The Dross respond to your tactics and react accordingly.

Pistols, rifles, shotguns, heavy weapons, and explosives complement your arsenal against the Dross. Upgrade your suit, weapons, and tools to help you fight the way you want.

No two runs are the same, every delve into the installation uncovers new paths and secrets for you to discover as you make your way to the core.

Uncover the secret of the facility, discover why you ended up on this planet and how the Dross have come to infest it. Only by reaching the reactor at the core of the complex can you reveal the dark secrets hidden within and assist your trusty companion Vanth

data.name: Zone of Death
data.detailed_description:
Zone of Death is a game with different modes and character classes, for single player and online gaming.

Zombie Mode:
Basic mechanics:
- Infinite number of waves. With each wave the zombies get bigger and stronger.
- Variety of weapons
- For every zombie you kill, you receive points, as well as points for hitting the body, which you can spend on buying new weapons and ammo.
- Cooperative multiplayer for up to 4 people (the more people, the more difficulty increases)

Shooter Mode:
At the moment, the game has 4 modes:
- Conquering the point
- Capture the flag
- Team deathmatch
- Solo deathmatch.

So there are 4 unique classes:
- Assault: using the ability increases movement speed
- Assistant: when using an ability, puts a mine before itself
- Medic: when using the ability, causes a drone that treats all allies around it.
- Sniper: when using the ability Can take off for a short distance from the ground and climb on buildings

In the near future will be added several maps and new game modes such as repel the wave of zombies in both solo and cooperative, survival in the open world. This is not all that will be added, but about this later.

data.name: SIONIC LOVE
data.detailed_description:
SIONIC LOVE is a visual novel game in which you search for goals and love by moving between the viewpoints of two main characters in the world of cyberpunk. Explore the world, talk to different characters, and reach different endings.

Plot

"Love City" where various people live together.

Rico, who lives with his family on the outskirts there, meets Aaron, the man who collapsed behind the house.

Getting to know each other and building a bond, the two come to a big tipping point in their relationship...

Character

Aron

A cold-tempered man lying in the back of Rico's house. He saves his life with Rico's help and opens up to Rico, but he seems to have something to hide about his goals.

Rico

A bright, warm-hearted man who lives with his family in a small neighborhood. There seems to be something he didn't tell Aron about his disabled legs.

※As the story progresses, the loveliness of the above two characters intensifies, and the player's choice determines the ending of the two.

Game Features

JRPG Type Field Map & Point & Click Navigation Both-Sided Play

Go around the map for clues, or visit various places.

Or, you can explore a place by looking closely at it.

5 Multi-Endings

The ending direction varies depending on the in-game junction and selection.

Conversation that varies from place to place

Follow the emotional lines of the two main characters through the conversation and learn about the character.

Variety of mini-games

Make money through mini-games and buy various items.

About 80 cut scenes

Meet a variety of cut scenes that will enrich your journey.

data.name: Prop Hunt 2.0
data.detailed_description:
Prop Hunt 2.0 is a game where you have to become an prop or a hunter.

An exciting game for a company of friends and new acquaintances.

Hunter

  • At the beginning of the round, hunters cannot move for a certain amount of time.

  • Use all methods of deduction to reveal your goal.

  • Find the player who is disguised as an prop.

  • Each mistake will cost dearly. Choose wisely!

Prop

  • Players can turn into almost any object on the map.

  • Depending on the size, objects take over the health and speed of the object of transformation: large objects are more difficult to destroy than, say, breaking a small bottle, but escaping in this form will be somewhat difficult.

  • Run, hide, disguise yourself. Do everything so that the hunter does not find you.

  • The cost of your mistake is life.

We hope that our new game will cause a lot of positive emotions for you and your company!

data.name: Burial
data.detailed_description:
Do you believe in the supernatural?

The main character of the game, videographer Vasily Panin, also didn’t believe it until he found himself in an old Soviet apartment in the middle of the night. He received the task of filming the wake, which would last until the morning. People will come and say goodbye to the deceased and all this needs to be captured on film. However, when Vasily gets into the apartment, he realizes that there is no way out of it anymore, and no one will come to the wake.

In the middle of the room there is a closed coffin and now Vasily needs to unravel all the secrets of the damned apartment and its owner in order to get out alive and not go crazy from wild horror...

What do the walls of this Soviet apartment hide within themselves, what horrors happened here and how is this connected with its owner? Do you have the courage to find the answers to these questions?

GAME FEATURES:

  • Scary atmosphere

  • Realistic sounds that immerse you in history

  • Realistic graphics

  • Found film effect

  • You need to look for objects and follow the plot

  • Great soundtrack that enhances the horror atmosphere

  • Completion time: about 60 minutes.

data.name: Wrapix Doner
data.detailed_description:
One Ordinary Night Shift, but very wrong place.

You came to Germany looking for making more money, but you don't have any options, only Wrapix Doner accepts an illegal night shift. Your job seems simple: take orders, prepare food, clean the shop, and make it through the night.

Every night, the road to your dreams turns to nightmare. Through the your dream life, you will serve weird customers and investigate strange events. All your shifts will starts with a familiar routine: Take orders → Prepare food → Serve → Get paid → Clean → Close. Sometimes routines can be strange, suspicious and dangerous.

Every Customer Has Their Own Secret

You will build relationship with people from neighbourhood, and other people who pass through Wrapix Doner. Conversations can reveal clues, relationships, and hidden dangers.

Officers and polices are looking for answers. Whatever you do, don't ask too many questions. Keep yourself low profile, try to understand what are people are talking about unexplained events around the Wrapix Doner.

Customer will be strange but the most frightening thing isn't always what's strange to you.

Many Questions, Two Person

You aren't explored what happened before you begin the work at Wrapix Doner. The police and customers are ambiguous about what happened to the previous guy. Was he really work at Wrapix?

Gameplay Abstract:
It's a First Person paranormal Restaurant Simulation
A psycho-horror with interactive dialogues
Use tools around the shop to protect and investigate things that don't make sense
Each night shifts introduces new menu items, characters, information, and danger.
Story Mystery with evidence-accumulation style composirion, but made entirely from in-game objects.
Single-player with story elements.

data.name: Wings Of Rage
data.detailed_description:
Scramble!  

Fly your biplane behind enemy lines, free the prisoners of war, and bring them home! 

World War I has spread to the Pacific Islands, and these scattered pieces of land stretching all the way to Antarctica hold precious prisoners.  

For each island, you'll need to locate defenses and objectives, decide on a strategy, and spring into action. Shoot down as many enemy planes, tanks, and ships as possible, and collect rewards to upgrade your plane. Watch out for your arch-nemesis, Baron Alfred Von Kartoffeln, flying his red Fokker! 

Wings of Rage is an action game in the tradition of the early 90s, the first 3D arcade games.

data.name: Pit Fighter Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
Pit Fighter Tycoon is a creature-collector RPG with Auto-Battler combat. You will play as an Alien that abducts humans to build the ultimate gladiator team! Surgically enhance your humans and then send them to die in the arena for profits!

SURGICALLY ENHANCED

Unrefined humans are weak and squishy - so you will need to use your advanced alien technology to stuff them full of powerful new organs! Choose your best humans and turn them into monstrosities with additional hearts and lungs - or just rip an arm off and replace it with a better one.

A SPECTACLE OF VIOLENCE

You will need to build a team of deadly, surgically enhanced humans; carefully balancing their strengths and weaknesses. You will train them in combat or uncover their latent psychic powers.

GREED IS GOOD

The only thing that matters is profit - you're an entrepreneur after all! The money made from your humans can be re-invested in your spaceship, unlocking cruel new technologies to further enhance your humans. When your humans are of no further use to you, you can grind them down into goo for a tidy profit.

GET RICH FROM HUMAN MISERY

Prepare to get rich with features, such as:
  • Deep RPG gameplay with a range of humans to abduct to create the ultimate team.
  • Rivals to crush in the arena - who you can mock and shame afterwards. Or be nice to them, I guess.
  • Leveling, equipment, organs, skill trees - make your humans powerful!
  • Character customization - add your friends into the game and watch them die!
  • Base building, upgrades, characters to talk to and quests to complete!

data.name: Nirvana: The First Travel
data.detailed_description:
Nirvana was a company specialized in gravity research. At first, all they had was a spinning room, and the desire to, one day, be able to manipulate space-time, and therefore, gravity itself. Then came the day: they finally made it! All the equations were right, and that led the Nirvana Facility to prosperous times... for around two hours. Gravity could do so much more than deform space time, so much more... and they found it in a "not so good" way. They ended up colliding their dimension with someone else's, opening a very unexpected gateway. What, or who, did they find in the other side?

The puzzles on this game usually present you with a situation, with no obvious way out. You must use all the resources at you disposal to proceed, and keep moving foward. You play as Tom Walker, a security guard that wakes up in an empty room inside the Nirvana Facility soon after an emergency evacuation. Right at the beginning, you meet the familiar voice of Doctor Lestrade, the man to instruct you through the various puzzles the facility presents. The puzzles involve interesting gravity shifts, and a gun that can move heavy objects, create anti-gravitational spheres and teleport Walker around.

data.name: Discussion Over Dinner
data.detailed_description:
Discussion Over Dinner is a simple, snappily paced experience which forces you to quickly formulate coherent responses to your new neighbor's almost interrogatory questions in real time.

As you keep the conversation flowing, study your host's body language for any sign of irritation while remembering to keep your own physical mannerisms in check.

Depending on your social skills you may be able to leave the table good friends!

Or you might become another secret he'll have to hide from a future dinner guest.

Discussion Over Dinner is designed specifically to be played on computer with a keyboard and requires every key to be working properly in order to play.

Please only play the game if it's running at a smooth framerate to avoid any potential softlocks or sequence breaks!

data.name: VRZ: Torment
data.detailed_description:
Note to VR Arcade partner.
If you experience difficulties with the parameters.

Please subscribe to VRZ arcade beta, for that:
Open Steam.
Click on "Games" from the "Libary" menu tab.
Put your mouse cursor on "VRZ: Torment", right click and choose "Properties".
Select "Betas" tab.
Write in the following password: password54321
Klick on "Check Code".
From top down menu choose "vrarcade - VR Arcade".
Select "Close". Arcade modifier should now start downloading and modifying the game.
You now have to wait until downloading and installing have completed.
This will revert you back to old version and everything should work as before.



WELCOME TO PURGATORY ISLAND...
A prison for the undead and dying. A hell from which you will never escape.

If you’re reading this, you’ve likely found that the nuances of life are slowly leaving you. One breath at a time. One paused heartbeat within your chest.

The Far Watchers own this diseased island and have infected you with their Animus, a machine that holds you together, and one that aims to kill the death inside you! They’ve created this hell to test you, their weapons, and all their other damnable creations. Their cameras both seen and unseen track your every movement throughout this swamped and accursed place, and their flitting shadows move just beyond the edge of observation. They have given you a second life, and it is for you to find out how and why.

Features:

  • Solve mysteries while trying to survive!
  • The game supports Virtuix Omni, Cyberith, Hardlight WIP and Oculus Touch.
  • Story written by Mark Rein-Hagen (Vampire: The Masquerade, I AM ZOMBIE).
  • Huge arsenal of firearms and melee weapons! Bows and arrows, axes, bats, pistols, rifles, shotguns, grenades and much more.
  • Fight against hordes of different type of zombies.
  • Multiple options to complete the game.
  • Includes bonus mini-games which you can show to your friends: Shooting range, duck hunting, arcade.

data.name: Project Hardline
data.detailed_description:
Project Hardline is a first person shooter game where two teams of mercenaries fight to be the last ones left or to capture an uplink station. This uplink station contains vital intel and must not fall into the wrong hands. Every time a team loses a round, they come back better equipped with better weapons, gear and equipment. This game is perfect for a party of casual shooter players, with tight physics based gun mechanics and fast paced round.


NOTE: This game is developed nearly entirely by one person, content updates may be slow and sporadic and bugs may still exist due to the limited resources available to testing the game. Bug reports are highly appreciated and any considerable bugs and errors will be patched immediately.

data.name: The Clues
data.detailed_description:
The Clues is a challenging logic deduction game set in a charming town of animals.

Step into the paws of a cat detective and investigate mysterious cases across Paw Town. Read the clues, connect the information, and determine who is Criminal and who is Innocent to recover the town’s missing items.

Pure Logic. No Guessing.

Every conclusion can be logically proven from the clues available to you.

Compare clues, eliminate possibilities, and follow the chain of deductions until only one answer remains.

No guessing. No luck. Just logic.

Handcrafted & Uniquely Solvable

Every puzzle and every clue is handcrafted by the developer.

A dedicated validation system ensures that each puzzle is logically consistent and has a unique solution. The system only verifies the puzzles — it never generates them.

How Far Can You Go?

The puzzles start simple, but they won’t stay that way.

Each chapter brings tougher clues and deeper deductions, putting your logic skills to the test.

How far can you make it?
