data.name: Legion and Tavern
data.detailed_description:
A map on the table. Six squads ready to march. A company counting on you.

Legion & Tavern is a single-player tactical auto-battler about building a company and leading it through a three-act expedition. Choose your commander, plan your formation, and watch your squads fight automatically—with tactical pause giving you time to intervene when the battle turns.

Begin with six squads and grow toward an army of up to 32 active squads, supported by reserves. Recruit new troops, train individual squads, and choose between two promotion paths. Combine distinct unit types to activate faction bonuses, then strengthen your strategy with relics.

Your decisions continue on the battlefield. Position your company before combat, inspect enemy threats, and spend limited command points to shield allies, focus attacks, or reposition squads. Pause to consider your next order, then resume and see your plan unfold.

Between battles, choose your route and decide where to spend your gold. Visit merchants for recruits, training, and relics, or recover Resolve at camp. Stronger enemies offer richer rewards, but each defeat brings your expedition closer to its end—and a boss stands at the close of every act.

  • Three commanders: Lead with Captain Aurelia, Marshal Nyra, or Warden Eira, each with distinct passive and command effects.

  • A growing company: Manage active squads and reserves as your army expands across the expedition.

  • Tactical boss encounters: Respond to armored escorts, summoning zones, and dangerous area attacks.

  • More ways to set out: Earn alternate starting companies, cosmetic badges, and optional challenges through boss victories.

  • Play at your pace: Enjoy offline play, tactical pause, adjustable battle speed, and saved expedition progress.

data.name: Bridge Constructor Portal
data.detailed_description:
Bridge Constructor Portal on Discord


About the Game

Enter the Aperture Science Enrichment Center and experience Bridge Constructor Portal – the unique merging of the classic Portal™ and Bridge Constructor™ games.

As a new employee in the Aperture Science test lab, it's your job to build bridges, ramps, slides, and other constructions in 60 test chambers and get the Bendies safely across the finish line in their vehicles.

Make use of the many Portal gadgets, like portals, propulsion gel, repulsion gel, aerial faith plates, cubes, and more to bypass the sentry turrets, acid pools and laser barriers, solve switch puzzles, and make it through the test chambers unscathed.

Let Ellen McLain, the original voice of GLaDOS, guide you through the tutorial, and learn all the tips and tricks that make a true Aperture Science employee.
The bridge is a lie!

Features:
  • The merging of two worlds: the first Bridge Constructor™ with an official Portal™ license
  • Create complex constructions in the Aperture Science labs
  • Let GLaDOS accompany you through tricky physics adventures
  • Use portals, aerial faith plates, propulsion gel, repulsion gel, and much more to master the complicated tasks
  • Evade dangers such as sentry turrets, emancipation grills, laser fields, and acid
  • Help your Bendies cross the finish line – on their own or in a convoy
  • The Level Editor lets you create your own sophisticated test chambers and share them with other test subjects all around the world

data.name: Don't Let Him Cook
data.detailed_description:
Only Uncle can cook. Don’t let him.

Once a year, the cooking show “The Golden Spoon” films its finale in the Lozhkin family kitchen, and every year the same man cooks it: Uncle. He promised to join his father at the judges’ table the night they turn down his plate. They never have.

Tonight, the family has decided to help him.

He cooks. You get in the way.

Uncle isn’t a villain: he sincerely believes he’s saving dinner, and he cooks it properly, from his father’s recipe card. He sears the duck, flips it and lets it rest, gives the risotto nothing but hot stock, and whisks the beurre blanc over low heat. You don’t need to cook anything. You need his plate to fail: swap his salt for sugar, turn up the heat under the sauce, carry off a pan, snatch food out of his hands, slip something extra into his saucepan. Drop a pinch into his pan right in front of him, and he’ll say, “Good. You salted it.” It was sugar.

He sees everything right in front of him, and he turns toward noise. Use that: one of you makes a racket in the corner or politely asks “Uncle, how?”, and while he explains, another works behind his back. Get caught in the act and the judges give you a strike. Three strikes and you’re out the door, on the stairs: knock to be let back in, and shout so he turns toward the door while the others finish the job.

Every discovery hurts his feelings a little more: “Dad!”, then he walks straight through you as if you weren’t there, then “QUIET.” — and then something worse than shouting. And he learns: let him find the same trick twice and he picks up a habit. “Right. I count the pans now.”

At the end of the round, three judges taste his plate: Father, the show’s founder and Uncle’s dad, who calls everyone “son”; Margot, a critic and the author of a book called “No”; and Timur, an influencer who is already putting all of this in his stories. If they accept the plate, the round is his. If they don’t, it’s yours.

What’s in the game

  • Co-op: two on one screen, each with their own controller or half the keyboard. Or up to three online through Steam, from your friends list or with a code.
  • Uncle is always played by the game, so nobody gets stuck being the chef, and you can play solo too.
  • Three dishes: duck breast with cherry sauce and celery remoulade, porcini risotto, and zander with beurre blanc and asparagus.
  • 105-second rounds, plus 15 seconds to rearrange the kitchen before he comes down.
  • Original music, with a theme for every dish: jazz manouche for the duck, a tarantella for the risotto, a polka for the zander.
  • Controller and Steam Deck support.
  • Father teaches the rules himself: the show’s Charter, one Article at a time, right in the kitchen. Once, before your first dinner.

data.name: Mascot Mayhem (Asymmetrical Horror)
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Mayhem!

The very first asymmetrical mascot horror game focusing on survivor AND killer teamwork!

The realm is breaking... survivors of the many colorful yet fearful mascots have banded together to defeat a higher evil force together: the Controller. To stop this, The Controller has sent the mascots from other realms to defeat and combat the survivors from getting closer to the truth.

This... is Mascot Mayhem.

What is Mascot Mayhem?

Mascot Mayhem is an asymmetrical mascot horror game featuring 2 killers and up to 8 other survivors! The goal of the game is to kill them all together as a team of killers, or survive until time's up as a survivor. Survivors must deliver crystals into the portal to reduce the timer- but beware... mascots lurk at every corner...

Mascot Mayhem has tons of features that seperate itself from the competition- so what are they?

  • FREE TO PLAY!

  • Emotes to dunk on the killers OR survivors!

  • Server Browsers with tons of gamemodes to choose from!

  • Sandbox mode to customise and host private sessions!

  • Killer and Survivor Skins!

  • Fast-paced action!

  • Teamwork!

  • Play with up to 9 other friends in a single lobby!

  • Earn Mascot Points just by playing the game- buy Killers and Survivors with them!

    Mascot Mayhem wouldn't be complete without allowing some familar faces into the Mascot Realm...

  • RadioWave

  • PlayTown

  • Happy Place

  • MUZY

  • The Black and White Doors

  • + More coming soon!

data.name: Touch the Color
data.detailed_description:
Take your reflexes and aim to the next level with Touch the Color, the arcade-style reaction and accuracy game that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down.



In Touch the Color, you’re given a matrix of colors but only one is your target. All you need to do is click on the correct color as fast as possible to ramp up your score. If its simplicity is reminding you of time-waster games, think again. Touch the Color is an arcade reaction time game that’ll work your mouse aim and take it to new heights. The faster and more accurately you click, the sharper your brain and skills become.

Fast-paced color switching means you’ll be challenged at every turn. And as the pace increases, so does your drive to keep improving your score. It’s a reflex challenge that’s both addictive and beneficial yet can also be as calm or as tryhard as you want it to be. Chill by focusing on improving your own score or take it to the online stage by climbing the leaderboard ranks.

Fast-paced Gameplay

Touch the Color’s gameplay only requires a single click of the mouse, making it easy to pick up. Focus on your speed and accuracy for optimal gains.


Customize Your Experience

Touch the Color features tons of unlockable themes, each with its own personality. Ramp up your score to earn stars to make the experience your own.


Ranking System - Challenge yourself further by ranking up.

Touch the Color features a worldwide ranking leaderboard where you can beat the scores of others including your friends.

Fast-paced color switching means you’ll be challenged at every turn. And as the pace increases, so does your drive to keep improving your score. It’s a reflex challenge that’s both addictive and beneficial yet can also be as calm or as tryhard as you want it to be. Chill by focusing on improving your own score or take it to the online stage by climbing the leaderboard ranks.

Fast-paced Gameplay

Touch the Color’s gameplay only requires a single click of the mouse, making it easy to pick up. Focus on your speed and accuracy for optimal gains.


Customize Your Experience

Touch the Color features tons of unlockable themes, each with its own personality. Ramp up your score to earn stars to make the experience your own.


Ranking System - Challenge yourself further by ranking up.

Touch the Color features a worldwide ranking leaderboard where you can beat the scores of others including your friends.
data.short_description: Take your reflexes and aim to the next level with Touch the Color, the arcade-style reaction and accuracy game that’s easy to pick up but hard to put down.

data.name: Dreamy Duels ~ Tales of Heroes in Gensoukyo
data.detailed_description:
"Dreamy Duels" is a card game inspired by the "Touhou Project" universe and various classic card games. In this game, you can also use the card editor to create unique custom cards, building a vibrant and diverse card game world with other players.

Game Content


In "Dreamy Duels", you can build your deck with over 100 characters from Gensokyo, then play with CPU or with other players in a game similar to most popular trading card games. During Early Access, you can build decks with 6 character classes without needing to collect anything:

Custom Cards


The card editor in "Dreamy Duels" is user-friendly and powerful, allowing for editing by simply clicking on elements of the card's appearance for a WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) experience.



The visual node system enables the arrangement and combination of all effects in the game, creating complex cards.

Online Battles


"Dreamy Duels" supports players battling in server lobbies. Here, you can not only use official cards but also your own creations to compete against other players. You'll also encounter unknown cards created by other players. Are you ready to explore this card universe built by everyone?

Future Plans


Unlike most card games, "Dreamy Duels" aims to create a player-centric game ecosystem. We will do our utmost to support player creativity and sharing.

In the future, we will continue to refine the game's editor, such as adding custom sound effects, special effects, and custom game rules. Similarly, we will also introduce corresponding official content based on this, such as a tactical battle mode and PVE mode.

To foster a healthy ecosystem for player-created content, we will launch a dedicated battle mode for custom cards——Homebrew Mode. In this mode, players can rate the custom cards they have battled against. The ratings received by the cards will determine their influence in the environment, allowing creators to better receive player feedback.

Moreover, we will consistently release the Android version of "Dreamy Duels" for free, hoping to allow more players to join our game through various platforms. In the future, we will also introduce some in-game purchase content, enabling players to buy game content in their preferred way of payment.

We look forward to your support to help the "Dreamy Duels" community flourish!

data.name: Kora: Neural Gridlock
data.detailed_description:
Kora: Neural Gridlock is a psychological horror game, set in a dark Cyberpunk/Brutalist world. The events unfold in an isolated research facility, plagued by weird anomalies, in which a menacing presence moves through the environment while leaving creepy marks of its passage.

In this dystopic future, you will have to survive and solve puzzles, while being hunted by a relentless creature. Planning every move with care while managing limited resources is the key to keeping yourself alive.

"The drone" is a necessary tool: it allows players to solve puzzles, to track The Intruder's movements and to explore otherwise unreachable areas.

As Minerva, you will have to decipher the mysterious story of Kora: Neural Gridlock, hidden between classified documents, flashbacks and the inhabitants of the facility.

KORA

Explore Kora, a creepy vertical labyrinth that hides secrets behind every corner.

Carefully plan every move, study the facility’s conformation, and take advantage of hiding spots to elude “The Intruder”.

Meet other survivors and collaborate to unveil the mystery hidden behind Kora and find a way out.

THE INTRUDER

“The Intruder” is a powerful entity that will hunt you during your stay in Kora.

It cannot be stopped in any way. Exploit distractions, hiding spots, and your intelligence to elude it and survive.

This threatening creature is capable of adapting to its surroundings, creating neural copies that confound Minerva. A photographic memory and the use of the drone are vital to discovering the deception.

THE DRONE

Leverage a powerful logistical tool: the recon drone. Use it to find your way in the dark thanks to its service flashlight, and to access exclusive abilities.

Study “The Intruder's” movements without exposing yourself by positioning the drone at strategic spots to plan your next move. However, be careful of the battery life: if depleted, it exposes Minerva to extremely dangerous situations.

Hack digital devices and unveil messages hidden inside the facility thanks to a special UV light, allowing Minerva to gather information to solve puzzles and intercept messages from other inhabitants.

Recover rare and otherwise unreachable objects thanks to remote pick-up.

data.name: SCP-087: Recovered document
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever think about the conspiracy theory?
SCP-087: Recovered document will open one of them.
The story based on the history of Dr. Kester. You have to explore the object, reveal its secrets and get to the truth, which SCP fund so carefully conceals from "ordinary mortals."
Are you ready to get an access to the secret fund's information?

Features:

  • Video cut-scenes with the real artists
  • Game Engine: Unreal Engine 4
  • Horror Athmosphere
  • Full retelling of object: SCP 087
  • Story Mode
  • Free Mode

Learn the truth

You'll know what the fund is keeping in secret from men of mould
Dr.Castor is one of the few who had courage to stand up to the system
Learn about the research works of SCP 087 straight from the horse's mouth

Don't be afraid

Fear is a feeling that all people experience, try to feel like a class D experimental
Fullfil all the directions of the fund inviolately, otherwise you may regret about your actions
Awareness and fear about the unknown are your main but not the only enemies

Document 4

Now you'll know what's hidden under "the top secret"
Everybody has an own motivation for studying SCP objects

There's a plot in Horror

The storyline based upon SCP 087 research works
Video extracts with lively actors

Our lives are full of exciting and terrifying moments. The objects we are studying are basically used for weapons development. We sacrifice thousands of lives in sake of studies. The purpose is welfare, as they say. But, in fact, we are executors who have forgotten what pity and mercy are.

data.name: Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise
data.detailed_description:
Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise is an open-world survival horror video game serving as both a sequel and prequel to the original Deadly Premonition: The Director’s Cut.



The story takes place in present-day Boston where it turns out FBI Special Agent Francis York Morgan will have to revisit a case he thought was solved in 2005. Through unique storytelling, venture back in time to the American town Le Carré, Louisiana and uncover the mysteries buried within this once peaceful town.



Follow Agents Davis and Jones as they begin a new investigation into the Le Carré serial murders. Through the memories of a former FBI agent, go back in time to Le Carré and step into the role of Special Agent York to begin unraveling the mystery.

• Return as FBI Special Agent Francis York Morgan (just call him York - everyone does) and experience a brand-new murder mystery!

• Both a prequel and a sequel: A historic investigation to uncover the murder mystery in Le Carré

• An open-world adventure: Travel around the town of Le Carré by foot or skateboard

• Mini-games: Bowling, Bayou Ride, Skateboard Challenge, and more

• Customisation: Customise your character and upgrade your skateboard for improved speed and landing more difficult tricks

content_descriptors.notes:
Deadly Premonition 2 is for the larger part an investigative adventure title - there are also action parts interspersed. There is what can be considered (unrealistic) violence against enemies, be it fantasy creatures or sometimes animals. There are horror elements in a fantasy setting and the main character (a detective) uses a gun as well as a fantasy weapon against enemies.

In the earliest stages of the game there is In the earliest minutes of the game you see:
A naked body of a woman, preserved in an ice block, not realistically or explicitly shown. Soon after, a man is shown sitting in a chair smoking marijuana in the first circa 10 minutes, described as being for medicinal use, and legal in Boston (the sequence of smoking is not controlled by the player).

There is a bar in the game, where alcohol is served, and the investigation (in the past) centers around a murder case - but the violence is rarely realistic. When violent acts are shown in the adventure sections, it's often in service of the story - and the violent acts are often more alluded to (shown with phantom figures or camera angles disguising the details).

data.name: Alchemy Tunes
data.detailed_description:
Deliver magical essences across a living desert in this online co-op survival adventure for up to four players.

Play as wandering desert mages, working together to supply nomads, keep the oasis alive, and push back against a growing invasive market threatening the oasis.

The desert gives little… but it echoes back.

Follow melodies carried by the dunes, survive sudden sandstorms, and use memory, alchemy, and teamwork to complete dangerous deliveries and return home safely.

WORK TOGETHER

Success depends on coordination. Assign roles and survive together… or get lost together.

SURVIVE THE DESERT

The desert is unpredictable and extreme.

  • Navigate without reliable maps or weather forecasts

  • Endure scorching heat and sudden sandstorms

  • Use melodies and echo patterns to find nomads and your way home

KEEP THE OASIS ALIVE

Complete deliveries, support nomad communities, and resist the spread of the invasive market.

Every run helps keep the oasis alive.

FEATURES

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-op + Single Player

  • Delivery-based survival gameplay

  • Memory and melody-driven navigation

  • Proximity voice chat with goofy voice alteration

  • Alchemy crafting

  • Ghosts if you are unlucky enough

  • Melodies. Lots of melodies.

data.name: STORY OF SEASONS: A Wonderful Life
data.detailed_description:
Put down roots on your new farm in the peaceful town of Forgotten Valley. Forge precious memories as you weave your own generation-spanning tale of friendship, family, and farming. Bring life to the land by cultivating crops and raising animals, find love among the town's friendly folk, and make lasting memories with a family of your very own in this reimagining of a beloved farming classic.



Establish your homestead
Live a carefree life on the farm growing an abundance of crops and nurturing the land to improve your yield. Raise cute animals that reward your affection with handy produce that is perfect for recipes, as gifts or sold for a profit at your very own market stall. Discover new animals, create hybrid crops and build upgradeable facilities to help you on your way to a dream life in Forgotten Valley.

Befriend the residents of Forgotten Valley
Find new friends among the charming cast of characters in the tranquil town of Forgotten Valley, and get to know them through all-new events! In this close-knit community, there’s an abundance of memorable personalities, from the mischievous Nature Sprites to the nutty scientist Daryl, that make Forgotten Valley… unforgettable!



Tell your story your way
Play as male, female, or non-binary, and customise your look as you start your new story in Forgotten Valley. Regardless of how you choose to play, all of the eight eligible bachelors and bachelorettes have romantic potential, so you can truly be who you want to be and fall in love with your heart’s desire.

Fall in love, start a family and build precious memories
Once you’ve found your one true love, it’s time to settle down and start a family. Watch your child grow into adulthood as the years pass! Will they inherit the farm? Or will they find their calling somewhere else? Help your family thrive across the decades in Forgotten Valley, guiding your child on the path to finding a future that’s right for them.



A Wonderful Life for a new generation!
Revisit a beloved story as never before, with updated visuals, additional marriage candidates, new animals, seasonal events and a wide array of gameplay improvements. This reimagined version of A Wonderful Life brings all of the heart and charm of the original to a new generation as the definitive experience of one of the most cherished entries in the long-running farming series.

Or will they find their calling somewhere else? Help your family thrive across the decades in Forgotten Valley, guiding your child on the path to finding a future that’s right for them.



A Wonderful Life for a new generation!
Revisit a beloved story as never before, with updated visuals, additional marriage candidates, new animals, seasonal events and a wide array of gameplay improvements. This reimagined version of A Wonderful Life brings all of the heart and charm of the original to a new generation as the definitive experience of one of the most cherished entries in the long-running farming series.

data.name: 命运&通胀 -Fate&Inflation-
data.detailed_description:
Fate & Inflation is a game that combines RPG roguelite elements with card building mechanics. Embark on a mysterious and unknown journey of fate, constantly strengthening yourself, and experience the thrilling charm of exponential combat power growth!

Unique combat style

This game's combat system employs a non-traditional turn-based approach, where enemies have a countdown timer. Each time you play a card, the enemy's countdown is reduced by 1. When the enemy's countdown reaches zero, it will launch an attack against you. During combat, you can select up to 5 cards to attack the enemy at a time. The total damage caused by each attack is determined by multiplying the sum of the points on the cards by the card type multiplier and then by the level. Combined with the skill effects attached to each card, making reasonable choices ensures that each attack is unique.

Exaggerated numerical inflation

After defeating enemies and achieving victory in battle, you will obtain their levels. As the game progresses, the numerical values of both the enemy and your own characters will rise to an extremely exaggerated level. So much so that you may encounter counting units that you have never encountered before

data.name: SAIBI
data.detailed_description:
This game is a horror puzzle game in which a man goes to the village where his parents lived.

Playtime is 15-30 minutes and there are two endings.

Explore the village

You can't contact your parents. Go to the village where your parents live and find out what happened in the town.

Long ago, from the point when you left the town, the village started to have an evil aura. Now the village is quiet as if no one lives there. Find the people who disappeared and the memories you forgot.

Choose your path

Villagers have been holding rituals since ancient times. But their rituals were not common. You will be confronted with the lives that were sacrificed.

Will you join your parents in believing in the pseudo-religion? Or will you take the side of the lives that were sacrificed?

Follow the trail

Religious items used by your parents remain in the house. There are also hidden traces of someone other than your parents. You must interpret the messages left by that person and follow the path she leads you. Check every nook and cranny of the house to make sure there is no evidence you have missed.

data.name: Spellsword Cards: Demontide
data.detailed_description:
The only solo CCG this year, where you level up and access more powerful cards as you adventure through a story driven campaign.

With 7 main classes to mix and match with, you can easily customize your own hero and deck to suit your individual play style. Adventure through a diverse world with heaps of quests and encounters. Hundreds of cards to acquire via loot or stores and unique crafting recipes for legendary cards that are lost artifacts.

- OPEN QUEST PvE RPG + CHAMPION'S ARENA MODE + GAUNTLET ROGUELIKE DECKBUILDER MODE
- 500+ COLLECTIBLE CARDS (earned through gameplay only)
- 40+ BOSSES TO DEFEAT (along with hundreds of battles)
- UNIQUE MULTI-CLASSING SYSTEM (Mix and match between Warrior, Mage, Priest, Rogue, Necromancer, Ninja and Monk)



QUEST AND EXPLORE

A rich and deep storyline pervades an expansive world ready for any and all adventurers to seek their fair share of bounty and power. Ancient tombs and rich politics in a fantasy world will capture your imagination, all the while the strategy card game will keep you on your toes.



DEADLY ENCOUNTERS

Each encounter brings you one step closer to solving the mysteries surrounding your heritage. Learn the secret your master died trying to protect. Earn the respect of the state and other kingdoms one battle at time. Discover hundreds of cards of untold power, undiscovered in the lore books of old.

Meet powerful foes such as Dragons, Demons and Devils. Also find a complete bestiary of trolls, ogres, vampires, knights, orcs, goblins, giant bats and insects and more!



UNIQUE CLASS LEVELLING AND DECK BUILDING SYSTEM

Each skill and level choice you make determines how your strategy unfolds. With immense scope for developing your own unique play style, everyone can enjoy what Spellsword Cards: Demontide has to offer.



COMMUNITY

This is a community led game. Come inside to find details on how you can contribute and get cool tips and hints for secret unlocks inside!

data.name: Twig of Y
data.detailed_description: 《Twig of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，围绕战斗中的连接与断裂展开。玩家将在清晰的回合结构中，通过维系脆弱平衡来引导战局走向，每一次选择都可能加固或动摇整场战斗的立足点。在每一场战斗中，角色与敌人之间构成一种不稳定的连接关系。玩家需要根据技能链条与行动顺序，在连接与舍弃之间做出判断，使队伍始终维持可延续的作战结构。不同敌人的组合会施加不同程度的断裂压力，迫使玩家在巩固现有连接与寻求新的突破之间持续权衡。随着流程推进，角色能力逐步延展，可用于编织更复杂的策略网络或提升连接韧性，使玩家在面对更具破坏力的战斗时仍能保持整体结构的完整。整个体验强调在脆弱中维系延续性，通过连续决策守住不断被考验的平衡支点。《Twig of Y》为喜爱传统回合制 RPG 的玩家提供一段以连接维系与断裂应对为核心的单人体验，在持续的拉扯与重建中完成完整的冒险流程。

data.name: Firmament
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT FIRMAMENT


Firmament is a new puzzle-adventure game by the legendary game studio behind the best-selling games Myst and Riven. Featuring deep storytelling and world-building, discover the story of this seemingly abandoned world as you explore and unlock the mysteries of 3 unique Realms… and beyond!

EXPLORE THE WORLD


Featuring a unique steampunk aesthetic, Firmament invites you to explore the legendary deep world-building Cyan Worlds is known for. Firmament is a fantastic visual feast, with thrilling new sights to see around every corner. At the same time, the world of Firmament feels completely plausible; as though it were constructed with a bigger purpose in mind… A purpose you will be compelled to discover as you play.

SOLVE THE PUZZLES


You carry with you a device called an “Adjunct” as you explore. This Adjunct is your interface as you interact with the various devices throughout the Realms of Firmament. Employing the Adjunct to solve the puzzles you encounter will bring you ever closer to unlocking the secrets this place holds.

DISCOVER THE STORY


You are not entirely alone in Firmament. In addition to The Adjunct, you are joined by a mysterious apparition, who has a story of her own to share with you. As you explore you will be introduced to 3 Realms - each with secrets and mysteries to reveal. What purpose do the Realms serve? Can the spirit who accompanies you be trusted?

REVEAL THE MYSTERY


Are the realms of Firmament abandoned? What are these giant, mysterious machines scattered throughout the world? What is their purpose? What part do you play in this grand mystery? Explore, Discover, Solve, and Reveal the mystery for yourself by playing Firmament!

TECHNICAL DETAILS


Built For Both VR and 2D Displays

Firmament supports both 2D and VR play. The VR experience of Firmament includes both Free Roam and Teleport modes.

Additionally, Firmament includes many “comfort level” features for both new and experienced VR users, including the option to enable smooth or snap turning, quick travel up stairs and ladders, vertical height quantization, and more!

data.name: Jumfrog
data.detailed_description:
Objective

Light up those peepers and hop your way out of this gloomy well!

Key Features

A Platformer That Doesn’t Mess Around

  • No enemies, no deaths—just pure, unfiltered challenge.

  • Your skill and patience are the only things standing between you and glory.

See Through the Shadows

  • Navigate a dark world where your froggo’s glowing eyes light the way.

  • Right-click to peek ahead—those peepers are your trusty guide!

Slingshot-Style Jumping Shenanigans

  • Pull back and launch your frog like a slingshot—boing!

  • Fine-tune your jumps with a crouch animation that shifts pixel-by-pixel and over 10 frames of glorious control.

  • Go for a short, safe hop, yank hard for a wild leap, or angle it just right to thread the needle through tight gaps—the possibilities are endless.

  • A slick physics engine means every tweak changes your fate, letting you tackle the same platform in a dozen dazzling ways.

  • Sketch thousands of jump arcs with your fingertips and nail that perfect landing.

Adorable Star of the Show

  • Pixel-art so cute it’ll make you forget how many times you’ve faceplanted into the abyss.

  • A lovable frog buddy on a hardcore adventure.

Sing When the Going Gets Tough

  • Mid-struggle, treat yourself to your frog’s “ribbit ribbit” serenade—available on demand!

  • Feeling beat? Belt out a tune and take a breather.

  • Messed up? No sweat—kick back and regroup.

Celebrate the Fall

  • Took a tumble? Congrats!

  • Every fall is a spectacle: confetti bursts if you drop from high up, and a ghostly onlooker shows up to comment on your "impressive" leap.

  • Track your downfall with an on-screen height-loss label—because sometimes falling really far deserves its own scoreboard.

Hard Mode for the Hop-Obsessed

  • Think the normal climb’s too easy? Try doing it blind.

  • In Hard Mode, your flashlight’s gone—no peeking, no previews. Just your memory, instincts, and raw skill.

  • The only help? Your frog’s natural glow shines a bit brighter... but don’t expect it to save you.

  • Only the most daring frogs make it out alive.

About the Game

Welcome to JumFrog—a relentless gauntlet of challenges where even the tiniest slip-up can send you plummeting. This isn’t for the faint of heart; it’s a brutal test of skill that’ll push you to your limits. But oh, the sweet, sweet taste of victory? Worth every heart-pounding second. Every jump’s a thrill, every misstep a potential disaster—talk about an adrenaline rush that’ll keep you hooked.

But hold up, there’s more to this than just hopping around. Where’d this crown-wearing frog come from? Why’s it snowing inside a well? What’s waiting beyond the walls this little guy’s so desperate to escape? And most importantly—what’s the deal with this mysterious pit? Buckle up, because this journey’s got questions galore.

Gameplay

Light up those peepers and hop your way out of this gloomy well!

Key Features

A Platformer That Doesn’t Mess Around

  • Your skill and patience are the only things standing between you and glory.

See Through the Shadows

  • Navigate a dark world where your froggo’s glowing eyes light the way.

  • Right-click to peek ahead—those peepers are your trusty guide!

Slingshot-Style Jumping Shenanigans

  • Pull back and launch your frog like a slingshot—boing!

  • Fine-tune your jumps with a crouch animation that shifts pixel-by-pixel and over 10 frames of glorious control.

  • Go for a short, safe hop, yank hard for a wild leap, or angle it just right to thread the needle through tight gaps—the possibilities are endless.

  • A slick physics engine means every tweak changes your fate, letting you tackle the same platform in a dozen dazzling ways.

  • Sketch thousands of jump arcs with your fingertips and nail that perfect landing.

Adorable Star of the Show

  • Pixel-art so cute it’ll make you forget how many times you’ve faceplanted into the abyss.

  • A lovable frog buddy on a hardcore adventure.

Sing When the Going Gets Tough

  • Mid-struggle, treat yourself to your frog’s “ribbit ribbit” serenade—available on demand!

  • Feeling beat? Belt out a tune and take a breather.

  • Messed up? No sweat—kick back and regroup.

Celebrate the Fall

  • Took a tumble? Congrats!

  • Every fall is a spectacle: confetti bursts if you drop from high up, and a ghostly onlooker shows up to comment on your "impressive" leap.

  • Track your downfall with an on-screen height-loss label—because sometimes falling really far deserves its own scoreboard.

Hard Mode for the Hop-Obsessed

  • Think the normal climb’s too easy? Try doing it blind.

  • In Hard Mode, your flashlight’s gone—no peeking, no previews. Just your memory, instincts, and raw skill.

  • The only help? Your frog’s natural glow shines a bit brighter... but don’t expect it to save you.

  • Only the most daring frogs make it out alive.

data.name: Petmancer
data.detailed_description:
Petmancer – A Roguelite Dungeon Crawler with Magical Pets

Master the art of Petmancy in a pixelated roguelite adventure where strategy meets whimsy. Explore mysterious dungeons, recruit powerful familiars, and outwit your enemies in turn-based battles. Whether you’re commanding an army of enchanted animals or auto-exploring the depths of the dungeons, Petmancer offers an endlessly replayable journey full of charm, challenge, and discovery.

Roguelite Replayability

No two runs are the same! Procedurally generated dungeons offer unique layouts, enemies, and loot every time you play.

Build Your Pet Army

Recruit fierce and whimsical creatures—living and otherwise—to fight by your side. Shape your party to attract pets, position them strategically, and guide their growth. Each pet brings unique abilities to master.

16 Unique Hero Classes

From Necromancers to Clairvoyants, choose your playstyle and unlock powerful synergies between talents, pets, and relics.

Turn-Based Combat Meets Auto Exploration

Plan every move in tactical battles or let your team explore on their own in idle mode—perfect for casual and hardcore players alike.

Unlock Ancient Talents

Mix and match 16 magical talents like Mind Control, Chronomancy, and Chaos to build your own strategy.

Prestige & Progression

Defeat the 7 Realm Lords to unlock new meta-abilities, bosses, and realms. Keep your pets, relics, and talents across runs for true long-term growth.

Explore 14 Themed Realms

Battle through shrines, fountains, secret rooms, and more in handcrafted environments like Vampire Castles, Underworld Crypts, and the chaotic Astral Spire.

data.name: China Coin Pusher
data.detailed_description:
A Oriental Arcade Feast

Imagine this: with a gentle push of your finger, gold coins cascade down like a waterfall, accompanied by crisp, clinking sounds, as wealth accumulates amidst a rich Chinese ambiance. This coin-pusher game, built with the Unity3D engine, perfectly blends classic arcade fun with oriental aesthetics, offering an immersive casual experience.

The game's visuals feature backgrounds of ​​classical lattice windows, red lanterns, and traditional courtyards​​, creating a festive atmosphere. The Unity3D technology provides realistic physics for coin dropping and collisions, making every push full of anticipation

The core gameplay is simple and easy to pick up: by precisely controlling the push angle and force, players aim to push coins or prizes into the collection chute, experiencing the thrill of toppling a carefully built wall of coins. The game innovatively introduces a ​​combo system and a lucky wheel​​ for multiple rewards, alongside collecting cute pets and unlocking new maps for sustained enjoyment.

Players start with 50 free coins and can accumulate wealth even offline

. Embark on this oriental coin-pushing journey now and let the delightful sounds accompany your path to prosperity

data.name: Recursive
data.detailed_description:
Recursive is a recursive incremental game about helping your kingdom survive by building yourself into something unstoppable. You start by clicking enemies for XP, then you turn that into upgrades that unlock more systems, more currencies, and more ways to scale.

Unlock towns with their own minigames and progression, route their output back into your build, and keep feeding everything into your knights growing power. The loop is the point: every system exists to strengthen another.

FEATURES

  • Click enemies, fight bosses, and push progression

  • Unlock towns with unique minigames and currencies

  • Build compounding upgrade loops that reshape your run

  • Craft and equip gear to power up your Giant

  • And so much more!

data.name: Socks!
data.detailed_description:
Strategic, Satisfying Sock Packing Action!

DROP SOCKS INTO YOUR BASKET!

The socks are dry and it's time to pack!

DON'T LET IT OVERFLOW! MAKE BUNDLES BY MATCHING PAIRS!

Match identical pairs of socks to create sock bundles and free up space in the sock basket! But be warned, this also fills up the bundle basket! Match 2 bundles to clear space in the bundle basket!

OH BUT YOU'RE NOT SAFE YET! DON'T LET THE BUNDLE BASKET OVERFLOW EITHER! 

The heart of Socks! is the strategic balance of the baskets! Do you match a sock now and risk tipping over the bundles? Or do you throw a turn and risk building up the sock basket?! Dynamic decisions like these keep every round fresh!

data.name: The Last Secret
data.detailed_description:
Join the Adventure!


You and your friends suddenly discover strange mental abilities. A girl with pink hair seems to be behind it. Join your friends on an epic quest to reveal the "last secret", discover the truth about the world and save your life and the whole earth...
Epic and light-hearted story with lots of puzzles (that mostly can be skipped if you're not into it), the chance for romance (also optional) and 8 good endings. (The romance part works for male and female players, a "rainbow mode" for homosexual players can also be activated.)

Main Characters


Time to introduce the cast of The Last Secret in a bit more details... Here we go!

Let's start with your childhood friend, Meilin...

The second of the main cast: kind and smart Honghong...

Here comes Karina: the sweet and nerdy math girl with a love for strange hoodies...

Not one of your high school friends, but instead an international music star: Ben Benjamin... Where will you manage to meet him?

And finally, the mysterious girl with pink hair... Is she behind all these strange events happening? And *what* is she?

Game Play


The Last Secret is a visual novel with a complex story and lots of mini games and puzzles. You can play as female or male protagonist. Activating the "rainbow mode" allows you to get close to same-gender characters. (If you're only into story and romance, you can always let one of your smart friends give hints or solve the puzzles for you. If you're only into story and puzzles, you can skip the romantic part and enjoy the game nevertheless.)

Here's one of the puzzles the heroes have to solve on their way: connect lights of the same color along the lines, but no lights of different colors!

Fun in the sun (you wouldn't guess where this is):

A pic from one of the romantic parts of the game:

Meilin Under Cherry Blossoms

Content


  • Interesting and rich story line with many hours of game play
  • 8 good endings, numerous bad ones
  • Playable as male and female, you can chose to date different gender or same gender characters (or nobody at all).
  • Tons of nice background graphics, simple but cute character design (300+ images)
  • Full original soundtrack, including several songs with vocals (in English or Chinese with subtitles) plus a few songs from Lemmino
  • Many puzzles to be solved on the way, each of them unique
  • Multiple language versions available: English, German, Chinese, Spanish and more.

Conclusions:


Try out the game - since if you don't, Meilin will be pretty angry with you:



(And she can be scary, you know! ;-)

data.name: She Doesn't Speak My Language
data.detailed_description:
Say it in your own English. Can you make her smile?

A lovely woman is right in front of you. You find the courage to say hello in Japanese or Chinese, and she doesn't understand a word!
This is a dating sim for Japanese and Chinese speakers who want to speak English. There are no dialogue choices. You say what you want to tell her in your own English, by voice or on the keyboard. Her lines stay in English, and a translation appears only if you ask for one.

When she understands you, her face softens and she smiles. As you grow closer, some days she quietly tells you something she hasn't told anyone else.
When she doesn't, she gives you a puzzled little smile and says something like "Sorry... I don't understand." Then she waits quietly while you try again. Searching for the words while she looks at you, a little awkward and a little heart-pounding, is part of the fun.
No classroom. No monthly fee. No real person watching you make mistakes. Just four women waiting to hear your English.

Mistakes stay between you two

Making mistakes in English with a real person can be scary. Here, however many times you get it wrong, it stays a secret between you and her.
If she doesn't understand, try saying it another way. The number of retries depends on the difficulty level: on Casual you can try as many times as you like, and on the default Normal level you get two retries for each of her questions (after that, the story moves on even if she hasn't understood).
After each date, you can press a button to look back at some of what you said, next to a more natural way to say it. The review doesn't catch every mistake. What you see there is something to build on next time.

This game is for you if...

  • You want to practice speaking English, but there is no one to practice with.
  • You are afraid of making mistakes in front of real people.
  • You have tried English classes or apps, but found it hard to keep going.
  • Monthly fees for English lessons or apps feel like too much.
  • You are tired of dating games where you only pick from a menu of lines.
  • You enjoy stories about growing close to someone from abroad.
Right now the game supports Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese speakers. Your first language sets the menus, the dictionary meanings and the translations. If English is your first language, this game is not made for you: it is made for people who want to practice speaking English, and the conversations happen inside scenes designed in advance, so it is not an open chat with an AI companion.

Four heroines, each with her own English

All four are living in Japan, far from home. The level in parentheses shows roughly how hard her English is. It uses CEFR, an international scale: A1 is the easiest, then A2, then B1.
  • Mira (A2): A librarian from Dublin. She teases you with sarcasm and puns, but she'll search hard for a book you can actually read.
  • Sofia (A1, the easiest): A barista from San Diego. She loves to talk and is good at keeping the conversation going. She writes your name on the cup, spells it wrong, and laughs as she writes it again.
  • Chloe (B1, a little harder): An art student from London. She's cool and rarely gives compliments, so from her, "Not bad" is the highest praise.
  • Amara (A2): A doctor from Nairobi who does medical research. She's kind to everyone and always seems so dependable that nobody ever worries about her. But maybe, deep down, she'd like someone to ask her, "Are you okay?"
If you don't understand an expression from her hometown, just ask ("What does grand mean?") and she may explain it in simple English.

Sometimes, she brings up what you told her

What you've told her, what you like and your plans: she may bring them up herself in a later conversation (not every time, and with limits on how often).
When she talks about something she loves, add that English word to your wordbook. You can only give her items whose English names are in your wordbook.
Get through to her day after day, and on milestone days she'll send you gifts: a note, a voice message, a photo and more, with a letter on day 50. You can give her gifts and celebrate anniversaries too.
If you get busy and can't visit for a while, she won't hold it against you. She might miss you a little, though...
The gifts she's given you and the illustrations of your moments together can be revisited on the Memories screen at any time.

Features for learning English

  • You can speak to her or type your replies. Speaking out loud is the better way. When the words won't come, or you're somewhere you can't talk, you can switch to the keyboard at any time.
  • Click a word she says to see what it means. Words you add to your wordbook come back for review at spaced intervals (spaced repetition).
  • By default, suggestions and corrections wait for you after the date (press a button to see them), so they don't interrupt the conversation. The number of sentences reviewed and the number of corrections for each sentence are limited, so it won't catch every mistake. If you'd like to see them right away, turn on "Show wording tips during the date" in Settings.
  • From the second day on, the review at the end of each day compares your accuracy, sentence length and range of vocabulary with the day before, and shows how many words you've spoken in English so far.
  • Pronunciation hints are designed around sounds that Japanese speakers often find difficult (L/R, TH, V/B, and adding extra vowels at the end of words).
  • There are four difficulty levels. Casual, the easiest: try again as often as you like, and affection never drops (though some scenes only appear when she understands you). Normal, the default: two retries for each of her questions, then the story moves on. Strict: one retry. Spartan, the hardest: in principle no second chances. On every level except Casual, affection drops if she doesn't understand you at all, and on Spartan the drop is bigger; her listening gets stricter too.

The in-game AI runs on your PC

While you play, all of the game's AI runs on your own PC, not on an external server.
No account or subscription is required, and nothing you type or say is sent to a server to be processed. If you turn on Steam Cloud, though, your save data (including lines you said and what she remembers about you) is synced through Steam.
Because the AI runs on your PC, her replies can be slower on an older computer. Please check the system requirements.
You can visit her every day, whenever you like. The longer you keep playing, the more memories you'll share with her.

From the creator

For years, I kept signing up for English classes and trying new apps, only to give up each time.
People told me to make friends from abroad or find a foreign partner, but I'm not that outgoing.
What I wanted was a game that is genuinely fun and still lets you practice English seriously, one you can keep coming back to. So I decided to make it myself.
I sincerely hope that anyone who has struggled the same way will enjoy talking with these four women and keep speaking English, little by little.

In Early Access, I'll keep improving it with your feedback

I'm making this game because I want to be able to speak English myself, so I have no intention of releasing it and walking away.
In Early Access you can play the early-to-middle part of all four stories. The conversation is the part I want to improve most.
I'll read every piece of feedback and every request, and keep improving the conversations, the stories and the way the heroines are written.
Going forward, I also plan to work on versions for learning languages other than English, a version for women players, and a stronger conversation AI.

How the game uses AI

The story and the goal of each scene were designed in advance.
The AI phrases her replies within each scene. It never decides where the story goes.
Her replies may sometimes not quite match what you said, or she may repeat a question. When that happens, try saying it another way.
Character art, event illustrations, voices and music were created using generative AI that is licensed for commercial use.

Other notes

  • The menus, dictionary meanings and translations are shown in Japanese, Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese, depending on your first language.
  • All characters are adults. There is no sexual content.
  • Pronunciation hints and corrections are for guidance only and are not a substitute for a language test or certification.
  • New outfits and new heroines (for example, one who is good at business English) are planned as add-on content. The full release is being made so you can enjoy the main story without buying any add-ons.

data.name: UpBreakers
data.detailed_description:
"UpBreakers" is an absolute must for casual gaming lovers. As a perfect party game, it is a great alternative to popular games like Overcooked and the predecessor to Moving Out. This chaotic multiplayer indie game is specially designed for quick play sessions as an exciting couch multiplayer. Dive into a furniture moving game that impresses with its breakable environment mechanics. Whether you are looking for competitive casual games or local co-op, "UpBreakers" will not disappoint. With simple controls and a colorful indie aesthetic, it's the perfect game for casual gamers looking for the next big laugh.



Do you know the feeling when a dream couple suddenly turns into two angry singles? That's exactly your setting in UpBreakers. You are part of a moving team that has split into two competing companies. The goal? Grab, haul, and sometimes throw more furniture out the window than the other team!

The beauty of "UpBreakers" is that it's perfect for those who want to play in short, chaotic and absolutely fun sessions with 2-16 friends. Whether you only have a few minutes or a whole hour, this game offers quick fun and delightfully crazy moments that you won't soon forget.



So, indie fans, invite your friends, throw on an "UpBreakers" session and enjoy the crazy, chaotic and incredibly fun moments that only such a diamond in the rough can provide!

data.name: Hex of the Lich
data.detailed_description:
The hall stinks of rot and decay. You feel the gaze of countless horrors as you enter the room, each thrice your size. You pause only for a moment to ready your wand, before unleashing a barrage of eldritch obliteration. One by one, you fell the beasts. In a chest across the room you spot your prize: a horde of gleaming hexes, rife with arcane energy.

Hex of the Lich is a turn-based dungeon-crawler roguelike with a twist: Spellcrafting!



  • 80+ Spells to learn and master
  • Spells are built of hexes and super customizable
  • 60+ Effects that upgrade spells, including lasers, explosions, chain lightning, buffs, curses, and more
  • Summon tentacles, robots, and undead horrors
  • Unlock more powerful spells as you delve deeper

Can you break the Hex of the Lich?

4v1 - Up to four players explore a haunted house while another player sneaks around on a second screen as an invisible ghost.

2-Screen Competitive Mode

-Requires a Second Monitor-

One player secretly controls a ghost that can possess objects and use them to attack the other players.

Up to 4 other players must work together to activate all of the grimoires before time runs out. The investigators share a screen and can't see what deviousness the ghost is up to.

Playing two-screen games is easy! Find an extra television or monitor and plug it into your computer. Just remember to tilt the screens away from each other so the investigators can't peek!

Pumpkin Haunt Co-operative Mode


1-4 players play on just one screen and race to unlock grimoires while being attacked by flying pumpkins.

7 Unique Haunted Houses


Including a mansion, castle, riverboat, hedge maze, snowed-in lodge, mine and forest.

data.name: Neural Drive
data.detailed_description:
Everything slows down except you — Experience Hyper-Acceleration Combat

Neural Drive is an action rogue-lite where you harness acceleration powers to perform extraordinary feats and take on a powerful megacorporation.

Activate your acceleration, and time itself slows — enemies, bullets, even missiles move in slow motion… except you. What will you do in this slowed world? Parry frozen bullets with your katana. Dodge sluggish enemy strikes and strike back — turn every action you imagined into reality.

But the corporation won’t go down easily. The more you threaten them, the stronger their forces become, sending massive robots and elite enemies to stop you. Clear stages, collect rewards to enhance your abilities, and reclaim your freedom as the pressure intensifies.

FEATURES

  • Acceleration-Based Combat

    Bend time to your will. Deflect projectiles, evade enemy attacks, and strike back against waves of enemies with precision and speed.

  • Three Weapons with Unique Skills

    Wield close-range katanas, mid-range rifles, and long-range sniper rifles, each with specialized skills. Strategically choose which weapon to enhance with the abilities you acquire during your run.

  • Challenging Stages and Bosses

    Face waves of enemies and powerful bosses to unlock new stages. As you progress, uncover the hidden truths lurking in this cyberpunk world.

data.name: Buns, Booze & Bucks Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to 1920s London, where foggy streets hide secrets, and every other person is either a gangster or an informant. In Mafia Bakery, you’ll take on the role of a young criminal who, under the guise of baking bread, runs a bootleg alcohol operation. Sounds simple enough: just bake and brew, right? But remember: one wrong move, and your business will collapse faster than you can say, "Hey, it’s just buns!" 

Parallel management of two businesses

For the people of London, you are the owner of a small bakery, where you need to serve customers, monitor the quality of bread products and maintain a reputation. For those who know the truth, you are a moonshiner who creates unique drinks for smuggling. One process should not interfere with the other, otherwise serious consequences await you. For example, if the dough dries out, housewives will start complaining, and if the alcohol ferments, the whole batch will be ruined, and you will owe a lot of money to the bad guys.

Creating Alcohol

From braga to distillation, every stage of production requires attention. Experiment with ingredients (from fruits to... mushrooms?) to create drinks with different flavors and effects. Be careful: mistakes can lead to explosions or damage to the batch. Add too much chili and you'll find out how hot your customers are.

Customer service

Different types of customers come to your bakery: housewives, workers, inspectors, and even competitors. Each of them has its own preferences and requirements. One mistake, and the police might come to check. And if you sell stale bread to a drunk, he can start a fight right in the hall.

Smuggling and strategy

Your task is to deliver alcohol to the pier, bypassing customs officers, competitors and "rats". Choose reliable routes, negotiate with gangs, and pay bribes to protect your business. Give it to the informant's paw so that your paws are not handcuffed.

Development and modernization

Upgrade your equipment, expand your product range, and discover new recipes. The better your product, the more money you will earn. But don't forget: the bigger the business, the more attention it attracts. The police may suspect that the baker can hardly afford a Rolls-Royce, but if this is the legacy of a deceased uncle, then it's a completely different matter.

data.detailed_description:
Pre-Purchase Offer

Are you ready to play your friends in AquaBall?  You got next!  Get special rewards for your pre-purchase.  We will send you the crowdfunding information also.  Cheers!


About the Game

Welcome to the AquaBall League (ABL) The Ultimate Ocean Showdown! 

Compete, explore, and complete epic quests to protect the seas, unlock power-ups, and become an AquaBall legend! Are you ready to dive in?

Long ago, in the crystal-clear waters of JamRock Bay, a young islander named Jay and his adventurous best friend, Odon the dolphin, dreamed of bringing the oceans fastest, smartest, and most agile creatures together for an electrifying new sport. With the help of their dolphin pod and a crew of marine champions, they created AquaBall League a high-speed, high-energy water sport where teamwork, skill, and oceanic instincts collide!

Now, the AquaBall League is a global sensation, with teams from every corner of the seven seas competing in 2v2 matches, using their natural abilities dolphin flips, octopus tentacle passes, squid ink defense, and more to score epic goals. Players train all year long for a chance to compete in the legendary annual playoffs, leading up to the most prestigious event of all:

(AquaBall League Championships) THE OCEAN BOWL CHAMPIONSHIPS 

Held in the breathtaking Arenas of Atlantis Prime, the Ocean Bowl is where only the best of the best battle for the Aqua Crown! From the mystical Shadalar Gardens to the treacherous waves of Poseidons Horn, every match is a test of speed, precision, and teamwork.

AquaBall League exposes our audience and community, to concepts of being eco-friendly citizens, promoting conservation, and creativity. In between matches, players embark on quests to clean up arenas, solve oceanic mysteries, and build new technology to protect marine life.

So, are you ready to dive in, make history, and become an AquaBall legend? The next Ocean Bowl is calling will you answer?  You got next!

Introduction


Phantom typist is the typing arcade game which you can learn and improve typing skill of Chinese characters.

Type correct Chinese characters to clear the falling blocks before they fill up the screen, get the high score at the leaderboard with various play modes and levels!

How to Play




1. Chinese character blocks will fall down
2. You need to type the correct word to remove the corresponding block.
3. If these blocks fill up the screen, you will lose.
4. Type fast and correctly to achieve high score.
5. Also, apply game modes to experience different rules.

Features

  • Self-defined difficulty and game modes
  • Show the meaning and pronounce of characters
  • Game records
  • Steam leaderboard
  • Steam acheivements

Story mode and other features will be updated during early access!

data.name: Bullet Banshee
data.detailed_description:
Bullet Banshee is a vertical shoot-'em-up built around roguelite item stacking. You fly one ship up through 21 stages, spending what you kill on the items that decide how the run ends. Beat the Sovereign at the top and Endless mode unlocks, letting the ladder keep climbing past stage 21.

BUILD A GUN OUT OF PARTS

Draft from over 40 passive items and stack them. A second Multishot is another bullet in the fan. A fifth Poison can outdamage the gun. Fork splits shots sideways, Ricochet bounces what's left, Crit rolls on all of it. You're looking for the combination that gets out of hand.

MYTHIC TRANSFORMS

Every 10 levels the draft offers a Mythic item, but only if you already own the item it changes. Unishot folds the whole Multishot fan into one round that still carries all that damage. Virulence pays poison out on hit instead of over time. Bloodforge turns max HP into bullet damage. One of these and the rest of your items mean something else.

TEN ACTIVE EQUIPMENTS

One slot. Charge fills as you kill. Blink through a barrage, drop a black hole, fire a laser the height of the screen, or chain lightning until nothing in reach is left. Pick up a new one and the old one falls back onto the stage.

A CROWDED SKY

More than 10 types, built by hand into 100+ formations. Gnat swarms of two dozen. Turrets that rake a fan across the screen, laser stars that fire rings in every direction, weavers on a fixed dive, steppers, splitters, dragonflies, battleships that park at the top. Later stages unlock nastier formations instead of just giving everything more HP.

Deeper in, elites start showing up - their own attacks, their own tells. Then the Sovereign.

DIE, THEN COME BACK HEAVIER

Every run pays Salvage, including the ones you quit. Spend it on permanent hull, charge, damage, and starting items. You can unequip any of that if you want a clean run. Three ships, paints, and an achievement for beating the game with none of the hangar stuff on.

MOD IT

The game reads your user folder on boot. Resource packs can override existing content. Loose `.tres` files can add spawn cards, ships, and items to the pools the game already uses. A menu shows what loaded and what got refused.

data.name: Tiny Atolls
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

TINY ATOLLS is a minimalist island auto-battler.

Discover new combinations to build your civilization from nothing, and watch your island go to war with others.

Combine elements to create new tiles. Each discovery opens up more combinations, from your first plants and rocks to castles and houses that change how your island grows and fights.

Expand your island and choose what to build. Put your civilization to the test against other players and challenges.

  • Little Alchemy mechanic meets auto-battler city builder

  • Build a civilization from just water and earth

  • Battle other players islands in asynchronous combat

  • Choose your route through battles, treasures and bosses

  • Unlock new starting decks

  • Modular buildings, secret merges, very secret combo patterns and more

data.name: One Man! One Gun! One Thousand Zombies!
data.detailed_description:
After she was gone, I realized how weak I was... I never want to feel that again.

That promise manifested as metal and firepower. A single gun, infinite in its fury, became the answer to my weakness.

When a voice on the radio whispered of a safe base, the hunt was given a destination. But the world hasn't forgotten. The dead have evolved. They don't stumble in the dark; they hunt, they dodge, and they think. To reach my goal, I will have to become the monster they fear.

One Man. Driven by a promise.
One Gun. Infinite as his rage.
One Thousand Zombies. Smart enough to be a challenge, but not to survive you.

Features:

  • Enemies That Hunt, Not Wander: Forget brainless hordes. Face the undead that dodge your shots, surround you, and use the environment against you. Your brute force means nothing without tactics.

  • A World That Hides the Truth: Amidst the carnage, the mystery remains. Why do all survivors wear masks? What truly happened? The truth is scattered among the wreckage.

  • Absolute Power, Essential Control: Your weapon is a godlike power, but control is in your hands. Use your agility to stay one step ahead of enemies that adapt to your actions.

  • Tactical Destruction: The environment is more than destructible; it's your primary weapon. Create chokepoints, blast escape routes, and turn the world into a deadly trap for the intelligent horde.

The path to the safe base isn't about survival. It's about proving you will never be weak again.

Add One Man! One Gun! One Thousand Zombies! to your Wishlist now!

data.name: Terms of Service
data.detailed_description:
READ CAREFULLY. ANSWER HONESTLY. ACCEPT THE TERMS.

Terms of Service is a short, linear psychological horror game about compliance, surveillance, and a questionnaire that becomes increasingly hostile.
You sit alone before an old CRT monitor.
Your task appears simple:
Answer 100 Yes/No questions.
At first, they are ordinary.
Personal, perhaps, but harmless.
Then the questions change.
The CRT begins to distort. Memories interrupt the questionnaire.
The system becomes increasingly invasive, and its demands begin to feel less like questions and more like instructions.
Something is wrong with the service.
And it seems to know far more about you than it should.

THE QUESTIONNAIRE

Work through 100 Yes/No questions as a routine agreement gradually turns into a psychological horror experience.
The questions become more personal, coercive and disturbing as the system begins testing how readily you will comply.
Your attention remains exactly where the service wants it:
On the screen. On the questions. On your answers.

MEMORIES BREAK THROUGH

The questionnaire does not stay confined to the CRT.
Fragments of another person's life begin appearing around you, revealing pieces of a disturbing story hidden behind the service.
As the memories continue, the boundary between the questionnaire and what happened before it becomes harder to ignore.

THE SYSTEM DETERIORATES

The CRT and the room become increasingly unstable as you progress.
Visual distortion, flickering lights, interrupted questions and aggressive screen effects reflect a system that is becoming less controlled, and increasingly threatening.

A SHORT PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR EXPERIENCE

Approximate playtime: ~30 minutes.
Terms of Service is designed as a compact horror story that can be completed in a single sitting.

DO YOU ACCEPT THE TERMS OF SERVICE?

data.name: Wolves In The Flock
data.detailed_description:
By day, you keep the flock. By night, you keep the gate.

Your little farm sits at the end of a dark lane, and every night something knocks. A sheep, it says, running from a wolf. Let me in, quick. It might be telling the truth. It might be the wolf.

Spend your days in the pen getting to know your flock. Spend your nights at the gate with a lantern, deciding who gets in. Let a wolf in and the morning count comes up short.

Three knocks a night.

Pick from more than twenty questions, from "Say 'baa'" to "Show me your feet" to "What do you think of the moon?" You only get three per visitor, so make them count.

Look closer. Listen harder.

Raise your lantern and look for pointy ears, a long snout or a zip down the back. Listen for footsteps that pad instead of trot, or a bleat with a growl in it. By day, watch for the ones who never graze and keep staring at the others. And shear one sheep a day, because wool never lies.

Happy sheep talk.

Every animal has a heart meter. Kindness fills it, while thirst, grief and a cold shearing drain it. Happy sheep gossip more, and they grow better wool.

Something always goes wrong.

Every few days a calamity hits: a thunderstorm, a twister, a wildfire, an earthquake or a wolf raid. You'll get a warning and a way to fight back. Whether you listen is up to you.

Thirty nights.

That's a month at the gate, with a strange visitor full of stories and a very big wolf who knows the rules better than you do. Every fifth night ends in something big, and the month can end more than one way. Some of those endings are not what you'd expect from a sheep game.

Try it free.

The demo is the first five nights, and your save carries straight into the full game.

Trust no fleece.

data.name: Unending Galaxy
data.detailed_description:
Buzz


You might also be interested in looking at our second game, After the Collapse: a post-apocalyptic base building game set in urban environments. It will be released on October 8th, 2018.


About the Game

Unending Galaxy is a unique mix of space-sim and 4X strategy.

WARNING: Unending Galaxy is an OLD game made for Windows XP systems, back when 32bit apps and 4:3 monitors were still common place. As a result, this game is not very stable on modern systems. I heavily suggest that you check the steam forums, especially the sticky topics before considering making a purchase. UG is no longer under active development.

Explore a vast and dynamic universe in which the different factions conquer new territories, colonize planets, and conduct diplomacy. Start as a simple pilot and amass wealth through trading, mining, and fighting. Turn this wealth into new stations and warships that you will use to carve the frontiers of your own empire. Or do none of that and become a powerful pirate and war profiteer by turning other factions against one another.

  • Multiple maps featuring hundreds of sectors and thousands of NPC
  • Includes multiple hand-crafted maps and a procedural map generator
  • Sandbox gameplay: mine, trade, build, colonize, fight, destroy, scavenge
  • Control multiple ships and switch between them at will
  • 10 factions, 90 ships and 70 station types, dozens of weapons
  • No in-game loading screens, real time gameplay with active pause
  • Powerful modding toolkit included

  • 10 factions, 90 ships and 70 station types, dozens of weapons
  • No in-game loading screens, real time gameplay with active pause

data.name: Enigma Manor
data.detailed_description:
Enigma Manor is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Navigate your way through the procedurally generated manor, fend off monsters, solve puzzles and find a way to escape.



  • Limited Resources: Scavenge the manor for ammunition and health items to protect yourself from the monsters that lie within, but use them wisely as resources are limited.
  • Puzzles: Collect keys around the area to unlock new rooms, find more items and get access to a variety of different puzzles. Solve these puzzles to get one step closer to escaping.
  • Hardcore: Getting out alive won't be easy, there are no checkpoints and no saves. You only get one chance to escape, and you'll receive a final rank based on your performance.



  • Rooms: The layout of the manor is procedurally generated each time, so players must learn how to navigate through the area as they play.
  • Items: Keys, resources and other such items are spawned in different locations of the map for every playthrough. Search rooms carefully for everything you need to survive.
  • Enemies: Monsters are randomly selected and spawned around the area, so you never know what might be waiting for you on the other side of a door.
  • Locks: Doors can be assigned with various different lock types, or even without a lock entirely. Remember which keys are required and only carry what is needed.
  • Puzzles: Puzzles are chosen at random and their solutions are changed each time, which makes problem solving necessary to escape.



  • 4 Players: Play alone or with up to 3 other people, invite players to a private server only accessible to you and your friends.
  • Co-operative: Work together to escape and leave no one behind, share resources among each other to ensure everyone has a fighting chance.
  • Proximity Chat: Use the in-game proximity voice chat for the best experience, listen closely as your friends scream in the distance.

data.name: The First Pixel
data.detailed_description:
At first, there is almost nothing.

A blank space.
A single pixel.
And one small decision: click it.

Something responds.

The pixel begins to change. New signals appear. Patterns form where there was only silence. Memory starts to accumulate. Strange systems emerge, each one suggesting that what you are building may have existed long before you arrived.

The First Pixel is a quiet, mysterious incremental game about watching something simple become increasingly difficult to understand.

You will grow resources, awaken unfamiliar structures, uncover hidden mechanics and push deeper into layers that do not always explain themselves. Progress is not only about making numbers larger. Sometimes it means noticing something that was not there before. Sometimes it means remembering a pattern. Sometimes it means opening a door you were never told existed.

Scattered across erased worlds are 100 lost relics.

What they are, who left them behind, and why the pixel seems drawn to them is something you will have to discover for yourself.

There are no armies to command.
No kingdom to build.
No hero waiting to save the world.

There is only the pixel.

And eventually, it may start looking back.

data.name: Born to Win
data.detailed_description:
Born to Win — 5 Cards, Infinite Possibilities (Probably)

🟢 Extreme Minimalism (Actually, nobody’s left to write code)

Tired of "The door does not open from this side"?

Tired of mana management?

Tired of elemental reactions?

Tired of Special Summons?

Tired of paying $76 for DLC?

Relax. This game has none of that. (The designer said he only knew how to make Gacha mobile games before he quit.)

🎴 Welcome to pure bliss—just 5 cards and a board of 🔥🌪️💧🌳⚫. (The Lead Artist used AI to generate these five icons and vanished.) Your board, your layout. (We only built five slots anyway.)

⚡️ Just 5 cards. Build whatever you want. No mana, no crystals, no energy. (The coder originally made four slots. While I was sweeping the floor, I bumped his mouse and added a fifth one. He left without fixing it.)

🔥 Infinite Growth: Literally. As long as you play, the cards get stronger. (I strongly suspect this exponential scaling is a game-breaking bug. Use it to crush the game before I figure out how to update it.) 🎡 Elemental Roulette, changing like crazy every round: (Don't look at me. The dev is gone; I’m just the security guard.)

✨ Strategy? Sure, but not much. You get 5 random elements every round. (The dev was smoking in the guard booth and muttered that the algorithm was copied from G-site. I only know about P-site; I didn't even know there was a G-site.)

Will it be 🔥🔥🔥🔥⚫ or a 💧🌳🌪️ total mess? Good luck, Chosen One. (I saw the ex-programmer this morning selling crepes at the community gate. His cooking is much more stable than his code.) Single-run build? Just gamble! (It's a single-player game anyway; if you lose, there’s always Cheat Engine.)

💥 Enchanting is like a blind box. Damage, Healing, Shield, Burn, Poison, Recovery, Shock... all random. High-rolled a god-tier build? Enjoy your day. Low-rolled garbage? It’s only a 20-minute run. (The team is gone; QA testing was handled by my cat walking on the keyboard.)

⚡️ 20 minutes a round. If you can’t finish, I lose. (I have to leave the booth to patrol every 20 minutes.)

🎮 Simple enough to make you laugh (or cry). Learn the rules in 3 minutes; get hooked for 3 hours. (At least, that’s how I tricked the neighbor’s kid into playtesting.) "Hardcore Strategy"? "Infinite Deckbuilding"? (Just marketing buzzwords for Steam. The game only feels "deep" because there are so many bugs.)

⚪ About the Developer (Current Staff: 1 Security Guard) Born to Win is a technical miracle stitched together from a deleted repository, three empty folders, and one "New Microsoft Excel Worksheet.xlsx" left behind by the run-away team.

Version v0.9: The remaining 0.1 depends on the angle I hit the keyboard next time I’m sweeping the floor. Powered by Love: If you encounter a BUG, please stay calm and treat it as a "Narrative Fragment." Why release it? They said Unitree is releasing security robots to replace me. I’m just trying to make enough for a train ticket back home.

data.name: The Toymaker's Apprentice
data.detailed_description:
The Toymaker's Apprentice is a journey into the twisted world of the toymaker's offspring and his army of evil.
Growing up in a small village, the apprentice patiently learned the craft of toymaking from his adopted father. Eventually, the young boy grew an interest in the dark arts, and his subsequent toy-like manifestations grew more and more sinister.
One day, the apprentice turned on his father, and unleashed his evil toys on the town, forever casting the town into darkness and enslaving its humble citizens.

In this immersive VR adventure, the player must escape the dungeon where he has been doomed, and embark on a quest to capture the Apprentice's evil toys.
If he succeeds, he will be transported to the Apprentice's land where he will face off in a final battle for lasting freedom.

data.name: Hina-chan's Sticker Survival
data.detailed_description:
Hina-chan's phone has broken and can't text or make calls!

In this game, a sort of roguelite sticker deckbuilder, you'll help Hina-chan by selecting stickers to send to her friends Nitori, Suika, and Joon to avoid suspicion.

For example, if they ask you what you ate for breakfast, you could use a meat sticker and they'll interpret that as you saying you had meat.

Or, you could use an X sticker, which they'll interpret as you saying you didn't have anything.

But of course, you could also send the wrong stickers and just watch how they react instead.

That might be fun too. Gather useful stickers and cards to survive all the chats, and help Hina-chan make it through all the way 'til the end!

*This game is a Touhou Project fangame.
