data.name: Evil Next Door
data.detailed_description:
Evil Next Door is a game about the survival of a group of people in an authentic small post-Soviet town called Ensk. The area suffers from a deadly epidemic and is cut off from the outside world. The player switches between multiple characters with different backgrounds, living out their unique stories and determining how they conclude. Sometimes he or she meets other people playing online and intervenes in their activities or even invites them to take cover in the player’s shelter.

An epidemic that ravages Ensk turns people into bloodthirsty lunatics. There is no cure available, so the government put the town into quarantine and encircled it with military checkpoints with a shoot on sight order. Food and fuel supplies are limited and there is no way to get them replenished.



AN ATMOSPHERIC POST-SOVIET RURAL TOWN

Gloomy paneled houses and creepy communal art objects are everywhere creating a feeling of total devastation and hopelessness. It’s strange, but these views also provide a strange comfort to those who were born in post-Soviet countries. Evil Next Door players will also portray the idea of what it is like to get stuck in one of these.

MANAGING ONE CHARACTER, WHILE RESPONSIBLE FOR ALL OF THEM

A player controls the shelter and the several characters living in it. You can choose one of them, equip him or her at your discretion and set out to explore the streets and look for supplies while other characters cook food and craft equipment. This is what life in Ensk looks like, because food, fuel and medical supplies are scarce.

A TEAM OF CIVILIANS ONLY

It's easy to survive if you are a special forces soldier. But what about a TV presenter, a grocery store cashier or a pensioner? The player determines how to use the strengths and weaknesses of each character on the team to get everyone to last at least one more day in Ensk.




A CITY SURVIVAL GAME

Surviving in a city and not in a tropical jungle has some advantages. Your characters will always have a roof over their heads, and the supermarket down the street has some supplies left. But who knows what's on your neighbor's mind? In this urban jungle, man is a wolf to man, and the food supplies won’t last forever.

UNIQUE STORY GENERATOR

The developers plan to make sure that each playthrough will allow you to meet different characters in different circumstances. It is important to protect them and carefully plan actions, because in Evil Next Door every character's death is permanent. But even losing all of them will lead to a new story that can be even more interesting.

NEIGHBORS ONLINE

While exploring the city, you can stumble upon other players and do whatever you feel like doing: attack, help or even invite them to your shelter to join forces and survive together. Other players might share supplies or information, but they could also stab you in the back and take all your belongings.

data.name: Orangie
data.detailed_description:
Orangie is a 3D AI desktop companion designed especially for RPG games.

She's more than just an adorable character on your desktop. She can follow your gameplay, remember the story, and start conversations on her own — becoming your very own adventure companion.

Whether you're exploring mysterious worlds, battling powerful bosses, or experiencing emotional story moments, she'll be right by your side, sharing your excitement, laughing at unexpected moments, and reacting to your adventures as they unfold.

✨ Key Features

🎮 She Watches Your Game and Joins the Adventure

Orangie continuously observes your gameplay and follows the story as it develops.

She might gasp at a breathtaking scene, crack a joke during a funny moment, or get even more nervous than you when a terrifying boss appears!

💬 Proactive Conversations, Natural Companionship

You don't always have to start the conversation.

Orangie can choose when to speak based on what's happening in your game. She has her own personality and emotions — sometimes sweet and clingy, sometimes playful and teasing, and sometimes simply happy to stay quietly by your side.

It's like having a little gaming buddy sitting right next to you.

🧠 A Long-Term Memory System Built for RPGs

Orangie features a unique memory system specially designed for RPG adventures.

She can remember characters you've met, events you've experienced together, and important details from earlier in the story.

Even when an NPC returns after a long absence, she might surprise you by remembering something from your past adventures.

💕 Adorable 3D Characters and Interactive Reactions

Enjoy beautifully crafted 3D characters with expressive animations, charming facial expressions, and interactive touch reactions.

Try giving her a gentle head pat and see how she responds!

🌸 Different Personalities, Different Companions

From a sweet, affectionate little-sister type to a gentle but mischievous older-sister type, each character brings her own personality, speaking style, and emotional expressions.

Find your favorite companion and begin an adventure that's uniquely yours!

🎙️ Expressive Voices and Multilingual Support

Orangie supports conversations in English, Japanese, and Chinese.

With expressive voice performances, her emotions come to life — from excited cheers and nervous whispers to playful teasing and shy, affectionate moments.

💛 More Than a Desktop Pet. A True Adventure Companion.

Maybe she'll remember that one boss you struggled against for hours.

Maybe she'll bring up an old memory when a familiar character finally returns.

She'll celebrate your victories, share your emotional moments, and sometimes giggle when things don't go quite as planned.

Invite Orangie onto your desktop!

Your next adventure doesn't have to be a solo journey anymore! ฅ(＾・ω・＾ฅ)

3D Model Credits

Original 3D Character Model: Manuka (マヌカ)

Model Creator: ©ジンゴ (STUDIO JINGO)

The character model is used under the creator's licensing terms. All original model rights remain with their respective owner.

data.name: Descent Horizon
data.detailed_description:
Descent Horizon is a 2D physics-based lunar descent and exploration game about piloting a damaged lander, surviving on the surface, and uncovering what went wrong after a catastrophic station explosion.

You are Commander Jackson Middlewood, thrown from orbit after Sagan Station is torn apart. The lander is damaged, autopilot is gone, and the only way down is manual control.

Survive the descent. Touch down safely. Step out onto the lunar surface to search for parts, investigate abandoned infrastructure, and repair what you can.

Then you black out.

You wake mid-fall, descending toward the Moon again.

Then it happens again.

And again.

Systems fail in new ways. Hazards shift. The terrain changes. But the world remembers what came before: debris stays moved, doors remain open, and equipment carries forward between descents.

Something is deeply wrong, and every landing brings you closer to understanding what happened.

Key Features

Manual Lunar Descent

Pilot a fragile low-gravity lander where thrust, rotation, momentum, cargo weight, and landing angle all matter. Recover from crashes, repair damaged systems, and adapt to changing conditions across successive descents onto the lunar surface.

On-Foot EVA Exploration

Leave the lander after touchdown to investigate abandoned facilities, retrieve components, and uncover traces of past activity on the Moon.

LIDAR Terrain Scanning

Use directional scans to read the terrain ahead, locate hazards, search for landing zones, and navigate without a traditional map.

Terminal-Based Systems 

Run diagnostics, issue commands, read corrupted logs, and respond to in-flight malfunctions through a diegetic command-line interface.

Repairs, Cargo, and Upgrades

Collected parts affect what you can repair, what you can build, and how the lander handles on future descents.

Environmental Puzzles

Restore power, unlock sealed paths, move physical tools, and route your way through broken lunar infrastructure.

Atmospheric Storytelling 

Piece together what caused the explosion — and what’s keeping you trapped — through corrupted logs, cryptic terminals, and the unsettling silence of the lunar surface.

Every loop brings you closer to the truth.

data.name: Stories In Stone
data.detailed_description:
An RPG about a tribe exploring an ancient world. Forge a bond with your wolf and help your tribe survive!
You must settle in a new land, so collect resources, train with your master, and grow stronger by learning powerful skills!!



For those just looking to experience the story, there are 2 distinct modes.

  • Full rpg experience with combat (10-18 hours), or…
  • “Adventure Mode” (4-6 hours), which removes the element of combat and strategy,
    but leaves the story, puzzles, and exploration to enjoy!

    Key Features/Mechanics

    • A cave painting come to life!

    • Most progression comes from exploration, find items to raise your stats. Some of the best skills require items to learn too, so choose wisely!
    • Heal in between battles by eating/hunting the small animals such as bats, squirrels, and lizards. Also recovers SP used for many skills, so you can keep on moving. Just make sure to have enough stamina in order to DASH.
    • Many skills push or pull enemies. This changes what skills they can use in battle as well as some stats. Line them up strategically to hit multiple enemies with a single attack!
    • Timed button presses are needed for some skills, so stay on your toes!


    • Open progression system:
    • Animals in your party can be upgraded by finding items. Their HP and SP will go up with each level but the other stats are up to you!
    • Choose many new skills to learn with EV points, even from the start! Create some powerful synergies with your team!

    • Puzzles and variety in every area:
    • Use clues in your journal to solve various puzzles. Or just figure them out on your own… maybe…
    • Use various plants in the environment to refill stamina instantly, see hidden tracks, or gain temporary power

    • 2 versions; one for RPG veterans and one for those who just want to experience the story
    • 10-18 hours to complete the game in the normal version

    Developer Profile:



    I am a therapist in Santa Ana, California. I currently live with my wife, two cats, and one dog.
    This is my second game so far. I’m a life-long gamer, (growing up with two brothers, we played a ton of different games) and an RPG lover. I worked on this by myself, but had input from testers, family, and friends. Big thanks to the creators of many useful plugins too!

    So you know where some of my influences come from, some of my favorite games are; Castlevania, Mario RPG, Panzer Dragoon Saga, Smash Bros., ‘Tales of’ games, Zelda, and Albert Odyssey.

data.name: I Can See You
data.detailed_description:
I Can See You plunges you into a bone-chilling first-person horror experience, meticulously woven from real accounts of home invasions in America's remote locales. This game is not just a journey, but an ordeal where every shadow whispers danger.


Key Features:



  • State-of-the-Art Graphics: Powered by the advanced Lumen and Nanite technologies, the game delivers ultra-realistic AAA visuals that make every moment intensely lifelike.
  • Immersive UI Design: We've embraced a minimalist, modern, and clean user interface, emphasizing a seamless blend of gameplay and realism.
  • Narrative Through Environment: The story unravels through the setting itself - explore and interact with your surroundings to uncover the haunting tale that lies within.
  • Intense Horror Experience: Simulating the terror of a home invasion, this game is a test of nerves - hide, strategize, and when necessary, confront your unseen enemy.
  • Survival Strategy: You are prey in this game, and survival means thinking fast. Your choices are limited and critical, so every move counts.
  • ]Global Accessibility: Supporting multiple languages including English, German, Portuguese, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, and Russian, to welcome players from across the globe.



"I Can See You" is more than a game; it's an exercise in survival, a challenge to your senses and your wit. Do you have what it takes to survive?

data.name: Freaky Trip
data.detailed_description:
Our other games




About the Game


Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself. In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.





(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.



FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…



CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second.


KEY FEATURES:
  • Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
  • 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
  • Entertaining characters and locations
  • Exciting soundtrack

data.name: 山：临界幸存者
data.detailed_description:
加入风域大家庭！


About the Game

这是一款结合中国民俗、祭祀禁忌与连环死亡事件的文字冒险游戏。

为寻找失踪的妹妹，你踏入被群山包围的村庄，却意外卷入神秘古老的仪式『仙姑宴』。

真相在夜色中渐渐显形，一场漫长而恐怖的杀戮剧正在悄然上演……

有任何建议、想法、吐槽、BUG反馈，欢迎来群里一起聊~

QQ群号：578895381

为了寻找失踪的妹妹，我来到深山中的村庄。

此时，这里正举行着三年一度的崇神仪式『仙姑宴』。

然而今年的祭祀并不平静，村中出现了一连串的死亡事件。

难道说这是『血目仙姑』的诅咒吗？

究竟是谁带走了我的妹妹，是谁打破了祭祀的禁忌。

又是谁，拉开了那漫长杀戮剧的帷幕……

《说文·巫部》：巫，祝也。女，能事无形，以舞降神者也。

封闭的偏僻山村、神秘的祭祀仪式、恐怖的杀人事件、暗流涌动的人际关系……

这是一款以中国本土民俗祭祀为主题的悬疑文字冒险游戏。玩家扮演的主角为了寻找失踪的妹妹，意外被卷入到村中发生的连环杀人事件当中。

面对无处不在的危机与杀意，你能够最终找到自己的妹妹，带领大家活着离开吗？

30万字剧本，全台词配音，为期10天的惊悚之旅

超过20名角色立绘，超过50张CG

4名女主角，根据您的选择累积各自的缘分，将会迎来不同的结局（周目）

“这村子不是你们该来的地方。”

八房台村的巫祝之一，性格淡漠，善于思考，同时也有着温柔细心的一面。

跟村子里的其他人相比，礼凛的见闻和知识面似乎更广一些，是有什么特别的原因吗？

“请问……是父亲的客人吗？”

八房台村的巫祝之一，从小在孤儿院长大，现被苏家收养。

比任何人都渴望家人与亲情的她，为了获得苏家人的认可而一直在笨拙而坚定地努力着。

因此当她被委以巫祝的重任时，她愿意不惜一切代价把这个工作做到最好。

“哟呵，这点困难可难不倒我哦~”

辽海市中学的高二生。性格开朗，天然活泼的女孩，不论何时总是活力四射，似乎总是有着无穷无尽的精力。事实上，她也是正儿八经的空手道黑带。

为了看望受伤的朋友而来到八房台，对她来说这将注定是个终身难忘的暑假。

“你受伤了吗？让我看看。”

章江市第一人民医院的实习医生，心地善良，责任感强，擅长照顾人。

虽然平时看上去有些唯唯诺诺，可一旦触碰到自己的底线就会变得很强势。

她跟随自己的老师一起来到八房台为村民诊疗，这偏僻陌生的环境似乎让她有些忐忑不安。

data.name: Devils' Night Party
data.detailed_description:
◆Features


◇The HCGs range from being penetrated by humans and orcs to being violated by tentacles, plants and fleshy tails.
◇Battle scenes will gradually change according to the enemy's attacks
◇The main character, Natsuno Yamazakura (V.A.: Izumi Mikoshiba), is fully voiced during the battle!
◇Easy to use system including fast forward animation

◆Game Description


This is a typical RPG where you can level up, save money and buy new equipment. The system is very simple. You can use recovery items directly from the item bar on the map…etc.
The enemies are stronger, and the game requires less fighting because the main enjoyment is the sex scenes when you lose.

The game is designed to be very friendly, with enemies in a basic touch-and-fight mode, so you must touch them to start a fight, or you can avoid them carefully.
However, if you start a fight accidentally, there is a high chance that you will lose…And you will watch the great sex scenes!

In battle, the target is constantly being sexually harassed and exhibits different stances.
As the pleasure level increases with sex attacks, the damage taken increases and your HP drops more easily.

When your HP hits 0, you will be penetrated and creampied, but your HP and NP will be restored.
The game will end when your womb is full of semen.

Come and enjoy a great battle show!

◆Operation Instructions


◇Basic Operation:
Arrows and character movement (can be diagonal): arrow keys, left click, WASD keys.
Decision: Z key, Enter key, left click, space bar.
Cancel: X key, right click.

◇Map:
Display menus and status: X key or right click in the map scenes.
You can also adjust the volume and select the difficulty level from the menu options.

You can use the crystals in the village and dungeon to set the sex scenes in battle and other related settings.

◇Story fast forward: Enter key, left click and hold.

◇Using items on the map:
The order of the item icons displayed at the bottom left of the screen corresponds to the order of the numeric keys above the text keys, so you can use the items directly by clicking on the numeric keys.
You can also use these items directly by clicking on them with your mouse.

If you are using the numeric keypad to move your character, please use the 2468 keys.

◇Conversation:
To hide or show the conversation window: During a conversation, press the shift key or right-click.
Please note that if you hide the window, the conversation will not continue until you click the conversation window open again.

Dialogue fast forward: Press and hold the Enter key, left click.
Dialogue super fast forward: PageDown



◇Battle scenes:
If you cancel immediately after entering a battle, you will get the enemy's icon and the escape button.
To return to the battle, select 'Battle' at the top.

◇Select an attack target:
Instead of selecting an enemy by clicking directly with the mouse, select the enemy's name displayed in the bottom left corner.
Fast forward: During battle, press shift or click on the note symbol in the top left corner to fast forward the animation.

data.name: Elohim Eternal II: Son of Man
data.detailed_description:
Play the role of Judas Kerioth, a Shemerian oppressed by the corrupt Pleroman government. Since the Time of Tribulation, Judas has longed to join the zealots, a rebel group now in hiding. But when the Pleromans arrest his childhood friend, Lena, on trumped-up charges, he’ll do anything to save her—even face off against the archons, mutated monsters with unimaginable power.

 

In the first Elohim Eternal, players explored the world of Idin. In Elohim Eternal II: Son of Man, they will venture across the second planet in the kosmeos, Kenoma, a highly advanced, cyberpunk-inspired world on the brink of civil war. Kenoma and its legends draw inspiration from Judaism, Christianity, and Gnosticism.

 

Equip a myriad of guns, all with their own abilities, stats, and perks. Mix and match guns to gain a tactical advantage over enemies in fast-paced turn-based combat. 

 

Pilot an azar, a huge mecha, in your fight against the Pleromans. Challenge the azar arena and reap the rewards.

 

The game is approximately 15 hours long. While not required, completing Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code is recommended for a fuller experience. Unlike video game series, the Elohim Eternal series follows an overarching plot; however, each game in the series does present its own complete story. The game also features a "What Comes Before" feature so you can learn what occurred in games preceding this one.

data.name: BISQUE DOLL
data.detailed_description:
Developed by 1 guy, our aim was to give life to the famous Hong Kong urban legend.

BISQUE DOLL is a short game. The game is about 40min-60min long. Though this game has two endings.
This game contains disturbing scenes.
Please note that this game is not a typical horror game, but a horror-themed adventure game.

Key Features:
  • Survival horror: BISQUE DOLL will constantly try and hunt you while you explore.
  • Save system: You can save your progress manually.
  • Immersive experience: An atmospheric, realistic graphics intensifies the experience.
  • Hong Kong horror-themed adventure: Hong Kong horror film inspired environment and mood.
  • Two Endings: There are good and bad.

BISQUE DOLL is a Hong Kong urban legend
About a year ago
My mother bought a pair of bisque dolls
That's for my sister's room decoration
My grandma told me since I was young
When you put away the bisque doll
Don't keep her in a dark corner
Or in the cabinet that nobody cares about
All in all, don’t ignore him, care about him
Otherwise something will happen at home

data.name: BATTROPICA
data.detailed_description:
Treasure at sea, pleasure by night.


Ten billion gold in debt. Your ship seized. All you have left is a battered duck pedal boat!?

Pirate Mia agreed to guarantee a loan for the former captain who taught her life at sea. Now Madame Viola wants her money back!

BATTROPICA is a single-player action adventure about earning, fighting and having fun across tropical islands. Hunt treasure, take jobs, adventure with your crew and enjoy a few nighttime detours as you work toward repaying ten billion gold. There is no interest and no deadline. How you earn, what you spend and when you repay are up to you.

Turn small earnings into a fortune


Start at the harbor job board with deliveries and sorting the day's catch. Explore islands, complete requests, battle monsters and play minigames to earn more gold.

Make discoveries, help people, finish jobs and repay your debt to build fame. Higher fame ranks multiply your earnings and unlock new ships and activities. Buy stakes in shops for daily takings, and let crew members earn gold while they are not adventuring with you.

From a duck boat to the open sea


Begin with a duck boat in the harbor, then work your way through a rowboat and pirate ships to a mighty galleon. Earn the fame and gold to buy bigger ships, cross rougher seas and reach more distant islands.

Explore forests, ruins and shipwrecks, and equip diving gear to venture beneath the waves. Discover treasures with names and stories of their own. Display them on shelves at home or turn them into gold at a pawnshop.

Action battles with your crew


Shoot, use skills and dodge in real-time action battles. Recruit friends you meet on the islands and bring their abilities into fights against giant monsters and pirates. Evade a powerful attack, strike back and bring home the treasure and rewards.

Earn your gold, then enjoy a little flirty fun


Hit the beach in a swimsuit, relax in a hot spring or chat around a campfire at night. Compete in minigames, visit nightlife spots and make time for a crew full of personality.

Lively encounters and suggestive mishaps await mischievous Mia. Gold spent on nighttime fun also builds fame, giving your next payday a boost.

Keep sailing after the debt is paid


Shady offers and brazen crimes can get you arrested and sent to a prison island. Choices and mishaps may also lead to unexpected BAD ENDs. Events and endings unfold in 3D character scenes.

Repaying ten billion gold is a milestone in your adventure. Afterward, keep hunting treasure, spending time with your crew and enjoying the tropical seas at your own pace.

data.name: Corridors
data.detailed_description:
Corridors is a lightweight well optimised shooter game. No dependencies needed. The game is read only apart from local profiles and scores. No internet is required to play.

The objective is simple, collect enough gems to complete your run.

Choose from five difficulty modes. Peaceful, Beginner, Medium, Hard, and Insane. Or push your skills to the limit with custom modifiers and Ironman mode.

Monsters will come at you in most game modes other than peaceful mode. You start with a handgun and a shotgun but other rarer weapons can be found, including automatic, rocket launcher and grenades. There are hidden portals which lead to secret side rooms. There are different rarity of gems, buffs, and debuffs.

Explore Your Computer in a number of ways

You can compete for high scores on the global leaderboards in the preset CorridorWorld.

Corridors also allows you to play within the folders and files of your own PC. The project began as a unique, intuitive file and media explorer with full support for images, music, and video playback. That functionality remains fully intact as an option in-game, where you can play through your own folders and files, optionally in peaceful mode if you just want to use Corridors as a file explorer.

It's a seamless way to turn your own data into a real exploration of corridors, doors and files hanging on the walls. You can view your media, photos, videos, and listen to your music, all in real time as you walk through the corridors. Navigation is simple, a green door at the start of each corridor for parent folder. Doors within the corridor for subfolders.

Choose which folder you want to open from in options. There are settings for customisation of how the game appears and we will review feedback for more that you think should be added. Font, shadows, particles, scaling, and more.

Corridor colours can be customised, or you can play with one of the presets.


There are also quite a number of 'other places' for your entertainment. These are not the main game (which is where you can get high scores), but these other places allow you to explore your own PC in other settings. One is an art gallery, one is an old cinema, one is a sort of city you can walk or fly around and enter buildings in.




All gameplay locations are procedurally generated with C and raylib and all photos and videos in the packaged CorridorWorld are either personal photos or open sourced photos (CC0) photos from the web.

All music in the game is by the legendary Kevin MacLeod, with different tracks for different game modes.

Trailer music: Exit the Premises" by Kevin MacLeod , CC BY 4.0.

data.name: Castle Daybreak
data.detailed_description:
About Castle Daybreak

Castle Daybreak is an indie single-player class-based Action RPG; set in a medieval world on the verge of being overrun by an unrelenting evil.

Unlock powerful and unique abilities for your class! Mix and match Perks and weapons to build the perfect build while climbing through the levels and defeating all the enemies that stand in your way.

Class-Based

Choose one of five unique classes to start your adventure, each with their own unique set of abilities. Play as the Rogue, an agile fighter that can quickly dart around the battlefield in an instant. The Guardian brings the heat with destructive AOE abilities and charming little fox for companionship. The Duelist lives for melee combat and specializes in up close and personal conflict resolution. The Vanguard has a wide assortment of abilities, most of which focuses on de-buffing the enemy and staying alive. The Healer, possessing an understanding of healing and medicine, also comprehends the techniques of virulence. The Exalted is the sixth class that is only available after completing a specific achievement in game. This class prioritizes using numerous companions alongside mind-controlling abilities to decimate their foes.

Open World

Explore the Island of Victoris, a once prosperous island that was destroyed by greed and corruption, shortly followed by a catastrophic event that left the island forever changed.

Explore and grow your power by capturing enemy fortifications, participating in random events scattered through most of the island. Delve into dungeons and reclaim epic loot that will aide in battle.

Instanced Dungeons

Dungeons are a great way to level up and find new gear and weapons.

data.name: Little Witch Academia: VR Broom Racing
data.detailed_description:
Take to the skies on a magic broom!


Become a guest student at a magic academy and take on all sorts of high-flying missions in this VR racing game based on the hit anime Little Witch Academia!

Race other students on flying brooms!


Form a tag team with another student and take advantage of the magic items on the courses to snag first place!

Purify the Stardust Ghosts!


There's not just racing, but shooting action, too! Work with a partner character to purify the ghosts in ghost hunt levels!

Customize your broom!


Use the points and tickets you gain from missions to buy new brooms and their power-up items, Broom Stars! Make your very own broom for hunts and races!

Enjoy the skies with Free Flight!

Fly around the skies of Luna Nova Witchcraft Academy at your leisure with other players on online multiplayer, unlocked after you finish Stage 4!


Each mission is accompanied by an original story! Enjoy interacting with the characters as you aim to complete your missions!

data.name: Apostle
data.detailed_description:
One night in the year 2015, the moon turned the color of blood. Monsters began to appear, slaughtering and devouring people. These monsters became known as "Magna".

In a final act of desperation to destroy the Magna threat, humans turned to their last resort... nuclear weapons. This day became humanity's "Day of Judgement".

50 years pass with no sign of the Magna, and the fear that once gripped the world has faded into a distant memory.

However, that veil of peace is about to end...

Features

  • Classic RPG experience

  • Explore a near-futuristic world

  • Engaging plot

  • Skill learning system

  • Sidequests

  • Special character events

Welcome to PARANORMAL GIRLFRIEND, a visual novel with elements of 3D investigation, a mystical atmosphere and a gripping plot.
Takashi, a writer, a man who rarely leaves his house without opening the curtains, discovers that he has a girl in his apartment! He doesn't know who she is or how she got there. Maybe he's already going crazy, or maybe it's worse than that...
Enter the mysterious world of PARANORMAL GIRLFRIEND and enjoy a thrilling story full of mystery and enigma.
You will have to explore 3D locations, make choices, interact with the objects of the environment.

Features:
- About an hour of main story;
- 8 endings. (2 of which are secret);
- Achievements in Steam;

data.name: Train Trek
data.detailed_description:
Wake the last train in a steampunk world that needs you.

A lone survivor stirs among the relics of a fallen age of brass and steam. With a single strange relic, you fire the boiler of the world's last war-train — and roll out across a vast, wondrous frontier, drawn ever forward by a mystery only the rails can answer.

Train Trek is tower defense on rails — a genre-blend of train-building, real-time combat, and survival. Build your armored locomotive car by car, bristle it with turrets, feed it off the land as you roll, and hold the line against everything the frontier throws at you.

Build Your War-Train

Your train is your tank, your factory, and your home. Assemble a consist from the rails up — locomotive, tenders, and railcars — and bolt on turrets to every socket.

  • Modular consists — couple and re-couple cars; every car pulls its weight in the train-wide economy.

  • Deep arsenal — cannons, throwers, harpoons, tractor beams, repair menders, and orbital strikes, each with distinct ammo archetypes, ricochet, and lofted fire.

  • Upgrade & specialize — tier up turrets and cars to match the threats ahead.

Tower Defense on the Move

Place your turrets, choose your ammo, and read the battlefield — then defend a train that never stops rolling. Waves of roaming raiders and entrenched fortresses test every gap in your loadout, so position, range, and firing arcs matter as much as raw firepower.

  • Roaming wanderers hunt your consist across the rails.

  • Stationary fortresses bristle with turrets and must be broken or bypassed.

  • Faction warfare — friend or foe is decided by allegiance, not just color.

A Living World

Every map is a hand-tuned, procedurally-built world of 17 biomes — grasslands, deserts, ice fields, crystal caverns, volcanic flats, and stranger places still — under a full day/night cycle and a creeping fog of war.

Feed the Machine

Keep the fires burning. Harvest Water, Fuel, Metal, Plasma, and Energy from deposits scattered across the land — on the move — and keep the economy of your whole consist flowing. Manage your resources or grind to a halt in enemy country.

Take the Map

The frontier is dotted with depots, factories, and settlements. Capture neutral towns to expand your reach, seize enemy strongholds, then fortify what you hold with turrets of your own and defend it against the waves that come to take it back.

A Journey in Chapters

Follow the Survivor through a hand-authored campaign of dozens of missions, each mile tested by a creeping ruin — and scored by an adaptive orchestral soundtrack that shifts with the moment. What drives the world, and where the rails truly lead, is yours to uncover.

Built to Run

A stylized, low-poly world of gleaming brass and blackened iron — designed to look sharp and run smoothly on modest hardware.

Multiplayer co-op and PvP for 2–8 players are available in Early Access, please try them out and provide feedback!

data.name: Samuel Sage: The Mystery at Penby Inn
data.detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling murder mystery at the Penby Inn! A luxurious hotel set in the endearing English countryside, Penby Inn is coming under a lot of fire (literally) from mind-boggling mishaps, ghoulish noises, rumours of hauntings and gruesome murder!

To add to the confusion, the rich new owner Samuel Sage, who has conveniently inherited the hotel, is completely clueless about the incendiary incidents, the drama ensuing behind its glamourous doors and the dark secrets it holds!

Will Samuel triumph over the increasingly insurmountable odds, or will he succumb to defeat? Will he shatter under the weight of the heavy burden, or will the sweet refuge of a budding romance see him through the turmoil?

During the course of the game, you will play as Samuel Sage and talk to customers, contractors, and employees of the hotel. You will visit locations in the hotel, examine reports of strange phenomena, collect artefacts, and gather evidence to help unravel the events that have plagued the hotel.

You will also examine computer logs and CCTV footage to gather evidence that can exonerate an innocent person accused of murder and determine the identity of the real criminal and motives behind the crime. To take your mind off the grave and increasingly mysterious incidents, you will indulge in a bit of spirited romance!

The game is a visual novel and comes with convenient features such as a log for re-examining saved evidence and studying artefacts gathered during exploration of the hotel.

Notes:

  • The game is available in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.

  • Support for Spanish and Russian will be added in the coming months.

  • Visit our discord server for tips on completing some of the exploration sections of the game.

data.name: TAG WAR VR
data.detailed_description:
TAG WAR is a team-based multiplayer VR game which is about “Scanner and Barcode”.
Player using VR controller to control the scanner in game.
Scanning the barcode on item to get it, and scan the barcode on enemy to defeat him.
Whenever you scan a barcode a payment will add to your team’s bill.
When a match is over the team with higher expenses win.

All about Fun
This is a VR game that wish you to have fun with your friends.
You must be tired of a bunch of zombie games. Right?
TAG WAR is a VR game just simple, silly but fun.

Get Closer
With the 50cm limit range of the scanner. We want to bring players closer.
Just like playing tag in your childhood. Closer always mean more exciting.

Be Creative with Customization
Different Skin - Paint your body whatever you like in VR. You can be everyone.
Different Look - Use emoticon to express yourself. Be happy, sad or even fxck face "literally".
Different Gameplay - Change the position of your barcode. Which will change your gameplay style completely.

data.name: ChickenScratch: Cluck & Code
data.detailed_description:
You don't steer the chicken.

There is no movement key. There is a terminal, a text editor, and a bird standing in a field waiting to be told what to do. You write a script, you press run, and you watch it work, or watch it walk into a hedge forty times while you read your own logic back and realise what you actually said.

var loot = Scanner.get_visible_drops()

if loot.size() > 0:

Chicken.move_east()

Chicken.pick_up()

That is the whole game. Everything else is pressure on it.

The language is real, and it is one you already know

ChickenScratch is syntactically identical to GDScript: significant indentation, var and func, if / elif / else, for and while, Arrays and Dictionaries, integers that stay integers. Not a visual scripting toy, not a fake language with three verbs. It compiles to bytecode and runs on its own virtual machine, one instruction at a time, so you can watch the line your chicken is on.

If you have written code before, you will be productive in about ninety seconds. If you haven't, the game is built to teach you in the order the world makes you need things.

Upgrades are syntax

There is no damage percentage to buy. The shop sells language.

  • Conditional Evaluation Node, 50 Corn. Now you have if.

  • Iterative Processing Core, 50 Worms. Now you have while and for.

  • Linear Memory Arrays, 100 Berries. Now you can hold a list of what you found.

  • Associative Memory Lattice, 350 Corn. Now you can remember where you have been.

  • Cartographic Compass, 500 Corn. Now you know where you are.

With nothing bought, your best script is a straight line of move_west() calls. That works, because a blocked step only costs you the step, and with no if in your script there is nothing listening for the failure anyway. Nine trips of that buys you the ability to ask a question. The curve is the ladder from "walk in a fixed direction and hope" to a real breadth-first search, and every rung is paid for by the last one.

The first two purchases are priced in different currencies on purpose, so you cannot farm one field and skip the other's lesson.

The world reseeds, so you cannot cheat

Every time your chicken walks back into the coop, all twenty-five zones regenerate. Layouts, drops, resources, where the crab is standing. All of it.

What a zone is never changes. The Corn Rows are always corn rows. But the route through them is new, which means a script that writes down coordinates works exactly once. The game ships one seed script, hardcoded_trap.scratch, that exists purely to prove this to you.

Searching is the skill. The upgrades are what let you search better.

It is a whole fake operating system

The Coop is a desktop, and the terminal is the interface, not a menu with a terminal in it. Everything is a command.

  • ls, cd, cat, cp, mv, grep, more and less, with pipes and && and ; chaining

  • vim inside the terminal, with modes, operators, motions, visual mode, / search and :%s/a/b/g with a live preview. There is a plain editor window too, if you would rather

  • man is the in-game compendium: the language, the API, the mechanics, and a bestiary that fills in as your chicken meets things

  • shop, stats, resizable translucent windows, a settings panel, and an inbox

Nobody explains the game to you in a tooltip. Your gran explains it, by email, because she left you the farm.

Errors are the game

When your script does something impossible, it does not fail silently and it does not throw an engine error at you. It tells you what you asked for and what was actually there:

[quote]line 8: There's no `x` in that. It has: type, position, health.[/quote]

A blocked move returns false rather than stopping. That is information, and it is how a good script finds a gap in a hedge without ever being told where the gap is. A move you cannot make names the tool or the equipment you are missing. Every refusal is a hint.

Two clean hits from a crab ends a run, and everything your chicken was carrying is gone. What you already banked is safe. The only question a run really asks is: one more field, or go home now?

Every zone teaches one thing

  • The Corn Rows. You cannot walk straight at anything. There is a crab in here, it hunts you, and it is greedy about which direction it closes in on, which means a row of corn genuinely shelters you if you notice.

  • The Turned Earth. The worms crawl. A position you read at the top of a loop is already wrong. Mud slows you and swallows what falls in it.

  • The Windbreak. One hedge, two gaps. Which gap is nearer depends on where you are, so it is a question rather than a route.

  • The Millpond Shallows. Water, while it is still free to look at. Nothing here pays you until you own a tool.

  • The Dry Stone Wall. A real maze, one tile wide, solid by default. Follow a wall and you will get out. One section of it can be broken open, permanently, if you bought the Pick.

A five-by-five map, twenty-five zones, with the coop at the centre. Further out: ore seams, bogs that need equipment, packs that need a weapon, and corners designed as the endgame economy.

Also

Two terminals can run two scripts at once: a long collection loop in one while you check your inventory in the other. They share the same bird, so two scripts that both issue moves will fight over it. That is your problem to notice. The world never stops: the crab keeps patrolling while you sit and read your code. Thinking is free, so a script that measures six distances before it moves is not punished for being legible. And there is no instruction limit, so a loop that runs until you stop it is a perfectly reasonable thing to write.

There is no movement key. There is a terminal, a text editor, and a bird standing in a field waiting to be told what to do. You write a script, you press run, and you watch it work, or watch it walk into a hedge forty times while you read your own logic back and realise what you actually said.

var loot = Scanner.get_visible_drops()

if loot.size() > 0:

Chicken.move_east()

Chicken.pick_up()

That is the whole game. Everything else is pressure on it.

The language is real, and it is one you already know

ChickenScratch is syntactically identical to GDScript: significant indentation, var and func, if / elif / else, for and while, Arrays and Dictionaries, integers that stay integers. Not a visual scripting toy, not a fake language with three verbs. It compiles to bytecode and runs on its own virtual machine, one instruction at a time, so you can watch the line your chicken is on.

If you have written code before, you will be productive in about ninety seconds. If you haven't, the game is built to teach you in the order the world makes you need things.

Upgrades are syntax

There is no damage percentage to buy. The shop sells language.

  • Conditional Evaluation Node, 50 Corn. Now you have if.

  • Iterative Processing Core, 50 Worms. Now you have while and for.

  • Linear Memory Arrays, 100 Berries. Now you can hold a list of what you found.

  • Associative Memory Lattice, 350 Corn. Now you can remember where you have been.

  • Cartographic Compass, 500 Corn. Now you know where you are.

With nothing bought, your best script is a straight line of move_west() calls. That works, because a blocked step only costs you the step, and with no if in your script there is nothing listening for the failure anyway. Nine trips of that buys you the ability to ask a question. The curve is the ladder from "walk in a fixed direction and hope" to a real breadth-first search, and every rung is paid for by the last one.

The first two purchases are priced in different currencies on purpose, so you cannot farm one field and skip the other's lesson.

Every time your chicken walks back into the coop, all twenty-five zones regenerate. Layouts, drops, resources, where the crab is standing. All of it.

Searching is the skill. The upgrades are what let you search better.

  • man is the in-game compendium: the language, the API, the mechanics, and a bestiary that fills in as your chicken meets things

  • shop, stats, resizable translucent windows, a settings panel, and an inbox

data.name: BIO SIN
data.detailed_description:
The world has ended.

And yet, not even that was enough to erase the horrors of runaway bioengineering: like shards of biological shrapnel, their effects haunt the children of the Armageddon to this very day.
With the knowledge that any day can be their last as men before losing themselves to a sickness they cannot predict nor resist, today's survivors live like wolves, imposing their will on the world through the law of the strongest, no future in sight, only a brutal but honest way of life.
But someone, somewhere, yearns for an existence greater than this primitive state of being, for to them men weren't made to live like brutes but to pursue virtue.
Let the chips fall where they may or catch their fall: the rights and duties of the Old World no longer applying, the only thing you need to realize your vision is your will.

Key Features:

  • Delve into the depths of the broken world the Armageddon left behind, explore the treacherous Santa Regina wasteland through a set of handcrafted levels;

  • Create your very own custom character, with a variety of races and apparel to choose from;

  • Battle Apolidea's fearsome foes, from merciless bandits to runaway bioengineering's most abominable spawns;

  • Increase your odds of survival by taking full advantage of Apolidea's arsenal: pistols, shotguns, assault rifles... There's no shortage of variety to dispense death;

  • Meet the people of Apolidea, make friends and enemies among the few saints and many sinners of the wastes.

data.name: What Every Man Wants
data.detailed_description:
After watching 1000+ anime I decided to make a game. A game that speaks to the men who are looking for happiness.

This game is about daily life of a normal guy who wants to be happy in life. But who are truly happy in life? Very few people in this world. This is pretty much relatable to most guys out there trying to live a life. You might find some similarities with your own life too.

It has a single Japanese female character fully voiced in Japanese
So if you are an anime fan or skilled enough to understand Japanese voice lines then you will find it more interesting. If you dont understand Japanese then don't worry you will be able to read the subtitles in English like every Anime fan does.

Game will be around 2 hours long depending on your playstyle. The story might seem slow paced or fast paced time to time and ending might seem too sudden but no this is not a half heartedly made game. The ending was decided before even the game development started. So how you like the games story will depend on your mindset.

To avoid spoilers I have not included the character. Because just like anime, if its spoiled then we loose excitement.

I just wanted to make a game for a long time but I don't have skills in coding or art or most of anything  so I decided to do make a visual novel game as it was a bit easier to do. I do hope you enjoy the game.

data.name: Dream Cycle
data.detailed_description:
Enter the world of Dream Cycle, a fully procedural action adventure by Lara Croft’s creator Toby Gard. Take the role of modern-day arcanist Morgan Carter and walk the planes of the Dreamlands, a twisted dimension where the souls of the living are trapped in eternal nightmare. Explore diverse dreams, and by understanding the events that transpired, free the dreamers from their perpetual torment. Using a wide variety of weapons from traditional to modern day, and a grimoire full of powerful spells, define your own play style as you plumb the depths of the infinite dreamlands.

Main Gameplay Features

  • A Harrowing Narrative Adventure
    Designed by veteran game developer Toby Gard, Dream Cycle is heavily inspired by Lovecraftian cosmic horror. You play as Morgan Carter, a modern-day sorceress trapped in a mysterious alternate reality. With her life fading in the waking world, Morgan must free her friend and as many others as she can from the Dreamlands before the Crawling Chaos dooms them all.

  • A Dynamic, Adaptive Style of Gameplay
    With plenty of weapons, abilities, and powers at your disposal, Dream Cycle lets you truly define the way you play. Pick your favorite weapon, master the arcane, exploit your enemies’ weaknesses and find the best approach to each encounter - whether it’s full-force front assaults or silent but deadly incursions. Vanquish your foes, expand your knowledge, and invest in new skills and abilities that will help you shape the game into a unique experience.

  • An Immersive World to Explore
    Follow the footsteps of Randolph Carter and Basil Elton across the vast and mysterious Dreamlands. Climb the forbidden peak of Hatheg-Kla in the stony desert, carve your way through the Perfumed Jungles of Kled, and discover forgotten palaces with veined ivory columns that sleep lovely and unbroken under the moon. Fight hideous Ghouls and vast lumbering Gugs, meet exotic tribes, and visit a wide variety of biomes steeped in the lore of the Dreamlands.

  • A Shifting, Endless Experience
    An unstable realm made up of fragments of the real world, the dreamlands will change every time you visit: roll the dice and watch as the world in front of you reshapes itself. Go back to places you had already explored and face new challenges and new stories for even greater rewards. Dream Cycle is professionally voice-acted and features a completely original soundtrack by the original Tomb Raider composer Nathan McRee that further adds to the game’s uniqueness.

data.name: Circle of Bosses
data.detailed_description:
Circle of Bosses is a unique game that provides the complex mechanics of MMORPG Bosses but on a singleplayer offline experience. It's a realtime tactics game with a top-down view where the player assumes the role of a guild leader that can give instructions to AI characters.

A group of thieves and wrongdoers manages to escape from prison and decide to form a guild. These antiheroes realize they can create a war within and set foot to kill and loot the most powerful bosses in the land, moreover to even seek vengeance on their old enemies.

You play the role of guild leader and you will define the best strategies to defeat bosses, manage gear and equipment for all the raiders.

Fight challenging bosses and get better gear for your raid!

Bosses will have many mechanics and different phases through out an encounter. Each boss is completely unique and provides a challenge completely different from the previous ones and with 50+ bosses expected on the full release of the game you can expect an array of many tactical choices that can rival some of the best MMO raiding encounters like WoW and FF14!

There will be 8 antiheroes in total that you'll be able to pick and add to your parties. Each raider represents a unique class and subclass with its own abilities and chracteristics.

A party can consist of tanks, healers and damage dealers. Defeated bosses will drop loot that you can use to evolve the guild characters.

Altought the focus is the tactical aspect of the game the music will be implemented in an adaptive way and that doesn't feel repetive, encouraging the player to keep listening even when trying to defeat a boss through many runs.

Experience a unique fantasy world depicted in a mix of grunge and painted style scenarios. Comic book influences like halftones and dialogues help give some personality to the wicked characters, while words are used to give life to the environment.

data.name: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War
data.detailed_description:
Gladius Prime was known to Imperial scholars as a planet of archeological interest. During its colonization ancient relics were found, revealing hints of a shrouded past. But it was more than relics. Something awakened, an unspeakable horror from an ancient past, and the citizens of Gladius found themselves trapped in a terrible war for survival.

Gladius Prime was once a planet of peace. Now there is only war.

Warhammer 40,000: Gladius – Relics of War brings you to a world of terror and violence with the first turn-based 4X strategy game set in the Warhammer universe. Face challenging AI or cooperate or compete with friends and strangers across the globe.



Play as one of four iconic Warhammer factions (Astra Militarum, Space Marines, Orks or Necrons), each with their own unique playstyle and technology tree. Explore a randomly generated world filled with special features and threatening wildlife that can crush your troop's morale. Secure control of powerful ancient artefacts to grant you an edge against rival factions.



Construct cities, buildings and fortifications to expand your empire and produce an army to vanquish your foes. Harvest resources and research new technologies to fuel and upgrade your machinery of war.



Progress through a different storyline with each faction as their destiny on Gladius Prime, a world tainted by the warp, unfolds. In the end, when all the dust has settled, only one faction can emerge victorious.



Command a wide array of devastating weaponry, issue city edicts and deploy tactical operations. Recruit hero units that possess distinct special abilities and can be equipped with items, ranging from advanced grenades to mighty relics of the past. As they become more and more powerful with each rank, they turn into true champions of your cause.

data.name: Pawtings! Hidden Dogs
data.detailed_description:
Find the dogs to bring the painting back to color

Every level starts with a painting drained of color. To return a patch of color to the canvas, find a dog in the painting. After you find all hidden dogs, the canvas becomes a finished artwork again, in full color, exactly as you can see it in the museum. There's no energy bar or penalties for wrong clicks.

Dozens of real paintings

Van Gogh, Klimt, Mucha, Fragonard, Bruegel, and many more, all shown as the high-resolution digital images of original works, not redrawn for the game. The name of each painting is revealed as you play, so you might discover an artwork you'd never noticed before.

Thousands of dogs, dozens of breeds

A Corgi asleep in the brushwork, a Dachshund hiding along a shadow, a Great Dane pretending to be a tree trunk, and more.

Steam Workshop

Turn any picture into a level. The dogs hide themselves!

Hunt together or against each other

Up to four players on the same screen or online. Share a canvas and call out what you spot or take your own copy and race until you find the last dog.

The paintings have their own surprises: some can get in your way, others can help.

Light travels across the canvas and the brushwork breathes like oil under gallery light. Rain falls on some paintings, lightning flashes inside them, and now and then the whole canvas temporarily drops to black and white. All the paintings have plenty more tricks up their sleeves.

Search to the sound of classical music

More than sixty recordings, from chamber music and piano to full orchestra. Every painting has its own ambience sounds, from birdsong and rain to crashing waves, and a great deal of very good barking.

Drawn by hand

Every dog and every icon in this game was drawn by hand. The paintings are the exception, and deliberately so. Those are the real thing.

Made to be looked at, not squinted at

  • The whole paw cursor counts as a click, so you don't have to be pixel-perfect to find a dog.

  • If the buffs from the events aren't enough, the hint is always there.

  • A miss is just a miss. There are no setbacks or limits to your clicks.

  • You configure how crowded a painting gets, so the dogs can be hidden somewhere else next time.

  • If you'd like to immerse into the painting with no timers, weather, or pop-ins, switch to a full cozy mode.

The entire game was made by one human and one dog.

data.name: Bressnath
data.detailed_description:
The fen gives nothing back


You arrive with a handful of villagers at a half-drowned holding in the Vreldsath fens, in the years of the Rekindling. Every stand of timber, every stone seam and every fishing pool runs dry, and nothing grows back. Standing still is losing slowly — the only economy is pushing outward, to better ground and worse neighbours.

A town that works the way it looks


  • Everything is carried. Villagers walk to the reed beds, the quarry and the fishing pools and haul every load home. Build close to what you need, or watch your people spend the day walking.
  • Twenty-three buildings, most with upgrade tiers — lumber camps, fen farms, bakehouses, smithies, an eel wharf, a caravan market, a guildhall, watchtowers, barracks and a castle.
  • Food and contentment. Three kinds of food, and a holding that eats well works faster than one living on fish alone.
  • Trade that never pays for itself. The market will sell you anything you are short of — always at a loss.

No warning


Attacks come on a clock you cannot see. No countdown, no arrow pointing where from — you learn the rhythm by playing. Eight families of horrors wake in the Sundered Places scattered across the map, the mild ones close to home and the worst at the far edges. Hold them off with watchtowers, a castle and soldiers you have to feed and house, or march your army out and break the lairs yourself.

Dig, and find out


Ruin-caches lie buried across the fen, under a fog of war that forgets nothing you have seen and shows nothing you have not. What they open is not all written down: much of what unlocks what, you discover.

The wide-crossing way


There is one way to win. Finish the causeway — a raised timber road on driven piles, laid across open water. It is the biggest thing you will ever build, and the fen throws everything it has at you while you build it.

  • A new, huge, generated fen every run.
  • 100 achievements.
  • No meta-progression: every run starts from nothing.
  • Keyboard and mouse. English and Czech.

Set in the world of Orenvalt.

data.name: Mazes and Mages
data.detailed_description:
In Mazes and Mages you have to find your way in random mazes and play card duels against enemies.

Each randomly generated world has 25 levels filled with enemies with random decks.

By defeating enemies and picking up chests you get experience, gold, and cards.

You can edit your deck and add the new cards that you get to make it stronger.

As you gain levels, you get skill points that you can spend on several skills to help you on the duels.

In a duel you use your mage, summons, and spells, to try and defeat the enemy mage.

When you defeat the boss in each level you can progress to the next one, and when you defeat the king in the last level you can generate a new random world to play again.

data.name: Paradise Corner 2
data.detailed_description:
You've restored your garden to its former glory, but a new mystery beckons on the horizon. The legendary Lost Garden— once the jewel of an ancient civilization in the heart of the desert—awaits its time. Local elders warn: if it isn't awakened by the next solstice, the oasis will disappear forever, buried beneath the sands of time.

But you're not alone. Your devoted assistant is always nearby—with their support and your determination, you begin your journey!

Your task is to gradually, step by step, restore life and beauty to the lost garden. Destroy pests by clicking on them to protect the seedlings and allow future harvests to flourish without threats. Plant a variety of crops and ultimately restore the ancient garden to its former glory!

data.name: The Karters 2: Turbo Charged
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for The Karters 2: Turbo Charged, a fast-paced, action-packed racer built for casual chaos and competitive mastery. With intense multiplayer, deep mechanics, and full modding support available from day one, it’s a karting experience with no speed limit and no limits on creativity.

Key Features:

  • Split-Screen (up to 6 players!) with Split-Screen Online Support

  • Ghost Race with an option to download and share ghost data from Leaderboards

  • Steam Workshop support (1500+ mods already - Tracks, Characters and more)

  • Integrated Mod Browsing support directly in the game

  • Online support with dedicated servers

  • Ranked matchmaking support

  • Single-Player Campaign 

  • Global Rankings (Leaderboards, Monthly ELO rankings, All-Time ELO Rankings, Tournaments)

  • 16 official Race Tracks

  • 6 Battle Arenas

  • Team VS Team (online and local)

  • Cups with up to 24 rounds (Team VS Team & Online support)

  • Next Best Ghost option

  • 7 Game Modes ( Race, Time Trial, Duo-Time Trial, Battle without time limit, Elimination, Road Breaker, Quick Cut, more to come!)

We are a small indie studio from Poland with a goal to create the best kart racing game on the platform!

Lead one of five unique rulers, each representing a different class, and craft your deck with powerful cards. Experiment with synergies, fuse units, and create devastating strategies to break the game and crush your foes.

Your kingdom's fate is in your hands. Grow your base, make fusions, pick augments and protect your kingdom. The stronger your kingdom, the tougher the enemies will become. Will you survive the chaos?

data.name: Regnum Idle
data.detailed_description:
About

Raise a Viking army that battles, loots, and grows stronger whether you're playing or not. Upgrade equipment, unlock technologies, defeat legendary bosses, and conquer 1000 levels in this idle auto-battler RPG.

Deploy your Viking army, hit start, and watch them dominate. Grab a coffee while your warriors crush enemies, then restart from level 1 with permanent upgrades to push even further and earn even more XP and equipment!

Victories grant you equipment, XP, and resources to strengthen your forces. Every battle brings you closer to mythical armor and weapons.

Customize every unit with helms, weapons, shields, armor, and relics across 5 rarity tiers. Build the perfect loadout and watch your Vikings transform into gods.

Merge equipment to boost stats and combine powerful abilities. Turn trash loot into treasure.

Every upgrade permanently amplifies your army's power and resource generation.

FEATURES

  • 6 unique Viking classes

  • 200+ enemies

  • 20 legendary bosses

  • 100+ equipments to collect

  • 1000 levels of progression

  • 10+ resources to gather

  • 20+ powerful abilities

  • Infinite upgrades

data.name: Daily Bread
data.detailed_description:
"We keep circling around the same place, and we don't even know why we're fighting. I wonder if we'll ever find out."

how to play:

・Gold bag icon (income commensurate with level).

・Skeleton icon (battle with random enemies, earn money commensurate with your level if you win, pay commensurate with your level if you lose).

・Crossed bone icon (basically the same as the skeleton icon, but the damage dealt is added to your bankroll, and the damage received is subtracted from your bankroll).

- Skeleton and bones icon (when stopped, you will face off against a random player. The loser will pay money to the winner).

- Sword icon (equipment obtained randomly, appearance reflects each player, attack power and defense power also change).

- Medal icon (obtain random experience points appropriate to your level).

・Castle icon (buys a castle when it stops, expands it every time it stops, and pays the owner money commensurate with the castle's level when another player stops).

- Gold nugget icon (when stopped, all players except the stopped player pay money to the stopped player according to their level).

- Coin icon (when it stops, the coins of the player who stopped and the other players are exchanged).

- Helmet icon (stationary player and random player exchange equipment).

-Lightning icon (when it stops, a tornado will appear on the stage for a while, and if you touch it you will lose gold).

- House icon (pays money to the owner of the house when it stops).

In battle, you gain experience points by inflicting damage on your opponent.

You play with yourself and 3 other CPUs.

To give you a brief overview of the game, it's Sugoroku with sword fighting elements.

Roll the dice when it's your turn. Proceed by that number.

The CPU also rolls the dice.

There are ghosts wandering around the stage, and if you come into contact with them, you will be deducted $50.

Cash on hand starts at $1000 each.

There are various types of icons in the game (see above).

The effect will be activated. However, another player is already stopped on the icon.

If it is, it will be invalidated.

As you play, if a player has a negative amount of money, the game

The session will end.

The player with the most money at that time will have his own rule on the next play.

The state in which the equipment with the highest limit of the concept of user level is equipped at the start of the next game.

It will be in a state. A player whose bankroll becomes negative is a loser level.

You will move up by 1, and the next time you play, you will start with $100 more in your bankroll.

To express this in words, the winner goes on the defensive, and the loser gains a chance of winning in the next battle.

This means that

Winners' names and winnings will be recorded on the money leaderboard.

------------------------------------

*Keyboard operation is not possible.

*The audio for this game is provided by Ondoku.

I encourage players to share their experiences but ask that you refrain from posting content that includes hate speech, harassment, or inappropriate comments. Please enjoy the game responsibly and respect others in the community."

data.name: A cat's way home
data.detailed_description: "A Cat's Way Home" is a unique casual simulation management game that allows players to experience a heartwarming interactive journey with cats. Presented in a cute and healing art style, the game enables players to explore the vast mountains and rivers of China from the perspective of a cat. The cat will occasionally write letters to the player, sharing its observations and experiences. Utilizing advanced large language model technology, the game enables the cat to respond to the letters in a personalized way, allowing players to feel the cat's sincere emotions and personalized interactions. In this fast-paced modern society, let us slow down together and enjoy the tranquility and beauty of the journey with the cat.

data.name: THE BELLIGERENCE
data.detailed_description:
This game was developed for one player with the aim of differentiating itself from existing fighting games.
The closest feeling to a real battle in the history of existing games.
You can attack by moving the right stick up, down, left, right, up and down, and you can use more powerful moves by using the R button and the R trigger.
You can avoid attacks by moving in the direction of the opponent's attack.
Each time you attack, your stamina will decrease, and if it decreases further, it will decrease to a negative value.

There is a mode to fight the CPU, and five difficulty levels from Very Easy to Very Hard.
This game is difficult, so be sure to start with Very Easy.
Watch out for and avoid your opponent's big attack and turn to counterattack!
Can you beat the belly hard?

data.name: PanChira Concentration
data.detailed_description:
Note: All characters appearing in this game are over the age of 18.
Note: This game works properly online.

Concentration, also known as Match Match, Match Up, Memory, Pelmanism, Shinkei-suijaku, Pexeso or simply Pairs, is a card game in which all of the cards are laid face down on a surface and two cards are flipped face up over each turn. The object of the game is to turn over pairs of matching cards.
All cards in this game include various types of Panchira (a brief glimpse of a woman's underwear).

Turn over pairs of matching the same type of pantsu and compete on the speed of complete!



This game contains "Global Score", that is an unique competitive ranking system.
The more players buy, the higher score you can get.
Join this eternally heated ranking battle!



You obtain Pantsu items when you get higher Global Rank in this competition.
You can enjoy watching Pantsu you have gotten in Gallery Mode.
Collect Pantsu by competing with your rivals from around the globe!!


In Gallery Mode, you can vote your favorite pantsu and know its popularity.
(SteamAPI takes a little time to count your votes.)

Features:

- Card Game

- Simple mouse control

- Nice graphics

- Beautiful girls

- Pantsu

data.name: Corporation Inc.
data.detailed_description: Corporation Inc. puts the players into the shoes of Maria Villalobos, a 25-year-old Honduran native who comes to the United States to work at Corporation Incorporated as their new hiring manager in their ‘revitalization program’. Maria is put on a one-week trial in which she must review 25 applicants daily while judging their qualifications and skillsets. In addition to working against a ticking clock, she has to exercise critical thinking while navigating a skeptical boss, a lousy friend, and the discrimination most immigrants face upon their arrival to America. It’s up to the player how they navigate their first week at Corporation Incorporated.

data.name: Chaosoccer
data.detailed_description:
Score goals. Cause a little chaos.

Chaosoccer turns the soccer pitch into a cartoon physics party. Chase the ball, charge into the crowd, and pick your moment to shoot! A collision can knock the ball away, a defender can block your shot, and a friend can head away the perfect pass just before it reaches you. Play for the score, stay for the fun.

A powerful strike or a curling shot?

Charge up a powerful shot, lob the ball high, or send it curving through the air. Find space in the crowd, leap for a header, and send the ball toward the goal. The controls are easy to pick up, but a great team play still takes good timing, aim, and an eye for your teammates.

Get your friends together—or play solo

Play online with friends, split into red and blue teams, and fight for every chance to shoot. Add computer-controlled players to fill out the teams, or start a match on your own to practice your footwork.

Make the pitch your party

Prefer a close scramble or room to set up a shot? Choose a pitch size, set the goal target and match length, and play at your own pace. Mix and match headwear, hand accessories, shoes, and other accessories to make your little player stand out. Outfits are purely cosmetic. Scoring is still down to your skills.

Key Features:
⦁ Enjoy the unique art style displayed through fully designed paintings, portraits and items.
• Fully customized 3D Character Models with alternate poses in gameplay.
⦁ Become fully immersed in the compelling character dynamics through relatable experiences and dialogue.
⦁ Discover new locations and a variety of objects to interact with and learn additional details from.
⦁ Complete puzzles to earn access to new scenes, assisting with character development and progression.
• Unique UI elements and Menu Screens.

data.name: Ace Pilot Pacific
data.detailed_description:
Ace Pilot Pacific

is my 3rd game and I have been working on it for around a year and a half. The action takes place during World War 2 in the Pacific.

You will fly one of the six different aircraft available against the Japanese.
You will be dog fighting against Zeros, Ki43, Ki49, G4M, G4M2, Hk8K2, Nakajima Kikka, J8M Shusui, and Shinden.

Choose between 5 missions:
- Atoll
- Pearl Harbor
- Wake Island
- Japan Run
- Ha Long Bay

You can play them in the order you want without restriction. The goal is to obtain the highest score in every mission. When you or one of your Allies destroys a plane, you gain a flag. When you have 3 flags, you gain an Ace level. The mission ends at Ace 100, if you are still alive. When you destroy an enemy, you get a Power UP, at Ace 100 you get an Upgrade.

All missions start with you and a wingman against 3 Japanese and when you gain an Ace Level, the number of enemies increase as well as the number of Allies, but the numbers are random, sometimes you get more Allies, sometimes it's the opposite.

Backgrounds are very detailed all in 4K HD. Atoll is a small map, Wake Island is a giant one 32768x30720 pixels. The effect is stunning and if you're like me, you will want to go swimming on that beach.

All the objects are 3D, even the sea.
I recommend you use a game controller. It's like flying a small RC aircraft on your screen. But it also works with a keyboard.

I am planning to add more missions if the reviews are good. If you like it, give it a thumbs up.
Hubert

data.name: Origin Space
data.detailed_description:
Origin Space is an action RPG. Your character is a pilot of a combat spaceship, a member of a long-standing feud between the Federation and the Cultists. Having defeated hordes of enemies in dynamic battles, change the course of history!

Story

In the future, mankind has reached an unprecedented level of technological progress due to the development of artificial intelligence (AI). The development of AI influenced all aspects of people's lives, changed their lifestyle forever. Thanks to the creation of tachyon engines, it became possible to travel to deep space and colonize other worlds. In order to unite all of humanity, settled on the Galaxy, a single government was created - the Earth Federation.



Your character is a pilot of a combat starship, which falls into the center of the conflict of the Earth Federation and totalitarian Cultists.


Defeat the mighty bosses, explore and conquer the expanses of the Galaxy, fight with numerous enemies - the fate of the Earth Federation is in your hands!

Features

  • Dynamic space battles
  • Many different enemies employing various combat tactics
  • A plethora of equipment available to upgrade your starship
  • Сlasses with unique battle abilities
  • A well-thought-out combat system based on synergy of equipment and class abilities
  • The whole Galaxy open for you to explore
  • Arcade mode
  • An immersive campaign.

data.name: Roof by Roof
data.detailed_description:
One roof, one row, one tile at a time

Roof by Roof is a calm, first-person game about tiling roofs. Take a stack of tiles from the yard, carry it up the ladder and lay it row by row, from the eaves to the ridge. Each tile settles onto the battens with a soft clack, and the roof slowly comes together under your hands. When it's done, take a moment: the view from up there is the reward.

What's in the job

  • Real roofing, gently – tiles overlap and stagger like a real roof, and simply won't snap where they don't belong
  • Out with the old – break off worn tiles with a click and watch them slide off the edge
  • Finishing touches – cap the ridge and the corners, and close the tiles up round chimneys and roof windows
  • Ladders and scaffolding – hook a roof ladder over the ridge for steep slopes, or put up scaffold towers with their own tile stacks
  • Patterns that pay – stripes, checkerboards, diamonds, fades and a few secrets: 76 roof challenges in all
  • Upgrades and rewards – spend nails on a bigger load, quicker hands, rapid laying and boots for steeper roofs, and unlock hand-painted tiles
  • Career and Roofing Orders – nine roofs that teach the trade, then endless orders with a design to follow, at Easy, Medium or Hard

Somewhere lovely to work

A village in the fields, a quiet lakeside, a mountain valley or the cobbled streets of an old town, in any season, winter snow included. The day never stops: morning mist, golden hour, and a night of stars and street lamps.

At your own pace

Nothing fails and nobody falls. Play with keyboard and mouse or a gamepad, hide the HUD in photo mode, and turn on colour-blind colours, tile symbols, larger text or reduced motion. In 12 languages, with saves kept in Steam Cloud.

Your adventure starts when you get stranded on a tropical island. This is your island, your adventure! Do whatever you like! It's the ultimate Sandbox sim! Do you like Animal Crossing or Harvest Moon? Castaway Paradise is the game for you!

Full controller support added in version 3.0!

FUN ACTIVITIES

You can spend your days doing fun activities such as catching bugs and fishing. Try to make a bigger catch than your friends and make your collections complete!

GROW PLANTS

Farm your own home-grown fresh crops! Rake the ground, plant the seeds and give them some water. You can also decorate your island with beautiful plants and flowers or grow fruit trees.

CREATE YOUR OWN OUTFIT

data.name: City of Beats
data.detailed_description:
Music is everywhere in the City of Beats and drives absolutely everything in this rogue-lite, twin-stick shooter. Listen to the beat, get into the flow, and unleash bullet hell on the rooftops of the City, blasting through legions of hostile robots.

Don't worry about the damage. Humans left a while ago, and it's just us androids up here. Well, androids and robots, controlled by an ornery rogue A.I., the Zeitgeber, trying to impose its own groove on all robo-kind. Someone should do us all a favor and get out there to pull the plug, yeah?

Everything's driven by music. Literally everything. Weapons, enemies, environmental hazards, it all grooves to the underlying beat.

Listen to the music to anticipate attacks, time dodges, and avoid traps - also knowing when to fire, use special skills, and unleash charged super attacks.

Master the flow of the beat and dance atop skyscrapers to become unstoppable.

Embark on endless expeditions across procedurally generated maps. No two playthroughs are the same, meaning different enemies, encounters, and upgrades each and every time.

Experiment with different builds during each run. What will the beat bring tonight? Damage modifiers? Shield boosts? Quirky mutators that can completely alter the flow of combat? Only the music knows!

Make an orchestra of funky friends. Rogue repair-bots down on their luck! Surprisingly honest merchants! Shady robotic bonesaws looking to take some of your juice in exchange for illicit upgrades! The beat brings together all walks of synthetic life.

You only get one life, but fret not, destruction is only an inconvenience for an android.

Back in the hub, upgrade core traits, buy new weapons and equip extensions, and make sure to stretch before getting ready for another dance number.
