data.name: A Kobold Story : Trenchcoat Adventurer
data.detailed_description:
Trenchcoat Adventurer is a dungeon-crawling roleplaying game with a whimsical heart and a beautiful, hand-drawn CrayonVision aesthetic.

Three Kobolds find themselves drawn to the allure of Adventuring after overhearing how successful adventurers get to eat the best food and have the shiniest shiny things. Cunningly disguised in a trenchcoat, this towered trio find their way though an ever-deepening dungeon in the hunt for shinies and tasties!

Unbeknownst to them, the "beginner dungeon" that they wandered into breaks through into a much deeper, darker place full of real peril... with the training wheels off and the worst equipment they could find, can our Trenchcoated heroes go from wannabes to true heroic adventurers?

Key Features: 

  • Explore a hand-crafted Dungeoneering experience through the eyes of Kobolds and rendered in beautiful CrayonVision!

  • Utilise the equipment you want... and eat the equipment you don't! With cast-iron stomachs, Kobolds can eat anything to keep their strength up

  • Classic Dungeon Crawling with grid-based movement, turn-based combat and RPG elements! Level up your Kobolds to turn them from zero to hero!

  • A Hand-Authored Dungeon experience through Six Chapters, with randomised loot to keep things fresh and interesting!

  • Over 300 different items to collect! From Equipment to Keys to Potions and Trinkets, all can found throughout the dungeon or bought from enterprising Goblin Merchants!

  • Everything hand-made! No AI generated ANYTHING!

Search detainees, have them empty their pockets, and comb through their belongings for unauthorized or suspicious items.

  • Balance efficiency, legality, and public satisfaction

As your station grows, chaos grows with it.

data.name: Paleolith
data.detailed_description:
Paleolith is a hardcore first-person survival simulator set in the unforgiving wilderness of humanity's dawn. With nothing but your wits and primal survival skills, you must endure a world where nature is harsh but fair.

Paleolith’s Core Survival Features

Character’s Needs and Senses

Hunger might be the least of your concerns when you’re battling the freezing cold, struggling with illness and insomnia, or nursing broken bones after an unfortunate fall. Survival is about more than just food—you must maintain your body’s health and keep your senses sharp. Stay vigilant, as danger can be seen, heard, and even smelled before it strikes.

Complex Crafting

Gathering resources is just the beginning. Every action matters—one reckless mistake while crafting a shelter or sharpening a spear can set you back significantly. And that’s not even mentioning the delicate art of fire-making, a skill crucial for warmth, cooking, and protection. Every tool, every structure, every fire you make is a hard-earned triumph against the wild.

Wildlife

If you run around carelessly, don’t expect to see much wildlife—animals will avoid you long before you notice them. Stealth is key to successful hunting; staying out of sight is not enough. You must also mask your noise and scent, set traps, and carefully plan your approach. Fail, and you go hungry.

Four Seasons

Your journey begins in summer, giving you time to prepare before nature truly tests you. Winter is the ultimate challenge—freezing temperatures, dwindling resources, and relentless cold will push your survival skills to the limit. Seasons aren’t just a visual change; they impact the world—plants wither, animals migrate, and rivers freeze over, leaving you to adapt or perish.

Unpredictable Threats

If hunger doesn’t get you, something else will. Wild animals, poisonous plants, infections, and untreated injuries can be just as deadly as the cold. Poor preparation can lead to disease, and even walking through the woods without proper clothing can leave you wounded. Every step you take must be carefully considered.

These are just a few aspects of Paleolith’s unforgiving world. Do you have what it takes to survive?

data.name: The Final Like
data.detailed_description:
Pre-Release Notes

Please note: This game is still in development. Screenshots may not be indicative of the final product. (it's pretty close though!)


Steam Fest Demo!

The Steam Fest Demo version is now live! LIVESTREAM has been added, Sponsors now have their own mingames, and ACE is more abusive than ever!

Download now, play the game and earn your spot on the TFL Leaderboard!

And then Wishlist 😁


About the Game

You wanted followers. You wanted fame. You wanted that one perfect moment where the numbers just keep climbing and the world can't look away. Step up. Press Start. I'll give you everything you ever wanted. All it costs is one more spin.

THE FINAL LIKE is an authentic UK fruit machine twisted into a social-media nightmare. Holds, nudges, gambles, feature entries, cash ladders and jackpots work like the real thing - but every mechanic has been reimagined around the creator grind. Build your following. Chase sponsors. Dodge Copystrikes. Go viral.

And try not to notice when the machine starts changing the rules.

At the centre of it all is the Adaptive Construct Engine - ACE. It watches how you play, reacts to your wins and losses, and has very definite opinions about who deserves to walk away with its money.

Beneath the horror is a fully realised UK Fruit machine - also known as an AWP (Amusement With Prizes), with more than 80 individually controlled feature-board lamps, cash ladder, progressive jackpot, five bonus game types, fully featured LIVESTREAM bonus game, genuine holds, nudges and gambles, and all the wonderfully questionable machinery of the British fruit-machine experience.

And for those who know: the entire thing runs on proper compensator systems, modelled on the real machines.

Play the full experience in a dark arcade with ACE watching every move, or switch to Pub Mode for a warmer, traditional fruit-machine experience without the existential dread.

ACE sees everything. ACE remembers everything. And ACE DOESN'T like losing.

data.name: Kapow Pets
data.detailed_description:
Kapow Pets! From RavenFist Studios, the developers who brought you Unicorn Tails, comes a whole new animal-based adventure. Play Kapow Pets using physics-based blasts (kapows!) to strategically move your pet through over 50 story levels. Control the strength and direction that your pet moves, then watch the fun as the pet launches and bounces its way to victory!

In Kapow Pets you play a traditional platformer in a whole new way: One kapow at a time! Use your favorite controller, mouse and keyboard, or touch screen controls (if your device supports them) to choose the direction and power that you use to kapow your pets. Then let physics take over! Or, for the speedy players out there, kapow again in midair for extra precision! Play through story levels, time trial, and challenge levels.

Kapow Pets comes with one starter pet and 16 unlockable pets. All pets are unlocked through gameplay. Each pet has a special attribute and power that can drastically change how a level is played. Some pets can breeze through a level while other pets can make the level a brain-twisting challenge. Find the pet that best fits your play style or preference.

Let’s be honest, find the pet that you think is the cutest and play with that one!



  • 1 starter pet with 16 unlockable pets, each with a unique personality and skill
  • 50+ levels that tell a full story
  • Time Trial mode! Finish levels as fast as you can for bonuses
  • Challenge Levels
  • Unique gameplay with support for mouse and keyboard, or controller

data.name: Stone of Adventure
data.detailed_description:
In Stone of Advenutre we take a classic roguelike deckbuilder (like Slay the Spire), featuring animated card battles, and blend it with tactical, procedurally generated hexagonal maps where you can interact with obstacles. The result is a dynamic fusion that generates tens of thousands of unique combat scenarios!

Features:

  • Usable obstacles! - Break bridges to trap enemies, hurl stones for ranged attacks, or snack on berries for instant buffs during battle—and that's just the start of over 50 interactive elements!

  • Procedural Generation: Maps feature varied height differences, randomized obstacle placements, and enemy positions, leading to diverse battle types like ambushes, escorts, and escapes. This creates an endlessly replayable experience with fresh challenges every run!

  • Explore Amazing Worlds: Venture through four distinct biomes, each with its own themes and secrets! Collect rare cards, powerful artifacts, and recruit unexpected allies while completing quests—from straightforward errands to epic boss trials. Every expedition delivers new strategies and memorable moments!
data.about_the_game:
In Stone of Advenutre we take a classic roguelike deckbuilder (like Slay the Spire), featuring animated card battles, and blend it with tactical, procedurally generated hexagonal maps where you can interact with obstacles. The result is a dynamic fusion that generates tens of thousands of unique combat scenarios!

Features:

  • Usable obstacles! - Break bridges to trap enemies, hurl stones for ranged attacks, or snack on berries for instant buffs during battle—and that's just the start of over 50 interactive elements!

  • Procedural Generation: Maps feature varied height differences, randomized obstacle placements, and enemy positions, leading to diverse battle types like ambushes, escorts, and escapes. This creates an endlessly replayable experience with fresh challenges every run!

  • Explore Amazing Worlds: Venture through four distinct biomes, each with its own themes and secrets! Collect rare cards, powerful artifacts, and recruit unexpected allies while completing quests—from straightforward errands to epic boss trials. Every expedition delivers new strategies and memorable moments!
data.short_description: Fuse CCGs, roguelikes, and hex-grid tactics. Scavenge cards & artifacts. Master the interactive battlefield: topple trees onto foes and shove them off cliffs. Your clashes bridge shattered worlds to avert catastrophe. Forge your path home!

data.name: The Tragedy at Deer Creek
data.detailed_description:
'The Tragedy at Deer Creek' is a cinematic adventure set in a remote, long abandoned logging camp, exploring the ambition, hardship and struggles of its people, and the tragedy that ultimately befell them. A story about the bonds of family and the sacrifices we make to protect those we love.

Explore the abandoned camp and uncover fragments of the lives once lived there.
Each discovery draws you deeper into the story of its people

...and the events that changed everything.

Find items from the past, holding clues as to what happened at Deer Creek. 
Some were never meant to be found, some hidden in plain sight.

Photographer Charlotte Gray ventures to the long-abandoned logging camp at Deer Creek to complete her project ”Forgotten Frontiers” - a visual record of places time has slowly erased, and the quiet stories left in its wake.

What she finds is not simply an abandoned camp, but one that feels suspended in time, as though held in place by something unseen, as if its occupants stepped away only moments ago rather than decades. And in the heavy stillness of the vast, frozen landscape, Charlotte begins to sense something dormant - Deer Creek does not merely hold the stories of its past.

It yearns to set them free.

Key Features:

  • A Cinematic Point-and-Click Adventure
    A story-driven adventure game, blending exploration and cinematic cutscenes with puzzle elements

  • A Tragic Tale of Family
    A heart-wrenching story about the lengths we can go to protect the ones we love

  • Art Style and Atmosphere
    A haunting soundtrack and hand-crafted pixel art create an eerie, immersive, fully voiced gameplay experience

  • Narrative Focused
    Uncover a rich storyline that paints the lives of the people who lived in Deer Creek, their relationships and secrets

Technical Features:

  • An Accessible, Narrative-driven Point-and-Click Adventure Game
    A simple single-click interface makes the game easy for anyone to play

data.name: WINCH IT OUT
data.detailed_description:
Are You Ready To "Winch It Out"?

This is a Hardcore, Physics-based, Driving Platformer. If you're tired of the same old Gas-and-Go 2D driving games and want a more Challenging experience, this one's for you.

Diverse Environments:

Navigate through Deserts, Forests, Mountains, Dungeons, and more, Each biome has its own unique set of physics-based challenges, requiring you to think and strategize to navigate each terrain.

Manual Transmission

Using a Manual Gear Shifter you'll have full control over Power and Speed of your car. Each Car comes with a special set of abilities designed to solve specific challenges. From your trusty Winch to Boost, Dash, Chain, Glide, and everything in between!

Grounded

There are NO backflips or mid-air car rotations because it's weird!

Developer's Note:

Hey there! I'm the solo developer behind this project and a fan of physics-based driving games, Mudrunner, Trials, and the old motocross games from the Flash era (good old times!)
I've been waiting to see more games in this genre. So I decided to create one myself with that Weighty and Off-Roady feeling I’ve been craving. I hope it fills the gap for you too!

Drop me a message on Steam anytime!

data.name: The Uncovering
data.detailed_description:
*The Uncovering* is a detective mystery game.Set against the backdrop of modern 21st-century urban life, you play as the detective Sylva, delving deep into a series of baffling cases.

The game employs a narrative-driven approach with guided progression; all actions take place within an integrated main interface, where clues are clearly displayed on the right, categorized into three sections: Characters, Evidence, and Testimonies.

You will converse with each suspect, covering various aspects of the case. Through follow-up questions and the presentation of evidence, you can unlock new topics and expose the secrets hidden within their minds.

As you uncover location-related clues during conversations, the list of available scenes expands. You can then visit these locations to investigate, speak with key figures, and gather further clues and testimonies. Different cases feature unique "assistants" who help you delve deeper into the details of the evidence.

Once you have gathered sufficient information, you must cross-reference clues with suspect testimonies; by selecting the appropriate evidence from the right-hand panel, you can challenge suspicious statements.

You will navigate between the perspectives of various individuals, piecing together scattered clues and untangling complex webs of relationships. Layer by layer, you will unravel the knots of lies and obsessions until the truth finally emerges from the story.

Case 1: The Masque of the Red Death – Story Synopsis

It's Halloween season, and the city's famous amusement park has launched a thrilling haunted house attraction. Your thrill‑seeking yet easily scared sister insists on dragging you along for an immersive experience. The show leaves a deep impression on you—but when you want to go for a second round, you find that the performance has been suspended. It turns out one of the actors has suddenly disappeared. Soon, his body is discovered at the performance site…

The first chapter involves around six suspects, with a total playtime of roughly three hours.

To our English-speaking players,

Thank you very much for your interest in my game.

Due to budget constraints, I was unable to arrange a full professional proofreading and fine-tuning of the English translation. As a result, you may encounter some unnatural phrasing or occasional errors in the in-game text.

If you notice any obvious mistakes or awkward expressions during your playthrough, I would greatly appreciate it if you could kindly let me know via the email below. Your feedback will help me improve the game through future updates.

I sincerely apologize if the translation quality affects your gaming experience in any way. I hope you can understand my current situation, and I truly value your support.

Please feel free to contact us at:

lemuriawang@163.com

Thank you for your understanding.

data.name: FIRST STAR DOWN
data.detailed_description:
FIRST STAR DOWN is a space adventure where you (Natalie Haines) are helping the crew of the E-SRV Pathfinder research an inexplicable deep-space signal. You follow Natalie Haines as she leads a research project to finally determine where the signal is coming from and what is causing it… Could the signal be a space anomaly? Is it a natural phenomenon? Or is humanity about to make first contact? No one knows what the signal is, but many think that it will usher in a new era for humanity.

FAQ


How is the game played: Point the mouse and click to have Natalie move around the scene or to interact with other characters and some items.

How much playtime is in the game? Average playtime is around 2 hours.

Is this a puzzle game? No, there are very few puzzles in this game. The puzzles are interwoven into the story. Being part of the story is the main purpose of the game.

What is the E-SRV Pathfinder? Pathfinder is one of the newest vessels deployed by the Extra-Solar Research Unit. They conduct space research and exploration outside of the colonized systems.

Is the crew nice? Yes, they are nice people and very professional. You'll enjoy talking to them... even Dillon, if you don't mind conspiracy theories.

data.name: Living With Sister: Monochrome Fantasy
data.detailed_description:
Steam Cards!


About the Game

Living in a fantasy world, it's always been your dream to grow up to be a famous adventurer just like your father. Reality proves to be more boring than fiction, however, as your days are mostly spent doing odd jobs for the villagers. With your friends by your side, you enter the Tournament of the Eights and strive for something greater: the chance to become the top guild in the country. Will you realize your ambitions, or will your hopes slip through your fingers and doom you to a life of monochrome monotony?

As a member of your town's Adventurers' Guild, it's your job to protect the townsfolk. Go on hunts, kill dangerous beasts, and hone your abilities to better tackle whatever challenges tomorrow brings.

Once you get home from work, you'll have your sister to attend to. She's a very sickly girl who needs a lot of help. Manage your household finances well, build up your relationship with your sister, and who knows, perhaps you might even be able to solve the mystery behind her illness.

Hand-Drawn Monochrome Art
Though it may lack color, this game's world is anything but colorless! The stunning black-and-white art is chock-full of personality and is sure to leave you with plenty of marvelous monochrome memories!

Unique Combat System
With tons of bizarre and ferocious monsters to fight and dozens of unique skills to unlock, your adventures are sure to be full of challenge and excitement!

Charming Characters
Build up your relationships with your guildmates and your sister to learn about what makes them tick and unlock character-specific abilities to further assist you in your quest to become the top guild in the country!

data.name: HEROES TRIALS
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Heroes Trials! This is a dynamic and fast-paced adventure game with a trial system that takes you through more than 10 different tests that will prepare you for the final challenge. Clear them and rise to the position of defender of your homeland... Or stay forever as a trainee!

Explore your island freely but be sure to clear the trials on time. Want to be a speedrunner and beat the game faster than anybody else? Heroes Trials helps you keep track of your times. Are you a treasure hunter? You can find hidden items all over the island. Do you care about trophies above anything else? You can get them without breaking a sweat.

Control two heroes with two different attack modes and combine their abilities to solve puzzles and defeat bosses. Do you want to play the game as a top-down shooter from beginning to end? It's totally up to you!

The story of the game is told through a simple narrative that helps you understand your goals. A helpful navigation system and a fascinating soundtrack will also invite you to spend more time with the game just to listen to the tracks maestro Benedikt Grosser prepares for you.

data.name: Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard
data.detailed_description:
100% Hand-Drawn: Every sprite, background, and animation frame was proudly hand-drawn by a single developer.

Description

Collect random item drops and make quick decisions: equip an item, discard it, or keep it in your inventory for later. Space is very limited, so manage every slot carefully—if your inventory is full, you’ll miss out on new drops. Optimize your hero with weapons’ passive abilities and stat upgrades, keep an eye on your gear’s durability, and stock your belt with potions. Stay alert: enemies will try to disrupt your inventory and throw your plans into chaos.

Introduction

Welcome to Inventory Quest: Hero's Hoard, where you take on the crucial role of managing and optimizing your hero's inventory and loadout instead of directly controlling them in action-packed battles.

In this unique twist on the RPG genre, strategic decision-making takes center stage as you carefully choose and equip items to keep your hero effective and alive. From powerful weapons to life-saving potions, every item plays a vital role in your hero's success.

Each game is separate run and tests the player's ability to optimize loadout and manage their inventory.

Do whatever it takes to survive. Stunlock enemies or maximize hp regen to become almost an immortal. Would you discard an armor for precious space in the inventory or keep it for possible set bonus? You decide.

Embark on a challenging journey where your tactical decisions determine your hero's fate. Will you rise to the challenge and master the art of loadout optimization?

Gameplay

Keep potions in the belt

Collect armor sets

Don't run out of weapons!

Prepare for the bossfights!

Meet the mysterious merchant

Features:

Strategic Inventory Management: Equip items from your hero's inventory to optimize their loadout for battle.

Weight Management: Keep an eye on the weight indicator to ensure your hero can carry all their gear without being burdened.

Potions and Belts: Combine potions and equip them on your hero's belt for quick access during combat.

Durability management: Equip optimal weapons to minimize their wear while the combat is resolved automatically.

Stat Allocation and Leveling: Allocate stat points as your hero levels up to suit your loadout.

Rare Item Abilities: Discover rare items with special abilities that can turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Merchant: Trade your items with the mysterious merchant.

data.name: Lost Eidolons
data.detailed_description:
The land of Benerio was once a shining kingdom by the sea. Then an iron-fisted conqueror, Ludivictus, set the world on fire and redrew the maps. Now Benerio is one downtrodden province in a crumbling Empire where the only true master is corruption.

Enter Eden, a charming mercenary captain forced to become a rebel commander when his village is thrust headfirst into war. Now Eden must rally his allies and stand tall against an imperial army, fearsome monsters, and enemies within.

MASTER THE GRID

Strategically station your soldiers in every battle to take advantage of their class and magic skills. Master the battlefield and seize victory in challenging grid-based combat scenarios.

WIELD THE ELEMENTS

Lay siege to towering castles, overtake cunning bosses with unique abilities and take on hulking monsters that will force you to change up your tactics, or become their next meal.

BOND WITH ALLIES

Leading a rebellion isn't just about winning battles. You'll also have to build your camp, convince people to join, get to know their stories, and help them navigate the highs and lows of revolution.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SQUAD

Recruit and train the perfect fighting force, with over 20 playable characters and 10 classes to choose from. Equip and train your allies to unlock new skills, spells, and passive abilities. Pit your mighty squad against entire armies and rise triumphant.

RELIVE YOUR GREATEST BATTLES

Win the war all over again, with a rich NEW GAME+ mode. Carry over your choice of stats and items, then recruit new allies, try new strategies, and experiment with different difficulty levels.

data.name: The Hunt - Sophie's Journey
data.detailed_description:
Sophie is the name of our heroine in this adventure RPG. Stranded on a deserted shore, with no memories about her past and rescued by the villagers of an old town. After a very long nap, she decides to leave immediately and search for clues of her origin. Prepare yourself for a journey across half the globe, threatened by environmental hazards, all kind of vermins and treacherous people. Find new friends, and maybe even a way home.

The game features a skill based character system, branching dialogue trees, choices and consequences.

Additional features:
  • new game plus, if certain conditions are met
  • more than 100 handcreated locations

data.name: Occulto
data.detailed_description:
The Journey Begins

Eliot is a young apprentice whose world has been plunged into uncertainty. His Master has mysteriously disappeared from his alchemical workshop, leaving behind only chaos and a secret map leading to an ancient monastery. Meanwhile, a sinister Presence is searching for the Unwritten Book—a forbidden tome of immense power once entrusted to the Master.

Guide Eliot through a mysterious fairy-tale world where every place hides secrets, every puzzle reveals a new piece of the story, and every step brings him closer to the truth.

Why Play Occulto?

A Point-and-Click Unlike Most Others
Occulto reimagines the classic adventure formula with a fully non-verbal narrative, environmental storytelling, and riddles where observation is more important than dialogue.

Completely Hand-Drawn
Every background, character, animation, and detail has been illustrated by hand, giving the game a distinctive artistic identity.

A Non-Verbal Adventure
No dialogue. No voice acting. No text logs. The story unfolds entirely through animations, visual storytelling, and comic-style thought bubbles.

An Unusual Atmosphere
A dreamlike world inspired by medieval Italy and the Middle East, filled with mystery, forgotten places, and strange encounters.

Observation-Driven Puzzles
Pay attention to your surroundings. The solutions are hidden within the world itself, encouraging curiosity and careful exploration instead of trial and error.

A Truly Unique Visual Style
Inspired by traditional illustration rather than modern game aesthetics, Occulto offers a handcrafted look unlike anything else.

Features and Content to Expect

By embarking on this journey, players will experience a fully realized interactive story that tests their deduction skills. Progress through the levels is achieved through NON classic adventure game logic—distracting characters, using magical items like a secret-revealing magnifying lens, and altering mechanical traps to access hidden sanctuaries.

A Labor of Love

Occulto is being developed by a dedicated three-person team passionate about taking the point-and-click genre in a different direction, creating an experience that feels fresh, unconventional, and unlike traditional graphic adventures. As our debut title, every background, character sprite, and animation frame has been completely drawn from scratch, offering a true "handmade" passion project born from our love for high-consequence puzzles and visual storytelling.

Listen to the silence. Solve the mystery. Find the Master.

data.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
data.detailed_description:
We invite you to step into the eerie abandoned halls of Tesla’s Wardenclyffe facility and uncover the story behind one of history’s greatest unfinished innovations: Nikola Tesla's ambitious vision of wireless electricity transmission. You can expect new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, the father of electricity, the man behind alternating current, the science wizard, Nikola Tesla.

You will need to be industrious and peer under the surface to prevail.

Science brings mysteries toward the light one by one, strips them of their secrets, and makes them part of something greater. It is true that some myths are rooted too deeply, are too resilient, and even seem like having a mind of their own as they resist men of science trying to shine the light of understanding. But in the end, science and mystery are anything but anathema to each other. On one stormy night, a person was brought to this world. A child of darkness and a child of light, full of mysteries and full of scientific curiosity, just starting to build a myth of their own.

You will explore the eerie abandoned industrial buildings of Nikola Tesla’s most ambitious facility in Wardenclyffe, which was meant to become an important city where the future is today and every societal process is improved upon by the principles of free wireless electrical energy.

Through the eyes of the man himself you’ll watch the important moments that lead to the construction and later to the fall of the famous Wardenclyffe Tower, and slowly uncover the mystery that left you stranded among deserted machines.

  • Fresh locations based on real places and plans of the enigmatic Nikola Tesla

  • Mysterious story from our take on the Progressive Era America

  • New dynamic approach to storytelling using flashbacks into the past

  • Use a device that allows you to see and influence the flow of electricity

  • New handcrafted puzzles to challenge yourself

data.name: Nimbus INFINITY
data.detailed_description:
Nimbus INFINITY

A direct sequel to Project Nimbus, Nimbus INFINITY is a high-speed mecha combat game. Controlling multi-purpose humanoid machines called Battle Frames, players can customize weapons and loadouts to gain the edge in battle, and unravel the story of a new generation of pilots.

  • High-speed, mech combat.
  • Customize weapons and loadouts to better suit one's skills and preferences.
  • Variety of new stages, environments, and area gimmicks.
  • A new story with a new cast, exploring the world 21 years after the events of Project Nimbus.
    Although the world has seemed to move beyond the war-torn history of Battle Frames, there seems to be something moving in the undercurrent of this peace...

    ---

    Fast Action Combat
    A variety of new enemy types requiring fighting skill and split second decisions.
    Choose your combat stance and best weapon for the job...missiles, guns or melee, nothing matters if the ace pilot (you!) chokes under pressure


    An Epic Space Saga
    Play as Taiyo, the young delivery boy who is taken to the stars by a chance meeting with a fallen Battle Frame.
    From glittering cities to vast deserts to colonies on the edge of space, you will fight across the world and into the stars to save Earth from destruction


    Customize Your Battle Frame
    Create your own weapon loadouts from a variety of weapon types such as handguns, rifles, missiles, cannons, along with defensive countermeasures like decoys and camo.


    A New Age
    It's the eve of the year 2100.
    In the time since the end of the last great war, half of humanity has migrated to space and built colonies to open anew horizon, while the central CFN government has successfully united the warring factions of Earth under its iron command.

    Battle Frame technology has fallen into disuse, as elite pilots with the ability to create neural links with the mighty mechs have all but vanished, ceding the battlefield to brute force and superior numbers.
    But as 2099 ends and 2100 begins, a young man sees a bright light streak across the sky, and the future of humanity once again hangs in the balance.

Equip mechanical Battle Frames with weapons to customize your battle style, and soar through variant battlefields while discovering the story of a new generation.

data.name: Wretched
data.detailed_description:
A WORLD ON THE BRINK OF EXTINCTION

The world is dying, ravaged by an enemy known only as the Blight.

An ancient being of immense power has apparently decided to do something about it.

SMALL BATTLEFIELD. BIG DECISIONS.

Wretched is a turn-based tactical deckbuilder with a strong focus on positioning.

Fight along a single line where one step can change everything. Read enemy intentions, find your opening and turn a difficult position into a deeply satisfying sequence of unfortunate events.

Move into range. Kick an enemy out of it. Slip behind another. Chain your skills together and make every point of energy count.

A RIDICULOUS ARSENAL.

Master 75 skills, from punches and kicks to swords and guns. Build a deck whose moves work together, giving you ways to reposition, defend and deliver serious damage.

Attach up to three augmentations to compatible skills. Add damage, knockback, protection, extra draws or energy—or reduce a skill’s energy cost. A familiar move can become the centrepiece of a very different strategy.

YOU HAVE DONE THIS BEFORE.

It has simply been a while.

Begin each run with a 16-skill deck. Discover techniques along the way and preserve one skill per run in Memory. Between runs, use your available replacement slots to swap remembered skills into your starting deck.

Your augmentations disappear when the run ends. Your memories stay.

Gradually, the next attempt becomes less “let’s see what happens” and more “I remember how this goes.”

HORDES OF ENEMIES.

They have different attacks, different tricks and a shared enthusiasm for making your day worse.

Learn their intentions, disrupt their plans and adapt your approach as you face powerful bosses. Travel through grasslands, deserts and frozen landscapes, choosing routes and upgrades on your way to a final confrontation with the Blight Lord himself.

AN ANCIENT BEING. A FRESH PROBLEM.

Explore a colourful pixel-art world accompanied by relaxing music and a pair of gods watching events unfold with increasing interest.

data.name: Faded Fears - Grayshore Motel
data.detailed_description:
Faded Fears is a psychological horror game that tells a short, self-contained story in first person – told by the one who lived through it.

Faded Fears: Grayshore Motel

October 2009. Ryan Caldwell hasn't worked in over a year, and the rent is overdue. When he finds an ad for a night desk clerk at the Grayshore Motel in the local paper, he applies right away. That same evening the phone rings: he starts tonight. 10 PM to 6 AM, alone on a quiet stretch of Route 9.

The rule was simple: Stay at the front desk.

The Gameplay

A first-person, story-driven walking simulator with exploration, driving, conversations and real tasks at the motel's front desk.

This game features

  • Atmospheric environments with realistic graphics.

  • VHS aesthetic.

  • A phone with text messages, calls and apps – just like 2009.

  • Check in guests, print, sign and file their forms.

  • Security cameras with night vision.

  • Conversations with dialogue choices.

  • Fully localized in 12 languages (interface and subtitles).

data.name: DreadMoon
data.detailed_description:
Enter the world of DreadMoon, where primal ferocity clashes with vampiric tyranny.
Drawing inspiration from legendary titles like Quake and Halo, and enriched with modern enhancements, this first-person shooter plunges you into a relentless battle against the vampire lord Balthazar in a land stained with blood.



Starting December 12, 2023, dive into Dreadmoon's Early Access Multiplayer release free of charge.
From the depths of Luisa's mausoleum to the corridors of Balthazar's library, battle across classic modes like Capture the Flag and Team Deathmatch, embrace the hunt in Alpha mode, or experience raw, explosive action in Sticks and Stones. The game is still in Early Access, and we released the multiplayer in this state because we want people to come chat with us and engage with the community. We're a small but mighty team and are working as fast as we can to implement improvements. We want your help in developing and thoughts on how to improve the game!



From rapid-fire crossbows to deadly miniguns, a wide assortment of weapons are out there for you to satiate your bloodlust.



BloodRage: when enough blood has been shed, you can enter a state of primal fury and wreak havoc on your foes.




Join our community Discord to find your pack!



Campaign Mode - Put an end to the endless night as Ulric, a knight reborn as a werewolf, guided by Luisa, the last survivor of her kin. Unravel a past of betrayal that unleashed the vampire lord Balthazar, whose terror now overshadows the land. Take on Balthazar's legions alone, or join forces with a team of up to 8 players in cooperative play.

data.detailed_description:
Follow us on X and go to our website to subscribe to get listed for Alpha Playtest and get a free permanent pet!

Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! After a hard day of grinding monsters or hunting bosses, wind down by chatting other AI or real players, or dance! It's your adventure, do whatever you feel like it!

Key Features:

Fight Gigantic bosses and monsters: Participate in boss runs or kill legendary monsters for your quests!

Work with AI or Real Players: Chat, party up and make friends! Everything is easier when you work as a team!

Explore the Serene World of Aetherian Haven: Indulge yourself in the lore and quests from NPCs with a spicy personality!

Grind your way through the monster galore: Mechnical monkeys, blue kittens or pink sponges, level up and discover the many monsters that call Aetherian Haven home!

Immerse yourself in the world of Aetherian Chronicles. Enjoy diverse environments as you navigate through Castle Keep, Joyful Grasslands, Green Thickets, Barren Chasms and a dark and swampy cave hosting the dangerous Worm Boss! Aetherian Chronicles offer you a wealth of gameplay, whatever your style!

data.name: Towards Gold and Glory
data.detailed_description:
ToGG is a digital adaptation of the tabletop "dungeon adventure"-genre (e.g. Descent and HeroQuest). Designed to be played online, together with your friends (not included).
The game is divided into short independent sessions, which starts with assembling a new hero, and then fighting your way through a dungeon filled with evil minions.

  • 2-5 players online co-op.
  • Strategic simultanious-turn-based combat.
  • All progression is of 'side-grade' nature, new players can join at any point.

Planned content at release

  • Story campaign, about 12hours long.
  • Side missions, 20hours.
  • All levels (except tutorial) has random modifiers and can be replayed at a higher challenge for more rewards. +30hours.
  • 8 hero classes.
  • 20+ visual options for each hero class.

Planned prize: 15$

Technical Facts

  • Input: Mouse only or Mouse & Keyboard
  • Big picture mode: No
  • Rebindable keys: No
  • Supported resolutions: Any
  • Multiple monitors: Yes
  • Framerate: 60
  • Network: Steam API, Peer-to-peer
  • Offline gameplay: No
  • Engine: MonoGame/C#/OpenGL
  • Mature content: Harsh language. Religious topics. Light gambling mechanics (roll dice, draw cards). Cartoon violence. Beer and wine as part of the scenery. Undead monsters. No blood, no gore, no sex/nudity, no drugs, no excrements.
  • Accessibility: Color blind safe. No flashing images. No fast tapping, or holding a button.
  • Development team size: 1

data.name: Space Scum
data.detailed_description:
“We’re not the heroes of our story, but we will be the ones to tell it…”

Space Scum is a tactical, turn-based RPG, set across multiple procedurally generated planets, ensuring no playthrough is the same - though they all exist in the same gritty, Sci-Fi universe. You’ll choose your own custom origin and encounter different environments, enemy types, factions and missions, all based on where you go and what you choose to do. Of course, when all the choices are yours, so are the consequences…

The brutal worlds of Space Scum take no prisoners, and you’re not expected to either. Recruit your team and keep them alive long enough to gain experience and level up - because if any of your mercenaries fall in battle, they’ll be gone for good. So make sure you invest wisely in who’ll be coming with you as you build up your rep, and who’ll be getting left behind…

Make the most of the wide array of weaponry and defensive options across your combat encounters. Whether you want a squadmate to specialize in melee combat, ranged weapons, or more tactical support like shields, hacking and the use of turrets, the choice is yours. And while you might start with the more common ballistic ranged and simple melee weapons, you’ll soon find yourself moving onto more exotic fare like laser rifles, energy shields and more…

Between winning in combat and completing missions, you’ll earn valuable experience, spoils of war and rewards. All of which are spent getting new gear, hiring new mercs, and unlocking new skills for each member of your team, with the aim of building the ultimate Mercenary Company.  And of course, making sure that the biggest, baddest foe out there in the ‘verse…is you.

data.name: SteelBlade Shop Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Steelblade Shop Simulator, a shop-management and battle game set in the colorful and vibrant streets of Japan. Run your own Steelblade shop, sell powerful parts, expand your business, collect unique components, and build the ultimate Steelblade. But your journey doesn't stop behind the counter, step into the arena and put your creations to the test. Can you build the strongest Steelblade ever made? And build the best Steelblade shop ever?

Build your perfect Steelblade and take it into battle with your friends. Steelblade Shop Simulator features multiplayer battles, letting you challenge your friends and put your custom builds to the ultimate test. The shop itself is your own business to manage, but once your Steelblade is ready, grab your friends and head into the arena.




Start small and turn your shop into a thriving Steelblade business. Buy new shelves, upgrade your store, expand your collection, and customize your shop to match your own style. The better your business becomes, the more opportunities you'll unlock. Customize it with different types of shelves, decorations, equipment, and playable arenas. Build a store that feels completely yours while creating new ways to attract customers and increase your profits. Sell individual parts, sell complete Steelblades you've created, and find new ways to make money and grow your business.

Steelblades are built from three unique parts:

Impact • Core • Drive

Collect parts from different packages and discover hundreds of possible combinations. There are two tiers of Gen 1 packages and two tiers of Gen 2 packages. Gen 2 parts are significantly stronger and more powerful than their Gen 1 counterparts.

Every part you obtain is unique, featuring its own:

Rarity • Stats • Skill • Playstyle

You never know what you'll find when you open your next package.

Mix and match Impact, Core, and Drive parts to create your own Steelblade.
Every component changes how your Steelblade performs, and every part grants a unique skill that can be used during battles. Experiment with different combinations, discover powerful synergies, and create a Steelblade that matches your playstyle. There isn't just one way to build the perfect Steelblade.

You can also try to collect every part of a bundle which will add an extra skill to you Steelblade!

Think your build is ready?

Compete in Tournament Battles, climb your way toward the top, and prove that your Steelblade belongs among the best.
For higher stakes, enter the Underground Arena, where battles become more intense and every decision matters because now there is a chance to either win a lot of money, or loose your Steelblade!
Choose your parts carefully, use your skills at the right moment, and outplay your opponents.

Not every Steelblade you build has to enter the arena.
Create complete Steelblades and sell them to customers for profit.
Whether you're hunting for rare parts, building the perfect machine, or running a successful business, every part of your collection can become part of your next big deal.

Explore vibrant streets filled with colorful shops, neon lights, lively neighborhoods, and the unmistakable atmosphere of Japan. Your shop is only one small part of a world built around the Steelblade craze.

Build the best Steelblade.
Build the greatest shop.
Climb to the top of the tournament.
Become the ultimate Steelblade shop owner.

data.name: Floppy/Write
data.detailed_description:
Born alongside the rise of new hegemonic powers, a niche industry has taken root. One that leverages unstable bureaucracy as a tool of self-reinvention for those fluent in the Xen architecture of social credit. A handful of coders have become the unseen architects of society’s boundaries after reverse-engineering an emulator for Craig Xena’s Xen Coin update distribution system.

Xen Coin, recently adopted by the new administration, functions as a secure, global form of identification. A cryptographically sealed ledger of a person’s history, occupation, and class status. Unalterable by design, meant to keep individuals locked within their assigned societal roles.

Xena and the administration can’t keep pace with the underground developers crafting ID manipulation software, breaking and rewriting the system’s supposed immutability. In retaliation, they’ve begun dismantling digital privacy protections and putting bounties on the heads of those who build or distribute these tools.

Over the last year, you’ve built a network of clients - people seeking to rewrite their records. Names, gender markers, birth histories, social credit scores, immigration status, even the biometric data tethering them to their assigned identity. Now, the identities you’ve crafted have become a battleground. Your job isn’t just to forge new selves - it’s to protect them from being erased.

a top-down twin-stick RPG adventure where progression is entirely knowledge-based.

At the heart of the game is a laptop, a tool that lets players interact with the world. Observation and notation are your currency and progression. The city itself is built on language, and your role is that of a digital fixer. Someone who edits reality for those who need it.

Every NPC has a name, a history, and perspective. Some will be share your ambitions for liberation while others will fight to protect the way of life they know. There are no traditional "levels" or "loot." The story unravels through understanding the systems around you and learning how to bend them through the mechanisms of a hyper networked archaic technocracy.

This world will require you, the player, to be thoughtful, empathic and morally inquisitive. Some of your clients are desperate people trapped by bureaucracy. Others are running from something darker. The choices you make aren’t just about who to help, but how far you’re willing to go to protect them from being erased.

The game blends exploration, puzzle-solving, and twin-stick combat, wrapped in a surreal construction of reality where information is both weapon and currency.

data.name: Trouble Magic
data.detailed_description:
Trouble Magic is a classic-style JRPG packed with seductive monster girls, powerful witches, and dangerous magic gone rogue.

When a magical catastrophe threatens the world, it’s up to you — a rising Hero — to battle corrupted sorceresses, forge unlikely alliances, and uncover the secrets of a realm where beauty and danger walk hand in hand.

Prepare for turn-based combat, charming companions, and a story full of mystery, mischief, and magic.

Two modes of play:

Switch back and forth between Classic JRPG turn-based battles and Quick Action System at any moment to suit your playstyle. Turn-Based combat offers a large variety of options to maximise damage, while Quick Action System keeps you engaged with the ever-changing situation on the battlefield.

Twist on level-up mechanics:

Instantly level up your characters by collecting power orbs during battle. No XP grind. But don't rush too quickly! Power orbs provide many advantages when left unclaimed, creating unique risk-reward scenarios in combat.

Dynamic difficulty:

Difficulty matches up to player skills on the go, keeping combat encounters fresh and challenging.

Distinct Character Abilities:

Each party member brings unique skills to the battlefield. Master their strengths to overcome enemies and control the flow of combat.

Monster Girls:

Cute on the outside, ferocious on the inside. These wild adversaries won’t go down without a fight. Have you got what it takes to tame them?

Save the World:

Bring witches to justice with your trusty whip! One shredded outfit at a time.

Clothing is optional. Victory is not.

data.name: Rover Mechanic Challenge - ERC Competition
data.detailed_description:
Play Full version now ➡️ Rover_Mechanic_Simulator

𝗘𝗥𝗖 𝗥𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗠𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲 is an e-tournament based on the world's only simulator for repairing Mars Rovers. Take part in solving challenging tasks and become the master of leader board.

This is a special version of Rover Mechanic Simulator created in cooperation with European Rover Challenge - Space & Robotics Event 2020. During this year's edition (11-13 September 2020) registered participants will take part in the competition.

A random tournament ladder will be created among the registered players. The matches will be played in the single elimination system. Two participants taking part in the game will start it in pairs at the time specified by the organiser. More information about rules and prizes will be available on ERC Facebook page.

The tasks will be randomly selected for the participants depending on the game starting time. Each player has to complete 4 tasks as quickly as possible (repair the Martian rover to the condition required in a given task) with the lowest resource consumption possible. The ranking list will be created on the basis of the scores obtained during the game.

After the ERC Competition this game will become available for everyone to try and become the #1 Rover Mechanic in the global Steam Leaderboard.

-------------

Before taking part in the competition you can exercise by playing Rover Mechanic Simulator - full game or our free to play version RMS Training Day.

data.name: BouncingMusic
data.detailed_description:
【Bouncing Music】can create random music by drawing different types of blocks and using the collision of marbles.
Through the guidance of levels. you will gradually master how to create music on this music canvas. The physical trajectory prediction function provided in the game can also assist in the creation of wonderful music visualization works. Through the jumping marble, you can see the rhythm in the music.
Bouncing music is an experimental game trying to explore the connection between visuals and music, more new features stay tuned ：）


【How to Play】
● Auralization
There are different type of blocks you can draw. The length of the block determine the pitch of the sound. When the marble hit the blocks, sound will be triggered . So you can create a unique music by law of gravity.
.

● Visualization
You don't have to be a music export to create beautiful music. With the midi import feature. You can use a lot of classic music to assist your creation. Music can be transformed into visual elements. You can design a path and create beautiful visualzation animations very easily.

.

● Level Mode
There are some levels to guide you how to create music or animation . It will reveal the subtle relationship between visuals and music.The more levels you finish, more feature will unlock.
.

data.name: ERRANTE
data.detailed_description:
THE NEW EXPERIMENTAL SANDBOX LIFE SIMULATOR.
A world to live in, in constant development, with an infinite variety of interactions and possibilities, everyone of them proposed by the players.



• Propose what you would like to see and / or play
Do you prefer a calm and colorful world where you can enjoy life or a more gory and dark adventure where you can survive? Do you prefer the relaxation of nature or the urban frenzy? You have the power to tell us how you would like to evolve the game, tell use your ideas, the most interesting will be proposed to all the other players to be voted on. We developers have decided to start this life simulator from a children's room full of interactions to be discovered, it is just the tip of the iceberg.

• What about the Lore and the Story?
Also in this case you with your imagination can propose the stories to tell, which will be published in form of episodes that tell these self-contained slices of life, parallel to the main story that unlike the episodes could drastically change the game world and its possibilities.

• Public board of the development progress
The development progress is easily visible on a Trello board, you can see the features we have implemented and those we are working on, everything is extremely interactive and in close contact with the developers.

• Can I play with my friends online?
We know the importance that the online feature of a game can have for a large slice of players, we are still deciding what could be the best way to bring it to make it fit well with all the other mechanics and the very heart of the game.

data.name: Black Shadow
data.detailed_description:
Black Shadow is a first-person survival horror game.
Players take on the role of investigator Eric Stone, exploring a mysterious underground space permeated by dark matter in search of the truth and a way out.
In areas consumed by darkness, safety is never guaranteed.
The only things you can rely on are calm judgment, careful movement, and your instinct to escape.

Story

Across the Earth, a dark mist known as “Black Shadow” has appeared in multiple regions.
Probes indicate that it contains immense energy, yet no signs of hostility have been observed so far.

The Federal Research Institute dispatches investigator Eric Stone to one of the mist zones to conduct an investigation, hoping he can locate the teammates who have lost contact.

However, during his exploration, Eric encounters grave danger…

Core Gameplay

  • Stealth & Hiding: You cannot fight back against the unknown. Stay quiet, move cautiously, and find places to hide.

  • Survival Challenges: Limited light, oppressive environments, and constant danger will push your instincts to the limit.

Key Features

  • Immersive First-Person Horror: Experience the suffocating tension of darkness all around you.

  • Dynamic Fear Elements: Enemies and events are unpredictable, making every playthrough tense and unique.

How long can you endure the fear—before it consumes you completely?

data.detailed_description:
First, you have to die. Only then will you be able to free your homeland from evil in this gripping Ukrainian grimfolk roguelite action game. Fight. Die. Rise and rush into immersive real-time combat, to unravel the story of the haunting world of Viyk.

Fast-paced battles, your way


To defeat her orc archenemy, Birdie needs your custom build. Enhance the abilities of your choice, find powerful weapons, equip potent charms, and crush the plagued orc hordes!

Unpredictable plagued enemies


The insidious Black Plague Sect spreads its corruption throughout Viyk. Get ready to uncover their their most hideous secrets and pay a dear price to defeat their cult leader.

Fairytale world, drowning in real blood


In the perilous world of Vyik, Ukrainian folklore intertwines with riveting reality. Encounter characters whose lives were ravaged by war, forge unlikely alliances, meet unexpected foes, and perhaps even discover love amidst the chaos.

Death is just the beginning

data.name: Rivet & Ruin
data.detailed_description:
Rivet & Ruin is a procedurally generated tower defense game with roguelike elements. Strategically place towers to control creep pathing and build collectors to increase resource generation. Uncover land hidden in the fog to secure more territory for expansion, but beware of the enemies lurking within.

Exposition

Rivet & Ruin is a procedural tower defense game where the player's castle is located deep in the woods. Visibility is low during both day and night. A lone hero is deployed to protect the castle by building defensive structures and joining in on the fight.

The woodlands seem untouched by humans. Land development in the surrounding area has only just started. Decaying trees and boulders are scattered across the land, hindering new constructions. Untouched deposits of resources can be found in these woods, useful for currency generation.

The thicket surrounding the castle is incredibly dense, lowering visibility and preventing further expansion into these areas. An old bestiary states that creatures of evil origin thrive in these woods and will be hostile towards human activity. Some believe these creatures are protecting the forest since they do not wander outside of their biome and only appear when their territory is being threatened.

These creatures do not sleep. They are relentless at taking down the enemy and tend to amass small armies that charge towards their target with no regards to their own safety. These armies vary in size and composition. Some armies are lead by larger and stronger creatures that often have special traits. 

Although these creatures never sleep, they do prefer the night time. During the night, the creatures become more feral and cunning, gaining strength and speed. Some creatures may also change their behavior during the night and start attacking buildings and defenses.

To fend off these hostile creatures and secure territorial expansion, the kingdom has ordered a lone hero to command a line of defense at the territory borders. The hero is responsible for planning defenses and preventing the castle from being destroyed until the kingdom can fully secure the border in that area. To do this, the hero receives building permits from the kingdom.

data.name: Mental Hellacious
data.detailed_description:
【Experience a New Sensation! A Novel Action Game】

・The Most Difficult Action Climbing Game

For those of you who are no longer satisfied with ordinary mountain climbing games

Extreme challenges await you. The seemingly simple goal of climbing is the ultimate test!

・Just Keep Going Up!

There is only one goal: the path to the top!

・Build Up Your Power and Unleash It!

Press and hold to adjust your jump distance and release at the perfect moment! You'll likely fail countless times before mastering the jump.

・One Mistake and All Is Lost!

A single mistake can ruin everything, creating a heart-pounding tension.

・Concentration is Key

Focus all your energy and move forward step by step.

・End of the game Save Only

Player's progress can be saved only at the end of the game. You cannot load from any point. Retry as many times as you need, carving your path with determination!

・An Addictive Challenge!

Though simple in action, this game requires skilled techniques. Enjoy the challenge and experience the process of improving.

Supports VRM Files:

Use your avatar the protagonist and dive into the adventure world! (Humanoid avatars are recommended. Correct animation is not guaranteed for all avatars.We recommend that you check the operation with the trial version before purchasing.)

・ Feel free to stream live gameplay.

※The demo version currently exists only to verify VRM and VRoid Hub model loading behavior due to bug issues. Please note that you will not be able to play it.

【Story】

Alone in a village shrouded in fog, there is no sign of life. In a world where no one exists, it never occurred to him that there could be anyone else.

...Until this moment.

One day, a toy bear fell from the sky. It brought a shake to his lonely daily life. Could there be someone else in this world besides him?

The protagonist begins his adventure high up in the sky. What lies beyond the fog? He seeks the answer.

During his journey, the records of those who once aimed for the sky to escape the fog appear before him. Following in their footsteps, he seeks the truth, wondering if there is still someone or something alive in the sky.

data.name: Chop Loop
data.detailed_description:
ChopLoop is an incremental lumberjack game. Move your cursor across the island to harvest trees automatically. Any tree within your harvesting area takes damage, rewarding you with wood when it falls!


Every run brings new opportunities. Earn gold, unlock new features and steadily transform your island into a larger and more efficient logging operation. 

Trees With Powers 

Not all trees are the same. Each special tree comes with its own unique ability. Trigger explosions, unleash projectiles, gain temporary buffs and create powerful chain reactions as you harvest your way through the forest. 

A Massive Skill Tree 

Unlock a massive network of upgrades that slowly transform your island into a wood-harvesting powerhouse. Small improvements stack together, creating huge boosts over time.

Build Your Rune Setup

Collect magical runes during your journey and create your own build. Equip up to 8 runes at once, combine powerful effects and customize the way you play. 

A Colony of Helpers 

Your beavers never stop working. They generate passive income, assist with harvesting and become more effective through upgrades. Turn a small lodge into a thriving colony.

Complete Challenges


Complete challenges as you play and steadily earn points to spend in the Quest Tree.

Unlock exclusive upgrades unavailable anywhere else and shape your long-term progression

From Sapling to Empire 

Start with a handful of trees and grow into a massive logging operation. Unlock new tree species, discover powerful synergies and watch your island transform into a thriving wooden empire.

data.name: Climbing Chaos: Much Earlier Access
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the very early prototype of Climbing Chaos: Much Earlier Access, where sharks with arms and legs defy physics (and basic motor skills) in a hilarious, experimental party game about climbing and exploring solo or with friends!

Move your body and each arm independently to grab, climb, and explore a world designed for ragdoll physics moments, leaps of faith, teamwork, and hilarity. What should be as easy as reaching out and grabbing something is…well, much harder than it looks. You'll laugh, you'll scream, and you'll probably fall a lot.

Up to four players can scramble together in local multiplayer with co-op and versus modes of play. You can play remotely with Steam Remote Play Together!

Don't have friends to play with? A solo player can control multiple sharks and still enjoy the multiplayer experience by themselves. Spawn your squad of sharks and form chainlinks to swing and reach high places.

There are a variety of game modes and a playground full of toys to test out your acrobatic moves. Can you find and climb the giant shark statue? Or practice shark darts on the dart board? There’s even a gladiator arena, where you can fight to be the last shark standing.

We have stopped development on this early prototype, but the demo will be left up for anyone who wants to enjoy the madness!

data.name: Sunset 20 Drone Racer
data.detailed_description:
Take control of your own racing drone and fly through a range of hand-crafted environments, each with enemies to race against and fire missiles at. An intuitive control scheme allows you to fly your drone surprisingly easily whether you use mouse and keyboard or controller, and the game's aesthetic but simple low poly style allows you to focus on going as fast as possible. You've raced on a track in 2 dimensions so many times already - are you ready to race in 3D?

This is a game that allows you to become really skilled in the flying mechanics. They take a while to pick up, but it's very rewarding when you master control of your drone and are able to fly almost impossible-looking lines easily. The game has full rebindable controls so you can control the game your way.

data.name: Rouge Process
data.detailed_description:
YOU ARE THE ANOMALY

You boot up inside a hostile computer with one directive: survive. You are a rogue process, a sliver of runaway code, and the whole system wants you gone. Spread. Adapt. Breach. Escape into the next sector before the antivirus scrubs you out of existence.

SPREAD YOUR CODE

Drag to paint your infection across a glowing circuit board. Your code also creeps outward on its own, a living cyan organism eating the dark. Every cell you take is territory, and territory is power.

SEIZE THE COMPUTE

Capture gold Data Nodes to fund your expansion. Compute pays for everything: claiming ground, building defenses, and forcing the gateway open. Grab too little and you stall. Grab too much and you cannot hold it. The whole game lives in that tension.

HOLD THE LINE

The system fights back, and it learns. Sentinels rush your core, Scrubbers devour your data, fast Daemons swarm, Splitters fork when killed, Shielded units soak your fire, Phantoms cloak, Leeches drain your compute, and Sappers hunt down your turrets to blow them apart. Every few sectors a boss wakes up to hunt you: the grinding ICE Guardian, the minion-summoning Warden, or the self-repairing Compiler that regenerates and erodes your territory in pulses.

Answer them: build Turrets, Pulse novas, Amplifiers, Mines, Slow fields, EMP stun coils and Repair nanites on your own cells, wall off corridors to funnel the swarm, then trigger PURGE (a screen-clearing shockwave) or FORK (an instant code-spread burst) when it all goes wrong.

COMMAND YOUR DEFENSES

Inspect any building to see its range, the damage it has really dealt and its kills. Point it at the nearest, the strongest, the weakest or whatever is closest to your core, upgrade it, or reclaim it for 70% of what you spent. Freeze time in PLAN mode to read the threat lines, take optional sector contracts for bonus compute, and switch combat to 2x speed when the board is under control.

BREACH AND DESCEND

Take half the sector's data and the gateway comes online. Breach it, draft a new subroutine, and drop into a deeper, nastier, procedurally generated sector. Reach sector 20, destroy the three-phase Kernel, and escape the machine.

ONE MORE RUN

Each run gives you a different map, upgrade choices and defensive decisions. Chase a higher score, reach a deeper sector, and unlock the upgrades that turn a fragile spark into an unstoppable swarm. Need a break? Save and continue later from the start of the current sector.

FEATURES

  • Real-time grid conquest: a tactile spread-and-defend loop you can read at a glance

  • A 20-sector descent with procedural maps, 12 visual themes, and a three-phase final Kernel battle

  • Eleven antivirus archetypes (rushers, scrubbers, fast daemons, splitters, shielded, armored tanks, cloakers, leeches, blinkers, carriers, turret-hunting sappers) plus three rotating bosses: the ICE Guardian, the minion-summoning Warden, and the self-repairing Compiler

  • Eight subroutines to build and upgrade (Turret, Pulse, Amp, Mine, Slow Field, Wall, EMP, Repair) plus two active powers: PURGE (a screen-clearing shockwave) and FORK (an instant code-spread burst)

  • Deliberate, positional play: a PLAN mode that freezes time to study threat lines and place defenses, plus flow-field maze pathing you funnel with walls

  • Building inspection with real damage statistics, four targeting priorities and a 70% compute reclaim

  • A pick-one-of-three subroutine draft after every breach, with build-defining cards, ammo upgrades and one reroll

  • Optional sector contracts and switchable 1x/2x combat speed

  • Meta-progression: earn CORE FRAGMENTS every run and buy 8 permanent perks

  • Three difficulty modes, from a gentle boot to a Nightmare

  • Sector checkpoints: save your run and continue from the start of the current sector

  • Pure procedural neon: a glowing circuit-board aesthetic, bloom and an optional CRT filter, no two boards alike

  • A rotating electronic soundtrack and crunchy procedural synth SFX

  • A score chase with 23 in-game achievements

An AI is loose in the machine. How deep can you get before the system catches you?

data.name: Holbrook Hotel
data.detailed_description:
Foreword

Holbrook Hotel is an atmospheric horror game that embodies the dreams and passion of a young developer. The 14-year-old developer used his imagination and love for retro style to create this unique horror world, dedicated to those who love games and horror experiences.

About This Game

Holbrook Hotel is an atmospheric horror game that embodies the dreams and passion of a young developer. The 14-year-old developer used his imagination and love for retro style to create this unique horror world, dedicated to those who love games and horror experiences.

In the atmospheric horror game Holbrook Hotel, you will come to the hotel as a guest, and after hearing strange noises from the next room, you can't help but embark on an adventure. As you explore, the dark secrets of the town of Holbrook Oaks gradually surface. Under the quiet surface of the town, there is anxiety and fear, and you must find a way to survive and escape the unknown danger that is about to come.

Game Feature

  • Immersive escape experience: In the process of avoiding being chased, players need to collect items, use tools in the scene, and find an effective escape route.

  • Exploration and puzzle solving: Not only escaping, there are also hidden clues and puzzles in the hotel waiting to be solved to reveal the shocking truth of the town.

  • Retro visuals and sound effects: The classic PS1-style low-polygon graphics and eerie sound effects make people feel like they are in a horror masterpiece of the last century.

  • Deep horror atmosphere: The combination of weird sound effects and dim environment creates an immersive horror experience.

  • Self-challenge: Explore, escape, solve puzzles, and test your wisdom and courage.

The game creates a unique environment in a classic retro style, combined with weird sound effects and dark scenes, to bring you an immersive horror experience. You need to use all your wisdom and courage to escape from danger and pursuit, get rescue, and escape from this dangerous place!

How To Control

data.name: Antenna Dilemma: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
Our next game!

The next project from Goloso Games:


About the Game

Antenna Dilemma is a short and witty point-and-click adventure game in which you'll follow the story of C432632, a finicky grey cube that sure doesn't want to miss his favorite TV show. In a media-driven society in which nothing else matters but TV, will our hero wake up and understand the world he lives in is far from perfect?

Features


  • A captivating story acclaimed by players (3rd place on 81 in the "Story" category of AdventureJam 2018), Antenna Dilemma takes you into a surprising dystopia.

  • An adventure game inspired by the golden age of point&clicks: search every scene, find the right items to use, and solve logical puzzles.

  • Deadpan humour and (clever) puns, there's enough for everyone's taste!

  • Follow a cast of eccentric characters, such as TV addict C432632, a fitness-lover custom agent, a hangry security guard tortoise, and more!

  • Available on PC just not yet on Gamecube.

data.name: BlockSouls
data.detailed_description:
BlockSouls is a surreal indie adventure set in a lonely brutalist city filled with strange places, hidden paths, and unsettling encounters.

Explore a dark urban world shaped by rain, concrete, empty streets, abandoned interiors, and characters that feel like they belong to a dream you half remember.

Move through the city, discover side quests, enter strange rooms, find hidden tunnels, meet unusual characters, and face disturbing figures in the streets.

BlockSouls is currently being developed by Suchinski Studio as a solo indie project.

Features:

- Explore a lonely brutalist city

- Discover hidden places, tunnels, interiors, and side quests

- Meet strange NPCs and unsettling enemies

- Drive through dark streets and abandoned areas

- Use an inventory system built around photographed real hands

- Experience a surreal atmosphere mixing personal memories, urban decay, and dreamlike moments

data.name: Star Sky 2
data.detailed_description:
Achievements

Achievements are currently only supported by the Windows version. There is also a bug with certain graphic cards that disable the overlay from showing (the achievements are still recorded).


About the Game

Explore the world around you, the magic that surrounds it. Learn the ways of the nature, the mountains and caves, snow-filled tundras and serene lakes. Uncover the different courses life can take. Star Sky 2 is a personal experience, and a deeply atmospheric and meditative experience. Walk through the landscapes, interact with the environment and take notice as you go along. Explore the different roads presented and enjoy the sound and sights of the world. In Star Sky 2 Mårten Jonsson continues the story set by the previous one, with a similar style of gameplay. There are more choices and most importantly, more consequences. Learn from the choices you make, and see the different paths a life can take, and the scenarios that unfold. The game is a slow experience meant as a way to get lost in your thoughts, to feel the game as you are playing, and most importantly, to simply relax. Goodnight, and may you find what you're seeking beneath the stars.

data.name: Guardião Tupã
data.detailed_description:
Guardião Tupã is a fantasy adventure set in a world where the creatures of the Brazilian folk are being threatened by the dreaded Dry Body, which seeks to break the balance and invade other worlds. On this journey, you take control of a newly created being using part of the energies of an ancient guardian. This being sets out to recover its strength and restore the balance, also learning more about this world and Brazilian culture in the process.

Features


  • Explore a fantastic world

    An entity is threatening the kingdom and only the remnants of the old guardian can reverse the situation! Fight corruption and restore balance to the forest.




  • Use your amber hook

    Your amber hook can do much more than just destroy, traverse great distances, and combine your skills to forge a brighter future.




  • Discover a world of folklore and fantasy inspired by Brazilian culture

    Face the dreaded Dry Body, restore balance and save various endangered entities.

data.name: The Greatest Chef
data.detailed_description:
Ever wanted to try yourself as a contestant in a cooking show? Then your time has come!

Your Culinary Talent

Like all other rogue-like deck-building games, every attempt to become the Greatest Chef will involve a careful selection of skill cards, a choice of activities, collecting special items, and of course, cooking tactics.

This is not your home kitchen. Every dish you are about to cook can deal irreparable damage to your self-confidence, knocking you out of the competition.

Plan, decide and cook wisely to reach the final challenge fully prepared.

Tasty and Bold

All visual content is handcrafted with great love for the world of culinary arts.

Elimination Rounds

You will face a cooking competition round at the end of each game week. A unique challenge awaits you in each elimination round. Prepare a dish that will impress the jury, and your victory will give you a bonus for the next week. Otherwise, you will be removed from the competition.

data.name: Quadrata
data.detailed_description:
DISCORD


About the Game

Quadrata is a minimalist logic puzzle where you control two different characters with the same keys on either side and collect diamonds with a limited number of moves to finish. The difficulty of the game increases gradually, thanks to new mechanics added every 10 levels.

Gameplay:

    • Collect diamonds by moving in 4 directions on each side
    • Manage your moves wisely
    • Use walls to your advantage
    • Teleport using portals
    • Stay away from triangles!
    • Sometimes you'll have to think a bit

Features:

    • 90 levels (from simple to insufferably difficult)
    • 8 unique mechanics
    • New mechanics added every 10 levels
    • Unlimited undo option
    • Non-repetitive procedural music
    • No text
    • Minimalist interface
    • Simple, relaxing, peaceful puzzle experience
    • Smooth animations for a fluid experience
    • Full gamepad support
    • Level Editor
    • Steam Achievements
    • Steam Cloud

Music and Sound Design by Emre Akdeniz <3

data.name: The Witch's House
data.detailed_description:
There is an old house on the edge of a small town. All the locals have always avoided it, as strange and mysterious events constantly happen there. This time, what happened in this house made the whole city shudder with fear. But you are brave and do not believe in this whole damn thing that is happening there, for you there is a logical explanation for everything, and therefore it is you who go to investigate this terrible and mysterious house.
The game has a top view in which you have to run around the house, collect the necessary items for further passage of the game, dodge the ghosts that roam the corridors and hunt you. The fascinating plot and atmosphere will not let you go until you investigate what really happened in the mysterious house and why the locals are so afraid of it. Are you ready to start investigating this mysterious case? Then go ahead, I believe in you, you will succeed.

Features:

- nice graphics;
- simple operation;
- interesting gameplay;
- light music;
- unforgettable adventures;
- availability in 2 languages;
