data.name: Turn Limit 100
data.detailed_description:
Steam engines and trams. Gaslight giving way to electric light. Kimono and three-piece suits sharing the same street. Nagoria is a world caught between Taishō-era romance and an encroaching modern West. Long ago, colossal guardian machines called Boundary Vessels were built to hold the world back from total ruin. Now, for reasons of their own, they have begun to stir again — trying to write the present back into the shape of that final, ruinous day.

Nagoria, a world where the light is new, yet the wounds remain old. Now those old wounds have begun to turn the world back to what it was. Carrying someone's memory, the journey begins again — and again, and again.

Core Gameplay: A Deck-Building Roguelike With a 100-Turn Clock

Gather cards called Echoes — fragments of the dead's memories — and build your own deck to fight your way through. So far, so familiar, if you've played a deck-building roguelike before. But TURN LIMIT 100 runs on a clock no other game in the genre does.

You get exactly 100 turns, total, for the whole run.

Burn through them, and it's a forced defeat — no matter how much HP you have left. A deck built only to survive will eventually be swallowed by the clock. The fewer turns it takes to put an enemy down, the higher your score climbs. This isn't just a game about winning. It's about winning fast.

Features

  • A hard 100-turn clock[/b] — Run it out, and you're forced to lose. Every choice weighs speed against safety.

  • Three playable characters, three very different runs — Start as the nameless Wayfarer of the Remnant, then unlock the Shinobi of the Wharf and the Miko of the Shrine Approach as your score grows. Each carries a unique card pool and starting artifacts that demand a completely different plan of attack.

  • Three formidable Boundary Vessels— Ancient guardian weapons, one dwelling in each faction's territory: faith, trade, and military rule. Worshipped, traded, or turned into a weapon — each carries the weight of its own fate into the fight.

  • Forked paths and rest sites— Take the safe detour, or the fast shortcut. Every decision echoes straight into your turn count.

  • Artifacts and upgrades— Dig up artifacts and refine your deck at rest sites, building your own speed-clearing machine one run at a time.

  • 28 achievements — Beyond simply clearing a run, chase challenge achievements built to test real skill: no artifacts dug, minimal HP, a flawless boss kill, a lean deck, and more.

  • A world where East meets West — Explore Nagoria across three stages, each ruled by a different faction, in a setting steeped in nostalgia and quiet unease.

  • One Run Is Short. The Journey Isn't.A single run won't take long — that's the point. But it's far from the whole game. Cumulative score unlocks new characters, and several of the 28 achievements are next to impossible to earn in a single clear. Rebuild your deck, switch characters, take on self-imposed challenges, and keep shaving turns off your best time. That's where TURN LIMIT 100 really begins.

    You have 100 turns. Carry someone's memory, and run.

data.name: Time For Revenge
data.detailed_description:
Time For Revenge is a co-op survival horror game where 5 people got together to get their revenge from the Chef for his cruelty when they were in the orphanage.
The Chef.. He is still evil but he turned out even more inhuman. His vision is mostly gone but he can smell way better than the average human. He can see the odour trail the avengers left behind. No place is safe from the Chef.
But the situation has changed. It turns out the Chef is still keeping some children captive. Now players have a new goal. Save the children from the Chef and escape the town before Chef gets you!
Game Features:
  • Inventory system.
  • Character customization.
  • Level Up system.
  • Increasing difficulty as you level up.
  • Build your own safe house.
  • Single Player support.
  • Voice commands.
  • Play as a human or the Chef.

data.name: The House Always Wins
data.detailed_description:
The hand you’re dealt is only the opening bid. Roll Dice to empower cards for the rest of the battle, then combine their effects with Relics and Cheats until an ordinary turn becomes a devastating play. Exacties make every point of damage matter, rewarding builds that can bring an enemy to exactly zero.

  • Empower cards using Dice for the remainder of the battle.

  • Combine cards, Relics and Cheats into powerful synergies.

  • Deal Exacties to trigger card and Relic abilities.

One Relic can change a fight. The right combination can change an entire run. Every Relic grants a unique ability, while matching ranks and suits forms powerful Relic Combos. Build several combinations at once and turn a collection of individual Relics into a strategy far greater than the sum of its parts.

  • Gain a unique ability from every Relic.

  • Match ranks and suits to form Relic Combos.

  • Combine multiple Relic Combos in the same run.

Fair play is a terrible strategy. Socket Gems into cards to permanently change how they behave—reduce costs, draw cards, double plays and more. Choose from 12 single-use Cheats for the moments when your deck needs something impossible. The House may control the casino, but you decide when to break its rules.

  • Modify cards with 7 different Gems.

  • Discover 12 Cheats with powerful abilities.

  • Time each Cheat for maximum impact.

The elevator only goes one way. Everything else is up to chance—and you. Every run generates a new map of Battles, Elite Battles, Quests, Events, Gem Shops and Cheat Shops. Routes, encounters and opportunities change with every attempt, while each Battle takes place in one of four casino universes with its own enemies and atmosphere. Each attempt also earns XP, raising your progression level and unlocking new cards, Relics, Gems, Cheats, Quests and mechanics.

  • Navigate a newly generated map through 3 full Acts.

  • Earn XP and level up to unlock new ways to play.

  • Climb through 10 difficulty levels.

Despite the casino theme, the game contains no gambling mechanics — only strategy, synergies, and replayability.

data.name: Frostrain 2
data.detailed_description:
Frostrain 2 is a roguelike game built around synergy-building, with a touch of management elements added to the mix. In this frozen world, you take on the role of the last remaining Conductor within the train society and must lead your passengers to survival. Acquire, place, and upgrade train cars to generate Happiness, and make decisive choices to determine the direction your train will take.

Combine a wide range of train synergies with hundreds of powerful artifacts to generate more Happiness. Greater Happiness will further solidify your authority within the train society.

Upgrade your train and arrange it to suit each situation. Proper placement and enhancement of train cars will allow you to generate even more Happiness.

You are the last remaining Conductor of humanity, tasked with ruling the final train society. Each run presents you with randomly occurring events—respond to them, resolve them, and obtain the outcomes you need.

Make decisive choices and lead your train society toward the future you believe in.

As the Conductor, you must also decide the train’s direction. Travel through dozens of landmarks across diverse environments, find the optimal route, and guide your passengers to survival.

At the end of each run, you will earn Purple Coins. Spend them to unlock new artifacts.

As the story unfolds, you will uncover the tales of different Conductors. Unlock future Conductors and help fulfill their long-held aspirations.

If you prove yourself a truly exceptional Conductor, you can guide your passengers even through the harshest conditions. Challenge the “Frost Mode” and discover hidden rewards.

Fulfill certain special conditions... and you might just uncover the Conductors’ hidden stories.

data.name: Frog Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
Adventures Await!

Frog Odyssey is a turn-based auto-battler where frog heroes, guided by honesty and courage, confront corrupted animals whose bad habits disturb the balance of the land. Buy and combine ingredients to craft special dishes, feed them to your frogs, and unlock powerful bonuses as you restore peace across the world.

Unique Characters !

Recruit and upgrade frogs with different abilities, creating powerful synergies and strategies.

Delicious Food !

Buy and combine ingredients to craft special dishes, then feed them to your frogs for game-changing bonuses.

Story

In a world where not all creatures live by honesty and fairness, the frog heroes rise to defend what is right. Guided by their unwavering values, they cannot ignore the harm caused by those who fall into selfish habits.

What begins as small disturbances soon grows into chaos spreading across the land. Food is stolen, trust is broken, and harmony between creatures begins to fade. The frogs know that if no one stands against this, their world will fall deeper into disorder.

And so, they set out on a heroic journey. Through each encounter, they face animals who have strayed from the path of virtue, challenging them in battle to reveal the strength of honesty, courage, and justice.

It is a quest to restore balance and remind the world that true strength comes from values worth defending.

Still in development...

Stay up to date by adding the game to your Wishlist and following us on social media.

data.detailed_description:
Can you survive the nightmare and take control of the dream?

You wake up in the maze of the monster - Bartholomew. In this maze, reality shifts between nightmare and dream, a constant cat and mouse chase where you take contrasting roles in each state.

During the Dream State you will need to chase Bartholomew and try your best to put him down with your trusty revolver however you need to be quick before the nightmare state begins anew.

In the Nightmare State, You are disarmed and hunted, the only viable options are your traps that can help slow down the monstrosity chasing you.

Collect the coins scattered along the maze so you can buy upgrades for your revolver and additional traps to kill the beast faster.

Don't stop running, don't stop hunting. HE. IS. Bartholomew...

data.name: Duskers 2.0
data.detailed_description:
Scavenge derelict spacecraft with your drones, navigating past whatever is still alive in the dark, in order to save what little of humanity is left.

You sit alone at a terminal, surrounded by old gritty tech that acts as your only eyes and ears to the outside world. You control drones as they explore derelict spacecraft - in an attempt to salvage equipment and the survivors left behind. What you hear comes through a remote microphone. What you see is how each drone sees the world. 

Motion sensors tell you something's out there, but not what. And when you issue commands, you do it through a command line interface.

The procedurally generated universe pushes back at every turn, with hazards as you travel between systems, and creatures lurking in the darkness of the derelicts you explore. Weapons are rare, so you'll often need to use sensor and ship functions to avoid or trap anything that's wandering the derelicts.

But even if you find a way, the sensor that you rely on may break down, or your lures may run out - even your drone's camera feed can start to fail. Your strategy will have to adapt to your current equipment and surroundings.

What will you sacrifice to bring humanity back? When you die you lose everything... but the survivors you rescue don't. At the beginning of each run you'll get reports back - detailing how they have fared on the planet you chose for them, with the equipment you left them with. For each settlement you'll learn who survived and who didn't - their triumphs and failures.

Features

  • Use a Command Line Interface to control drones & ship systems

  • Explore procedurally generated derelict ships and maneuver system hazards as you chart a course across the galaxy

  • Upgrade your ship and your drones, with equipment you salvage along the way

  • Find survivors in cryostasis and send them to the best planet you can, with equipment to help them survive

Sequel

This game is a sequel to our previous game: Duskers

About us

We're the indie studio behind Duskers, Below the Crown, and A Virus Named TOM

data.name: Prime World Legends
data.detailed_description:
Prime World is a free online game in RPG / MOBA genre with a unique universe where tactical session battles, castle management, and hero development are mixed together. It is inspired by the original Prime World by Nival.

ATTENTION: Prime World Legends is a fan-made game based on the original Prime World. It uses the official open-source code of Prime World under a license agreement with NIVAL INTERNATIONAL LTD.

Prime World brings the MOBA genre to a new level:

 play in different modes;

 improve your heroes not only on the battlefield but also in your own castle;

 gather and create lethal combinations of skills;

 use these combinations in battles to defeat your enemies.

An incredible amount of talents and skins allows you to build up a one of a kind character depending on your preferences!

The game is based on the conflict of lords, who fight in the endless battle for control over prime - the most important resource, the possession of which can change the alignment of forces. Prime is magic and a source of technology, a dangerous alien substance, which can change the world and give power over it - everyone needs it. The one who controls the prime, controls the whole world!

Gather a collection of exclusive talents and create an army of invincible heroes. Attack the enemy towers and conquer new territories. Conclude profitable alliances with other clans or subordinate them in battle. Become the first in the world of Praya!


Every hero in the world of Praya can become one of a kind with the help of the talent system.


Prime World features an exclusive terramorphing system, which allows you to capture lands by raising your faction’s flag over it. Native terrain beneath hero’s feet makes him more powerful.


There are few combat modes in the game, which are a bit different from each other. Check the schedule of the modes being online in the special thread in our Community Hub!


Every hero has multiple individual skins, which are made limited timed to different special occasions. Choose a suitable look for your hero, it’s up to you, how it will look like! What is more, skins provide suitable voice-overs and can even change the hero’s gender.


Prime World combines tactical fights with strategic elements. You can become a powerful commander and a magnificent ruler of your castle at the same time!


The game is based on the conflict of lords leading constant battles for prime with the help of their Heroes - warriors with unique abilities who can return to battle after being defeated again and again.


Prime World offers its players a rich social system: players can join clans and develop them together, capture clans of other players.


There are numerous ways to upgrade your character in battle sessions, from farming creeps to playing mini-games on the base. This makes PvP part of the game even more diverse.

data.name: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
data.detailed_description:
Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based games, using real one-word answers from real people. Really!

Welcome to a new era of party games!

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All game modes supports 2 to 10 players and 10,000 audience members.

All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well. Crikey!

Multiple New Game Modes

Hilo: Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.

Speed: In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?

Squares: Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.

Bounce: In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer!

Dash: The race is on! You’re competing against your fellow players: find the most popular answer in a group of options taken from one of our enormous lists to move ahead. Double down on your choice for more progress (or more punishment), send extra choices to your opponent’s list to slow them down, and tune into public opinion to outpace everyone on your way to the finish line.

  • A game for everyone: Multiple family-friendly modes mean that there’s something to enjoy for every type of party game player.

data.name: It's Only Money
data.detailed_description:
It's Only Money: Minimum Wage Demo


It's Only Money: Founders Edition

Show your day one support for the liberation of Rockhaven with It's Only Money: Founders Edition!


Join Our Discord


About the Game

It's Only Money is a 3rd person open world simulation game where you take the role of an Undercity resident – someone forced to live amongst the sewers and subways by the newly elected evil Mayor.

Along with other Undercity residents, you will venture to the surface to steal, fight and destroy. Take down corporations owned by the Mayor’s corrupt cohorts. Win back the city for everyone, block by block. Buy houses, businesses, clothes, cars and whatever else your materialistic heart desires. Play alone or bring up to three friends to share in the chaos.

Rockhaven is your playground. Explore a dynamic city filled with shops, houses, activities, and missions. Unleash your creativity as you exploit the open world to your advantage: pickpocket the wealthy, steal cars for a wild joyride, or jack a UFO and take it for a spin! Test your combat skills with new moves available at the Dojo, or take on the Mayor’s inner circle in epic Takeover missions, including boss fights against his lieutenants.

Feeling tactical? Recruit Homies from the Undercity, who follow, fight, and contribute to your street misdeeds, making every heist more thrilling.

As you claw back cash from the city’s elite, use your ill-gotten gains to purchase homes and businesses. Every house you buy brings more people back from the Undercity to the surface, allowing you to customise their living spaces for gameplay buffs and unique items. Invest in properties like the landlord you’ve always wanted to be. Become the 1%! Profit off the land and contribute nothing to society! Concentration of wealth? Sounds like a poor people problem.

Business ownership isn’t just about money; it’s about power. Manage the Slimeway to create a steady income stream and unlock new gameplay opportunities. Want more action? Rake in cash, REP, and other rewards when you dive into some of the city’s tantalising, minimum wage earning side-hustle minigames.Hustling for a wage too boring for you? We got you covered. Go bigger with the latest addition to Rockhaven’s underground scene - the 'Metro Dungeon'. A roguelite experience where every wave of enemies brings more upgrades and strange powers to make you feel absolutely unstoppable.

Make your mark on Rockhaven not only by dressing the best but also with fully customisable vehicles. Whether you're tweaking the headlight colour, installing hydraulics for jumps, or kitting out your ride with NOS, the possibilities are endless, with millions of part combinations. Unlock new parts by jacking and crushing cars around the city, then bring them back to your garage to build the wildest ride Rockhaven has ever seen. Just remember - without a seatbelt, crashing will send you flying.

It's Only Money is a playground for you and up to three friends. Steal together, fight together, and complete missions together - or just hang out in the Slimeway and gamble away your hard-earned cash on snail racing. If competition is more your style, dive into various PvP microgames like Prop Hunt or Gorb Rush, where you're thrown into a giant orb and tasked with being the last one standing on a sky high platform.

With tons of new content, including expanded player upgrades, new missions, and enhanced vehicle systems, Rockhaven is yours to take back. The Mayor took everything from you - now it’s time for payback.

Enjoy the ride, cause chaos, and, most importantly, reclaim what's yours.

data.name: Live checkpoint
data.detailed_description:
The apocalypse came and a huge number of zombies invaded the planet. Help the main character protect himself and his refuge from the attack of bloodthirsty monsters.

The game is a 2D platformer with a side view of the game. The main task of the game is to protect the checkpoint from bloodthirsty zombies and prevent them from breaking inside, because there are people in the building, and the walking dead are eager to taste their brains. Destroying the wave of enemies after the wave, we collect the fallen coins, on which we can buy improved weapons and supplies for them, as well as we can upgrade the structure.

Game Features:
- 4 types of weapons
- Old school gameplay
- Pixel art graphics

data.name: Parker & Lane: Twisted Minds
data.detailed_description:
When a killer from Parker’s childhood plots a series of murders, she must face her past before it steals her future!

Join Lily Parker and Victor Lane as they try to solve their most mysterious crime yet. Parker has gone from rookie to being one of the best detectives on the force. Yet, what is to come may be too much for even her extraordinary detective skills!

A restaurant owner is found standing over a dead body with a bloody knife in his hand. An open-and-shut case, right? But Parker has doubts…

The traumatic events of her childhood are coming back to her, and the M.O. appears to be the same as back then. But when more victims start to fall, all the evidence points to one person - Parker?!

Unravel the mystery, find justice for Parker and the victims, and bring back law and order. People are counting on you!

Features


🚨 Master all 12 mini games and become a top detective

🚨 Use Your police Skills to Solve Crimes

🚨 find the Criminal Before It’s too Late!

🚨 Witness A dangerously Compelling story

🚨 perform Csi Tasks and Examine Clues

🚨 Use forensic tools to analyze weapons, fingerprints and DNA samples

🚨 Level up your detective team and make them stronger and better

🚨 Uncover clues in 60 levels and 30 challenge levels

🚨 Investigate in 10 locations, including 6 crime scenes

data.name: Space Hulk: Ascension (Classic)
data.detailed_description:
Re-release

Originally released in 2014, Space Hulk: Ascension is the standalone sequel to its 2013 predecessor, Space Hulk, and builds on its faithful adaptation of Games Workshop’s classic board game. With added RPG elements, deeper progression systems, and expanded tactical options, it earned a dedicated following within the Warhammer 40,000 community. It now returns to Steam with a range of updates, ensuring a smooth experience on modern systems (see “WHAT’S INSIDE THIS RELEASE” in the section below).


Includes

This re-release includes:

  • Base game

  • Successor Chapter Pack DLC

  • Dark Angels DLC

  • Salamanders DLC

  • Imperial Fist DLC


About the Game

Set in the isolated corridors and tomb-like chambers of ancient vessels lost in the graveyard of space, players lead a small force of fearless Space Marine Terminators in a ferocious fight for survival against hordes of predatory, alien Genestealers.

The standalone sequel to Space Hulk brings an all new and improved single-player experience for the turn-based strategy game.

WHAT’S INSIDE THIS RELEASE

This edition updates Space Hulk: Ascension to run smoothly on modern Windows systems, delivering improved user experience. The game’s UI now scales properly up to 4K resolution, and Steam Cloud saves are supported. Based on community feedback, various gameplay and interface improvements have been introduced to enhance overall usability, including reducing unintended actions during gameplay.

Please note: This version no longer includes native Linux and Mac support. A previous version with native support remains available via the “Legacy” branch in the game’s properties.

FEATURES

New Ultramarines Chapter

An all new Space Marine chapter, including a Terminator armed with Cyclone missile launcher.

Terminator Progression and Customisation

Earn XP during missions and level up attributes and skills, and give your Terminators a personal touch by customising their names, weapon loadout and appearance.

Campaigns and Missions

100+ missions spread out over 3 complete campaigns, and all new flash missions. These are opportunistic mini-missions encountered as you explore the deep unknowns of the Space Hulk that can yield a tactical advantage or be a deadly trap.

Rogue Mode

Play random generated Hulks in this all new way to play Space Hulk collecting points to challenge friends and foes on Steam Leaderboards.

Exploration and Discovery

Terminators reveal the layout of the Space Hulk as they venture deep into the darkness.

Additional Weapons, Tactical Options and Game Rules

Game mechanics have been reworked to make Space Hulk Ascension a true video game experience. Combi-weapons (Combi-Melta, Combi-Plasma and a Combi-Flamer) have been added to the game as well different firing modes like aimed shots and alternate flamer patterns.

Genestealer Variations

Genestealers with Fleshhook, Feeder Tendril and Acid Maw biomorphs have been added to the game, each with their own special game mechanics. You can also encounter biomorphs with scythes that have multiple attacks or carapace for increased armor.

WARHAMMER CLASSICS

Warhammer Classics is a collection of the greatest titles from the annals of Warhammer video game history, spanning the last 30 years, brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy. These games have been revived in their original state. Because of their classic nature, some of the content may not accurately reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the current Warhammer universes and settings.

data.name: ZeroZeta
data.detailed_description:
ZeroZeta is a precision racing game that is:

  • true minimal

  • weird and different

  • very chill and calming

Soar through hand-crafted levels and shave milliseconds from your time.

Listen to great surreal, lo-fi and ambient music and satisfying sound effects.
Discover the flow of perfect runs.
Whether you're chasing personal bests or just casually gliding, ZeroZeta is a game you can sink into. 

MECHANICS

  • Score - start with a set time for each level, finish quicker to get more score

  • Obstacles - the game contains 5 types of obstacles, learn to use them to your advantage

  • Minimal controls - you can only turn left/right, you auto thrust forward, be creative when you need to brake

  • Unlockable options - best score on a level counts towards a sum, as you sum rises you will unlock more options

Whether you're chasing personal bests or just casually gliding, ZeroZeta is a game you can sink into. 

MECHANICS

  • Score - start with a set time for each level, finish quicker to get more score

  • Obstacles - the game contains 5 types of obstacles, learn to use them to your advantage

  • Minimal controls - you can only turn left/right, you auto thrust forward, be creative when you need to brake

  • Unlockable options - best score on a level counts towards a sum, as you sum rises you will unlock more options

data.name: Tongue of Dog
data.detailed_description:
Join Discord

5Wxh4WmTbY


About the Game

A 'Getting Over It' style game. Play as a cute dog. Lick, grip, and swing with your tongue. Overcome 8 distinct levels: Big Swings, Ice Sliding, Space Drifting, Volcano Escaping, etc. No checkpoints. Has collectables, leaderboards, and dog customisation.

Obviously, we learned from ‘Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy’, but the game wasn't all about hurting a certain kind of person. We were trying to find a balance between psychological horror and classic level design.

We learned Nintendo-style level design patterns. Each level has a unique element running through it and combined with other elements to create challenges. The entire game has 8 normal levels, 4 types of mechanisms, and 3 types of level mechanisms.

This game is undoubtedly challenging, and you may experience repeated failures. However, with practice and experimentation, you will gradually master the art of tongue skills and gain control over your dog's movements, allowing you to navigate forward with flexibility and precision.

data.name: Ash of Gods: The Way
data.detailed_description:
BEFORE YOU PLAY


About the Game

Build winning decks of warriors, equipment, and spells from four different factions in this story-driven tactical card combat game. Battle your way through a series of major tournaments, each with their own opponents, battlefields, and even rules. Earn new cards and upgrade your favorites, then combine them into any number of decks: you’re free to experiment as much as you like! Do prepare carefully for key battles with major characters: you’ll only get a few chances before defeat will change the course of the story, though the game continues…



All the while you will meet new characters, have conversations, and make decisions that will affect the fate of the entire world.



You play as Finn, a young man whose only hope of preventing a neighboring nation from attacking his home is to master the card game they use to teach aristocrats the art of warfare: the Way. Infiltrate the tournaments they hold, and you can get close to their elite commanders. What you do once you get there will be up to you. Just remember, your decisions have consequences!

The core gameplay is deceptively simple: every turn you can play one warrior, and one support card, then all your units will advance towards the enemy and attack if they can! But the challenge comes in what combinations you choose, how you build your deck, and when you hold back cards for a better opportunity. Your opponents play by the same rules… most of the time. Each battle can have different rules or special features that can be exploited by smart deck building!



Warriors range from front line brutes to fragile archers and supporting spellcasters. Equipment cards buff warriors on the battlefield, while spells can aid your fighters or harm the enemy. There’s no one way to play - build a deck that uses tough fighters with armor and healing to grind down your opponents, roll in with high damage archers and poison wielding bandits to put down enemy warriors before they can even react, and much more. With a huge range of cards to choose from, the number of possible combinations is enormous.

EVERY BATTLE IS A NEW CHALLENGE!


Each battle in Ash of Gods: The Way is a carefully crafted test of your skills with different objectives and opponents. Whether you’re capturing checkpoints, defending your commander from a deadly enemy or fighting a series of one on one duels you’ll need all your wits about you to prevail. The outcome of every battle is significant!



Make sure to use every detail of the battlefield to your advantage. You’ll encounter traps which can be a danger or an opportunity depending on your strategy, and power runes which could change the course of a battle entirely!

If your current tactics aren’t working out, just switch out your cards and upgrades to try something different — there’s no penalty for experimentation or changing strategy.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY


Ash of Gods: The Way is a novel genre mix of RPG style conversations, a collectible card game, and a turn-based tactical battle — your choices in all of these areas will influence the outcome of your story.



You build your deck in Ash of Gods: The Way with a combination of character cards and support cards. Your characters are deployed to the battlefield, while support cards boost your characters or cast powerful spells. Both types of card can be upgraded to become stronger, and characters can even gain brand new skills like cunning counter-attacks or armor smashing strikes.



Each card belongs to one of five distinct factions in the game, all with their own synergies and metagame strengths. Earn new cards by winning battles, buying them, or completing special tasks. You can mix and match faction cards as you wish, or focus on just one — it’s your call — your way.

INTERACTIVE STORY WITH MULTIPLE ENDINGS


The story centers on young Finn who is sent on a dangerous mission that could stop a murderous war… but on his journey he'll learn that some of his enemies are quite different from what he’s been told. There will be hard decisions to make and Finn will have to live with the consequences. In addition to the non-linear main plot, told through (fully voice acted) cutscenes and conversations, there are also side quests to explore.



And last but certainly not least, you can join us on Discord for all the latest Ash of Gods updates.

data.name: Survivor Rat vs Zombies
data.detailed_description:
A SURVIVAL GAME THAT SITS ON YOUR DESKTOP

Survivor Rat vs Zombies is a tiny wasteland island that floats on top of your windows. No fullscreen, no alt-tabbing: the window is transparent, and every click outside the island goes straight through to whatever you are working on. Drag it to any corner, scale it from 50% to 200%, keep it always on top or let it hide — it idles quietly until the next wave.

BY DAY: SCAVENGE, COOK, CRAFT

Your rat has no health bar — only hunger, thirst and radiation, and any one of them can end the run. Break down plank piles, rubble and scrap heaps, pick mushrooms, hunt the crow, boil dirty barrel water and stay away from the glowing sludge. Then open the workbench: better tools mean more resources per trip, better weapons mean more zombies per shot.

BUILD A TREE HOUSE

The ground is not safe at night. Lay a wooden platform in the dead tree, tile by tile, and fill it with machines: a furnace for steel, a workshop for advanced recipes, a rain collector, a mushroom garden, a still for fuel, an ammo press, turrets, a floodlight and a shock coil. Space is tight, so every tile is a decision.

BY NIGHT: HOLD THE LADDER

The old TV flickers red, fog rolls over the island — and they come. Zombies crowd the trunk and climb the ladder one after another. Knock them off with your bare paws, then with a slingshot, a crossbow, a shotgun, an assault rifle, a flamethrower, a rocket launcher or a tesla gun. Throw grenades and Molotovs, set bear traps and mines, drive spikes into the trunk. Every wave is bigger and tougher than the last.

ONE GOAL: CALL FOR EVACUATION

Radio parts drop only from zombies, and you need a lot of them. Build the radio, send the signal — and survive the final stand while the whole wasteland comes for you.

FEATURES

  • A desktop widget game: transparent, click-through, draggable, scalable, always-on-top optional
  • Survival and tower defense on a single screen, played entirely with the mouse
  • More than 40 tools, weapons, supplies and buildings to craft across four tech tiers
  • 11 weapons, plus grenades, Molotovs, traps, mines and trunk spikes
  • 11 buildings for your tree house, most of them upgradable
  • Endlessly growing waves and a long run toward the final evacuation
  • Hand-made pixel art, synthesized sound and music
  • Autosave: close the game any time and continue later
  • Built-in tutorial and “How to play” guide
  • 11 languages

data.detailed_description:
Drop planets to combine them. If they go over the limit, you lose and they explode!

If you want to reset, then create a black hole (which also forms after you combine two suns). However, if you use this ability it will half your points and it only works once a game so choose when to use it carefully.

To get extra points, try to chain multiple planet combinations together to get a combo bonus.

There's a total of 4 abilities at your disposal. Another example, is the lightning, which destroys any planet it strikes.

Bounce, Merge, and Evolve Slimes to Brew the Ultimate Beer! 🍺

Your goal? Create delicious beer from bouncing slimes! Brew, brew, brew, and drink, drink, drink to your heart's content! 🍺🍺🍺

data.name: Keziah's Realm
data.detailed_description:
Keziah’s Realm is an immersive survival game where you and 144 NPCs are scattered across a vast map divided into 36 procedurally generated chunks, each belonging to one of eight unique biomes. From the very start, you must forage for resources, craft essential items, and defend yourself to survive the perilous first night. From then on collaboration is key; forming clans with other survivors allows each member to specialize in roles such as hunting for food or constructing shelters. This specialization enables players to focus on their strengths while relying on their clanmates for other essential tasks, fostering a dynamic and cooperative gameplay experience.

As clans grow by recruiting more members, a leader will be elected based on their popularity and contributions. data.name: Muerte's Arena
data.detailed_description:
Voxels and Vector Graphics combine in a VR Arcade Shoot Em Up where you must always be on your toes and aim true.

Presently in Early Access, Muerte's Arena places you in an underground crypt for the dammed where spooky enemies seek to destroy what remains of you. You will be armed with a realistically functioning M1911 and a flashlight for the darkness. At the center lies the control that will allow you to test your limits. Put your aim and reloading skills to the test after haughtily thinking the default settings are all there is.

Features
  • Voxelized M1911 with the ability to eject and load magazines
  • M1911 Magazines with the ability to eject and load rounds (automagically reload in the Slime Arena)
  • Belt that can hold the voxelized M1911 along with 3 spare magazines, a health gauge and 2 generic slots for the flashlight and bullet box (in the Training Ground)
  • Flashlight that illuminates the darkness
  • 2 levels, The Training Ground and the Slime Arena (In Early Access : more to come in the future)
  • Ghostly Slimes (Slime Arena) that can have their speed, spawn limit and spawn rate adjusted

More features to come as they're implemented.

Dive into a medieval adventure filled with magic, potions, and intriguing research.

How?

Study alchemy and create various things, whether they are combat skills, devices to help characters, tools to transform the world, or ways to change it.

Unique?

The game features an Aspect system on which the entire world is built. Through this system, you can study the world, modify it as you wish, and solve puzzles either to help characters or to serve your own goals.

data.name: Survivor Cells
data.detailed_description:
STEAM DECK


About the Game




From life to death, our cells face countless battles, annihilating thousands of invading viruses and bacteria. Embark on this incredible journey and unlock new cells, medications, and nanotechnology to strengthen yourself in the greatest adventure a living being can face: life!



In Survivor Cells, speed is just the beginning to protect your cell from relentless attacks. You'll also need to make strategic decisions by controlling your nanobot and upgrading your medications as you progress. This is a casual and challenging game with elements of roguelite, bullet hell, and tower defense, where survival is the key to victory!



In Survivor Cells, you:


- Will face and defeat bacteria with devastating attacks and unique abilities;



- Advancing in the journey of life unlocks new cells with new special abilities;



- Use nanotechnology and control nanobots to destroy viruses and bacteria;



- Can use medications to increase your ability to destroy viruses and bolster your defense;



- Face different viruses and bacteria with distinct characteristics and abilities;



- Face super bacteria "Boss" with special abilities;



And much more...





COMMUNITY
We are a small studio, but we work hard to make our games as fun as possible. Your feedback is very important and would make us very happy!

If you want to follow the development and participate in future game tests, follow the studio page on Steam and join our Discord.

data.name: Tavern Tales: Tabletop Adventures
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to every tabletop enthusiast's pipe dream made manifest. Grab some friends (Maybe even an enemy or two), and jump into your own personal tavern that’s stocked to the rafters with all the miniatures, set pieces, and tools you could ever want to create a tabletop gaming experience like no other!
Come together, role dice, slay goblins, meet new friends, and tell stories that live and breathe like you do.

Tavern Tales: Tabletop Adventures is a cross-platform online multiplayer tabletop RPG platform that makes it easier than ever before to get started playing tabletop RPGs or elevate your existing games to the next level. (With or without a VR headset!)

Build, save, and share 3D maps using an extensive library of scenery pieces, buildings, props, dungeon tiles, and more. Populate your creations with NPCs to meet, creatures to slay, and secret areas to discover. Or, create a player character of your own to enjoy someone else’s world.

It’s easy to manage your games from any web browser using the convenient player portal. Level-up characters, edit notes that you can pull up in-game, find games/players, or schedule your next session, even when you’re not in VR.

Includes both VR and non VR versions. (VR mode required to host a game and build maps)

data.name: Reverie
data.detailed_description: This game presents a vivid animated style where players take on the role of a kitten armed with a gun, embarking on adventures in a challenging world. Using the ASDW keys for movement, the space bar for jumping, and the left mouse button for shooting, players navigate through the game. The background music is cheerful and energetic, with a fresh sound effect accompanying every jump, setting a light-hearted and enjoyable atmosphere. Along the way, players face various monsters but can also collect sun-shaped coins that enhance their abilities. By leveraging the terrain, the kitten can perform higher and farther jumps. The health bar in the top-left corner shows the kitten’s condition, and by picking up items, players can recover health or gain additional playtime. Additionally, tunnels allow the kitten to teleport to different locations, adding strategic depth and fun to the gameplay.

data.name: 10k Generators: The Ultimate Idle Game
data.detailed_description:
10,000 Generators. 20+ Currencies. Infinite Depths.

Welcome to the most layered idle game you've ever encountered. Start with a single currency and 1,000 generators. Unlock the next. Prestige. Convert. Research. Evolve. Rebirth. Every system feeds into another, creating a web of strategic decisions that rewards both patience and planning.

Foundation Layer – Generators & Currencies

  • 10,000 Generators – Divided into 10 unique base currencies, each with 1,000 generators.

  • 100 Generators dedicated to generating prestige currency – your gateway to permanent power.

  • 10 Prestige Currencies – Each base currency has its own prestige counterpart, generated by prestige generators.

  • 1 Super Currency – The ultimate resource, unlocked through deep progression, binding everything together.

Prestige System – 5 Upgrade Categories

Permanently enhance your generators across five distinct trees, each affecting a core stat:

  • Base Value – Increase the foundation of all generator output.

  • Multiplier – Multiply total income from every source.

  • Speed – Generate currency faster than ever.

  • Max Level – Push generators beyond their normal cap.

  • Upgrade Cost – Make every improvement cheaper.

Converters – Exchange Base Currencies in Ascending Order

Converters allow you to exchange base currencies between themselves, but only in ascending order of significance. You must convert lower‑tier currencies into higher‑tier ones first – each step unlocks the next. With 10 base currencies, each has its own dedicated converter, creating a strategic progression path where every conversion decision matters.

Prestige Generators – Earn Prestige Currency Directly

While converters handle base currency exchange, 100 dedicated generators produce prestige currency autonomously – no conversion needed. Every prestige currency has its own generator, giving you a passive, reliable source of permanent power that grows alongside your active strategies.

Interest System – Passive Prestige Growth

Your prestige currency isn't static. Earn interest over time – a percentage-based accumulation that rewards long-term strategies.

Perk System – Permanent Generator Bonuses

Unlock and equip permanent perks that directly boost your generators. These bonuses persist through prestiges, evolutions, and rebirths.

Bonus System – Amplify All Prestige Upgrades

Stack global bonuses that increase the power of every prestige category simultaneously. The deeper you go, the more powerful each prestige becomes.

Research System – Optimize Your Economy

Invest research points to enhance three critical systems:

  • Converters – More efficient conversion rates.

  • Auto-Purchases – Smarter, faster automatic upgrades.

  • Interest – Higher percentage gains over time.

Tier System – Reset Progress, Gain Global Bonuses

Climb through tiers by performing limited resets. Each tier increases overall difficulty but grants global bonuses that persist across all future runs.

Evolution System – Full Reset, Ultimate Power

When you've pushed as far as possible, trigger an evolution – a complete reset of all progress in exchange for the most powerful global bonuses in the game. Start fresh, but infinitely stronger.

Global Level System – Unlock Content Gradually

Progress through a global level that gates content. Each new level unlocks new currencies, systems, and features – ensuring a steady stream of fresh goals.

Auto-Purchase System – Set It and Forget It

Since prestige resets generator levels, auto-purchase automatically buys upgrades after every reset. Focus on strategy, not clicking.

Statistics & Steam Achievements

Track every metric – generators owned, prestige points earned, conversions made, tiers climbed, evolutions triggered. Steam Achievements reward your milestones with lasting recognition.

Handcrafted Development – 100% human-made

No AI generation. Every mechanic, every line of code, carefully written by hand.

  • 1 Super Currency – The ultimate resource, unlocked through deep progression, binding everything together.

Prestige System – 5 Upgrade Categories

Permanently enhance your generators across five distinct trees, each affecting a core stat:

  • Base Value – Increase the foundation of all generator output.

  • Multiplier – Multiply total income from every source.

  • Speed – Generate currency faster than ever.

  • Max Level – Push generators beyond their normal cap.

  • Upgrade Cost – Make every improvement cheaper.

Converters – Exchange Base Currencies in Ascending Order

Converters allow you to exchange base currencies between themselves, but only in ascending order of significance. You must convert lower‑tier currencies into higher‑tier ones first – each step unlocks the next. With 10 base currencies, each has its own dedicated converter, creating a strategic progression path where every conversion decision matters.

Prestige Generators – Earn Prestige Currency Directly

While converters handle base currency exchange, 100 dedicated generators produce prestige currency autonomously – no conversion needed. Every prestige currency has its own generator, giving you a passive, reliable source of permanent power that grows alongside your active strategies.

Interest System – Passive Prestige Growth

Your prestige currency isn't static. Earn interest over time – a percentage-based accumulation that rewards long-term strategies.

Perk System – Permanent Generator Bonuses

Unlock and equip permanent perks that directly boost your generators. These bonuses persist through prestiges, evolutions, and rebirths.

Bonus System – Amplify All Prestige Upgrades

Stack global bonuses that increase the power of every prestige category simultaneously. The deeper you go, the more powerful each prestige becomes.

Research System – Optimize Your Economy

Invest research points to enhance three critical systems:

  • Converters – More efficient conversion rates.

  • Auto-Purchases – Smarter, faster automatic upgrades.

  • Interest – Higher percentage gains over time.

Tier System – Reset Progress, Gain Global Bonuses

Climb through tiers by performing limited resets. Each tier increases overall difficulty but grants global bonuses that persist across all future runs.

Evolution System – Full Reset, Ultimate Power

When you've pushed as far as possible, trigger an evolution – a complete reset of all progress in exchange for the most powerful global bonuses in the game. Start fresh, but infinitely stronger.

Global Level System – Unlock Content Gradually

Progress through a global level that gates content. Each new level unlocks new currencies, systems, and features – ensuring a steady stream of fresh goals.

Auto-Purchase System – Set It and Forget It

Since prestige resets generator levels, auto-purchase automatically buys upgrades after every reset. Focus on strategy, not clicking.

Statistics & Steam Achievements

Track every metric – generators owned, prestige points earned, conversions made, tiers climbed, evolutions triggered. Steam Achievements reward your milestones with lasting recognition.

Handcrafted Development – 100% human-made

No AI generation. Every mechanic, every line of code, carefully written by hand.

data.name: Ortheo Voyage
data.detailed_description:
Ortheo Voyage is a race-against-time precision platformer, focusing on fluid movement, level exploration, and a dynamic backtrack mechanic. Explore a world where every jump, dive, and maneuver is crucial, and where time is your most relentless adversary. Can you conquer the challenges and retrieve the gears before the clock runs out?

Ortheo, a plucky pirate with a thirst for adventure, embarks on a quest to find his lost relative. Along the way, he crosses paths with Nailbe, his new ghostly friend, and together, they must gather gears to achieve their respective wishes. But beware, each gear collected triggers a world-altering explosion, forcing you to navigate back to the level's start.



  • Embark on an adrenaline-pumping, fast-paced platforming adventure with fluid character movement!
  • Immerse yourself in a world brought to life with stylized 3D models and graphics, creating a visually captivating experience!
  • Form connections with lovable characters, each with their own unique quirks and personalities!
  • Navigate through a collection of exquisitely crafted settings and levels, each of which has a unique mix of difficulties and secrets to discover.
  • Enjoy engaging gameplay that gives you the option to select your preferred playstyle—push through to the finish line for a quick thrill or take your time to discover every nook and crevice!
  • Play platform games in a silky smooth manner with controls that are well calibrated for accuracy and responsiveness!
  • Battle deadly bosses who will put your abilities to the test!
  • Enjoy a pleasant soundtrack that goes well with the dramatic scenarios and mood of the game!

data.name: Granvir
data.detailed_description:
Try The Free Prelude!


About the Game

Granvir is an action roguelite featuring mech building. Players battle through a route of their choice reaching extraction and completing side objectives at the cost of valuable resources. Between battles, players can swap out parts for upgrades found on the battlefield and manage their campaign by taking on loans to afford ammunition, aiding the locals for support in battle and more.

Equip devastating melee weapons such as swords, rocket spears and pile bunkers. Wield powerful long range guns like cannons, machine guns, flamethrowers and rocket pods. Mix and match armaments to suit your play style.

Mix torsos, legs, armatures and special modules to customize your Granvir. Defeating enemy ace pilots unlocks their unique parts.

Complete any campaign in single-player or multiplayer co-op with up to 10 Granvir pilots at a time. Share parts and resources utilizing the squad depot in rest areas as you plan your next moves.

No campaign is the same as you manage time, resources and your route to each objective. Each zone impacts what services and resources are available. Use down time between missions to refit and upgrade your Granvir to prevail.

data.name: DEADCAM | ANALOG • SURVIVAL • HORROR
data.detailed_description:
DEADCAM is an 80's & 90's inspired analog-survival-horror game based around found-footage and built in Unreal Engine 5. Explore and survive various short stories presented as "recordings", set in unique settings and locations. Each recording offers a unique mystery for you to uncover.

ANALOG


In DEADCAM the player plays through various stories presented as “recordings” It’s up to YOU to survive and uncover what happened there.

SURVIVAL


Each recording is a unique, self-contained experience set in its own location along with its own set of unique challenges and back-story. Some recordings might lean more into action while others will engross the player into a frightening horror experience. It's up to you to survive all the way through!

HORROR


DEADCAM leans heavily into the gritty horror aesthetics of the 1980’s and 90’s and takes inspiration from classic J-horror movies as well as American horror and slasher movies presented in a VHS style presentation.

data.name: One-Eyed Lee and the Dinner Party
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THE GAME:
Beracus and Lee finally have a lead to more information about a potential cure for Beracus' suffering village.
Upon finding the entrance to an apparently abandoned bunker, the two become trapped inside and discover the place is inhabited by a family of hospitable cult members, who also happen to be skeletons. The family mistakes the two for fellow members, and invites them to "stay for the party" and wait for the "New World". Unfortunately, Lee and Beracus don't have that kind of time! They'll similarly meet their deaths down there if they don't escape, and they still have to find their all important cure!

Together they must explore and talk to the skeleton family to discover clues, collect items, and try to unravel the tragedies that turned this simple bunker into a tomb.

GAME FEATURES:
-Point and click your way through a mysterious bunker!
-Uncover the horrifying events that happened there...
-Meet and greet a family of skeletons and decide if they are friend, or foe!
-Get to know, guide, and ultimately judge, your pal One-Eyed Lee!
-Casual, easy to pick up puzzles
-1-2 hours for each complete playthrough
-Completely original art, story, and soundtrack
-Available for Windows, Linux, and Steam OS




ABOUT THE CREATOR:
DarkChibiShadow finally makes their Steam debut!
Known for such titles as "Tomai", "Yarrow Valley", and "Solanaceae: Another Time", DCS is a queer comic artist and game developer who mostly writes erotic stories, but this time has written a spooky, character heavy adventure game.

DCS hopes to make the "One-Eyed Lee" line of games into four parts all featuring Beracus and Lee. As the story continues, we will learn more about both of them, and learn more of Beracus' journey to save his village. Will Lee stay by his side and help him? Will Lee leave? Will Lee even be the answer Beracus oh so hopes him to be? We'll find out!

ABOUT THE MUSICIAN:
NomnomNami makes her musical debut on Steam with a completely original soundtrack!
Known for such titles as, "Lonely Wolf Treat", "Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet", and "Her Tears Were My Light", Nami is a game developer who also composes music, and has written some very spooky and fun tracks for this game.
Nami also helped code huge chunks of this game, so without her, this game wouldn't be possible. Thank you, Nami!

data.name: Mars Horizon 2: The Search for Life
data.detailed_description:
Mars Horizon 2: The Search for Life is an authentic space management game where you lead a space agency. Your mission? The search for life. Comb the Solar System and trace biosignatures to prove there’s life out there. Explore different planets and moons, plan missions, build bases, launch rockets, design payloads, and make crucial discoveries.

Following on from Mars Horizon where you re-wrote history, now you’re going to be making history. Mars Horizon 2: The Search for Life is a game about exploration, learning, and discovery. Will you be the first to find evidence of life in our Solar System or will your rival agencies have their name etched in the history books instead?

  • You’re in charge of mission control; plan all the aspects of your missions to find anomalies, use satellites to reveal the terrain and rovers to make discoveries

  • Design rockets and customise specialised payloads to ensure you have the right vehicles for your exploratory missions

  • Build and manage your bases on planets across the Solar System. Make your mission as efficient as possible with buildings such as extra-terrestrial laboratories, launch pads, and more!

  • Every launch is an exciting opportunity to propel your agency and exploration further into the Solar System

  • Follow the clues, perform experiments, and discover biosignatures that get you closer to discovery of life – how will you be able to prove the existence of life in our Solar System?

  • Conduct tests, gather samples, explore the surface, expand your bases… until you discover life

  • Adapt your mission as you explore different celestial bodies and make decisions on the best way to identify life as you uncover more evidence

  • Face and overcome hazardous landscapes to ensure your success - will your mission survive the perils of space exploration, and will your payloads hold out?

Now that you know what is required for this mission, will you be the one to make that monumental discovery? Take to the Solar System and embark on the scientific journey for the ages.

data.name: Scarecrow’s Curse
data.detailed_description:
Can you tell the difference between reality and error?

Anomali is a psychological observation horror game built around attention, memory, and tension. Your task is simple: Inspect the rooms. If something is wrong, report it. If nothing is wrong, reset the system.

But are you sure?

Every small detail matters. An object may have changed its position. The lights may behave differently. Or something that should not be there… is now there.

Correct decisions keep the system stable. Wrong decisions have consequences. With increasing difficulty, randomly generated anomalies, and a decision-based progression system, each playthrough offers a different experience.

Features:

Psychological horror atmosphere
Minimal yet disturbing sound design
Decision-based outcome system
Randomly generated anomalies
Replayable structure
Multiple endings

Warning:

This game requires high attention. Some anomalies may be difficult to notice.

data.name: Grandpa's Euchre
data.detailed_description:
Grandpa's Euchre

NO TABLE TALK!!!!!!

This is the card game version of Euchre that my Grandpa taught me. I grew up in Illinois and we played this at every family gathering. 

Become The Joker!

Earn XP to become the Joker and reach higher levels!

Friendly For New Players!

Card Power Styling

  • Cards will glow blue if their suit is trump.

  • Left Bower will glow purple.

  • Right Bower will glow gold.

Two Difficulty Modes

  • Normal: Suitable for those starting out, wanting to learn the game rules or experiment with strategies. Bots will sometimes make bad plays. Your bot teammate has a slight logic enhancement when it is dealer. Player 2 on the other bot team plays like a novice. 

  • Hard: Bots remember cards played in previous tricks & use sophisticated logic to determine trump & card play selection.

  • NOTE: bots never know what is in another player or bot's hand & will always follow suit when possible!

Always Follow Suit

The game will never let you play a card that doesn't follow suit! (unless you have no cards that can follow suit)

Single-Player Only

Your teammate won't yell at you!

Rules

Setup & Dealing

The Deck:

  • 24 cards (9 through Ace)

The Deal:

  • Deal 5 cards to each player. Flip the top card of the remaining deck face up.

Rotation:

  • The dealer role rotates clockwise.

Making Trump

Ordering Up:

  • Starting left of the dealer, players may pass or choose the flipped card's suit as trump.

  • If chosen, the dealer adds the card to their hand and discards one.

Stick the Dealer:

  • If everyone passes, the face-up card is turned over, and a second round begins where players can name any other suit as trump. If everyone passes again, the dealer must name a suit.

Going Alone:

  • Any player who names trump can choose to "go alone." Their partner sits out the round.

Gameplay

The Bowers:

  • The Jack of the trump suit is the Right Bower (highest card). The other Jack of the same color is the Left Bower (second-highest card and counts as trump).

The Lead:

  • The player to the dealer’s left leads the first trick.

Following Suit:

  • Players must follow the led suit if possible. If they cannot, they may play any card. Highest card of the led suit (or highest trump) wins the trick.

Scores & Points

  • Trump Makers win 3 or 4 tricks = 1 point

  • Trump Makers win all 5 tricks = 2 points

  • Defenders win 3+ tricks (a "Set") = 2 points

  • Loner wins all 5 tricks = 4 points

  • Loner wins 3 or 4 tricks = 1 point

  • First Team To 10 Points Wins!

data.name: Backrooms: Savior
data.detailed_description:
Go deep into the Backrooms, complete the search and rescue, and get out alive.

Backrooms:Savior is a first-person tactical exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. Together with your teammates, you will venture deep into unknown spaces and confront a variety of threats. Search for critical items, locate missing personnel, complete the mission, and evacuate.

This is not a battlefield where you can just charge ahead. You must act with caution. Remember, completing the mission is only the beginning—the real challenge is making it out alive.

Push Forward Step by Step

In narrow corridors, empty rooms, and repetitive, disorienting spaces, treat every door and every corner with care. Use cover, light, and sound to coordinate with your teammates, neutralize threats, and advance steadily. Gunfire will give away your position, and a single misjudgment can quickly spiral out of control.

Search for Clues, Open the Way Forward

You can't complete the mission by shooting alone. Find key items, keep a clear head, and locate the right path to push deeper into the Backrooms.

Find Survivors, Escort Them to Safety

Your goal is not just to stay alive—the most important part of rescue is bringing people out alive. Once you locate missing personnel, the pace shifts instantly: you must protect the survivors, reroute your path, avoid unnecessary combat, and reach the extraction point under mounting pressure. A successful evacuation is the only true completion of the mission.

Face the Enemy, and Face the Rules

Firearms are not all-powerful. The threats in the Backrooms are not limited to enemies who shoot back. Certain anomalous entities cannot simply be taken down with firepower—they react specifically to sound, light, line of sight, or movement patterns. Observe, learn, and adapt to these rules. That is the key to survival.

Game Features

  • Liminal spaces in the Backrooms style, with an atmosphere of constant unease

  • A blend of first-person tactical shooting, exploration, search and rescue, and escort extraction

  • Supports multiplayer cooperation, pushing forward together in high-pressure environments

  • Searching for items, unlocking doors, and light puzzle-solving are deeply tied to mission progression

  • Hostile units and rule-based anomalies coexist—combat and evasion are equally vital

  • An immersive experience that emphasizes sound, lighting, spatial structure, and resource management

Enter the Backrooms, complete the search and rescue, and get out alive.

Backrooms:Savior is not just a gunfight—it's a mission-driven operation about judgment, pressure, and survival.

data.name: Car Service Together
data.detailed_description:
Build Your Team, Manage Your Garage, and Transform Vehicles from Scratch!

Car Service Together is a detailed simulation game with co-op support for up to 4 players, where you manage your garage, repair and modify cars, and maximize customer satisfaction.

Realistic Repair and Maintenance

Work on everything from engine failures to brake systems with a detailed repair system. Replace broken parts, disassemble and reassemble engines, and use advanced equipment to bring cars back to top condition.

Legendary Modifications

Don’t just repair! Cars—enhance their performance! Upgrade engines, install high-performance suspensions, and add custom exhaust systems to make vehicles truly unique.

Professional Painting and Customization

Use sprays and special coatings to completely transform cars. Create stunning color combinations and patterns, turning your garage into an automotive art studio.

Detailed Car Washing and Maintenance

Deep clean dirty vehicles, polish them, and restore them to showroom quality. Provide top-tier service to boost customer satisfaction.

Strategic Business Management

Negotiate with customers, set your pricing strategy, and make smart decisions to grow your business. Expand your service by acquiring new equipment and hiring skilled workers.

Test Driving and Final Checks

Take your repaired or modified cars for a spin. Evaluate handling, braking performance, and acceleration to ensure every vehicle leaving your garage is in peak condition.

Play Solo or With Your Team!

Go on a journey to mastery alone or join forces with friends in co-op mode to build the ultimate garage. Teamwork will take your service to the top!

Start your engines, grab your tools, and become a legend in the automotive world!

data.name: Hollybound
data.detailed_description:
A radioactive invasion is taking over, and it's up to you to save Wayfield! An action-packed top-down shooter game with several wide-open maps and a dozen unique (and maybe underqualified) heroes, Hollybound truly has it all! Unlike in boring real life, in Hollybound you'll face inconvenient traffic, a dangerously crowded shopping mall, and even an Italian restaurant! ... I promise, it's cooler than it sounds.



THE STORY

On the first night of summer vacation, a party is going down on Holly Lane! Celebrating their newfound freedom, twelve friends enjoy a night of paintball, soda, and drawing. When a collective rumble of stomachs rings out, the boys get some ice cream out of the freezer. Unfortunately, it's rock solid! Ethan suggests heating up the spoons in the microwave to make it easier to eat, and everyone overlooks the common knowledge that silverware in a microwave is a TERRIBLE idea. Josh mentions that food is supposed to be wrapped with a paper towel when microwaved, and when nobody can find a napkin, Colin just uses the drawing paper from earlier to wrap up the spoons. The geniuses set the timer for 10 whole minutes, and the radiation begins to react to the spoons and the drawings they had made. But before anyone could notice... BOOM!!! A radioactive explosion bursts through the house! Escaping the blast, the boys laugh, as explosions are really cool and kind of funny. But then, the sky flashes an ominous red, as the booming voice of LORD OPPTAVIOUS calls upon his army to invade! From the flames, creatures that resemble the ones they had drawn rise and begin to terrorize the town, spreading across it by using radioactive portals. To save Wayfield, and hopefully prevent their parents from finding out they caused the apocalypse, the 12 underqualified heroes grab their paintball guns and prepare to take on the radioactive invasion!





A BEGINNERS GUIDE TO HOLLYBOUND

THE GOAL: After spawning in a deactivated portal, you must collect the amount of radiation specified in green under the HP display to activate the portal in each map. When the required amount is reached, an arrow will point you back to the portal to complete the level!

RADIATION: You can collect radiation by finding it scattered across the map, or by defeating enemies. When an enemy is defeated, you will receive an amount of radiation that directly correlates to the amount of health that the enemy had.

POINTS: You get points for finding radiation, as well as damaging/defeating enemies. The points you collect will be added to your total score once you complete the level.

SHOPPING: You can use your points to buy upgrades! The shop is located on the level select screen.

STAMINA WHEEL: The stamina wheel in the top left corner is very important! When it is full, you can do a special move. Each special move is different depending on which character you use, so make sure to try them all to find your best fit. An indicator below the wheel will also notify you when a special move can be performed. Another indicator to the right of that one will notify you when a dash can be performed. It only requires the stamina wheel to be half-full, and is useful for crossing busy streets or escaping hordes of enemies! The stamina wheel is the key to success, so make sure to pay attention to it.





CHARACTERS

data.detailed_description:
Proving Grounds: Where the Brave Are Born

In the Proving Grounds, the four bravest little bears face death head-on… or at least the most absurd and chaotic challenges the radio can imagine.
As you advance, the radio will give you instructions that may be correct, incorrect, or simply mock you.

Each time you enter a level, the environment changes, the rules shift, and the bears adapt to new mechanics that will test your patience and teamwork.

10 Colors to Represent You

Orange, Gray, Red, Cyan, Violet, Purple, Blue, Magenta, Fuchsia, and Green.

data.detailed_description:
Priest vs. Poltergeist is an asymmetrical local VR multiplayer game. Two players play on one PC: one is in VR as a Poltergeist, the other one plays on PC with a mouse and a keyboard as a Priest.

Explore the huge mansion as a Priest to find and destroy five Altars - sources of Poltergeist's power. Or embrace your inner demon, become invisible, and kill the Priest before he destroyed the last Altar.

The Priest is armed with holy weapons blessed by the Pope himself. Word of the Lord is on his side. He is hardened by dozens and dozens battles with unholy creatures of all calibres. And he always wins.

The Poltergeist while doesn't have a material body has very real powers of controlling the material objects. It is tired of living in the shadows and wants to take control of something that by the Pact for thousands of years didn't belong to either of sides - Earth. Although he is still trapped between Hell and Earth he found a way to break into it - Priest's blood. It is destroying Priests all over the world and invisibility and immortality are it's allies.

Which side do you choose?

data.name: Murmurs of the Mist
data.detailed_description:
Murmurs of the Mist is a short psychological horror story where you play as Bunni, the stuffed toy of a 7-year-old girl, Sofia. She struggles to speak about what happened to her but in therapy, Sofia speaks through you, the only one she trusts. 

As Bunni, you explore the mysterious landscape of Sofia’s psyche, where her innocence, fear and childish state of mind blur together. What you see, hear, and touch slowly reveals the dreadful truth.

This 20–30 minute experience invites you into a quiet descent through memory, trauma, and the first steps of healing. A short unraveling of a story that is waiting to be heard.

PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES READ THIS NOTICE BEFORE PLAYING

This game contains flashing lights or light patterns that may be harmful for certain individuals. If you have an epileptic condition or have had any kind of seizure, consult your physician before playing any video game. Immediately discontinue use and consult physician if you experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. 

TRIGGER WARNING 

Murmurs of the Mist touches upon highly sensitive subjects involving child abuse, please absent from playing the game if you may find such themes triggering.

You can earn a new computer model every hour you play, adding to your collection, which includes a diverse array of computers ranging from classic desktops to sleek laptops and futuristic gadgets. The challenge lies in amassing all the unique models available, keeping players engaged as they strive to complete their collection. "Meh" offers a blend of casual fun and strategic clicking, making it an ideal choice for anyone looking to unwind while aiming for the ultimate goal of collecting them all!

data.name: Embrace Of The Embers
data.detailed_description:
Welcome home, Arthur:

This game contains a large amount of grotesque blood, and horror and thriller elements. Players with weak psychological endurance should play with caution.

"Embrace of Embers" is a simulated interactive cinematic game that combines dark fantasy and psychological horror. The game features an open-ended narrative with multiple branches and endings, and each of your choices could determine the ultimate fate of the characters.

You play as Arthur, who awakens in an unfamiliar room filled with signs of fire damage. Outside the room, strange footsteps and the dragging of heavy objects can be constantly heard, and a sense of danger permeates the surroundings.

Now, you must explore every corner of this eerie house, avoid deadly traps, and search for key items that can awaken fragments of your memory, unraveling the truth of the events that occurred in this burned house.

And your family may become the greatest obstacle on this journey to uncover the truth.

In the process of continuous attempts, your memory will gradually reorganize, and ultimately, you will personally uncover the truth of the event that spanned five years and altered the fate of your family.

data.name: DCL - The Game
data.detailed_description:
Download DCL - The Game and fly on the world’s most spectacular Drone Racing tracks. DCL - The Game is the official videogame of the Drone Champions League - the world’s leading series for Drone Racing Teams. An innovative race series, blurring the lives between virtual and reality. Join the flying revolution!

WHAT PILOTS SAY

Alex "Chief" Campbell (QuadForceOne):"It feels like flying a real drone."

Andrzej "SirCrashALot" Krasny: "This is by far the best Drone Simulator on the market. It enables pilots to race on authentic DCL tracks in epic locations. I can't wait to race against my best friends online."

Angelo Felchle: "The DCL Game is perfect to practice the hardest and most spectacular tracks in the world. I'm playing a lot if I don't have the time to go outside and fly to stay in shape and get stick-time."

FLY AROUND THE WORLD

Fly through over 30 spectacular tracks and compete online against other pilots from all over the World!

Discover real drone racing tracks like the snow halfpipes of LAAX or the castle ruins of Reutte. Race through the incredible Proptown and Oilbando, as well as other real-world DCL races locations: each will present a new and unique challenge and will demand all your piloting skills!

ARCADE OR SIMULATION?

DCL - The Game presents the perfect challenge for every experience level. You can have fun with the Arcade mode even if you have never seen a drone before. You can improve your skills as an amateur pilot or you can practice and compete as an experienced pilot. You will be able to fly in four flight modes:


Arcade Mode:  Perfect for racing thanks to the automated altitude control and simplified controls.

GPS Mode: Flies like your standard camera drone, with stabilization and altitude control: it's Ideal to practice your piloting and filming skills, but not designed for racing.

Angle Mode:  Also known as Stabilized mode, it's available on most amateur racing drones and great for practicing. Not ideal for top racing performance.

Acro Mode: This is how the real drone racing and freestyle pilots control their drones. You will have the complete control over the aircraft, in order to compete at the highest levels. It will take some time and dedication to master but it will allow you to experience flying at its fullest!

FLY LIKE A PRO!

Control your drone with a keyboard, gamepad or - for the ultimate simulation - connect your transmitter and fly like a real drone pilot! Beginners can fly in Arcade or GPS mode and use keyboard or gamepad as their input method.
