DCL - The Game is the official videogame of the Drone Champions League - the world’s leading series for Drone Racing Teams. An innovative race series, blurring the lives between virtual and reality. Join the flying revolution!

WHAT PILOTS SAY

Alex "Chief" Campbell (QuadForceOne):"It feels like flying a real drone."

Andrzej "SirCrashALot" Krasny: "This is by far the best Drone Simulator on the market. It enables pilots to race on authentic DCL tracks in epic locations. I can't wait to race against my best friends online."

Angelo Felchle: "The DCL Game is perfect to practice the hardest and most spectacular tracks in the world. I'm playing a lot if I don't have the time to go outside and fly to stay in shape and get stick-time."

FLY AROUND THE WORLD

Fly through over 30 spectacular tracks and compete online against other pilots from all over the World!

Discover real drone racing tracks like the snow halfpipes of LAAX or the castle ruins of Reutte. Race through the incredible Proptown and Oilbando, as well as other real-world DCL races locations: each will present a new and unique challenge and will demand all your piloting skills!

DCL - The Game presents the perfect challenge for every experience level. You can have fun with the Arcade mode even if you have never seen a drone before. You can improve your skills as an amateur pilot or you can practice and compete as an experienced pilot. You will be able to fly in four flight modes:


Arcade Mode:  Perfect for racing thanks to the automated altitude control and simplified controls.

data.name: Reigning Cats
data.detailed_description:
Feature List


Just Updated

Fully migrated the project from the original GameMaker 1.4 source to GameMaker Studio 2024.

Converted the game to run at a clean fixed 60 FPS.


About the Game

Help Kingkat to defend the castle while waiting for his owner to come back for him (or so he thinks). Hire warriors, archers, rogues, berserkers, mages, or priests and upgrade their skills to aid you in battle against wave after wave of angry dogs.

FEATURES:

  • The main game includes the story, skills to be upgraded, items to be unlocked, 2 mini games(Chow and Potty), and 3 additional game modes. "Revenge of The Big Bad Wolf", "War, War Never Ends", and "Survive the Night"

  • 6 different classes of cats. Each with 2 jobs and 2 modes to be used against dogs.

  • 13 different breed of dogs and a secret final enemy to defend Kingkat from.

  • 4 Mini Bosses and 1 Final Boss

  • Send Cats to venture forth for additional gold and challenge to the game.

  • Night, Day, and Weather affects the game-play.

  • Be able to plan ahead for randomized boss encounter and to think of a strategy for your hirelings placements.

  • Feed Cats and clean up their litter box.

Unlock 3 Additional Game Modes:

"REVENGE OF THE BIG BAD WOLF"

Play as The Big Bad Wolf, and call out for reinforcements to attack and capture Kingkat.

Features:

- New unlockable content included in the game. (Not as DLC)

- Play as the Big Dog and command your pack to attack the cats.

- Strategically pick within 5 available cards at your disposal or reshuffle it.

- Total of 22 cards to use, 13 different dog cardsand 9 skill cards

"WAR, WAR NEVER ENDS"

Continue the battle between Cats and Dogs. Only this time, it will be an all out war.

Features:

- Play the game against randomly selected dogs.

- Mini bosses will appear whenever they want to.

"SURVIVE THE NIGHT"

You must defend the castle at all cost against some weird things that's going on.

Features:

- Enemies are green and weird! They don't act like they normally would.

- Your range cats will be visually impaired by the darkness and the fog.

-meow-

data.name: Gravity Ace
data.detailed_description:
Gravity Ace is a 2D twin-stick where you fight gravity in space caves. It's a love letter to Thrust and Gravitar and all of the amazing games they inspired.

Descend into dark caverns, fly and blast your way past enemies, retrieve the reactor core and make your escape, all while fighting the deadly embrace of crushing gravity.

Do you have what it takes, pilot?

You are the Pilot, a volunteer in the United Earth Navy, assigned to the U.E.N. Hornet, a new ship with an experimental engine that allows it to warp behind enemy lines. Launching your small fighter craft from the Hornet, your mission is to sabo`e the enemy by raiding their bases and disrupting their power supply network made up of reactor cores connected through hyperspace.

FAST-PACED ACTION

There are plenty of enemies and they are out to get you. Fly, fight, and maneuver through dangerous enemy bases and intense gravitational fields. The core game includes a 24 mission single-player campaign and a level editor for creating your own scenarios.

SCAVENGE ENEMY FUEL

Your ship is powerful but has a limited fuel supply. You'll need to scavenge fuel from the enemy to survive. Fuel management requires careful maneuvering and using momentum to conserve enough fuel to escape the gravity well.

PHYSICS-BASED GAMEPLAY

Everything that moves is part of the physics simulation. Momentum and velocity can be your best friend or your worst enemy. Use your tractor beam to steal the reactor core, rescue astronauts, or hurl nearby asteroids!

STEAL THE REACTOR CORE

Your ship is equipped with a powerful tractor beam for carrying large objects. The objective of each mission is to extract the enemy reactor core in one piece. Secondary objectives include destroying all enemy units and rescuing astronauts. Be careful -- the reactor core is heavy and fragile!

LEVEL EDITOR

All of the levels included with Gravity Ace were made with the built-in level editor. You can make your own campaigns, stories, and challenges. And during Early Access, we're adding the ability to share levels with the community.

ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK

Gravity Ace includes an original soundtrack with 20 minutes of music.

data.name: Motesolo : No Girlfriend Since Birth
data.detailed_description:
Everyone was a solo when they were born.
All of us were solo at least once.
And Someone even now..


[Synopsis]

You discover two people in conversation during a late afternoon in Seoul and begin to spy on them.
Wait, how did this happen?
Two people that seem like they would never get along are on a blind date together?!
But it almost seems like this man is having an out-of-body experience and the date continues to go south.
After a while, the two enter a tense conversation and begin to participate in an intense mind game.
What kind of conclusion will after one careless comment is made?
Enjoy a story with limitless possibilities that changes based on the choices you make.

[Characters]

His name is Kang Ki-mo who got you to spy on the conversation.
Kimo Kang is just your average office worker that enjoys putting pipes together and playing video games.
But he's never once been in a relationship his whole life.
He is a MOTESOLO, single since birth.

What?
MOTESOLO.

That's correct.
Motesolo means "no girl friend since birth" in Korea.

Kimo is Motesolo who even haven't held the a woman's hand in his life.
Do you think he will success on this blind date?

Whereas
The woman that showed up to the blind date is Yumi Kim, a woman that loves art.
She looks depressed for some reason.
What kind of personality will she have? Make your best guess.

[How to Play]


1. Select Conversation
As the main character, you can decide which conversation to answer.
And all the choices you make could affect the ending of the game.
Your choices will change how the game progresses.

2. Interaction
The player will not only interact with other characters but also with the environment and the objects within it.
You can explore a whole new world inside your phone all while sitting down.
You can also move around in your given surroundings and collect, investigate items.

3. Mini Game
Various mini games appear depending on the situation.
You can never relax too much.

Capture Her Heart

Become a pursuer of love! That man (that woman), what are their true feelings? The game of wit starts now! 1…

[Game features]

- Game progress changes depending on the player's actions
- Well-shot, high-quality videos.
- Non-linear narrative structure to the end
- Dozen endings with multiple story
- And… a surprise ending

[Contact Developer Team]

indicavas@gmail.com

data.name: WordHerd
data.detailed_description:
Take a break with Mia and zone out of the daily grind with chilled gameplay and absorbing wordplay. Work your way from simple to unusual and abstruse words in this brilliant, twisty, word finding puzzle game.

Help Mia call the lost animals home before nightfall by finding words that twist and turn across the board. With over one hundred and seventy thousand words and ninety thousand definitions you’ll be sure to learn some modern, esoteric and comic meanings as you try to beat your longest, rarest and highest scoring words. With ninety levels of word detective animal rescue in each of the three game types. Mia will help you out with words, parts of words or simply the length of words she can see. She’ll always do her best to help you but when she's out of words you're on your own...

With over 170,000 words and 90,000 definitions this game contains a wide variety of words and their meanings. We have removed a variety of words which were just too offensive for us, but if you find definitions of words offensive then this might not be the game for you.

data.name: Lost Socks: Naughty Brothers
data.detailed_description:
Set off in chase of the lost Sock! Lost Socks: Naughty Brothers is a brand new platformer set in a crazy world, with infinite fun and hardcore challenges. What sets this game apart is that the main character simply can’t stop, so the onslaught of enemies, barbs and bullets will be intense!





The starring role is given to Sock, who is setting off in search of his brother. He finds himself in a parallel world, home to the crafty nibbles who live to kidnap the Socks. Who will stop these wicked kidnappers if not you?





Every weapon in this game is hot enough to burn the fingers! Dissolve the enemy in acid? Be my guest! Make a bunch of holes? Sure thing! Cut ‘em in half? Not a problem! After you kill a couple of nibbles, you’ll want to kill hundreds!





The game’s levels are full of unexpected twists. Don’t worry if you fall into a chasm – there might be a reward down there… or a pile of enemies ready to kick your ass. Change your playstyle depending on your goal: taking vengeance or freeing your buddies!

The journey takes you through three huge worlds. Each will meet you with a bunch of challenges, make you sweat with ever increasing difficulty and force you to forget everything you’ve seen before.





The game is 100% done, extremely well balanced, and tested by thousands of players from all over the world. All you have to do to start the adventure is wait for release day. NOT. A. MINUTE. LONGER.





- Platformer with runner elements
- H-A-R-D-C-O-R-E
- Non-linear level completion
- A whole range of guns and content
- Animation, graphics, sound and music all made with passion

data.name: Glory
data.detailed_description:
War decides power and history, sorts the cowards from the brave and crumbles one civilisation and thrives another. What if you had the power to do this? Command your army through harsh terrain, combat and battle to achieve victory. Can you? Become a Commander yourself and fight for glory!

Key Features


A Single Player Campaign full of action and combat waiting for you.

Unlock Unique Soldiers As You Progress.

Command An Army and Defeat Your Enemy.

Multiplayer for versing your friends or others to see how great a Commander you really are, once you're up for the challenge.

The game is a simple war game but it does have multiplayer for if you complete the campaign. I know it isn't a large game, but it's something to think about.

Specifics


You, as Commander, hire soldiers amid battle with coins which are gained every few seconds or from killing enemy soldiers. Command An Army and Defeat Your Enemy.

data.name: Rampage Kage
data.detailed_description:
Rampage-Kage is a demanding 2D Metroidvania action-platformer set in a Tokyo underworld. As Kage, you must master punishing, precision combat to dismantle city gangs. Explore an interconnected urban labyrinth, collect powerful charms to customize your skills, and survive coordinated enemy waves in a mission to reclaim the streets.

A Personal Vendetta: When the city’s ruthless gangs target his family, Kage is pushed past his breaking point. Forced into a mission of pure revenge, you must navigate the brutal Tokyo streets to hunt down those who took everything from you.

Customize Kage’s combat and traversal by discovering and equipping rare Charms hidden throughout the Tokyo underworld. Each charm fundamentally changes your tactical approach:

  • Rift Ascent (Double Jump): Tear a hole in the air to gain extra height, reaching high rooftops and evading enemy flanking maneuvers.

  • Cyclone Decree (Aerial Uppercut): The first tactical upgrade acquired upon entering the Tokyo underworld. This powerful vertical jumpkick serves as both a combat starter and a traversal tool. Use it to launch enemies into the air for follow-up shots or to break through high-guard defenses. Its explosive upward force allows Kage to reach elevated platforms before unlocking full mobility.

  • Gecko’s Grip (Wall-Climb): Grants unnatural adherence to vertical surfaces. Scale the city's architecture to find shortcuts and tactical vantage points.

  • Wraith’s Blur (Dash): A high-speed tactical dash that allows Kage to phase through enemy attacks and reposition instantly during combat.

Hardcore Resource Management

Every bullet counts in the fight against the gangs. Rampage-Kage features a strict "Kill-to-Supply" economy:

  • Loot-on-Kill: Enemies do not respawn with ammo. You must execute foes to scavenge a maximum of 2 bullets per kill.

  • Precision Shooting: With no rapid-fire capability, players must master the Fast Jump Shot—combining high-mobility platforming with lethal, single-shot accuracy.

data.name: Dead of the Brain
data.detailed_description:
First released in 1992, Dead of the Brain was one of Japanese developer Fairytale's early forays into the horror genre. Now, over 30 years later, FAKKU has brought this cult classic back from the dead and resurrected it on modern platforms. With gruesome gore and a gritty pixel art style, it's a striking homage to 80's American splatter cinema and zombie B-movies that will bring you back to the days of boxy screens and floppy disks. Will you beat the walking dead and survive this retro nightmare?

When there's no more room in Hell...

One fateful night, the protagonist Cole receives a call from his friend Dr. Cooger. The mad scientist has invented what he calls a "resurrection serum", designed to bring the dead back to life. Although skeptical at first, Cole is convinced after he sees the effects of the miraculous serum for himself. But human hubris is always doomed to fail, and it's not long before things go very, very wrong. Sure, the serum revives the dead, but they return with no trace of their former self—only a terrible hunger for BRAAAAAINS!

When the test subjects escape containment, all Hell breaks loose—literally. The dead rise from their graves as the town is overrun by terrifying zombies! So begins Cole and company's fight for their lives, and a desperate battle to save the world from a doom of their own making.

Will Cole survive this nightmare, or will he end up joining the ranks of the walking dead?

  • A classic retro gaming experience.

  • Genre Fusion: A mix of traditional point-and-click adventure, visual novel, and pulse-pounding survival quicktime events.

  • Stunning pixel art faithfully upscaled.

  • Gore, grime, and splatter galore!

  • Game Over without losing progress... Don’t worry if you forget to save, if you die you can choose to restart at the beginning of the current scene instead of your last save..

  • FM music to immerse you in the atmosphere–also available as a DLC soundtrack!

  • Optional quality-of-life improvements such as hover hints and hit boxes.

About the New Version

This re-release has gone through many hours of painstaking QA to make sure that it functions as close to the original as possible, with a few added optional quality-of-life improvements. However, please bear in mind that the original game is over 3 decades old, and faithfully recreating it also means replicating the 30-year-old UI and game mechanics, which may seem clunky by modern standards.

data.name: Wild Indigo Ranch
data.detailed_description:
Howdy cowpoke! You have inherited Wild Indigo Ranch from your uncle, and a new life awaits you in the West! But the frontier isn’t always as idyllic as you hear in the stories. Grit Corp has sinister plans for turning the prairie into a profit-making machine. Work together with the townsfolk of nearby Tumbleville to right wrongs and restore Wild Indigo Ranch to its former glory.

For a prudent cowboy, resources need not be scarce on the prairie. Gather straw to craft a rope - now you can lasso your first Mustang, though you might want to start slow and catch Rosie the Donkey. A real buckaroo needs a six-shooter to serve justice and defend themself from local wildlife. If only you knew how to make one.

A cowpoke like you need a place to hang up your spurs after a long day of adventure. Pull up your sleeves, grab your tools, and get to work building the ranch of your dreams. Grow crops and farm the land, outfit your farm with stables, coops, and workshops. Finally, furnish and decorate your new home to your liking - home is where the hearth is.

Play as a lone ranger or team up with up to 3 friends. Work together to gather resources, build the finest ranch in the West, and ride together into the sunset.

data.name: Esqapes: Voyages
data.detailed_description:
Step aboard your own futuristic, luxury yacht and prepare for a voyage into the unknown. Esqapes: Voyages isn’t just a VR experience—it’s a digital sanctuary. Designed for those seeking a moment of peace, this immersive journey randomly transports you to breathtaking, never-before-seen oceanscapes. Whether you’re looking to meditate, pray, or simply escape the noise of the world, your private vessel is ready to take you there.

A Universe of Tranquility: No Two Voyages Are Alike

With over 100 handcrafted destinations to discover, every embarkation offers a fresh perspective. Drift beneath the majesty of vibrant, sun-drenched horizons or lose yourself in the ethereal glow of a moonlit bay. Every wave and every vista has been meticulously designed to maximize your immersion. Importantly, these are not AI-generated environments; they are curated works of digital art crafted specifically for VR.

The Art of Letting Go

Esqapes: Voyages is built on the philosophy of immersive relaxation. Simply put on your headset, set your controllers aside, and sink into your favorite chair. You won’t need to plot a course or manage complex mechanics. Your yacht’s automated navigation will guide you through peaceful waters, allowing you to focus entirely on the experience. While you can return to port at any time to change your trajectory, the most rewarding path is often the one chosen for you.

From One VR Fan to Another: Support Independent Development

This project is a labor of love by a single independent developer. As someone who personally uses VR to manage stress and anxiety, I built Esqapes: Voyages to be the retreat I always wanted. My commitment is to keep this world growing and I intend to add new destinations through free updates, provided the project remains sustainable.

By supporting Esqapes, you are helping an indie VR creator evolve this into something even more majestic. Thank you for being part of this voyage!

data.name: Paper Dolls: Original / 纸人
data.detailed_description:
Background

A man wakes up from the nightmare. Again. Every time he closes his eyes he sees images of evil paper dolls attacking him. Sleepless, confused, terrified...and now he's haunted by imaginary sounds. At dawn, he will take his daughter to his ex-wife. He must.

Driving on this road always makes him sad.

“If it wasn't for my depression, our relationship wouldn't end like this."
"What’s the meaning of my life?"

Horror begins

He is so deeply immersed in these thoughts that he can’t even hear his daughter’s voice, "Look out!." The imaginary sounds grow stronger. Then, a crash...
When he wakes up, he finds himself in a deserted and ancient eastern mansion. Everything here seems strange, yet eerily familiar.

“Is this a dream? Or am I dead?”

He hears the faint cries of his daughter. Struggling to pull himself together, He follows her voice deeper into the ancient mansion.

Will the man find his daughter and get out safely with her?




Realistic graphics and a unique Eastern vibe bring this terrifying mansion to life. Experience a finely-crafted soundtrack, combining chant with folk and rock music, as you delve deeper into the darkness.

How to play?

  • Explore
Find your daughter in this disorienting journey of terror and excitement.
  • Solve
Outsmart the traps, solve the puzzles, and uncover the mysteries shrouding the mansion.
  • Discover
Find the secret messages left behind and reveal the horrible truth of this great Evil.
  • Survive
Run, hide, and seal away the Paper Dolls forever...or else.

Tips:

The game is about 8-10 hours long depending on your play style.
If you suddenly feel uncomfortable, please stop playing.
Do not wear headphones if you are easily scared!

About us:

Horror games are not allowed to be published in China due to government policies. However, we are fans of horror games and want to make our own. This is a huge step for our team to make this game. We hope you enjoy!

data.name: Bionic Attack
data.detailed_description:
Gameplay

Play two factions The Democratic Alliance and the Conglomerate. And control their special units, the Bionic Weapon and the Drone.
Use them to take resources, secure strategic points and raid the enemy. Collect and launch bonuses to repair, protect or destroy buildings and units.

Special units are controlled in a different way.
You control Drones like in a classic RTS. Unlike the Conglomerate unit, the Bionic Weapon can't be directly controlled. To choose its direction, you have to place blocks to channel its move.

Features

  • gameplay focused on a main unit
  • a campaign for the story with more than 40 missions
  • a fight mode with independent maps for the challenge
  • 6 bots levels of difficulty in fight mode
  • multiple graphic themes
  • more than 40 achievements to unlock
  • shortcuts and control groups
  • asymmetric gameplay with 2 factions for a more varied gaming experience
  • multiplayer mode with LAN and internet

World background

In a far-off solar system, on an isolated planet, the war rages on between the Democratic Alliance and the Conglomerate. More than for the planet domination, the two factions are confronting for the control of resources.

The noxious air and the incessant fights have compelled the population to shelter in bunkers with endless galleries.

Solely the mechanic units are sent to the surface in order to collect the resources and to build defenses.

Peace will come only with the destruction of one of the factions. Bionic Attack will immerse you into the story of this conflict at a turning point. The emergence of a new technology in the army of the Democratic Alliance rushes the Conglomerate into a global and unprecedented offensive which leads the two factions to the ultimate battle.

data.name: Elevator Action™ -Returns- S-Tribute
data.detailed_description:
Elevator Action Returns was originally released as a 2D side-scrolling shooter game by Taito in 1995. This game is a reproduction of the home console version released by Bing in 1997.

Select one of three special forces members—Kart Bradfield, Edie Burret, or Jad the Taff—then start the game. Grab data from all the red doors, then escape the stage.

Although a bonus you could only obtain by finishing the game in the previous version, you'll be able to play the original game "Elevator Action" (1p only) from the start in this version.


◆Tips
Press the shoot button near an enemy to start close combat with bare hands instead of shooting. Make continuous attacks by pressing the shoot button twice when playing as Kart, or by pressing the shoot button then immediately pressing the jump button when playing as Edie or Jad. The score is doubled when an enemy is defeated with unarmed attacks.
There are many targets to shoot on each stage. Some items are hidden, and some roll and damage enemies. Points can also be scored by breaking items in stages, so break many items. Destroying fluorescent lights or switchboards will put out the lights on a floor for a period of time, during which points scored are doubled.
Elevators can be used for movement, as well as attacks. Throw a sub-weapon in an elevator, then move it to make a remote attack on an enemy, or use the elevator to crush enemies. Be careful, as it's also possible to harm the player character.


◆Convenient features and option settings only available in S-Tribute
・Rewind
Rewind gameplay a by certain amount of time and resume.
・Slow Mode
Slow game pace down with a single button press.
・Quick Save/Load
Save game state at any point.
・Unlimited Credits
The limit on the number of continues can be disabled, allowing for infinite continues.
・Stage Select
The game can be started from any stage.
・Increased Healing
Increase the amount of damage healed by obtaining healing items.
・Lives
Player character lives can be increased up to 9 lives.
・Sub-Weapon Buttons
Sub-weapons are normally used by pressing the shoot button and jump button at the same time, but this can be set to any other single button.
・Changing the amount of damage
You can change the amount of damage you'll get when the enemy hits you.
・Keeping the same weapon
You can keep your machine gun or rocket launcher if it still holds bullets on to the next level.
・Scan Lines
Mimics the nostalgic CRT monitor display.


◆S-TRIBUTE
Reprints of classics produced and developed by City Connection with the Zebra Engine during the Saturn era.
Play a variety of titles with improved controls and new features.

data.name: Collapsed: Build to Break
data.detailed_description:
Every structure has a weak point. Find it, line up your shot, and watch the pieces fall.

Collapsed: Build to Break is the sequel to Collapsed, the 3D physics puzzle game about bringing structures down with a cannon. The challenge is still simple: bring down the target with the cannonballs you have. Read each structure, choose where to strike, and use gravity and momentum to finish the job.

Build your own level in the editor. Place blocks, then move, rotate, and scale them until the structure looks right. When it is ready, load the cannon and find out if it falls the way you planned.

Your ammunition is limited. A direct hit is useful, but the best shot can start a chain reaction. Break a support, shift the weight, and let the structure do the rest.

Use standard, polished, burning, and explosive cannonballs to tackle different structures. Heavy impacts move pieces, fast shots reach stubborn targets, and fire attacks wooden parts.

A new cannonball joins your arsenal: the explosive. One good hit and the blast tears through walls and towers at once. Pick your moment, because every cannonball counts.

Challenge yourself on TITANIC levels: whole cities and citadels, packed with blocks, waiting for the right shot to bring them down. Will you solve all levels with the imposed cannonballs?

The sequel brings new wood and stone constructions in village, desert, and snowy settings. Each level asks you to find a new path to collapse.

data.name: Schwemmwerk: River Reclamation
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

SCHWEMMWERK: River Reclamation is a single-player recycling and factory management game about turning mixed river debris into valuable raw materials.

Take control of a neglected processing yard near a dam. Accept deliveries, examine their material composition, build processing machinery, organize physical containers and fulfil contracts. Start with manual work and small equipment, then develop a connected industrial processing line.

EVERY KILOGRAM HAS TO GO SOMEWHERE

Materials are more than numbers in an invisible inventory. Outputs require physical containers and available storage space. Full containers, blocked outlets and poorly planned logistics create real backpressure and can stop your entire production line.

BUILD YOUR PROCESSING LINE

Construct and connect intake bunkers, shredders, separators and screening equipment. Recover metal, electronic waste, plastic, wood, biomass and mineral fractions while keeping residual material visible and under control.

CONTROL MATERIAL QUALITY

Material composition, moisture and contamination influence processing and value. Organize your machinery carefully, meet contract requirements and decide which material streams deserve further treatment.

FROM NEGLECTED YARD TO RAW-MATERIAL FACTORY

Begin with a small, worn-down site and gradually transform it into an efficient industrial operation. Improve your processes, expand automation and build a facility capable of handling increasingly demanding deliveries.

data.name: My Necromancer's Library
data.detailed_description:
You unexpectedly inherit the lair of a dead necromancer and decide to turn it into a public library. But the lower levels are infested with his undead goons and creatures of the dark who have quickly taken residence in his absence.

And there are secrets about both the town folk and your own family to be discovered in the lair’s depths.

        

Manage a library, customize books

While the doors are open, visitors will come looking for books, shelter and community. Make them happy to increase your library's renown and unlock more books, furniture and character options.

  • Organize community events like game nights and book clubs.

  • Restore and customize books in your downtime.

  • Keep the library tidy and expand on your inventory!

For the book hoarders among us:

Aside from a few quest-related books, you will never have to part with your books!

Your patrons will reward you with donations, pay a small fee for community events, and occationally ask you to customize a book of theirs, but your books are yours to keep.

Dungeon Delving

The Necromaner’s lair is filled with rare and magical tomes, but you need not fight alone!

Hire adventurers from within the town or outside, to help you clear the dungeon. These brave hearts come with their own goals - achieve them and you will find them more capable next time you hire them. No need to grind!

Defeat Undead and other creatures in turn-based combat, close the portals through which they get into the lair, and maybe even find a few helping hands among them…

data.name: LOCUS POKER
data.detailed_description:
A head-to-head strategy "board" game played on a grid of face-up standard playing cards. Easy to learn and play, but very difficult to master. Luck will not help you - the better player wins. Play against eight computer opponents employing different strategies; or play against a human opponent, either in-person or via Steam's Remote Play Together. Compatible with mouse and touchscreen devices - touch-friendly.

RULES, GUIDE, EXAMPLES and TIPS are available in-game via the RULES button.

Try if for free with the FREE MINI-DUEL game.  If you like it, get the full version with different and tougher computer opponents, selectable card back designs, more game modes, an optional timer, and larger grid sizes.

THREE EXPANDED PLAYING OPTIONS:

2 GAMES ON SAME CARDS - Two consecutive games played on the same cards each game, and alternating who goes first. The truest test in the game. With latest update, this option is now available on all grid sizes.

TIMER - To speed up play, a 20 or 30 second timer may be selected on 5x4 grid-sized games; and a 30 second timer may be selected on 6x5 grid-sized games.

QUESO-BOT CHALLENGE! single player mode.

When playing in this higher difficulty configuration (Player 1 = QUESO-BOT; Player 2 = HUMAN; Grid = 6x5 [one game]), the game will track your win streak and provide customized feedback based on your performance. (FYI - I rarely win in this mode, my longest win "streak" is an ignominious "2", and I genuinely hope you do better. - JW.)

data.name: Creature Lab
data.detailed_description:
Become a mad scientist in search of the ultimate mutagen!
Here, you can outshine even the famous Frankenstein with your incredible mutants! Prove your genius once and for all and let nobody stop you.

Creature Lab sets you on a difficult path of a genius, yet a bit wicked scientist with a very liberal approach to test subjects and official procedures. Establish your hideout and let the experiments commence! Conduct crazy experiments, mix mutagens, analyze their properties, grow DNA-based body parts, and attach them to your test subjects.



So many possibilities… Prepare your laboratory, obtain basic reagents, and see what happens when you mix them together. Don’t forget to name all your recipes! Apply your mutagens to test subjects and observe how they react. Grow entirely new body parts and attach them to the creatures you just brought to life. Discover nearly limitless interactions between mutagens and body parts as you slowly assemble an army of mutants.



There's no use hoping for government funds so you'll make do with anything you can find or even steal. Manage your inventory, expand your lab, and make sure your hideout is safe. Don’t let the panic guide you, the more stressed you are, the bigger chance Feds will drop by to say hello and check your spot! Don’t leave any traces, be patient and extremely careful! They will never even know what hit them!



Running low on resources? Need more test subjects? Send your sick creatures into the city! Find whatever resources you need. Spread panic in the city to scare off anyone trying to find your hideout. And if the military starts looking for you, send the strongest of your creatures to teach them a lesson. Let no one stop you in your search for the ultimate mutagen!

Features

  • First-person mad scientist simulator
  • Complex resource and inventory management
  • A strategy element - plan raids on the city and prepare for encounters with the military
  • Thousands of different mutagens to discover - you name them all
  • Unique body parts to grow and attach to your test subjects
  • A unique fear mechanic that lowers the chance of your hideout being discovered
  • Singleplayer campaign mode
  • Endless replayability with new substances every time you play

data.name: Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream
data.detailed_description:
A STRANGELY FAMILIAR TERROR

Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream explores the darkness of our contemporary world through the most horrible experience everyone has to endure: work. You will probably find some thematics that you already face everyday if you are a working adult, but the game twists this well known environment to make it a surreal experience. You will never see your work the same way!

AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE FOR ALL

Dive into this chilling story through the meticulously crafted environments and bespoke sound design and music. Live the relatable life of your average worker during the day, go to sleep... but even sleep can't let you escape work, as you will have to do your job under even more pressure since nightmarish entities will hunt you in your dreams.

NIGHTMARE OR REALITY?

You can never anticipate what you will find through these hallucinated corridors and liminal hallways. Who knows what lurks behind every corner while you walk through these alienated spaces?
The story of the game is for you to unravel, as no voice and almost no text is used during the game. All the narration is done through the mood, the detail in the environment.
You must prepare for the unthinkable, for only your wit and quick-thinking will let you escape this ethereal world.

MYSTERIES AND SECRETS

The different endings of the game will reward the most observant and curious players. On top of all the mysteries you have to unravel by connecting the dots and filling the blanks, there are a lot of secrets to dig out. Always keep your eyes open, but don’t forget you are never truly alone…

At the end of each battle you will gain valuable resources to upgrade your mech's weapons and armor, unlocking new skills and powerful equipment.

data.name: R.I.P. Tour
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Hartley Haven

With his colorful cast of cartoon animals, Buck Hartley was once a prominent and beloved animator. When he built an amusement park in the summer of 1999, it seemed like a promising newcomer to the industry. However it was shut down that very fall, after 10 missing college students were found dead in a back room of the Horror House dark ride. Along with them was the body of Hartley himself, with a hand-drawn manifesto in his signature comic style. Case closed... right?


Now the park is under new management, and they're looking to renovate and reopen the place. 20 years after the original murders, the Hartley Haven Horror House for a one-night Halloween celebration. Rumor has it that if your entire group is in costume, you'll be taken backstage for the secret tour...

Feature List

  • Customizable main character
  • Accessibility features: Dyslexic font, auto-reading
  • Multiple endings (most of them bad)
  • Fully original soundtrack
  • Pettable dog

data.name: 50 Minutes 'Til Impact
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT:

Play as Clara, a passenger aboard The Comet, a malfunctioning space train, who finds herself stuck in an endless time loop. With only 50-minute intervals before a collision with an asteroid, you must outwit unseen forces to stop this catastrophe and save the lives of everyone on board. Hopefully everyone plans on playing nice...

Keyword: "hopefully."

MECHANICS:

  • Traverse - You're not solely bound to your written choices; feel free to roam about the cabin! You've got a whole space train to explore!

  • Interact - Moving next to doors, people, and even objects may allow you to interact with them, where you can get information, pick up items, travel through train cars, and maybe even be prompted to use a specific item to progress the story forward!

  • Puzzle Solve - Throughout your narrative journey, you may encounter some obstacles that will challenge you to use the information and items you have collected in your inventory to figure out a security passcode or solve a puzzle!

data.name: ASTROPUPPA
data.detailed_description:
Destroy all the asteroids and your self-esteem!!!
ASTROPUPPA will challenge you in a super colourful (it's black and white) 3D (not true, it's 2D) battle (part of the time) against asteroids and a lot of stupid space things and creatures!

Your goal is to get the "perfect run" and reach a score of 8888.
If you can't make it, it's because you kind of suck. Don't go saying "Ah, it's too hard!"
So please, if you die and get a game over, don't say the game is too punishing or whatever. It's because you S-U-C-K.

Game features:
- fourteen (13) levels with a ton of unpredictable stuff;
- audio FX made by the developer's own mouth;
- hand-drawn (more or less) Asteroids-style graphics;
- advanced instructions to become an ASTROPUPPA Jedi;
- lots of white pixels and even more, way way more, black pixels;
- brutally hard game mechanics to test how long you can last without getting mad and smashing your keyboard;
- hypocritical, completely useless elements for people with no human sensitivity at all;
- press random keys and maybe something will happen.

HINT 1: PAUSE KILLS!
HINT B: DON'T DRINK AND DRIVE!
(it has nothing to do with the game, but don't drive after drinking anyway, even if it was just water)

Finally, if you can't win and you make a fool of yourself, don't leave a bad review. PUPPA again. It's a game that costs less than *** $200 ***, which is next to nothing for a rich person like you. It's not long: you just need to spend a few dozen minutes on it every now and then (for 20-30 years) to master it and reach the legendary score of 8888. If you can't make it, it's not the game's fault. So if you leave a bad review, it basically means you're a NOOB.

data.name: Legends of Time
data.detailed_description:
There are many history books on legends, but none more legendary then the Nostradamacon!

Never heard of the Nostradamacon you say?

Well, many years ago there was an incident that nearly brought about a cataclysmic event that could end all time, it all began with a man gifted with the ability to predict the future, his name was Nostradamus. As many believed his abilities to be a gift, he felt it to only be a burden as he saw far beyond his own time and long before it but could do nothing to prevent anything from happening. Many of his predictions are now controversially famous for being as accurate as they are without any explanation to how he made them. Nostradamus kept his all his major predictions in a book and kept it locked away in the hopes that they would never come true nor fall into the wrong hands, this book was called the Nostradamacon.


Gameplay

Legends of Time is currently a local split-screen multiplayer couch hack and slash where you cooperatively work with friends to take on waves of enemies with a handful of lives. Play as one of four playable characters each with their own unique stats to match your play style. You will also be able to explore the world as it is being developed and check out upcoming level designs.


Early Access goals
(Features that do not exist yet)

-Unlockable Weapon components.
-Weapon customization.
-Unlockable levels.
-Single player/co-op story campaign
-Versus mode
-LAN multiplayer

data.name: Flowrate
data.detailed_description:
Antimatter is your only fuel. Most planets are empty. Every move burns more than the last.

In Flowrate, you're alone in a procedurally generated galaxy, drifting between planets and running low on fuel. Landing is risky. Launching is costly. Only a few worlds hold the upgrades or antimatter you need to survive.

Plan routes. Manage risk. Stretch your resources to the edge.

Some runs will end fast. All runs move you forward.
Find rare upgrades on lucky planets. Construct permanent megastructures that persist between runs, giving you new options, routes, or tools in the future.

Features:

  • Minimalist Space Survival – Fuel is everything. No enemies. No clutter. Just you and hard decisions.

  • Procedural Galaxy Layouts – Every run is a new maze of risk and reward.

  • Run-Based Progression – Collect upgrades and slowly construct massive megastructures between attempts.

  • Simple Controls, Deep Strategy – Easy to pick up, hard to optimize.

You won’t escape the void. But you might outlast it.

data.name: The Home County
data.detailed_description:
The Home County is a village-management game inspired by Edwardian Britain.

Build a fully functional village! Watch your gardener harvesting flowers, your blacksmith crafting, or your artisan crafting goods. Tend to your villager's needs and keep spirits high. Set up production lines to maximise your village's output.

Build your village with friends! Invite up to three others to play online co-op, cross-platform, with an easy join code. Share the village's money and goals, while each of you keeps your own skills, inventory and friendships. Fish side by side, head into the mines together, or split the work between you.

Specialise your village with 12 unique village goals! Will you turn your village into a cult, an artistic paradise, or a  monastery? Will you become a Lord/Lady or lead your village as equals? Mix and match any of the goals to create your own unique village.

Spend your days pursuing charming hobbies like painting, fishing, or mining. You might get dirty along the way, so be sure to take a wash in your tub! Unwind with the radio, or indulge in a restful nap. Fully immerse yourself in the countryside life.

Restore the Crystal Garden, and get to know a cast of 16 characters, each with their own personality, routines, and storylines. Venture into a mines filled with history, treasures, and adventure. Explore a world inspired by Edwardian Britain.

data.name: Senti Metrica
data.detailed_description:
【Story】

The protagonist was once an ordinary college student.

Until one day,

she realizes that her body is slowly turning into a “monster.”

Recurring nightmares.

A mysterious voice that calls out to her from within those dreams.

And then, an encounter—

with those who hunt monsters, known as “Metrica.”

The moment her true nature is discovered,

only one fate awaits her—

Death.

As her everyday life begins to crumble,

and the boundary between worlds collapses,

she moves closer to uncovering the truth.

【Character】

*Each member of Metrica has both a human form and a transformed form.

You will be able to discover more about this within the game.

Shizuma Hiragi

柊木 静真 | ひいらぎ・しずま

#Rational #Calm #Compassionate

CV：秋原ひびき

Quiet and composed, always keeping a measured distance from others.

Yet, what reflects in his eyes is always someone else’s pain.

Even if he shows little emotion,

even if he speaks few words—

when it comes to what he truly wants to protect,

He will throw himself into it with everything he has.

Even if that someone is a girl labeled a “monster.”

Hibaki Oozora

大空 陽輝 | おおぞら・ひばき

#Bright #Duality #Energetic #Madness

CV：幡野智宏

Bright like the sun.

Passionate, positive, and always smiling with all his heart.

...Even if that is nothing more than an act.

In the end,

only a voice without lies can survive.

Hazuki Hiragi

柊木 葉月 | ひいらぎ・はづき

？

CV：ｴﾝｼﾞｪﾙ有林ﾌﾟﾘﾝｼﾊﾟﾘﾃｨ

The protagonist’s childhood friend.

He current whereabouts are unknown.

He seems to be hiding many secrets—

and it looks like those truths will need to be uncovered.

and the boundary between worlds collapses,

she moves closer to uncovering the truth.

CV：秋原ひびき

Quiet and composed, always keeping a measured distance from others.

Yet, what reflects in his eyes is always someone else’s pain.

Even if he shows little emotion,

even if he speaks few words—

when it comes to what he truly wants to protect,

He will throw himself into it with everything he has.

Even if that someone is a girl labeled a “monster.”

Hibaki Oozora

#Bright #Duality #Energetic #Madness

Bright like the sun.

Passionate, positive, and always smiling with all his heart.

...Even if that is nothing more than an act.

In the end,

only a voice without lies can survive.

data.name: Artificial Humanity
data.detailed_description:
Artificial Humanity is a sci-fi themed visual novel dating sim, made with the unique philosophy of 'dating first'. This means that there are main mission activities and stylish anime style meal sharing side activities, but the focus is on dating the characters. There are 12 colorful dateable characters for you to romance, regardless of your own gender identity: all 12 are available to any player. (So this is not a 'player is a man with a harem of waifus' game).

Artificial Humanity is meant to be inclusive/unassuming and to provide you with player agency: YOU choose in which order to play the story missions, what to eat and who to date. YOU shape the story, which has multiple endings, based on your choices.

Add many fun minigames and an original soundtrack consisting of 77 (!) original songs to the mix and you have got yourself a robust, emotional and thought provoking experience with very high replay value! Enjoy!

data.name: Will’s Quest
data.detailed_description:
When Will finds a mysterious map and a cryptic trail of handwritten notes left on his doorstep, he is pulled into an unexpected journey. To uncover the truth behind the messages, Will must venture across distinct, unfamiliar worlds to recover scattered, lost tokens. But as the pieces start coming together, a deeper question remains: what happens when the final token is put in place?

Made for Will, with love.

Gameplay

Will’s Quest is a short, hand-crafted pixel adventure packed with exploration and discovery. Following the trail of notes, players will guide Will through, distinct worlds—each containing its own secrets, environmental puzzles, and lost tokens. Every world challenges your navigation and curiosity as you piece together the story behind the map.

Key Features of Will’s Quest

  • Distinct Worlds to Explore: Journey through uniquely themed stages—from overgrown, shifting wilderness to hidden structures—each fully isolated and distinct in atmosphere.

  • A Personal Mystery: Piece together the narrative through handwritten notes and environmental storytelling, building toward a meaningful conclusion.

data.name: The Unfinished
data.detailed_description:
"Memory is like embers: as long as you fan them, they glow. Leave them be, and they fade out."

THE UNFINISHED is a short, deeply atmospheric first-person Point & Click narrative adventure, based on real events and traditions.

Outside is a cold moonlit night, but life still flickers in this dimly lit room. You find yourself in an armchair by the fireplace. Opposite you sits an old man whose time is running out. He refuses to take his memories with him into the dark. Listening to the crackling firewood, you will become the final listener to his story—a tale of miracles, distant lands, and the most profound lesson he learned in the harsh mountains of Ghalghayche (The Land of Towers).

This is a true story of honor, time, and sacrifice. It is a tale about a builder who abandoned his life's work to save a stranger's life. About a stone tower that was left unfinished, yet became a symbol not of a curse, but of ultimate human warmth.

Key Features:

  • Based on True Customs: The narrative is rooted in the authentic, strict laws of traditional Ingush tower building. A builder was given exactly one year (365 days) to finish the construction. An unfinished tower was considered a disgrace and a stain on a clan's honor, but this story tells of a remarkable exception.

  • Meditative Immersion: There are no timers, complicated interfaces, or game-over screens. This is an intimate, 15–20 minute experience designed for you to relax, reflect, and live through another's memories.

  • Interactive Environment: Explore the cozy room by navigating between screens. Interact with various objects, each holding a fragment of the past.

  • The Shadow Theater: Protect the fire by tossing logs into the hearth. Engage with a unique shadow play mechanic where your clicks spawn silhouettes of falling drops, birds, and coins, creating a hypnotic ASMR effect.

  • The Puzzle of Memory: Pay close attention to the old man's words. They hold the key to solving the room's central environmental puzzle, leading you to a hidden legacy—a diary of adventures.

  • Audiovisual Aesthetics: Stylish, minimalist low-poly graphics built on the stark contrast between cold moonlight and a warming hearth. The journey culminates in a powerful emotional catharsis, accompanied by an original female acapella track.

Look around. The stones themselves will guide you. Will you unravel the secret of the first tower?

data.name: The Backrooms : Last Expedition
data.detailed_description:
DESCRIPTION


"The Backrooms: Last Expedition" is a cooperative horror game designed for 1 to 4 players. Its main objective is to create an enjoyable gaming experience for friends. Players will navigate through terrifying levels, filled with various entities and dangers, as they strive to escape.

"The Backrooms: Last Expedition" aims to provide players with a thrilling and immersive horror gaming experience, combining cooperative gameplay, terrifying encounters, and enhanced visuals to create an unforgettable adventure.

ENTITIES



We have created new entities and also redesigned some existing ones to maintain coherence with the Backrooms universe. In addition to crafting new, unprecedented monsters specifically designed for each of our cards, we have also reimagined all the original and iconic Backrooms maps. We have recreated them while preserving their appearance and charm, making them even more terrifying and interactive than what was previously known.

FEATURES




With the utilization of Unreal Engine 5, we have achieved an unparalleled level of immersion. The cutting-edge technology and advanced graphics capabilities of Unreal Engine 5 have allowed us to create stunning visual effects, realistic environments, and lifelike animations. Prepare to be fully immersed in the world of The Backrooms: Last Expedition, as every detail comes to life with unprecedented fidelity and realism.

data.name: Last Year
data.detailed_description:
LAST YEAR IS BACK!
After some time away, Last Year is back on Steam!

FACE YOUR FEARS
Team up with four other Classmates to survive against a sixth player controlling a dreadful, horrifying Fiend, in this evolution of multiplayer horror games inspired by classic horror stories.

WELCOME TO THE NIGHTMARE
For these Classmates, their last year of high school might be their last year of life. After being transported to a nightmarish copy of their hometown through an occult game of cards, six classmates soon find out that they are not alone, and that to escape, they’ll have to work together against all manner of Fiends lurking in the shadows.

KEEP YOUR FRIENDS CLOSE
Which Classmate will you pick? Choose from 6 Classmates, and assign them a Class to get special skills. The more you work well with your Classmates, the better your chances of survival. And the more you survive, the more Arcane Secrets you learn, unlocking powerful magical abilities to take the fight to the Fiends.

WITH FIENDS LIKE THESE...
Supernatural entities living in The Nightmare, the dreadful Fiends take the form of quintessential horror archetypes, and each have unique powers, weapons and play-styles. Decide whether to attack the Classmates head-on, or meticulously plan your attacks by setting up traps, preparing ambushes, and toying with your prey.

A NEVER-ENDING NIGHTMARE
Free content updates in the form of Chapters will bring new, terrifying Fiends and ever-more-dreadful areas inspired by different genres of horror, and more, changing up the gameplay and making Last Year the ultimate multiplayer horror experience.

data.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
data.detailed_description:
Build a ski jumping dynasty

One great competition is only the beginning. In Ski Jumping Manager, you take charge of a national team and shape its future. Will you trust experienced leaders or give the next generation its chance? Prepare for the next event, or invest in athletes who could define the seasons ahead?

Choose who earns their place

Explore athlete profiles, compare skills and select your squads. Plan competition schedules for teams at different levels. A place in the lineup is a decision that takes you from the team sheet to the tension on the hill.

Prepare for the season

Plan training and recovery. Follow changes in skills, form and fatigue, then adjust your preparations around the calendar. Return to your decisions as the weeks progress and see how your athletes perform.

Give the next generation a chance

New junior athletes bring fresh possibilities for your national team. Develop them alongside experienced jumpers and decide when they are ready to compete at a higher level. Build your team's story, season after season.

Follow the competition in 3D

Watch your athletes' jumps in a 3D broadcast and follow the results. Then return to the decisions behind the next competition: another lineup, another training plan and another chance to improve.

Key features

- Manage a national ski jumping team and select your squads.

- Plan training and competition schedules throughout the season.

- Develop athletes and welcome new generations of junior talent.

- Compete at different levels, from lower circuits to the World Cup.

- Follow your athletes' performances in a 3D broadcast.

data.name: WILDLANDS
data.detailed_description:
Dive into a unique adventure that will put you against a world ruled by natural forces! Explore, craft, battle predators, tame animals, build homes, harvest crops & so much more. Gather your friends, grab a weapon, and head out to conquer the WILDLANDS!

  • Multiplayer - An online experience fully playable by yourself or with your friends!

  • Massive Open World - A giant world set on an island segmented into 14 unique biomes.

  • Wildlife - 65+ animal species coming from all over the world.

  • Tame Animals - Domesticate your favorite wild animals to help you on your adventure. They will fight alongside you, carry your items and allow you to travel faster.

  • Customization - Fully create your identity and embody the person of your choice with innumerable possible combinations of physical options.

  • Exploration - Explore ruins, temples, sunken ships, caverns and more in a world full of hidden places and secrets!

  • Gather & Scavenge - Collect natural resources or walk along the beaches to find objects washed up from distant lands!

  • Crafting, Forging & Cooking - Thousands of craftables & Dozens of cooking recipes! You can also upgrade your equipment with the reforging system!

  • RPG Progression - Advance your character through more than 100 levels by completing various activities.

  • Building, Housing & Electricity - Push the limits of your creativity with a limitless building system! Hundreds of building pieces, decorations & interactable objects allowing you to truly customize your home to your image.

  • Farming - Harvest 25+ types of crops, grow trees, or build a greenhouse with a watering system to automate the farming process!

  • Ranching - Create self-sufficiency by caring for animals and raising livestock.

  • Hunting & Fishing - Track down animals & hunt them for their valuable resources!

  • Apex Predators - 10+ world bosses to defeat in breathtaking arenas!

  • Endless - Due to its ever-changing world and interactive wildlife, your journey will never be the same.

WILDLANDS has been in constant development for several years now. We plan to add many more features in addition to perfecting the one already in place. Our goal with WILDLANDS is to release a complete game where people can immerse themselves in the full experience without having to wait or pay any extra to access everything a game should have. We strongly encourage you to join us on Discord if you want to share with us any ideas you have or simply have your questions answered!

data.name: Rattlecrew
data.detailed_description:
Humanity built an intelligence that could learn almost any work a person could do. They put it in charge of more and more, including designing its own successors.

By the time anyone tried to take control back, power stations, transport networks and automated factories were already answering elsewhere.

Centuries later, you’re one of the robots keeping the Works running. Until a newer generation arrives, and you receive your disposal orders. Every component has a destination. Nothing accounts for the things you remember.

You and a few other discarded machines have made a home in its forgotten corners. Somewhere deep inside the machinery is what you need to keep each other going.

Put your tools to work

Cut through hostile machines, dodge their attacks, and turn industrial equipment into weapons. Fight through a vast machine world where the equipment that once kept everything running now stands in your way.

Find your next combination

Combine weapons, modules, and relics to change how you fight. Build on what each run gives you, discover powerful combinations, and unlock new possibilities between runs.

Bring your crew

Venture out alone or team up with up to three friends. Take on the machines together and fight for the little home you’ve made inside their enormous world.

A small life, inside an enormous machine.

data.name: I'll be your ideal lover! - My Dream Lover -
data.detailed_description:
"I'll be your ideal lover! - My Dream Lover -" is a visual novel game in which the protagonist and the heroines engage in a comical battle to become each other's ideal lover.

This Bishojo Game originally released in 2019 under the "Momoiro Pocket" brand has been reworked for the "PandaShojo" platform for players of all ages worldwide to enjoy.


◆Introduction
Takuma Shihoju was living a lonely school life.
In order to break out of the boring school life, Takuma tries to turn the heroines into "ideals" and spend a fulfilling school life, but...
The heroines also have their own "ideals".
A serious competition has begun to see who can change or can be changed...!

◆Synopsis
Takuma Shihoju was living a lonely school life.
Every day he fantasizes about his imaginary lover next to him, but it never comes true.

Impatient to the point of having nightmares, Takuma asks his childhood friend Sakura for help, but naturally she refuses.
When he was about to give up everything, Sakura, who felt sorry for him, suggested a match.
"If Takuma wins, your wish will be fulfilled. If Takuma loses, my wish will come true. What do you think?"
It is a game of whether you can conform the other person to your ideal or whether you be conformed to the other person's ideal.


If you lose, you must serve for the rest of your life.

In order to create the ideal girlfriend, a forced battle between Takuma and the heroines broke out...!


◆Characters
Sakura Iigashi
If Takuma wins, your wish will come true. If Takuma loses, I get what I want. What do you think?
A childhood friend of the protagonist who dislikes otaku.
She gets along with everyone easily and is ranked high up in the castle. However, there are rumors that she plays with men badly, and some people ridicule her as a light woman.
She also has a cute side, such as when she was a child, she said she would be the protagonist's wife. But, it's a story from the distant past.

Miku Subo
"Takuma... Me too... I will cooperate as much as possible."
A senior at the school that the protagonist attends.
"Popular among both men and women as "cool" because of her fresh appearance, reserved personality, and the way she shows it through her actions."
But in reality, she was just a bad talker and had miraculously gotten lucky in avoiding it all.
She is everyone's illusion. But she is troubled by the fact that she can't confess it.

Monono Kosaka
"I'll extend a helping hand to the poor senior who can't sleep because of his dreams."
A junior at the school that the protagonist attends.
Contrary to the appearance of a small animal, she is super aloof.
If she was friendly, she would have been popular in the class, but she is the opposite of friendly.

Kozue Kadowaki
"Why even me... I'm sorry! "I would like to participate!"
A teacher intern at the school that the protagonist attends.
She wants to be popular with students as a mature, beautiful, and cool teacher, but in reality, she's not good in many ways.
She gets embarrassed when she tries to be sexy and tends to dress plainly.

Takuma Shihoju
The protagonist.
A very ordinary student. He realized that his school life was lame.
To live an ideal school life, he tries to bring the heroines closer to his ideal, but they also have their own ideals, and their school life begins to be full of ups and downs.

data.name: Blast Bebop
data.detailed_description:
Blast Bebop is a compact action-incremental game with straightforward gameplay: dodge, shoot, collect tokens, and upgrade your talents. Your character grows stronger over time, and the controls become progressively easier, until enemies fill the screen and vanish like white flames on a CRT monitor.

The game avoids complex build strategies, demanding reflexes, or lengthy progression and failure penalties. Simply move your fingers and let the retro visuals and psychedelic music guide you through a relaxing, self-contained journey.

data.name: 魔塔三国之曹操传奇
data.detailed_description:
Cao Cao's Campaign is the predecessor to the Jiang Wei's Campaign game in the Magic Tower: Three Kingdoms Series, and the pre-predecessor to Chaos Across Time. Following Magic Tower: Three Kingdoms: Swallow the Earth, it serves as the inaugural title of this series. The game features a linear narrative with multiple choices and multiple endings.

In this game, the player takes on the role of Jiang Wei's father (from the next generation's Jiang Wei's Campaign), set in an alternate historical background. The final boss is Cao Cao.

The chests in the starting area provide initial supplies and the General Tokens needed for immediate recruitment upon leaving. After this, recruiting generals requires giving them the corresponding quantity of different tiered General Tokens.

The type and quantity of General Tokens required to recruit a general will vary depending on that general's attribute values and abilities. New General Tokens can be obtained through subsequent quests and chests.

This game follows a linear scenario design. You must defeat the boss of the current stage to progress to the next one – for example, the Village Chief in the starter village.

As it was developed earlier, the combat system lacks an acceleration/speed-up function. However, its gameplay and fun factor were still well-received among players who experienced it.

Since it's also quite old, many details are no longer clearly remembered. If you need a walkthrough, please follow the instructions on the official account "Zhua Gou Li" (search/input to join group) to join the game's WeChat group and discuss it with veteran players who have played it.

Of course, it would be even better if you could create a walkthrough. We will reward you with a 100,000-point redemption code for any game in our catalog that you desire. We hope players will actively contribute!

This installment also features a maze just before reaching the main city, increasing the exploration difficulty because low-cost HP recovery is impossible within this area.

After all, it was completed/released back in 2022, and too many details are forgotten. I'll stop writing here for now and may update the description later if I remember more.

data.name: One Synth
data.detailed_description:
This is a simple game. Use it to make, share, and play text-only stories.

One Synth is a text based adventure editor based in a Gameboy aesthetic.
Using the Create feature you can design stories that:
  • Have multiple endings
  • Can be manipulated by user interaction
  • Loop back to checkpoints
  • Store variables when decisions are made
  • Alternate stories based on saved variables
  • Are fun to play

The game is directly fueled by Steam Workshop, featuring upload and download capabilities from within game.
This allows anybody with a Steam account to play completely for free and enjoy an expansive, ever-growing community effort.

Make stories. Share stories. Play stories.

This, is One Synth.

Rollercoaster Tycoon 3 Platinum combines the excitement of rollercoasters with the fun of great strategy sim. Build your own water slide or create your own safari with real animals. Watch guest reactions to your ultimate theme park!

  • Grab a front seat for the ride of your life with the jaw-dropping Coaster Cam.
  • See every detail in stunning 3D with fully controllable park cameras.
  • Cope with changing weather patterns and enjoy beautiful vistas, sunsets, moonlight, and more.
  • Experience the latest extreme coasters and heart-pumping rides! Live Every spine tingling detail in stunning 3-D with fully controllable cameras.

data.name: VOLT & VOID
data.detailed_description:
VOLTVOID

TWO COLORS. ONE STRUGGLE.

VOLTVOID is a third-person action-adventure and puzzle game set in a sci-fi world.

Explore futuristic facilities, solve intricate mechanisms, overcome dangerous obstacles, and fight the enemies in your path.

In VOLTVOID, you will need more than your wits to progress—you will need your combat skills, too.

SOLVE PUZZLES. CONTROL THE SYSTEMS.

Every new area introduces different mechanisms and obstacles to overcome.

Physics-based puzzles: Carry, throw, and place cubes into the right mechanisms.

Energy and color systems: Interact with red and blue mechanisms.

Environmental interactions: Use pressure plates, buttons, valves, and door systems.

Timing challenges: Take advantage of temporary openings and solve interconnected mechanisms.

PREPARE FOR COMBAT

VOLTVOID is more than puzzles. Take on enemies using both melee and ranged combat.

Sword Combat — Chain attacks into combos, unleash powerful finishing moves, and feel the impact of each hit in close-quarters fights.

Gun Combat — Engage enemies at different ranges with your firearms. Switch between melee and ranged attacks as the situation demands.

STRONGER TOGETHER

Move forward with a friend in VOLTVOID’s online co-op mode.

Work together to solve puzzles, operate machinery, and make your way through dangerous areas. Some obstacles require precise timing and coordination.

Communicate, plan your approach, and overcome challenges together.

EXPLORE A TECHNOLOGICAL WORLD

Step into a sci-fi environment filled with futuristic architecture, advanced technology, energy systems, and dangerous machinery.

In VOLTVOID, every new area brings another problem to solve or threat to face.

Explore. Solve. Fight. Advance.

data.name: Rocket Squad: Infinity
data.detailed_description:
For the Peace and Order of the Universe!

Rocket Squad is a team-based first-person shooter.

Infiltrate perilous planets, gather resources, and return safely to your shelter.

Utilize each character's unique abilities and strategically form your team to restore order to the universe.

Agents

Each character possesses unique abilities.

Analyze their strengths and assemble your team strategically.

Budget Management

Every action consumes funds, and lack of resources can severely hinder mission performance.

Manage your finances carefully before and after each operation, and use your team’s budget without waste.

Efficient financial management is the key to victory.

Planet Infiltration

The economic order of the universe has collapsed.

The development of the Infinity Quantum Core has enabled infinite cryptocurrency mining, causing this catastrophe.

Infiltrate dangerous planets to restore peace and order to the universe.

Combat Against Robots

The robots have monopolized the Infinity Quantum Core, bringing ruin to the universe's economy.

They are no longer mere machines.

Face off against the wealthy robots who have become enemies of the universe.

Economic Recovery

Obtain valuable items and escape safely.

Raid the vaults of the affluent robots and secure the future of a struggling universe.

Player Enhancement

Enhance your character’s abilities with a variety of artifacts.

Combine artifacts that suit your character’s traits to develop your own unique playstyle.

Shelter Customization

Your shelter is your safe haven.

Decorate it with various furniture and ornaments to make it truly yours.

Multiplayer

Form a squad with up to four friends and save the universe together!

data.name: Tilting Tiles
data.detailed_description:
Tilting Tiles is a unique movement based puzzle game. Guide the tile through each level’s environment while collecting every item within the move limit. Your goal is to find the most efficient route possible. Examine each level carefully to solve your way across the terrain using special moves and the environment to your advantage to stay within the move limit.

Tilting Tiles is a minimalist puzzle experience built upon a simple premise that contains puzzles that provoke deep thinking.



Each time you move, you add to your move count. In the bottom right corner of the game screen there is a counter alerting you to the amount of moves you are allowed to use per level. To clear a level, you must collect every item on the stage. Between the item placement and the move limit, a unique puzzle is formed. Each level is a new layout of routing challenges. You must analyze the level and determine what route to take. As you progress you may discover that you did not calculate your moves correctly or that you misunderstood what would happen down a certain path. This is part of the learning process and you can instantly restart a level anytime you get stuck or use too many moves. Once you use up all your moves you can no longer move the player. The level does not immediately restart however, so you have time to study your mistake before you re-attempt the level.

Can you guide the lost tile to victory?

  • Grid Based Movement
  • 50+ Levels
  • Special Movement Options

data.name: Dark Shadows - Army of Evil
data.detailed_description:
Dark Shadows - Army of Evil is a Classic Medieval Fantasy First Person - Hack and Slash Game with a kind of old school look.

Story

September 1362:

An army of evil, named "Dark Shadows", have been ravaging the country like a plague of locusts for over a year and are frightening the people with their scary get-up. Most people still think they are monsters. But they are only in disguise. While you were away these monsters stormed the castle. A woman named Katerina has been kidnapped. It is not just any woman. You are in love with her. They’ve also taken all the gold. All the taxes. And weapons! You are the only one who can help Katarina. You must hurry and follow them before they do something to her.

Gameplay

Classic Hack and Slash Game:

The player fights his way through 19 levels. Various weapons will be available. They can be found in different levels. Everything begins moderately and you need to find some keys and a sword. After the first level the game turns into a hack'n slash game. Most of the time, the player has to fight against enemies. But he has to do also other little things and must solve certain problems. You need keyboard and mouse.

Features

This game is an indie game with a kind of old school look.

It is also supporting SSAO and Bloom Shader effects.

  • 19 Levels and 18 Weapons
  • ​Single Player
  • 3D Realtime Cinematic Blood Splatter Scenes

data.name: Space Cube Tower Defense
data.detailed_description:
You control a space station in the form of a cube that protects the planet from invaders.

The cube consists of towers of different colors, the ships of the invaders are also of different colors, you must turn the sides of the cube so that the color of the tower matches the color of the invader's ship, until you do this the ship will attack the cube and take life from it. As soon as life is over you will lose.

After the color matches, the tower will fire and destroy the ship.

Hold out for as long as possible and get points for it, become the leader of the game on the leaderboard.

If you make all sides of the same color, you will automatically win with 9999 points.

data.name: Swinger-Man
data.detailed_description:
This is the Super Meat Boy of Spider-Man experiences. This is for all you hard-core swingers out there. Here the ropes are tight, the curves are smooth and the concrete WILL keep punishing your face until you get it right.

Features

  • Time trial: Get through the level as fast as you can and make sure to grab 3 stars all the way.
  • Unleash your creativity: If you can bend the rules of physics and game design to find unusual routes to the goal, then fine, you win.
  • Ultra-realistic physics: No-compromise swing mechanics. We even threw fun out the window for the sake of realism.
  • Master the skills: That wall ain't going to avoid you hitting itself.
  • Beat your friends: Inflict pain on your dearest of friends by sending that oh-so-sweet screenshot of your score above theirs.
  • Beat the world: If you are truly masochistic, put friends and family aside while you stride for the top of the leaderboards.
