data.name: Clean Co. - Window Cleaners
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Clean Co.

In a world where people subscribe to everything, why shouldn't they subscribe to their windows?

Whenever a window gets dirty, a company comes along, takes it away, and replaces it with a fresh one. The dirty windows are shipped across the world to facilities like yours, where minimum-wage workers clean them before they are sent back into the great window subscription cycle.

Congratulations. You are one of those workers.

- And there are a LOT of windows.

Clean Co. - Window Cleaners is a chaotic arcade window cleaning game for 1-3 players, playable solo or in co-op with your friends.

Clean windows. Make money. Buy upgrades. Survive increasingly ridiculous workdays...

...and try not to get fired.

Your job is simple:

Clean all the required windows (if possible) before the day ends. The better you clean a window, the more money you earn. But every day gets harder.

The available cleaning time gets shorter. The windows get dirtier. The dirt gets tougher to remove. The workload keeps growing. Push your luck and see how far you can make it.

Hit your quota and the exit door unlocks. Clock out, bank the day, walk away clean...

...or stay on the line. Overtime windows still pay.

But the clock is still running and the crane is still delivering. Every pane you rush drags down the day's average, and ruin too many and the shift is over - and the run with it.

When the run ends, start again from Day 1 and try to beat your previous record or compete in the global cleaning facility rankings, to be the very best window cleaner.

How long can you keep the window factory running?

Not all dirt is the same. Unfortunately. Bring the wrong tool and the window will let you know. It smears. It films over. It scratches. And scratched glass does not pay.

No idea what you are looking at? Hold TAB and the window will tell you exactly what it wants. High maintenance, these windows.

Some panes turn up with complications. Boarded windows arrive with planks nailed across the glass, courtesy of somebody who really did not want this window cleaned. Or Security windows arrive with the alarm lasers still switched on. Clip a beam and the pane is whisked away and graded exactly as it is. Half-finished counts. Rude.

Cleaning windows isn't just about making things shiny. It's about making money.

Use your hard-earned cash to buy upgrades during your run and become faster, stronger and more efficient.

Improve your equipment and cleaning abilities to keep up with the increasingly ridiculous workload.

Every run gives you another chance to experiment with different upgrades and find a setup that lets you survive just a little longer.

You thought you were here to clean windows? Unfortunately, the building has other plans.

During your workday, unexpected events can disrupt the entire facility.

Power outage? Fix it.

Water pipe bursting? Fix it.

Something else has exploded for reasons nobody understands? Probably fix that too.

These events interrupt your cleaning operation and force you to deal with problems around the facility before you can get back to work. Every second counts. The windows don't care about your problems.

...and sometimes the line just sends you the wrong thing entirely.

Being a minimum-wage window cleaner is stressful. Luckily, the facility has a vending machine.

Get yourself a treat. Enjoy it & feel the effects.

But beware: Drinking affects your character and can lead to some extremely questionable decision-making.

Tired, weak, drunk? - Get yourself a coffee!

Coffee can help sober you up and even give you a temporary speed boost.

Clean Co. isn't trying to be a realistic window-cleaning simulator.

The facility is packed with physics-driven toys, ridiculous movement options and opportunities to make a complete mess of your workplace and a fool of yourself.

Ride cleaning carts, get launched around by the hose, slide, stumble, crash and fling yourself across the facility.

Why clean hundreds of windows alone when you can make your friends do it too?

Play solo or team up with your friends in co-op.

Divide the work, coordinate your upgrades and keep the facility running. - Or don't.

There is nothing stopping your friend from drinking three beers, driving a cleaning cart into a window and somehow becoming the biggest obstacle in the entire operation.

And nothing is stopping you from retaliating.

Throw anything at anyone. A hurled tool staggers a teammate just long enough to steal their bay. A well-aimed can takes them off their feet completely and leaves them seeing stars.

Or keep it professional and simply hose them down - a faceful of degreaser will not cost them a single point, but it will cost them the ability to see anything at all.

Work together. Make money. Cause problems and then solve them before you get fired altogether.

  • Arcade Window Cleaning: Clean dirty windows quickly and efficiently by choosing the right tools while racing against the clock.

  • Multiple Kinds of Dirt: Dust, mud, grease and graffiti each need a different tool - and the wrong tool smears, scratches or ruins the pane.

  • Awkward Windows: Boarded-up panes to pry open and live security lasers to clean around.

  • Roguelike Runs: Start every run at Day 1 and see how far you can get before the workload becomes impossible.

  • Overtime: Fill the quota and clock out safely, or stay on the line and keep earning until the shift eats you.

  • Buy Upgrades: Spend the money you earn during a run to improve your equipment and abilities.

  • Random Events: Power outages, leaking pipes and other facility disasters force you to stop cleaning and deal with the problem.

  • Solo & Co-op: Work alone or clean with your friends.

  • Physics Chaos: Ride cleaning carts, get dragged by hoses and abuse the laws of physics for workplace efficiency.

  • Pure Arcade Fun: No deep meaning. No serious simulation. Just dirty windows, questionable physics and the eternal struggle of getting paid.

The windows won't clean themselves.

And judging by the size of that pile...

You're going to be here for a while.

data.name: Goblet of Maya
data.detailed_description:
Release!

Welcome to Ancient Maya world!


About the Game

Marcus is an amateur archaeologist. He, as a newbie, had no chance to show his worth. He got only boring tasks. During one of these tasks he was sent to check already examined temple of Maya. No one has expected Marcus to find the secret entrance and get into the part of the ruins that any real archeologist has ever visited. He, together with you, will have to face the ancient ruins full of dangerous traps – all this to find the ancient artefact – the goblet of Maya, which, as the legend says, has a power of day and night.

Goblet Of Maya - Challenging Pixel Art Platformer

  • 50 absorbing levels
  • The atmosphere of Maya ancient civilization
  • The ability to change day and night time as an instrument for solving puzzles
  • Challenging gameplay
  • Dangerous ruins
  • Fauna

data.name: STARSHRED
data.detailed_description:
STARSHRED is a fast-paced, top-down arena shooter set in the depths of space. Take control of Gemini, weave through barrages of bullets, and survive against waves of enemies that grow deadlier with every round.

At the end of every wave, choose one of three different upgrades and shape your build on the fly. Combine upgrades, discover new synergies, and create a completely different playstyle with every run. The same beginning can turn into a different kind of chaos every time.

Every run tells its own story. Choose upgrades between waves, collect transformations, chain synergies, and improve your ship in the hangar for the next attempt. Short runs, readable combat, and an arcade pace.

What awaits you?

  • Fast, readable top-down space combat

  • Escalating threats and boss encounters wave after wave

  • In-run upgrades and transformation synergies

  • Permanent progression through the hangar

  • Different regions, enemy types, and trading encounters

  • A replayable arcade loop designed for a single session

  • From the Crimson Square to spiked spheres, from cosmic tentacles to siege ships, every boss forces its own rhythm on you. Read the patterns, find the openings, survive.

If you're ready, launch. Space shows no mercy — neither should you.

data.name: Mandrake
data.detailed_description:
Horticulture is a cursed and forbidden practice... except to you. You come from a long line of sorcerers who practiced the green and growing arts, and you’re able to grow such marvels as: runner beans! Cherry trees! The humble turnip!

And as your skills grow, you'll be able to plant stranger seeds, like thunder-calling taran, or rhewyn, which waters your gardens for you. Perhaps you'll even grow a goose-tree! (Where did you think geese came from? Other geese? Preposterous.)

Place beds, decorations and resting spots. Find, plant, nurture, grow and harvest plants both mundane and magical, and gradually expand your gardens into the tangled grounds of your family's abandoned castle.

Discover a beguiling new world inspired by British history and folklore. A world of old, wild powers, of uncanny spirits that reside in those places mortals dare not go; of deep histories, and deeper mysteries.

You won't just work in your gardens. Forage for resources in the nearby woods and along the beach. Go fishing (but take care not to be cursed by the river). Delve into dangerous mines in search of bright minerals and stolen secrets.

Breathe life into the Mandrake lodge with your choice of furnishings and renovations; acquire old books, and spend the evenings reading in the candlelit comfort of your study. Learn to cook. Meet your neighbours, become entangled in their lives, give them gifts and learn their stories.

Long ago, the world changed. The Covenant of the Hearth decreed that the day belonged to humanity, but the night... the night belonged to other things. Now, all earthly lights save hearthfires go out when the sun sets, and the Mara ride the night-winds. Don't go out after dark – the night is not for you. 

For now. (After all, what self-respecting sorcerer follows the rules?)

Magic in Mandrake isn't about flashy fireballs and shimmering shields, but about folkloric ingenuity, whimsy and patience. Grow a cherry tree from seedling to maturity in seven days rather than seven years, then fashion your sorcerer's staff from its wood. Befriend a river. Eavesdrop on the dead. Spend a haunted night at the Butcher's Oak. Drink tea with the god who lives in your chimney. 

Welcome to the village of Chandley. It's small, it's complicated, and everyone's got their own story. 

Meet Rosen – bee-keeper, candlemaker, rook-speaker – the even-handed village leader charged with steering this troublesome community of eccentrics. Or Gideon, the sombre hunter who makes pacts with the wild powers of the woods.

Befriend Nessa, the village smith, whose kindness conceals the scars of an old tragedy; and Thackery, the effusive Voicer, who keeps technology that no-one – least of all he – fully understands.

Visit the lighthouse, where Jory and Ruan Vicory live with young Tamsyn: the girl they saved from the sea, and who still hears voices calling to her from beneath the waves...

Chandley may be small, but it's old, thick with secrets, and set in its ways. Is it ready for the return of a Mandrake?

Encounter the spirits, gods and bogles that live alongside the people of Chandley: the smiling revenant imprisoned in a tree, who claims he knows you (even though he's hundreds of years dead). Lonely, long-armed Granny Jakes in her hidden orchard, who offers you a sip of a drink that the world has forgotten how to make. The Regent of the Woods, bearer of a white crown. The shy thing that whistles an old tune in the depths of a mine no-one has worked in decades. Hroame, who is sometimes stone and sometimes not.

Mandrake is complex and has some very unusual features, so we’ll be seeking ongoing feedback from players. For this reason, we're expecting to run some playtests here on Steam.

If you’d like to hear from us when we release Mandrake or upload a demo, please consider wishlisting the game!

Founded in 2009, we’re an indie game studio known for quality storytelling and highly atmospheric art. You might know us from our other games: Sunless Sea, Sunless Skies and Mask of the Rose, which are set in the world of our long-running browser game Fallen London. In a break from studio tradition, this is a game where you can't eat people.

We are making Mandrake for you, by hand, in the UK and Ireland.

Make friends, tend your gardens, and put down roots. Fish, gather and delve in the wilds. Make a place for yourself, and uncover the mysteries your family left behind.
data.reviews:
“As a rural life simulation, Mandrake is odder and more beguiling than most... should you tire of tilling the soil, you might wander off the beaten path of this mythical, Brythonic-inspired land, perhaps eavesdropping on the dead or even befriending a river.”
The Guardian

data.name: Heim
data.detailed_description:
Heim is an indie puzzle adventure game inspired by Norse mythology. An unexpected visitor turns Ashyr's homelife upside down, bringing him into a mystical adventure that takes him to far-off places and different worlds. Use your wits and acquire magical abilities to regain your home!

Travel from world to world to discover ancient magicks sealed within runes: harnessing runic magic grants Ashyr various abilities, from seeing the memories of the past unfold before his very eyes, to moving objects without even touching them. Ashyr wields no weapons or armour, but overcomes obstacles with his magic flute. His adventure sees Ashyr sail the endless seas, discover the secrets of a shattered world, delve in the misty realm of the dead, and seek out the gods themselves.

Heim revolves around exploring a handcrafted open world, traversing four Realms with puzzle platformer mechanics, and solving unique, varied puzzles while uncovering the secrets of Heim's story and world. Collect Lore Scrolls and Arcane Remnants, and unlock outfits & accessories to customize Ashyr's appearance by keeping an eye open and overcoming optional obstacles. Heim is a game for explorers, puzzlers and lorehounds!

data.name: Beff Jezos Simulator
data.detailed_description:
From Launch to Success: Build Your Online Empire!

Kick off your e-commerce adventure with Beff Jezos and build your online empire from scratch! Ask yourself—what would Beff Jezos do?

Beff Jezos Simulator combines realistic business mechanics with fun gameplay to deliver an immersive experience that is perfect for both casual gamers and simulation fans.

Start from Scratch

  • Launch Your Store: Begin in a cozy office, customize your shop’s name, design a logo, and open your virtual doors to the world.

  • Discover Products: Browse wholesalers, source popular items, and stock up to meet customer demand from a variety of new suppliers. Choose from a wide range of products, from affordable goods to rare antiques, and adapt your stock to changing market trends.

  • Set Profitable Prices: Stay competitive by analyzing market trends and competitor pricing to attract more buyers.

Manage and Grow

  • Grow Your Business: Hire a skilled team, expand packaging stations, and even open a warehouse as demand soars. Strengthen your workforce to improve efficiency and keep your operations running smoothly.

  • Upgrade Your Skills: Unlock powerful abilities like bulk shipping, advanced sales insights, and marketing strategies through a rich skill tree!

Packaging Machines and Operations

  • Product Packaging Machines: You can now expand your operations with product packaging machines, allowing you to employ a dedicated worker for each machine. There is no limit to the number of machines you can purchase, giving you the flexibility to streamline your operations. Choose from different machine types with varying speeds to efficiently manage fulfillment and keep up with demand.

Delivery and Fulfillment

  • Fulfill Orders Efficiently: Pack items quickly and accurately, manage customer service, and keep satisfaction high!

  • Customizable Delivery Options: You can now choose how you want to deliver your products—whether it's through a cost-effective, fast drone service, or by using your own delivery vehicle for more personalized control. The new delivery options allow you to balance operational costs with delivery speed, offering the flexibility to meet your goals.

  • Vehicles: If you’re ready to hit the road, you can now purchase delivery vehicles to handle your shipments or buy sports cars to cruise through the city for fun. Choose vehicles that fit your operational needs or enjoy the perks of a flashy car to unwind.

Dynamic and Realistic Gameplay

  • Real-World E-Commerce Mechanics: Face real challenges like inventory management, pricing strategies, and keeping customers happy.

  • Adapt to Market Trends: Stock popular items and adjust quickly to shifts in demand to keep profits high.

  • Customer Feedback: Respond to reviews to boost your store rating, attracting more buyers and unlocking new wholesalers.

  • Customizable Delivery Options: You can now choose how you want to deliver your products—whether it's through a cost-effective, fast drone service, or by using your own delivery vehicle for more personalized control. The new delivery options allow you to balance operational costs with delivery speed, offering the flexibility to meet your goals.

Customize and Optimize

  • Office Layout: Arrange furniture, equipment, and goods for maximum efficiency in your office and warehouse.

  • Team Management: Assign employees to specific tasks to boost productivity and speed up order fulfillment.

  • Personalize Your Store: Style your shop’s appearance to build a memorable brand and draw in more customers.

  • Vehicles: If you’re ready to hit the road, you can now purchase delivery vehicles to handle your shipments or buy sports cars to cruise through the city for fun. Choose vehicles that fit your operational needs or enjoy the perks of a flashy car to unwind.

Join a Thriving Community

Connect with fellow virtual entrepreneurs on our Discord server! Share strategies, get tips, and stay updated on the latest game developments.

Why Beff Jezos Simulator?

  • Unique Gameplay Experience: Enjoy a rare blend of e-commerce excitement and immersive simulation!

  • Surprisingly Addictive: Building your e-commerce empire is more fun than you would expect!

  • Unmatched Replayability: Face new challenges every time, keeping the gameplay fresh and rewarding!

Start Your E-Commerce Journey!

Take on the challenge in Beff Jezos Simulator and turn your vision into a virtual success! Build your e-commerce powerhouse today—discover products, set prices, ship orders, and grow from a startup to an empire! Don’t forget to ask yourself—what would Beff Jezos do?

Disclaimer: Beff Jezos Simulator is a satirical work of fiction intended for entertainment purposes only. Any resemblance to real persons or entities is purely coincidental.

data.name: Godking: Master of Rituals
data.detailed_description:
Godking: Master of Rituals is a fantasy strategy game inspired by 25 years of classics, while bringing a host of new features and innovations to the table.

Pick your faction and your god-like incarnation, build your empire and crush all enemies.

Play as the Blackbog Goblins - who rely on cheap slaves and dark magic, the Scaleborne - lizardmen clans who can swim across the seas, Mercia - the once great human kingdom who can field huge armies of armored knights, United Tribes - the human barbarian brotherhood of freefolk, the Returned - skeletal armies of undead warriors and necromantic mages, Khaoset - the chaos entity able to reproduce itself into a whole faction of mind linked mutated chaos creatures, Alfendor - the first elven kingdom reforged, or play as Imperatus - a faction of scavenging ratlings that specialize in plaguecraft and necromancy.

Pick one faction to lead. The rest you will have to destroy...

Key Features

  • A new 4X experience, with a rich fantasy universe to explore and powerful enemies to destroy
  • Eight unique playable factions, all with their own set of units, spells and even mechanics and how to play them
  • Ten unique god-like incarnations - the representation of you the player in the world, each with their own set of passive abilities, combat stats, spells and strategies. They combine and mix with all factions, for added replayability and experience differentiation
  • Visually beautiful automatic combat - with knights, arrows, flying spells and terrifying monsters - you plan your army compositions to effectively beat the next enemy, then you lean back and watch as your brilliant plans unfold
  • Rogue-like elements, with randomly generated maps, randomly placed holdings, randomized holding defenses, randomly placed magical artifacts and randomly placed world treasure chests and wandering monsters - this gives the game enormous replayability. Always a new experience and sometimes with almost hilarious results

Will you take form as the Blazing Invoker, a master of fire? Or the ghostly Banshee Queen that can only be damaged with magic? The Bonerat Emperor, a skeletal ratling back from the dead. The elven Lightmaid on her sacred Jaden mount? Will you be the Older Earthmother, who protects and heals? Will you play the High Shaman, a barbarian incarnation able to summon wolves and shapeshift into wereform? Maybe you pick the Wraith Lord, an ancient undead mage? Or are you at heart the Harbinger of Chaos, a creature able to summon mutated forms from the plane of chaos? Or play as the Godwyrm, a fire dragon so powerful it can win almost without help from its faction.

A new world awaits you - so awaken as Godking. Claim your throne.

data.name: Hard Place
data.detailed_description:
You are stuck in a huge room and have no idea what to do. You only option is to survive,
and that's not going to be easy — you will have to get through numerous rooms, each one harder than the last.
Will you get to the very end or drop dead along the way?

In this first-person game, you have to run around various rooms in search of the right items to open the next room. It's really the Hard Place, and you have to prove it's an easy test for you.

Features:
- Numerous distinct worlds
- True hard-core experience
- Tons of salt
- Low-poly graphics

A simple 3D game in which you play as a person locked in a room, and only you can find a way out.

data.name: ClashingBlades
data.detailed_description:
The Journey Starts

ClashingBlades is A Free-to-play Classic 3D MMORPG. it features Fantasy-themed gameplay reminiscent of your favorite games from the early to mid-2000s. Make a character and begin your quest in an open world with no guidance.

It Gets Better

Invite your friends, create Guilds and Parties, Wage wars against other Guilds, or Participate in tournaments and weekly Siege wars for the ownership of one of Ethernia's cities.

If your Guild controls a city, your Guild master can impose a tax on every token that falls within the city's boundaries or every good that is bought or sold there; the money collected from these taxes goes into your Guild's treasury. The tokens can be taken out by the Guild Master or distributed among the Guild members.

Something about classes?


ClashingBlades uses a unique class system where you are what you wear. You don't choose a class at character creation. You select a weapon, and as you level up, you will be able to learn masteries and skills unique to your weapon, or you can switch it for another and learn a completely different mastery from what you selected on character creation.

You could only master two masteries per character, which allows you to use two different weapons. You could be a Warrior and an Archer or a Cleric and a Warrior.

ClashingBlades is A Free-to-play Classic 3D MMORPG. it features Fantasy-themed gameplay reminiscent of your favorite games from the early to mid-2000s. Make a character and begin your quest in an open world with no guidance.

It Gets Better

Invite your friends, create Guilds and Parties, Wage wars against other Guilds, or Participate in tournaments and weekly Siege wars for the ownership of one of Ethernia's cities.

If your Guild controls a city, your Guild master can impose a tax on every token that falls within the city's boundaries or every good that is bought or sold there; the money collected from these taxes goes into your Guild's treasury. The tokens can be taken out by the Guild Master or distributed among the Guild members.

Play as a monk wielding superpowers in this fast-paced arena shooter with roguelite elements.

Survive waves of bouncy enemies raining from the skies as the challenge escalates. Buy upgrades and special abilities to create game-breaking builds and push back the chaos.

Master attacks, special abilities, and precise movement in fast-paced arena combat

Choose from powerful upgrades between waves and create game-breaking builds

Play as unique monks with distinct starting abilities and playstyles

  • Challenging boss encounters
    Face dangerous bosses that demand precision and smart positioning.

  • Unlockable content and higher difficulties
    Earn new characters, upgrades, and increasingly challenging levels as you improve.

data.name: Digital Eclipse Arcade: Candy Creeps
data.detailed_description:
Happy Halloween! Candy Creeps is the very first entry in Digital Eclipse Arcade, a series of all-new games inspired by classic '80s arcade vibes.

Play as Elma and Harper, two tweens who may or may not have inadvertently summoned the evil Pumpking, who has swiped the whole neighborhood's Halloween candy and hidden it inside his army of tiny, adorable decorative gourds. Smash the pumpkins to find candy, then chow down. Once you're turbo-charged with sugar, bash the Pumpking until he explodes! Master four unique levels and go for a high score in one- and two-player modes.

Instructions

  • Stomp the pumpkins while avoiding enemies
  • Collect the candy that pops out
  • Get three pieces of candy to exact some Sweet Revenge!
  • While in Sweet Revenge mode, bash the Pumpking until he explodes

Hint: Bash the Pumpking while you're not in Sweet Revenge mode to force him to release more pumpkins!

Hint: Enemies can smash pumpkins too! Use this to your advantage.

Game Controls

  • Move, climb ladders: Joystick/gamepad
  • Jump: Button
  • Drop down a level: Hold down on stick/pad, press Jump
  • For local 2 player, a controller is required

Setting Controls

  • F1 through F3 control the screen effects, including CRT filter and distortion
  • F9 resets the game
  • + and - adjusts audio volume

The Story So Far…

Beware the Pumpking's wrath, my child
Each darkened Halloween
On Mischief Night, he watches all
And should your pranks be seen
A hefty toll he will exact
While naughty children sleep
He'll steal your candy, every piece
And give it to his creeps!

Elma and Harper were not the kids to get into the bad kind of mischief on Halloween. Yes, they egged people's houses, but they used cage-free eggs! And the toilet paper in the trees was always 2-ply for extra comfort. If the neighbors were unhappy, they shouldn't have given out raisins and dental floss! So it was something of a surprise to these considerate fourth-graders when the Pumpking emerged that night to take their entire candy haul (even the rare full-size bars!). Now, using only their wits, the power of sugar, and several very sharp knives, these tweens are on a mission to take back their sweet earnings.

About Digital Eclipse Arcade


A series of throwback games made for the Digital Eclipse community, Digital Eclipse Arcade is a celebration of pure arcade gameplay. Sign up for the Digital Eclipse email newsletter to be the first to get exclusive drops!

data.name: Southern Legends - The Temple Defenders
data.detailed_description:
Feature List

- Several playable classes - Numerous Subclasses to specialize - Hundreds of Skills/perks to build your unique character - Different maps, with each map having its own special unlocks and unique features. - Hundreds of unique enemies each with their own weakness and strenghts. - Collect materials to gain experience - Upgrade your character by purchasing new spells, skills.


About the Game

There is a war on-going, unbeknown to the rest of the world in distant lands. Every night the hoard descends from the depths of darkness to seek the power of the ancient scrolls hidden inside the forgotten temples, and every night they are faced with the guardians of the temples. Brave warriors from various origins who dedicated their lives to protect the ancient scrolls. The battle rages on, numerous guardians have sacrificed their lives to protect the scrolls and each time a guardian falls, a new one takes his place, for if the darkness ever gets to the scrolls the world as we now know it will end. Temple Defenders is a time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements. The night has fallen, the hoard is here to desecrate your temple grounds. As the protector of the temple your task is to make sure non enters the sacred grounds. Defend the treasures inside the temple with your life or die trying. They are many, you are one, all you can do is to try to hold them off till the dawn. Gather gold in each run to buy upgrades that will help you become stronger and hold off tougher enemies.

data.name: Dungeons 4
data.detailed_description:
Digital Deluxe Edition


About the Game

Once upon a time in a realm far, far away, everything was lush and green. The unicorns mingled among the trees and the elves and humans lived peacefully in harmony with their surroundings. Yet somewhere at the edge of a clearing half-hidden among the trees, obscured by a rising veil of fog in the hazy half-darkness of a weather-beaten hut, a shape huddles over a large and ominously glowing crystal ball. A mumbling voice sings ancient formulae, urging the swirling glowing mists inside the crystal to part and give an insight into the future.

“All is in flux, nothing seems certain. Come, oh vagaries of space and time, separate the veil and show us what is yet to come”, the voice grumbles with the hint of an eye faintly reflecting the glow in front of its hood. The shape’s audience, only barely visible in the dim light, leans in closer and listens intently. “Time ebbs and flows, forming pools and wrinkles… but when the mists part only vague images rise from beyond the veil. Shhhh—don’t come too close, you don’t want to disturb my delicate magical weavings do you?” The shape, still bent over the orb, mutters and shoos the other back a bit more into the shadows. “Ah, now it seems to be clearing a little. I can see… something… several somethings, hints of voices echoing in the haze. A baby, something happening on Hill Doom and the coming together of the Council of Snots – what could all this mean?”

In a flash, the light reflected in the eye turns red and a distant evil laughter echoes through the woods. Stay tuned for the return of the Soothsaying Evil!



The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 after the events of its fabulous predecessor to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more.

Build a cozy and comfortable Dungeon to suit your creatures’ needs and rule over them, then send them out into the Overworld to kindly remind the good people living there that the Absolute Evil rules over their lands. Gather your Evilness in new and dynamic ways and unleash it upon the lush green forests and plains of the Overworld to turn them over to the dark side. But make sure that your Dungeon is well-secured by traps and defended by your creatures, for those pesky Overworlders won’t just twiddle their thumbs while you turn their land into the Absolute Evil’s most pleasurable holiday paradise.

But what is that noise? “Gold, gold, gold and gems, gold and gems and gold!” The ancient song echoes throughout the underworld, accompanied by the clanging steel of hammers and axes. The Dwarves have arrived to claim their share of the abundant resources and together with the Elves and Humans of the Overworld, they send out their raiding parties to find the Dungeon’s heart.

Dungeons 4 keeps the spirit of its predecessor, but everything is now bigger, better, and with even more dynamic Evilness™.



Everything is better with Dwarves™: The Dwarves have arrived to build their underground strongholds and the hardy little fellows (although they don’t like being called that) compete with the Ever-Expanding Evil for space and resources.


It makes your Dungeon great again: Dungeons are up to four times larger than before and there are many more creatures who wait for the All-Commanding Evil’s orders to conquer the Overworld. Now the time has come for massive armies and truly sprawling dungeons!


Ripe for the taking: The Overworld is bigger than ever before. Gain Evilness by beating Mini Bosses like the obsessively harmonious Unicorn and use it to transform the Overworld into stunning biomes of pure evil.


New and shiny: An ability-based Perk system for Thalya, the Absolute Evil’s trusted *cough* and most loyal subordinate, grants her impressive new powers. The Absolute Evil can now enjoy taking over the world, governing the creatures and slapping subordinates even more with the customizable Evil Hand.


Minions, everywhere: The Horde, the Undead and the Demons wait to do the Absolute Evil’s bidding, with more creatures than ever eagerly following the gesturing Evil’s orders, and Snots will play a much more prominent role this time.


Many ways to tell the story: A long campaign, narrated by the beloved English Narrator from previous titles, as well as several skirmish maps all to challenge your rule as the Absolute Evil.


Change the world: Spread your Evilness across the Overworld to bring lush and green environments over to the dark side, now shining even more vibrantly and beautifully evil as you spread your evilness across many new biomes.


Work together, slay together: 2-player co-op multiplayer with both players managing one Dungeon together. All maps from the skirmish mode and the campaign are playable in co-op.

data.name: The Last Convoy North
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Red Isolation, an arid desert where the toughest peoples have carved out a precarious living.

Two moons past, a beacon scorched the night sky and stirred the once dormant pestilent rust into a frenzy. 

Homes destroyed, communities shattered. All must reach the safety of the northern peninsula or be consumed.

Take direct control of your convoy and fight off enemies from all sides. Pick your route, collect resources and explore the Red Isolation.

Rearrange your convoy as the situation demands, each day brings new challenges and keeping the convoy in order will prevent devastation.

Each vehicle has access to numerous abilities and upgrades. Balance offense, defense and support to keep your convoy moving.

Recruit friends (and sometimes foes) as you journey across the Red Isolation. Each new ally potentially brings unique vehicles, weapons and abilities. Manage the crews morale or they might abandon you and leave you for the pestilent rust.

data.name: Paper Dungeons
data.detailed_description:
Paper Dungeons is a fantasy board-game boosted by online content. With the ability to create and share online your own levels, you are up for an infinite replay value! The game is visualized as a classic tabletop board-game with dice and tokens. You can destroy walls and auto-heal as you uncover new dungeon tiles, which widens your choice of moves.

Game Modes


Paper Dungeons features 4 SINGLE PLAYER MODES, each with a different gameplay:

  • Boardgame mode:
    Begin every dungeon as a new board from a long adventure set: each new dungeon, your character resets to level 1 fortunately you keep your inventory. Unexplored parts of the dungeons are hidden by a fog of war. Monsters and items are placed at random, combats based on your statistics and dice rolls. Mitigate the combat’s result with a 2d6 (one for damages and the other for effects). Favor one attribute when you level up. Unlock and collect sets of dice (common/uncommon/rare/epic), but Beware! Monsters use their own too. An awareness system makes the monsters move towards you if you are in their line of sight. Dig up the walls to flee, at the cost of some precious health...
  • Campaign mode:
    This new mode allows you to play a fully-fledged adventure with up to 10 dungeons linked together by an introduction, dialogs between dungeons and a conclusion. Your character doesn't reset and keeps his inventory between dungeons.
  • Rogue mode:
    Your character doesn't reset at each new dungeon and keeps leveling up until you meet your demise. What will remain is your name in the Hall of Fame and more powerful sets of dice that you can use in your next Rogue run.
  • Puzzle mode:
    Hard-core campaign levels with no place for luck. No fog of war: the dungeon's layout (mobs and items) is shown. Monsters are static and won't move towards you. Strategize all your moves to ensure victory.

Also availables:

  • A MAP EDITOR, to create your own dungeons and publish them online.
  • A CAMPAIGN EDITOR, to tell your own story and post it online.
  • ONLINE LEVELS feature, to play user's created content in Adventure or Puzzle modes.
  • A CODEX listing all elements of the game.
  • An hardcore difficulty THE VOID with alternate color for the monsters.

Features

  • Supports high resolution with native 1080p graphics.
  • Big adventure of 125 Boardgame levels and 31 Puzzle levels.
  • 5 character classes (warrior/archer/priest/mage/thief), male and female, each with a unique gameplay.
  • 2 Official campaigns.
  • Dozens of different dice sets to improve your character.
  • 80+ monster types.
  • More than 50 unique pieces of equipement, 30 scrolls and 8 potions.
  • 4 different starting zones, each with specific monsters and bosses, 3 sizes of dungeon and special boss stages.
  • 5 zoom levels.

data.name: Mining Days
data.detailed_description:
Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation!

Start with a simple pickaxe and a pile of rocks. Break stones, discover valuable ores, and use your earnings to improve your equipment and expand your operation.

As your mine grows, you won't have to do everything yourself. Hire miners to carry resources, break rocks, and help keep your operation running. Upgrade your workers, improve your tools, increase your mining speed, and steadily turn a small mining site into a productive operation.

⛏️ Mine & Discover

Break rocks and uncover different types of valuable ore. Every piece you collect brings you closer to your next upgrade.

⛏️ Build Your Team

Hire miners, sorters and logistics workers to take over the hard work. Assign more workers as your operation grows and watch them keep the resources flowing.

⛏️ Upgrade & Progress

Use your earnings to improve your tools, workers, and mining efficiency. The more you invest, the faster your operation becomes.

⛏️ Grow Your Operation

Start small and gradually build a larger, more efficient mining operation. Keep upgrading and see how far you can take your mine.

⛏️ Relax & Enjoy

Mining Days is designed around simple, satisfying gameplay, a colorful low-poly style, and relaxing incremental progression. Take your time, watch your workers do their jobs, and enjoy seeing your mine grow.

data.name: Desserted
data.detailed_description:
“Desserted”

1-6 player co-op survival horror game.

Explore procedurally generated maps in your mobile food truck. Gather, cook, and defend your power grid from monsters seeking to sabotage you. Survive deadly blackouts and complete sacrifices to progress to more difficult and exciting maps.

THE CORE LOOP

Scavenge → Collect → Sizzle → Blackout → Escape → Sacrifice → Repeat

Monsters — Not Just Killers, they troll.

Monsters aren't just hunters; they are saboteurs.

  • Power Phase: Monsters focus on sabotaging electrical infrastructure (breakers and cables) rather than direct player combat.

  • Blackout Phase: Once power hits zero, monsters enter a "Starvation" state and actively hunt players. Survival difficulty scales exponentially.

Power & "Sacrifice" System

Survival depends entirely on Time Management.

  • Fixed Time Limit: Each session has a set power duration. When it runs out, the map enters a high-difficulty "Blackout Mode."

  • Monster Sabotage: During the day, monsters prioritize locating and destroying circuit breakers. Damaged breakers significantly accelerate power drain.

  • Defense Priority: Players must patrol and protect breakers to delay the onset of night and maximize exploration time.

  • Blackout Phase: When the lights go out, the environment shifts. Monsters enter an active hunting state, but high-reward resources only become accessible during this time.

Food truck is the heart of the team.

The truck is your primary tool for survival and resource processing.

  • Ingredient Scanner: Use the short-range scanner to highlight hidden ingredients, significantly increasing gathering efficiency.

  • Cooking System: Process raw ingredients into dishes to fulfill mission objectives or gain vital survival buffs.

UP TO 6-PLAYER CO-OP

Coordinate with your team to survive:

  • Scavenge raw materials together.

  • Maintain the power grid and defend critical infrastructure.

  • Evade or fight back during the hunt.

  • Complete objectives and perform sacrifices to the gods.

Full Procedural Generation. Every expedition offers new layouts, lethal traps, and "unplanned" anomalies.

Explore Themed Nightmare Zones:

  • 【Casino Hotel】

  • 【Cyber City】

  • 【Sci-Fi Laboratory】

Each area features unique:

  • Layouts

  • Resource

  • Monster

  • Random events

Supports 1-6-Player Online Co-op

Add to your Steam Wishlist and check for the latest updates

data.name: DUST - Post Apocalyptic RPG
data.detailed_description:
A Brutal Post-Apocalyptic Turn-Based Survival RPG

Hello, survivor.

Let me introduce you to a game I created entirely on my own—designed with passion, grit, and a love for classic post apocalyptic RPGs pop culture movies and video games.

This is a randomly generated post-apocalyptic survival RPG with deep systems, tough choices, and PERMA-DEATH.

⚠️ PERMA-DEATH WARNING

This game doesn’t care about your snowflake feelings. When you die, your character is gone for good. But don’t worry—you’ll keep the currency you earned and can unlock new survivors with each run.

Retro-Inspired RPG with Modern Survival Depth

I studied the design of classic 90s pop culture media games to craft a world of horror, danger, decay, and discovery. The game uses real photography with a gritty 90s VHS aesthetic to create a truly unique visual atmosphere.

FEATURES

- 🌍 Explore a harsh, randomly generated wasteland full of secrets, encounters, and hidden lore.

- ⚔️ Turn-based tactical combat where every choice matters—and mistakes are permanent.

- 🧬 Unlock new survivors and build them up with attributes, skills, and perks.

- ☢️ Track survival stats like hunger, health, sickness, radiation, and virus exposure.

- 🧤 Scavenge ruins & settlements for valuable gear or take on missions to earn resources.

- 🧱 Visit unique locations—from crumbling cities to strange underground bunkers.

- 🧟 Fight against mutants, robots, aliens, raiders, and horror in a world where nothing is safe.

- 🎧 Atmospheric audio and an original soundtrack that brings the apocalypse to life.

💬 Join the Community

Want to report bugs, suggest features, or just talk about the game?

Join us on Discord:

data.name: Phobopetra
data.detailed_description:
PHOBOPETRA

Antarctica, 1962.

An expedition reveals something special under the ice.

When Captain Arthur awakens, he finds himself inside a strange manor that should not exist. The world around him feels familiar — yet something is deeply wrong.

A mysterious artifact known as the Phobopetra may be the key to understanding what happened.

But the deeper Arthur goes, the less certain everything becomes.

PHOBOPETRA is an atmospheric psychological mystery game (inspired by exploration-driven titles like Outer Wilds) where knowledge is your only tool to unravel a shifting world.

WHO DO YOU BELIEVE?

A mysterious light reveals things that should remain hidden.

A woman's voice tries to reach you.

And something else may be watching from the shadows.

Each of them seems to have an explanation.
Each of them may have a reason to lie.

There is no narrator telling you what is real.

You will have to decide for yourself.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH — YOUR WAY

Explore the manor and uncover its secrets at your own pace.

Read notes, examine objects, listen carefully, and piece together fragments of a story scattered throughout the world. You may discover crucial information long before you understand what it means.

The order in which you find the clues is up to you.

But be careful:

Not everything you discover should be trusted.

A WORLD THAT CHANGES AROUND YOU

Reality does not remain still.

Strange events, shifting spaces and impossible discoveries blur the line between memory, perception and reality.

The more you uncover, the more you may begin to question not only the world around Arthur —

but Arthur himself.

YOUR CHOICES MATTER

What you believe can change what you do.

And what you do can change how the story ends.

There may be no perfect answer.

Only the answer you choose to believe.

Who do you trust?

What is real?

And if you finally discover the truth… will you want to accept it?

KEY FEATURES

  • Atmospheric psychological mystery

  • Non-linear discovery of clues and secrets

  • A mysterious light that reveals hidden elements

  • A shifting, reality-bending manor

  • Environmental storytelling and scattered evidence

  • Connect the clues and form your own interpretation

  • Multiple endings shaped by your decisions

  • Cinematic atmosphere inspired by classic psychological horror

The truth is somewhere inside.

The question is whether you will believe it.

MUSIC AND AUDIO

  • Featured Track: "MUTUAL HARM" by pianocafe Kumi

  • Featured Voice Actor: MercilessBatVA

Personal note from the developer:

"I’ve finally brought my passion project to life, and I am excited to introduce PHOBOPETRA to you soon. I’m a gamer from the ’90s, and my gaming journey began with an Atari, a 486 PC, and every game console imaginable. Now, as a 45-year-old family man, I’ve finally managed to turn my dream into reality alongside my day job, and I am proud to present my very first game to you :D "

PHOBOPETRA is an atmospheric psychological mystery game (inspired by exploration-driven titles like Outer Wilds) where knowledge is your only tool to unravel a shifting world.

WHO DO YOU BELIEVE?

A mysterious light reveals things that should remain hidden.

A woman's voice tries to reach you.

And something else may be watching from the shadows.

Each of them seems to have an explanation.
Each of them may have a reason to lie.

There is no narrator telling you what is real.

You will have to decide for yourself.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH — YOUR WAY

Explore the manor and uncover its secrets at your own pace.

Read notes, examine objects, listen carefully, and piece together fragments of a story scattered throughout the world. You may discover crucial information long before you understand what it means.

The order in which you find the clues is up to you.

But be careful:

Not everything you discover should be trusted.

A WORLD THAT CHANGES AROUND YOU

Reality does not remain still.

Strange events, shifting spaces and impossible discoveries blur the line between memory, perception and reality.

The more you uncover, the more you may begin to question not only the world around Arthur —

but Arthur himself.

YOUR CHOICES MATTER

What you believe can change what you do.

And what you do can change how the story ends.

There may be no perfect answer.

Only the answer you choose to believe.

Who do you trust?

What is real?

And if you finally discover the truth… will you want to accept it?

KEY FEATURES

  • Atmospheric psychological mystery

  • Non-linear discovery of clues and secrets

  • A mysterious light that reveals hidden elements

  • A shifting, reality-bending manor

  • Environmental storytelling and scattered evidence

  • Connect the clues and form your own interpretation

  • Multiple endings shaped by your decisions

  • Cinematic atmosphere inspired by classic psychological horror

The truth is somewhere inside.

The question is whether you will believe it.

MUSIC AND AUDIO

  • Featured Track: "MUTUAL HARM" by pianocafe Kumi

  • Featured Voice Actor: MercilessBatVA

Personal note from the developer:

"I’ve finally brought my passion project to life, and I am excited to introduce PHOBOPETRA to you soon. I’m a gamer from the ’90s, and my gaming journey began with an Atari, a 486 PC, and every game console imaginable. Now, as a 45-year-old family man, I’ve finally managed to turn my dream into reality alongside my day job, and I am proud to present my very first game to you :D "
data.short_description: A Soul, A Story, A Stone. 1962 Antarctica. An expedition unearths a stone that shatters reality. Trapped in a shifting 1960s estate, you must use its unnatural light to reveal hidden secrets. Time is bleeding away in this cinematic mystery. Can you escape before the heartbeat stops?

data.name: Apartment 10
data.detailed_description:
You are trapped in Apartment 10.

The only way out is down.

Each floor brings you closer to the lobby… but something isn’t right.

Objects move.
The environment changes.
Some things appear when you’re not looking.

Your only chance of escape is to spot the anomalies and make the correct choice.

But be careful.

Something doesn’t want you to leave.

And a single mistake will send you back to the start.

🎮 GAMEPLAY

  • Ride the elevator between floors

  • Carefully observe your surroundings

  • Identify anomalies and make the correct decision

  • Progress towards the lobby… one floor at a time

  • Fail, and start over

😈 FEATURES

  • Psychological horror focused on observation and paranoia

  • Short, tense gameplay sessions (30–60 minutes per run)

  • Highly replayable — every mistake resets your progress

  • Subtle environmental storytelling

  • 50 anomalies to discover

⚠️ NOTE

Best experienced with mouse, keyboard and a headset.

data.name: Finding Cinderella
data.detailed_description:
A lighthearted game about love and murder.



Assume the role of a royal successor to the throne, who is definitely not very good at their job or the brightest bulb there is, in their quest of finding the love of their life in the upcoming royal ball - select one of the 9 ladies to be your Cinderella. Fun times.

But beware! There is an assassin coming for your life disguised as one of the ladies! Oh no! You must reveal the assassin's identity in 3 days time while winning the heart of your future queen. Get to know each lady, search for clues, but most importantly, survive!



  • Multiple playthroughs! Assassin changes every round!
  • Approximately 10 hours of quality time filled with love and blood.
  • 9 or so romanceable ladies
  • Epic minigames that will challenge your sanity as they progress
  • Interactive BGs and daily activities!
  • Achievements! Can you collect them all?
  • Funny and livid dialogue sure to keep you mildly entertained!
  • A unique art style, 20+ CGs, animated sprites!
  • Jampacked with OWO energy throughout!



Lady Anna Belle

A bubbly daughter of merchants who just wants to know what’s inside your heart. Also, never refuse her cupcakes made with love, NEVER.

Lady Sophie de Fleur

A lady of royal lineage such as yourself, except that she’s a loner, but wants someone to understand and love her. Will you be able to catch her eye?

Lady Juliet Espada

Fearless, bold and confident, and a member of the royal guards, this lady sure is no damsel in distress. Humor is her best defense.

Lady Katarzyna Von Liechtenstein

Horses.

Lady Gwynne Vanderbilt

A lady with a mysterious background, for some reason, doesn’t show any interest in you at all. Maybe the rumors were true, maybe she did, infact, only come cus her father told her to.

Lady Jewell Blue

Your childhood friend, you remember her don’t you? A perfect lady in every way, or so they say.

Lady Maria Keetab

Smart, kind and patient, this lady is a teacher at the local orphanage. Is there a place in her heart for one more child?

Lady Anastasia Nikolaevna Romanov

I know.

Lady Lilly Lupin

Curious, energetic and eager to live her life to the fullest, this lady never stops. Will you help her find what she’s looking for?

data.name: Esoteric
data.detailed_description:
This is a small game that tests players' quick reaction ability!

The game graphics are fresh and bright. Players need to use the space bar to control the ball's jump and avoid various obstacles.

If you are unfortunate enough to touch an obstacle, the game will end.

The ball moves very fast, so players' reaction speed must keep up with its pace.

The game is cleverly designed. Every jump and collision with an obstacle greatly enhances the tension and immersive feeling of the game.

This is a game that not only tests reaction ability but also is full of fun, and it is suitable for players of all age groups to try.

Gameplay

Players will manipulate a ball.

The ball will automatically move forward quickly.

Players can only control the ball's jump.

Players need to control the ball to jump over obstacles.

If the ball fails to jump over the obstacle, the game will end in failure.

Game operation method

Jump = SPACE

data.name: Truck License Trainer
data.detailed_description:
Driving a big vehicle is much harder than most people think. Find out if you are able to finish challenges which are laid out before truck drivers every day. Drive solo, tandem, semi-trailer trucks in a top-down view game. If you want to learn driving skills, then you can mix business with pleasure. If you are confident in your skills, check out especially hard maps for greater fun.

Main Features

  • Driving various types of tracks like solo, tandem and semi-trailer

  • Maps which represent real life exam scenarios from various countries

  • Maps made just for a challenge which will teach you how to drive with great precision

  • Guidelines which will help you drive where you want

  • For of War hide part of map which would be invisible in real life

  • Map scores so you know if there is more to learn in a given challenge

  • Controller support

  • SteamDeck support

  • Support for selected Driving Wheels (Logitech G29)

Solo Truck Scenarios

  • Turn and Back

  • 90 Turn and Back

  • Backward 90 Turn and Forward

  • Parallel Parking

Tandem Scenarios

  • Turn and Back

  • 45 Turn and Back

  • 90 Turn and Back

  • Backward 90 Turn and Forward

  • Parallel Parking

Semi-Trailer Scenarios

  • 45 Turn and Back

  • Offset Back Maneuver

  • 90 Turn and Back

  • Backward 90 Turn and Forward

Challenges

  • Back Trailer to Shop

  • Zig Zag

  • Zig Zag Reverse

Is it real life?

It is not, but it is a great way to know how the trailer reacts to your tractor.You can gain real life skills, like:

  • Intuition of wheel turning when backing down

  • Visualization of where the trailer should be to complete any maneuver

  • Confidence in what manuver you are able to do

  • Ability to do maneuvers with limited visibility

Unlimited try and repeat is also a great helper in tuning your skills.

data.name: Friendly Duel
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview:

Friendly Duel is a fun-filled soccer competitive game designed to allow players to have a relaxed duel with friends or other players. The goal of the game is to score as many goals as possible within the specified time while enjoying a relaxed atmosphere.

Gameplay:

In Friendly Duel, players can choose between single-player and multiplayer modes. In single-player mode, you can challenge AI opponents to hone your skills, while in multiplayer mode, you can compete with friends in real time. Each game lasts five minutes, and players strive to score as many goals as possible within this time.

Control:

The control scheme is simple and intuitive. Players can use the arrow keys to move the character and the space bar to shoot. The design is flexible and user-friendly, suitable for players of all ages. Whether you are a soccer novice or an experienced player, you can easily get involved.

Game Features:

Customizable Characters: Players can personalize their characters, including appearance and skills, to create a unique soccer star.

Diverse Venue Selection: The game offers multiple arenas, each with its own unique style and challenges.

Visuals and Sound Effects:

The game uses cartoon graphics style with bright colors and smooth animations. The cheerful soundtrack enhances the game atmosphere and provides players with a pleasant experience while playing.

Conclusion:

Friendly Duel is an easy-to-play yet challenging football competitive game. Whether you want to relax or test your skills, this game has something for everyone. Gather your friends, step into the world of football, and experience the excitement of the game!

data.name: Grid Leaper
data.detailed_description:
VR Support

Grid Leaper is an OpenXR game and has been tested on Oculus headsets(all), HTC Vive, and HP Reverb G2. It should be supported by all headsets that support OpenXR but has not been tested with the Index or other newer HTC headsets. If you run a different headset and run into problems, please contact us at contact@neonp.ink and we will do our best to support.

Jumping varies between headsets and arm length, so we strongly recommend fine tuning the "Leap Strength" setting under "Controls/Input" on the settings page to fit your preference.


About the Game

VR Platforming taken to the next level

  • Jump. Climb. Grab. Swing. Fly. Dodge. Do whatever it takes to reach the goal.
  • Grid Leaper takes classic game mechanics, furthers them, and blends everything into a progressive, all-out, no-compromises VR Platformer.

Progressive Challenge

  • Taking place across 90 increasingly-challenging levels, Grid Leaper brings you on a journey through 20 unique environments designed to harden you into a master.
  • Enter a speed runners' paradise with world leaderboards and nearly infinite ways to decrease your time and increase your ranking.
  • Grid Leaper knows how to keep you challenged and wanting to come back for more.


Obsessive focus on VR gameplay

  • Designed from the start as a VR-only game with an obsessive focus on gameplay.
  • Sometimes subtle in its approach, Grid Leaper challenges you to find your own path. There are always more than one way to the goal.


Level Editor

  • Smashed the goals and are still looking for a challenge?
  • Create your own levels with our fully-featured level editor. The editor is constantly being improved and is currently in beta.

data.name: Kaia's Ascent
data.detailed_description:
Kaia's Ascent is a first-person speedrunning platforming game all about running, climbing and charge-punching your way out of the deep, dark Abyss.

  • Fast-paced, fluid, freestyle movement mechanics that'll test your reflexes and platforming abilities, and have you coming back again and again to achieve faster times.

  • Dozens of challenging levels, each with record times to beat and hidden collectibles to find.

  • Story cutscenes, conversations, and data logs that flesh out the characters and their surrounding world.

  • A retro PSX art style inspired by late 90's-early 2000's classics.

  • An original soundtrack ranging from chill ambient IDM tunes to frantic drill and bass breakbeat mashups.

You play as Kaia, a brash fox girl stranded deep underground in the Abyss, determined to get out with the help of a mysterious guardian and a power fist that sends you rocketing through the air.

Standing in your way is Dark Matter, the terrifying, insatiable monster plaguing the Abyss. It's out to get you, whether via deadly lasers or its bulbous mass plaguing the landscapes.

Are you tough enough to escape the deep, harrowing Abyss, and take down a terrifying alien threat in the process? And just who exactly is that mysterious guardian aiding you?

data.name: MayDay MayDie
data.detailed_description:
Trust No One in the Sky!

As a group of passengers, your only chance to survive is to work together while your plane’s engines fail one by one, cabin pressure drops, and critical systems collapse.

But there’s one problem…

Your closest friend might actually be a hijackers trying to turn the plane into a fireball.

🔧 Cooperation & Tasks

To save the plane, players must complete tasks that appear in different areas.

  • Restart complex systems

  • Set up correct connections and configurations

  • Keep critical devices stable

  • Find the right solutions through trial and error

Some tasks require precision, others demand speed.
Some will punish you for mistakes.

And most importantly:
You can’t do everything alone.

🔪 Sabotage & Betrayal

There are hijackers hiding among you; instead of attacking directly, they’re working from within.

  • Disable critical systems

  • Delay task completion

  • Start onboard fires that damage the aircraft

  • Drain the plane’s fuel, bringing it closer to a crash

And while doing all this…
They act like they’re on your side.

🎮 Features

  • Multiplayer experience for up to 8 players

  • Real-time tasks and sabotage mechanics

  • Constantly increasing tension and chaos

  • Character customization with different outfits and appearances

This game consist of 12 levels, one of which is a zodiac constellation. Every constellation has several stars, you need use keyboard or gamepad controll the rocket, avoiding any obstacle, to land rocket on target platform and so light up a star. press F key or push left joystick to ignite left engine
press J key or push right joystick to ignite right engine
press Esc key or Circle/B button (on gamepad) to pause/resume
press R key or Square/X button (on gamepad) to restart level

data.name: Alien Snap
data.detailed_description:
You fled to an unexplored planet - and gotten yourself into millions of debt with Homeplanet. To pay back what you owe, you'll need to build an online following by snapping alien wildlife. But survival means more than making payments. It means learning to trust the crew you're stuck with, and maybe figuring out who you are when nobody back home is watching.

Build relationships with your crewmates!

Get to know your crew: Web (the social media manager), Iron (the pilot & mechanic), Sprout (the botanist) and Talon (the zoologist).
Your choices and conversations shape your relationships and where they might lead.

Deal with remnants of your past...

You may have escaped Homeplanet, but your past still haunts you awake from time to time. As the journey continues, fragments of who you were (and who you were told to be) surface in dreams you can't always control. Perhaps you can seek shelter within yourself or your crewmates.

Explore a strange new world!

Venture though multiple areas, uncover alien wildlife and figure out how to take the best snaps!
As you progress, you'll discover new ways to traverse the environment; allowing you to explore further and encounter even more unique wildlife.

Snap them all!
Discover all wildlife this planet has to offer. Learn how each creatures' personality affects your shot setup, and take the best snaps you can to grow your following!


Discover new recipes!

After a short while, you will be able to figure out how to turn those alien plants into delicious meals. Explore all combinations and find out who of your crewmates likes which meal the best.

data.name: First Date : Late To Date
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

FIRSTDATE: LATE TO DATE is a romantic-comedy interactive cinematic (FMV) game in which the audience determines the progress of the movie with the options that appear every minute.
Erdem must make Derya forgive him in this late first meeting, or their relationship will end before it ever started.
Erdem will be dragged along different paths with the decisions he will make, and he will be able to experience many situations that may arise from the relationship between men and women. Every decision he takes will lead him to different paths and different endings.

Features

  • It is a romantic-comedy FMV game shot in 4K with real actors.
  • There are 7 elimination endings and 8 main endings with different option combinations.
  • It takes an average of 30 minutes to reach any end of the game.
  • When one of the main endings of the game is reached, the return to the milestones passed or the beginning of the game is unlocked.
  • It offers stories set in parallel universes with a story of more than 5000 words.
  • Provides the player's effect on the character, with options coming in less than a minute.

data.detailed_description:
Cards of Binokee is a trading card game with the aim of collecting different cards to be able to assemble a powerful deck of cards. With this deck of cards, you can then compete against different opponents. With each completed game you collect orbs (in-game currency), which you can use to expand your card collection.

Play with your deck of cards against the computer in various game modes to train, gain
experience and expand your card collection through the orbs you earn.

Collect more than 1000 cards

Over 1000 different cards with different strengths can be collected throughout the game.
This also includes rare cards and cards with various elements.

Open chests to collect cards

With the orbs you earn, you can always buy new chests to expand your card collection.
There are different chests to choose from which ones each containing five new trading cards.
Depending on the selected chest can also stronger cards or rare cards may be included.
With the new cards, you can then keep improving your deck of cards.

One card can change everything

There are different, freely selectable/combinable game modes. Depending on the game
mode or selected game mode combination, it can therefore also happen that one single card
changes the entire duel.

data.name: Echoes of Fear
data.detailed_description:
Echoes of Fear: Remastered draws you into a forgotten valley, a place untouched by time, yet far from lifeless. Beneath the quiet fog and decaying homes, unseen voices stir, and something in the shadows seems to listen. Deep within the valley lies an ancient vault said to contain a powerful Artifact…  but there is something, centuries old, guarding it.

Your task is simple: find the keys and unlock the vault and get out. Alive.
But as you explore, you’ll come to realize you’re not alone. The valley remembers — and it wants to be heard.

Gameplay Features

Explore the Forgotten Valley
Venture through dense fog, empty houses, and long-abandoned paths as you uncover the valley’s buried past.

The Spirit Box
Use a spirit box to communicate with lingering souls. Their voices echo faintly through static, offering guidance—or warnings. The signal grows stronger indoors, where the veil between worlds feels thin.

The Lurking Presence
Something follows you through the mist. It doesn’t speak, and it doesn’t stop. You may not always see it, but it always sees you. The only warnings of its approach: your heartbeat, growing louder and faster, and the booming echo of its footsteps. 

Unbroken Immersion
No stamina limits. No torch restrictions. Just the sound of your footsteps, the hum of the spirit box, and the weight of what hides in the fog.

Lost the beast? Find the statue.

Once placed by the valley’s lost inhabitants, the angel’s sword serves as a grim guide to the creature stalking the shadows.

Can You Face What Watches You?

There are no weapons.
No safety.
Only whispers, shadows, and the echoes of what should have been forgotten.

data.name: The Rig: A Starmap to Murder
data.detailed_description:
THE RIG is a single player, point-and-click style ADVENTURE game for VR, without the point-and-click! Inspired by our favorite adventure games from the 1990s, you explore — in first person — a dilapidated travel agency, an old beater of a starship, and finally encounter The Rig itself -- a hulking asteroid mine at the very edge of deep space.

The Rig lets you experience a tight, focused story with a playtime of around the length of a feature film.



WOLF 424A, VIRGO SECTOR -- DECEMBER 5th, 2132:

You're Willard Pike, failing Mars-based travel agent, now sent to the far reaches of edge-space by your desperate sister-in-law. She's charged you with tracking down Dixon, your estranged, deadbeat brother. Dixon's last known whereabouts are the AMR Alexey Stakhanov — a remote, ominous mining rig hitched to the side of a massive asteroid. But if you do find Dixon, if you stop him from running... what then? Do you bring back the man who ruined his family?

THE RIG is a story-driven, immersive ADVENTURE GAME for VR, where you try to unravel the chain of events leading up to the present-day by exploring a small space-freighter and solving conversations and environmental puzzles to find a way to resolve your family's deep-space drama.



  • Story-centric Puzzles
    Outer space can be unforgiving, and you'll need to find creative solutions to get where you need to be. Sometimes the answer may be obvious and right in front of you, or sometimes you'll need to think a bit outside the box. Sometimes you'll need to turn the gravity off. Just another day in the Twenty-second Century.

  • Rich, old-fashioned detective storytelling over a century in the future! In the tradition of "The Maltese Falcon" or "Touch of Evil," this is a noir-style story like out of the 1940s, but told in the 2100s. You're play as Willard Pike, a Mars-based travel agent thrown back into a family drama he'd hoped he'd left behind for good. Willard's mission? Find his deadbeat brother Dixon, the man Willard hates, before someone even worse does.

  • The story centers around a fully lived-in, explorable starship — hand crafted by an artist — in the style of classic science-fiction vehicles like the Millennium Falcon or the Serenity.

  • Built For VR
    Designed from the ground-up for a VR experience. Interact with objects and your surroundings in a realistic way, and try not to break anything. Pull levels and panels, command your spaceship, and communicate with a number of friendly or not-so-friendly characters, all without leaving your living room.

  • Play at your own pace. This is a game about exploration, about story and atmosphere.

  • Fully Voice-acted
    Features a diverse cast of talented and professional voice actors for an immersive experience with branching, narrative dialog. Are you tough-as-nails, no time to argue? Or easy-going and just down on your luck? Optional subtitles can aid in the experience.

data.name: Kodoku：As the Moon Mourns
data.detailed_description:
Kodoku is a single-player survival horror game.

Within an otherworld sealed inside a jar, players must gather “Souls” while hiding from relentless, nightmarish creatures.

■ Into the Jar-Bound Otherworld

The protagonist, Urohoshi, a university professor of folklore, journeys deep into the mountains in search of a friend who vanished without a trace—drawn there by a grotesque statue of Kannon.

After leaping into a massive jar found at the site, Urohoshi awakens in an otherworld ruled entirely by monsters.

A man whose head is fused with a jar.

A skeleton dragging an enormous ox cart.

In a realm dominated by grotesque beings, Urohoshi encounters a solitary young girl.

“For my sake, gather souls within the jar.”

Thus begins Urohoshi’s journey—to survive, and to return alive to the world of the living…

■ Features

• First-Person Survival Horror

You can slow monsters and abominations, but you cannot defeat them.

Press onward through darkness while fighting the terror of being hunted.

• Collect Souls

Explore each stage and gather glowing souls scattered throughout the environment.

Once the required number is reached, escape through a torii gate.

• Master the Jar

The jar you carry can be thrown after collecting enough souls.

Use it to divert enemy attention or activate switches for overhead doors.

■ A World of Beautiful Finality

The otherworld inside the jar is filled with someone’s regrets and trauma.

Blazing wastelands. Bottomless ravines. Temples steeped in hollow splendor.

At the end of this solitary journey, what truth awaits Urohoshi――？

data.name: Audioglide
data.detailed_description:
Take your favorite songs and turn them into an electrifying, music-driven adventure! This innovative rhythm game transforms any track you import into a visually stunning, procedurally generated road where every beat shapes the challenge. Soar through vibrant landscapes, collect notes in sync with the music, and experience a fusion of sound, speed, and style like never before.

Key Features

  • Play Any Song – Import your own music files, and let the game craft a unique level just for you!

  • Dynamic Music Analysis – The game detects beats, notes, and BPM to ensure precise rhythm-based gameplay.

  • Procedural Track Generation – Every song creates a one-of-a-kind road, adapting to its energy and volume dynamics.

  • Disco Lights & Mesmerizing Effects – Experience pulsating neon visuals that react to the music, bringing every song to life.

  • Compete on Leaderboards – Climb the online leaderboards for any song and prove your rhythm mastery.

  • Level Editor & Steam Workshop Support – Create, share, and play custom tracks.

  • Multiple Game Modes – Play through multiple distinct game modes that challenge your rhythm skills with gliding, platforming, and precision-timing mechanics.

data.name: Vespia: Shield of Aberration
data.detailed_description:
Original Soundtrack

The game features an original soundtrack (OST) created by Honywood Lofi, an independent music studio.


About the Game

Overview

Vespia: Shield of Aberration is a tower-defense game where you combine spells to modify the effects of your projectiles. In this game, it is not the tower that defines its magic power, but how you choose to apply modifications to it. Create a shotgun wizard by combining multi-casts, create shots that explode into a burst of black holes, and absolutely break the game with your insane combinations!

In Vespia, you will be tasked with protecting the city for 20 days before a powerful prime anomaly appears. During this time you will earn experience, upgrade your characters and unlock new spells - slack off and the increasing amount and types of enemies will be bound to overrun you.

Between each day, you will have the option to unlock special modifier effects which add a little bit of interest to your run; however, the more powerful the benefits, the more powerful the consequences.

Features

Your journey cannot be completed alone, each new student joining your party will bring something new to the table with unique abilities, spells and upgrade trees.

Each new character that you unlock has:

  • A unique skill tree for that character.

  • An upgradable ability card active while you are using that character.

  • Character-specific cards to enhance your deck.

During battle, each student can be given modifier cards that bring them closer to mastering the anomalous and becoming an unstoppable force.

  • Spells interact with other spells, creating an expansive range of combinations.

  • Modifier spells modify the fired projectiles with effects like swift-cast and freeze-shot.

  • Cast spells change how your spells are triggered with effects like multi-shot and burst.

  • Projectile spells spawn projectiles that can damage anomalous threats.

Between each battle, perform research to gain new cards which unlock an exponential number of formidable combinations.

  • New cards unlock powerful and interesting new spells.

  • Cards are designed with interesting effects in mind, some may upgrade your characters, others may grant some great boon at the cost of sacrificing something else.

Each battle requires a different set of skills. Each card provides something unique, from cards which enhance a student's powers to ones that sacrifice or enhance the cards in your deck.

As the days progress and the intensity of their attacks intensify, the world beings to distort and the threats become greater. You feel like something is waiting for you...

Will the infection work? There is only one way to find out: be the virus!

data.name: Codename: Mallow
data.detailed_description:
A human ninja fused to an experimental battle suit of extradimensional origin, Mallow is now Earth's only hope against an imminent alien invasion.



Codename: Mallow is a combat focused metroidvania with a large interconnected world to explore. Master an ever expanding arsenal of combat maneuvers as you traverse a multitude of unique biomes, each with their own secrets to discover and dangers to overcome.

The game boasts delightfully squishy 2D pixelated artwork and tightly tuned combat mechanics. While exploring this hand-crafted world you are destined to encounter a myriad of unique enemies and level dangers. Should you fail to emerge victorious, you will quickly discover the game includes many satisfying ways to die.
