data.name: BLACKFROST: The Long Dark 2
data.detailed_description:
BLACKFROST: The Long Dark 2 is the sequel to the hit survival game, THE LONG DARK, launched on Early Access and honed over 10 years of open development. It is the evolution of the survival sandbox, refining every aspect of the original, and introducing co-op to the formula. Conceived of and developed by Hinterland, the same creative team that brought you the original.

Brave New World

Experience the Quiet Apocalypse as survivors in the northern industrial city of Harmont and its vast environs. A year has passed since the Aurora first appeared in the sky, rendering all technology inert, with survivors just starting to emerge to face their new reality in its aftermath. Surrounded by a majestic, rugged wilderness, encounter the remnants of an isolated society still coming to terms with how the world has just been forever changed. How will you choose to survive?

Live Together. Die Alone

Survive as a lone wanderer in this frozen wasteland of city, town, forest, and farm, or huddle together as a group of survivors in whatever shelter you can make for yourselves. As solo players, decide how much you’ll learn to live with NPC survivor communities struggling to find their way in this harsh world. As co-op players, lean on each other and combine your skills and efforts to eke out another day of existence in the hostile environment. Alone or together, choose your own path to survival.

The Next-generation Survival RPG

Built on the foundation of survival gameplay pioneered and perfected by THE LONG DARK over 10+ years of development, BLACKFROST evolves every aspect of the survival formula to its 2.0 iteration, setting the table for the next generation of survival games. Build your own survivor, customize traits and skills, collect scars and stories, and experience a life as a survivor in this beautiful yet dangerous world. Many games have tried to bring survival mechanics to their open-world RPGs, but BLACKFROST is the first survival game built ground-up as a survival RPG.

Urban Survival

Experience the fantasy of wilderness survival at a 19th-century level of technology due to the aurora’s effects on the world and its inhabitants, and enjoy the same deep simulation of survival in nature from THE LONG DARK but with a new twist. Cities and towns offer new opportunities, and new hazards to your survival, introducing a fresh take on the established survival formula. The wilds are dangerous, but sometimes the city is where the real threats lie.

The Will to Live

Survival is as much about what’s in your head as what’s in your pack. With BLACKFROST, your success is no longer just about your physical Condition. BLACKFROST’s new Will to Live system adds elements of psychological survival to the mix, introducing Resilience and its sub-stats to the well-established mechanics. Manage your doubts and fears, and find comfort in the small things if you want to survive.

New Hazards

Urban risks. The deep freeze of an intense northern winter. Extreme weather events. Aurora Storms. And the dreaded radioactive Blackfrost, emitted by the reactor complex looming on the horizon. Layered on the dangers from wildlife and other survivors you encounter along the way, BLACKFROST introduces a whole host of new hazards to the survival sandbox.

Permalife

The innovative Permalife system turns every death into a new adventure. Accumulate new risks and fears for your survivor as you move through the world and succumb to various hazards. Face your fears, overcome their downsides, and strengthen your Survivor’s story in the world. Make your mark. (Classic Permadeath still an option!)

Early Access

BLACKFROST is being built using Early Access to maximize the player feedback loop and the team’s ability to iterate in a cycle of constant improvement. This builds on Hinterland’s longstanding reputation as a pioneer of the Early Access model with THE LONG DARK, being the first game to exist simultaneously on multiple early access platforms and on PC and console at the same time (Xbox Game Preview launch title in 2015). Similarly, BLACKFROST will be built a piece at a time, and will launch without the game’s complete planned world or feature set. We believe this is the ideal approach to work towards strength in community-informed iteration and development, but it’s not for everyone, so please make sure you are comfortable with this approach before you jump in! More details of how the team plans to handle roadmaps, timelines, and player feedback will be released closer to the 2026 launch.

data.name: 锈翅 逃离我的家乡 Without Wings
data.detailed_description:
《锈翅-逃离我的家乡》是一款互动音画小说，在游戏中“你”的选择将影响角色的命运。

本作的灵感来源于《守望先锋》的一则树洞投稿，描绘了山中因家庭原因而辍学的少女，在接触到网络之后走出故乡的故事。

- 我想逃离我的家乡。那一天，我突然觉得我不应属于这里。

我从小在大山里的小镇中长大，从山的这一头到那一头，这就是我生活的全部。

高中辍学后，我来到注塑厂打工，日复一日地在流水线不变的工作，看着工厂里那些比我年长的阿姨，我仿佛看到了自己未来的模样。

就算未来能够结婚生子，也是继续在工厂里打工，重复我现在的生活。

直到有一天，我去了镇上的网吧，接触到了外面的世界，认识了在城市生活的阿澈。

我下定决心，想要逃离我的家乡。

- 游戏以清新的像素风格，来还原写实的生活，力求增加代入感。

- - 4小时感人肺腑的沉浸式故事体验，故事的结局因你的选择而不同。

- 全中文语音配音，配角方言口音还原大山生活。

- 60张以上全原创像素CG与场景，总计超过100张差分。

- 30首原创BGM与1首主题曲，由独立音乐人RAiNSE雨观、中国游戏创新大赛音频奖得主寻雾、音乐艺术家王秋予、赵雪丹妮共同操刀。

- 部分场景采用动态像素风格，并加入了2段动态过场动画。

欢迎加入《锈翅》交流群：701378368

data.name: Train Sim World® 2020
data.detailed_description:
Train Sim World is an immersive first-person simulator perfect for everyone, with complete in-cab interactivity, accurate detail on locos, real-world routes and hours of gameplay. Take to the rails with the brand-new Train Sim World 2020 Edition and find everything you need to master new skills, from general to advanced operation of locomotives as you operate smooth passenger and freight services, scenarios and much more.

START A NEW JOURNEY


Train Sim World puts you in the engineer’s seat of breathtakingly authentic machines. Balance your brake pressure, control your speed, manage refuelling, switching, yard work and more.

The ‘Journeys’ feature will guide you through over 24 real hours of scenarios, tutorials and service timetables for each route – plus a new progress tracker will highlight hundreds of railway jobs available for you to complete as you master the routes.

EXPERIENCE AUTHENTIC SIMULATION


Powered by SimuGraph®, Train Sim World locomotives accurately recreate not only the appearance of their real-world counterparts, but also under-the-hood physics, cabs, control desks, sounds and even the feel of the trains.

All of this is set on a collection of real-world routes from around the world. Fight your way up Germany’s Spessartrampe incline, navigate the sprawling underground station at New York Penn or simply gape at the cavernous wonder of Manchester’s Victoria Station – and on every route you’ll find true-to-life regional signalling systems and a brand-new set of challenges.

MASTER THE RAILS


Step into any Train Sim World cab and you’ll be greeted with the same sight as any engineer – banks of controls ready for your command, giving you power over every aspect of your locomotive’s operation.

In Train Sim World 2020 we’re taking you one step further with updates to the sim experience such as the new Action Point scoring system that rewards you for accuracy and debriefing screen will help you track your performance.

Key Features

  • Explore famous routes from around the globe.
    • Main-Spessart Bahn - Carry freight and passengers over the Main-Spessart Bahn, a wondrous mix of steep gradients, scenic hillsides and swooping turns.
    • Northern Trans-Pennine - Control icons of British motive power on the towering moors, challenging grades and tight curves of the famous Trans-Pennine Railway.
    • Long Island Rail Road - Experience America's busiest commuter railroad and all the bustle of railroading in New York City in Train Sim World: Long Island Rail Road.
    • Great Western Express - Departing the busy London Paddington, you'll have to negotiate the intense traffic and adverse signals, keeping-to-rule, and your nerve.
    • CSX Heavy Haul - Explore Rockwood Mine, Sand Patch Summit and Cumberland Yard in the powerful CSX AC4400CW.
  • New for Train Sim World 2020:
    • Journeys – Blends together more than 24 hours of sequential gameplay for each route. Start a Journey on any route and enjoy hundreds of scenarios, service timetables, and jobs to complete around the railway.
    • Tutorials – Improved tutorials will teach new players all they need to master the rails – and even old hands might find something new to learn.
    • UI and HUD – We’ve overhauled our user interface to give players more control and confidence as they master some of the most powerful machines in the world.
    • Action Points – Rewards you for completing objectives, driving with accurate timing and records your best performance for each route scenario and timetable service.
  • 12 incredibly accurate locomotives and a control car, including the iconic Inter-city 125, Metro-North’s memorable M7 and Deutsche Bahn’s workhorse BR 185.2 bringing you a range of challenges to master.
  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology
  • Download size: 4.4 GB

data.name: DETECTIVE - The Motel
data.detailed_description:
🕵️‍♀️The detective has done their part. Now it’s the forensic team’s turn.🧪

FORENSIC – M.E. Protocol shifts the focus of investigation games, moving away from dialogue-based deduction toward hands-on crime scene analysis.

You won’t just question suspects, you’ll examine the environment and collect every piece of evidence needed to reconstruct what really happened.

Each of the nine cases presents a different scenario, ranging from violent confrontations to incidents that appear to be accidents. Nothing is explained in advance. You arrive at the scene, study the details, and determine the truth for yourself

There are no time limits to pressure you and no predetermined solutions. In FORENSIC – M.E. Protocol, you take the time to catalogue evidence, review clues, and carefully piece together the sequence of events.

Add Forensic M.E. Protocol to your Steam Wishlist!


About the Game



Grab a pencil and paper to write down what you need because no one is going to help you.

You play the role of a detective who has been assigned a case. When you arrive at the crime scene, you find a hotel with several rooms. At that moment you will have to discover what has happened, but it will not be easy. The evidence is not visible, the residents have secrets and they do not want anyone to know them. You will also find some puzzles that will test your determination and your ability as a detective.



DETECTIVE - The Motel is a realistic deduction game where only your detective instinct will help you.
Inspect all the rooms, find evidence, understand the relationships between the residents, their motivations and you will be able to solve the case.



To solve the case, you will need to answer these questions:

  • Names of the suspects.
  • What room does each of them live in?
  • Approximate time of the crime.
  • Crime day.
  • Who died?
  • Who is the murderer?

You will have to be very attentive to your surroundings to find all the possible evidence, it will not be easy, but if you are a good detective you will find the truth that is hidden behind the walls of each of the rooms in "The Motel".

Inspect all the rooms, find evidence, understand the relationships between the residents, their motivations and you will be able to solve the case.



To solve the case, you will need to answer these questions:

  • Names of the suspects.
  • What room does each of them live in?
  • Approximate time of the crime.
  • Crime day.
  • Who died?
  • Who is the murderer?

You will have to be very attentive to your surroundings to find all the possible evidence, it will not be easy, but if you are a good detective you will find the truth that is hidden behind the walls of each of the rooms in "The Motel".
data.short_description: DETECTIVE The Motel is a deduction game where, to advance, you must take a pencil and a piece of paper and write down everything that seems like evidence in order to answer all the questions that arise. Solving the case will depend only on you.

data.name: Trail of Stars
data.detailed_description:
A noble lord brings two squires along on a hunt. One is a gentle boy who should not exist. The other is a girl who dreams of plunging a dagger into her master’s heart.

Trail of Stars is a short, bittersweet visual novel about two vulnerable souls navigating first love, growing up, and protecting what they have—when all they have is each other.

A short and (bitter)sweet tale, under 3k words with two endings. A moving story you can finish in one sitting. 

Beautiful hand-drawn artwork. Watch the scenes unfold through storybook-inspired visuals and three detailed ending illustrations. 

An emotional original score featuring cello performances by ArcanaXIX. 

One knightly kiss on the hand. A must for fans of tender romances and stories featuring childhood friends to lovers.

Story, programming, GUI, logo design, project direction: ENDYSIS

Character art, cover illustration: Pauline Reinacher

Background art: Sparrowling

CG illustrations: Akua

Music: ENDYSIS, Calamanser, ArcanaXIX

Ambient SFX: Calamanser

Cello performances: ArcanaXIX

Created in one month for Sealed with a Kiss Jam (2025).

See more of this world (and the characters many years in the future) in my upcoming game The Last Winter Knight.

data.name: SEX TOURIST
data.detailed_description:
The main character is a young man who has come to a foreign country in search of adventure. In bustling Tokyo, he meets Ren, a vulnerable girl who recently broke up with her boyfriend. To help her, he creates a new identity as an American rock star seeking peace and inspiration. Ren believes him and invites him to her home.

He must decide whether to continue playing the role and enjoying her attention and body or take a risk and reveal who he really is. The deeper he gets into this story, though, the more he realizes that lies have a price and that he will have to pay for them with more than just passion.

Game features:
• A gripping storyline where passion and deception go hand in hand.
• The atmosphere of modern Japan, with its contrast between the noise of the streets and the silence of private life.
• Characters with depth, weaknesses, and hidden motives.
• Suspense, humor, and explicit scenes.
• Vivid visuals that make every encounter an event.

data.name: nothing & nowhere
data.detailed_description:
While taking an early morning walk along a foggy beach, reclusive writer Cora encounters a young girl. She looks damp, down on her luck, and utterly dejected, and Cora soon deduces that she must be a runaway.

Despite her coaxing, Cora is able to learn very little about the girl or her circumstances. She doesn’t know why the girl ran away from home, or even what her name is, but this doesn’t dissuade her.

Cora soon offers the girl a place to stay, and the girl — being homeless — has no option but to accept.

The girl moves in with Cora, and sleeps in her dingy guest bedroom with outdated furniture and a thin, mean bed. Cora buys the girl new clothes, plies her with mystery novels, all the while trying to discern her true identity.

What in the world happened to her?




  • 45,000 words (aprox 2-3 hours of reading)
  • A kinetic story with no choices or branches
  • Detailed background art
  • Custom soundtrack
  • A gentle story about healing and facing past ghosts

Note: It is advised to read Lynne before reading this story.

data.name: Movie Business - Die Welt der Filme
data.detailed_description:
Do you have what it takes to turn a small film studio into a global entertainment empire?

In Movie Business, you step into the shoes of an aspiring producer on the edge of the Dream Factory. With modest starting capital and huge ambitions, it is up to you to write film history. From the first draft of a script to the glamorous premiere, every decisive step is in your hands.

Choose the perfect script from a constantly changing market or commission your own writers to create the next masterpiece. Discover hidden gems among actors and directors or sign established but expensive stars to lead your project to success. Every artist has unique skills, preferences, and quirks that will influence your production.

But a good script and a star-studded cast are just the beginning. As a producer, you make the tough decisions: Set the budget for crew, locations, and special effects. Determine the creative focus of your film and navigate through unforeseen events during shooting – from brilliant acting performances to conflicts on set.

Once the film is in the can, the battle for the audience's attention begins. Negotiate with distributors for the best deal, plan the release, and hope that your work conquers the box office charts and wins awards at renowned film festivals.

But it’s about more than just the next movie. You will expand your own studio lot with specialized buildings, research groundbreaking new technologies, speculate on the stock market with competitors' shares, and manage your finances down to the last detail. Even your private life as CEO plays a role in your reputation and opportunities.

Face the ruthless competition, also vying for the viewers' favor, and lead your studio through the decades.

Will your name be immortalized in Hollywood's history books? The spotlight is waiting for you.

🎬 COMPREHENSIVE FILM PRODUCTION
From the first idea to the finished film – you control every aspect: script selection, casting directors and actors, budgeting for crew and equipment, setting the creative focus during production, and complete post-production.

🌟 DEEP TALENT MANAGEMENT
Discover, sign, and develop hundreds of actors and directors with unique skills, genre preferences, character traits (from "Team Player" to "Diva"), and potential. Train them, manage their morale, and watch them become legends – or box office poison.

🏦 IN-DEPTH ECONOMIC SIMULATION
Manage your finances in detail. Take out loans to bridge gaps or invest your surplus capital in the dynamic stock market by trading shares of rival studios. Detailed financial reports help you keep track.

🏗️ BUILD YOUR STUDIO EMPIRE
Expand your own studio lot! Construct and upgrade buildings like writers' bungalows, research labs, scouting offices, and even your own cinema to boost your income and unlock powerful bonuses.

🔬 RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT
Invest in a complex research tree to unlock new film genres, better production techniques, more efficient marketing methods, and the ability to produce ever-larger blockbusters (from B-Movies to AAA).

🏆 FAME, GLORY, AND FESTIVALS
Bring your masterpieces to the top of the box office charts and compete with rivals. Submit your best films to prestigious film festivals to win coveted awards, prize money, and a massive reputation boost.

🌍 A LIVING, UNPREDICTABLE WORLD
No two games are alike. A huge selection of random events – from world news and industry trends to unexpected problems on set – ensures constant challenges and unpredictable twists.

💼 MORE THAN JUST A JOB: YOUR PRIVATE LIFE
Manage your CEO's life as well. Determine your salary, invest in real estate and luxury goods, further your education, and cultivate relationships that can influence your personal reputation and career.

data.name: Bonds Defiled
data.detailed_description:
Relationships change you.

Bonds Defiled is an adult dark fantasy RPG about relationships, corruption, and transformation. Follow Rylan from life in Lindale into a growing adventure with an ensemble of companions, rivals, and people who have plenty to hide.

Spend time together, pursue romance, and discover character scenes shaped by your choices. The people you grow close to have their own loyalties, desires, and problems. Getting to know them is a large part of the journey.

Choose your relationships.

Get to know the cast through visits, dates, conversations, and intimate scenes. Affection, attraction, and your decisions influence which moments become available and how characters respond to you.

This is a game for adults aged 18 and over, with explicit sexual content, fantasy violence, and mature themes. Content settings let you choose which relationship routes to explore. NTR is optional and can be disabled.

Choose how Rylan changes.

Follow masculine, femboy, or female paths as transformations develop through the story. Changing forms affect character appearances and later scenes, while the Soul System connects progression with blessings and corruption.

Customize the protagonist's name and relationship labels. Explore different choices and discover how the same cast responds to a different Rylan.

Play at your own pace.

Between character scenes, explore, develop your party, take on combat encounters, and defend your dungeon. Later chapters open up life in a dungeon city.

  • Visual Novel: Focus on the story and choices, with combat and management skipped.
  • Light Gameplay: Keep the game systems with easier settings.
  • Full Game: Manage your upgrades and fight your battles.

You can change your play style in Settings as you go.

data.name: Trade or Threat
data.detailed_description:
Run a medieval shop stocked with goods recovered from dangerous dungeons. Arrange your stock, serve unusual customers, and decide which deals are worth the risk. The boss sets the rules, and some goods may be forbidden.

Enter the dungeon after dark to search for valuable loot. Open locked chests, avoid traps, hide from enemies, and escape with what you can carry. Inventory space is limited, so every piece of loot matters.

The boss expects regular payments. Make enough profit before the deadline—or face the consequences. Sell by day. Loot by night. Pay what you owe.

PROFIT OR PLAY IT SAFE

Selling forbidden goods can earn you more gold, but illegal business comes with consequences. Follow the boss’s rules for a safer life, or break them to increase your profits—and the danger surrounding your shop.

Spend your earnings on upgrades that help you carry more loot, open better locks, and discover new ways to recover valuable items.

FEATURES

  • First-person shopkeeping and dungeon exploration

  • A day-and-night gameplay loop

  • Physical items and limited inventory space

  • Dangerous traps, enemies, locked chests, and hiding spots

  • Legal and forbidden goods with different risks

  • Shop, equipment, and exploration upgrades

  • A dark medieval atmosphere combining cozy trading with dungeon tension

data.name: Dissimilation
data.detailed_description:
Take control of a ship of your choice and explore a randomly generated galaxy in Dissimilation!

Dissimilation is a top down, retro styled shooter set in a randomly generated galaxy. Dock at space stations and land on randomly generated planets, populated by alien flora and fauna.
Upgrade your ship by buying new weapons and armor, or craft them yourself! The upgrades will be vital in fighting off pirates, androids and even the galactic police force!
Attack elite Capital ships in brutal space battles to board the wreckage and kill the captain.
Slaughter the inhabitants of a colony or space station at your own risk – the structure may come under siege by galactic police.

Key Features:

Randomly Generated Galaxy
Space stations, planets and nebula are all randomly generated to provide a unique gameplay experience for each user.

Story
Dissimilation features a full single player story. While exploring, you will encounter story events which will ultimately reveal the dark secret of this galaxy.

Exploration
A key element of Dissimilation is exploration. You can land on nearly every planet to explore its surface. Each planet will be unique with its own weather, plants and wildlife. Some will be nothing more than an arid, barren wasteland, devoid of any natural life. Some may be lush, with a climate similar to the Earth's. Depending on these conditions, the human structures will change. The more barren planets may only have a single research station or mining colony. The more picturesque planets will likely be popular galactic tourist destinations.

Resource collection
To acquire resources, you must mine asteroids or natural structures on planets. The yield of the planet’s structures is strongly influenced by various conditions on the planet, particularly the chemical makeup of the crust. However, Dissimilation is specifically designed to give players the maximum amount of freedom. It is therefore possible to play the game without collecting a single mineral or touching a crafting table.

Loot System
A variety of containers and other items of interests are randomly generated on each planet’s surface. Venturing out from the colonies and research stations is often rewarded by finding crashed escape pods or old cargo containers. There structures may contain valuable items or credits to aid you on your journey.

Ship Upgrades
There are a huge variety of upgrades for your ship. There upgrades range from simply installing larger fuel tanks in order to explore for longer durations of time, to increasing power to the laser cannons for a higher intensity attack.

data.name: 姉妹道中千両箱 : Edo Village Nightmare
data.detailed_description:
【Overview】

“Sisters' Journey: The Thousand-Ryo Chest: Edo Village Nightmare” is an exploration-based fantasy horror game set in a small Japanese village.

【Story】

An Edo-period countryside village, lined with several thatched-roof houses.

One day, the protagonist, a lonely girl named Onene, begins to sense the presence of her “older sister.”

With the villagers' help, Onene searches for [her sister's memories].

Was it a mistake in her memory, or did her sister truly exist...?

Following the villagers' advice,

One-ne-ne takes on occupational trials as challenges.

For each trial she clears,

she receives a magatama from the villagers.

The secret of “Anesama” felt through the magatama.

Who exactly is “Anesama”...?

One-ne-ne's trial to find “Anesama” begins.

【Game Features】

️A third-person 3D adventure game.

️You control the protagonist to clear trials.

Clear trials to receive magatama and advance the story.

[Day Mode Trials]

️Knead baked manju dough and bake it golden brown.

Cut soba noodles, boil them, and fry tempura.

Through this experience, you'll feel as if you've stepped back in time to the Edo period.

(*Only for the trial of baking the manju to a golden brown: press the key at the perfect moment. The rest proceeds automatically.)

[Night Mode Trial]

A warrior pursues the protagonist. Hide well and escape.

The thatched-roof house has a door that only opens at night.

Inside the room beyond that door lies...

An Edo-period slot machine?! Hit the jackpot! (Click the stop button to line up 7s or dog symbols.)

A picture-story-style animal silhouette quiz featuring animals soaking in hot springs. Guess the animal from the choices.

Once you've collected the magatama, ascend the stairs and head toward the maze floating in the sky.

The goal is just ahead.

【Game Features】

・Playtime: Approximately 2 hours

・Single-player only

・No multiple endings

・No controller settings

・No voice narration (only subtitles, BGM, and sound effects)

【Regarding Gameplay Streams】

Streaming and live commentary are highly encouraged!

Please include this store page URL in your stream description or similar section.

【Overview】

“Sisters' Journey: The Thousand-Ryo Chest: Edo Village Nightmare” is an exploration-based fantasy horror game set in a small Japanese village.

【Story】

An Edo-period countryside village, lined with several thatched-roof houses.

One day, the protagonist, a lonely girl named Onene, begins to sense the presence of her “older sister.”

With the villagers' help, Onene searches for [her sister's memories].

Was it a mistake in her memory, or did her sister truly exist...?

Following the villagers' advice,

One-ne-ne takes on occupational trials as challenges.

For each trial she clears,

she receives a magatama from the villagers.

The secret of “Anesama” felt through the magatama.

Who exactly is “Anesama”...?

One-ne-ne's trial to find “Anesama” begins.

【Game Features】

️A third-person 3D adventure game.

️You control the protagonist to clear trials.

Clear trials to receive magatama and advance the story.

[Day Mode Trials]

️Knead baked manju dough and bake it golden brown.

Cut soba noodles, boil them, and fry tempura.

Through this experience, you'll feel as if you've stepped back in time to the Edo period.

(*Only for the trial of baking the manju to a golden brown: press the key at the perfect moment. The rest proceeds automatically.)

[Night Mode Trial]

A warrior pursues the protagonist. Hide well and escape.

The thatched-roof house has a door that only opens at night.

Inside the room beyond that door lies...

An Edo-period slot machine?! Hit the jackpot! (Click the stop button to line up 7s or dog symbols.)

A picture-story-style animal silhouette quiz featuring animals soaking in hot springs. Guess the animal from the choices.

Once you've collected the magatama, ascend the stairs and head toward the maze floating in the sky.

The goal is just ahead.

【Game Features】

・Playtime: Approximately 2 hours

・Single-player only

・No multiple endings

・No controller settings

・No voice narration (only subtitles, BGM, and sound effects)

【Regarding Gameplay Streams】

Streaming and live commentary are highly encouraged!

Please include this store page URL in your stream description or similar section.

data.name: Impeachment Survivors
data.detailed_description:
It's impeachment time!



- Choose your brazilian president and destroy your opponents;
- Several brazilian presidents to choose from, with unique play styles;
- Choose public policies after defeating waves of opponents, which improve your president;
- Collect taxes and buy new improvements before trying to escape impeachment;
- Lots of Brazilian memes;
- Lots of social criticism.



Impeachment Survivors is an action roguelike, in which you must survive through waves of enemies. At the end of each wave, choose a public policy that improves your president, making him stronger and more immoral. As you shoot down enemies, you receive tax money, enabling you to spend it on improvements before starting another match.

Choose a president from four, each with their own unique play style, and face impeachment.

The game features:
- 7 presidents to choose from;
- 22 different enemies;
- 13 different upgrades to choose from after a wave;
- 2 bosses;
- 2 game modes.

data.name: Handyman Corporation: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
Remember wishlist full game, release soon!


About the Game

HANDYMAN CORPORATION Prologue

Free version of Handyman Corporation. You can try our prologue for free, We are giving you first few tasks to repair.
Launch your very own business in the maintenance service industry! The world of toolboxes, duct tape, stinging live wires, and infuriantingly tiny, easy-to-misplace screws awaits! Collect job orders from clients and perform them to the best of your abilities so that you can expand your Handyman Corporation!

HANDS OF GOLD

Money makes the world go round, and if you want some of your own as a handyman, you'd better get started on some jobs. Use your trusty source to browse hundreds of contracts available in the game and select the ones that you're ready to handle and offer the most lucrative deals. Once you have the cash, you'll be able to buy tools and spare parts, as well as skill upgrades in training programs.

– Hundreds of jobs
– Contract browsing feature
– Spare part and tool shopping
– Inventory management

A GAME WITHIN A GAME

There's a broad variety of jobs featured in Handyman Corporation – ranging from repairing home appliances, to eliminating electrical hazards, to refurbishing entire apartments into liveable spaces. Whatever you decide to get your hands dirty with, each task is accompanied by a specific minigame governed by its own rules. Your tools and unlocked character skills determine how easy the puzzle will be to solve, but of course nothing beats good old practice! Don't forget that your clients' patience is limited Soon after, you will advance to more complex and rewarding tasks.

– Be a repairperson, electrician, plumber, painter, carpenter, and even an interior designer
– Complete tasks based on dozens of minigames
– Numerous customisation options in painting, styles, and materials

EXPAND YOUR BUSINESS

As you secure an income for your handyman business, don't forget to look after its finances and manage any other costs alongside buying equipment and training. If you do it successfully, you'll be able to hire subcontractors, incorporate them into your business, and also teach them the right skills for this line of work. Your employess will be able to complete lots of jobs for additional income.

– Business simulation
– Hire and manage subcontractors

So focus, don't let your hand slip, and... are those wires supposed to cross like that? Well, looks like that blew out the fuses. But that's okay, there's nothing we can't fix at Handyman Corporation!

data.name: Sort Pawzzle 2: By the Purrthenon
data.detailed_description:
Meet Sort Pawzzle 2: By the Purrthenon – a cozy tile-sorting adventure starring a charming black kitty!
Step into a gentle world inspired by ancient Greece, where soft colors, graceful columns, and peaceful melodies create a warm and soothing atmosphere. Match and organize picture tiles, reveal delightful scenes, and restore the quiet beauty of a serene Greek-inspired haven.

Each level offers a calm and satisfying puzzle experience designed for relaxation and joy. Sort colorful tiles with simple taps, clear the board, and unlock lovely decorations for your tranquil corner of Greece. Whether you play for a few minutes or unwind for longer, Sort Pawzzle 2 makes every moment peaceful and rewarding.

As you progress, your elegant feline companion stays by your side – curious, graceful, and full of charm. Discover gentle stories hidden among ancient stones and help bring harmony back to beautifully crafted landmarks in your own cozy style.

IMPORTANT:
The base version of Sort Pawzzle 2 includes free access to the first 25 levels.
To unlock all remaining levels and enjoy the complete game experience, the "Sort Pawzzle 2: By the Purrthenon Full Version Unlock" DLC is required.

Features:
- 230 relaxing tile-sorting levels in the full version
- Graceful black kitty companion
- Restore and decorate a serene Greek-inspired area
- Cozy visuals and smooth, soothing gameplay

Easy to pick up, endlessly warm, and filled with charm, Sort Pawzzle 2: By the Purrthenon invites you to relax, decorate, and enjoy the art of sorting – all in the company of your delightful kitty.

data.name: Collect Call
data.detailed_description:
Collect Call is a puzzle platformer game. You might work through the puzzles on your own, or you might talk to other characters to piece together a mystery.

Features


Gameplay

Puzzles gradually introduce new mechanics so you learn at a comfortable pace with intuitive elements, including levers, buttons, physics objects, bridges, and more.

The game also includes a story told through dialogue with other characters and lore hints hidden in the levels. Your dialogue choices do matter.

Steam Deck
Works fine on my Steam Deck. The game runs natively on Linux and Windows, controllers are detected automatically, and it will use 800p by default. My Steam Deck gets about two-thousand fps with vsync and the frame-rate limit turned off.

Graphics & Performance
The game may use pixel art, but there are still graphical options to configure. The game supports most common resolutions all the way up to 8K. You can also toggle v-sync or set a frame rate limit.

Modding & Steam Workshop
Collect Call can play custom levels from the Steam Workshop. Custom levels can include custom dialogue, puzzle elements, graphics, and more. Levels can even be chained in a sequence for a custom campaign just like the included one. Custom levels can also be installed manually.

You will need map editing software to make your own levels. I used Tiled and suggest you do the same, it is free and open-source. You should also format your levels similar to the included ones for compatibility.

data.name: Dead Head Drive
data.detailed_description:
Drive for your life in a city that keeps you trapped.

Dead Head Drive is a short horror arcade taxi racer set in a nightmare city. Streets twist, routes change, and something is always watching. Drive through shifting routes, chase high scores, and uncover hidden secrets of the city that wants to trap you.

You’re on the clock, the only thing keeping you together is what you do best: drive fast, push luck, survive.

Key Features:

data.name: Wuxing - Elemental Array Poker
data.detailed_description:
Place the beasts. Channel the elements. Break the throne.

Cards fall, elements chain, the multiplier catches fire.

Wuxing: Elemental Array Poker is a feng-shui roguelike deckbuilder. You don't just play a good poker hand — you place it onto a 3×3 altar, card by card, and let the Five Elements flow between cells. What you play matters. Where you put it matters just as much.

Fully playable in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.

Send each beast home

Fire lands in the South — the Vermilion Bird wakes.

Every element has a home cell: the Azure Dragon in the East, the Vermilion Bird in the South, the White Tiger in the West, the Black Tortoise in the North, the Qilin at the center. Land a card on its home and the beast wakes for a bonus multiplier. Feed the center and the Qilin's qi builds across the run — at full charge it discharges for a ×2.5 burst.

Chain Generation…

Wood feeds Fire, Fire feeds Earth — one chain, and the multiplier climbs.

Neighboring cards react to each other. Wood → Fire → Earth → Metal → Water: every Generation edge between neighbors adds to your multiplier. Walk all five elements across the board in one unbroken path and you've built the Generation Chain.

…or gamble on Counter

Counter scores big. Calamity is the bill.

Counter edges — Water quenches Fire, Fire melts Metal — don't add, they multiply. But every one scars your hand size on the spot and calls down a storm that breaks over the next stage, unless you wash it away in the shop first. Greed is a real decision here, not a dice roll.

Wield the relics of myth

Immortal-Slaying Sword, Wind-Fire Wheel, Whip of the Gods — legends you can carry into battle.

Treasures out of Chinese myth and legend, each one bending the rules its own way. Find the few that fit your board, and watch your build come alive.

Every relic can carry an aura

The same sword — plain, then wreathed in five different auras.

Any relic can turn up wreathed in a Relic Aura — some make it stronger, some make it stranger, and one comes at a price. Eight in all, each one worth hunting for.

One more run

The boss falls; the gold pours in.

Four seasons, each guarded by a beast boss that bends one rule of the board — a dragon that seals your Wood, a bird that melts cards as they score and rises from its own ashes. Between rounds you build: over 100 relics, 25 talismans, the nine stars of the Big Dipper that level up your hands, a crafting furnace, vouchers, and Shanhai beasts that rewrite a run when you open the right pack. Five sect decks, sixteen mini-bosses, nine stake tiers, achievements, seeded runs, and an Endless mode for when four seasons aren't enough.

Why Wuxing?

Five Elements, generating and countering, in endless cycle.

Most deckbuilders score the order you play. Wuxing scores the shape you build — a 3×3 board that fights back. Look at the board and you can say "because Wood → Fire → Earth," not "no idea why that just happened."

⭐ Wishlist now

Wuxing launches on Steam in Q1 2027. Wishlisting is the single biggest thing you can do to help us launch — and Steam pings you the moment it goes live.

data.name: ShadowBringer
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to GEC, new employees! Here at the Genetic Engineering Corps, the future of mankind is created!

ShadowBringer is a 3D stealth game set in the retro-futuristic era, where the players take on the role of a lab-created shadow monster. Without recollection of the past, the voice in its head urges the player to discover the truth buried deep within an unknown territory and try to escape from the underground research facility.

Light is the bane of your existence, and darkness is your only safe haven.
Security guards will be your obstacle to the path of freedom. They are relentless, and they are not afraid to put their lives in line to stop you.



  • Stealth gameplay with various abilities to aid your journey
  • 3 unique levels (The Containment Chamber, The Lab, The Server Room)
  • Retro sci-fi atmosphere
  • Various collectibles that reveal more background of your origin
  • Underpaid and overworked guards that will hunt you down



This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

data.name: Hellterns
data.detailed_description:
Heaven won't take you. Hell is packed.

So the damned get one last chance. You get a job.

You're a devil intern in a Hellish workshop. Your job is to process souls, rid them of their sins, handle the paperwork, and send them on their way.

Up to four devils work a shift. You have seven machines, a toolbox, and a plan for the day. The souls have seven deadly sins and absolutely no intention of getting rid of them.



First things first: don't lose the souls.

One comes out of the Cryo Chamber as a block of ice. Another is already floating near the ceiling. A third has decided to lie down somewhere nobody will find it.

The machines help get rid of sins, but each one has its quirks.

And yes — some of them work perfectly well on more than just souls.

Especially interns.



The paperwork matters too.

Every soul has a file: a photo, cause of death, and a list of sins.

Find the right file, figure out who it belongs to, get rid of the soul's sins, fill out the paperwork, and send it to Heaven.

Just like a normal job.

Except mix up the files and Heaven pays less. Ignore the paperwork and things get even more fun.

Just don't lose the file.
Especially along with the soul.



You can work alone. But why make things easier for yourself?

A partner can catch a flying tool, bail you out when everything goes wrong, or, on the other hand, find a way to make things even worse.

Working together is more fun.

Usually.

Sometimes even faster. Sometimes.



The machines don't care who gets put through them.

The Cryo Chamber freezes. The Press flattens. Electroshock scrambles the controls. The Confiscator knocks every tool out of your hands.

If you're really unlucky, you'll become a soul yourself.

No big deal. Your partners can process you, put you back on the job, and the shift goes on.

That's how it's supposed to work.
Exactly why is a different question.



Even in Hell, you can look decent.

Your rank and salary go up over time, along with new tools and perks.

You can also customize your work uniform, choose different hats, and change your look.

Because a promotion should look the part.

Otherwise, what's the point?



Nothing in Hell stays working for long.

With every shift, the workshop starts falling apart a little more.

Fires, power outages, eclipses, floods, breakdowns, and other workplace inconveniences.

Someone stole something? Normal.

Something caught fire? Happens.

The whole workshop stopped working?

Stay calm.

Actually, don't.



  • Online co-op for up to 4 players or single-player
  • Seven machines, each with its own side effects
  • Machines and tools work on the devils too
  • Souls with different sins and quirks
  • Files, stamps, and other workplace bureaucracy
  • Fires, breakdowns, fights, and theft
  • 18 shift modifiers
  • Ranks, upgrade shop, and perks
  • Training for new interns

There's work to do. Heaven is waiting. Your shift starts now.

data.name: Outcast Tales
data.detailed_description:
Be tactical (or mash buttons; might work just as well)!



Robots, mutants, desert raiders: almost all enemies have something up their sleeve. So do your characters: some abilities are most effective in combination with others. Find your opponents' weaknesses, humiliate them on the battlefield, and never ponder the moral implications of your actions!

Use your strengths (if you can find any)!



Combine class and personality types to give each of your characters a unique set of abilities. A Preacher Mercenary and an Antihero Mercenary will behave quite differently. Create a balanced crew, or just try out the wildest combinations to see how they turn out!

Overcome challenges (or mess everything up)!



Your characters will encounter dozens of unique situations that test their skill and wits. The Pacifist might talk his way out of trouble, the Egghead might try setting up traps, and the Daredevil will most likely just start blasting! In Outcast Tales, there are no wrong answers.

Develop relationships (like in a dating game, but not quite)!



Your characters can develop deep bonds or even fall in love - but can also come to despise each other, all depending on your actions. Your journey can become a wholesome story about newfound friendship, or a gruesome tale of three strangers constantly at each other’s throats. Whatever sounds more fun…

Let the chat join the action (or, more realistically, set you up)!


Connect the game to your Twitch account so that your viewers can influence the gameplay! The Twitch Integration feature will enable your chat to make crucial decisions during events, as well as choose your next destination or ability upgrade. And don't worry, your viewers won't ever try to harm you. They love you. Right..?

data.name: Grimstone Survivors
data.detailed_description:
TAKE A SEAT


About the Game

Key Features

3D Top-Down Roguelite Experience:

Breathe new life into the roguelite genre with 3D top-down shooter depth. Experience action-packed battles in an adventure where death is not the end and every new beginning makes you stronger.

Strategic Weapon Combinations:

Shape the battlefield to your playstyle by carrying different weapons in each hand. Hunt enemies from afar with a long-range weapon, while preparing for sudden attacks with a melee weapon in your other hand. Each weapon combination offers a different strategic advantage, discover the deadliest combination!

Personalized Skill Tree:

Choose from a wide variety of abilities to create your own unique playstyle. Whether you're increasing your stamina as a life-stealing specialist or taking down enemies with fast attacks, each skill selection will make you unique.

Dynamic and Surprising Battlefield:

Momentary events can turn the tide of battle in an instant. Gain a tactical advantage over your enemies by launching turrets or life towers. Using the battlefield wisely is key to survival.

Strategic Resource Management:

The Market offers you different paths. Get instant advantages by buying temporary power-ups from the market. Managing your resources wisely will help you survive challenging levels.

Infinite Replayability:

With randomly generated levels, enemies, and items, every play experience is different. Each time you will face new challenges and develop different strategies to explore the depths of Grimstone Survivor.

Depth Layers:

  • Bullet/Potion: Adds a chance to give unique properties to the player's bullets.

    Reload: Each time you reload a weapon or use an item, you can gain different stats.

  • Steps: When you walk, your steps become magical.

    Dodge/Parry: Abilities that increase speed while dodging or parrying.

  • Sprint & Dash: Leave a trail behind you when running.

    Buttons/Interactibles: Buttons with unique properties appear when a certain damage threshold is reached.

  • Melee: Power-ups that affect melee weapons.

  • Ranged: Power-ups that affect long-range weapons.

  • Market: Old, worn out tokens that provide discounts in the Market.

  • Wearables: Customize your character with visible clothing.
data.about_the_game:
Key Features

3D Top-Down Roguelite Experience:

Breathe new life into the roguelite genre with 3D top-down shooter depth. Experience action-packed battles in an adventure where death is not the end and every new beginning makes you stronger.

Strategic Weapon Combinations:

Shape the battlefield to your playstyle by carrying different weapons in each hand. Hunt enemies from afar with a long-range weapon, while preparing for sudden attacks with a melee weapon in your other hand. Each weapon combination offers a different strategic advantage, discover the deadliest combination!

Personalized Skill Tree:

Choose from a wide variety of abilities to create your own unique playstyle. Whether you're increasing your stamina as a life-stealing specialist or taking down enemies with fast attacks, each skill selection will make you unique.

Dynamic and Surprising Battlefield:

Momentary events can turn the tide of battle in an instant. Gain a tactical advantage over your enemies by launching turrets or life towers. Using the battlefield wisely is key to survival.

Strategic Resource Management:

The Market offers you different paths. Get instant advantages by buying temporary power-ups from the market. Managing your resources wisely will help you survive challenging levels.

Infinite Replayability:

With randomly generated levels, enemies, and items, every play experience is different. Each time you will face new challenges and develop different strategies to explore the depths of Grimstone Survivor.

Depth Layers:

  • Bullet/Potion: Adds a chance to give unique properties to the player's bullets.

    Reload: Each time you reload a weapon or use an item, you can gain different stats.

  • Steps: When you walk, your steps become magical.

    Dodge/Parry: Abilities that increase speed while dodging or parrying.

  • Sprint & Dash: Leave a trail behind you when running.

    Buttons/Interactibles: Buttons with unique properties appear when a certain damage threshold is reached.

  • Melee: Power-ups that affect melee weapons.

  • Ranged: Power-ups that affect long-range weapons.

  • Market: Old, worn out tokens that provide discounts in the Market.

  • Wearables: Customize your character with visible clothing.

data.name: Demonicon
data.detailed_description:
The Dark Eye - Demonicon is a thrilling action-RPG set in the extraordinarily popular universe of “The Dark Eye”, a richly crafted fantasy world beloved by fantasy gamers across the globe.

The Dark Eye - Demonicon tells the tragic story of a brother and sister who become pawns of sinister forces in a world of cruelty and depravity. In this bleak yet magical world, their affection is both a blessing and a curse. Both are constantly threatened by mortal danger and demonic temptation, and must find a way through their tortured lives by facing serious moral decisions. Their common destiny will determine that of the entire continent, and will be decided by the choices they make. Hordes of fiends block their way to freedom and peace, and only through battle and magic they will truly become free of the darkness.

  • A third-person action-RPG featuring brutal melee attack combos and dazzling magic spells
  • Powerful storytelling with an elaborate narrative rich with twists, as well as believable conflicts and ethical decision-making opportunities
  • Action-packed battles, where pin-point timing and clever tactics play important roles
  • Unique magic system: a dark talent grants the player devastating mystical powers and changes his physical appearance
  • Comprehensive crafting system allows for creation of potions, poisoned blades and enchanted armor
  • State-of-the-art 3D visuals using the powerful Havok Vision engine
  • A richly detailed game world embedded in the extensive fantasy world of The Dark Eye

data.name: Cmoar VR Cinema
data.detailed_description:
Watching your favourite movies has never been so immersive as in our Cmoar VR Cinema! Bringing the atmosphere of your favourite cinema straight to your home enables you to relive all those exciting moments you had when you first stepped into the auditorium. Relax and enjoy those glorious battles, romantic finales, comedic moments once more in the most immersive VR Media Player on Steam!

FEATURES

  • Dynamic Lighting effect
  • Four beutiful realistic sceneries
  • LAN PLEX support ( DLNA server) [NEW!]
  • LAN shared media (UPNP/DLNA media servers) [NEW!]
  • Disc (DVD) with navigation (inside LAN category) [NEW!]
  • 3D 180° & 360° movies with options (orientation/zoom/tilt) [NEW!]
  • Support for 2D & 3D Movies (SBS/Over-Under)
  • Watching Youtube videos (1080p 2D)
  • Watching Youtube videos (1080p 3D)
  • Seat change ability
  • Embedded subtitles and audio track support
  • Full Native HTC Vive & Oculus support
  • VR gamepad support
  • VR menu interface
  • Add every video and directory to Favourites
  • "Last-viewed” option
  • Many subtitle encoding formats

If you have problems with Plex discover - see a tutorial (if default Plex setup is not working) : or to restart Plex server.
If you encounter any problems feel free to contact us on sboczek@10antshill.com.

Dynamic Lighting
The VR Cinema enables you to fully immerse yourself in the world of virtual reality and watching your favourite movie once again has never been so realistic. Sit comfortably in your seat an allow yourself to be mesmerised by the experience.

Seat change ability
Can't see enough? Don't like your seat? Now you can change your seat in three of our environments and enjoy the movie from a completely different perspective.

Youtube & Youtube 3D
Watching videos has never been easier as now you are simply two clicks away from enjoying every Youtube video in our cinema. Whether it be Youtube or Youtube 3D, everything is within your reach.

Steam VR compatibility
Your favourite mobile VR Cinema is now available on PC. Precise motion tracking and natural controller gestures enable you to fully adopt stationary VR's advantages to enhance your experience within our virtual reality.

VR Gamepad support
Use your VR controller to fully navigate within our cinema's menu. It has never been easier to manouver through your files and search for your favourite moments. In conjuction with its precision and intuitive user interface, Cmoar VR Cinema enables you to sit back and fully enjoy the movie.

Transitional realistic sceneries (home, cinema, boat show)
If you don't like the current auditorium you can immediately make a quick switch to a cozy, comfortable room or you can quickly disable the entire environment to solely focus on the main screen. The choice is yours.

Add every movie to Favourites
With just one click you can add your most beloved movie to the Favourites label. It will always be there for you whenever you would like to quickly watch it again without all the tedious searching and selecting.


Only Local* - means that Plex server has to be on a machine that runs Cmoar VR Cinema. We're working on expanding Plex support further in the near future.

data.name: trophies
data.detailed_description:
Curses aren't real... everybody knows that.

Right?

Siobhan finds herself alone after the mysterious death of her friend.

As she attempts to move on, things begin to unravel out of control.



trophies is a visual novel about trust, truth and what to do with it.





A quiet girl who keeps herself to herself.

Unfortunately, Siobhan's been forced into the spotlight as the sole witness to a fatal accident.



Strange, but harmless - Grace claims she's a witch.

But surely she can't be serious about it... Most girls grow out of pretending to be witches, don't they?



An out-going, headstrong girl. Charlie's a bassist in the local band, Devil Dog, with her two close friends.

As events unfold, she finds herself caught in the middle.



Siobhan's best friend, and Grace's younger sister.

Aisling is a cheerful girl who always looks forward to tomorrow.



Aisling's ex.

Declan fancies himself a bit of a detective after watching too much TV.



  • 2D animation
  • 30-35 thousand words
  • 2-3 hour playtime
  • 2008 Ireland

data.name: ANVIL
data.detailed_description:
ANVIL is a multiplayer co-op top-down sci-fi roguelike action shooter where you control characters called Vault Breakers to explore various galaxies that are crawling with monsters. Find relics inside Vaults to increase Breaker's ability to survive and fight on this godforsaken galaxy.

# ANVIL
Ancient Vault Investigation Lab


ANVIL is an agency that searches for "Vaults”, the remnants of alien civilizations scattered throughout the universe. Become a "Breaker" searching for “Vaults” and explore the unknown galaxy. Each galaxy consists of random planets and unique boss monsters. By defeating monsters and opening the Vaults, you will be able to utilize the stunning powers within.

# Breakers

The Breakers are the seekers of Vaults. They have maximized their combat capabilities to survive various threats that they may encounter on different planets.
Breakers with unique abilities and skills are waiting to be selected.

# Artifacts and Vault Weapons

Over 100 randomly generated artifacts and dozens of weapons will make every session unique and different from previous sessions. You will be able to explore a combination of different playstyles by testing synergy between various artifacts and obtain powerful weapons to get the “ultimate” Breaker!

# Death and Rebirth

The Breakers enter combat with their mechanical body. They are rebuilt in ANVIL if they are destroyed during an exploration. Your Breakers will gain EXP during battle that will enhance their strength and give them new powers. The Breakers are not afraid of death because death only makes them stronger when they are rebuilt.

# Operator

A new companion has been added to your journey. They may not directly aid you in combat like Toy Workers,
but they provide you with essential details about ANVIL and occasionally provide helpful information through interactions.

Conquer the battlefield with the newly added Operator.

data.name: First Person Shouter
data.detailed_description:
First Person Shouter is a cat tamagotchi (virtual pet) rage room with voice-powered minigames and real-time procedural destruction. Take care of your very cute cat, destroy your enemies and escape from eternal damnation.

Come for the shouting. Stay because Whiskers will kill you if you try to leave.

WHISKERS THE CAT

You are in the service of Whiskers, a perfectly normal cat who has given you the power to destroy the world with your voice. There is nothing unusual about Whiskers. This is just what cats do. All he wants you to do is reduce the world to rubble. So cute!!!

VOICE POWERED RAGE MINIGAMES

So your job is simple: go out into the world, shout at it until it goes away, and find gifts for your cat. Whiskers’ things are hidden in the world’s most frustrating environments. There are traffic jams, crowded airports and soul-crushing offices just waiting to be destroyed. Each one of these locations requires a unique approach, just to keep you on your toes.

DESTROY PURR-GATORY

Each time you venture into purr-gatory, the world regenerates and randomizes itself, creating an endless playground of noise and destruction. The game also features procedural real-time destruction, letting you destroy the world differently every run.

data.name: Garden of Earthly Delights
data.detailed_description:
"I'm a man with amnesia. However, I see in my dreams a paradise filled with carnal pleasures, pornography, and explicit sex.

I need to find this place to recover my lost memory."

- Excerpt from Lenny's diary -

A man needs to follow a trail in the desert that will lead him to the mythical and erotic Garden of Earthly Delights. He has lost his memory and the only reference to his past is in the mysterious stones he was carrying. He was found by Melody on the banks of a river completely naked, carrying only a bag of said stones. What is this legendary paradise that the stones reveal? What is his relationship with this paradise of carnal pleasures, watered with the most libidinous explicit sex?

This is the story of Lenny "Nobody", a man in search of answers about his past. He was found with no memory by a young recluse named Melody in the swamps. Lenny was naked and carrying a bag of runestones and valuable diamonds, which are the only clues he has to discover more about himself.

After extensive research, he finally finds the answer in the Atacama Desert. The place hides a passage that leads to a world full of carnal pleasures, known as "The Secret Garden of All Delights". It is a true erotic paradise, full of nudity, consensual pleasure, and explicit sex. A place full of passion, love and sexual freedom for everyone.

He discovers traces of a pagan temple within the desert, containing huge Germanic runes scattered among the stones and a cave mouth shaped like a vagina. Upon entering the cave, Lenny catches a glimpse of an incredible mythical world, filled with lots of sex and pornography.

In this world, Lenny envisions hundreds of men and women engaging in explicit sexual acts in the middle of an enormous bucolic garden, an explosion of carnal and humid pleasures, a true paradise of the flesh.

This is a traditional visual novel with choice options buttons and mouse-click navigation.

Click on the text or in the "colored leaf" to advance. The game has a menu located at the top left. When clicking on the orange icon with four black stripes, a submenu will appear with options to control sound, go back to the beginning, and save the dialogs.

On the game's home screen (Main Menu), you should go to the PLAY menu. Three language options will appear. Each of them is represented by one of the characters.

Just click on the character corresponding to the language of your choice to start the game. English, Spanish, Portuguese.

IMPORTANT!

This game is AVAILABLE in ENGLISH, PORTUGUESE, AND SPANISH.

Only the MAIN MENU BUTTONS (In English) is not available for other languages.

Game Time:

Approximately 3 hours and 10 minutes if you read approximately 200 words per minute.

Of course, the player can stay longer per scene to enjoy the animations and screens.

On average each sequence is 5 to 8 minutes long. There are 982 screens and 260 animations

1246 SCENES spread over 16 chapters. If the player stays 12 seconds per SCENE the game will extend for 4 hours.

data.name: Please Don’t Break My Dungeon
data.detailed_description:
Take the treasure. Leave my home alone.

At the back of a dungeon, a little rag doll named Nubi has a room to call home. Unfortunately, the visiting heroes love smashing things. Even finding the treasure does not stop them if there is still time to spare.

Please Don’t Break My Dungeon is a single-player dungeon-defense game about rebuilding under pressure. Clear debris, repair structures and revive your monsters while preparing the next nasty surprise. Keep the heroes busy—and keep them away from Nubi’s room.

A dungeon that fights back

Send boulders rolling through the party, fill a passage with poison or lure curious heroes into a spring-loaded jester box. Chain lightning, explosive barrels and supporting helpers give you different ways to disrupt an expedition. Injured heroes flee individually, dropping items you can put to use.

Rebuild, place and prepare

Choose where your helpers work, bring fallen defenders back and strengthen your tools and skills. Expand into rooms with different layouts, monsters and bosses. Zoom out to follow the chaos, then move in to repair the places that need you most.

Just one little room

Between stages, take your time to prepare. Collect furnishings for Nubi’s home and keep their permanent benefits across attempts. The dungeon may be a mess, but that little room is yours to protect.

  • Hands-on repairs alongside automatic helpers and tactical traps.
  • Individual hero retreats and reusable dropped loot.
  • Distinct dungeon rooms and bosses across a 20-stage challenge.
  • Persistent home furnishings to support your next attempt.
  • Mouse-and-keyboard controls with zoom and room shortcuts.

data.name: Gimlé Trials
data.detailed_description:
Gimlé Trials is a high-energy multiplayer arena game where precision spellcasting meets dynamic strategy. Engage in rapid, skill-based battles where abilities can knock opponents into danger—or save you from the brink of defeat. The rules are simple: stay in the safe zone, outplay your rivals, and become the last one standing.

Key Features:

  • Fast-Paced, Skill-Based Combat: Easy to learn but hard to master, Gimlé Trials rewards sharp reflexes and tactical outplays. Timing, aim, and positioning are your keys to survival.

  • Dynamic Knockback Mechanics: Manipulate the battlefield with unique knockback spells that send foes into deadly hazards like lava, creating exciting, high-stakes moments.

  • Customizable Loadouts: Between rounds, adapt your strategy by drafting new abilities. Craft your arsenal and find creative ways to dominate your opponents.

  • Evolving Arenas: The encroaching lava mechanic turns each match into a thrilling showdown, forcing players into intense close-quarters combat.

  • Strategic Round Progression: Earn currency, draft new abilities, and build your strategy between rounds for an ever-changing battle experience.

Whether you're a competitive player seeking mastery or a casual gamer looking for quick fun, Gimlé Trials delivers chaos, creativity, and excitement in every match. Step into the arena and prove your skill!

data.name: MIND
data.detailed_description:
MIND: A Challenging Minimalistic Puzzle Game to Stimulate Your Mind!

Welcome to the captivating world of "MIND," a minimalistic puzzle game that will put your problem-solving skills to the ultimate test! Prepare to embark on a mind-bending journey through 60 levels filled with intriguing challenges and an interactive environment. Let's explore the features that make "MIND" a truly unique gaming experience.

Engaging Gameplay:
"MIND" offers a simple yet addictive gameplay concept. Using only four directions, navigate through meticulously designed puzzles to reach the final square. Each level presents a new challenge, requiring careful planning and strategic thinking.

Intuitive Controls:
Take control of your journey using either the arrow keys or the WSAD controls, ensuring a seamless and immersive experience. The intuitive controls allow for precise movements, letting you focus on solving the intricate puzzles.

Object Interaction:
Unleash your creativity and problem-solving skills by manipulating the environment. "MIND" offers the unique ability to turn objects on and off, opening up new possibilities for puzzle solutions. Experiment with different object states and discover innovative ways to overcome challenges.


Diverse Block Types:
Encounter over 20 unique blocks (lasers, fans, switches..) throughout your puzzle-solving adventure. Each block introduces new mechanics and interactions, adding layers of complexity to the gameplay. Adapt your strategies as you encounter these thought-provoking elements.

60 Levels of Increasing Difficulty:
Prepare to challenge your mind across 60 carefully crafted levels. The initial stages ease you into the game mechanics, allowing you to grasp the basics. However, as you progress, the difficulty ramps up significantly, presenting you with mind-bending puzzles that will truly test your abilities.

Relaxing Music:
Immerse yourself in a calming and soothing musical backdrop as you delve into the world of "MIND." The enchanting soundtrack enhances your concentration and focus, creating the perfect ambiance for a rewarding puzzle-solving experience.


In-game features:
Arrows or WSAD controls
R to restart the current level
I to display a direction visualizer
Over 20 unique blocks
60 levels ranging from easy to herculean
Relaxing music

data.name: Heads Will Roll: Reforged
data.detailed_description:
Heads Will Roll: Reforged Big Box Edition


About the Game

Heads Will Roll: Reforged lets the player to take a role of an ordinary medieval soldier who finds himself in the middle of the legendary Hundred Years War between the kings of England and France. You start your way as a simple footman, whose sole ambition is to survive, but with proper skill and cunning or through blood and preservation, you might soon see yourself becoming one of the most famous knights of your time.

This game is a unique type of RPG with survival mechanics and turn-based combat that requires player to make careful decision both inside and outside the fight. The sophisticated combat system utilizes many different parameters including characters’ stats and attributes, familiarity and proficiency with certain weapons, weapon length, fatigue level, various traumas and injuries, as well as hundreds of different items and consumables.

Loot it All

The game offers more than 200 different lootable items varying from all kinds of medieval weaponry and armor to trinkets with unique effects, several types of poisons, medical supplies and many crafting items.

Face the consequences

All of the actions that your character takes will have in-game consequences. The NPCs will change their opinions of you depending on how you treat them and how you behave both inside and outside of battle. This in turn will enable or disable various future interactions with them and sometimes trigger special events.

Crafting System

Make good use of any loot or supplies that you got your hands on. A lot of them can be combined in order to craft medical and utility items, as well as many types of crossbow ammunition.

Big replayability

Heads Will Roll utilizes many random generation elements that will turn two separate playthroughs into two completely unique experiences. Start with different items and stats, face different enemies, make different choices and live through different events each time you play.

Huge Arsenal

The game has dozens of weapons ranging from swords, axes, maces and spears to throwing knives and crossbows. All of them have varying movesets that rely on and make use of different stats & skills (strength, agility etc.), while also having distinct features and countering each other in some way.

All's fair in love and war

Fight not only for wealth and honor but also for the hearts of several stunning beauties with unique personalities, views on life and tastes in men. Conquering some of them might prove to be just as tricky as surviving the war.

Authentic equipment

Choose from a wide array of authentic medieval defensive equipment: from all kinds of helmets and armor to gorgets, bracers, greaves and chainmail stockings. All with varying qualities and characteristics.

Roguelike mode

Game features a complete Roguelike mode where player can level his profile with each death, unlocking new starting items and improving character's base characteristics allowing to progress further and take on even harder challenges.

Story mode

There is a special story mode for those who are after the thrills and twists of the story rather than hardcore survival. It offers just enough of a challenge to keep you engaged as well as quick save and quick load options that can be accessed at any time.

data.name: Shattered Dimension
data.detailed_description:
Shattered Dimension is an overhead perspective tabletop puzzle game that transports you to a mysterious and fantastical border world. As an investigator unexpectedly drawn into a labyrinthine plot, you'll delve deep into the heart of the mystery, navigating bustling restaurants, solemn police stations, cluttered grocery stores, and even a hidden, enigmatic laboratory.

Employ your wit and courage to unravel intricately designed puzzles, acquire essential items, and gradually uncover the secrets that have ensnared you in this bizarre world.

As you explore, you'll need to meticulously untangle the complex storyline, map out character relationships, and skillfully select and use items to solve seemingly impossible puzzles. Stay alert and actively engage with the environment by clicking, interacting, and conversing with characters to gather clues and items that will lead you closer to the truth and the hidden forces at play.

While Shattered Dimension features a distinct art style compared to other CottonGame titles, it maintains the studio's commitment to innovation and unique interpretations of fantastical worlds. Embark on a mind-bending adventure filled with imaginative elements and a romantic atmosphere.

Join us on this challenging and captivating puzzle-solving journey!

data.name: Endless Shift: Haunted House
data.detailed_description:
A cozy Halloween restaurant game. Welcome to the night shift! In Endless Shift: Haunted House you're the ghost waiter of a haunted hotel's restaurant, where every guest is a monster… with very little patience.

  • Seat every party at the right table: chair count and tablecloth colour matter. A perfect, matching fit pays more!

  • Serve monstrous drinks and dishes: blood, ectoplasm, potions, steamed brains and witch fingers.

data.name: Hadean Lands
data.detailed_description:
Marooned in an alien, airless wasteland — your starship fractured — your crewmates missing. Can an apprentice alchemist learn how to survive?

Hadean Lands is interactive fiction — a classic text adventure. No graphics! No dialogue trees! No point-and-click! You type your commands, and read what happens next.

(Keyboard controls only. Because you have to type everything. Get it?)

Hadean Lands is a game of alchemy and exploration, with an intricate structure of interlinked puzzles. Every ritual you learn adds a new ability to your toolkit. But every ritual requires a different combination of ingredients, and some ingredients are in desperately short supply.

The game's sophisticated goal-tracking system permits you to experiment freely! Any ritual you've learned can be performed with a single command. Any puzzle that you've ever solved can be re-solved automatically. Click on the in-game map to travel to any room you're familiar with; the goal system will even find known keys and re-solve intermediate puzzles to get there. But beware: many puzzles have multiple solutions. If the ones you've found don't fit together, you may have to go searching for alternatives...

Repairing an alchemical starship single-handed? Not easy; perhaps impossible. You’ll have to discover the rituals you need, and then search for ingredients, and then improvise and substitute. You’ll have to calcine, distill, dissolve, and precipitate. And somehow, somewhere, you’ll have to figure out what happened and why.

data.name: Hunker Bunker
data.detailed_description:
HUNKER BUNKER is a retro-futuristic tactical survival game about leading

a squad through a shifting underground bunker, scavenging salvage, and keeping

the lights on when the dark starts moving back.

You command three specialist operators:

  • Scout for fast recon and wide salvage coverage.

  • Tank for heavy defense and frontline survival.

  • Engineer for rerouting systems, terminal work, and tactical utility.

Every run pushes you deeper into procedural bunker corridors, hostile biomes, and broken infrastructure.

Manage oxygen, recover resources, repair critical systems, and decide which threats are worth fighting when supplies run thin.

Features

  • Procedurally generated bunker runs with shifting layouts and escalating pressure.

  • Distinct operator classes with different movement, abilities, and combat roles.

  • Oxygen and salvage management that rewards careful route planning.

  • Discoverable terminals, lore logs, codex entries, camps, and faction secrets.

  • Multiple endings that reflect the choices and survival of your crew.

  • Keyboard/mouse support, touch-friendly UI, and remappable controls.

Some secrets in Hunker Bunker are not hidden behind keys.

They are hidden behind the cost of surviving long enough to ask the right questions.

content_descriptors.notes:
Hunker Bunker contains frequent sci-fi violence and horror, including firearm combat, blood and biological splatter, acid injuries, dismemberment, corpse disintegration, parasitic infection, and body transformation. The story also includes psychological horror involving manipulation, loss of bodily autonomy, mind control, captivity, and disturbing biological imagery.

Some story paths address death, self-sacrifice, self-annihilation/suicide themes, and characters facing or anticipating their own deaths. The game also contains occasional non-explicit sexual and sensual themes, suggestive dialogue and intimacy, references to sex work as part of a survival economy, and limited implied/veiled nudity. Sexual activity is not graphically depicted, and the game does not contain explicit sexual acts or explicit genital nudity.

data.name: Sargon's Lair
data.detailed_description:
Sargon's Lair is a 2D roguelike shooter following a lost adventurer spelunking through an ancient cavern riddled with various enemies. Along the way, there will be five guardians that must be defeated until the player reaches the end in addition to hostile minions scattered in between. But, the adventurer can pick up different sets of guns, food, and upgrades to make himself more powerful as the enemies become more difficult further into the dungeon. Can you brave Sargon’s Lair and reach the end?

Dungeon: The dungeon itself is constantly being randomly generated with each playthrough. No run will be the same. Additionally, enemies and pickups will appear at different rates and magnitudes to ensure for a great experience each time.

Enemies and Bosses: Sargon’s Lair, having been abandoned for thousands of years, has been inhabited by the strongest of monsters. Five major guardians reside in the lair along with many different minions. You can choose to avoid the minions, but defeating the guardians is a must.

You: Your job is to take control of the adventurer and reach the end. You will have to get good at dodging in a bullet hell environment.There will be plenty of resources to acquire along the way that will help you survive, good luck!
