data.name: JiivJiiv
data.detailed_description:
Grandma has left you her little coop. Raise a flock of felt chickens, send their eggs off on the truck and grow a quiet farm that keeps working while you're away.

JiivJiiv is a cozy idle farm made to look like handmade felt toys. Every chicken lives its own little life: pick one up, give it a toss, watch it peck and wander. Throw eggs into the truck one after another to build a combo.

  • Desktop strip mode (Windows only): the farm lives in a thin strip above your taskbar while you work. Ctrl+Alt+Shift+J (or a key you choose) shows and hides it, it steps aside for full-screen games and videos, and clicks on empty space go through to the window behind.
  • TV mode hides the interface so you can just watch the flock.
  • Full controller support with on-screen button prompts for your controller.
  • Streamers: viewers type !civciv in chat to name a chicken. No login needed, and names are filtered.

Her postcards and album notes lead you towards the legendary First Hen. Finding her on Cloud Peak is the end of the story; after that, an endless mode opens.

Move to a new region with the chickens you choose. Each region has its own rule that works as an opportunity:

  • Rainy Coast: spring rain triples laying
  • Windy Highland: the wind carries your thrown eggs, combos up to ×2.5
  • Oasis: the Golden Hour triples egg value
  • Dark Island: mutations triple at night
  • Cloud Peak: Puff! recipes give two eggs

Your old farm is never deleted, and you can visit it any time.

Village Hen, Rhode Island Red, Leghorn, Silkie, Araucana with its blue eggs, Marans with chocolate eggs, guest breeds such as the Sultan and the jet-black Ayam Cemani, and the mythic Anka. Mix two chickens in Puff! recipes to find new breeds, and chase six mutation colours and star layers for your album. 25 Steam achievements.

No chicken is ever sold, deleted, sick or lost. Retired chickens go to the meadow and can come back whenever you like. While you're away your farm keeps earning, and a "while you were away" summary welcomes you back. Your save travels with Steam Cloud.

No forced ads. Speed is never sold for money. No premium currency, no loot boxes, and the game has an ending.

For every player

Text size up to 200%, interface scaling, reduced motion, screen flashes off, hints off and separate volume channels. Day and night follow your real clock, with rain, rainbows and full moons, plus a slow-day option.

Optional theme packs have their own store pages. They change only how the farm looks: Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, French and German villages, the Turk Era, Anatolian Hıdrellez, Sakura and a golden supporter farm. They never change income, odds, the album or achievements.

  • Streamers: viewers type !civciv in chat to name a chicken. No login needed, and names are filtered.

Her postcards and album notes lead you towards the legendary First Hen. Finding her on Cloud Peak is the end of the story; after that, an endless mode opens.

Move to a new region with the chickens you choose. Each region has its own rule that works as an opportunity:

  • Rainy Coast: spring rain triples laying
  • Windy Highland: the wind carries your thrown eggs, combos up to ×2.5
  • Oasis: the Golden Hour triples egg value
  • Dark Island: mutations triple at night
  • Cloud Peak: Puff! recipes give two eggs

Your old farm is never deleted, and you can visit it any time.

Village Hen, Rhode Island Red, Leghorn, Silkie, Araucana with its blue eggs, Marans with chocolate eggs, guest breeds such as the Sultan and the jet-black Ayam Cemani, and the mythic Anka. Mix two chickens in Puff! recipes to find new breeds, and chase six mutation colours and star layers for your album. 25 Steam achievements.

No chicken is ever sold, deleted, sick or lost. Retired chickens go to the meadow and can come back whenever you like. While you're away your farm keeps earning, and a "while you were away" summary welcomes you back. Your save travels with Steam Cloud.

No forced ads. Speed is never sold for money. No premium currency, no loot boxes, and the game has an ending.

For every player

Text size up to 200%, interface scaling, reduced motion, screen flashes off, hints off and separate volume channels. Day and night follow your real clock, with rain, rainbows and full moons, plus a slow-day option.

Optional theme packs have their own store pages. They change only how the farm looks: Japanese, Chinese, Korean, English, French and German villages, the Turk Era, Anatolian Hıdrellez, Sakura and a golden supporter farm. They never change income, odds, the album or achievements.
data.short_description: Raise a flock of felt chickens on Grandma's old farm. Throw eggs into the truck, migrate across six regions with their own rules and follow her postcards to the legendary First Hen. A cozy idle game with no ads, no premium currency and a real ending.

data.name: ASANA Visual Novel
data.detailed_description:
A visual novel with English voices where the world is dying, the cat is a live AI god, and the captain is dangerously oblivious to her own past...

Controls

Play with only a mouse, only a keyboard, or both. A controller is optional (partial controller support). The in-game keyboard lets mouse users enter written answers using Latin, accented Latin and Cyrillic characters.

ASANA Visual Novel is a sci-fi dark comedy visual novel where your choices shape your character, your stats shape your options, and N.E.K.O., the ship's godlike AI, currently in cat form, permanently in judgment mode, watches everything and is not impressed.

You are Captain Asana. Planets keep exploding in your rearview mirror, heavily armed Cat-Ptain Paradox is getting too close too fast, and nobody will tell you why. Build your character. Make your choices. Try not to make things worse.

Things will go wrong. They always do. Whether you fix them, survive them, or fail spectacularly depends on you. And yes, you can let the world rot if that's who you are.

And in selected story scenes, you can talk to N.E.K.O. in your own words. AI generates his replies within the scene and the character's role. Conversations and challenges have rules and limits. He has opinions. You will not enjoy all of them.

🐱 Features

* 🎛️ Stat-based character creation: Captain, Explorer, Pilot, Charm, and a hidden fifth skill (good luck finding it)

* 🌌 Branching routes through the crisis: your stats open and close doors you didn't know existed

* 🤖 Live AI conversations: talk to N.E.K.O. in selected scenes, with replies generated through Anthropic Claude within the game's rules

* 🎯 AI conversation challenges: write your own response, follow the challenge's rules, and try to talk your way out of trouble...

* 📖 A story planned across eight chapters: branching routes, new challenges, and escalating cosmic chaos

* 🔁 Replay value: different stats, different routes, different outcomes, and AI responses that can vary

* 🎨 Hand-drawn concepts, handcrafted story: set in the established ASANA webcomic universe

* 🛠️ Solo dev, first game. Built with love, sweat, and Ren'Py. No, it will not do your dishes or clean your room!

* 🎙️ English voices: prerecorded dialogue, with optional English speech through ElevenLabs for selected AI replies

Online features and offline play

Live AI conversations and challenges require Internet, as does generating new speech. You can turn online AI off. When online services are unavailable or disabled, the story continues with text and built-in offline responses.

Online features include up to 200 AI requests to use across chats and minigames, plus 50 English voice-generation requests per installation. These allowances are shared across playthroughs. When a limit is reached, the game remains playable using text and built-in offline alternatives. Prerecorded voices and already-generated cached audio remain available.

🚀 Wishlist now

 N.E.K.O. is waiting.

WISHGATE-A49BX4WB

data.detailed_description:
Sweet Age - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with the theme of the Stone Age. It describes the daily life of five beautiful and cute girls in the Stone Age, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girls' photos in the gallery.

data.name: Soundwave
data.detailed_description:
Can you hear it? Can you hold it?
A pure tone plays… then silence.

Now find your way back to it.

Think your friend is better than you at every game?
Tell them to prove it.

Welcome to Soundwave — a competitive frequency memory game that tests your ear like nothing else. No aim. No luck. Just pure listening skill.

Using a scrolling piano keyboard, your job is simple:

Hear the tone
Memorize it
Recreate it
Get scored on accuracy

Sounds easy.

It isn’t.

Five rounds.
Scored out of 75.
Every note matters.

Simple to understand — brutally hard to master.

Can you trust your ears under pressure?
Can your friends?


Versus Mode

Challenge friends or random players in real-time.

Same tones. Same conditions. No excuses.

If your friend says they’re better than you—
queue up and settle it.

Win matches, gain SR, and climb the ranks.
Lose, and you drop.

Performance matters, not just wins.

Ranks

Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond → Master → Legend

Climb the ladder.
Protect your rank.
Become the player everyone avoids matching against.

Global leaderboards track the best of the best.

Win to climb, lose to drop — performance matters, not just wins

Game Modes:

Ranked Play

5 rounds, score out of 75, full leaderboard tracking

Chord Mode

Identify root notes + major/minor chords

Practice Mode

Unlimited attempts, no pressure, pure improvement

Daily Challenge

Same tones for everyone. One attempt. One chance.

Compete globally and see where your ears rank.

Features

• Global leaderboards (Ranked + Daily)
• Versus mode with full SR ranking system
• 34 Steam achievements
• 4 sound themes (Sine, Piano, Strings, Flute)
• Easy + Hard difficulty
• Multiple screen modes (Widescreen / Portrait / Fullscreen)
• Daily challenge system
• 7 supported languages
• Headphones highly recommended

Some players rely on mechanics.
Some rely on reaction time.

You rely on your ears.

How good are they, really?

data.detailed_description:
Have you ever wanted to explore the depths of the ocean?

In this submarine simulator, realistic ocean floor bathymetry is home to a range of flora and fauna. Take photographs and sell them to upgrade your submarine - the more species in your photos, the more they are worth!

Observe and record different varieties of animals in your catalogue - an albino blue whale, a giant Japanese spidercrab, and many more...

PLEASE NOTE: I have not yet uploaded a version of TethyScope that works for older machines that do not support Vulkan (modern graphics API). I believe computers newer than 2013 should have support for Vulkan. If you purchase TethyScope and are unable to play it due to this issue, please contact me for a full refund.

data.name: Project Abyss
data.detailed_description:
Project Abyss is a pixel-loving 2D survival RPG that takes place in the deepest place on Earth. Using a mixture of realism and fun, you control a diver and mini-submarine as you explore a living world of beautiful and deadly sea life, wreckages and enemy subs. Loot money for upgrades, complete tasks, unlock other submarines, and uncover more of the mystery deep below.



Utilise your equipment in a stylish blend of combat and beautiful aquatic moments, with a great original soundtrack and ambient sounds; we have created a living, breathing underwater world in pixel art graphics, with it's own day/night cycle. Much of the world is destructible, from blowing up wreckage doors with C4, to drilling and torpedoing your way through rock for fuel cells and chests.





  • Survive an often brutal world of bosses, turrets, and poisonous plants, filled with lots of sea life to find- including Sharks, Orcas, Whales, Jellyfish, and lots of fish!
  • Control your submarine with the turbines; as well as claws, weaponry, and drills! #Updated to include simpler submarine controls as an option.
  • The ability to explore outside your submarine, calling drones, repairing your sub and swimming through abandoned wreckages from pirate ships to a massive world war submarine.
  • Lots of equipment and upgrades to purchase along 3 tech-trees... Survival, Attack and Defence.
  • Pick up notes to build the story of one diver's destiny that will take you across huge areas; defeating bosses and unlocking the secret of the abyss.


There is a lot to see and do, with many hours of open gameplay!

data.name: Crew 167: The Grand Block Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
A puzzle game where you're rewarded with cinematic story-telling.

Delve into a psychological and atmospheric cinematic mystery as you solve puzzles in this block-pushing adventure. Crew 167 is the story of same-named character who finds himself isolated in the midst of an interstellar journey. His home planet, Source, is severely suffering from climate change and a backup plan is essential for his home planet’s survival. However, after traveling for over a century, the implant in his head has begun to show signs of malfunction and is starting to affect his mental health.

Conquer 75 satisfying puzzles with increasing mechanics

Discover new mechanics cleverly introduced without tutorials

Experience the story through cinematic cutscenes

Enjoy voice acted cutscenes



When we're all alone, we play games in our mind.

data.name: D1896
data.detailed_description:
D1896 is an action adventure platformer in the style of the early horror movies, inspired specifically by "Le Manoir Du Diable", the first horror movie ever made (it was released in 1896).

The story of D1896 is loooosely based on Georges Melies 3 minute film "Le Manoir Du Diable", Bram Stoker's novel Dracula and Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland.

What is (or isn't) D1896?



  • D1896 is not a metroidvania
  • D1896 has no colors
  • D1896 has no HP bars
  • D1896 has no RPG elements
  • D1896 has only one weapon and no items at all
  • D1896 sounds like piano - you'll never hear any other instruments
  • D1896 has no voice acting
  • D1896 is short
  • D1896 is hard
  • D1896 has no optional content besides one secret boss

So... what D1896 has?



  • D1896 has battles with enemies and bosses
  • D1896 has traps and platforms
  • D1896 has puzzles and mazes
  • D1896 has long dialogues with NPC

That's all D1896 has.

Controls:


Keyboards: W-A-S-D + J-K + ESC

The game supports an Xbox controller (must be plugged in beforehand) (press "Start" if the game asks to press "any button"). If you want to use a different controller or set the controls however you like you might want to use a third-party software like Xpadder.

data.name: REPTILE CHRONICLES
data.detailed_description:
Enter the realm of the reptiles, where magic and might intertwine. "Reptile Chronicles" is a captivating fantasy PVP arena, drawing players into heart-pounding battles set in magnificent 3D environments. Whether you're a wizard craving arcane showdowns or a warrior thirsting for combat, this game is designed for those who seek glory in real-time multiplayer clashes.

Key Features:

Dynamic Magic Combat: Master a wide variety of spells ranging from the classic fireball to the devastating laser beam. Strategize and unleash your arcane powers to decimate the opposition.

Stunning 3D Arenas: Fight across intricately designed battlefields, each boasting its own challenges and opportunities. Every arena is a spectacle of graphics and realism, ensuring players remain immersed in every duel.

Real-time Multiplayer Duels: Engage in intense PVP matches against players from around the world. Forge alliances, challenge foes, and climb the leaderboards to prove your supremacy.

Regular Updates: The world of "Reptile Chronicles" is ever-evolving, with regular updates bringing in new arenas, spells, and champions to ensure the battle never grows old.

Prepare your strategies, sharpen your skills, and step into the arena. In "Reptile Chronicles", only the fiercest will survive. Are you ready for the challenge?

data.name: Cloud Heart
data.detailed_description:
Release date

Planned release date: after August 7th
Hi. Currently, the store page has a planned release date of July 26th, but according to Steam rules, the actual release will be possible at least two weeks after the store page has been visible as 'Coming Soon'.
However, the store page was released without accidentally changing the planned release date.
So, it will be available for purchase from August 7th, two weeks after the release of the store page. Sorry for the confusion.😵


About the Game

The war that swept the heavenly world is finally over. The darkest time has passed, and now the world is full of trench coats, brass phonographs, art-deco-style skyscrapers, and all-night party music instead of machine guns and barbed wire.

In this world, you chase the Cloud Heart, the legendary treasure, at the request of your benefactor. It's a thing that would only appear in trendy adventure movies, which even its existence is uncertain. However, is there a more romantic goal that suits this romantic era than a treasure hunt? And, you have a reason why you can never refuse the request…

Humans are the only race that cannot fly in this world where sky islands float in the sea of clouds and flying is a normal thing. However, humans dream about flying more than any other race. So, they built a flight school.

The main character, Celestine, is a rookie pilot who has just graduated from Canopy Flight School. At the request of Terra, his/her benefactor and best friend, he/she is searching for Cloud Heart, a treasure that has infinite power.

Canopy City, where Celestine lives, is one of the largest and most complex cities in the world. Luxurious parties, propaganda posters left by the war, and unfamiliar races from sky Island are mixed in the heart of the city. Find where Cloud Heart is... and enjoy your daily life in this metropolis.

-Basic system

Cloud Heart is a game of turn-based RPG and adventure.

Players travel around the world and face various stories. In some stories, the player's choice changes the ending and moves the fate of the NPC.

In the game, players find new stories by raising character stats, NPC favorability, and reputation.

New quests and stories will be unlocked as stats, favorability, and reputation increase. The goal of the game is to unlock the story until the ending in this way.

data.name: 遠古大陸-經商世界
data.detailed_description:
這遊戲是一個需要收集資源來建造城鎮的遊戲，遊戲主要類似建築塔防類型的遊戲，一開始要透過雇用小幫手來幫忙採集資源，然後資源可以蓋房子做生產線，最後則是透過城鎮的人口來徵招士兵上戰場對抗敵人。

遊戲本身有單人模式也有聯動模式，聯動模式是和遠古大陸外傳-古道的盡頭做數據的聯動，每個玩家都能選擇自己喜歡的遊玩模式進行遊戲。

1. 遊戲本身操作方式是透過滑鼠或快速鍵來進行建造城鎮

2. 遊戲有追隨者能夠替玩家做採集的工作，採集後的資源可以讓建築做加工，加工過後的資源能夠供應人口，並且使人口成長。

3. 成長的人口可以徵招為士兵，而士兵能夠上戰場抵禦敵人。

4. 遊戲本身是採用與遠古大陸外傳-古道的盡頭相同世界觀，而且有相同數據互相做聯動的。

5. 遊戲的進度是以儲存檔案方式進行，儲存後順便與遠古大陸外傳-古道的盡頭做同步數據傳遞，開啟遊戲一樣也會做聯動。

6. 遊戲聯動是採用Google所提供的Firebase做數據的控管，因此沒有支援Google使用的國家無法做數據的聯動。

7. 遊戲的新規則會隨著更新做出更多新的改動，往後會越推越多新的遊戲玩法。

8.遊戲新增詳細的遊戲指南提供玩法上的詳細解說，使玩家更容易上手此遊戲。

1. 遊戲需要聯動遊玩是必須要有支援Google的國家才能聯動，不過不用擔心遊戲也有單機遊玩的模式可以選擇。

2. 喜歡城市建造或據點塔防的玩家這遊戲可以是玩家不錯的選擇。

3. 遊戲有提供說明手冊讓玩家參閱遊戲更多詳細的規則與內容。

data.name: Liar-for-hire
data.detailed_description:
#8 (prize) place in Ctl+Alt+Disinfo (United with Ukraine Game Jam) competition.

You are a simple guy who joined a dubious company for good money. You have friends, a life, a mother with sick knees, a student sister, and if you close your eyes to who exactly you are working for, the opportunity to build a good future. But will it make sense if the destructive influence of your own organization can lead to the ruination of your present? Our game offers to take the uncomfortable role of a "simple person" and to reconsider the morality of "simple money". Educational gameplay will teach you the tactics of propaganda, disinformation, and how to recognize them in the future.

Sometimes the best way to learn how to stop something is to understand how easy it can be done.

Gameplay

- A series of working days where the hero has to manage resources of a disinformation organization, and undermine people's reputations and trust in the authorities.

- The mechanics of online discussions, where you can both successfully persuade your audience of your point of view, or lose.

- A glossary explaining common disinformation practices, with illustrative examples of how successfully propaganda can affect ordinary life.

- The possibility of bad and good endings that will directly affect the life of the protagonist, and the potential to use your knowledge about disinformation practices for good.

This job is easy. Make news, spread lies and don't think about the consequences.

data.name: Pocket Waifu
data.detailed_description:
This is your story!

Your peaceful life changes overnight when a charming girl unexpectedly moves in with you. From now on, everything depends on your choices. Pick one of three completely different beauties and try to win her heart.

Pocket Waifu is a relaxing and heartfelt dating simulator where your choices matter. There are no right or wrong answers. Just choose what she likes.

Key Features

  • Three Unique Girls — Each with her own vibrant personality, stunning appearance, preferences, and individual reactions. What melts the heart of one may leave another completely indifferent.

  • Natural Dialogues & Reactions — The girls respond to your words and actions in authentic, personal ways — from deep conversations and playful teasing to genuine embarrassment and tender emotions.

  • Freedom of Choice — Freely explore the city, choose different locations, and decide how to spend time together.

  • Gifts & Fashion — Shower her with thoughtful gifts, buy new outfits, and create looks she’ll adore.

  • Unlockable Gallery — Capture beautiful and intimate moments through achievements and special events. Keep your warmest memories forever.

  • Relaxing Strategic Gameplay — Observe, experiment, learn what makes her happy, and gradually become the most important person in her life.

data.name: QBob: Remastered
data.detailed_description:
Play QBob like you never have before in this modernized version of the 1996 shareware classic with updated graphics, music, sounds, levels, and gameplay!

Help QBob leap from rock to rock as he surveys an array of strangely shaped asteroids, all while avoiding a host of alien creatures—each more devious than the last. The job's not done until all the cubes have been marked for demolition. Hit the big red button and skedaddle to your escape rocket before the Big Kaboom!

QBob: Remastered is an action/arcade game, filled with strange space landscapes and bizarre, deadly alien creatures. Prepare to have your nerves jangled and your senses overloaded: the only sound you can hear is the beating of your own heart... that is, until you hear your helmet cracking!

Features:

  • 32 unique levels: 20 from the original game plus 12 brand new bonus levels!

  • Three difficulty settings!

  • Customizable keyboard controls!

  • Mouse and gamepad support!

  • A groovin' soundtrack!

  • Colorful characters, art and environments!

  • Old school arcade intermissions!

  • Pop culture references that were dated even in 1996!

data.name: 花落冬陽 Snowdreams -lost in winter-
data.detailed_description:
相關推薦


About the Game


《花落冬陽》是一款以夢想與思念為主題的戀愛文字冒險遊戲。講述青年在追尋作家之夢的過程中遭遇的困境，以及與兩位女主角的戀愛故事。
▶ 37萬字感動人心的劇情
▶ 50張精美的CG插畫
▶ 20首悠揚的原創音樂
▶ 遊戲全程語音
▶ 豐富的台灣在地元素
▶ 繪師「日津樹伶」、《夜光》作曲家Oli Jan、知名配音團隊「嗓音不甜也有春天」參與製作
　

▌故事｜Story


——離別的冬日，編織出一段夢想與思念的故事

聖誕節前夕，人來人往的台北東區街頭既冰冷又熱絡。謝子臣為了追尋作家之夢而離家，然而無法跨越的現實之壁，卻一次次迫使他退回原點。
租約即將到期，不肯放棄的子臣決定最後一次挑戰時，邂逅了兩名少女：熱情直率的咖啡廳打工女孩「夏芊帆」、以及神秘的幽靈「雪見」。
與兩人的相遇，讓他重新審視自身夢想的初衷，也喚醒了那段被埋藏在內心深處的記憶。渴望再一次向雪許願的青年，他真正的願望是……？
　

▌主要角色｜Characters



本作主角。以職業作家為目標的青年，習於將觀察到的人事物轉化為寫作靈感。他以自己的步調前進著，卻陷入了跨不過去的瓶頸，但今年冬季的某個邂逅將改變他的生活。


悄悄潛伏在子臣住處的幽靈，將子臣視為入侵者，打算把他趕出住處。生前不詳，實際年齡不詳，充滿謎團。時而表現出優雅的舉動，卻也有古靈精怪的一面。


在冬陽咖啡廳打工的女大學生，活潑開朗受到客人的歡迎。對開設屬於自己的咖啡廳懷抱著憧憬，為此正在努力學習。最近似乎被店內某位常客勾起了好奇心。


子臣的好友，個性心直口快、行事灑脫。頂著一頭金髮與一身「性格」的打扮，卻是在出版社上班，從事文藝工作。目前單身，想募集好姻緣。


子臣的妹妹，活潑外向又直率。子臣離家後接手了照顧柴犬Nono的任務，常一起散步。相見時兄妹倆總會拌嘴個幾句，但其實擔心著哥哥，盼望他早點回家。

▌製作團隊｜Staffs


製作團隊：觀象草圖 Astrolabe Draft
原畫：日津樹伶
劇本：嘯風弄月、希比基、月亮熊
音樂：Oli Jan
配音合作：嗓音不甜也有春天
聲音導演：徐偉翔
歌曲填詞與演唱：Uniparity、凍凍

data.name: Arvoch Alliance SE
data.detailed_description:
Arvoch Alliance SE is a first person 3D space combat flight simulation. As a squadron commander in the Alliance Navy, you will take on the challenge of leading a team of fighter pilots through a series of missions spanning the vast region of space known as the Evochron quadrant. As the story unfolds, you will take part in the events that eventually lead to the end of the Federation/Alliance war and the liberation of Evochron. In the midst of an ongoing war, the sudden return of the Vonari signals a dramatic change in the course of human history as forces unite in an epic battle for survival.

Inspired by space combat games of the 80's and 90's, originally released in 2011, and later remastered for the SE update with new features and options (including Workshop and Networking for Steam). Arvoch Alliance was built with a similar focus on space fighter combat, squadron command through issuing orders, intense battles featuring epic explosions, and diverse control capabilities utilizing Newtonian style physics as well as more updated graphics. With single player and multiplayer gameplay modes, varied objectives, advanced avionics/instrumentation, and versatile combat systems, Arvoch Alliance SE provides a feature-packed and immersive space combat experience.

• 3 Single Player Gameplay Modes - Campaign, Custom Campaign, and Instant Action. The Campaign features 30 missions of diverse objectives including escorting, spying, planet surface strikes and recovery, rescuing, capturing, mining, and building. The Custom Campaign mode lets players load missions they design using the mission editor. The Instant Action mode creates a randomly generated combat mission.

• 4 Multiplayer Gameplay Modes - Cooperative Campaign, Dogfight, Squadrons, and Strike. The Cooperative Campaign mode lets players join together to complete the game's built-in campaign. The Dogfight mode is a battle for survival with all players hostile to each other. The Squadrons mode is a team-vs-team battle that lets players choose which side they will fight for and provides stations for each team for repairing and rearming. The Strike mode is also a team-vs-team battle, but it adds a command ship for each team to defend. The first team to destroy the opposing team's command ship wins. The host can define a kill limit or a time limit for the latter 3 modes and can add AI controlled ships to fill in empty player slots. The multiplayer mode also lets players quickly set up battle scenarios to play on their own using the mission options available to the host.

• Advanced Order/Command System - Lead your squadron(s) by issuing commands to specific groups or individual ships using the mouse driven command interface (optional key and button bindings are also available). Give orders to attack, defend, join formation, hold at a particular location you select, or reload, repair, and refuel. Giving the right orders at the right time may often be critical to victory. Your ability to plan and lead can be just as important as your skill in combat.

• Player Controlled Ship Selection And Configuration - Your command authority puts you in charge of which ships your flight group will use during most missions as well as what weapon and equipment configuration your ship will have. A simple drag-n-drop interface lets you quickly select ships and a loadout configuration prior to each mission.

• Diverse and Interactive Environments - Descend into planets from space, travel through dense nebula clouds, fight the powerful winds of a gas giant, balance the pull of a high gravity star, navigate clusters of asteroids, and battle it out in the no-excuses realm of open space. Arvoch Alliance SE features several environments that can impact ship performance, fuel use, weapon availability, visibility, sensor range, and more.

• Extensive Target Selection and Tracking Systems - Monitor the conditions of the battle with the Tactical Console and select ships for orders or targeting right from the console menu. Select targets by mouse clicking on them or use the proximity, gunsight, and list selection options. Track a target's missile count, particle and beam weapon types, speed, shield status, hull and subsystem damage, and even its trajectory with motion ladders.

• Wide Array of Space Combat Systems and Options - Control and manage a range of elements related to space combat including heat signature management, shield array management, energy management, weapon selection spanning three classes, automatic and manual aiming factors, 2D and 3D radar modes, full three rotation axis and three direction axis Newtonian style physics, detailed instrumentation (including six velocity gauges, flight path markers, compass, and pitch ladder), multiple counter measure options, and target specification/status scanning.

• Realistic Newtonian Style Physics Model - Utilize the flight tactics available with the inertial physics system that lets you drift freely and perform maneuvers such as high speed strafe passes and flipping around to fire at a target while flying backwards. Use the afterburner for quick speed and course changes while manually controlling the hull thrusters for additional adjustments. An optional Inertial Dampening System (IDS) is available to help keep flight control easier to manage.

• Detailed 3D Cockpit and Instrumentation - The first person perspective pilot view offers an in-scene 3D cockpit that moves and responds to control input and impacts for a realistic sense of being in the ship itself. A helmet visor based Heads-Up-Display (HUD) renders important information that matches the pilot's view and is center focused. As much information as feasible is displayed on the central HUD gunsight and directly on the target being tracked for quick information gathering and situational awareness. Players who prefer an unobstructed view can optionally turn off the 3D cockpit, leaving only the HUD and displays.

• New Graphics Engine and Effects - The new Vulkan based graphics engine provides several new special effects.

• Event and Time Driven Missions - The new mission structure allows for in-game dialogues, ship departures, ambushes, and other timed events to occur. Players can even design their own dynamic campaigns in branching mission structures (where victory or defeat determines the next course of the campaign) using the optional mission editor.

• New Music and Sound Effects - Dynamic music system (with music by Rich Douglas). The music changes with the level of hostility around you.

• Diverse and Flexible Control Options - Supports keyboard, mouse, gamepad, and joystick flight control. Use the control device you prefer to play the game. The game supports up to 10 simultaneous control devices with up to 40 buttons each.

• Full Support for TrackIR - Natural Point's TrackIR 3D head control system lets the player manage the viewpoint from the cockpit with all six degrees of movement.
data.about_the_game:
Arvoch Alliance SE is a first person 3D space combat flight simulation. As a squadron commander in the Alliance Navy, you will take on the challenge of leading a team of fighter pilots through a series of missions spanning the vast region of space known as the Evochron quadrant. As the story unfolds, you will take part in the events that eventually lead to the end of the Federation/Alliance war and the liberation of Evochron. In the midst of an ongoing war, the sudden return of the Vonari signals a dramatic change in the course of human history as forces unite in an epic battle for survival.

Inspired by space combat games of the 80's and 90's, originally released in 2011, and later remastered for the SE update with new features and options (including Workshop and Networking for Steam). Arvoch Alliance was built with a similar focus on space fighter combat, squadron command through issuing orders, intense battles featuring epic explosions, and diverse control capabilities utilizing Newtonian style physics as well as more updated graphics. With single player and multiplayer gameplay modes, varied objectives, advanced avionics/instrumentation, and versatile combat systems, Arvoch Alliance SE provides a feature-packed and immersive space combat experience.

• 3 Single Player Gameplay Modes - Campaign, Custom Campaign, and Instant Action. The Campaign features 30 missions of diverse objectives including escorting, spying, planet surface strikes and recovery, rescuing, capturing, mining, and building. The Custom Campaign mode lets players load missions they design using the mission editor. The Instant Action mode creates a randomly generated combat mission.

• 4 Multiplayer Gameplay Modes - Cooperative Campaign, Dogfight, Squadrons, and Strike. The Cooperative Campaign mode lets players join together to complete the game's built-in campaign. The Dogfight mode is a battle for survival with all players hostile to each other. The Squadrons mode is a team-vs-team battle that lets players choose which side they will fight for and provides stations for each team for repairing and rearming. The Strike mode is also a team-vs-team battle, but it adds a command ship for each team to defend. The first team to destroy the opposing team's command ship wins. The host can define a kill limit or a time limit for the latter 3 modes and can add AI controlled ships to fill in empty player slots. The multiplayer mode also lets players quickly set up battle scenarios to play on their own using the mission options available to the host.

• Advanced Order/Command System - Lead your squadron(s) by issuing commands to specific groups or individual ships using the mouse driven command interface (optional key and button bindings are also available). Give orders to attack, defend, join formation, hold at a particular location you select, or reload, repair, and refuel. Giving the right orders at the right time may often be critical to victory. Your ability to plan and lead can be just as important as your skill in combat.

• Player Controlled Ship Selection And Configuration - Your command authority puts you in charge of which ships your flight group will use during most missions as well as what weapon and equipment configuration your ship will have. A simple drag-n-drop interface lets you quickly select ships and a loadout configuration prior to each mission.

• Diverse and Interactive Environments - Descend into planets from space, travel through dense nebula clouds, fight the powerful winds of a gas giant, balance the pull of a high gravity star, navigate clusters of asteroids, and battle it out in the no-excuses realm of open space. Arvoch Alliance SE features several environments that can impact ship performance, fuel use, weapon availability, visibility, sensor range, and more.

• Extensive Target Selection and Tracking Systems - Monitor the conditions of the battle with the Tactical Console and select ships for orders or targeting right from the console menu. Select targets by mouse clicking on them or use the proximity, gunsight, and list selection options. Track a target's missile count, particle and beam weapon types, speed, shield status, hull and subsystem damage, and even its trajectory with motion ladders.

• Wide Array of Space Combat Systems and Options - Control and manage a range of elements related to space combat including heat signature management, shield array management, energy management, weapon selection spanning three classes, automatic and manual aiming factors, 2D and 3D radar modes, full three rotation axis and three direction axis Newtonian style physics, detailed instrumentation (including six velocity gauges, flight path markers, compass, and pitch ladder), multiple counter measure options, and target specification/status scanning.

• Realistic Newtonian Style Physics Model - Utilize the flight tactics available with the inertial physics system that lets you drift freely and perform maneuvers such as high speed strafe passes and flipping around to fire at a target while flying backwards. Use the afterburner for quick speed and course changes while manually controlling the hull thrusters for additional adjustments. An optional Inertial Dampening System (IDS) is available to help keep flight control easier to manage.

• Detailed 3D Cockpit and Instrumentation - The first person perspective pilot view offers an in-scene 3D cockpit that moves and responds to control input and impacts for a realistic sense of being in the ship itself. A helmet visor based Heads-Up-Display (HUD) renders important information that matches the pilot's view and is center focused. As much information as feasible is displayed on the central HUD gunsight and directly on the target being tracked for quick information gathering and situational awareness. Players who prefer an unobstructed view can optionally turn off the 3D cockpit, leaving only the HUD and displays.

• New Graphics Engine and Effects - The new Vulkan based graphics engine provides several new special effects.

• Event and Time Driven Missions - The new mission structure allows for in-game dialogues, ship departures, ambushes, and other timed events to occur. Players can even design their own dynamic campaigns in branching mission structures (where victory or defeat determines the next course of the campaign) using the optional mission editor.

• New Music and Sound Effects - Dynamic music system (with music by Rich Douglas). The music changes with the level of hostility around you.

• Diverse and Flexible Control Options - Supports keyboard, mouse, gamepad, and joystick flight control. Use the control device you prefer to play the game. The game supports up to 10 simultaneous control devices with up to 40 buttons each.

• Full Support for TrackIR - Natural Point's TrackIR 3D head control system lets the player manage the viewpoint from the cockpit with all six degrees of movement.
data.short_description: Advanced First Person Space Flight Combat Simulation.

data.name: Arcade Shop Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Arcade Shop Simulator is an immersive first-person simulator where you step into the shoes of an ambitious entrepreneur, running a small but promising arcade shop. Your ultimate goal is to transform your humble establishment into the Ultimate Arcade Empire!


Build your collection of arcade cabinets by scouting deals, haggling with sellers, and carefully weighing factors like condition, size, and game popularity. Open your doors to eager teenagers ready to play. Collect your earnings, and make strategic choices: should you invest in new machines or repair the one you already have?

But running an arcade isn’t all fun and games! Keep your shop spotless and welcoming to earn good reviews and boost your reputation. A higher reputation means more traffic and higher profits.

Take your business to the next level by upgrading your tools. Fix machines faster, clean more efficiently with a vacuum cleaner, and automate cash transfer with wireless money collectors.

Unleash your creativity and personalize your arcade shop! Purchase decorations and furniture to give your shop a one-of-a-kind vibe that’ll wow your customers and enhance your reputation. And when your current space can't handle the hype, expand your empire by buying additional floorspace and making room for even more epic arcade experiences.

Are you ready to build the arcade of your dreams and dominate the world of gaming?

data.name: Hamster Clicker!
data.detailed_description:
Hamster Clicker!

Welcome to the world of Hamster Clicker — a fun and engaging clicker that will steal your heart! Help the adorable hamster girl collect coins and unlock new outfits in this dynamic adventure!

Story

In a faraway magical forest, there lives a hamster girl who dreams of becoming the happiest and most successful in her world. Together with you, she will collect coins and acquire new outfits, becoming more beautiful with each step. Help her on this incredible journey and become a true clicker master!

COLLECT YOUR COLLECTION OF HAMSTERS!

Game Features:

  • Intuitive gameplay: Easy to learn, hard to put down! Simply tap the screen to collect coins and help your hamster girl grow.

  • Upgrade system: Unlock new outfits and items for your character as you progress through levels.

  • Colorful graphics and animation: Enjoy high-quality animation and charming character design.

  • Simple yet engaging progression: Pass through numerous levels, each offering new outfits and items for your hamster girl.

  • Compete with friends: Surpass your friends and players worldwide by climbing to the top of the global leaderboard.

  • Shop: Purchase various items in the shop to make your hamster girl even more attractive.

data.name: Grey Havok's Crystal War
data.detailed_description:
Grey Havok's Crystal War is a chaotic arcade FPS where you defend powerful crystals from waves of monsters, mutants, flying enemies, and oversized nightmare fuel. Fight solo, team up locally, or jump into

Steam online multiplayer as you blast through arenas, survive escalating waves, and try to keep the crystal and yourself alive.

Choose your character, customize your guns, grab power-ups, and push through multiple game modes built for fast action and endless replays.

Features

-Wave Defense

Unlock levels and protect the crystal surviving all the waves.

-Inferno

There is no end.  You will not survive. 

- Local Multiplayer

Play couch co-op or local 1P vs 2P modes with split-screen support.

- Steam Online Multiplayer

Create or join online lobbies and fight through networked matches with friends.

- 1P vs 2P Battles

Face off in player-versus-player modes while customizable enemies and hazards keep the pressure on.

-High Scores

Each mode tracks high scores.

- Power-Ups

Turn the fight around with pickups like health, ammo, grenades, freeze time, and other boosts.

- Character Customization

Pick different characters and head styles to personalize your player before jumping in.

- Cheat Codes

Unlock goofy and powerful modifiers, including DK Mode, party lights, rainbow guns, god mode, and more.

- Enemy Variety

Many strange and demented enemies with different abilities to fight.

- Arcade FPS Chaos

Fast movement, loud weapons, monster swarms, glowing crystals, portals, explosions, and plenty of “what just happened?” moments.

Defend the crystal, survive the waves, and bring a friend if you want someone else to blame.

KAFAK –  Build your colony, craft, survive, and fight .

When a strange extraterrestrial organism fell from the sky, it appeared like a parasite-like,It could invade the human body through take full control of a person’s actions. In the early days, only a small portion of the population was infected, but it spread rapidly like a virus. Those who were taken over were forced to harm others. The government tried to contain the situation by declaring a state of emergency and deploying officers and military forces to suppress the threat, but it was already too late. Within just a few weeks, more than 90% of the nation’s population had been overtaken by the creature.

Society nearly collapsed. Order and law vanished. The remaining survivors had to hide carefully, because being possessed meant losing their humanity completely. They were forced to fight to preserve whatever remained of their human selves.

data.name: AntiBots
data.detailed_description:
AntiBots is an online PvP arena party game for 2-4 players where anti-gravity constantly switches on and off.

Armed with explosive bullets and a speedy grappling hook, face off against your friends across 12 different maps and 6 unique gamemodes to become the ultimate champion!

Combat


  • Players cannot be shot directly, bullets will simply pass through them
  • Instead, bullets will explode on contact with any surface, instantly eliminating anyone in it's radius - this explosion will travel through walls!
  • Remember, no surface is safe! Use the environment to eliminate your enemies from angles they never saw coming

Anti-Gravity


  • All arenas have been fitted with Anti-Gravity devices, which will power up as rounds progress
  • Be prepared! Gravity will fluctuate frequently, so be ready to adjust your strategies on-the-fly
  • Keep an eye on the progess bars found throughout the arenas to track Anti-Gravity progress

Gamemodes


  • Deathmatch: Eliminate other players to gain points
  • Heist: Pickup and hold onto the battery whilst avoiding everyone else to gain points
  • Elimination: Round-based, last player standing each round gets a point

  • Hunt: Round-based, one player becomes the hunter and must eliminate all other players before time runs out
  • Control: Stand alone inside the control zone to capture it and gain a point

data.name: Layers of Fear 2 (2019)
data.detailed_description:
The acclaimed sequel that redefined the award-winning series. Climb aboard a mysterious ocean liner as you step into the shoes of an actor called to perform under strange circumstances by a director with unsettling intentions.

Echoes of past performances twist into distorted memories, props become threats, and the line between stage and self begins to collapse. With every step, you’re pushed to achieve the director’s cryptic demands – and answer the question of what you’re willing to sacrifice for the perfect role.

Created by the modern masters of horror at Bloober Team, Layers of Fear 2 is a feast of cinematic storytelling amidst shifting, nightmarish environments.

Game Features:

  • Story-driven Exploration – Explore the world around you in order to uncover your past and reveal the hidden reasons why you were chosen for this role.

  • Psychological Horror – Is this part of the film, or are your memories playing tricks on you? The world may change in an instant and only you can decide what's real and what's not.

  • Unique Ocean Liner Setting – As you descend into the depths of the ship, the scenes you shoot for the film grow ever more surreal, and ever more terrifying.

  • Classical Ominous Soundtrack – An original score composed by Arkadiusz Reikowski, conducted by George Strezov, and performed by the Sofia Session Orchestra.

data.name: Evercoil
data.detailed_description:
Evercoil starts with a familiar problem: eat an apple, grow a little, don't hit your tail. Then another snake cuts across your path, a volcano wakes up, and the way out is on the other side of your own body.

In this endless Snake survival game, growing gives you more room to explore and more ways to get yourself into trouble.

Give yourself room to grow


Eat to grow and open new zones of the arena. Slip through narrow gaps, take portals across the map and keep a way back open. Every segment you add makes the next turn a little harder.

Make your own traps


Rival snakes share the arena. Some keep their distance, some defend their territory and some come straight for you. Cut off their escape and pin them against a wall with your body. A long snake can be someone else's problem too.

Keep a power in reserve


Chests hold powers you store until you need them. Slow time, phase through a wall or jump out of a bad spot. Obsidian lets you cross lava while it lasts. Unlock more powers between runs and decide which deserve a place in your limited inventory.

You'll need the help. Lava spreads, volcanoes lob fireballs, and rival snakes get faster and more dangerous the longer you survive.

Race your friends


Host a private match and race up to three friends online. Everyone starts small in one arena, with every power unlocked and nobody's upgrades. Shared food opens the arena wider, roaming snakes give growth to whoever traps them, and the first snake to reach length 50 wins. If nobody reaches length 50 within ten minutes, the longest snake wins. Empty slots fill with AI racers on Easy, Medium or Hard.

Come back with a plan


Keep the gold you earn and spend it on permanent upgrades between runs. Add health, carry more powers or open bigger arenas. Then go again, beat your best score and see how far you get this time.



There is no final wave. Keep eating, keep moving, and try to leave yourself a way out.

Features

  • Endless solo runs that speed up over time, with no boss or forced time limit
  • Three rival temperaments you can read at a glance: passive, territorial and aggressive
  • Six powers, from Slow Time and Wall Phase to Bulldozer Head and Slimy Snake
  • Volcano eruptions, spreading lava lakes and one-way portals
  • Permanent gold upgrades, a best-run leaderboard and 19 achievements
  • Online multiplayer for up to four players through Steam, with AI racers for empty slots
  • Rebindable keys, separate volume controls, adjustable screen shake and flashes, and a high-contrast mode

Translation notice

Non-English store descriptions and in-game text were translated with AI and may contain errors or awkward phrasing.

data.name: Techno Prank
data.detailed_description:
"Head of Section Two, report to Office 314 immediately!"

Techno Prank is an immersive simulator of a techno prankster’s life — a chaotic blend of creativity, absurdity, and total audio mayhem.

Find phone numbers, call people using pre-recorded lines from others, record their shocked replies, and reuse them to trick the next poor soul. Dig into your victims’ secrets, uncover weird mysteries, and turn your mischief into a full-blown show for your growing audience.

Talk Like You Belong

You’ll meet dozens of unique characters who aren't too happy to hear from strangers at first.

Use familiar voices to earn their trust, take advantage of duty or emotion, and push them deeper into surreal conversations. Or just sit back and enjoy the beautiful chaos you’ve created.

You can throw in any recorded phrase — from anyone, at any time. Even use your target’s own voice! But be careful — if something feels off, they’ll hang up and ghost you forever.

The Art of the Prank

Stream your calls live in-game to build your fanbase, grab donations, and climb the viral ladder. Become the most notorious prankster on the net… unless the police catch wind of what you're doing.

You’ll start small — cheap food, random gigs, and terrible sleep. But it’s all worth it for your creative rise to chaos stardom.

Check the prankster community daily for new phrases and fresh targets. Who knows who’s next on the list?

The more phrases you collect, the more combinations you can create — and the deeper your conversations will go. Absurdity, freedom, and improvisation are your tools. The rest? That’s up to your twisted imagination.

  • Haptic feedback
  • Support for custom skins

data.name: Empire Eleven 2026
data.detailed_description:
Game made by 1 person without million-dollar funding. Please be patient, we will improve over time <3

Empire Eleven is a premier football management simulator where you take total control of your club, stepping into the shoes of a Manager or even the President/CEO. From tactical decisions on the pitch to high-level financial strategies off it, every choice dictates the success or failure of your organization.

Key Features:

  • CEO/President Mode: A deep and complex management system. Oversee club finances, set ticket prices, negotiate sponsorship deals, and much more.

  • Multi-Club Ownership: Create and manage your own group of clubs to dominate multiple leagues simultaneously.

  • Wealth Progression: Your salary as a Manager isn't just a number. Reinvest your earnings to buy Clubs, Stadiums, and even become a Sponsor yourself.

  • Infinite Replayability: Thousands of stories waiting to be told—from leading a bottom-tier side to the heights of the global elite.

Experience the match through a specialized 2D tactical view. Be prepared for every moment of the game. Master the pitch. And everything beyond it.

Designed to be mechanically complex yet relaxing in execution, Empire Eleven allows you to dive into spreadsheets and financial projections without the pressure of punishing timers. It is pure strategy, distilled into a clean and intuitive interface.

  • Total President Mode: Control the club’s destiny far beyond the touchline. Negotiate multi-million dollar sponsorships, manage stakeholder expectations, and dictate the commercial direction of the franchise.

  • Stakeholder Management: Keep investors satisfied and board members informed. Your financial decisions shape the market’s confidence in your project.

  • World-Class Infrastructure: Design and expand your stadium and centers of excellence. Every upgrade directly impacts revenue and youth development.

  • Customizable Club Culture: Define your team’s philosophy. Will you be a talent-producing powerhouse or a buyer of global superstars?

Transform a regional club into a commercial juggernaut. Manage everything from match-day pricing to global naming rights contracts.

  • Strategic Transfer Market: Buy low, sell high. Use data analytics to find undervalued talent and maximize ROI (Return on Investment) with every sale.

  • Deep Financial Ecosystem: A realistic economic model where cash flow is as vital as the scoreline. Navigate carefully through Financial Fair Play regulations!

Take total control of the footballing world with our powerful In-Game Editor. Shape the beautiful game exactly how you envision it:

  • Complete Customization: Build your own leagues, create custom clubs, and mold players from scratch.

  • Master the Database: Control every aspect of the football ecosystem with ease.

  • Datapacks & Community: Create your own custom Datapacks and share them with the world!

  • Mod Hub: Join our community and download content from our dedicated Modding Hub, available on our official website.

Your legacy starts in the front office. Build more than just a team; construct an institution that stands the test of time. From financial ledgers to the top of the podium, the fate of the club is in your hands. Do you have what it takes to become the greatest CEO in football history?

Master the pitch. And everything beyond it.

Add to your Wishlist now and start planning your dynasty.

data.name: Dracula Awakens
data.detailed_description:
Dracula Awakens is a short horror game about Dracula's return to this world.

A world where you desperately need to keep your job. And to do so, you offer to get evidence about the disappearance of a man in Dracula's castle, which was a tourist attraction before the incident.

Since the police didn't care about the immigrant man, you will find out what happened to him.

Welcome to Dracula's Castle




Here you will find:

  • An ancient vampire lord with his wife chasing you
  • Retro style low poly graphics
  • Unique puzzles
  • A castle and catacombs to explore
  • Bats and ghosts to use your super flash camera
  • Multiple endings

data.name: Adventure Master
data.detailed_description:
This unique trivia game is the perfect way to be tested to see if you could actually follow in the steps of the famous adventurers, Indiana Jones and Nathan Drake! Developed by a professional treasure hunt designer with hunts facilitated all over the world, this trivia game will test your knowledge on everything from outdoor survival skills and basic handguns to geography and world history to even how to SCUBA and basic plane flight and so much more.

You find yourself stumbling across the Quest Adventure Society, an underground society responsible for creating adventure across the globe, and desire desperately to become a member of the team. They don’t accept new members so readily, though. You’re tasked with finding 50 treasures hidden all over the world. You’ll go from location to location in a treasure hunt fashion to find each treasure and only way to continue on your adventure will be to correctly answer trivia questions on a variety of topics that Jones and Drake would likely know. With numerous randomizers utilized, there are literally trillions of possible combinations of locations and trivia questions possible to find each treasure.

Additionally, sometimes when you answer a question correctly you’ll be given an opportunity to answer a BONUS question based on classic adventure stories in the movies and literature for additional experience points in various categories.

Your progress is also tracked with a variety of possible XP categories from specialties in specific continents to proficiencies in vehicle handling and negotiating jungle terrain. Over 20 different categories are tracked.

No matter what your knowledge base currently is, find all 50 treasures in this game and you’ll be primed by the end to travel the globe in search of your own real world adventures.

This game plays in your Internet browser and with nearly 1500 adventure trivia questions being asked, you’ve likely never been tested like this before...

data.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II
data.detailed_description:
Peace is but a memory.

In the wake of the Noble Faction’s occupation of Heimdallr, civil war has broken out across Erebonia. The provincial armies, loyal to the aristocracy and the Four Great Houses, have claimed many of the nation’s great cities in the name of the Noble Alliance. The Imperial Army, called back from the four corners of the Empire, has only just begun its sweeping counterattack.

After Rean managed to escape Trista with Celine and Valimar, he awakens in the mountains near his hometown uncertain what fate befell his friends, who bravely threw themselves in harm’s way to buy him time to flee.

Though the road will not be an easy one, Rean decides to take up his sword again, journeying across Erebonia with his Divine Knight, Valimar, in search of his friends from Class VII and a way to end the conflict before its price becomes far too dear…

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Taking place on the same continent as the fan favorite Trails in the Sky offshoot of Nihon Falcom’s storied The Legend of Heroes franchise, Trails of Cold Steel II (Sen no Kiseki II in Japanese) is a direct sequel to Trails of Cold Steel, picking up one month after the decisive collision that changed the fate of the entire nation of Erebonia. The speedy, tactical turn-based combat with the newly-developed “ARCUS” system returns with all the bells and whistles together with the new Overdrive mode, new means of transportation both across the land and sky, new allies, new dangers, and a renewed sense of hope as Rean tirelessly works to right the wrongs that have led the country to disarray.

KEY FEATURES


  • A Direct Sequel that Remembers the Past
    Clear data from Trails of Cold Steel carries over into Trails of Cold Steel II, granting players bonuses, and most importantly, remembering the many relationships cultivated during time spent at Thors Military Academy, allowing for more personalized conversations throughout the story.

  • Take to the Land and Sky in New Modes of Transportation
    Fast travel isn’t just for Trista anymore; a personalized airship now allows players to swiftly choose and descend upon both familiar and foreign destinations alike—and on land, horseback riding not only returns, but players can now customize and utilize Angelica’s orbal bike for fast transportation across the map.

  • The Link System Returns with a new Overdrive Mode
    Bonding with allies continues to pay off with the Combat Link System, netting a variety of combat benefits including healing, guarding, and more, and the new Overdrive mode allows linked characters to attack up to three turns in a row for new strategic battle options.

  • Experience the Game as Never Before
    50% more lines of English voice-overs have been added to the PC release, bringing a fresh experience to even those who have played it before on console. New features for this release include ultrawide aspect ratio support, turbo mode, and an instant resume feature that allows players to launch directly from Steam to their most recent save.

data.name: Spheric Bombs
data.detailed_description:
Explore an Explosive World of Strategy and Reflection!

Immerse yourself in a turn-based 3D tactical puzzle game that tests your strategic skills. Guide a bomb through stimulating grid-based levels, where every move counts. Face unique challenges, unlock achievements, plan your strategy and survive to claim victory. Are you prepared to tackle the most challenging puzzles?

Key Features:

  • 25 Unique Levels: Go through a variety of levels, each presenting unique challenges and objectives.

  • Unlock 25 Achievements: Showcase your skills by unlocking 25 achievements, earned by completing each level with 100 life points.

  • Explosive Tactical Puzzles: Engage in a captivating blend of puzzle-solving and tactical decision-making, putting your thinking skills to the test.

  • Strategic Buffs and Debuffs: Consider the strategically placed buffs and debuffs throughout the various levels, adding a tactical dimension to every decision.

Face 8 Types of Enemies:

Discover imposing opponents, each possessing distinct characteristics. Anticipate their moves to survive, but beware, when they fuse, they become even more powerful!

  • Pyrospheric: Walks on magma cubes without taking damage.

  • Hydrospheric: Walks on water cubes.

  • Atmospheric: Jumps up to 4 cubes instead of 2.

  • Terraspheric: Reduces the player's damage resistance.

  • Chronospheric: Add 2 turns to the game.

  • Tempospheric: Skips the next player's turn.

  • Sinistospheric: Inflicts fatal damage to the player.

  • Electrospheric: Moves by 2 cubes instead of 1.

Fusion Rule:

If enemies are at the same level, the moving one consumes the stationary one. Otherwise, the higher-level always consumes the lower-level.

Buffs and Debuffs:

The player can pick up buffs and debuffs by passing through or by finishing on them. These effects apply only to the player.

Achievement Hunter Tips:

  • Sometimes, it's better to skip your turn on the current cube.

  • Be aware of the enemies playing order to take advantage of it.

  • Git Gud.

Developer's Note:

I'm thrilled to share this game with you. Your support means the world to me as a solo developer. Have fun and good luck!

data.name: Rack and Slay
data.detailed_description:
THE BILLIARDS ROGUELIKE

A pure-fun roguelike dungeon crawler where you're a billiard ball making your way through randomly generated levels full of monster balls, traps, collectible power-ups and more!

DRAFT YOUR BUILD

Between levels, draft from a wide variety of 100+ items with game-changing effects (all of which are stackable) to find combos, build synergies and refine your playstyle!

ASCEND THE LADDER

Battle through 20 levels of difficulty, each one adding more challenging modifiers!

VALUE YOUR TIME

While you unlock additional items by playing for even greater variety, there's NO meta treadmill "+1% power" grind!

PLAY YOUR WAY

Play a full 10-level dungeon crawl in 20-30 minutes, or choose the condensed Delve Mode with half the levels but extra loot, or tackle a single-level raid with random items.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

Wins are not just tracked per difficulty and mode, but you also receive difficulty-specific badges for each item you win a run with. Fill your item compendium and collect them all!

SUPPORT AN INDIE TEAM OF 2

Design & Code: Fabian Fischer (@Ludokultur)

Art & Animations: Victor Negreiro (@estivador)

FEATURES (if you're into lists)

  • UNIQUE GAMEPLAY: Face physics-based billiards combat challenges tied together by a roguelike run structure in a dungeon setting!

  • LONG-TERM REPLAYABILITY: Procedural dungeon layouts filled with randomized monsters, obstacles and power-ups combine with a large variety of 100+ items to draft from to ensure no two runs play the same!

  • RELENTLESS CHALLENGE: Climb through 20 difficulty levels, each one modifying the game to become more challenging!

  • GAME MODES: Play a full dungeon crawl in 20-30 minutes, or condense your run to half the length with extra loot, or tackle a single-level raid for just a few minutes!

  • ENDLESS MODE: Continue after winning a run to see how broken your build can get!

  • DAILY RUNS: Face a new gauntlet featuring a unique combination of run modifiers every single day!

  • SIMPLE CONTROLS: Pick-up-and-play controls make sure you’ll aim and shoot (via mouse or controller) within seconds!

data.name: Colossus Down
data.detailed_description:
Nika has just finished the first phase of her plan to destroy everything that isn't cool: the construction of a combat mecha called MechaNika. There's no time to lose, so join forces with her, get your hands on MechaNika's controls and demolish the entire planet. You have to put an end to history books, planned obsolescence, kitschy dresses, never-ending sagas of boring video games and pea soup.

And if there's someone in the world that hates vegetables more than Nika, it's her friend Agatha, the insomniac butcher and prophetess of Carnivorism that loves animals and their succulent meat in equal measure. That's why, when she learns of the objectives of Nika's plan, she doesn't hesitate to join the mission of destruction alongside the Great Bleeding Pig, god of Carnivorism, to subdue any grass-eating, non-believers that get in the way.

But watch out, because along the way you'll realise that Nika and Agatha are not the only ones that have a plan to change the world, and not everything's as simple as it might have seemed at the start. You'll have to make some tough and irreversible decisions to achieve your objectives, or renounce them.

  • Join forces with Nika, get behind the controls of MechaNika and bring an end to everything that isn't cool.

  • Convert your mission into a cooperative experience for 2 players with Agatha and the Great Bleeding Pig.

  • Manage your resources during combat and execute endless, strategic combos to cause more and more harm to your enemies.

  • Unlock the dumbshredder, the chopping tornado, the groundcracker, the scarlet vomit and up to 8 devastating special attacks.

  • Take on innumerable challenges in a combination of beat'em up, shoot'em up, platforming and puzzles.

  • Discover the Neon District, Candyland and the rest of the Psychotic world through 18 totally distinct levels.

  • Locate all of the geeky references, illustrated in a unique visual style.

  • Revel in an original, varied, dynamic and immersive soundtrack.

  • Take crucial and thought-provoking decisions during your quest and discover the 4 alternative endings for this epic and twisted adventure.

  • Complete the mission with infinite lives or with just one chance in permadeath mode, if you dare...

data.name: Dream Team Supreme
data.detailed_description:
Pilot the two-headed Super Supreme across lands unknown, battling boxing octopi, blood-sucking burgers, giant stone feet, and other memorable kaiju. Defeat them in battle, upgrade cartridge decks and Super Supreme, and stop the invasion to save the world in co-op or solo modes!

Choose two scientists from a group of five, each with their own specialized decks of cartridges, to pilot Super Supreme each run. Find the synergies between each scientist, earn new carts and upgrades after each battle to concoct kaiju-crushing combos! Play with a friend or control both pilots solo.

Plug cartridges into a predictive beat sequence shared by the monster! Plan out the perfect turn, “Lock In” and watch Super Supreme execute the actions in order. Mind the order of single-sided, double-sided, and instantly-used cartridges in each scientists’ arsenal to make the most of each sequence, and converting unused blocks into momentum to power up for the next round!

Take on a new challenge every run! Explore different map options, experiment with new cartridges, and test the latest mods for Super Supreme on each journey. Discover new strategies while earning unlockable content, which creates near-endless combinations to master!

Just like the scientists that make up Dream Team Supreme, we believe in a strong feedback loop and testing our hypotheses. We regularly organize playtests and seek your feedback for future updates! Join the community on Discord for development news, co-op partners, and join our experiment!

The playable demo is available in English only at this time. For your convenience, we localized the demo and store page using Google Translate. If you would like to assist with localization, please join the Discord.

data.name: Hold the Bastion
data.detailed_description:
Early Access. The game is fully playable and updated often.

Defend a bastion against an onslaught of goblins that attack from all sides. How long can you hold out?

Three classes, six weapons. Play the Ranger, Engineer or Warden. Fight with bows, crossbows and fire, two weapons per class, each with its own skill tree.

Choose your build. Shape your weapon through branching skills, from phantom archers and mobile batteries to burning roads and bouncing meteors.

Build between waves. Raise turrets and towers, shore up your walls, then watch them tear into the horde.

No two runs alike. Collect cards as you go. Stack the right ones and build something that shouldn't work, until it does.

data.name: Card Draw
data.detailed_description:
CARD DRAW is a relaxing roguelike deck builder where you construct equations with your cards to earn points.

HOW TO PLAY

Draw cards from your deck to create equations and earn points for your final score.

Use ability cards to discover strategies and synergies to earn even more points.

Spend points in the shop to expand your deck with new cards and abilities.

Your score is your currency: points you spend in the shop are deducted from your score, you should carefully determine when it's time to stop buying cards and start accumulating points.

FULL GAME CONTENT

  • 7 DIFFERENT GAME MODES:

    • RELAXING MODE
      Draw cards and see your score go up

    • STRATEGIC MODE
      Draw and place cards to craft the perfect equation

    • SURVIVAL MODE Level up and survive for as many turns as possible

    • IDLE MODE
      Watch your score grow while you do other things

    • ADVENTURE MODE
      Solve quests to earn new draws and play longer

    • DECKBUILDER MODE
      Craft the perfect deck with the cards in your collection

    • CHALLENGE MODE
      Solve challenges and math puzzles with your cards

  • ONLINE LEADERBOARDS

  • 1000+ card & ability types

  • STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS

  • Challenges, playground, cards collection, and more!

data.name: The Crooked Table
data.detailed_description:
At the start of every game each player gets a secret role. Nobody knows who is on which side, and the whole table pulls on one shared number: the Group Score.

  • The Team Players (two of them) win together. They work to push the Group Score up, and when it's high enough they win, as long as their combined Player Score beats the Neutral's.

  • The Saboteur works against the table, quietly dragging the Group Score down. Sink it low enough and the Saboteur wins, unless the Neutral has scored more.

  • The Neutral doesn't care which way the Group Score goes. They play for their own Player Score, and whichever end the game reaches, a high enough personal score steals the win from either side.

So the Team Players need each other, but can't be sure who the other one is. The Saboteur has to look like a Team Player. And the Neutral is happy to help anyone, as long as it pays.

The Crooked Table is a social deduction card game for 4 players. Sit down at a candlelit tavern table, play your cards face down, and tell everyone what they are. Lie if you like. Just don't get caught.

Every change to the Group Score is only revealed at the end of the round, all added together. Did that card really push it up? Who dragged it down? Watch the drums turn, then work out who's lying.

Every turn you play one card face down and announce what it is. Play it honestly, claim a card you don't have, or disguise one card as another. Nobody sees the truth unless somebody calls you on it.

  • Group Score cards push the shared score up or down.

  • Player Score cards add to your own score, or knock points off a rival.

  • Balance cards win you more chips to gamble with.

When a card goes down, the hourglass turns. Think it's a lie? Wager your chips and call it. The card rises over the table and flips for everyone to see.

  • Caught lying: the card is cancelled and the liar pays your wager.

  • Telling the truth: you were wrong, and you pay them.

Every call is remembered. Get caught once, and the whole table will be watching your next claim.

Every few rounds the centerpiece opens and the shop rises out of the table. Spend your chips on items that bend the rules:

  • Iron Nerve: your next card can't be challenged.

  • Bounty: put a price on someone. Catch them lying for an extra reward.

  • Loaded Purse: if your next bluff is caught, the bank pays for it.

  • Double Down: your next Group Score card counts twice.

  • Borrowed Shield: protect another player from an attack, and get paid when it blocks one.

  • Saboteur's Kit, Tax Collector, Confession Box, Private Message and more.

  • Online with up to 4 players, each seated at the same table.

  • Built-in voice chat: accuse, deny and swear you're telling the truth. Characters move their mouths and turn their heads to whoever they're watching.

  • AI players fill empty seats. They bluff, call your bluffs and shop for themselves.

  • 最具特色的技能习得系统再提升，单一角色、多重养成方向，是剑术是魔法，随您挑选
  • 超大型等比例地图首领登场，巨大震撼的压迫感将考验您的战略与战术应用
  • 角色方向性的概念系统导入，更为多元与刺激的战略性将让您爱不释手

  • 自由的角色升级配点系统导入，搭配多元化的技能学习，爱怎么玩就怎么玩
  • 自由在武防加入特性的鍊金系统搭载，高达数千种变化的装备品任您随意打造
  • 最新技术制作，突破传统２维空间概念的３Ｄ化运镜必杀技导入，叹为观止的表现将震憾您心
  • 多达数百种，使用效果、特色截然不同的职业特技，让您怎么玩都有全新的游戏体验
  • 超过千张，最精细角色动作所呈现的动感战斗体验，将带给您超乎想象的次世代游戏乐趣
  • 大人气的魔兽捕捉系统登场，喜欢哪只可爱敌人，都可以抓牠来变成同伴唷
  • 高度战略思考功能的ＡＩ系统再提升，个性丰富拟人的敌物将与您展开多场刺激的激烈对战
  • 飘雪、下雨、舞叶、夕雾，最优３Ｄ引擎所呈现的华丽场景将带您一窥这如梦似幻的风色世界
  • 最易上手的半环型直觉式操作界面搭载。轻松上手，毫无负担的掌握游戏每一秒
  • 时而动人、时而磅礡的配乐，将随着多变感人的剧情，带给您最深刻难忘的游戏回忆
  • 多重分歧剧情系统导入，新增的游戏分歧将让您玩出大不相同的多重结局
  • 完全针对玩家建议进行修正与进化的整体系统，风色系列最高游戏性代表作
  • 经典风色系列－魔导圣战篇长达三部曲的动人大结局。您将亲身体验那最难忘的一刻

【剧情简介】
大陆历１９０年末，正值后世称之『冰火之战』的战争末期，北方帝国－冷夜和南方的圣燄联合公国各自为了彼此的理念而争战着，殊不知这场战斗却只是有心人为了防堵未来将会降临的灭世之祸而策动的必须手段。

虽然原罪劫结束，但和平尚未来到这世上．．，身负救世主加瑟多救世之道的少男少女们，为了世人期盼的和平世局而努力，他们深信只要纷争结束，原本因彼此所属国家关系的伙伴们将会再度重聚，不过这一丝丝的梦想真的可以如他们所愿吗？还是说之后来到的和平治世只是暴风雨前的宁静？

此刻位居大陆南方的龙之墓冢陆续发生不寻常的怪事，圣都尼鲁为了厘清怪事真正的原因，派遣新生带刀祭司－妮依．迪亚诺耶鲁前往调查；另一方面，在布朗西斯女王希洛依的指示下，龙骑禁卫队副官－修伊．海尔蓝特在禁卫队队长－法姆．冯．布朗西斯的带领下协助来自圣都尼鲁的调查队．．．初次执行实战任务的少男、少女在任务过程中相遇，这俩人的邂逅将会如何影响彼此的信念？？与断罪之翼一行人的羁绊又将会发生怎么样的发展？？全新的序幕、壮大史诗的终曲即将呈现在众人的面前！！

虽然原罪劫结束，但和平尚未来到这世上．．，身负救世主加瑟多救世之道的少男少女们，为了世人期盼的和平世局而努力，他们深信只要纷争结束，原本因彼此所属国家关系的伙伴们将会再度重聚，不过这一丝丝的梦想真的可以如他们所愿吗？还是说之后来到的和平治世只是暴风雨前的宁静？

此刻位居大陆南方的龙之墓冢陆续发生不寻常的怪事，圣都尼鲁为了厘清怪事真正的原因，派遣新生带刀祭司－妮依．迪亚诺耶鲁前往调查；另一方面，在布朗西斯女王希洛依的指示下，龙骑禁卫队副官－修伊．海尔蓝特在禁卫队队长－法姆．冯．布朗西斯的带领下协助来自圣都尼鲁的调查队．．．初次执行实战任务的少男、少女在任务过程中相遇，这俩人的邂逅将会如何影响彼此的信念？？与断罪之翼一行人的羁绊又将会发生怎么样的发展？？全新的序幕、壮大史诗的终曲即将呈现在众人的面前！！
data.short_description: 故事直接承续着风Ⅲ结局发展，甚至风Ⅲ的记录还能直接共享，可说是风色幻想系列作自Ⅰ代至今的「菲利斯多篇」之大完结。因此其内容除了有着超豪华的历代著名角色大集合外，贯穿数代间、延续千万年的层层谜题也在本作中逐一的解开，并引起诸多让人赞叹的游戏高潮，可说是风色幻想系列自风一推出以来的六年里，最为精彩且壮大的完结之作。

data.name: Pipe or Die
data.detailed_description:
Pipe or Die is a 1 to 6 player co-op horror game with proximity voice chat. The Company lowers you into the Pit, a monster-infested hole in the earth, to build a factory out of whatever pipe you can scavenge. Lay pipe, fill crates, get them to the elevator, and make rent.

Haul an extractor out to the ore, then lay pipe all the way back to the fabricator. Watch your ore rattle through the glass, one piece at a time, into a machine that turns it into money. Laying pipe is a team activity.

The natural predators of the Pit roam free. The more you build, the more of them show up to see what all the noise is about. The Company's official position is that they are a you problem.

Shove friends into a pit. Pipes stop people but not monsters, so you can wall a coworker into a dead end and let nature take over. Record your own voice into a decoy and see what falls for it. The Company does not condone workplace horseplay. The Company also has no cameras down there.

When you die, you live on through your hard hat. Talk to your living friends through it, flick its lamp, and guide them home, or straight into something's mouth. Survivors can wear the hats of the fallen. Stack three and you are basically management. Did I mention there's PIPES?!

Every crate your factory builds is real. Carry it to the elevator yourself, or lay enough pipe and send it home in style. Rent is due every three days. Miss it and the Company terminates your contract, your save file, and the floor you are standing on. Make extra and spend it between shifts.

FEATURES:

  • 1 to 6 player online co-op (solo shifts for the brave)

  • Built-in proximity voice chat

  • A new procedurally generated mine every shift, from cold rock tunnels to magma caverns

  • 11 monsters, each with its own rule to learn

  • Real pipe logistics. Ore and crates physically travel through every pipe you lay

  • A job board you vote on. More risk, more pay: blackouts, rush orders, sentinels and more

  • A shop between shifts: upgrades, glow sticks, night vision, voice-recording decoys, and pipe bombs for when you need to lay a lot of pipe in a hurry

  • Haunt your friends through your hard hat after you die

  • 200+ cosmetics to earn: hard hats, outfits, tool skins, pipe finishes

  • PIPES! 

Welcome to the Pit. The Company thanks you for laying pipe.

data.name: The Single-Eye Nightmare
data.detailed_description:
The Single-Eye Nightmare is a first-person horror game where every step into the darkness could be your last. You’re trapped in the crumbling ruins of an underground temple, filled with twisting passageways, hidden chambers, and ancient mechanisms designed to keep intruders from ever leaving. To escape, you must outsmart deadly puzzles, survive dangerous traps, and avoid the watchful gaze of a monstrous Cyclops that hunts relentlessly through the tunnels.

Survive the Temple

Explore the maze-like environment to look for a way out. But be warned: the temple wasn't made with the intent to keep you alive. Crushing stone mechanisms, hidden spikes and crumbling ruins awaits you in every room you enter.

Outsmart the Cyclops

The Cyclops is hungry and won't stop at nothing to find your location. Stay dark areas, be weary of your footsteps and keep an eye out for the one-eyed monster lurking at every corner, searching for his newest prey - you.

Solve Ancient Puzzles

The temple expects a lot from travelers trying to survive. Manipulating water systems, pulling counterweight levers and solving combination locks are essential to get back to the surface alive.
