data.name: Secret Files: Tunguska
data.detailed_description:
Unravel one of the greatest mysteries of our time!

On the 30th June 1908 an explosion with the combined energy of 2000 Hiroshima bombs rocked the region of Tunguska in Central Siberia and felled over 6,000 square km of trees. The explosion could be heard from as far as 1,000km away. Eye witnesses saw a long object fall from the sky which was illuminated in a blue-white light. A 20km high column of light was followed by a black-mushroom shaped cloud. It has been reported that for the next three nights it was so bright across all of Europe that you could read a newspaper outdoors.

To date it still remains a mystery as to what happened that day, and now YOU will find yourself immersed in a race against time to uncover a global conspiracy that will carry you to the far reaches of the world. Prepare to have your detective skills challenged like never before in the dark world of cover-ups and corruption.
  • 80 highly detailed and atmospheric pre-rendered backgrounds
  • Atmospheric weather effects (e.g. rain and snow)
  • Cinematic full screen videos for intro and cut-scenes
  • 25 beautifully rendered 3D characters to interact with

data.name: The Plant Shop
data.detailed_description:
The Plant Shop is a cozy horror game where you manage a small plant shop.

Craft plants, serve late-night customers and grow your plant collection to attract more people.

You play as Silvia, a 26 years old girl who decides to open her own small plant shop on a late-night shift because she has a corporate job during the day.

Your job is to serve the customers coming to the shop. Depending on the order you will have to craft flowers, plants or cacti.

Crafting plants is easy. You just need a plant pot, soil, a seed and water.

The customers talk about a curse that struck the town 30 years ago. As you manage your shop, you begin to see and hear strange things. Is the curse real—or just an old legend?

FEATURES

  • Gameplay: Narrative walking simulator with a simple game loop: take orders from customers, craft plants and serve them.

  • VHS film aesthetics: Emulates the look of old CRT screens that adds an eerie atmosphere.

  • Immersive Story: Experience Silvia’s journey and uncover the truth about The Plant Shop and the strange events happening in town.

  • Multiple Endings.

GAME MODES

  • Story Mode: Follow Silvia's dream of having a successful Plant Shop.

  • Relaxed Mode: Manage your own cozy Plant Shop at your own pace.

  • Endless Mode (with leaderboard): Fulfill orders against the clock and try to survive as long as possible.

FOR CONTENT CREATORS

You are free to create content from the game and monetize the gameplay by any means.

data.name: Don't Get Fired!! ~Hospital Reception Simulator~
data.detailed_description:
Can You Avoid Getting Fired?

The stage: a busy hospital reception desk. Your mission is just one thing—don't get fired.

Every patient you handle, every decision you make, and every single yen you earn will decide your survival.

This is an unusual survival experience: hospital reception sim × asset management × high-stakes gambling.

■ Reception Work

Process the patients streaming in one after another, as fast as you can. Identify the type of insurance card (employee insurance, national insurance, elderly insurance, or paper certificates) and handle check-in and payment correctly. Accurate, speedy service raises patient satisfaction and lowers your risk of getting fired.—Mistakes, or keeping patients waiting too long, put your job in danger.

■ Improvement Proposal Shop

Use the Contribution Points (CP) and salary you earn from work to make the hospital better.

・Facility upgrades like extra waiting-room chairs, a ticket dispenser, and barrier-free access

・Introducing DX (digital) equipment—though some of it only pretends to work...

・Boosting the hospital's reputation with flyers, social media, and TV commercials

・Earning "Titles" that make your job easier when equipped

What you invest in, and how you work—your choices decide your survival rate.

■ Grow Your Assets

Between shifts, it's your chance to build wealth.

・Stocks: Read company fundamentals (earnings and news) and trade shares

・Forex: Take on exchange rates that shift in real time

・Casino: Go for a fortune with Baccarat and dealer-versus-player Poker

High risk, high reward. Whether you multiply it or burn it all is up to you.

■ Multiple Endings

Your performance decides your fate. Survive to the final day and reach one of several special endings.—But miss a single day of work, and it's instant game over.

■ Replayability

Aim for a high score and take on Hard Mode. Collect a wealth of achievements—how long can you survive?

Serve, earn, and survive.—Can you avoid getting fired?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of gambling using in-game currency only.
The casino features baccarat and poker played against a dealer, and the
game also includes stock and foreign exchange (FX) trading. No real money
is used or wagered at any point, there is no purchase of in-game currency,
and no winnings can be exchanged for real-world money or items.

The game also portrays financial hardship as a consequence of the player's
choices: the player character can accumulate credit card debt, become
unable to pay it back, and reach endings depicting bankruptcy, unemployment,
poverty, and compulsive gambling. These are presented as cautionary outcomes
of risky decisions.

The game contains no sexual content, no nudity, and no violence or gore.
It does not depict drug or alcohol use, self-harm, or sexual assault.

data.name: Costume Quest
data.detailed_description:
Costume Quest is a Halloween adventure from Tim Schafer's Double Fine Productions. In this charming role-playing game, choose your hero and trick-or-treat through three beautiful environments full of Double Fine humor and story. Complete quests, build your party, and collect costumes along the way that allow you to transform into powerful champions and take down the evil Repugians. This heroic holiday tale will capture the imaginations of kids and kids-at-heart.
Continue the Costume Quest adventure with the Grubbins on Ice DLC pack, included free in the PC version! Face new enemies while collecting additional quests, costumes, battle stamps and creepy treat cards. Help the monsters overthrow Araxia to bring peace back to Repugia!

data.name: Restaurant Simulator 2023
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Restaurant Simulator 2023, the ultimate culinary adventure where you can build and manage your very own restaurant empire! Step into the shoes of a restaurateur and unleash your creativity as you design and run multiple unique restaurants in this immersive simulation game.

With its charming and colorful graphics, Restaurant Simulator 2023 offers a delightful and relaxing gaming experience for players of all ages. Dive into a vibrant world filled with mouth-watering dishes, bustling customers, and endless possibilities.

As your restaurant grows, you'll have the opportunity to hire and train a dedicated team of chefs, servers, and other staff members. Keep them motivated and efficient by providing a positive work environment, organizing team-building activities, and rewarding their hard work. By hiring skilled managers, you can delegate tasks and focus on expanding your culinary empire.

To truly thrive in the competitive restaurant industry, you'll need to make smart investment decisions. Study market trends, analyze customer preferences, and choose strategic locations for new restaurant ventures. Take calculated risks, invest in profitable ventures, and watch your economy soar.

Restaurant Simulator 2023 is not just a game about food and business; it's a journey of self-expression, creativity, and entrepreneurship. Discover the joys and challenges of running a restaurant, unlock exciting achievements, and become the ultimate culinary tycoon.

Are you ready to embark on this gastronomic adventure? Get ready to tantalize taste buds, satisfy hungry customers, and build an empire that will stand the test of time. The restaurant industry is waiting for your unique touch - step into the kitchen and make your mark in Restaurant Simulator 2023!

Key Features:

Customize and design your own unique restaurants
Automate workflow to increase productivity and income
Hire and train a dedicated team of staff members
Make strategic investments to boost your economy
Experience a relaxing and immersive gameplay
Suitable for players of all ages

data.name: Barrage
data.detailed_description:
Barrage is a turn-based, strategic worker placement game: Engineers are the key elements of your game plan. Send Engineers to carry out different Actions, such as gathering new Machinery, managing water, building structures, and produce energy, but be careful: Action spaces are limited and shared among all players, so timing is crucial to avoid opponents stealing your next move.

The game unfolds in turns; each turn, players will be able to pick just one Action at a time. Engineers are few, and the more powerful an Action, the more Engineers it needs, so managing your workers carefully is the fundamental aspect of every gameplay.

Every corporation is unique in its own, and unlocks different rewards as the game progresses. Plus, every CEO has a special passive power that can be unlocked to maximize energy production, profits, or resource management.

But that’s not all: CEOs are assisted by Executive Officers, useful helpers which heavily impacts the gameplay rules and results in very different play styles. Experiment with different CEOs and XOs to find the ones that fits you best, or draft them at the beginning of the game for more unpredictability.

Objectives, Energy Contracts, and Technologies are randomly chosen from all available possibilities, ensuring a unique experience every time you play. This element of randomness fosters replayability, making each game a new challenge to overcome and forcing you to adapt your planning and strategy.

Dive into the uchronic world of Barrage, redesigned for a better gaming experience on PC, without waiving the beautiful visual language of the board game. Actions, resources, and the captivating visual elements of the board game have been preserved to charm experienced players and new ones alike.

Whether you want to challenge players worldwide or enjoy a solo game, you won’t be disappointed. The online mode allows you to compete against players from around the world. If you prefer a more personal experience instead, the offline mode lets you enjoy the game at your own pace, customizing factions, XOs, and other options.

We would love to hear from you! Connect with Cranio Creations on our social platforms to stay updated on the latest news, or write us through Steam Community or on BoardGameGeek. Your feedback and experience help us make Barrage better and better.

data.name: Dragon Banner
data.detailed_description:
Dragon Banner is a video game of strategy and building. It is built from the love of building blocks and real-time strategy games. Dragon Banner is created by one person over the course of seven years, working on it here and there.

In Dragon Banner you take on the role of a commander. You hire villagers to gather or generate resources, build defenses to protect them, and hire an army to fight alongside you. You will customize a town as your headquarters, where you take on quests and purchase equipment to alter your command style.

The Skull Queen controls all the land, but her skeleton army is full of bullies. Play as Arc and recruit villagers and warriors, uniting under the dragon banner. Arc shares an unusual bond with a dragon spirit. Discover what became of dragons! If you show strength, the people will rise up with you. Build a town as your base of operations. Embark on a campaign to overthrow the Skull Queen, gaining new allies and tools along the way.

Features

  • Experience a story. Discover the fate of dragons as you wage a campaign against the Skull Queen and her army of skeleton warriors.
  • Take direct control of your commander. Choose to collect resources, hire workers, hire soldiers, build defenses, or to take part in battle directly.
  • Don't do it alone. Hire miners and villagers to grow your resources.
  • Choose your strategy. Hire Knights to patrol the land, or take a defensive approach and build walls and hire archers to defend your villagers. Unit types with their own behaviors provide strategic variety.
  • Build. Unlock blueprints to build room frames, walls, doors, and more. Combine them to make unique creations. Build Tech to upgrade and assist your army.
  • Start a town. Create a town as your headquarters. As you progress through the story, you unlock new town blueprints to build. Your town will grow and bring in recruits and merchants.
  • Equip your commander. In the course of the story, recruit merchants. Place their shop in your town and buy new equipment for your commander. Not only does it change your appearance, equipment affects your command style by offering bonuses to you or your entire army.
  • Keyboard Only mode. Ever want to play in a café but you don't want to drag your mouse around with you? Toggle Keyboard Only mode in the game options and use the p/l/;/' keys to move the camera and menus, replacing the need for a mouse.

data.name: Ambidextrous Psychopath
data.detailed_description: Ambidextrous Psychopath is all about the gameplay, and is designed for the gamer who wants a fresh platforming challenge.  It offers a unique take on the platformer genre, offering a 63 level campaign and unique design characteristics.  Ambidextripath is designed to challenge the player to develop strategies to split their focus onto two simultaneously moving player objects.  The game is developed and designed by Rylan Yancey, with a stellar soundtrack composed by the Jogey Man himself.  You have never played a game like Ambidextrous Psychopath.

data.name: 电竞俱乐部/ESports Club
data.detailed_description:
ESports Club is a sim game based on electronic sports industry, including most popular game types such as FPS and MOBA. You can create your own club and clans, manage club finance, sign players from all over the world, train your teams, create and adjust tactics, so that your clan can win against your opponents in various important leagues and cups. Besides, you are able to move your club from a garage to the most modern buildings with different styles and facilities. Last but not least, you are going to enjoy the most exciting match with the highly realistic match simulation engine, discovering considerable amount of classic tactics from the real esports games.
What are you still waiting for? Start your esports career now!

Features

  • Tens of countries, hundreds of clubs, thousands of players.
  • take part in different games,fps or moba.
  • Players could be affected by age, injuries, emotion and competition conditions.
  • Each player owns several attributes including position, play style, and abilities stats. Determine the lineup based on the opponent playstyle and your own tactics.
  • Customize training plans for your players, train them into superstars.
  • Realistic player tradings and contracts.
  • Freely managed club finance, various kinds of sponsorships.
  • Upgrade club facilities, unlock new features and training plans.
  • Enjoy diverse tactics in the realistic match simulation engine. Smart AI.
  • All sorts of classic FPS tactics are supported, such as rush, separate, fake, etc. A detailed weapon and economy simulating system is also included, providing deeper strategic space.
  • Set the team with appropriate instructions and attitudes could convincingly enhance match performance.

data.name: The Citadel Must Hold
data.detailed_description:
The Citadel Must Hold is a base-building survival RTS where hero-led exploration, strategic fortification, and game-bending choices impact whether you fall or survive the siege.

Grow a settlement around the Citadel Heart by gathering resources, expanding production, training soldiers, and raising your defenses. Expanding is a choice that makes your citadel grow stronger...but remember that every new border brings more ground to protect.

Send your army into the fog-covered wilderness to explore dangerous biomes, gather resources, and conquer Places of Power. Defeat their guardians to stop raids and claim powerful rewards. Monsters can also be recruited - use them wisely and reshape the battlefield to turn the tide in your favor.

Between building, exploring, and expanding, you also have to balance defending your citadel from persistent raids and Tides. Command your units and defend critical chokepoints. Don't forget: Each Tide brings a greater threat, forcing you to adapt your defenses and fight to keep your Citadel standing.

Choose a Founding Oath at the start of each run to shape how you build and fight. After surviving each Monster Tide, select a Rally Decree to strengthen your forces, cover your weaknesses, or enhance your build. Mix and match these choices to create a unique strategy every run.

data.name: Psychopath Massacre
data.detailed_description:
BEFORE BUYING: This is a short horror puzzle experience. It's a scare simulator. Solve the puzzles, and escape the house, you've got 5 hours. You can use your microphone to distract the enemy or to do certain in game events.


The game may contain bugs, I'm actively working on it and improving it.



Psychopath Massacre is a first-person short psychological horror game with a VHS effect. (It's a short puzzle game) Be cautious and observant, because a sinister psychopath lurks within these rooms, hidden in the shadows and monitoring your every step.






Authorities in Romania discover a very unsettling record detailing, the horrible murders committed by a single person during a police raid on a home. Approximately 60 videotapes, recorded by the psychopath and documenting the graphic details of his killings, are among the discoveries. Law enforcement teams from both state and federal agencies carefully examine the graphic footage to find crucial hints such as the name of the murderer, the victims' identities, and possible leads regarding his whereabouts. Even after numerous viewings, the tapes don't provide much information other than the terrifying reality of the atrocities. The powerful effect of the gruesome visuals unnerves detectives as they probe further into the insane mind that produced the recordings.

After months of investigation, one tape, in particular, draws the attention of the authorities despite the abundance of others. Florentina, the victim, recorded this tape, which unintentionally revealed the identify of the attacker and shows her frantic attempt to break free from the grip of her attacker. Through close examination of the video, the authorities are able to reconstruct Florentina's terrifying experience inside the house as well as the identity of the criminal. With the potential to make significant progress toward catching the offender and providing the victims with justice, this vital evidence acts as a ray of hope for the investigation.




George Dinescu imprisons you within his home, refusing to let you go. A pounding headache wakes you up in a dimly lit room, reminding you of a hard blow to the head. Your flashlight, is the only source of illumination.



The main exit is sealed behind a series of locks, forcing you to search the house for keys and other items required to unlock the door to freedom. However, caution is advised because the psychopath has acute hearing; any sound, whether a dropped object or a creaking floorboard, indicates his imminent arrival. Beware of his bear traps.



Choose from three difficulty levels: Hard, Normal, and Easy.


  • True Survival Horror Experience: You are no fighter, and your only chance of surviving the horrors of the house is to escape... or hide.
  • Immersive Graphics: RETRO VHS quality graphics provide gamers a complex, horrifying environment to explore.
  • Hide & Seek: Stealthy gameplay with parkour areas and hide zones.
  • Unpredictable Enemy: Players have no idea when, or from where.
  • The game has speech recognition, use your microphone to distract the enemy or trigger certain game events.
  • In game shop, beat the game on certain difficulties, earn coins and customize your game.

data.name: TENET
data.detailed_description:
TENET is a fast-paced shooter where you are trapped underworld in a nightmarish arena, and the only key to survival is to stay within the light. Survive, collect, and upgrade! With help from the underworld seer, you can exchange your earnings for powerful upgrades for increased chances of survival, along with cosmetics to fully customize your character, killing your foes in style.

TENET takes inspiration from several classics to bring about a fusion of old meets new. Compete for high scores and place among the leader boards. Your skills will be put to the test as you blast, punch, and stomp your way through this gore infused gauntlet as you tear your foes limb from limb.

In TENET your goal is to survive waves of enemies increasing over time in difficulty. Every series of waves end with a Boss Encounter, surviving the encounter enables you to meet the "Underworld Seer" to summon the "Pillar of Vis" which grants access to a powerful weapon upgrade or exchange to convert the current sessions collected "Runes" into "Purified Tokens" for purchasing higher quality upgrades and cosmetics in the "Player Profile".

Please note that the game is currently in Early Access which means this is not the final state of the game. Please read the Early Access notes above for more information about our current and future plans.

data.name: Strait Defense
data.detailed_description:
Find the threat. Hold the line.

Ships on the horizon, missiles overhead, and enemies beneath the surface put every deployment to the test. Strait Defense is a single-player 2D tactical tower defense game inspired by Taiwan and its surrounding waters. Coordinate detection and firepower, manage limited funds, and protect the facilities that keep your defense standing.

Detect before you engage

Firepower needs information. Use radar, surface search, and anti-submarine units to locate threats, then bring the right weapons to bear. Air defense, anti-ship, ground combat, and anti-submarine roles each have a place in your plan. Adapt your sensor coverage and defensive positions as the battlefield changes.

Build your tactical loadout

Choose equipment to suit your battle plan, from air-defense missiles, main battle tanks, and coastal anti-ship missiles to frigates, attack submarines, and aircraft. Support your line with repair and supply facilities, or prepare interception zones with land and naval mines. Deployment, upgrades, repairs, and support all compete for your funds.

Diverse battlefields. Unique boss encounters.

Defend the island's airspace and the strait, then fight across beaches, valleys, city streets, and the final perimeter. New terrain and attack routes call for new plans. Each stage ends with its own boss challenge, while campaign outcomes carry forward between battles.

Research, adapt, and improve your results

Invest in permanent equipment research, revise your loadout, and return with a stronger plan. Study the enemy gallery, identify threats, and refine your deployments to improve your star ratings.

Features

  • A single-player campaign across varied battlefields with distinct bosses.

  • A varied equipment roster to build your tactical loadout.

  • Air, ground, surface, and underwater threats with specialized detection and weapons.

  • Battlefield deployment, upgrades, repairs, support, and resource management.

  • Permanent research, an enemy gallery, persistent campaign outcomes, and star ratings.

  • Colorful pixel-inspired cartoon art and battlefield music.

The campaign, maps, and combat values are fictional game settings.

data.name: The First Templar - Steam Special Edition
data.detailed_description:
The First Templar follows the story of two main characters – a French Templar, and his companion, a noble lady who has been proclaimed a heretic. Taking control over these two unlikely allies, the player must uncover the mysteries behind the Templar Order, play a role in a grand conspiracy, and discover the secret of the Holy Grail. The heroes face powerful opponents at every turn, including Sacracen, King Philip the IV of France and the Inquisition.

The First Templar features both single player and co-op modes. When playing solo, the player can switch between the two characters, leaving the control of the second hero to the game’s AI. At any moment a second player can join in and take control of the AI-controlled hero.

Key Features

  • Expansive Historical Game World: Return to the 13th century, where European culture is on the brink of collapse. 20 historically accurate locations from around Europe have been recreated for the player to explore
  • One player - Multiple Roles: Instantly swap between playable characters, focusing on the best skills for the job. Drop in/out cooperative play allows a friend to help out!
  • Fast Paced Action-Based Play: Unlock furious combos to unleash upon waves of challenging opponents
  • RPG-inspired Character Development: Each character has unique abilities and skill trees, which players develop as they explore the game world

data.name: What if George Washington was a Girl?
data.detailed_description:
A historical visual novel about history's greatest heroes and villains and their trials and tribulations.

It is important to note that a lot of time and research was put into the writing of this game's story and themes, all historical people and events were heavily studied to make sure everything is accurate. This was taken extremely seriously and any naysay will not be tolerated.

So anyways, the story starts with the Dark Musician (Mozart) plotting to destroy Antarctica. Georgia Washington (George Washington) and Teddy Rosebelt (Theodore Roosevelt), knights of the United Nations were sent to stop the mad musical genius before the icy continent is lost forever.

BUT THEN, more stuff happens and there's intrigue and suspense and penguins? Find out more and meet other historical figures in this first chapter of an exciting new saga, Alter Historia.

Yeah that's right it's only the first chapter, hopefully this doesn't get popular because there will be more if it does.

Game Features

  • Meet several historic figures like Georgia Washington, Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte), The Night Gale (Florence Nightingale) and more.
  • Has an in-game wiki that unlocks exciting info about the actual historic figures as you progress through the game.
  • Features a custom made visual novel engine. It currently has camera effects, map scenes, particle effects and more, with lots of other features being planned.
  • Has an actual plotline. (It's sort of similar to Shonen stuff like One Piece.)
  • Bonny is the best character.

Parental Guidance Suggested, this uses some brief strong language like "Heck".

  • Has an actual plotline. (It's sort of similar to Shonen stuff like One Piece.)
  • Bonny is the best character.

Parental Guidance Suggested, this uses some brief strong language like "Heck".

data.name: ROBOBEAT
data.detailed_description:
Join our Discord


About the Game

Beat. The. Bot.


You're Ace - a famous bounty hunter after your latest target, the eccentric robot-showman Frazzer. To find your way through his twisted techno-playground, you’ll have to master the art of shooting, wall-running, sliding, and bunny hopping, all in sync with the beat! Get ready to dance till you're dead and then suit up for the remix in rogue-like rhythm shooter ROBOBEAT.

Shoot to the Beat

Shoot to your own beat with the custom music feature. Simply upload & trim your track or leave it as it is in our in-game editor to auto generate beats that suit your play style. Change custom songs effortlessly in-game anytime anywhere without interruption. The feature will support .wav, .mp3, and .ogg files. Maximise your damage and shorten your cooldown time by shooting in sync.
Master the art of charged shots, damage multipliers, armour piercing rounds, and more!

Move to the Music

You’ll want some slick moves to go with those slick new weapons. Your enemies aren’t going to wait around for you to take a dance break, so you’ve got to keep moving if you want to survive.

Wall run, slide, double jump, bunny hop, and grapple hook your way through technicolour levels to give your enemies the runaround. Keep it fluid, keep it funky, and keep it moving.

Rewind, Remix, Replay

ROBOBEAT is a rogue-like remix.


Fast forward through procedurally generated levels, equip an arsenal of finely-tuned weapons, and accompany your arsenal with a symphony of modifications. Your playstyle is on continuous shuffle, so you never know what each new run is going to bring!

Will you have what it takes to break the infinite loop and stop Frazzer in his tracks?

Features

  • Make your enemies face the music with an orchestra of guns and melee weapons;
  • Choose from a diverse playlist to find a track that suits your playstyle;
  • Unlock new songs, weapons, and utilities as you progress through the mansion and uncover its secrets;
  • Shoot to your own beat with the custom music feature.
  • Feel the beat with environments and visuals that adapt to the music;
  • Mix it up with a range of modifications to give you an extra boost;
  • Use your smooth moves to master platforming levels.



∞ Shoot - Remix - Repeat ∞

Additional bonuses that reward those who replay the game.

data.name: Last Summer
data.detailed_description:
Enter the terror of your Last Summer.

A group of campers arrive at the Silent Lamb Camp three days early to prepare for the upcoming opening season. They party, swim in the lake, drink alcohol and just have a good time. By the light of the campfire, the dark history of a mysterious killer unfolds.

Hunt or be hunted.

Last Summer is an upcoming asymmetrical multiplayer horror game that places you in the hands of a malevolent killer or one of the unfortunate, but tenacious victims. As the killer, your priority is to ensure that no one is left standing at the end of your hunt. As a camper, work together with your team to escape the nightmare knocking at your doorstep.

Multiple ways to survive (or slaughter).

The fight for survival will never be the same. Every action has consequences and every glimpse of hope is judged by dynamic gameplay. Equip items to fight back the horror, access multiple escape routes, chase down your targets, or create art with your executions.

data.name: Scyla
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the waters of Scyla, a third-person 3D exploration adventure inspired by Lovecraft's universe. Discover the mysteries hidden into the depths as you pilot a submarine through a strange cave system. Run away from a criature that stalks you.

Mechanics





At the controls of a submarine, you must explore a mysterious cave system that is fragmenting the depths of the ocean of an island near Cape Verde.
Rumors say that a treasure has been found inside these caves along with the remains of ancient ships.





At the beginning of the adventure, you will forge an alliance with a small creature that will accompany you and help you defeat the strange sea creatures that you will encounter along the way by throwing water jets at them as projectiles.





To move through some areas of the map, you will have a hook that will let you move easily, grab certain surfaces and attract certain objects.
In addition to using your insight and skill, you can find the hook upgrade, with which you can imbue it with electricity and use it to stun your enemies and go through areas with electrical surfaces.





The state of the submarine will be represented by a barometer. When the submarine is hit, the pressure of the barometer will decrease until it reaches the critical point. After this critical point the submarine will explode.
We can stabilize the state of the submarine by collecting orbs that we will find by destroying some objects.



  • Dive into the waters of Scyla to find the new treasure that has been discovered.
  • Explore the interior of the cave system that is fragmenting the ocean depths.
  • Overcome obstacles and defeat strange creatures from the seabed to achieve your goal.
  • Upgrade your hook and fight along with a small creature that will go with you during your entire adventure.
  • Keep an eye on every move, a creature will be stalking you at every step.

data.name: Tropico 7
data.detailed_description:
Pre-Purchase Offer

Pre-Order now!
Early Toucan Bonus: Pre-order Tropico 7 – Deluxe Edition to gain access to the game 48 hours before its official launch, get an exclusive “Supervillain” Outfit for El Prez and snatch a 10% discount.


About the Game

Get rich or die trying! You are free to agree with El Presidente – on the greatness of Tropico and his unmatched leadership skills. In Tropico 7, you step into his shiny boots again to build your archipelago nation and – literally – move mountains.

With great power comes great responsibility – and even greater opportunity. As the most benevolent leader of your island nation, guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity. Remember: Control isn’t tyranny, it’s efficiency – and more control means more efficiency (except when Penultimo is involved, but that’s another story).

Exert your control and shape the landscape you are building on to fit your vision. Plan and construct complex city layouts, fulfil the multifaceted needs of your subjects, give precise directions to your army, and look down on your opponents in the council, all while revelling in your own splendour. See how it all leads to ever greater efficiency? This could be an aspiring dictator’s dream come true indeed… however, sometimes life gives you lemons. Or obstacles in the shape of a very clever and very annoying opponent: Victoria Guerra! You will need all your skills, cunning and presidential ‘grandeur’ to end this latest chapter with a simple truth: ¡Victoria no es la revolución!

  • Lead your nation to new heights: Tropico 7 tells El Presidente’s continuous success story across 5 campaign maps – starring himself, Penultimo and a new nemesis: Victoria Guerra.

  • More is more: Archipelagos, with the biggest islands ever in the series, await your rule, expanded with 10 extra scenarios, more than 20 sandbox maps, and endless possibilities with a random map generator.

  • Move mountains – literally: Erase them, create beaches, or even create entirely new islands! The new terraforming feature brings your megalomaniac dreams to life. Start that mammoth project – NOW!

  • Bollocks uhm… Politics: Navigate the snares and pits of internal politics, when you summon the different factions to your council, a new way to meet them face to face while you pulverize their dreams – or use them for a BIG DEAL to your own advantage.

  • Make the world your playground: Elections, election speeches and a vast portfolio of edicts depending on your political standing spice up your daily rule while you juggle foreign affairs and occasionally steal... uhm relocate a landmark to revel in its benefits.

  • Built to prosper: Strategically place buildings to make use of synergy effects, keep citizen satisfaction high, and fill any unused plots of land with beautiful parks in a freely customized size.

  • Generalissimo No. 1: Eliminate those pesky rebels and fend off foreign threats with a reworked military system enabling more direct control of your military units.

  • Always judge a book by its cover: Customize the appearance of your palace and El Presidente with new and creative options.

data.name: Witch's Apocalyptic Journey
data.detailed_description:
Road Map


About the Game

Press the link on the right to JOIN US ON DISCORD!

Witch's Apocalyptic Journey is a roguelite deckbuilding game with role-playing elements. You can customize the daily schedule of the witches, and create your own unique Super Cards! Team up with your friends to form a witch squad and destroy this world!

 The witches, symbols of ominous, are the very stars of disaster. In Aldrin, their presence means only one thing: the world is on the brink of its end.

  They are both executioners and undertakers, guiding their steps as they're about to deliver the world its final rites!

 Experience the fun of strategic deckbuilding.

 Meet the requirements, spend Truth Crystals, and craft the card you want.

 Don’t want one card to appear in your deck...? Replace it with one of your super cards!

 The witches cannot reverse time, but they can manipulate karma.

 You can customize the events the witches will encounter by drawing a certain number of Fate Cards on the map interface and arranging them along the timeline according to your will.

 Once the route is set, the witches will follow your planned course, and some ingenious combinations might lead to unexpected twists along the journey.

 You will acquire a variety of resources to strengthen your witches in the game.

 Construct your basic deck with cards, build your genre with relics, and strengthen your attributes with blessings.

 You will encounter enemies with different special abilities. Counter or be countered, it depends on your choice.

MODs and Workshop

After game launches, we'll open up the Workshop, allowing players to experience a variety of witches' worlds, adding new cards, customizing the appearances of the witches, and designing more quests, keep infusing the witches' world with more and more vitality!

【Add to Wishlist! Adventure alongside the Witches!】

  They are both executioners and undertakers, guiding their steps as they're about to deliver the world its final rites!

 Experience the fun of strategic deckbuilding.

 Meet the requirements, spend Truth Crystals, and craft the card you want.

 Don’t want one card to appear in your deck...? Replace it with one of your super cards!

 The witches cannot reverse time, but they can manipulate karma.

 You can customize the events the witches will encounter by drawing a certain number of Fate Cards on the map interface and arranging them along the timeline according to your will.

 Once the route is set, the witches will follow your planned course, and some ingenious combinations might lead to unexpected twists along the journey.

 You will acquire a variety of resources to strengthen your witches in the game.

 Construct your basic deck with cards, build your genre with relics, and strengthen your attributes with blessings.

 You will encounter enemies with different special abilities. Counter or be countered, it depends on your choice.

MODs and Workshop

After game launches, we'll open up the Workshop, allowing players to experience a variety of witches' worlds, adding new cards, customizing the appearances of the witches, and designing more quests, keep infusing the witches' world with more and more vitality!

【Add to Wishlist! Adventure alongside the Witches!】

data.name: Stellar Smash
data.detailed_description:
Stellar Smash is a modern brick breaker game with focus on gameplay and player experience.

The game has different paced levels to increase tension. Breath and collect bonusses before entering boss fights. Yes, boss fights in a brick breaking game.

Astra, the main character, will guide you through out the game with random dialogues. She tries to be annoying but be kind with her - she lived her life lonely in her spaceship.

Get power-ups and do not drop the ball. Wait, the ball also can collect power-ups. It goes beyond normal "ball double" and "bigger paddle", for example: electric ball that destroys bricks from a far, blossom ball that shoots projectiles at your will and many more.

Collect scraps, you may use them in the workshop menu for permanent upgrades.

Story

The story is narrated between the chapters and continued during levels with dialogues between entities. 

Astra wonders lonely in the universe when she discovers a strange looking structure. She dives in to discover who built it. Through this journey she realises that what her purpose in life is and why she is lonely.

Things that make this game special

  • Fast action paced levels combines with slow paced breathing levels and boss fights

  • Random dialogues through out the game

  • Workshop for permanent upgrades

  • Hand drawn indie game art style

data.detailed_description:
From Eipix Entertainment, the studio that brought you Dead Reckoning and Final Cut, invites you to step into the spotlight of the latest Danse Macabre!

Ruth Fisher is the up-and-coming star of a popular figure skating show, but her final dress rehearsal is cancelled after her biggest fan drops dead. He was trying to warn Ruth, but about what? You’ll need to use all of your deductive skills to investigate the scenes and uncover the true threat, before Ruth Fisher’s opening night becomes her final performance in this chilling Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

Explore a winter wonderland of figure skating and murder!
Find lots of hidden collectibles and earn achievements.
Experience the Art Gallery, Soundtrack, and Endless Match-3.
Solve a kidnapping in the exciting bonus chapter!

data.name: Junkyard Space Agency
data.detailed_description:
Junkyard Space Agency is a scrappy, realistic space simulator where you run a space agency by flying DIY ships built from scavenged parts and securing vital supplies in a post-apocalyptic Solar System.

MASTER ORBITAL MECHANICS

Spacecraft and celestial bodies obey real orbital mechanics. Perform delicate rendezvous and docking maneuvers, build stations in orbit, and fly interplanetary missions. But watch your delta-V — fuel is limited, and mass works against you.

BUILD FROM SCRAP

Build functional spacecraft from salvaged parts — pipes, tanks, sheet metal, repurposed electronics. Design it your way, as long as it gets you into orbit in one piece.

SCAVENGE TO SURVIVE

Space is full of loot... and stories. Scour derelicts and remote outposts for the provisions you need to survive. Every can of food, every drop of water, every piece of gear is hard-earned.

RUN A SPACE AGENCY

Your agency’s outposts and stations depend on you, and you depend on them. They need supplies, oxygen, and power, and they provide you with fuel, parts, and tradable goods. Bring your agency to prosperity by running missions, scavenging or trading.

SOLO OR TOGETHER

Be a lone space wolf or split roles with your pack. In outer space, survival odds are better when you stick together. When stranded on the dark side of a moon with dry tanks, even the toughest lone wolves wish they had someone watching their back.

data.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 12
data.detailed_description:
The Franchise Hockey Manager series returns for its 12th version in 2025-26, with new additions that will further expand on the most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find.

Choose one of dozens of leagues around the world and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize: FHM12 is licensed by the NHL®, allowing you to take the reins of your favorite franchise to capture the Stanley Cup®.  Or, take control of a national team and try for international supremacy.

You can also choose a historical game, where you can begin in any year in NHL® history, play in one of several historical minor leagues, or play in a legendary international tournament, including (new for this year) the World Championships as far back as 1929.

If you'd like to create your own customized league, you can do that, including allowing international play in the world you design.

If you've been playing FHM11 and can't bear to part with your team, import that save into FHM12 and carry on with the addition of FHM11's new features.

However you choose to play, you have control of your team and can oversee finances, select strategies, hire your staff, make trades, sign free agents, and draft the newest generation of stars as you try to build a championship team - and then make it into a dynasty!

All new for Franchise Hockey Manager 12:

  • Preseason training programs can be selected and directed to help your players make big improvements before the season starts

  • Targeted training during the season can help direct your players into the exact improvements you want to see

  • An improved Draft Day Experience, including ongoing deal-making and news coverage as the draft is underway

  • Trade news has been significantly enhanced, including observations about the reasons the trade was made

  • We've continued to modify and improve the AI's roster handling and player management, and cleaned up a large number of small issues that were detracting from performance and realism

  • Historical mode has added the World Championships: all the historical World Championship tournaments back to 1929 are now included

  • Better tactics management: sets of tactics can now be saved and re-loaded 

  • Player generation has had further improvements, making superstars rarer but adding the long-shot possibility of a generational-level talent appearing that will eventually (if all goes well) stand with the best of the best in hockey history

  • A new in-game help system so the information you need is there when you need it

  • The big flow of good major junior players into college hockey has been implemented, and the college transfer portal activity has been ramped up

  • New league reports: staff ratings and alumni rankings, so you can compare your carefully assembled staff to those around the league, and discover which teams in the league have been producing players that go on to bigger and better things

  • As always, complete team and player updates for the new 2025-26 season, as well as smaller changes

data.name: RK Override
data.detailed_description:
**INCOMING BROADCAST**

For 50 years, Synergy Corporation has secured our prosperous nation and saved us from tyranny. Today, under the landmark Preservation Statute, the art of modern warfare has changed for the better. Our compliant mechanical mission systems contain our threats at no risk to human life.

Our 4th generation Mecha systems have now been accepted into service by your government. 10,000 new units will be delivered over 5 years under a 50 billion dollar contract, creating thousands of jobs at the newly expanded Synergy Central Plant.

We have sworn to defend our way of life, and will do everything in our technological power to defeat anyone standing in the way of progress and peace.

Reverence to Synergy Corp and glory to our pilots.

**END BROADCAST**

The only hope against the Scrapper’s endless onslaught has always been Synergy Corp. They have defended the country for years, and managed to convince the Scrappers to agree to the Preservation Statute, ensuring that neither side kills the other. Conflicts are carried out using Mecha, with each Synergy Mecha Captain being assigned an RK System, an Automated Replicant Knowledge System that helps copilot their Mecha and ensure the statute is maintained.

Assume the role of Chimera, a Mecha Captain of Synergy Corp, as they fight in this endless war. They have never truly believed in the statute, trusting neither the Scrappers nor Synergy Corp. They believe the only way to end the war is to break the statute and wipe out the Scrappers once and for all. Chimera’s RK System “Ki”, who is optimistic and hopeful about the world, disagrees with their outlook, and tries to convince them to see value in the statute.

When Chimera's Mecha Squadron is deployed on a mission to defend the Synergy Central Plant from an invading Scrapper force, the status quo unexpectedly changes, and the fate of the conflict is put in Chimera’s hands.

KEY FEATURES

  • Immerse yourself in an hour-long fully voiced narrative

  • Assume the role of Chimera as they fight in the ruthless conflict between Synergy Corp and the Scrappers

  • Experience 2D animated cutscenes and 3D in-engine cinematics as Chimera attempts to alter the course of the war

  • When in breach of the Statute, your RK System will interfere with your Mecha’s controls - fight back to ensure you achieve your goals

data.name: RevenBlade
data.detailed_description:
RevenBlade features primarily melee-focused combat with abilities that are focused on getting up close to enemies.



Mobility is at the forefront of RevenBlade gameplay. Dashing, climbing, sliding, hovering, and more all give characters tons of outplay potential and depth to character mastery. Each map is also carefully designed with verticality in mind which allows you to flank and dive your opponents not just from the sides, but also from above and below.



Work together with four teammates to control Towers, allowing you to destroy and take over enemy Crystals as your own. Coordinate your efforts into a single place, or split up to contest Shard points and look for the flanking opportunities that could turn a lost objective into a massive win.

Instead of having an overly complicated shop, RevenBlade's Upgrade and Augment system allows you to level-up your abilities and choose up to four of a collection of Augments hand-tailored for each character. These Augments give bonus effects, buffs, or alterations to each ability, making them fit the specific needs of your team composition or counter enemy strategies.

data.name: God Of Weapons
data.detailed_description:
The world was once a bright and beautiful place, filled with light and wonder. But one day, an evil force swept across the land, stealing away the world's light and plunging it into darkness. As a result, chaos and destruction spread across the world, and many feared that the darkness would never end.

In this action roguelike, survive hordes of monsters on every level with automatic weapon attacks. Dodge and collect loot to improve your chances in the next round. It's all about strategy, reflexes, and smart movement.

Explore the Endless Abyss and Uncover Forgotten Truths

RELICTUM is a 2D Metroidvania action adventure where exploration and character progression go hand in hand.

Each new ability unlocks previously unreachable areas, revealing hidden paths, secrets, and new challenges.

data.name: Mahou Arms
data.detailed_description:
Mahou Arms is an anime-inspired character-action hack and slash that tells the story of a magical girl paramilitary group fighting back against an unknown force invading Earth.

The human race is on the brink of total annihilation by the mysterious force known as the ‘Locks. GARDA, a global paramilitary organization, has finally discovered the means to fight back: magical girls.

Lead your small, ragtag group toward victory at all costs. Get to know your “soldiers” and take direct control on the battlefield to reclaim Earth. Good luck.

KEY FEATURES

  • Smooth Character Action Combat – Control a magical girl and fight with a variety of moves to take out your opponents!

  • A Gripping Story – Follow the struggle of GARDA and get to know the magical girls, along with a number of other characters!

  • Two Playable Magical Girls – Experience their unique movesets and playstyles!

  • Side Quests and Alternative Gameplay – Complete side quests and enjoy a variety of different mini-games (cyberspace battles, drone racing, and rail shooting) 

  • Exciting Boss Battles – Fight unique bosses!

  • Spells and Skills to Unlock – Level up to become stronger and unlock unique abilities through the skill tree!

data.name: Bake Neko Love
data.detailed_description:
About the game :

In an enchanted world, play as an immortal Bake-Neko whom everyone mistakes for… a simple cat.

Haunted by the voices of those they have lost, tired of living, they now long for only one thing: to end it all.

After centuries of wandering, guided by whispers of magic, they arrive in a city where people are about to celebrate a very odd event.

A visual novel with multiple choices, featuring diverse, deep, magical and deeply endearing characters.

Every decision will shape your relationships and your fate.
So… will you be able to give this grumpy cat a reason to live again?

Features:

~ Make tons of friends and help them solve their problems!🌸

Use others to get what you want.

~ Learn more about this magical city and your past!✨

Settle for what you have and let Death come to you.

~ Unlock illustrations using one of your superpowers!💕

What’s the point of collecting images? They won’t follow you into the Other World.

~ Multiple cutscenes packed with emotion!🌟

Relive your torment, whether you want to or not.

~ Make choices that will determine your own ending!🌈

What ending are you hoping for? Death might be your best option.

~ Will you manage to save this grumpy cat? ❤️

🐈Find out in this visual novel! 🐾

data.name: The Fisherman and the Drifting Bottle
data.detailed_description:
The Fisherman and the Drifting Bottle is a unique desktop idle game. Instead of dominating your screen, it resides quietly as a narrow strip at the bottom. Whether you are working, studying, browsing the web, or watching videos, the lonely fisherman will always be there with you—fishing, waiting, and keeping watch.

Key Features:

🎣 Fishing

No constant interaction is required; the fisherman catches fish automatically. With its non-intrusive design, the game blends perfectly into your desktop environment.

The game features 180 unique types of fish, each with imaginative images, names, and descriptions.

Includes a complete encyclopedia (Pokedex) and fishing achievements!

🌊 Drift Bottles

This is the soul of the game. Use your fishing earnings to purchase exquisite bottles, stamps, and gifts.

Send: Write down the thoughts, secrets, or wishes you cannot share with people in real life. Seal them in a bottle and cast them into the vast ocean.

Retrieve: Randomly fish up bottles sent by strangers from around the world. It might be a simple "good night," a joke, or a touching story.

The ocean tides are unpredictable. When will your letter arrive? When will you get a reply? Every moment is an unknown surprise.

In some drift bottles, you may find a piece of parchment. It could be a word of encouragement, a sad thought, a famous quote, lyrics, or a poem.

We have prepared over 2000 notes, and every content will be translated into your language.

If you like a note, you can also add it to your bookmarks.

Besides drift bottles, you can also consume stamps to communicate in real-time based on the other person's address.

The game can become even smaller and more hidden, ensuring it never interrupts your work.

data.name: HyperQ: The 4Dimensional Roguelike
data.detailed_description:
HyperQ is a 4Dimensional Roguelike Horror Shooter. It looks like The Binding of Isaac and Crimsonland melted into one & spiced with a bit of absurd humor. The stroryline is inspired by science-fiction horror movie Cube2: HyperCube.

  • 5 unrelated people
  • 5 unique characters
  • 5 different stories
  • 5 combat styles

1 common goal... Survive ...


  • Randomly generated world - each time your game experience will be different!
  • It's a shooter game with RPG system – the longer you survive, the stronger you become!
  • It's hard to survive alone - together will be much easier in Co-op mode!
  • 5 characters - own story, gameplay, skills, weapons each!
  • Dynamic world - depends on your decisions!
  • Over 100 Challenging Achievements - so much fun!
  • Many Unlockables - new Weaons, PickUps, PowerUps!
  • If you love The Binding of Isaac, Hotline Miami or Crimsonland you will be satisfied for many hours!
  • Once you finished this game, you are far from seeing everything – there are many ways to reach the goal!
  • Beware the Darkness!



A.K.A. "BoneCrusher". Do not provoke him because you'll find out why they call him that. His fists are harder than rock. Not very talkative. Many legends circulate about him, but no one knows why he is in jail. He is unbelievably strong but still relatively fast.

  • Primary Weapon: Fists
  • Secondary Weapon: Pistol
  • Ability: Bullet time


She lost her parents and then escaped from the orphanage. Brought up by the street. As a teenager, she became a gang leader. Smuggling... Kidnapping... Robberies... Inhabitants from afar see her and run home. The police are helpless. Nobody's messing with her. And if there is even someone... He lives short... It is extremely fast, agile and… fragile. It helps her to survive everyday on the street.

  • Primary Weapon: Baseball
  • Secondary Weapon: Uzi
  • Ability: Jump


A brilliant scientist. He led a group of scientists during a secret governmental science program. His team managed to distinguish the Singularity from the inside of the black hole. With it, they managed to create the first 4-dimensional object – HyperCube. At the next stage of the experiment, the Object was extremely unstable and absorbed him. Officially Declared Dead. P.S. His wheelchair is rapid.

  • Primary Weapon: PortalGun
  • Secondary Weapon: BlackHole Generator
  • Ability: Hawk King's ForceShield


A teenager hacker, the network knows as _Cond0r. Every electronic device can be hacked & this young man knows how to do it. Never alone. He always has his best companion with him - Drone. He modified this toy in a deadly weapon. Small but ingenius.

  • Primary Weapon: Drone Fazer
  • Secondary Weapon: Drone MiniRifle
  • Ability: Hacking


He was a rat exterminator. Unaware. He took up the dangerous job of cleaning the HyperCube, thinking it was just another job. Nobody told him there was no way out. His contract was an ordinary pitch. His titanium PowerArmor is extremely durable and hence extremely heavy and slow.

  • Primary Weapon: Heater
  • Secondary Weapon: FlameThower
  • Ability: Release valve

data.name: Flux Caves
data.detailed_description:
Your spaceship has crashed on a foreign planet...and there are many challenges and surprises to overcome!
Fix the energy pipes so that enough fuel can reach your spare spaceship, and you'll be able to fly away.

The goal of Flux Caves is for the player to have a peace of mind at the end of a hard day. In this game, there is no losing or dying; here, you can discover peaceful caves and open-world puzzles, all while listening to soothing music and working your brain muscles.

Game runtime is 180-240 minutes.

The game made by a single developer



The game was made by one developer, Zsolt Várady alias fubenalvo, who developed Flux Caves in his free time. So the result is not perfect, but there's are no known blocker bugs. I hope you will enjoy it! ;)

Music credits

Title: Untitled

Alexander Skeppstedt

data.name: EternalQube
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to EternalQube, the game where the grid is ever-changing, the Qubes are relentless, and your goal is simple: survive, adapt, and score as high as you can. With over 100 procedurally generated levels, no two playthroughs are the same. The Qubes shift, the boulders fall, and the chaos never ends.

Features That Will Keep You on the Edge:

  • Procedurally Generated Madness – Every level is unique, with shifting grids, unpredictable Qube patterns, and endless challenges. No two games are ever the same.

  • Boulders from Above – Dodge falling boulders that crush Qubes, block your path, and add a layer of chaos to your strategy. One wrong move, and your plans could be flattened.

  • Special Qubes from the Sky – Look out for rare, glowing Qubes that fall randomly, offering massive score multipliers, grid-clearing explosions, or temporary power-ups. Grab them before they disappear!

  • Dynamic Movement – Dash, run, and jump to outmaneuver the chaos. Use your agility to avoid boulders, reach special Qubes, and navigate the ever-shifting grid.

  • Score Attack Mode – Your goal is simple: get the highest score possible. Chain combos, activate special Qubes, and survive as long as you can to climb the global leaderboards.

  • Over 100 Levels of Mayhem – Each level introduces new challenges, from faster boulders to more complex grid patterns. Can you make it to the end?

  • Sanity-Warping Visuals – As you progress, the grid becomes more chaotic, the colors more intense, and the soundtrack more unnerving. The game itself seems to fight back.

  • Global Leaderboards – Compete with players worldwide to see who can endure the chaos and claim the top spot. Will you be the EternalQube champion?

  • Steam Integration – Track your achievements, share your progress, and let your friends witness your descent into Qube-fueled madness.

How to Play:

  • Shift and Match – Align Qubes to clear them from the grid and score points. But beware: the Qubes shifts constantly, and boulders will crush your plans.

  • Grab Special Qubes – Keep an eye out for glowing Qubes that fall from the sky. They can give you massive bonuses, but they won’t last forever.

  • Move Smart – Use your dash, run, and jump abilities to outmaneuver boulders, reach special Qubes, and stay alive.

  • Survive and Score – The longer you last, the higher your score. But as the levels progress, the chaos intensifies. Can you keep up?

EternalQube: Where the Grid is Infinite, the Qubes are Relentless, and Your Sanity is Optional.

data.name: Travellers Rest
data.detailed_description:
Craft, farm, build and cook! In Travellers Rest you will have to use all the available tools to become the best tavern keeper in the realm. Create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers as you discover the world and its colorful characters. Take your establishment to the top in this exciting new adventure!

Your tavern, your rules

Expand and manage your own fantasy tavern. Customize it with furniture and other decorative elements to improve your reputation. Do not stop until you have the tavern of your dreams!

Tend to your customers

Hundreds of customers are waiting to be tended to – serve them a nice mug of beer or kick them out if they start to bother the others! Earn mountains of gold and become the best tavern keeper in the land.

Create your own style

Discover new recipes and create unique dishes and drinks to please your customers. Of course, you will have to get your hands on the best products to keep them satisfied – craft hundreds of items and furniture to take your establishment to the highest level!

Discover the world

The realm is full of colorful characters and things to do. Take a couple of days off and explore to discover all that the realm has to offer – you are sure to find something useful for your tavern on your journeys!

Play with your friends

Have fun playing online in games of up to 4 players! Team up with your friends to explore the world, or set them to work at your tavern! (And you won't have to pay them any gold for it!)

data.name: Office Wars: Escape from 9 to 5
data.detailed_description:
Escape the 9 to 5

Office Wars: Escape from 9 to 5 is a fast-paced bullet-hell roguelike focused on build variety and controlled chaos. In a dystopian future, a mega-corporation rules over the workforce. As one of the few rebels, you try to break free from the 9 to 5 and fight your way up to the executive floor.

Armed with stapler pistols, toner launchers, and other absurd office weapons, you’ll blast through anything standing in your way – from stacks of invoices to mighty bosses with their own special abilities.

Will you escape the 9 to 5?

Upradeable Weapons & Perks

  • 20+ weapons, each with 3 unique upgrades

  • 50+ perks for crazy builds

  • Random combinations make every run unique

Two Game Modes

  • Campaign – climb the corporate tower floor by floor until you face the Boss of Bosses

  • Arena Mode – endless survival on different maps

Achievements

  • Unlock new perks, characters and weapons by completing challenges

data.name: Line Story
data.detailed_description:
Open the sketchbook of Lili the cat and Nene the rabbit, where little moments from everyday life are waiting to take shape.

Follow the numbers, connect the dots, and watch each solved puzzle become a drawing that brings their cozy storybook world to life, one line at a time.

Every drawing begins with a puzzle.

Follow the number clues on the grid and connect neighboring dots — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Find the right connections, satisfy every clue, and watch the hidden picture gradually take shape.

From simple outlines to more intricate patterns, each puzzle brings a new little discovery.

Every completed puzzle adds a little something to Lili and Nene's storybook.

Draw familiar objects, collect your finished illustrations, and watch them find their place in a larger scene.

As more drawings come together, once-empty pages fill with delightful details, gradually revealing the everyday adventures of Lili and Nene.

What starts with simple number clues gradually unfolds into new challenges.

Discover different counting rules, multi-layered puzzles, and increasingly intricate patterns that invite you to think a little differently.

Take your time, observe the possibilities, and find the connections that satisfy every clue.

There's no need to rush. Enjoy each puzzle at your own pace, or revisit completed levels and aim for a higher rating.

The joy of creating doesn't have to stop at solving puzzles.

An in-game level editor and Steam Workshop support are planned for the full release. Our goal is to give you the tools to design and test your own line puzzles, share your creations, and discover imaginative challenges made by other players.

From simple sketches to intricate logic puzzles, every creation is a chance to share a little story of your own.

The level editor and Steam Workshop features are currently in development and are planned for the full release.

Key Features

  • Draw by connecting the dots: Follow number clues and connect neighboring dots to reveal hidden illustrations, one line at a time.

  • From simple lines to intricate puzzles: Discover different counting rules, new challenges, and multi-layered drawings.

  • Bring storybook scenes to life: Complete and collect illustrations that gradually fill Lili and Nene's world with everyday moments.

  • A cozy hand-drawn world: Enjoy soft colors, delicate paper textures, and the company of Lili the cat and Nene the rabbit.

  • Play at your own pace: Take your time with each puzzle, or replay completed levels to improve your ratings.

  • Create and share your own puzzles: An in-game level editor and Steam Workshop support are planned for the full release, opening the door to new puzzles and creative possibilities.

Every little story begins with a line. Pick up your pencil and start drawing with Lili and Nene!

data.name: Peg Cascade
data.detailed_description:
Peg Cascade is a polished neon arcade-idle game built around satisfying drops, escalating upgrades, score-chasing, timed progression, and creative Custom Board play.

Drop balls into glowing peg boards, trigger cascading score chains, and build your way through increasingly powerful upgrade paths. Every run starts simple: a few balls, a board full of pegs, and a score target. Then the screen comes alive with multipliers, charged effects, faster drops, and waves of bouncing arcade chaos.

In Sandbox, progression unfolds board by board while your score keeps climbing. Complete the target, keep the cascade running, continue upgrading, and let the board turn into a glowing score machine. Sandbox is built for players who enjoy watching numbers rise, experimenting with upgrade paths, and pushing a board far beyond the clear requirement.

For a sharper challenge, Timed Race turns each board into a clean speedrun-style clear. The clock starts on your first peg hit and stops when the board is complete, giving you records to chase across different Prestige tiers.

Peg Cascade also features a major Custom Board mode. Build your own peg layouts, test different shapes, create your own cascade playgrounds, and share board layouts with friends. Import a friend’s board, try their design, compare results, and see who can make the most chaotic, efficient, or ridiculous cascade.

Designed to be easy to understand and satisfying to optimize, Peg Cascade blends idle-game progression with arcade-style feedback. It is about watching the board light up, finding stronger upgrade paths, letting the score run wild, shaving time off your clears, building custom layouts, and sharing the cascade with other players.

Key Features:

- Drop balls into neon peg boards and watch the cascade build

- Progress through 10 standard boards, each with its own scoring challenge

- Upgrade across four paths: Core, Cascade, Precision, and Charge

- Play Sandbox mode for steady progression, experimentation, and long-running score growth

- Keep Sandbox boards running after completion to push your score higher

- Play Timed Race mode to chase faster clears and better records

- Prestige through speed tiers from 50% to 100%

- Track records by Prestige tier

- Unlock a full Sandbox-only Custom Board mode

- Build your own peg layouts and experiment with board shapes

- Export Custom Board layouts and send them to friends

- Import shared Custom Boards and try other players’ creations

- Built-in original soundtrack with randomized playlist playback

- Polished arcade presentation with glowing effects, responsive UI, and fullscreen desktop support

- Simple to start, satisfying to optimize

- Available in 8 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

data.name: Valley Run
data.detailed_description:
An addictive endless runner that will test even the best reflexes! A classic mobile game genre brought to VR with endless fun of progressively more challenging speed and a daring test of you skills.

You've entered a dangerous valley full of gold and dangerous challenges. Ride on a futuristic hover bike in the red valley collecting coins that increase your multiplier, drastically improving your chances of reaching a new high score!
On your path you will encounter challenging obstacles, like cliffs, buildings, flames and more! But don't worry there is help along the path, you will encounter four different power ups that will help you survive longer. Double Points - will double the points gathered, Shield - will make you immune to losing the game, Magnet - pulls in all nearby coins letting you focus only on avoiding any obstacles and finally Frenzy - where for a short duration only coins will spawn letting you relax and collect enormous amounts of points!

data.name: Broken Lands Village
data.detailed_description:
The real world no longer exists! I was trapped in this cursed Village made of inkblots on parchment. Every day I'm stalked by an assasin and stuck in a time loop. None of the residents remember me, although I myself have memories. I need to get out of here ASAP!

Discover the secret of the dark Village by exploring it every day in a time loop! Find out what the Shadow Council is and what their intentions are for Your soul. Explore objects, collect items and use them to keep moving forward and discover the truth. Have interesting conversations with the inhabitants of the Village. They certainly hide more than one secret in their minds. The end is inevitable. The end will be the beginning.

Key Features:

  • Time loop - In the morning, You wake up in the town square. You must use the time until midnight as efficiently as possible to collect informations, items, talk to characters and explore new locations. Midnight is the marker of the end and a new beginning. The only thing left is the knowledge and experience acquired, or maybe something more?
  • Soul Reflection - Discover mystical decision-making possibilities. Will you keep the light within? Will the darkness consume you?
  • Character Mood - Meet the inhabitants of the Village. Remember, however, that everyone can have a bad or better day! More may depend on this than you might think.
  • Day and night cycle - Watch the sky to approximately determine how much time is left until midnight. You are stuck in a time loop, so this is a very important issue. How much can you do in the time given to you? Check on your own
  • Diary - A few sheets of paper with a cover, but you can't move without them. Accumulate knowledge in the inherent object of every seeker of truth.
  • Items - Explore locations, maybe you will find something useful?
  • Clear interface - You no longer have to search the entire screen with the cursor to find an interactive object, as in other adventure games. All this type of stuff is marked with buttons.

data.name: John Christian
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the John Christian game installation.

The John Christian Game is a third-person game, with challenges, traps throughout the levels and spiritual battles of good against evil represented by seven sins and their soldiers.

The story tells of the heroism of a young man, who after receiving the armor of God, goes in search of imprisoned lives. On his journey, he will need to face obstacles and enemies who want to keep these people in the prison of sin.

To win and see the lives freed, he will use the armor of God, the knowledge of the Word acquired during the walk, the prayer and the power of the Holy Spirit.

Standing firmly, girded with the belt of truth, wearing the breastplate of justice and having his feet shod with the readiness of the gospel of peace, young John will continue his journey in preaching the message of deliverance. Using the shield of faith to defend himself against the enemy's incessant attacks, the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God, he will fight the good fight and keep his faith until the end of his journey.


Thank you for contributing and participating in the project for the first version of the game.

Sincerely,

Carlos Martins - Blue Crab

data.name: Education
data.detailed_description:
Having done some terrible things in his youth at school, his memories call Bart Blake back to that place, in his nightmares.

Education is a short and atmospheric horror game. In it, you unravel the mysteries that took place 15 years ago at the school that you want to escape from. There are six short chapters filled with gore and puzzles.

  • Six highly immersive levels that save the game progress at their beginnings
  • Some locked doors with mysteries behind them
  • A captivating storyline that reveals itself via reading the students' diaries and old newspapers
  • Atmospheric sound designed to carry you through the highs and lows of your journey
  • Thrilling music that accompanies the atmosphere
  • Gameplay that involves exploration through the corridors of the abandoned school
  • Some collectibles to be found and collected through careful exploration

Save progression: The game saves your progression at the beginning of each level.

PS: The core aspect of this game is the atmosphere. It is recommended for those who mostly seek to experience the mood.

data.name: Whispers
data.detailed_description:
Whispers is a psychological horror experience presented through the last recorded vlog of a missing vlogger.

You enter an abandoned hospital to retrace their final moments. What begins as an exploration of a forgotten place slowly turns into something far more disturbing, as unexplained sounds, whispers, and strange events begin to blur the line between reality and what may exist only in your mind.

Listen carefully. Something is always there.

Explore the Unknown

Explore three distinct environments: a dark forest, an abandoned hospital, and its basement. As you move deeper into each location, the environment gradually reveals more of the story and the events surrounding the hospital.

Investigate What Happened

Search the environment for notes, newspaper articles, and other clues scattered throughout the hospital. Piece together what happened and uncover the disturbing story hidden within its walls.

But not every answer comes easily. Anonymous notes found throughout the hospital raise new questions and make it increasingly difficult to understand what is really happening.

Listen to the Whispers

Sound is at the heart of Whispers.

Unexplained noises and voices can emerge from different directions, using spatial audio to create uncertainty about what is around you. Whispers may come from somewhere in the environment, surround you from multiple directions, or feel as though they are coming from inside your own mind.

You won't always know where the sound came from.

Question What Is Real

As the footage continues, reality becomes increasingly uncertain.

Disturbing sights and unexplained events begin to appear, making it difficult to tell what is actually happening and what may exist only within the protagonist's mind.

Survive the Experience

Whispers focuses on psychological tension, atmosphere, sound, and anticipation rather than relying entirely on jump scares.

Traditional scares are combined with visual disturbances, environmental changes, and an unpredictable soundscape to keep you constantly questioning what might happen next.

Found-Footage Horror

The entire experience is presented through a VHS-style found-footage aesthetic.

Distorted footage, limited visibility, and eerie environments create a feeling of vulnerability. Darkness doesn't simply hide the environment - it makes you question what you might be seeing.

Enter the hospital. Follow the footage. Listen to the whispers.
