data.name: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition
data.detailed_description:
Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition adds all-new enhanced features to the content of Neverwinter Nights Diamond Edition.

Slink through the shadows as a deadly half-elven rogue, wield fearsome magics as a powerful gnomish sorcerer, vanquish your foes as an armor-clad dwarven paladin... whatever hero you create, incredible adventures await.

Discover magic, wonder, and danger at every turn on your own or with friends in these classic Dungeons & Dragons adventures.

Enhanced Features:

  • Improved Display: Your portrait, combat bar, inventory, and other UI elements adjust in size based on your chosen resolution including 1080p and 4k.
  • Advanced Graphics Options: Pixel shaders and post-processing effects make for crisper, cleaner visuals. Enable contrast, vibrance, and depth of field options as preferred.
  • Community Endorsed: Original developers have teamed with key members of the Neverwinter Nights community to curate important fan-requested improvements to support players, storytellers, and modders.
  • Backwards Compatibility: Works with save games, modules, and mods from the original Neverwinter Nights. A galaxy of community created content awaits.
  • Restored Multiplayer: A completely rebuilt multiplayer system makes it easy to find online persistent worlds and game with friends
  • More Modder Opportunities: Toolset quality-of-life improvements, shaders, filters, texture maps, and a new material systems allow creators to make amazing looking models and modules.

All the content of Neverwinter Nights Diamond Edition:

The original Neverwinter Nights campaign: Find yourself at the center of intrigue, betrayal, and dark magic in Neverwinter Nights. Journey through dangerous cities, monster filled dungeons and deep into uncharted wilderness in search of the cure for a cursed plague ravaging the city of Neverwinter.
Two expansion packs:
  • Shadows of Undrentide: Another adventure begins in Shadows of Undrentide! Charged by your master to recover four ancient artifacts, travel from the Silver Marches to unravel mysteries of a long-dead magical civilization.
  • Hordes of the Underdark: Continue the adventure started in Shadows of Undrentide and journey into the ever-more bizarre and hostile depths of Undermountain to challenge a gathering evil.
Three premium modules:
Discover over 40 hours of new stories, then go on to sample the hundreds of modules created by community members just like you.
  • Kingmaker
  • ShadowGuard
  • Witch’s Wake
The Aurora Toolset: Build your own world full of unique monsters, items, traps, encounters, and settings, then share your creation with the rest of the Neverwinter Nights community. (Windows only)
Dungeon Master Client: Become the storyteller! Control monsters, creatures, and characters your players will meet over the course of an adventure.

data.name: Color Hunt - Number Jigsaw Puzzle
data.detailed_description:
Color Hunt is a fun and relaxing puzzle game. It’s more than just coloring- it's a randomly generated number block jigsaw game that'll take your brain to another level!

data.name: If Fusion Were That Easy
data.detailed_description:
If Fusion Were That Easy is a classic point-and-click adventure.
You take on the role of the young physicist Daniel, who is working on a reactor for cold fusion. As the project spiraled out of control, a mysterious association emerges that somehow appears to be involved. When Daniel meets crazy old George, the chaos seems perfect.

A mixture of 2D pixel art and 3D characters and elements creates a unique visual world of experience that invites you to explore and discover. Games like "The Secret of Monkey Island" or the Deponia series, but also Professor Layton, have inspired this game. With an exciting story, lots of humor, and challenging puzzles, If Fusion Were That Easy offers hours of fun entertainment.

In summary, If Fusion Were That Easy can be described as a modern retro point-and-click adventure that you can never have enough of.


The hero of If Fusion Were That Easy is the young physicist Daniel, who likes to get himself into a mess from which he has to free himself again. In addition to Daniel, the player also slips into the role of George, a crazy guy who is often helpful, but all the more confused.
In the present, cold fusion is on the verge of a breakthrough as things spiral out of control. Daniel seems to be the only one who can still stop a disaster. But he needs help - and then the Clan gets in his way, a mysterious association that causes Daniel a lot of trouble. Can our hero find a way to stop the inevitable and save the world? What does the Clan want? And are things really as they seem?

The coherent game world offers a lot of different settings and scenes in which the player can move freely. The city park, the nuclear power plant, or the tavern are just some of the more than 40 different scenes that the player has to visit and master in addition to the numerous minigames and puzzles.





Simple controls and a sleek user interface make the game suitable for die-hard fans of the genre as well as casual gamers. "If Fusion Were That Easy" is designed to be controlled with a mouse and keyboard, but the controller support also allows you to play comfortably from your couch.

data.detailed_description:
Landflix Odyssey is an action platform in which players play as Larry, a lazy binge-watcher who finds himself trapped inside the streaming service after using special batteries. This incredible world is called Landflix!
In order to return home he has to recover all five batteries ended up inside the TV shows on the Landflix platform.

Landflix Odyssey is a clear reference to video-on-demand platforms and TV shows universe.
In each TV show our hero can count on some special powers that will help him overcome obstacles and dangers in any game world.
Our hero can move through parallel dimensions, use magic swords, do superhero stuff with superhero tools, take drugs to increase productivity and defend himself with a crossbow against hordes of zombies.

data.name: Amicraft Factory™
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Amicraft Factory™ — the cozy automation adventure

where cute Ami creatures (your little "friends") help you

build a beautiful production paradise.

🐾 Tiny creatures. 🏭 Massive factories. ✨ Zero stress.

Amicraft Factory™ lets you create a living town-factory that

grows with you. Start with simple tools and tiny machines,

then expand into full production lines with conveyors,

crafting stations, power, and upgrades — all while your Ami

friends cheer you on, move in, and help run the place.

═══════════════════════════════════════════

🏡 BUILD A FACTORY THAT FEELS LIKE HOME

═══════════════════════════════════════════

This isn't a grim, polluted industrial world — it's a vibrant,

stylized land where your machines can be tidy, creative, and

aesthetic. Design cozy workshops, decorate your town, lay

down beautiful pathways, and make your mega-factory look as

good as it runs.

═══════════════════════════════════════════

🐾 YOUR AMI FRIENDS MAKE IT ALIVE

═══════════════════════════════════════════

Meet adorable Ami creatures with personalities and roles:

🛠️ Some love building and upgrading machines

🚚 Some haul rare materials across your factory

💡 Some invent new recipes and request town improvements

🎨 Some just want to decorate

Completing their projects unlocks new recipes, new tech, and

new areas to explore.

═══════════════════════════════════════════

🤝 CO-OP FACTORY BUILDING WITH FRIENDS

═══════════════════════════════════════════

Play solo or team up in seamless co-op to gather resources,

plan massive production grids, and build together. Split

jobs, eliminate bottlenecks on the assembly line, decorate

the town, and create the ultimate cozy factory world as a

team. Argue about whether the conveyor should turn left or

right.

✨ The best factories are built with friends.

🔧 RELAXING PROGRESSION, ENDLESS SATISFACTION

⚙️ Automate more

🧪 Unlock new materials

🏘️ Watch your town evolve from a tiny workshop into a thriving

factory community

— powered by friendship, creativity, and the joy of "just one

more upgrade."

day excited to do it again.

═══════════════════════════════════════════

🔨 Build with friends.

🌈 Automate with joy.

🌟 Make a world you'll want to live in.

data.name: Cosmic Cafe
data.detailed_description:
🍽️ About This Game – Cosmic Café

You are the new owner of the once-legendary Cosmic Café. With the previous owner missing and the galaxy ravaged by a ruthless corporate overlord, Take charge and restore the café to its former glory and discover the mystery behind your new and unexpected role.

🍽️ Manage & Upgrade Your Café

Bring this forgotten café back to life with new machines, décor, and custom asteroid biomes. Upgrade your kitchen and cafe tools to serve up exotic dishes and premium services 

🧭 Explore Biomes & Gather Ingredients

Battle your way through artificial biomes to collect rare alien ingredients for your menu.

🧪 Transform Your DNA & Adapt

Use the Cafe's advanced technology to Harvest DNA from mutated lifeforms and transform yourself unlocking new forms!

👽 Rescue and Serve your Customers

The Gecks, a once peaceful native species, have been taxed and brainwashed into servitude.  Rescue them and turn them into loyal café customers.

⚖️ Fight Back Against the Galactic Revenue Service

The Galactic Revenue Service will stop at nothing to shut you down. Master alien-level tax evasion and defend your cafe while uncovering the truth behind their grip on the universe.

About the Developer
I’m Michael, a solo game developer who began my journey as a 3D artist, collaborating with studios to craft unique art styles and immersive worlds.

Cosmic Café grew from my love of sci-fi, ’90s cartoons, and adventure into unknown worlds. Set in a bizarre, handcrafted space environment, it’s a world where creativity, chaos, and weird alien cuisine collide!

data.name: Overhang
data.detailed_description:
OVERHANG

Overhang is a minimalist, skill-based stacking game focused on precision and control.

Launch blocks, control your angle, and land them perfectly to build an unstable tower. Every placement matters—one bad landing can end your run.

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Aim and launch each block with precision

  • Build vertically while managing balance

  • Land clean placements to keep your run alive

MECHANICS THAT MATTER

  • Bounce system — Use walls to reposition mid-flight

  • Nudge ability — Earn limited corrections through skillful play

  • Tight control — No randomness, only execution

MODES

  • Standard Mode — Full mechanics with wall bounces and nudges

  • No Wall Bounce Mode — Pure precision, no recovery

REPLAYABILITY

  • Endless runs with increasing difficulty

  • High score chasing

  • Simple mechanics with a high skill ceiling

What is Undead Darlings?

Journey with and learn more about a crew of half-zombie girls through visual novel sequences and as you crawl through dungeons, beating up twisted creatures that were born from the fall of society in fast-paced turn-based RPG combat, and ultimately deliver the only known cure for what ails your party members to a place where it can be mass produced!

The visual novel portion contains a multitude of branching dialogue paths that, based on the choices you make, gives deeper insight into the different characters, whereas the RPG portion of the game uses a familiar but refined turn-based battle system with unique twists. Both of these gameplay features are contained within a dungeon crawler, meaning dungeons are explored from a first-person perspective in four cardinal directions, with the dungeon itself built like a maze and filled with traps and hidden paths.

Story

The story of Undead Darlings ~no cure for love~ revolves around Reginald "Reggie" P. Happenstahnce and his journey to take the cure for the zombie plague someplace safe; somewhere it can be mass-produced. His father—one of the scientists purported to be involved in the outbreak's inception—created this cure and left it behind before leaving on his own for the same purpose.

The game opens with Reggie waking up from an alcohol-related coma (courtesy of his own father, no less) and being told by his childhood friend Pearl that society had crumbled due to a virus outbreak that turned most everyone into zombies while he was sleeping. This includes Pearl herself. However, Pearl has managed to hold onto her human conscience, and she relates that she is not the only one this has happened to. As with every half-zombie Reggie will run into, she may be undead, but her heart is still human.

Your role as Reggie is to be the girls’ loot donkey and carry the things they find in dungeons. Since Reggie is a human, the girls will prevent him from getting infected by fighting in the front lines! Go them!

While on this adventure, you will learn more about the undead girls' lives from before the outbreak, but whose tale you will hear is based on the choices you make during the visual novel scenes. Perhaps one of them will connect with you, open up about their hardships, and maybe even develop romantic feelings... The ultimate result of these interactions will determine whether or not any of these girls trust you enough to take the biggest risk of their undead lives—volunteer to be the first test subject for your father's cure!

Key Features

  • Explore a multitude of complex post-apocalyptic dungeons—a total of over 20 huge floors to explore! Discover loot, secret event scenes based on your current battle party, and more!
  • Become invested in a novel-sized epic adventure—a script of over 300,000 words and more branching dialogue choices than you can shake your boomstick at await! The adventure is filled with comedy, slices of romantic life, and the horrors associated with surviving the zombie apocalypse from a zombie’s perspective!
  • All character art has been specifically drawn inverted as well, so you never get pulled from the story because someone's scar magically switched shoulders (inverted art vs. mirrored art—never spoken of because it is hardly ever utilized...until now!)
  • Key events give you the chance to grow closer to the girls, and by doing so, you will access specific character story arcs that come with gorgeous HD images of the characters for you to unlock! Over 20 unlockable images in total—gotta collect 'em all!
  • Six playable, awesome half-zombie girls lead the charge!
  • Nine endings based on your choices and how close you grow with the characters!
  • No currency or stores exist in the post-apocalypse, so you will need to fill up your war chest by finding loot in dungeons. Be careful, though—weaponry will break if used too much!
  • Loot system supplies you with armor, items, and weaponry. Weapons come in both Common and Rare varieties—but both come with durability counts that indicate how much abuse they can take.
  • Rare weapons may have Skills attached, adding a bit of flexibility in balancing out an effective battle party!
  • Exploit multiple enemy weaknesses simultaneously in the unique Exponential Exploitation battle mechanic! Increase your damage multiplier and utilize it for a one-time attack that can deal tremendous damage!
  • Set up custom battle strategies with the Macro function! Use this wisely in tandem with the EE System to create efficient tactics against your current roster of foes!
  • When all is said and done, you will enjoy a 50-hour adventure unlocking everything!

data.name: Kriegsfront Battlescaper - Diorama Editor
data.detailed_description:
Kriegsfront Battlescaper is a free utility tool / mecha-diorama-building-toy where you can create battlefield dioramas using built-in photo mode, mecha builder, and level editor. This is based on the development and modding tool for our upcoming mecha turn-based tactics game, Kriegsfront Tactics.


Mecha Editor:
- Create and design your own Krieger Mecha.
- Mix-and-match various mech body parts to create your own unique Krieger.
- Customize the look of your Krieger using color, patterns, materials, etc.
- Arm your Krieger with an arsenal of weapons and artillery.


Level Editor:
- Use various terraforming tools to create your own battlefield diorama.
- Place props and objects to add more details.
- Utilize the Photo Mode to take action shots.

data.name: Zootisan
data.detailed_description:
Zootisan is a relaxing nature-building strategy and puzzle game in which you play cards to create enclosures from biomes and animals for this ever-growing zoo. With Zootisan, you can immerse yourself in a quiet, peaceful world at any time and take a break from everyday life.

In Zootisan you start with a deck of cards of your choice. Each day you can play cards into your zoo based on your energy. Once you run out of energy you can end the day and draw a new set of cards from your deck. Your goal is to reach the next score at the end of the week proving that your zoo is thriving.

Groups of biomes are formed, such as grasslands, forests, mountains, deserts, water bodies or arctic, which can accomodate animals based on their size and biome requirements.

Unique biomes will appear once you reach them, each providing a variety of quests with exciting rewards once completed.

What Zootisan offers

  • Relaxing atmosphere

  • Building endless and beautiful landscapes

  • High replay value

  • Idyllic zoo scenery

  • Cute animals

  • Strategic placement

  • Many unlockable cards

  • Beautiful artstyle

What Zootisan doesn't offer

  • Combat & Violence

  • Online Multiplayer

  • Guns

  • Microtransactions

  • Trading

  • Deal for your soul

Zootisan was developed by a group of game developers from Hungary. Together we want to develop many more small, high-quality indie games in the future.

We are happy about constructive feedback of all kinds, so feel free to contact us! We will do our best to respond messages quickly and fix any problems that may arise.

data.name: Project Sundive
data.detailed_description:
Can You Assemble Your Ultimate Spaceship?

Project Sundive is a 2D wave-based arena auto-shooter roguelite, where you pilot a spaceship, while your weapons attack nearby enemies. Between rounds, you spend your collected gold on new weapons and boosts, allowing you to create unique and overpowered builds.

Dying or winning will end the run. You start again, with another shot at creating a build strong enough to defeat the final boss.

Drift in Space

Piloting the ship requires you to master physics.

Your ship only rotates towards the mouse, while keeping its full inertia. Thrusting will accelerate you in the direction you are facing, so it's up to you to find the perfect curve to avoid the enemies.

Assemble Your Ship

Each round you collect gold to buy weapons and boosts, or upgrade your existing ones by combining the correct stats.

Each block is slotted into a hex grid, where boosts and corruptions are affecting their adjacent weapons.

Let Bosses Corrupt You

Every 4 waves you fight a boss and receive a special corruption block, which greatly alters your build and playstyle.

Get Even Crazier Next Run

Each run gives you the opportunity to discover and unlock new weapons and ships, allowing you to build even crazier spaceships in your next run.

data.name: AirMech
data.detailed_description:
AirMech® is an Action-RTS game that can be played solo, coop, or against other players or teams online. A unique blend of Tower Defense with light RTS gameplay has something for everyone. Explore at your own pace, recovering Parts from defeated enemies, making your AirMechs more powerful as you advance. Gameplay related items are unlocked through play, with tons of content to explore

Key Features:

  • Action-RTS Transformed: Your AirMech is your cursor for a twist on typical RTS games! From the skies pickup and drop your units to help them, or transform into mech mode and fight along side them. Currently there are 9 unique AirMech frames to choose from, and many skins for each. Every AirMech suits a particular playstyle, so you can pick one and make it perfect or collect a full stable for maximum flexibility.
  • Build Your Army: Dozens of Units are available as you progress through the game. Play the way you want to, between your AirMech and the Units you choose to build.
  • Control Options: Supports both mouse/keyboard and gamepad. (gamepad support WIP, plays well ingame)

data.name: Lady Legal Officer's Submission Training
data.detailed_description:
Lady Legal Officer's Submission Training - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction
Elijah West was originally a low - level hacker. He was hunted by the FX Group for investigating the Ethereal Singularity project. On the verge of death, he was reborn after fusing with the No. 7 Consciousness Insect. With the determination to take revenge and seek the truth, he embarked on a journey to investigate the real purpose of the project. In different places, he met many allies and also encountered various dangers and challenges, such as saving Victoria in a London club and maneuvering with Isabella in a Los Angeles laboratory.
Worldview Atmosphere
The story constructs a future world full of cyberpunk elements. Technology is highly developed, consciousness can be digitized, and there are various mysterious organizations and projects. The Ethereal Singularity project of the FX Group attempts to create controllable consciousness harvesting, which breaks the balance between power and humanity and triggers a series of crises. The whole world is full of conspiracies, dangers and unknowns, giving people a tense and exciting atmosphere.
Highlights of Female Character Interactions
Elijah met several female characters with different personalities during his journey, such as Kyung - eun Choi, Victoria Lancaster, Isabella Somerville, etc. They had different interactions with Elijah. Some were in a cooperative relationship, while others had emotional entanglements. For example, after being saved by Elijah, Victoria played a master - slave game with him, showing the charm and desires of a mature woman.
Tension in Character Relationships
There is both a cooperative relationship and certain contradictions and conflicts between Elijah and the No. 7 Consciousness Insect. He has a life - and - death opposing relationship with the enemies of the FX Group. In addition, the relationships between him and the female characters are also full of tension, with both emotional attraction and considerations of interests. These complex character relationships add a lot of drama to the story.
Scene Features
The story scenes are rich and diverse, from the dilapidated streets of Brooklyn to the neon data clubs in London and then to the laboratories in Los Angeles. Each scene has a unique style and atmosphere. Elements such as cyberpunk - style buildings, holographic screens, and smart devices make players feel as if they are in a future world.
Immersive Experience
Players will follow Elijah's perspective and deeply experience his adventure. Through interacting with various characters and solving various problems, players can feel a strong sense of substitution, as if they are Elijah themselves, personally experiencing everything in the story.
High - Definition Visual Performance
The game uses high - definition graphics to carefully depict character images, scene details and special effects. The cyberpunk - style pictures are colorful, and the lighting and shadow effects are realistic, bringing a visual feast to players.
Functional Gameplay Features
The game supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review previous plots. The automatic playback function allows players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly find the chapters they want, and the high - definition CG presents wonderful pictures to players. The smooth reading experience allows players to enjoy the game without any hindrance.

data.detailed_description:
Woke Quest is a satirical turn-based role-playing game that humorously critiques real-life events, personalities, and RPG conventions.

Four unsuspecting individuals from diverse backgrounds are drawn together by a mysterious force that transcends the boundaries of their reality. Suddenly, a surge of energy engulfs them, transporting them from their computer screens into a realm unlike anything they’ve ever imagined.

Emerging from a cosmic rift, they find themselves in a vibrant world brimming with magic, mythical creatures, and breathtaking landscapes straight out of an RPG. It quickly becomes clear that they are far from home.

Unbeknownst to them, their arrival marks the beginning of an epic saga that will shape the destiny of this enchanted realm and challenge their very understanding of reality.

data.name: Notmads
data.detailed_description:
Your home is a living beast

Customize and expand your home on its back, then take it with you as you explore a handcrafted open world. Notmads is an open world action RPG where you fight with magic, gather resources, find loot, craft, and grow stronger as you progress.

Take your home with you

Your beast carries your home across the world. You can stay with it or move ahead on your own when needed. It stays with you, and you can explore on your own whenever you want.

A magical home

Your home is more than a shelter. Powered by its core, it lets you build magical stations, refine materials, and shape your setup as you go. Add utilities and defensive towers to turn it into a moving fortress.

Gather without tools

You gather resources through your Magical Beam, not axes or pickaxes. Improve it over time, unlock new ways to gather, and use the materials you find to refine resources, brew potions, combine gear, and improve your setup.

Shape your magic

You are a mage, but you are not locked into one path. Focus on one style or mix different ones. Use fire, frost, lightning, arcane power, or physical strength, and find spells with different tiers, stats, and variations. Your gear, perks, and choices define how you fight.

Explore the world

The world is handcrafted and meant to be explored at your own pace. You will come across towns, caves, camps, and hidden places, always looking for better loot, new materials, and the next step forward.

Play solo or with friends

Play solo or with up to 5 players online. Share the same living beast, build on the same moving home, explore together, and progress in a shared world.

Key features

  • Build your home on the back of a living beast

  • Travel across the world with your moving base

  • Play in first or third person

  • Let your beast move and follow you while you explore

  • Build magical stations and defenses to grow your fortress

  • Gather resources using your Magical Beam instead of tools

  • Improve your Magical Beam over time to unlock new uses

  • Brew potions, refine materials, and automate parts of your base

  • Improve and customize your gear to fit your playstyle

  • Find loot with different effects and strengths

  • Use different types of magic and combine them your way

  • Explore a handcrafted world with towns, caves, and dungeons

  • Play solo or with friends in online co-op

data.name: Just Anomalies
data.detailed_description:
"The room is waiting. It has always been waiting. But something is changing."

You open the door, step through—and find yourself back in the same room... Familiar, yet wrong in a way you can’t quite place. There’s a door behind you and a door ahead. Moving forward seems simple enough. Until it isn’t.

Every time you step through, the room reshapes itself, subtly… or not so subtly. A chair that wasn’t there before. A shadow that lingers a little too long. A feeling, creeping at the edges of your mind—that you’re being watched. But by what? Or by whom?

The rules are simple:

  • If the room is the same as when you first saw it, turn back.

  • If something has changed, move forward.

  • Count each right choice till the end.

There are no monsters. No chases. No jump scares. Just the growing weight of the unknown. The deeper you stare into the shifting reality, the stronger the feeling becomes—something is staring back.

Will you reach the end? Or will the room consume you first?

An eerie, slow-burning psychological horror where the only enemy is doubt.

data.name: Alisa: The Parting
data.detailed_description:
Alisa: The Parting is a spin-off of the critically acclaimed 2021 title: Alisa.

Hot on the heels of a wanted criminal who stole a set of mysterious blueprints, Alisa and her partner - Jean François - scour the countryside in search of their quarry. However, unexpected developments lead to Alisa being engulfed, descending down into the madness of the Dollhouse - and Jean is left with his own mystery and set of questions to answer.

You will meet all kinds of characters, good and evil, while trying to survive dangerous situations and uncovering the truth about the stolen blueprints... all the while helping out your new "friends".

The whole campaign can be played either Solo with a CPU partner, or in couch co-op mode with a friend (the good kind)!

Alisa: The Parting provides many avenues for exploration, with a central hub area connecting together the world as you embark on your missions and hunt for the truth. In between adventures, return for a spot of respite, where you can play mini games and complete tiny quests.

This game features:

  • More than just your standard survival horror

  • Real pre-rendered backgrounds and eye-watering cutting edge 640x480 resolution

  • Multiplayer

  • Tons of unlockable content! Not just weapons and cosmetic outfits...

  • Genuine replayability

  • Lots of gameplay variety within the boundaries of the genre

  • WARNING: high difficulty as a standard

  • A large variety of enemies and locations

  • Surprises around every corner

  • Silly humour

  • REALLY good 90's style voice acting

  • A nostalgic trip to the late 1990s ~ early 2000s

data.name: Spiritstead
data.detailed_description:
Spiritstead is an easy going and satisfying city builder. Arrive in a quiet, enchanted land where humans and magical spirits work together. Take charge and put your villagers to work as you create their homes, support their lives, and make your village beautiful along the way.

RELAXING AND SATISFYING

Create freely in creative mode without any pressures and just enjoy building. Here for a satisfying challenge? Manage your villagers needs and wants as you make something as aesthetically pleasing as it is practical in adventure mode. 

A GENTLER EXPERIENCE

Enjoy an easy to learn, laid back village clicker. Spiritstead is a simple yet satisfying city builder with fun clicker elements and takes around 3-5 hours to play through end to end in survival mode. Spiritstead is endlessly replayable, but the game world remains the same each time. 

Overseeing the lives of so many can be hard work, but here you have a magical place full of spirits ready to help. Discover them through interactions with the world as you meet quirky, charming creatures who make each day in your village easier to manage. Collect them all to live alongside your people and create spirit buildings to support them.

Support your townsfolk by assigning them jobs, meeting all their needs, and helping them enjoy life with happiness-boosting buildings like cafes, markets, and bonfires. Unlock new buildings, decorations, and upgrades as you progress through the game to help you look after your residents.

Enjoy creating the town of your dreams in a stunning bespoke visual style inspired by Miyazaki films and your favorite cartoons, handcrafted by our talented artist. Beneath its comfortable atmosphere lie hidden secrets waiting to be discovered as you expand into new territories with the help of wandering spirits and work to restore the Grand Spirit Sanctuary, bringing balance between spirits and humans.
data.about_the_game:
Spiritstead is an easy going and satisfying city builder. Arrive in a quiet, enchanted land where humans and magical spirits work together. Take charge and put your villagers to work as you create their homes, support their lives, and make your village beautiful along the way.

RELAXING AND SATISFYING

Create freely in creative mode without any pressures and just enjoy building. Here for a satisfying challenge? Manage your villagers needs and wants as you make something as aesthetically pleasing as it is practical in adventure mode. 

A GENTLER EXPERIENCE

Enjoy an easy to learn, laid back village clicker. Spiritstead is a simple yet satisfying city builder with fun clicker elements and takes around 3-5 hours to play through end to end in survival mode. Spiritstead is endlessly replayable, but the game world remains the same each time. 

Overseeing the lives of so many can be hard work, but here you have a magical place full of spirits ready to help. Discover them through interactions with the world as you meet quirky, charming creatures who make each day in your village easier to manage. Collect them all to live alongside your people and create spirit buildings to support them.

Support your townsfolk by assigning them jobs, meeting all their needs, and helping them enjoy life with happiness-boosting buildings like cafes, markets, and bonfires. Unlock new buildings, decorations, and upgrades as you progress through the game to help you look after your residents.

Enjoy creating the town of your dreams in a stunning bespoke visual style inspired by Miyazaki films and your favorite cartoons, handcrafted by our talented artist. Beneath its comfortable atmosphere lie hidden secrets waiting to be discovered as you expand into new territories with the help of wandering spirits and work to restore the Grand Spirit Sanctuary, bringing balance between spirits and humans.

data.name: Corsairs Legacy: Naval Mission - Pirate Action RPG
data.detailed_description:
‘Corsairs Legacy: Naval Mission - Pirate Action RPG’ is an immersive pirate game that will take you to the golden age of piracy in the Caribbean. Play as a pirate captain and command your crew through a variety of exciting ground and sea battles, while experiencing an engaging story driven by characters from the original Corsairs Legacy game and its sequel.

With historically accurate ships, weapons, and tactics, the game provides an authentic and immersive experience of pirate life in the 17th and 18th centuries. Experience the thrill of ground and sea battles, treasure hunting, and more as you progress through the game's story-driven adventure.

Game features:

- naval battles: boarding and destruction of ships
- rpg quests on the islands
- breaking the locks of chests and doors
- the ability to change weapons and appearance of the character
- Perudo mini-game
- story cutscenes: voiceover + subtitles
- several endings of the game depending on the player's choices

data.name: LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon
data.detailed_description:
LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state.

LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon is a smaller addition to the LOGistICAL series. This is good for beginners getting to understand the game, but still big and complex enough with plenty of challenges.

* Supply and finish many large cities
* Work your way through the long complex maze of road enhancements to finally allow all your large trucks access across the state
* Many, many other small and large puzzles and situations to complete.

LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon brings you all the fun and puzzling of LOGistICAL with even more towns, more puzzles and much more to do.

THIS GAME DOES NOT REQUIRE THE ORIGINAL LOGISTICAL GAME TO PLAY.

Over 300 towns to Complete.
LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon game covers the US state of Oregon including cities like Portland, Eugene and Salem.
There are many new obstacles and deliveries to make.

...
LOGistICAL: USA - Oregon is an independent, standalone game independent from the main LOGistICAL game (and other add-ons).
It has its own money, trucks and of course, challenges.

...
LOGistICAL is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the country.

The whole game is a huge puzzle while each town is its own little piece of puzzling. There are over 1,000 towns to complete.
Plenty of towns are easy enough. Some take complex planning. Do them in your own order. Get bonuses for completing regions and contracts.
Some cargoes are easy to get. Others you have to create in industries. Use existing industries and build your own.
The further you get from the start the more strategies you have to use.
Pimp up your trucks with bonuses. Last truck delivering gets the bonus.
The towns and map are to scale. Current or historical industry placement. You could even say that playing is educational.

There is plenty more to keep you on your toes.
Towns consume the cargoes you are trying to get to completion.
Big trucks are great for moving lots of stuff, but can't travel everywhere.
There are lots of broken roads that need deliveries.
Upgrade the industries for better exponential throughput.
Cargo stores can sure come in handy.
What! I can't take my big trucks across the water on a ferry.
... and what is with those quarantine checkpoints?

Complete towns, roads, industries, contracts, regions and states for lots of in-game and Steam achievements.

data.name: Model Kit Shop Simulator: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
Model Kit Shop Simulator: Prologue is a limited version of the full game that lets you start running your own local model kit store. Wishlist the full version to experience the complete game.

Model Kit Shop Simulator: Prologue is a first-person store management game where every sale starts with a Model Kit.

Build and grow your own hobby shop by ordering master boxes, unpacking deliveries, stocking shelves, setting prices, and serving collectors and enthusiasts.

But running a successful model kit shop is not just about selling boxes. To maximize profits, you need to keep the right matching paints in stock, increase basket value through the Hobby Basket System, and create a store that supports both shopping and building.

Core Systems

Hobby Basket System

Customers do not just buy a single kit — they start a project. When a customer picks a model kit, they may also look for the matching paints needed to complete it. If you keep those paints on your shelves, they can add them to their basket, increasing the total value of each sale. If the paints are missing, they may still buy the kit, but your basket value and profit will be lower.

Build Table System

Customers who complete the right kit-and-paint combination can use a Build Table after shopping. There, they sit down and start assembling their kit, bringing their project to life inside your store and making the shop feel more dynamic.

Features

  • Run your own first-person model kit shop

  • Order and unpack products from master boxes

  • Stock shelves and organize your store layout

  • Set prices and manage your profits

  • Use the Hobby Basket System to increase basket value

  • Keep matching paints in stock to support model kit sales

  • Let customers use Build Tables to assemble their kits

  • Unlock theme licenses and expand your product variety

  • Grow from a small shop into a larger hobby business

Build a store that hobby fans love and turn your small shop into a thriving model kit business.

data.name: The Aching Aversion
data.detailed_description:
A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker.


The bunker will have different horrors or surreal worlds waiting within it, all depending on how you broke into it!

6 different bunkers!
16 unique endings!
Collect all of the endings, and explore all of the bunkers to figure out how to reach the final bunker...

Atmospheric audio and a unique 3D art style come together to create an experience you will remember!

A continuation of The Aching Aversion: Blood Orange Dreams...

"Everyone has seen it at some point, we all have an aversion to it, the bunker has invaded your mind at some point in your life.
No one has ever entered it...
And if the inside has never been seen, how can one be so sure that the inside really exists.
Whether it is a safe room, an armoured bunker, a torture dungeon or just empty space depends on the "input details" of the entrant.
No one can try to enter what they have an aversion to."


7 Steam achievements to unlock.

data.name: AXERAS
data.detailed_description:
AXERAS is a turn-based tactical military SRPG that draws inspirations from the classics and aims to modernize the genre with a unique take on the nature of war and combat. 

Yohannes Trofyeld, a Captain in the Evestrian Armed Forces, finds himself caught in the midst of the Evestrian Civil War, and is forced to choose between loyalty to his government and allegiance to his own people. With the lives of his personnel in his hands, will the war turn him into a hero or a demon?

  • Combined Arms Combat

    • Deploy a diverse variety of military hardware and infantry teams, call in airstrikes and drone attacks, and remember: Mobility is key to your success.

  • Unit abilities shape the battlefield

    • Unique abilities and how optimally they are used mean the difference between life and death, and victory or defeat.

  • Capture or Kill

    • Enemies on the battlefield can be killed or spared and captured. Killing is an efficient short-term way to remove the threat, but captured units can be recruited to bolster your ranks.

  • XP, Rank and Permadeath

    • As units survive the war long enough while gaining battlefield experience, they are promoted to higher ranks and obtain new abilities.  

  • War is about map control

    • Eliminating the enemy is only a means to an end. To gain the upper hand, you must fight over every inch of the map to control Strategic Zones or prevent the enemy from denying you key positions.

  • Decisions have consequences

    • Each decision you make, has consequences that are either immediately apparent or will only manifest as you progress through the story. There is no right or wrong decision, only what you deem as a moral choice or an atrocity.

  • Dynamic story and replayable campaign

    • The story of Acorns Company is driven by player decision. Each different playthrough results in different decisions, which in turn result in different scenarios being played out, and ultimately influence the ending.

  • Immersive Hand-drawn Cutscenes

    • The story of Acorns Company comes alive with lovingly hand-drawn animated cutscenes, in contemporary Japanese anime style.

    • Deploy a diverse variety of military hardware and infantry teams, call in airstrikes and drone attacks, and remember: Mobility is key to your success.

  • Unit abilities shape the battlefield

    • Unique abilities and how optimally they are used mean the difference between life and death, and victory or defeat.

  • Capture or Kill

    • Enemies on the battlefield can be killed or spared and captured. Killing is an efficient short-term way to remove the threat, but captured units can be recruited to bolster your ranks.

  • XP, Rank and Permadeath

    • As units survive the war long enough while gaining battlefield experience, they are promoted to higher ranks and obtain new abilities.  

  • War is about map control

    • Eliminating the enemy is only a means to an end. To gain the upper hand, you must fight over every inch of the map to control Strategic Zones or prevent the enemy from denying you key positions.

  • Decisions have consequences

    • Each decision you make, has consequences that are either immediately apparent or will only manifest as you progress through the story. There is no right or wrong decision, only what you deem as a moral choice or an atrocity.

  • Dynamic story and replayable campaign

    • The story of Acorns Company is driven by player decision. Each different playthrough results in different decisions, which in turn result in different scenarios being played out, and ultimately influence the ending.

  • Immersive Hand-drawn Cutscenes

    • The story of Acorns Company comes alive with lovingly hand-drawn animated cutscenes, in contemporary Japanese anime style.

data.name: Blunatic
data.detailed_description:
Blunatic is a grimdark dystopian visual novel.

THE STORY
You play Blunatic, a BLUE creature in underwear with a foul mouth that loves to go against the Establishment.

The Establishment is run by Kai Devilson of the Devilson clan. They're a bunch of brutal, brutal RED creatures who also wear underwear, who enslave all Blunatics.

Now, Kai Devilson really did a number on you. Could be NUMBER 1 or NUMBER 2. It's unclear.

What's clear is, Blunatic want REVENGE.

THE GAME PLAY
Play as the main character and take control of all the decision-making in the game.
Explore different branches of the story. Discover parts of the story that will blow your mind.
Make choices in this visual novel to get said REVENGE.
Curse, deceive, slaughter your enemies.

FEATURES
Simple point and click system.
Realistic bone animations and movements that bring characters to life.
Select choices to shape the outcome that you want.
Replay the game to explore different paths.

CLOSING REMARKS
Look, I'm not sure if you've even made it to this sentence. But, the scenes are BRUTAL. There will be BLOOD. Turn away if you can't take it.

data.name: Caesar's Revenge
data.detailed_description:
Caesar’s Revenge is a die-and-retry retro FPS set in ancient Rome. Assassinated by the senate on the Ides of March, 44BC, Julius Caesar returns to exact revenge on those who betrayed him. Storm a corrupt senate in this relentless slasher. Indulge in the violence. Become the fall of Rome.



  • Thrash through murderous, high-risk gameplay with a bloodlust mechanic that rewards aggression.
  • An assortment of historic weaponry including the Gladius, Composite Bow, Sling, Spear (Hasta), Greek Fire, Sica, Falx, Fire Siphon and the mighty Scorpion!



  • Three distinct acts with more than 30 hand crafted levels across the ancient world. Slaughter your betrayers across Roman fortresses, gladiatorial arenas, untamed wilds, Babylonian gardens, unholy ruins and the depths of the underworld itself.
  • An extensive bestiary of treacherous foes to be slain, both mortal and mythological.

  • Scribe your skill in blood with time trials, secrets and unlockables for a higher skill ceiling and extended replayability.

  • Bone rattling thrash metal soundtrack recorded and performed by the developers.

data.name: TERPENIE
data.detailed_description:
After a long day at work, you return home.
Everything seems ordinary: preparing dinner, tidying up, and trying to put your life in order. But as night falls, the mundane becomes a fragile illusion. Someone is watching you. Someone is hunting you.

In this game, you will explore the confines of your room while uncovering a terrifying truth. Balance the normality of everyday chores with a growing sense of dread, because the maniac may strike when you least expect it.

Set against the backdrop of a post-Soviet setting, this game captures the haunting feeling of domestic horror and paranoia — the fear of being trapped with nowhere to run, even inside the walls of your own home.

Can you keep your sanity and survive before the darkness takes over?

Key Features

  • Domestic Horror – a unique atmosphere inspired by life in the post-Soviet era.

  • Routine Meets Fear – cook meals, clean your room, and explore while being watched.

  • Unpredictable Threat – the maniac can appear at any moment, when you least expect it.

  • Gritty Visual Style – a bleak, realistic environment of an old apartment.

  • Psychological Tension – fear builds gradually, relying on atmosphere rather than cheap jump scares.

data.name: Monocre
data.detailed_description:
White or Black—

A world painted in just two colors. Toggle the colors of your character and the blocks to "forge" your path to the goal in this brand-new puzzle experience.

◆ Master the Two Colors

This game revolves around just two colors: white and black. When your character is white, you can touch white blocks but will phase right through black ones. Conversely, when your character is black, you can interact with black blocks and will pass seamlessly through white ones.

◆ Manipulate Colors at Will

Your character can transfer color to the blocks, or absorb color from them. Should you change your character's color, or the block's? Master color manipulation to reach the goal!

◆ Dynamic Gimmick Blocks

  • Gray Blocks: Solid blocks you can touch regardless of whether you are white or black.

  • Frame Blocks: Outlines that materialize into solid blocks once you pass through them.

Swap Blocks: Special blocks that instantly swap colors between themselves and your character.

◆ In-Game Content

  • You can play 12 stages per world.

  • Currently, up to 9 worlds are available, with more to be added in future free updates.

  • Even if you get stuck on a stage, you can check the solution step-by-step to see how to clear it.

data.name: Arcana Autonoma: Fourteen Races
data.detailed_description:
Story

Twenty years after the War of Unification, the warship Bloody Rain still patrols the skies above the continent. Its mission is said to be keeping the peace that followed unification. On the ground, its shadow is called the "blood rain."
According to the ship's record, blockades and seizures broke out across the land that year. Captain Hisame signed an order authorising removal by the ship's guns wherever a blockade was not lifted by the deadline. In the margin of the same order is a note: "Send the daughter down first."
In the records of each nation on the ground, every blockade is put down to its own local cause, and no link between them is acknowledged. That the guns had been authorised appears in none of those records.

Collect cards

151 cards from fourteen races. Draw them with ten-card summons and browse them in your collection book.
In every chapter, the techniques of those Setsuna faces stay in her hand as cards.

Grow your cards

Cards of the same star rank and the same or higher "+" become enhancement material. A fully grown card evolves.

Battle with five

Take on a single powerful foe with five cards. Advance one move at a time with "Attack", or switch on "Auto" and let the battle play out to the end.
  • Every race has two abilities and one finisher.
  • Seven kinds of abilities: heavy strike, attack up, defence down, healing, damage cut, finisher charge and draining the enemy's charge.
  • Races have affinities against each other.
  • A finisher fires when its charge is full. When two or more finishers land in the same turn, they become a Link.
  • When the enemy's charge fills, it unleashes an attack on your whole party.

Raids

You can defeat a raiding foe entirely on your own — and when you can't finish it, you can call for help. Rankings are kept for each raid boss.

data.name: BunnyFlow
data.detailed_description:
Keep an eye on rabbits, protect them from foxes or destroy the population.
For the glory of the Goddess!

As the owner of a rabbit farm you have a dream: to become the best breeder and attract the attention of the Rabbit Goddess. She gives you land and in return asks for a small favor. Complete tasks to gain her trust. But hurry up: the Goddess is impatient, and does not like to wait long.

Cute fluffy rabbits…

…breed uncontrollably. They also get sick and die. Don`t leave the rabbits for a long time, they need you. Put rabbits of different colors in the same lawn to get a new coloring. Occasionally the goddess wants something unusual.

Beware of foxes!

They enter the farm to feast on your dependents. Separate the rabbits from the foxes if you don't want them to die. However, sometimes foxes can be quite useful...

data.name: ShellShock Live
data.detailed_description:
ShellShock Live is a strategic online multiplayer artillery game developed by kChamp Games.

Fight Alongside your Friends (Or blow them up... we won't judge!)




Take part in action-packed 8-Player team and free-for all battles. Tactical gameplay is essential to victory, while numerous distinct tanks, weapons, items, maps, and play styles make every match unique.

Way Too Many Weapons




It's a bit ridiculous. Unlock, upgrade, and master over 400 unique power-packed weapons, from the intimidating 'Seagull' to the ever-powerful 'Mega-Nuke'. The best part is that we're building and adding more daily.

Loads of Modes




Armored carnage must get old after a while, right? Wrong. Unique game modes keep things fresh and give you the opportunity to demolish tanks in a multitude of ways.

Become the Best There Ever Was




Earn XP to level up and become king of the battlefield. Play through 100 unique ranks, each with their own rewards and unlocks. Global leaderboards and rankings keep things spicy.

Upgrade Everything




And when we say everything, we mean everything. Upgrade your tank. Upgrade your skills. Upgrade your items. Upgrade your arsenal. All 400+ of the game's weapons can be upgraded to more powerful versions.

Nature Doesn't Stand a Chance




Fully destructible terrain creates a dynamically changing battlefield. Earthquakes and other natural disasters keep you on your toes (just like in real life!)

(Very) Active Development




We've been cranking out ShellShock Live updates with new features and awesome community suggestions almost daily. Check out the Announcements section for full release notes, or join the community on the Forums.

Non-Evil Developers




All gameplay content is earned by playing, not paying. Any content that can be purchased is purely cosmetic and can only benefit other players and the community.

data.name: The Doors That Led to Nowhere
data.detailed_description:
Darkness hides in the recesses of everyone's mind...

A normal man finds himself trapped in an alternate reality enveloped in darkness and twisted, bloodthirsty creatures. Explore and uncover secrets about this aberrant world as you find your way back home.

Features

  • A unique take on old-school 3D RPGs, drawing elements from FPS and Parkour games.

  • Explore an unnerving, atmospheric world with 5 hours of content.

data.detailed_description:
Live the life of an up-and-coming superstar in this unique football career game. Start out as a 16 year old lad and work your way to the top to become a footballing legend! You need to train hard, play matches, make transfers, do interviews, stay in touch with friends, sign sponsorship deals, go to the casino, buy cars, and more! With so many distractions in a footballer's life is it any wonder that so many don't make it? But what about you? Can you become a new star?

Key features:

  • Thousands or clubs and hundreds of leagues to play in, with realistic continental and international competitions.
  • A global leaderboard lets you compare your progress and transfer value against other players around the world.

  • Casino games and horse racing allow you to fritter away some of your hard-earned riches.
  • Haggling for a better contract or giving a post-match interview – there are loads of mini-games to master.

data.name: Conan Unconquered
data.detailed_description:
Conan Unconquered - Belit's Fury


Other Conan the Barbarian games




About the Game

Assemble a massive army, build an unconquerable base, and send your heroes out to fight and explore.



From the Command & Conquer veterans at Petroglyph comes the first ever survival RTS set in the savage world of Conan the Barbarian. Play solo or team up in multiplayer in Conan Unconquered’s action-packed co-op Mode where you build a shared stronghold and fend off the hordes together.

The people of Khoraja flourished during its years of peace and prosperity. But they also turned lazy and feeble. The devious and tyrannical wizard Thugra Khotan looks to seize this opportunity and is marching his army to claim your kingdom as his own. You must awaken your people from their apathy, you must build your city defenses and fend off armies of attacking monstrosities.

How long will you be able to stand against the invading hordes?

  • Play solo or with a friend in the intense and action-packed multiplayer Co-op Mode.
  • Choose between four different heroes, including Conan, with their own special abilities.
  • Research new technology to build more advanced structures and improve your defenses.
  • Randomly generated maps ensure that every playthrough is unique.

NEW! 10 challenges to overcome, as well as the potentially never-ending Unconquered Mode. Take on the online leader-boards – or submit your own challenge!

MULTIPLAYER CO-OP MODE


Play together online and build a shared stronghold while fending off the enemy hordes. Both players can build structures freely, and research upgrades, walls, and structures are all shared. You can also try the game in challenge mode, where you can play the same maps as other players and see how well you compare to them.

STAND AGAINST THE HORDE


Battle wave after wave of increasingly more difficult enemies coming to destroy your stronghold, from lowly footmen to experienced elites and mighty siege weapons. Giant snakes and scorpions, spearmen, necromancers, and flying demons will arrive in vast numbers to see your home burn to the ground.

CONTROL LEGENDARY HEROES


Heroes are incredibly powerful units that can greatly influence the outcome of battles. These heroes, including Conan himself, possess special abilities and you can equip them with unique artifacts that you find as you explore the world.

MANAGE YOUR RESOURCES


Manage resources such as food, gold, wood, and iron to fuel your expanding stronghold. Construct a variety of different buildings from housing to temples and military barracks. Build defensive walls around your stronghold and equip them with traps such as oil cauldrons to keep attackers at bay. Train units and keep them fed and paid to see their power grow.

SURVIVE DISEASE, FIRE, AND DEATH


The world of Conan the Barbarian is one of blood, battle, and savagery. As your soldiers and those of your enemy die on the battlefield, their bodies will be left to rot and spread disease that can quickly turn the tide of war. Of course, a necromancer might be able to turn that to their advantage.

EXPLORE THE ENVIRONMENT


Randomly generated maps allow for infinite replayability and each map holds vast opportunities for players that dare to explore beyond their stronghold. Discover ruins hiding great treasures, but beware: these are often protected by massive guardians that you need to bring down to claim your loot.

CALL UPON THE GODS


Build a temple and dedicate your stronghold to Mitra. Summon their massive avatar that towers above the battlefield and crushes your enemies in its footsteps.

data.name: Momentum
data.detailed_description:
Momentum is a fast-paced racing game in a retro 80's neon style.
Race against your friends in this easy to learn, hard to master couch pvp racing game, where you control your hover car around a gravity defying, twisting and turning racetrack.

Use your hover car's grapple hook to swing yourself around corners at full speed, take shortcuts and make various other maneuvers. Just make sure you detach on time!

For some extra speed, collect the various momentum charges found all over the track, to enable your boost to overtake your friends!

Beat your friends at all of the three tracks in this game!

This game was developed by 3rd years students at Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment

FIT Food is a multiplayer card game with a new battle mode called CUBE RUN. We developed it to make nutritional education at schools, universities, companies, and healthcare organizations fun and engaging.

Tell your teacher and your friends to have fun and learn about food. What impact does it have on health, cost, and the environment? What is a Nutri-Score? You probably know more than you think - but there will be surprises as well.

Play 12 game modes, including an easy BEGINNER mode, PRACTICE solo, the multiplayer CUBE RUN battle, as well as the challenging NO HELP and KNOW-IT-ALL modes. Also, try beating the AI-NPCs. Win a different trophy in each game mode. Collecting all trophies fast makes you the FIT Food Champion.

Also, click on the question marks in the game, you will find lots of additional info and videos.

data.name: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure
data.detailed_description:
More from HandyGames


Join our Discord


About the Game

Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure is a blend of Automation and Real Time Strategy for both the die-hard fans of the Automation genre and the Automation-curious. Explore a strange fantasy world, uncover the mysteries of the past, automate your workshops, and go on adventures with your odd & adorable Sparks!

Oddsparks is a great entry point into automation games, but with a fresh spin for those who’ve already played thousands of hours in the genre. You’ll design automated workshops and put your Sparks to work in carrying and crafting everything you could need - including more Sparks!

Without conveyor belts, you'll have to manage the Spark traffic to optimize your designs. Use your wide toolbox of options to solve the logistics puzzles you'll face as you tackle distance and elevation.

Take your Sparks for an adventure into procedurally generated worlds! Face unusual enemies like Spunnies and Beelephants as you explore diverse and distinct biomes. Find resources amidst forgotten ruins. Clear up the way to build and connect your workshops. Bring your newfound knowledge home.

Help your cozy village grow, share with, and learn from the folks you’ve grown up with. With this new technology and the secrets of the past, what changes will you spark in the world around you?

FEATURES

  • Play in single-player or online co-op (Up to 4 players officially supported, uncapped) with a simple host & join system to jump in and out of any friend's game.

  • Build massive automation & logistics networks to carry your items and Sparks places.

  • Use an advanced logic system with tools for logistics management, including sensors, wires, gates, actions/events, and switches.

  • Build a comprehensive elevated Spark train system to overcome the greatest distances and the highest mountains!

  • Complete quests from your fellow villagers to unlock new buildings for your workshop and watch your village grow.

  • Construct a base defense system to protect your workshops from waves of corruption with new defense tools.

  • Explore procedurally generated worlds with diverse and distinct biomes, unusual enemies, and forgotten ruins.

  • Unlock new customization options for your character to show off your fashion style.

  • Customize the world settings to tweak challenge levels, unlock automation features, or use terraforming tools.

  • Designed for both gamepad and mouse & keyboard play.

  • Designed with an accessible core that's further backed up by accessibility features, such as the ability to rebind both mouse & keyboard and gamepad controls.

  • You can pet the Sparks!

data.name: Reapers' Tide
data.detailed_description:
The dead do not rest. Neither will you.

Every night the tide rises. Skeletons, ghouls, wraiths and worse pour out of the dark by the hundreds, and all that stands between them and the living is you. You move, your weapons fire on their own, and every soul you reap feeds your next level-up. By the fifth minute the screen is a storm you built yourself. Then the final boss walks out of the dark.

Eight minutes, four acts, one final horror

Every run is a tight eight-minute night: four acts, four Tides and three mid-boss fights before the final boss arrives at 8:00. Something new hits the field every fifteen to thirty seconds.
  • Tides - the Bone Tide, a Blood Moon of champions, the Soul Tide and The Last Night.
  • Run events - about once a minute: defend a shrine, accept a cursed altar, answer an omen or step through a rift.
  • Reap Combo - chain kills for bonus XP, soul pulses and chests. Grave Hands drag down anyone who stands still.
  • Fate - every mid boss and won event grants a reroll for the card you need.

Build your storm

Level-ups deal three cards from Common to Legendary. A build holds five weapons and four passives, so every slot is a choice.
  • 17 weapons and 15 hidden evolutions: max a weapon, hold its catalyst passive, open a boss chest.

Six heroes, six ways to reap

data.name: Starbase Starlight
data.detailed_description:
Blast your way to victory in an arcade defence shooter about protecting your Starbase from a never ending horde of opposing ships. Each with its own way of trying to break your precious platform. Destroy your enemies in storms of bright colourful explosions and sprays of bullets before they reach you and annihilate your Starbase.

Multiple Weapons

Select from a variety of different weapons each with a unique play style. The generic Burst Rifle for that classic feel. The heavy Rocket Launcher, powerful, explosive but limited in ammo or the more unique Mine Lobber, laying dozens of small explosive traps for the unwary enemy.

Utilities

Along with your weaponry the Starbase is equipped with powerful Utility tools. Deploy a rapid-firing auto-turret system to track and destroy nearby enemies, unleash the Electrofield to fry enemy systems as they approach, or activate the Shield Generator—because sometimes the best offense is a strong defense.

Waves and Rewards

With each wave, enemy ships will fly towards your Starbase in their aim to destroy it. It begins with small groups, becoming dozens, before finally becoming overwhelming hordes. After clearing a wave, you select a Starbase upgrade permanently powering up your Weapons or Utilities - At least until you finally crumble under the endless foes.

Unlockables

By defeating several waves of enemies you gain an Unlockable. These are bonuses that you persist between runs, they come in a variety of types, new weapons, new powerful upgrades, a special ability for your Weapons, or a function adding upgrade for your Utilities.

Features

  • 9 Weapon Options

  • Over 200 rewards

  • Turrets

  • Drones

  • Weapon Special Abilities

  • Bouncing Bullets

  • Exploding Bullets

  • Homing Bouncing Exploding Bullets

  • Lasers

data.name: Ember Fall
data.detailed_description:
EmberFall: A Flame Rekindled in a World of Ash

Become a nameless wanderer and follow a faint ember through a world reduced to cinders. Silent forests and dried-up rivers hold remnants of a forgotten past and buried truths. With each step you take, the ember flickers brighter. But who was it meant for?

A World That Changes With You

The desolate, lifeless landscapes begin to shift and transform through your journey. Each boss you defeat subtly alters the world, reflecting the impact of your actions. What starts as barren ruins slowly blossoms with traces of life, turning your journey into a symbol of true change—beyond just visual flair.

A Soundtrack That Evolves

The music in EmberFall isn’t just background—it breathes with your progress. As you move forward and reshape the world, the score transforms from somber tones to melodies filled with hope and warmth, deepening immersion and emotional resonance.

Light as a Puzzle, Shadows as an Enemy

Solve puzzles centered around the innovative use of light and shadow. These intuitive challenges grow more complex as the game progresses, pushing you to think creatively and feel rewarded when you succeed.

But light alone isn't enough. Hidden in the darkness are predators corrupted by the void. Combat is more than attack and dodge—it demands smart use of the light mechanics you've mastered. Each boss has unique patterns and weaknesses that must be understood and exploited to prevail.

Fragments of a Deeper Story
As you piece together the scattered remnants of the world’s lore, you’ll uncover the origins of its downfall—and your own identity. Through encounters with mysterious characters, hidden documents, and environmental storytelling, you’ll experience a journey filled with emotion and meaning beyond gameplay.

Follow the ember, walk through the ashes, and spark a new beginning in EmberFall.

data.name: EONIA
data.detailed_description:
On this journey you will connect with the dear Master Enodio and with Lanius, Albius's faithful friend. You will hear about the eight Master Explorers and the artist, writer and inventor, the unique and perfect Mivos Esterus.
EONIA is a game to be enjoyed alone. A vast and colorful place where you must explore every corner to know its mysteries and legends.
You will find books and scrolls that will help you learn new skills and discover the rich history that surrounds it.
There are dozens of items and a wide variety of skills.
You can navigate by boat and over land to travel long distances in seconds thanks to the Magic Portals that the Forgotten Civilization built years ago.
You can build structures and the chests and their mysteries will not be a difficult task if you have a lockpick and the necessary knowledge.
A skill tree will show you everything you already know and how much you need to learn. Let's not forget that Albius is a simple apprentice.
A complete inventory will allow you to track objects and know their characteristics and uses.
A mission journal will allow you to understand what remains to be done and what adventure to continue.
Life surrounds each stone and you will have to learn what advantage you can get from it through all kinds of books.
Books are an inexhaustible source of knowledge in the EONIA world and there are many of them and, perhaps with a little luck, you will be able to solve the mysteries of EONIA.
And let's not forget what Master Enodio always says: "The one who seeks, shall find a reward."

data.name: The Abandoned
data.detailed_description:
The Abandoned is a short first-person horror experience where you will explore an uncanny dream world and use your abilities to blast through waves of supernatural enemies while you uncover the story one chapter at a time.

Chapter 1: Awakening is included with this purchase of The Abandoned, with the remaining three chapters being included as free updates as they are developed. There are content updates and extra features being added on a regular basis during the evolution of the game.

The player assumes the role of our main character; let's leave him unnamed for now. He is a young man, recently married, but still with a bit of a wild side. After a long weekend night out with a few friends, he awakens to find himself on an old dirt path deep in some remote forest. After cursing his friends for dumping him out here, he realizes that the real problem is figuring out where 'here' is and how to get back home.

You will use your newfound abilities to blast away waves of supernatural enemies while finding the clues to where you are and the means to get back home.

You will look for keys and items to unlock new rooms to progress the story. There are plenty of options to customize your experience, including a darkness level and the ability to disable the enemies if that's your style. You can have short, atmospheric, and uncanny gameplay with the enemies turned off.

Gameplay

  • Find keys and items to progress through the story chapter by chapter.

  • Use magic abilities to defeat waves of supernatural enemies.

  • Find hidden documents to unfold the entire story.

  • Find hidden items that stay with you throughout your experience.

  • Replay unlocked chapters to find missed items.

Features

  • Realistic first-person perspective.

  • Detailed 3D environments with a dreamlike (nightmarish)  feel.

  • Real-time 3D audio.

data.name: E-xode: ROM
data.detailed_description:
One person, one long-held galaxy

For years I carried this whole game in my head: the rules, the mechanics, the way a fleet crossing a sector should feel. I had already written most of the code in earlier versions, but I never had the means to make the sounds, the music and the art that a place like this deserves. E-xode: ROM exists because I finally found a way to carry it to the end, and I used AI to do it. I say so openly, and I explain why in the AI disclosure on this page, because it is part of the story.

A galaxy that does not wait for you

Command your fleet from the bridge of a capital ship, in real time, in a shared and persistent universe. The server never sleeps: sectors and fleets keep moving whether you are logged in or not. No turns, nobody to wait for.

Nine regions, 729 sectors, and a choice of how far to go

Every universe holds 9 regions, 81 star systems and 729 sectors, linked by gates. You start in the Ethereal Expanse, fully secured. The further out you fly, the thinner the law gets, and the edge is not policed at all. The most precious ore, voidglass, lies exactly where the patrols are not. Every mining run is a bet.

Build a fleet with a purpose

Command specialised hulls, from miners and haulers to escorts, strikers and tanks, and group them into fleets. Armed ships take on the pirates of lawless space; miners and haulers keep your economy alive. Every choice has a price.

A galaxy full of other commanders

Found a corporation and fly its tag. Earn standing with the two powers that share the stars, the Nexus Protectorate and the Crimson Corsairs, and live with the consequences. Grow a character through a passive skill tree with a free, unlimited respec. Follow what the commanders around you are saying on the Broadcast board.

Made by a player who grew up on these worlds

This game sits where my own history as a player meets: the early browser space games I lost whole evenings to, the huge online universes where every pilot's decisions ripple outward, and the space operas that taught me what a fleet on the horizon feels like. It is a small production without a big budget, built with love for that heritage.

Browser and desktop, one universe

E-xode: ROM runs in your browser and as a desktop client. Same account, same galaxy, same session.

Early Access, and how you can help

E-xode: ROM is free to play. The free version is limited: one character and up to 20 ships per character, in the MMO universe. If you enjoy what I am building, you can buy time for your account (30, 90, 180 or 360 days, one-time, no renewal): up to 100 ships per character, up to 3 characters, access to the PvP and Tournament universes, and posting on the Broadcast board. It is also the most direct way to support the project. Every bit of income goes back into the game before anything else: new features, people to help me build them, and the artwork, video, music and sound the game deserves. The game is in Early Access, and the roadmap will be shaped with the players who join it. It is currently available in English and French; more languages are planned.

data.name: Wall Ball
data.detailed_description:
WallBall is a Single Player and Multiplayer Game Where Timing is Everything.

Hit the ball just right and score big points quickly.
Hit the ball too early or late and suffer a painful wait as you see your opponent score points.
*Arcade styled game plays as fast or as slow as you play.
**Start in the Moon Arena and collect wins to earn different interstellar arena locations.

The Rhythm:

When you hit the ball just right a rhythm begins to develop, much like a boxer with a speed bag, timing is everything.
This natural rhythm starts to speed the ball up, the question is, can you keep up and put big points on the leaderboard?

Single Player:

Score as many points as possible before a third out and make it to the top of the leaderboard!

Multiplayer:

Score 21 points before your opponent to win the game!
*Win 3 out of 5 games to take the match.
**Win 3 games in a row and put a Domination Match on the leaderboard.
***Average multiplayer game is ~45 seconds, fastest game on record is 11 seconds!
****Auto-Rematch is engaged until best of 5 is reached unless a player quits.
*****Quitting mid-game is impossible. Quitting is only possible after game... quitter.

Scoring:

Hit the front wall = 1 point
Hit the roof = 2 points
Hit the backstop = 3 points
Hit the back wall = 7 points (WALL BALL)
Hit the floor before front wall = Out (single player only)
*all combinations possible
**Hit 3 WallBalls in a row and put an Impossible Shot on the leaderboard.

Fun, fast, intensely-competitive when you want, chill when you don't.

Welcome to the Future, Welcome to WallBall.

data.name: YANKAI'S TRIANGLE
data.detailed_description:
YANKAI'S TRIANGLE is a love letter to TRIANGLES. A puzzling puzzle game about the beauty and joy of infinitely tapping on TRIANGLES for some reason.

With an elegant innovative revolutionary TRIANGLE-first approach to interface, YANKAI'S TRIANGLE lets you tap on TRIANGLES to spin them and stuff. Colors play a part in gameplay too I think. Bring TRIANGLES to a forgotten TRIANGLE, and uncover a TRIANGLE hidden deep beneath the YANKAI.

  • Pretty Fun Gameplay (it's all right)
  • No Filler - A Veritable Infinity of Meticulously Definitely Handcrafted TRIANGLES
  • Over 1.74 x 10^26 Possible Levels (all definitely handcrafted)
  • Color
  • An Inscrutable Three-Pronged Scoring System
  • A 'Happy Sounds' Option (woohoo!)
  • A 'Colorblind' Option if You Are Colorblind (it's not great tbh)
  • A Cool Film Grain Effect
  • A Cool Tiled TRIANGLE Background Effect
  • Also there are Achievements

A Game By Kenny Sun


(YAN rhymes with KEN and KAI rhymes with EYE by the way)

data.name: The Unseen Fears: Ominous Talent Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Grandma Studios presents another mysterious journey beyond the everyday world in The Unseen Fears: Ominous Talent!

Your friend Carlos, an art critic, asked you to visit Italy to help investigate the disappearance of a colleague. The clues all lead back to the same local gallery where you quickly discover that this disappearance wasn’t the first. And as the pieces fall into place, you’ll discover a supernatural web of lies, jealousy, and betrayal. You’ll have to find the clues, learn the truth, and watch who you trust to solve the case and stop the disappearances in this intriguing new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

- Help a muse child find her true calling in the bonus chapter!
- Replay your favorite mini-games and unlock a bonus Hidden-Object Puzzle!
- Collect art palettes to paint your own work of art!
- Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, music, videos, concept art, and more!
- Never get lost with the strategy guide!


This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
