data.name: Cartographers
data.detailed_description:
Queen Gimnax has ordered the reclamation of the northern lands. As a cartographer in her service, you are sent to map this territory, claiming it for the Kingdom of Nalos. Through official edicts, the queen announces which lands she prizes most, and you will increase your reputation by meeting her demands. But you are not alone in this wilderness. The Dragul contest your claims with their outposts, so you must draw your lines carefully to reduce their influence. Reclaim the greatest share of the queen’s desired lands and you will be declared the greatest cartographer in the kingdom.

Experience the fascination of this tactical Flip & Write game now as an App.

Includes both the Heroes Expansion and the Undercity Expansion!

data.name: Borderlands 4
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated

Play as the all-new Vault Hunter, Loveless the Hacker, and wield her unique Action Skills and skill trees across all of Kairos. This symbiotic assassin shares her mind with a virus that takes the physical form of a vicious pet Wyrm.

Fight alongside FL4K to hunt down Tediore forces invading the tropical island of Providence! This wild adventure features new missions, activities, loot, and a lush new region.

Team up with Amara to prevent the universe from falling apart, fight a new boss and two new mini-bosses, and hunt down a new Pearlescent weapon and six new pieces of Legendary loot!

Vault Card 5 lets you earn new rewards through gameplay, including 24 cosmetic items and four pieces of rerollable Legendary gear to unlock!


DELUXE AND SUPER DELUXE EDITIONS

*Borderlands 4 Bounty Pack Bundle consists of 4 separate post-launch DLC packs: Bounty Pack 2, 3, 4, and 5. The Bounty Pack Bundle is included with the Deluxe and Super Deluxe Editions of Borderlands 4. The Bounty Pack Bundle, and the individual DLC packs that make up the bundle, will also be available for separate purchase at launch (base game required). Exact release timings of each DLC pack to be announced at a later date and will be subject to change. Terms apply.

**Borderlands 4 Vault Hunter Pack consists of 2 separate post-launch DLC packs. The Vault Hunter Pack is included with Borderlands 4 Super Deluxe Edition. The Vault Hunter Pack, and the individual DLC packs that make up the bundle, will also be available for separate purchase at launch (base game required). Exact release timings of each DLC pack to be announced at a later date and will be subject to change. Terms apply.


About the Game

Borderlands 4 brings intense action, badass Vault Hunters, and billions of wild and deadly weapons to an all-new planet ruled by a ruthless tyrant.

Crash into Kairos as one of four new Vault Hunters seeking wealth and glory. Wield powerful Action Skills, customize your build with deep skill trees, and dominate enemies with dynamic movement abilities.

Break free from the oppressive Timekeeper, a ruthless dictator who dominates the masses from on high. Now a world-altering catastrophe threatens his perfect Order, unleashing Mayhem across the planet.

Become an unstoppable force of battle, blasting through enemies with an all-new arsenal of outrageous weaponry. Move across the Borderlands like never before—double jumping, gliding, dodging, grappling, and more—dealing death from every direction. Explode each encounter with devastating Action Skills that unleash your Vault Hunter's unique abilities. Craft your perfect build with branching skill trees and a deep, rewarding loot chase full of wild weapons and powerful gear.

Wreaking havoc across Kairos is awesome alone and even better with friends in 4-player online co-op.* Borderlands 4 is designed for co-op from the ground up; whether you're hunting for loot, tackling missions, or wandering freely, level scaling and individual difficulty keeps the party together and having fun.

Freely explore a vast and dangerous world rife with warring factions. Hop on your hover bike and ride through lush fields, towering peaks, and deadly deserts full of fearsome enemies, dynamic events, and engaging quests with unforgettable characters. Unite the people of Kairos and ignite a revolution, tackling this adventure however you see fit in a seamless Borderlands experience.

*Online play requires Internet connection, and cross-play requires SHiFT Account. Terms apply.

data.name: TRIBAL "The 12 Gates"
data.detailed_description:
TRIBAL is a Persistent Online Multiplayer 2D RTS/RPG where you take the role of Tribe Chieftain and lead your medieval tribe to global domination… or not.

Access to the lands of TRIBAL are guarded by 12 powerful bosses that award a unique spell to any tribe that defeats them. Only Tribe Chieftains can learn and use these spells.

You can pick from 6 different Tribe Chieftains each with unique spawn trees. Your tribe’s success depends on you and how you command and control them to grow and prosper.

Recycle and Spawn Tribe Raid Teams on the fly and use them to conquer new lands and rid them of the Dark Lords and their minions that infest them. Each Raid Team has a different configuration and purpose.

It’s a little bit micro and a little bit macro. You control everything your Tribe Chieftain does. You have to micromanage every step, strategy, and consequence. Once you spawn one or more Tribe Raid Teams the Game AI will macro-manage each team according to what you spawned them for.

Grind and buy your way to destiny! You can save up gold and technology resources (yeah, like 100M) and pay for essential Tribe improvements and upgrades. You can level up by earning experience (and you earn experience for pretty much anything) and the bonus is… wait for it, your Tribe Raid Teams continue grinding away and gaining your Chieftain XP even when you are busy doing other things.

The challenge continues even after defeating the 12 Gates – because each boss encounter gets harder (way harder) after the 12th Gate, and you can do it all over again in Tribal Evolved!

Your tribe worships you and will perform their duties until death. Spawn different raid teams such as Combat (an aggressive team with a Tank and DPS to attack enemies); Defense (a mixed team that will hold steadfast until threatened); Conquest (a team of builders to quickly assemble structures for resource generation); Chaos (a team of destroyers that quickly raise enemy structures); Siege (a multi-purpose team to hold and defend a map you conquer); and Zen (a team of healers and clerics to protect you and your tribe).

You do you, while your Raid Teams perform their duties even when you are not online. The Tribes of the 12 Gates including the Dark Lords and the bosses who rule them never sleep. They are always learning new things and preparing for your return (assuming you keep a server running when you’re not).

Tribe Spellcasters can cast over 60 different spells and take on one of three roles, DPS, Healer, or Protection. Their roles are determined by the type of Raid Team you spawn.

You’re going to need gold, and lots of it. The quickest way to bootstrap your economy and power up your Raid Teams is using Gold and Technology resources to research over 40 unique technologies and upgrades to give you the advantage.

Tribe Builders can build over 100 different structures depending on the type of land available and the climate around them. You can let them build whatever they want or focus their efforts on a particular resource you need.

Build your tribe. Conquer new lands. Enlighten your people. Get rich. Rejoice. Rule the world with an iron fist or gentle hand. Rush, turtle, explore, idle… the choice is yours. Defeat the bosses at the 12 Gates to gain access to new maps and higher levels. Help other tribes or crush them. Play alone or with the masses. But ultimately the goal is simple, survive and prosper.
data.about_the_game:

Access to the lands of TRIBAL are guarded by 12 powerful bosses that award a unique spell to any tribe that defeats them. Only Tribe Chieftains can learn and use these spells.

You can pick from 6 different Tribe Chieftains each with unique spawn trees. Your tribe’s success depends on you and how you command and control them to grow and prosper.

Recycle and Spawn Tribe Raid Teams on the fly and use them to conquer new lands and rid them of the Dark Lords and their minions that infest them. Each Raid Team has a different configuration and purpose.

It’s a little bit micro and a little bit macro. You control everything your Tribe Chieftain does. You have to micromanage every step, strategy, and consequence. Once you spawn one or more Tribe Raid Teams the Game AI will macro-manage each team according to what you spawned them for.

Grind and buy your way to destiny! You can save up gold and technology resources (yeah, like 100M) and pay for essential Tribe improvements and upgrades. You can level up by earning experience (and you earn experience for pretty much anything) and the bonus is… wait for it, your Tribe Raid Teams continue grinding away and gaining your Chieftain XP even when you are busy doing other things.

The challenge continues even after defeating the 12 Gates – because each boss encounter gets harder (way harder) after the 12th Gate, and you can do it all over again in Tribal Evolved!

Your tribe worships you and will perform their duties until death. Spawn different raid teams such as Combat (an aggressive team with a Tank and DPS to attack enemies); Defense (a mixed team that will hold steadfast until threatened); Conquest (a team of builders to quickly assemble structures for resource generation); Chaos (a team of destroyers that quickly raise enemy structures); Siege (a multi-purpose team to hold and defend a map you conquer); and Zen (a team of healers and clerics to protect you and your tribe).

You do you, while your Raid Teams perform their duties even when you are not online. The Tribes of the 12 Gates including the Dark Lords and the bosses who rule them never sleep. They are always learning new things and preparing for your return (assuming you keep a server running when you’re not).

data.name: Spiritual Prophecy
data.detailed_description:
In Spiritual Prophecy, you are entrusted with a sacred mission: to save an innocent spirit from the clutches of malevolent entities that torment it. This game, set in a horror atmosphere, challenges you to confront dark forces and protect both your own life and the life of the needy spirit. Before the game starts, you can choose up to three special abilities, known as blessings, which will provide powerful aids on your journey. However, these blessings will not all be available at the start; they will be unlocked as you save more tormented spirits.

Throughout the game, you must collect four fragments of faith scattered throughout the dark environment. These fragments are vital because, upon gathering them, you will activate a sacred altar. This altar is the key to saving the tormented spirit, freeing it from the malevolent forces surrounding it. However, the task is not easy: if either of your lives reaches zero, the mission will fail, and both will succumb to the darkness.

Therefore, it is crucial to balance your actions, ensuring your own survival while protecting the innocent spirit. Use your blessings wisely and explore the environment cautiously to find the fragments of faith. As you progress and save more spirits, new blessings will be unlocked, expanding your combat and strategy options. In the game, you will need to dodge attacks and counter-attack to protect yourself and the spirit. Focus on saving the spirit and achieving victory in Spiritual Prophecy.

data.name: Rooster Booster 3D
data.detailed_description:
All of the charm of Rooster Booster - now in glorious 3D!

Rooster Booster 3D is a speed-oriented platformer inspired by retro titles that are snappy, simple, and most importantly, fun!

Roll, bounce, and boost your way through tight turns and over death-defying jumps! Master the game's 3 playable courses by precisely timing each boost and discovering shortcuts along the way.

Each of RB3D's courses showcase a different vaporwave-style aesthetic, complimented by groovy original music! As a reward for fast completion times, players can also unlock new playable critters in addition to the Golden Torus (and if the rumors are true, gold versions of each critter).

data.name: Static Voice
data.detailed_description:
The Story

You play as Artyom, a resident living in an old Soviet apartment block. After a massive factory explosion released a deadly neurotoxin, the building went silent. His friend Viktor left behind blueprints for a radio device. Now, Artyom must scavenge for electronic parts to build an SOS transmitter on the roof and signal for help.


The Gameplay

This is a first-person stealth survival horror. You must explore the toxic stairwell, manage your gas mask filters, and avoid the "Somebody" while gathering parts for the device.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Soviet aesthetic.

  • Gas Mask mechanic.

  • Scavenge for electronic parts to build the SOS device.

  • Sound-based stealth.

  • Immersive Apartment Hub.

data.name: Ko-Archie: Eeny Meeny Miny Moe
data.detailed_description:
Take control of Ko-Archie, a brave little koala taking the ultimate gamble on an experimental teleporter to rescue his kidnapped sister, Ko-Emily! When the machine malfunctions, space-time shatters, hurling you into dynamic time-travel combat across wildly different eras.

From piloting high-speed hovercrafts to mastering lethal physics-based weaponry, every run challenges your reflexes, tactics, and survival instincts in high-octane VR.

KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • High-Octane Vehicle & Wave Combat

    Pilot a high-speed hovercraft through intense arenas, blast through relentless enemy waves, and face off against massive, multi-stage bosses across shifting historical and futuristic eras.

  • Hybrid Arsenal & Skill System

    Master precision gunplay with ranged weapons and throw boomerangs like a pro with 1:1 physics. Outsmart enemies by curving attacks around cover, executing high-skill combinations, and solving physical environmental puzzles to advance.

  • Interactive NPC Relationship System

    Every action has a reaction. Your choices shape how NPCs treat you throughout your journey:

    • Earn Trust: Help NPCs out, offer them food, water, or assistance to gain valuable allies and unlock hidden shortcuts.

    • Face Consequences: Step out of line or cross boundaries with inappropriate behavior, and prepare to get slapped or punched right back into place!

  • Dynamic Time-Travel Survival

    No two journeys play out the same. Adapt to changing environments, manage survival pressure under time constraints, and outwit sinister forces as you race against the clock.

Can you master the teleporter chaos and survive the ultimate dynamic time-travel combat?

Add to your WISHLIST NOW on Steam VR and join the rescue mission!

data.name: Recollect
data.detailed_description:
Recollect is a 2D topdown puzzle-adventure game. In this game, you're given the ability to cast a number of spells by typing them on the keyboard. You will acquire a spellbook that will serve as a hint for what those spells are. As you progress through the game and solve various puzzles using these spells, you will come across fragments of your past which will uncover parts of the spellbook while also uncovering mysteries of the alien world around you.

Venture Into a Puzzling World of the Mind

In Recollect, you take the role of a wizard who has lost his memory. Overcome plenty of obstacles with creative solutions by casting spells with help from your spellbook. Encounter strange, otherworldly sights and piece together memories from your past to take control of your life once again.

Knowledge Is Your Ally

Coming across flashbacks, context and secrets is not only key to understanding your story, but also helps you traverse the world with ease. The game is designed to reward those who understand its quirks.

Typing Done Differently

Recollect gives you the freedom to use your keyboard to think of spells and triumph over various hardships. Be expressive! There are many hidden spells and the world reacts to the actions you take.

List of Features

  • Typing mechanic which is used to solve unique puzzles

  • Multiple characters with their own personality and their own dialogues that get more detailed as you progress through the game

  • A Spellbook that helps discover new spells

  • Adaptive soundtrack that gets more complex as you progress through the game

  • A story that reacts to your actions

Co-financed by the European Union through the Prague Smart Akcelerátor+ project (Reg. No. CZ.02.01.02/00/22_009/0008344).

data.name: Have Fun, Don't Die!
data.detailed_description:
Have Fun, Don't Die! -  is an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer VR shooter that puts you in the role of both warrior and weaponsmith.

Design and build your own arsenal from the ground up by hand-placing 3D pixel blocks—each with unique properties that shape your weapon’s look, feel, and performance.

Outsmart your rivals with wild, unconventional creations or command respect with sleek, finely tuned masterpieces of destruction. Every battle is an opportunity to experiment, innovate, and perfect your personal combat style.

Game Features:

1. Custom Weapon Crafting: No more generic guns—build your destiny, one block at a time! Each piece changes how your weapon looks, feels, and fights. Experiment endlessly and craft a weapon that’s truly you.

2. Character Customization: Express yourself and stand out on the battlefield! Create your own unique avatar with an extensive range of outfits, accessories, and body customization options. Whether you’re aiming for style, intimidation, or pure chaos, your look will be as unforgettable as your gameplay.

3. Choose Your Style:
Find your rhythm on the battlefield with two core weapon classes: pistols and SMGs. Will you master precision and control as a deadly sharpshooter, or dominate the arena with a blazing-fast custom SMG? The choice is yours—your style, your rules.

4. Dynamic Multiplayer:
Jump into intense, fast-paced multiplayer battles with friends and players from around the world! Test your skills in tactical team clashes or dive headfirst into chaotic free-for-all showdowns. Victory demands sharp aim, clever tactics, and flawless teamwork.

5. Block Variety:
Experiment with a vast selection of blocks, each bringing unique attributes to your creations. Mix and match to fine-tune stats like damage, accuracy, recoil, and more. Every combination opens new tactical possibilities—no two weapons (or fights) are ever the same.

6. Strategy Meets Action:
Have Fun, Don't Die! - redefines the shooter experience by blending creativity, strategy, and high-octane combat. Plan your loadout, build your weapon, and adapt to every encounter. Outsmart, outbuild, and outplay your opponents—your ingenuity is the ultimate weapon.

data.name: Mist
data.detailed_description:
🌫️ A Dark RPG Journey Through the Mist

Mist is a gripping RPG adventure that blends story-driven exploration, character evolution, and chilling horror elements — all wrapped in an atmospheric idle experience.

👤 Start your path as a fragile human in a world overrun by alien horrors. Evolve, adapt, and become something far greater — or far more terrifying — in your quest to save your missing daughter and uncover the secrets hidden within the Mist.

⚔️ RPG Progression with a Monstrous Twist

Gain experience, unlock new abilities, and transform your appearance as you grow stronger. Your evolution changes everything — your powers, your look, even your morality.

Talk to survivors of the invasion — the Missourians. Friend or foe? Your choices shape the story. Decide who you trust, what you become, and how far you’re willing to go.

🧬 Key Features:

  • FIGHT hordes of alien enemies and face off against deadly bosses.

  • EVOLVE your hero as you gain strength, transforming into a terrifying force.

  • UNLOCK unique superpowers, search for resources, and uncover ancient totems.

  • CHOOSE dialogue options that affect the story and relationships.

  • EXPLORE 8 eerie, story-rich locations inspired by 90s America.

  • IMMERSE yourself in a haunting horror RPG atmosphere with stunning visuals and sound.

🕹️ Idle Mechanics. Active Decisions.

Enjoy a relaxing idle core that lets you grow even while you're away — but don't let your guard down. The world of Mist is dangerous, and every decision counts.

🌑 Will You Remain Human… or Embrace the Monster Within?

Dive into a dark RPG experience like no other. Download Mist now and step into the battle between light and darkness — your destiny awaits.

data.name: Seven Doors
data.detailed_description:
Seven Doors is a first-person horror game set in a mysterious world that resembles Korea's Joseon Dynasty.

Trapped in a strange and unfamiliar world, you must explore dark and unsettling places, search for hidden clues and items, and find a way to escape.

But you are not alone.

Terrifying, unknown entities roam the darkness. You cannot fight them.

Hide, run, and sometimes hold your breath as you wait for them to pass.

Survive, uncover the secrets hidden within this place, and find your way out.

KEY FEATURES

• First-Person Horror — Experience the fear up close through the eyes of the protagonist.
• Exploration & Puzzles — Investigate your surroundings, discover clues, and solve environmental puzzles.
• Hide & Escape — You cannot fight the creatures. Hide and escape their pursuit to survive.
• Dark & Unsettling Atmosphere — Explore environments designed to create constant tension and unease.
• Traditional Korean Horror — A distinctive horror setting inspired by the Joseon Dynasty and traditional Korean culture.
• Hidden Story — Uncover the mysteries of this world through clues and items scattered throughout the environment.

data.name: Citadels
data.detailed_description:
The Legend Of King Arthur Reborn!

A vast army has gathered in front of the castle gates and is preparing to attack King Arthur! How has it come to this?
Witness important events in the history of the legendary king and accompany him and his army on the path to an uncertain future. It is up to you to restore the honor, the glory and the reign of the Arthurian line, and rewrite the course of history!
Good or evil? The decision is entirely yours! Two extensive campaigns give you insight into both sides of the war.

Key Features

  • Construct impregnable fortresses, equip them with units, ditches and palisades and crush the hordes of enemies with your defense structures!
  • A fortress alone does not mean victory! Build a dependable infrastructure and manage your resources.
  • Your strategy will decide between victory and defeat! Only with the right combination of defense structures, units, extraction of raw materials, and production, will you emerge victorious from the sieges.
  • Experience epic battles with realistic destruction! Assemble your army from a multitude of different units. But beware of falling rubble and take geographical conditions into account in your battle plan.
  • Unlock legendary characters! Complete specific tasks and gain the support of famous heroes, granting you strategic advantages in battle.

data.name: Polyball
data.detailed_description:
GET READY TO ENTER A NEW ERA OF PHYSICS PLATFORMING

Polyball is a modern take on classic ball rolling games such as Super Monkey Ball, Marble Madness, and Marble Blast - while taking cues from games such as the Sonic series, Trackmania, and Mario Kart.

A BIT ABOUT POLYBALL

There's a lot to do in Polyball -- Challenge yourself or a friend to one of over 60 levels included in the initial release, with plans for many more levels via DLC. If you've got some friends over and are looking for something to play, Polyball's splitscreen multiplayer promises a good time. With classic modes like Battle and Trails, as well as a multiplayer version of the single-player experience, Polyball promises to be a must-have party game.

CASUAL, COMPETITIVE, OR BOTH

With global leaderboards built right into the level select menu and pregame screen, you can see where you stand among the worlds best and race against their ghosts. If you're more interested in beating your friends, check out the friends-only leaderboards. Collecting shards during your single-player journey will unlock a vast array of customization options, from different ball models to particle effects. This customization carries over into your high-score ghost, online races, as well as local multiplayer having its own version of the customization system designed for split-screen play.

FOR THE PEOPLE, BY THE PEOPLE

If you've mastered every challenge we put into the game, take a look at the Steam Workshop content to face a whole new set of challenges. Community made content will bridge the gap between developer and player as well as provide a steady stream of new content for you to experience. Steam Workshop gives the players a voice, allowing for the mechanics and level designs of Polyball to stretch far beyond what we had initially put into the game. With a built-in level editor easily accessible from the main menu creating content is a breeze, it even supports custom model and texture importing!

A BIT ABOUT US

The first full release from digital design practice Studio Monolith, Polyball is an experiment in low-poly visuals and open-ended game design. Our approach with the project was to make the kind of game we used to play, something that had both casual appeal and a limitless competitive ceiling. It was also a genre that we felt hasn't been adequately adapted to the modern world of game design. Our vision was simple: build a game that's easy to pick up, hard to master, and fun both on and off screen.

FEATURES


  • 60+ levels and free DLC
  • Powerful customization system
  • Full controller support and keybinding
  • Splitscreen multiplayer support
  • Global/Friends Leaderboards
  • Full soundtrack made by independent artists
  • Steam Workshop
  • Tuned mechanics and balanced levels based on community feedback
  • Mac/Windows/Linux support
  • Alternate language localization
  • Ghosts
  • Steam Cloud Saves
  • Level editor with custom model support
  • Stats display
  • Achievements

MULTIPLAYER MODES


  • Trails
  • Battle
  • Split-Screen + Online Story Mode
  • More modes coming soon!

data.name: Bugs Don't Pay Rent
data.detailed_description:
Got pests that just won't quit?

Is cleaning a total nightmare, or your secret obsession?

Some things are better left to the pros.

Hello there! We're Bugs Don't Pay Rent – Cleaning & Pest Control Co.

FLUSH 'EM OUT

They love to hide. Right-click to lift the furniture, hold your UV lamp along the baseboards, and follow the glowing droppings straight to their nest.

BAIT 'EM, SEAL 'EM, SMASH 'EM

A crack in the wall keeps refilling the room. Lay down bait or slip them some poison, then seal it shut with caulk. Timing is everything: seal it too early and they'll chew right through. As for the nests? See one, smash it.

THE RIGHT TOOL FOR THE JOB

Every tool has one thing it's good at. A fly swatter won't do squat against a roach, and too much spray just breeds resistance. Boiling water? Boiling water doesn't care. Your license decides what the Shop will sell you.

EXTERMINATION IS ONLY HALF THE BATTLE

Grease, soap scum, dust, cobwebs, and whatever the bugs left behind. Mop the wet messes, sweep the dry ones, scrub the grime, and feel that little rush every time a piece of furniture goes "ding!"

Then put everything back where it was. Clock out for before-and-after photos and a star for every client request you met. Stars mean tips.

SKILL UPS & ROBOTS

Practice makes perfect: the more you use a tool, the better it gets. Later you can buy robot vacuums and drones. Need a scout, a bait runner, a nest wrecker or a laser for the flies? There's a bot for that. As the saying goes, "A craftsman is only as good as his tools."

FROM HALF A STOREFRONT TO HEADQUARTERS

Grow a tiny shop into a real company. Put your pay back into the storefront and watch it go from a hand-nailed wooden sign to a headquarters with a giant cockroach on the roof. Every level comes with a real perk.

BUG-SHY MODE

Too creepy? Bug-shy mode turns every creepy-crawler into a harmless little bean.

WALK-INS WELCOME. BUGS: NOT SO MUCH.

data.name: The Deep Paths: Labyrinth Of Andokost
data.detailed_description:
The Deep Paths: Labyrinth Of Andokost is a first-person, dungeon crawling RPG, with traditional grid-based movement, and active turn-based combat. Players explore a vast labyrinth filled with dangerous creatures, and hidden treasures, to unravel an ancient mystery and deliver their city from harm’s way.

Featuring rich, 3D environments with an old-school, retro feel, this huge adventure pays a modernised homage to classic 80’s and 90’s dungeon crawlers, such as “Dungeon Master” and “Lands Of Lore”.

  • Rich, 3D environments with high-quality art.

  • Tough, old-school combat, and traditional character levelling.

  • Dozens of secrets to discover.

  • A light-hearted adventure that doesn't take itself too seriously.

Big News!

A spiritual successor to this game is in development. A complete reimagining built from scratch with all new mechanics and countless refinements!

data.name: AI Script: Infinite Text Adventures
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to "AI Script: Infinite Text Adventures", an infinite text adventure game powered by an AI Game Master (GM). Experience the future of gaming that captures the magic of classic tabletop role-playing (TRPG), featuring AI-driven, never-repeating storylines and strategic dice-rolls that determine your fate.

• An AI Game Master with a Mind of Its Own
Your AI GM has its own "personality". It might be a generous benefactor, smoothing your path; or it could be a harsh judge, setting daunting challenges for your journey. With each new game, you will face an unknown GM, ready for unexpected surprises and shocks.

• An Infinite Universe of Stories
At the heart of the game is a powerful AI script generator. It builds worlds for you, generates characters, and weaves completely original storylines. No two adventures are the same, as every choice opens a new narrative branch.

• The Soul of TRPG: Strategy & Luck
When faced with crucial choices (ABCD) presented by the AI, you must weigh their different success rates. Roll the decisive dice and feel the dramatic tension where strategy meets luck, hanging in the balance between success and failure.

• Your Adventure Starts Now
The initial version of the game launches with the "Starship Journey" campaign, taking you to explore the mysteries of the vast cosmos. More diverse script worlds are planned for the future, aiming to expand your horizons of adventure indefinitely (Note: DLC plans are subject to change based on development progress).

The initial version of the game launches with the "Starship Journey" campaign, taking you to explore the mysteries of the vast cosmos. More diverse script worlds are planned for the future, aiming to expand your horizons of adventure indefinitely (Note: DLC plans are subject to change based on development progress).

data.name: Beast Blasters
data.detailed_description:
Well shoot, I think it's about time we blast the beast and have a feast!

"Beast Blasters" is a show starring Kyle (the leader), Gulp (the researcher), and C Bun (support) where these passionate southern men blast various beasts (often of supernatural origin) in long hunts across the South, saving the victimized counties. And now, with this game, you'll be able to live that big part of their lives. You start as Gulp so you can view his research, which often has key information, and from then on you're able to switch between the three Beast Blasters throughout the hunt. They each have their own special abilities and talents somewhat based on their role, and to defeat the beast, you're going to have to use their specific flair effectively.

And hey, if you do that, you may just blast the beast and have a feast. The county is counting on you to save them from the terror. Do what you can.

data.name: Super Ubie Island 2
data.detailed_description:
NEW Pre-Alpha Demo!



Super Ubie Island 2 is under active development, and your feedback is invaluable. Dive into the pre-alpha demo, share your thoughts, and help shape the final game.





Embark on an exciting platforming adventure with Super Ubie Island 2! This game is a heartfelt tribute to the 90s classics, bringing a mix of nostalgia and fresh gameplay to players of all ages.

Features



  • Classic Platforming Gameplay: Relive the magic of 90s platformers with gameplay inspired by Sonic the Hedgehog, Donkey Kong Country, Super Mario Bros 3, and Kirby. Traverse through beautifully crafted levels filled with secrets, obstacles, and enemies.

  • Over 25 Levels: Dive into a wide range of levels, each with its own unique challenges and secrets to uncover.

  • Challenging Bosses: Face off against formidable bosses that will test your platforming skills and strategy.

  • Hand-Drawn Art and Animation: Explore a world brought to life with stunning hand-drawn art and smooth animations. Each level offers a unique visual and gameplay experience.

  • Captivating Story and Characters: Help Ubie as he returns to Climate Island to rescue his Ubalien friends who have been captured by the nefarious Dr. Terrestrial. Encounter a delightful cast of characters, each adding depth and charm to the adventure.

  • Difficulty Modes: Choose from different difficulty modes to match your preferred level of challenge, including the Nubie mode for a more relaxed experience.

  • Tons of Collectables: Hunt for a variety of collectibles scattered throughout the levels, adding an extra layer of challenge and replayability.

  • Mini Games and Secret Areas: Discover hidden mini-games and secret areas that offer additional gameplay and rewards.

  • Robust Soundtrack: Enjoy a rich and immersive soundtrack that complements the game's action and environments.

Add Super Ubie Island 2 to your wishlist now to stay updated on all the latest news and developments. Join Ubie on an unforgettable journey and rediscover the joy of classic platformers with a modern twist!

data.name: Pitfalls 64
data.detailed_description:
MEET THE CAST


About the Game

"Pitfalls 64" is a brutally challenging collectathon about a homesick gnome in search of his way back home! This punishing journey will demand full mastery of acrobatic jumping. Just remember, with each bonk back down there is a lesson to be told...

You'll be fighting the climb home! Each butt-clenching jump raises the stakes; a single slip sends you tumbling back down, and you're the only one who can pick yourself back up.

Don't give up little gnome! With a little bit of practice you'll become a master of acrobatic jumping in no time - after all, falling is half the fun!

Or just be passing through? Learn to love (or hate) the whimsically tragic characters that you'll meet along your tall journey home through this bizarre vertical world. But keep in mind, that your choices matter...

Gameplay & Atmosphere:

  • Manually save progress with checkpoints

  • Tough but addictive gameplay

  • Hours of butt-clenching platforming

  • Classic N64 graphics - blocky characters, fluid animations, diverse environments

  • Legendary OST by Shaun Cheetham

data.name: Neon Nights
data.detailed_description:
Lately, Kate has been a little restless. The glowing lights of Metropolis 12 simply don't hold the luster they once did in her precocious youth. Now, the only things that give her joy are intimacy, and hoverbike racing. And since the intimacy has been sparse lately, she's taken to speeding her bike through the dark alleys of the city at night, trying to outpace her life.
This night, however, might be a little different…


Tall, gorgeous, deeply sexual; you'd think she'd have no trouble getting laid, but there's just something about her that sends men (and most women) running the other way. Not tonight though… Tonight she's going to find the perfect pair to handle her. Or, more accurately, she will handle them. Thoroughly


A precocious little woman with a smile always on her lips, and a love of internal body augmentation – augmentation she puts to very good use. But can those expensive upgrades handle what Kate is going to give her?


Violet's best friend, and night-time partner. Unlike V, she's kept herself all-natural and un-augmented – she swears there's just something better about an all-natural body when it comes to their line of work. Secretly though, she's worried clients prefer the luxury services Violet offers, so she always works double-hard to prove herself.

Features

  • Kinetic Visual Novel.
  • Two complete standalone stories.
  • Over 10,000 words of story.
  • Contains ~200 CG artworks in 4K format.
  • Five background music tracks for you to choose from, select your favorite music.
  • Multiple achievements for each story.

data.name: Pot by Pot
data.detailed_description:
Pot by Pot is a cozy organizational logic puzzle game about plants, pots, and finding the perfect place for everything. Follow clues, make connections, and enjoy satisfying, bite-sized puzzles as you arrange your little plant shop and watch beautiful plant-and-pot pairings come together.

Each puzzle gives you a set of plants, pots, colors, prices, and other rules to work out. Piece the clues together, eliminate the impossible combinations, and organize the shop one pot at a time.

Satisfying deductions
Piece together the clues, narrow down the possibilities, and enjoy that satisfying moment when everything clicks into place.

Discover new plants
Meet new plants and uncover more of the charming world of your little plant shop.

Beautiful pairings
Watch plants and pots come together into lovely pairings as you uncover the solution to each puzzle.

Bite-sized logic puzzles
Solve logic puzzles that are easy to pick up and satisfying to work through.

A cozy plant shop
Take your time, organize the shop, and enjoy the simple satisfaction of seeing everything come together.

data.name: FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE
data.detailed_description:
"FUBUKI ~zero in on Holoearth~" is a high-speed pixel action game where you control the protagonist, "Shirakami Fubuki," and battle using swords and skills.

An exhilarating 2D pixel action adventure with Fubuki across "Holoearth"!

You take control of "Shirakami Fubuki," one of the "Kami" residing in "Yamato."

With her beloved sword "Murasamemaru," she skillfully performs sword fights, high-speed movement, and even wall jumps with ease.

Fight alongside Fubuki, defeat the "Ayakashi" blocking your path, and resolve the anomalies occurring in "Holoearth."

(This game is developed with reference to the world settings of the teaser PV and manga of Hololive Alternative. Please note that some content and expressions may differ from the official settings.)

The world of "Holoearth" is diverse and ever-changing.

Each stage features a completely different appearance, enemies, and mechanics.

Utilize your player skills and the allies you meet along the way to overcome challenging obstacles.

During your adventure, you may encounter Hololive menbers who have been corrupted by "Kegare" and turned hostile.

Defeat them to restore their sanity—they will surely lend you their strength once they are back to normal.

data.name: Andy's Apple Farm
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Andy's Apple Farm!

On this farm, you control Andy the Apple! Meet up with other fun characters such as Felix the Fish, Melody the Moon, Margret the Mole, and Claus the Clock!

Andy and his friends are having fun on this nice sunny day on the farm! Andy's house is missing its key, and he needs your help to find it and get back into his house! Each character has a game to play and playing these games will reward you with "BONUS STICKERS" Help Andy collect everyone's "Bonus Sticker" and they might just tell him where his key might be!

Will you help Andy win back his keys and get back into His house?

In this game, you play a copy of a fictional beta test version of the game "Andy's Apple Farm", a game that was supposed to be released in the mid-1980s. The game isn't actually a beta test, however, the game's version is designed to appear as one.

The game starts to "glitch" and reveal more of the story behind the game. This game has a lot of secrets to discover so it may require several playthroughs to have different experiences and fully understand the game's internal story.

WARNING: This game contains loud noises, scary imagery, and flashing lights.

data.name: Studio System : Guardian Angel
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the bloodletting...

Days before high school's end, one of your friends decided to bring to light the existence of an abandoned film studio underneath the school. From within the dusty sepulcher everything went black. Then reality struck as you came to. The students have vanished. All of your friends are gone.

Stammering creatures now wander the halls. You choke on your breath; the air here is disgusting. The walls here are moving. Pulsating. You remember a voice, made clear to your unconscious mind: "END THE CYCLE."

Newfound power lies before you. Unravel the mystery. Escape this hell.

Features

  • Explore dingy surrealist environments...

  • Fixed camera horror with light survival elements, use the fixed camera to defeat enemies and solve puzzles...

  • Form a pact with a God to ensure your safety...

data.name: ARES
data.detailed_description:
Embark into a lore-rich online Milsim campaign with detailed virtual reality interactions in this military sandbox game. Experience the story from multiple perspectives as Infantry, drive vehicles, aircraft, and more.

After over a decade, this community-fated story campaign finally gets the home it deserves,

This is ARES.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――

INTERACTIVE VR SYSTEMS

Kick in doors, climb ladders, manipulate your weapon, interact with vehicles, and more.

Utilize direct contact feedback, and open a new world of interaction unique to ARES.

CAMPAIGN

Take part in the extremely lore-rich storyline crafted for literally over a decade in the deep-history

of this alternate reality. From hidden intel documents, to in-world mysteries, and faction diplomacy.

Your choices and interactions with the game will affect the outcome of the Global Campaign, including
other players also participating, fating history itself.

TRUE VEHICLES

Full-simulation aircraft and vehicles that give a first-hand interaction basis to

allow you to truly take control, thinning the line of reality and virtual reality.

From advanced avionics, water displacement, and engine torque, each vehicle

feels part of the world and not just a gameplay mechanic.

DENS ENGINE

Experience destruction and true surface tension like you've never seen before.

Explosives deform terrain, shockwaves shatter windows, structures collapse-

Each surface, object, vehicle, and weapon down to the casings they eject simulate

accurate and immersive ballistics data to truly give you a Milsim experience.

ADVANCED BALLISTICS

Firing your weapon is not just a gameplay feature. Air pressure, weather, gravity,

and even the way you hold it will affect your shot. Experience a simulated ballistics

system like you've never seen before. Shoot through walls, shatter glass, and redefine

what is "cover" and "concealment" in a video game.

INDIVIDUAL CUSTOMIZATION

Mount attachments, replace receiver groups, alternate your grip, and modify optics to

truly fit your preference. Expand past just your weapon, change fatigues, alternate mounts,

gear up with rigs and plate carriers- Individual customization effects your weapon and gear's

performance, weight, interactions with the world, and more.

ADAPTIVE AUDIO

Experience audio-based immersion like you've never before. Hear and feel everything around you,

from explosions, to footsteps, to the rumble of a tank passing by.

TRUE MILSIM SANDBOX

ARES is more than a game- Utilize the in-game mission builder and level editor-

use it for specific scenarios, train your shot with true-to-world weather effects, bullet

ballistics, smart enemy conflicts, and make it your experience.

data.name: Packed Lair
data.detailed_description:
Heroes. Always barging in. Always swinging swords. Always acting like you’re the problem.

In Packed Lair, you play as an evil lord trying to defend your very valuable underground real estate from an endless parade of so-called heroes. Draft buildings, rotate them into place, and squeeze every last bit of evil efficiency out of your cramped lair to create a monster army capable of keeping those meddling do-gooders out for good.

Part Inventory Management, part Base Builder, part Roguelike Auto-Battler, Packed Lair is about squeezing maximum villainy out of limited floor space.

Your lair may be small, but your ambitions are not.

Every building you place can create minions, produce gold, improve your army, or unlock new ways to scale your evil operation. The trick is finding where everything fits. Rotate buildings, connect them carefully, and discover powerful layout synergies that turn a messy cave into a perfectly packed engine of villainy.

Between battles, expand your lair, unlock new buildings, and adapt your strategy to whatever the heroes throw at you next.

Each run gives you new buildings, new synergies to chase, and new opportunities to create the most absurdly efficient monster factory your tiny lair can contain. 

Once your lair is ready, it is time to let your minions do what minions do best: charge directly at the problem.

Watch your goblins, shaman lizardman, dragons and other questionable employees clash with waves of increasingly determined heroes. Your army fights automatically, but you are not just sitting back and hoping for the best. Cast different spells during battle to tip the odds, disrupt the enemy, and turn a heroic invasion into a heroic mistake.

  • Draft, rotate, and pack buildings into a cramped evil lair

  • Create powerful synergies through smart spatial placement

  • Build and unleash chaotic armies of minions

  • Cast spells during auto-battler combat

  • Expand your lair and unlock new buildings across each run

  • Enjoy fast, tactical roguelike sessions full of goblins, monsters, and heroic regrets

data.name: Cubesc VR
data.detailed_description:
Step into a world where your deepest fears become reality and solve puzzles that challenge both courage and intellect in this thrilling VR experience.

FIND YOUR WAY

Find your way across precarious platforms suspended in darkness, where falling is a constant threat.

EXPLORE DIFFERENT FEATURES

Confront the fear of heights as you navigate misleading paths and uncover hidden secrets.

DON'T FALL DOWN

Be careful what step you take, it could be your last.

Join Kira and his faithful teddy bear as they find themselves high above an abyss in a dark and mysterious realm. Every step could be their last, and only by facing the vertigo-inducing heights can they hope to escape.

  • Immerse yourself in a minimalist puzzle world brought to life with stunning 3D visuals that amplify the sensation of towering heights.

  • Experience unique melodies and soundscapes that intensify the atmosphere and draw you deeper into Kira's journey.

Are you brave enough to face your fears and help Kira find his way out?

data.name: Lark
data.detailed_description:
Lark is a chaotic solo/co-op survival roguelite where you play as a strange little Wildthing trying to become an unstoppable problem for the world around you.

Harvest resources, craft tools, build a barely-respectable shelter, steal from strange villages, and throw questionable treasures into THE PIT in exchange for powerful equipment buffs. Every run is about scraping together supplies, making bad decisions, and stacking enough strange powers to grow from small nuisance to unhinged little god.

Play alone or host a run with up to five friends as you explore, loot, fight, sacrifice, and spiral wildly out of control together.

Gather resources, craft what you need, build basic shelters, raid villages, steal loot, and decide what is worth keeping — or what deserves to be thrown into THE PIT.

Sacrifice stolen goods and strange treasures to gain equipment buffs that shape your build over the course of each run. The more you offer, the more ridiculous your Wildthing can become.

Combine equipment tags, buffs, and scaling effects to create strange synergies. Start weak, get weird, and turn your tiny creature into an absolute menace.

Play solo or host a multiplayer run with up to five friends. Work together, split up, hoard resources, make terrible plans, and try not to become the reason everyone dies.

Craft simple, crude hut pieces for storage and protection without turning the game into a full construction sim.

Explore a world filled with villages, shrines, graveyards, enemies, loot, hazards, and strange events that create chaotic little stories every run.

Lark is designed to be polished enough to play seriously, but weird enough that things can go horribly wrong in the funniest way possible.

Lark is being developed by a solo developer, and player feedback will help shape where the game goes next. Nothing below is a hard promise or locked release date, but these are the main areas planned for development during Early Access.

The current focus is making the core loop as fun, readable, and chaotic as possible:

  • harvesting, crafting, stealing, and sacrificing

  • equipment buffs and build synergies

  • multiplayer stability and hosting

  • enemy encounters and world danger

  • run pacing, balance, polish, and clarity

Future updates are planned to include:

  • More playable characters with their own abilities, strengths, and chaotic nonsense

  • Darker character powers and more unstable upgrade paths

  • Randomly generated maps, events, loot, enemies, and sacrifice opportunities

  • More bosses, including a final boss as a main victory condition

  • More equipment buffs, strange items, build combinations, and ridiculous scaling

  • Unlocks, cosmetics, secrets, rewards, and funny little surprises

  • Steam achievements, friend support, progress tracking, and multiplayer improvements

  • More enemies, races to steal from, hazards, secrets, polish, sound, music, VFX, and general nonsense

Some ideas may grow, some may change, and some may be thrown directly into THE PIT if they do not work. The goal is to keep improving Lark with feedback from the players who are helping shape this strange little creature into something bigger, weirder, and much more dangerous.

data.name: Vampire's Kiss: Time Paradox
data.detailed_description:
💖 ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST 💖

✦ A destiny bound by time and a vampire's bite. Are you ready to make your choice?

«Vampire’s Kiss: Time Paradox» is a romantic anime visual novel where the secrets of ancient vampires and the mysterious Order intertwine with the fateof the main heroine. This is a story not only about love, but also about trust, choice, and consequences. Perfect for those seeking a deep plot, emotional engagement, and the chance to live out their own unique version of an anime drama.

✦ 🧛‍♀️ Meet the Characters:

  • Ayane: An ordinary schoolgirl with a heavy past... but her fate is already intertwined with the night world.

  • Akira: A daring vampire who wants not only Ayane's heart, but also power over the world.

  • Kaito: A doctor with a kind heart. But why does his care feel so much like a mask?

  • Ren: A vampire hunter for whom law and duty have always come first. But their meeting will turn even his own convictions upside down.

✦ 💞 Immerse Yourself in the Story:

Ayane's ordinary life shatters after a mysterious bite. Now, her fate and the fate of the entire world depend on the choice she must make. Build a relationship with the one who has touched your heart and uncover all the secrets held by the port town of Port Harumi.

✦ 🔮 Key Features:

  • 3 unique romantic routes with deeply developed characters.

  • Destiny in Your Hands: A choice system that influences the plot and endings.

  • Multiple unique endings – from happy to dramatic.

  • A captivating plot at the intersection of mysticism, romance, and science fiction.

  • Expressive animation and atmospheric backgrounds in the best anime traditions.

Become the heroine of this incredible story! Add «Vampire's Kiss: Time Paradox» to your Wishlist right now and write your own love story!

data.name: Chasmal Fear
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Chasmal Fear is a first-person tactical shooter survival horror game that puts players in a mysteriously empty sci-fi underwater facility where something has gone terribly wrong. Ammo is scarce. The odds are stacked against you. Choose wisely between fighting or sneaking past the monstrosities which once killed might mutate into something even worse. Unlock hidden areas and solve puzzles to uncover the truth of what happened in this top-secret facility. Every decision will impact your gameplay experience, some swarming relentless monsters against you while others offer the chance to employ stealth and cunning to survive.

Wishlist Chasmal Fear now to stay up to date with the latest news!

KEY FEATURES:

  • LIMITED RESOURCES

Limited player ammo and scarce ammo boxes will encourage players to think strategically and be cautious while traversing the abandoned steel hallways.

  • IMMERSIVE BODYCAM

Artistic direction that utilizes the perspective of a bodycam footage. Set in the near future, players are also equipped with an AR Interface to help you through the dark hallways of the Magnus Facility.

  • MONSTER MUTATION SYSTEM

Some monsters will randomly start to mutate when killed into a stronger form. Do not be surprised when you encounter more dangerous foes in an area you thought you cleaned out. Make sure to end them before the mutation starts.

  • CHOICES AFFECT YOUR PLAYTHROUGH

Your choices will affect your gameplay experience. Choosing to open one way will close other paths to your next goal. Depending on your choice, you can dive guns blazing or sneak stealthily above a swarm of enemies; hide in the shadows or use your environment to squash the monstrosities.

  • FULLY RANDOMIZED EVENTS

Randomized events occurring throughout the game provide replayability from varying sounds, crumbling ceilings, floors, and unexpected scares.

  • LORE & INTERACTION

Find out clues, pieces of lore, emails, audio logs, and video logs, and find out how Magnus Underwater City came to be, what happened in the meantime, and learn more about the dangers you're facing.

  • REALISTIC ENVIRONMENTS

Graphically realistic, sci-fi underwater station built underneath the waves and inside a massive ocean cliff. Its hallways seem abandoned. It is up to you to find your way out and survive the things that lurk within.

  • CO-OP POSSIBILITY

Bring a friend to Chasmal Fear and survive this nightmare together. The difficulty changes procedurally based on whether you play singleplayer or multiplayer co-op.

data.name: On the Keyboard
data.detailed_description:
Game Summary

This is a keyboard action game where you control a virtual keyboard to carry a Sphere.

The controls are simple: just follow your intuition and press the keys. The virtual keys that correspond to the ones you press will move, and the Sphere will move in response to the force from the keys. Your goal is to carry the Sphere to the finish line without letting it fall off the keyboard.

However, you can't move the Sphere directly, so it often won't behave as you'd like. To manage this irregular Sphere behavior, you’ll need to quickly identify and press the right key from the 40 available. This makes the game more action-packed than it may initially seem.

Moreover, even though it's challenging enough to move the Sphere as intended, the path to the goal is filled with various obstacles that block your way. Overcoming these obstacles requires flexible thinking and skillful manipulation of the keyboard.

Additionally, this game also functions as a typing game, as understanding the spatial arrangement of the keys is crucial. It can improve typing accuracy for both beginners and experienced typists. Why not sharpen your typing skills while having fun with an action-packed game?

And be careful not to break your keyboard!

Supported keyboards

QWERTY

Streaming Guidelines

You are free to stream, record gameplay, or post videos of this game, regardless of whether you are an individual or a company.

It would be appreciated if you could include the game title "On the Keyboard" in the video or stream title, and add the URL of the game's Steam store page in the description.

Please be aware that the game includes a system that retrieves the Steam profile name, so please take care when streaming.

data.name: Apostate
data.detailed_description:
In Apostate, battle as a magical champion, created and trained by a cult of powerful wizards. After witnessing the devastation caused by this cult, you realize the true horrors of their magic. Choosing to run away, you are soon deemed an Apostate and must now escape their ever expanding grasp. Fighting your way through the monsters and demons of the cult, you must strategize and sharpen your magical abilities to gain your full potential and possibly freedom.

In this top down, action roguelite, choose from a vast selection of spells, augmentations, items, and stats to create your own unique custom hero every playthrough. Discover synergies and unlock builds as you compete against your foes. Choose from a wide variety of spells with different status effects and interactions. Augment your champions weapons and armor to change how your spells function. Through a variety of items and stat modifiers you can further customize how your magical hero performs. Combine all these choices to create a variety of different powerful builds.

Battle your way to freedom in either a solo or co-op campaign mode. As well as the ability to challenge others in a streamline pvp mode, where you can fight against the hordes of monsters and compete to see who can create the ultimate custom hero and escape. Watch out though, only one Apostate can make it out alive, and the others will do their best to stop you.

Please check out our development roadmap to stay updated and informed on future content and demos!

data.name: Pest Protocol
data.detailed_description:
Pest Protocol is a short, active incremental game where you start with a swatter and end with orbital-level pest annihilation. Squash bugs, buy ridiculous upgrades, and build an unstoppable extermination engine.

Destroy Insects and other pest

Deploy specialized drones, bombs and definitely lightning to vaporize the pests.  Watch as your initial, frantic cursor evolves into a self-sustaining engine of total pest annihilation.

Upgrade your cursor and customize your weapons

Choose the quadrants for your weapons for strategic placement and control on how to kill the pests.

SCALE TO THE LIMIT

This is a tight, high-density incremental experience designed for players who love to optimize.

  • Optimize your layout: Strategically place your auto-eradication tools to maximize coverage.

  • Unlock the "Exponential" feeling: Use the currency you earn to upgrade your systems, turning a trickle of damage into an unstoppable flood.

  • Clear the screen: Take on everything from annoying mosquitoes to massive, screen-filling pest infestations.

A TIGHT, FOCUSED EXPERIENCE

We’ve designed Pest Protocol to be a short, satisfying incremental loop. Experience a pure, focused progression arc where every click, upgrade, and automation decision brings you closer to ultimate efficiency.

How efficient can your pest-killing factory get?

data.name: Vizier
data.detailed_description:
A young king sits the throne of Tasvirate. The court bows to him — but it listens to you.

As his Vizier, you do not rule. You advise. Every petition, every plot, every war begins as a few quiet words in the king's ear — and becomes your legacy, or your ruin.

The power is his. The words are yours.

Each turn brings a decision: a desperate petitioner, a scheming noble, a province in revolt. You choose the counsel — but the king has a mind of his own. His temper, his fears, and his trust in you decide whether your advice becomes law or is thrown back in your face. Win him, steer him, or be undone by him.

A court that remembers

  • Factions watch every move and shift their loyalty as you favor or betray them.
  • A realm to hold together — treasury, provinces, and an uneasy peace between rival houses.
  • A reputation that follows you: schemer, reformer, butcher, saint.
  • Rivals, lovers, protégés, and a spouse whose fates twist around your own.

Intrigue has a long memory

  • Conspiracies brew across many turns — smother a coup before it reaches the throne, or quietly ride it to power.
  • Wars, assassinations, and succession crises play out as slow-burning arcs that end in triumph or catastrophe.
  • The court hides as much as it reveals. You act on what you can learn — never on everything you wish you knew.

Every reign ends

Dismissed in disgrace. Cut down in a coup. A knife in the dark. Or old age, at last, in your own bed. However your story closes, the next Vizier inherits what you leave behind — your fortune, your lessons, your unfinished schemes. Here, tragedy is not failure. It is the point.

Features

data.about_the_game:
A young king sits the throne of Tasvirate. The court bows to him — but it listens to you.

As his Vizier, you do not rule. You advise. Every petition, every plot, every war begins as a few quiet words in the king's ear — and becomes your legacy, or your ruin.

The power is his. The words are yours.

Each turn brings a decision: a desperate petitioner, a scheming noble, a province in revolt. You choose the counsel — but the king has a mind of his own. His temper, his fears, and his trust in you decide whether your advice becomes law or is thrown back in your face. Win him, steer him, or be undone by him.

A court that remembers

  • Factions watch every move and shift their loyalty as you favor or betray them.
  • A realm to hold together — treasury, provinces, and an uneasy peace between rival houses.
  • A reputation that follows you: schemer, reformer, butcher, saint.
  • Rivals, lovers, protégés, and a spouse whose fates twist around your own.

Intrigue has a long memory

  • Conspiracies brew across many turns — smother a coup before it reaches the throne, or quietly ride it to power.
  • Wars, assassinations, and succession crises play out as slow-burning arcs that end in triumph or catastrophe.
  • The court hides as much as it reveals. You act on what you can learn — never on everything you wish you knew.

data.name: Not born to be King
data.detailed_description:
"My King, wake up … It's your first day. Your people are waiting for you."

Have you ever dreamt of becoming king by accident?
Not Born to be King invites you to do so.
Everyone needs to start somewhere anyway...
So... accept your fate!
Choose your personality and embrace your destiny!
This simulation game takes place in the Middle Ages,
where you must prosper your kingdom by dealing with a variety of events.

Play as you want:
The core of the gameplay lies in your capacity to make the right decisions at the right moment.
Each of your decisions will change the course of events and lead your kingdom to either success or downfall.
The decisions are yours and only yours.
You are the king, after all…

Dynamic environment:
Witness your kingdom grow and evolve throughout your journey.
Watch your castle get bigger or get destroyed.
Watch your churches shine or watch them burn !

A deep and balanced system:
In Not born to be king you must deal with many different features.
Will your reign be based on influence?
Will you build the biggest possible army?
Will you bring happiness or sorrow?
Finding the right balance between those attributes is key to survive in this ruthless world.

Easy to play, hard to survive:
Being a king is definitely not an easy job.
Making the right decision is not easy.
Balancing your economy is not easy.
Does it make it harder when you are not born to be a king?
Let’s find out!

data.name: The Public Domain: The Game
data.detailed_description:
Somewhere in another dimension is a world created from all humanities ideas and imagination. This mindscape is divided into two distinct parts, the exclusive ivory tower known as The Copyright Heights where all ideas and characters currently under copyright live in luxury, and the vast chaotic wasteland below that is The Public Domain. After 96 years of copyright protected status the world's most famous Mouse is thrown out into the cold. Ejected out into the Public Domain with the rest of yesteryear's garbage He must fend for himself and try to find his place in a world where he's no longer the big cheese.

ADVENTURE ACROSS HUMAN IMAGINATION

Encounter places and characters from all throughout the history of media as they are mashed together in a grand story about the structure of civilization and the role that individuals play within it. Stripped of all the power and prestige he has come to define himself by, our favorite cartoon mouse is thrust into a crisis of faith and identity. Desperate for a path back into the Copyright Heights he embarks on an ill-advised journey across the Domain that ends up challenging his closest held notions of individualism, purpose, success, and above all happiness.

AN UNPRECEDENTED, UNAUTHORIZED ODYSSEY

Every single image and sound in this game is taken from a public domain or royalty free source. This project is NOT AFFILIATED with the Walt Disney company or any other corporation or IP license holder. It is the work of a single individual WITHOUT THE PERMISSION OR ENDORSEMENT of ANY company or rights holders

A COLLAGE OF GENRE AND GAME PLAY

The Public Domain: The Game is a blend of 2D puzzle platforming and point-and-click adventure game elements, a "run and jump adventure game" if you will.

data.name: Hollow Remains
data.detailed_description:
Hollow Remains is a first-person exploration horror game set in a hospital.

You must hide from a lurking entity, explore the building, and uncover the truth through the records left behind.

There is no way to fight back.

To survive, you can only keep running.

Story

You lose consciousness on the operating table.

When you awaken from anesthesia, the hospital is empty.

No doctors.

No nurses.

No patients.

The corridors stand silent.

The only sound is your own footsteps.

And yet… you can clearly feel that something is there.

Why is no one here?

What happened inside this hospital?

As you follow the remaining records, you draw closer to the truth hidden within its walls.

About Streaming & Videos

Please include the game title and a link to the store page in your video description.

data.name: Happy Digger Go-Go
data.detailed_description:
Dig deep, sell shiny stuff, upgrade your happy little robot.

In Happy Digger Go-Go, you play as a cheerful little digger bot exploring underground tunnels, collecting minerals, and bringing them back to the surface to sell for cash.

The deeper you dig, the more valuable the minerals become — but you’ll need to keep upgrading your bot if you want to survive longer trips underground.

Dig, sell, upgrade, repeat!

Mine your way through dirt, stone, and buried treasure. Return to the surface, sell what you found, and spend your earnings on useful upgrades to help you dig deeper next time.

Upgrade your digger bot.

Improve your little robot with better equipment, stronger digging power, bigger storage, and other upgrades that make each trip underground more rewarding.

Make your bot your own

Unlock cosmetics and customise your digger bot with different looks as you play.

Bring a little friend along

Collect cute pets that can join you on your digging adventures.

[*]Buy upgrades to dig deeper and last longer

[*]Unlock cosmetics for your bot

[*]Collect pets to follow you around

data.name: Pedro of Brazil
data.detailed_description:
Embark on the grand saga of the Empire of Brazil in "Pedro of Brazil". Join historical heroes like Dom Pedro II, Dom Pedro I, Princess Isabel, André Rebouças, and Maria Quitéria, and fight for honor, duty, and destiny.

Uncover hidden abilities deep within Brazilian history, facing challenges from the Independence to the battles of the Paraguayan War. Withstand external threats and ensure the security of the largest empire in the Americas.

From Quasares Game Studio, this next-generation Action-Adventure brings to life the vibrant events of the Brazilian Empire.

Choose from various historical characters and navigate through conflicts, betrayals, and alliances on your journey across Brazilian lands and beyond.

In a vast country, filled with challenges and opportunities, your path will be shaped by the decisions you make. As the empire grapples with revolutions, political intrigues, and supernatural forces, the fate of the nation rests in your hands.

Developed with the powerful "Unreal Engine 5", "Pedro of Brazil" delivers a storyline true to reality, curated with the expertise of renowned historians. The game offers unparalleled freedom to explore and interact in a world that responds to your choices. The captivating and cinematic narrative brings characters to life in a unique way, creating an immersive experience in the heart of imperial Brazil.

The Empire of Brazil, a land of diversity and wealth, conceals secrets and offers profound exploration that challenges the player at every turn, with maps true to historical cities.

The gameplay of "Pedro of Brazil" is not just about combat. Assist the Abolitionist Association and Princess Isabel in freeing the enslaved, fighting for abolition and the rights of the oppressed.

Historical Characters: Dive into the journeys of legendary figures, each with their unique characteristics, motivations, and visions. Recruit them to fight by your side or experience each of their personal journeys.

Dynamic Combat: Rely on authentic combat techniques from the era, emphasizing strategy and insight. Challenge yourself across different difficulty levels and feel the impact of every decision on the battlefield.

A Cinematic Journey: "Pedro of Brazil" is more than a game; it's an experience. Relive the nation's historical events with intensity and passion.

Quasares Game Studio invites you to this experience. Step into history and leave your mark in "Pedro of Brazil".

  • A shop that's also a slot machine… it's up to you to buy smartly to hit the jackpot!

  • Multi-phase bosses whose attack patterns evolve over your attempts.

data.name: Scrap to Strip
data.detailed_description:
Find it. Fix it. Race it. Own the strip.

You start with a pocket of cash and a lot full of rust. Pick a junker, drag it into your bay, and bring it back from the dead one bolt at a time — pull the worn carb, bolt on a four-barrel, swap the cam, fit headers, drop in a transmission, and breathe on the intake until the old engine wakes up.

Then take it to the strip and find out what it's worth.

WRENCH ON A REAL ENGINE. The garage isn't a menu — it's a workbench. Loosen each bolt, lift the old part off, seat the new one, and watch the engine bay change as you build. Carburetors, manifolds, headers, cams, transmissions — every part has a feel, a tier, and a trade-off. Tune your timing, gearing, and launch RPM to find the sweet spot, and shed weight to a safe floor for a quicker ET.

RACE FOR CASH — OR FOR KEEPS. Size up your opponent before you lay money down. Each rival is a character with their own car, driving style, and tells — read their racer permit, weigh the odds, and pick your wager. Run for pocket change, run for the big purse, or put your PINK SLIP on the line and drive home in their car.

NO TWO RUNS ARE THE SAME. Launch quality, traction, tire wear, and weather all swing the result. Fit the right rubber for today's track (dry, damp, or wet) — grip is everything off the line.

CLIMB THE LADDER. Start with parking-lot street kids and work up through the back-lot bangers, strip regulars, and outlaw pros to dethrone the King of the Strip. Build your reputation to unlock tougher classes and better parts — and watch for the nitro legends who occasionally pull up in something ridiculous.

data.about_the_game:
Find it. Fix it. Race it. Own the strip.

You start with a pocket of cash and a lot full of rust. Pick a junker, drag it into your bay, and bring it back from the dead one bolt at a time — pull the worn carb, bolt on a four-barrel, swap the cam, fit headers, drop in a transmission, and breathe on the intake until the old engine wakes up.

Then take it to the strip and find out what it's worth.

WRENCH ON A REAL ENGINE. The garage isn't a menu — it's a workbench. Loosen each bolt, lift the old part off, seat the new one, and watch the engine bay change as you build. Carburetors, manifolds, headers, cams, transmissions — every part has a feel, a tier, and a trade-off. Tune your timing, gearing, and launch RPM to find the sweet spot, and shed weight to a safe floor for a quicker ET.

RACE FOR CASH — OR FOR KEEPS. Size up your opponent before you lay money down. Each rival is a character with their own car, driving style, and tells — read their racer permit, weigh the odds, and pick your wager. Run for pocket change, run for the big purse, or put your PINK SLIP on the line and drive home in their car.

NO TWO RUNS ARE THE SAME. Launch quality, traction, tire wear, and weather all swing the result. Fit the right rubber for today's track (dry, damp, or wet) — grip is everything off the line.

data.name: Spellinkers
data.detailed_description:
A turn based strategy game, with some flavour of tower defense, RPG and luck games. But mostly a fun challenge!
You are a summoner and war mage commander! Be a master of fire, water, wind and earth while commanding mages and spellinkers of each element to defeat great armies of hommunculi. Build your strategy over a randomly generated field of elemental tiles; you never know how the next battle will be. Cast spells or make powerful linked attacks with your units to defeat tons of enemies! Get stronger with each battle while chasing the mad villain Midas through the world to recover the stolen Philosopher's Stone. The mages of the Ivory Tower are counting on you!

data.name: Reversed Rebecca
data.detailed_description:
A unique RPG game with appealing characters and where your actions have consequences!

You are Rebecca, an engineer who has had her technology stolen. Your mission: take it back.

Travel over the world in search of objects and characters that will help you in your mission, through a universe full of challenges!

Ho, yes... And... Rebecca can reverse the flow of time...


(The .gif compression slightly degraded the rendering quality.)

Features

  • Intelligent NPCs: they move, talk, never say the same thing twice, notice what you are doing, etc.
  • Dozens of mini-games, each more addictive than the next.
  • Original graphics and an unforgettable soundtrack.
  • An adjustable difficulty, for noobs and pro ;)
  • 6 to 8 possible endings!

Your actions have consequences

- You treat John like shit -> He won't like you.

- You forget to water your plant -> It dies.
- You hug someone while being half-naked -> ERECT... Hm... Refusal of the hug.


(The .gif compression slightly degraded the rendering quality.)

- You want to play it "psychopath"? -> … Yes… It is possible…

Warning

Reversed Rebecca is not a horror game. But the player has every right to try to play trash, or worse… This will inevitably have consequences. Be ready to face them.

data.name: Blind Bullet
data.detailed_description:
Blind Bullet is a top-down 2D action shooting game.

The player is blind but possesses exceptional hearing, allowing them to perceive their surroundings through echolocation generated by footsteps.

Evasion

In the game, unknown enemies will attack the player.

When sound waves from footsteps hit the area where an enemy’s attack is coming from, the color of the waves changes.

Pay close attention to the changes in the echoes to avoid enemy attacks.

Attack

When sound waves from footsteps hit an enemy, the waves flicker, revealing the enemy’s location.

The player is skilled in handling firearms and can effortlessly use a shotgun when acquired.

Rely on the echoes to aim and take down enemies.

Investigate

The player is unaware of their current situation.

While they wish to find out what has happened to them and what is going on around them, their blindness limits what they can do alone.

Work together with companions they meet along the way to uncover the truth.

Contact & Guidelines

  • If you encounter any issues, I would appreciate it if you could contact me via my Discord server or by DM on X (@tesakiza).

  • The streaming and content guidelines are available at patreon.
