data.name: Tales of Anturia: Farathan
data.detailed_description:
Story line


Fifteen years ago, your Father conquered Elion province and saved it from the orcs. But he wanted more, pushed into orc territory and went missing. After all that time without a ruler, the empire is on the brink of civil war and the most trusted imperial advisor and your mentor decides it is time to crown you to save the empire from falling apart. He summons you to the capital city of Elion.

Few people know about your travel and the route you will take. Mainly your family, your mentor and the Sartorian captain that has to escort you, your dear friend Elrys.

You did not reach Elion, ambushed by orcs, that never before occurred so deep into Elion province. During the ambush, you were "lucky" enough to fall of a bridge into a river. You crashed your head on a rock, but an old fisherman managed to save you. You are weak,do not remember how to fight and no one belives you are Eristan - the rest of the story is yours to tell.

Sartorian


We are a small but very ambitious and full of passion studio. We care deply about every detail but we do not have big budgests to serve us.


If you want

- A game that lets you explore
- That does not hold your hand and tell you where to go
- That has many monsters and locations (from the beautiful meadows of Velden, across the forests of Calden to the Iceland's and Sulfur fields in barons Verdons realm) 
- That you have to listen to the dialogues and beware of the environment to figure out a quest


Then. Welcome adventurer on the journey you will go with Eristan the presumed that heir to the throne. That has lost everything probably betrayed by his own family. 

Main heroes - no spoilers


Eristan - Main character, the oldest son of the emperor. Prepared by teachers and war masters to take over the throne from the day he was born. Everyone considers him the only hope of the empire to endure. But after his presumed death he is weak, and the world has fast forgotten about him. You have to guide him through this dark times.

Elurfion - Eristans brother. After Eristans death, he fast took over the northern part of the empire. After all he was next in line. But he is the opposite of Eristan. He always spent time on games and loving woman. He fast became a puppet ruler.

Ewain - Eristans cousin - He took over the southern part of the empire, which can show some Ill will on his side. A great Sartorian general, the army listens to him. Some say he just wanted to save the empire from a ruler like Elurfion - did not plan on taking over the throne.

Elrys - An orphan, brought up by the imperial army. Your dear friend. He is something between an uncle and a brother for you. Very experienced fighter, but he did not manage to save you.

Nistreth - The most trusted advisor of the emperor, your mentor and in fact the man who raised you as your father never came back from the war he rode out on when you were a little boy. He is behind the plan of your coronation and summoning you to Elion.

Grand Master Amon - the leader of the Velden Monastery, the only baron that held his ground against the imperial army (now paying tribute to the empire for peace), one of the 12 heroes that saved the world from the old gods many years back.

Wengo - the leader of the Drangheir hunters. An army of mercenaries created from the survivors of Barons Stalgard army and bounty hunters from Hejstos a province overrun by orcs. He dreams of announcing his independents from the empire, but for now he has to serve.

Elerin - A great battle mage that serves the empire. One of the 12 heroes that saved the world from the old gods many years back. It is said he has ambitions to become a god himself.

Elrim - The emperor himself. Not seen for 15 years.

Ergon - Your uncle. A peacemaker. Dedicated his live to help the common folk. Living in the woods, far from the noise of the court.

World


The action is taking place in Elion province. But it has few parts.

Elion - Around the capital city that is also called Elion

Velden - Terrains around the monastery.

Fronta - Forests and a village far to the southeast

Stalgardia - former realm of baron Stalgard. Beautiful place.

Calden - The place of fierce battles with the orcs that are trying to conquer Elion as they did with the rest of the north.

IceLands - A very cold uninhabited land with lots of secret to discover.

Dead Forest - Former realm of Baron Verdon. A dark lord, he gave a lot of trouble to the empire, and he was the spark that made the empire conquer the whole province.

data.name: Sniper Rust VR
data.detailed_description:
Crush Enemies with your Sniping Skills in the Immersive Sharpshooter: Sniper Rust VR!

Toughen Up! Become an Elite Sniper and Embark on a Dangerous Mission Against a Global Insurgency in this hair-raising, breathtaking Virtual Reality First-Person Sniping Experience where any shot could be your last!




The players have spoken! We’ve heard your feedback and updated Sniper Rust VR with some of the most popular requests.
Get back in the action with:

  • Cutting-Edge Weaponry - Stalk your prey with a plethora of lethal firearms, locked and loaded with special functions suited for specific occasions. Available weapons include real-world guns like the DSR-50 and SVD sniper rifle, as well as the MaC-7, which was inspired by the CheyTac M200, and the Scout Rifle-inspired DG-5000.

  • Death-Dealing Enemy Troops and Vehicular Combatants - Diverse enemy classes make every playable mission a challenge: be wary of well-concealed snipers, air/group assaults and traps behind enemy lines.

  • Immersive Virtual Reality Experience - With numerous uniquely designed environments to explore — including ports, forests, mountains, deserts and even ancient temples — you’ll feel like you’re truly part of Sniper Rust VR’s virtual world! Although with multiple, varied objectives to complete on your adventure, there’ll hardly be time to take in the sights.

  • A new bonus level – ready for a new challenge? New enemies lay in wait – and so does a new firearm for you to dispatch them with.

  • New cover mechanics – catch your breath and stay out of sight by ducking behind crates, barrels, and pallets. When the bullets stop, you go.

data.name: Are You Smarter Than a Troll?
data.detailed_description:
The Troll thinks you're too stupid to claim his treasure

He has invited you into his tower to prove it. Survive his monsters, overcome his challenges, and defeat him to claim his fortune. As far as he's concerned, you're just the entertainment.

Answer questions. Battle monsters

Choose the correct answer to attack; get it wrong, and the enemy strikes back. Test your knowledge with over 5,000 questions across 11 categories, including video games, TV and movies, science, history, music, and more.

Choose your hero and build your strategy

Play as the Warrior, Wizard, or Thief, each with unique skills and a different playstyle. Combine skills and artifacts to unleash powerful attacks, stack poison, or build your defenses. Eliminate wrong answers, manage your energy, and spend your gold wisely. A good build gives you options when your knowledge lets you down.

The enemies know how to complicate a quiz

Some burn away the answers while you're reading them. Others leave your fate to a final draw, with every correct answer improving your odds. And some hide the answers altogether. Learn their tricks and adapt your strategy. The Troll considers all of this perfectly fair.

Keep climbing

Take on Ascension challenges with each hero, face new rules, and put your builds to the test. Complete all three heroes' challenges to unlock the way to the Troll himself. Play solo or bring your audience into the adventure with Twitch integration!

Outsmart the Troll and claim his treasure!

data.name: Tarnish
data.detailed_description:
Harvested

The world has fallen to alien conquerors, leaving humanity struggling to survive amidst the chaos. Harvested is a gripping multiplayer survival experience set in a post-apocalyptic Earth, where every decision could mean life or death. Collect resources, build shelters, and fight for your survival against alien threats and rival survivors in a immersive world ravaged by war.

Tactical Game-play

Comparing Harvested to other competitive survival games, it aims to achieve tactical and strategic gunfights. You can prefer silenced weapons with extra light clothes, use night vision gadgets to turn dark as a benefit, prepare traps around the battle zone, build your gadgets and weapons at the fight zone before storm rise and more..

Signal System

Signal system adds an extra layer of depth to tactical gameplay. Signals will work as the main aspect of the game and will be used for communication, navigation, locating air drops and events, jamming devices, prevent offline raids and use both defensive and offensive.

Dynamic Survival

Manage hunger, stamina and temperature. Use specific items to heal specific injuries. Build unique bases with using environmental features, and store tons of loot.

Inventory & Loot

There is no better mechanic than looting a fellow player's all hard work and tears. We love loot, so designed a grid based inventory that you can organize your items in a strategic way and simply provide a more realistic feeling when you carry your equipment.

Multiplayer Mayhem

Call your buddy, because Harvested is a hell.

Quest Line

All maps will be designed carefully and with full of details. Hang around, or follow the NPC quest line. It features boss fights, puzzles and lots of rare loots.

Will you thrive in the alien's shadow or succumb to the Harvest?

Wish-list Now and Prepare for the Ultimate Fight to Survive!

data.name: Rescue Party: Live!
data.detailed_description:
Team up with your pals to rescue people from disasters in this terrific adventure. Cooperate with your squad to set things right!

Rescue Party: Live! is a cooperative game where players must work as a team within scope to save as many lives as possible while facing catastrophic events—earthquakes, fires, floods, avalanches, and biological hazards. You will need to coordinate with your 4-person rescue team to resolve ongoing emergencies.


Choose and take control of your character to rescue victims!

Work along with your friends in a fun race against time—everyone's contribution is essential for the success of the mission!

Your goal is to save those in danger. Analyze the environment, gather information, plan your moves, and spring into action!

Have fun with your friends and learn the importance of teamwork in rescue missions. Help your teammates by removing obstacles, combining resources, and solving puzzles to heal the wounded and bring them to safety. But be careful how you move! One wrong move and you might get in the way of your teammates!



9 characters to choose from

• Fireman
• Student
• Guide dog
• Doctor
• Reporter
• Volunteer
• Lifeguard
• Team leader
• Reserves team member

6 different environments to explore

• City
• Forest
• Seaside
• Factory
• Tunnel
• Snowy mountain

Game modes

• Single player
• Multiplayer (local and online)

data.name: The Legend Of Piss Boy 2
data.detailed_description:
A retro action platformer that takes place after the events of Season 1 of "The Legend Of Piss Boy" animated series! Play as Piss Boy or King Krow and make your way through dangerous levels and boss fights! This game IS season 2 of the cartoon! Beat the game as both characters to know everything that happens leading up to season 3!

Disable Steam Controller Input if you want to use the gamepad


Unlike some of the newer games out there, this game embraces the simple controls of the days of old! Both Piss Boy and King Krow can be controlled with a keyboard or gamepad (Playstation or Xbox Controller)! Your choice!

Keyboard Controls:

In Menu:
  • W - Move Selection Up
  • A - Move Selection Left
  • S - Move Selection Down
  • D - Move Selection Right
  • Space - Select Option

Gameplay:
  • W - Jump
  • A - Move Left
  • D - Move Right
  • Space - Attack/Shoot
  • F - Special ability (Piss beam with 3 G&Ts or an Atomic CAW with 3 Eggs!)

Gamepad Controls:

In Menu:
  • D-Pad Up - Move Selection Up
  • D-Pad Left - Move Selection Left
  • D-Pad Down - Move Selection Down
  • D-Pad Right - Move Selection Right
  • X or A - Select Option

Gameplay:
  • X or A - Jump
  • D-Pad Left - Move Left
  • D-Pad Right - Move Right
  • Square - Attack/Shoot
  • Circle or B - Special ability (Piss beam with 3 G&Ts or Atomic CAW with 3 Eggs!)

Will you be able to find the Time Wizard . . . in time?

- Collect flowers throughout the game
- Unlock puzzles in the Pantheon Treasury
- Gorgeous wallpapers and concept art
- Bonus soundtracks and screensavers
- Integrated Strategy Guide

data.name: You Are Not Alice
data.detailed_description:
YOU ARE NOT ALICE is a social engineering sandbox game where you play the role of a hacker who has taken over Alice's work computer. 

Your goal is to spread through her company by talking to her coworkers and convincing them to run a virus file you can send them.

Learn about Alice, her coworkers, and her company as you explore this open-world conversational sandbox that changes every time you play.

As you infect each employee's computer, you'll be able to...

  • Browse their computer files to learn about them, their job, and their relationships with other employees. Sometimes you'll find a personal file or two, too.

  • Masquerade as others by using their chat login to talk to their coworkers. Take advantage of their trust by convincing their coworkers to run your virus file.

  • Take over other computers as you spread throughout the network: every employee has a new story and new connections to infect.

Choose your own adventure: will you help each employee, or pretend to be them while making things much worse?

What is this company hiding?

data.name: Mega Man Legacy Collection
data.detailed_description:
Mega Man Legacy Collection is a celebration of the 8-bit history of Capcom’s iconic Blue Bomber. Featuring faithful reproductions of the series’ origins with the original six Mega Man games, the Legacy Collection will remind long-time fans and introduce newcomers to what made Mega Man such a popular and iconic character. Mega Man Legacy Collection will feature all six games and more!

In addition to the six Mega Man games, Mega Man Legacy Collection features new ways to experience the classic games with the Museum Mode and new Challenge Mode. Challenge Mode remixes gameplay segments from all six games, with plenty of scaling difficulty objectives for experienced players to conquer yet serving as a good starting point for new players, too. Museum Mode contains a comprehensive collection of history, high-res art and original concept pieces – a mega treat for any fan of Mega Man and video game history.

FEATURES


  • Six classic games in one – Play a piece of video game history with the original six Mega Man games and experience the origins of the classic series.
  • 8-bit style with HD flair – The games retain their retro 8-bit style with an added HD finish, giving a crisp, clean look to the charming, classic sprites.
  • Challenge remix mode for new and veteran players – The robust new Challenge Mode remixes gameplay from all six games for a new type of challenge. It provides both increasingly difficult trials for experienced players and also teaches newcomers to become familiar with the style of the games and tackle some of the trickier areas.
  • Museum of the era – The Museum Mode features a massive repository of history and art collected from the era of the games in this collection. Take a look back at the history of Mega Man with loads of information, high-res art, concept pieces, sketches and more in the Museum.
  • Developed with an all-new engine – Using the newly developed Eclipse Engine, Capcom and Digital Eclipse are able to archive these six pieces of video game history with faithful reproductions of the originals for a new generation of gamers.
  • Leaderboards and video replays – Fans will be able to watch video replays of the top players on the leaderboards, showcasing a whole new generation of Mega Man talent!

data.name: Aeternum Grand Plaza
data.detailed_description:
Discover the fascinating Aeternum Grand Plaza hotel, where you must pay attention to your surroundings and choose the right path to find the exit.



Aeternum Grand Plaza is an anomaly-seeking game set in a hotel with different scenarios and inspired by "The Exit 8". In this game, the player must progress through the various floors of the hotel, trying to reach the exit while observing the details of the hallways they walk through, looking for strange elements that might indicate it’s not the correct hallway.
The procedure is simple: if the hallway contains no anomalies, the player must continue forward to advance through the floors. But if the hallway contains strange elements, you must turn back and keep ascending floors to try to reach the exit.

FEATURES

  • Enigmatic Adventure: Explore the different hallways of this mysterious hotel and find the exit.

  • Visual Challenges: Observe and analyze every detail to identify more than 50 anomalies.

  • Procedural Environments: Each floor of the hotel is procedurally generated, offering a great variety of possibilities.

  • Multiple Game Modes: In addition to Classic Mode, enjoy three other more complex modes that will test your skills to escape the hotel.

  • Developed by a Small Team: A personal project developed with dedication by two people.

PLAY TIME

40-100 minutEs

data.name: Freddy Frog 2
data.detailed_description:
Freddy Returns For Another Adventure

Freddy Frog is back and ready to climb higher than ever before.

Armed with incredible jumping skills and an appetite for insects, Freddy must navigate dangerous platforms, collect valuable rewards, and avoid hostile creatures on his journey upward.

The higher you climb, the greater the challenge becomes.

How far can you go?

Every Climb Is Different

No two adventures are ever the same.

Procedurally generated levels create fresh platform layouts, new opportunities, and unexpected dangers every time you play.

Adapt to constantly changing environments and discover new routes as you push for a new personal best.

Collect Flies And Black Ants

Flies and black ants can be collected throughout every run.

Gather as many as possible to increase your score and maximise your rewards.

Some collectibles are easy to reach, while others require risky jumps and careful timing.

Will you play it safe or risk everything for a bigger score?

Search For Extra Lives

Keep your adventure going by collecting valuable extra lives.

Finding additional chances can make the difference between setting a new record and seeing your run come to an early end.

Every life counts when you're aiming for the top.

Avoid Red Ants And Wasps

Not every insect is friendly.

Dangerous red ants patrol platforms while aggressive wasps threaten you from above.

Stay alert, react quickly, and avoid their attacks as you continue your climb.

One mistake could cost you a life.

Chase The Ultimate High Score

Freddy Frog 2 is easy to learn but challenging to master.

Compete against yourself, challenge friends, and climb the Steam leaderboards as you pursue the highest score possible.

Every run offers another opportunity to improve your strategy and beat your previous best.

Classic Arcade Action

Inspired by classic arcade platformers, Freddy Frog 2 combines simple controls, fast-paced gameplay, and endless replayability.

Whether you're looking for a quick game or a long high-score session, there's always a reason to come back for one more climb.

Features

  • Endless arcade climbing gameplay

  • Procedurally generated levels

  • Collect flies and black ants

  • Search for valuable extra lives

  • Avoid dangerous red ants and aggressive wasps

  • Fast-paced platforming action

  • Steam leaderboards

  • Steam achievements

  • Family-friendly gameplay

  • Easy to learn, difficult to master

  • Endless replayability

How High Can You Climb?

Freddy is ready for his next challenge.

Jump between platforms, collect every insect you can find, avoid dangerous enemies, gather extra lives, and climb higher than ever before.

Your next record-breaking run is waiting.

Every night, something is off. The same path as yesterday now hides "anomalies."

Deliver the sushi carefully. No matter what happens—_do not_ drop it.

A short horror game about delivering sushi.

  • Randomly changing anomalies each night

  • Includes jump scares

  • Playtime: Around 30 minutes (longer to find all events)

  • This game contains unreasonably difficult action elements.

Gameplay Tips

  • Click and hold the left mouse button to grab the sushi.

  • Dropping it on the ground results in a game over.

  • If the sushi touches an "anomaly" (paranormal event), it will fall.

Streaming Policy

No restrictions. Monetized streams are allowed.

data.name: Miner to Die
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Ready to Go Down The Mine?

Then start breaking rocks right away, then break more rocks, and then break even more rocks!

Of course, you won't just be breaking rocks. You'll access different minerals, make different products for more money, loot treasures, and keep earning money to regenerate your constantly decreasing health.

Features

  • Satisfying breaking animations and sound effects.

  • A procedural mine formation that will truly make you feel like you're in a mine.

  • Character development mechanics such as digging speed, damage increase, and health increase.

  • Events with both positive and negative impacts in every new mine.

  • Randomly triggered in-game events.

  • Grid-based, easy-to-control character movement system.

  • Fast-paced, motivational background music.

  • Leaderboards so you can compete with your friends and other players.

data.name: Burgle Supply Company
data.detailed_description:
Friends who burgle together, stay together! ...At least the living ones do...

Gather your gang. Loot some houses. Easy, right?

Welcome to Burgle Supply Co., where we help thieves help themselves! Dive into this friendslop horror comedy game for up to six burglar buddies. Pull of grand heists in the strangest town in the world, filled with odd locations, bizarre mutations of science…and the neighborhood’s… friendliest… dog?

Complete mandatory goals, tackle optional objectives if the squad is feeling ambitious, then make out like the bandits that you literally are.




Acquire piles of epic loot without making noise, or risk summoning mutated pets that defend the town. Every dropped lamp and bumped corner will fill up the noise meter, and lead the squad one step closer to chew toy territory. That’s you. You’re the chew toy.

While you’re heisting the fanciest houses, stores, museums, and over-sized bathrooms in town, evade unsettling monsters like explosive-egg-laying slugs, dimensional vacuum mice, hungry geese, giant spider hamsters, and of course, a very good boy.

We can’t guarantee there will be any survivors at the end of the heist.

Make it back to home base with your ill gotten gains, split the cash, and upgrade your burglar hideout. Purchase van enhancements, cool posters, basement themes, and even new drip so you can roll into the next heist in style. There are hundreds of masks, skin, and clothing options to collect!

Earn reputation points by completing successful heists, and climb the ranks at Burgle Supply Co. Reach rank 10 to covet the top Burgle Trophy, and burglar bragging rights, of course.

data.name: Carthage: Bellum Punicum
data.detailed_description:
Prepare for an immersive wargame experience where every decision and every battle matters. Carthage: Bellum Punicum plunges you into the 3rd century BCE, and into the brutal, world-shaping conflict of the Second Punic War. In this authentic, deep historical strategy game, you command one of the major powers fighting for supremacy.

Will you lead the Carthaginian forces under the legendary Hannibal Barca to crush Rome, defend the Republic alongside heroes like Scipio Africanus, or seize the opportunity as an ambitious third party, waiting for a chance to carve out your own Mediterranean empire?

Inspired by the renowned YouTube channel HistoryMarche, Carthage: Bellum Punicum is crafted with a meticulous focus on historical authenticity and challenging strategic combat. It's time to rewrite the fate of the ancient world.

UNPRECEDENTED HISTORICAL SIMULATION

Carthage: Bellum Punicum is built for true wargame enthusiasts, combining the scale of grand conflict with granular tactical detail:

  • Individual Unit Rendering: Witness the chaos of ancient warfare come alive. Every single soldier, from the hardened Carthaginian veteran to the green Roman recruit, is individually rendered on the battlefield, creating a realistic, dense, and visceral combat simulation.

  • Unique Visual Style: All military units are rendered in a distinctive square formation style, giving the game a unique and visually recognizable presentation.

GRAND CAMPAIGN: A (ANCIENT) WORLD AT WAR

Embark on one of the greatest military sagas in history, blending grand strategy with tactical depth in real time:

  • Dynamic Map & Borders: Experience a real-time campaign where borders are fluid and dynamic, constantly shifting based on conflict and influence. This unique feature allows you to pursue both historical paths and compelling alternative history scenarios across the vast Mediterranean war theater.

  • Strategic & Tactical Blend: Whether commanding Carthage, Rome, or an opportunistic third nation, the campaign features dynamic events where your leadership choices shape the morale, political landscape, and supply health of your army. Successfully managing vulnerable supply lines through treacherous mountains and hostile lands is crucial.

REALISTIC BATTLEFIELD DYNAMICS

Master the challenges of command in the fog of war and the heat of battle through unique & realistic simulation mechanics:

  • Command & Resource Logistics: Issue orders that take time to arrive through messengers. This unique command delay mechanic forces careful pre-planning. Similarly, resources, such as supplies and diplomatic messages, are realistically delayed, as they travel by caravans or ships on the campaign map.

  • Comprehensive Realism Factors: The outcome of every clash is determined by dozens of realistic factors, including morale, stamina, organization, experience, weapon proficiencies, terrain, and weather. Unit stats are dynamically impacted by flanking maneuvers, proximity to commanders, and relative troop numbers.

ICONIC HISTORICAL BATTLES

Relive the legendary, pivotal clashes of the Punic Wars with unparalleled historical precision and detail:

  • Meticulous Battlemaps: Engage in blood-soaked conflicts like Hannibal's magnum opus at Cannae, the ambush at Lake Trasimene, the brutal surprise attack at the Trebia River, or the decisive Battle of Zama. Carthage: Bellum Punicum's battlemaps are crafted and verified using detailed historical sources, ensuring you fight on the exact same ground where history was made.

  • Authentic Ancient Warfare: Command historically accurate unit types, from the disciplined Roman acies triplex formations and heavy legionary infantry to the dreaded Carthaginian elephants, and Iberian mercenary light troops.

CHALLENGING & ADAPTIVE AI

Face an opponent worthy of a strategic genius, designed for a demanding real-time tactics experience:

  • Competent Opposition: The enemy AI is a formidable opponent that actively flanks, employs realistic historical maneuvers, retreats when necessary, and dynamically adapts its strategy based on your moves.

  • Faction-Specific Tactics: The enemy also reflects the unique military doctrines of different historical factions. Clash with the unwavering resilience of the Roman Legions, or face the relentless harassment tactics of the Iberian tribes, ensuring every engagement is demanding and unique.

ATMOSPHERE & IMMERSION

Immerse yourself fully in the world of the Punic Wars through stunning presentation:

  • Original Soundtrack: The game features an original, evocative soundtrack. Battle music dynamically shifts based on the cultural army you are commanding, while the campaign soundtrack changes based on your geographical position on the map, enhancing regional immersion.

  • Beautiful 2D/3D Graphics: Enjoy a simplistic and captivating visual style combining detailed 2D and 3D artwork that brings both the grand campaign map and the intense tactical battles to vivid life.

data.name: Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game
data.detailed_description:
Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game is a turn-based strategy roguelike Minesweeper-style game set on a snowy night.

The game is played on a small grid-based board, where every tile is drawn from the deck you build.

Before each level, you choose and construct a deck that determines what may appear on the board — rewards, tools, and unexpected events. As you explore, you must use hints to infer where enemies might be hiding, decide which tiles to reveal, how much risk to take, and whether it’s time to ring the bell and leave safely.

Resources gained during exploration can be spent to acquire new board elements and upgrades, allowing you to shape a strategy that fits your playstyle.

There is no single correct path. Play cautiously or take bold risks — and enjoy this quiet Christmas adventure.

Inspirations: Mr. Magpie’s Harmless Card Game

data.name: Lacuna: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
Lacuna: Prologue tasks you – CDI agent Neil Conrad – with investigating the murder of a high-profile victim whose death could plunge the solar system into war. Solve the first in a series of connected cases that lead you deeper and deeper into the conspiracy at the core of this captivating 2D sci-fi noir adventure.

Another cigarette tumbles into the abyss. The sun is slowly coming up, glistening in the sea of buildings below.

I look up at the stars one last time before they disappear. They don't provide any guidance. They don't give a f*ck.

I have to make this decision on my own, and very soon. Problem is, I don't know how. I've never been able to figure out why I do what I do. Not really.

No more time to think. I have to go.

Here's the deal

You are Neil Conrad, CDI agent. Awoken by the news of a murder, you rush into a case that will soon turn your life and the whole solar system upside down. Ask questions, collect evidence, and put the pieces together until the ugly truth reveals itself... or not.

No takebacks

The story branches and ends based on your actions. There's no going back. Sure, you can rush your way to the end – if you don't mind paying the price. Play your cards right, and you might make it out alive.

How far will you go?

Some questions don't have a right answer. Will you sell out a friend to protect your family? Will you endanger a loved one in exchange for public safety? Will you keep the peace or reveal the horrible, world-shattering truth?

Hungry for Point & Click Adventure?

While the classics were great in their time, Lacuna does away with the baggage of many adventure game tropes:

  • Pointing & clicking Platformer movement controls (WASD / controller)

  • Selecting all dialog options one by one anyway Non-repeating conversations and choices

  • Inventory management and counter-intuitive puzzles Immersive, story-driven mysteries

  • Pixel hunting Optional outlines on anything interactable

  • Story grinds to a halt at every puzzle can always be driven forward

  • "x will remember this" Real choices and multiple endings

data.name: Ariel
data.detailed_description:
Ariel is a First/Third person survival experience, story based, Sci-Fi adventure.

Be ready to experience a unique survival adventure as Ferdinand Ludec, a mathematician who is suddenly kidnapped and forced into a drama. Professor Ludec arrives in Ariel, one of Uranus' moons, only to find an entire crew of scientists dead. He is an expert in Electro Mono-Pole theory, and somehow, this knowledge puts him in an extreme situation which will test his inner endurance. Ariel is the name of a black budget project funded by a mysterious group of men. The space station is desolated; all the crew members from the first and second expeditions are dead; you find yourself alone.

With a partially procedural generated world, along with different endings to the story, Ariel takes into account the re-playability as one of its assets. Hunger, getting tired and avoiding insanity will only be some of the threats to face.

Ariel - There is no way out -

FEATURES



Survival Mechanics
  • Dozens of items, enemies to hunt down and survival skills will be needed to succeed and escape the isolated moon.
  • Different types of weapons and upgrades.
  • Internal Stats are displayed in the player's interface, so you can always be aware of your hunger, dehydration, mood etc.
  • Pressurized station systems, Food and liquid Processors; Manage your resources.

Open World
  • A full open world with mysteries to explore, get lost in Ariel.
  • Weathers Events; Ariel's climate is always changing.
  • Environment that reacts according to your decisions.

Space Terror
  • Different levels of difficulty are considered for the experienced players.
  • Both First and Third Person modes.

  • The sound design has been carefully created in accordance to the project's atmosphere and story line.
  • The composer wanted to pour down mixed feelings; A Sci-fi OST which was unique, not limiting itself to the standards.
  • Many experimental, as well as classical sounds merge to find the right atmosphere.

Ariel is being developed by a small team.

- The lead programmer has worked on various projects in the past, such as Kerbal Space Program.
- The second developer is a musician who has experience on Playstation releases. He worked on the 3D models, sound effects, music and story line. He is the producer of the game as well.

Many skilled people have helped us along the way. Ariel is the result of much dedication and commitment. We are very happy with the results, and we can't wait for you to experience the game.

With a tiny budged and a lot of passion, Ariel stands as an indie videogame that we want everybody to play; we think the price range will allow this, encouraging players into Ariel's experience.

data.name: Undertone
data.detailed_description:
raise the curtain

  Everyone harbors a hidden agenda, as feigned romance, marriage-for-power deals, and generations of family hatred intertwine. In this immersive cinematic interactive experience, every pivotal choice is yours to make — shaping character favor and faction rivalries, unlocking multiple independent story branches, and unearthing the conspiracies and blood debts concealed beneath the gilded façade of a powerful dynasty. Every path leads to a radically different ending of revenge.


About the Game

Curtain Rises

  Everyone harbors their own secrets—feigned romance, marriage alliances, and family feuds intertwine. You will make every crucial decision in an immersive interactive cinema format. Your choices will shift character affinity and factional rivalries, unlock multiple independent story branches, and reveal the conspiracies and blood-deep grudges hidden beneath the glamorous veneer of a wealthy dynasty—guiding you toward vastly different paths of vengeance and their endings.

Description:

  Set against the backdrop of urban high-society dynasties, this interactive cinematic game is a saga of choices and strategic maneuvering, buried deep within the feuds of a wealthy clan—and with it, the curtain rises on a battle of wits and intrigue.

Ji Xiaoxue — maid of the Gu family.

Xia Wanqing — heiress of the Xia family, and Gu Chengyan's fiancée.

Gu Chengyan — eldest son of the Gu family, left paralyzed by a sudden misfortune.

Gu Chengjing — second son of the Gu family, a spoiled, idle rich kid.

  By chance, Ji Xiaoxue crossed paths with the Gu family's second young master and, through that encounter, entered the Gu mansion to work as a maid—tasked with caring for the Gu family's eldest son, left bedridden by a sudden misfortune. Within the deep halls, all seems calm on the surface, yet undercurrents have long been stirring.

  The eldest son of the Gu family is already bound by an engagement, his fiancée hailing from a prestigious family. Between the two young masters and the two women, a web of emotional entanglements quietly unfolds, with the clash of dynastic rivalries poised to ignite at any moment. And behind it all lies far more than meets the eye—secrets waiting for you to uncover firsthand through the game.

Core Gameplay:

  Multi-Branch Storylines — Hundreds of branching paths, several major ending routes, and hidden easter-egg plots waiting to be discovered. Every choice you make steers the direction of the story, leading you to a storyline that is uniquely your own.

A Message from the Production Team:

  Thank you for opening The Undertone—a story of revenge, strategic maneuvering, and the choices that define our humanity. Beneath the glamour of high-society dynasties lie desire, betrayal, and blood-deep grudges. We hope this is not merely an interactive cinematic work that delivers satisfying revenge, but one in which every choice carries real weight. Here, there is no such thing as a perfectly happy ending; each decision you make tugs at the fates of the characters, guiding you toward a story's conclusion that is uniquely yours.

  From refining the script and shooting the footage to debugging the branching logic, our team has poured tremendous effort into this project, striving to deliver an immersive ensemble narrative experience. Every choice you make is the true stroke of the pen that writes this story.

We look forward to your experience and feedback. We will continue to polish and optimize, and in the future bring you more high-quality interactive narrative works.

Follow Us:

  Be sure to follow us to stay updated on the latest progress of The Undertone. In the future, we will also be releasing more games with additional gameplay features.

  Official QQ Group Number：684348587、977495562

data.name: Rated Mutant
data.detailed_description:
Tori’s life is turned upside when her father is kidnapped. Rappelling deeper into what she once believed was an abandoned laboratory she begins to find herself fighting against hordes of monstrous creatures, fighting not only for her own life but her father’s as well. Discover the secrets of the lab and uncover the truth beyond the mysterious “V”.

Features



  • Side-Scrolling Platformer Action - Rated Mutant is a high energy action-platformer, navigate around environmental hazards, run, dash and dodge enemy attacks. Return fire with a barrage of short and long range weapons. Hot swap your weapons and switch your techniques to gain an advantage over your foes, as enemies will adjust and adapt.

  • Uncover Secrets - Travel down the road less traveled and reveal secret passageways and mutants, always something new to find.

  • Epic Boss Battles - Experience battles as unorthodox as the creatures themselves, with tough but satisfying combat.

  • Rogues Gallery - Discover over 30 unique monsters, defeat them to unlock new information and lore.

  • Master Weapons - Unlock new weapons, and new ways to use them as you continue your descent.

  • Custom Soundtrack - Rated Mutant features a modern soundtrack, designed to fit its action packed game play and chilling atmosphere.

data.name: Global Fortune
data.detailed_description:
Global Fortune is a business management game on a global scale.


It is a data-rich game played on a hex-based globe meant to give a taste of a modern and truly global market.

  • Manage a business as its CEO, making sure not only to see the company survives but also that you become wealthy as well.
  • Expand your reach across the globe, both to get access to new customers but also to take advantage of the different regional advantages, transporting your goods by land or sea.
  • Produce resources and products, from simple items like fruit to complex items like cars which require production chains and skilled workers to produce.
  • Research not only how to make other products, but how to improve them beyond their most basic into something much more valuable.
  • Design your product lines with custom properties such as the level of luxury or the level of complexity, making them harder to produce but worth much more to potential customers.
  • Specialize offices for each region to focus on research, finding new customers, or cutting operating expense.

Global Fortune is still in Early Access.


That means for the foreseeable future it will continue to be under development. We will continue updating it, adding new features, and balancing things as best we can. We have no plans to lock any features behind additional pay DLC. We also want to hear from you as early and as much as possible, we are a small team and hearing feedback is what makes it possible to keep improving in a way everyone can enjoy.

data.name: Eco-friendly Car VR Maintenance Training
data.detailed_description:
It is a self-directed experiential virtual reality technology education and training platform for future eco-friendly vehicle education and training based on HMD (Head-Mounted Display).

Immersive VR training ensures high voltage isolation and safety against various risks. Cost savings can be achieved by maintaining a low-cost training center.

Educate and train on understanding and problem solving of complex and diverse automotive structures, and train experienced professionals.

Start the game and on the main screen, you can click on the subject for car maintenance with your right-handed controller.

Moving to the learning scene allows the player to move to the left-hand controller as a first-person point of view, and to hold and control car parts with the right-hand controller.

After the instruction of the study precautions, select the tools and put them in the toolbox to start maintaining the car according to the narration. The related objects will be glowing in fluorescent colors to allow you to act like 'holding the handle of the car door open, etc.'

After completing the correct step-by-step action, the parts associated with the next step will glow in fluorescent colors, allowing you to continue learning with narration.

data.name: Dungeon Wizards
data.detailed_description:
You are a wizard!

Explore the dungeon, collect mystical relics, learn powerful spells and defeat as many enemies as possible! Choose a class and embark on your adventure!

Gameplay

Dungeon Wizards is a match3- rogue-lite- role-playing game. By combining attack tiles with enemy or boss tiles, you defeat your foes and gain experience points to level up your wizard. Spend your attributes with caution to survive as long as possible.
Collect rune tiles to learn powerful spells and use these spells to weaken your opponents, to strengthen yourself or to manipulate the playingfield. Matching coin tiles unlock relics that give you passive bonuses. For example, earn additional experience points every round or an attribute bonus after using a spell.

Features:

  • Playable tutorial for an easy introduction
  • 3 levels of difficulty
  • 8 classes with different playing styles
  • 21 bosses with unique skills
  • 45 relics with different characteristics
  • 30 spells in the categories fire, water and earth

data.name: Panic! at the Jigsaw
data.detailed_description:
“Panic! At the Jigsaw” is a cozy organizing simulator where you fit jigsaw puzzle pieces scattered across the floor to restore a painting. The countless puzzle pieces gradually transform into that famous painting that everyone has seen at least once.

Classic Jigsaw Puzzles

Complete six different jigsaw puzzles, ranging from easy 108-piece puzzles to challenging 1000-piece ones.

Use the shape, color, and pattern of each piece to identify its correct position and fit it into place. There are 2,708 pieces in total.

Perhaps starting with the edge pieces is the best strategy?

Useful Skills

Fit puzzle pieces to earn points and unlock skills!

Highlight edge pieces, or pull pieces belonging to the same painting as the one you are holding closer to your hand. (and more...)

The skill to snap pieces instantly into their correct places is powerful!

You will find strategic joy in combining steady, methodical progress with these powerful skills.

Famous Paintings

Mona Lisa, Girl with a Pearl Earring, Munch’s The Scream... etc.

Enjoy the satisfying process of watching these world-renowned masterpieces gradually come together.

Gameplay Features

You will feel a deep sense of accomplishment as you pick up countless pieces cluttering the floor one by one, place them into the frame, and watch the chaotic pile shrink.
There are no time limits or game-over screens. Just sit back, relax, and lose yourself in the quiet joy of assembling puzzles.

data.name: Cards: Tidy Up!
data.detailed_description:
One room. A spectacular mess. Every card has its place.

Welcome to Cards: Tidy Up!, a relaxing first-person sorting game about bringing order to a room overflowing with playing cards.

Search through scattered piles, discover different deck designs, and match each card to its place on the wall. Start with a few cards in your hand and work toward a room full of completed collections.

Find the card. Find its place.

Pick up cards, flip them over, and identify their theme, suit, and rank. Fill the gaps in each collection and enjoy the little satisfaction of getting another card exactly right.

From fantasy illustrations to futuristic designs, familiar playing cards take on different personalities. The more you sort, the better you’ll know your decks.

Make room for your own method

Use portable trays to group cards, carry batches across the room, and keep promising finds close at hand. Gather one theme at a time, work through a pile, or concentrate on finishing that almost-complete suit.

Your trays and equipment can move with you, so you can arrange your workspace around the way you like to sort.

Turn a little progress into a helpful upgrade

Earn money as you sort correctly and collect bonuses for reaching milestones and completing groups of cards.

Choose what to unlock next: a bigger hand, quicker handling, abilities that reveal missing cards, or machines that lend a helping hand. Keep enjoying the rhythm of manual sorting, or experiment with tools that make each trip more productive.

Give your cards a helping hand—or a little throw

Collect nearby cards with a vacuum, separate themes with a sorter, and feed trays into a machine that fills the wall for you.

Unlock new ways to move cards around the room, including throwing them into place and sending them between paired trays. Try different arrangements and discover a satisfying little sorting system of your own.

Enjoy finishing what you started

Watch the piles shrink, the table clear, and completed decks gather in boxes. Every finished collection brings the room closer to tidy.

Settle into a warmly lit room for a compact single-player experience. Take your time, save your progress, and return whenever you feel like sorting a few more cards.

data.name: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Case of the Tin Soldier
data.detailed_description:
Inspector Smythe from Scotland Yard has informed Watson and me of the murder of General Armstead, a Tontine ticket holder. Of course, I was aware of the Tontine – a lottery that was set up to aid the veterans of the Battle of Waterloo. Something about this case intrigues me. Perhaps it ís that there are only five surviving ticket holders here in London? Perhaps it ís that the General was about to publish a scintillating addendum to his infamous book on treasure.

Zojoi teamed up with famed board game company Sleuth Times to reproduce the award-winning Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective video mysteries for Windows and Mac. This original titles was considered the pioneer products for emerging optical technologies and took advantage of the medium with full-motion video (FMV), intriguing storylines and fun game play. The restored retro game feature recaptured video, high-resolution graphics and strong storytelling and design.

Direct the famous Baker Street detectives through the fog-filled streets of London, and solve mysteries in a faithful adaptation of the board game that features:

  • 30 minutes or more of original video footage
  • Sherlock Holmes, his case companion, Dr. Watson, and over 20 additional characters (both trustworthy and unscrupulous!)
  • Full English subtitle support
  • Search the London Times for clues, peruse Holmes’ personal files, scour through the London Directory and receive hints from Watson himself
  • Present your findings to the Queen’s magistrate – and learn how you did against the master detective

data.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
data.detailed_description:
· The Adventure Never Stops

Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure is a desktop idle RPG built around three-member teams, collecting, progression, and automatic combat.

Let your Dreamspirits keep adventuring in a corner of your desktop. Focus on work, browse the web, or watch a video, then return to make the decisions that matter: adjust your lineup, equip new gear, unlock talents, and send the journey onward.

The demo launches on October 6—your progress will carry over to the full game.

· Three Dreamspirits, Countless Combinations

Choose three members from 451 collectible Dreamspirits and build a team of your own.

Roles, races, elements, skills, innate affixes, and synergies all interact. Protect your main damage dealer, combine skill effects, or build an entire lineup around a favorite Dreamspirit—every adjustment can take your team farther.

· Step Away. The Battle Continues.

Your team automatically fights enemies, uses skills, and advances through stages. Even while you are away, it continues earning offline rewards.

There is no need to click endlessly. Decide how to develop your members, allocate resources, and refine your setup. Leave the fighting to your Dreamspirits and keep your time for yourself.

· A Collection Begins with a Dream Egg

Find Dream Eggs, hatch new companions, and discover Dreamspirits of different rarities—including rare Shiny variants.

Use fusion and evolution to raise the members you love, expand your Codex, and find the missing piece for your next team.

· Grow Through Equipment, Crafting, and Talents

Defeated enemies drop equipment, materials, and loot chests. Enhance equipment, socket bonuses, craft resources in the workshop, and plan your path through 132 talent nodes covering combat, collection, economy, and idle progression.

Every reward and every choice changes where your team goes next.

· Journey Deeper into the Dream

Challenge 5 map floors, 4 difficulty levels, and 200 stage combinations. Hunt for better equipment, hatch rarer Dreamspirits, and keep perfecting your three-member team.

Build your team. Adventure automatically. Keep dreaming.

data.name: In Search Of You
data.detailed_description:
Unique Game Features


- Fully integrated first-person perspective, immersive real-life interaction——
The game is shot entirely in first-person perspective, allowing players to fully immerse themselves in the role of Tian Long( Main Character ), interact closely with the different beauties, and experience the emotional pulls of nightclub life in an immersive way.

- The first nightclub-themed romance simulation game——
The game’s theme revolves around nightclubs, a popular aspect of contemporary society, showcasing the art of flirting within nightclub culture.

- Real-life improvisation, fully on-location filming——
Characters in the game abandon traditional rigid scripts, letting natural dialogue development guide the narrative. This makes the interactions more realistic and provides a more immersive experience for the players. It also brings the actors closer to their roles, allowing players to understand the inner world of the actors as they play.

- Multiple heroines to pursue, multi-branching storylines——
In real life, choices are often singular, but in the game, players can correct past mistakes, encouraging them to embrace love boldly and passionately. The game offers multiple beauties storylines to pursue, with personalities ranging from pure and playful to elegant, fiery, and sexy. There's always one that will catch your eye. This time, be a "nightclub master" and capture all the goddesses in your grasp!

Which beauty will you be mesmerised by?


ViVi - The adorable, sweet looking beauty?


Mia - A beauty with a love for children?


Lily - Does the dream of a beauty aspiring to be a singer appeal to you?


Eva - Would you mind a beauty who has experienced troubled past relationships?


Ella - A beauty with a masculine heart but occasionally shows her feminine side?


Monica - Or a beauty who occasionally flashes a beautiful smile?

This makes the interactions more realistic and provides a more immersive experience for the players. It also brings the actors closer to their roles, allowing players to understand the inner world of the actors as they play.

- Multiple heroines to pursue, multi-branching storylines——
In real life, choices are often singular, but in the game, players can correct past mistakes, encouraging them to embrace love boldly and passionately. The game offers multiple beauties storylines to pursue, with personalities ranging from pure and playful to elegant, fiery, and sexy. There's always one that will catch your eye. This time, be a "nightclub master" and capture all the goddesses in your grasp!

Which beauty will you be mesmerised by?


ViVi - The adorable, sweet looking beauty?


Mia - A beauty with a love for children?


Lily - Does the dream of a beauty aspiring to be a singer appeal to you?


Eva - Would you mind a beauty who has experienced troubled past relationships?


Ella - A beauty with a masculine heart but occasionally shows her feminine side?


Monica - Or a beauty who occasionally flashes a beautiful smile?

data.name: Covid Carl
data.detailed_description:
Update Notes

Now version 1.2! A lot of content has been added since initial release. Post Processing Effects, more enemies, hidden rooms, player skins, and reskins of some levels have been completed. More content and localization will come in the future!


About the Game

Covid Carl is a Metroidvania/Contra-style 2d side-scrolling shooter. It will feature a brief story, 10 levels, and boss fights.


The story follows the player as they attempt to stop a super soldier from a government project to vaccinate everyone. In typical fashion the government project goes awry and he starts mutating people instead. That's where you come in to shoot or burn almost everything that moves. Shoot stuff, burn stuff, blow stuff up, and have fun doing it. That's the game in a nutshell. Not really much to sugarcoat. There's no planned DLC. There will be updates as needed for bugs and maybe a feature addition or two down the line.


Covid Carl was born out of frustration in dealing with certain societal elements during the Covid-19 pandemic. It has a pretty heavy dose of satire(is it, though?), some self-awareness about how bad it (the game) is, and hopefully more fun than frustration. Let's be honest, though. I'm not producing something that's AAA. You can run, jump, shoot, go prone, and die. Mostly die, in my experience, but I also might be getting too old to have good reflexes. There may or may not be a flamethrower involved. Who knows? I fully expect that the end product will be a mostly well-functioning dumpster fire. Clearly, I am not made out to be a salesman, as I am being honest and probably underselling this beast I've worked on for the last couple of years. But if it provides whoever pays a pittance for it with a modicum of entertainment, then I'll consider this endeavor a success. This isn't going to be a work of art, but it is my magnum opus.

data.name: Card Revolution Soccer
data.detailed_description:
Card Revolution Soccer

Card Revolution Soccer is a football card game that simulates football matches in an unusual way: instead of directly controlling the players on the pitch, you influence the course of the match by revealing cards.

Football Through Cards

During a match, cards are revealed to simulate what happens on the pitch. The game develops step by step as different events unfold through the card system.

Instead of controlling every player directly, Card Revolution Soccer focuses on the excitement of watching a football match develop through its card-based simulation.

Develop Your Coach or a Nation

In Card Revolution Soccer, you can progress as a coach or follow the development of an entire nation.

As you progress and level up, you can continue developing your career and your chosen path through the game. You can decide whether you want to focus on developing a coach or advancing an entire nation.

Play Different Game Modes

Take on different challenges and play your football matches across several game modes.

World Tour

In World Tour, you face different opponents and make your way through the international football world.

Cup Mode

In Cup Mode, your goal is to advance through the competition round by round and ultimately win the cup.

Customize Your Gameplay

Want to experience the game differently? Card Revolution Soccer includes various sliders that allow you to customize different aspects of the gameplay.

Adjust the available settings to create a gameplay experience that suits your

data.name: Mythic Manager
data.detailed_description:
Mythic Manager is a guild management simulator where you recruit, train, and lead a roster of MMORPG players through dungeons, raids, and PvP tournaments.

Build Your Roster
Sign promising players from the recruiting pool that grows as your guild's prestige grows. Every member has unique stats, personality traits, and potential. Managing your roster means tough decisions about who to develop, who to bench, and who to cut.

Watch Them Fight
Your guild runs auto-battled dungeons and raids with real mechanics — tank swaps, AoE dodges, interrupts, and burst phases. You don't control the combat directly, but your decisions on team composition, gear, talents and the player's personalities as well as their talent determine whether your team wipes or clears.

Manage Everything Else
Balance your gold, assign professions, craft gear, manage morale, and navigate the social dynamics between your members. Rivalries form, friendships develop, and personalities clash.

Compete for Glory
Progress from a scrappy startup guild through dungeons, heroics, mythic raids, and PvP arena seasons. Earn prestige, unlock milestones, and prove your guild is the best on the server.

Push Your Sigils

Clear a dungeon on Mythic to open the Ascendant Trials. Your Sigil names a dungeon and a tier: clear it and it climbs, wipe and it drops. Every third tier adds an affix, the loot keeps scaling, and rival guilds push their own Sigils on the same leaderboard.

Features:

  • Deep roster management with player age, potential, and career arcs

  • Auto-battle system with visible mechanics and attribute-driven AI

  • 9 classes with 3-4 specs, talent trees, and gear progression

  • Professions, crafting, and a high amount of QOL and automation

  • Personality traits, morale, and relationship systems

  • Arena tournaments

  • Ascendant Trials: an endless dungeon ladder with twelve affixes and a Sigil leaderboard

Early Access — The game is actively in development. Core systems are playable now with full end game content with even more content, polish, and features on the way.

Props & Environmental Themes: The game world may include decorative props with thematic implications (e.g., stylized ropes, hanging chains) and settings like dungeons or palaces that contribute to the atmospheric world-building.

The game features cartoonish, fantasy-based combat involving actions like dragon breath, magical spells, and swordplay.

Combat is depicted through light effects, particle animations, and skill visuals. There is no realistic blood splatter, gore, dismemberment, detailed wound depiction, or prolonged suffering.

The level of violence is consistent with standards for mainstream fantasy role-playing games.

This game does NOT contain: Depictions of explicit sexual acts, nudity exposing genitalia, realistic blood/gore, sexual violence (e.g., rape), depiction of drug use, or discriminatory language targeting real-world groups.

data.name: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush
data.detailed_description:
Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush

Are you ready for the ultimate fusion of match-3 puzzles and physics-based Pachinko excitement? Match colorful tiles, launch bouncy balls across bouncy pegs into multiplier slots, and hit massive score combos!

KEY FEATURES

  • Unique Hybrid Gameplay: A satisfying blend of classic match-3 puzzle mechanics and physics-driven Pachinko action.

  • Destructive Power-Ups: Create 4 and 5-matches to unleash Explosive Bombs, chain Lightning, and the Cosmic Black Hole that wipes out all tiles of the same color!

  • Permanent Upgrade System: Spend your earned EXP to permanently upgrade extra balls per match, lucky slot multipliers, and critical ball drop rates.

  • Risk & Reward (Penalty Slot): Aim carefully! While most slots multiply your score and grant EXP, the Red Penalty Slot deducts points. Every drop is a strategic decision!

  • Global Leaderboards: Your score and level are synchronized in real-time with Steam Global Leaderboards. Climb to the top and compete worldwide!

  • Wide Language Support: Fully localized in 27 languages.

HOW TO PLAY

  • Match: Swap and match 3 or more tiles of the same color to clear them.

  • Drop: Each cleared tile spawns bouncy balls that ricochet down through the peg field.

  • Hit Multipliers: Guide balls into high-multiplier slots (x5, x10, Lucky 2x) to boost your score!

  • Upgrade: Level up, earn EXP, buy permanent upgrades, and crush your high scores!

data.name: Chinese Empire: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
CHECK THIS OUT



About the Game





After many years of war, a time of peace has come. Unfortunately, the great Emperor is dying and you, the young, inexperienced Huangdi, are in charge of the country. Your father's court adviser still has a few things to teach you. He will help you build your first prosperous city.

The prologue will introduce you to the world of Chinese Empire, explain the most important mechanics in the game, teach you how to manage resources and goods, and how to optimally build cities.



Each citizen plays an important role for the entire empire. By assigning employees to strictly defined tasks, it allows you to maintain order, efficiency and control over the entire ecosystem. Workers can cultivate crops, extract resources, produce goods, breed animals, slaughter, trade, etc.


Each building must be connected to the rest of the settlement by roads in order to function. It is on the roads that residents march to go to their work or move goods. A well-designed road network will increase the effectiveness of the entire empire.


Resources are obtained in many ways. Some we can obtain from crops, others from extraction, and others from trade. The processing of raw materials also plays a key role, because from specific ingredients we can now produce completely new goods such as bread, paper or silk.


The game has a full year cycle. Each season has a unique palette of colors and climate. Seasons also affect the gameplay as modulators, e.g. slowing down residents in winter or increasing crop growth during rain.


The map of the continent allows you to manage trade routes more conveniently. You can import goods from distant regions in exchange for produced goods.


Each year, the player chooses one of three drawn cards. The bonuses contained in the cards work for another year. They affect the game in various ways: increasing or decreasing the efficiency of workers, buildings, adding weather bonuses or random events from the region, e.t.c.

data.name: Ayo the Clown
data.detailed_description:
In Ayo’s hometown, things are generally peaceful. Accompanied by his talented circus dog, Bo, Ayo juggles in the park, hangs out at the carnival and longs after the Shoemaker’s granddaughter. Until one day, Bo goes missing!

You play as Ayo, your not-so-average clown, in search of his best friend and beloved dog who has mysteriously disappeared. What happened to Bo? Will they ever juggle together at the park again? Or set up that circus act they’ve always planned? You’ll find out along this incredible adventure as you strive to reunite clown and dog. Like all good adventures, you won’t be all on your own. Ayo’s world is full of friendly people and interesting creatures that are willing to lend a helping hand.


FEATURES:
  • Unique Platforms- The most important part of any platform game. Each stage has a unique theme and interesting platforms to ensure gaming is fun and not repetitive because Ayo is not the kind of clown to make the same old jokes over and over again. His jokes get better each time.
  • Huge Bosses and loads of enemies- Take on bosses bigger than life itself and prove that clowns are much tougher than they seem. Don’t be fooled by Ayo’s sweet demeanor!
  • Weapons - Tanks, helicopters, dinosaurs, toy hammers, balloon swords, water balloons, you name it. They can help uncover hidden places, extinguish fire, defeat enemies, prank your friends...etc.
  • Skills- Head stomps, wall jumps, slope slides, and many more, Ayo sure has a lot of tricks up his sleeve.
  • Side Quests- There’s plenty of side quests you can take on in Town or along your journey, so be prepared for some surprising rewards.
  • Collectibles- Can you find and collect all the hidden items throughout the game? Rubber chicken and fart bag anyone?

data.detailed_description:
Reality Unravels. Our last stand starts here


New Ganymede is an upcoming free-to-play MMOARPG, set in a bizarre near future of interplanetary oligarchs, transhuman bounty hunters and virtual revenants, developed by a Melbourne-based team of industry veterans and rising stars, and published by Metakey.

Explore a living, scarred world


In the approaching demo (from Q4 2023), you will be introduced to the eponymous city hub of New Ganymede, a living nexus for the narrative, progression and social hooks of this new sci-fi fantasy universe— a fallen paradise crippled and besieged by an orbiting fleet as reality unravels around it
.

Lead perilous raids


The first instanced co-op PVE environment, Umbriel, will also be playable at this time. Alongside a team of friends, you will be tasked with braving the dark world and its relentless inhabitants, to uncover a mystery that threatens the future and fabric of life and civilization. Pull together with your allies and we may yet stand a fighting chance!

data.name: Dungeon & Burglar
data.detailed_description:
Just moving around can be so tough!
Sneak through traps on different floors to get treasures in this thrilling and action-packed game!
Find the best way to conquer each of the 30 dungeon floors by learning from each death!

■ Observe how enemies move and slip through them!
The player can only move.
The way forward is blocked by many enemies and obstacles!
Steal all treasures using big brain moves!

■ Die, learn, and break through!
Touching an enemy or trap is an instant death!
Every death helps you come up with a strategy to conquer each floor as you aim for the end!

■ Enhanced replayability!
Plenty of replayability with trophies, time attack, and ranking boards!
This simple game gives the player plenty of room for deep gameplay.

data.name: Giggy Shangri-La
data.detailed_description:
Thank you for calling. This is Shangri-La, a live music club.

Welcome to the exhilarating staff action x live music cafe management simulation!

[Giggy Shangri-La] is a game in which you conquer a dungeon with a guitar in your hand and experience being a bartender at a live music club visited only by monsters.

The curtain opens on another exciting gig today, with colors that come to life and music that soars!

The main character, Yu Furuiido, wakes up to find that his favorite toys have attacked her!

  • Watch out for their attacks and play your guitar to close the gap between you and your enemies.

  • Jump left and right on the floor to find your own route of attack.

When you get right in front of the enemy, you have a chance for a direct attack!

  • When an enemy collapses, swing the guitar to inflict damage.

  • The damage increases according to the number of consecutive hits!

The defeated enemies will drop ingredients for drinks to be served to the live music club's guests!

  • If you don't make it back alive, you won't be able to take the items home. Be sure to win and go home.

    Coughing ventilators, tired refrigerators, and glasses shaking on the table. This is Shangri-La, a live music club.

    Offering musicians for the customers who come here in search of exciting time.

    • Offer an artist to take the stage tonight from among four different music genres.

    • The clientele changes depending on the artist you offer. Call out to them according to your mood tonight.

    Guess the audience's tastes and offer them a fancy drink!

    • Make the best drink with the items you brought back from the gig.

    • Try to give exceptional service to the customers  by judging their taste of drinks and how they feel about music club.

    Sometimes you'll get a customer who is a little difficult.

    • When a special customer comes in, have a conversation and find out what they like.

    • Use the recipe and the items you have on hand to mix the best drink. Don't forget to use the hints!!

    • if your strategy is successful, you will level up in the game faster.

data.name: Elixonomy
data.detailed_description:
Plan each morning, gather and grow ingredients, brew remedies, choose what reaches the shelf, set prices, and serve customers with different needs and budgets. Every day asks you to decide what to make, what to save, and how to respond when the market changes.

A potion can be technically suitable and still be too expensive, poorly matched, or unavailable. Customers remember whether your shop helped them, and recurring visitors return with requests and consequences shaped by earlier decisions.

The Elixonomy

  • Plan stock around visible customer needs and tomorrow's forecast.

  • Gather fragile magical materials and cultivate an apothecary garden.

  • Brew manually or use accessible automatic options without punitive early failure.

  • Set prices and prepare shelves for customers with individual budgets and preferences.

  • Respond to weather, demand, supply pressure, and regional events.

  • Meet recurring characters and make readable choices with lasting effects.

  • Review sales, profit, missed opportunities, and practical guidance after each day.

Elixonomy rewards adaptation and understanding—not memorizing one perfect solution.

data.name: SpaceBourne 2
data.detailed_description:
SpaceBourne 2 is a single-player, open-universe RPG and third-person shooter game with an abundance of features, including role-playing, mining, trading, piracy, crafting, and deep exploration. The story picks up where it left off in SpaceBourne, but now the player's goal is to build a new empire in the galaxy, with the methods of doing so being completely up to the player.


In SpaceBourne 2, players are offered tens of thousands of diverse solar systems to explore. Each system has a unique structure, featuring different planets with varied surfaces and areas to discover. The locations, from the solar systems to the planets, are procedurally generated, ensuring that each system and planet is unique and has numerous points to explore.

SpaceBourne 2 boasts massive planetary surfaces, each with its own structure, climate, and gravity, as well as cities, villages, caves, outposts, and secrets to interact with. With tens of thousands of different planets available, players are given an unparalleled amount of opportunities for exploration throughout the galaxy


Every scenario needs a hero.
In SpaceBourne you have two of them; Your Pilot and your Ship
With the new character customization system and the realistic rendering feature of Unreal Engine, you will create lifelike characters and embark on an adventure with your ships that you have modified according to your own preferences.



In SpaceBourne 2, you have the ability to establish your own faction and wield complete control over it. You get to decide on the faction's internal operations, policies, governing principles, and management structure. By expanding your faction's military, capturing other stations and solar systems, or constructing new stations, you can become the supreme ruler of the galaxy.

SpaceBourne 2 offers a rich diplomacy system, featuring Starlords loyal to each faction, as well as houses connected to Starlords. Each house has unique characteristics, stations, planets, cities, and fleets, allowing for diplomacy not only with factions but also with Starlords and Houses.

Diplomacy can now be done not only with factions but also with Starlords and Houses.

The relations of the Starlords in the galaxy can change all diplomatic dynamics in the game. This forces you to think hard before you act.


"Any galaxy is too big for one person to rule. "

In SpaceBourne 2, you are not alone on your journey. You have companions who can assist you in combat and lead your team. Players can assign team members different roles on board based on their skills.

GUILDS

In the game, there are guilds available, a total of 7. The player can join the guilds they choose and progress within these guilds. Each guild can provide numerous side quests to the player within their respective areas of expertise. As the player completes these quests, they can rise in rank within the guild and gain access to unique benefits offered by the guild members.

SIDE MISSIONS

In SpaceBourne 2, players can expect to encounter side missions scattered throughout the galaxy. These missions not only offer a change of pace from the main storyline, but also provide an opportunity for players to earn extra rewards, learn new information about the game's world and characters, and immerse themselves even further in the game's rich and diverse universe.

LIVING GALAXY

In SpaceBourne 2, you will enter a living galaxy where opportunities for adventure and intrigue are waiting for you at every turn. With a vast array of spaceships at your fingertips, you can engage in communication with other ships, and experience random encounter events that will pull you into new stories and challenges.

data.name: Modules
data.detailed_description:
Modules is a project by Maxim Zhestkov, where different forms of art – architecture, sculpture, film, and music – blend together to create an intense, interactive virtual experience.

Modules will expand to contain Maxim Zhestkov’s entire body of work. Over the course of years, the project will grow as he grows, expanding into new territories and blurring the boundaries between art, games, and reality. With experimentation at its core, it is Zhestkov’s playground, where he is able to refine his work with no end, challenging the limits of his own medium.

Features:

data.name: Painkiller
data.detailed_description:
Painkiller is a reimagining of the classic franchise, featuring co-op play for up to three players and full offline support. Battle hordes of demons and titanic terrors across richly detailed gothic environments.

Trapped in Purgatory, you are sentenced for your transgressions against Heaven. But the Voice of the Creator gives you a chance to redeem yourself. As one of the Champions, you are to stop the fallen angel Azazel who is about to unleash his demonic armies onto Earth. You will face hordes of enemies, demons with unique powers and three monstrous children of Azazel - the Nephilim. 

Will you succeed in your mission and earn your salvation?

Purgatory Is Your Playground - Jump, dash, and hook across vast biomes while fighting enemies with a host of new and classic Painkiller weapons. 

Grotesque Terrors Await - Challenge a variety of enemies ranging from hordes of smaller demons to titanic terrors.
Unleash The Pain - Utilize tarot cards to enhance your abilities and combine them with other players to obliterate your foes. 

Choose Your Character Wisely - Play as one of four distinctive characters - Ink, Void, Sol and Roch - and take advantage of their unique perks to boost your energy, health, power and damage.

Rogue Angel Mode – Step beyond the main campaign and into a new realm of Purgatory. Team up with your friends and fight for survival in handcrafted randomized arenas.

Game currently features:

• Fully procedural levels, every fight is new.

• Physics based play and weaponry.

• Companion AI, no friends necessary!

• Split Screen Local play up to 4 players, some friends necessary.

• Cooperative, Deathmatch, Speedrun game modes.

Plays best with a dual stick controller.
