data.name: ROSE
data.detailed_description:
ROSE is a violent arena shooter with rogue-like elements. Create your own builds by sacrificing parts of your body or reversing the sacrifices to gain boost and new abilities. Unlock new weapons, enhance them with powerful upgrades. Progress through randomized arenas, defeat demented enemies and vanquish titanic bosses to uncover the dark story. What are you willing to sacrifice to save your lost daughter Rose?

Sacrifice your flesh and blood

After each arena has been cleared you can choose from several sacrifices. Sacrifices will increase the complexity and difficulty of the game. Each body part sacrificed will add new mechanics and will change the game in a meaningful way.

Each sacrifice will increase your stress level, with enough stress you can reverse a sacrifice to gain a new ability instead.

Ever-changing arenas

Arenas are randomly selected from dozens of pre-made layouts. Traps, enemies and other objects are procedurally spawned. Each arena can spawn multiple waves of enemies.

In some arenas you can figh for additional rewards. In such cases, enemies will spawn with a special rule-set, forcing you to strategize and change your play style to complete the rule objective.

Not all the arenas are created equal, some may offer special mid-run upgrades or present you with an additional challenge in the form of a mini-boss.

Weapons and abilities

Each weapon provides a unique gameplay experience, some can even alter the maps themselves.

The gun selection ranges from a simple revolver to a demented gun which consumes your blood for ammo and punishes you each time you miss.

Unlock new weapons, upgrade them every time you die, then jump into battle once more!

Enemies and bosses

Enemies spawn in waves. After you clear a certain number of waves, the sacrificial altar will unlock, and you will move to a new arena. Some arenas may spawn bosses instead of regular enemies.

Story

Rose tells a story about life, death and hope.

You will find out more about the story by progressing through the arenas, special encounters, defeating bosses and dying.

Features:

  • Sacrifice your flesh and blood to progress

  • Reverse sacrifices to gain boosts instead

  • Unlock and upgrade unique weapons

  • Slaughter waves of demented enemies

  • Defeat titanic bosses

  • Progress through the randomized arenas to uncover the dark story

  • Avoid traps and other procedurally placed obstacles

You play an ordinary office worker who is pulled into this gender-reversed world and meets four male leads: Gu Lian, Li Ruoxi, Feng Tiantian, and Shen Wei. Your choices shape affection, hidden variables, routes, and endings as the romantic comedy gradually reveals something strange beneath everyday life.

  • Four main romance routes with different personalities and relationship dynamics.

  • Choice-driven story progress with affection changes, hidden variables, saves, character portraits, CGs, and background music.

  • Multiple endings, including route endings, bad endings, and clues toward a deeper hidden truth.

The game contains satire, romance, comedy, and light social themes, but no explicit adult content.

data.name: 4D Miner
data.detailed_description:
4D Miner is the first-ever 4-dimensional survival sandbox game, where you can explore an infinite, procedurally-generated, 4-dimensional world!

How It Works


Since you and I are 3-dimensional beings, we can only directly experience 3 spatial dimensions at a time. So how would we go about exploring a 4-dimensional world?

Let's take a step back. Imagine there was a 2-dimensional being named Frank, and you wanted to show him a 3D world.



Since Frank can only interact with 2D objects, you could let him explore a 2D slice of a 3D world.



If Frank can only interact with a tiny slice of the 3D world around him, he won't have a very good understanding of the 3rd dimension.

If we really want him to understand the 3rd dimension, we have to allow him to rotate his slice of the world so he can access all of the 3rd dimension.



In a similar fashion, this game allows us to rotate our own 3D slice of a 4D world! This means we can explore the entirety of the 4th dimension!

data.name: Ortharion : The Last Battle
data.detailed_description:
Ortharion: The Last Battle is a solo hack'n slash RPG set in a fantasy medieval world. Choose from various combinations of classes and equipment to become as powerful as possible, explore a vast world, and overcome all the toughest challenges and bosses!

Class Evolution: Start with one of the three available classes at the beginning of the game, and gradually select new classes that provide different advantages, ultimately choosing seven specialties simultaneously from a pool of thirty-nine, leading to nearly infinite possibilities.

Over 350 Upgradeable Spells: Spells must be found and learned, and they come in six rarity types and can be leveled up. Learning requires specific stats and classes. The functioning of spells is then modified by talents and equipment.

15 Major Bosses to Face: Bosses are divided into two categories: regular bosses that serve as minor challenges and 15 major bosses that leave little room for error. Not all major bosses are equal.

Explore the World: Enhance your character by exploring and uncover all the secrets it contains.

Procedurally Generated Items: Each item can have unique powers, belong to a set, feature a runic word or a gem, making the number of combinations greater than in other hack'n slash games. Stats are also randomized and tiered. A consumable-based customization system is also available.

Talent Trees: Each fragment of Ortharion gives you a point in talent trees, allowing for further customization of your character. The talent trees are specific to each class, with some talents completely altering gameplay.

Competitive Modes: The game has been designed with a ranking system. You need to accumulate points and can compare them with friends or the community through a seasonal system.

High-Level Content: Participate in multiple high-level systems while engaging in the campaign, boss arenas, monster waves, random dungeons, objective protection, and more.

data.name: Realms of Antiquity: The Shattered Crown
data.detailed_description:
Prepare yourself for a journey to a world of fantasy and adventure!

A land fallen into chaos needs stalwart heroes to save it from a sinister and powerful force of evil...

Enter a massive sprawling world of wild forests, frozen plains, misty mountains, scorched deserts, and endless oceans. Explore cities, towns and villages to rest and recover as well as buy equipment. Talk to sages, warriors, peasants and sovereigns to aid you in your quest. Sail the open seas or pilot boats up rivers. Descend into dark dungeons, castle ruins, and mysterious places to find treasure, fight evil, and locate powerful relics.

Do you have what it takes to save the Realms of Antiquity?

This is a retro computer role-playing game, written for the classic TI-99/4a home computer, released in 1981. It runs in full emulation on modern Windows systems as well as the original hardware.

Provided ready-to-play in the Classic99 emulator!

Features:


  • 16-Color bitmap enhanced graphics
  • Nine character classes
  • Control up to four characters
  • 2d turn-based tactical combat
  • Huge multi-disk fantasy world
  • Over 250 unique powerful items
  • 60 spells, seven schools of magic
  • Over 200 terrifying monsters
  • NPC’s with complex dialogue

Requirements:


  • PC running Windows OS 7-10

data.name: Skate Story
data.detailed_description:
You are a demon in the Underworld, made out of glass and pain. The Devil has given you a skateboard with a simple deal: Skate to the Moon and swallow it — and you shall be freed.

Ollie, kickflip, and grind your way through the ash and smoke of The Emptylands as you take on a seemingly impossible quest. Learn to master your weight and motion to conquer the weeping concrete. Savour the ritualistic beauty as you set your feet to pop a perfect kickflip.

Skate fast to destroy vicious demons, help a forgetful frog, and save other tortured souls on your journey from fragile beginner to hardened skater. Push through hell and discover The Devil’s greatest weakness: humility, perseverance, and a disgustingly sweet backside tailslide.

All you need is your skateboard.

Stylish Street Skating Adventure

Skate through nine layers of The Underworld. Cruise through streets and surreal landscapes full of waxed ledges, unholy gaps, and tortured demons. Push your way through precarious paths and shred freeform skate spots. Discover and create your own challenges as you explore the world and master your board.

Succumb To The Beauty of The Board

Sell your soul for decks, wheels, and trucks to keep your skating fresh. Over 70+ skate tricks to progress and improve. Complete skate trials to level up, learn new tricks, and get new gear. Destroy vicious demons with your 360 flip… or at least impress them.

Hypnotic Beats for Demonic Streets

Cruise through The Underworld to a psychedelic soundtrack by enigmatic New York artist Blood Cultures, and additional tracks by John Fio.

data.name: Defy Gravity Extended
data.detailed_description:
Defy Gravity is an action platformer that is a mix between classic platforming and gravity based puzzle solving. Kara, our heroine, has access to a unique gameplay mechanic that she uses to manipulate the world around her. She has a gun that is able to alter the laws of physics through the creation of pockets of gravity and anti-gravity. By mastering the use of these abilities Kara is able to augment her jump in order to almost fly past obstacles. These powers can also be utilized to move objects that block her path and platforms that Kara stands on in order to traverse the levels.

Key Features:

  • Unique physics engine that provides a never before experienced gameplay experience.
  • Xbox controller and keyboard/mouse support
  • 24 unique levels
  • A second quest mode that radically changes the game and adds an additional 24 levels
  • Custom Soundtrack
  • 8 Steam Achievements

data.name: Bunker KYS
data.detailed_description: BUNKER is an intense social multiplayer survival game for 4–10 players where deception is your primary tool. Every player begins with a secret, dynamically generated Player Card that defines their role in the bunker, encompassing a critical set of attributes: Profession (Skill), Health, Psychological state (Psychics), and a Personal Item. Crucially, each player holds a unique, hidden Target Goal (e.g., "You must survive," "Everyone must die") that guides their negotiation strategy and determines their final win condition. The environment is set against a backdrop of a randomly determined global cataclysm, which shapes the final survival criteria, such as a Nuclear War or an Alien Invasion. The game progresses in rounds consisting of phases—Reveal, Discuss, and Vote—where players must use the integrated Push-to-Talk voice chat to form alliances and selectively disclose their attributes to prove their worth. Strategic depth is added by the optional Linear Mode (Turn Mode), which enforces a strict turn order during the critical Reveal Phase, muting all other players to maximize pressure on the acting player. Furthermore, each player is assigned a Super Ability, chosen from 17 powerful options, that can be used once per game to dramatically alter the characteristics of others—for example, "Genetic Experiment" to swap Health and Psychics, or "To rejuvenate" to lower a player's age. When a player is eliminated by the vote, they do not leave but become a Ghost, retaining the ability to move freely and express their frustration or approval using unique, non-verbal emotional animations. The final outcome is calculated based on the surviving group's collective traits against the backdrop of the set apocalypse scenario.

data.name: Roll to Riches
data.detailed_description:
Build a settlement from nothing

Starting from nothing. You gather enough wood to build your first campfire and shelter. From there, settlers will join you and merchants will arrive, allowing your city to thrive. Roll to Riches is an incremental city builder that allows you to build a thriving Viking city with a roll of the dice. Every building you raise and every worker you assign is a step toward economic prosperity.

Roll the dice

Every resource gathered, grown, mined, or processed is determined by the roll of a die. Expand and improve to gain more and better dice. Build out your settlement, increase your population, and automate each dice roll with your villagers.

Trade and expand

Once per minute, a traveling merchant arrives in town, ready to trade. The merchant brings tools for mining, seeds for farming, and sheep for shearing. Sell what your settlement produces and buy tools to construct new buildings or improve production.

From fire pit to Viking trading hub

The gameplay loop focuses on growth: build, roll, trade, and upgrade. As your wealth increases, so does your production. Can you develop your production chains and manage your resources effectively to make your ancestors proud?

data.name: SMIL333
data.detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in Mexican religious horror

In 2010s México, Guadalajara becomes the setting for this story where you can explore, through Víctor's computer, various emails, documents, photos, and found footage recordings that reveal the disturbing events he uncovered during his investigation.

Enter Víctor's world, created by author María Ramírez, with a story full of unexpected twists, secrets, and supernatural moments that challenge the protagonist's understanding of reality.

The first FMV video game in Mexico

SMIL333 is the first Mexican Full-Motion-Video video game, using pre-recorded live-action footage with actors, instead of sprites or 3D animation. With an original story strongly linked to the occult and religious horror, be part of this fully immersive experience with a different perspective on psychological terror.

Discover the alternate endings

SMIL333 features two completely different endings that can be unlocked from your first playthrough. Just pay attention to the clues and look for the secret files 👁️

data.name: Realms of Magic
data.detailed_description:
Realms of Magic is a fusion of classic, old-school game mechanics (such as crafting, talent trees, quests) presented in a modern, open-world structure. This 2D Action RPG transports you to the universe known as The Old Kingdom – a high fantasy setting filled to the brim with quests to complete, characters to meet, and monsters to beat.

But let’s not get too confrontational with various imps or minotaurs. When you are not saving the villagers, you can also focus on gathering resources, leveling up your professions (such as lumberjacking, mining, or cooking… there are 16 of them for you to choose!), and building a house or a farm.



Live your life in the Old Kingdom and write your own story. Create a character, choose one of many available races (such as humans, dwarfs, wild elves, or orcs) and show the world what you got! You can strive to become the most powerful knight or the best pyromancer. You can even try to make your playstyle more unique by combining many different techniques (Mixing fire and ice spells? Yep, sounds like a plan!).

You can also lead a quieter, more laid-back life focused on woodcutting, planting vegetables, and trading with the locals. With time, you might be remembered as this inspiring self-made man who built a house, created an agricultural business, and enjoyed a little bit of leatherworking on the side (as a hobby). Oh, and also cooked some killer onion rings!



The Old Kingdom is not a peaceful place. On the contrary, this world is inhabited by hundreds of various creatures that think about killing you. This is especially true when visiting the dungeons – these places are not for the faint of heart! However, you are far from powerless against the evils of this world. You have a whole arsenal of weapons, armors, spells, or traps at your disposal. Develop your skill tree (Have we mentioned that there are 7 of them for you to pick from?), choose the most suitable approach, and create your very own tactic.

Become an ax-wielding, ice spike blasting machine that action rolls straight at the biggest guy in the group or focus your skills on necromancy and let your skeleton army do the job… when you sit back and rub your hands… in a rather dastardly manner.



Crafting and building are essential components of Realms of Magic. These are the basic tools that will help you take this world head-on. There are 16 professions in the game (e.g., farming, alchemy, tailoring). All of them will help you reinvent your character and set your priorities. They might also prove to be vital in ensuring your survival during the roughest of days.

These professions are your go-to stats when thinking about creating and managing your own keep. But even the most battle-hardened, wayfaring adventurers might want to take some time to learn how to mine or cook. Rich ores could prove to be a suitable source of income while on the road, and that onion rings recipe might save your life one day.



Realms of Magic is also a narratively driven experience. The Old Kingdom, with all of its races and characters, has a very rich written history. There are volumes upon volumes of books for you to find. And they aren’t just about spells and history. Some of them are for pure entertainment and will allow you to lose yourself in the amazing adventures of two witch hunters - Hansel and Ritter. Who knows… you might even meet them during your journeys!

Your adventure will also have a grand purpose. During your travels, you will find many diverse communities. Some of them might be hostile, and some of them might perceive you as their savior – a brave outlander capable of protecting them from all manners of beasts, bandits, or monsters. But watch out… because some of the biggest threats… are just on the horizon… ready to destroy the beautiful capital city of the Old Kingdom.


  • Fascinating, vibrant epic fantasy world that provides you with a lot of freedom
  • Beautifully crafted fantasy landscapes (including various villages, graveyards, dungeons, etc.).
  • Ability to craft your own meaning of “adventure.”
  • Flexible and intuitive fighting system that allows you to design your own strategies.
  • 7 skill trees that allow you to reinvent your character and playstyle constantly.
  • 16 professions that allow you to build, craft, gather, farm, etc.
  • 9 playable races with a plethora of customizable options.
  • Hundreds upon hundreds of items for you to wear, use or show off because why not? #flexing
  • Living and breathing world with many diverse communities and rich lore.
  • Monsters to slay, dungeons to conquer, spells to learn and loot to obtain…
  • … but you can always simply become a farmer/alchemist/that weird herbalist that has a crazy look in his/her eyes, but somehow can cure people’s rash on their backs!


  • what's it like to fuse old-school RPG mechanics with modern open-world structure?
  • what's it like to shoot that fireball across the whole cave?
  • what's it like to visit a fantasy world that is beaming with life?
  • what's it like to admire a greatly detailed pixel-art?
  • what's it like to summon a horde of undead rabbits?
  • what's it like to protect the whole realm from evil?
  • what's it like to explore a vast and beautiful world?
  • what's it like to build a house from the ground up?
  • what's it like to square up against the most dangerous creatures in the whole realm?
  • what's it like to enjoy fine leatherworking?
  • what's it like to FINALLY complete that copper armor set? #fashionrealms
  • what's it like to discover the deepest secrets of the Old Kingdom?
  • what's it like to have a purpose in your journey?

Well… Realms of Magic might be the title you have been waiting for!

data.name: Shadows of Betrayal
data.detailed_description:
Shadows of Betrayal is a mystery/thriller visual novel about a group of recent high school graduates who set out for a trip to a remote cabin. The game is set in current day but with 80s/90s horror vibes.

Get to know the intriguing friend group, enjoy the banter, plot twists and optional romance, and try to survive the unexpected events in Shadows of Betrayal while solving the multi-layered mystery! Who will survive, and at what cost?

How will it all unravel? The answers lie in Shadows of Betrayal.

Features

  • Interesting story with unexpected plot twists
  • Well written characters with engaging and witty dialogue
  • Meaningful choices
  • Relationship system that gives you feedback of what people think of your actions
  • Toggleable map that shows you where the current scene is taking place
  • First person narrative

data.name: Beetle Hunter
data.detailed_description:
BEETLE HUNTER is a simple first-person shooter. Beat various ferocious enemies, collect powerful weapons, explore the randomly generated complex steampunk stage, aim for the top floor and hunt the mighty beetle!

Version 1.1

  • Changed the timing of AUTOSAVE.

  • Fixed bug: HISTORY's death count.

  • Increased the appearance rate of HEAL items.

  • Increased the count of bullets.

Control

  • WASD - Move

  • Mouse - Direction

  • Left Click - Fire

  • Right Click - Aim

  • Space - Jump

  • Shift - Dash

  • C - Crouch

  • E - Activate

  • R - Reload

  • G - Grenade

  • H - Heal

  • F - Freeze

  • Mouse Scroll - Change Weapon

  • 12345 - Change Weapon

  • P - Pause

  • ESC - Pause

  • Alt + Enter - Fullscreen

Save

  • It has AUTOSAVE and PAUSESAVE.

  • When you continue from the game over, AUTOSAVE data will be used.

  • PAUSESAVE will be deleted when you load it.

  • You cannot use AUTOSAVE in hard mode.

Weapon

  • PISTOL with no limitation bullet

  • ASSAULT RIFLE with continuous fire

  • LASER GUN with penetration possible

  • SHOTGUN for a short distance

  • Powerful ROCKET LAUNCHER

Item

  • HEAL restores HP.

  • GRENADE attacks multiple enemies and destroys wires and rocks that block the way.

  • FREEZE stops the enemies for a moment.

  • WEAPON PLUS upgrades the weapon you are using.

  • GEMs make you stronger.

Enemy

  • Ant

  • Hornet

  • Mantis

  • Locust

  • and more…

Difficulty

  • There are two types of difficulty, NORMAL and HARD.

  • In NORMAL mode, you can resume from AUTOSAVE even if you are killed.

  • When you are killed in HARD mode, it ends there.

data.name: The Naked Game
data.detailed_description:
DESCRIPTION


The Naked Game is a first-person psychological thriller/puzzle/exploration game inspired on real events connected by a strong immersive story of a young Eurasian girl who goes on a trip from Japan, her home country, to France.

One day she wakes up at an unknown, yet familiar place…

Mia was kidnapped and she is trying to escape from the hostile place. However, her journey to freedom is not easy nor straight.The Heroine is forced to seek her memories in order to solve the riddles that the kidnapper prepared for her. Yet not everything is as it seemed at first.

GAME FEATURES


- Solving hardcore yet logical puzzles -
Which result from the story and correspond with the environment

- Great atmosphere and artistic style -
Reflecting today's graphics standards and imagination of the kidnapper

- Discovering all elements of our universe -
Including pop culture trends, brands and also conspiracy theories

- First person immersion -
The Naked Game is not your typical first person game where the player controls only levitating hands. The heroine is presented to the player from head to toe which guarantees better connection with the character.

- Exploration of levels -
The player can explore dark corners of the levels and uncover more about the heroine's past. Thorough exploration can player find different points of view and help them find another solution of the levels.

- Inspired by real historical events -
Such as the Fukushima accident and German expeditions to the Far East and many more...



The game is built using Unreal Engine 4.

Some parts of the game may not be suitable for people experiencing photosensitive seizures.

data.name: Heaven's Ladder
data.detailed_description:
Prepare for an exhilarating journey in this platforming adventure, where every step is a test of skill and perseverance. Ascend towering platforms, execute breathtaking leaps of faith, and navigate the narrowest of paths with precision. You'll find yourself standing in places you never imagined possible.

The game’s realistic physics and unique control mechanics demand patience and mastery, offering a rewarding experience for those who rise to the challenge. Immerse yourself in a world of serene landscapes accompanied by a soothing soundtrack, making each climb both a challenge and a pleasure.

data.detailed_description:
Play as a crab trying to keep a ball in the air. Move side to side, bop the ball up, and scoop up gold as they rain down upon you! The longer you keep the bounce going, the more treasure you earn.

Relaxing, meditative, replayable, and yet surprisingly difficult. Play alone or with a friend in Coop and competitive mode.

🎮 How to Play

  • Move left and right with the joystick

  • Keep the ball bouncing

  • Collect coins for extra points

Miss a bounce? It’s game over!

✨ Features

  • 🦀 Simple joystick controls: just move left or right

  • 🏐 Ball physics: keep it bouncing as long as you can

  • 💰 Coin collection and score chasing

  • 🔁 Easy to pick up and play

🎯 For Players Who:

  • Like casual reflex games

  • Difficult games

data.name: Raise Your Own Clone
data.detailed_description:
PLEASE WISHLIST 🙏


About the Game

WARNING: This is a text game and requires a lot of reading. Introducing the latest, proper interactive fiction game from CoaguCo Industries.

Story 4 is now out and Story 1 is now free! The last story of the series has finally dropped. Follow Aloysius as he witnesses the end of Marsch's tale, the beginning of Madelyn's, and finds out what really happened to Dr. Stansfield. Also, Story 1 is now available, in full, for free. Click the demo button to get it!


You are about to uncover four twisted tales of misadventure surrounding people connected, in some way, by the late Dr. Cyrus Stansfield's cloning machine. Within these stories you must face the ethical dilemmas and possible fortune while guiding each character to their own end.

The story takes place in the city of Starkham; the same location as One Way To Die and The Dope Game, and features recognizable places and characters spanning both games. Owners of previous games will get alternate story chunks unlocked as well.

In the proper fashion of text adventures, the player starts a story and navigates by making decisions at certain times to move forward. Each decision has a variety of outcomes and consequences, many of which have randomized elements to them. Before the start of each story, the player is given the opportunity to change various elements about the story, similar to Mad Libs. These changes will move forward with each story as the player progresses.


The game comes with four stories which are released in episodic fashion:

Story One
The Addict follows the nephew of Dr. Stansfield, Marsch, after he gets out of rehab and inherits his uncle's mansion and lab. Will he fall back to old habits and ruin this opportunity or will he take advantage of it and finally improve his life while continuing the family legacy?

Story Two
The Doctor reveals exactly what happened to Dr. Stansfield leading to his nephew taking over. How did he die? Did he even actually die at all?

Story Three
The Neighbor follows a little girl, Madelyn, who stumbles into the lab after it has been condemned following the nephew's untimely mistakes. She also falls victim to the cloning machine and must not only clear her good name but stop her clone from doing further damage.

Story Four
The Clone is about Aloysius, one of the clones who survives Marsch's failed experiment, who tries to make sense of everything that happened since then as well as unravel the mystery of Dr. Stansfield's death.

The game launched with story one, The Addict, with the additional stories to follow as episodic updates.


The game also keeps track of various statistics, both personal and global, such as decisions made, random events encountered, and wins/losses over games played. Progress on each story's branches is also kept so the player can use it to experience all the different outcomes for each one, if they choose.

There are also a total of twenty-five achievements broken up among the stories, five each, as well as five global ones.

data.name: Endor Awakens: Roguelite DRPG
data.detailed_description:
Endor Awakens is a thrilling evolution of Depths of Endor, a Roguelite DRPG where chaos reigns in the changing world after the fall of Mordoth. In this Dungeon Crawler, you'll venture through procedurally generated dungeons, encountering new challenges and treasures with every step.

The city has transformed with new features:

  • Shop: Buy weapons and armor to prepare for your adventures.

  • Inn: Meet new NPCs, take on common quests, and delve into the main story and side adventures.

  • Guilds: Unlock skills via a new skill tree and customize your character to match your playstyle.

  • Bestiary: Track the monsters you've faced and defeated.

  • Bank: Store items you don't need for later use.

  • Daily Chest: Log in every day for rewards and bonuses.

  • Morgue: Resurrect fallen heroes and continue your journey.

Create your characters by choosing their race, gender, guild, and portrait. Hardcore mode adds extra challenge: if your character dies, there's no coming back. Pick a custom avatar from your device's gallery to make your hero truly unique.

Turn-based combat allows you to strategize every move, whether it's attacking, casting spells, using items, or defending. Beware of traps and events as you explore the depths of dungeons.

Endor Awakens offers endless possibilities for adventure, as you forge your path through this ever-changing world. Your choices shape your journey, with each dungeon and character offering new opportunities. Will you rise to defeat the chaos, or succumb to the darkness of the depths? The fate of Endor lies in your hands.

data.name: Vaulted Valor
data.detailed_description:
Vaulted Valor is a single-player first-person mystery set in a post-apocalyptic underground vault.

You're trapped inside Vault E-9, a supposed sanctuary built to outlast the Great Cataclysm. You entered by choice, but the walls that were meant to protect you now feel more like a cage.

Rumors of people vanishing and whispers of sabotage circulate through the dark corridors, all pointing to one man: the vault's elusive president, Sylas. Explore the labyrinthine sectors, navigate tense relationships with your fellow survivors, and dig into a web of hidden agendas. In this place, every conversation and choice matters.

The truth is waiting, but how deep are you willing to go?

Key Features:

A gripping narrative mystery – Uncover conspiracies, betrayals, and the fate of missing residents.

Choice-driven dialogue – Influence relationships and story outcomes through branching conversations.

Atmospheric world-building – Explore distinct sectors: sanitation, engineering, hydroponics, and more, each with unique NPCs

Multiple outcomes – Your actions determine the outcome for you and your fellow residents.

data.name: Overdrive 2048
data.detailed_description:
Overdrive 2048 is a 2048 × survivors-like mashup: slide tiles with one hand, mow down swarms with the other.

◆ Merging = Charging, OVERDRIVE on YOUR call

every merge charges a 3-segment energy bar. Hit [SPACE] to trigger OVERDRIVE — fire from 1 segment for a quick save, or hold out for all 3 and go full-throttle, longer and stronger, wiping the screen. When to go into overdrive is the core skill.

◆ Bullet-heaven combat

mix 15 main weapons with 10 passives, evolve maxed pairs into super weapons, and fuse two maxed mains into devastating fusion weapons — 17 evolved forms in total. Kill elites to drop treasure chests — spin the slot machine for up to 5 rewards at once!

◆ Mythic milestone protocols

hit 1024, 2048, 4096… each milestone offers 1 of 3 permanent run-wide protocols — boost your firepower, supercharge your OVERDRIVE.

◆ Three modes

Normal (20-min challenge), Quick (10-min chaos, achievement-unlocked), Endless (exponential pressure + Steam global leaderboard).

◆ Meta progression

spend coins on 9 permanent upgrades, unlock 8 characters and hidden weapons through achievements — every run makes the next one stronger.

data.name: Ground Parkour : First Mission
data.detailed_description:
Ground parkour: First Mission, where there are many obstacles and will help you cope with the obstacles.
It is a fun game full of supporting characters and also has a multiplayer system. In the game, you can try to complete the track either online or offline and have new characters. But you should remember that everything is not as easy as it seems. Obstacles can mislead you and get on your nerves. For this reason, always be careful and alert.

The environment of the game is the construction site in the city. Players can have characters with many different themes. For example; You can have many characters such as a worker, a commoner, a boss, an assistant, and add fun to your entertainment with their abilities in the game.

Additionally, the lack of a save function in the game increases the difficulty of finishing the game. You won't get a second chance. Even the slightest misstep can take you back to square one. But your character has different features that will give you an advantage. Depending on the body structure of the characters, some can run fast, some can walk fast, and some can jump high.

Don't be intimidated by the moving obstacles in the game, because your characters are designed to overcome them. Within the map environment; There are moving obstacles, elevators, small and large obstacles, and while these obstacles sometimes give you an advantage, sometimes they can create a disadvantage. There are also objects on the map that will help you jump higher. By using these objects correctly, you can reach the finish point in a shorter time.

Playing the game alone may be boring, so you can increase your fun by inviting your friends.




- You can play with your friends with Online Mode.



- Auxiliary items that will easily take you to heights



- Characters with different physical characteristics.



- Many different categories and characters with different physical characteristics.


Ground parkour: First Mission, in short, you compete with yourself to reach the highest point on the track with different characters and different abilities in a construction site in the city. Each character has different abilities and you progress on this track full of obstacles. Your goal is to reach the finish line at the highest point. Enjoy!

data.name: MechRunner
data.detailed_description:
MechRunner is an endless action game that casts you as a powerful mech in stunning cinematic battles against a relentless robotic army.

Game Story

On June 30th, 1908 a mysterious explosion took place over the Tunguska River in Siberia, Russia that wiped out trees and wildlife for over 800 square miles. To this day it remains the largest “impact event” in our planet’s recorded history.

In the years that followed, dozens of scientific expeditions to the site attempted to explain the disaster but failed to come to any conclusions. In the mid-1940s however, a team of scientists from the Russian secret service visiting the site stumbled upon the wreckage of an alien spacecraft containing technology that far exceeded our own. In the years that followed, the KGB set to work harnessing this mysterious new power source and created a new secret weapons program - The Division of Advanced Weaponry or "O.S.O."

They thought they could control the new power they’d discovered, but it began to do more than run their machines. It began to drive the men working on it mad. The man in charge of the O.S.O., General Yuri Petrakoff, seemed particularly affected and on April 14th, 1949, Petrakoff launched a full scale assault on Europe.

One of Petrakoff’s lead engineers, Jesper Teterev, went AWOL and left the program early, wary of what was happening there. He went to live in secret with his sister, Isabel and niece, Allison. While in hiding however, Jesper (with the help of budding engineer and pilot Allison) was busy building his own mechanized war machine, called the XP-41, certain it may be needed one day to stave off the O.S.O.'s evil creations. He was right.

Gameplay

MechRunner is an endless-style action game mixed with fast and furious mode-changing mech action!

It is a "runner" in that the player is constantly moving forward while tracking down lethal O.S.O. forces but what makes it special is that you’re piloting a giant robot capable of some serious destruction! Other endless runners feature action elements, but none like this. Heat seeking missiles, heavy caliber bullets, laser cannons, and concussion bombs meet destructible buildings, debris littered streets, and tons of slice-able enemies to create a fast paced, visually stunning experience!

A typical game may take anywhere from a few seconds to several minutes to play. The higher your skill, the longer the game, the more rewards you will collect, and the more content you will unlock!

Features

  • Meticulously detailed, fast-paced action
  • Switch between Tank and Robot modes on the fly
  • Slice & Dice disabled enemies in cinematic fashion!
  • Extensive arsenal of weapons, customizations, and power-ups
  • 3 unique environments that blend seamlessly together - you decide when it's time to switch
  • Procedurally generated levels for endless variety
  • Numerous enemy types with different tactics
  • Epic boss battles!
  • Dynamic environmental obstacles
  • Unlockable skins, upgrades, and achievements
  • Rescue civilians and escort them to safety
  • Amazing Hollywood quality soundtrack
  • Optional controls - play with a mouse or controller

data.name: LEGO® Batman™ 2: DC Super Heroes
data.detailed_description:
Legends Unite! The Dynamic Duo of Batman and Robin join other famous super heroes from the DC Universe including Superman, Wonder Woman and Green Lantern to save Gotham City from destruction at the hands of the notorious villains Lex Luthor and the Joker.

Key Features

  • Collect 50 DC Comics characters and flex your new super abilities--soar through the air with free-roaming flight, freeze and push objects with Super-Breath, and heat up and cut holes through objects with Heat Vision.
  • Master new suits and gadgets such as Batman’s Power Suit and Robin’s Hazard Suit equipped with a Pressure Cannon that can absorb and dispense hazardous liquids.
  • Players can also explore Gotham City by walking, flying or unlocking and controlling a variety of cool vehicles including the Batmobile, Batwing and Batboat.
  • For the first time in a LEGO video game, hear the LEGO characters talk!
  • Enjoy the game with friends and family using easy drop-in/drop-out co-op play that features dynamic split screen.

Root of Win is a 3D puzzle game with lots of interesting mechanics, music and small details that are only visible during gameplay.

Root of Win single player game presents a new type of puzzle where you can follow different paths to reach the end and shed light on the creation of this world.

Multiplayer mode for two players provides even more interesting gameplay, unique levels, mechanics and diverse cooperation with your friend. In co-op, you can play with your friend and communicate in the built-in voice chat.

  • 10 cooperative levels
  • Fully original music
  • A lot of interesting game mechanics
  • Never seen before style of game
  • Multiplayer cooperative for two players
  • Many ways to communicate with friend in the cooperative game

data.name: The Lost Hunter
data.detailed_description:
BULLET - TIME EFFECT:

Aim, pull the trigger and follow the bullet's journey moment by moment!

Thanks to the bullet tracking effect in our game, you will be able to track the power and impact of each shot in detail. Take your hunting experience to the next level by tracking every bullet as it reaches the target, whether it's in vast woodlands or open fields.

This feature makes every moment more strategic and exciting. Now it's all up to your sniping skills to hit the target!

CRAFT SYSTEM:

Not only will you hunt the prey, but you'll also process it into valuable resources!

Not only will you get meat from the animals you hunt, but you'll also be able to use the craft system to collect leather and other materials. You can set up camp and build a fire to cook the meat you've gathered, and test your survival skills by preparing your own food.

But the hunt is only the beginning! With the materials you gather, you can craft new equipment, upgrade your weapons or strengthen your camp. You can also chop wood for valuable resources to trade and craft new items with craft mechanics.

Nature offers everything you need to survive - it's just a matter of knowing how to use it!

EAGLE TRACKING SYSTEM:

Your faithful friend, your talismanic eagle, will be your greatest helper during your hunting adventure!

This mysterious and powerful eagle will scour the skies to track prey and guide you. When you lose your way or danger approaches, he will always be by your side.

His keen eyes will make spotting prey and strategizing much easier. This unique bond with your eagle will unite your hunting not only with skill, but also with intuition and the power of nature.

ENERGY DRINK - THE MECHANICS OF SLEEP:

Using the right supplements is just as important as resting to survive!

At certain times, your character can replenish their energy by sleeping or consuming energy drinks. But you have to be careful; nature becomes more dangerous when night falls. Sleeping and consuming energy drinks require you to make strategic decisions about how to spend the night.

If you choose to go without sleep, energy drinks can keep you going, but this will strain your immunity in the long run. If you get sick or injured, antibiotics will be one of the most important resources to keep you alive.

SHOOTING RANGE:

Thanks to the shooting range system exclusive to our game, you can test and improve your shooting skills. Equipped with different distances and targets, it's the ideal environment to hone your aiming skills. Master the range with sharp reflexes and the right strategies and get ready for the real hunting adventure!

TRADE MECHANICS:

You can earn income from hunting by selling resources such as meat, skins and bones to traders who open at certain times. Trading is one of the most important ways to increase your chances of survival. With the money you earn, you can buy the equipment that the trader offers and make the hunting and survival process more efficient. However, traders will not always be open, so you need to time your trades well and use your resources strategically.

data.name: PlanetSmith
data.detailed_description:
Disaster strikes a remote research base on a distant moon. Your escape pod malfunctions and slams into an uncharted, Earth-like planet. You wake with nothing but wreckage, your instincts, and a whole world to tame.

Survive. Build. Escape. But escape is only the beginning. The creatures hunting you are connected to the catastrophe that stranded you here, and whatever caused it has spread across the solar system. Build a ship, launch into space, and find out why no one ever came to rescue you.

  • Fully spherical worlds. Walk in one direction long enough and you will come home again.
  • Seamless space travel. Fly from planet to planet with no loading screens.
  • Survive and progress. Crafting, farming, dungeons, and boss fights on the road to building your ship.
  • Create without limits. Hexagon building in a dedicated Creative Mode.
  • Worlds that make sense. Procedural planets driven by real climate simulation.
  • Play your way. Solo, with friends, or on massive multiplayer servers.

Survive the Landing




Crash-land with nothing and claw your way back. Forage, hunt, and craft your first tools. Cook to stay alive, raise shelter before nightfall, and upgrade your gear as the wildlife grows bolder. Deeper progression unlocks farming, advanced crafting, and equipment forged from rare ores buried far beneath the surface.



The deeper you dig and the further you roam, the deadlier it gets. Delve into dungeons, fight what lives there, and take down the bosses guarding the technology and materials you need for one goal: getting back to space.

A Whole Planet, Not a Map




Every planet is a true sphere with no edges and no invisible walls. Biomes are placed by simulated climate: temperature, rainfall, elevation, and latitude decide where deserts bake, forests spread, and ice gathers at the poles. If you can read a landscape, you can predict where resources will be, so discovery feels earned instead of random.

Build a Ship. Leave the Planet.


Escape is not a cutscene. Build your own spaceship, climb in, and fly it out of the atmosphere yourself. The planet shrinks behind you, the stars sharpen, and the whole solar system opens up for you to explore.

** Image 06 **

Every moon and planet is fully explorable, with harsher conditions, stranger lifeforms, and more advanced resources. Some worlds feel almost familiar. Others have molten oceans, bizarre geological formations, and maze-like terrain twisting across an entire globe. Each landing asks you to adapt all over again as the mystery of the system unfolds.

Create Without Limits




Creative Mode removes every limit: unlimited resources, no threats, and the entire solar system as your canvas. Hexagons open up shapes and angles that block grids never could. Carve and sculpt whole planets into living dioramas, hollow out worlds, raise floating cities, or build scenes that wrap seamlessly around a full sphere.



Every surface is rendered in trixel art, triangular pixels built to match our hexagonal block shapes edge to edge. Where square pixels fight the geometry, trixels follow it, giving every build sharp, seamless detail whether you are shaping a tiny cabin or terraforming an entire planet.

Play Together


PlanetSmith is built to be shared. From day one of Early Access, play the full survival journey solo, team up with friends, or join massive multiplayer servers where whole communities carve up a solar system together.

Growing Through Early Access


PlanetSmith launches into Early Access with Survival and Multiplayer together from day one. From there, the solar system keeps growing: new moons and planets to land on, new creatures to fight, new biomes and resources to discover, and deeper technology to unlock with every update. We build in the open: five years of public devlogs, a funded Kickstarter behind us, and a community whose feedback directs what gets built next.

Wishlist PlanetSmith and follow the devlogs as we build it, in the open, one hexel at a time.

data.name: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice
data.detailed_description:
From the makers of Heavenly Sword, Enslaved: Odyssey to the West, and DmC: Devil May Cry, comes a warrior’s brutal journey into myth and madness.

2021 Update:
Return to Helheim and experience Senua’s world through new eyes with enriched visuals and new features. Upgraded materials, particles and LOD, DirectX Raytracing and optimised performance with NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR support. We have also used this opportunity to include some key accessibility improvements, including full controller remapping and colour blindness settings.

Set in the Viking age, a broken Celtic warrior embarks on a haunting vision quest into Viking Hell to fight for the soul of her dead lover.

Created in collaboration with neuroscientists and people who experience psychosis, Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice will pull you deep into Senua’s mind.





Accessibility Features:

GAMEPLAY
- Accessibility options available on launch within the first-boot options menu.
- Adjustable combat difficulty between dynamically-adjusted 'Auto' mode, or manually-selected 'Easy', 'Medium', or 'Hard' modes.
- Game can be paused both during gameplay and cinematics.

AUDIO
- Custom volume controls can be adjusted for Master, Music, SFX, Voices, and Menu audio.
- Audio output can be adjusted between Stereo and Mono sound modes.

VISUAL
- Color blind modes, and correction intensities can be adjusted for the included Deuteranopia, Protanopia, and Tritanopia filters.
- Subtitles for spoken content can be set to On or Off.
- Subtitle text size can be adjusted between 'Standard' or 'Large'.
- Subtitle text color can be adjusted between White, Orange, Green, or Blue.
- Subtitle backgrounds can be adjusted between Transparent or 'Solid' black.
- Text contrast for menu backgrounds can be adjusted between 'Half-Transparent' or 'Solid' black.

INPUT
- Adjustable input sensitivity for controller joystick and mouse axes, and ability to invert camera axis.
- Input remapping for keyboard keys and controller buttons (camera control and menu navigation keys excluded).
- Full keyboard support allowing the game to be entirely played with a keyboard (arrow keys replace mouse/right stick movement).
- Controller vibration can be set to On or Off.
- Running modifier can be set to be activated on key/button Toggle or Hold.

Note that the listed accessibility options apply to the Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice Enhanced on PC version of the game.

data.name: AFTER 9PM
data.detailed_description:
AFTER 9 PM

Your parents left.
You are home alone.
And the night is just beginning.

AFTER 9 PM is a first-person psychological horror game focused on realism and a heavy, oppressive sense of isolation. You play as a child left alone overnight, where a familiar home slowly begins to distort.

After 9 PM, the house is no longer the same.
Sounds grow louder.
Shadows grow deeper.
And the line between dreams and reality starts to fade.

You must survive the night by completing simple everyday tasks, while unexplainable things begin to happen around you.

Sometimes, it’s just nightmares.
Sometimes… it’s not.

Features:

  • A highly realistic, ordinary home atmosphere

  • Seamless transitions between dreams and reality

  • Psychological tension instead of cheap jump scares

  • Immersive sound design

  • A perception-based experience: can you trust your eyes?

  • Mysterious entities that may not be part of your imagination

You are not a hero.
You are not a hunter.
You are just a child trying to survive the night.

The only rule —
don’t panic.

And wait until morning.

data.name: FrogPop
data.detailed_description:
Small frog. Big bubble trouble.

FrogPop is a pixel-art arcade roguelite about quick dodges, satisfying bubble pops, and finding a build that makes you want one more run. Clear the arena with your tongue, catch Power Bugs for temporary abilities, and combine relics as you push deeper into the pond.

Pop, split, repeat

data.name: Dear Future
data.detailed_description:
Dear Future is a multiplayer wandering game where you photograph a cryptic city using an inherited camera. Working collectively with every other player in the world, you must document the ruined land of your predecessors and lift an ancient curse.

Tread across a procedurally-generated world of pseudoclassical architecture and take photographs in it, saving a single one to pass down to future players. After your first session ends, the next player will inherit the camera and continue from where you left off. What will you leave for those that come after you?

Use the camera tools to create striking and creative photographs. Restore paths to open hidden areas to future players. Leave messages to help future players delve deeper into the city. Uncover hidden truths as you drift the depths together over generations.

A UC Santa Cruz Games & Playable Media MS Capstone Project.

What City Limits Is and is Not

  • City Limits is a chill and relaxing experience. It is best played with headphones. It is deeper than it seems.

  • City Limits is not a super long game. It's not a traditional city builder.

data.name: Utopia: Haven
data.detailed_description:
Utopia: Haven is a retro metroidvania adventure originally developed for the Game Boy Color! Play as Nevan, an explorer of the Galactic Firm, tasked with discovering a planet capable of sustaining humanity’s future.

The Fate of Humanity is in Your Hands

Planet Earth is dying, and humanity stands on the brink of extinction. You embark on a lonesome journey across three distant planets in search of a new home to replace Earth. Many soldiers have walked this path before you, but none have returned to tell their tale.

Will you persevere?

Game Features

  • A 2D Metroidvania adventure inspired by classic games of the genre.

  • Tight, responsive controls with movement abilities such as a double jump to enhance exploration.

  • Three expansive planets, each featuring distinct biomes and immersive environments.

  • Shoot ’em up sections woven throughout the game, acting as unique arcade-style minigames.

  • A progression system with a mix of familiar and unique upgrades to expand your abilities.

  • Retro-inspired visuals that capture the look and feel of classic Game Boy Color titles.

  • A wide variety of unique enemies and challenging bosses to test your skills.

  • A scan system and bestiary that lets you document creatures and complete your logbook.

  • Insignias to collect by completing special in-game objectives. 

  • Fully playable on real Game Boy Color hardware!

data.name: cLocked In
data.detailed_description:
Description:

Step into the boots of a rookie officer in cLocked In, a fast-paced open-world police simulator set in a vibrant, low-poly, fantasy city where humans, orcs, elves, and goblins coexist—and crime never sleeps. You're the newest recruit on the force, starting small but dreaming big. From writing parking tickets in quiet suburbs to breaking up dangerous drug rings and surviving magical shootouts, your rise through the ranks begins now.

Explore Four Unique Districts:

  • Hannara – Human-dominated suburban streets with minor infractions and neighborhood disputes.

  • Morgatelis – Glittering skyscrapers housing wealthy elves and goblins—and the white-collar crimes they commit.

  • DelDedria – A gritty, dangerous zone home to orcs and humans, where gang violence and illegal deals run rampant.

  • Colezaria – An industrial wasteland policed with grit, where orc laborers and criminal rings clash in the factories.

Gameplay & Features:

🛡️ Tier-Based Crime Response

  • Tier 1 (Low-Risk): Chase down fleeing suspects such as graffiti artists, write parking tickets, and detain petty criminals using handcuffs.

  • Tier 2 (Medium-Risk): Use your trusty baton to break up street fights, control vandalism, and disarm and detain drug dealers.

  • Tier 3 (High-Risk): Gear up with a pistol and deploy a futuristic shield to face magical shootouts, bomb threats, and organized bank robberies.

🎖️ Level Up Your Officer
Earn XP and credits by resolving crimes correctly—non-lethal takedowns and appropriate force earn bigger rewards. Level up to take on more dangerous assignments, access higher crime tiers, and unlock perks and cosmetics.

🚓 Customize Your Loadout
Spend your hard-earned credits on:

  • Weapon camos for your pistol and baton

  • New police vehicles including high-speed cars and bikes

  • Weapon upgrades such as ranged and melee damage output as well as magazine size

🎰 Live the Off-Duty Life
Take a break from justice and explore city life:

  • Hit the casino and try your luck at four unique table games using the credits you earn in game

  • Socialize with NPCs, explore district cultures

🔓 Master Your Role
Climb from rookie patrol to elite enforcer. With every promotion (level up), you'll unlock access to new camos, special achievements to unlock vehicles, and the trust of your precinct to handle the city's darkest corners.

What are you waiting for? Serve by the book to bring justice your way. The city awaits, Officer.

data.name: Idle Hoops
data.detailed_description:
Idle Hoops is an incremental idle basketball game. It starts with one kid, one hoop and a driveway. Where it ends is up to you, but it does involve a stadium in space and a goat in a crown.

You shoot. Your team shoots. Everyone scores, even while the game is closed. It's an idle game you can actually play, with a timing meter that rewards a steady hand and a roster that keeps getting stranger the further you go.

Every shot runs on a timing meter. Let go in the green for a perfect swish worth double, then keep it going. Each make in a row adds to your streak multiplier, and miss and it's back to zero. Hold the button down and you'll keep shooting, if you trust your rhythm.

Sign teammates who score for you around the clock. It starts with the neighbour kid and a pickup baller who calls his own fouls. Later you'll be paying a mascot, a robot calibrated to 100% free throws, an alien who grew up in low gravity and, eventually, the actual GOAT. Fourteen of them in total, each with a long ladder of upgrades.

Hit ten in a row and you're on fire: every shot is worth triple until you cool off. Golden balls float onto the court every so often. Catch one for a points frenzy, a lucky windfall, a hot hand, or a full ball rain where every ball that drops pays out.

When a season's gone as far as it can, win the championship. You start over in the driveway, but you keep your rings, and every ring makes the next season faster. Spend them on perks like shooting automatically, keeping more of your offline earnings, or starting each season with a bench already full.

Eventually even rings stop being enough. That's when the Hall of Fame opens. Retire your jersey number and it hangs from the rafters of every court for the rest of the game. In return you get Banners, which boost everything for good and pay for the Front Office: an Auto-Scout that signs players, an Assistant Coach who buys your upgrades, and a Dynasty Planner who wins titles for you when the timing's right. Then you pick a new number and do it all again, faster.

  • 7 courts, from the driveway to the Hall of Fame Arena

  • A wide variety of teammates, and upgrades for every one of them

  • Your own player: pick a number, skin tone, hairstyle, accessories and shoes in the Locker Room

  • Progress while you're away

  • Full controller support, plus mouse and keyboard

  • 29 languages

  • No ads, no energy timers, no micro-transactions

data.detailed_description:
Unleash Carnage Upon Demon-kind

Play as Red, a marine dropped into foreign, demon-ridden arenas, and unleash carnage upon demon-kind.

Fight through brutal encounters, master an arsenal of devastating weapons, and survive hordes of bloodthirsty demons in a relentless and fun battle for survival.

Play with Friends or Randoms

With online co-op, fight against hordes of enemies in an infinitely chaotic survival co-op experience. Coordinate your attacks, watch each other's backs, and fight your way through increasingly chaotic encounters in a fast-paced co-op experience where things can spiral out of control at any moment.

data.name: 無名から伝説のアイドルへ
data.detailed_description:
（This game is only available in Japanese. Some puzzles require an understanding of the Japanese language.）

As the manager of the wildly popular idol group “Miracle Cute,” you are tasked with supporting a young girl auditioning to become their newest member.

But the audition takes an unexpected turn…

It’s a puzzle-solving challenge!?

Only your wit can help her achieve her dream.

The hit idol group “Miracle Cute” is holding auditions to find its next rising star.

However, the selection process is unlike anything anyone expected—it revolves entirely around solving puzzles!

As the group’s manager, you must guide and support a talented young candidate.

If you fail, she’ll lose her chance to join the group…

Search the room for hidden clues, crack mysterious codes, and solve clever puzzles.

Her future is in your hands.

Lead her one step closer to becoming a legendary idol!

Enjoy a short escape room–style puzzle adventure designed to be approachable for both newcomers and experienced puzzle fans.

Experience a unique blend of idols and puzzle-solving in this heartwarming story.

Features

  • Easy to Normal difficulty

  • Includes hints and full solutions

  • Sound effects included

  • Original background music

Estimated Play Time

30–90 minutes

Streaming & Video Content

You are welcome to stream, record, and upload gameplay videos of this game. Monetized videos and livestreams are also allowed.

Credits

  • Sound Effects: Sound Effect Lab

  • Font: Ranobe POP

data.name: Alien on the Radar
data.detailed_description:
Warning! this game is not compatible with mobile version of Alien on the Radar

Arena, cat-and-mouse game between marines and aliens.

The demo is fully functional version of the game, but has only one marine look (the full game has all three looks).

Playing as Marine

Marine tries to discover alien's location and destroy its eggs as soon as possible.

                  When the top time runs out, marines win.

                  The closer marine gets to an alien, the more precise they see alien's position.

*Detection improves with time.

*Only the closest alien gets detected.

                  When a marine stops for a while, they discover alien spawns.

                  Marine uses item maker to get machine gun ammo, or time speed-up.

*Chosen item can't be changed until item maker gets broken.

Playing as Alien

Alien tries to create breeders which then flood marines with minions. When a marine run out of machine gun ammo, an alien itself can finish the job.

                  Mid-game, alien grows and gains a regenerating (yellow) life.

                  Alien knows what marines see.

Red icon means the marine sees alien.

*Bullets hurt alien even when it's not visible.

                  

                  Alien lays eggs. Small egg (left) is undetectable. A big egg (middle) becomes an alien spawn (right):

  • minion (top) attacks marines.

  • artillery (middle) shoots item makers.

  • breeder (bottom) creates minions. The longer it lives, the stronger are minions it creates.

Alien spawns are invisible until a marine stops near them.

                  Artillery shoots item makers.

*When the artillery bullet hangs over the target, It becomes visible to the marines.

*When no item maker in range, artillery shoots marines.

                  When alien breaks an item maker, they gain some time.

Other Features

  • Multiplayer and single player

  • AI Bots

  • Chat and voting to kick players

                  When a character dies, they stay inside game with blacked graphics and skull icon, they can't shoot or attack.

*Hurt marine can still detect spawns (at smaller range).

*Hurt alien can still leave tracks.

data.name: ボク姫PROJECT
data.detailed_description:
少年よ、美少女よりも可愛くなれ。
女装覚醒アドベンチャー「ボク姫PROJECT」。

■プロローグ
女子生徒率99％の超お嬢様学校「私立百合愛学園」。
その学園のルールは「可愛さ」こそ全て。

学園内の謎の事件に巻き込まれた姉を救うため「女子生徒」として入学した
主人公「伊草 ミナト」は、学園一の美少女となるために「女装」を磨いていく。
しかし学園には、別格の可愛さを誇る4人の美少女「四姫」が存在した。

女装少年 ｖｓ 超美少女
前代未聞の「可愛さ」対決が――今始まる！

■キャラクター紹介

●伊草 エリカ　（CV：？？？）
趣味は「家事」、特技は「掃除」と「護身術」。
入学式で変質者を華麗に撃退したことから、『戦姫』と呼ばれる学園の人気者になる。
清楚で礼儀正しく、人当たりもよい性格から同級生からも『お姉さま』と慕われている。
ただ、その素性には、謎も多くて……。


●伊草 ミナト　（CV：？？？）
「伊草エリカ」の実の姿（♂）。
姉・マリカの身に起きた事故の真相を探るため、女装をしてお嬢様学校に潜入することになった正真正銘の男子高校生。
本心では「漢らしい男」を目指すが、姉のマリカを崇拝するドシスコンが故に、羞恥心を押し殺して“女装”に挑むことになる。



●伊草 アキラ　（CV：川上ゆき）
主人公・エリカ（ミナト）の従姉妹で幼馴染。
実は彼女こそが本物の「伊草エリカ」で、ミナトに女装をさせた張本人。
自分の代わりにミナトを通学させ、自分は自宅でゲームを楽しむ生粋のひきこもり。
卑屈な皮肉屋で、ミナトに対しても毒舌気味だが、本当はミナトのことが大好き。


●鬼灯 リラ　（CV：河瀬茉希）
見た目は天使、中身は小悪魔なカリスマギャル。
天才的なファッションセンスとメイク技術を持ち、JKの間で大人気の読者モデルでもある。
自分以外の生徒を「雑草」呼ばわりする毒舌家だが、ヒトの努力は決して笑わない誠実な一面も持つ。
実は、ドがつくほどの隠れオタク。


●龍宮院 ウラン　（CV：白城なお）
黒髪ロングに和風の羽織り、性格はおっとりマイペース。
華道に茶道、日舞に箏を得意とする、超が付くほどの“大和撫子”。
ただし、世俗から隔離された生い立ちから、男性や洋風文化には今まで縁がなく、壊滅的な洋菓子や英語を披露することもしばしば。


●姫神 エルメス　（CV：ななひら）
国民的人気を誇るトップアイドルであり、学園一の姫の称号「姫皇」の名を持つ美少女。
間近でウインクされれば、可愛さのあまり吹き飛んでしまうほどの「美少女」の化身。
多忙のため学園に来ることは稀だが、何故か時折ミナトの前に現れては親しげに話しかけてくる等、その行動には謎が多い。



●姫神 ダリア　（CV：寺井らん）
エルメスの姉であり、彼女を守る「騎士」。
見目麗しい外見と、優雅な立ち振舞から姫“騎士”と称されている。
優しく面倒見がよい反面、美少女を見ると口説かずにはいられない困った一面も…。
エリカの姉・マリカとは親友でもあった。

■ストーリー
主人公「伊草ミナト」は、男は女の子を守るものという考え方をもち、強い男を志す少年。
──にもかかわらず、女装してお嬢様学校へと潜入するはめになってしまう！！
さらには、学園最高峰の美少女「四姫」たちとの人気対決で、美少女の頂点を目指すことに！？


姉を救うため、やむなく美少女となって女生徒たちと交流するミナト。
しかし、お嬢様学校の女生徒たちは、女の子同士（？）のスキンシップにためらいがなく……！！
戦姫「伊草エリカ」の正体を隠し通すには、女装を極めるしかない？！


突然のことに戸惑うミナトだったが、姉・「マリカ」を昏睡に追いやった事故の真相に
たどりつくため、校内で絶大な影響力をもつ「四姫」の座を目指すことを決意する。
従妹である「アキラ」の協力や「四姫」との交流を通して、ミナトは戦姫「伊草エリカ」として、女装に磨きをかけていく。
だが、ミナトを待っていたのは想像を超える苦難の連続だった……。



■ゲームの進め方
シナリオは章立てで構成されており、物語を読み進めるタイプのアドベンチャーゲームです。
あなたは『伊草エリカ』として、学園一の美少女を目指して生活していきます。


イベントシーンではイラストが見られることも。
シナリオを進めてコンプリートを目指しましょう。



エリカには『ビジュアル』『教養』『精神』という３種類のステータスが存在します。
各ステータスの数値は、物語中の選択肢『特訓』によって変化していきます。
エリカのステータスによって、シナリオ展開に分岐が発生します。

data.name: A Love Like Broken Glass
data.detailed_description:
It’s simple. You’re an exorcist, he’s a ghost. Except… not really?

On a visit to a client’s haunted house, you find that this handsome ‘full-bodied apparition’ is a little more ‘full body’ than you’d anticipated.

There’s something wrong with Lorenn’s soul. Something wrong with this house. And with your client refusing to cooperate until you’ve finished the job…

Looks like you’ve got the world’s cutest half-dead roommate on your hands!

A Love Like Broken Glass is a story-rich romance visual novel, featuring:

  • You, a self-trained exorcist with a penchant for teasing pretty boys.

  • Lorenn, an adorably clumsy post(ghost?)-grad with a penchant for being teased.

  • The looming threat of his fractured soul, fated to fade away before your very eyes...

  • And a not-so-safe soul-linking ritual that twists his innocent feelings into obsession, spiralling quickly out of control. But that’s nothing you can’t handle, right?

From roommates, to friends, to literal soul-mates… Nobody ever said exorcism was easy. Love is even harder.

And when you’re all out of time, will either of you be ready to say goodbye?

  • A gender-neutral protagonist, with appearance otherwise unspecified.

  • (New!) Full professional voice acting! See cast below!

  • An original soundtrack that will make you bop your head or pluck at your heartstrings at any moment’s notice.

  • Adorable character sprites and event CGs.

  • ~60k words (4-8 hours of gameplay), and varying dialogue trees that’ll allow you to flirt and tease to your heart’s content.

  • FOUR different endings: and only one leads to your happily ever after. You and Lorenn’s fate is in your hands now; will you find your way to a blissful eternity?

  • A gallery of every unlockable CG viewable at any time!

  • A music room, in which you can play, pause, and shuffle each track you unlock as the game progresses!

  • The prettiest, most loveliest ghost boy that will stay in your soul forever.

The following topics appear across the game’s story(+ = mild, ++ = moderate, +++ = frequent):

  • Depression ++

  • Death and the afterlife +++

  • Unhealthy attachment styles ++

  • Possessiveness and jealousy +

Many thanks to the incredibly talented cast, for helping breathe new life into the script!

  • Elaine Deveaux as Lorenn

  • Harold Ingram-Gaither as Quinn

  • Dontae Majors as Mr Mortimer

  • MekhiWilsonVO as Ticket Guy

  • Ekamy as Unnamed Friend

data.name: Corrupted Skies
data.detailed_description:
THE SKIES ARE CORRUPTED. YOUR ARMY IS ALL YOU HAVE LEFT.

Corrupted Skies is a tactical, turn-based card battler where three factions clash in brutal 1v1v1 warfare. There's no hand-holding, no mercy — just you, your army, and two rivals who want the same thing you do: survival.

Command a Living Army
Your units don't wait in your hand — they stand on the battlefield from the first turn, bleeding, dying, and turning the tide of war with every decision you make.

Every Spell Is a Gamble
Heal, buff, poison, burn, or strike from afar. Your hand refills each turn, but so does theirs — and in a three-way war, your enemies are watching each other just as closely as they're watching you.

Build Your Collection
Crack open packs, level up your units, and grow a deck that reflects how you play — whether that's brute force, slow attrition, or calculated precision.

No Two Matches Alike
With four distinct factions, dozens of unique units, and a battlefield that shifts with every turn, no two runs feel the same.

Will your army still be standing when the corruption clears?

data.name: Humanity: First Woman In Space
data.detailed_description:
Create more harmony and equality - reduce discrimination in the world! Feel how it is to be the first woman astronaut.

What Is Humanity?

Humanity: First Woman in Space transports you into the body of the first woman to go into space. View the world through the eyes of Astronaut Turova as she navigates through the male dominated world of astronaut training. Experience how it feels when most people around you don't believe in you. Research shows that this type of experience can reduce your bias: by playing Humanity: First Woman in Space, you are not only having fun but you are increasing harmony in the world!

Compatibility

This is a Virtual Reality experience that will work on any SteamVR compatible device! It will also work with an Oculus Quest 1 or 2 using an Oculus Link or Virtual Desktop.

Status

Humanity: First Woman in Space is still in development and for now only the first part of the story - before the Rocket Launch - is available. We are looking forward to your feedback to shape the second part of the story, which happens in the spaceship. The second part of the story will include: asteroid shooting, panels fixing, 0 gravity flying.

How Does It Work?

Humanity: First Woman in Space is based on scientific research about increasing empathy and decreasing bias/ discrimination through the use of Virtual Reality. If you’re interested in learning more about these topics, please reach out to us.

Who Are We?

Our mission is to transform and empower people and organizations with Virtual Reality. We are a Berlin-based startup. We combine cutting-edge technology with the latest scientific research and a great passion for innovation. Together we share the vision of an awakened humanity, happy, healthy, aware, caring for themselves with joy!

Credits

  • Thanks to Lucas King for his music.

Help Us

Every feedback is greatly appreciated! We are creating this story together and we would be more than happy to integrate the features you want. Please, tell us what you liked, what you would like to change, or what you would love to see in the second part.

If you’d like to support us, you can do so by rating this experience, by joining our Discord or by sharing this experience!

data.name: Capesong
data.detailed_description:
CAPESONG IS IN EARLY DEVELOPMENT -- STAY TUNED FOR UPDATES! 
Wishlist to follow along as new features, art, and content are added.

Capesong is a superheroic plan-and-clash strategy game where you create original characters and send them into battle, aiming to build the ultimate squad. Every hero wields a unique combination of elemental affinities and superhuman traits that defines their style. Use post-battle rewards to enhance their strengths, but push your luck too far and you'll lose them forever.

Every run starts with a new hero, created with a personality and a powerset. Lay out their combat plans and guide them through an increasingly challenging gauntlet of enemies. Between fights, spend shards to deepen their strengths or branch into new abilities. But be aware, every shard spent on healing is a shard not spent on growth. Heroes who survive long enough can earn a permanent spot on the Global Defenders, your ultimate squad of five. Heroes who don't are gone for good.

Battles play out on a shared timeline. Each round, you and your opponent set your strategies, making reads and counter-reads to gain an advantage. Chips are revealed simultaneously and collide tick by tick. Use the power of wind to stagger their timing. Siphon momentum with darkness to stop their plans before they start. Or frost the ground with ice then knock them out while their defenses are impaired.

Placement is the key to victory. Different powers can react to your opponent's, boost elemental effectiveness, disrupt the enemy's timing, or set other conditions that shift the flow of battle in your favor. Arrange your sequence so that each power makes the next one more dangerous while dismantling whatever your opponent has lined up. The ability to execute your plan, and to thwart your enemy's, is at the heart of every encounter.

The ultimate goal is the Global Defenders, your permanent squad of five. Heroes who survive long enough can earn a spot on the roster, but each new addition means retiring an existing member. The squad auto-battles are where thoughtful composition beats raw power, as a well-balanced team built with intention will often outperform a mismatched collection of individually strong heroes. Compose your team with care... the fate of the world depends on you!

I've always loved the idea of creating my own superheroes and watching them come to life. I'm also a huge fan of tactical card games, strategy battlers, and squad builders. Capesong is my attempt to combine the joy of creating original characters with the strategic depth of a satisfying deckbuilder or combat roguelike. Every hero is born with their own identity, personality, and abilities, granting different strengths and weaknesses to manage on each run. The goal is a game where your creativity and your strategy matter equally, and where every decision carries real weight.

Though it may be hard to believe, our world has recently seen the emergence of actual flesh-and-blood superheroes. Flashy costumes. Fantastic powers. The whole nine yards. At first, most dismissed it as some kind of social media publicity stunt. But when the Global Defenders arrived in the nick of time to thwart a monster invasion off the coast of California, the truth could no longer be denied. Earth had entered a new age.

But what prompted this sudden transformation, and what mysterious force is guiding the superpower-granting shards to find their unsuspecting hosts? In Capesong, you take control of ordinary people whose lives are upended the moment a shard chooses them. Guide them through their first uncertain battles as they struggle to understand their new abilities, develop new powers from the remnants of defeated enemies, and grow strong enough to protect the universe.

The ranks of the Global Defenders are constantly in flux, and your heroes can earn a place among them. But the choice is yours: accept a hard-earned spot on the roster and secure your hero's legacy, or keep pushing deeper into danger to build them even stronger. Every additional battle is a chance to make your hero more powerful, but losses are final, and those who fail are gone for good.

___

PLEASE NOTE: Capesong is a text-description-heavy game, and at this time, only English language support is being developed. Thanks for your understanding!

data.name: Nightmare Loop
data.detailed_description:
Explore a dark vision of early-2000s Gdańsk, a real city transformed into an unsettling nightmare. Uncover its mysteries, explore familiar places, and confront something lurking beneath reality in this psychological horror adventure.

You play as Oskar.

Explore a dark vision of early-2000s Gdańsk, a real city with a second face. Uncover its mysteries, from a kilometre-long concrete apartment block to the Baltic coast, and descend into the Nightmare lurking beneath reality.

Following the clues, Oskar begins to uncover a hidden layer of reality lurking beneath the familiar world around him. The deeper he goes, the harder it becomes to tell what is real, what is imagined, and what should have remained forgotten.

Poland, early 2000s. Gdańsk.

Explore a faithfully recreated version of a real, living city. From towering concrete apartment blocks and quiet residential streets to cemeteries, forests, and the Baltic coastline. These are places that actually exist, brought into the game and transformed into the setting of Oskar’s story.

Experience the early 2000s, when dial-up internet, CRT monitors, mobile phones, and the first online communities were changing everyday life. Beneath this familiar nostalgia, however, something else is taking shape.

As technology spreads through the city, the boundary between the physical world and something far older begins to collapse.

Nightmare Loop

Reality is not as stable as it seems. Familiar places become distorted, ordinary moments turn unsettling, and every discovery raises new questions about what is happening to Oskar and why.

Explore two versions of the same city: the Gdańsk you recognize and its disturbing reflection — the Nightmare. Uncover a story filled with mystery, occult influences, and unexpected twists as you descend deeper into the Nightmare, where nothing can be taken at face value.

Game Features

  • Psychological and digital-occult horror with a mysterious story, deep lore, and unexpected twists

  • A real city brought into the game - explore faithfully recreated locations from Gdańsk.

  • Two visions of reality - move between the Gdańsk you know and the Nightmare, its distorted reflection

  • A unique camera system combining third-person, first-person, and side-scrolling perspectives

  • Early-2000s nostalgia - experience the era of dial-up internet, CRT screens, mobile phones, and the dawn of the digital age

  • Varied gameplay combining exploration, combat, puzzles, and original gameplay mechanics

data.name: Way Far Home
data.detailed_description:
Tags: Hardcore, Platformers, Adventure

Join the Hardcore adventure with little Fox. Travel through lands and sky, discover the secret of the Jungle. Overcome the suffering of exhaustion, painfulness, lost in fear. Find true love.

Way Far Home is a story about the little Fox, who gets bored of normal daily life. He decided to hang out, to start his own "heroic" adventure. Everything looked like to be a normal trip, but he didn't know his first adventure would change his life forever.

data.name: Crown's Trial
data.detailed_description:
Crown's Trial is a Souls-Like Boss Rush where each battle takes place in a different realm. Master the tight combat mechanics to defeat legendary heroes inspired from various historical eras like Ancient Rome, Feudal Japan, and The Crusades.

History's Greatest Warriors

Plunge into a fantasy world where legendary figures from across time await your challenge.

Freedom to Choose

Explore a stunning, non-linear experience that gives you total freedom. Decide which legendary enemy falls first. The order is entirely up to you.

Unique Combat

Enter each fight with a unique load-out and abilities, as well as it's own core mechanic that you'll need to master to triumph.

Immersive Locations

No arena is like the other. Each with its own unique era, look and feel, get ready to step into an entirely different world with each challenge.

Cinematic Narrative

Become invested in your foe's most crucial moments through a series of well crafted illustrations, and a fully-voiced narrative.
