data.name: Sun Breed
data.detailed_description:
THE STORY

WARNING 18+: Life has been tough for you as a half-vampire because your kind isn't the most welcome. Add to that your human mother and vampire father are killed when you’re still fairly young.. The tragic incident has brought you closer to your childhood friends Valentine and Camilla, with their parents having been close with your mother since high school. There’s also the vampire sisters Aditi and Najah that you’re just as close with, with your father who was the clan’s war general and strategist being close with their mother who is the current clan leader. The vampire sisters don’t exactly see eye-to-eye with the human sisters, but you try to keep the peace as much as possible, because they're all you have.

Your already difficult life becomes a lot more so when vampires and humans alike suddenly start coming up dead. The very same way your parents died. Before you were young and weak, but now as a relations officer dealing with both vampires and humans, you will investigate who or what exactly is doing this and finally get your revenge.

THE GAME PLAY

In Sun Breed, you play as the main character and take control of all the decision-making, such as choosing the way you conduct your investigations into the murders, whether that be a more diplomatic or aggressive approach. You'll also be deciding which characters you'll be spending time with, and how you interact with them. Most choices have hidden points that you gain or lose, so be careful before making a decision!

***A free in-game walkthrough is also included for those who have trouble with selecting the correct choices, or for players who want to access every scene!***

FEATURES

- Name your own character

- Define the relationship within the game

- Select choices that shape the story you want

- Replay the game and choose different choices to access all content

data.name: Lies Under Ice
data.detailed_description:
Lead the first settlement on Jupiter's frozen moon, Europa! What alien life lurks beneath the ice? Who is sabotaging your mission? Who can you trust?

Lies Under Ice is a 200,000-word interactive science fiction novel by Joey Jones, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

The year is 2079. Your mission is to build a settlement, explore Europa's treacherous oceans, terraform the moon, and send findings back to Earth.

But political factions within your colony vie for dominance, constantly on the brink of open conflict. While they are technically collaborating on this mission, each one has their own goals for Europa. Will this colony be a site for new trade? A home for Earth's ever-growing population? A clean slate where humans can break free of older social models? How far will each side go to get what they want?

With the most advanced science at your disposal—massive terraforming systems, gene splicing, AI therapy-bots, nerve-connected bionic prosthetics, and more—you can venture from the safety of your spaceship out into the hostile frozen world. Descend beneath the ice of Europa, pilot a submarine through frigid waters that no human has ever seen, and uncover ancient secrets of an alien world.

There's definitely alien life here. But does it pose a danger to you and your fellow settlers, or is it the greatest opportunity that humanity has ever known?

  • Play as male, female, or nonbinary; gay, straight, bi, or aromantic; poly or monogamous.
  • Choose among six distinct professional backgrounds: diplomat, aerospace engineer, arcologist, asteroid miner, pilot, or marine biologist.
  • Manage the complex needs of an extraterrestrial base: prioritize the comfort of the workers, maximize scientific output, build luxury domes, dig mazes of ice tunnels, or engage in terraforming.
  • Navigate the treacherous politics of Earth’s squabbling factions from millions of miles away!
  • Interact with Europa's alien ecosystem: will you release fish as a sustainable food source, bring along cats for companionship, or rely on synthetic creatures to avoid introducing invasive species?
  • Run for office in Europa's fledgling government!

Delve beneath the ice, and reach for the stars!

data.name: Haiju
data.detailed_description:
Plot

Play as Raiju, an electric dog spirit searching for his missing brother Fuju, a Benevolent Wind Spirit whose disappearance has thrown the winds into chaos. With powerful yokai emerging in his wake, collect the 36 Heavenly Wind Bells to unlock the path forward and bring him home.

Play Your Way

Haiju is a classic collectathon at heart, with optional RPG elements for players seeking deeper narrative and worldbuilding, designed so neither system ever interrupts the flow of the other. All dialogue and NPC interaction is entirely optional, woven into the RPG layer for those who choose to engage with it. Drop in for a short session or stay for the long haul. 

The World

Haiju is rooted in traditional Japanese mythology and folklore, bringing ancient spirits, sacred landscapes, and timeless legends to life across every realm.

Boss Fights

The deeper you dig into Haiju's world, the more secrets reveal themselves. Seek out hidden boss battles that demand skills beyond the standard game, and track down the wise sages to learn the abilities needed to topple these ancient foes.

Features

  • Explore an expansive array of spirit realms, each connected to a grounded central hub world

  • Glide across vast distances to reach hidden paths and secret areas

  • Scorch yokai with Raiju's electrical shock attack

  • Channel the thunderous Taiko drum to charge through obstacles at high speeds

  • Uncover ancient lore through the spirits and villagers you meet along the way

  • Solve environmental puzzles woven into the landscape itself

  • Collect Heavenly relics to complete each realm

  • Revisit each realm to uncover new NPC interactions and tackle time challenges

Inspiration

Spyro the Dragon meets Okami, with a hint of Princess Mononoke

data.name: Bridge Constructor Playground
data.detailed_description:
Bridge Constructor Playground on Discord


About the Game

Bridge Constructor Playground offers people of all ages an introduction to the topic of “bridge building”. This game gives you the freedom to let your creative side run riot – nothing is impossible. Across 30 innovative levels you have to build bridges over deep valleys, canals or rivers. Following this your bridges will be subjected to a stress test to see whether they can support the weight of the cars and/or trucks which drive across them.

In comparison to the #1 hit Bridge Constructor, Bridge Constructor Playground offers an even easier entry to the game including an extensive tutorial. With no fixed budget, and next to no limitations on building materials, there are almost no limits: you can build and construct to your heart’s desire. Here you are free to do as you please and let the time fly by with creative bridge building. Experienced players will enjoy the challenges of the new badge system: for every bridge there are 5 badges to be won for which you must fulfill certain requirements. For example, building a bridge that can carry no more than a certain load limit. All of this, paired with a bright and friendly look, makes Bridge Constructor Playground an exciting as well as educational experience for the whole family, offering hours of gaming fun.

Key Features

  • 32 Levels
  • 5 Settings: City, Canyon, Beach, Mountains, Rolling hills
  • Survey map with unlocked worlds / levels
  • Extensive tutorial for easy entry to the game
  • New badge system for beginners and pros
  • 4 different building materials: wood, steel, steel cable, concrete piles
  • Percentages and colored visualization of building material’s stress loads
  • Two different stress levels: car and truck
  • High score per Level
  • Steam Achievements and Leaderboards

data.name: Kingdom Rush Origins - Tower Defense
data.detailed_description:
The most addicting tower defense game returns in an all-new prequel adventure - welcome to Kingdom Rush Origins!

Kingdom Rush Origins is the third installment of the award-winning Kingdom Rush saga, loved by millions and earning accolades from gamers and critics around the globe. Take a trip back to the beginning, before Vez’nan ever thought to threaten the kingdom with the gem of power, and experience even more of the lightning-fast, exceptionally captivating gameplay that made the franchise a cornerstone of essential tower defense games. In this exciting prequel, command your elven army and defend mystical lands from sea serpents, evil sorcerers, and wave after wave of gnoll tribesmen, all with the help of brand-spankin’ new towers, heroes, and spells to fend off every last baddie.

Kingdom Rush Origins packs in a treasure trove of new content and features while keeping the signature look that millions have come to love.

Key Features

  • Re-enter the world of Kingdom Rush: visit mysterious elven forests, magical faery realms and even floating ruins of an ancient metropolis!

  • Unleash the power of the elves with brand new towers and troops! Elf Archers, Mystic Mages, Stone Druids and the Elven Infantry make up the backbone of your army.

  • Discover new specialized tower upgrades with over 18 abilities! Vanquish your enemies with elven marksmen, runed bears, magic-wielding wizards, and even giant animated trees.

  • Take up arms against new enemies and engage in epic boss battles! Face hordes of Gnolls, giant spiders, and the terrible Twilight army.

  • Master and upgrade legendary heroes and their awesome powers and spells!

  • Rain lightning, summon reinforcements, and use each hero’s unique power to obliterate scores of enemies!

  • Immerse yourself in hours of gameplay with over 70 achievements, with three difficulty modes for the newbs and veterans alike.

  • Play different game modes - Classic, Iron, and Heroic - and prove your mettle as a master tactician.

  • Study your enemies and your towers with an in-game encyclopedia.

data.name: Sweet Train
data.detailed_description:
Sweet Train - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with train as the theme. It tells the story of the encounters of five pretty and cute girls on the train, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girls' photos in the gallery.

- The game has three levels of difficulty: 2x2, 2x4, 4x4 puzzles

- Press "F" to turn on black and white when doing puzzle

- Players can complete the puzzle by pressing the 'Blank' key during the game.

- Players can quickly view girl pictures by pressing the AD key, left and right keys or the left and right keys of the mouse in the gallery

* Puzzle image size is 800x960 px

* Gallery image size is 1088x960 px

data.name: Beer Bar
data.detailed_description:
The god's wraith falls upon citizens of a small town, corrupted by the sin of alcoholism. They cursed the local bar. The huge beer keg will constantly be filled with this filthy drink. It must be destroyed before it gets overfilled and destroys the entire city!
By the will of fate, the only sober resident of the city work as a bartender. Empty the keg by filling and distributing drinks. The more visitors you serve, the more you earn money and you can buy new characters and change the look of the bar.
Do not overfill the keg and reasonably distribute drinks, because visitors need a break. Some of them will not be able to drink a few mugs in a row.
The life of the local population lies in your hands. Save the city from the wrath of the gods and the explosion of a bottomless keg!

Game features:
Mystical plot.
Simple and addictive gameplay.
The game does not contain dialogs and texts (only the description of the gameplay).
Earn in-game currency and buy new characters and change the type of bar.

data.name: Dream Factory
data.detailed_description:
Sitting in front of a screen or TV you might think that the process behind filming and producing a movie is a piece of cake. Try and play Dream Factory first. With this Filming Simulator you will ‘dive’ headfirst into the busy world of movie making.

Dream Factory is a PC (Win, Mac, Linux) and tablet (iOs, Android) based Simulator game. The movie making process doesn't always catch everyone’s attention because everyone likes watching the final result. But many of us really do like to know what lies behind the curtain, behind the stage…

Our approach is to look at the industry in an ironic way. We’ve reviewed many different samples and cliches of both the old and modern Hollywood Industry, and rediscovered the most memorable names who made the filming culture of 20th-21st centuries what it is today.

In Dream Factory you will have to create and organize the movie process, you will have to deal with greedy marketeers and tricky-chicky finance directors, while also having to put all your efforts to butter up capricious actors. On top of this you will have to learn how to build your studio and production company, brick by brick while, dealing with accounting problems and the like.

But it won’t be a boring process, as we aim to take the humor and irony of the real world filming process and bring it into to our game. You can play the demo on our website & give the games mechanics a go.

Our story starts from at the very beginning, that is from brothers Lumiere's era and then continues through epoch by epoch to today and even beyond. That means Dream Factory will give you a glimpse into the future.

In the final version of the game you will engage in the following tasks:
  • Studio building process
  • Screenplay writing
  • Movie shooting process
  • Movie promotion by means of marketing campaign
  • Solve different complicated tasks and objectives
  • Level up your characters
  • Discover new movie genres
  • Track the needs of your characters
  • Act according to the cases prescribed in the contract for actresses and actors
  • Avoid waves of fans
  • Manage Actors who are affected by traumas and nervous breakdowns or manage situations where Actors have died while shooting a film
  • Receive awards and participate in exhibitions
  • Compete with your friends and attract their or other competitors actors to your own studio
  • Look up the reviews in press after the movie released and track what was done right and what was done wrong
  • Buy new territory to expand and grow your studio

We plan to have 21 type of characters with at least 20 modifications to be drawn for each character to provide the game with more variation. All characters are hired via a HR market that is generated randomly during game play. Super-skilled characters (with high fame or status) may be found on the market alongside with unknown ones which you will have to train and grow yourself. Each type of character will posses his or her own modifiers (traits) that will influence certain game aspects. These traits are added to a character when they're born. Also during the process of filming, relationships between your staff may also come into being. These can be both positive and negative. For example, some relationships may influence other characters to leave the studio. We have already show some of the characters we plan to add below, but we plan to add more from the cinema industry, such as Audio Engineers, Movie Directors or Producers, Stage Movie Directors, Janitors, Managers, Handymen, Finance Directors, Marketeers, Costume and Makeup Artists, Extra Actors, Stunt Coordinators.

data.name: SEED
data.detailed_description:
START A WORLD

SEED is a persistent, player-driven MMO that simulates humanity in a world that never sleeps.

Welcome to Avesta, a planet where humanity has a second chance to define its future. Every character, known as a Seedling, is a bio-engineered human who works, sleeps, and socializes based on their own schedule. Seedlings coexist autonomously in the same shared, persistent world, working together and forming lasting connections, even while you’re offline.

Built by former EVE Online developers, the planet of Avesta is truly persistent, evolving over time based on the decisions of the Seedlings and you, their beloved Cultivators.

THE STAKES ARE REAL

In SEED, survival is a collaborative effort: if you don’t produce food, others don't eat; if others don't build shelter, you have nowhere to stay. Because the simulation runs around the clock, the stakes are high; failure to maintain your community’s production could mean the permanent death of your Seedlings.

DEEP INTERACTION

SEED leverages Perspective, a system that allows Seedlings to think, feel and from true emergent relationships with each other and, you, the Cultivator. Talk directly to your characters via the Seedling Chat, with every conversation having a lasting impact on the development of your Seedlings and the surrounding society.

PLAYER-DRIVEN EVERYTHING

From the smallest chair to the most complex machinery, every item in Avesta is gathered, crafted and sold by players in a completely player-driven economy. As your camp grows into a city, you must navigate the challenges of collaborative governance. Form shared societies and define your own laws, ranging from fair democracies to strict authoritarian dictatorships.

BUILD A LASTING LEGACY

In this single-shard MMO, everyone shares the same world. Seedlings have life cycles and eventually pass away, so your decisions carry long-term weight. The relationships, conflicts and history they build with one another leave a lasting mark on Avesta, shaping the course of humanity.

You are just a regular guy, who just happens to be around a beautiful girl, among 8 candidates, you can pick from the stern but kind Beatrice, the seductive and airhead nurse Clara, to the endlessly emotional and passionate Felis, and 5 others more!. Reach their heart and drown in love.

Additionally, if breaking bricks is your thing, you can enjoy the endless mode, where everything is randomized and chaos will certainly ensue!

data.name: 9Grids VR
data.detailed_description:
*Content Update*

Hard Mode
We have implemented a Hard Mode that comes along with a World 1 environment re-skin.
In Hard Mode, the player can only take 5 damage (between 1 to 3 hits) and it's game over.
It is strongly recommended to familiarize yourselves with the controls using the standard mode.

---------
There will be other free content updates in the form of new worlds, weapons and modes (how quickly they are implemented is dependent on interest in the game).

Bug-fixed and optimization updates: Our current priority is bug fixes and weapon optimization - The sword attack gesture is rather restricted currently (only upward to downward slashes) and the hammer needs better targeting.

Planned Content Updates
ii. World 3 - Vote between the following:
a. 'Bosses' only levels - where each enemy has more HP and unique abilities
b. Different mechanics - player to battle in close combat (room-scale style) and hop between different platforms
iii. Multiplayer Versus Mode

We target to have World 3 up in a couple of months, depending on our progress on bug fixes.


About the Game

9 Grids VR is an arcade-style, fast-paced, short and easy fun game for the HTC Vive that is a combination of whack a mole and dodgeball in a apocalyptic world.
*Please note that you MUST have a HTC vive in order to play the the game!*

Slash or blast up your enemies and dodge their attacks by moving physically around the unique 9 Grids movement system!

Features
Currently 2 Worlds available with 5 levels each. Game-time is approximately 3 minutes for each level.

Gameplay
▪ Achieve the highest kill score while taking as little damage as possible
▪ Waves of enemies with increasing difficulty
▪ Defeat a boss at the end of the level
[To start round, use weapon to touch 'Start' button. Then use weapon to hit the level orbs that are orbiting around player. To change between worlds, press top left touchpad button]

Watch Level Select Tutorial Video at

Movement Mechanisms
▪ There are 9 locations (in the form of logs or rocks) and the player can hop to any of the location to dodge projectiles
▪ Layout of the 9 locations is similar to the numpad
▪ Enemies spawn in a separate set of 9 locations in front of the player
To move, player has the current two options:
Basic - Press trigger and move in real life to hop to the next location in game
Auto - Trigger button not required before each hop
[Press both triggers to toggle between Basic and Auto]

Watch Movement Tutorial Video at

Attack Mechanisms
Sword: Slash from up to down (vertically or diagonally) or from right to left to unleash a sword arc
Hammer (experimental): Hammer motion - Raise the hammer up high and strike downwards - to call lightning strikes
Gauntlet (experimental): Punching motion - from back to forwards - to fire energy punches
Each weapon has a different hit radius and damage. Possible to wield two different weapons at the same time.
[Hold grip button and bring current weapon behind player - Imagine there is a sheath on your back]

Watch Weapon Tutorial Video at


------
Developer's Comments
The game may still contain several bugs at this point of time. We have priced the game with the consideration to increase prices in the future with more content updates, somewhat like an early access title / pre-order. All proceeds will go towards game content.
Early buyers get free content updates although if there isn't much interest in this genre, there's the risk of little future content.
We appreciate all feedback and support (in terms of comments or reviews)!

data.detailed_description:
Gear's Life is a story-driven puzzle adventure which takes place inside of your computer. You’ll have to explore this unusual world and befriend its residents. Travel around the fallen kingdom and get to know its key characters. They will teach you all the necessary royal skills: how to run, jump, teleport, write, read, move rocks… and maybe something else, I don’t remember everything, ha-ha. In other words, they’ll prepare you for the trial which proves if you’re worthy to become the next ruler of these lands. But are all of them completely honest?.. Learn the truth behind your true purpose!


[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION]

Source: Damaged diskette №?..

Status: Data recovery and Decryption. 

[DECRYPTING...]

Recovered file from the damaged diskette:

"At first glance, it's a simple story about a hero destined to become the king of these lands...

But there's something wrong with these lands - even I no longer know what it is, and I never will…

I have one last request: do grant me my final wish and discover what hides beneath the shadows of these lands. Only then shall my soul find rest.

Thank you for at least hearing me out. 

Farewell, wanderer!"

[END OF FILE]

Do you dare to solve this mystery?

data.name: Wait - Extended
data.detailed_description:
"Wait" is a mystery horror game, inspired by the works of H.P Lovecraft and the Silent Hill series.
The gameplay is put together by elements of exploration and riddle solving.
We want to offer a different kind of horror. A horror without jump scares or fighting monsters, but with the fear of the unknown and unimaginable.

What is "Wait"?


The game is all about atmosphere and we wanted to support that by giving the player the opportunity to interact with almost every object at different times during the game.
It's about exploration and discovering what is happening around you.
Everything in "Wait" is experienced by a young man, the player knows nothing about. And it's intended to be that way.
You are literally thrown into another mans life and you can find out more about who that man is, by exploring.
His behaviour, his characteristics are slowly revealed through interacting with objects or continuing with the story.

"Wait" may be inspired by the Cthulhu mythos created by Howard Phillips Lovecraft, but doesn't actually take place in it.
There are some references here and there, but what was most important to us was the feeling and the atmosphere Lovecraft created in his stories - the fear of the unimaginable.

About the project


We originally created "Wait" for the 2014 Indie Game Maker Contest. It was a contest in which you had 4 weeks to create a game, using any official engine. Since the contest was hosted by the RPG Maker Team we decided to go with their engine.
Although the engine was made for roleplaying games, we saw potential for an adventurous horror game.
During development we grew fond of our little project and once the contest was over we didn't want to let go.
There was still so much we wanted to implement, but due to the time limit of 4 weeks we could only do about half of it.
That's when we decided to do an extended version to "really" finish the game, add more details, enhance some visuals, erase plot holes and add some more story content.
But that's all just supplementary. "Wait - Extended" has the following features:

Features:


  • Atmospheric exploration gameplay
  • Alternative endings
  • Dynamic replayability (Successive playthroughs will not be same)
  • Achievement system
  • Hidden storylines

We hope you will have as much fun with "Wait", as we have working on it. Every feedback is much appreciated.

data.about_the_game:
"Wait" is a mystery horror game, inspired by the works of H.P Lovecraft and the Silent Hill series.
The gameplay is put together by elements of exploration and riddle solving.
We want to offer a different kind of horror. A horror without jump scares or fighting monsters, but with the fear of the unknown and unimaginable.

What is "Wait"?


The game is all about atmosphere and we wanted to support that by giving the player the opportunity to interact with almost every object at different times during the game.
It's about exploration and discovering what is happening around you.
Everything in "Wait" is experienced by a young man, the player knows nothing about. And it's intended to be that way.
You are literally thrown into another mans life and you can find out more about who that man is, by exploring.
His behaviour, his characteristics are slowly revealed through interacting with objects or continuing with the story.

"Wait" may be inspired by the Cthulhu mythos created by Howard Phillips Lovecraft, but doesn't actually take place in it.
There are some references here and there, but what was most important to us was the feeling and the atmosphere Lovecraft created in his stories - the fear of the unimaginable.

data.name: KIRILMA: Helix Horizon
data.detailed_description:
There was a before.
And then… something left unfinished.

After a global collapse, you find yourself inside a massive structure belonging to Korxtech. You don’t remember who you are or why you came here. But the silence around you makes one thing clear: something has changed irreversibly.

KIRILMA: Helix Horizon is a story-driven adventure experience set in a dystopian sci-fi world, focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

As you move through abandoned floors, collapsed systems, and traces left behind, you gradually uncover the truth behind the devastation.

GAMEPLAY

Players freely explore interconnected areas, restore systems, and solve environmental puzzles to progress.

As notes, audio logs, and environmental details are discovered, the story deepens. Dangerous zones and unseen risks require careful movement and awareness.

STORY

As you progress, limited communication with the outside world begins to guide you toward who may be responsible for what happened.

However, each new piece of information reveals that the truth may be far more complex than it first appears.

data.name: Destroy Geometric Shapes
data.detailed_description:
ALSO RECOMMENDED FOR YOU:





About the Game



Imagine yourself throwing balls to destroy geometric shapes like cubes, triangles, lozenges and hexagons



The big problem is, you need to find the perfect trajectory of the balls for them to destroy everything at once



But you are persistent and this is your challenge from now on, can you do it?

You pass the level when all the balls fall into the hole after destroying all the shapes

Challenges along the way


Halfway there will be tunnels, invisible walls, movable cubes and rotating hexagons



They will all try to make you give up

Don't let that happen, use your skill to get through these challenges

Original music and sound effects


All of this within a sound environment prepared exclusively for you

Don't forget to use headphones to get the most out of stereo sound

Learn while playing


Don't you have the skill? Do not worry!

Levels are progressively set up for you to learn while playing

Minimalist design


No score, no timer and no pressure

We don't want to rush you or embarrass you

Solve the puzzles in your own time and enjoy the game experience

  • 62 levels designed progressively
  • Choose the color of the game you like best
  • Go back to any level you want to challenge yourself again
  • You can use the angle system to help you or disable them if you want a real challenge

data.name: Command & Conquer™ Remastered Collection
data.detailed_description:
Steam Workshop

Steam workshop support for User Maps


About the Game

Command & Conquer and Red Alert defined the RTS genre 25 years ago and are now both fully remastered in 4K by the former Westwood Studios team members at Petroglyph Games. Includes all 3 expansion packs, rebuilt multiplayer, a modernized UI, Map Editor, bonus gallery of unreleased FMV footage, and over 7 hours of legendary remastered music by Frank Klepacki. Welcome back, Commander.

New and Remastered Features

  • Graphics Switching — Switch in real-time between legacy and remastered 4K graphics when in solo play.


  • Bonus Gallery — Contains over 4 hours of B-roll footage, making-of photos, and unreleased music tracks.


  • Music — Enjoy over 7 hours of remastered music, including 20 music tracks re-recorded live by original composer Frank Klepacki and the Tiberian Sons.


  • Mod Support — Create, share, and play mods with the Steam Workshop.

  • Cinematics — Immerse yourself in hours of upscaled full-motion video cinematic footage.

  • Enhanced Sidebar UI — The fully redesigned Sidebar UI embraces a modern approach with less scrolling.

  • Jukebox — Customize your entire soundtrack via an enhanced Jukebox with playlist support.

  • Custom Game Lobbies — Host and join custom game lobbies to set game rules, teams, and maps.

  • Rise Through the Ranks — Go head to head in 1v1 Quickmatches, and fight your way to the top of the Leaderboard.

  • See All the Action — Don’t miss a minute of combat with Replays and Observer mode.

  • From Console to PC — Experience the original console missions now on PC.

  • Console Cinematics — Watch the original console cinematic videos now on PC, featuring community favorite General Carville.

  • Maps — Take control of the terrain with the Map Editor, available on both Origin and Steam versions.

  • Mission Selection — Track your campaign progress on the new Mission Selection Screen.

  • Camera Zoom — Zoom the camera between the legacy DOS and Gold distances for a better look at the battlefield.

  • Skirmish Mode — Take on the AI — with controllable difficulty settings — in Skirmish mode, new for Tiberian Dawn.

  • Customizable Hotkeys — In-game Hotkey customization, now with support for the new Sidebar UI.

  • EVA — Your battle interface sounds better than ever! The original voice-over actress, Kia Huntzinger, reprised her role as EVA and re-recorded her lines in high definition for Tiberian Dawn.

  • Control Improvements — Enjoy updated mouse controls, camera movement, unit queueing, and selection improvements.

Additional features and content:
  • Over 100 campaign missions
  • Over 250 multiplayer maps
  • In-game tooltips
  • Accessibility features
  • Quicksave and Autosave support
  • Cinematic subtitles for both games
  • Text localization in French, German, Russian, Spanish, Polish, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
  • Voice-over in English, French, and German
The Steam version includes:
  • Steam achievements
  • Steam friends lists
  • Steam Trading Cards
  • Steam Workshop support for User Maps

data.name: Son Of A Dealer
data.detailed_description:
Son of A Dealer is a life simulation that combines shop management with a rich story. You have taken over an old shop. Use your trading skills to grow your business, build relationships with the locals, and shape your own destiny.

BECOME A MASTER TRADER

The rule is simple: Buy low, sell high. But to succeed, you need to sharpen your skills. Bargain hard with customers and learn to spot the real value of items. Make a fortune!

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS

You are not alone in this town. Meet unique characters with their own dreams using the dynamic dialogue system. Improve your relationships to unlock new stories and opportunities. You decide how people see you and your shop.

DESIGN EVERY CORNER

Arrange your shop exactly how you want. Decide how to display your products. Use your resources to create the perfect layout. Ask yourself: "If I were a customer, what kind of shop would I want to see?" and build it.

EXPRESS YOUR STYLE

Don't settle for boring walls. Change the atmosphere of your shop to match your taste. Customize the floors, walls, and furniture to turn this place into a space that is truly yours.

LIVE A LIFE

The game is not just about the shop. There is a life waiting for you outside. Walk around the town and discover new places. This isn't just a map; it is a living world with new sights and secrets waiting in every corner.

data.name: Bee Space
data.detailed_description:
Bee Space is a cozy, roguelike, strategic terraforming deck builder, following the adventures of a handful of bees as they embark on reclaiming the Earth for all Bee-kind.

Their honey bee ancestors were sent to space in the 80s as a science project. After a while, contact with the humans was lost, but the bees kept evolving and thriving. Now, countless generations later, the bees are returning to reclaim the little blue planet and find out what happened to its old inhabitants.

Build out your unique deck each run. Buy cards and exotic charms from the commissary shop to create amazing combos and synergies that help you throughout your expedition to reclaim Earth.

Enjoy a unique and relaxing mix of solitaire-like puzzle mechanics and strategy by playing cards from your hand to place plants and structures from orbit on a hex-grid island in order to terraform it. Plan your moves carefully to take advantage of fickle weather, deal with strange creatures, and recover mysterious human artifacts that affect the rules.

Each expedition is unique, with a campaign map traveling across three different regions. Every island you visit is different from the last, constructed from hex tiles of various types and heights that affect cards in different ways. Some islands you terraform, while others contain mysteries or inhabitants that will affect your chances of success.

Explore Earth and the bizarre human culture through the lens of whimsical sentient space bees. Discover new cards, artifacts, charms, characters and abilities to assist you on your expedition. Reclaim Earth one island at a time for the all Bee-Kind!

What you can expect:

  • 100+ unique cards with plants, tech and actions.

  • 30+ charms to discover

  • 30+ mysterious human artifacts

  • 30+ encounters with meaningful choices for good or worse.

  • 18 encounters with meddling managers and bosses

  • 5 unique bee companions with different specializations and abilities

  • 3 different regions with unique biomes

  • Endless variety of beautiful 3D islands to play on

  • Relaxing music by Andervel

  • Deep strategy

  • Funny dialog

data.name: YokesDoomedWish
data.detailed_description:
[Game Overview]

Embark on a narrative-driven 2D pixel-art Metroidvania RPG. Explore an interconnected world, uncover hidden secrets, and let the story guide your journey.

[Story]

"Ever since I became an Administrator, my workload has only grown..." Yuka sighed.

She used to be an ordinary girl without any strong convictions. It was only at her best friend's insistence that she joined the Matrix Management Council. Yet, to everyone's surprise, she was unexpectedly elected as an Administrator in the last Node Election.

"Sister, there's a letter for you... it's... it's from Lord Luna Zhu!" her younger sister, Yuri, called out in a hurry...

Thus, a newly appointed Administrator sets out on an experiment that intertwines her fate with the world—and her own Doomed Wish.

[Combat]

Designed with a low difficulty curve, the game offers a smooth and accessible experience, featuring two distinct types of combat:

Exploration Combat: Engage enemies in adventure zones to clear paths and unlock new areas. (Though sometimes, running past them is a valid exploration strategy!)

Story Boss Battles: Face off against formidable foes at key narrative milestones. Defeat them to push the story forward.

[Exploration & Items]

Discover multiple interconnected maps, with new regions unlocking as the story progresses. Utilize a diverse array of items in your inventory to overcome obstacles and enrich your exploration experience.

data.name: Horror Movie Bingo
data.detailed_description:
Are you the kind of person that loves catching horror movie tropes while watching a new horror flick? Well then grab some friends, put on a movie, and prepare to get a Horror Movie Bingo!

Horror Movie Bingo will generate a bingo card for each person watching - Instead of numbers, each space is its own horror movie trope, and your goal is to be the first player to notice enough of them to fill 5-in-a-row. All you need to do is provide the video! It's simple to use, easy to get into, and it's a great way to add a little something extra to the experience. And you can play using phones, tablets, or laptops! The game even works over a Zoom, so you can still enjoy it even if everyone can't be in the same space.

Get it today and experience a new way to Bingo!

data.name: Rat Shoot
data.detailed_description:
Shoot the rats as they invade the room! It gets tenser by the second as the rat invasion grows. Be quick on the trigger to shoot them before they escape!

Don't Let them Escape!!

Your goal is simple, stop any rats from escaping. The game features two weapons to help you achieve this: a handgun and a machine gun. Swap between them to manage the invasion at different stages. You will need to be careful not to run out of ammo. Manage your ammo resources!


As time progresses, more and more rats will invade. The pressure keeps mounting, and if that isn't enough to manage, you will need to clean up the mess and blood left behind to gain trash cans which can later be exchanged for benefits. You must carefully strategize when it's a good time to clean up.

One final note, rats, are quick and sneaky. They will hide under objects in the room. Shoot them in hiding if you can. Play across the rooms and take part in challenges. Beat the leaderboards and become to best rat shooter out there.


Unlock benefits

Clean up the dead rats to gain trash cans. Visit the benefits area to trade your trash cans for benefits that will assist you with killing more rats than ever before. Benefits only apply to room levels, however. You are on your own for challenges. Trash cans are vital to unlocking more rooms and challenges. Clean up the dead rats whenever you can.


Play Across 6 Rooms

There are six level rooms to play. Each one is harder than the last and contains more and bigger objects that the rats can hide under.

- Empty Garage
- Bathroom
- Bedroom
- Kitchen
- Full Garage
- Living Room


Challanges

As you complete rooms, challenges will be unlocked. Challenges are more complex than levels and will take more strategy to come out on top.

- 5-Minute Countdown
- Closing In
- Low Ammo
- Move, Move, Move
- Now You See Me, Now You Don't

Beat the leaderboard

Each level and challenge is complete with a leaderboard. Try to top the leaderboard and become the best rat shooter!

data.name: Jack Walker: Ethereal
data.detailed_description:
test

TEst


About the Game

As Jack Walker, you are an intergalactic bounty hunter who operates dangerous contracts in different planets and galaxies. Your left robotic arm is your ultimate weapon which provides you power and agility you need. With your hacker partner called Frosty, you are the perfect duo for any job in deep space. Use your spaceship to receive bounty requests and travel to diverse backgrounds playing J.W.E.

Jack Walker can:
-Launch his left robotic hand to surfaces and pull himself to it and fly
- Shoot laser beams out of his left wrist, when his hand is away
- Send magnetic shock waves to enemies' brains and incapacitate them by grabbing their heads from behind
- Slow motion
- Grab objects from distance using his high-tech gauntlet
- Slice enemies with his custom-made plasma sword

Single Player Modes

Contracts: This mode is the campaign-like mode for single player. Different missions will be playable in different planets and some of them will require different skills, weapons and strategies. By completing these missions you will earn credits and will be able to upgrade your weapons.

Survival:This is the wave shooter mode where you can test your skills in the maps, where enemies come in waves. You will choose the maps and the types of enemies will differ according to the map selected.

data.name: Witching Hour
data.detailed_description:
Every small town has its secrets, but some are worse than others...

Witching Hour is a horror story that takes you out of your family home and across Hollow Hills to face its dark history of witchcraft. Your fate depends on making difficult choices, your relationship with your father and sister, and confrontations with the matriarch of the town’s affliction, Lucilia.


  • As Above, So Below: Learn of the “other church” in town, with its members and location hidden to most locals.
  • Hollow Hills: Explore locations like The Pasture, The Parish, Eastern Village, Greenwater Gardens, and more.
  • Witching Hour: There’s no place like home, but be cautious to not wander your family house too much at night.




Explore, discover, and survive:
  • Explore a variety of grim locations with hidden clues and cryptic puzzles.
  • Engage in frightening encounters with the witch Lucilia and her coven.
  • Learn of black magick and witchcraft while the world starts to break around you.
  • A cast of talented voice actors bring the dialogue and characters to life.

Genre: Story-driven psychological horror that takes place over several months in your family home and surrounding area.

From the creator of:

data.name: Rope
data.detailed_description:
Connecting and erasing ropes...that's all there is to this pure puzzle game.

This is a never-ending thinking-type puzzle game without stages or excessive effects.

When ropes of the same color are connected, they disappear, and the board is rearranged little by little.

On the other hand, the special rules test the player's judgment and foresight.

The game is a game of thinking, making mistakes, learning, and getting better little by little.

There is nothing flashy. There is only the essence of fun. For those who seek such puzzles.

data.name: #DRIVE Rally
data.detailed_description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD


About the Game

#DRIVE Rally not only nails the spirit of the 90s. It reignites it for a new generation of drivers. Whether you're a veteran of dirt roads or a rookie just looking to get their tires wet, this game will let you redefine speed over and over again.

#DRIVE Rally 1.0 Main Features:

  • Redefined Arcade Racing – easy to pick up, challenging to master.

  • Local Party Mode – up to 12 players take turns racing for the top spot in leaderboard!

  • Free Roam Mode with collectibles – explore and unlock interior decors.

  • Global Leaderboards with saved Ghosts – chase records and race yourself.

  • 6 Passionate Co-Drivers with their own Championships – complete them and unlock more cars.

  • 25 Customizable Legendary Cars – each in 3 rally classes.

  • Over 600 km of Rally Stages in 6 iconic locations – from snowy Finland to the deserts of the USA.

  • Perfect shots with Photo Mode – capture your rally moments.

  • Controller and Wheel Support – including force feedback.

  • Steam Deck Verified – play anywhere, anytime.

#DRIVE World

From the sunny landscapes of Dry Crumbs, through the whispering woods of Holzberg, to the chilly wilderness of Revontuli. Take a journey to a diverse world you haven’t experienced in racing games before.

Legendary Cars

Jump behind the wheel of legendary rally cars, including Das Holzwagen, The Doggo, The Bobond, and many more. We’re going 90s this time, so there’s also going to be new stuff. Das Sandsturm and Celestia just for a start!

Passionate Co-Drivers

Your co-driver can be your biggest cheerleader and toughest judge. It's a partnership that thrives on performance and emotions! Their goal is to assist your performance with helpful directions and navigation, critical to informing your next maneuver, and tips on improving your performance - sometimes delivered a little too passionately.

#DRIVE Design

Build your cars from the ground up to match your racing style and rally your way. Personalize the body, the paintwork, the decals, and then add that little cherry on top with custom decorations.

#DRIVE Arcade Mechanics

Simple enough for beginners yet addictively challenging and demanding in its depth. It’s a handling system designed to bring back joy to racing games.

Retro Revival

#DRIVE Rally is packed with throwbacks, nods, and Easter eggs that'll make any car enthusiast
take a trip down memory lane.

Photo Mode

Get creative and capture your greatest #DRIVE Rally moments. Adjust the angles, switch filters,
go crazy. Create the perfect shot and then share it with your friends.

#DRIVE Community

Ready to dive deeper into the world of #DRIVE? Join our Discord server where every
member is a co-driver.

#DRIVE Rally is packed with throwbacks, nods, and Easter eggs that'll make any car enthusiast
take a trip down memory lane.

Photo Mode

Get creative and capture your greatest #DRIVE Rally moments. Adjust the angles, switch filters,
go crazy. Create the perfect shot and then share it with your friends.

#DRIVE Community

Ready to dive deeper into the world of #DRIVE? Join our Discord server where every
member is a co-driver.

data.name: Wojak Rush
data.detailed_description:
Wojak Rush: A Cartoon-Themed Adventure

Wojak Rush is an exciting cartoon-themed adventure game packed with multiple levels, dynamic platforms, parkour mechanics, ragdoll physics, and challenging enemies. Wojak, bored with his mundane life, seeks refuge in sleep to escape reality. However, this time, his sleep takes a bizarre turn.

Trapped in a surreal and perilous dream, Wojak embarks on a relentless struggle to wake up. Despite his desperate attempts to escape, his dream is filled with relentless obstacles and enemies determined to keep him asleep. Overcoming these challenges won’t be easy, but with perseverance and the help of unexpected allies, Wojak can grow stronger and find his way out.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Navigate through diverse levels with engaging parkour and ragdoll mechanics.

  • Combat and Strategy: Use your turret to fend off waves of enemies and avoid obstacles that block your path.

  • Upgrade System: Collect gold from defeated enemies to enhance your skills and gear, making each challenge a stepping stone to victory.

  • A Unique Storyline: Immerse yourself in Wojak’s surreal dream world and help him wake up from his endless slumber.

Will you conquer the obstacles and awaken Wojak from this relentless dream? Can you outsmart the enemies and guide Wojak to freedom? The fate of Wojak lies in your hands—are you ready to take on the challenge?

data.name: Sheepageddon
data.detailed_description:
Sheepageddon is a 2d puzzle game where you play as a cute wolf that is constantly craving for sheep to eat in order to not starve to death. In each level it is more difficult to do so as the sheep have guard dogs near by to alert all the sheep in the level. A level is passed when all the sheep have been eaten in any given level.
The game is made to be fast paced due to a constant decline of the wolfs health and zero second transition delays between levels or restarting the level at hand.
There are 7 levels. Estimated play threw time is 10-30 minutes depending on how fast you figure out how to get all the sheep. The game is locked to 640x640 windowed mode, so it should run on any device.

data.name: DEATH FROM BELOW
data.detailed_description:
Aye, the sea’s been restless as of late. Folk say something stirs beneath the waves, something as old as the tides themselves. Me, I don’t pay such tales much mind, but even so, I’d keep that harpoon close at hand. There’s good money to be made... for crews that make it back.

WORK TOGETHER OR SINK ALONE

This is not a solo voyage. Your ship is a complex system that demands coordination. One crew member manages the boiler pressure, another navigates through the fog, while someone else scans the depths for what lurks in the dark. No single player has the full picture.

MASTER A LIVING, STEAM-POWERED SHIP

Your vessel is not a menu, it’s a machine. Every module inside the ship is physical, interactive, and interdependent: open valves to redirect steam, pull levers to operate the crane, and load ammunition by hand. The ship is your greatest tool… and your greatest liability.

AN UNFORGIVING OCEAN

You’ll cross the seas as a trespasser, never as its master. Navigate treacherous waves, avoid hidden hazards, and manage limited resources as you push further into the unknown. Odds may seem dim, but fortune favors the prepared.

WHAT STIRS BELOW

Something moves beneath the surface. Massive leviathans and the cursed shadows of drowned sailors will test your crew at every turn. These aren’t simple fights against bullet-sponge behemots, each encounter demands strategy and coordination: cripple a creature’s movement, blind its senses, expose its weak points. You’ll have to adapt, or be dragged under.

data.name: 画境(Picturesque) VR
data.detailed_description:
“Picturesque” is an adventure game developed based on HTC Vive. Step into a Picturesque World filled with natural beauty and reminiscent scenes, embarks on a larger than life journey, and re-collect the lost memories.

Game features:

-An innovative puzzle-solving experience based on HTC Vive. Become a Tiny doll, interact directed with the environment you are in.

-3 scenes containing numerous different hints and puzzles, with one bonus mission included. The estimated game time for the main story line is about 40-50 minutes, and detailed observation and deep understanding of the game is required to beat the bonus mission.

-Completed story line. Open an ancient journal, listen to the direction of a mysterious voice, and find out what's hidden behind the pictures.

"Picturesque" is the 1st completed VR game made by Omnigames, we meant to deliver some innovative game ideas and warmth into your heart. We combined room-escape elements into a immersive story, in order to give you a special VR experience.

FYI: If you want to experience "Picturesque" in Chinese (and Voices in Chinese as well!), please change the game language in Options to Simplified Chinese and re-download the game, thanks!

Explore a desolate environment, collect scattered resources, and construct your own creations block by block.

Use the robot's building system to place and stack blocks freely, allowing you to create structures, towers, and designs however you like. You also have prebuild buildings and environmental building to bring the planet back to life.

data.name: RetroRange
data.detailed_description:
RetroRange is a casual retro cyberpunk sandbox first-person shooter with object-destructive physics.

If you are looking for a Casual shooter experience then look no further than RetroRange. A variety of firearms to choose from and lots of different objects to shoot and pick up and move around.

Features:

Shooting: Firearms included are Pistol, AK, Auto Shotgun, Sniper Rifle, Pump Shotgun

Loads of objects and targets to shoot, pick up and move.

The scope in mind with RetroRange was to make what Thomas Brush says your "first game". This is definitely not a AAA game. RetroRange is more like a Prototype and was developed as a learning experience for 788 Garage Studio. This project is no longer in development and will remain as an Early Access due to being a Prototype. Those who purchase this game will help support 788 Garage Studio in future games and software development.

data.name: Marrowlight
data.detailed_description:
IT DID NOT COME WITH AN ARMY

Nine hundred years ago, something came up out of the deep places under Vaskaryn.

The chroniclers of that age could not agree on what it was. They agreed only on what it did. Every man who fell before it stood up again behind it — not sorcery, but simple accounting. A thing that adds every enemy to itself does not need to win a battle. It needs only to be present at one.

Eleven kingdoms fell learning that it could not be killed, because there was nothing there to kill.

Only multitude.

So it was bound instead.

The seal was not a spell. It was a load-bearing structure, and it required anchors — six living women, each shackled to one chain, each holding one aspect of the thing down beneath the bedrock. Wrath. Sorrow. Memory. Light. Silence. Hunger. Name.

They were sealed into vaults and left there.

They did not die. That was the cruelty nobody accounted for. The magic that made them anchors also made them permanent.

Nine hundred years in the dark. Awake. Holding.

YOU ARE THE LAST WARDEN

It is not a heroic office.

Wardens walk the seal-sites and check the chains. And when an anchor finally breaks — when nine centuries alone in a stone room become too much — the Warden kills her, and the order finds another woman to take her place.

You have opened forty-one doors in your life. You have closed forty-one.

Now the marrowlight is rising, the seal is failing at every point at once, and behind the first vault door is a woman who is entirely, terribly sane — and who would like to have a conversation before you raise the blade.

FIGHT THE MULTITUDE

  • Horde survival, sharpened. Hundreds of enemies on screen at once. Auto-attacking weapons that evolve as you level. Fifteen to thirty minutes per run, and the last five of them are a wall of bodies.

  • Six stages, each a different grave. Flooded catacombs beneath a collapsed cathedral. A city that burned for six years and never fully went out. A frozen siege plain. A tidal shelf of drowned shrines. A library grown into the rock. And the pit itself.

  • Thirty-Two enemy types that escalate from wax-sealed corpses to things the light beneath the world manufactures fresh, still unfinished, still wet.

  • Weapons that change how you play, not just your numbers. Chain-binding zone control. Burn and reveal. Berserker builds that get stronger as you get closer to dying.

THE RELIQUARY

Free an anchor and she gives you her memory — a full cinematic of the moment she chose what put her in the dark.

They are kept in the Reliquary, seven stone alcoves in a Vigil waystation. A locked alcove holds only the epitaph the order carved for her, and in every single case that epitaph is a lie about who she was.

"She gave her name gladly to the work."

She gave her name to nothing. She kept it. It was everything else she gave.

THE SEAL HOLDS, OR IT DOESN'T

Do the job you were raised to do, and the world survives — grey, quiet, diminished, and you die as the last holder of an office with nothing left to guard.

Or open all six doors, and find out what nine hundred years of listening taught six women about the thing they were holding down.

There is a third ending. It requires knowing everything, and it costs more than either.

FEATURES

  • Horde-survival roguelite with runs of 15–30 minutes

  • Five playable characters, Four of them unlocked by in-game gold

  • 24 enemy types and 6 stage bosses

  • Meta-progression that persists across runs

  • Grim dark fantasy, heavy on the grim

MARROWLIGHT contains graphic violence and depictions of death and bodily harm. It is intended for adult players.

data.name: Model Railway Easily
data.detailed_description:
You can build highly detailed and functional model railway layouts in this game.
You can start with different empty terrain types and populate them with beautiful 3D models of engines, wagons, buildings, plants etc.

Creating the track layout is very easy with the self explaining menus, which offer always only the possible actions during the use. The length of the track is practically unlimited. You can add as many switches as you want, only your fantasy limits the complexity.

Put engines and wagons on the built track and just push them with your finger, and they start to move. They will travel the prepared track and stop automatically at the placed stations. If a train reaches and end of the track, it will stop, and move backward after a few seconds.

Add different houses, buildings, plants, roads to increase the reality of your layout, and enjoy the beautiful details of all 3D models.

data.name: TEMPUS: A Wizard Awakes
data.detailed_description:
A Wizard alone in a shattered world

Journey across Tempus, a world of floating islands flora and fauna. You are a lonely wizard, once a caretaker of the temporal flows, now retired and hoping for the world to return to what it once was. With no purpose left a call to action comes from a small rock critter, crying for help as it finds itself far from home and lost in the wilderness.

Use your magic to guide the critter and it's family home while you traverse hostile terrain, solve puzzles, fight vegetative enemies and find secrets in this charming student-made action adventure game.

And if you don't want to save the critters... There's always the alternative..

Magic

In the world of Tempus, magic is not free. Every action has consequence and as such you must be careful when harnessing the energy of your surroundings to fuel spellcasting. Carelessness will limit your options and you may just find yourself in a pickle.

On the flipside, move  without haste and the friends you make along the way might lend you a hand or crystal to aid your spell slinging adventure.

A Reactive world

With only a simple projectile TEMPUS aims to provide some engaging moments and fun interactions through handcrafted challenges, puzzles and environments. Take your time to explore a small world and journey through the clouds.

Blast a companion, hug a "friend", the world will carry on without you in the end.

Secrets

While the main story is short, we've made sure to include several achievements and secrets for curious players to find and hopefully enjoy, give it a whirl if you dare, take a leap of faith and don't trust a flower by it's petals.

Thank you for playing!

data.name: Don't Touch My Phone
data.detailed_description:
"Don't Touch My Phone" is not just your ordinary 2D side-scrolling platform adventure—it's a hilarious escapade that follows the misadventures of a six-year-old boy desperately trying to connect with his crush, Susan. The catch? He's phoneless! To chat with Susan, he must sneak into other people's phones, but it's anything but easy. These digital devices are fortified with guns, wires, bombs, mines, nukes, and heavy weapons, turning each level into a wacky obstacle course.

The game revels in its intentional silliness, throwing absurd challenges at our pint-sized hero. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to use your smarts to navigate this ludicrous landscape, outwit the phone defenses, and win Susan's heart. Can you help the boy overcome these comically exaggerated obstacles? Brace yourself for a laughter-filled adventure that's as funny as it is tricky! Get ready to dive into a world where the absurd meets the amusing, and where the journey to romance is anything but conventional!

.............................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

..............................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

..............................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

Key Features:


* Discover a world worth exploring. Run, climb, dash, and glide as you immerse yourself in a virtual world. Each level is meticulously designed to transport you inside your own phone, enabling you to playfully manipulate its elements. Picture yourself navigating through a digital realm, solving brain-teasing missions, and outsmarting quirky obstacles—all while enjoying a healthy dose of laugh-out-loud humor.

* Speak the language of the phone, allowing you to communicate with and address everything as if it were a living entity within the device. However, be wary—your phone elements have turned into real enemies and obstacles against you, transforming each level into a challenging battleground where wit and strategy are your best allies for you to get your charge back.

* Susan will send text messages while you are playing that can either help you on your journey or bring it to a sudden stop. Pay attention to her messages as they can shape the outcome of your gameplay!

* The player's secret weapon for survival? Just their foot! They can stomp, run, avoid traps, open doors, and even destroy enemies—with the power of their feet, they kick their way through challenges and emerge victorious!

* An additional weapon in the player's arsenal is the umbrella, helping them glide through the air and overcome gravity's attempts to bring them down.

* And more .....

data.name: Rover Wars
data.detailed_description:
If you are up for a casual yet spicy cocktail of action and strategy, but not planning to spend hours learning how to play, then Rover Wars might just be your thing.

You jump straight into the action with your little Rover to start building factories and hurting enemy units. The tactics in the game are in resource management and the placement of factories. Factories poop out minions that will find their way to the enemy facilities and destroy them. Once you destroy the enemy base, you win. simple.




Rover Wars has a neat local multiplayer system. It allows up to 8 users to join the game. To avoid couch conflicts we implemented some brilliant AI to battle cooperatively. There are always 2 teams and each side has a maximum of 4 Rovers. During battle, players can even switch teams or add some AI.


Rover Wars has a campaign mode and a battle mode. The campaign mode will keep the average player busy for about 2 hours. Instead of providing a deep story, the campaign focuses on challenging you incrementally. You can play the campaign in co-op too.

Besides the campaign there is also the battle mode. This allows you to battle in one of the 17 instantly available maps and tweak many settings such as base strength and AI intelligence.



  • Explosions? Yes, lots of them!
  • Many maps? Yes, 17!
  • Local multiplayer? Yes, up to 8 players can join.
  • Different environments? Yes, there is a dusty Mars planet, a freezing ice world and a mossy place to fight in.
  • Online play? Yes, We integrated Steam Remote Play. With a decent internet connection it works very well.




An average match takes about 5 to 20 minutes depending on the amount of players and the AI level. The game has good replay value and is good fun to play with a bag of crisps and a few beers. If you would play the campaign with a friend the total man hours of fun would sum up to 4 hours. That means you paid about the same for a few drinks and the crisps as for the game... unless you live in Finland.



Developers Note
Thanks for even reading this far! We are a team of 5 and had an amazing amount of fun making this game. We hope you will too. If you need any support just drop us a line. We are happy to help. If you did not like the game or it does not run on your pc. It is your good right to refund. In all other cases we are super thankful for your support and will keep our ears open for improvements. ❤️

data.name: Multiversal Affairs
data.detailed_description:
The Multiverse has not been conquered, and it is not to be conquered. Instead, creatures of all backgrounds and beliefs coexist by diplomacy and cooperation.

This roughly episodic physics-based pixel-art metroidvania/platformer/thing will show you a multiversal civilization, a home for some, and a ruthless autocracy for others.

Know the system!


The Omega Multiversal Union is a federation of governments of different worlds, ruled and founded by the wise Council. While most of the governments inside the Multiversal Union focus on votes, terms, and checks and balances, the Coulcilors of the Omega do not change. You mustn't worry about it, though! The Council knows best.

See the worlds! Impact the people!

In Multiversal Affairs, you'll be able to:
  • Perform tasks as a physics-based square creature for the wellbeing of The Omega's citizens;
  • Meet other troublemakers, enemies, and just wanderers;
  • Decide the fate in unique dialogues with CHOICE and unexpected reactions to very subtle actions;
  • Solve puzzles based on funny two-dimensional physics!
  • Shoot. Occasionally. Enemies react to physics too!
  • Return to previously visited worlds and see how they changed!

data.name: The Golden Horde: Survival
data.detailed_description:
The Golden Horde: Survival is a first and third-person medieval survival RPG.


The game takes you to the brutal and mysterious 13th century, where the mighty Golden Horde rises to power. Break free from slavery, survive, build your own settlement, and lead a rebellion in a world where real history intertwines with elements of fantasy.



Join one of the factions to find allies in the unforgiving medieval world.

Choose your path: become a loyal supporter or a secret rebel. Fight for freedom, lead an uprising against the mighty empire, and rewrite the history of your era. Your choices will shape the fate of your faction and the entire world.


Embark on an exciting journey through an open world filled with mysterious caves and dangerous dungeons.

Explore hidden corners, find treasures, and battle enemies to free the enslaved. Every life you save brings you closer to creating a new, free world!


Surviving in the medieval world is the ultimate test of endurance!

Beware of deadly diseases, avoid poisonous snake bites, and steer clear of accidents. Take care of your body—losing a limb could be fatal. Conquer hunger and thirst, evade the threat of slavery, and fight for every single day of your life. Here, every step could be your last, and every decision is a matter of life and death.


Immerse yourself in an ancient era where your destiny is forged by your own hands.

Build cozy yurts and transform desolate lands into a thriving village. Explore vast territories in search of rare resources, and craft weapons and tools to face the challenges of a harsh medieval life. Your story is a legend of survival, craftsmanship, and courage.

data.name: Waitventure
data.detailed_description:
Waitventure is an idle RPG focused around Time, recruiting monsters and fusioning them to get stronger allies in your party.

The game currency is "seconds", and you get one second/second at first, that can be increased later. After choosing your main character class, you can train your player, level up, increase their stats and learn new skills, by using your time currency.

When you are ready for the adventure, you can enter the dungeon, where your party will fight enemies in automated battles, and sometimes, the enemies will join your team! And when you come back to town, if your allies are strong enough, you can fuse them to get monsters and humans from a higher tier, with different stats and abilities.

The dungeon is divided into years, months and days, like a calendar. At the end of each day there is a boss, that is stronger than regular enemies, but gives more EXP. Can you reach 31st December and beat the final boss?

data.name: Bloons TD Battles
data.detailed_description:
Play the top-rated tower defense franchise in this free head-to-head strategy game.

It's monkey vs monkey for the first time ever - go head to head with other players in a Bloon-popping battle for victory. From the creators of best-selling Bloons TD 6, this game is specially designed for intense multiplayer combat, featuring over 50 custom head-to-head tracks, incredible towers and upgrades, all-new range of powers, and the ability to control bloons directly and send them charging past your opponent's defenses. Easy to learn, hard to master - this game offers endless fun for casual and competitive players alike!

Check out these awesome features!

* Head-to-head two player Bloons TD

* Over 50 custom Battles tracks

* 22 awesome monkey towers, each with 8 powerful upgrades, including the never before seen C.O.B.R.A. Tower.

Multiple ways to play!

* Assault Mode - manage strong defenses and send bloons directly against your opponent

* Defense Mode - build up your income and outlast your challenger with your superior defenses

* Battle Arenas - Put your medallions on the line in a high stakes Assault game. Winner takes all.

* Card Battles - Build the ultimate deck to slam your opponents in this unique twist on bloons TD gameplay.

Even more awesomeness! 

* All new Powers - supercharge your towers, boost your bloons, or try the new sabotage, eco, and track powers.

* Battle it out for top scores on the weekly leaderboards and win awesome prizes.

* Create and join private matches to challenge any of your friends

* Build your clan and work together to be the best of the best for weekly rewards.

* Customize your bloons with decals, or grab new tower skins so your victory has a signature stamp

* 16 cool achievements to claim

REQUIRES INTERNET CONNECTION

**********

Please review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You will be prompted in-game to accept these terms in order to cloud save and protect your game progress:

data.name: Civilization Idle
data.detailed_description:
Civilization Idle

Build. Expand. Conquer time itself.

Step into a world where every decision shapes the destiny of your civilization. Start small, manage resources, and watch your empire grow from a single settlement into a sprawling civilization across 6 eras, from the Stone Age to the Galactic Era.

  • Idle, But Strategic – Progress continues while you’re away, but smart planning is key to unlock 60+ technologies, 70+ buildings, and 40+ worker roles that define your civilization.

  • Rewards – Complete 100+ milestones, build legendary 12 wonders, and earn powerful bonuses that reward patience and strategy.

  • Dynamic World – Explore hundreds of procedurally generated territories, interact with neighboring civilizations, trade resources, and survive random events that test your empire’s resilience.

  • Simple to Start, Hard to Master – Easy to pick up for casual players, with depth and complexity for those who love optimization, automation, and tactical strategy.

Whether you’re a strategist or a casual gamer, Civilization Idle lets you shape history at your own pace. Your civilization awaits—can you guide it from a humble village to galactic dominance?

data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

MARBLE FLOW is a physics-based puzzle game.

Place rails and various objects to create a path

that guides the marble to its destination.

Use the unique properties of objects and physics interactions

to solve puzzles in your own way.


INTERACTIVE OBJECTS

Combine over 20 different objects

to create your own solutions.

Objects connect and interact with each other,

creating a variety of chain reactions.

CREATE YOUR OWN SOLUTION

Each puzzle can be solved in multiple ways.

Design your own paths

and discover unique solutions.

60 STAGES ACROSS 3 CHAPTERS

A total of 60 stages await you.

Progress through 3 different chapters

filled with new objects and puzzle mechanics.

- 12 Extra Stages

Experience satisfying physics-based sounds

created by marbles and interactive objects.

Smooth movements and sound effects

bring a relaxing ASMR-like atmosphere to the game.

The use of in-game BGM, sound effects, and gameplay footage is fully allowed.

data.name: Lanterns & Pacts
data.detailed_description:
Leave a light on until she comes home.

Your parents' spirit shop should have been a place to come home to. Instead, you find empty pens, unpaid bills and a missing sister. She had been keeping Fallen Leaf afloat, until its creatures were stolen and her search for answers took her away. Now Xiaohe has brought you the old ledger. With one companion at your side, it's time to reopen the shop—and find the person who belongs behind its counter.

Your next encounter could change your team

Explore woodlands, river valleys, snowy paths and forgotten ruins in search of local spirits. Even creatures of the same species can have different aptitudes and randomly selected natural skills. Buy information from local people and follow it to the right location to improve your chances of finding a particular spirit. Venture deeper for rare individuals and regional bosses.

Raise a companion your way

Allocate points as your pets level up, nurture their growth, strengthen their elemental roots and equip spirit cases that suit their roles. Teach active and passive skills with books, then use fusion to pursue inherited abilities and further growth. Some rare signature skills can only pass to other species through fusion. Every new catch could hold a piece of your next build.

Build a team whose skills work together

Bring three companions into turn-based battles and give each a purpose. Draw attacks with a guardian's taunt, buy time with shields and healing, and link passive triggers, marks and offensive skills. Your choices in training meet your choices in battle: experiment with combinations and discover what a carefully built team can do.

Make a name for the family shop

Bring new opportunities home from your travels. Place pets with new owners, provide care and complete commissions to support the shop. Display your creatures in resting areas as visitors gather to watch. Raise the shop's grade and see its humble interior grow more impressive. Reinvest your earnings, challenge rival shops, earn a reputation and qualify for the climb to the top of the rankings.

Follow the clues. Bring your sister home.

Talk to people in town, investigate out in the wild and meet new faces through your work and battles. Stolen spirits and a suspicious debt contract point toward an organization with something to hide. Follow the main investigation and regional side stories as you rebuild. Save the shop your parents left behind, find your sister and confront those who tore your family apart.

One companion. One struggling shop. A light to find your way home.

data.name: Light of Veilendor
data.detailed_description:
Light of Veilendor is a third-person action adventure game in which the main character you play is a mighty crystal wolf from an ancient wolf clan descended from the first gods. The wolf has several skills and powers that you learn more about and will be able to use during the game, where you have to explore and follow the clues that unfold through the narrative.

Explore the world of Veilendor

Travel through thrilling landscapes on your epic quest to overthrow the lord of darkness, Gotarath. While various magical animals and creatures roam this world and offer their own challenges, the evil nightmare monsters lurk in the shadows, ready to attack.

Unlock special abilities as the story unfolds

To learn more about the story and to unlock the wolf's magical abilities, you must collect various items along the way.

Note

Light of Veilendor is in an early stage of development, which means that the images shown here are subject to change. Follow the game development on our Discord server!

data.name: Sacred Land
data.detailed_description:
A group of settlers has arrived on a lonely island, intent on claiming the land and it's resources for themselves. As a powerful nature spirit, you must drive them back and protect the island from their growing presence and mining efforts.

Features

  • Fast-paced runs across 20 increasingly difficult rounds

  • Play as one of 12 unique spirit characters, each with unique starting abilities or effects

  • Defend five different islands, each with it's own challenges

  • Utilize the island map: Your abilities will charge faster depending on the type of terrain you are on

  • Shape each run by acquiring powerful artefacts and modifying the island's landscape to unlock their full potential

  • Hand-crafted abilities with several upgrades to discover during your runs

  • Dynamically adjustable difficulty level: During each run a system of royal decrees strengthens the enemies or yourself.
