data.name: Mafia III: Definitive Edition
data.detailed_description:
Mafia: The Omertà Collection


2K ACCOUNT BENEFITS

Sign up for a free 2K Account to add these items to your in-game collections:

  • Mafia: The Old Country - "Garzia Tumulto" Race Car

  • Mafia: Definitive Edition - Black Cats Motorcycle Pack

  • Mafia II: Definitive Edition - Made Man Pack

  • Mafia III: Definitive Edition - The Classico Outfit & IL Duca Handgun

By signing up to receive newsletters and promotional messaging related to the Mafia franchise from 2K and its affiliates using your 2K Account, you can also add the engraved "Lupara Tradituri" Shotgun to your in-game arsenal in Mafia: The Old Country. 

Each reward requires an internet connection and a 2K Account linked to the applicable Mafia title. One of each reward per 2K Account. Reward will be automatically entitled in the applicable game. Void where prohibited. Terms apply.


About the Game

Mafia III: Definitive Edition includes the main game, all Story DLC (Faster, Baby!, Stones Unturned, Sign of the Times) and Bonus Packs (Family Kick-Back Pack and Judge, Jury & Executioner Weapons Pack) bundled in one place for the first time.

Part three of the Mafia crime saga - 1968, New Bordeaux, LA.
After years of combat in Vietnam, Lincoln Clay knows this truth: family isn’t who you’re born with, it’s who you die for. When his surrogate family is wiped out by the Italian Mafia, Lincoln builds a new family and blazes a path of revenge through the Mafioso responsible.

NEW BORDEAUX, LA:

A vast world ruled by the mob and detailed with the sights and sounds of the era

A LETHAL ANTI-HERO:

Be Lincoln Clay, orphan and Vietnam veteran hell bent on revenge for the deaths of his surrogate family

REVENGE YOUR WAY:

Choose your own play-style; brute force, blazing guns or stalk-and-kill tactics, to tear down the Mafia

A NEW FAMILY ON THE ASHES OF THE OLD:

Build a new criminal empire your way by deciding which lieutenants you reward, and which you betray

Own Mafia III:

Definitive Edition to unlock Lincoln’s Army Jacket and Car in both Mafia and Mafia II Definitive Editions

data.detailed_description:
Puzzle Penguins is an engaging puzzle game featuring colorful images of various penguin species. Piece together scenes of penguins swimming, resting on ice floes, caring for their chicks, and traveling across snowy landscapes.

* Colorful images of various penguin species.

* Progressive difficulty levels.

* Increasing number of pieces with each level.

* Simple and intuitive controls.

* Develops memory, attention, and logical thinking.

* Calm and relaxing gameplay.

* Suitable for both children and adults.

Assemble all the penguin images, beat every level, and immerse yourself in the amazing world of these unique birds with Puzzle Penguins!

data.name: Operation Zeta
data.detailed_description:
Join our discord


About the Game



Operation Zeta is a space action game. The great battle codenamed 'Operation Zeta' has been lost. Your ship is in shambles and you have to act quickly to collect all of the parts and repair your ship before the warzone is completely destroyed by the enemies death laser. Play and unlock 13 playable characters each with their own unique set of skills and challenges. As well unlock new abilities and upgrades with credits you earn during each run. Each time you play the world is randomly generated with random quests to get your ship parts back. Made in our custom game engine built from the ground up!



Explore a randomly generated space system to find the parts to your broken ship.
Each time you play the game is randomly generated from the planets to the quest to the enemies & loot.



Help out or fight the bizzare and exotic natives to recover the parts of your crashed warship.
Over 100 different NPCS and enemies, with new ones being selected each playthrough.



Collect rewards to unlock new ships and races from monkeys with space helmets to space slugs to play in future playthroughs!


Uncover the lore of the world, with tons of lore entries detailing the creatures of the world, the planets they originate and general history of the universe!


We are committed to bringing more and more content to Operation Zeta up until release and even have an update timer on the main menu telling you when the next update is going to come! Updates will come out roughly once every month and a half until release. Give us any feedback or ideas you may have and you might just spot your ideas in the game!

data.name: Madballs in Babo:Invasion
data.detailed_description:
The spiritual successor to the massively popular freeware top-down shooter BaboViolent2, Madballs in Babo:Invasion is an arena based 3D shooter offering players a satisfying and immersive experience in both single-player and multiplayer, including 'Invasion Mode' where players are able to design their own combat maps almost instantaneously by placing a combination of map tiles to create a never-before-seen map before gameplay starts. Truly, no two games are ever the same.
Featuring the recently re-released Madballs™ characters, Oculus Orbus™ and Horn Head™, from the popular 1980s toys best remembered for their outrageously bad looks and graphically colourful names, Madballs in...Babo: Invasion is a feature laden 'casually hardcore' action shooter.
Key Features:
  • Single Player — Hours of repeatable gameplay through 10 epic levels
  • 2-4 Player Online Co-op — challenge individual campaign levels with your friends or play the whole campaign in ‘Enduro’ mode
  • 16 Player Multiplayer — 21 maps to match all game sizes
  • 'Invasion' Mode — the signature mode of the game, players take turns placing map tiles to create a unique multiplayer map prior to each match
  • Voice Chat — Talk to the other players in-game
  • Classes — 10 character classes (each with 2 special abilities) over two warring factions, with each faction having 5 unique weapons each with two distinct firing modes
  • Madballs Characters — Oculus Orbus™ and Horn Head™ from the infamous 80’s toy craze as in-game characters
  • 5 Archetypes — Assault, Heavy, Runner, Flyer, Support
  • Deployables — active (rocket turrets) or passive (healing towers) can be placed in Invasion mode
  • Unlocks and Secrets — 50 unlocks and 50 Secrets to find during campaign gameplay
  • Action — emphasis on fast-paced, visceral action that is easy to pick and play, yet offers a real strategic challenge for hardcore gamers

data.name: Them
data.detailed_description:
It was supposed to be just another afternoon at the arcade...

You play as Tommy, a 9 year old boy who finds himself alone in a mysterious, dimly lit video game club from the 1990s. Your only goal is to enjoy the arcade machines and have fun. But time slips away, strange noises echo from the dark corners of the room, and what starts as an innocent trip quickly spirals into a dark nightmare. Something is waiting for you here something far beyond what a child should ever experience.

A Game Within a Game

The only way out is through. To escape the horrors lurking in the real world, Tommy must enter a strange, haunted video game. THEM masterfully blends tense first person psychological horror with challenging retro 2D platforming. You must navigate two completely different realities, forcing you to solve complex puzzles and face the deepest fears hidden within.

Key Features:

  • Two Worlds Collide: Seamlessly transition between an eerie, realistic 3D environment and a punishing 2D retro platformer.

  • Nostalgic Terror: Explore a meticulously crafted 1990s arcade club where childhood innocence meets intense psychological dread.

  • Puzzles & Secrets: Search for hidden objects and solve diverse environmental puzzles across both dimensions to progress.

  • Your Choices Matter: Uncover a deep, captivating story with unexpected twists and unlock Multiple Endings based on your actions.

  • A Focused Nightmare: A short, highly concentrated horror experience designed to keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish without any filler

Will you escape the arcade, or will you become a part of THEM?

Join Our Community Stay connected with Lexip Games for news, updates, and future psychological horror projects:

  • Follow us on X (Twitter): @LexipGames

data.name: Love Cult
data.detailed_description:
Upon receiving visions of doomsday fast approaching, Meridian is left with one mission before time runs out: to reverse the world’s fate by summoning love through the forbidden art of divine matchmaking.

Skilled in an arcana of her own, Meridian’s answer lies in the heart of the mystical Lapis cards, as she consults the cosmos to inspire new love connections across the city, which has been overtaken by astral gods peddling their own twisted notions of love to their believers.

With the astrals’ targets set on her, Meridian must ensure that those who believe in her magic will be guaranteed an everlasting love, no matter the otherworldly obstacles awaiting. For as she sees it, a true love as foretold by the stars is simply the only way to stop the doomsday clock... and the key to a most amorous salvation.

Play as Meridian, leading your followers to save the world from doomsday with the power of love!

Customizable Cult Members in the love pairing mini-game. You can customize their skin tone, hair style, and clothes and watch your customized cult members date NPCs to bring love to the city to stop doomsday's approach.

Experience a different common route each time you play with the Lapis Arcana illuminating your way

There are three romanceable love interests in the main story of the game - Vanille, Void, Zephyr

data.name: Card Or No Card
data.detailed_description:
Welcome To Card Or No Card

The newest game you'll want to play with your friends!

Grab up to 8 people or join a public lobby for some low-skill, tense fun!

Enjoy the plethora of customization options to show off your personality and have our game look the way you want!

How To Play

  • Create a lobby or join an existing lobby.

  • Guess whether the dealer drew a card or not (Make sure to guess in 10 seconds!).

  • That's it! Keep guessing until you're the last one standing or all the items have been drawn.

Customization

Card Or No Card provides plenty of customization options to make your experience unique!

Such options include:

  • Player Icon Avatars and Borders

  • Colors for Icons, Borders, Game Backgrounds, and Title Screen!

Mess around with all the unique settings and see what themes you can come up with!

data.name: Lootbawx
data.detailed_description:
EARLYBIRD 5000 USER SPECIAL LOOTBAWX

We'll be releasing an extra special LOOTBAWX for the first 5000 players.

Be sure to wishlist this game so you can launch on release date!


NEW BAWXES SINCE RELEASE

- Crawly gnome bawx
- Revolver bawx (our first interactable gun bawx!)
- Clicker bawx (collect all your favorite clicker loot!)
- Meme bawx (collect your favorite memes!)


About the Game

LOOTBAWX let's you collect unique loot by opening free loot boxes.

You will be awarded a free loot box between every 30 minutes and 2 hours as long as you are playing the game. It is your choice whether to open the crate, sell the crate, or even trade your loot on the marketplace to other fellow LOOTBAWXers!

REGULAR DROPS

Loot crates dropped every hour and new ones released weekly.

WEAR VALUE, ITEMS GUARANTEED UNIQUE

Loot has WEAR VALUE meaning each item you receive is UNIQUE. NO OTHER CLICKERS HAVE THIS! Each item also has rarity and special effects can be rolled too!

INTERACTABLES

Interactable items such as guns which actually shoot!

SHOP, BUY AND SELL

Shop where you can SELL your low tier loot for COINS and BUY crates.

VIRTUAL PLINKO

We even have PLINKO where you can roll to get coins buy even more crates!

Party system!

Join your friends to get loot faster!

... And many more features

- Tons of steam achievements
- Friendly discord ^_^

Upcoming features

Beyond looting, we're also close to releasing a few features to make this an even better experience including both a FLEX and WAGER mode. In FLEX mode you get paired against a fellow player in a minigame and can flex your loot; WAGER mode is a winner-takes-all minigame where you can wager your loot and the winning player takes all the spoils.

Please join our discord and give feedback on what you would like to see!

data.name: 竞速驾驶
data.detailed_description:
This is a 2D retro cartoon single-player time trial driving game that gets back to the essence of racing! Bright cartoon visuals + retro pixel textures, paired with upbeat nostalgic BGM, instantly transport you back to the thrilling days of arcade halls. No complicated controls needed—just pick it up and enjoy pure driving joy!

Core Gameplay

1. Pure Time Trial Challenge: A single core track focused solely on speed duels! Your sole goal is to push your limits and set the fastest lap record. Every launch and cornering decision impacts your final time.

2. Precision Controls + Authentic Feel: Dual support for virtual buttons and controllers. Light taps steer, smooth drifts flow. The physics engine replicates real racing inertia and friction—mastering cornering lines is all about skill. Beginners can dive right in, while veterans can hone their racing lines to perfection.

4. Retro Tracks with Hidden Secrets: Consecutive hairpins, long straightaway accelerations, and concealed shortcuts distill classic racing essence. Every run reveals new optimization potential—enjoy the full thrill of record-breaking achievements during spare moments!

data.name: Exit, Seriously?
data.detailed_description:
Short Description:
An observation-based horror (?) game co-created by a university student and a near-breakdown AI assistant.
Find the anomaly, or turn back. If you get stuck in a weird bug... let's just call it "Post-Modern Art."

Detailed Description:
Exit, Seriously? is a walking simulator that pays "tribute" (and by that, we mean we stitched a lot of memes together) to The Exit 8.
Prepare to face not only eerie anomalies but also a codebase built on 30% logic, 20% luck, and 50% blind faith in an AI helper.

Key Features:

  • Immersive "Masterpiece": Experience visuals and lighting that scream "I tried my best, I promise."

  • AI-Enhanced Logic: Some scripts were written by an AI assistant after being screamed at for the 50th time about a compiler error.

  • The "No-Save" Challenge: Why no saves? Because of the... uh... "plot requirements." One sitting, one soul, no regrets.

  • Live Bullet Chat (Danmaku): You’re not alone. The hallway is filled with abstract rants and internet wisdom.

  • The Ultimate Dilemma: Is that an anomaly, or is the Shader just glitching? That is the question.

Dev Note:
If it runs smoothly, it’s a miracle. If it crashes, it’s "Atmospheric Horror." It’s been a long journey, now it’s your turn to taste the... art.

data.detailed_description:
A captivating blend of deckbuilding roguelike and tower defense genres. Craft your powerful deck, embark on a grand adventure through the Forest Kingdom, and wage epic battles against relentless enemy hordes.



TOWERS AND SPELLS IN THE FORM OF CARDS


Discover hidden treasures, relics of ancient power, gleaming gold, and powerful cards as you journey through the Forest Kingdom

Key Features:
  • -Deckbuilding Mastery: Craft and refine your deck of cards, each representing a unique spell or tower, to develop a winning strategy.
  • -Epic Adventures: Explore the lush and immersive Forest Kingdom, each map presenting a new tactical puzzle.
  • -Tower Defense Challenges: Defend your kingdom against hordes of cunning foes in thrilling tower defense battles.
  • -Roguelike Progression: Embrace the roguelike elements as you face perils, earn rewards, and grow stronger with each playthrough.
  • -Strategic Choices: Adapt your deck, manage resources, and make critical decisions to survive the evolving challenges.


Explore and conquer the untamed landscapes of the Forest Kingdom. Chart uncharted territories, unveil secrets, and establish your dominion in 'King Wizard of the Forest Kingdom.

data.name: Dungeon Forge
data.detailed_description:
Descend Into the Dungeon

Choose your class, prepare your gear, and head below the surface.

In Dungeon Forge, every run starts with a simple goal: gather what you can, become stronger, and see how deep you can go before the dungeon gets the better of you.

Choose Your Class

Start as one of several different classes, each built around a different playstyle.

Take the direct approach as a Warrior, rely on speed and Dexterity as a Rogue, use magic as a Mage, fight from range as a Ranger, or combine strength and support abilities as a Paladin.

Your starting stats shape how you approach combat and progression from the beginning of the run.

Explore the Depths

Leave the village behind and descend floor by floor into dark dungeon chambers.

Explore the map, search for resources, fight enemies, gain experience, and look for a way deeper underground. Keep track of your health, mana, equipment, resources, and everything you have collected along the way.

The farther you go, the more important preparation becomes.

Gather Resources

Not everything you need comes from defeated enemies.

Chop trees for wood, mine stone and collect different ores that can be used for crafting and construction. Better tools allow you to gather resources more efficiently and prepare for tougher parts of the run.

What you bring back to the village can be just as important as what you find inside the dungeon.

Craft Better Equipment

Use collected materials to create improved tools, weapons, and armor.

Upgrade basic axes and pickaxes into stronger versions made from materials such as iron, copper, and mithril. Build a Forge to gain access to more advanced equipment and prepare yourself for deeper floors.

Choosing what to craft — and when to spend your limited resources — is part of every run.

Develop the Village

The village is more than just a starting point.

Spend wood and stone to construct useful buildings such as a Sawmill, Forge, Kiln, and Trading Post. Each structure provides bonuses or new options that can make the rest of your run easier.

Invest in the village early, or save those materials for your equipment. The choice is yours.

Take On Quests

Visit the Quest Board for additional objectives while you explore.

Hunt specific enemies, collect requested materials, or complete other tasks to earn XP and valuable resources. Quests give you another reason to explore and can help speed up your character's progression.

Grow Stronger

Defeat enemies, earn experience, level up, improve your equipment, and build around the strengths of your chosen class.

Every floor gives you another chance to improve — and another chance to lose everything.

Choose your class. Gather. Craft. Fight. Descend. Die. Repeat.

data.name: Your Heart
data.detailed_description:
Puzzle game with a little story. The rules are simple! Clear the stage by absorbing the three colored orbs into the pedestals of each color. Gradually, various gimmicks are added, and the difficulty increases.

By the way... who are you, and why are you solving these puzzles?

Play with a mouse or gamepad. Gamepads only support XInput.
You can change the language, resolution (1920*1080 or 1280*720), and gamepad cursor speed from the "Settings" in the game.
Languages ​​available are Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified) (Traditional), Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Korean, and Russian.

data.name: Infinite Ball Heaven
data.detailed_description:
You've been sent down to the deepest layer of Infinite Ball Hell.

The only way to save yourself? Meet your quota and ascend through ball purgatory by taking advantage of more than 100 combo heavy Charms, game changing Relics, unique Pegs, and more.

In Infinite Ball Heaven, you gain points from dropping a ball onto a peg or falling to the bottom of the screen, multiplied by the time it took you to fall for the first time. When you fall to the bottom, you end up back at the top! It's Infinite, remember?

I wonder what would happen if you had a charm that converted hits to falls? Or one that gave a bonus based on how quickly you fell?

Infinite Ball Heaven is a game about synergies. Your approach varies drastically depending on your build, and there's no shortage of interesting strategies to discover.

More than 18 unique bosses stand in your path to Ball Heaven as you traverse 9 layers of purgatory, forcing you to carefully consider your approach.

The game features detailed pixel art, Photorealism, and hand drawn elements.

data.name: Cooperate! Angel idol! 連動!天使偶像!
data.detailed_description:
◆Story

Idols live for their fans, and when an idol graduates, she says goodbye to them for good.

Angel Idol has graduated - or so the whole world believes. In truth, it's all evil hypnosis! The evil organizers keep the fans hypnotized as hostages, and that lets them do whatever they want with the idols.

Can Golden Axe Idol beat the odds and save her friend? Or will she give in to money and power?

Can Angel Idol stay a virgin at her new job? And while everyone is hypnotized into thinking she graduated, what kind of work is she really doing?

The number one rule for idols: No lewd stuff allowed! So this time nobody gets hypnotized and nothing naughty happens. For sure.

◆ Gameplay

At a rookie idol's meet-and-greet, look for a way to break the hypnosis. Compared to "Golden Axe Idol - Escape The Room", expect a bit more puzzle-solving and thinking.

Some puzzles call for serious thinking, others for a dirty mind.

◆Game Features

1. Set in the same world as "Golden Axe Idol" and "Hypnosis Prison", this is the story of idols fighting back against the agency that makes money off them.

2. Simple escape-the-room puzzles: combine items and enter passcodes.

3. No lewd stuff! This game was made with a single goal in mind: a virgin run.

4. But anal doesn't count!

◆ Author’s Note

I love Angel Idol, and I miss her. Beautiful and fleeting, like fireworks - that's the angel's way of being an idol. Even so, I hope she lives on forever in little H-games.

I was only hypnotized into thinking she graduated. She'll always be the lewd idol in my games. Still, my favorite is Golden Axe Idol, so much of the game is about her.

It's a small game, made for my own enjoyment after long hours at a day job, and it reuses the same CGs many times - that's my kink >_< If that's a dealbreaker, hold off on buying; if it's the price, wait for a sale. And if you run into any bugs, I'll fix them.

This game is my everlasting tribute to the legendary idol Kanatan.

data.name: Wilmot Works It Out
data.detailed_description:
Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and hanging them in your house.

You play as Wilmot, who likes to unwind from sorting out a warehouse by sorting out puzzle pieces. Yesterday’s puzzle was a snake wearing a hat, but today’s looks like it might be an octopus?  …or maybe that’s a hamburger?

Once complete, you decide where to hang it. Then the mail person delivers a brand new puzzle! Oh dear, this one has a few extra pieces - I hope there wasn’t a mix-up at the puzzle delivery service!

Complete a series of puzzles to unlock new customisation options for your house, including colours, wallpapers, bookcases, and cats. This house is going to feel like a home in no time at all!

Features

  • Assemble more than 60 original puzzles by Richard Hogg (Hohokum, Flock)

  • Unlock 7 additional rooms in Wilmot's house

  • Decorate each room to your liking with 20+ additional unlockable items

  • Adopt a cat or a dog

  • Sequel to beloved organization game Wilmot’s Warehouse

  • Enjoy hours of extra organizing fun, Wilmot's Warehouse-style, when you unlock Marathon Mode

  • A gentle and slightly jazzy electronic soundtrack to listen to as you ponder and solve, brought to you by composer and sound artist Eli Rainsberry (Wilmot's Warehouse, Flock)

data.name: Toy Soldiers
data.detailed_description:
The Xbox LIVE® Arcade smash hit Toy Soldiers comes to PC!

Toy Soldiers is an action-packed strategy-based game in which players command antique WWI toy soldiers vying for control of the trench-filled battlefields of Europe. Deploy an exciting arsenal such as tanks, cavalry, biplanes, and flamethrowers in vintage WWI toy dioramas. Developed by Signal Studios, Toy Soldiers allows you to take control of individual units or control the entire battlefield from a strategic view. Integrating multiple game genres and world-class visuals, Toy Soldiers is a unique and action-packed entertainment experience!

Command your Toy Soldiers in epic, action-packed battles. Position your defenses and take direct control of your artillery to bomb the enemy positions, pilot your bi-plane against the enemy trench, or maneuver your tanks across No-Man’s Land and lead your Toy Soldiers to victory!

All DLC from the Xbox LIVE® Arcade hit is included!

The Kaiser's Battle DLC


Enjoy all new French inspired content with THE KAISER'S BATTLE! Take on the new experimental boss, The K-Wagen!

Invasion DLC


The British are bringing brand new secret weapons of tiny toy mayhem in Invasion!, the second add-on to Toy Soldiers from Signal Studios! Put on your Kaiser’s helmet and command the German Army against a mad menagerie of new antagonistic toys, including flying saucers, chivalrous knights, and the “Rolls Royce of the Sky,” the WWII Mustang. Defend Germany in a new Mini-campaign topped by the most calculating, head-strong boss of all (batteries not included)! Raise your saber, soldier, and lead the charge against… is that a spaceman? The Invasion has begun!

Content Activation

To activate Toy Soldiers after your purchase, launch Toy Soldiers and select 'Redeem Code' from the main menu. Then follow the instructions to redeem your content.

Alternatively, you can redeem Product Codes for the downloadable content at .

data.name: Division of Labour
data.detailed_description:
In Division of Labour, the player takes on the role of The Manager in a developing nation called Auriverde during a world ecological collapse.
The player manages the workforce and machinery of a factory, fulfilling contracts and earning profits for the Overseer Corp. Buying resources, manufacturing goods, managing the workers and facing moral and ethical decisions are the core of the game.

Compassion

The player has the option to make their workers more comfortable to improve efficiency, or pay them more to increase worker happiness. Events may occur where the player can do a favour for a worker, give time off for a holiday or generally try to help them.

Exploitation

However, Overseer Corp always demands larger and larger profits, and so balancing these becomes the core of the game. To make greater and greater profits, more sacrifices will need to be made and corners will need to be cut.

Storytelling

Along the way, the player will be presented with moral and ethical decisions regarding their works and the world at large. Whether it's simply a worker who needs time of for medical reasons or an earthquake on the other side of the world sending migrants flocking to Auriverde for work and security, there's always decisions to make.

Development Progress



A playable demo will be available very soon. To stay up to date with development you can follow our site. For now, consider adding us to your wishlist!

data.name: Ambienz
data.detailed_description:
Ambienz: States of Mind is a vision quest experience through worlds of seemingly endless variety and moods. Choose how you’re feeling when you start, and you’ll be floating through procedurally-generated spaces, with an AI composer generating music to accompany you. Every experience is unique. Find and collect gems, evade and hide from enemies in challenges against time, or enter zen mode and fly and float in complete freedom.It’s hypnotic and entrancing. It’s all about your state of mind.

FOR ANYONE
It’s an open journey where the interface is simple and intuitive. Made for all ages and experience levels.

CHOOSE YOUR STATE OF MIND
On launching, the experience will ask you, “How are you feeling right now?” Your answer will plunge you into environments that match the mood you’re in, and slowly, world-by-world, let you experience a progression of other states of mind.

DIVERSE CONTENT
Fly and float through spaces simple and complex, colorful and rich, and inspired by a myriad of aesthetics and styles. The worlds are procedurally generated, which means there’s no end to the number of possibilities that await you.

HYPNOTIC MUSIC
The AI composer adapts to your chosen state of mind and comes up with the appropriate music to guide you along your vision quest.

Letter from the publisher:

Hi there, this is the publisher. Thanks for buying Ambienz, we hope you enjoy the experience.

We wanted to let you know some of the background behind this game and why we chose to publish it. It was developed by just two people. Byron, a very experienced game developer in the UK who’s worked for games studios like EA, Sega, and Lionhead, and Joseph, a Professor working at a school in the USA teaching game development to the next generation of game developers. In other words, this wasn’t made by some faceless corporation pumping out mass market games but an artisanal approach to game development, made by hand by two people who cared about it a lot.

Byron wrote the code while Joseph designed the levels. Joseph is a child of the 60’s, which might go some way to explain some of the ‘trippier’ levels. To both of them, Ambienz is an attempt at providing an antidote to the turmoil and hate that the world seems to be going through at the moment. It’s designed to be something you can pick up and chill out to rather than be fast paced and adrenaline-filled. You won’t find any violence in this game, just abstract procedurally generated levels to explore and relax in.

One of the other reasons we decided to publish this game was the technology behind it. On the outside it may look humble but on the inside there’s a lot going on. Each level is procedurally generated which means technically, if you wanted to, you could go on playing forever. Then there’s the music. It sounds simple but the music is being composed in real-time using an ‘AI’ procedural music generator. It’s like having a live musician improvising a tune right next to you - that’s what the music generator in Ambienz is doing. It’s impressive technology.

So, we hope you enjoy it and if you do, please leave us a review!

data.name: Captain of the Guard
data.detailed_description:
You have been charged with the defense of a new settlement in a hostile land. Prepare your guards and send them into battle against the horde of creatures that stalk the wilderness. As time passes and the settlement grows, so do the threats that you face.

Upgrade your guards with a unique leveling system along with a wide variety of weapons, armor, feats, and magical abilities to keep them one step ahead of danger. With randomly generated encounters, no play-through is the same, forcing you to constantly adapt to new enemies and challenges.

Manually control your guards in battle or watch them fight on their own with the auto-battler system.

How long can you survive as Captain of the Guard?

  • 300+ Enemies and Bosses

  • 70 Weapons (Swords, Daggers, Bows, Greataxes, Spears, Staves and Shields)

  • 30 Armor Sets (Cloth, Medium, Heavy)

  • 36 Unique Spells and Abilities

  • 45 Feats to Specialize each Guard

  • Randomly generated world map, encounters, and upgrades for a unique gameplay experience

data.name: Anipocalypse
data.detailed_description:
The Animal Apocalypse has begun!
Play thrhough the epic, totally normal and definitly 100% serious storyline of Anipocalypse!
Shoot your way through hordes of zombies and mutated animals of all kinds. Go in guns blazing in the forest, or go stealth mode with a sniper on a rooftop.
Meet other survivors, do sidequests, fight zombies and mutant animals, learn cheatcodes from your uncle, and complete super useful tutorials!

Your mission:
You, John Jonas Johnson, are the last super soldier of the secret government experiment "Project Super Soldier" You are the only one who can complete this most important mission. Bring the super important intel to the last operational lab facility in the country, and we might be able to stop the Apocalypse and save humanity.

Expand your arsenal!
Fight impending death with stopping power in all shapes and sizes, wether you prefer spraying and preying with an AK or an SMG, or you'd rather stay in the treeline with a sniper, we got you! Anipocalypse offers a wide variety of guns for different playstyles. And with your mechanical arms, you'll have nearly zero recoil! Just watch your Arm Durability, if your arms break down, you're in big trouble...

PVP against your friends!
With the optional Multiplayer Mode, you can battle your friends on different maps based on iconic in-game locations! Using different story-charatcers and their specialized skills.

Grind for epic gun skins!
If you're anything like the developer of this game, you LOVE gun skins. Anipocalypse offers challenges that will seamlessly blend into regular gameplay, to unlock shiny new gun skins for all you completionists out there! And if you're good at finding secrets, there might be some skins in store for you too!

data.name: Avatars
data.detailed_description:
JOIN US ON DISCORD!


About the Game

Avatars is an AI-powered creative sandbox and social role-play experience where you design unique characters and bring them to life. Choose a name, photo, backstory, and personality tone to shape your creation, then release it into the community for others to discover and interact with.

Each avatar uses artificial intelligence to generate dynamic conversations and unique behaviors based on the traits you define, making every interaction feel personal and alive.

The game offers a wide set of features:

  • AI-Driven Personalities: Every avatar has its own conversational style and logic powered by artificial intelligence, adapting to its mood, tone, and story.

  • Avatar Creation: Build characters in minutes by combining names, images, biographies, and personality traits.

  • Role-Play & Interaction: Talk naturally with your avatars or those created by other players—each responds in real time according to its defined personality.

  • Community Sharing: Publish your creations and explore a growing library of AI-generated characters made by others.

  • Voting & Discovery: Rate community avatars, climb the charts, and find unique personalities shared by fellow players.

  • Endless Variety: Create celebrities, historical figures, fictional heroes, or completely original personas—your imagination sets the limit.

  • Quick Sessions or Long Play: Jump in for a short AI chat or spend hours expanding your collection and developing complex personalities.

Avatars is not about winning or losing, but about creativity, imagination, and AI-powered social play. Build your personal collection, interact with living characters, and share the avatars that only you could imagine.

data.name: Fail Fail Succeed
data.detailed_description:
A Puzzle Game About Failure

A puzzle platformer about turning failure into progress, inspired by the developer's struggles with cycles of manic highs and depressive lows.

You’re trapped inside a dream-like dimension, with no clear way out.

She wants to guide you forward.
But, the path ahead is full of deadly traps… and your only real ability? To fail.

Fortunately for you, there are mysterious orbs that let you leave a fragment of yourself behind. What remains will become barriers against hazards or platforms paving your way forward.

Fail and fail again, until you succeed.
Persistence and clever thinking is the only way out of this place.

Key Features

  • Logic-Driven Puzzles
    With 40+ handcrafted levels, every puzzle has a solution grounded in consistent logical systems. 
    Put your creative problem solving to the test, and discover all the ways to fail!

  • Fail To Succeed 
    Failure isn't optional. Embrace failure to learn, uncover and overcome whatever stands in your way.
    Fail, reflect on the new possibilities, adapt, and try again.

  • Fast Resets
    Did you fail too much? Fear not! 
    With fast resets, the game encourages you to experiment with failure, to learn, and try again.

  • Narrative Without Words
    No spoken or written dialogue.
    Meaning is implicitly told though visuals and game play.

  • Dog(s)!
    Choose between multiple dogs to be your guide, source of comfort and motivation, in an otherwise bleak world.
    Is your dog missing from the game? Contact us and we will try to remedy that!

Background

Originally conceived while a student, Fail Fail Succeed grew from feelings of being stuck in a cycle of manic highs and depressive lows. The mechanics were designed as metaphors for those struggles: failure as an inevitable outcome, but traces of progress being left behind. In a bleak world of exhausting repetition, small comforts in the companionship of a loyal pup often became a guiding light.

Fail Fail Succeed is developed by a single developer. What began as a small weekend project, slowly grew after positive feedback, was further developed for Gotland Game Conference and Swedish Game Awards, and is now finally coming to Steam for everyone to play!

data.reviews:
“Equally beautiful, fun and easy to relate to.”
Gamereactor

“Fail Fail Succeed is undoubtedly fun, the puzzles are clever, and more importantly, they make me feel clever whenever I figure them out.”
8/10 – Fix Gaming

“Fail Fail Succeed is one of those games that do what they do nigh-on perfectly. The minimalist art and satisfyingly tricky puzzles are a delight. But it’s the sense of kindness and compassion at the core of its beautifully implemented ludonarrative premise that, as it lovingly taxed our brains, simultaneously stole our hearts.”
4.5/5 – So Many Games

data.name: POTUS Election Sim
data.detailed_description:
A political career, from a statehouse seat to the White House

POTUS Election Sim follows one politician through a whole career. You start in a state legislature, a city hall or a seat in Congress, in any year from 1960 to today, and work your way up through governor, the cabinet and the vice presidency to the presidency. Each office is a full game, with its own campaign and its own job to do once you win.

Campaigns are played as debates, town halls, canvassing, donor calls and rallies across real states and districts. The results come in on election night, which runs like a TV broadcast: counties report, the networks call states when the count supports it, and the House and Senate fill in seat by seat.

Winning is where the work starts. Bills go to a floor vote in which every member of Congress votes on their own record. Budgets have to add up. Courts strike things down. Foreign governments remember how you treated them. Every decision comes with written options to pick from, and you can always write your own answer instead. An AI running on your own computer reads what you wrote and works out what happens next.

Your record goes with you. The governor you crossed as a state legislator is still there when you run for president.

The career ladder

  • State legislature: a short district campaign, then floor votes, leadership elections and a re-election that depends on how your district rates you.
  • City hall: 36 real mid-sized American cities, each with its real number of council wards. Pass a budget where every line has voters behind it.
  • Congress: House or Senate. Vote on 71 bills, run for leadership, and chair a committee: hold hearings, mark up bills, open investigations, and advance or bury the President's nominees.
  • Governor: sign or veto bills, survive override votes, balance the state budget, rule on clemency petitions, handle disasters and raise a State Defense Force.
  • Cabinet: the one job nobody elects you to. A President can appoint you from Congress.
  • Vice President: preside over the Senate, break tied votes, take on a portfolio, and be ready if the President cannot finish the term.
  • President: the top of the ladder, below.

A career that starts in the past is set in that year: its map, its campaign issues, its political class, and the real Senate, House and governor candidates who ran in each state. Pick one of 21 backgrounds, from military veteran and prosecutor to union organizer, tech founder and farm owner. Each one brings its own donors, voter blocs, natural committees and the attack line your opponents will use. Every office has its constitutional minimum age. After the presidency you can go back down the ladder, or run for president again if the Twenty-Second Amendment allows it.

Campaigns

Classic mode plays the campaign as minigames: debates, town halls with local questions, canvassing, donor calls, rapid response, rally hecklers and more. Freeform mode replaces them with a text box: write any answer you like, and the AI scores it.

  • Primaries with a delegate race, their own election night and a convention
  • A running mate who matters, or two, if you want to try a fusion ticket
  • Super PACs that spend for you and against you, and that you are not allowed to coordinate with
  • Questions that fit the year, so a 1960 town hall asks about 1960
  • Run as a Democrat, a Republican, a party you found yourself, or as Ross Perot in 1992 and 1996

Election night

Election night is a live broadcast. Returns arrive county by county across all 3,142 counties, states are called when the count supports it, and you can switch between the presidential map, the Senate, the House and the county view at any time. On the 3D map, each state rises as it is called, as tall as its electoral votes. Maine and Nebraska split their electoral votes by district in the years they really did. Third parties get their own column and their own colour on the map. Primary nights, midterm nights and down-ballot races get the same broadcast.

The presidency

The First 100 Days come first: cabinet confirmations, your agenda, a first bill and a first crisis. Then the term runs day by day through the midterms and into re-election.

  • Congress: 71 bills, each with its own coalition. Every member votes on their own lean, and you whip the votes you are short of. A bill tracker follows each one from introduction to signature.
  • The budget: a fiscal model under the whole term. Deficits pile up, interest crowds out everything else, and a balanced budget amendment forces real cuts.
  • Executive orders: six policy areas and three scopes. The bigger the order, the more likely a judge strikes it down.
  • The courts: nine justices who age, retire and die. Your laws and orders are challenged in court and can be appealed to the Supreme Court. Replacements need the Senate.
  • Treaties: negotiate trade, defence, climate and arms deals with the major powers, then find 67 votes in the Senate.
  • Amendments: two-thirds of Congress and 38 states. You can also amend Article V itself and change those numbers.
  • Constitutional hardball: resize the House or the Supreme Court, end the filibuster, repeal the Twenty-Second Amendment, admit new states. All legal, and all expensive.
  • Approval: every point you gain or lose comes with its cause, so you can see why the number moved.
  • Losing the job: scandals can lead to impeachment and a Senate trial with every vote counted. You can also resign.

The world, and war

A world map runs under the presidency: relations with every country, sanctions, foreign aid, covert operations, NATO enlargement, trade blocs, and a UN Security Council where any permanent member can veto a resolution.

Going to war takes votes in both houses of Congress. Then you commit real US formations, and the war is fought on a board of brigades laid over the country's real terrain, built from NOAA elevation and ESA land-cover data. You give orders, a day of the presidency passes, and you watch a replay of what happened. A war can end in a peace deal, an occupation, or a quagmire that eats your approval and your budget.

Nuclear command follows the same rules. DEFCON moves with what you have done in the world, a launch order passes through people who can refuse an unlawful one, and a reckless presidency can draw a first strike on the United States after months of warnings.

A Washington full of real people

372 real officeholders fill the game: senators, governors, House members, state legislators and mayors. They remember how you treated them in every office you hold, and you can ask them for endorsements and favours. A career set in the past uses the political class of its own era. After 2026 the world keeps going without you: real people retire, run and win the races you are not in, differently in every career. A social feed, written by the local AI, reacts to what you post.

Third parties

Found your own party with its own name, colour, ideology and platform. It grows with your career: members first, then state legislators, mayors, House and Senate seats and governors, and those seats vote with you. Run the party organisation, with its leadership elections, factions, treasury and platform, whether or not you hold an office yourself. You can also run as John Freedom, the political creator behind the Freedom 2040 movement.

History

Historical Elections replays every presidential race from 1960 to 2024 against the real nominees, on the real state results and that year's electoral votes. The world of that year comes with it: the Soviet Union, the NATO of the time, the arsenals of the time. Parliamentary America takes any of those elections and re-runs it as if the United States elected a Prime Minister, under four different voting systems.

Quick games

  • Quick Play: Presidency: skip the campaign, set your Congress and your Supreme Court, and govern from day one.
  • Quick Election Simulator: any two candidates in any national climate, simulated county by county. Put two presidents at their peak against each other.
  • Quick Midterm Simulator: set the President's approval and each party's strength, then watch all 435 House seats, the Senate class and the governorships come in.
  • Challenge Scenarios: 12 presidential scenarios and 8 career challenges judged on your whole record.
  • Political Playground: six short games built on the simulation: Policy Lab, the Situation Room, the Spin Room, the Cabinet Draft, Which Voter Are You? and the Hall of Fame.

The AI runs on your computer

The game ships with a small language model that runs on your own PC. It writes the briefings, the news, the social posts and the article about your career at the end, and it reads any answer you choose to type. There is no cloud service, no account and no API key, and nothing you write leaves your computer. The model runs in its own process, so if it fails the game carries on. On a weaker machine you can turn it down or off, and every screen has written content to fall back on.

Mods and the Steam Workshop

Make your own elections (any year, real or invented, with its own map, electoral votes and candidates), worlds, parties, campaign event cards and presidency events, and share them on the Workshop. Almost every mod is plain data. A mod that includes code is labelled, and nothing in it runs until you have read it and allowed it.

Also included

  • Story mode hides the numbers; Analyst mode shows every calculation. Switch whenever you like.
  • Six save slots, Steam Achievements and a Steam play-time leaderboard
  • Custom candidate photos, custom music and your own accent colour
  • A three-minute feature tour and a full in-game guide
  • One price. No subscription and no microtransactions.

Most of the changes since launch came from players' suggestions on the game's Discord and the Steam forums. You can join from the main menu.

data.name: Hunter's Arena: Revolution
data.detailed_description:
Escape, Survive, and Extort

Hunter’s Arena: Revolution is an exhilarating and adventurous action set in the Ancient East. Combine various skills, equipment, and tactics to survive and escape a world full of enemies. If you don’t, you may lose all your precious belongings.

In In Ancient Asia

Hunter’s Arena’s expansive map is filled with exquisite oriental beauty. At the same time, the solemness of the ruins of war exists. This is a place where all the resources are rare. Explore hidden locations to obtain these various resources.

However, you must be careful at all times to ensure survival. Between the buildings and the forest, there are many others like yourself looking for resources.

A a Strategic Battle with Various Weapons & Skills

Fortunately, your character is a natural fighter and can fight with any weapon. Survive using weapons and skills that are appropriate for each situation.

The Last Survivor Takes All

Survivors have everything to gain. All loot and treasures acquired during battle are yours to keep.

Now you can strengthen yourself in the safety of the lobby. Upgrade your Shop and combine your weapons and skills to make yourself stronger.

However, remember this. The easiest way to become stronger is to skill and loot others.

data.name: RC Cars
data.detailed_description:
R.C. Cars is an exciting arcade racing game featuring the world of highly realistic toy radio controlled cars. Jump, accelerate, perform acrobatic feats in the air, and bounce on big hummocks, pits and bumps while contending with opponents for victory. Win prize money for placing in the race, purchase car upgrades and participate on further tracks!

Introducing magnificent physics engine, three types of unique racing vehicles and ten off-road levels closely reproducing the real world, R.C. Cars is a real challenge! In the world of R.C. Cars participate in championship, quick race or ghost race. From looped tracks in different environments to real-life obstacles and outstanding off-road abilities, maneuverability and boost capacity of the realistic looking vehicles, R.C. Cars is a truly amazing racing/driving experience!

Key features:

  • 12 characters - each one with her own skills and motivations
  • Physics engine outperforming the majority of car simulators currently on the mass market
  • Fully interactive environment
  • Challenging tracks
  • Unique toy racing vehicles
  • Various upgrades and bonuses
  • Multiplayer support via LAN/Internet

data.name: Ruler of the Roost
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Welcome to the world's most serious chicken warfare simulator.

In Ruler of the Roost, heavily armed chickens wage war across sprawling farms in a chaotic multiplayer party shooter packed with ridiculous weapons, absurd power-ups, and deadly vehicles.

Battle your friends in frantic free-for-alls, team up in objective-based modes, race weaponized chicken karts, defend the Roost from relentless invasions, or simply try to survive the madness. Whether you're pecking opponents into oblivion, launching explosive eggs across the map, or fleeing from a missile-launching police cruiser, no two matches play the same.

Because on this farm...

There are no Geneva Conventions.

FEATURES

🐔 CHAOTIC MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM

Compete online in a variety of game modes including free-for-all, team battles, kart racing, demolition derby, objective modes, and cooperative survival.

🥚 WEAPONS OF MASS EGGSTRUCTION

Explosive eggs. Lightning weapons. Laser eyes. Airstrikes. Rocket launchers. Ridiculous power-ups. If it shouldn't exist on a farm, it's probably here.

🚜 VEHICULAR VIOLENCE

Jump behind the wheel of armed chicken karts, battle in demolition derbies, evade police cruisers, dodge crop dusters, and survive complete farmwide chaos.

👑 RULE THE ROOST

Fight to control the Golden Chicken Statue, steal eggs from rival nests, defend your coop, or survive endless sieges against waves of determined enemies.

🦊 COOPERATIVE CHAOS

Join forces against invading foxes, heavily armed farmers, towering bosses, and horrors that definitely weren't approved by the Department of Agriculture.

🏆 UNLOCK ACHIEVEMENTS

Earn dozens of achievements, unlock new playable chickens, and prove you're worthy of becoming the one true ruler of the roost.

REMEMBER

  • If you hear clucking, it's already too late.

Now get in the coop, soldier. The Peckoning has begun.

data.name: Last Mortem
data.detailed_description:
Are you bored of modern FPS games? Do you hate pay-to-win mechanics? Want to have fun without spending a fortune? Welcome to Last Mortem!

Last Mortem is a fast-paced Multiplayer FPS Game that brings back the nostalgia of 2010s browser shooters! Play with bots or online with friends. Collect over 100 weapons and in-game items, compete for points, and climb to the top of the global leaderboards! Explore more than 10 maps, capture exciting gameplay moments, and become a legend!

No microtransactions, no paywalls, no toxic players!
Tons of content, fast-paced gameplay, and endless fun to cure your boredom!

What Last Mortem offers you:
  • Full AI bot matches or online Multiplayer gameplay
  • Over 100 fully collectible and unlockable weapons, items, and killstreaks
  • Stats and global Leaderboards to compete for legendary status
  • More than 10 detailed maps
  • Extremely simple controls and gameplay - jump in and play
  • Extremely fast progression!

Available Game Modes:
  • Gun Race
  • Deathmatch
  • Team Deathmatch
  • Occupation

Weapon Classes:
  • Assault - light combat rifles
  • Support - machine guns
  • Sniper - sniper rifles of all kinds
  • Demolitions - bazookas and grenade launchers
  • Secondary - SMGs, revolvers, and pistols
  • Melee - knives, swords, and other hand weapons
  • Lethal - grenades, molotovs
  • Non-Lethal - flashbangs, smoke grenades

Maps:
  • Favela - small, fast-paced map in Rio de Janeiro favela
  • Oil Rig - close-combat arena at sea
  • Barbados - large map with a pirate shipwreck on the beach
  • Dolina - small, fast-paced map in a snowy region
  • Tropical City - abandoned city arena
  • Factory - close-combat factory arena
  • Winter Mansion - Xmas themed map
  • Sand Storm - desert village arena
  • Jungle Strike - tropical jungle map
  • Naval Strike - huge island base map

Pluses of the Game:
  • Play with bots or combine them with online players
  • No microtransactions, paywalls, or other restrictions
  • Huge amount of content
  • Fast adaptation to simple gameplay controls
  • Small player-base community: Discord

Minuses of the Game:
  • This is a hobby project indie game; we used some assets, and you might encounter some bugs
  • Our online player base is very limited
  • You might not play the game for long periods daily, but it's perfect for killing some time with fun

data.name: Lingua Fleur: Lily
data.detailed_description:
"Unlike destined and blessed love seen in stories..."

The introvert Yuyi arrives at school every day with a secret deep in her heart.
She kept this secret even from her tutor in middle school.
Meeting new friends, she became determined to say goodbye to her emotions of the past...
But then she suddenly received a party invitation...


Focusing on the theme of "a feeling different from the majority", with delicate and elegant illustrations, and a complete voiceover, this is a visual novel that follows a girl trying to know herself and admit her own sexuality.
The music is mainly created by Oli Jan, who is experienced in performance and composition. They also enrich the work with short animations and fine-tuned performances.


● A kinetic novel of over 60,000 words (no options)
● Fully voiced in Chinese
● A planned DLC to release for free!
● 7 custom CGs

*About it is a yuri game or not, you can check 'Last night before release'





Yuyi Wu

"I've always hoped to be someone just like her. Someone as reliable and gentle as her..."

The introverted protagonist of the story, an excellent university student. She really admired the tutor she had in middle school.
After four years of hard work, no matter in coursework, cooking, or temperament, she did it impeccably.
Her only obvious weakness shows when she plays sports...
Dreaming of meeting someone just like in her otome comics, she's gradually realized just how different they are from reality.

Yile Lin

"When you're in a bad mood, you have to laugh more! Come on, it'll bring you good luck! Smile! Hehe~"

Yuyi's classmates with such an optimistic personality it can clear a cloudy sky.
As the public relations person of the faculty, she's organized many activities and is the rising star of the volleyball team.
Her direct and straightforward character can be somewhat offensive at times though.
But her upbeat and innocent nature is hard to stay angry at.

Sis Tutor

"I'm happy you've come to ask me. Hopefully we can chat a bit afterwards too."

Yuyi's middle school tutor, giving off a very gentle impression.
The two were very close, but because of some reasons...
After Yuyi graduated, they never met again. They only talk now through social media...

data.name: Booeys: Rip in the Rift
data.detailed_description:
A rip in the rift has brought items from the human world to Booey's world! Booey needs your help to clean everything up and send it home. Can you bring order to the chaos?




Discover over 150 unique things to possess and control! Balls roll, ducks waddle, planes fly, and toast... toasts?






For Clinicians, Teachers, and Parents

Booeys: Rip in the Rift was built to supplement VB-MAPP assessments and curriculum in a fun and engaging format and provides countless levels of customization to support individualized instruction.

Easy to get started; powerful enough for professional use!



The Verbal Behavior Milestones Assessment and Placement Program (VB-MAPP) was designed by Dr. Mark Sundberg as a criterion referenced assessment curriculum guide, and skill tracking system. Based on the theory of verbal behavior, the VB-MAPP is an evidenced based assessment commonly used for early learners with language delays and autism spectrum disorder.

Booeys: Rip in the Rift seamlessly integrates with your curriculum, aligning with educational standards and VB-MAPP goals for visual perception and matching skills. Students sort objects based on various criteria, mirroring activities you already use in the classroom. This game effectively supports:

  • Early learners: Identify identical objects (fruits, shapes) like Kindergarten standards.
  • Developing learners: Group similar items (colors, categories) like Grade 1-2 expectations.
  • Advanced students: Find variations within categories (textures, patterns) like Grade 3 and above challenges.

Booeys engages the player with embedded visual prompts subtly guiding players, mimicking therapist instructions, and “explosive” scenes when matching correctly. As children play, Booeys tracks their progress. See accuracy rates, submitted items, and active input time, gaining valuable insights into their development. This data can be shared with clinicians, educators, and parents to guide further learning and interventions.

data.name: Romancing SaGa -Minstrel Song- Remastered
data.detailed_description:
The original Romancing SaGa -Minstrel Song- included many of the SaGa series trademark elements, such as the Glimmer and Combo mechanics and was considered to be the epitome of the series when it first released.
The free scenario system that lets you create your own storyline remains at the core of the game, letting you select one of eight protagonists with completely different origins and backstories, then set off on a unique journey.
This remastered edition has evolved in all areas, featuring upgraded HD graphics and numerous enhancements to improve playability. This makes it highly recommended for both fans of the original and newcomers to the SaGa series.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Story

The gods created man and man created stories.

The primordial creator Marda brought forth the land of Mardias.
In ages past a mighty battle rocked this land, when Elore, the king of the gods, fought three malicious deities: Death, Saruin and Schirach.
After a long and drawn-out struggle, Death and Schirach were sealed away and rendered powerless, with the final deity Saruin also trapped through the power of the Fatestones and the noble sacrifice of the hero Mirsa.
Now 1000 years have passed since that titanic battle.

The Fatestones lie scattered across the world and the gods of evil are resurgent once more.
Eight heroes set off on their own journeys, as if guided by the hand of fate.

What tales will these adventurers weave across the vast tapestry of Mardias?
You are the only one who can decide!
-------------------------------------------------------------------

▷New Elements

In addition to a full HD graphical upgrade, various new features expand the gameplay even further.

■ The sorceress Aldora can now be recruited!
The sorceress Aldora, who once traveled together with the legendary hero Mirsa, appears in her original form. Experience new events where she recounts the journeys of Mirsa first hand.

■Unique and interesting characters now made playable!
Fan-favourite Schiele finally joins your adventures and characters such as Marina, Monica and Flammar can now also be recruited.

■Enhanced bosses!
Several bosses now appear as super powerful enhanced versions! Take on these terrifying adversaries to a new arrangement of the battle music score.

■Improved playability!
Various new features have been added to make your play experience even more convenient, such as a high speed mode, mini maps, and a “New Game +” option that lets you carry over your progress when you play through the game again.

■And even more...
・New classes to expand the breadth of gameplay.

data.name: Project: Autumn
data.detailed_description:
Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands. 

Run, climb, and crawl across the islands as you collect and find new items and tools! 

Why are we always so pressured by efficiency? Work together with many fun and quirky people as you each learn to relax and enjoy the beauty around you.

Although on a top secret mission, the distractions here are plentiful!

"Surely our bosses won’t mind if we collect a few more flowers."

data.name: Nine Realms Prologue
data.detailed_description:
WHISLIST THE FULL GAME


About the Game

DESTROY ALL THE GODS!
The body of the thunder god has been taken over by the most cunning god of the universe. Find the gods hidden in different realms and destroy them all until you are the only god left standing!

YOU'RE THE VERY RAGNAROK ITSELF
There's no hero's tale here. On the contrary, you will be the nightmare of heroes! Develop your strategy and unleash the cosmic calamity.



EVERY DEFEAT IS A NEW BEGINNING
Giving up is not in the nature of the thunder god. Each time you are defeated, warp time and start over with what you've gained. Embark on your next journey more experienced and powerful.



CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER TO FIT YOUR STRATEGY
Various weapons, armors, abilities, allies, and more have been specifically designed for you to develop your own strategy. Choose what suits you best and develop it permanently. You are free to choose whatever you want before you start fighting.



REALMS, CHARACTERS, AND CREATURES TO DISCOVER
With dynamic and voiced dialogues, realms offering different experiences and challenges, a vast bestiary, and dozens of characters you will get to know, Nine Realms presents a new universe and a deep story that tackles Norse Mythology in a different reality, waiting for you to discover.


FATE BOWS BEFORE THE INEVITABLE
Enjoy being the thunder god with detailed leveling and development systems, an immersive story, and realistic graphic quality! Remember, there are no rules here, you are here only to destroy.

data.name: Icity - a Flight Sim ... and a City Builder
data.detailed_description:
1 Week, 1 Dozen Countries!!!


Thank you Everyone for making our 1st week on the Steam Store a Worldwide success!


December Update Now Available



Icity is a flight sim … and a city builder, and we have good news! Our first game update is now available, and is based on the great feedback that we’re receiving via our website, social media, and the Icity Community Hub on Steam. There are many improvements and new features for flying and city building, including:

  • A key-mapping system with new keyboard layouts.
  • A “hot-key” for attaching and releasing Cargo Modules.
  • A “hot-key” to centre aircraft flight controls and hold position.
  • A major overhaul of the Fine-Adjustment system for thrusters.
  • Data-overlays on the Satellite Map view.
  • New velocity indicator on the HUD.
  • A “buddy drone” camera view.

And perhaps most important of all … the pilot seats now have adjustable armrests and cup-holders! Building a city can be hard work, even while sitting in the BA3’s comfortable pilot seats (and the cupholders were a popular request).

We’re also getting ready to introduce multiple building styles, and have included an early look at the upgraded Building Printer controls to try out ahead of time, along with a new House style.

A nice slideshow on the Main Menu presents more updates. Thank you everyone for your feedback and suggestions!


January Update Now Available



Happy New Year from everyone at Icity - a flight sim … and a city builder. The January 2017 update is now available with some big changes ... new aircraft and new buildings!!! Pilots can now try out the zippy little Firefly Mark.I and the larger Dirigible Mark.I, two new aircraft which can be accessed via the Game Options menu (while in-game, type 'G' with the default keyboard layout). They share the BA3's control layouts and startup procedures which means the Ice-City pilots are now cross-certified. Awesome.

The Building Printer module can now make 2 new houses, 2 new offices, and 2 new factories, which will help Ice City develop with new style!


About the Game


So ... you're a brand new pilot with dreams to take on the world? How about building one of your own? You've always thought that things would be much better if you were in charge - now here's your chance! Icity is a flight sim ... and a city builder! And like nuts and gum, they're together at last.

Your new job as the chief-pilot with the Icity Development Company means that you're now in charge of a bold project to build a new city on the Alta Ice Cap. An exploration crew has just discovered a reservoir of Di-Hydro-Oxygen crystals that could be very profitable if an efficient mining operation can be established. The company is willing to set up a base camp to try out a test mine, and if everything looks good ... well, the sky's the limit.

Why do you get to be the chief pilot? Because Alta is located high on a frozen ice sheet, thousands of miles from the nearest outpost, and no one else wanted the job. In fact, you're the only pilot, and until you help build something there, the company won't be sending any help.

Fly specially-designed aircraft to explore and build your own ice city of the future. Transport workers, deliver supplies, and collect the spoils of the crystal mines to help your city grow ... or just fly around and explore your new world. Icity puts the pilot in charge of everything.

This is your time to shine and show the world! Can you found a profitable mining camp and grow it into a city? Perhaps you might build an empire of your very own!

Features:


  • Innovative aircraft with interactive controls, displays, and switches.
  • HUD and Autopilot-enabled for easy cruising and precision construction work.
  • Unique Payload and Cargo Modules for special missions.
  • Multiple cameras providing real-time views and map systems.
  • Complete control of city construction (direct or automated).
  • City economic system linked to growth.
  • Logistics controls for building supplies and product shipments.

data.name: Dark Hill Museum of Death
data.detailed_description:
Dark Hill Museum of Death is a journey through a virtual museum where uniquely themed exhibits are unlocked by solving puzzles. Never opened to the public, the museum's secrets are yours to discover.

  • Experience the atmosphere of six uniquely themed exhibits.
  • Solve puzzles of varying difficulty. Stuck on a puzzle? Go explore and come back to it!
  • Learn the history of death through the ages.
  • Admire real death-themed artwork from different cultures and time periods.



Monarchs, prisoners, deserters, and witches all have one thing in common - the occasional early demise at the hands of an executioner.

Learn about execution methods from the middle ages to the 20th century then escape this exhibit unscathed.



Spanish conquistadors wrote of their horror upon first witnessing Aztec sacrifices. You won't see anything quite so gruesome here, but you can see some artistic depictions inside the museum's Aztec-themed pyramid.



Keep your head down while exploring this recreation of a World War II trench and you'll find your way to the dugout.

Check out the collection of war posters and listen to real war-era radio broadcasts while you're there.



Take a stroll through the museum's own mini-graveyard and enjoy the atmosphere of a starry night among the graves.

Try out the interactive cremation exhibit, but don't let the dust get in your eyes.



Do you know who Pesta The Plague Hag is? You will.

Planning your visit


  • You should expect to spend around an hour at the museum.
  • You'll likely complete your tour in one visit, but you can leave and pick up where you left off at any time. No hand stamp required.
  • There are no jump-scares in the museum. It's a little creepy, but nothing will pop up and scare you.
  • The museum contains artwork depicting death, but nothing excessively graphic.

data.name: Tower Of Penguinaria
data.detailed_description:
General:
Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica. 
What Makes This Game Different:

In addition to being a Rougelite, RPG, Dungeon Crawler, Timeloop, game (where character stats improve based on what you wear). Depending on what you wear will change what you're move set in the turn based combat will do!
There is also a death loop feature. Dying will make you enter Kenos (land of the dead) where you can unlock metaprogression to give yourself more time, or power, to defeat the Sealsorer who lurks on top of the Tower.
Finally a mix of unique enemies, traps, and bosses makes even crawling on this randomly generated 2d dungeon engaging. Timing runs over dangerous spikes, dodging meteors, and blocking attacks on the game map, before heading into the battlefield keeps crawling dynamic and fun!

Game Loop:
Enter the dungeon to get xp and money
Buy new gear to get further (and unlock checkpoints)

perish or run out of time, allowing you to spend those hard earned levels on permanent buffs

Credits:
Developer: RpgPenguin
Artists: RpgPenguin, BlueIsTopia

data.name: Tower Fall
data.detailed_description:
Tower Fall is a fun PC alternative to the board game known as "falling tower". The principle is quite simple: a tower is built from even bars (each new “floor” is made with alternating laying direction and consists of 3 bars), and then the players begin to carefully pull out one bar at a time and put it on top of the tower. The one who loses in the game, after the course of which, the tower fell.

Game features:

- 3 types of game:
* game against artificial intelligence
* game between two people
* scoring game
- different types of locations
- several types of bars

data.name: Miner Meltdown
data.detailed_description:
Miner Meltdown is a 2D team-based online competitive multiplayer game. Scour the map for minerals, upgrade your gear, and attempt to blow up the opposing team all the while avoiding monsters, traps, and environmental pitfalls along the way. Maps are randomly generated and 100% destructible, so every match is a fully unique, fast-paced, and chaotic affair.




  • 4 vs 4 online multiplayer
  • Randomly generated and 100% destructible terrain
  • Over 20 unique weapons and gadgets to choose from
  • Fast-paced gameplay using ropes and jetpacks to move around the map with ease.
  • Bots, so you can play online or solo
  • "Deathmatch", "Crazy King" & "Diamond Dash" game-types
  • Tons of thrust-dancing

Two teams of 4 spawn on opposite sides of the randomly generated mine. Players must explore the map in search for gold, which can be used to purchase better weapons and equipment. Teams that collect more gold will generally have an edge in battle.

Teams collect points by killing enemy players, or neutral monsters. The team with the most points at the end of the round is victorious.

Gameplay is fast-paced, so hold onto your butts.

data.name: EchoLink: Recursion
data.detailed_description:
EchoLink: Recursion is an active incremental, cyberpunk hacking simulation where every breach makes you stronger, and every reset makes you faster.

You're a hacker sent back through time to uncover a conspiracy that keeps collapsing history. You start in the 1990s with just a dial-up modem, a terminal, and your wits before you advance to the neural megacities of 2150.

Hack → upgrade → automate → bigger hack → reset stronger.

At the beginning, you do everything manually. Crack networks one keystroke at a time, run missions, scrape together enough creds for your first real upgrade. Then your second. Then a script that handles tasks for you. Then a crew running side jobs with you. Then an AI automating your hacking skills.

Unleash Devastating Payloads

When stealth doesn't cut it, you go loud. Deploy devastating neural viruses, build proxy chains, and automate your entire operation while enemy factions deploy their own viruses and ice sentinels to hunt you down. Watch a hostile network just… stop existing.

Huge Meta-Progression Tree (it's not even it's final form)

When the timeline finally collapses (and it will), you keep what you learned. A meta-progression tree with hundreds of nodes means every reset peels off a new layer. By the end you're not really hacking systems anymore—you're hacking time itself.

P.S. I am a solo indie developer and read every comment and review. Join my Discord and shape the future of EchoLink with me!

data.name: Football Life
data.detailed_description:
Finely Tuned Football Simulation

  • Real tactics. Real movement. Players plant their feet, pivot, and accelerate like they do on a real pitch—no skating.

  • The football simulation is meticulously crafted, so every result feels earned, not scripted.

  • A player with poor long shots won’t suddenly score screamers from distance. Attributes are modelled carefully and drive the results.

  • As the manager, you can issue detailed, per-player instructions. You can also use different formations in attack and in defence.

Carefully Blended Genre Hybrid

  • Your club isn’t just text—it lives in an RPG world with its own training centre and stadium. Experience the full football life as a manager.

  • Prefer pure management? You can skip the RPG part entirely. The game is designed to support different playstyles.

  • Success in the RPG world or strong personal relationships won’t help you win matches. But a healthy club atmosphere and clear internal order can subtly influence your players’ mindset and training attitude.

  • Residents of your club’s home city may or may not be football fans. Club success and positive impact can draw more locals into the sport and boost matchday attendance.

Powerful Customisation

  • Our community builds incredible worlds, so we’re giving you the same powerful tools we use. Build your own football hometowns or grab cities from other players and jump straight into a season.

  • At launch, we officially provide Manchester region with two playable clubs. All other local clubs are playable via our powerful customisation feature. We plan to expand to London in a post-launch update.

  • We’re aiming to support a broad set of leagues, with more to come.

  • And yes—player, manager, club, and league names, plus club logos, are all editable.

The enemy has been feasting on your territory for so long that they forgot to evolve.

  • 6 Levels

  • 30 Enemies

  • Endless Mode

This is a solo-dev project, made with a custom C++ engine.

data.name: She Fell Off
data.detailed_description:
Unravel the enigma of the post-apocalyptic world in "She Fell Off," an indie game crafted by a single developer that plunges you into a dystopian, sci-fi reality where everything familiar has been lost. This atmospheric, third-person, 3D platformer draws you into a mystery that transcends reality as we know it, enveloping you in a paradox where you control Eve, a vibrant, mysterious heroine.

"She Fell Off" paints a dark yet colorful World where the Earth's crust has been devoured, replaced by an unforgiving, acid ocean. With nothing but three enormous, black lily pad-like plants spanning the size of Africa as the only remnants of life, you'll navigate the once-vibrant world, now turned silent and spectral.



But the real mystery lies beneath the surface. Test your courage and step into the underground realm, a perplexing anomaly that houses horrors more terrifying than the surface's desolation. Here, in this minimalistic, precision platformer world, danger lurks in the darkness and the only source of light is you, with Eve's radiant yellow outfit piercing the ever-present gloom.

Survival is a matter of skill and grit in this game. Designed for gamers seeking an intense and frustrating challenge, "She Fell Off" provides no save points. Every demise, every failure, will bring you back to the beginning, forcing you to learn, adapt, and ultimately, to conquer the unknown. It is a relentless test of your resilience as you leap from platform to platform, seeking answers, and perhaps, redemption in the eerie quiet of this post-apocalyptic underground landscape.



The game’s precision platforming, combined with its terrifying premise, creates a unique and unsettling twist on the 3D platformer genre. data.detailed_description:
