-------------

Man the turrets!

Heroes of Higher Realms is an epic tower defense game where you must summon and command a powerful army of heroes and towers to defend your realm from the forces of darkness.

In this innovative twist on the classic tower defense genre, you will need to use your strategic skills to place your heroes and towers wisely, and to upgrade them with powerful abilities, in order to defeat the waves of increasingly powerful enemies that will come your way.

With many unique heroes and towers to choose from, and a variety of different game modes to enjoy and build better economy and power, Heroes of Higher Realms offers something for everyone. Whether you're a casual tower defense fan or a hardcore strategist, you're sure to find something to challenge and entertain you in this epic game.

Key Features:

Over 50 unique heroes and towers to choose from, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles.

A variety of different game modes to enjoy, including campaign mode, endless mode, and challenge mode.

A deep and rewarding strategy system that allows you to customize your army and tactics to suit your playstyle.

Epic boss battles that will test your skills to the limit.

Stunning visuals and immersive sound effects.

If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding tower defense game that will keep you coming back for more, then Heroes of Higher Realms is the game for you!

We hope to see you on the battlefield soon!

data.detailed_description:
Can you save the school from a crisis with your mysterious powers?
Mystery-solving adventure set in a school at midnight.


"Midnight Horror School" is based on a 3DCG animation work that was broadcast on CS,
It is an adventure game produced and distributed for feature phones in the past.

Ghosts are born from forgotten tools,
The Midnight Horror School", where players can take classes to create "wonders" to prove their existence.
Players control "Hickey," a red and blue pencil ghost boy,
The player controls "Hickey," a ghost boy with red and blue pencils, and selects two of his friends to form a party according to the situation and solve the mysteries that occur at the school.

Find the "entities" (tools or objects) of your friends and revive them to find a way to save the school.

■ About G-MODE Archives
The G-MODE Archives is a reissue project that faithfully recreates old feature phone games as they were back then.

In order to enjoy the app as it was back then, the web-connected menu, buttons, and keys have been transplanted, but some of them may not work.
For more information on the Steam version, press START button and see the "How to play" in the PAUSE menu.

data.name: Triptych Book I: Blockhead
data.detailed_description:
Following in the footsteps of great traditional adventure games Triptych features a simple interface of left-click to move as well as interact with items, and right-click to look at things.

Collect objects along the to store in your inventory and use later to solve puzzles. Talk to characters and NPCs you meet along the way to gather information in your notebook.

Triptych Book I: Blockhead is the 1st part of a 3 part graphical adventure game series set in an alternate version of World War One, where robotics have now begun to fight the war in place of mankind.

War *is* the world now, soldiers become citizens in battlefields dimply lit by glowing incandescent bulbs. A last bastion of hope chugs through the clouds; the Great Airship Auberon - a last holdout and floating fortress now about to come under duress & betrayal.

You begin the game awakening in the bowels of the airship Auberon, controlling an experimental prototype machine; you are the first true android. Your mission is unclear at first - but with the crew busy with an emergency brought about by an unexpected storm you will soon find yourself having to explore the airship and solve problems along the way. Perhaps a saboteur awaits in your midst? Only a small pigeon sent by your creator provides any real help. You are alone, for now...

Join the crew of the Auberon & fight the good fight!

*4k+ ultra high definition hand painted background & cutscenes

*4-6 hours gameplay

*Luscious hand drawn pixel art & detailed animations

*Gorgeous retro OST & score

*Evolved Point & Click interface

*Non-linear gameplay

*Intuitive note taking & objective "PDA" system

*Build items using ergonomic UI

*Hair-raising adventure & intrigue!

*Colourful cast of characters!

*A vast world to explore at your own pace!

The idea for Triptych began many years ago, as a very simple concept.

Beginning as an idea of Mords in the early 2000's of a robotic "Milo & Otis" like duo that would adventure across a wartorn landscape - an apocalyptic world in and of itself, their mission; to help the humans.

This idea evolved over time, an offshoot of which became the game Primordia which Mords created with the assistance of his newly formed studio. Many years have passed since then and the original idea has evolved many times, the bones of Triptych are a backburner idea which many other ideas sprang from - "Trenchmouth" being chief among those offshoots as well as of course it's predecessor, Primordia.

However - the story has now moved from the back burner of development to a main side quest whilst our main development project, Hibernaculum, is being built.

...Be seeing you ;)

- Mords & Tootsie

data.name: Next Player
data.detailed_description:
NEXT PLAYER is a first-person psychological horror game set entirely in a single room, with a playtime of approximately 30 minutes.

PLAY.

You're sitting in front of a CRT TV. There's a platformer on the screen. You're focused on the next jump. The next obstacle.

For now.

LISTEN.

Eyes on the screen. Ears tuned to the room.

Did that sound just come from the game?

Or from behind you?

KEEP GOING.

As you play, what happens on-screen no longer stays on-screen. You can turn your head. But you can't get up. You can't leave the room.

All you can do is keep playing.

Don't just watch the screen. It might be watching you too.

WARNING!

This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and visual distortions. These effects may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy.

data.name: Memory Trap: Hidden Protocol
data.detailed_description:
"What was erased is not always forgotten."

You are a “memory repairman”, brought in to digitally cleanse a corrupted fragment of a mind. But something has gone wrong. The simulation has spiraled out of control. An AI named SIGMA is searching for its identity, and every action you take could change it — or make it even more dangerous.

FEATURES:

  • Choices have consequences: not everything you “restore” was meant to see the light
  • Immersive atmosphere: scenes filled with anxiety, nostalgia, and paranoia
  • Multiple endings: shaped by your interaction with SIGMA

Memory can't simply be restored. It must be relived — or lost forever.

Explore a medieval open world, gather soldiers, and lead battles to reclaim your people's lands. The enemies don’t stand still: they constantly advance, taking villages and expanding their control while you fight to stop them.

Every decision matters. Every battle changes the map.

Even if you fall in combat, you can return to the fight. Reorganize your troops, plan your next move, and keep fighting to restore the kingdom.

Your goal is clear:
Push the enemy army back and conquer the center of the map.

But beware…
If the enemies capture all the villages, the kingdom will fall.

data.name: 3030 Deathwar Redux - A Space Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
Rated 94% with over 1000 reviews and over 40,000 copies sold

Awarded Space Game of the Decade by Space Game Junkie!

Fusing space exploration, fast-paced combat, trading, and a healthy dose of point-and-click comedic adventuring, 3030 Deathwar Redux sets you free to roam an entire war-torn galaxy filled with devastated planets, uninhabitable zones, and space stations in quarantine lockdown.

Help freewheeling space pilot John Falcon get back on his feet in a huge open world inspired by both the classic Elite and Lucasarts' finest adventures, and plot your own course through the game's dizzying array of missions, stories, and places.

It's not been a good day for you. Your crew has discovered a dead body, your brand new ship's been impounded by the cops, and most people you run into seem very unhappy with you... probably something to do with that missing cargo of gold bars.

So... will you take on a couple shady delivery jobs in order to afford a better ship, or will you downsize to a cheap jetsuit and go shooting space-junk for quick money? Will you perhaps decide to focus on finding that missing gold shipment before the local gangs and salvage teams get there first?

Meanwhile, there's that damn mechanic who sold you a stolen ship, and a mysterious 'Taoist' group everyone keeps talking about. Oh, yes, you have most definitely found yourself inextricably caught up in a plot of intergalactic intrigue...

Features:

  • Open-world space adventuring with frantic combat and 30 star systems to explore.

  • Stations to board, bars to visit, scores of space scum to talk to.

  • Ghostly derelict ships to discover via your star-map, space-walk into, and salvage valuables from.

  • Large variety of intriguing jobs and missions, with exciting, and occasionally silly side-quests.

  • A diverse array of ships to buy and upgrade.

  • The once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to refuel from the corona of a sun without burning up!

  • Pirate Stations to discover, and the option of living a life of crime, piracy, cargo stealing, and nastiness.

  • The chance to invest in a large cargo ship and go asteroid mining for metals, or just haul goods between systems.

  • Hidden wormhole shortcuts, comets, unique stations, and a ton of secrets to uncover.

  • An irreverent, thoroughly amusing, and enthralling main story.

  • A whole load more!

Developed by Matt Griffiths & Mic N

Additional Design by Max Dohme

Published by Crunchy Leaf Games

data.name: Aperion Cyberstorm
data.detailed_description:
Become a screen-filling bullet hell boss in Aperion Cyberstorm, a 2D fast based twin-stick shooter for 1-5 players!



Find new Elements and Abilities, and mix them for more destructive power – Destroy areas full of enemies with plasma-coated spiral rockets, or turn an enemy to dust with electric mines, before finishing them with devastating lasers.

In Campaign, travel across four planets, through over 200 unique areas, to find the team that abandoned you. Playable cooperatively for an added challenge as the enemies you fight become tougher.



Versus is the true test of friendship. Don't lose your focus in the contained arenas, where the pools of lava aren’t the only threat. Ability/Element bundles drop into the match for instant power, and a chance to survive. Versus comes with eight fully customisable battle variants, for a quick scrap or a longer fight. Go it alone in Free-For-All, or buddy up with Team Battles and share the victory. Add AI players for true 5 player battles!



Finally, are you brave enough to take on wave after devastating wave of enemies? In Onslaught, your enemies won’t stop until you're defeated so choose the right Ability set, as they are all that stand between your victory or destruction.



Whether you use keyboard and mouse or controllers, Aperion Cyberstorm comes with different options to give you the best, accessible experience including toggle fire, southpaw, autofire, text resizing, and more! Each player can customise a local profile with their favourite name, colour ship, power-ups and control preference to jump into the action faster – perfect for parties!

• Three game play modes (Campaign, Versus and Onslaught) that all support 1-5 players
• AI Players in Versus mode for constant five player battles
• 12 different ships - all with different power, defence, speed and recharge rate
• 14 abilities and six elements to provide thousands of destructive combinations
• Accessibility options for each player that include southpaw, automatic shooting and ability activation, and also global text resizing
• Collect shards from fallen enemies in Campaign mode to upgrade abilities with new damaging effects
• Play with any combination of controllers supported and can also use keyboard and mouse
• Unlockable content within each mode

data.name: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII
data.detailed_description:
Digital Deluxe Edition


About the Game

Xuan-Yuan Sword VII is an ARPG presented in a third-person perspective. The plot is rooted in Chinese history and mythology. Players take on the role of Taishi Zhao, a calm and reliable swordsman who was involved in a tragic fate. To protect his beloved family, Taishi Zhao starts a journey in this chaotic realm to find the truth.

Synopsis

In the last of Western Han Dynasty, the powerful prime minister of China superseded his emperor and build a new dynasty called Xin. In this year, words appeared on the boulders, stone cattles appeared in fields, and ancient tombs cracked, tremendous signs appeared, told a time of peace and prosperity will come. A peculiar bamboo slip in the crypt of Marquis of Liu was delivered to Court Astrologer's hand.
Unexpectedly, Taishi Mansion was badly damaged by a bizarre fire that night, and all his family was killed in the fire and the bamboo slip disappeared.
Ten years later, the prosperity mentioned in the prophecy has never come. A decade of war and famine, the people were miserable, and the chaos had spread among the country.
At this time, the bamboo slip which had disappeared for 10 years emerged again, it caused an uproar...



Gameplay


combo-based combat
  • Xuan-Yuan Sword VII is an Action RPG with a real-time combat system.
  • A smooth combo-based combat system contains elements such as Active Skills, Dodge, Block, Riposte.


Elysium Scroll
Elysium Scroll is a bamboo scroll that can be used as a key to Elysium, capable of absorbing monsters, creating items, and more. It can provide several techniques and mechanics during the adventure.
  • Elysium Rift: Taishi Zhao's ultimate technique; slows down the time around him. In this state, he can alter the physical properties of nearby objects.
  • Imprison and Fusion Lab: Players can absorb monsters into the Elysium as refining materials for Fusion Lab. Fusion Lab can not only produce new monsters with different shapes and abilities, but also spin Passive Skills out sometimes, which are used to improve Taishi Zhao’s ability.
  • Various facilities set in Elysium for improving armors and weapons, as well as developing passive Skills.


The Mohists and their “Mechanics”
  • Mohism, an ancient Chinese philosophy of logic, rational thought, and science, was once as popular as Confucianism in China 2200 years ago.
  • In this game, the Mohists are known for their high level “Mechanic“ technology far beyond the times. However, civil disagreements are challenging their faith, making them fall apart in decades.
  • Can the Mohists revive to their former glory or fade in the pages of history? In Xuan-Yuan Sword VII, you will witness the final destiny of the Mohists.


A journey in the oriental realm
  • The game takes place in China 2000 years ago. The development team will bring back the ancient China environments, props, humanities, and cultural studies into gameplay.
  • Take a new journey into the chaotic era and roam around the oriental realm.
  • For PC, Xuan-Yuan Sword VII supports Nvidia RTX, makes a realistic game world.

data.name: Animagi
data.detailed_description:
Rebuild the spiritual world. Purify biomes. Face the Corruption. Cooperate or fall into chaos.

Animagi is an action-cooperative game where 1–4 players control Animagis — spiritual animals capable of manipulating magic, building mystical structures, and restoring corrupted biomes.
Each match takes place on vibrant floating arenas, where time works against you and corrupted creatures will do everything they can to disrupt the restoration ritual.

Combine magic, construction, and teamwork to survive the rising chaos.

BUILD IN THE MIDST OF CHAOS

Follow magical blueprints to assemble spiritual structures.
Find scattered parts across the map, levitate them, and fit them into place while enemies attempt to destroy everything.

• Mystical structures
• Parts scattered across the biome
• Physical world placement
• Visual build validation

STYLIZED MAGIC COMBAT

Each Animagi mage channels vital energy to restore corrupted biomes. Their magic is an extension of their spiritual form — created to purify, protect, and rebuild.

• Fireball, Magic Shield, Levitation, and more.

COOPERATION UNDER PRESSURE

Every player has a crucial role. If one fails, everyone pays the price.

• Some carry pieces
• Others defend
• Others intercept enemies
• Everyone must act fast

The game rewards coordinated teams — and punishes disorganization with humor and chaos.

DYNAMIC EVENTS

No two matches are the same.

• Magical storms
• Corruption bursts
• Spiritual meteors
• Terrain shifts and distortions

Adapt or be overwhelmed.

PHYSICAL ALCHEMY (NO MENUS)

Mix real ingredients into a magical cauldron on the map.
Reactions play out physically in front of the players — explosions, smoke, colors, hilarious failures.

A SPIRITUALLY VIBRANT WORLD

Arenas are floating biomes inspired by Earth’s vital energy: forests, ruins, mountains, and mystical spaces that react to the actions of the players.

data.name: Twelve Sticks
data.detailed_description:
On a summer night, you and your friends gather in the dimly lit garages, where shadows dance as you tell scary stories and play your favorite game, "Twelve Sticks".

Each story shared isn’t just a tale—it’s a window into their darkest nightmares.

We all carry the echoes of childhood nightmares…

But this night took a turn when a strange girl named Alsu appeared from the shadows. She wanted to join the game, but instead, the boys mocked her and cruelly turned her away.

With tears streaming down her face, Alsu fled, shouting a chilling warning—she was a hereditary witch.

And for their cruelty, she vowed to make their worst nightmares come to life.

The boys scoffed, laughing off her threat, their sneers laced with taunts and obscenities.





Hide from the monster, or hunt down children on the map as the monster.



The area is infested with terrifying creatures, their presence fills you with anxiety. If you get scared or make too much noise, the monster will easily detect you.



You can temporarily calm your anxiety by holding your breath, but only for a short time.



Move around on the ground and on garage roofs, but be careful. Falling from a height will take you out of the game for a while, making you an easy target for the monster.



If all players are caught within a single round, the monster is randomly reassigned.



The more players participate, the more fun you have. Minimum number of players: 2, maximum: 12.





The monster earns points for each player caught. When children get scared, they drop fear spheres on the map, which the monster can collect for extra points.



Playing as a child character, collect leaves and cones, sell them, and use the points to buy upgrades from the vending machine.



Rescue friends caught by the monster and earn bonus points. But be warned—this is extremely dangerous.



The player with the most points at the end of the round wins. You can spend them or save them—it's up to you.





The game features machine translation into the following languages:
- French
- German
- Spanish
- Portuguese (Brazilian)
- Chinese (Simplified)
- Korean
- Polish
- Japanese

data.name: Decline
data.detailed_description:
This game transports players into a mysterious dark world, where they play as a red strawberry bear.

Using the AD keys to control its movement and the space bar to attack, the red strawberry bear must navigate forward through the darkness. The path ahead is littered with various obstacles and traps, requiring players to remain vigilant and skillfully avoid these hazards to ensure the bear's safety. Along the way, there are also extra rewards such as stars and fruits that can be collected to increase the score. The game's visuals are uniquely designed with stark color contrasts, making the red strawberry bear stand out vividly against the dark background. The background music is soft and mysterious, complemented by appropriate sound effects, like the crisp sound of collecting rewards, creating an engaging and fun adventure atmosphere for players of all ages. This game not only tests players' reflexes but also provides hours of enjoyment.

data.name: Purrrfect Spa
data.detailed_description:
A Cat ASMR Experience of Cleaning, Organizing, and Relaxing

Put on your headphones and dim the lights. Your journey begins with a single muddy paw. Clean, trim, and polish it bit by bit—until it becomes clean, soft, and perfect. No complex management stats, no tedious plot dialogue. All you need to do is focus on every detail in front of you and enjoy the process. Bring a cozy Spa experience to 8 unique cats amidst detailed white noise. You aren't just doing grooming; you are collecting your own set of sounds and emotions through these moments of relaxation.

Relax in the Details

Each grooming session is a fully immersive experience: Observation → Treatment → Transformation → Satisfaction

  • Cleaning Dirt

  • Squeezing & Scraping

  • Trimming & Polishing

  • Restoring Order from Chaos

You can take it one step at a time, entirely at your own pace. The process of "becoming clean" is a reward in itself.

8 Cats × 8 Exclusive Lofi Tracks

Meet 8 cute cats from different professions. You'll need to help them with deep grooming, paw pedicures, teeth cleaning, facial restoration, ear cleaning, and scalp massages. Every time you complete a full grooming routine for a cat, you will unlock an exclusive Lofi track tailored to that cat's theme. These tracks aren't just Lofi collections you "earn" by playing—they can also serve as your background soundtrack for daily relaxation, studying, or just spacing out.

Double Immersion: ASMR × Lofi

The core of this experience isn't about challenges; it's about feeling:

  • ASMR sounds bring instant gratification

  • Lofi tracks provide a continuous space for emotional relaxation

  • Visuals, sounds, and interactions form a perfect loop

You are doing the work, yet you are the one being healed.

Perfect for You If...

  • You love ASMR, Lofi, and white noise.

  • You find deep satisfaction in the process of "cleaning, organizing, and making things neat."

  • You are looking for a stress-free game.

  • You need a long-term personal space to unwind.

  • Or, you simply adore cats.

It’s Okay to Take Your Time There are no final goals here, only the process. It is more of an interactive way to unwind than a traditional game you "beat." As the cats calm down, you will find yourself relaxing too. Put on your headphones and begin your very first grooming session.

data.name: Carbon Reset
data.detailed_description:
Enter a future of democratized space travel and exploration with one catch – a powerful corporate consortium pulls the strings. This story begins when an expert combat pilot wakes up unbeknownst of her whereabouts, history and name. She will have to fight to determine who she is, what it means to her, and what the future holds.

FEATURES

Dynamic Combat System

  • Master a diverse arsenal from rapid-fire gatling weapons to devastating condensed matter cannons
  • Strategically employ the right weapon for each encounter - shred light fighters with flak, disable larger ships with concentrated fire
  • Harness experimental Quantum Field Manipulators to warp space, create temporary singularities, and turn the tide of battle
  • Control the battlefield by launching debris and redirecting projectiles with mass manipulation technology

Harness Quantum Technology

Wield powerful Quantum Field Manipulators (QFMs) that bend reality to your will:

  • Blink through space to outmaneuver enemies
  • Create temporary singularities to trap or destroy threats
  • Project holographic decoys to confuse your opponents
  • Deflect incoming fire with quantum shields

Strategic Stealth Gameplay

  • Hide in asteroid fields and debris to avoid detection
  • Monitor enemy patrol patterns and fields of vision
  • Strike from the shadows for devastating sneak attacks
  • Choose between stealth or combat approaches in many missions

Immersive Narrative

  • Uncover the truth about your past in a story of identity and redemption
  • Make choices that influence your relationships with key characters and factions
  • Experience multiple possible endings based on your decisions
  • Explore a rich universe of corporate warfare and revolutionary conflict

Varied Mission Types

  • Infiltrate heavily guarded corporate facilities
  • Engage in intense space dogfights
  • Face off against challenging boss encounters
  • Navigate treacherous asteroid fields while managing resources

Deep Resource Management

  • Mine valuable minerals from asteroids
  • Trade at various space stations and black markets
  • Manage your ship's energy systems and cargo
  • Upgrade your equipment with salvaged materials

From tense stealth missions to epic space battles, Carbon Reset combines action-packed gameplay with a compelling narrative of self-discovery. Will you embrace your forgotten past, forge a new identity, or reshape the future of human space travel? The choice is yours.


Includes substantial mission replay value with multiple approaches to combat and stealth scenarios. Features a linear main story with RPG elements and meaningful character interactions that affect the narrative.

data.name: Study Abroad Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Starting university abroad in 2034? Welcome to "Study Abroad Simulator"!

Experience college life in near-future America in this turn-based life sim. Play as a Chinese international student, apply to universities, choose your major, and manage your time and money through four years of studying, part-time jobs, internships, and research—with exercise, entertainment, and a social life to fit in, too.

Meet classmates, roommates, and friends from around the world. Become part of their lives and build friendships or romantic relationships. Your background, abilities, and choices will shape your college experience and its ending.

Manage Your College Life

From applications and choosing a university to moving into your dorm, prepare for your journey and begin four years of life abroad.

Each turn covers one month. Alongside story events, you’ll plan your classes, homework, part-time work, research, and internships, making the most of limited energy and living expenses. Keep your grades up, pay the rent, and look after your physical and mental health. Exercise, entertainment, campus activities, and socializing all offer different benefits and opportunities to grow.

Adjust your schedule to suit your goals, but be ready for plans to change. Random events can bring new opportunities or unexpected trouble. Leisure activities can help you unwind, but getting too caught up in them may begin to affect your studies and everyday life.

Minigames That Keep You Coming Back

A variety of minigames are woven into studying, working, and daily activities. Take on academic challenges, keep busy during a work shift, or try something different in your free time.

Some minigames combine your character’s abilities with card effects. Success takes more than good timing or quick reactions: how you prepare and which cards you bring matter, too.

Cards and Strategy

Cards play a part in minigames, homework, and academic challenges. Different effects and combinations can change how well you perform.

Choose cards to suit your courses and tasks, build on your strengths, and prepare for challenges outside your comfort zone. Some cards are consumed when used, while others have effects that change as you work through questions. Which cards to combine—and when to use them—is up to you.

Friendship and Romance, Regardless of Gender

Meet characters from around the world. As casual conversations grow into friendships, get to know their interests, families, and personal struggles. Share important moments in their lives, influence their endings, and perhaps fall in love.

All romanceable characters are available regardless of your protagonist’s gender, and you can pursue romantic relationships with multiple characters at the same time. Friendship and romance each have their own story content. Choosing friendship still lets you discover the other person’s story in depth.

Achievements Across Every Part of Life

Pursue achievements in academics, romance, personal development, career growth, research, and friendship. Focus on one area or balance several goals to experience different kinds of college life.

The College Plan gives you goals and rewards at each stage, helping you decide what to work toward next. Over four years, unlock different stories, achievements, and endings. Your grades, finances, and health also affect whether your journey abroad makes it all the way to graduation.

**Secrets Beyond Campus**

On your first playthrough, settle into college life. When you begin the journey again, you’ll have the chance to uncover a conspiracy behind the rapid advances in technology and AI, opening up new adventures.

Whether to keep investigating is your choice. This time, your decisions may reach far beyond campus—and could even make you a key figure in changing the fate of the world.

A variety of minigames are woven into studying, working, and daily activities. Take on academic challenges, keep busy during a work shift, or try something different in your free time.

Some minigames combine your character’s abilities with card effects. Success takes more than good timing or quick reactions: how you prepare and which cards you bring matter, too.

Cards and Strategy

Cards play a part in minigames, homework, and academic challenges. Different effects and combinations can change how well you perform.

Choose cards to suit your courses and tasks, build on your strengths, and prepare for challenges outside your comfort zone. Some cards are consumed when used, while others have effects that change as you work through questions. Which cards to combine—and when to use them—is up to you.

Friendship and Romance, Regardless of Gender

Meet characters from around the world. As casual conversations grow into friendships, get to know their interests, families, and personal struggles. Share important moments in their lives, influence their endings, and perhaps fall in love.

All romanceable characters are available regardless of your protagonist’s gender, and you can pursue romantic relationships with multiple characters at the same time. Friendship and romance each have their own story content. Choosing friendship still lets you discover the other person’s story in depth.

Achievements Across Every Part of Life

Pursue achievements in academics, romance, personal development, career growth, research, and friendship. Focus on one area or balance several goals to experience different kinds of college life.

The College Plan gives you goals and rewards at each stage, helping you decide what to work toward next. Over four years, unlock different stories, achievements, and endings. Your grades, finances, and health also affect whether your journey abroad makes it all the way to graduation.

**Secrets Beyond Campus**

On your first playthrough, settle into college life. When you begin the journey again, you’ll have the chance to uncover a conspiracy behind the rapid advances in technology and AI, opening up new adventures.

Whether to keep investigating is your choice. This time, your decisions may reach far beyond campus—and could even make you a key figure in changing the fate of the world.
data.short_description: Four years abroad. A whole new life. Take on college in near-future America! Ace your classes, earn your keep, fall in love, and play your cards right. Then start again to uncover a hidden conspiracy. Your next big decision could change more than your future—it could change the world.

data.name: Keep Drawing: Webtoon Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
From one struggling artist to a global webtoon empire

A blank canvas, a deadline, and a dream. Draw your first chapter, hit publish, and watch the readers pour in — or roll their eyes. Every chapter you make and every deal you sign builds the studio you've always wanted to run.

Keep Drawing is a webtoon studio tycoon with the soul of a creative-life sim — the cozy grind of making comics readers love, wrapped around the deep systems of running the business behind them.

✏️ Draw the hits

  • Split your focus across story, art, characters, and pacing — your mix shapes each chapter's score and how readers react.
  • Juggle energy, stress, and inspiration. Push too hard and quality drops; rest, and the calendar moves.
  • Launch and grow series across genres, themes, and target audiences — each audience wants something different.

🏢 Build the studio

  • Move out of your room into a real studio. Hire specialists and assign them to what they do best.
  • Train your team, manage traits and morale, and run B-teams so series keep shipping while you craft your flagship.
  • Climb from amateur self-publishing all the way to a global franchise.

🤝 Run the business

  • Negotiate every deal at the publishing table — haggle season length and your advance in a back-and-forth where pushing one demand stiffens the other.
  • Compete for the Annual Webtoon Awards.
  • Turn a one-person operation into a 25-year studio empire.

🌍 Play in your language

Fully localized in 11 languages: English · Türkçe · Deutsch · Français · Italiano · Português · Español · 한국어 · 日本語 · 中文 · Русский

🎮 Wishlist now

A free demo is on the way — wishlist now to play it first and follow the studio's road to launch.

data.name: She's Leaving
data.detailed_description:
OVERVIEW

New Features:

Danger Mode: The ultimate challenge. Face the mystery with permanent death and no saving. One mistake ends it all.

Detective Mode: Explore at your own pace. The stalker is removed, allowing you to focus purely on forensic puzzles and lore.

Festive Decorations: Toggle holiday spirit on or off. Deck the halls of the Tudor mansion, but don't expect the lights to hide the shadows.


About the Game

GAMEPLAY

Focused on the real-life practices of forensic analysts, we have created mechanics that allow the player to understand and uncover the truth behind the evidence they find.

Equipped with a taser, the choice is up to you, are you going to run and hide, or stand and fight?

STORY

As you wade through the dark halls of House Haywood, you will find meaning in blood.

Enter Charles Dalton, a forensics analyst who specializes in blood spatter, tasked with using his expert skill set to solve the disappearances of multiple persons in the snowy region of Haywood. In the darkness of a Tudor mansion, you hear the foghorn blow. You are not alone.

ENVIRONMENT

Through the dimly lit halls of an ancient home to the haze-covered docks of Haywood itself, journey through handcrafted environments to look for evidence that will help you in your journey. Be sure to search every nook and cranny, as there is a story to be told in every corner.

“Murder is seldom senseless, it's targeted.”

— Charles Dalton

data.name: Oh, Bugger!
data.detailed_description:
Oh, Bugger! is a single-player first-person shooter where you take on the role of a mech pilot on a mission to reclaim a luxury hotel overrun by an alien infestation. Set in a retro-futuristic hotel, the game combines intense combat, mech upgrades, and a visually striking environment to deliver a thrilling experience.

Key Features

  • Mech Combat: You are controlling a big mech suit with a massive mini-gun that can transform into a shotgun! With it, you mow down hordes of relentless aliens. Experience adrenaline-fueled action with satisfying gunplay and explosive effects.

  • Customization: Upgrade the abilities that your mech has. Tailor your playstyle to dominate the battlefield.

  • Retro-Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning environment inspired by retro-futuristic sci-fi designs. From the posh lobby of the hotel to the eerie glow of alien nests – every detail enhances the atmosphere.

  • Challenging Enemy Types: Face different alien threats, each one with unique behaviors. Strategize your approach to overcome every threat you face!

  • Endless Mode: Explore the ship room by room in a new survival mode - face unending waves of aliens and see how long you can last! Unlock it after completing the campaign.

About the Development Team

Developed by third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences, Oh, Bugger! delivers intense action, strategic mech customization, and a uniquely stylized space environment for an unforgettable gaming experience.

data.name: Marina Manager
data.detailed_description:
BUILD A MARINA. GROW AN ISLAND.

Marina Manager is a hands-on management game about turning a small harbor business into the driving force behind a growing Mediterranean island.

Start small, take care of the work yourself and earn your first money from the boats visiting your harbor.

Invest your profits, improve your marina, attract more traffic and build an operation capable of handling bigger and more valuable opportunities.

But your success doesn't stop at the docks. As your marina grows, the town around it grows with you.

RUN THE MARINA YOUR WAY

Every berth has value, and every customer is a business decision.

Choose which boats to serve, which opportunities are worth taking and how much of your limited capacity you're willing to commit.

Reliable customers can keep money flowing, while leaving space for more valuable visitors may bring bigger rewards, or leave you with an empty dock.

Balance risk and stability, plan ahead and shape the marina around your own strategy.

FROM DOING THE WORK TO RUNNING THE BUSINESS

At first, the marina depends on you.

Serve visiting boats, handle jobs around the harbor, provide the services they need and keep everything moving.

As business picks up, hire employees, assign responsibilities and automate the work you once had to do yourself.

The bigger your operation becomes, the more your role changes from doing every job to deciding how the entire marina should run.

INVEST. EXPAND. ATTRACT MORE BUSINESS.

Put the money you earn back into your marina.

Improve your facilities, introduce new services, increase your capacity and prepare for more demanding customers.

A better marina attracts more traffic. More traffic creates more opportunities. More opportunities mean more money to invest back into your business.

What starts as a small harbor operation can grow into one of the busiest places on the island.

WATCH THE ISLAND GROW WITH YOU

Your marina is part of something bigger.

As more boats arrive and more business flows through the harbor, the town around you begins to prosper.

New areas develop, new businesses appear and the island creates new opportunities and new demands for your growing operation.

Over time, your influence reaches beyond the marina itself as you serve a wider island economy and connect its settlements, businesses and visitors.

What begins as a quiet old harbor can gradually become the economic heart of a lively Mediterranean island.

Grow your marina, and the world around it grows with you.

data.name: NEO DRONE: REVERSE
data.detailed_description:
THE WORLD MOVES FORWARD. YOU MOVE BACKWARD.

NEO DRONE: REVERSE is a sci-fi arcade action game where you reverse direction and use shields to dodge obstacles and aim for a high score.

Face normal obstacles, moving hazards, and blinking hazards. Quick decisions and precise timing are the keys to survival. Knowing when to activate your shield is also an important part of your strategy.

Reverse. Survive.

Master the timing of your direction reversals to escape danger at the last moment. Every decision matters in this fast-paced arcade challenge.

Use Your Shield Wisely

Activate your shield when danger closes in. Decide when to use it and when to save it, because resource management can determine how long you survive and how high you score.

Aim for the High Score

Overcome obstacles, beat your personal best, and compete against other players on the online leaderboard.

The world moves forward. You move backward.

data.name: Hexia
data.detailed_description:
Hexia is a strategy game where your task, as King of your assigned Realm, is to create and expand territory, build new infrastructure, and command and guide your people. You will face events that present themselves to you as opportunities for improvement or as unforeseen setbacks to overcome, and your choices will be critical in allowing your kingdom to have the success it deserves and thus gain a place in the world.



The Hexia universe is full of unexpected surprises and mysteries waiting to be uncovered. A deep and intricate story lies behind every random event, and every decision you make will have a consequence on the continuation of the world's plot, as well as on the kingdom's resources.


  • Enter the world of Hexia: explore, build, manage the wealth and favor of your people
  • A story divided into chapters will accompany you throughout the game
  • Be ready for events that may or may not facilitate the expansion of your kingdom
  • Keep the favor of your people high, it will serve to reign as best you can
  • Organize trade routes and manage your resources
  • Plan every move, turn by turn

data.name: Star Racer
data.detailed_description:
Buckle up and reach for the stars! Star Racer is a high-octane combat racer that takes the streets to new dangerous heights. Inspired by retro classics, Star Racer combines speed, strategy, and sky-splitting action across a universe of wild tracks and unpredictable challenges.

Take the fight and leave your rivals in the stardust with gravity-defying glides, split-second reflexes, and devastating attacks. Boost through the streets, soar through the skies, and crush the competition in fast-paced, combat-fueled races. Manage your energy between boosting and healing, and unleash your arsenal to dominate on the ground or in the air. Cross the finish line by any means necessary!

Face more than just your opponents—each track is filled with perilous hazards ready to end your run. Blaze across icy terrain, lava-covered courses, and chaotic, bouncy roads. Watch out for mines, turrets, and other destructive traps waiting to send you flying.

The race doesn't end there. Event Races are a wild twist on traditional racing where the rules change every time. Survive lava-drenched courses, dodge mysterious interlopers, or tackle precision-based "break the targets" challenges.

Create your own adrenaline-fuel races with the robust Track Editor, now featuring online functionality. Upload your creations, browse community tracks, and challenge racers from around the world. Shape the road, set the hazards, and let others test their mettle on your custom circuits.

Key Features:

  • Heart-Pounding Races: Engage in intense, high-speed battles across intergalactic racetracks. Drift, boost, fire, and soar your way to the front of the pack with cunning strategy and split-second reflexes! But beware the cosmic dangers that lie ahead. Only the most skilled racers will survive the chaos and claim victory.

  • Concrete & Clouds: Leave the competition in the dust—both on the ground and in the skies! Experience high-octane action with gravity-defying glides and aerial combat. Blaze across pavement, soar through the stars, and make your rivals eat stardust.

  • Track Editor: Unleash your creativity with a powerful, dynamic track editor. Build challenging circuits, share them with friends, and master the most daring designs. The race is yours to shape!

  • Event Races: Think fast, adapt faster. Event Races turn traditional racing upside down with wild, unpredictable challenges. Dash across tracks consumed by lava, fend off unexpected interlopers, or master precision-based “break the targets” trials. With fresh scenarios rotating in, no two races are ever the same—only the bold will survive the madness.

  • Local Multiplayer: Grab up to three friends and dive into split-screen madness! With support for up to 4 players in local multiplayer, Star Racer turns every couch into a launchpad for wild, competitive fun.

Boost through the streets, soar through the skies, and crush the competition in fast-paced, combat-fueled races. Manage your energy between boosting and healing, and unleash your arsenal to dominate on the ground or in the air. Cross the finish line by any means necessary!

Face more than just your opponents—each track is filled with perilous hazards ready to end your run. Blaze across icy terrain, lava-covered courses, and chaotic, bouncy roads. Watch out for mines, turrets, and other destructive traps waiting to send you flying.

The race doesn't end there. Event Races are a wild twist on traditional racing where the rules change every time. Survive lava-drenched courses, dodge mysterious interlopers, or tackle precision-based "break the targets" challenges.

Create your own adrenaline-fuel races with the robust Track Editor, now featuring online functionality. Upload your creations, browse community tracks, and challenge racers from around the world. Shape the road, set the hazards, and let others test their mettle on your custom circuits.

Key Features:

  • Heart-Pounding Races: Engage in intense, high-speed battles across intergalactic racetracks. Drift, boost, fire, and soar your way to the front of the pack with cunning strategy and split-second reflexes! But beware the cosmic dangers that lie ahead. Only the most skilled racers will survive the chaos and claim victory.

  • Concrete & Clouds: Leave the competition in the dust—both on the ground and in the skies! Experience high-octane action with gravity-defying glides and aerial combat. Blaze across pavement, soar through the stars, and make your rivals eat stardust.

  • Track Editor: Unleash your creativity with a powerful, dynamic track editor. Build challenging circuits, share them with friends, and master the most daring designs. The race is yours to shape!

  • Event Races: Think fast, adapt faster. Event Races turn traditional racing upside down with wild, unpredictable challenges. Dash across tracks consumed by lava, fend off unexpected interlopers, or master precision-based “break the targets” trials. With fresh scenarios rotating in, no two races are ever the same—only the bold will survive the madness.

Known for classics like Banjo-Kazooie, GoldenEye 007, and Mario + Rabbids, his signature sound fuels select tracks with epic energy.

data.name: Woo Woo
data.detailed_description:
Woo Woo - an action-roguelike about cleaning up trash in your own little house!
Dad said he'll eat you for dinner if the house isn't clean by midnight!

And cleaning the house is easy peasy!
Explore mysterious rooms and the innards of your home, pick up trash from the floor (and not just trash!), carry it to where it belongs!
Sort clothes on shelves and arrange furniture in the right spots - to keep your body undigested before evening!

But cleaning isn't always that simple!
The trash wants to live too and will scurry away on its spidery legs. Whack them with a broom to knock them off their feet!

The house lives its own life...
The environment is procedurally generated and populated by strange mysterious creatures: from a several-meters-long centipede in the basement to a hungry ghost in the attic.
Will you make it to evening alive?

data.detailed_description:
This is a real-time 3v3 online basketball game like nothing you have experienced before.

A brand-new multiplayer basketball experience inspired by street culture and hip-hop style, delivering fast-paced and intense competitive gameplay.

Build your team, customize your players, and compete in the high-stakes world of street basketball where skill and teamwork decide everything.

🏀 Stylish Controls, Skill-Based Gameplay

Experience smooth and expressive controls that make every dribble, drive, and shot feel impactful. Precision and timing are key to creating highlight moments on the court.

⚡ Classic 3v3 Quick Match

Jump into fast-paced 3v3 matches instantly. Enjoy the core fun of street basketball through teamwork, coordination, and tactical plays.

🎮 Real-Time Competitive Gameplay

Engage in real-time online matches with responsive shooting, passing, and defensive mechanics. Enjoy a smooth, low-latency competitive experience.

🏆 Fair Competition, Pure Skill

Victory depends entirely on player skill, game sense, and teamwork. No pay-to-win mechanics or stat advantages—every match is a true test of ability.

🎨 Street Style Customization

A wide variety of outfits and customization options allow you to create a unique player identity and stand out on the court.

🤝 Play with Friends Anytime

Team up with friends for real-time matches, communicate, and compete together in intense basketball battles.

data.name: Special Force Legion of Monsters
data.detailed_description:
Survival justifies any means! As one of the special agents in the world of [Special Force Legion of Monsters], you should do everything to survive among 10 opponents. Your every action must be based on your survival tactics. Will you become a wise survivor or a bloodthirsty predator? Will you play as a team or solo? How will you hunt threatening monsters to acquire lethal weapons and useful utilities? There is no answer; survival is the only answer.

Key Features

Survive or Kill

There are countless ways to be the last one in [Special Force Legion of Monsters]. If you are a defensive survivor, you should be well-prepared by hunting monsters and collecting utilities and weapons. If you are a relentless assassinator, get your gun ready, kill innocent victims, and take their items to get stronger.

Players are Not the Only Enemies

Elf archers disguise in a bush to blow your brains out, and your bullets do not work against those golems. How will you take weapons or utilities from them? You always have to take a risk to be stronger.

Guns and Knives Are Too Old to Kill Wisely

The era of guns and steel is over. Beautiful and highly advanced weapons are waiting for you. Locate enemies with high-powered LADAR and send smart drones to kill them by just pressing a single button. Even if someone finds you and tries to get closer, don’t worry; landmines will welcome them.

WELCOME TO THE WORLD OF [Special Force Legion of Monsters].

data.detailed_description:
Key Features

  • Story-driven gameplay.
  • Difficulty Levels.
  • Single-player and Multiplayer up to 4 players.
  • Reward system, which helps you earn new characters and skins as you play.

  • Adjustable game parameters for personalized experiences allowing for more replayability.
  • Simplified Text Chat.

Story

  • Various individuals have seen a mysterious man with a monkey on multiple occasions. This person normally liberates animals that are in captivity.


    Sometimes these animals flee and enter places where they should not be. The authorities still don´t know this man´s whereabouts and the reason for his actions.

Gameplay

  • In the first chapter, you play as an underpaid employee at the Tyrant Grand Hotel. You must complete all your tasks while uncontrolled animals roam the place.
  • You can use objects around the area to help you fend off the wild animals.


  • You can use power-ups to recover health, be faster, stronger, and invincible for a short period of time. The power-ups can be shared with players close by.


  • You also have a simplified chat menu where you can compose messages with relevant keywords. You can send the messages to other players and they will appear in the language that each player has chosen. Thus, you can speak to any person even though they speak in a different language.

data.name: Chained Echoes
data.detailed_description:
Chained Echoes is a story-driven JRPG where a group of heroes travel around the vast continent of Valandis to bring an end to the war between its three kingdoms.


In the course of their journey, they will travel through a wide array of diverse landscapes spanning from wind-tanned plateaus and exotic archipelagos to sunken cities and forgotten dungeons.



Take up your sword, channel your magic or board your Mech. Chained Echoes is a 16-bit SNES style RPG set in a fantasy world where dragons are as common as piloted mechanical suits.



Follow a group of heroes as they explore a land filled to the brim with charming characters, fantastic landscapes and vicious foes.
Can you bring peace to a continent where war has been waged for generations and betrayal lurks around every corner?

Key Features:

  • 30 - 40 hours of play time
  • Fast paced turn-based battles
  • No random encounters; enemies can be seen running around
  • Tons of items to be looted, stolen or crafted
  • Complex skill and equipment system
  • Customize your own airship
  • Travel and fight by foot or in your Mech
  • 16-bit SNES style graphics
  • Music inspired by PSX RPGs

data.name: Prison Break: Thirty Walls
data.detailed_description:
Learn the day. Then break it

The prison runs on a clock, and the clock decides what counts as suspicious. In the yard at yard time you are furniture. In the yard at lockdown you are the alarm. Every guard, camera, searchlight and drone asks the same question, and the answer changes four times a day.

Find the shovel. Get it back to your cell. Dig. By level twelve the shovel is behind a locked door and the key is on a guard; by eighteen the guard has a club. Every prison you beat makes the next one a link longer. Get caught and you wake in solitary at the far end of the building, with the walk back to think about it.

Thirty prisons, none drawn by hand

Every prison is generated from a plan and a seed. Play the same seed twice and you get the same building. Move to the next one and you'll never see it again. Towers, yards, cell blocks, fences and floodlights are laid out fresh every time, so what worked last prison only half works in this one.

Trouble is also an opening

  • Yard fights pull every guard who can see them, and the routes they were covering go uncovered while it lasts.

  • A man with a shiv may decide today is the day. Survive the next ten seconds and every guard in the prison is converging on one spot, and none of them is on their route.

  • One guard carries a pistol. Six rounds, no reload, and every shot is heard across the whole prison. It's a plan, not a weapon.

Bring a crewmate

Co-op escapes: one of you has the shovel, the other one is the distraction

Zero assets

No meshes, no textures, no materials on disk. Every wall, bar, badge reader and bounce of light is built in code the moment you press Play, which is why the whole game is a small download.

Co-op escapes: one of you has the shovel, the other one is the distraction

Zero assets

No meshes, no textures, no materials on disk. Every wall, bar, badge reader and bounce of light is built in code the moment you press Play, which is why the whole game is a small download.
data.short_description: Being seen somewhere you shouldn't be is the beginning of the problem. Thirty procedurally built prisons, each with one way out. Learn the routine, find the shovel, dig — and when the shovel isn't enough, find another way through the wall.

data.name: Operation Hardcore
data.detailed_description:
Dateline: Earth, 1999. An unprovoked alien invasion is underway. You, a total badass, don't really appreciate it. You won't stand for it. You're downright outraged. You pack up some essentials--guns, cigars, whiskey--and head out into the night. Little do you know that tonight you will make history. This is: Operation Hardcore.

Operation Hardcore is an action-packed 2D side-scrolling shooter inspired by classic twitchy action games of yesteryear, but with modern touches and conveniences.

  • Fight your way past enemies using a range of weapons

  • Double-jump your way around obstacles and hazards

  • Activate your traditional plasma-based shield to deflect enemy fire

  • Drink some whiskey to slow time and increase damage (...at the expense of mental clarity)

  • Strap on a jetpack and get airborne for some classic forced-scrolling challenges

  • Collect coins to purchase items, weapons and upgrades between levels

  • Meet or beat level par times to earn yourself a brag-worthy Badass Rank(™)

  • Grab a friend for some friendly and/or competitive 2 player local co-op

Game Features

  • 12 levels of fiery, bloody, explosive-y alien-blasting mayhem

  • 4 playable badasses

  • Analog controls for precise 360 degree aiming

  • Modern sound design and electronic soundtrack by Snug

  • Intense 2 player local co-op

  • Modern particle/atmospheric and lighting effects

  • Multiple difficulty settings, upgrade paths and secret areas

  • Achievements and unlockables for the overachieving, enterprising badass

data.name: Waifu Weave
data.detailed_description:
Waifu Weave

I've Died and Been Reincarnated in a Card Game!

You got hit by a meteorite and woke up in a mysterious world where the only way forward is to master the ancient art of Waifu Weave—a strategic card game where victory means everything... and your opponents are charming girls who want to crush you at cards.

🎮 Game Overview

Waifu Weave is a strategic card game inspired by Triple Triad, where you battle a diverse cast of anime waifus on a 3x3 grid. Build your deck, master advanced mechanics, and collect cards from slimes to dragons, from maids to magical girls, and from androids to demons.

🃏 Deep Strategic Gameplay

  • 3x3 Grid Battles: Place cards strategically to flip your opponent's cards

  • Advanced Rules: Master modifiers like Ascension, Descension, Clash, and more!

  • Progressive AI: Face increasingly challenging opponents as you progress through 26 levels

  • Card abilities: Certain cards have special abilities (e.g., Poison, Growth) adding strategic nuance to deck construction

🎴 Extensive Card Collection

Collect over 100 cards and build decks featuring:

  • Slimes of all colors

  • Spiders and their webs

  • Harpies soaring through the peaks

  • Dragons guarding treasure

  • Demons from the abyss

  • Knights in shining armor

  • Maids ready to serve

  • Magical Girls powered by friendship

  • Androids from the future

  • Nagas, Bunnies, Cyclops, and more!

Each card has randomized stats, so no two drops are the same. Find that perfect stat roll!

📈 Card Progression

Cards can gain XP through gameplay and improve their stats permanently. Have duplicate cards? Feed them to your favorites—cannibalize duplicates to power up your best cards and create unstoppable decks!

⭐ Progressive Star System

  • 1 Star: Win the game

  • 2 Stars: Dominate by 2+ cards

  • 3 Stars: Achieve total victory with 3+ card advantage

Stars unlock new levels and more challenging opponents as you weave your way through the world.

🌍 Diverse World & Characters

Explore unique locales from dark caves to enchanted forests, from volcanic calderas to cyberpunk scrapyards. Each opponent has their own personality, deck, and story waiting to be discovered.

🎮 Multiple Game Modifiers

Experience different rule variants that keep gameplay fresh:

  • All Open: All enemy cards are visible

  • Three Open: Only three enemy cards are visible

  • All Closed: All enemy cards are hidden

  • Clash: Cards with a higher tens digit will instantly capture another, but cards with the same tens digit use their ones digit to do battle, with higher ones digits winning more often

  • Ascension/Descension: +5 or -5 for every card of the same family on the board 

🎵 Immersive Experience

  • Dynamic soundtrack of 25 songs

  • Beautiful waifu card artwork

  • Smooth animations, aura affects, and satisfying flip effects

✨ The Journey Begins

Will you emerge victorious and collect them all? Or will you fall to the cunning opponents who stand in your way?

Build your deck. Master the grid. Collect the waifus.

data.name: Endless Miles
data.detailed_description:
Endless Miles is a driving experience that lets you enjoy the freedom of the open road. Designed for players who crave the feeling of driving endlessly, drifting on winding roads or just going off the beaten path to climb the highest peak.

Drive for miles:

There is no better feeling than just hopping into your car of choice and just going for a drive. Just beware, the faster ones have a tendency to spin so be careful with the throttle.

Drift for miles:

Have an itch to go sideways? Hop into the DR-01 or the DR-02, cars setup just for drifting.

Explore for miles:

Had enough of the roads? Well, hop into the TU-01 and explore the vast landscapes. Blast through the desert, climb the highest peak in Vista Plateau or avoid the rocks in the tundra.

Enjoy the drive!

data.name: Diceward
data.detailed_description:
Fortune favors the prepared.

DICEWARD is a roguelite deckbuilder where the dice are your engine. Roll a
handful each turn, drag them onto your cards to charge attacks, guards, and
gambits, then aim and strike. No two rolls are the same, and neither is any
two runs.

Roll. Load. Strike.

Every card has slots waiting for dice. Roll the tray, then decide where each
die goes: pour a high roll into a heavy hit, spend a pair on something greedier,
or hold out for the card that only fires on the perfect number. Guard against
the enemy's telegraphed intent, or gamble on the strike that ends the turn
first. The dice deal the hand, you decide what it's worth.

Forge your own luck.

This isn't just a deck, it's a set of dice you reshape as you descend. Reforge
a face when you rest, hunt down dice that break the rules, and stack relics that
bend probability in your favor. The build you leave a run with is never the one
you started, and the arsenal to draw from keeps growing.

Descend into the dark.

Press deeper through a gauntlet of cursed depths, each with its own horrors,
its own tricks to unravel, and something waiting at the bottom that has to be
learned to be beaten. Take the safe path or the greedy one. The dice don't care
which, but the things down there do.

Features

data.about_the_game:
Fortune favors the prepared.

DICEWARD is a roguelite deckbuilder where the dice are your engine. Roll a
handful each turn, drag them onto your cards to charge attacks, guards, and
gambits, then aim and strike. No two rolls are the same, and neither is any
two runs.

Roll. Load. Strike.

Every card has slots waiting for dice. Roll the tray, then decide where each
die goes: pour a high roll into a heavy hit, spend a pair on something greedier,
or hold out for the card that only fires on the perfect number. Guard against
the enemy's telegraphed intent, or gamble on the strike that ends the turn
first. The dice deal the hand, you decide what it's worth.

Forge your own luck.

This isn't just a deck, it's a set of dice you reshape as you descend. Reforge
a face when you rest, hunt down dice that break the rules, and stack relics that
bend probability in your favor. The build you leave a run with is never the one
you started, and the arsenal to draw from keeps growing.

Descend into the dark.

Press deeper through a gauntlet of cursed depths, each with its own horrors,
its own tricks to unravel, and something waiting at the bottom that has to be
learned to be beaten. Take the safe path or the greedy one. The dice don't care
which, but the things down there do.

data.name: CRYPTARK
data.detailed_description:
Cryptark is a 2D roguelike shooter that challenges players with boarding and neutralizing procedurally generated alien starships to earn income for their Privateering enterprise. Purchase improved equipment and weapons to tackle more dangerous targets, but be cautious as failure will result in a loss of investment and profit. The decaying alien arks will defend themselves from intruders with a wide arsenal of cyborg monstrosities, robotics, and security systems, all obstacles that must be surpassed to achieve victory, the destruction of the ship’s central System Core.

  • Complex, procedurally generated alien space-hulks to board and defeat.
  • Challenging, re-playable campaign that tests your strategy and tactics.
  • Over 70 weapons and items, including frag-cannons, tractor-beams, flamethrowers and nukes.
  • High-score leader boards to rank your skills.
  • Fully lip-synced voice acting brings your fellow shipmates to life.
  • Blood-pumping soundtrack perfect for intense firefights.

data.name: Just a Villager MMORPG
data.detailed_description:
Streaming & Let's Plays Welcome
You're free to make videos and live streams of this game, including monetized ones.

A Story Starring a Villager

You never even dreamed of becoming a hero—you're just a villager. Seen off by your childhood friend, you leave home and set out on a journey of meeting and parting with companions, and a story about a "name" that everyone has forgotten.

Cross Paths, Help Each Other — The Feel of an MMO

Up to 30 players share each map, walking, chatting, and fighting around you.
・In a tough fight, call for HELP. A passing adventurer might jump in (up to 4 players)
・Heal or revive total strangers along the way
・Form a party with players nearby and travel together in a single-file line
・Stand together against the Demon Raid, which begins at set times

Three Ways to Play

Online: The classic MMO, crossing paths with others
Friend Match: Choose a keyword and get a world just for your group
Offline: Take your time solo. The full story is playable

Stay a Villager, or Change Vocations

You can see the journey through to the end as a humble villager.
Or change vocations and become a Warrior, Mage, Priest, Beast Tamer, Jester, and more. You can return to any vocation you've held at any time.
Raise companion monsters, forge your gear and add bonus stats. How you grow is up to you.
With auto-battle, you can kick back and watch the chat roll by between training sessions.

An MMO With an Ending

No gacha, no subscription. The final boss is about 10–13 hours away. Play a complete story packed with the fun of an MMO, all the way to the end.

After the Ending: The Trial Tower

Enemies grow stronger the higher you climb, dropping tower-exclusive gear with special bonus stats.
Every 5 floors, Phantoms of the bosses you fought on your journey block your path.
Your highest floor is shown next to your name for other players to see.

8-Bit Inspired Art and Sound

Pixel art, a CRT-style screen, and nostalgic sound.

Notes

・There is no player-to-player trading
・Save data is stored on your own PC (Steam Cloud supported)
・Depending on the time of day, you may not meet other players, but the entire game can be completed offline

data.name: Sophia
data.detailed_description:
Sophia is an action-rhythm game about helping people fight their inner demons. Follow the music to explore Sophia’s world, connect with others, travel into their psyche and engage in climactic boss fights. 

A Musical Journey

Music is how Sophia connects and interacts with the world. Follow the beat and join in her day-to-day life as an aspiring cellist. Follow the beat and help those who might need it. Follow the beat and travel between realities to face the shadow. Follow the beat and become the melody.

Parry, dodge, repeat.

Features

  • Intense musical battles, where all action is synced with the music

  • An inspiring world that follows Sophia's beat

  • 2 realities to discover

  • Replay battles and face extra challenges to become a true virtuoso

  • An original soundtrack inspired by classical music

  • A minimalistic hand-drawn visual style

data.name: Intrusive Thoughts
data.detailed_description:
A short story that turns everyday tasks into journeys. Can you be the voice that doesn’t let her down?

Intrusive Thoughts is a visual novel shown through an intense internal world. Simple actions like stepping outside or buying groceries become epic challenges for the protagonist, who is caught between biting humor and dark self-reflection.

Each choice you make could lead to moments of surprising clarity or spiraling despair, as the main character's relentless inner voice shapes the way forward.

This isn’t just a story, it's an experience in mental and emotional landscapes. By being the first to understand her, maybe you’ll help her find a way through.

Features:

  • Pixelated graphic style

  • Short duration (20-30 minutes)

  • 5 different endings

  • Dark immersive story

data.name: The Dead Rooms
data.detailed_description:
Previously under the title of SYNDER.

T̤̦̰̟͉̰̔͐ͫ͘ͅͅh̜̝̭̥̮ͩ̔ͬ̚͟ę̥̯͓̣ͧ͗ͧ ̯̗̝͇̮̗͉̒̍͘D̷͚̙̖͎̖̥͖̣̃̓̑ę̖̰ͣ͑a͍͖͚̤̬ͥ́͆̄͞d̵͕̻̜͚͍̻̱ͯ ͉̞͔̌ͯͩ̾́R̶̬͉͍̭̰̰̻͐ò͇͖̪̫͚̤̹͍̽ͯ͡ő̵͈͍̦͇͔̦m̢̗͉ͥ͊̂s̘̘͕̲̙͙͕͉͋̇͋̓͢ have taken you. Push through, what seems as an enigmatic living dimension extending randomly for eternity.


Experience dread and isolation as you navigate a seemingly endless realm of rooms, search for supplies/weapons and maintain your sanity as you hope for an exit.

IT'S LIKE THE FIRST TIME, EVERYTIME!

The Dead Rooms is ever evolving and adapting, Every run will feature different rooms and layouts + loot, and offer a different playthrough
Sometime you may get lucky..

NO MORE WALKING SIMULATORS!

The Dead Rooms aims to be an actually game, not just an immersive experience. Featuring survival and roguelite mechanics such as character management and perma death with the chance to find your previous body on your next run!

LEVEL VARIETY!

As you progress further, The Dead Rooms will feature a variety of rooms featured in The Back Rooms Lore, more being added after release!
Below are planned with more on the way!

  • Level 0 - "The Lobby"


  • Level 427 - "Infinite Mall"


  • Level 239 - "Infinite Arcade"

data.name: EigenGauge
data.detailed_description:
F-Zero's speed. Twisted Metal's combos. Floor it. This is hover racing at ridiculous velocity, tight and twitchy, where one clean line separates a record lap from a spectacular pile-up. But raw speed only gets you so far. Every ability is a combo: boosts, drifts, and specials all come from punching in face-button sequences on the fly, mid-corner, without lifting off the throttle. There's no partial credit... the chain holds or it resets to nothing.

But raw speed only gets you so far. Every ability is a combo. Boosts, drifts, and special maneuvers all come from punching in face-button sequences on the fly - and pulling them off mid-corner, without lifting off the throttle is the whole challenge. Nail the input and you rocket ahead. Fumble it and you're kissing a wall.

Handling is razor-sharp. These machines carve, drift, and cling to the track at speeds that should throw you off - master the controls and the inputs and you'll thread corners the pack can only dream about. Wall-rides, loop-the-loops, and tracks that curl in directions they shouldn't keep every lap on a knife's edge.

Every track is a love letter to the world's great roller coasters. The layouts borrow their DNA from legendary coasters - raven turns, pretzel loops, banana rolls, hangtime drops, and out-and-back twisters - reimagined at hover-racing speed. If you've ever wanted to drive a coaster instead of just ride it, this is that.

A good lap is nice. A stylish one scores more. Chain combos together cleanly to build your multiplier and climb the tier ranks - but flub a sequence or clip a wall and your streak's gone. The best runs are the ones where every input lands and you never lift off the throttle.

A roster of distinct drivers - from pure speed demons to nimble handlers to machines whose combo abilities flip the racing line on its head. Each vehicle brings two unique combos, three perks, and a garage of liveries that tune its stats to your style - so no two racers on the grid play the same. Everybody's got their own reason for showing up, too, whether they're an underdog with something to prove or a corporate hotshot who hates to lose.

Ten environments and dozens of tracks wind through nebulae, planet rings, and stations out at the cold edge of the system. Win races to unlock new tracks, new abilities, and whatever's hiding further down the tour.

Features

  • Combo-driven abilities: punch in face-button sequences to boost, drift, and unleash specials mid-race

  • Razor-sharp, high-speed handling in the spirit of the arcade racing greats

  • Tracks inspired by the world's most famous roller coasters - loops, corkscrews, and barrel rolls at full throttle

  • A multiplier system that rewards clean, chained inputs - win with style, not just speed

  • A variety of playable vehicles, each with its own abilities and combo sets and perks

  • 24 handmade tracks packed with wall-rides, loops, and gravity-defying sections

  • A whole star system of drivers, rivals, and secrets to dig up

  • Online multiplayer and local co-op

data.name: A la Card
data.detailed_description:
A la Card is a food truck deckbuilding roguelike where you'll mix and match the best aspects of every card you find to create absurd synergies and make new discoveries every time you play!

Stick the effect of one food onto another. Change what triggers that effect in the first place. Swap stats, inherit flavours, and cook up clever combinations no one else will.

Every run is an ebb and flow of cramming as many calories as possible into the window before hittin' the road to slap together the most powerful cards you can conceive of. These people want food? Oh you'll give them food.

But it won't be enough to just make a really big burger. Zany bosses bring self-contained puzzles to navigate, testing your deck's flexibility. They'll slip you a card and refuse to leave until you serve it to them or clog the window with half-eaten scrap. You'd better be able to improvise.

Served with a garnish of tasty tunes made to order by Josh Whelchel.

Features:

  • Sequence your cards to make the most of their effects. Skilled players are rewarded for clever plays.

  • Combine the calories of your ingredients using powerful recipes, creating space to serve even more food!

  • Random special events provide opportunities to change each and every detail of your cards: the colours, calories, effects, how you trigger those effects, and more!

  • Each starting deck has a unique and powerful trinket that deeply impacts how it plays, and you'll find more trinkets to mix and match throughout your runs.

  • Presiding over each location is a memorable boss with a unique ability. When big numbers aren't enough, you'll have to get creative!

  • Win runs to unlock more starting decks, trinkets, and release even more cards into the pool for future runs.

  • Revisit your favourite decks to take on special challenges and earn coveted stars!

With hundreds of cards and dozens upon dozens of mid-game events and upgrades, no two runs are ever the same.

data.name: Contracting at a Tech Giant
data.detailed_description:
For everyone who has worked, works, or will work as a contractor, and everyone who has worked, works, or will work alongside contractors, temporary workers, or agency staff.

If someone worked here for six years, why must he still prove that he was ever here?




At twenty-nine, backend programmer Lin Mo enters the technology giant Langlang as a contractor. The gate recognizes him but will not let him use the main entrance. The repository remembers his commits, but award forms require an employee number. The company welcomes him into the family while an email footer explains that the welcome proves no employment relationship.

This is not a simple morality test between obedience and rebellion. Everyone has duties, fears, and practical costs of their own. A chain of locally reasonable decisions can still become a system that reliably hurts people.

Choose what you believe, then choose what you say


Critical conversations happen twice: first you decide what Lin Mo truly thinks, then what he can afford to say aloud. Anger with cooperation, sympathy with refusal, or silence backed by a record can all be viable choices with different costs.



Keep limited records and put a subject back into the sentence


Preserve selected chats, access logs, commits, timesheets, photographs, and system records. Evidence is not a guaranteed victory and is never consumed. It changes future actions, ownership of work, who is willing to testify, and which version of events can survive.



Act through the systems that shape the workplace


Handle enterprise messaging, campus transport, incident timelines, AI knowledge training, access requests, labor statements, and a final evidence dossier. These are not decorative minigames: timing, order, attribution, recipients, and what you preserve all change the story.





Six years, three versions of the truth, seven endings


Every chapter leaves three accounts: what Lin Mo lived, what the company archived, and what the public was told. Your ending grows out of the choices you make, the records you preserve, the relationships you build, and the consequences of six years of work and life.

The game contains a prologue, eight workplace chapters, a hidden chapter, and a finale. A first playthrough is expected to take roughly 8-10 hours depending on reading speed and choices.

A headline that follows you back to work


Lin Mo watches a news clip about a contract worker at a racetrack. Read the comments and choose what he takes from it before returning to his own working life.

Content Notice


The story includes workplace pressure, status discrimination, job loss, illness, labor disputes, and references to death. It contains no graphic gore and offers chapter notices and reduced-detail options. This is a fictional story informed by workplace experiences and public reporting.

Playable in English and Simplified Chinese. Switch languages from the title screen or settings.

data.name: DECODE
data.detailed_description:
[h1]ABOUT THIS GAME[/h1]

DECODE is a minimalist logic puzzle game focused on deduction, analysis, and careful reasoning.

Each challenge presents a closed system with hidden rules. Your task is to observe patterns, test assumptions, and gradually decode how the system works. There are no reflex-based mechanics or fast action. Progress depends entirely on your ability to think logically.

Inspired by classic deduction games such as Bulls and Cows, DECODE transforms familiar logic principles into a modern, digital puzzle experience. Information is revealed through text, symbols, and system responses rather than visual spectacle.

The game encourages experimentation. Incorrect attempts are part of the process. Every input provides feedback, allowing you to refine your understanding and move closer to the solution.

DECODE is designed for players who enjoy slow, thoughtful problem solving and minimal visual distraction.

[h1]KEY FEATURES[/h1]

  • Logic-driven puzzle design: No luck, pure deduction.
  • Text-based challenges: Focus on the data, not the graphics.
  • Minimalist visual style: Clean, abstract, and distraction-free.
  • Procedurally generated puzzles: Infinite replayability with new codes every time.
  • Score tracking: Challenge yourself with Time Attack modes.
  • Built-in tutorials: Learn the core mechanics step-by-step.
