data.name: Drum Legend
data.detailed_description:
We proudly launch Drum Legend 2.0 !

Drum Legend is a music rhythm game with multiple drumming gameplay options. In the 'Drum Maestro' mode,you can simulate a band drummer ,learn a variety of drumming skills, and play your favorite music In the 'Rhythm Rush' mode, challenge yourself with more difficult tracks, aim for higher scores.
The game now support Custom Songs! Visit our Discord for Import Guide and get the Song Editor.（Please click the Discord link at the bottom）

- Drum Maestro:
Simulate playing the drum kit and get a taste of being in a band!
This mode comes with a certain level of difficulty. If you haven't played the drum kit before, you can start practicing with the 'Practice Album' song pack.
Enjoy a refined drumming experience with professionally designed drum charts, gradually becoming a VR Soulful Drummer.

- Rhythm Rush:
Don't make any miss, smash all notes accurately!
This mode is easy to pick up, but achieving SSS ranks or challenging level 9+ tracks requires continuous practice.
Every season, we release new featured song packs with meticulously designed music and charts for an exhilarating rhythmic experience.

We welcome your feedback to help us improve the product experience.If you encounter any problems while playing, please contact us at：drumlegend2023@gmail.com

data.name: Hadley's Run: A Starship Saga
data.detailed_description:
You are Hadley Orah, the pilot of a mining craft from a South African space colony. Going through a portal with an untested piece of tech leaves you stranded and alone in a distant alien galaxy. An unlikely hero, you must portal jump your way home, with Nia as your guide, to defeat the DraadMek and save the universe.




This game balances electrifying action with heart and soul. You’ll fight overwhelming enemies, obliterate powerful bosses and meet an array of weird and wonderful aliens such as //o||\*, a poetic sentient nebula, the terminally existential Void Droid Hoolihan, and Ick the Blob, barkeep at a deep space drinking den. Uncover a story as big and old as the universe itself.



  • Exhilarating and fast paced gameplay inspired by classic arcade games.
  • Over 80 upgrades to unlock, install and equip, ensuring each attempt is unique and memorable.
  • A diverse cast of interesting characters to meet and build relationships with.
  • A creative, African inspired universe to explore. Discover a vibrant tech-noir future.
  • A banging and distinctive soundtrack to immerse yourself in as you spank AI alien butt: A Mixture of electronic genres such as d&b and EDM fused with eclectic African flavours. All killer no filler.
  • Easy Mode: An easier version of the game that provides a more forgiving experience.
  • Arcade. Pick up and play. Smash your high score.


With every attempt to return home Hadley learns more about the universe and his place in it, building upon ever evolving relationships even as he battles the AI menace that threatens all of existence. Permanent upgrades improve your odds of survival, while upgrade floppies ensure each attempt is a unique opportunity to try something new.



Unsigned Double Collective is a small team based in Cape Town, South Africa. Full of heart and passion, we gave our all to bring this game to life. We hope it brings you as much enjoyment as we had making it.

Our team consists of: Romy (art), Lasse (coding), Liam (writing) & Matinino (music).

We plan on making many games after this, so we hope you enjoy this game and join us for our future journeys.

data.name: SurrounDead
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

Miscellaneous Updates:

  • More map updates

  • Remove trash objects

  • Reworked tutorial

  • Translations

  • Archery system

  • Improved FPS camera

  • Controller support

  • More difficulty options

  • Farming & more

  • And more...


About the Game

5 years have passed since civilization fought against the virus, but nothing has changed. The world lays in pieces, with no one to lead us to a brighter future fighting back against the zombies, people have fallen back to a dark life style.

With few remnants of civilization left, you are left to your own devices to survive in an unforgiving landscape.

Current Features:

  • Open World Zombie Survival Game for many to explore and survive.

  • Travel through a devastated post apocalyptic landscape.

  • Fight zombies, human survivors and more.

  • Vehicles that you need to manage and maintain. Also to use as portable storage.

  • Find many different firearms, melee weapons, clothing and different types of equipment.

  • Trade with survivors in trader hideouts or safe zones to get that one piece of equipment you need.

  • Barricade buildings or find your self somewhere in the wilderness to escape to.

  • Weather and day/night cycles, be careful.

  • From doing current activities, improve your ability to do them and unlock new abilities in the skill tree.

  • Ability to customise the game's difficulty and mechanics.

Planned Features:

  • Quest and bounty system.

  • Story system linking into the quests. Find out more about The Valley.

  • Vehicle customisation.

  • Farming system.

  • More locations and secrets to discover.

  • Online multiplayer survival with player run servers.

  • Finally, in the future co-op. Still there is much more... Stay Tuned.

data.name: The Simulation
data.detailed_description:
A never-before-seen game is the only clue left at a crime scene. Called in as a retired game designer to help with the case, you discover hidden breaches that let you cross into game worlds from within.

As more enigmatic games emerge, you begin to work alongside each game’s hero, alter what lies behind its visible rules, and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the games themselves.

Features:

A Mind-Bending Thriller
Investigate a strange case that unfolds across reality, playable games, and the hidden worlds behind them, blending psychological horror, mystery, and science fiction.

Original Gameplay
Control two presences in the same world: the hero inside the game, bound to its visible rules, and Hugo, the intruder who moves behind them. Progress depends on how both sides affect each other.

Layered Puzzle Design
Solve puzzles across multiple layers of reality, where actions inside the visible game and interventions behind it open new paths, reveal secrets, and deepen the story.

A World Behind the Veil
Enter strange simulated spaces that seem to be trying to look like games. As you push deeper, characters, rules, cameras, and hidden intentions begin to break apart.

Handcrafted Places, No Fillers
Explore detailed, authored environments where objects, characters, sound, and visual design are built with intention. Every level has its own identity in both art and gameplay.

Playmestudio is an independent studio focused on original, carefully crafted games where story, mechanics, art, and atmosphere work together as one.

We’re pretty serious about games; we aim for the heart.

The Simulation is under active development.

data.name: The Final Witness
data.detailed_description:
Every family hides secrets. Every victim has a story. Every clue can lie.

Investigate a haunted mansion in this first-person psychological horror detective game. Search for hidden evidence, solve interconnected mysteries, and identify the real killer before the darkness consumes your sanity. Every investigation unfolds differently, and every decision brings you closer to the truth... or further from it.

The Story

A once-prestigious family inherits an old mansion, hoping to restore it and build a better future. As financial struggles, buried secrets, and personal conflicts begin to tear them apart, tragedy strikes.

But the truth is never the same twice.

Each investigation presents a different version of the family's downfall. A different family member becomes the victim. A different suspect becomes the killer. Even the cause of death changes, creating a brand-new mystery every time.

When unexplained paranormal events prevent the local police from continuing their investigation, the case is handed over to a paranormal detective... You.

Now it's up to you to uncover the truth... before the mansion consumes your sanity.

Investigate the Truth

Explore every corner of the mansion, inspect objects, decode hidden messages, and connect scattered clues to reconstruct the crime.

Every piece of evidence matters, but not every clue tells the truth.

Your final accusation determines the fate of the investigation.

Every Investigation Is Different

No two investigations are exactly alike.

Each new investigation features:

  • A different victim.

  • A different killer.

  • A different cause of death.

  • Different clue locations and evidence.

Every investigation challenges you to adapt, observe carefully, and reach the correct conclusion.

Special Story Scenarios

As you solve investigations, you'll unlock handcrafted Special Scenarios.

Unlike the randomized investigations, these are handcrafted, fully scripted mysteries with fixed victims, killers, motives, clues, and outcomes.

Successfully solving a Special Scenario rewards you with the complete story behind the murder. Each one tells its own self-contained mystery.

Beware the Darkness

The mansion is never truly empty.

Supernatural forces lurk in the shadows, distorting reality and testing your sanity as you search for answers.

Perhaps the only one capable of helping you uncover the truth...

...is the spirit of the victim... The Final Witness to their own murder.

The victim's spirit may assist you during your investigation and guide you closer to the truth. But take too long, and they won't be the same anymore.

Every ghost behaves differently, with its own tactics, behaviors, and dangers. Learn what you're facing and adapt your strategy before it's too late.

More Than Just Investigations

Between investigations, you'll discover optional activities hidden throughout the mansion.

As you progress, you'll also unlock minigames, giving you new ways to enjoy the world of The Final Witness beyond solving crimes.

Features

  • Investigate replayable murder cases with randomized victims, killers, causes of death, puzzles and clues.

  • Unlock handcrafted Special Scenarios featuring unique mysteries and stories.

  • Explore a detailed haunted mansion in first-person, illuminated only by your flashlight. The electricity is gone, leaving you alone with the darkness.

  • Search, analyze, connect evidence and craft your own equipment to identify the true killer under the pressure of being watched.

  • Experience psychological horror with supernatural encounters and ghosts with different behaviors and tactics.

  • Make choices that influence the outcome of each investigation.

  • Discover optional activities throughout the mansion.

  • Unlock bonus minigames as you progress through the game.

  • Planned Early Access updates introducing new rooms, characters, investigations, and unique online modes.

Development Note

The Final Witness is currently in active development. Visuals, gameplay, features, and content shown on this page may change as development continues toward release.

data.name: FUCK STALIN
data.detailed_description:
LOST & FOUND - PLAY FOR FREE


About the Game

In FUCK STALIN your task is to torture Joseph Stalin and get as many points as possible using a wide variety of blocks and weapons.

GAMEPLAY

In the game you can build your own torture constructions, create an infinite number of Stalins and inflict suffering on him with firearms and white weapons, for which you receive points.

LEADERBOARD

All the points earned in the game are added up and then recorded in the global leaderboard. Perhaps it is YOU who will find yourself at the top of it!

PHOTO MODE

You can stop the game at any time using the advanced photo mode to take the perfect shot and share it with the community.

STEAM WORKSHOP

The game has support for Steam Workshop. Download maps created by the community or add your own creations.

data.name: Horizons of Achaea
data.detailed_description:
Chart the skies in this story-rich JRPG where the stars have vanished!

In Horizons of Achaea, command your airship, recruit a crew of sky-farers, and uncover the mysteries behind a shattered world. Explore floating islands, battle foes in classic turn-based combat, and engage in tactical airship encounters as you restore what was lost — one constellation at a time.

Inspired by genre-defining classics like Skies of Arcadia, Dragon Quest XI, and Tales of Symphonia, Horizons of Achaea blends nostalgic design with modern storytelling and systems. Build your island home, upgrade your vessel, and form deep bonds with your crew — every journey you take shapes the future of Achaea!.

  • 🌌 Explore and Navigate by the Stars — chart a broken world where every new island is a discovery!

  • ⚔️ Turn-based ground combat — classic JRPG battles with modern pacing and character synergy!

  • 🚢 Tactical airship battles — outmaneuver enemy vessels with timing, positioning, and skill!

  • 🏠 Build your home base — upgrade a floating island into your personal command center!

  • 🧑‍✈️ Recruit and bond with your crew — assign characters to roles on your ship or in battle, each with unique stories and benefits!

  • 🎵 Orchestral soundtrack — composed by Tony Manfredonia (The Outer Worlds 2) and dynamically synced to your journey!

data.detailed_description:
Step into a world where old-school cartoon charm meets pure horror. Horror Camp is a survival horror puzzle game set in a twisted, ever-changing maze filled with deadly traps, cryptic puzzles, and a relentless monster hunting you down.

Explore the eerie labyrinth, collect valuable resources, and use strategic thinking to escape before it's too late. Every corner holds a secret, and every decision matters—will you risk searching for upgrades, or will you run for your life?

Avoid terrifying creatures lurking around every corner.

"Stay on edge as you navigate through a world filled with monstrous beings waiting to strike when you least expect it."

Seek out places to regain your lost confidence.

"Find rare moments of respite to restore your sanity and strength, and keep moving forward in a world designed to break you."

Explore the horror camp’s dark corners to discover ways to enhance your survival skills.

"Delve into the hidden areas of the camp, uncovering tools and upgrades that might just give you the edge you need to make it out alive."


Solve cryptic puzzles hidden within the labyrinths, uncovering clues to escape the horror camp.

"Piece together the mysteries buried deep within the camp’s twisted labyrinths, revealing secrets that could be your only hope for survival."

data.name: Space Traveler's Brain Creator
data.detailed_description:
Story Background


The earth is about to perish. The universe is very big, and don't forget your home! But! But you forgot the direction! So, join the Go-home Plan of "Space Traveler's Brain Creator" now, and set out for the happy world of love and peace!

What can you get?


Game content:

  • Various cognitive ability training levels require players to remember passwords, and then answer correctly in the answer area, and pass after completing all puzzles.
  • In each training, the password corresponds to the 3D object state in a unique way, requiring you to use your cleverness and comprehend the inherent logic of each training.

Game style:

  • Minimalist style 3D world model. Rendering performance and experience are balanced.
  • Perfectly supports gamepad with a first-person controller. Walking, jumping, and interacting give a great feel.
  • UI design is especially friendly to large-screen displays.

The cognitive science of the game


This game features 3D cognivitve function training, helping players to develop and enhance their brains on cognitive abilities as recognised by cognitive science, like working memory, motion perception, mental rotation ability, spatial cognition, etc.

Each training level contains one uniquely designed task that evolves from easy to difficult throughout the entire level, requiring about 5 minutes to finish.

By conbining different levels together or going through levels as what he or she wants, the player can have a customized experience on his or her training plan.

How to benefit from the game?


Players are recommended to go through all puzzle levels and find out their personal advantages and shortages for each task during the first launch of the game. After that, they should make a plan for daily exercise.

Typically, 10 minute training in the morning gives you an entire day of fresh intelligent brain. Ambitious players should extend the training time to 20-30 minutes per session to maximize their profits.

About the Game

The mysterious island of Lyndaria, home to vastly different tribes, has survived wars, cataclysms, and the fall of gods. data.name: Touhou Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Touhou Adventure takes place in the land of Gensokyo, a super natural realm made of magic.

Dangerous youkais dwells the infamous places of Gensokyo, prepare yourself to fight, train, become stronger!

But fear not! you can be helped by various inhabitants of this mysterious land, sells, buy stuff and become richer!

In this game you can
  • Craft
  • Plant and plow
  • Shoot
  • Talk to people
  • Sell and buy
  • Travel
  • Fish
  • Mine
  • Collect

Crafting

Crafting lets you build various objects, such as bullets and pellets, by adding various object in the correct order on the crafting grid, you can a new item out of it, which can be sold or bought.

Plant and plow

A core mechanic of the game, where you can plow your fields, plant crops and harvest these crops, but you need to know that you can't plow everywhere, only where the player reside can the land be plowed, see it as convenient farming, where you don't need to travel a lot to get your crops done.

Off course crops can be sold and bought.

Shoot

Another core mechanic of the game, since it is based on bullet hell.

You can shoot any bullet you have on your inventory by equipping them on the hotbar, then pressing on the numbers from 1 to 9.
You don't actually kill enemies, they always respawn at some point, they just get too tired to fight and disappear, every enemies drops a coin when defeated, coins are useful for trading!

Talk to people


As the land is full with a bit of everything, including NPC, you can interact with them, by click E when closed to it. Some off the NPC might have things to sell, or important piece for the lore, it's up to you to talk to them, embark a journey of wonders!

Sell and buy


Money is important to anyone in anywhere, even in Gensokyo! Why not trading then ? Sometimes you can't find an item you want, or maybe it's too hard to get it.

Well then money is the way to go ! Each coin is 1 amount of money, but use it wisely! Most of the shops are in the human village for now

Travel


The playable will be huge! But for now it's way smaller, but even that, there is still a lot to explore, NPC are scattered around the map, they might have important things to say, who knows...

Each bit of the map is unique, having points of interest, and based from the original franchise, if you're a Touhou fan, you might enjoy these little things

Fish

Fishing is another way to make money in this game, you can go fishing in a medium to large body of water and get some fishes you can sell

Mine

Going mining is fun, it gives you the possibility to craft bullets and sells these ores to a profit ! but it may be dangerous to go there

Collect

what's better than collecting all items in this world in displaying them in a... display.. get to kourindou and start filling sets !

Controls


"WASD" is for moving
"LMB" for shooting

"RMB" for using tools
"SHIFT" for going slower
"E" is for interacting
"B" for brining the inventory
"X" is for bombs
"R" is for getting back the catch(when fishing)
"C" for bringing the crafting menu

data.name: ENF Novels: Dress Code
data.detailed_description:
ENF novels: dress code is an erotic choice based visual novel with multiple endings. The player will not directly impersonate a character, but will have control over the evolution of the story. The character Brigitte Wagner has 10 days to force 3 of her subordinates to resign, to do so she will resort to the most despicable means. ENF novels dress code is based on around 550 full hd images, 20,000 words and an original soundtrack.

ABBY


Abby is a very serious and professional girl. She is a hard worker, she is gifted with great intelligence and self-control. She enjoys helping people and doing menial jobs. Abby is something of a leader, her decisions are always very wise and thoughtful.

LINDA


Linda is a very down to earth girl. At work she is very skilled, although she prefers to enjoy her free time by following her bizarre lifestyle. Linda is shrewd and direct in dealing with problems and always tries to find the shortest way to solve them.

MEGAN


Megan is the most naive of the three girls. She loves her job, even though she is more interested in making a career than in producing results. She respects the chains of command a lot and has esteem for her superiors, she tries to defend them even when they objectively commit injustices.

BRIGITTE


Brigitte Wagner is the boss nobody wants to have. Brigitte is ready to do anything to defend the economic interests of the company she works for. She loves her boss and she would do anything to please him. She is merciless with her subordinates, she has no limits and is ready to humiliate them in any way to obtain their resignation.

data.name: The Wailer
data.detailed_description:
The Wailer is a highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. With torch in hand, explore and find a way to escape before falling prey to the unspeakable horror that lurks within.



Delve into a dark and mysterious dungeon. Discover secrets and uncover hidden passageways as you explore. Find the way out before the darkness consumes you. The dungeon is also filled with challenges and obstacles, so players must be vigilant and use all the resources at their disposal. With every twist and turn, players will come closer to unraveling the mysteries of the dungeon and ultimately, escaping.



Light plays a crucial role in the gameplay as it not only helps the player navigate and uncover secrets but also protects them from the darkness that threatens to consume them. Be warned, the safety of the light comes at a price.



Hello! I am Ethan Robichaux and I solo developed this game over 6 months. At the time of The Wailer releasing I am a college student and I create games in my free time. This is my 3rd full Steam game and first fully 3D game. This game is completely free because I want as many people as possible to be able to play and enjoy the game I worked very hard on!

data.name: Shiba Inu Rescue
data.detailed_description:
Embark on this action-adventure journey of Yuki, who is on her way to rescue her puppies from the world's troubles. Yuki's puppies are always up to something that makes her worried and wander around. She knows that this countryside is packed with wild animals. Moreover, Brutus (The famous DogCatcher) of the town is always on a mission to capture dogs. It's a dangerous world out there.
One fine day, Yuki prepared the finest meal for her puppies. She was so happy that puppies would enjoy this delicious food. Little did she knew that this day would be a nightmare for her. As she went out from her home to call her puppies, she could not find them anywhere. The naughty puppies have lost again. This is where your adventure starts.
It's time to be in the shoes of Yuki. Help her in finding her cute puppies and bring them back home safely. Beware of Brutus and the Wild Animals. You have to use your dodging tactics to survive. Shiba Inu Rescue is a colorful 2D action-adventure game that will remind you of some classic games like Mario. Let's relive the retro moments one more time. :)
Yuki must take on this challenge for her puppies. Run, Jump, and Dodge to survive the obstacles and make your way to the different levels. The game is super fun to play with much easier controls. Move Yuki left by pressing ‘A’ and move her right by pressing the button ‘D’ If you want to make her jump, press spacebar. It's that simple, however it has so much fun that it will immerse you into this colorful world.

How to control Yuki?
Shiba Inu Rescue is a huge fun to play. The game carries simple and easy controls. Move your character Yuki left by pressing ‘A’ and move her right by pressing the button ‘D’. If you want to jump? Press Spacebar. It's that simple, however it has so much fun that it will immerse you into this colorful world.

Key Features
• Fun and addictive gameplay
• Cute setting that reminds you of some of the classic video games
• Simple and easy controls.
• Beautiful Graphics
• Immersive Experience

Notice
Shiba Inu Rescue will be released in 2 parts with more enemies and bosses coming soon.

Play & Contribute Towards Animal Protection
We love animals! We have decided that a portion of the proceeds will go towards local no-kill animal shelters near our area. Hopefully, we will extend our support to a more no-kill animal shelter in the future. Let's play this addictive game and automatically contribute to this beautiful cause.

data.name: Codeguess
data.detailed_description:
One word, one number, 25 files

Codeguess is a word game for 2 to 24 players. Two teams face off, Red against Teal. Only the two spymasters know which files belong to which team. Each turn they give their agents a single clue: one word and a number. "Ocean 3" means three files are linked to ocean.

The agents talk it over, mark files and reveal them. Hit one of yours and you keep guessing. A civilian ends your turn, a rival file helps the other team. Reveal the bomb and you lose on the spot.

Gadget cards: help, sabotage, chaos

Each team holds a hidden hand of gadget cards and draws a new one every turn. There are 22 cards in three rarities: common, rare and epic. The Compass lights up the row with the most of your files, X-Ray reveals a civilian. Against the other team you can drop a smoke screen, flip every file into mirror writing or jam the radio so their agents never hear the number. Sabotage stays secret until it strikes.

Hits earn credits, misses cost them, and credits buy extra cards. The team that's behind draws rare cards more often. Five presets range from "Classic" with no gadgets to "Chaos" with every card, or you build your own set.

An AI spymaster from two players up

Not enough people for two spymasters? Let the AI take over for one team or both, so a single agent per team is enough. Pick one of three levels: the Recruit gives simple clues, the Agent plays like a solid teammate, and the Master Spy links up to four files and plays its gadget cards with purpose.

Voice chat that knows the rules

No Discord needed. Voice chat is built in and decides who hears whom: agents hear each other, including the rival team. Spymasters hear every agent but only talk to each other, so nobody can leak what's on their key card.

More show, more tactics

  • Combos up to ×3 for hits in a row and jackpot files with bonus points
  • Radio call: the spymaster records a five-second extra hint, distorted as robot, helium or deep voice
  • Objections with a vote when a clue breaks the rules
  • A debrief after every mission with all clues, the files each spymaster meant and every radio call to replay

Made for streaming

Streamer mode hides your invite code, and the room code alone won't let anyone in. A privacy screen only shows the spymaster's colors while a key is held. Your Twitch chat can play along too: "!tip word" suggests clues when you're the spymaster, "!card 7" marks files when you're an agent.

Everything included

Buy once, play forever. No subscriptions, no in-game purchases.
  • Nine word packs in English and German, over 1,800 words per language, plus your own words
  • Community word packs from the Steam Workshop, and you can publish your own right from the game
  • All 22 gadget cards and every preset
  • Six file designs: Manila, Classified, Blueprint, Noir, Terminal and Gala
  • Steam achievements, invites through your friends list and Rich Presence
Every player needs their own copy. Invite friends through your Steam friends list or the invite code.

Buy once, play forever. No subscriptions, no in-game purchases.
  • Nine word packs in English and German, over 1,800 words per language, plus your own words
  • Community word packs from the Steam Workshop, and you can publish your own right from the game
  • All 22 gadget cards and every preset
  • Six file designs: Manila, Classified, Blueprint, Noir, Terminal and Gala
  • Steam achievements, invites through your friends list and Rich Presence
Every player needs their own copy. Invite friends through your Steam friends list or the invite code.
data.short_description: Two teams, two spymasters, 25 secret files. One word and a number lead to the right files, the bomb ends it all. With gadget cards to help and sabotage, an AI spymaster from two players up, built-in voice chat and Twitch chat help.

data.name: Mumu's Soup Adventure SAMSARA
data.detailed_description:
Mumu's Soup Adventure SAMSARA is a puzzle story adventure game where you play as a cute ghost cat and explore various settings such as a forest, a school and a mansion.

  • Solve puzzles by using items you've found, or observing hints while exploring.

  • A different story in each chapter that focuses on the character you've encountered. The stories also contains elements of drama and josei themes.

  • Hand drawn CG art and world set in a town that mixes modern life with cute fantasy.

"The scent of flowers...it calms me."

Story

Mumu is a ghost cat, whose master is Jill, the candy witch with a wicked sweet tooth.

One day, Jill decided she wants to make soup, and one of the ingredients is Mumu's heart! 

Running away from the persistent witch, he also encounters a mysterious (and sexy) flower witch, and thus a new duty has begun. 

"Become the overseer of lost souls"

Observe with Mumu the stories of various lives...

Angelo's story: A listless child wanders in a mysterious forest to search for his mother. 

Varinna's story: As a final memory before graduation, A curious student wishes to see the rumoured ghost at the school's rooftop.

Silvia's story:  Alone in her mansion, the past lingers the widow's mind, slowly consuming her.

Explore, solve puzzles, and follow Mumu's story in his adventure!

You can run, but you can't hide!

data.name: Layoff Revenge!
data.detailed_description:
RE: Your final day with us

You have fifteen minutes left before you leave the building after being fired. And there is one manager who deserves every second of them. For years, he has been holding you back: ignoring your suggestions, taking credit for your work, and giving performance reviews that never changed anything.

Coffee machines, wet floor signs, party supplies, a ping-pong table, and a cleaning closet nobody has opened since 2019. All of it can become a weapon if you are creative and petty enough.

Grease the hallway and see if the manager knows how to ice skate. Put something in his coffee and show him what the office bathroom is really for. Combine it all into ridiculous chains and make this bastard regret ever deciding to mess with you.

RE: Fill the RAGE meter

Every sabotage gives you a different number of points. Tweak the printer just a little, and a thousand pages will bury the manager’s desk. Simple, reliable, cheap. Ruin the coffee machine and get more. Replace the manager’s quarterly presentation with a bunch of stupid memes and hit the jackpot. It is your time and your choice how to spend it.

The moment a trap lands, you earn RAGE points. Chain sabotages together and the numbers get huge. Fifteen minutes is enough for either a pile of small pranks or a few massive ones.

RE: Keep suspicion low

Everyone else is still working here. And they keep noticing you. When you crouch by the coffee machine, loiter outside the manager’s door, hold a bottle of floor polish, and try to look like everything is completely normal.

Each coworker has their own suspicion level toward you. If it gets too high, your former coworker will go get the manager, and he will start looking for you.

Bribe the witnesses! A donut and a coffee are always a good solution. Keep them busy with figurines from the game room and get thirty glorious seconds where they could not care less about you.

RE: Go alone or bring a team of up to 4

You were not the only one who got a “happy” email today, so gather your accomplices and make the most of your 15 minutes.

Pass items to each other, cover for each other, send one player to work on the presentation while the rest keep the office distracted.

Get caught and the manager throws you out of the building. But a teammate can try to let you back in. Playing alone? Send a former coworker off on an errand and get to work while they are gone.

RE: And then there is the floor above

One manager is only a warm-up. Every floor you clear unlocks the next one, and the people up there are already better at their jobs. More observant coworkers, tighter offices. Managers who have already heard what happened downstairs and started taking countermeasures.

Keep climbing. At the very top of this building is a huge office. Inside sits someone who has never once in his life been held responsible for his actions. He is your main target.

data.name: MAD TOYS
data.detailed_description:
In Mad Toys, your mission is to defend the moving train

by engaging in intense battles against the pursuing enemy,

while also managing resources such as refilling ammo and repairing damages.

At pit stops, replenish supplies and purchase crucial upgrades to

enhance the train's capabilities.

With each run, collect resources to upgrade the train,

making it powerful enough to defeat the invading enemy and save the realm.

Challenge your decision-making skills with management tasks,

from resource allocation to target prioritization,

shaping the outcome of your battle.

Engage in challenging boss battles where strategy is key.

Uncover and exploit weak points during intense confrontations.

From disarming missiles to dismantling shields,

each boss encounter presents unique mechanics that demand

quick thinking and precision for success.

Experience intense first-person vehicular combat. Navigate an
armed train with different mounted guns and engage
in high-speed battles against a variety of enemy forces.

Defeat your enemies earn rewards and use them to become more powerful!

  
Combine 2 Upgrade Bricks into A More Powerful one!

data.name: Seven Dunes: Curse on the Golden Sand
data.detailed_description:
Seven Dunes: Curse on the Golden Sand is a game about an operation for rescuing a princess kidnapped by monsters in a fantasy desert kingdom. The hero (user) must solve numerous puzzles and deal with countless monsters to complete the operation. It combines adventure puzzles and RPG elements. Please find the introduction of the story below the following features:

- We also had the story written as a novel, which might be available to you.
- While it is essentially an adventure game, we incorporated lots of RPG elements to enrich the content of the game, like the drops of elixirs, herbs, potions, and mixtures.
- As we know that a game must offer replayability in the future, we tried to randomize many things like enemies, objects, locations, characters, including the title songs, some dialogs, and other sounds.
- Surrounding objects will offer many surprises that are randomized carefully.
- We used highly diversified sound assets and voice-overs of all characters were done by carefully-selected artists with special skill in their profession.
- Enemies are many and they have special melee or magic skills depending on their character or maybe boss.
- We included numerous cut-scenes to tell the story nicely and enjoyably.
- We incorporated special animations to people and monsters with different activities in line with the particular things they do, like mining.
- We attached particular importance to the bosses. We wanted them to be a little different from classical bosses with supreme power and converted them into intelligent and interesting beings, ranging from the one who vomits similar but smaller monsters to the one who converts the objects in the interior of the castle into enemies and from the one who cooks enemies in a huge magic cauldron to the one who becomes the hero himself!
- The game is assertive especially with its puzzles.

Introduction of the story:
(Excerpt from our novel)

Chapter 1
Curse befallen


Anyone who would take look at the view of the Castle of Seven Dunes could see it looked uglier, darker, and gloomier than a few weeks earlier, with its artisanal architecture and build made of the golden sands of the desert, following the fulminant curse spider-webbed all around the locale. One of the centers of happiness and justice in Seven Dunes had turned into chilling somberness behind the western walls of the town. The people of Seven Dunes were unwilling to see it any longer. In fact, no one was feeling like a bit of fresh air, coming outside from their homes that they were probably considering the safest place for the time being. The gate at the eastern walls was opening to a temple that looked a bit larger than the one a visitor of the town would expect, as a significant portion of the townsfolk was imprisoned or lost. The gate at the southern walls was the passageway of the people to an oasis where they could fulfill their needs of bathing, trading, breeding their livestock, and enjoying conversations with the foreign passersby of other kingdoms of the desert. The land beyond the northern walls did not offer much for a visitor as it was mere sand and endless view of the desert, despite the presence of a nice pavilion for public meetings situated on the northern dune, one of the seven dunes encircled by the walls, which were the inspiration for elders to name the town. The southern dune also had a pavilion on it, where Ande-ryn, the female Chief of the town, or other individuals met to govern the locale. Four of other dunes were home to the housing of the townsfolk, while the last one was used as the entrance to the castle in the west. There situated inns, merchants' workplaces, market, etc. as well as palm trees on the fords naturally formed between the dunes.
In the middle of the night, one of the rooms somewhere in the castle was lit with numerous candlesticks. Seven Dunes, as always in lands dominated by deserts, more particularly the hot weather during daytime, was shinier and more cheerful at nights and recent days saw the townsfolk tired and less willing to enjoy things under the control of unknown beings. The room was the one where Princess Elryn, the Governor and Ruler of Seven Dunes, under the aegis of King Gorlough, her father who was in charge of all kingdoms and princedoms of the desert, was kept as a prisoner. Princess Elryn had fallen in love with Seven Dunes and wanted to lead her life there, in a visit her father paid together with her. Indeed, Seven Dunes was also home to the endless gold-colored sands of the desert but its proximity to the oasis and the small creek running from it, entering the town, and passing by the font side of the temple, were able to make the area fertile enough and the people continue living in peace. Now the princess was imprisoned in her own castle, in a part of it she even did not discern. That night, she wrote a letter to her father:

““My lord
Seven Dunes is in danger!
All of a sudden, some unknown creatures started to appear everywhere...
They first imprisoned me in the depths of the castle.
And made weird shapes on walls!
They built their statues arbitrarily everywhere....
Wanting us to witness the presence of their vile shadow.
In the desert, in the caves, in the gardens, even in my castle.
They say they keep destroying everything in my kingdom...
They occupied every nook and cranny.
And inflicted undefinable damage and suffering on my people and my land.
I do not know where they hide and attack hideously... And I also do not know where they emerge from.
Please, Excellency, please help my people survive. Your force is my only chance and shelter.
As always...
Faithfully yours
Princess Elryn

Princess Elryn then stood and took the letter as well as a living thing that was not unfamiliar to the royal people of the region: a Crystalbird. She had bluish, bright, crystal feathers and body parts and was shedding more light than the torch on the walls of the room and the candlestick on the table of the Princess. Crystalbirds were one of the means of communication among nobles.
“How unfortunate it is that this is the only Crystalbird I have,” she thought to herself, fearing that the Crystalbird, vulnerable against cursed spells, might be lost forever in the skies. She tied the letter to one of the legs of and petted the bird who was content with any kind of affection like other animals. Wishing good luck for her people, the Princess released the Crystalbird into the cursed skies of Seven Dunes. With a slight halo of light behind her, the bird disappeared in the heavens.

data.name: lil' Sherman
data.detailed_description:
lil' Sherman is a 3rd person action tower defense RPG that takes place in a stylized WW2/Alt-Universe.



The year is 1945 and with the help of Element 115 the evil Nazi Scourge has won the great war in Europe. However, with lil’ Sherman leading the counteroffensive all hope is not lost. This elite U.S. Sherman tank, along with the support of the command center, will help take back Europe one country at a time.

Key Features:

  • Customize your weapons, armor and engine to destroy your enemies in whatever ways you see fit!
  • Collect resources and use them to build your tank into the ultimate tool of destruction!

data.name: The Beauty Cult's NECTARMANCER
data.detailed_description:
Nectarmancer is a Gardenvania action-platformer where you grow living weapons, engineer plant genetics, and explore a vast interconnected world powered by a mysterious substance called Nectar.

Master fast-paced acrobatic combat, cultivate powerful plant species, and explore a vast interconnected world where every discovery can unlock new ways to fight, survive, and progress.

STORY

Congratulations on your duty, Nectarmancer.

As the realm's most trusted collector, collect bounties to expand THE THRONE's eternal dominion.

THE THRONE governs. THE THRONE protects. THE THRONE provides.

The world runs on Nectar, a mysterious substance that changes the world around it. 

Play as Aisa, a prisoner forced into the Collection Corps, an expendable Nectarmancer sent beyond the walls to harvest the life-sustaining substance that powers the realm. But outside THE THRONE's domain, the truth is taking root. Spirits rage. Ecosystems collapse. Forbidden experiments twist nature into weapons. And the deeper Aisa ventures, the clearer it becomes: the world is not dying by accident. 
Will you continue feeding the machine consuming the world, or use its own tools to bring it down?


GROW LIVING WEAPONS. Plants are your weapons and tools. Discover rare species, preserve genetic traits, and breed powerful new hybrids. Every expedition expands your arsenal with new ways to fight, explore, and survive. Unlock new movement abilities, combat options, and hidden paths through illicit research, genetic traits, and Nectar-fueled upgrades.

Dash, vault, strike, and chain abilities together in fluid, high-skill combat. Master movement, timing, and plant synergy to overcome aggressive enemies, dynamic encounters, and challenging boss fights.

The Wilds are beautiful, hostile, and unforgiving. Death means losing the seeds, fruits, and plants you carry. Every journey is a calculated risk. Every successful return matters.

Expand your research through a living biological computer that powers your progression. Unlock Nectar abilities, socketable upgrades, skill-tree enhancements, and new ways to customize your playstyle.

And More...

- Challenging boss fights that demand mastery of movement and plant combat

- Dynamic enemies that target your plants and punish passive strategies

- Thousands of genetic combinations, every trait a double-edged sword

- Ultrabit 2.5d pixel-art

- Original fantasy soundtrack crafted from boutique analog synthesizers, real instruments, drums and choirs

data.name: Jack - The Puppet
data.detailed_description:
"Jack - The Puppet" is a spine-chilling survival horror game that takes you on a journey into the heart of a cursed mansion. You play as a daring researcher who uncovers a lead to a priceless golden Shiva statue hidden in an abandoned mansion deep in the forest. Despite warnings of an evil doll named Jack that haunts the estate, you venture inside, only to find yourself trapped in a nightmare.

Explore the mansion's eerie halls, unravel cryptic puzzles, and uncover secrets that lead you closer to your goal. But beware—Jack is watching.

In the game's climactic showdown, Jack is released from his confinement and will hunt you down, giving you only 150 seconds to survive. The only way to stop him is to find a gun hidden in his lair and fire 30 rounds before time runs out. Fail, and Jack will claim your life. Succeed, and the golden Shiva statue will be yours.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Horror: Experience a chilling ambiance with detailed visuals and immersive sound design.

  • Engaging Puzzles: Solve intricate puzzles that test your wit and unlock the secrets of the mansion.

  • Intense Survival Gameplay: Outrun and outwit the relentless Jack during a nail-biting 150-second chase.

  • High Stakes: Face the ultimate decision—fight for your life or fall victim to Jack's wrath.

  • Rewarding Payoff: Secure the legendary golden Shiva statue and escape the mansion... if you dare.

Do you have what it takes to outlast Jack and claim the ultimate treasure?

"Jack - The Puppet" contains themes and content intended for mature audiences. These include:

Psychological Stress:

The game involves high-pressure situations, such as solving puzzles under a countdown timer and surviving within a haunted mansion.
Sensitive Content Notice:
The game does not include explicit sexual content, references to sexual assault, non-consensual acts, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm. However, players should be aware of the intense horror themes and violent encounters.

"Jack - The Puppet" is rated suitable for players aged 13+ due to its horror elements and mild violence. Parental discretion is advised for younger audiences.

data.name: Outergod Abduction
data.detailed_description:
~~~Hi, darling! I’m Chtuli, your one and only!~~~

~~~

You're finally awake... my darling ♥

I've been waiting so long for this moment. You're even more adorable than I imagined!

Do you like your new home? It's my space station, far away from everything.

Don't worry, I'll take care of you~ Hugs, games... anything you need!

~~~

~~~

Oh, darling? Are you feeling unwell?

Don't worry, I've prepared my special mix just for you~ Why is it pink? Don't worry about it~

~~~

~~~

This is Mimi, my little pet! Say hi~ She's a bit messy, but she's a good girl.

~~~

~~~
Now let's play together! Rock... paper... scissors!

~~~

~~~
You'll stay with me forever, right? ...Darling? Why are you looking at the door?

.....................
........
...

No... Don't leave me...  Don't leave me... Don't leave me... Don't leave me... 
Don't leave me... Don't leave me...  Don't leave me... 
Don't leave me... 
~~~

◆------------------! Features ! ------------------◆

◆-A unique twist on the yandere genre-◆

Chtuli is an alien girl with telekinetic powers, and unlike other yanderes, she doesn't want to kill you!

◆-She'll never let you go-◆

She loves you so much she will do anything to keep you by her side forever.

◆-Don't make her mad-◆

Push her away or mistreat her, and the sweet alien turns into a terrifying hunter armed with flying syringes.

◆-Hide and seek-◆

Crawl into a locker, hold still, and pray she doesn't find you.

◆-Mimi, the adorable pet slime-◆

Cute, clumsy, and dying to play ball with you.

◆-More than a horror game-◆

Explore the station, mess with everything you find, uncover hidden events and play mini-games with Chtuli and Mimi.

◆-Secrets and multiple endings-◆

Lots of secrets and easter eggs to find, and endings that change depending on how you treat Chtuli.

◆-Japanese voice acting-◆

Chtuli comes to life with Japanese voice acting.

※ Psychological horror, jump scares and violence.

data.name: memu is space cat
data.detailed_description:
Drift with memu, through a slightly strange universe.

The space cat memu floats through a wondrous, neon-soaked universe. Neon grids, a melting sun, shapes you can't even begin to name. It's way too much information — so much that your brain just gives up trying to process it.

So much chaos, somehow cozy. And wait — what even is a space cat?

◆ Bathe in the sights and sounds

Leave it be and memu drifts on its own. You can just watch. Dazzling scenery, strange music. Space out, and just soak it in. Feel like it? Take the wheel, pull up to a planet, snap a photo. Don't feel like it? Do nothing. That's fine too.

◆ Every time, the music and the space are brand new

Planets, pockets, ruins of no known purpose. Roam places scattered at random. Sky, color, shapes, and the music playing — all freshly generated, every time. The same view, the same track, never comes again. Today's universe is today's only.

◆ Two ways to play

Pick by mood. Neither one can kill you. Neither one rushes you.

  • Drift — the leave-it-on one. Launch it, walk away. Its whole job is to run in the background — sights and sounds like a BGM behind your work.
  • Journey — the actually-play one. Tilt a whole star and roll memu around inside it. Wind down a course grabbing cat cans to the goal. Fall off? A ramp right there rolls you back on.

◆ Bookmark the ones you like

The same universe never comes back. Pull a weird one and you can show it off to friends. Or just keep it to yourself. Your "huh, I kinda like this" collection slowly piles up.

◆ Grab a cat can, if you want

There are cat cans lying around. Pick them up, or drift right past. There's nothing in this universe you have to do.

◆ Loose achievements fill in on their own

No rush. No failing. Drift, roll, find things, grab the odd can — and somehow it's filling up.

No goal. No hurry. Watch it, or roll it. Just melt your brain in a weird space, with weird sounds.

data.name: SpellForce 2 - Anniversary Edition
data.detailed_description:
SpellForce 2 - Anniversary Edition presents the award-winning SpellForce saga hits: "SpellForce 2 – Shadow Wars" and the add-on "SpellForce 2 – Dragon Storm" for a spectacular game experience!

Experience the age of heroes: roleplaying action & realtime strategy in a perfect mix of genres.

Mysterious powers arise from darkness and shadow. They are threatening Eo, the world of SpellForce, already devastated by wars and sundered by intrigues. A hero, born of the legendary Shaikan and linked by a life bond with an ancient dragon now holds the fate of the world in his hands! Unite powerful heroes and armies under your banners, as only with joined forces you can combat this threatening doom! The burden of ancient blood is heavy, and it is yours to carry…

  • Fight epic campaigns with your heroes, with over 90 hours of playing time.
  • Individual development of the avatar and heroes with an extensive skill tree!
  • Control various game factions with three races each in a life-like fantasy world.
  • Command infantry, mounted and flying units, and unleash the enormous titans!
  • Experience spectacular mass battles in breath-taking 3D graphics!

Anniversary Edition Features:

  • Re-implemented multiplayer and NAT traversal for a smooth online experience
  • Many Bugfixes
  • Additions and Fixes for the Free Game Mode
  • Widescreen Support
  • Full compatibility with modern operating systems

Major Engine & Technical Re-Design/Re-Work:

  • Grass rendering improved
  • View distance improvements
  • Improved trees (trunk/branch)
  • Improved leaf rendering (add leaf subsurface scattering)
  • Improved lighting (per pixel, basic Bidirectional reflectance distribution function specular, rim light, view dependent ambient, etc)
  • Improved shadows (soft shadows, percentage-closer filtering)
  • Shader Model 3.0 usage only

data.name: Mine Climbers
data.detailed_description:
Mine Climbers is a vertical platformer where you'll be dashing and jumping your way out of a collapsing mineshaft while avoiding the falling rubble. An unlikely mix of falling block puzzle gameplay and traditional platforming. Currently in development.

Features

  • Fast-paced platforming action that demands sharp reflexes, constant focus, and split-second decision-making to secure victory.

  • Jump in for a for quick run or grind through longer sessions to hone your skills. Only mastery will see you escape the mine.

  • Captivating arcade-inspired soundtrack to support the flow of the game.

  • Unlockable abilities that evolve gameplay and reward skillful play.

  • Global leaderboard where players can challenge friends and rivals alike for top rankings.

  • Multiplayer versus mode offering a fresh block-vs-player experience: one player controls the character while the opponent commands the falling blocks. Playable both locally and online.

data.name: Step into the Dark
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the grim depths of the underworld - the Pit, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

Explore the open underground world

Escape the ruins of the Old Prison, reach the main underground city of Hometown, break through the lair of the Wererats, infiltrate the abandoned laboratory of the Mechans, and delve into other meticulously crafted locations.

Fight formidable enemies

Engage in battles with dangerous foes that inhabit the Pit. Use your combat skills and a wide arsenal to gain the upper hand and survive in this ruthless, danger-filled place.

Solve riddles and uncover hidden elements

Solve a variety of puzzles, unearth hidden secrets, and collect valuable items that unlock new opportunities and help you progress deeper into the abandoned corners of the underground world.

Unique Immersive Combat System

Dive into dynamic and thrilling battles, controlling every strike and movement. Use a variety of weapons and find your own style to masterfully defeat enemies and feel like a true fighter.

Deep Atmospheric Immersion

Explore the living, dark world of the Pit, interact with the environment, and make difficult decisions that will affect both you and the fate of the underground world, forever doomed to never see the sun.

Well-crafted Lore

Discover the grim history of this place. Here, every note, symbol, and forgotten corner comes together to form a single, living, breathing universe. Delve into its mysteries and Step into the Dark, where ancient secrets lie waiting to be uncovered.

data.name: COLONY 13 - Into The Void
data.detailed_description:
In the beginning there was nothing,

suddenly , a spark of hope in utter darkness..

Crossing immense space and time , light began to describe wholeness of the space eternal..

creating what appears to be some kind of geometry divided in eight quadrants of eternal space..

endless beams of light, carrying life with them ..

soon the eternal space was teeming with life..

Eridanus , the dark river flows between the quadrants, keeping them united and separated simultaneously..

Suddenly ,Phaeton , the "Dark star", fell into the river igniting the separation between quadrants..

From that point Eridanus started flooding quadrants of space ..

from its depths , alien species , the "Distorts", emerged..

Technologically advanced they quickly conquered intergalactically quadrants of space.. galaxy after galaxy..

destroying everything in its path..

Life forms had to flee before the eternal darkness..

Historians, eternal beings who were there from the beginning made sure that every life form had its chance to flee before it get caught by the waves of Eridanus..

This is our story..

In Year 2061, mankind finally touched the surface of the red planet.

Our probes were sending data of the site of unknown origin in the northern hemisphere of Mars for decades.. and emitting data of big magnetic disturbances in surrounding area..

Substance, latter called "Octium" because of its omni-potency in bending and traversing space and time was found soon upon Mars landing.

Mankind officially became interstellar species in the year 2091..

With knowledge gathered from those journeys mankind also left the trails of their visits that ultimately led them to us.

Play as simulated subject [G]..

Little droid called Trace is a small but powerful companion so you are not completely alone on this journey.

"The only thing Avatar remembered was the sound of the ultra high-end stereo fields and undiscovered songs in the back of his mind!"

Indulge in this fast paced action shooter with puzzle elements..

You need unleast two Octium crystals to pass the portal..

Fly, drive, upgrade your weapons, upgrade your droid companion and unlock multiple endings..

data.name: The Lost Crown
data.detailed_description:
Unravel an ancient mystery and search for an ancient treasure on England's fog-shrouded coastline, famed for its legends of smugglers, pirates and ghosts. Join ghost-hunters Nigel Danvers and Lucy Reubans as they investigate a tale of horror and haunting. Wielding the tools of the modern-day ghost-hunter in a cinematic, richly detailed interactive world of wind-swept coastlines and crumbling crypts, you will be captivated, taunted and teased by mind-bending puzzles and interactions with the town 'locals'. But, be warned, there are those who will stop at nothing to prevent Nigel discovering "that which should stay hidden". With nerves of steel and wits to match, in your search for The Lost Crown you will soon discover long lost secrets previously known only to the dead!

Key features:

  • Spine-tingling ghost story.

  • Realistic ghost-hunting, featuring actual E.V.P. (Electronic Voice Phenomena).

  • Explore isolated, creepy locations with a nite-vision camera.

  • Photographs of unexplained entities captured by creator Jonathan Boakes while researching the game.

  • A Full cast of actors to bring the world of Saxton to life.

  • Chilling original soundtrack.

  • Point and click gameplay with both first and third person interaction.

  • Realistic and integrated puzzles.

  • A stunning 30+ hours of gameplay.

data.name: Raysing!
data.detailed_description:
Raysing! is an open world racing game where you choose where your tires tread. Alone or with friends, race for the best time, collect bolts, and unlock new paint jobs. Explore the island of Caradise and go crazy in Raysing!

EXPLORE CARADISE

Explore all the nooks and crannies of Caradise and reveal your true purpose. From the sandy beaches to the highest snow-capped mountain, leave no road undriven.

RACING IN RAYSING!

Participate in a variety of races and events to see who tops the leaderboard! Earn the best times on races and the highest scores in other exciting gamemodes!

CAR-LLECT-A-THON!

Collect nuts and bolts hidden in every corner of Caradise to spend on upgrades, cosmetics, and other abilities.

A TIRE FOR EVERY OCCASION

Traversal across the island is a breeze with special tires to race across any terrain - even water!

DRIVE YOUR WAY

Customize your car to suit your taste! Choose from different paint jobs, decals, and accessories to make the car match the driver. Unlock new cosmetics as you explore more of the world.

data.name: Wordforge: Silent Letters
data.detailed_description:
Wordforge: Silent Letters is a dungeon-crawling word roguelite and strategy puzzle game where every word you place reveals new rooms, enemies, and hidden rewards.

Explore handcrafted dungeon floors in a turn-based dungeon crawler filled with randomized encounters. Battle creatures lurking within the grid and awaken rare Silent Letters that can change the course of a run. Every submission pushes you deeper into the dungeon, forcing you to balance health, positioning, and risk.

Wordforge introduces the first word crawler — a dungeon roguelite where every word you place pushes you deeper into danger.

Each descent is a self-contained run. If you fall, you return to town to prepare for the next expedition — stronger and wiser than before.

Features

Awaken Silent Letters
Discover glowing Silent Letters hidden throughout the dungeon. Use matching letters to awaken them for immediate health and score bonuses.

Run-Based Progression
Death ends the current descent and returns you to town. Permanent upgrades carry over between runs — collect hearts to increase starting health, gather pouches to expand inventory, and recover rare books to unlock deeper floors.

Restore the Town
Supplies recovered from the dungeon strengthen Rivermoor and raise the town’s standing, helping support future expeditions.

Descend Deeper, Face Greater Risk
Each level grows larger and more dangerous. Battle enemies revealed within the grid and decide when to descend — or keep exploring for greater rewards.

Endurance Dungeon
Unlock a special dungeon where the descent never ends and danger escalates the deeper you go.

data.name: Pizza Kidd
data.detailed_description:
🔥 Pizza Kidd is now crowdfunding on Kickstarter!
Help us finish the full game and bring the Pizza Kidd universe to life... here on STEAM (Early Access)!

👉 Back the project — June 11th, 2026!

In a world on the brink of destruction, one unlikely hero steps forward. KIDD, a young martial artist as swift with punches and kicks as he is with delivering your pizza, is humanity’s last hope. Pizza Kidd pulses with the spirit and edginess of 90's anime and the grit of classic arcade brawlers of the same era, blending beautifully detailed 16-bit pixel art with fast-paced, responsive combat. This isn’t just another "indie" game—it’s an electrifying homage to a golden era, crafted with love and modern flair to keep things feeling fresh yet familiar.


Santos, the sinister architect behind the city's destruction, now commands an army of nightmares: creepy creature clones, zombified scarecrow ninjas that strike without warning, drone bots that patrol the gates, and towering monstrous behemoths that crush everything in their path. The streets are crawling with terror, but KIDD’s mission is clear—recover the 8 sacred seed stones, harness their power, and put an end to Santos' reign of madness.




Unleash the Action

• High-Impact Combat: Fast, responsive attacks, air juggling, and long chain combos for intense expressive gameplay.

• Side-Scrolling Adventure: Expansive 2D levels with skill-based, fighting-style special moves.

Retro Pixel Brilliance

• Vivid 16-Bit Art: Hand-drawn / animated, comic noir pixel art with detailed stages, big character sprites, and explosive effects.

Sound that Hits Hard

• Crunchy Arcade Sound Design: Satisfying hits with every punch and kick!

• Energized Soundtrack: Original music that amplifies the energy and action — with original compositions by Kevin Ripley, Martin Lande, Yanni Ziangos, Silent Sphere, Dj Spinna, Byron the Aquarius, Rashad "Tumblin' Dice" Smith, Lisa Bella Donna, and other guests musicians.

#PIZZAKIDD


*Please note: The Pizza Kidd Steam demo is still in active development.

data.name: (para)Normal Commute
data.detailed_description:
In (para)Normal Commute, you get thrown into the first person of your average office worker, simply trying to make your way home using any means necessary. Things turn sour when you arrive at London's Elephant & Castle subway station and fancy taking a cat nap while waiting for your connection train...

After awakening, all the lights are out. You are left with nothing but your thoughts, trusty phone torch, and complete darkness... or so it seems. If the eerie darkness doesn't get you, something or someone sure will! Run for your life, through various station tunnels and modes of transport, solving puzzles and finding secrets to make your way home safely without being bitten, bruised, or well, to put it lightly... dead. You will be challenged.

The controls are simple enough to anyone who has played a FPS game before, use W, S, A, and D keys for movement and mouse for looking and interacting with in-game and user interface elements, a full list of controls can be found in the settings menu after launching the game.

Happy commuting! ;)

data.name: Pixel Ripped 1989
data.detailed_description: Pixel Ripped 1989 is a wacky multi-dimensional homage to the early days of gaming. The player embarks on a journey into the screen of a classic videogame and beyond. Set in the era of portable 8-bit consoles, this game-within- a-game follows the adventures of Dot, an in-game character who sees her world torn apart by the Cyblin Lord, a villain able to break through the video game screen and invade the real world. In the game, the player inhabits Nicola, a second-grade student who must help Dot save both realities from this menace by facing challenges in the retrogaming 2D world, all while distracting the cranky teacher and escaping from the furious headmaster in her own 3D world.

data.name: LOVE COMPANY: A Romance Escape
data.detailed_description:
Love leaves clues.

LOVE COMPANY is a first-person escape-room adventure about love. Play as Manager Kim, an employee of a company that delivers feelings of love. Search for clues and solve puzzles to complete your assignment.

Your assignment begins at a university club in the summer of 2006. Find out who a student has feelings for, then help deliver his love. But matters of the heart do not always go as planned.

Find clues in everyday objects

Photos taken together, text messages, and notes left on a desk. Pick up and inspect objects around you, then connect the clues to work out who he likes.

Discover feelings left unspoken

Objects hold emotional traces: feelings left behind from moments in the past. Follow them to discover what the written clues cannot tell you and learn how the characters are connected.

Use what you find to move forward

Find the tools you need, unlock mechanisms, and solve codes. Inspect and interact with objects to solve puzzles and uncover new places and parts of the story.

A very unusual line of work

Explore a university club room, a music room, and the Love Factory, where feelings are handled by curious machines. Finding the right person is only part of the job.

data.name: Cellular Harvest
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated

Recently updated with new quality-of-life features!

  • 15 Steam Achivements
  • Export your in-game photos to your computer
  • Updated save game system
  • Select GREEN or PURPLE Edition when starting a new game


About the Game

At the edge of explored space, your camera will decide the fate of a world.

Cellular Harvest is a shortform first-person photography exploration game. You are an Auditor. An AI embedded in your suit evaluates the value of every being you encounter for the corporate interests that direct humanity's journey into a wider universe.

Track alien creatures. Catalog their existence with your camera. Follow orders. And enjoy an alien planet - while it's still intact.

This package contains both Cellular Harvest GREEN and Cellular Harvest PURPLE as a single game. You can select your edition from the main menu.

DEVELOPED BY: Nate Berens / @ludodrome

WRITTEN BY: Xalavier Nelson Jr. / @WritNelson

data.name: PANDARA
data.detailed_description:
An exceedingly simple 2D scrolling shooter.
Press Z to shoot. Press X to change speed.
Defeat enemies to gain experience and power up.
If you make mistakes, your defense will improve.

>BILINGUAL
Japanese and English story.

>GAMEPAD
Some gamepads can be used, but they are not fully supported.
Xinput (Z key: A button, X key: B button)
Sometimes the movement is set to 4-way input. Please select joystick movement in the controller settings.

>SYNOPSIS
What went wrong?
When the box opened,
all color drained out of the world.
This greyness blankets everything,
and the emperor brings judgment
upon all from the unreachable sky.
Anything that has the potential
to threaten the peace is removed soundlessly.
The animals have always known only black and white,
and they have chosen to fight.
They fight to destroy the woman who opened the box...
Wiseman 31 Cleare.

* Cat bazooka character design *
Emilia kuzyou

data.name: Citrus & Stone
data.detailed_description:
Citrus & Stone is a cozy pixel-art base builder for one player, two players online, or two on one screen. A grapefruit and a cherry wash up on a fully dynamic island with a wrecked boat and a broken campfire. By day you gather, build and hire help. At six every evening mushrooms pour out of the Rotten Bushes to put that fire out.

                                                                                      

Build by day, hold by night

Chop trees, break rocks, cook recipes, fish, smelt iron, and work your way up from a makeshift axe to walls, gates and archer towers. Upgrade the campfire to unlock new recipes.

The mushrooms bring friends. If they put out the campfire, the run is over. Prepare strategically during the day to survive the many boss encounters.

                                                                                      

A camp that mostly runs itself

Survivors are camped around the island. Pay them to join, then give each one a job.

Brew a round

Grow wheat, brew it into beer in a keg and serve it at the Bar Tab. The little green guys love it and may be motivated to work harder.

Better with two

Tony Grapefruit is a citrus. Sherry is a cherry, which is a stone fruit. Play them together in split-screen couch co-op: two players, one screen, separate inventories. Player 2 picks up a controller and joins at any time. One of you fishes while the other rebuilds the wall.

                                                                                    

Fix the boat

Five shrines are hidden in the forest, and each one asks for its own offerings. Complete all offerings and she's ready to sail.

The rest of the island

  • Catch fish from the beach and from your rowboat.

  • Cook a plethora of recipes, from Guava Chiffon Cake to Sea Serpent Sashimi Boat.

  • Grow wheat and different fruit, from bananas to dragon fruit.

  • Build a rowboat to explore the sea!

Features

  • Couch co-op: two players, split screen, separate inventories; Player 2 joins at any time

  • Online co-op: sherry can join from online

  • Day and night: build by day, defend by night, many bosses to fight

  • Your own camp: hire survivors into jobs, level them up and upgrade their gear

  • Island life: fishing, cooking, farming, brewing, pets and traders

  • Controller support: keyboard and mouse or controller

  • Soundtrack: built around acoustic guitar played by Oort

  • Steam achievements

data.name: Men of War: Red Tide
data.detailed_description:
Men of War II Available Now


About the Game

Experience the war where land meets sea.

Men of War: Red Tide combines the tactical depth of real-time strategy with the raw intensity of direct third-person combat. Developed in collaboration with a writer and concept author Alexander Zorich, this standalone expansion tells the story of the Black Coats – Soviet Naval Infantry, an elite force renowned for their ruthless precision during the Black Sea campaigns of World War II.

Lead your troops through 23 missions that recreate the fiercest battles along the Eastern Front – from Odessa and Sevastopol to Nikolaev and Constanta. Coordinate amphibious assaults, capture enemy fortifications, and command armored trains, naval fleets, and aircraft as the chaos of war unfolds around you.

Men of War: Red Tide delivers an authentic atmosphere, challenging missions, and the perfect blend of large-scale tactics and personal control. Its campaign offers both variety and historical depth, creating a mix of sweeping operations and tense, close-quarters heroism that defines the Men of War experience.

Key Features:

  • Extensive single-player story-driven campaign – over 20 handcrafted missions covering six major historical operations between 1941 and 1945.

  • Four playable factions – command Soviet, German, Romanian, and Italian forces across diverse battlefields.

Men of War: Red Tide combines the tactical depth of real-time strategy with the raw intensity of direct third-person combat. Developed in collaboration with a writer and concept author Alexander Zorich, this standalone expansion tells the story of the Black Coats – Soviet Naval Infantry, an elite force renowned for their ruthless precision during the Black Sea campaigns of World War II.

Lead your troops through 23 missions that recreate the fiercest battles along the Eastern Front – from Odessa and Sevastopol to Nikolaev and Constanta. Coordinate amphibious assaults, capture enemy fortifications, and command armored trains, naval fleets, and aircraft as the chaos of war unfolds around you.

Men of War: Red Tide delivers an authentic atmosphere, challenging missions, and the perfect blend of large-scale tactics and personal control. Its campaign offers both variety and historical depth, creating a mix of sweeping operations and tense, close-quarters heroism that defines the Men of War experience.

Description:

Immerse yourself in the spellbinding chaos of "MagFighter," a top-down multiplayer brawler where mages collide in a spectacular array of magical mayhem! With over 50 spells at your fingertips, every skirmish promises a unique and thrilling experience.

Spell Variety Extravaganza: Choose from a staggering arsenal of 50+ spells, each offering a distinct magical flair. Whether unleashing fiery infernos, summoning tempests, or manipulating gravity, the possibilities are endless.

data.name: Sakura Gym Girls
data.detailed_description:
Kitagawa Shouhei is a young man who lives in a quiet town, where he runs his deceased grandfather’s bookshop. His life is an ordinary one, but he’s content with it, even if he hasn’t had a girlfriend in years.

Shouhei is happy enough to while away his days among stacks of old, dusty books, while chatting with his favorite (and only) colleague, the sweet-natured and mild-mannered Asa…

But his luck with women takes a sudden turn for the better when Asa asks him to go to the local gym with her, to help her shed some extra weight.

While at the gym, Shouhei runs into two very different women: the haughty and aloof Tsumiki, and the cheerful, energetic Ranko, with whom Shouhei shares a complicated past.

Join Shouhei as he helps Asa with her fitness regimen, all while trying to win over the icy Tsumiki and processing his feelings for Ranko.

Whether Shouhei will end up with Asa, Tsumiki, or Ranko (or all three of them) is up to you in this visual novel.

Characters:

Asa works at Shouhei’s bookshop as his most trusted (and, indeed, only) employee. She’s a quiet girl with low self-confidence, but her gentle smile ensures she always leaves her customers feeling satisfied.

Asa is very short, which is something she’s horribly embarrassed about. She tries to counteract this by wearing heels, though she can’t help but envy popular idols and models for being so tall and willowy.

She’s liked Shouhei for a long time, but she’s too shy to act on her feelings.


Ranko used to be Shouhei’s girlfriend, back when the both of them were in university. They’ve since broken up, however, and Shouhei didn’t imagine he would ever see her again – that is, until he sees her at his local gym.

Ranko is a cheerful, upbeat girl who doesn’t sweat the small stuff. She’s always smiling, laughing, and cracking jokes, which makes her fun to hang around with – though it can be hard to tell whether she’s being serious or not.


Tsumiki is an aloof, haughty girl who acts like an aristocrat. She takes against Shouhei after their first meeting, and she’s aggressively rude towards him.

Tsumiki might seem unapproachable, but she does have a sweet side. She’s a huge fan of romance novels, though she’s never been in a relationship before herself. She dreams about being swept off her feet one day by a handsome prince, and having her own happily ever after ending…

But that’ll never happen, right?

data.name: The Legend of Legendaria: Where Legends are Born
data.detailed_description:
An eighties fantasy film you get to play

Four hundred years ago a star fell on Legendaria and broke the sky. Those who rule now take a tithe from every village in its name. In the hill town of Thistledown, three ordinary people say no.

The Legend of Legendaria is a single-player tactics RPG on a hex grid, built in full 3D. Its main story runs forty to fifty hours across three paths and six endings, and the choices that send you down each path are yours.

Hex tactics where death sticks

  • Turn-based battles on hex boards, where flanking, high ground and timing all count.
  • Permadeath. A hero who falls stays fallen, and the story carries on without them.
  • Spirit Stones bind abilities to your heroes, so you build each fighter your own way.
  • Auto-Combat, one key away, for the fights you would rather watch than play.

Forty heroes, one long road

Recruit up to forty characters across the journey: farmers, sell-swords, scholars, outcasts. Each one has a story of their own and a place in yours.

Dragons, the arena and the open sea

  • Tame dragons, breed them and race them.
  • Fight your way up the ranks of the Carrowgate arena.
  • Take ship and sail the globe map.
  • Go down into procedural underkeeps and the shifting Wandermaze.
  • Fish the quiet waters between battles, then go after the superbosses that wait at the edges of the world.

Villains worth the trip

Warlord Hask the Iron Reeve. The Pale Choir. King Othric the Golden. Each of them stands between you and the truth about the star that broke the sky.
