data.name: Starets
data.detailed_description:
Summer of 1319. Starets Nikodim begins his journey from Tver, where he served as a princely scribe for 20 years.

Ahead lies a long road to the Monastery of Saint Nicholas, standing on the Zhabna.

The path will wind through many landscapes of Rus of that time — fields, forests, swamps, crossroads, villages, rivers, groves, and so on.

Along the way to the monastery, the starets can keep records of the people he meets. The number of pages is limited, and the book will represent the path he has walked — how exactly he walked it, whom he met along the road, whom he chose to record.

Nikodim is no longer young. At the start of the story he is around 50 years old. A scribe's sedentary life, forever bent arms, not the hardiest legs, shortness of breath — all of this will make itself felt on the road.

The events take place in Rus in 1319, in the lands of the Principality of Tver. War, robbers, refugees, devastation, burned villages — all of this is reflected along the road to the monastery.

On the path you will encounter many different events, the consequences of which depend on your choice: to speak or to pass by, to record or to forget a person, to turn off the path or to walk straight, to help or to refuse.

data.name: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
data.detailed_description:
A fun, laid-back game

No one will rush you, or watch your every step, or criticize your actions. You can meditatively sift through garbage looking for interesting things... or just run around with a trash bag! Your dump site, your rules!

Find 'em all!

There are dozens of unique cards with hand-drawn illustrations by the world's best artists!* Collect sets of different colors to earn rewards. If you're lucky, you'll find an unopened cereal box with a super-rare foil card inside!

------

*According to the artists themselves

Mend and swap cards!

A dump site is not a good place to store cards. Often, you'll be find cards that are crumpled, damaged... or torn into pieces even. Don't worry; you can mend them or swap them for better ones! The better the card's condition, the more expensive it is!

Hidden treasures

In addition to collectible cards, you can find lots of interesting things at the dump site that were thrown away by mistake or by accident. The site owner will pay you well for each such find!

Garbage makes you better

Upgrade yourself to become better, faster, stronger, and more efficient at clearing tons of garbage. Turn yourself into a veritable trash-mowing machine!

data.name: The Last DeadEnd
data.detailed_description:
The Last DeadEnd is an adventure game with the elements of FPS and horror.

Plot


In this game, we play the role of young scientist Farhad Novruzov, who returned to his homeland to help in filming a documentary movie for an international television channel. Here he faces strange events connected with the ancient religion of Zoroastrianism and the scientist has to find out the reason of these events.

Gameplay and game's world


The game takes place both from the first person and the third person. Most actions and active research take place in the first person view. The main action of the game takes place in Baku, Azerbaijan. It takes place in an actually existing inner city of Baku. This is the oldest district of the city with a thousand-year history, surrounded by a fortress wall, inside which along with the old streets, there are dozens of historical and archaeological sites.

The Last DeadEnd es un juego con elementos de aventura, disparos y terror. Hay una atmósfera misteriosa de una ciudad antigua real, donde el protagonista busca respuestas a sus preguntas y lucha contra las fuerzas del mal.

Features of the game


  • There are several regular enemies in the game, as well as strong enemies (bosses), that were inspired by local legends. In the fight against some of them, there is its own tactic of winning them.

  • The game has an extensive encyclopedia and the possibility of research. Articles in a vast encyclopedia, containing articles about historical objects, characters, symbols, etc., are added along the course of the game. In the game there are various items that can be selected, viewed from all sides, learn information about them. With the help of technological glasses, which the main character has, you can read and decipher the inscriptions in the ancient languages that are on the walls of the old city.

  • Some of the locations are built one-to-one with real city and historical buildings, the game has many objects that reflect the national flavor of the old city.

  • Most of the game takes place in unusual locations for the genre - a flooded fortress, an ancient palace, ancient ruins, etc. This is one of the rare games in the genre, with elements of horror, where action takes place in a real city, enveloped in a mystical atmosphere.

  • Survival mode. Special mode where you can fight with different enemies in various maps. There are three types of survival: try to hold out "waves" of enemies, kill all enemies in a certain time and finally, to last as long as possible, remaining alive.

data.name: ORION
data.detailed_description:
ORION is a real-time 4X grand strategy game. A young civilization begins on its homeworld, and it falls to you to lead it outward into a procedurally generated galaxy holding both wonders and dangers. To build an empire you have exploration, politics, diplomacy and war at your disposal; should the galaxy itself turn against you, those same tools must keep it standing. Whether you play alone or with others, the game is playable from start to finish today—from the first survey ship to the end-game crisis.

EXPLORE AND EXPAND
Multiple galaxy shape types like Spiral(2,4,6 arms) ring, ellipse or a simple circle.
Across nine planet types, you can explore single, binary and trinary star systems along with neutron stars. Chart hyperlanes, survey systems and investigate anomalies.Worlds rich in energy, minerals and rare resources like Dark Matter and Xenon are yours to claim. Push your borders as far as you can hold them by founding colonies and terraforming worlds.

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE
Develop planetary districts and buildings to keep your people housed, fed, employed and content. Sectors can group colonies together, and an appointed governor runs each one. Operate freighters and trade routes, and trade on internal and galactic markets. A strong economy keeps your shipyards busy and your wars going.

SHAPE YOUR SOCIETY
Choose from different governments,  faiths and ethics as you set policies and doctrines. Rulers carry traits, grow older and die, so plan for succession and contested heirs. In elections, candidates make promises they are expected to keep. When your society outgrows its government, push through reforms, and launch empire-wide campaigns. If running every detail doesn’t appeal to you, hand day-to-day politics to automation,the last word always remains yours.

DIPLOMACY AND INTRIGUE
One civilization’s values, opinions and ambitions differ from the next. Goods, systems and even fleets can be traded. Sign open borders, non-aggression and defensive pacts. Found federations with their own charters and projects, or take subjects as vassals, tributaries, scholariums or bulwarks. Rally coalitions, mark claims on the map, and share or withhold intelligence. Negotiate peace terms down to the last payment, and plant spy networks in rival territory.

SHIPS AND WAR
Physics, Society and Engineering hold nearly 400 technologies to research. From weapons, shields, armor, reactors, drives and stealth systems, design your warships; build fleets from templates and refit them as your technology improves. Fortify key systems with starbases, defense stations and minefields. In the operations planner, plan multi-fleet campaigns, bombard enemy worlds from orbit and invade them with ground armies. Firepower matters, yet objectives, occupation and war exhaustion win wars just as much.
Planetary guns arm your worlds! The first tiers shoot down raiders in their own system. Later tiers strike enemy colonies several jumps away, and the most terrible will collapse a star into a black hole or fold a whole system out of space!
Each shot needs a long charge, giving your enemies time to stop it, and the whole galaxy will remember what you did.

CRISES AND WONDERS
Megastructures such as a Habitat Ring, a Stellar Shroud around a star or a Grand Observatory are yours to build(or take it from another empire) .Stop outbreaks before they spread across your worlds. In the late game you must face one or all of eight galactic crises, among them the Glass Plague, the Rogue Foundries, the Devourer Migration and the Dimming.
ps: you will get a warning :).

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose one of 50 premade empires, or design your own species, government and ships with ten different ship styles. Conquest, domination or score by science,economy or military power can bring victory, or you can simply survive the crisis.


MULTIPLAYER AND MODDING
Play with friends online through Steam or over LAN. ORION is built to be modded: all game content lives in readable data files, and from the in-game mod manager mods can be published to Steam Workshop.
There is a modding guide that needs some feedback on it so its easy to understand for everybody.

EARLY ACCESS ROADMAP
ORION enters Early Access in December 2026. I expect the full release between Q4 2027 and Q2 2028. Shaped by the feedback the game will get, updates will follow this plan:
Early 2027:
New music and sound; performance work for very large galaxies and huge battles.
Deeper politics and warfare; more crises, events and megastructures.
Mid 2027 - Late 2027:
Work begins on procedural galaxy events (see the note below); balance and quality-of-life updates.
Mid 2028: 1.0 Release.


Procedural events: rather than fixed event chains, the galaxy builds its stories from smaller building blocks, so every playthrough stays interesting. The current hand-written events and anomalies keep working, and new fully written event chains can still be added, by me or by modders.

data.name: Hello Neighbor Alpha 1
data.detailed_description:
Hello Neighbor is a stealth horror game about sneaking into your neighbor's house to figure out what horrible secrets he's hiding in the basement. You play against an advanced AI that learns from your every move. Really enjoying climbing through that backyard window? Expect a bear trap there. Sneaking through the front door? There'll be cameras there soon. Trying to escape? The Neighbor will find a shortcut and catch you.

  • Suspenseful horror gameplay that focuses on sneaking around your neighbor's house
  • Constantly evolving experience where the Neighbor's AI counters your moves, and learns from what you do
  • Sandbox-style gameplay with plenty of environmental interaction and physics

data.name: Rockin' Hell
data.detailed_description:
Rockin' Hell is a rhythm-based Metroidvania where you play as Victoria Riot, a rising rock star who, just before playing at the biggest concert in her career, dies and wakes up at the gates of the underworld.

She must descend to the deepest depths of hell and defeat all the different threats to face Death and earn a second chance at life.

Experience an adventure full of action and nostalgia to the rhythm of rock.

Enjoy the soundtrack inspired by 2000s rock, subgenres such as emo, punk, nu metal and heavy metal, our main sound and aesthetic inspirations.

Prove that you were born to be a rockstar using your different instruments as weapons to fight for your life:

  • Bass Guitar: shoot powerful notes and deal damage from a distance using the different effects pedals that will give you different power and sound.

  • Guitar: perform heavy strikes at the rythm of the music fighting at close range.

  • Drum Sticks: strike the enemies with quick hits that will give you a better mobility.

  • Microphone: Take advantage of the cable's elasticity to hook enemies, swing across ceilings, and hit them all with the microphone.

All of them have sound effects that will complement the background music. The better you follow the rythm, the more powerful your attacks will be.

data.name: BrickWorks
data.detailed_description:
BrickWorks supports the Steam Workshop!

Steam workshop support is a planned feature of BrickWorks. Your creations can be uploaded with ease for the entire BrickWorks community to enjoy.


About the Game

BrickWorks is a game creation and modding platform, utilising Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a high-fidelity brick-built creative experience to a wide range of hardware. With BrickWorks, our goal is to create a platform for creating game experiences in the traditional brick-built style, with a heavy focus on custom content and the ability to make bespoke games, entirely from within the BrickWorks platform. As a player, what you can expect from the BrickWorks platform, is the ability to create experiences that other players will enjoy, and more importantly come back to consistently. Players will create using our custom 'NodeBlocks' visual scripting system, which will allow complex gameplay interactions and other scripted features to be developed. NodeBlocks will be an abstract scripting system that anybody can pick up quickly. Our system aims to provide an easy workflow to users, allowing them to form an understanding of the concepts of both programming, and game development, without spending too much time learning the often complicated and convoluted syntaxes of traditional programming languages. Games and experiences created within BrickWorks can be uploaded and shared to the Steam Workshop. We hope that the BrickWorks community will grow to become a group of players and developers who we can interact with and plan to maintain a Steam Community forum. On this forum, we aim to be very pro-active within the community, allowing our players to suggest ideas for the platform, or games we plan to create with it. We also would love community members to give feedback and submit bug reports to us. The goal of this project is to make a platform for everyone, whether they are playing on Windows, Linux, or Mac. We also aim to fully support game controllers, for playing and creating games on the platform, and as a result the full BrickWorks suite of tools, and all of the games created as a result, will support the Steam Deck and other handhelds.

data.name: Below, Rusted Gods
data.detailed_description:
Attention Operator,

You have been selected to oversee a critical mission. Our team of elite soldiers is set to descend into a newly discovered abyss, believed to lead to uncharted territories beneath the earth. Your role is to monitor the soldiers' progress, ensuring their safety and collecting data.


As they venture deeper, remain vigilant and provide guidance based on their transmissions. You will have access to a status monitor, a radar, a radio to scan various frequencies, and other equipment to assist in your mission.
Be aware that communication may become sporadic as they descend. Strange anomalies have already been detected, and the nature of the abyss remains unknown.

Prepare for the unexpected and maintain operational readiness at all times. Prepare to face the unimaginable.

End of message.

data.name: Packet Plague
data.detailed_description:
You are the virus. Turn a fragile malware process into a screen-clearing outbreak—solo or in online co-op.

Packet Plague is a neon bullet-heaven roguelite inside a hostile computer network.

Move, dodge, and collect XP while your payloads attack automatically. Draft

upgrades, combine weapons, and evolve your build as the security response escalates.

Build your outbreak

Experiment with 22 payload weapons: beams, orbitals, missiles, mines, summons, and

more. Pair weapons with passive upgrades to unlock evolutions and discover the

combinations that fit the way you move.

Survive the security response

Fight across six network sectors with different layouts and hazards. Face phased

bosses while keeping an escape route through the swarm. Fifteen minutes is a

milestone, not a finish line. Keep the run alive for as long as you can.

Breach together

Play solo or team up through Steam online co-op. Share XP and the run, but choose

your own upgrades and build your own arsenal. Coordinate before the breach;

players join in the lobby, not halfway through a run.

Come back stronger

Turn completed runs into permanent progression. Unlock eight malware characters,

invest in the Evolution Grid, and take on new loadouts and challenge protocols.

data.name: Cube Hero Odyssey
data.detailed_description:
JOIN our discord to be in on the development


About the Game

Cube Hero Odyssey is a hack-and-slash, monster slaying roguelite, where you play as a caped hero wielding his trusty anti-fragile blade.
Dive into combat with a myriad of creative build paths with skills and passive abilities!
Each playthrough promises a new experience as the world of Celestia is beautifully shown in colourful & stylish procedurally generated maps!

𝙈𝙀𝘾𝙃𝘼𝙉𝙄𝘾𝘼𝙇 𝙎𝙆𝙄𝙇𝙇 𝙈𝙀𝙀𝙏𝙎 𝙎𝙏𝙍𝘼𝙏𝙀𝙂𝙔

Standard roguelites may have combat that feels closer to bullet hell, where your abilities can wipe out entire waves of minor enemies.
In Cube Hero Odyssey, combat is slow and methodical; each enemy can present a challenge to overcome!
Master dodging, attack with precise timing, and make strategic use of your skills as even a single enemy could take you down!

➜ 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗖𝗘𝗗𝗨𝗥𝗔𝗟𝗟𝗬 𝗚𝗘𝗡𝗘𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗗

Each round features a uniquely designed environment, complete with varying hurdles and enemies lurking! From gentle greenery to fierce lava landscapes, explore to guarantee you claim all your loot!

➜ 𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗔𝗖𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗕𝗢𝗦𝗦𝗘𝗦

Every few rounds, go head-to-head against colossal beasts, and test your might! Be careful with these giants... Or you'll be defeated in the blink of an eye!

➜ 𝗖𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗩𝗘 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗕𝗔𝗧 𝗕𝗨𝗜𝗟𝗗𝗦

Experiment with diverse builds and unlock powerful skills, tailoring your caped hero to your gameplay style for various tactical advantages!
The game provides 3 types of modifications, called Mods: Skill Mods (active skills), Stat Mods (stat upgrades), and Effect Mods (passive effects) as well as a newly added feature called Bloodlines, where you choose from one of the many character archetypes to have a distinguished start with unique traits!

➜ 𝗥𝗢𝗚𝗨𝗘𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗘 𝗘𝗡𝗗𝗟𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗚𝗔𝗠𝗘𝗣𝗟𝗔𝗬

Dying is inevitable, and it'll put you back to round 1 where you can retry with your newly gained knowledge and practice. On top of that, you can craft a different build as you play to tackle your foes in a new way!

𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗾𝘂𝗲𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗖𝗨𝗕𝗘𝗦! 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗶𝘀 𝗬𝗢𝗨𝗥 𝗢𝗗𝗬𝗦𝗦𝗘𝗬!

Cube Hero Odyssey caters to everyone who enjoys mastering combat systems and evolving their approach through inventive gameplay strategies! The game offers a rich blend of challenging encounters and creative build paths, ideal for players looking for an engaging roguelite experience in a colourful, cute cube-like world.

Paraverse Studio is a team of three. And this is our first foray into the roguelite genre. We are actively working on the game regularly.
Join our to share your ideas or any thoughts, and contribute to the game's development. Or, just come to chat!

data.name: Warhounds
data.detailed_description:
Warhounds is a turn-based tactical & strategy game, inspired by XCOM and Jagged Alliance, about a mercenary squad with an old-school action movie vibe. Command an elite team of bold, stylish operators, wage a campaign in an alternate-future Africa, and decide the war’s outcome mission by mission.

Be the commander.

Calculate lines of fire and flank angle, break cover, and seize the high ground. Every turn is decided more by your planning and tactics, less - by RNG.

Hire fighters with personality.

Combine classes: Assault, Specialist, Sniper, Machine Gunner, and Grenadier. Pick the right gear for the job, treat and extract, and protect key operatives. Take calculated risks. High combat lethality makes every decision count.

Run the base between missions.

Recruit, upgrade, purchase equipment, and handle logistics, finances, medical supplies, and downtime. Choose allied factions, build relationships, gather intel, and execute covert ops. Your choices have consequences: your decisions determine your access to missions, gear, and allies.

Use the tools of tomorrow.

Deploy drones, combat scanners, smoke, and optical camo. Upgrade and improve your kit to win under any conditions.

Set your own pace.

Knock out a mission in 25-40 minutes, or settle in for a long session. Customize the challenge: go for a brutal tactical hell or a light, relaxing run.

What you’ll get:

  • No point-blank misses - flank + close distance = 100% hit chance.

  • Real ballistics, destructible cover, vertical gameplay, and cone overwatch.

  • Mercenaries with character and mission-focused loadouts without any busywork.

  • Base management, contracts, budgets, allies, and consequences for your actions.

Assemble your squad. Take the contract. Decide Africa’s future beyond 2035.

data.name: Trigger Range
data.detailed_description:
A fast-paced, competitive shooting range game where speed and precision are everything.

Race through compact, handcrafted levels, eliminate target dummies, and optimize every shot to achieve the perfect run. Every millisecond counts.

It's like Track Mania with guns.

This shooting range is used by best shooters from all over the world: Police, SWAT, tactical units, infantry, border guards, Navy SEALs, Delta Force, SAS, GROM, Rangers, security personnel, convoy operators, FBI agents, DEA agents, alien hunters, Wild West bounty hunters, mercenaries, gunslingers, cyberpunk operators, space marines and retired agent still in shape.

Who will you be?

Key Features

  • Fast, skill-based gameplay
    No RNG. Only your speed, aim and reflex matter in every run.

  • 5 handcrafted levels
    Each level features a unique weapon, pace, and playstyle, with its own dedicated leaderboard.

  • Speedrunning-focused design
    Optimize routes, minimize mistakes, and shave off milliseconds.

  • Instant reset flow
    Fail, retry, improve... no downtime.

  • Competitive leaderboards
    Climb the rankings and prove your mastery.

data.name: Pieces Left Behind
data.detailed_description:
A granddaughter. A lifetime of memories. A story woven through the objects left behind.

In Pieces Left Behind, you play as Meredith Carter, returning to her late grandmother’s home to sort through a lifetime of belongings.
Each item holds echoes of Margaret "Peggy" Carter’s life, shaped by war, love, hardship, and hope across generations.

This is a narrative-driven walking simulator without combat or puzzles. Instead, you engage with letters, journals, and keepsakes to uncover deeply personal stories from 1940 to 2025.

Pieces Left Behind offers a quiet and reflective journey about memory, loss, and the enduring ties that connect generations.
It is brought to life through immersive voice acting, atmospheric visuals, and historically inspired environments.

The game will launch on May 16, 2025.
Add it to your Wishlist and discover the memories left behind.

data.name: Shadow Warren
data.detailed_description:
Become a defenseless rabbit lost in a twisted, mysterious world. Journey through horrors, cryptic rituals, and ancient powers you may never truly understand. Every step is a struggle for survival; every shadow hides a new threat.

AWAKEN IN THE UNKNOWN

You regain consciousness in a misty realm, not knowing how you arrived. Your only guide is a whispering voice; all around you—uneasy silence and chilling dampness. But safety is fleeting: something is always hunting you here.

EXPLORE AND FIGHT TO SURVIVE

The world is full of strange locations—from spectral meadows and lakes to wastelands and nightmare forests. Seek a way to escape, perform mysterious rituals, hide in burrows, and try not to become part of someone else’s game.

Chthonic predators lurk around every corner. Each has its own danger: the bear tracks your scent, the fox stalks you in the dark, and the nightmare appears where you least expect. Be quieter than the grass and smarter than your fear if you hope to survive.

The voice that guides you through the night always whispers advice… but can you trust it? In this world, no one tells the whole truth, and not all forces want your freedom.

Experience a psychological horror filled with ancient mysteries, strange rituals, and endless loneliness. Will you become the key to someone else’s plans—or find your own way home?

data.name: Who is the hero of this Game
data.detailed_description:
Explore the world of days similar to each other, like "Groundhog Day", interact with objects, look for new ways and discover opportunities.

In this adventure game in the genre of walking simulator, there are no shootouts, jumping on platforms, fighting monsters, and saving the world. Or at least a princess. There is a daily rise at 6 am, morning coffee, and the way to the office by bus.
There is no cool protagonist that you want to be like. There's a protagonist here that you already look like.
And there is also an opportunity to go beyond the routine. The main thing is to use it, despite all attempts to keep you from it.

Answer the main question — who is the main character of your game?

data.detailed_description:
In a future where there is only capital and blood in the universe, where everything is run by money,
The capitalist corporations that control the galaxy have only the government in their sights to maintain stability,
At the dawn of the 3rd generation, it all begins with a struggle,
The universe is once again in turmoil, but...
The opponents rise and fall, everything is money,
And in this future, your choices do not determine the course of everything,
But if you choose, this society and this universe will give you something in return.

Game core and content
Pixelated real-time combat
Round-robin battles with large bodies and ships
(The combat system will be modified in the future based on player feedback)

A plot that has been revised and written several times,
The storyline is not simply a single storyline
Full storyline with 4 main characters and various events
A total of 10 chapters, each containing 1 main story and 2 or 3 subplots
More than 10 sets of cg's and cg's for each female character available
The female characters do not require you to go through a lot of trouble to get a good rating or complete special events,
Players and characters are mutually exclusive and trigger each other's events during the course.

data.name: FOG
data.detailed_description: FOG is a role-playing game centered on combat and character progression, with a clever integration of Minesweeper-style gameplay. Built-in mechanics such as Chain Fog Dispelling allow even newcomers unfamiliar with traditional Minesweeper rules to get started quickly. Players take on the roles of distinctive heroes, clearing layer upon layer of fog to challenge monsters corrupted by malevolent power. Combat uses a semi-real-time turn-based system, and players can flexibly use various items to support their battles. Defeating monsters grants resources that can be used to strengthen heroes and take on even tougher challenges. The game has no death penalty; instead, it offers death rewards—come and taste death for yourself!

data.name: Pummel Party
data.detailed_description:
Pummel Party is a 4-8 player online and local-multiplayer party game. Pummel friends or AI using a wide array of absurd items in the board mode and compete to destroy friendships in the entertaining collection of minigames.

ONLINE AND LOCAL MULTIPLAYER

Play how you want. Pummel Party allows 1 to 8 players to compete both online or locally on the same screen. Whether it's online, or in person, it's all the same friendship ruining fun.


BOARD MODE

There can only be one winner here, and you know it has to be you! Battle through hazardous terrain to acquire an arsenal of weapons and items and employ them however you can to make sure that you reign victorious over your friends.


ITEMS

It's all out war! Use an array of absurd weapons and objects to claw your way to victory. From the simple 'Punching Glove' to the ridiculous 'Remote Controlled Eggplant' the items in Pummel Party will lead to many funny and rage inducing moments. It's never been easier or more satisfying to crush your friends aspirations of winning!

MINIGAMES

From simple nostalgic fun to unique and evolutionary Pummel Party contains a wide array of exciting minigames. Knock your friends in to the abyss in 'Snowy Spin', dig three dimensionally in 'Sandy Search' to be the first to find the treasure and make sure you're not holding the bomb when it goes off in 'Explosive Exchange'.

MINIGAME MODE

Just want to jump in to the action? Pummel Party includes a minigame mode so that you can get straight to the games!

BOTS

Already destroyed all your friendships or just need to fill out your roster? Pummel Party includes full bot integration meaning you can still play or practice Pummel Party with any number of real players.

data.name: Attack of the Earthlings
data.detailed_description:
Attack of the Earthlings combines turn-based combat and stealth in a dark comedic single player campaign, where you the player, take control of the native alien race to defend your home world from the invading humans.


Galactoil, a comically dysfunctional energy corporation, are hell-bent on harvesting the known universe for energy and will drill anything in its incessant quest to line its pockets with profit. However, their latest foray into energy exploration on Planet X13, has placed them into a bit of a pickle. The Swarmers, the native insectoid species, have another idea - to eat all the workers!


You take control of the Swarmers, a highly aggressive insectoid species, who must convert human flesh into alien muscle, upgrade their units and even find the time to gatecrash a birthday party.

To put a stop to the invasion, the Swarmers must plan attacks carefully. Take control of unsuspecting workers, set traps, emerge from vents and hiding spots to take your human prey by surprise, and assault in groups to kill multiple enemies at once.


The more earthlings killed, the more corpses can be consumed and transformed into new units with specialized roles and unique abilities. The flesh of their own workers is the key ingredient to developing a successful alien insurgency against Galactoil.


Voice actor and Vine extraordinaire, SungWon Cho A.K.A ProZD (A Hat in Time, Paradigm)[/b], lends his brilliant voice to X13 mining operation Regional Manager Dennis Dickinham; a man both massively unqualified and massively overpaid. A gregarious fellow who finds joy in everything, be it catching a few rounds of golf with the boys or rerouting power from sickbay to the massage chairs in the boardroom, Dickinham's a delight to be around! Just never, NEVER utter the phrase "bad idea" in his presence.

The game also features an original soundtrack by composer Mikolai Stroinski (Vanishing of Ethan Carter, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, Blood & Wine).

data.name: Lichtspeer: Double Speer Edition
data.detailed_description:
LICHTSPEER is an action arcade lightspear-throwing simulator based in an Ancient Germanic Future. Get ready for a brutal, stylish and psychedelic adventure in the lands of techno-vikings and lasers. Co-op mode for 2 players included!

/Licht is Light/



The mighty Lichtgods need a champion to fight for their amusement - they chose YOU. Armed with the powerful Lichtspeer you must embark on a vicious one way journey.

With precision and skill dispatch Wurst Zombies, Penguin Vikings, Hipster Ice Giants, flying Pegahunds, treacherous Warlocks, Evil Spacedwarfs, Penguins in boats, interplanetary Space DJ’s, FISH and more!

Fight and die in many wunderbar locations such as: the Wildwoods of Wurstland, the Techno Piramids of Egyptonia or the faster than licht interplanetary Disco Express!

Earn favor of the Lichtgods in the form of LSD (Licht Standard Denomination) and expand your arsenal with mighty powers of Licht!

AIM. SHOOT. KILL. DIE. THE LICHTGODS DEMAND IT. This is LICHTSPEER.

--------------------------------------------

A ONE-OF-A-KIND MIX

Experience an über fantastisch mix of arcade action and lightspear-throwing simulation.

THUNDEROUS TEAMWORK

Fight for the glory, hand-in-hand with your four-legged friend in a local, 2 player co-op mode.

WUNDER BOSS BATTLES

Battle a diverse legion of gargantuan wunder bosses – exploit their weaknesses and smash them into pieces!

AN ANCIENT GERMANIC FUTURE IS HERE

Discover the lands of an ancient Germanic future and fight a horde of Biedermeier beasts from another dimension – Wurst Zombies, Evil Spacedwarfs, Skater Walruses, you name it.

SHOW OF YOUR LICHTMAISTER SKILLS

Decapitate your enemies with headshots, execute special attacks, and generate zuper massive combos to improve your score and impress your friends!

BOMBASTISCH SOUNDTRACK

Rave to a bombastisch space soundtrack by Marcin Sonnenberg, from electro space marches to the vibrating sounds of tecnocumbia.

RAGE QUIT AND NEW GAME+ MODES

Want more? Rise to the challenge and see if you’ve got what it takes to beat the cruel, nerve-racking Rage Quit and New Game+ modes.

data.name: Quicksant
data.detailed_description:
QUICKSANT

A retro ant colony sim where your ants think for themselves.

Your colony is waking up and the queen needs food. Place pheromone trails to direct your ants to dig, haul, and build. Each one autonomously follows the nearby scent trails, finding its way to work, food, or danger. Guide the colony organism to grow, expand, and conquer the dangers of the world.

And there are many dangers. The enemy anthill is quietly growing. Can you defeat their queen before they are too strong to fight back? Rain pours down into your tunnels and needs to be hauled back to the surface or contained safely underground. Ants get lost too far from the queen, but storing the queen's jelly along the way will keep them working far from home.

The world is fully destructible, and when you dig deep you need to haul that dirt and sand back to the surface so it doesn't block the tunnels. Direct your ants to build and harden soil on the surface to make room for more grass and the fruit it produces. Eventually the underground berries will run out, but if you plan carefully your colony will be ready.

Features

Guide thousands of ants through pheromone trails: forage, dig, haul, build, attack, and more

Shape the nest and the surface in a world where every grain of dirt moves, falls, and piles

Farm food on the surface and defend your tunnels from the rain

Outgrow and overrun a rival colony with its own instincts and its own plans

Coming next

Indoor levels with crumbs, cupboards, and things that step on you

Aphid herding and the sweet payoff for protecting them

Underground mushroom farming

Trees and termite colonies

The Underants, an evil ant species that attacks when you breach the depths

Human attacks when your colony gets too big or too obvious

From the developer of POUND SAND.

data.name: 101 Circuits
data.detailed_description:
101 Circuits is an electronics puzzle game about turning a set of components into a working circuit. Draw wires between terminals and watch the result on the oscilloscope. Each puzzle is solved when every output matches its target signal. Any valid circuit that produces the required signals is accepted.

Explore 101 circuit puzzles

Begin with simple connections and LEDs, then progress to capacitors, filters, transistors, amplifiers, and oscillators. Practice each new idea through several circuits before taking on the next challenge. Smooth a pulse, shape a waveform, or generate a repeating signal.

Learn as you build

The built-in Learn library explains component symbols, connections, and behavior through diagrams, formulas, and practical examples. Puzzle guides help you understand the concepts behind each challenge. Open a component's help or practice circuit directly from a puzzle. Build everything visually with the mouse and keyboard, with no programming required.

Experiment in Sandbox

Use the components you discover to create and save your own circuits. Change supply voltages, resistance, capacitance, and signal settings while watching the results. Pin frequently used values to the bottom control bar and adjust them with knobs or exact numeric entry. Add colored LEDs and see them light as current flows.

Inspect the signals

Choose the Blueprints or Dark theme, zoom into scope traces, and inspect voltage and current measurements. Undo and redo make it easy to try another connection, while saved puzzle progress lets you return to a circuit later.

data.name: Us or Them
data.detailed_description:
Us or Them is an asymmetrical horror extraction game for expeditions of up to 26 players. Raid cursed lands for resources and treasures before nightfall, reach the ship, and survive.

Most players begin each expedition as Explorers, but one player starts as a brutal Monster stalking the group from the shadows. When an Explorer dies, they change sides and return as a Lesser form of the Monster, turning former allies into new threats and making every death more dangerous for those left behind.

Work together, gather resources, and escape with your rewards!

WORK TOGETHER OR FALL APART

Explorers must rely on each other to search the environment, carry valuables, light the way with lanterns, and get their findings back to safety. Staying together improves your odds, but fear, greed, and panic can tear even the best expedition apart.

BECOME THE MONSTER

Hunt your friends as a relentless Monster. Use speed, ambush tactics, and pressure to isolate Explorers, break their formation, and turn their mistakes against them.

Every Explorer you kill returns as a Lesser Monster, creating a deadly chain reaction where the expedition becomes more dangerous with every casualty. Self preservation is key, but altruism will increase your odds of success.

BURNING DAYLIGHT

Each expedition changes as the sun rises or sets. Nightfall makes the world far more dangerous for Explorers trying to search, navigate, and escape.

Use lanterns, teamwork, and haste to survive the dark, or get the job done before the daylight is gone.

SURVIVE THE EXPEDITION

Monsters can watch from afar, ambush stragglers, and overwhelm isolated players. The more Explorers fall, the more Monsters are drawn to the madness.

Every expedition offers rewards, but only those who make it out alive get to keep what they found.

FEATURES

  • Up to 26-player asymmetrical PvP multiplayer horror

  • Explorer teamwork, looting, hauling, and extraction

  • Playable Monster role focused on hunting, ambushes, and pressure

  • Fallen Explorers return as Lesser Monsters

  • Escalating matches where every death makes survival harder

  • Day-to-night expedition pressure

data.name: Hamstr Protocol
data.detailed_description:
Hamstr Protocol is a first-person bio-mining simulator where you build, manage, and scale a mining operation powered by hamsters.

Start in a garage with a few rigs and a handful of runners. Assemble your hardware by hand, keep your hamsters fed, control the heat, and turn a small operation into an industrial-scale bio-mining business.

ASSEMBLE


Experience tactile, first-person interaction. Pick up, carry, and place every piece of hardware by hand. Every component matters in your quest for the ultimate mining setup.

SCALE


The more you scale, the harder it gets to keep everything under control. Manage heat, noise, and hunger as you expand from a small garage setup into a massive industrial operation.

LIQUIDATE


Money never sleeps. Use your in-game ATM to track market trends and trade your HAM for USD at the terminal. Reinvest your profits to break the system or save up for the next big upgrade.

CORE FEATURES

  • Hamster-powered rigs - Put your runners to work and pair hamster power with high-end hardware.

  • Hands-on building - Pick up, place, and manage your equipment directly in first person.

  • Thermal management - Heat can destroy your operation. Keep your rigs cool or pay the price.

  • Hamster management - Keep your runners fed and your operation moving.

  • Fully interactive PC - Manage key parts of your operation through a functional in-game computer.

  • Garage to industry - Start small and build toward an increasingly ridiculous industrial operation.

  • Something doesn't add up - But that's a problem for later.

  • Each time you die, you are sent to a hub with NPCs, and the hub changes according to each level.

  • Your choices in the text adventure can change the routes of the magic/skateboarding stages.

  • Multiple endings!

data.name: From The Night
data.detailed_description:
In this retro platformer, the goal is simple. Get to the exit door. Of course, it's never just that simple…

You begin the game trapped in prison.



First you must break out, which is a task in itself – but breaking out of prison is never easy, unless you're Stallone! But it's simple once you know how…



After that, you'll make your way into a complex network of levels which you must traverse.



The path from door to door becomes increasingly difficult.



Ingenious traps – each one designed to kill you – litter your pathway. Some you can simply jump over. Others you can crouch underneath. However, there are those where you'll need luck, skill and speed.



And two questions remain. Are you really free? Indeed, who's the one who's really trapped…?



Maybe you'll choose to stay a prisoner and escape faster and faster each time. Perhaps even death might be out of the quesiton…

data.name: Thank You For Your Application
data.detailed_description:
Thank You for Your Application is a work simulation game themed around job interviews. Players take on the role of an interviewer at the largest company in Aeropolis City, reviewing applicants’ resumes and documents according to strict and constantly changing hiring requirements, before making decisions that may alter the course of other people’s lives.

Throughout the game, players will encounter a wide range of applicants, absurd corporate systems, ever-changing policy demands, and the company’s dark secrets gradually coming to light. data.name: 無慈悲な笑顔Re
data.detailed_description:
A story where they all
　"wept," "laughed," "wove,"
　　"destroyed," "beckoned," "killed," and "created" together.

・・・―――・・・―――・・・―――・・・―――・・・―――・・・

■ STORY

An exploration-driven adventure game depicting the tragedies that unfold between girls chosen to stop the gods and the gods themselves. As you encounter a different god in each story, a cruel truth will gradually come to light.

See their stories through to the very end.

■ CHAPTER INTRODUCTIONS

▪ Chapter 1 — A Story of Someone Weeping

We have been offering up our lives to the goddess.

All to stop the everlasting rain.

▪ Chapter 2 — A Story of Someone Laughing

The ritual to move the seasons forward never succeeds.

Lady Dieanna, the goddess of death, kills the ritual children.

▪ Chapter 3 — A Story of Someone Weaving

One night, I heard someone’s voice.

Someone spoke to me.

How can that be? That voice is…

▪ Chapter 0 — A Story of Someone Destroying

Calamity raining down, villagers injured.

Ruins crumbling, a goddess wounded.

The goddess says:

“You reap what you sow.”

▪ Chapter 4 — A Story of Someone Beckoning

The rain has stopped, and the sky asks you without mercy:

Will you save your friends—or abandon them?

Now, choose.

▪ Chapter 5 — A Story of Someone Killing

You killed them.

As for the other stories...

Discover them for yourself.

・―――・―――・―――・―――・―――・―――・―――・

■ GAMEPLAY

  • The story unfolds as you explore the map and interact with characters and objects.

  • At times, you'll need to make a choice.

  • Your decisions and actions will shape how each story ends.

  • Some choices cannot be undone, so choose carefully.

    Everything is up to you.

■ IMPORTANT NOTES

  • •Some menus require mouse clicks to navigate. Using a mouse is recommended, but is not required for story progression.

  • This game contains depictions of death and blood, as well as dark themes.

  • Each chapter features multiple endings, with some exceptions.

  • Estimated playtime: 8+ hours.

data.name: Space Inflation
data.detailed_description:
Engage in a galactic struggle for economic survival!

Step into a universe where wealth is power and strategy decides who thrives and who falls. In this card-driven game, every decision matters. Will you build your fortune through careful planning, or tear down your rivals with ruthless sabotage? The galaxy rewards only the clever.

Strategic Card Play
Outsmart your opponents by managing your deck wisely. Each card you play can shift the balance of power, whether it undermines another player, or unlocks new opportunities. Timing and foresight are key, one well-played card can change the course of the game.

Mini-Games That Test Your Skill
It’s not just about strategy, it’s about proving yourself in unique mini-games. Sharpen your reflexes and logic as you battle through challenges that can earn you advantages.

Survival of the Wealthiest
The endgame is simple: only the last two players with credits left will claim victory. Every round brings new tension as inflation rises. Can you hold out while others crumble?

Features at a Glance

  • Multiplayer matches with friends and rivals.

  • Card-driven mechanics.

  • Mini-games.

  • A unique blend of economic survival and player interaction.

Do you have what it takes to survive the galaxy’s unforgiving economy? Gather your cards, outthink your enemies, and fight for your fortune!

data.name: MOM SAID DON'T OPEN
data.detailed_description:
Don't Open the Door for Anyone

Your parents left you home alone and won't be back until morning. Until then, you have the whole apartment to yourself. But it seems like everyone wants something from you tonight.

Friend or Foe?

Some are your neighbors, some simply knocked on the wrong door, and others claim to be your relatives. Don't take anyone's word for it, or it might be the last thing you ever do.

The First Rule

Not every stranger will leave when you say no. Some will try to force their way inside. First things first, call the police and give them your address! Be careful, or you might wake up not in your cozy bed, but in someone else's basement...

Gameplay

Your goal is to survive until morning. Choose who to let in and who to keep out. Search the apartment for clues that reveal your connection to the visitors. Solve puzzles, and remember — sooner or later, someone will try to get inside without an invitation!

If someone tries to break in, call the police and barricade the door. You need to hold out until they arrive!

Otherwise, your visitor will take you away with them...

data.name: Blink the Bulb
data.detailed_description:
THE STORY


Everything was once peaceful in the Jubilee Realm - a distant universe formed from individuals' fond memories of the holidays. Here, humanity's composite recollections were weaved into brilliant landscapes and simple, kindly beings. However, ages have passed and the thoughts that shaped the realm have been tainted by a dark force - people's spiteful memories of their special occasions. The Holidaemon, six ruthless beings born from this negative energy, have begun taking over the Jubilee Realm and threaten to infect all its inhabitants with their influence.

Thankfully, all is not lost. Blink the Bulb, a lone resident of Winter Land, has set off to defeat the Holidaemon before they conquer the entire world. Looking skyward, he vows to vanquish their evil and restore the inhabitants of the Jubilee Realm to their former selves.

THE GAME


Blink the Bulb is a 16-bit platform game styled after Genesis-era classics with added pseudo-random content for replayability. The game spans six holiday-themed worlds and features:

  • massive, open levels to explore
  • day/night cycles that occur between levels, altering enemy behaviors, minibosses, stage gimmicks, and obtainable items
  • 20 different "passive" items to collect, with percent chance or cooldown-based effects such as: spawning zombies, increasing invincibility frame duration, creating a protective barrier of thorns, and preventing fatal damage
  • 10 different "active" items that can be used at will, including a fire-spewing candle and a shooting star dash attack

data.name: Destiny of a Wizard
data.detailed_description:
THE STORY THUS FAR:

Since the dawn of time, the power of the Blue Wizards
has been known to all folk. Life was peaceful for many years until an evil being known as Darklin came into the realm of the Vale Islands

This was known as the "Darkest Hour".
Many perished...men...women...and children.
The battle between the powerful Blue Wizards and the
force known as Darklin waged on for many, many years. Until finally, the Wizards drove off Darklin and he was banished to another realm.

Even though he was defeated, he was not dead.

The Wizards sealed him away. The only way he could be brought back is by sacrificing a Wizard. By sacrificing a Wizard, their power could be used to release the powers of darkness.

This would break the seal that binds Darklin.
Knowing this knowledge, the Wizards decided to shut themselves away from everyone.

They decided to live in secret so that no force, good or evil, can know where the descendants of the Wizards lived.
Our story begins here, where the Wizards reside in peace and in secret....

FEATURES OF THE GAME:
* A linear turned based RPG spanning over five chapters.

* Old school style retro fast pace combat.

* Comedy references full of derpness including "4th wall" ones!

* Over 50 various monsters to do battle with!

* Experience voice overs from over six different characters that bring the game to life!

* Extra features including bloopers and commentary bonuses!

* Unlock magical spells as you seek out the four elemental crystals of the Vale Islands.

* A special hidden sixth chapter which includes several features not from the main adventure!

data.name: StarFringe: Adversus
data.detailed_description:
This is the story about the beginning of the conquest of outer space by earthlings. It began as a global idea of saving mankind from hunger and lack of resources, and ended as a brutal and merciless war in space far from Earth. The target was a group of planetary systems in the constellation Draco, and what was found there changed everything ...

The game is not a classic real-time strategy (RTS) - we changed the basic principles of resource harvesting, units control and implemented a number of interesting ideas(unusual for RTS). We expect that this will give players a new gaming experience and bring a lot of fun.

The main goal of the player - the organization of an effective system of extraction and processing of resources to get the maximum benefits in the construction and research, capture control points on the map and the complete destruction of the enemy. Style of gameplay can be different, depending on the conditions of victory.

The game has a built-in wiki, which will be expanded with the development of the project and will help players to understand the intricacies of the gameplay.

data.name: Maieutic
data.detailed_description:
Maieutic is a roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are philosophers — and they argue back.

Build hands from real thinkers and let intellectual history do the scoring. Cards from the same school reinforce each other. Lineages fire across centuries — Aristotle's inheritance running through Scholasticism, Empiricism handing itself to Pragmatism. Play opposites and your multiplier collapses, because when contradicting ideas shout at once, none of them is heard.

  • 272 real philosophers, each with a school, an era, fields, tags and a passive that belongs to no one else

  • 97 schools, 41 fields, 31 tags and 15 eras feeding into one synergy system

  • Genuine contradictions that punish incoherent hands — not arbitrary card colors

  • Philosophers who knew each other speak on the table: teachers recognize students, rivals interrupt

Between rounds you choose where to go: the Agora to trade for what you're missing, a school's faculty to recruit from its lineage, or a dilemma that pays well and costs something you can't take back.

  • 88 relics that bend the rules of your run

  • 30 consumables for reshaping a deck mid-fight

  • Routes, events and dilemmas that send every run somewhere the last one didn't go

  • Six-chapter Story Mode through philosophy's own history, each ending against what that era actually feared: Censorship, Silence, the Inquisition, the Leviathan

Runs end. Your school doesn't. Hire philosophers as faculty and watch them level up across runs, commit your academy to a doctrine, and grow it from a room with one teacher into an institution with a reputation. Plato founded the Academy. Aristotle left and founded his own. Now it's your turn.

  • Recruit philosophers as permanent faculty who gain levels, mentors and rivals between runs

  • 24 doctrines to commit your school to — each one changes what your academy is good at

  • 5 academy paths, 9 rites and a faculty council as your reputation grows

  • Fame, Prestige, an Honor Tree and weekly objectives that persist long after a run is over

The game asks you things. Is freedom real, or a story we tell about necessity? Does knowledge come from experience, or from reason? You answer — and separately, the Ledger records the hands you actually played. At the end of a run it puts both columns side by side, and your dominant philosophy reshapes the world into one of 20 different endings. Most players find out they argued for one philosophy and played another. It doesn't punish you. It just shows you.

  • A run-end Ledger measuring what you claimed against what you did, across three axes

  • 20 world-state endings decided by the philosophy you actually played

  • 548 real works and full biographies, unlocked as you play

  • A codex of schools, eras and combinations, plus a gallery of curios

  • Daily runs and endless mode.

You can play this game for the score.

People also play it to find out what Diogenes said.
data.about_the_game:
Maieutic is a roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are philosophers — and they argue back.

Build hands from real thinkers and let intellectual history do the scoring. Cards from the same school reinforce each other. Lineages fire across centuries — Aristotle's inheritance running through Scholasticism, Empiricism handing itself to Pragmatism. Play opposites and your multiplier collapses, because when contradicting ideas shout at once, none of them is heard.

  • 272 real philosophers, each with a school, an era, fields, tags and a passive that belongs to no one else

  • 97 schools, 41 fields, 31 tags and 15 eras feeding into one synergy system

  • Genuine contradictions that punish incoherent hands — not arbitrary card colors

  • Philosophers who knew each other speak on the table: teachers recognize students, rivals interrupt

Between rounds you choose where to go: the Agora to trade for what you're missing, a school's faculty to recruit from its lineage, or a dilemma that pays well and costs something you can't take back.

  • 88 relics that bend the rules of your run

  • 30 consumables for reshaping a deck mid-fight

  • Routes, events and dilemmas that send every run somewhere the last one didn't go

  • Six-chapter Story Mode through philosophy's own history, each ending against what that era actually feared: Censorship, Silence, the Inquisition, the Leviathan

Runs end. Your school doesn't. Hire philosophers as faculty and watch them level up across runs, commit your academy to a doctrine, and grow it from a room with one teacher into an institution with a reputation. Plato founded the Academy. Aristotle left and founded his own. Now it's your turn.

  • Recruit philosophers as permanent faculty who gain levels, mentors and rivals between runs

  • 24 doctrines to commit your school to — each one changes what your academy is good at

  • 5 academy paths, 9 rites and a faculty council as your reputation grows

  • Fame, Prestige, an Honor Tree and weekly objectives that persist long after a run is over

The game asks you things. Is freedom real, or a story we tell about necessity? Does knowledge come from experience, or from reason? You answer — and separately, the Ledger records the hands you actually played. At the end of a run it puts both columns side by side, and your dominant philosophy reshapes the world into one of 20 different endings. Most players find out they argued for one philosophy and played another. It doesn't punish you. It just shows you.

  • A run-end Ledger measuring what you claimed against what you did, across three axes

  • 20 world-state endings decided by the philosophy you actually played

  • 548 real works and full biographies, unlocked as you play

  • A codex of schools, eras and combinations, plus a gallery of curios

  • Daily runs and endless mode.

You can play this game for the score.

People also play it to find out what Diogenes said.
data.short_description: Play philosophers as cards and turn each hand into an argument. Schools, eras and ideas amplify or contradict one another — and the game keeps a Ledger of what you claimed versus what you actually did. Build a doctrine. Then live with it.

data.name: Hup Hup The Cupcake
data.detailed_description:
Hup Hup and Away!

Life is sweet with Hup Hup the Cupcake! With no bills, no worries, and no end in sight, Hup Hup spends his days roaming the blissful sky, hopping across grassy lumps in a dreamlike journey above the clouds. Leap between towering platforms in search of the sacred Finish Dish. Set your own challenge as you play through batches of procedurally generated levels with a quantity and difficulty of your choosing. Treat yourself to peace of mind, knowing you can always try again if you fall, and there will always be a new level to play when you finish. Welcome to the world of Hup Hup, where fun is a piece of cake!

Have your Cake… and Cup it Too!

Choose your number of levels in increments of 10, all the way up to 1000!

Set your minimum and maximum difficulty, so you can enjoy a sweet and simple ride, a trek with rising action, or a constant chocolatey challenge!

Or, set the level count to 0 to play forever, with an infinite chain of levels of random difficulty within your chosen range!

If it Smells, Skip it!

Don’t like a level? Skip it in the pause menu to get a new one!

data.name: Tempus Triad
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis:

In a secret facility located deep within a remote island, scientists experiment with a rare substance capable of manipulating the boundaries of space and time: dark matter. The goal is to create revolutionary technological advancements, but the tests begin to produce anomalies, such as the appearance of prehistoric flora and the disappearance of objects, revealing the unpredictable dangers of time manipulation.

The team leader is a physicist who lost everything he loved when his wife and daughter died in a tragic accident. He sees time manipulation as an opportunity to correct the past and bring his family back. However, when he uses the technology for his own purposes, the experiment fails, and the temporal continuum ruptures, transporting him to a distorted world where time is unstable, and prehistoric predators roam freely.

Now, with the timeline on the brink of collapse, the scientist must face his choices and the monstrous creatures lurking around, while desperately seeking a way to restore the balance of the universe — and his own redemption.

Features:

  • Realistic and optimized graphics for full immersion.

  • First-person action for an engaging experience.

  • Discreet HUD to maintain total immersion.

  • Enemies with intelligent AI.

  • Microphone detection.

  • Jumpscares.

______________________________________________________________________

This game was developed by one person. If you wish to participate in the development or support the developer, you can find everything on Discord. Thank you!

data.detailed_description:
Tiny mortals VR puts you in the role of a god tasked with defending your people's castle. Defend against endless waves of enemies ranging, from tiny stick men to mighty ogres and fierce dragons! Key feature include:

  • Endless waves of increasing difficulty as well as custom waves including zombie swarms!
  • Collision physics allowing you to pick up and kill your enemies in whatever creative way you can think of, throw them at each other, pick them up by their feet and bash them on the ground, send them on a quick flight to the other side of the world the choice is yours!
  • Various weapons to slice, bash, launch, and dismember!
  • Assign your own people to repair your castle, worship you to allow stronger magic or defend your castle with a bow!
  • Unleash magic to kill enemies or convert them into mighty champions to help you repel the invasion!
  • Upgrade your castle and the surrounding area to make killing your enemies more fun or rewarding, as well as allow new abilities or options to make your enemies pay!

data.name: Blackthorne's Manor
data.detailed_description:
Blackthorne’s Manor is a first-person puzzle-horror experience that plunges you into the unsettling depths of a long-abandoned estate.

Your friend vanished after attending a party at the manor, and no one has seen them since. Armed with little more than your wits and a faintly glowing lantern, you step inside, not knowing what you'll find on the other side. Shadowed rooms, cryptic puzzles, and fragments of a dark history wait around every corner. The manor’s decaying halls and strange, unsettling details hint at the sinister events that took place here. Can you uncover the secrets of Blackthorne’s Manor, or will its mysteries remain locked forever?

RISING TENSION
Immerse yourself in the oppressive atmosphere of the manor, where every shadowed hallway and forgotten room hides a story. Interact with objects, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together the chilling history of Blackthorne’s family. Every discovery draws you deeper into the mystery, blending suspense and intrigue in a slow-burn horror experience.

ESCAPING THE UNKNOWN
Move through a semi-linear environment designed like a twisted escape room. Unlock doors, trigger mechanisms, and follow hidden clues to advance. Every puzzle solved reveals more of the manor’s story and brings you closer to finding your missing friend.

FEATURES

  • First-person exploration with environmental puzzle-solving.

  • Creepy, atmospheric manor with a story woven into every room.

  • Inventory-based interactions to manipulate the world and unlock new rooms.

  • Lore fragments and hidden notes that reveal the manor’s dark past.

  • Slow-burn suspense that escalates as you uncover the truth.

data.name: Bocage, a cozy puzzle game
data.detailed_description:
A bocage is a patchwork countryside made of small fields, hedgerows, animals, and the odd windmill. In this game, you build one, one piece at a time.

Pick a piece from the drawer, turn it, drop it on the board. Your meadow grows with every piece, at your own pace.

Cows need a fence. The windmill turns meadow into wheat. The bridge wants water underneath. Each puzzle is about keeping every rule happy at once.

From the green countryside to the Far West, sci-fi plains and snowy winters: 12 biomes, each with its own decorations to unlock. The weather turns from rain to snow to mist, and the light from golden hour to moonlit night.

Each world teaches something new, then mixes it all together.

Follow the path and open the chests along the way: they hold decorations to make the game your own.

Design a puzzle piece by piece, set its steps and test it. Then share it with a simple code.

data.name: The First Descendant
data.detailed_description:
PLAY FREE NOW


About the Game

The First Descendant is a free third-person cooperative action RPG shooter featuring high-quality graphics. Experience the fun of strategic boss fights through 4-player co-op and various unique characters, exciting gunplay, and looting. A variety of equipment is necessary for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses.

The player becomes a Descendant in the game and is given a mission to fight against the invaders for the survival of humans and to protect the ‘Ingris continent’. The player can experience a spectacular story by growing stronger through various missions and stories to finally discover the Descendants' secret. You can also feel the First Descendant’s unique atmosphere through high-quality fields developed with Unreal Engine 5 and gain a new experience of reality and SF fantasy coexisting in one place.

Charming and Unique Characters

You can play various characters with distinctive concepts and battle styles. We plan to add various customizable elements such as skins for each character to support character decoration.

Exciting Battles and Dynamic Action Using Various Skills and Firearms

Experience the First Descendant’s exciting battles composed of various characters with unique skill sets, free movements, and chain actions through Grappling Hooks, colorful firearms, and additional effects. With these, the player can create any battle style they desire.

Battles With Huge Boss Monsters Through Cooperative Play

You can target huge boss monsters with different appearances and abilities through 4 player co-op play. The various difficulties will stimulate your competitive spirit, and you can destroy or extract various parts of the huge bosses through 4-player cooperative play. By targeting the huge boss’s gimmicks, you will be able to experience a more compact team play.

Motivating Play and Growth

You can equip a character with 3 guns, 4 secondary accessories, and various sub-weapons. Of course, there will also be items to enhance a character or their firearm stats or add a new ability all together. A variety of equipment is a necessary element for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game, or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses. We provide equipment so you can develop the characters to play continuously through character growth and acquiring and combining the various equipment. Use it to challenge yourself with more difficult tasks and enjoy the thrill of clearing them.

data.name: Echoes of Seasons
data.detailed_description:
In order to restore the fertility of your town's land, play the role of Nikolos, a reckless young man who, with the blessing of the goddess Demeter, can change the seasons. Put your observation and logic skills to good use in this single-player 3D puzzle game!

Gather offerings from the various scenery so that Demeter can help you find your way, collect scrolls that hold mysterious secrets and find a way out of complex situations!

A variety of challenges await you, from pressure plates to pendulum swings, you'll need to solve multiple mechanisms to progress!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This game is the result of a final year project, now available on Steam! We hope you will enjoy it — have fun, and don't hesitate to share your feedback with us!

data.name: King Of Leberkas - Austria Restaurant Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to King Of Leberkas – Austria Restaurant Simulator! 

Run your own restaurant in Vienna and start with a true Austrian classic: the Leberkäse sandwich. Your restaurant itself won’t grow in size – but the number of customers definitely will!

Be careful though: your guests are not patient. They have the classic Viennese attitude – short temper, lots of complaints, and quick insults if you mess up.

🕹️ Gameplay

Easy to learn, hectic to master:

  • 👀 Take orders: Look at a customer to take their order

  • 🍳 Cook: Go to the correct machine and press E to prepare food

  • 📦 Serve: Pick it up with E and bring it to the customer

  • 🍽️ Payment: After eating, look at them again to receive money

  • 💰 Rewards: Earn cash and feedback

🔧 Upgrades & Progression

Instead of expanding your restaurant, you improve efficiency:

  • 🍺 Unlock new products (beer, coffee, schnitzel, toast)

  • ⏱️ increase customer waiting time

  • 👨‍🍳 Hire employees to assist and automate tasks

  • 📈 Attract more customers and increase income

The better you perform, the more customers arrive – and the more chaotic it gets!

German tourists will also visit and confuse things by ordering a “Fleischkäsebrötchen”… 😄

And if a customer becomes too annoying:
👉 Throw food at them!
Just be careful – it will make them even more aggressive!

Can you handle the pressure and turn your restaurant into Vienna’s most popular Leberkäse spot?

data.name: Hidden
data.detailed_description:
The game takes place in a big mansion divided in 4 biomes. Each biome has a different structure and has different traps to overcome, in order to continue the game.

HIDE EVERYWHERE IN THE ROLE OF A "HIDDEN":
Switch on the Reactors and press the buttons scattered all over the map.
Vanish from the Hunters with the help of the teleports.
Everything can be a hiding place, a wardrobe or a fountain or a barrel.
Each "Hidden" has a unique ability, so create your startegy to avoid the Hunters.

HUNT IN THE ROLE OF A HUNTER:
Seek and destroy all the "Hiddens".
Nothing can stop you. Do they hide? Demolish their hiding places.
They can run but they cannot escape.

PLAY ALONE...
Train in the single player mode by facing BOTS in matches with a different game logic than the multiplayer one.

...OR WITH OTHER PLAYERS
Choose your side in online matches from 2 to 10 players and play with friends by entering the same room.
Face them in the classic game mode, hide, hunt and team up to reach the victory.

data.name: Stories Adrift: Wake - Prologue
data.detailed_description:
A Message from the Development Team

We’ve seen that some players have already tried the game and left feedback. Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts. ❤

The current version is a concept demo, and you may encounter bugs or incomplete features. We are currently working on improvements and fixes for the next update. For now, we recommend waiting for a future version, which will offer a more polished and complete experience.

Thank you for your understanding.

Game

"Stories Adrift: Wake - Prologue" is a 2D point-and-click narrative-driven puzzle adventure game. 

As the new owner of a book boat, you are entrusted with returning a single page of a book and embarks on a journey through a world both mysterious and familiar.

By solving intricate puzzles and piecing together scattered clues, you uncover the truth of the world - and of yourself.

Features

100% hand-painted visuals delivering a deeply atmospheric experience

Narrative-driven puzzles where you investigate with a detective’s intuition

Original and multilayered worldbuilding inspired by diverse ancient cultures

A parabolic tale crafted in homage to Jorge Luis Borges

data.name: Rough Souls: Adventures
data.detailed_description:
🎒 Adventure Mode – Explore, Interact, Progress

In Adventure Mode, you freely roam a handcrafted world filled with interactive elements and hidden areas. You can:

  • Pick up, throw, and eat items

  • Jump and climb across the environment

  • Tame and ride animals like the Saiga Antelope

  • Navigate ships and reach new locations

  • Talk to NPCs to receive quests

Key locations include:

  • A quest-giving NPC near the start

  • A parkour section with falling barrels

  • A port area where you can buy your own ship after earning gold

  • A mini-challenge zone with taming and exploration opportunities

💀 Souls Mode – One Boss, Classic Challenge

There is one Souls-style boss encounter in the game, accessible early on via a quest from an NPC. This mode features:

  • A single, challenging boss

  • Emphasis on dodging, learning patterns, and punishing mistakes

  • A standalone experience inspired by soulslike mechanics

⚔️ Rough Mode – Precision Combat Arena

Accessible from the port area, Rough Mode is a directional 1v1 combat arena where you fight powerful mini-bosses using a custom mouse-driven parry and attack system.

  • Change attack and parry direction with your mouse

  • Fight enemies with unique abilities

  • Earn gold by defeating Rough bosses

  • Buy your ship after winning and collecting enough gold

🧭 Final Act – Sail, Survive, Escape

After purchasing your ship, you’ll sail into an ice basin, where you’re attacked by three marine monsters: a giant snake, kraken, and anglerfish. You must:

  • Collect explosives

  • Survive multi-enemy encounters

  • Escape the frozen trap

This leads to a descent into a glowing underground crystal city, where you face five additional Rough bosses. Once they’re defeated, a dragon captures you, marking the end of the game (until future updates).

Features

  • 3 distinct game modes: Adventure, Souls, and Rough

  • Directional combat system with mouse-driven attack/parry mechanics

  • Short but varied gameplay (1.5–2 hours of content)

  • Parkour sections, exploration, naval travel, and animal taming

  • Built entirely in the Godot Engine by a solo developer

data.name: Blobbs: Remastered
data.detailed_description:
Blobbs: Complete Edition

  • Get the base game plus the Mad Science, Elemental Mayhem and Outbreak! Level Packs (DLC) at a 20% discount over buying them seperately by buying the Complete Edition!


About the Game

Rebuilt from the ground up in a brand new engine with fully remastered graphics, improved animations, new visual effects and a brand new soundtrack.

Blobbs: Remastered combines simple but addictive gameplay, colourful and cartoony visuals, witty humour and ever so satisfying popping sounds. Ping, pop, zap, freeze and even explode your way through real time puzzles, attempting to create spectacular chain reactions in order to clear the screen in as few clicks as possible.

The Base Game contains:

  • Remastered Level Pack - 50 puzzling levels to solve, combining 40 of the best levels from the original 2 games with 10 brand new ones.

  • 16 unique and varied types of Blobbs (Including 4 new ones). Face off against Ninjas, Ghosts, Armoured Blobbs and even ones that can create blackholes!

  • New Boss Levels featuring special boss enemies, cut from the original games but now fully realised for the remaster.

data.name: Terminal Outbreak
data.detailed_description:
The lights are out. The dead are closing in. Your way out has to be earned.

Terminal Outbreak is a top-down, round-based zombie survival shooter where every round puts more pressure on your ammunition, defenses, and escape plan. Fight alone or join a squad, open new areas, restore power, and turn an overrun location into a fighting chance.

SURVIVE THE NEXT ROUND

Battle growing hordes while earning points to unlock routes, purchase weapons, and strengthen your loadout. Keep moving, watch your surroundings, and decide where to spend your resources before the next wave arrives.

TURN THE ENVIRONMENT INTO YOUR DEFENSE

Repair barricades, deploy traps, and place tactical equipment to control how the horde reaches you. Build a defensive position, set up an explosive ambush, or create enough breathing room to rescue a teammate.

BRING THE POWER BACK

Search for essential components, repair generators, and complete objectives while the outbreak closes in. Restoring power opens new opportunities—but reaching the equipment you need can mean leaving a defensible position behind.

UNLEASH DEVASTATING FIREPOWER

Combine firearms, explosives, perks, and weapon upgrades to shape your approach. Discover experimental weapons with extraordinary abilities and put them to work against the horde.

FACE MORE THAN ORDINARY ZOMBIES

Special infected and mutated bosses force you to adapt. React to their attacks, exploit openings, and keep your escape routes clear when a fight breaks through your defenses.

EARN YOUR EXTRACTION

Complete the steps needed to call for rescue, reach the extraction zone, and survive the final push. Calling for help is only the beginning of getting out alive.

KEEP BUILDING YOUR SURVIVOR

Earn experience, climb the ranks, complete challenges, and unlock cosmetic rewards as you take on the outbreak again.

data.name: Swords & Souls Legacy Collection
data.detailed_description:
From the creators of the highest-rated game in Flash history, this definitive collection brings five cult-classics to modern PCs – now in fullscreen 16:9 for the first time

Swords & Souls

In this iconic RPG-training hybrid, design your Soul, train them in fun mini-games, and prove your skills in the Arena. Unlock powerful abilities, grab legendary gear, and fight your way to the top. A true legend in Flash gaming, Swords & Souls remains the highest-rated game of all time on Armor Games and Kongregate. Yes, it’s that good.

Rogue Soul

Take on life as a rogue in this fast-paced runner where the streets are yours to conquer. Leap across rooftops, dodge traps, and take down enemies as you collect loot and build your reputation. With endless exploration, 50 treasures to discover, and a town full of challenges, this game lets you carve your name into history as the most wanted rogue in town.

Rogue Soul 2

The runner continues with even more adventure. Rogue Soul 2 expands the world with new enemies, detailed environments, massive upgrades, and tough-as-nails boss fights. Whether you’re perfecting your skills, finding rare treasures, or taking on challenges, this sequel is packed with so many reasons to keep coming back for more.

The Soul Driver

Buckle up and hit the road in this chaotic chase game! As a wanted outlaw, it’s you versus the police force in a mad dash to the border. Customize and upgrade your car, smash through roadblocks, and dodge everything from spike strips to helicopters. With 42 miles of mayhem, 6 unique challenges, and 24 achievements, the cops won’t know what hit them.

The Gentleman

Put on your top hat, grab your umbrella, and explore the life of a true gentleman. Navigate a world of clever puzzles and platforming challenges as you defy gravity and master the art of finesse. Equal parts stylish and tricky, this game is perfect for players who enjoy an elegant twist on the puzzle solving genre.

Key Features:

- All 5 original SoulGame classics now in fullscreen HD 16:9

- 100s of challenges, upgrades, and secrets to unlock

- Fan-favorite: Swords & Souls – highest-rated Flash RPG ever

- Run, fight, flip gravity, and out-drive cops in unforgettable adventures

- Fullscreen support, Steam achievements, and no Flash required
