data.name: Jammerball
data.detailed_description:
Jammerball is a sports game based on dodgeball and inspired by the classic arcade game Windjammers.

There are 8 teams in Jammerball, and all of them have their own unique arena. Each team has a specific weakness in some aspect of the game, with only two exceptions: one with no weaknesses, and one with all of them.

Playable teams


Drunken Brothers (all weaknesses) – Drunken Dome
Broken Wings (weak speed) – Wingless Garden
The Scratchers (weak shooting potency) – Little Claw Palace
Tired Spirits (weak energy recharging speed) – Yawning Center
Exhausteds (weak total energy) – Weakness Palace
Rubber Souls (weak resistance) – Bouncing Colliseum
Soapy Hands (weak catching ability) – Slippery Ground
Mighty Highers (no weaknesses) – The Very Best Garden

Main Features


3 Difficulty Levels
Cooperative mode
Versus mode (1vs1 & 2vs2)
8 different teams to play
8 unique arenas

data.name: Nanyang: Ballad of War
data.detailed_description:
One card to break their ranks. One fleet to brave the Southern Seas.

This is a strategic card game with auto-battler combat, set in a Chinese-inspired world of seafaring fantasy. Choose your hero, recruit followers, deploy equipment, and arrange your front and back rows. As your forces clash automatically, play cards from your hand to seize the moment and break through enemy formations.

Across the storm-tossed seas of Nanyang, wooden tokens kindle spirit fire, weapons bear mystical glyphs, and sea beasts forge pacts with humans to journey by their side. With a ship full of companions and a hand full of cards, set out to brave these waters.

Your forces fight on their own. Turning the tide is up to you.

Before battle, place your followers and equipment where they belong. Front and back rows, neighboring pieces, and the space occupied by pieces of different sizes all shape how your formation works.

Once combat begins, units act automatically. But the cards in your hand can still change the course of battle: deliver an extra hit, protect a piece of equipment, or play a wooden talisman to trigger a cascade of effects. Building your formation matters—and so do the cards you choose to play.

Three banners. Three ways to break their ranks.

Seafarers’ League | Bound by one pact, they fight for their place at sea.

Wooden talismans set equipment and allies in motion. A single card can trigger multiple responses, bringing your deck and battle formation together to work as one.

Heaven-Mandated Navy | Form ranks upon the waves. Let a hundred war engines roar as one.

Armored troops guard your equipment, while repairs and shields help you build up power. Hold the line and buy time for your next crushing strike.

Beastbinders of the Southern Seas | Read the tides, forge pacts with sea beasts, and weather the waves together.

Raise sea beasts, nurture their growth, and choose the right moment for them to evolve. Face the wind and waves alongside the creatures of the deep.

One sea. Many ways to build your fleet.

Choose from three factions and six heroes, each with their own origins and unique talents. Find followers, equipment, and cards that complement your hero, then refine your combinations as your journey unfolds.

Chain wooden talismans, guard equipment while building power, or nurture sea beasts toward their next evolution. From the effect of a single card to the interplay of your entire formation, discover the next combination that makes everything click.

Win the battle at hand. Keep something in reserve for the voyage ahead.

Choose your destinations along the route, encounter events, refit your fleet, and face new battles. Think one step ahead: what you gain now matters, but so does what you will need for the fights to come.

Take your newly discovered combinations back to sea, where every leg of the voyage becomes a fresh test of your formation.

Raise sea beasts, nurture their growth, and choose the right moment for them to evolve. Face the wind and waves alongside the creatures of the deep.

One sea. Many ways to build your fleet.

Choose from three factions and six heroes, each with their own origins and unique talents. Find followers, equipment, and cards that complement your hero, then refine your combinations as your journey unfolds.

Chain wooden talismans, guard equipment while building power, or nurture sea beasts toward their next evolution. From the effect of a single card to the interplay of your entire formation, discover the next combination that makes everything click.

Win the battle at hand. Keep something in reserve for the voyage ahead.

Choose your destinations along the route, encounter events, refit your fleet, and face new battles. Think one step ahead: what you gain now matters, but so does what you will need for the fights to come.

Take your newly discovered combinations back to sea, where every leg of the voyage becomes a fresh test of your formation.

Combine auto-battling, tactical formations, and well-timed card play to break enemy lines. One card to turn the tide. One fleet to brave the seas.

data.name: Subroutine: Deep Space
data.detailed_description:
In 3022, Andrew Mercer answered the first SOS from beyond Earth — undeniable proof of other life, asking for help. His wife, Evelyn, told him it was too convenient. A species that had never reached out before does not suddenly need saving. He went anyway.

The exploration ship Maximo never came home.

Their last transmission was another distress call. Then silence. Now a salvage operator is patched into the wreck: dead cores, fractured telemetry, and personal logs from a crew that started noticing the signal changing as they closed in. The pilot’s jokes stopped reaching her eyes. The comms officer saw a frequency no one else would admit was there. Forty-eight hours from history, it already felt like they were going the wrong way.

Recover what they left behind. Find out who called — and why anyone answered.

A visual programming puzzle game

Subroutine: Deep Space is a single-player sci-fi programming puzzle. You repair those dead cores by building executable node graphs. Every deck starts at a protected START node. From the toolbox you place and wire INBOX and OUTBOX for the packet stream, memory slots to hold values, arithmetic and branches for control flow, string ops for headers and tokens, logic gates for boolean work, and clock nodes when a deck cares about timing.

Then you run it. Open the validation panel and press Validate Core. Visible examples show the intended transform; hidden streams still have to pass. If the graph crashes, drops a packet, or exceeds the cycle cap, the core stays dark.

When a solution almost works, use playback like a debugger: step forward and back through ticks, watch the register and memory, and see which node fired. Each deck has a briefing, a repair guide, and a node budget. START, INBOX, and OUTBOX are free; everything else counts. Inefficient graphs fail even if the idea is right.

The goal of every deck is the same: emit the correct output stream. The challenge is how little hardware you spend doing it. Passing unlocks the next deck and can recover another personal log. Ratings (B, A, and S) score your best node count and cycle count against par, so you can return to a solved core and tighten the graph. New instruction types unlock as you move through the wreck, so later decks are not just harder puzzles — they are new kinds of programs.

Early Access

Early Access follows the first ten recovered decks of that expedition aboard the salvage site SV Asterion. A typical first playthrough is a few hours, longer if you chase S-rank solutions. More of the story is planned. Progress is saved locally on this PC. There are no extra game modes in this build — campaign, replay, and optimization are the whole loop.

Decks currently in the build:

  • Deck 1: Reverse Transmission — store packets and emit them last-in, first-out

  • Deck 2: Signal Boost — loop the stream and increment every reading

  • Deck 3: Calibration Offset — save the first packet, add it to the rest

  • Deck 4: Polarity Normalizer — branch on sign and zero

  • Deck 5: Parity Ping — reduce each value until you can report odd or even

  • Deck 6: Repeater Relay — echo every packet twice

  • Deck 7: Window Slice — cut a fixed routing window out of string headers

  • Deck 8: Parity Latch — compare boolean pairs

  • Deck 9: Clock Divider — align wait cycles with the execution clock

  • Deck 10: Authenticated Length — gate name lengths behind an OPEN token

    What you get with this purchase

  • A 10-puzzle single-player campaign with sequential unlocks and level select for recovered decks

  • A visual graph editor with undo/redo, node limits, and full keyboard play (rebindable in Settings)

  • Playback debugger and validation against visible plus hidden test streams

  • S / A / B ratings for compact, fast solutions

  • Briefings, repair guides, and an in-game Node Index for every instruction

  • Recovered story logs from the Maximo expedition

  • Sci-fi salvage interface with procedural ship-ambient audio

  • Local saves on this PC (Steam Cloud is planned, not in this build)

Recover what they left behind. Find out who called — and why anyone answered.

data.name: Green Horizon
data.detailed_description:
Green Horizon is a relaxing 2D weed-growing and life simulation game about taking over your uncle’s neglected operation and building a new life at your own pace.

After your uncle is sent to prison, you’re left with his old property and the beginnings of a small cannabis grow. What starts as a rough setup slowly becomes a much bigger operation as you grow different strains, earn money, upgrade your equipment, meet the locals and discover more about the town around you.

Grow and manage your crop, complete orders, explore different areas, visit shops and interiors, and talk to characters with their own routines and stories.

As you progress, you’ll unlock new strains, locations, equipment and opportunities, while story missions gradually reveal more about your uncle, the operation and the people connected to it.

Features

  • Grow and harvest different cannabis strains

  • Expand and improve your growing operation

  • Complete orders and earn money

  • Meet and interact with NPCs around town

  • Follow story missions and side jobs

  • Explore shops, interiors and new locations

  • Use your in-game phone for messages, missions and orders

  • Unlock new seeds, equipment and areas

  • Experience a changing day and night cycle

  • Play at your own pace with relaxed progression

Green Horizon is currently in development, and features shown on this page may change before release.

data.name: This Legion Kills
data.detailed_description:
This Legion Kills is a fast-paced, tense, two-player board game of tactical combat. You command a furious fighting force OF THE FUTURE against a ferocious foe. Recruit your armies. Scout out a unique map. Draw a hand of Command Cards. Deploy your Vanguard. The battle is joined!

To win, you must reduce your enemy’s Glory to zero before they do the same to you. Your successes on the battlefield chip away at your enemy’s Glory. It never goes up, only down; so it’s always a tense, back-and-forth race to the bottom.

Your turn is simple: play a Command Card to activate one or more of your units. Move them across the battlefield, and try to slaughter the enemy. In the process, try to hold on to the three Capture Points in the middle of the board, and keep your Headquarters alive.

Combat is resolved in a single roll of multiple colored dice. Dice quantity and color can be affected by terrain, as well as unit Special Abilities. Simple icons on the dice show the results

Adapated from the critically acclaimed tabletop game ARS VICTOR.

data.name: Escape from the Goblin Lair
data.detailed_description:
At the beginning of the game, you will play the role of a female college student with amnesia, searching for an exit deep in the cave.
1. Function:
The game controls the movement of the protagonist through the directional keys on the keyboard, and interacts with the scene through the space bar to obtain props. In the game, you will find various props that can be combined or used by opening your backpack. In addition, as the game plot unfolds, you will find that this cave is not an ordinary cave, and there are many goblins living inside. You need to use your skills and wisdom to evade Goblin's pursuit and finally find the exit to escape from the cave.
2. Content:
The game includes a total of 8 chapters, 20+levels, over 60 CGs, over 10 dynamic graphics, and hundreds of props. Each level in the game has a rating mechanism, and the system will rate you based on the number of deaths and escape time. If the rating is A or above, a hidden memory CG will also be activated.
3. Features:
Original plot, imaginative puzzles, passionate game between beautiful women and beasts, open your mind and embark on a thrilling escape from the secret room together

You control your player and drive the puck with a mouse - giving it the desired velociy and direction - lift it or let it go low, pass it to your partner or shoot.
You can push, escape collisions by jumping or catch and tumble someone trying to push you.
We hope you will enjoy our game and have a real fun and a nice time with friends.

data.name: Between Two Lights
data.detailed_description:
September, 2030. A disaster engulfs the continent: people are losing their memory en masse, disappearing without a trace from the streets, while a series of brutal murders spreads panic among the population. The State Security Service launches an investigation, trying to determine who is behind what is happening. Digging through the archives, the agents stumble upon what seems to be yet another routine inspection — the research institute SEC, officially engaged in the development of bioengineering. However, suspicions are raised by the fact that the institute is purchasing significant volumes of weaponry from private corrupt military companies.

Between Two Lights is an adventure shooter that raises the theme of awareness of what is happening and the value of personal choice. The player must decide: give in to love and escape without ever uncovering the truth, or sacrifice everything to learn it.

The main character is an agent of the State Security Service, operating undercover as a detective. He is tasked with finding out whether the SEC organization is involved in the unrest that has swept the country, and what connection all of this has to the project to create a “God.” As the investigation progresses, the hero realizes that he is being led by the nose, and a simple assignment gradually turns into a personal vendetta.
 

Explore the world when it truly matters.

The game world does not hold your hand.

Resources, modules, and weapons are hidden within the environment and are available only if you carefully explore the world.

Find and solve hidden puzzles embedded within the game world.
Help random passersby — their side stories may lead to unique rewards: character upgrades, rare modules, or even new weapons.

Exploration here is not a mandatory checklist, but a conscious choice that directly affects your capabilities and playstyle.
 

Every weapon is unique.

The game features fully procedural weapon physics.

Recoil, spread, and firing behavior — everything is generated dynamically and reinforced by detailed animation. No two guns are the same.

You can’t just pick up a gun and pull the trigger here.

Each weapon must be felt — how it behaves in combat, how it reacts to movement, rate of fire, and stressful situations. Choosing the wrong weapon before a mission is not a minor mistake, but a potentially fatal decision.

Over time, you decide for yourself which weapon truly fits your playstyle.

data.name: Flix and Chill 2: Millennials
data.detailed_description:
Finding long lasting romance in today's dating climate can seem like a challenge to many millennials. Dating now-a-days can be best characterized as fleeting one-time encounters, or exciting but short lived one night stands.



Are you tired of swiping left over and over, feeling that you'll never find the one with your paradox-of-choice myriad of choices? Are you tired of being overlooked by the pretty girl/boy at your office, who seems to prefer the more handsome/beautiful coworker over you?

If so, then you should try "Flix and Chill The Game 2: Millennials!" A game for the artsy fartsiest generation around!!



Flix and Chill 2: Millennials will be your guide in this constantly changing and sometimes exhausting social climate we find ourselves in. You'll learn how to:

- Woo that special someone with nothing but dialogue choices
- Not make a fool out of yourself on a first date
- Snap an awesome dating profile pic
- Use nothing but charisma to work your way out of a tough situation
- And so much more!!



So what are you waiting for!? If you're a millennial starving for recognition and a sense of belonging, then Flix And Chill 2: Millennials is what you need!

Get your copy today!

A short, cozy open-world adventure set on a charming little island.

🌿 Explore a Handcrafted World

Discover a whimsical island filled with playful characters and fun interactions. From scattered paper airplanes to shining mushrooms, every corner hides a collectible or secret waiting to be found.

💌 Connect with the Community

Immerse yourself in a close-knit, small-town vibe where every delivery brings you closer to the heart of the island and its people.

data.name: POSER
data.detailed_description:
POSER is a narrative-driven rhythm game set in a world overrun by a dancing plague. You explore a story about the hidden organ market after you lose your kidneys in an underground club. It is up to you to figure out the secrets hidden behind the glow of the disco ball.

MOVE TO THE BEAT

In a world overrun by a dancing plague, you and many others gather in underground clubs to groove and protest the government's ban on dancing. Move to the beat to explore the maze-like dancefloor and its secrets.

DANCE BATTLES

During your exploration you stumble across characters who have access or information you need, so beat them in a dance battle to prove you aren't just a poser.

FEATURES:

  • Explore an underground club packed with unique characters, secrets, and items

  • Dance battle 3 eccentric characters

  • Groove to 7 original alternative songs

  • Play on Poser, Regular, or Tryhard difficulty

  • Play with controllers or keyboard

data.name: Where Time Ends
data.detailed_description:
A psychological journey of mystery and puzzles

Build a time machine to see your deceased mother one last time. Driven by grief

and obsession, the protagonist clings to the only hope left: defy the laws of spacetime

to reclaim a lost moment.

Building the Time Machine

Shape the machine step by step, from welding its walls to creating a core capable

of manipulating time. Face a series of varied puzzles that will test your logic and

determination as you get closer to the heart of your goal.

Unlock All Nine Endings

Discover 9 unique endings that explore different ways of coping with grief. Each

one has its own tone, ranging from dark and symbolic to surreal and dreamlike,

revealing varied interpretations of pain, obsession, and loss.

An Introspective Journey

Experience an emotional journey through grief, the fear of facing reality, and the

consequences of clinging to the past in a world where logic breaks down and time

no longer behaves as it should.

data.name: Londoleon: not a single penny
data.detailed_description:
A visual novel about friendship, first love, and the investigation of a mysterious incident during a trip to London.

Max is an ordinary high school student who wins a trip to a language school in the UK capital. New friendships, visits to famous landmarks, and carefree days quickly turn a group of strangers into close friends.

But one day, Max's roommate discovers counterfeit money in his wallet. Determined to help their friend, the group launches an investigation of their own. Suspicion falls on different people, tensions begin to rise, and the truth turns out to be far more unpleasant than anyone could have imagined.

Experience an interactive story with meaningful choices and multiple story routes. Explore iconic London locations, meet memorable characters, and uncover the mystery behind the counterfeit money.

data.name: Castaway Harem
data.detailed_description:
Your plane never made it to Auckland.

Flight 119 went down somewhere over the Pacific. You wake up on a beach with nothing but the clothes you're wearing, and soon you find out you're not the only one who made it.

Nobody is coming to get you, so it's up to you. Collect whatever the sea washes up, build a camp, find fresh water and explore the island. And get to know the women you're stuck here with. Very well, if you play your cards right.

The survivors

Kai - a freediver from Hawaii. Acts first, thinks later, and spends more time in the water than out of it.

Dana - Kai's twin sister. The careful one. She plans everything, keeps lists and is usually right.

Wren - a goth girl from business class. Sarcastic, writes poems and hates the sun.

Margriet - a boat-builder's daughter from the Netherlands. Practical, good with tools, and the only one here who knows how a boat is put together.

Diane - the senior flight attendant from your flight. Calm, a bit older, and used to taking care of people.

And someone else, who was on this island long before the plane came down.

Features

  • 6 women to meet, each with her own story

  • Build your camp: shelter, pier, water still, signal fire and more

  • Explore the island and open up new areas with the help of the others

  • Fishing, diving and chests to find on the beach

  • Search the wrack line once a day in a match-3 minigame for wood, rope, glass and coconuts

  • Day and night cycle and changing weather

  • Uncensored sex scenes, many of them animated

  • Gallery to rewatch every scene

data.name: Timothy vs the Aliens
data.detailed_description:
Timothy vs the Aliens is an open-world platformer, and adventure video game where a gangster will defend his black & white city from an invasion of full-colored aliens.



The game takes place in Little Fish City, an open and large city that can be freely explored and hides many secrets and missions. This is a city full of platforms, and going through it won’t be just walking from one point to another. In addition, you will be able to explore the whole city by car, using any of the vehicles that appear in the game.

In Timothy vs the Aliens you will also find many moments of action in ambushes by aliens, as well as lots of puzzles to find items, help other characters, and access blocked or hidden places.



Of course, you will always be well-equipped to fight against the aliens, and you will be able to increase your inventory buying items from the Gunrunner.

All this and much more in a game full of stories, adventures and secrets.

data.name: PACIFICATION LIGHT
data.detailed_description:
PACIFICATION LIGHT is an exciting 2D platformer that takes us back to a time when spirits and ghosts inhabited our world. During this period, there lived a brave hero who decided to confront the darkness and cleanse the earth of sinister supernatural entities. You have to go as this hero through gloomy and mysterious locations filled with mysteries and dangers. Your goal is to use the power of light to banish darkness and restore harmony to the areas affected by it.

Exciting battles with ghostly enemies await you, requiring quick reactions and skillful use of light abilities. Explore intricate labyrinths and collect powerful artifacts that will help you in your sacred duty.

data.name: Gems of Destiny: Homeless Dwarf
data.detailed_description:
Wishlist now


About the Game


Enjoy the Match 3 gameplay in an intriguing story of dwarf Axel rebuilding his destroyed village. Earn coins by using 5 unique boosters to create a new city for Axel and his friends. Be amazed about the creation of the beautiful hand-drawn Dwarf's Forest World.



Young dwarf Axel has lost his parents in a massive tornado. After years of roaming the world, Alex tries to find a new home for him and a future family, Axel is no longer a young dwarf, but an impressive dwarf with a beard and an axe! Alex is ready to take over the world when he walks into the village of the Forest Dwellers. In this village, Alex discovers that the village is infested by the Goblins. Axel, the mighty dwarf he is today, is pinned down by the Forest Dwellers who beg him to help them fight the Goblins and kick them out of the forest the hard way. Alex teams up with Violet the Dryad and works the Goblins out of the village. After this, the villagers and Alex rebuild the village. It is a big surprise when they discover the terrible secret of the Goblin invasion, the village will never be the same afterwards.





In 100 challenging levels with increasing difficulty, you will destroy the Goblins. This Match 3 game combined an intriguing story with a smooth gameplay. Step into this beautiful hand-drawn world which will seduce you into hours and hours of gameplay. Make use of the more then 5 boosters like Shuffle, Magic Reach and Mana Tornado to reach your goals and be amazed by the outcome of the secret of the village.

data.name: Hide & Seek
data.detailed_description:
Paint. Hide. Seek.

Hide & Seek reinvents the classic game of hide-and-seek for online multiplayer. Every hider spawns as a blank white figure — and the world around you is your only camouflage. Grab your brush, paint your body to match the crates, walls, and props nearby, then freeze and pray the seekers walk right past.

HOW A ROUND WORKS

Lobby — Gather your friends and drop into a match.
Prep Phase — Hiders paint themselves and search for the perfect hiding spot. Seekers can already roam the same map, but the hiders stay invisible to them until the hunt begins.
The Hunt — When prep ends, every hider appears, and the seekers race to find and tag them all before the timer runs out.
Results — See who blended in best and who had the sharpest eye.

BECOME THE SCENERY

Hiding here isn't about ducking behind a wall. Use the in-game paint tools to hand-craft your own disguise — match the colors, copy the textures, and turn yourself into just another object in the room. The better your paint job, the longer you survive. New to painting? Switch on Camouflage Mode for a quick, automatic disguise.

EASY TO LEARN, TENSE TO PLAY

Simple controls, fast matches, and that heart-pounding moment when a seeker stops right in front of you. The perfect party game to play with friends.

data.name: The Last Days of Friendship Valley
data.detailed_description:
Heal friendships, uncover mysteries, and prepare for impending doom in The Last Days of Friendship Valley! You play as the Patcher, a goat whose job is to settle arguments and keep communities together. Your new home plans on putting your conflict negotiation skills to the test: a deep schism lurks beneath the surface of Friendship Valley, and there are mere days before everything breaks apart. Make friends with the town's inhabitants, evolve your conversational approach, and try to mend the broken heart of Friendship Valley before it destroys the world.

Build Your Conversation Deck

The Last Days of Friendship Valley's unique card-based tactical Friendship Encounter system lets you decide EVERYTHING about your Patcher, from your conversational quirks, to your emotional strengths and weaknesses, to the ways you break when the strain becomes too much. Flexible or firm, steadfast or melancholy, patient or explosive; you decide who you become and how you interact with the world. When every character has full emotional interiority, a single wrong word can be the difference between success and disaster. Do you have what it takes to tackle the chaos of interpersonal communication?

Uncover an Ancient Mystery

Not all is sunshine and rainbows in Friendship Valley; a mystery that stretches back to the dawn of time threatens to swallow the town. Uncover soul-powered machines, negotiate with fairies, and delve into deep emotional wounds in order to reach the truth. What does the floating obelisk in the middle of town really do? Why is there an abandoned building covered in magic sigils outside of town? Who is trying to destroy Friendship Valley, and why?

Try to Save the World

You won't be able to do it alone. Fortunately, you have help. The friends you make along the way will be there to support you in big and small ways alike, from a fresh meal to a trek through the wilderness. Each Friendship Encounter you successfully resolve brings you closer to the goats involved: Friendship Valley is a mistrustful place, but with time and effort, it can become a home.

data.name: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
data.detailed_description:
Earth in 2240 had survived war, ecological threats, alien invasions and more, but after all countries exhausted their nuclear stockpiles during the last war, the world was sent back into the Dark Ages. The United States was broken into kingdoms and the lands outside of their reach were populated with mutated orcs, evil mages and entire rogue armies.



Pedro and Sofia, siblings who were questing through the open lands, are called into service to a kingdom in need, where a strange new cult has been converting the local populace and building their own radiated army. Soon, they uncover a mystery across America that must be stopped before Earth is led to its final, nuclear annihilation.

Features:
  • Over 60 unique skills and more than 500 different types of weapons and equipment to find or build
  • Fully immersive 3D environments, including a massive, open-world with dungeons, towns and mysterious locations
  • A unique crafting system to build and upgrade a variety of weapons, armor and more
  • Real-time, action-RPG combat and a story-rich quest that takes place across America
  • Three different characters with original stories to play as and build with unique job classes
  • Hours and hours of quests and surprising adventures, plus fully playable on Steam Deck

data.name: Mors Blade - UNSLASHED
data.detailed_description:
From the hand that created Schwarzerblitz and 8-Colors Star Guardians, here comes a new hand-crafted sci-fi visual novel!

God is dead. Long live God

Senna is a Blade, one of the three girls that received the power to turn into hi-tech bioweapons from the mechanical rabbit Kochka. Their task? Kill all the scarabs, an invasive alien species that is trying to turn Earth into their new home. Or is that all that's behind it?

In the slums of paradise only the wicked survive

Senna isn't the strongest, the fastest, or even the smartest Blade and she's painfully aware of it, all while tangling with her unrequieted crush on one of her fellow Blades.

When the world dies, the parade begins

Juggle Senna's everyday life and her fight against the scarabs under her secret identity of 02-Ember Scarlet. 

Bring her to victory.

Or to question herself about the reality of her situation.

Find your way

Mors Blade features:

  • 80'000 words split into four paths

  • three endings plus a golden route accessible after completing all of them

  • hand-crafted cutscenes and stills, drawn on paper, inked, scanned, and then digitally colored

  • a marketable (?) rabbit robot

  • a certain yellow-hatted bartender that is totally not related with another yellow-hatted bartender

  • violent fights against alien creatures

  • romance between three dorks, in different combinations

UNSLASHED!

The Steam version of Mors Blade comes with an in-game gallery, achievements, cloud saves, and some extra content

data.name: STEP THEATER
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :)

An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

STEP THEATER is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, STEP THEATER gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

Features

  • A game system where the story comes together as you play on the music

  • A wide variety of stages, each with its own theme, presentation, and actions

  • Cute character animation paired with a warm art style

  • Colorful pop tracks

Collaborating Creators

Graphics: Subikaka, Aramon

Sound: Chroma, Mafumafu

Estimated Demo Playtime

20 minutes

  • These guidelines may change without prior notice. The most recent version will apply to videos posted or streamed after any updates.

data.name: Entropy
data.detailed_description:
In this dying age, only pockets of humanity remain. There was no apocalyptic event to speak of; only the cruel march of time and the inexplicable infertility of the world. Accursed creatures stalk the barren lands between settlements, which are themselves terrible places; squalid, medieval and mostly ruled by tyrants. 

Our story begins in the town of Draenog, where the theatre performance you are putting on is interrupted by fighting at the gates. Demons have arrived. Your wooden sword will have to do for now, gather the troupe and defend yourselves!

Entropy is a post-apocalyptic role-playing game with an expansive world map, explorable towns filled with colorful characters, and a tactical turn-based battle system.

KEY FEATURES

  • Embark on a quest across the lands to stop the demonic incursion.

  • Control your party of up to 6 characters.

  • Hire Mercenaries to replace your fallen party members.

  • Tactical Turn-Based Combat.

  • Explore a world full of unique characters, creatures, challenges, and treasure.

  • Level up your characters, increase your stats, and unlock new perks.

  • A beautiful retro 3D aesthetic.

data.name: Plastic Conflict
data.detailed_description:
Command your tiny plastic soldiers across massive battlefields and new worlds that we take for granted in the real world.

Fight across living rooms, bedrooms, gardens, forests, and more where everyday objects become towering terrain. Sandboxes, fountains, the base of a tree, rocks that look like mountains, and stuffed animals that feel like giant monuments all become part of the battlefield.

Build a base, defend it against wildlife critters that act as giant monster threats, and fight other factions trying to take control of the map in massive battles with up to eight players or AI.

Key Features

• Direct control mode – Take control of any unit and fight on the ground in real time
• Massive real world environments – Everyday locations become large scale battlefields
• Sandbox base building – Build, expand, and defend your base
• Large scale battles – Up to eight factions competing for control
• Dynamic sandbox warfare – AI factions fight each other, expand, and react
• Multiple game modes – Campaign, skirmish, survival, and gauntlet

Core Gameplay

In this real time strategy game, you can seamlessly switch between commanding your army from above and directly controlling any unit on the battlefield. Take over a rifleman and fire from a trench, use a sniper to pick off enemies from a distance, control an engineer to build out your base, or take over a fighter jet and fly bombing runs over enemy positions.

At its core, the game focuses on building, expanding, and conquering. Start from a single headquarters, capture resource points, grow your army, and push outward while defending your territory with bunkers and trench systems. There is no strict unit cap, allowing battles to scale based on your economy and strategy.

Campaign and Other Modes

On the campaign map, fight for dominance over a neighborhood in a 4X style system. Recruit infantry divisions, armor divisions, and air divisions, then move across regions strategically. Choose to auto resolve battles or fight them directly in RTS gameplay, with battles generated based on the region to keep each encounter different.

The game also includes skirmish across multiple maps, along with randomly generated indoor and outdoor environments that make every battle feel unique.

Units and Warfare

There are many different unit types including anti tank infantry, missile launchers, tanks, colossus mechs, snipers, machine gunners, stealth bombers, helicopters, and more. Air units, transports, and paratroopers allow you to strike anywhere on the map, reinforce positions, or launch attacks behind enemy lines.

Level up your faction using research points to unlock better buildings and stronger units. Build trench systems, fortify key positions, and adapt as the battlefield evolves over time.

World and Wildlife

The battlefield is not yours alone. Creatures such as ants, spiders, and other wildlife act as dangerous neutral threats, attacking any faction that gets too close and adding constant pressure to both players and AI.

AI factions range from very easy to nightmare difficulty. As difficulty increases, they react faster, maneuver more effectively, flank your positions, launch large scale assaults, and use artillery before attacking.

No two battles play the same. Adapt your strategy, build your army, and take control of the battlefield.

data.name: Escape: Zombie Maze
data.detailed_description:
Number19's terrifying adventure continues in a dark and eerie labyrinth. Finding himself in an unknown place, the test subject must face limited ammunition and increasing danger. In this labyrinth dominated by zombies, every corner and every step can be deadly.

Game Features


Limited Resources: With limited ammunition, each shot must be carefully planned. Zombies die from severe head injuries; some require one shot, others two or three to fall.
Varied Challenges: As you progress, the complexity and difficulty of the labyrinth increase. Each level is designed to test the player's intelligence and reflexes.
Realistic Atmosphere: Dark, gloomy environments and tension-filled music keep the player constantly alert. Danger lurks around every corner.
Secrets to Discover: Unveil the hidden secrets in the depths of the labyrinth. Hidden passages, mysterious notes, and surprises are part of this world, and survival requires exploration.
Engaging Story: Learn more about Number19's story, his past, and how he got here. The story unfolds layer by layer, captivating the player.

Deepening Mystery: Dimension Technology Lab


Dimension Technology Lab opens portals and sends people into labyrinths. Sometimes, they send them to unknown places. Is this company a cult? A secret organization? Or a scientific laboratory founded by extraterrestrial beings? Why did they choose Number19? Who is Dimension Technology Lab so afraid of? Why are they afraid? What is the real name of the character Number19? As you search for answers to these questions, you will discover hidden truths in the depths of the game. Are you ready to explore these mysteries and uncover dark secrets?

Escape Zombie Maze brings new life to the survival horror genre. In this epic escape story set in a zombie-filled labyrinth, strategy, skill, and courage will be your greatest weapons. Are you ready? Count your ammunition, hold your breath, and never forget what may be waiting around every corner.

data.name: Drug Lord Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
Start from nothing and rise to the top as you expand your criminal empire in Drug Lord Tycoon. You'll begin as a low-level street hustler working out of a tiny back-alley garage, hustling the streets on your own. With aspirations of power and wealth you rise through the ranks, hire workers, dealers, and gain access to powerful contacts in the criminal underworld.

Becoming a successful kingpin is not easy, and there are a lot of risks and dangers you have to take into account. Avoiding police, rival drug cartels, and insane partners, is all a part of running a drug empire. So be careful who you mess with, or become powerful enough to become the danger!

Starting an empire isn’t easy work, and without any connections to the criminal world, you will have to put in some work yourself. Start out by hustling the streets with your product, negotiate with stubborn customers or charge extra from drunk partygoers.

Once word is on the street that there is a new supplier in town, dealers will start to show up. Use them to deal your product while you take care of more important things.

Crossbreed plants and experiment with new recipes. Make your drug your own, get the best traits or show off a signature ingredient or trait. You can customize your drugs however you want.

Growth in this business doesn’t come without its challenges. Once your production scales you won't be able to keep up on your own. Hire workers to help you out. Each worker possesses a unique level of skill for different tasks, it’s your job as the manager of your empire to assign the tasks in the most optimal way. Experiment with task priorities and amounts to see which combination fits your production line the best.

data.name: PURPLEARC
data.detailed_description:
「Action games are so fun, aren't they?」

A beautiful world,
a deep story,
imaginative flavor text...

...Instead of all that,

I made this game so even people who don’t usually play action games can feel that it’s fun.

---

Special moves of the main character:

• Glide

Spread your wings and glide. The floaty feeling of flying far might get you hooked?

• Super Dash

The longer you keep running on the ground, the faster you go. It makes the glide even more powerful—guaranteed to feel great.

• Wall Bounce Glide

Use walls, one of the obstacles, to your advantage. It’s tricky, but if you can pull it off... it’s a blast!

data.name: Grand horse attraction
data.detailed_description:
From the makers of No. 1 in the Kids Entertainment Charts "Grand Horse Attraction" you get total playful freedom. You alone decide which task you want to do next: Stable work, such as feeding and cleaning the horses or rather earning money, with newspapers or bread rolls? Maybe you will have more fun steering the horse-drawn carriage through the vast landscapes of the riding country, through the small town or along the beautiful beach ... Why not take a photo tour and take great snapshots? Not only can you ride all the horses in the game, you can also take part in various riding tournaments or explore the area with bicycles and electric scooters. You can even drive the farmer's tractor! Talk to the friendly NPCs and listen to the cool songs from "Radio Reiterland".


FEATURES:
- Explore the game world. You decide what you want to do in the riding country. Take care of the rescue of the abandoned horses.
- Equip yourself with your favorite clothes in the boutique.
- Win exciting horse shows.
- Drive with many vehicles such as bicycles, electric scooters, tractors and carriages.
- Put together your own photo album. Take on part-time jobs like delivering newspapers.
- Ride through huge, varied levels.
- Help with the stable work (feeding, brushing and much more). Endless game mode!

data.name: Kappa Kanji Adventure
data.detailed_description:
Stunning Sky Environment


Immerse yourself in a vibrant and captivating sky world that keeps you engaged and motivated throughout your language-learning adventure. Dynamic visuals and atmospheric effects ensure your learning experience is anything but dull.

Kanji Pathways


The path ahead isn't always clear – unlock your way forward by deciphering Kanji characters displayed on each platform. Match the character's meaning or reading to progress, and watch as the sky bridges form before your eyes.

Kanji Cards


Discover Kanji cards that provide essential information about each character. These cards offer insights into stroke order, meanings, and example common words using the Kanji, enhancing your learning experience while you play.

Hiragana and Katakana Mastery


Hone your skills in the foundational scripts of hiragana and katakana. Master these essential Japanese scripts as part of your main journey, ensuring a strong linguistic foundation.

Collection Showcase


Track your progress and showcase your linguistic achievements in a dedicated collection. Review all the characters you've learned so far, reinforcing your knowledge and inspiring your journey.

data.name: 2番線 | Nibansen
data.detailed_description:
If something unusual happens, return to the opposite passage!
A mysterious respect-based escape game from the subway station to the exit "Line 2 | Nibansen"
・There is a bit of mild horror on this train. Please give up your seat to all passengers, including the elderly, those who are uncomfortable with fear, and those who are pregnant or with infants.
・We will soon be arriving at Line 2. The elements of abnormality, escape, puzzle-solving, and mild horror are here for your transfer. The exit is ahead at C7.
・Please be careful where there is a gap between the world and the platform.
【Game Description】
Escape from the endlessly repeating Line 2 of the subway station!
We've created abnormalities with the unique creativity of students! Enjoy!

Please use it without missing any abnormalities

If you find an abnormality, immediately turn back and head towards the opposite exit

If you don't find any abnormalities, just keep going as you are

Exit outside from Exit C7



"Line 2" is a short walking simulator inspired by Japanese subway stations and places like Exit 8.
【Playtime】
15 minutes to 60 minutes
【Video Distribution Guidelines】

Distribution is allowed without permission for both individuals and corporations.
Monetization is only possible using the features provided by the video distribution site.
It would be appreciated if you include the game's
name in the title of the video or stream and a link to the Steam page in the description or similar.

Furthermore, we take no responsibility for any damages that may occur as a result of distributing videos of this game.
The contents of these guidelines are subject to change without notice.
【Settings Screen】
You can restart from the settings screen. Additionally, you can adjust window settings, mouse sensitivity, volume, etc. It is advisable for streamers to restart after launching before starting recording.


【Post-Completion Content】

・After clearing the game, you can turn on the teleporter from the settings, making it easier to move from one end of the game to the other.
・After clearing the game, it's possible to turn off "No Anomalies" from the settings. Utilize this feature for searching anomalies.

【Camera Shake】
To prevent motion sickness, the camera is set not to shake.


Vehicle Used
Uses vehicles from the popular "Big Ed Line" subway, which recorded a total of 350,000 views on YouTube

Created with a focus on clarity. Please feel free to provide any feedback.

English Translation: ChatGPT

data.name: Desktop Akari ~my cute companion~
data.detailed_description:
She lives on your desktop. She studies, sings, and smiles — just for you.

Desktop Akari ~my cute companion~ is a unique blend of idle sim, raising sim, and desktop companion — starring Akari, your sweet and hardworking virtual girlfriend who lives right on your screen.

Watch her walk, read, chat with friends, and sing her heart out as she tries to grow in every way she can. Help her with her homework, cheer her up when she's down, and guide her as she works toward her dream of becoming a singer. Every interaction counts — the more time you spend together, the more she opens up to you.

Each date is a milestone — and Akari is determined to become the best version of herself with every one.

She’s always there, quietly living her own life beside yours. But she’s not just a program — she’s Akari, and she wants to make you smile.

Desktop Akari ~my cute companion~ is a real-time desktop companion game. Watch Akari live on your screen, assign her tasks, earn hearts, and help her grow. Balance study, singing, and friendship to unlock upgrades and dates.

data.name: Auto RiskRisk
data.detailed_description:
A strategic 2D equipment-based auto battler. Equip your fighters with different items and artefacts to form a team. Then send them off to fight against AI opponents. By combining certain types of items you can increase your strength or counter the opponents' strategies.

How to play

Auto RiskRisk is an equipment-based auto battler. This means your goal, as the one managing your fighters, is to assemble the strongest team possible using different equipment and strategies in order to win.

Use the money you earn each round to buy new equipment for your fighters.

Buying multiple of the same items combines them into stronger versions.

Each item belongs to two different sets. If you collect multiple of the same set you get additional set bonuses.

Position your fighters and their equipment to make the most of them during battles.

Each round you face off against an opponent's team.

Your fighters will automatically run out and fight for you with the equipment you have assigned to them.

The loser of the battle will lose health and if you go down to 0 health you are out of the game.

The last player standing is the winner!

Key Features

- Relaxed play mode

Face off against 7 other AI players of varying difficulty, each level demanding more of your skills.

Play as fast as you want. No turn timers and you will never have to wait for any AI players to finish. Pause and pick it back up whenever you got some time to spare or watch a stream while playing.

- Items

Use a total of 60 different items spread over 11 different classes and 15 different enchantments, each with their own flavour and strategy.

Over 70 different artefacts you can use to bolster your strategies or create entirely new ones.

Combine items of the same types to unlock set bonuses. Find a combination that bolster your fighters or counter your opponents.

- Game modes

In addition to the normal game, there are several other game modes to unlock.

Each game mode alters the game in different ways which will make you come up with new strategies.

- Achievements and rewards

70+ achievements testing your skill of all the aspects of the game.

Unlock new icons, playmats and squads to personalise your team.

data.name: Nimillion - The last expedition
data.detailed_description:
‘Nimillion - The Last Expedition’ is a vast, physics-driven rocket ship adventure with Metroidvania-style progression. Pilot your ship using only thrusters, unlocking abilities like a grapple rope, quick boost, zero-gravity mode, lasers and more. Master precise controls to explore treacherous terrain, face environmental hazards, enemies, physics puzzles, and platforming trials.

I’ve built this game with retro-inspired physics controls for those who crave brutal, yet fair challenges so if this is your jam and you're tired of hand-holding in modern games, this is your ultimate test of skill. It’s not for casual players expecting easy wins. It's a love letter to gamers who grew up on retro challenges and thrive on the rush of overcoming difficult odds, although, your abilities will help a lot!

  • Pilot your rocket ship through a vast, physics-simulated world using only its thrusters. No autopilot, no mercy. Every maneuver demands precision, practice, and commitment, turning simple flight into a high-stakes art form that's easy to pick up but hard to master.

  • Unlock game-changing abilities like a grappling rope, short boost, protective shield, zero-gravity mode, lasers, and more to expand your exploration arsenal.

  • 3 difficulty levels available for a perfectly tailored challenge that scales from tough to unforgiving.

  • Even with upgrades, survival hinges on your reflexes and strategy as you navigate deadly environmental hazards, solve physics puzzles, and outmaneuver or obliterate hostile entities.

  • Dive into over 20 hand-crafted levels, including 3 massive open-world zones filled with platforming perils, and dynamic phenomena like winds, waterfalls, gravity fields, and force fields.

  • Prove your mastery on global leaderboards with speedruns.

Highly replayable with over 15 hours of gameplay for the main story, speed runs with leaderboard and difficulty levels that change the way you play! Play in both small and huge levels.

Play the way you like: Reduce the length of the game using the guide / Cheat maps if you prefer to spend less time on exploration.

ACQUIRE NEW ABILITIES

Unlock essential tools like a grappling rope, quick booster, zero-gravity mode, lasers, and more to evolve your rocket ship from basic flyer to unstoppable explorer.

CHALLENGING BOSS FIGHTS

Brace for epic, multi-phase encounters against strong foes. Master physics and upgrades to survive these tough boss fights that demand strategy, timing, and unyielding skill.

TRAVERSE DIFFICULT TERRAINS

Navigate treacherous space environments with precision: battle howling winds, cascading waterfalls, erratic gravity fields, dense vegetation, and beyond in this challenging game.

USE PHYSICS TO YOUR ADVANTAGE

Turn the laws of nature into weapons. Exploit gravity pulls, weapon recoil, force fields, and other realistic mechanics to solve puzzles and dominate in.

XBOX controller support with Force Feedback
3 Save slots
Online leaderboard
Optional FSR3/4 with FRAMEGEN

data.name: Fatal Evidence: Art of Murder Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Domini Games presents another suspenseful installment in the gripping Fatal Evidence series!

You weren’t looking for trouble, but it finds you anyway when two special agents show up on your doorstep with grim news. The art-obsessed serial killer known only as “the Master” is killing again, and he wants you on the case! To make matters worse, one of the agents has his own doubts about you and your involvement. Who is the Master, and why did he choose you? Bring all of your crime-solving skills – you’re going to need them to answer these questions and more in this compelling Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

  • Tons of collectibles and morphing objects to find!
  • Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, music, videos, and more!
  • Don’t miss a clue with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

data.name: Project Human
data.detailed_description:
Project Human takes you to a human research center where artificial intelligence controls everything. It follows your every move and will always remind you how stupid and useless you are.

AI has set up a series of different puzzles and platforms for you to complete. But you are not here to stay, you want to escape. Things won't go in a way they were supposed to. This results in to events that none of us could have even imagined.

In Project Human you will always be surprised. Do not trust anything you see as what even is real, are you real? Who knows, only the game will tell.

You can play alone or with your friend in a cooperative campaing.

Game is heavily under production and you can follow it from YouTube on CraxyTheDev channel.

data.name: Squirrel Day
data.detailed_description:
Let's get nuts! Climb around the trees, explore the neighborhood, and collect the pecans, acorns, and walnuts in the yards from the viewpoint of a squirrel. Move effortlessly through the branches using your paws to jump and grab. Collect all the nuts as fast as you can and beat your best time.

The full version takes place across multiple neighboring backyards and spans all four seasons, offering dozens of different challenges. Also in the full version, find all of the hidden golden nuts to unlock red and gray squirrels, adding more challenging difficulties.

Features:
-- Unique perspective of a squirrel
-- Thrilling sense of height, speed, and scale
-- Intuitive physics-based movement, climbing, and grabbing controls
-- Non-violent platforming and collecting
-- Single player, no voice chat

data.name: Skiing VR
data.detailed_description:
Ski anytime you want on perfectly designed slopes. Find your way to the finish line and prove that you're the best skier!

RIDE WITH OTHER SKIERS OR WITH AI


Have a good time with your friends in a multiplayer game and find out who is the best skier or challenge riders from all over the world.

But sometimes, we all need a single ride. You can have a good time alone in all four game modes.

DIFFERENT SKIERS, DIFFERENT STYLES


Ski your way in the daytime or at night: set the best time in the race, come first to the finish, gain the highest score or enjoy a free ride. Navigate the slopes and find different ways to reach the finish line.

AI-POWERED REALISTIC CONTROLS


You don't need foot controllers to play Skiing VR, just your VR headset and two hand controllers. We developed a unique AI-driven control system that predicts your body movement according to different sensors. That's why Skiing VR is so realistic.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Ski in VR like on a real slope
  • Enjoy four game modes: time and speed races, score, and a free ride
  • Challenge your friends or players all over the world
  • Ride perfectly designed slopes
  • Feel the AI-driven controls
  • Let the music drive your ride

data.name: Oneirostasis
data.detailed_description:
Oneirostasis is a first-person psychological horror and anomaly-spotting game you can play solo or online with one friend. Each night, decide whether there are any anomalies in the house. If everything is normal, go back to bed. If you spot an anomaly, escape through the front door.

You are trapped in a dream

Each night, you "wake up" in the same house, where anomalies may be lurking. Your goal is to return to the real world. Go back to sleep on safe nights, or escape through the front door on nights with anomalies, to gradually strengthen your connection to reality. Choose wrong, and you will become lost in the dream.

Play online with a friend

Too scared to play alone? Invite a friend to brave the unknown with you! Two-player co-op includes additional anomalies designed specifically for playing as a pair.

More challenges

If you're brave enough, don't miss these challenging ways to play:

  • Dark Mode: Play with all the main lights switched off.

  • Evidence Mode: There are anomalies every night, and you must photograph them. The anomalies also become more challenging.

One more thing…

Some of the screenshots above hide anomalies. Have you spotted them?

data.name: Zombie Princess
data.detailed_description:
“Will you embrace this child and guide her back to humanity, or raise her to become the queen who will rule this dark world?”

Inspired by the cozy, nostalgic charm of classic life-raising simulation games, this game blends the warmth of raising a daughter with a cruel and bittersweet suspense: your daughter is slowly turning into a zombie.

Five years ago, when a mysterious plague swept through the forest, her mother used a life-draining spell to protect her daughter, Ria. But tragically, crimson veins have begun to spread across Ria’s delicate, pale skin, while her body grows colder with each passing day.

As her father, you will spend eight years caring for Ria, teaching her, and sending her into the dangerous world beyond your home.

Behind the peaceful rhythm of everyday life, a vast conspiracy and a hidden truth are slowly closing in.

And when the truth finally comes to light, what kind of fate will await your daughter?

  • A Strange World Where Warmth and Horror Coexist

    • In the morning, plan Ria’s schedule in a cozy home filled with the smell of freshly baked bread. At night, hold her increasingly cold hands and desperately hide her secret. Experience the strange immersion of a warm family life intertwined with a growing horror.

  • Two Grand True Endings Shaped by Your Choices

    • Explore four regions, uncover hidden clues, rescue Ria’s mother, and save humanity in the [Humanity True Ending].

    • Or embrace the virus, gain complete control over its power, become an immortal being, and rule over the world as the [Zombie Queen True Ending].

    • Your choices will determine which fate awaits Ria.

  • Over 60 Endings, Shaped by a Hidden Identity

    • There is an entire world of careers and possibilities waiting for Ria. Even if she secretly craves the scent of blood and can only move freely at night, you can raise her to become the kingdom’s finest noblewoman, a brilliant artist, or even a ruthless information broker.

    • Each path can lead to different outcomes, with both human and secret zombie variations waiting to be discovered.

  • A Different Fate Every Playthrough — The Marriage System

    • At the beginning of each playthrough, one true prince is randomly selected from four candidates.

    • Observe subtle hints, uncover his identity, and build a relationship that may lead to marriage and the secrets hidden behind the world.

    • And sometimes, Ria may end up marrying someone you never expected—not a prince at all.

  • A Daily Life of Love and Discipline

    • Every month, manage Ria’s education, part-time jobs, and rest to nurture both her abilities and her well-being.

    • Keep an eye on her stress, and sometimes treat her to a delicious home-cooked meal. After all, that’s part of being a father.

  • Dangerous Adventures Beyond Home

    • Venture into the wilderness beyond the village and explore dangerous fields in search of clues.

    • Collect the hidden pieces of a mystery and gradually uncover the truth behind Ria’s fate.

  • And Then, Her Fate Is Revealed

    • After eight years, the tears Ria has shed and the time you have devoted to her will finally bear fruit.

    • One of 60 different destinies awaits her.
data.about_the_game:

Inspired by the cozy, nostalgic charm of classic life-raising simulation games, this game blends the warmth of raising a daughter with a cruel and bittersweet suspense: your daughter is slowly turning into a zombie.

Five years ago, when a mysterious plague swept through the forest, her mother used a life-draining spell to protect her daughter, Ria. But tragically, crimson veins have begun to spread across Ria’s delicate, pale skin, while her body grows colder with each passing day.

As her father, you will spend eight years caring for Ria, teaching her, and sending her into the dangerous world beyond your home.

Behind the peaceful rhythm of everyday life, a vast conspiracy and a hidden truth are slowly closing in.

And when the truth finally comes to light, what kind of fate will await your daughter?

data.name: Granvil's Fairytale
data.detailed_description:
Granvil Arrives With An Arcade Challenge!




Granvil's fairytale is a new platform game from the one-man Voltic Solutions studio. Granvil's brother, Bloin challenges his brother to try and get him. The dwarf, trying to impress his older siblings, tries and runs through the levels to catch up with Bloin. Many surprises and obstacles await him on the road, but his dear brother always tries to warn his Granvil.

3d Platformer!

Each level is handcrafted by the creator. It has rich graphics, full of details and depth. Interesting surroundings make a very nice aesthetic impression and can please the eye.

Interesting Obstacles!

Do you think everything will be as simple as on the first level? You're wrong! The first ten levels are a kind of introduction to the world and getting used to the controls. Each next one gets harder and harder! Timing, cleverness and determination! Try your hand and prove to Bloin that Granvil is a dwarf of flesh and blood, and he is not afraid of challenges and new worlds!

New Worlds!

The creator predicted further lands in which Granvil will try to show his skills. The new places will be the next tests. Sometimes tricky riddles will embarrass many players. Slippery surfaces can confuse even Bloin! Don't be surprised and pay attention to the details! New worlds are coming soon, stay tuned for updates!

data.name: Sicaria
data.detailed_description:
Join our Discord server!


About the Game

​Step into the shadows of Antwerp and shapes events during this crucial moment.

Sicaria is a third-person stealth game set in ​Antwerp during the Eighty Years' War.
You play as an engineer, a person capable of overcoming any challenge through your own cleverness. Because of the war you lost an arm, but you were able to build a mechanical one. ​

​Stealth-Centric Gameplay​

Emphasize stealth and infiltration as the primary gameplay interaction.

Use the environment and your skills to remain hidden and accomplish missions undetected to avoid death.

Historical Setting​

You are immersed in a realistic reconstruction of the city during the Eighty Years’ War. You feel inside a dangerous urban warfare. ​

Use the city structure to your advantage, explore multiple pathways and take advantage of the verticality.​

data.name: Sex On The Beach
data.detailed_description:
This video game is a fun, daring, somewhat melancholic visual novel, and certainly a very deep one. Although everything depends on the decisions you make according to the options presented to you.

 

It is a 1–2 hour story in which you will have access to up to 4 explicit sex scenes and, best of all: every single image that makes up each scene is animated!

 

The basic premise is simple: a vacation trip to a remote island in Japan, touristy and paradisiacal. Your goal is to visit your friend Kana, but once you are there, you will meet other characters with whom you can build different kinds of relationships: friendship, romance, casual sex, lust, and much more.

 

 

The possibilities are very numerous, and having some kind of relationship with Kana is quite possible, despite the fact that until then, she and you had only been friends.

 

 

The whims of fate make you run into your ex-girlfriend, Rina, once again. Although perhaps it is not only fate after all, since you met Kana because she was a friend of Rina.

 

 

You will explore moments from your past, memories shown in black and white, where you will be able to see what your relationship with Rina was like.

 

Thanks to these memories, you may be able to choose more clearly whether you want to reconnect with Rina or whether you prefer to leave the past behind and move on with your new life.

 

 

If you choose not to hold a grudge and to build a new life with people from your past, you will also discover what kind of relationship Rina can establish with other characters in the story.

 

 

Although the story with Rina can lead to different moments and who knows? Perhaps old passions will arise again, or the two of you will try to rebuild a love that has not yet gone out.

 

 

But there are many more characters in this place!

 

Naoko, a fun and lively girl, loves nudism. As soon as you meet her, she herself will suggest that you take part in her wild habits.

 

 

And Naoko is not only interested in nudism: she is also interested in you. So if you make the right choices, this story may lead the two of you to an intimate moment.

 

 

This fun woman seems to get along with everyone, so you will also discover how she interacts with other characters in the story and makes daring comments to them.

 

 

You will also meet Megumi. This girl, in love with poetry and writing, has a harsh personality and can sometimes be a little unpleasant. Getting along with her is quite a challenge!

 

 

However, she is also a very lustful girl, and even eager to please, so if she invites you to her house, do not doubt that it will be a delight.

 

 

Discover how all these characters relate to one another and enjoy the different stories on offer.

 

 

Depending on the choices you make, sometimes you will be surprised to discover what kind of friend you are to them, and the different ways you have of having fun together.

 

 

We know that the translations into different languages may contain mistakes, since we currently use artificial intelligence for them. We promise to improve this aspect soon! We only hope that you enjoy the game, its replayability, and that you tell us in the comments what kind of storyline you built through your decisions. Have fun!

 

Main features:
• Adult visual novel with multiple choices.
• Explicit erotic content.
• Multiple endings and narrative combinations.
• Manual save and rollback system.
• One-click control.
• Adjustable sound and music options.
• All characters are over 21 years old.
• We stay in touch with our players; if you’d like to send feedback or suggestions, you can reach us by email or through messages on our Steam page.

data.name: Welding Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welding Simulator is a realistic, first-person welding simulation that allows you to learn and master various metal joining and cutting techniques. In the game, you will play the role of a welder who gains experience by performing various tasks. You will learn MMA, MIG and TIG methods, and you will be able to experiment with different materials and tools to create precise and durable structures.

Key Features:

  • Authentic Welding Techniques – practice MMA, MIG, and TIG.

  • Cutting and Processing – precisely cut and adjust elements.

  • Various Projects – create metal tables, bike frames, go-karts and other complex structures.

  • Workshop Customization – upgrade gear, organize tools, and expand your space.

  • Career Mode – earn money, invest in equipment, and tackle bigger challenges.

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to sharpen your technique, Welding Simulator offers a safe, accessible way to explore the craft of welding.

data.name: KeyLess
data.detailed_description:
In Keyless, you embark on a thrilling journey where your PC-keyboard becomes both your greatest challenge and key to progress.

As you navigate through this jump-and-run puzzle adventure, you need to regain control over your keyboard, to move forward, tackling logic puzzles along the way. Prepare to challenge your mind with innovative, never-before-seen puzzles that will push the boundaries of logic and creativity.

Navigate seamlessly between 2D and 3D movement mechanics, adding depth and complexity to your journey.

However, your journey is not just about solving puzzles — it is a deep dive into the ongoing conflict between poets and logicians.

As you uncover the roots of their dispute, you will be able to decipher the strange scheme that led to your scrambled keyboard.

This battle of intellect and creativity pulls you in, making you an integral part of the struggle.

Immerse yourself in a world where beautifully composed music sets the tone for an extraordinary adventure.

Experience stunning low-poly visuals that bring the poets' realms to life, contrasting sharply with the rigorous architectural design of the logicians' areas.

Throughout your adventure, you will stumble upon mathematical oddities crafted by the logicians, challenging your perception of logic and reason.

Simultaneously, you will discover famous poetic quotes, offering a different perspective and enriching your understanding of this unique world.

Keyless is not just a game; it is an intellectual and artistic journey, urging you to think outside the box, question conventions, and ultimately, reclaim control — one key at a time.

data.name: Urban Struggle
data.detailed_description:
THE URBAN STRUGGLE HAS STARTED
 

 The battleground is all the São Paulo city in Brazil, almost in the year 2099, when a rebel a military man start a riot that engulfed all this Megalopolis into chaos to try seize the govern with power using his minions to defeat all the resistance. That's where solitary wolves enter in the fray to stop the man the incident knowed as THE RIOT OF SÃO PAULO.

 URBAN STRUGGLE is a classic fighting game that have a simplified Game System to reach all kind of players with a classic Retro appeal using 8 Bits graphics and deep possibilities using all the features of the game.

GAME SYSTEM

NORMALS:

  • A: Weak attack

  • B: Strong attack

  • C: Trait Skill

  • D: Manifest

TRAIT SKILL

 Every character have an individual feature that allow him to use a skill like a tool that are different for each character and can be enhanced during the Manifest Mode.

MANIFEST MODE

 The Manifest Mode is a manifestation of the Faith of each characters that are based in the creed of the Deities. Each Deity have a particular power and only if the person have a big belief in that god, he can have super powers. There is a big mistery around the origin of the Deities but all that we know is they are around here before the humankind

 During the match, all characters can activate the Manifest Mode and reach the full potential of his creed and all his skills and movement are increased, specially super moves, that costs Special Gauge and have special effects, The wise use of the Manifest Mode and Normal Mode can lead you to the victory.

SUPER IMPACT  and HYPER IMPACT

 All the characters have two hyper moves that can be used in both modes, but they are not the version of the same movement but both costs 1 gauge bar. 

The move lists and How to Play guides you can see at the game file or in our Youtube Channel

YOUR NEXT INDIE FIGHTING GAME
 This game is a dream that come true for a short team that always loved the classic fighting games and don't stop playing it nowadays, that's why URBAN STRUGGLE have a classic design but modern concepts, but keeps the motion of directional buttom to make the super moves.

PIRITUBA HILLS STUDIO IS:
- Ulissan: Pixel Artist, Character Designer

- Chris Ketchem: Pixel Artist, Stage Designer

- Nana Yaw Baah (TheJetParadox): Original Themes and SFX

- vo1cel1k3thund3r: Announcer

 We are really glad and honored by your visit, try our DEMO and give to us a chance.

data.name: Banners & Frontlines
data.detailed_description:
Command historical armies one formation at a time. Infantry can hold a front while bowmen wear down the enemy, but committing your reserves too soon may leave another line exposed. In Banners & Frontlines, every formation represents a body of troops-and every order shapes the battle.

Hold the line. Choose your moment.

Deploy into support positions, contest the frontlines and spend limited command points where they matter most. Press an advantage, bring up reinforcements or pull back a battered formation to reform. Breaking enemy formations wears down the army's Resolve; protecting your own can matter as much as dealing damage.

Build an army that fights together

Combine infantry, ranged troops, cavalry and artillery with Orders, battlefield equipment and commanders. Some troops can fight independently or join another formation as a supporting Wing. Choose a Battle Banner to shape your army's strengths, then use your commander's ability when the opportunity comes.

Command across the battlefields of history

Lead historical armies across different eras and regions, including the Hundred Years' War and Sengoku Japan. Each campaign brings its own commanders, forces and battlefield pressures. Contest crossings, fight through sieges and respond to reinforcements and changing objectives. Read the briefing, watch the unfolding events and adapt your plan to the war in front of you.

Make your own fortune in Free Company

Lead a mercenary company through a roguelite campaign of contracts, recruits and captured banners. Choose your Captain Art, assemble the troops you will take into battle and decide whether a new recruit is worth the wages. Resolve carries between battles, while pay, recovery and recruitment compete for your coin. Winning the next fight is only part of keeping the company on the road.

Explore the history behind your army

Explore the troops, commanders and campaigns in the in-game historical library. Build and test an army in Skirmish, or learn deployment and command through the guided tutorial.

data.name: PAATH-Z
data.detailed_description:
A devastating alien pathogen, unearthed from the frozen depths of Antarctica, has unleashed chaos across the world. Once hailed as humanity's greatest discovery, the pathogen now fuels the ambitions of the shadowy Power Consortium—a ruthless alliance of corporations bent on weaponizing its horrifying potential. In the midst of this chaos, the PHANTOM Initiative rises to challenge the darkness.

Step into the boots of Dominic "Shadow" Kane, a BlackOps operative, as you infiltrate the heavily guarded Divinus Island. Your mission: dismantle the Consortium's operations, uncover the truth behind their sinister experiments, and survive the horrors they’ve unleashed. From high-tech labs to derelict villages swarming with abominations, each step brings you closer to the heart of the nightmare.

PAATH-Z features adrenaline-pumping combat, a gripping storyline, and richly detailed environments. Battle against relentless enemies—both human and mutant—in a fight where every decision could mean the difference between life and death. Uncover the dark secrets of the PAATH pathogen and confront the moral cost of humanity’s ambition.

Experience a reimagined vision of survival horror with modernized gameplay and immersive visuals that bring the terror to life. PAATH-Z is more than a game—it’s a descent into a world where survival is a luxury, and the fight for humanity’s future has just begun.

data.name: ViviEon
data.detailed_description:
ViviEon is a chill match-3 puzzle game. Unlike a regular match-3, blocks won't disappear the moment you match them. Instead, you have a set number of moves to match as many blocks at once as you can. When you're happy with your matches (or you've run out of moves) end your turn to remove all matched blocks simultaneously. When your next turn beings, a new set of blocks will fall in to replenish your supply. Should the stack of blocks ever reach the top row, it's game over.

- Endless arcade mode. See how high you can score!
- Compatible with keyboards and PS4/Xbox 360/Xbox One controllers.
