data.name: Synthwave Driver
data.detailed_description:
A nostalgic road trip on an endless highway, driving iconic '80s cars through a neon-filled paradise. Let the synthwave/retrowave soundtrack guide you toward the horizon, leading you into a world of nostalgic vibes.

The road stretches infinitely, taking you back to a simpler time, where palm trees sway gently in the warm breeze. As the rhythm takes over, you enter a state of serene reflection, racing through a universe where time is measured in moments of calm and nostalgia.

As you accelerate, you'll unlock new worlds and over 15 iconic vehicles, each offering customization options and upgrades. For competitive players, each world features an online leaderboard, allowing you to compete globally or with friends for the highest scores.

  • Over 15 Vehicles : Each with unique characteristics and a first-person view.

  • Soundtrack : An extensive library of Synthwave/Vaporwave/Retrowave tracks.

  • Gameplay : 5 different game modes.

  • Garage : Personalize it your way, by changing the flooring and wallpaper, as well as decorative objects.

  • Vehicles : Acquire new vehicles and improve your performance, as well as customize them the way you want.

  • Scenery: Explore over 10 worlds, each offering different atmospheres and feelings.

  • Rain Mode : Want more vibes? Or just chill with the sound of rain on your windshield.

  • Custom Music : Load up your own songs and drive to your perfect playlist.

  • Leaderboards : Chase high scores on global and friends' leaderboards.

  • Cool Vibes : Brings back fond memories of simpler times.

Let's hope to survive INVITATION, a first-person survival horror game
As Max, a graduate of Brownstone School and the subject of the experiment,
Explore schools like hell and discover the terrible secrets behind them.
Find a way to escape and avoid it to survive.
Good luck.

Max graduated from Brownstone School, a second-generation victim of radiation.
I was unhappy that I always had the same number in my class when I was in school.
When I was in elementary school, my eyesight got worse, so I went to ophthalmology, but I couldn't find the cause.

A mysterious invitation arrives in the mailbox for Max, a busy office worker.
It's Invitation to the reunion at Brownstone School. The date, place, and destination were specified. But I know Brownstone school was closed because of financial difficulties.
"Don't you think you'll find out when you go?" I accepted the mysterious reunion invitation with my curiosity behind me.
a closed school before one's eyes 'Are you a little early?'
I can't see anyone but me. Shall we go in? Open the door as if to break up the accumulated memories.

True Survival Fear: You must find a way to escape and escape to survive.

invisible fear: Not only do you feel fear with your eyes. Feel the fear of being invisible.
Unpredictable Experiment: If you don't find the study of the experiment, you'll never be able to survive.

data.name: EARTH:3000
data.detailed_description:
Earth: the year 3000…
EARTH:3000 is a survival RPG made with the Unreal 5 engine, set in a post-technological dark age.

Centuries have passed since the apocalypse. History is mostly forgotten, but relics of past eras remain. Swords and muskets exist alongside mutants and cyborgs.

Create a custom character and explore the mysteries and dangers of the wasteland! Will you search the ancient ruins for knowledge, or loot them for treasure? Fight other players and steal their items, or work together to build a new civilization? Rule over a city, or journey to distant lands - and maybe even find a way off of this doomed world?

Planned features (subject to change prior to release)
  • Survive in a future dark age wasteland
  • Fast-paced, full-loot PVP
  • Control towns and hire NPC guards
  • Loot ancient ruins for rare artifacts
  • Mix of mostly low-tech melee and ranged weapons
  • Play as a mutant, cyborg or techno-mage (very rare)
  • Defend against bandits... or become one
  • Fly across the deserts in a sandship or airship
  • Form caravans to trade resources
  • (or rob merchants and steal their goods!)
  • Fight for territory against rival factions
  • Journey to the toxic oceans and acid rainforests
  • Discover clues to the earth's lost secrets
  • Travel to SPACE
  • ...and more!

data.name: Hello Stranger
data.detailed_description:
Cam conducts his entire life from his electronically automated smart-home. Work, shopping, entertainment and most notably: socialising. Cam interacts with strangers on the platform Hello Stranger: a randomised video chatting application.

Eventually, he encounters a masked stranger with an altered voice. Unnerved, Cam leaves the call only to find the stranger has hacked his smart-home and locked him in. The Stranger tells Cam that he must win three rounds of games or it is ‘game over’. Viewers must make decisions and play the 3 games for Cam to survive but one wrong choice could lead to a grisly end.

This FMV psychological horror-thriller game features:

  • Choice-based mechanics and mini-games including 10 unique endings.

  • Two story modes: 

    - Cinema Mode: Limited games that only function with decision-making system – closer to an interactive film experience.

    - Game Mode: All games available with a variety of gameplay systems – a full FMV game experience.

  • Two game modes:

    - Timed Choices: A more immersive, pressured experience.

    - Paused Choices: For group play / audience participation during live streams.

  • A graphic Story Tree of all possible narrative branches. These branches unlock as the player progresses through the pool of 4 hours of filmed content, 16 mini games and 10 endings which all need to be seen to understand the full picture of 'Hello Stranger'.

  • Renowned acting talent, including George Blagden ('Vikings'), Danny Griffin ('Fate: The Winx Saga), Christina Wolfe ('FBI: International'), Laura Whitmore ('Queenie'), Kulvinder Ghir ('Goodness Gracious Me'), Yasmin Finney ('Heartstopper') and Derek Jacobi (Gladiator).

Paul Raschid - the writer-director, is one of the world's most prolific creatives in the FMV game format. His other titles include: 'The Complex', 'Five Dates', 'Ten Dates' and 'The Gallery'.

Paul Raschid - the writer-director, is one of the world's most prolific creatives in the FMV game format. His other titles include: 'The Complex', 'Five Dates', 'Ten Dates' and 'The Gallery'.

This salt-transmutation appears to be caused by a mysterious species of white dragonflies. The Princess of Grak Kingdom went missing a hundred years ago. The Grak Palace also inexplicably collapsed at around the same time. However, a girl who might be the Princess has been sighted in the Old Town recently. data.name: ORIKA : Rise From The Crash
data.detailed_description:
ORIKA is a fun 3D action-adventure and story-rich game inspired from 3D Platformer games, where the robot ORIKA sets out to clean up polluted water environments.
Explore beautiful landscapes, solve puzzles, and overcome challenges in this exciting adventure to restore clean water. Join ORIKA on this thrilling journey to make the world a better place!

Explore beautiful landscapes, solve puzzles, and overcome challenges in this exciting adventure to restore clean water. Join ORIKA on this thrilling journey to make the world a better place!


Story Of ORIKA

Awakening at the bottom of a polluted lake near a ruined factory, ORIKA, a small robot with a lost memory except for its name, emerges from the water to receive signals from a nearby boat. Through the radio, a former factory worker, now imprisoned for sabotaging the polluting facility as he told ORIKA, pleads for ORIKA's help. He urges ORIKA to use the boat to clean up the water and sell the waste to upgrade the vessel. In return, he promises assistance in restoring ORIKA's memories. Join ORIKA on this quest to cleanse the environment, enhance the boat, and unravel the mystery of its forgotten past!

data.name: PixelCraft VR
data.detailed_description:
PixelCraft VR is a sandbox game that allows you to construct 3D models out of colorful 3D pixels. Our user interface has been carefully tuned to be simple, intuitive, and enjoyable. You can move around the environment with your left controller and build with your right one. The game also includes handy features to streamline the building process:

FEATURES

  • Add, remove, and move 3D pixels
  • Fill and clear areas
  • Cut, copy, and paste groups of 3D pixels
  • Rotate and mirror selected groups of 3D pixels
  • Select any color on the RGB spectrum
  • Sample any color from an existing 3D pixel
  • Color fill a group of 3D pixels
  • Measure objects from one pixel to another
  • Change pixel scale from 0.2 to 20.0 inches (5 to 500 millimeters)
  • Fly and teleport around the environment
  • Undo/redo operations
  • Select black or white background
  • Save and load projects
  • Sample models include a house, living room, spaceship, car, and pistol

PERFORMANCE

Your models can grow to contain a very large number of 3D pixels. To ensure best performance, the game comes with optional project bounds and brush limits. It is recommended to stay within those limits, but they can be disabled from the options menu.

With Comedia captured, you must guide Jaxx to rescue her AND stop the map from falling into the hands of those diabolical, evil, merciless, despicable, Clowns!

data.name: Blah Blah Family
data.detailed_description:
A weird, funny, and slightly suspicious adventure.
You're visiting your girlfriend’s family for the first time. She’s lovely. Her family? A little... unconventional. But hey, you're just here to be polite, help out, and enjoy a quiet weekend in the countryside.

You’ll spend time with her relatives, take on a few simple tasks, and explore the house and surrounding areas at your own pace. Everything seems fine... if a little odd, but nothing you can’t brush off with a smile and a bit of patience.

And sure, if you start to get the strange feeling that something’s off or that the family might have... other intentions, well, that’s probably just your imagination. After all, they’ve never done anything wrong to any of the other boyfriends!

As you journey through the game, you'll interact with environments and characters, discovering the family’s peaceful routines while engaging in casual activities with your girlfriend. Little by little, you’ll find yourself questioning the seemingly ordinary moments and the people around you, all while making choices that shape how things unfold.

Everything will feel smooth and carefree, with you and your girlfriend enjoying a simple, fun weekend together. The family will be warm and welcoming... At least, that’s what you tell yourself on your way to the house!

Key Features:

  •  A narrative-driven experience full of offbeat charm

  •  Delightfully weird characters with questionable social norms

  •  Light exploration and surreal situations

  •  A dry mix of humour, tension, and "wait, did that really happen?" moments

  •  A one-way trip into polite discomfort

data.name: Surface Doctrine: Crater
data.detailed_description:
Surface Doctrine: Crater is a niche role-playing game about the fates of three protagonists in a cruel and little-understood world whose very origin remains a mystery. Each hero sees this world in their own way, faces their own trials, and meets people whose reputation, faith, and sense of righteousness are rarely simple or unambiguous.

You will be able to play as any of the three protagonists. Their stories cross the same places, conflicts, and inhabitants of Crater, but each path reveals a different view of what is happening. Where one hero sees a threat, another may find an opportunity; where one is powerless, another may be able to change the course of events.

In Surface Doctrine: Crater, dialogue choices affect not only character relationships, but also the difficulty of what comes next. A careless word may close a path, strengthen enemies, cost you someone’s help, or make future scenes more dangerous. Attentiveness, cunning, compassion, or cruelty may instead open alternative solutions, new items, allies, or unexpected consequences.

Try to avoid conflict — or go looking for trouble. Buy equipment, brew tinctures, steal, uncover hidden stashes, bargain, interfere in other people’s lives, and speak with the inhabitants of Sa-Tae. The game includes mini-games tied to specific character actions: combat techniques, crafting, reading, alchemy, and other situations where success depends not only on stats, but also on the player’s input.

The world reacts to your actions. Some decisions change available scenes, character lines, prices, rewards, the danger of encounters, and the way people perceive your hero. Sometimes the consequences are immediate. Sometimes they return later — in another scene, another dialogue, or another route.

Behind caricature, foolishness, cruelty, or faith, there is almost always a less obvious human experience. Surface Doctrine: Crater is a game about righteousness and deceit, the causes of human actions, the cost of survival, and whether one can remain oneself in a world that refuses to explain its rules.

data.name: Hope is Fading
data.detailed_description:
SOLO PROJECT
My name is Rens, I have about 20 years experience with 3D and have been working with video games for 15. I have worked with DICE, Epic, Sony, Intel, Sledgehammer | Battlefield 3, 4, hardline, COD. With Positions ranging from 3D Artist, Environment Artist, Expert TA to Technical Art Director. I have shipped games on a range of platforms, including PS3, PS4, PS5, 360, XBOXONE, XBOXSX and integrated graphics.

Any form of support is greatly appreciated to help push things forward and grow into a small, specialized studio.



CURRENT STATE
As a technical foundation, it incorporates a lot of the functionality that will be found in the main game. However it is the first implementation, every system needs a lot of work to bring it up to final quality. You can play through in about 30 minutes.

CURRENT FOCUS
+ Visual Benchmark
+ Enemy behavior
+ Additional armor and weapon parts and upgrades
+ Abilities
+ Crafting and resources
+ Overhaul menus and UI
+ Narrative and mission design

EARLY ACCESS REWARDS TO BE CLAIMED IN THE FULL RELEASE
+ Two exclusive full Armor Skins (stats can be transferred to these items)
+ Each armor part has a unique variation in appearance that can be unlocked through crafting
+ Special drone companion skin
+ Two unique banners (both flag and frame can be used separately)
+ Unique background (3D environment) for previewing your character in the menu
+ Unique Battle rifle, Assault rifle, and shotgun variation

Hope is Fading 
is set in the distant future, where you play a robotic character lost and separated from its combat unit. Facing a losing battle, you are the last hope against the relentless corrupted machines that are pulling the world apart.

Complete a Failed Mission in a Ruined World
Step into the aftermath of a catastrophic event, where everything now lies in rust and ruin. It’s your job to pick up the pieces of a mission left incomplete.

Confront the Horde
Fight off swarms of robotic combat units designed for war.
Survive encounters with zombie like wanderers who stagger through the wreckage.

Scavenge and Craft
Track down raw materials and blueprints scattered throughout the environment or looted from defeated enemies.
Forge stronger armor that boosts your resilience against overwhelming odds

Energy Management
Keep a close eye on your power core, ensuring your energy levels remain high enough for crucial abilities.


Weapon Upgrades
Enhance damage output, reload speed, or customize crosshairs.

data.name: Balloon Blowout
data.detailed_description:
Balloon Blowout invites you to pop weird and wacky balloons! In this colorful puzzler, balloons have escaped and you must pop them all before they get away. You get points for each popped balloon and additional points for grouped balloons or for popping balloons of identical color. Balloons come in different colors and some have funny facial expressions, while others contain surprising powers. Experienced balloon-poppers seeking the ultimate challenge can test their skills in Survivor Mode, where the objective is to gain as many points as possible before 20 balloons escape.

KEY FEATURES

  • Amusing balloons with funny faces
  • 45 challenging balloon-popping levels
  • Points- and star-system
  • Hilarious sound effects
  • Survivor mode with endless play

Solo is a simplistic singleplayer gamemode where enemies fly at you and you use different rockets to evade them and force them to crash into your trail; New rockets and multiplayer emotes are available through a points and upgrades system based on how many enemies you kill in a game.

2-4 FFA - try to defeat everyone else in a free for all


1v1 VOLLEY - hit the ball at the centre of the map into the enemy's goal


1v1/2v2 CTF - capture the flag from the centre of the map and put it in the enemy's goal

data.name: Olliefrog Toad Skater
data.detailed_description:
Olliefrog Toad Skater is the amphibian-based skateboarding game where its easy to be steezy! Create your own little custom cute frog or toad and hit up the local skatepark for a brief skating session, OR tackle the more extensive story/career modes and ollie, grind, and kickflip your way to the top.

Buttery Smooth and Squishy Skating Action


Inspired by the best-of-the-best skating games, Olliefrog Toad Skater prides itself in its faithful recreation of the gamefeel of late 90s and early 2000s skateboarding games. Flatland tricks, flip tricks, grab tricks, grinds, lip tricks, wallrides, wallplants, spine transfers, acid drops, and reverts are all yours to command and combo together.

A Frog in Your Image


While none of the characters in this game have been seen wearing shirts or pants, Olliefrog Toad Skater gives the play just enough customization options to make your amphibian feel like a cute little extension of yourself. We've got enough hats, glasses, wigs, fake moustaches + beards, body colors, body patterns, and enough miscellaneous accessories to make your little frog look like a duck if you wanted to. After all, no one's gonna care that you pulled off a 900 if you weren't wearing something worth looking at.

data.name: Better Days 2
data.detailed_description:
Put on your favorite outfit, pack your gun and ammo, and leave some room in the trunk.

You only meant to search one building—then an airdrop appeared in the distance. You finally found a safe—then the bombardment warning sounded outside. The loot keeps piling up, and your plans to head home keep changing.

💟 Extract now, or get greedy one more time?

Better Days 2 is a single-player PvE extraction shooter combining customizable heroines, first- and third-person combat, real-time tactical outfit changes, driving and dynamic events. Create your survivor, explore a world overrun by strange phenomena, and bring your haul back to base to build up your gear, collection and survival skills.

💟 One purchase. No microtransactions.

🎭 Create your heroine. Choose how she survives.

Shape her face, makeup, hairstyle, body and skin tone, then pick out the clothes you love.

Choose your starting point from 11 professions and combine traits with meaningful trade-offs. Lockpicking, medicine, explosives, vehicle repairs… Different specialties give you different ways to handle the same encounter.

Eight core skills improve through use. Running, fighting, reloading, searching and treating injuries gradually become part of your survival expertise.

👗 A new outfit. A different way to fight.

Bring up to three outfits on a raid and switch between them in real time using nanotech.

Light effects and transformation animations accompany outfit changes that activate tactical abilities: recover, change how you move, or prepare for your next shot. Time your switch and make changing clothes part of your combat strategy.

Each outfit can also carry tactical chips. Research, program and modify them to combine different modifiers and effects into your own combat style.

🔫 Aim in first person. Head into action in third person.

Switch between first- and third-person views to suit the situation. See your own body in first person, or watch your character's movements, outfit and surroundings in third person.

Prepare your guns, magazines and ammunition. Fit compatible attachments and hunt for equipment with the modifiers you want. You can also turn to melee attacks, fragmentation grenades, smoke grenades, flashbangs, Molotov cocktails and decoys.

Watch your surroundings: explosive barrels can set off chain reactions, burning areas can block routes, and gunfire or explosions may attract fresh trouble.

🚗 There's still room in the trunk.

Drive between homes, factories, clinics, logistics centers and other locations. Find something good? Load it into the trunk and head for your next target.

Your vehicle is both transport and a mobile stash. Haul more loot while keeping an eye on fuel, vehicle condition and cargo weight.

Back at base, refuel, repair and expand your cargo space. Next time out, you can make even bigger scavenging plans.

🌦️ What will this raid bring?

Rain, snow and sandstorms affect movement and supplies, making the choice between shelter and open ground matter. Find cover when bombardment warnings sound. Watch for approaching threats under a blood moon. A daytime eclipse may bring an eerie encounter of its own.

Chase airdrops, discover classified safes, complete field contracts, or meet unusual visitors who scavenge, flee and drop valuables along the way.

From a single explosive barrel to an event that changes your entire route, encounters large and small weave through your exploration. Even a familiar road may call for a new approach.

🔥 Your greed. Your decision.

Scavenging and combat build greed, raising your greed level and earning summon opportunities. As your greed level rises, so does the threat from enemies.

Spend those limited opportunities to deploy a vehicle, request a supply drop, locate a classified safe, challenge a boss or activate extraction points.

Stock up for more exploration, or seek out a more dangerous challenge? Where to spend your chances—and when to leave with your haul—is up to you.

🏆 Today's haul is tomorrow's confidence.

Bring loot back to base, complete contracts, trade supplies, expand your stash, tune your guns or invest in tactical chip research at the workshop.

Exchange in-game resources for outfits to permanently unlock new looks and tactical choices. Collect strange relics with special powers, display and upgrade them in your collection room, and choose which ones to take into the field.

A gun that feels right, an outfit you love, a trunk that keeps getting fuller—piece by piece, build your own life after the apocalypse.

Each outfit can also carry tactical chips. Research, program and modify them to combine different modifiers and effects into your own combat style.

🔫 Aim in first person. Head into action in third person.

Switch between first- and third-person views to suit the situation. See your own body in first person, or watch your character's movements, outfit and surroundings in third person.

Prepare your guns, magazines and ammunition. Fit compatible attachments and hunt for equipment with the modifiers you want. You can also turn to melee attacks, fragmentation grenades, smoke grenades, flashbangs, Molotov cocktails and decoys.

Watch your surroundings: explosive barrels can set off chain reactions, burning areas can block routes, and gunfire or explosions may attract fresh trouble.

🚗 There's still room in the trunk.

Drive between homes, factories, clinics, logistics centers and other locations. Find something good? Load it into the trunk and head for your next target.

Your vehicle is both transport and a mobile stash. Haul more loot while keeping an eye on fuel, vehicle condition and cargo weight.

Back at base, refuel, repair and expand your cargo space. Next time out, you can make even bigger scavenging plans.

🌦️ What will this raid bring?

Rain, snow and sandstorms affect movement and supplies, making the choice between shelter and open ground matter. Find cover when bombardment warnings sound. Watch for approaching threats under a blood moon. A daytime eclipse may bring an eerie encounter of its own.

Chase airdrops, discover classified safes, complete field contracts, or meet unusual visitors who scavenge, flee and drop valuables along the way.

From a single explosive barrel to an event that changes your entire route, encounters large and small weave through your exploration. Even a familiar road may call for a new approach.

🔥 Your greed. Your decision.

Scavenging and combat build greed, raising your greed level and earning summon opportunities. As your greed level rises, so does the threat from enemies.

Spend those limited opportunities to deploy a vehicle, request a supply drop, locate a classified safe, challenge a boss or activate extraction points.

Stock up for more exploration, or seek out a more dangerous challenge? Where to spend your chances—and when to leave with your haul—is up to you.

🏆 Today's haul is tomorrow's confidence.

Bring loot back to base, complete contracts, trade supplies, expand your stash, tune your guns or invest in tactical chip research at the workshop.

Exchange in-game resources for outfits to permanently unlock new looks and tactical choices. Collect strange relics with special powers, display and upgrade them in your collection room, and choose which ones to take into the field.

A gun that feels right, an outfit you love, a trunk that keeps getting fuller—piece by piece, build your own life after the apocalypse.
data.short_description: The pioneer of bishoujo extraction shooters returns! Buy once, play solo PvE, no microtransactions. Switch first/third person, change outfits via nanotech mid-raid and fill your trunk with loot. Amid shifting weather and eerie encounters, extract now or get greedy?

data.detailed_description:
Earth is a wasteland, and you're just another scavenger picking through the junkyard. But somewhere out among the stars, the fragments of a starship are waiting.

Stardust Scavenger is a post-apocalyptic sci-fi scavenging adventure. Every chapter is a 30-day journey, and you never quite know what the road holds — a random encounter, a choice that matters, or a pile of scrap worth digging through. Everything you haul back becomes credits, and credits are what get you further next time.

Features

  • 30-day journeys — Each chapter is a month on the road, full of random encounters and decisions, so no two trips feel quite the same.

  • Scavenge to grow — Turn salvaged materials into credits and spend them on HP, attack, and defense upgrades.

  • Six gear slots — Clothes, shoes, gloves and more, each with multiple tiers. Start in rags, end up properly kitted out.

  • Companions at your side — Companions travel with you and fight in their own way: dealing damage, healing, or soaking up hits for you.

  • 6 star sectors, 44 sub-chapters — Clear chapters to earn starship fragments, and raise your gene level to unlock the next sector.

  • Ash Village, your camp — Upgrade, manage equipment and companions, browse the shop, and check the star map before heading out again.

  • A wasteland of enemies — Face humanoids, beasts, and robots, with a speed-up option when you want combat to move faster.

  • Skeletal-animated hero — The protagonist moves with smooth skeletal animation.

Under the stardust, above the ruins — open the manual and start scavenging.

data.name: Runes of Aereal
data.detailed_description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD


About the Game

Runes of Aereal is a fast-paced, horror-themed roguelike deckbuilder set in the shadowy lands of Aereal. Build your deck, and blitz through enemies with a combination of combo-centric cards and items as you explore the land in search of the Runes of Immortality.

Deckbuilder Meets an RPG

Runes of Aereal combines deckbuilding and RPG elements- allowing players to choose from 6 characters with unique traits and abilities, making every playthrough immersive and unique.

Adventure Across the World of Aereal

Explore the vast world of Aereal, visiting towns, unique locations and terrifying monstrosities- experiencing unique and rare events that mean no two runs are the same.

Unlock New Combinations & Grow Your Power

Collect new cards and magical items by slaying monsters, trading in cities, or, even, through Runes of Aereal’s crafting system - transmuting mundane treasure into powerful scrolls.

data.name: Stay Home It Rains Outside
data.detailed_description:
Join the Community


About the Game

Greetings, Settlers!

Welcome to the Alpha Centauri Settlement.
Settler, this is your home. Located near the marshlands of this alien planet, it's the perfect place to rest your worn-out body. I hope you like it.

This place is your digital refuge. Visit whenever things aren't going well. Your stay will help you tackle real-life tasks while keeping you calm and relaxed, by providing built-in productivity features and a soothing environment.



Keep this digital comfort zone on the side of your screen while burning the midnight oil. With its low memory usage and 'Always on Top' feature, you can run it alongside other applications.

Features

This is a hybrid of a productivity tool and game. Use provided productivity features and unlock new customization items as reward.

Productivity Tools


  • Timers
    • A Pomodoro timer and a classic alarm is provided.
  • To-do List
    • Track and complete your real-life task one by one

Customization


  • Customize Your Alien Second Body
    • Choose your current mood, and your alien body will reflect it.
    • Unlock new customization items to make your alien even more stylish

Cozy and Comforting Environment


  • Choose Your Own Focus Music
    • Curated playlists are included
    • Import your own music and create custom playlist
  • Delicate and Versatile Lighting
    • The light from the window will reflect your local time and change smoothly as time passes.
    • Light intensity will adjust based on your settings, including curtain closure or indoor lighting preferences.
  • Friendly Visitors
    • Alpha Centauri is home to cat-like native species, Nyan. They will visit your home from time to time. Greet them and fill your Nyan dictionary.

And More

  • Built-in "Always on Top" setting
  • Low memory usage; runs well with other applications

data.name: Circus of Pain
data.detailed_description:
The circus welcomes everyone… but not everyone leaves.

Circus of Pain is a terrifying psychological horror game where you must survive a deadly circus performance. Waking up in an abandoned circus, you quickly realize that you have become part of a monstrous show. Every corner hides secrets, and sinister creatures are watching your every move.

To escape, you’ll need to solve challenging puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and uncover the dark history of this cursed place. Every step could be your last, as the horrors of the circus do not forgive mistakes.

Immerse yourself in a nightmarish atmosphere inspired by classic horror games and try to find a way out before the circus claims you forever. Are you ready to play your final role?

data.name: Twin Soul
data.detailed_description:
Twin Soul

Is a puzzle horror video game that takes place in an distant and desolate town somewhere in Eastern Europe. A player should face frightful creatures and solve twisted puzzles to survive. The game raises a variety of social problems, the expression of which can be found in the appearance of monsters, the environment and the characters themselves. The goal of the game is to restore the lost friendship between the two protagonists.

The project is heavily inspired by Team Silent, H.R.Giger and David Lynch works. Creating real psychological horror experience is the primary mission of the project.

Story:

[

The game takes place in a post-Soviet industrial city, in a seismically active zone.

There are more and more missing people over the past few years in the peninsula. According to local legends, they all could be the victims of abnormal earthquakes.

Two boys, the orphans, were raised by Kostya’s aunt, replacing their mother. But friends went their separate ways. Dmitry rose to the rank of captain, got into the investigation department and moved to the capital. Kostya became an engineer at a local plant, but he caused the deadly accident, so he was sent to prison.

Two weeks before the game action, an aunt was brutally murdered. Kostya returns to an empty apartment, Dmitry also goes to his hometown suspecting a former friend. An earthquake caught them off guard, so they find themselves locked in a huge empty house full of strange aggressive creatures.

You can choose each of the characters for playing to see the story from both sides. Characters have to work together to move forward and survive, also the player’s actions will affect whether the characters will become friends again or remain enemies.

Gameplay:

[

After the disappearance of a large number of people, you along with other survivors have to try to get out of a residential complex filled with dangerous creatures and puzzles.

Explore abandoned apartments, offices and shops, a vast basement, a bomb shelter and even anomalous spaces.

To survive, you will have to look for weapons and medicines, try to avoid direct encounters. Learn the behavior of creatures to find their weak points and use the environment against them or pit them against each other.

As a result, you can get something more than just salvation from the trap.

data.name: Major Mayhem
data.detailed_description:
Arcade cover shooter inspired by Time Crisis, Metal Slug and 80's action heros! He's got an itchy trigger finger, some scratchy stubble, and a fondness for shooting dudes in the face. Run and gun your way through gorgeous 3D environments as you embark on a mission to rescue your kidnapped girlfriend from the Forces of Evil. Guns, grenades and an assortment of other tools of destruction are at your disposal, and you'll need every last one of 'em. So what are you waiting for, Major Mayhem? The future of the Free World -- and your love life -- hangs in the balance.

Features

  • 45 levels of non-stop action
  • Battle your way past hordes of enemies in three picturesque environments: Tropics, Metropolis and Desert
  • 100 Achievements to earn and collect!
  • 150 Mission objectives (mini achievements). For extended gameplay.
  • 20 different weapons to unleash hell with!
  • Heaps of costumes and hats for the Major.

data.name: Prison Survivors
data.detailed_description:
You're the screws. They're the riot.

Clock on, grab your OC Spray and try to make it through a ten-minute shift in the worst-run prison around. Inmates, crooked guards and a few things that really shouldn't be on the roster pour in from every side. You keep moving; your gear does the rest.

Level up, stack ridiculous prison-issue weapons, evolve them into something the union would never sign off on, and outlast a boss every three minutes. Then the shift ends, an exit opens, and the real question starts: clock off, or stay for the Double Shift?

Features

  • 11 survivors: Harold and Deano clock on from day one. The other nine are earned through achievements, and most come with a ridiculous signature move.
  • 20 weapons, 20 evolutions: OC Spray, Glen40, a Weighted Mop, a Beanbag Shotgun, a Spoon... and what they become when you push them, like Backdraft, The Ladle and Hospital Grade Glen40.
  • 20 passives, plus re-rolls, banishes and lucky evolutions to bend each run your way.
  • 24 bosses: a new one every three minutes and a shiny Mega boss to close out the shift. Say hello to the Warrior Mech, Tony Parmesan, The Bailiff and Ghulk.
  • 7 stages: the Car Park, Security Checkpoint, Visitor Center, Exercise Yard, Infirmary, Isolation and Maximum Security, with 51 enemy types between them.
  • Shift events: riots, contraband drops, escapees and more keep every run off-script.
  • The Double Shift: beat the final boss and an exit opens. Leave with your pay, or stay and earn overtime while things get much, much worse. At twelve minutes the Warden comes down to deal with you personally.
  • The Shift Report: every run ends with the full breakdown. Damage by weapon, kills by enemy, every pick you made, a shower of cash and a verdict on your performance.
  • Equipment Room: spend your pay on permanent upgrades between shifts.
  • 50 Steam achievements (3 of them secret), Steam Cloud saves and full controller support.

Meet the crew

  • Harold, The WOK. Tall, bearded, unbothered. Try to push him around and he just says "nope..."
  • Deano, The Spoon. Starts the shift with a spoon. Makes it work.
  • Trev, Old Hand. Knock him down once and he gets back up with a "WOOOOOO!" that clears the room.
  • Jo, Clean Sweep. "I'm not licked yet... but you are!" You'll see.
  • Anna, By the Book. The lower her health, the bigger her hands. Eventually they drag on the floor.
  • Rams, Iron Roster. Foot pursuit cancelled. He's back, and he's on an e-scooter.
  • Binney, Full Kit. Cool, calm and collected... mostly.
  • ...and Tris, Mogs, Steve-O and the Sarge.

Who made this?

We're Harold and Deano: two 40-something dads with full-time jobs, kids and zero coding or art skills, who always wanted to make a game. Yes, those are our faces on the capsule, and yes, you can play as us.

We built Prison Survivors with a lot of help from AI (Steam's AI disclosure below says exactly how), our own ideas and jokes, and more than 100,000 prompts of "no, make it funnier". It's our first game and we're going to keep updating it.

Every review gets read. Tell us what to fix, what to add, and what to make sillier.

Deano & Harold
Pinched Productions

  • Harold, The WOK. Tall, bearded, unbothered. Try to push him around and he just says "nope..."
  • Deano, The Spoon. Starts the shift with a spoon. Makes it work.
  • Trev, Old Hand. Knock him down once and he gets back up with a "WOOOOOO!" that clears the room.
  • Jo, Clean Sweep. "I'm not licked yet... but you are!" You'll see.
  • Anna, By the Book. The lower her health, the bigger her hands. Eventually they drag on the floor.
  • Rams, Iron Roster. Foot pursuit cancelled. He's back, and he's on an e-scooter.
  • Binney, Full Kit. Cool, calm and collected... mostly.
  • ...and Tris, Mogs, Steve-O and the Sarge.

Who made this?

We're Harold and Deano: two 40-something dads with full-time jobs, kids and zero coding or art skills, who always wanted to make a game. Yes, those are our faces on the capsule, and yes, you can play as us.

We built Prison Survivors with a lot of help from AI (Steam's AI disclosure below says exactly how), our own ideas and jokes, and more than 100,000 prompts of "no, make it funnier". It's our first game and we're going to keep updating it.

Every review gets read. Tell us what to fix, what to add, and what to make sillier.

Deano & Harold
Pinched Productions

data.name: Storybook of Tactics
data.detailed_description:
Storybook of Tactics mixes deck building gameplay with a colorful auto battler. As a commander, you can feel the tactical depth with equipping items, obtaining powers, and placing units of your evolving army to crush multiple waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

Endless replayability

Randomly generated maps across multiple locations, a selection of leaders with unique powers, and risk-and-reward in-game events ensure that surprise awaits at every corner.

Tactical yet accessible auto battler

New players to the genre can quickly understand the rules of making a successful army, and loosing a battle doesn't require a frustrating restart. Auto battler veterans can fight for flawless victories with more difficult map modifiers.

Flexible playstyles

You are free to experiment with the available tactics and choose the right one for your style of play, the rules of the map and the type of enemies.

Colorful 2D art

From animations & UI, diverse locations, appealing visuals of bosses, to design of enemies and skills - everything is colorful and pleasant. But don't let your guard down!

data.name: Chores of Corruption
data.detailed_description:
One day you are living your happy toaster life, then corruption takes over and transforms the entire household into Hell! Your only option - equip a variety of weapons and defeat hordes of enemies while escaping from home.
Defeat wave after wave and equip weapons and items along the way. Collect experience and choose upgrades carefully to create powerful builds.

Features


  • Quick and casual runs
  • Achievement based progression unlocking new characters, weapons and items
  • Auto-aiming weapons
  • Multiple playable characters with unique traits and playstyles
  • Diverse bosses with unique mechanics
  • Corruption system altering gameplay
  • Variety of weapons and items
  • Supports mouse, keyboard and gamepads

Early Access Content


  • 1 stage featuring 7 layouts
  • 6 playable characters with unique traits and playstyles
  • 2 unique bosses
  • 23 unique monsters
  • 51 items
  • 17 different and upgradeable weapons
  • 11 character traits that upgrade characters and weapons
  • 80 achievements

This is the content the early access will start with and will be expanded on until the final release.

Please note that your progression in the game is tied directly to your achievements so even without Steam Cloud Save, you will be able to play on any PC/Steamdeck and keep your progress synced automatically.

Choices matter

After every wave you can select between three cards that can be new weapons, passive items or upgrades to your existing arsenal. Most cards directly influence future selections as the available card pool expands or shrinks into various directions.



E.g.selecting a Weapon Upgrade card will introduce additional duplicate weapons to the current run, enabling a level of control to your future selections. Don't be shy to ReRoll offers every now and then as you have plenty of opportunities to refill your ReRolls over time.

data.name: BRG's Red Riding Hood
data.detailed_description:
Meet Maisie, a child who is loved by all. Maisie decides to visit her sick grandmother. She dons her favorite red coat and becomes Red Riding Hood. Journey with her to experience dazzling visuals and an immersive audio experience. Make a life-changing decision that will affect the story. Experience the dangers and excitement of BRG's Red Riding Hood. This is the ENHANCED Steam version of our Visual Novel that was released on Nintendo's Wii U.

Brave Rock Games is an independent organization that makes interactive software for young audiences. Our current goal is to bring classic stories to digital platforms. We believe reading is fundamentally important to any child's growth. Some children dislike reading due to lack of visuals. We are bringing visual story tales to these children. We have learned that disabled gamers, also enjoy our software due to simplicity of the controls and production value. Lastly, many adults have approached us to give thanks for creating an application they can enjoy with their child.

  • No drama, no lengthy cutscene. Get to the action immediately!

data.name: The Kangaroo Conspiracy
data.detailed_description:
🦘Mainstream in Germany. Completely WTF everywhere else.🦘


(...and fully playable in English)

The Kangaroo Conspiracy is an absurdist retro platformer based on one of Germany’s most popular comedy franchises — a mainstream cult phenomenon about conspiracy logic, anti-authority satire, false wisdom, and a talking kangaroo with red boxing gloves, strong opinions, and a talent for being confidently wrong.

What is this game, exactly?
It’s a retro-inspired pixel-art jump’n’run adventure, following the surreal plot of the film: Marc-Uwe (the human) and the Kangaroo (the marsupial) get sucked into a conspiracy — and also, a computer game. That’s not a metaphor. They literally become pixel characters and must fight their way out while battling conspiracy theorists, questionable logic, and their own meta-commentary.

Features:
  • 21 levels of kangaroo chaos featuring jumping, fighting, puzzling and multiple choice dialog-ing
  • Subgenres include: Jump’n’Run, Jump’n’Box, Puzzle-Adventure-Jumping, and Rhythm-Jumping
  • Funky soundtrack featuring GERMAN RAP, if you can imagine that!
  • 21 decidedly un-cinematic in-game cutscenes with occasional attempts at humor
  • 10 Steam achievements
  • Certified: FUNNY (by Marc-Uwe Kling himself — you can trust him, he’s getting all the residuals)

Achtung!
May contain traces of Wanderlust, Zeitgeist, Fremdschämen, and a very German marsupial from Australia.

data.name: Geolocation Case Files: Road Trip to Robert's Grave
data.detailed_description:
Geolocation, a route to discover, and a decades-old family story waiting to unfold along the way.

Based on a series of dashcam photos taken every minute, your task is to reconstruct the routes taken during a multi-stage journey. You rely entirely on what you can see in the images: road signs, buildings, the lay of the land... By pinpointing your location on the map, you push the story forward. You don't have to determine the exact position of every single photo. To proceed with the story, you only need to pinpoint the location of the final photo in a given stage. However, each location can provide extra clues and make finding the subsequent ones easier.

The game interface is built around simple early-2000s devices: a notepad, an image browser, and a trusted GPS navigation system. No pressure, no rush – just you and the real world.

As your journey progresses, you will uncover fragments of Robert’s story. You are driving to light a candle on a grave. But whose grave will it be?

data.name: Cold Hearts
data.detailed_description:
Cold Hearts is a visual novel about refrigerators, loneliness and the meaning of life. Befriend and date household appliances, melt their frozen hearts, solve the crime story and uncover the truth - the real reason why these girl-fridges made contact with you, of all people!

Developed by two influencers and game developers, Outstar (The Witcher 3, Eventide: Slavic Fable) and Memoriesin8bit (Mothergunship) as a passion project to share the love for visual novels among those new to the genre, as well as experienced players.

Key features:
- no stats grinding to achieve your dream ending - all stories unfold solely by your decisions
- collectibles (fridge magnets) and multiple unlockable artworks in every path
- a mix of comedy and serious themes with sad undertones
- genderless protagonist - let your imagination run free and imagine any protagonist you like, as game won't mention your gender

Includes:
- 6 paths with multiple endings (including secret, unlockable path) and numerous decisions to be made
- 7 romanceable characters
- 20+ endings
- save, skip, rewind - all features you need to comfortably explore every route and ending

Free demo is available right now on game's website and soon on Steam!

data.name: Perish Parade
data.detailed_description:
PERISH PARADE is a dungeon crawling roguelite turn-based RPG with an emphasis on resource management and team synergies. Lead a band of heroes sent on a deathly climb to scale The Tower and save the world.

Features:

- Six playable party members with unique skills and synergies
Assemble your party of heroes, each with their own unique skillset. Equip them with magic relics you've unearthed on the path that can alter how your characters play.

- Beautiful hand-drawn monochrome art
Inspired by the works of Akihiko Yoshida's character design works and Tsutomu Nihei's Tower Dungeon, travel across seven different Tower strata in your journey to the apex of the world.

- Deadly turn-based combat

Hit enemy weaknesses to gain more turns, dodge and block enemy attacks and take their turns away. Arrange your party's formation to lessen the blow of the enemy's attacks. Every decision in combat matters.

- Exhilarating dungeon-crawling adventure
With dungeon-crawling gameplay inspired by DUNGEON ENCOUNTERS and Etrian Odyssey - Deadly monsters, traps, portals, strangers and freaks await as you roll the dice and navigate through each fallen kingdom. Analyze every tile, every enemy patrol, and make an informed decision on where to go next, one wrong step could spell doom for your party.

data.name: Life is Feudal: MMO
data.detailed_description:
Life is Feudal: MMO is a subscription-based MMO set in a medieval world of thrilling risks and unyielding realism. From intense PvP combat and large-scale guild wars to politics and diplomacy, the game is alive with possibilities. With unique crafting mechanics and professions, players can master their domain, build formidable fortresses, and dive deep into guild life for an immersive experience. The return of this legendary game opens the vast lands of Abella once more, offering players the chance to ascend through skillful swordplay or masterful wealth accumulation.


With limitless terraforming and free construction systems, transform any territory into a haven, or construct sky-high fortresses, prosperous villages, and grand fortresses in any configuration. Your creativity is your only limit.




Life is Feudal: MMO offers unparalleled sandbox freedom on an MMO scale. Engage in intense political maneuvering, thrilling battles, and immerse yourself in the complexity of medieval professions. Discover the depth of the crafting system, and shape your own destiny in this expansive world.




Life is Feudal: MMO takes you beyond battle and politics, offering immersive experiences like planting, harvesting crops, hunting or breeding a variety of different animals. Survival has never been this real.




The combat in Life is Feudal: MMO is visceral and real. Weapons must physically hit to cause damage and physics parameters are considered. Stand with your allies in prearranged battles, or test your mettle in solo survival arenas. Victory rewards the spoils of war: claim everything your fallen enemy possessed.




Immerse yourself in true political sandbox gameplay. Engage in authentic, large-scale sieges, guild wars, alliances, and real map land control tactics. Victory means the power to conquer, tax other players' guilds, and even rule whole kingdoms.




In Life is Feudal: MMO, you're never alone. Join one of the hundreds of guilds and shape the beautiful 36x36 km map alongside other players. Every corner of the world is yours to discover.




Life is Feudal: MMO offers complete character customization, from appearance to equipment. Choose your medieval profession and develop it in a way that suits your playstyle. Discover and unlock hundreds of blueprints to enhance your crafting skills, creating a unique experience tailored just for you.




In Life is Feudal: MMO, player feedback is paramount. We value the community's insights, regularly host Q&A sessions, and are always open to suggestions and critique. Players have the opportunity to shape the game's development, directly influencing the evolution of the game world.

data.name: Stop slacking
data.detailed_description:
Game Introduction

Welcome to Happy Campus! This is a multiplayer online party game featuring classic deduction gameplay inspired by *Avalon* and a cute campus aesthetic. 5–10 players take on the roles of adorable campus characters, engaging in a psychological battle of wits and lies across familiar settings such as classrooms, dormitories, and meeting rooms.

Core Gameplay

On the first day of school, a few "slackers" have secretly infiltrated the class! Good students must work together to complete mission tasks, while the slackers seek to slack off, sabotage, and mislead everyone. Each round, a team leader selects members to join the project team, all players vote on whether to approve the team, and those selected secretly determine the success or failure of the mission.

  • Good Student Camp:

Complete 3 missions to win. Among them, the "Class Monitor" can see through the slackers' identities, but once exposed, they become the target of public criticism—they must hide their edge in speech and guide their teammates to make the right choices.

  • Slacker Camp:

Sabotage 3 missions to win. They know each other's identities and can exchange glances and cover for one another. Make good use of lies and acting skills to blend in with the good students and fish in troubled waters.

Game Features

  • 5–10 players online—the more players, the more brain-burning it gets.

  • No character "deaths"—no boring AFK moments.

  • Cute campus characters with a variety of skins to mix and match freely.

  • Real-time voice chat + text chat—unleash your powers of persuasion.

  • Private rooms for fun sessions with friends—freely choose the discussion duration.

Why Choose This Game?

More relaxed than Werewolf, yet more brain-burning than Werewolf! No character "deaths"—no boring AFK moments! Whether you're teaming up with friends or playing with strangers, you'll create the most entertaining campus deduction stories. Dare you trust your teammates? Or are you the slacker hiding a dagger behind your smile?

Join the class now and begin your campus deduction journey!

More gameplay modes will be continuously updated in the future...

data.name: Thugz VS Zombies
data.detailed_description:
The Undead Are Taking Over Tha Block

The neighborhood is under attack, and the only thing standing between the Zombies and your Home is a crew of wild, specialized THUGZ.

Thugz VS Zombies is a cartoon row-defense action strategy game where you place defenders, build cash, unlock new characters, upgrade your squad, and survive increasingly ridiculous zombie waves. Every stage introduces new threats, new tactics, and a boss fight with its own personality.

Build Your Crew

Choose from a roster of unique THUGZ, each with their own role:

  • Ranged attackers who blast Zombies from across the block

  • Melee bruisers who charge forward and scrap face-to-face

  • Defenders who hold the line when things get ugly

  • Passive support THUGZ who generate cash or help your crew stay alive

  • Special units with turrets, fire, shotguns, buffs, and more

Earn cash during each wave, buy more plots, replace old placements, and upgrade your favorite THUGZ to hit harder, survive longer, and fire faster.

Fight Bigger, Weirder Bosses

Every stage builds toward a boss battle. These are not just bigger Zombies with bigger health bars. Bosses move differently, summon helpers, launch special attacks, stun, rush, retreat, and force you to change your strategy.

Survive Earl the Bowler, Badder Bunny, Dead Weed, the Z-Triplets, and the final nightmare herself: MomZom.

Use Special Abilities

Some Zombies drop special abilities that can turn a bad wave around:

  • Drive By - call in a car that rolls through and fires into the Zombie field

  • Freeze Friends - slow the entire Zombie side with icy backup

  • Cash Heist - drop a huge cash bonus when you need it most

Store abilities, spend them at the right moment, and keep the block alive.

Play Solo or Local Co-Op

Play through the campaign alone or team up in local co-op. In co-op, both players defend one larger Home with separate cash pools, separate plots, and shared pressure. Communicate, share cash, and hold both sides of the block together.

{Local Co-Op requires a connected gamepad for the 2nd player)

Fight a Friend in Local Versus Mode

Your friend thinks he can manage a crew better! Prove it! Gather your THUGZ and go one-one VS a friend in local Versus in split-screen mode! Protect your Turf while demolishing there's.

{Local Versus requires a connected gamepad for the 2nd player)

Replay, Upgrade, Survive

Cleared stages can be replayed to earn better scores, experiment with different THUGZ, and prepare for harder fights. Choose your difficulty, build your strategy, and see how long your crew can keep the neighborhood standing.

data.name: Plunder Pack
data.detailed_description:
A rag-tag group of animals makes it their mission to steal from the rich to give to the poor - and it's up to you to plan the heist! Become the leader of the Plunder Pack, research your targets, build gadgets, and make sure your team makes it home safe in this stealth/strategy game. Maybe you'll find both friendship and betrayal along the way.

Features

  • Help the poor & steal from those who wronged them
  • Plan your heist by researching your targets
  • Get to know your gang of thieves through their backstories
  • Open up new ways of stealing by buying gadgets & recruiting new members
  • Break into casinos, museums & mansions as you expose conspiracies across the city
  • Play the way you prefer - from quick & intense to slow & strategic

Be prepared!

Pick a team of thieves with different abilities and choose the gadgets to help you. Will you enter through the basement? Will you bring a drill to break through a wall or have you sent an undercover scout to figure out the secret combination for the backdoor?


The pack works together

Things don’t always go as planned! Pause the game at any time to give new orders to your crew. Create distractions with a stereo to save a cornered thief from being caught, cut the power at the right moment to allow another to pass the security lasers - or even let yourself get spotted to lead the guards on a wild goose chase!

data.name: Furriend
data.detailed_description:
Once upon a time, there was a lonely witch and she wants to have friends to talk and play with.

Sadly, her timidness makes her being bashful everytime she tries to approach someone.



Then one day, a brilliant idea popped out of the witch's head. With her skillful witchcraft, she decided to summon her own friends. But who or what will come out of the summoning portal?

Will it be an orc? A dragon? Or a demon instead?!

Nope, she summons furriends, the pawsome and adorable little creatures to be her friend.



But, how is this pawzzle rituals work...? How it can summon all those cute little furriends...?

Connect the Dot + Merge Puzzle Mechanism

Spawn Paw-friends by dragging the summoning circle around the tiles. Combines the summoning circles to create a new mix and reach the target to complete the level. Each animal have some unique requirements to be spawned, adding more complexity to the puzzles. Can you solve all the puzzles?

Key Features

- Cute visuals & sounds
- Relaxing music
- 20 Introduction Levels
- 3 cute themes

data.name: Kingdoms of Dice - The Elonia Chronicles
data.detailed_description:
Kingdoms of Dice - The Elonia Chronicles is a tactical RPG inspired by dice-based games, set after the events of Fate and Destiny.

Continue exploring the chronicles of Elonia through 4 iconic factions across 4 scripted campaigns.

To succeed in your adventure, enhance your troop of fighters, purchase bonus cards, and roll your resource dice to activate each warrior’s unique abilities.

Inspired by dice-based board games:

Kingdoms of Dice was designed to capture the feel of dice-driven board games. Develop your faction, buy bonus cards, roll resource dice, activate your fighters to face a wide variety of enemies, and more.

Discover 4 unique factions:

The game features 4 emblematic factions from the Elonia universe. Experience each faction’s distinct gameplay through 4 narrative campaigns, each divided into 6 chapters.

Roll the dice and fight:

Survive each chapter by battling a variety of enemies and defeating the final boss. To do so, roll your resource dice and activate your fighters’ diverse abilities. And hope your bonus cards appear quickly!

Upgrade your troops:

Before each new chapter, you can strengthen your group of fighters to become increasingly powerful. Level them up, recruit new warriors, purchase bonus cards with various powers, and more.

Take on even greater challenges:

After completing the 4 main campaigns, test your leadership skills in Advanced Campaigns with increased difficulty and expanded possibilities. Or dive into a Skirmish mode with a randomly generated campaign!

The dice of destiny await you!

data.name: Veridian Expanse
data.detailed_description:
Lost in the Veridian Expanse

The homeworld contracted your company for its first terraforming project, but something has gone terribly wrong... Instead of waking on a fresh new world, you find yourself stranded inside an asteroid, and the arrogant AI that your team was supposed to babysit has decided it's the boss now. Worse still, the surveys said this part of space was supposed to be lifeless... Imagine your surprise to find that your new home is infested with bio-mechanical monstrosities - hungry ones!

Set Lasers to Fun!

Drill, craft, and blast your way through winding caverns. Upgrade your utility pod with plasma cannons, missiles, and laser drills. Build an army of tireless drones to do your bidding. You are going to need every advantage to venture deep into the asteroid's secrets if you want to repair the ship and make your escape. Discover the genesis of this place, or become its lunch.

Terraforming may be the homeworld's last chance for salvation, but sending their best was too expensive. Instead, they stranded you in... the Veridian Expanse.

The Drift Engine

Veridian Expanse is incredibly lightweight; the system requirements are lower than the page you’re reading this on! Written from scratch in C, it runs efficiently for hours, even on a battery powered potato of a computer. The source code is included with the game under the GPL license, so players and tinkerers alike can build it for all kinds of devices. Free from the constraints of existing engines, it's all-in on fully deformable terrain and a lightfield model where everything can emit light, glow, and cast shadows. All while still running smoothly on that trusty potato.

Inspired by game other exploration/crafting like Terraria and Subnautica, though I wanted Veridian Expanse to stand out with it's freely deformable terrain and twin stick combat.

This is our work-in-progress shooter game which we aim to flesh out over the coming months - what is seen here is not representative of the final product.

data.name: World War Party: Game Of Trump
data.detailed_description:
If you love the President, good for you. If you don't, let's have some fun!
If you love shooting the ever living crap out of everyone and everything without remorse, we have the game for you!
Blow the German Krauts into smithereens on the battlefield and raise the proud American flag with the Muricah or Annihilate the Alakbas and Kimchis, it has never been so fun and fulfilling. Ever, period.
This isn't just a game, this is the most exhilarating, graphic and jaw dropping game where no one is best, and everyone is just a little less crap.
Join the battlefield in one of two teams, 8 real players in total, 4 in each team. Maybe your friends can join in too, if they can look past the GORE.
Pick a bone with the old World War buddies and recreate the Great War on the battlefield! But remember, President Trump will be on the great metal war machine and ready to take your attacks all day long! Sure you can hit the others on the battlefield, but Trump is your main target, destroying him means business! Remember to pick up some ammo on the way, so you have a chance against the President's mechanical doomsday contraption! There's rifles, landmines, and shotguns! It's most insensitive way to take the 80 year old revenge, and it is the most satisfying.
If your idiot butt forgot to pick up that ammo on the way, and your weapon jams up because you forgot to clean it, press the boost button and spear the propagandists right in the chest, and take, them, down. Tanks spawn too sometimes, only when Trump breaths heavily on your neck really hard, that hardcore killing machine takes down hundreds, even thousands of the foot soldiers and it is ghoulish! Don't fall into the trap and join any team they throw you in, choose which team you want to join first, because, free will, and play your friends over local Wi-Fi or the internet, it's literally a blast, okay.
The most exciting game to play with your friends!
If they're too busy for your game, grab them by the.. Arm and drag them into the battle arena! Team death match just got a whole new meaning, have fun with this new team game, collateral damage is just another way to take down the real enemy.
Get set, get loaded and remember, don't start World War 3.

data.name: Tiny Bunny
data.detailed_description:
Tiny Bunny Is A Non-linear Horror Visual Novel.

When winter comes, everything falls into slumber - everything except this forest.

There's something wandering its snow-covered paths, lurking behind black trees, and taking whatever it considers due.

It leaves behind strange rumors: voices calling you into the thicket, faces watching through your windows, mysterious prints in the snow, and… a growing number of missing-child posters.

Those who have heard the voice of the forest are beyond help. Their only option is to sink deeper and deeper into its cold embrace and face their final choice in that icy darkness: to stay alive… or to stay human?

Tiny Bunny is a non-linear horror visual novel with a branching plot, inspired by the short story of the same name by Dmitry Mordas. You’ll play as Anton, a young boy who has recently moved to a small, remote town surrounded by forest. In this isolated place, you find yourself pulled into a deepening mystery as unsettling events occur and local children begin to go missing. Your choices determine which paths open up as the danger around the town escalates.

✔ A fascinating horror story that lingers long after the screen goes dark

✔ Your choices carry weight, making every moment tense and unforgettable

✔ Hand-drawn, black-and-white art style 

✔ Bone-piercing original soundtrack

✔ Featuring 20 distinct endings

✔ Disturbing, oppressive atmosphere

✔ Horrifying secrets

Warning! This game contains offensive language and scenes of physical and psychological violence. Proceed with caution!

data.name: Last Group Out
data.detailed_description:
Last Group Out is a casual top-down extraction shooter set in a collapsed society where only survival matters.

Inspired by "Escape from Tarkov" and "The Escapists".

Scavenge & Survive

  • Enter a hostile, abandoned land teeming with danger and opportunity.

  • Grab what you can before time runs out, or risk losing it all.

  • Use your loot runs to level up, grow your wealth, and prepare for greater threats.

Loot, Sell, Upgrade

  • Find gear, weapons, and oddities scattered across the wasteland.

  • Sell what you don’t need to buy stronger equipment.

  • Customize and enhance your weapons with powerful buffs.

Level Up & Evolve

  • Gain XP by defeating enemies, looting gear, and completing quests.

  • Unlock new weapons, equipment, and boss challenges.

  • Upgrade your loadout to match your playstyle: stealthy, aggressive, or something in between.

Use All Your Senses

  • Danger lurks in every shadow.

  • Stop. Look. Listen. Smell.

  • Use your instincts and stealth to stay one step ahead of enemies and rivals.

Solo or Co-op

  • Go it alone, or team up with up to 3 friends.

  • Take on missions, level up, and extract with hard-earned loot, together.

data.name: Chicken Defender
data.detailed_description:
Chicken Defender is a low-poly 2.5D game which takes a slightly different approach from the classic tower defense concept.
In each level you start with a certain amount of chicken which live their life peacefully in their coop. However, as you may know, foxes have chicken on top of their menu. Moreover, the fact that the coop is mysteriously placed in the middle of the forest every time doesn't help. Therefore, the farmer has hired you to take care of his precious birds. Your task is to save as many chicken as possible at the end of the day.

Foxes are also smart animals, so they won't attack all alone; instead, they come in waves. But there's a catch: they won't come on a certain path, but rather from all directions, so you have to be prepared for attacks from all sides.

Before each wave there is a building phase when you can prepare for what's coming next. You can choose between 5 items and 3 power-ups which might help you to achieve your goal. The items can be placed on the map and have different properties:

  • Corn Turret: direct damage
  • Super Water Hose: slow effect
  • Missile Launcher: area damage
  • Not-So-Smart-Catapult: critical damage
  • Fence

Power-ups can be bought and used only once per level:

  • Fox Slower
  • Coop Shield
  • Turret Overclock

After each wave you receive a certain amount of money depending on how well you did so you can purchase more stuff.

At the moment there are 3 levels (easy, medium, hard) and a tutorial level. Being a 2-person team, it is quite difficult to build large-scale games on a very tight budget. Yet, should there be demand, we could add more things in the future. We're hoping you'll have a great time playing this game though and that you won't regret your purchase.

Thank you and have a nice day!

data.name: Friendly Fire
data.detailed_description:
Friendly Fire is a bullet hell survivor with a twist.

You'll need to survive 20 minutes against waves of enemies — but your

greatest threat might be your own weapons.

You can choose from many turrets, each with different strengths. The

stronger the weapon, the bigger the danger to yourself. Your turrets

don't care who they hit — every bullet that lands on you deals damage.

Your only ways to survive: movement, dash, and a shield with limited

durability.

────────────────

[Core Mechanics]

• Your turrets are double-edged — every bullet can hurt you

• Shield system — block and reflect friendly fire, with bonus

damage on deflected shots

• Dash through bullet hell — invincible while dashing

• Stronger weapons = greater self-damage risk

[Content]

• 24 turrets in EA — machine gun, sniper, shotgun, mortar, laser,

homing missile, flamethrower, black hole, sawblade, mine, gatling,

spike trap, echo, parasite shot, railgun, volley, harpoon, plasma,

tuning fork, catapult, drill, caltrop, burning ground, boomerang

• 22 turret upgrades — crit, pierce, ricochet, burn, freeze,

execute, overheat mode, and more

• 50+ player perks — death totem, lifeline, golden time, chain hit,

violent reflection, orbital shield, and more

• 11 enemy types — tanks, swarms, chargers, splitters, suicide

bombers, summoners, and more

• 5 characters — Average Joe, Live Round Purist, Laser Purist,

AoE Specialist, Defensive Build — each with unique bonuses and penalties

• 21 meta upgrades — convert kills into permanent boosts: health,

armor, weapon damage, enemy count, and more

• 3 difficulties — Easy / Normal / Hard

────────────────

[Endless Mode]

• After surviving 20 minutes, choose to continue the challenge

• Enemy HP and damage caps removed — push your skills to the limit

────────────────

[Supported Languages]

• English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese,

Korean, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Italian,

Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Polish

data.name: Reflectron
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the vibrant universe of "Reflectron", an endless arcade game where geometry rules all. One arena, one ball, one score to beat. Armed with a single bouncing ball, face the challenge of a pure and thrilling gameplay where each contact could be fatal.

Immersive Gameplay

Instantly accessible, "Reflectron" is crafted for anyone who desires to plunge right into the action. With intuitive controls and an enticing progression curve, the game offers an unexpected depth that will compel you to come back for more challenges.

Permanent Progression

In "Reflectron", what you do in one run carries into the next. Meeting objectives unlocks permanent additions to your options: an extra reroll, the ability to swap an upgrade you already own, a power-up to start the run with. A perk never makes you stronger on its own, it widens what you are able to do. Nothing is bought, everything is earned.

Challenges

Runs with their own rules, and their own way to fail. One caps your build and forces you to trade an upgrade away for every new one. Another takes every pickup off the field. Beat them and they open options you keep for good.

Visuals and Sound

Behold a visual ballet where each shape and color comes alive to the beat of a strong electronic soundtrack. Every shape is drawn by code rather than painted, so the arena stays razor sharp at any resolution, and the grid bends and lights up under everything that happens on it. The visual effects are not just a feast for the eyes; they are the vibrant feedback accompanying every one of your moves.

Competition

In "Reflectron," every game is a competition for the highest score. Face off against other players and prove your skill in this competitive environment where only perseverance is rewarded.

Key Features

  • Endless Arcade: A continuous challenge where the goal is to survive and thrive.

  • Seven Enemy Archetypes: They chase, shoot, split, copy themselves or simply refuse to die.

  • Dynamic Power-ups: Game-changing enhancements that ramp up the intensity of play.

  • Permanent Progression: Unlock new options by meeting objectives, never by paying for them.

  • Dynamic Visuals: A visual world that syncs with your performance and the beat.

  • Global Leaderboards: Compete against players around the world for a top spot.

  • Windows and Linux: A native build for each, and it plays on Steam Deck.

"Reflectron" is not just a game; it's an ongoing challenge where every second could catapult you to the top. Prepare to enter the arena.

A perk never makes you stronger on its own, it widens what you are able to do. Nothing is bought, everything is earned.

Challenges

Runs with their own rules, and their own way to fail. One caps your build and forces you to trade an upgrade away for every new one. Another takes every pickup off the field. Beat them and they open options you keep for good.

Visuals and Sound

Behold a visual ballet where each shape and color comes alive to the beat of a strong electronic soundtrack. Every shape is drawn by code rather than painted, so the arena stays razor sharp at any resolution, and the grid bends and lights up under everything that happens on it. The visual effects are not just a feast for the eyes; they are the vibrant feedback accompanying every one of your moves.

Competition

In "Reflectron," every game is a competition for the highest score. Face off against other players and prove your skill in this competitive environment where only perseverance is rewarded.

Key Features

  • Endless Arcade: A continuous challenge where the goal is to survive and thrive.

  • Seven Enemy Archetypes: They chase, shoot, split, copy themselves or simply refuse to die.

  • Dynamic Power-ups: Game-changing enhancements that ramp up the intensity of play.

  • Permanent Progression: Unlock new options by meeting objectives, never by paying for them.

  • Dynamic Visuals: A visual world that syncs with your performance and the beat.

  • Global Leaderboards: Compete against players around the world for a top spot.

  • Windows and Linux: A native build for each, and it plays on Steam Deck.

"Reflectron" is not just a game; it's an ongoing challenge where every second could catapult you to the top. Prepare to enter the arena.
data.short_description: One ball. One arena. Neon swarms moving to the beat. Send the ball flying, chain combos, stack upgrades and smash your high score in a fast-paced arcade brick-breaker, somewhere between Geometry Wars and Vampire Survivors.

data.name: Sky Paws Awakening
data.detailed_description:
Sky Paws Awakening is a handcrafted 16-bit action-adventure made with heart and love, inspired by retro classics.

Starring Bonnie and Clyde, twin cadets of the Sky Fleet Guard, the game follows a routine training mission that becomes the first chapter of a much greater legend.

High above an endless sea of clouds, the Sky Nations live in a fragile peace. But when a monstrous horde rises from the Clouds Below and attacks a remote training outpost, two young cadets must stand together against impossible odds.

Swap Between Two Siblings in Real Time

At the heart of the game is the Twin Tag System.

Bonnie and Clyde fight as a pair, each with a distinct combat style.

Bonnie is fast, precise and agile, cutting through enemies with swift swordplay.

Clyde is strong, bold and explosive, smashing enemies with raw power and momentum.

Switch between them during combat and exploration to extend combos, counter enemy attacks, overcome obstacles and keep the pressure on.

Fast-Paced 16-Bit Action

Slash, dash, jump, parry and unleash special moves across handcrafted side-scrolling stages inspired by classic action games, built with modern pacing and responsive controls.

Face hordes of Harakis, dangerous creatures from the Clouds Below, and powerful bosses as Bonnie and Clyde stumble upon a forgotten secret that will shape the future of the skies.

The Beginning of a Legend

Sky Paws Awakening marks the beginning of Bonnie and Clyde’s journey from talented cadets to future legends.

They are young. They are untested. They have everything to prove.

But together, they are exactly what the skies need.

Features

  • Fast-paced and precise 16-bit combat.

  • Master the Twin Tag System and swap between Bonnie and Clyde in real time.

  • Play as two siblings with distinct combat styles: Bonnie’s speed and precision, and Clyde’s strength and momentum.

  • Explore over 10 handcrafted side-scrolling levels set high above an endless sea of clouds.

  • Face hordes of Harakis and more than 20 enemy types from the Clouds Below.

  • Battle powerful bosses throughout Bonnie and Clyde’s first legendary adventure.

  • Experience 6 story cutscenes that bring their journey to life.

  • Collect every relic to unlock a secret true ending.

A World Made with Heart

Sky Paws Awakening is the first chapter of a larger world we are crafting with enormous passion.

The Sky Paws universe is a tribute to the animals who have shared our lives. Nearly every character is inspired by a real companion—some still by our side, others forever in our hearts. This world and its stories are our way of celebrating them, carrying their memories forward and letting their spirits soar forever.

The real Bonnie & Clyde, who inspired Sky Paws Awakening.

Bonnie, this one is for you. I miss you with all my heart. — Thomas
