data.name: Remnants of the Rift
data.detailed_description:
It was all going so well.

One day the world’s experiencing a golden age of technology, the next it’s forcibly merged with an alternate dimension. It happens.

Now there’s a new reality, a world between worlds: The Bast.

Remnants of the Rift is a roguelite tactics game where you can pause, plan, and play. You are Morgan, dimension-diving merc, delving deeper and deeper into The Bast at the request of the factions looking to exploit this new reality.

But you’re going to need help to survive in the depths. Help, and a whole lot of skill.

Remnants of the Rift combines the tactics of grid-based strategy with the thrills of an action game. Each level plays out in real-time, but you can pause the game to assess the battlefield, prep your attacks and plan your next move. Use mods and equipment to enhance your preferred style of play and overcome your interdimensional foes.

Every dive is different: change your strategies on the fly to counter a dimension in flux. Study each of the procedurally-generated battles and adapt to by customizing your playstyle to defeat all enemies and reap the bountiful rewards. But don’t worry, death isn’t the end. So head home, re-equip, and dive back in.

You’re not alone on your journey into The Bast. As a mercenary, you’ll deal with close associates and vying factions: everyone wants a piece of this new reality. But going deeper means getting better, and you’ll have to create unlikely alliances to procure the equipment you need to explore further.

data.name: Feed the Giants
data.detailed_description:
You are a giant. Under the gaze of your kind, you guide a group of lost children through a hostile world, in exchange for the gold they throw down to you. Some dream of seeing these children grow. Others feed on their suffering. Every choice has its consequence.

SURVIVAL AND SACRIFICE

Tend a campfire to hold back the creatures that prowl in the dark. Gather resources, build shelters, keep the children alive. Will you give in to the cruelest demands to be rewarded, or hold onto your humanity at the risk of losing everything?

A DIVIDED AUDIENCE

Every giant watching you has their own taste, their own morality. Some are benevolent. Some are merely curious. Others are toxic. Your decisions shape the crowd you cultivate: an act of cruelty will satisfy some and drive others away.

A HOSTILE WORLD

Each biome imposes its own rules. Threats evolve, resources grow scarce, and your audience grows ever more demanding.

KEY FEATURES

  • Survival god game built around the campfire: guide, protect, help them thrive

  • Roguelite progression with modifier synergies between runs

  • A reactive audience: whims, rewards, moral consequences

  • Ethical dilemmas that shape your community's identity

  • Varied biomes with shifting rules

  • Hand-drawn 2D art direction, dark and stylized

Each biome imposes its own rules. Threats evolve, resources grow scarce, and your audience grows ever more demanding.

KEY FEATURES

  • Survival god game built around the campfire: guide, protect, help them thrive

  • Roguelite progression with modifier synergies between runs

  • A reactive audience: whims, rewards, moral consequences

  • Ethical dilemmas that shape your community's identity

  • Varied biomes with shifting rules

  • Hand-drawn 2D art direction, dark and stylized

data.name: Chalk & Blood
data.detailed_description:
DEADLY MURDOKU

Un cadáver. Una habitación cerrada. Una sala llena de sospechosos que no piensan hablar. En Deadly Murdoku no hay armas ni persecuciones: solo tú, la tiza y una verdad escondida en la geometría fría de la escena del crimen. Aquí la lógica es la única arma, y todo asesino comete un error.

LEE LA ESCENA COMO UN DETECTIVE

Cada sospechoso estuvo en algún sitio la noche del crimen. Las pistas no mienten: quién estaba junto a la planta, quién sentado bajo la ventana, quién dos salas al norte del cuerpo. Deduce el lugar exacto de cada uno, colócalos a todos sin una sola contradicción y acorrala al único que se quedó a solas con la víctima. Ese es tu asesino. Nómbralo y cierra el caso.

UNA CAMPAÑA DE NOVELA NEGRA

Ponte en la gabardina de Arthur Vance, un detective quemado que corrige exámenes en un sótano para no volver a juzgar a nadie. Veinte casos hechos a mano lo arrastran de vuelta al oficio, escalando una conspiración en la Universidad de San Jude hacia un cerebro que el campus enterró hace un año. Cada crimen es un mensaje dirigido a él, y cada pista pagada con sangre.

UNA HISTORIA QUE SE LEE COMO UN CÓMIC

Capítulos cinematográficos, un Diario del caso que reúne a cada asesino y cada víctima, y un misterio final que solo el detective más afilado sabrá resolver. La narrativa se desvela a medida que cierras casos: descubre el móvil, ata los cabos y llega hasta el nombre que nadie se atrevía a pronunciar.

DEDUCCIÓN LIMPIA, SIN SUERTE

Nada de culpables sacados de la manga. Cada caso tiene una sola solución, demostrable con pura lógica: la pista que condena al asesino siempre está sobre la mesa. Insinuamos, nunca mentimos. Tu ingenio es lo único que separa la condena del error.

JUEGO LIBRE ILIMITADO

¿Se acabó la campaña? El crimen nunca duerme. Genera casos infinitos en tres tamaños, de aprendiz a maestro detective, y afina tu instinto tanto como quieras. Cada partida, una escena nueva; cada escena, una verdad esperando a ser leída.

Coge la tiza, detective. El caso te espera.

data.name: Terra Forma: Tower Combat
data.detailed_description:
In a far-off future... on a far-off world... you are called out of retirement to command the defense of terraformer installations attempting to convert the hostile environments of this alien planet.
Strange lifeforms and ancient machines are laying siege to sites all over the planet. Prove your command prowess one final time, and defend mankind's new hope.
With 4 elemental modules (fire, ice, iron, shock), build and fuse to protect essential human installations.

  • Command 12 unique towers and even more elemental fusions to form the ultimate defense. Utilize fire modules to inflict lingering damage, ice modules to slow enemies to a crawl, shock modules to control crowds, and metal modules to inflict massive single target damage. Only the most carefully considered strategies will lead you to victory.
  • Face off against 4 enemy varieties and 4 hulking boss enemy types. Slimy Reptyls and burrowing Insectoids sprint towards the terraformers, as ironclad Robots and lumbering Mutants clog your defenses with their slow speed and durability. Bosses also present their own unique challenges and surprises.
  • Complete a campaign with a dozen missions, with unique maps and special Challenge Modifiers. Prepare for anything from bigger waves to towers getting frozen in time.
  • Custom Scenario Mode allows you to create any mission you can imagine, from overpowered slaughter machines to impossibly challenging boss grinds.

data.name: Bullet Express
data.detailed_description:
Bullet Express is a high-octane action rogue lite looter shooter where there is tons of loot and zero junk! Join the professor as a prototype robot on a relentless mission of reclamation!

TAKE BACK THE BULLET EXPRESS

Your creator’s crowning achievement, the Bullet Express, has been hijacked by the rogue Conductor. To take back control, you must blast your way through treacherous mountains and across the speeding cars of a train that never stops, turning the Conductor's own stolen arsenal into your ultimate strength.

EVERY DROP FUELS THE FIRE

Tired of junk loot cluttering your inventory? In Bullet Express, no loot goes to waste. Combine weapon duplicates using a classic merge-3 system to synthesize higher-tier firepower, or feed unused guns directly into your primary weapon’s fusion core to unleash extra-strong modifier effects mid-fight.

FORGE PERMANENT POWER BETWEEN RUNS 

Return from every run with vital materials to craft permanent imbude attachments at the lab. Every attachment reacts differently to weapons you loot, creating a set of new weapons to discover every time!

Note from the developer: Bullet Express is currently in ALPHA. We are actively shaping the game based on player feedback. Everything from art to mechanics is subject to change as we work toward the final game!

data.name: Amygdala
data.detailed_description:
When a man has his body stolen he typically has one of two reactions; he either dies, or he sets out on an adventure as a disembodied head, hell-bent on revenge.
Amygdala is an action/adventure platformer where every living world you explore is a freshly generated permadeath challenge. There’s no hands and no handholding as you face off against swordheads, voidpigs, giant swarms of beez and the wizard that stole your body (hint: it’s NEVER his final form). Learn and survive. Avoid traps. Watch wildlife get in fights. SHOOT MINDBULLETS. POOP BRICKS. IT NEVER ENDS, IT JUST GETS HARDER.

For leaderboards, community videos and game help check out

Procedurally Generated Worlds

Amygdala builds each new world fresh and toasty. Every time you advance or die you will find yourself in a new world that no one else has ever experienced before or will ever experience again.

Permadeath Challenge

No checkpoints, saves or handholding. If you get hit with no energy or fall off the world you die, game over, start from square one. There's a lot to investigate in these worlds so feel free to go look up the answers in the manual, we're just not spoon feeding it to you.

Choose Eternal Vengeance

If you choose the dark side and seek eternal vengeance we are happy to accommodate. We'll keep turning up the challenge until you fall to your own hubris. Then we will laugh. Plus your name goes on the shiny high scores board for all to see forever!

A Lot Of Weird Stuff

  • 6 Different World Types
  • 22 Different Mob Types
  • 6 Different Wizard Forms
  • 12 Different Environmental Hazard Types
  • Many Ways To Die

data.name: MetaSpace
data.detailed_description:
MetaSpace is a 2D action strategy game in which you captain a ship and manage an outpost in a strange new universe. You are in charge of your faction's endeavours to solidify their position in MetaSpace but many other factions are all trying to gain their own foothold. Make wise decisions to use your time to its fullest or face an insurmountable enemy that grows ever stronger.

Develop your base!

Acquire resources by exploring, fighting or mining and use them to upgrade your base. Construct new facilities to better train your officers, upgrade and modify your equipment, build new ships and research new technologies! Construct new outposts to expand your territory but be wary of enemy fleets that may launch an attack!

Train your crew!

Your officers will gain new skills and traits as they gain experience. Some traits may be helpful such as allowing them to help another officer recover from an injury, while other traits may prove a hindrance. As your officers develop and gain more powerful and rare abilities the prospect of their untimely demise becomes more daunting.

Make Friends or Foes!

You'll encounter many factions in MetaSpace all with different traits that affect how they develop, behave and respond to you. Depending on your actions and decisions they may become a great ally or a terrible enemy. Visit their outposts to trade, hire officers or make pacts that will help both your factions flourish.

Highly Moddable

The same tools used to create content for the game are available to you! Create your own modpacks featuring ships, events, items and skills. Then share them with your friends on the workshop!

data.name: OrbiTank
data.detailed_description:
Tanks! Space! Tanks in space!
Does much more even need to be said? OrbiTank is a local-multiplayer tank game with a fresh spin on projectile combat. Use gravity to your advantage to shoot your shells in and out of orbit, hop from planet to planet, and dive bomb your enemies. Explore a vast variety of arenas which feature several gravitational mechanics such as planets, orbiting moons, spinning space stations, and even treacherous black holes.

Classic
The classic game mode is good old reliable. You can't go wrong! It's just you, a friend, and the most balanced version of the game that has been experimented with. Players have three lives per round, and in order to win it all, you must rack up five points. Points are collected by winning levels, and levels will continue to be generated until either player wins the game. Usually a game in the classic game mode will last about 10 minutes, or until your friend starts to call your mother names.

Tournament
With the tournament game mode, you can challenge a whole group of friends to your mega epic gamer skills. Winner gets to not be made fun of for playing MOBAs. No, but seriously. Although no more than two players will ever be hashing it out on the screen at once, tournaments can be generated with up to eight contestants. This is a great game mode for parties and does not disappoint as a fun time sink. Expect hoots and hollers.

Custom
Trying to shake things up? Then this is just the game mode for you! You can modify several balancing settings using the custom game mode. This means if you want a really long game but it switches levels after every time a player is killed, you can do that. If you want to speed or slow down the fire rate to make the game more arcade-like or more tactical, you have the options. And, finally, my favorite, you have the ability to turn the planet movement up to like, a lot a lot. Prepare yourself for ludicrous speed.

Tanks! Space! Tanks in space!
Does much more even need to be said? OrbiTank is a local-multiplayer tank game with a fresh spin on projectile combat. Use gravity to your advantage to shoot your shells in and out of orbit, hop from planet to planet, and dive bomb your enemies. Explore a vast variety of arenas which feature several gravitational mechanics such as planets, orbiting moons, spinning space stations, and even treacherous black holes.

Classic
The classic game mode is good old reliable. You can't go wrong! It's just you, a friend, and the most balanced version of the game that has been experimented with. Players have three lives per round, and in order to win it all, you must rack up five points. Points are collected by winning levels, and levels will continue to be generated until either player wins the game. Usually a game in the classic game mode will last about 10 minutes, or until your friend starts to call your mother names.

Tournament
With the tournament game mode, you can challenge a whole group of friends to your mega epic gamer skills. Winner gets to not be made fun of for playing MOBAs. No, but seriously. Although no more than two players will ever be hashing it out on the screen at once, tournaments can be generated with up to eight contestants. This is a great game mode for parties and does not disappoint as a fun time sink. Expect hoots and hollers.

Custom
Trying to shake things up? Then this is just the game mode for you! You can modify several balancing settings using the custom game mode. This means if you want a really long game but it switches levels after every time a player is killed, you can do that. If you want to speed or slow down the fire rate to make the game more arcade-like or more tactical, you have the options. And, finally, my favorite, you have the ability to turn the planet movement up to like, a lot a lot. Prepare yourself for ludicrous speed.
data.short_description: Local multiplayer tanks in space!

data.name: Let's make SILLY ART!
data.detailed_description:
Charlie receives a letter containing a flyer from a gallery looking for atypical artists.

He’s going to muster his courage to tidy up his house, find his supplies and seek inspiration to create unique artworks and send his application!

Let’s make SILLY ART! is a cozy and creative point and click that explores the themes of art block, imposter and blank page syndromes. Charlie will grow through these challenges to find inspiration again and reconnect with his passions.

Search every nook and cranny, find your belongings, get ideas and collect (a LOT of) stickers!

Clean up the workshop and solve puzzles to unlock stickers and access creative mini-games.

Create your own artworks with drawing, painting and collage mini-games. Follow directions to the letter or let your imagination run wild, as your heart wishes! Each piece created makes you win its own set of stickers.

Did we say already that there are STICKERS to collect??

Well, they will be useful in “Pouaint” : a creative software in which you can make your own compositions! The more you make art, the more you can make art! Well made, isn't it?

  • 10+ hours of gameplay

  • 50+ drawings, paintings and collages to make

  • Millions of stickers to collect (more or less)

  • To-do lists to cross out

  • A gameplay made for beginners and pros alike

  • Fun, laughs and surprises

  • Huge dilemma at the end when choosing artworks to send

  • Too many hours thinking about the world's lore

  • A very cute cat and his very cute friends

  • No AI generated content, we’re drawing with our own hands here

Let’s Make SILLY ART! is a game created by Laurianne (Distrophie), Lorine (LorineKirk), and Clément (ClemNewter), 3 friends brought together by the magic of online streaming!

  • Distrophie is a professional web developer and self-taught illustrator. She initiated the project and is in charge of the game's development and art direction.

  • LorineKirk is a trained video editor and self-taught 2D artist. She handles 2D graphic design, narrative design, and social media.

  • ClemNewter is a graphic designer by day and a musician by night. He makes all the music and sound design, and also assists with graphic design.

data.name: About A Mouse
data.detailed_description:
About a Mouse is a next gen third person sandbox “strategy” stealth game.

The common house mouse is the lowest of the food chain. They fall prey to Owls, Hawks, Cats, Dogs, Snakes…. Humans.
But not for this mouse. Born with a rare genetically anomaly, Super Intelligence.
Learning how to use the environment to its advantage, in rather quirky and dark humorous ways, this mouse dispatches the aggressive, rodent killing village folk using any trap or tool at its disposal.
About a Mouse sets itself apart from the third person market by using the shear cuteness of playing at a mouses level, with the comedic dark undertone of a stealthy assassin.

Key Features

• Object interactions (to solve puzzles, catch predators, feed)
• Exploration, to find safer areas to survive
• Real world physiques system challenging the player to improvise solutions to problems
• Sand boxes style play
• Utilizing the mouses skills to get through environments
• Camera and controls: simple, streamlined, minimum UI, to ease you into play
• Assassin like dispatching of enemies

data.name: Space Ballers
data.detailed_description:
Challenge your friends with your space ship in electrifying matches and fantastic arenas, aiming to score as many goals while avoiding obstacles. All this to the sound of an exciting soundtrack.

Matches in the versus mode involve the player taking the ball and scoring against the opponent team. The players can also get surprise boxes during the game, where you can win one of the four powers available, making everything more chaotic and fun when it comes to score or prevent the opposite team's goal. The team that score more goals, either by time or number of goals defined, wins the competition.

The challenge mode matches on the other hand, aim to achieve the best record in the chosen arena. Each arena has its own particularities, and you can try to reach the record with a friend in the co-op mode.

Resources:


  • 6 different space ships
  • 6 different colors for the team
  • Versus Mode - Player Vs Player
    • 2 to 4 Players
    • Choose the match between time or number of goals
    • 4 different arenas with challenges and obstacles to make the game more frenetic and fun
    • 4 different power that can be found on susprise boxes during the match
  • Challenge Mode - Exciting challenges to reach the best score
    • 1 to 2 Players
    • Choose the Nature Arena to grab 10 coins in the shortest time possible without touching the poisoned mushrooms
    • Choose the Space Arena to make the most number of goals in 1:30 minutes in a reduced space with planets and stars at your surroundings

Play with your friends locally or online via Remote Play Together and have fun!

data.name: Medieval Nightt - Part 1
data.detailed_description:
You are a young woman passionate about the paranormal, in search of the truth behind inexplicable phenomena. On one of your trips, you discover an ancient abandoned village, dominated by a majestic castle whose history has been shrouded in mystery and silence. The villagers warn you: no one knows what happened within those walls, but one night, everything mysteriously fell into oblivion.

Ignoring the warnings, you persuade a local to take you to the castle under the cover of night, ensuring your incursion remains secret.

Armed only with your hands and a torch, you will enter a vast, dark forest, traverse the corridors of an abandoned villa, and explore the dungeons where the most atrocious acts in history were committed.

Face a variety of puzzles, from the simplest to the most complex, that will test your wit and determination.

Prepare for chilling encounters with paranormal beings and monsters lurking around every corner, waiting for someone with enough courage to cross into their domains.

Each step will take you deeper into the darkness. Advance through dark and eerie labyrinths.

Your journey will not be easy. Paranormal horrors and monstrous creatures will always be lurking, ready to capture you. And remember, you will never truly be alone; something or someone will always be following your steps, watching your every move.

data.name: Fooling Dead
data.detailed_description:
Story Background
On a seemingly lighthearted April Fool’s Day, the protagonist is unexpectedly drawn into terrifying supernatural events. From eerie visions to unsettling sounds, every step is filled with unknown terror. As the investigation deepens, you’ll discover these events are tied to an unsolved tragedy from years ago. The truth awaits, and your choices shape the protagonist’s fate, determining life or death. In this suspenseful adventure, explore haunting scenes, unravel complex mysteries, and confront lurking horrors—can you stay calm and survive?

Gameplay
In this game, you play as the protagonist, exploring a mysterious and dangerous world in first-person perspective. Interact with objects, gather clues, solve puzzles, and make impactful choices at critical moments. The game is highly interactive, with detailed scenes hiding clues and secrets. Your choices influence the story and character’s fate, leading to different endings. Face threats bravely or avoid danger cautiously—every step tests your wit and courage.

Game Features

  • Multiple Endings: Various story paths shaped by player choices, unlocking unique endings with high replay value.

  • Immersive Horror Experience: Crafted scare elements and gripping storytelling, with realistic sound and visuals, immerse players in a terrifying supernatural world.

  • Deep Narrative and Interaction: Rich story and interactive scenes let players uncover the truth through exploration and puzzles, delivering an immersive experience.

  • Active Community and Updates: We foster a friendly player community, with the team listening to feedback and releasing regular updates for an evolving experience.

data.name: Kameko: Cosplay Love Story
data.detailed_description:
You're the photographer. Three cosplay idols. One camera that decides how close you get.

◆ 45+ fully animated H-scenes — every one interactive, every one replayable

◆ 18+ cosplay outfits across three heroines

◆ Fully voiced in Japanese, all three heroines

◆ Harem scenes and a complete replay gallery

◆ English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文

You're an otaku who has loved anime and hentai for years, and you own a camera. That is the entire résumé. Then three women with very particular cosplay fetishes walk into your ordinary life and ask you to be their personal photographer — which means managing their careers, chasing their dreams, and running private sessions that stop being about the photos surprisingly quickly.

◆ Frame the shot, and she reacts

Aim where she wants you to look and she opens up. Push too early and she covers up — and the shot is ruined. Every frame moves her affection, tracked per girl and per outfit, and it carries between sessions.

◆ The session doesn't stop when the clothes do

Push a shoot far enough and the camera stays on. The H-scenes are the shoot, further along — fully animated, and you are still the one making the calls in real time. What you unlock next depends on what you got this time.

◆ Then you edit what you took

Every photo lands in your album with its outfit, pose and score. Sharpness, saturation, colour, brightness — the better the edit, the better it pays, and the better the gear you can afford next.

◆ And you actually have to date them

Beach, café, mall. Different places raise different stats, and some outfits only unlock after a specific date. Nobody tells you what they are into. Pay attention.

18+ outfits — and they change how she behaves, not just how she looks.

Casual · Maid · Miko · Cyber Bunny · Succubus · Sailor Bikini · Street Idol · Cyber Neko · Myandero · Dark Nun · Lady Noir · Cyber Fox — and more.

◇ Mizuno Aya

CV: 天知遥 — Haruka Amachi

Once an awkward, bullied otaku, Aya rebuilt herself into a bright idol-cosplayer. She came back to Kame City chasing a promise she made to you, her childhood friend. Radiant and fearless the second a lens is on her; warm, and a little shy, the moment you put it down.

20 · 158 cm · 48 kg · B90 / W58 / H89 · Beach · Anime

◇ Hoshino Miu

CV: 伊ヶ崎綾香 — Ayaka Igasaki

Orphaned young and fiercely independent, Miu is a sharp, money-savvy VTuber who hides everything soft behind a tsundere quip. She cannot stand your otaku side and keeps showing up anyway. She owes you, she knows it, and she would rather die than say so — and she has a private collection of toys she would rather you never found.

19 · 152 cm · 43 kg · B82 / W56 / H84 · Mall · Finance

◇ Kanzaki Mari

CV: 奥川久美子 — Kumiko Okugawa

An elite doctor by day and the legendary cosplayer Lady Noir by night. She escaped a strict medical family by taking a campus clinic in a small city, and now runs two lives at once — brilliant in medicine, untouchable in costume. She admires people with real passion, and secretly loves being watched.

26 · 170 cm · 56 kg · B98 / W60 / H96 · Cafe · Education

data.name: Some Distant Memory
data.detailed_description:
Two colonies struggle to survive post-apocalyptic Earth. In the NASA-engineered Ares compound, the Professor serves as an interpreter for the artificial intelligence known as ARORA. The other colony, NOAH, has sent a wasteland-hardened but enthusiastic expedition leader, Commander Ti, to assist in a mission of dire importance.

Each colony has preserved its own facets of humanity, and neither truly knows how people used to live. So much has been lost, and the future struggles to survive without the knowledge of the past.


Long ago, humanity thrived. That was before the Collapse, and the corrosive algae bloom that now plagues the planet.

The Professor, Commander, and ARORA will reveal a cast of characters from past Earth. Their possessions and memories still remain, and will grant a new understanding of how people used to live. With the help of ARORA’s abilities, you’ll relive moments from their lives and discover a story of love, creativity, loss, and human perseverance.


The Professor and her companions have made an amazing discovery: a pre-Collapse house, mysteriously preserved underground. Explore the ruins and examine relics from those who used to live there. See memories from the past, and experience story moments in whichever order you find them.


  • A non-violent, character-driven story.
  • Lots of mysteries to uncover, from the cause of the fall of civilization, to the glitches of your computer, and the fates of the people who lived in the house centuries before.
  • A story that moves at your pace. Piece together moments of a vibrant story and reveal new scenes as you read and explore freely.
  • Themes of family, romance, friendship, and grief. Reveal a diverse cast of characters from both past and future Earth.
  • Amazing atmospheric soundtrack by ToyTree (Amos Roddy), the composer for Strafe and the award-winning Kingdom, Kingdom: New Lands, and Kingdom: Two Crowns.

data.name: Trust No Consort
data.detailed_description:
《This Is Not My Beloved Concubine》is a simulation game combining court inquisition, identity verification, and character interaction.

The story takes place in a fictional empire built around a vast inland sea, composed of twelve kingdoms, duchies, city-states, and autonomous territories. During the reign of the old emperor, the empire's unity was maintained through military power and political prestige. After the old emperor's death, the young you inherit the throne.

Each of the twelve kingdoms sends an adult royal woman or a high-ranking noblewoman.

🔍 Observe carefully and find the flaws in the disguise

To impersonate the real concubine, assassins will study the target's information in advance and receive targeted training.

  • 👁 Appearance: Face shape, hairstyle, eyes, skin tone, etc.

  • 👗 Dress: Clothing, jewelry, accessories, and the style of the country of origin

  • 📏 Physical Characteristics: Height, build, and personal features

  • 🗣 Voice and Accent: Language habits, pronunciation, and speaking style

  • 💃 Behavioral Habits: Actions, etiquette, posture, and walking style

  • 📖 Personal Experience: Family, hometown, experiences, and details known only to herself

Sometimes, a tiny mistake is enough to expose her true identity.

🌙 The King Personally Investigates

After the assassination attempt, you issued a secret decree:

Any woman entering the Emperor's private bedchamber at night, regardless of her identity documents, must be ultimately verified by the Emperor himself.

Some secrets can only be discovered up close, and the complete files of the concubines can only be viewed by the King himself.

🎮 Game Loop

Select difficulty → Multiple women enter in turn → Review files → Personally observe and verify → Determine authenticity → Deal with the assassin → Safely spend the night with the true concubine → Unlock character content → Proceed to the next night.

📈 The further you go, the harder it is to believe your eyes.

The game offers different difficulty levels.

Difficulty affects:

  • Number of female characters

  • Number of assassins

  • Degree of disguise

  • Completeness of information

  • Degree of concealment of identity clues

Observation and reasoning required for judgment

As the challenge progresses, you'll need to remember more and more character traits. The real challenge isn't remembering the twelve concubines.

But when an almost perfect "she" stands before you—Can you believe she really is her?

data.name: ChatFight!
data.detailed_description:
Out of Early Access!

[h1]ChatFight is out of Early Access![/h1]

After far too long, ChatFight Is finally out of Early Access! Thank you so much to everyone who has played this game and kept it alive for all this time. The game has been out for 3 years now and I decided it's about time I finally get around to adding some more content and some long-requested quality of life features for all the loyal community members.

[h4]Tournament Mode is here![/h4]

Fighters are no longer confined to the chaotic battlefield where they all fight at once, now they can duke it out on the main-stage for everyone to see, one fight at a time. View the bracket and watch each match one-at-a-time to highlight each and every viewer!

1.2.0 Patch Notes

  • Added the ability to switch game modes, allowing for potential additional gamemodes in the future!

    • Currently the choices are Battle Royale and 1v1 Tournament

  • New Gamemode: 1v1 Tournament

    • New map: Colosseum

    • When the tournament starts, a bracket is created. Matchups can be shuffled around, and then matches can either be played one by one or you can toggle "Auto-Advance" to continue the fights.

    • Press V for auto-camera, which simply rotates around the platform

    • Or control the camera manually like BattleRoyale mode.

    • Press Tab to view the bracket at any time.

  • Battle Royale

    • Auto camera is here! No more having to manually follow the action, now you can sit back and interact with your stream while the camera automatically finds the action for you!

    • Press V to switch camera modes

    • Press Left or Right arrow keys to change the auto-follow target

  • Quality of Life Updates

    • Advanced options are available now!

    • Edit the the following aspects of fighters:

      • Fighter Health

      • Max Damage

      • Movement Speed

      • Attack Interval (Attack speed)

      • Heal On Kill (toggle)

      • Heal Amount

      • Allow Overhealing

    • And also customizable bot settings, in case you want the bots to be easier or harder than real players 

      • Different Stats for Bots (toggle)

      • Bot Health

      • Bot Max Damage

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

Seriously, thank you all so much for continuing to play ChatFight! It means so much to me that even after the updates have significantly slowed down, there is still a community of players that continue to play this game every day. Thank you.


About the Game

ChatFight! is a battle royale for stream VIEWERS. Play the game on stream and let your viewers customize their characters, equip ridiculous outfits, and fight to the death!

Perfect for small groups of friends all the way up to hundreds of people beating each other up in hopes of being the absolute best at a game of PURE RNG. There is zero input from the viewers once their characters are in game, simply sit back and pray to the gods of RNG that your character will be victorious.

Practical Uses For This Game
  • Stream Giveaways
  • tournament Bracket Seeding
  • Entertaining Viewer Interaction
  • Mindless Fun

This game runs along with its website, where you can customize your character, view leaderboards, and keep up with any announcements for the game.

Twitch connectivity requires a Twitch account.

data.name: Elysia Sector™: The Unknown
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a journey beyond humanity's extinction. This Survival Horror plunges you into the boots of Lyraeth Mortis, drifting from the twisted realm of Elysia to the cruel emptiness of Reality. Unveiling the Sector's dark secrets is your only hope for survival. This is a First Person experience, focused on blending Sci-Fi, Survival, Mystery, and Horror.

Feature Overview

  • Unique Horror Mechanics: Experience Lyraeth as the last of Humanity, or as an Elysian Goddess. Sleep, Visions, Prayers, and even Death, can help you drift between Reality and Elysia. Giving you both sides of the Story, slowly you'll bring them together, giving a much deeper understanding of Elysia Sector, and the unknown that lies beyond.

  • Intense Survival Mechanics: Manage your resources carefully, scavenge for supplies, and craft essential items to stay alive. Every decision counts in this unforgiving environment. You need to keep The HDFC'S MK5 Station running, alongside your own needs. This means Oxygen Parts, Cooling Parts, HDFC Weapons, Energy Items, Health Items, and much more.

  • Challenging Enemies: Face off against grotesque demons; and relentless malfunctioning AI's. Although most of the experience happens outside of Combat, self defence is vital. You need every HDFC Weapon and Tool at your disposal to truly survive in this game.

  • Dark, Mysterious, and Unique Narrative: Immerse yourself in this story filled with suspense and mystery. Through exploration, the environment, and lore, unravel the true fate of humanity and discover the dark truth behind the events that left Earth in ruins.

  • Impressive Graphics and Performance: This may be an Indie title, but all the Visuals have been carefully crafted to provide stunning graphics, with an optional Raytracing Mode, Modding Support, DLSS 3, FSR 3, and a year of optimisation, I'm pushing the standard for Solo Indie Games.

  • DEMONS Mode: Demons is a new mode, stripped of all the story moments. It hyper-fixates on combat mechanics, With 3 complete and unique maps. Introducing hundreds of demons, wave based survival, intense enemy types, and much more. With shorter loading times, shorter introductions, and shorter setup, each match roughly takes 10-15m.

HDFC Station

You're completely isolated on this HDFC Station, and keeping it running alone isn't going to be easy. You need to collect Power Circuits; Cooling Parts, and Oxygen Parts. This could mean exploring the dark and mysterious handcrafted areas using keycards. Or, exploring the procedurally generated areas; filled with traps, enemies, and loot. But your efforts are in not in vain; you can also find Construction Parts, needed for constructing your own Safe Space.

Elysia Sector

Understanding and uncovering the Sector's dark secrets can be difficult, as various areas of Elysia offer different types of Horror. Some will have you sprinting through tunnels; searching for somewhere to hide; before the inhabitants of Elysia catch you. Others will have you crawling through twisted environments; praying you'll find an exit in time, because while you stay in Elysia, time still passes in Reality. Cutting away at The Station's resources.

Lyraeth Mortis

But, there's more. You'll also need to look after yourself, with the complete and in-depth stats system, you need to keep your BPM; Health; Hunger; Thirst; Energy; and Treatment all under control. This means finding medicine, foods, materials, weapons, and tools to survive aboard The Station. This experience will be challenging, and stress-inducing.

Modding Support

The Modding Tools project included allows you to package new content directly into Elysia Sector: The Unknown. You can add new Gameplay Actors, and more coming soon. Most content you can import or create with Unreal Engine 4 is automatically supported. Note: This feature is still in an Early Beta, and still being improved.
data.about_the_game:
Embark on a journey beyond humanity's extinction. This Survival Horror plunges you into the boots of Lyraeth Mortis, drifting from the twisted realm of Elysia to the cruel emptiness of Reality. Unveiling the Sector's dark secrets is your only hope for survival. This is a First Person experience, focused on blending Sci-Fi, Survival, Mystery, and Horror.

Feature Overview

  • Unique Horror Mechanics: Experience Lyraeth as the last of Humanity, or as an Elysian Goddess. Sleep, Visions, Prayers, and even Death, can help you drift between Reality and Elysia. Giving you both sides of the Story, slowly you'll bring them together, giving a much deeper understanding of Elysia Sector, and the unknown that lies beyond.

  • Intense Survival Mechanics: Manage your resources carefully, scavenge for supplies, and craft essential items to stay alive. Every decision counts in this unforgiving environment. You need to keep The HDFC'S MK5 Station running, alongside your own needs. This means Oxygen Parts, Cooling Parts, HDFC Weapons, Energy Items, Health Items, and much more.

  • Challenging Enemies: Face off against grotesque demons; and relentless malfunctioning AI's. Although most of the experience happens outside of Combat, self defence is vital. You need every HDFC Weapon and Tool at your disposal to truly survive in this game.

  • Dark, Mysterious, and Unique Narrative: Immerse yourself in this story filled with suspense and mystery. Through exploration, the environment, and lore, unravel the true fate of humanity and discover the dark truth behind the events that left Earth in ruins.

  • Impressive Graphics and Performance: This may be an Indie title, but all the Visuals have been carefully crafted to provide stunning graphics, with an optional Raytracing Mode, Modding Support, DLSS 3, FSR 3, and a year of optimisation, I'm pushing the standard for Solo Indie Games.

  • DEMONS Mode: Demons is a new mode, stripped of all the story moments. It hyper-fixates on combat mechanics, With 3 complete and unique maps. Introducing hundreds of demons, wave based survival, intense enemy types, and much more. With shorter loading times, shorter introductions, and shorter setup, each match roughly takes 10-15m.

data.name: 3D PUZZLE - Post-Apocalyptic 3
data.detailed_description:
Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

The game is a 3D puzzle, the player needs to put in place the missing pieces of the puzzle (items) scattered around the location. To create an entire location.

You need to go to the item, take it by pressing the left mouse button and take the item to the desired location marked in green. If you brought the correct item, it will snap into place and you will receive leaderboard points and achievements for this.

Collect as much items as possible as quickly as possible to get more points for the leaderboard.

If you brought the wrong item, you can throw it away, it will return to the starting location so that you can pick it up again.

data.name: The Imagined Leviathan: Prologue
data.detailed_description:
ADD FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST


About the Game

We are developing this short experience into a new full game called Imagined Leviathans, which will greatly develop the gameplay and themes into a full 2-3 hours of play, with improved visuals and significantly more to do and see, including meeting other survivors

“At fifty degrees below zero frostbite can strike in as few as five minutes”



A poetic survival horror set in a future where climate change has rendered Britain an arctic wasteland.

  • On your pilgrimage to Steel Henge you can only take what you can carry, so choose carefully what you leave behind.
  • Immerse yourself in this starkly monochromatic world as you scavenge for fuel, take shelter in the shadows, and burn stories to stay warm.
  • A malevolent presence lurks between the words, just out of reach.
  • Alone, you must sacrifice everything you knew to deliver the bitter truth of this world to future generations.
  • A brief but intense 20 minutes.

data.name: Tomb nightmares
data.detailed_description:
A cozy and atmospheric game for the evening.

The plot tells the player about one of the many expeditions of two speleologists Bane and Jess. This time they decided to go to the abandoned catacombs, where it is rumored to store many lost artifacts, including the crown of the leader of an ancient tribe. The caves were home to the ancient people, few tribe members were willing to venture out of them into the open world full of danger. Legend has it that the tribe was buried alive in these caves during an earthquake. Attempts by enthusiasts to find artifacts from that time have been unsuccessful. Can Bane and Jess do it?



Play Time
30 - 60 minutes



Game Features:
- Two endings.
- Tense atmosphere;
- Treasure hunt.
- 3D surround sound;
- Choice of path through the game.
- Elements of platforming.

data.name: Bad Run - Turbo Edition
data.detailed_description:
Evil Pen Did It Again!

He zapped our beloved hero, Square, with his new and powerful evil machine,
The Run-O-Matic 2000.

And though our hero is bound to a never ending run, he is determined and strong in will and he literally won't rest until he stops Evil Pen... again.

Join Square’s epic adventure, run, jump, dive, fly and shoot your way through, but most importantly stop Evil Pen's evil plans!

It's Up to You, Are You Ready?... Run!

Features

  • Procedurally generated mission levels - with over 100 predesigned sections, game world expands with each level.
  • 3 predesigned castle levels to explore metroidvania style.
  • Endless mode and 5 unique challenges, master your skills and get extra bonus coins!
  • Use your coins to upgrade your character and buy new items in the store.
  • Prize cards, daily rewards and lots of achievements with coin rewards.
Bad Run is a spin-off of Bad Pad, featuring a casual action packed, runner metroidvania platformer.
The game was designed for short playing session with simplified controls and mechanics.
That being said, it was not designed to be easy.

data.name: Kneedle Knight
data.detailed_description:
Kneedle Knight is a third-person, puzzle platformer game developed by students at SMU Guildhall Cohort 32. In Kneedle Knight, the player controls a mouse knight that uses his magical needle to sew fabric which he can merge into, moving back and forth between 3D and 2D.

Sir Lukoss the Small was a noble knight sent on a quest to defeat the evil Witch of Fabric. The Witch, using her enchanted fabric, imprisoned and transformed many citizens and knights into malicious fabrications. Sir Lukoss climbed up through her fortress to put an end to her tyranny, only to be hexed by her magic and transformed into a mouse. In the dark dungeon of the Witch’s lair, the mouse finds a magic needle, granting him special powers to sew fabric of his own and merge in and out of the enchanted threadwork.

Now Sir Lukoss must use his newfound weapon to sew his path forward and up through the evil stronghold. The mouse knight can use his needle to solve puzzles, overcome challenging obstacles, and defeat the animated candle minions of the Witch. All with the hopes of returning to face the Witch of Fabric yet again to finish his noble quest.

Features:
  • Single-player, puzzle platformer game
  • Playtime (main story): 1-2 hours
  • Playtime (100% achievements): 2 hours
  • Steam leaderboard support for level speed running
  • Made in Unreal Engine 5
  • Original soundtrack

data.name: The Dead House
data.detailed_description:
Developed by a solo developer, my goal was to create a game about a YouTuber who risks his life by exploring a haunted house to boost his channel's popularity.

Main character equipped with just a flashlight, camera, and nerves of steel, venture into its eerie, decaying halls of a house that belonged to old couple. The silence and unsettling sounds keep you on edge as you piece together the tragic and supernatural past of the house. What begins as routine content soon turns into a terrifying reality, blurring the line between myth and truth.

Find out what happened to the house and to old couple.

Can you survive the house’s dark history and escape to share your story, or will you become another lost soul in the The Dead House?

WASD for movement

"C" for Camera

CTRL for crouching

Special thanks to George Thompson for his dev services.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The character voices used in the game were generated by artificial intelligence.

data.name: NovaSaurs
data.detailed_description:
Soar and Roar! Prey on the horizon!

Take the role of Talon, leader of the NovaSaurs. Blast through alien skies where the path rises, dives, and banks like a roller coaster built for a dogfight. The world’s dance to epic music. Routes twist underwater, over mountains and through atmospheres that feel nothing alike.

Voice-acted briefings, mid-mission chatter, and boss taunts play out the way a classic on-rails shooter should. Power-ups drop in the heat of a run. Bosses own the end of every world. An original soundtrack drives the whole adventure, and the story lands in cutscenes between the levels.

Features:

• On-rails shooting with alternating paths and immersive camera work

• Roller-coaster altitude: climbs, drops, loops in the route, not just the horizon

• 14 Levels shaped by the action & influenced by epic music

• Power-ups and set-piece bosses

• Diverse planets, including underwater stretches, hot planets, frozen tundras and gorgeous jungles

• Story told through cutscenes and in game dialogue

• Original soundtrack (sold separately)

Tear up the skies as the Apex Predator!

data.name: Trap Shrine
data.detailed_description:
Overview


The Goddess was a Crossdresser?!

The enshrined deity turned out to be a cross dressing Goddess that was sealed within to... marry ME?!
This new frontier in the world of cutie boy visual novels is brought to you by Aogiri Penta and Nishida Hajime, the ultimate combo of veterans in the genre!

The grand, mythical curtain of the cross dressing legend opens here!

Characters


Endou Mishiro　

"My Sister Sense is tingling! There's a filthy sow getting close to Maa-kun!"


Self-proclaimed big sister, shrine maiden, and also a Crossdresser!
The protagonist's loving big sister, perhaps a bit TOO loving at times!
Her position as sister is put to the test due to Yui's arrival, and a fierce rivalry ensues.



Yui

"I shall grant your wish in full!"


Sealed cross dressing Goddess.
The Goddess sealed inside Kotomusubi shrine's cave. She wields the power to create and strengthen bonds.
The gods of heaven were afraid she might cause chaos in the world, so they sealed her.
It took our protagonist's heartfelt wish and a bit of magic to bring her back to this world.
Seeing the reincarnation of her past love in him, she immediately proclaimed herself as the protagonist's wife.



Hinowa

"I know I may not look it, but I'm a true, proud God!"


Exceedingly cute Komainu.
The incarnation of the Komainu enshrined at Kotomusubi Shrine.
A glorified errand boy for the gods, so his power isn't particularly exceptional, and despite his usual clumsiness he still claims to be a powerful God.
His original role is to watch over the sealed Goddess, but since the shrine's going through rough times, he took up a part-time job as a shrine maiden.
※The supporting cast (Hinowa) isn't a heroine this time around.


Masato
Protagonist extraordinaire.
The chief priest of Kotomusubi shrine.
Unable to keep up with his sister's advances, he ends up asking for divine intervention, only to end up being courted by a Goddess instead!
Our protagonist is between a rock and a hard place. What will he do?

Story

After enduring countless years of ascetic training to inherit his parent's shrine, our protagonist is surrounded by a parade of cuties with a surprise!
Despairing over not being able to enjoy a "normal" love, he seeks the aid of his local enshrined deity. And as if the heavens themselves heard his plight, the Goddess manifests in front of him.
But fate would deem that the Goddess he unsealed was... a cross dressing Goddess!

"Come, let us be united in marriage!"
"I want a normal girl, thank you very much!"


The shrine will become the stage where the legend of cross dressing conception will be born!

Features

  • Narrative based visual novel game.
  • 2-4 hours of playtime.

data.name: Slime Rancher
data.detailed_description:
Just Updated



Login to Viktor’s Experimental Update! Join Viktor Humphries and test his simulated reality of the Far, Far Range. Well, a work-in-progress version anyway...

Read more about Viktor's Slimulations here


The Automatic Update



The Automatic Update is here and introduces a new Slime Science gadget: DRONES! Drones are happy little helper bots that can be programmed to help with various tasks around the ranch!

Read more about Drones here


The Party Gordo Update



Let's get this party started! Every weekend, the Party Gordo comes to the Far, Far Range, but you have to find him first!

Read more about the special weekend events here!


The Little Big Storage Update



The Little Big Storage Update is here to help! Ranch storage is getting a huge upgrade and it’s just in time for a little spring cleaning.

Learn more about the new silo upgrades here!


Mochi's Megabucks Update



Mochi’s Megabucks Update is here and you've been invited to explore the Nimble Valley: a new zone that is home to the exceedingly rare quicksilver slimes!

Learn more about the Nimble Valley here!


Limited Holiday Event



Celebrate the season with our limited-time Wiggly Wonderland event! Hunt for ornaments and decorate your ranch from December 20 - 31

A new ornament will appear in crates every day, so hurry and collect as many as you can before they’re gone!

Read more here


Ogden's Wild Update




Ogden’s Wild Update has arrived! Slime Rancher v1.1.0 contains a dangerous, new zone to explore, missions to undertake from Ogden Ortiz, the feral descendants of the long-extinct saber slime, and more!

Discover more about The Wilds and version 1.1.0 here


About the Game

Welcome to the Far, Far Range!


Slime Rancher is a charming, first-person, sandbox experience. Play as Beatrix LeBeau: a plucky, young rancher who sets out for a life a thousand light years away from Earth on the ‘Far, Far Range.’

Each day will present new challenges and risky opportunities as you attempt to amass a great fortune in the business of slime ranching. Collect colorful slimes, grow crops, harvest resources, and explore the untamed wilds through the mastery of your all-purpose vacpack.



Stake Your Claim

The renowned rancher, Hobson Twillgers, has passed his ranch on to you. Get it back up and running, discover the secrets hidden on this mysterious planet, and dominate the Plort Market.

  • Grow crops and raise chickadoos to feed your collection of hungry slimes.
  • Complete daily requests from other ranchers to get bonus rewards.
  • Earn money to upgrade your vacpack, build more corrals, or expand your ranch.
  • Use Slime Science to find rare resources, craft decorations, and create gadgets that will help you on your adventures.
  • Explore a sprawling world loaded with lots of secrets and hidden treasures.




Slimetastic Features:


  • Choose from 3 game modes: Adventure, Casual, and Rush
  • Get creative and combine slimes into more than 150 hybrid slimes
  • Take advantage of our full controller support if you think keyboards should be used to play music instead of games

data.name: Darts Player Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Darts Player Simulator!

I am finally pleased to welcome you to the Steam page for Darts Player Simulator, a long time coming but wishlists are now open, I'm a solo dev building a game around a wonderful growing community and can't wait for you to finally play the game on PC.

From the pub to the Palace

Start with nothing but a set of darts and a place on the pub circuit. Win enough to earn a Tour Card, climb the Pro Circuit and the Order of Merit, and fight your way onto the televised Continental Series and the majors. Every season has a full calendar: floor events, TV weekends abroad, qualifiers, the Nations Cup and a World Championship. Or skip the long road with a scenario start: The Wonderkid, Last Chance Saloon or The Champion's Slide.

Create your player

Build your player in 3D before the first dart is thrown. Start from a quick-start head or shape everything yourself: face, eyes, skin tone and age, dozens of hairstyles and beards, build and height. Then pick your walk-on look, from the darts shirt to trousers, shoes and accessories. Check it under pub, floor and TV lighting, from a close-up to the oche. The player you make walks on and throws on the match stage, and your career portrait is rendered from them.

Every dart is simulated or thrown

Matches are played dart by dart on a 3D board, with a throw model built around your player's skills, form, nerves and kit. Play your own matches and aim every visit, throw your own bull-up, watch the key moments as highlights, or simulate straight to the result. Multi-day events play out day by day, and you can follow any televised event live in the Event Centre, round by round, with a televised draw for the majors. Or take control and decide where your player throws using several different throwing modes, all affected by your players current abilities.

Train like a pro

Plan your week: a basic block that sharpens the fundamentals, or an advanced plan built from eight real practice games, from Around the Clock and Bob's 27 to Shanghai, 121 and Halve It. Simulate them or play them yourself for a bigger boost. Each one builds a different part of your game.

A career off the oche

Sponsors and money: sign deals, hit their targets and watch the books. Entry fees, travel, hotels, staff wages, tax and prize money all add up.

The press: post-match interviews and press conferences before the majors, where how you answer changes your confidence, followers, public image and rivalries. The papers remember what you said.

Stories: decisions land in your inbox all season long, from off-season training blocks to rival grudges.

Your team: coaches, a physio, a practice partner, an agent. Manage your workload, or burn out.

Made to measure

Design your stage shirt in the kit designer and see it on your own player in 3D, front and back: the cut, collar and trim, the pattern, the colours, your name or nickname across the back, and the fabric, which affects how you play. Design your own darts in the workshop too, from barrel to grip, weight and flights, then test the prototype and launch your own signature range.

Every format in the sport

Straight knockouts, group stages, sets and legs, a weekly TV league with knockout nights and play-offs, rolling-entry opens where the seeds join later, qualifiers, a Women's Tour, a Junior World Championship, a Veterans Tour, and the Nations Cup with 40 teams.

A world that keeps score

Around 600 players rise, slump, switch darts, sign with sponsors and retire. Rivalries build from matches and from words. Each season ends with an awards night and a review of your year and the world's. Collect signed title cards, set records, and build a legacy worthy of the Hall of Fame.

Built to be modded

Everything in the game is data: players, tours, events, venues, sponsors, kit, commentary, interview questions and stories. Make your own with the in-game Mod Studio, import a mod from a zip, or write scripts for new stories, panels and rules.

Licensing 

This is an indie game, developed by one developer. Because of this the game is unlicensed as does not feature real world sponsors, players or event names, unless licensed and specified in release notes and via our social channels.

data.name: Writer's Block
data.detailed_description:
Writer's Block is a word-building roguelike. Spell words from a bag of letter tiles, hiring help and using tools to either get published or be rejected... AGAIN!

Every page has a score to beat. Each word scores Ink × Flair: Ink from the letters you play, Flair from premium squares, Tome levels and your Scribes. Discard what you can't use and play the odds.

The Pedant pays out for every vowel. Long-Winded rewards length. Playing along with the scribes multiplies your score by granting you bonus flair or ink.

  • Quills turn tiles into premium squares, wildcards and more

  • Tomes level up nouns, verbs, adjectives and more

  • Editions permanently upgrade your book

The Minimalist rejects words over five letters. The Deadline allows only two words. Plan your vocabulary around them or see your draft sent back.

Published or rejected, every run is saved in Your Library with its total score, its best word and the full manuscript.

data.name: Don't Mention B3
data.detailed_description:
You’re Just Here for the Night Shift

You are the new night-shift attendant at an underground parking garage.

Whenever a vehicle pulls up to the gate, you must verify the driver, their credentials, the vehicle scan results, surveillance footage, and internal records—then decide whether to let them through.

Inspect the driver. Check their credentials. Review the footage. Search the records. Make your decision.

The job seems simple.

Until the information starts contradicting itself.

Don’t Trust Everything You See

The driver in front of you may not appear on the surveillance feed.

The scan may show an empty back seat, even though something seems to be sitting inside.

The credentials may appear perfectly valid, while the internal records say the person has been dead for years.

The same vehicle may leave completely different information across separate records.

No Time Limit

There is no time limit during inspections.

Drivers will wait at the window, giving you as much time as you need to review the available information before making your decision.

Key Features

  • First-person psychological horror

  • Verify drivers, credentials, surveillance footage, and internal records

  • Detect anomalies through conflicting information

  • Allow or deny entry to every vehicle that arrives

  • No countdown—investigate each case at your own pace

  • The story changes based on the decisions you make over time

  • A confined, oppressive night-shift setting beneath an underground parking garage

  • Multiple endings in the full version

Remember

Your only duty is to inspect vehicles.

Do not leave your post.

Do not investigate irrelevant information.

Most importantly—

Do not mention B3.

data.name: NightClub Manager Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Build and manage your own nightclub in a decision-driven management simulator where every choice can shape the future of your business.

You are the highest authority in the club. There is no boss above you — every important decision is yours to make.

Throughout the game, different characters will come to you with their own unique scenarios, requests, complaints, proposals, and problems. Each character has their own situations to deal with, and it is up to you to decide whether to approve or reject what they ask. Your decisions can help the club, create new problems, or push the business closer to failure.

Your choices directly affect four core stats: Security, Money, Reputation, and Staff Satisfaction. There is rarely a perfect answer. A decision that benefits one part of the nightclub may damage another, so you must decide which risks are worth taking and keep the different sides of the business under control.

But running the nightclub is not just about making decisions.

Keep the venue clean, because leaving dirt and mess around the club will cause your Reputation to fall.

Security also has direct consequences. As your Security level decreases, the chance of a thief entering the nightclub increases. If a thief appears, you can confront and beat them up before they escape.

Fires can also break out inside the nightclub. When they do, you will need to react quickly, grab a fire extinguisher, and put out the flames before the situation gets worse.

Your management determines how the story of your nightclub ends. There are 5 different endings in total: 4 losing endings and 1 winning ending.

Key Features

  • Run the nightclub as the person with the final say.

  • Meet different characters, each with their own unique scenarios.

  • Approve or reject requests and deal with the consequences.

  • Balance Security, Money, Reputation, and Staff Satisfaction.

  • Clean the nightclub to prevent your Reputation from falling.

  • Manage Security to reduce the chance of thieves appearing.

  • Confront and fight thieves who enter your club.

  • React to fires and extinguish them before they become a bigger problem.

  • Experience 5 different endings based on how well you manage the nightclub.

Every decision matters. Balance your priorities, deal with unexpected problems, and keep your nightclub alive long enough to reach the winning ending.

data.name: DEADBYTE
data.detailed_description:
Step into an adrenaline-fueled, round-based zombie survival FPS—play solo or team up with up to 3 friends online! Mow down endless hordes of the undead, earn cash from every kill, and gear up with powerful weapons, perks, upgrades, and more. The deeper you go, the deadlier it gets!

  • A round-based zombie shooter inspired by classics

  • Play by yourself or up to 4-players online

  • A Complete Experience without Microtransactions/DLCs

  • 6 Maps at Launch

  • 50+ Weapons to use & Upgrade

  • Many Perks & PowerUps

  • Hidden Secrets (Easter Eggs)

  • Infinite Replayability

SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Built for up to 4 players online, BRAINDEAD cranks up the challenge based on how many survivors are in your squad. Strength in numbers—but only if you work together. Join our Official Discord to team up with like-minded fighters and take on the madness together!

CLASSIC ENEMIES

The world is overrun by zombies and hellhounds! Arm yourself and fight through relentless waves of terror—only the brave will survive and advance!

GUNS & PERKS

Customize your loadout mid-battle—buy powerful guns and game-changing perks on the fly! Unlock the mighty PowerPuncher3000 to supercharge your weapons, unleashing devastating laser-enhanced rounds that obliterate enemies in a blaze of glory!

POWERUPS

Slay any enemy and you might trigger a powerup drop—random, rare, and game-changing! These boosts grant survivors massive temporary advantages, or even permanent rewards like bonus cash or mysterious random perks. Every kill counts!

LUCKY OR NOT?

Got extra cash and a thirst for the unknown? Take a gamble at the Mystery Box—spin the odds and unleash a random weapon that could turn the tide of battle... or seal your fate!

data.name: Daymare Town
data.detailed_description:
the World of Daymare

Daymare Town is a hand-drawn puzzle adventure game. You find yourself in a heart of a strange city populated by peculiar Metamorph creatures. This town is full of nooks and crannies, puzzles, secrets and items to collect to help you along the way. Can you escape the nightmare of a day?

Story

You are not alone here. You will meet peculiar daymare inhabitants. Some of them will help you, some need your help. Almost everyone has a story. You can choose to learn those stories if you just listen or look carefully at the environmental storytelling.

Puzzles

You will have to dive deep into the nooks and crannies of this town in order to solve all its mysteries and puzzles, of which are plenty. The better part of them will have you fighting the entropy of a town, bringing back signal to noise. There are also creatures here that need your help, look at them closely to learn who they are and what they need from you. You will have an inventory of items to use while solving puzzles.

Graphics

Entire game is hand-drawn. There's nothing auto-generated nor procedural. There's no AI used in any capacity. Each location was thoughtfully designed. Its stylized and sketchy character emphasizes the eerie atmosphere of an unshaped nightmare you found yourself in.

Music

Piano music for this game was created by contemporary composer Alex Voytenko. His style of music perfectly emphasizes the atmosphere of unspoken madness permeating this town.

data.name: TRESPASS - Episode 2
data.detailed_description:
Trespass – Episode 2 Introduction:

The protagonist, Samuel Rodriguez wakes up and finds himself in an unfamiliar location.
He will revisit and attempt to escape from locations connected to his past and along the way uncover the mysteries behind his forgotten past.


“I regained consciousness in what seemed to be some kind of detention facility.
With a lot of difficulty, I made it out of the hall
only to appear in my own home,
the home I shared together with Jess.

She spoke to me in such a way
that she didn’t know about the strange situation I was finding myself in.
She spoke to me so ordinarily as if everything was alright.
No, something about it was a little off.

She told me not to follow her but even as I tried,
I found myself between two high-rise buildings with a narrow bridge connecting the two.

Fear suddenly gripped me.
Not because I found myself having to cross a tightrope between two buildings.
But it was an ominous feeling that I might lose her.

Finally, at the end of a dark hallway,
I see my wife once again.

What’s the dreaded meaning of this game of hide and seek?
And what are these absurd locations and experiences?

These things that I seeing and hearing,
Is it reality or just a dream?

I have to figure out what’s going on.”

Gameplay:

Trespass – Episode 2 is a game intended to test your cognitive abilities. Escape from various locations, all of which have unique objectives whether it’s searching for hints in a morgue through interacting with the surrounding objects or making your way through a military facility using various weapons and explosives.
Everything you need to escape is there. It’s all a matter of using your observational skills and thinking outside of the box.

data.name: Propaganda Llama
data.detailed_description:
Puzzling and adorable political intrigue.

  • Over 50 llevels of challenging puzzles and warm fuzzies.
  • Our friendly, one-button interface puts you in control of a propaganda machine.
  • Press and hold the broadcast button to indoctrinate as many folks as possible and progress to the next level.
  • Your utility-vehicle is on autopilot, so work the button with strategy and skill to solve the puzzles and progress to the big city.
  • Game features many llamas, extreme cuddliness, and what is being described as political palate cleanser.

Propaganda Llama puts you in control of the government broadcast machine on a mission to indoctrinate the masses and consolidate power with The Lleader. As you campaign the countryside, utilize the one-button interface to spread fluff to silence the resistance. Do not be fooled by a cuddly exterior, these are aspiring overlords. Lloyalty before dishonour!

With Propaganda Llama you have the sway to change minds and to orchestrate an ascendance to the highest ranks. To create such a movement, ignore diplomacy and deploy your machinery to wipe their slates clean. Prove that you can calm the revolution, promote conformity, and maintain cuteness. Propaganda Llama is soft on the outside, hard on the inside.

Enjoy snuggly, non-threatening gameplay with a simple format that encourages all members of the party to take the machine for a test ride. Casual gamers will be quick to fall under its spell, and seasoned enthusiasts will demonstrate their allegiance by playing through the game and returning to realize the rewards of perfection. Surrender your will to The Lleader!

data.name: Animal Sanctuary
data.detailed_description:
Build a home for a whole bunch of furry friends, from the largest elephant to the tiny meerkats.



Rebuild this old decayed Sanctuary to temp the Animals to return. Plant trees and flowers to make the place cozy, give them their favourite food and some shelter for those cold nights and maybe the occasional belly rub to keep them happier than ever. Of course you could just sit back and relax while they go for a swim or chase the beachballs, as well as each other, around!



With 40+ species of animal to look after, and each one having their own minor needs to cater for, keeping them all happy should prove a small challenge. Some have favourite foods and areas of the map, others need a few extra belly rubs than most to truly feel loved. Others are more playful and would rather belly flop from the waterfall or pop some balloons to keep themselves amused.

Look after them, they need a helping hand!

data.name: Alchemonium
data.detailed_description:
Several years after the Great Battle, circumstances lead to the breaking of the seals and the birth of a New God.

You have been forced to change, and therefore you have changed, as has the way you perceive the world and the way the world perceives you. It is up to you to remain who you once were.

Do you act on instinct, or do you fight for a greater purpose? Will your actions be in vain in the face of these new threats? Do you still retain your humanity?

Dissolve and coagulate. Discover water, earth, fire and air. Transform your raw material into the philosopher's stone.

Alchemonium is a 2D soulslike metroidvania set in a kingdom deeply rooted in alchemy, reconquered by chaos. Explore its lands and ruins in search of answers... or revenge. Go forward, go back, get lost and find new paths that were hidden before. Immerse yourself in a dark atmosphere, where a small black raven seems to be the only one who will guide you to your destiny.

With loneliness and death as your only companion, you must rely on your sword and your crossbow-arm to make your way through creatures born of flesh and chaos. Acquire new arrows and utilities and think of new ways to combine them to progress. Snatch the orbs and challenge the False God.

data.name: Lightstep Chronicles
data.detailed_description:
WISHLIST LIGHTSTEP CHRONICLES


JOIN THE COMMUNITY


About the Game

Lightstep Chronicles is a dark sci-fi text-based adventure set on the alien vessel with an insane AI as your captor.



You play as a military captain exploring an off-world underground crashsite. You discover an ancient spaceship of alien technology and imperial livery, and are then whisked away on an intergalactic adventure of trying to stay alive and relevant in a spaceship that clearly has a hidden agenda. At the heart of Lightstep Chronicles is a text-based adventure, allowing you to communicate with the ship's AI, a manic creature that seems to be at war with itself.

Lightstep Chronicles is set in stunning futuristic art deco off-world locations, sharing the universe of the Dark Horse Comics series Lightstep. The game focuses on the thin line between humanity and artificial intelligence, and the very nature of transcendence.

data.name: A Few Quick Matches
data.detailed_description:
A fast-paced, easy to play, tiny platform fighter for 1-4 players, built to honor the era where stick fights ruled the internet! 

STYLE ON EVERYONE! We wanted A FEW QUICK MATCHES to feel like an old-school stick fight, which means flashy animations and impactful moments! To attain this feel, we made it so that most successful hits can be cancelled into air dashes, meaning your follow-up routes are nearly infinite. Deep-diving into this combo system is incredibly rewarding, and landing a well-executed chain of attacks feels uniquely satisfying. While this mechanic is not necessary to enjoy your battles, those who choose to embrace it will push the game to its limits!






FIGHT ANYONE! We designed our game with online play in mind. A FEW QUICK MATCHES harnesses the amazing magic of ROLLBACK NETCODE to ensure smooth, lag-free battles across the internet. Host lobbies to challenge your friends, or hop into quickplay to match up with any player in your region.

data.name: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults
data.detailed_description:
The wicked Belcorra Haruvex haunts her forsaken home of Gauntlight Keep. Centuries ago, she threatened the world with an army of monsters, beasts, and abominations, only to be defeated by four brave heroes. But her magic and malice have brought her back to the world as a ghost—and her army has only grown stronger in her absence.

Now Belcorra is ready to take revenge against those who wronged her in life. Brave heroes are needed to venture forth into the undiscovered depths of Gauntlight Keep—a sprawling mega dungeon teeming with foul monsters—to defeat Belcorra’s army and put her wicked soul to rest once and for all.

Players control and customize four iconic heroes of the Pathfinder universe, whose stories will unfold as they advance ever deeper into the dungeon.

Delve deep into a sprawling mega dungeon beneath Gauntlight Keep. The Vaults are divided into several distinct biomes, each comprising its own chapter of the game. Each biome presents new foes, hazards, and bosses for the players to overcome.


Amiri the Barbarian, Harsk the Ranger, Kyra the Cleric, and Ezren the Wizard. Each features unique play styles, abilities, and feats, allowing for deep Pathfinder-style customization.


Players don’t just play one powerful hero - they control the full team of four! Players can stick with their favorite, and either switch to the other heroes when the time is right or deploy them to act on their own. For example, Amiri could kick open the door or be sent to hold off the enemies while Harsk picks the lock.

Controlling the entire team also allows players to take tactical advantage of each hero’s special strengths and even the odds against the abominations with powerful combos.

Some combos are a 1-2 punch where timing is everything, such as Harsk weakening foes with poison before they face Kyra’s slashing scimitar.

Other combos let heroes create something entirely new – for example, Ezren’s wall of fire becomes a flame vortex when Amiri spins her sword, a flame wave when Harsk swings his dual axes, or a wide-ranging fire dome when Kyra strikes the ground with her magic!

Each hero in Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults can be customized via various advancement paths. Players choose how to improve each hero's abilities as they level up to create the kind of hero they want to play.

For example, Kyra the cleric is a vital support character with her starting healing magic, but those spell effects can be altered to increase their range, add damage, or add additional protection, transforming Kyra from healer into a powerful blaster or a mighty frontliner.

Players can join forces with up to 3 other friends in local or online co-op for a fast & friendly pick-up adventure - either right from the beginning, during a tough boss fight, or just because they’ve discovered a new part of the dungeon and want to share the experience!


Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults is an epic adventure where cooperative play is key to defeating Belcorra's abominations and immersing yourself in the adventure. Are you ready to face the challenge and rescue Golarion? Prepare yourself for an unparalleled journey like none other.

Add Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults to your wishlist now.

data.name: Bizarre Barber
data.detailed_description:
Have you ever wanted to be a hairstylist? Or maybe you just love having fun? Grab your VR controllers, and get ready to snip away! Bizarre Barber is a surreal, fun & fast-moving haircutting game set on a subway platform.
There were no comfy barber chairs left after the apocalypse, so your eccentric clientele moves chaotically through the colorful worlds, unable to sit still even for a second. Are your reflexes, creativity and strategy skills strong enough to defeat the United Underground hairiest president?



— 7 unique worlds

— 13 challenging levels

— 5 scissor boosters, including sword-hands!

— flaming mushrooms, flying rats, drunk birds, and other fun obstacles

— Interactive groovy soundtrack

— award-winning design

— no artificial locomotion

— sitting and standing modes

— no tutorials, no buttons: easy, enjoyable and intuitive interactions

— for VR beginners and veterans alike

—streamer-friendly supports LIV mixed reality capture (with both green screen and avatars)
