data.name: Citadale: The Legends Trilogy
data.detailed_description:
Step into the hellhouse once again...

Citadale - The Legends Trilogy combines the original three 8-bit releases in one bloody package:

  • Chapter 1: Gate of Souls - Sonja Dorleac is on her way to Citadale castle to find her missing husband.
  • Chapter 2: Curse of Darkness - Sonja’s Son, Gabriel, takes up the mantle of the Demon Slayer.
  • Chapter 3: Legacy of Fate - Face the Dark Lord as Christopher – Sonja’s grandson and heir to the Shadow Blade!

Fight evil across three generations with distinct storylines, characters, levels and music.

A Dark Lord plagues the land ... and only YOU can stop him. Play as Sonja Dorleac and bring an end to the forces of darkness by wielding the legendary Shadow Blade. Battle the creatures of the night with swords, axes, shurikens and more – and face off against horrific bosses. If you prove your strength, you can unlock alternate endings for the first two games in the series. A boss rush mode for the original game can also be unlocked if you get the “good” ending in first game!

Features
  • Feast on the 8-bit style artwork combined with epic chiptune music.
  • Stage based, linear progression!
  • Test your skills against face-melting difficulty.
  • Spend hours looking for secrets and unlocking alternate endings.
  • Enjoy a platformer, action game, and adventure – all rolled into one.
  • Not a Metroidvania.

-------------------------------
Controller Information:
Due to limitations with the engine, some controllers, for example 8bitdo gamepads, may not work properly. There is, unfortunately, nothing I can do about that. Should you have any trouble with your gamepad, maybe try another gamepad or use the keyboard. I apologize for the inconvenience.

data.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
data.detailed_description:
SLOW ORBIT is a small idle space war made for the unused bottom corner of your screen. It opens there automatically in a borderless, always-on-top window, so you can keep an eye on the fleet while you work, watch something or play another game.

The ships handle combat and planet conquest on their own. Jump in whenever you want: click the battlefield to add a few shots, or fire a heavy barrage. A barrage can rescue a close fight, but it burns part of your hull and can end a run if you get greedy.

Each conquered planet pays credits. Spend them on more income, harder hits, stronger armor, quicker repairs and other upgrades. If the fleet is destroyed, you return to the first planet and lose the credits and upgrades from that run. Your rank, cards and weapons stay with you, giving the next attempt a better start.

Promotions offer four choices at a time, so every expedition can develop differently. Later, you can begin a new departure and trade the current run for Legacy and another ship. Gear and career progress carry over, and every type of ship adds something different to the fleet.

Every fifth planet is an outpost. Every tenth is a bastion with shields and defensive guns. That is usually where an easy run stops being easy—and where one more upgrade or a well-timed barrage can make the difference.

data.name: Choice Clash: What Would You Rather?
data.detailed_description:
Choice Clash: What Would You Rather? Dive into a world of choices with 300 mind-bending dilemmas. Your path, your destiny – choose wisely!
In this game, you will navigate thought-provoking dilemmas, make critical choices, and see how your decisions stack up against a global community of players.

🌎 Connect with the World:
Join a global community of decision-makers! Engage with players from around the world as you make your picks. See how your choices stack up against those of others in real-time, thanks to our internet-connected voting system. The world is your playground, and every choice counts!

📊 Real Votes, Real Insights:
Witness the true power of democracy as you watch the percentages shift with each vote. Curious to know how many would choose to teleport anywhere or time travel only once. Dive into the statistics, satisfy your curiosity, and let the numbers speak for themselves.

🔥 Unleash Your Imagination:
With over 300 mind-bending questions, 'Choice Clash' takes you on an exhilarating journey of imagination. Whether you're an adventurer at heart, a strategic thinker, or a lover of life's simple pleasures, there's a question for every preference.

💬 Share Your Thoughts:
Engage in lively discussions with fellow players in our vibrant community forums. Share your reasons behind your choices, debate the pros and cons, and even convince others to see things your way!

🌈 Endless Entertainment:
"Choice Clash" offers endless hours of fun and intellectual stimulation, making it the perfect game for gatherings, parties, or solo adventures. Discover new perspectives, and learn more about yourself.

Internet Connection Disclaimer: This game requires an internet connection to fully engage in real-time voting and access up-to-date results. While offline play is possible, we recommend staying connected for the complete experience, where your votes truly matter and reflect the global community's preferences.

data.name: The Ritual on Weylyn Island
data.detailed_description:
In the not so distant past, on a remote Pacific North West Island, 22 year old, Moira Weylyn has come back to her Grandfather’s property to meet her few remaining family members and witness the reading of his last will and testament.

Once landing on the remote North West Island property, she discovers her family has disappeared and a sinister evil has awakened on the island —an evil that begins with a neo-pagan cult, and ends with something far more dangerous ready to consume the world. Moira realizes her very fate lies in solving the larger mystery at the heart of Weylyn Island -a place with an ancient, dark history.

Inspired by classic horror movies, The Ritual on Weylyn Island is a combat-free, story-driven game. The main objective of the game is to find your family, collect information and stay alive long enough to unravel the evil plot that surrounds your bloodline.

During the game you can expect to do the following:

- Traverse the vast island and explore its richly-detailed, unique and treacherous environments.

- Solve and complete small puzzles and objectives to progress through the story and reveal what lies ahead.

- Discover and Protect Family and loved ones as you find them during the game

- Collect tapes and clues left by your Grandfather that add additional layers backstory to the dark tale.

- Survive the island, as well as the twisted cult members and their demon-possessed followers to reach the end alive.

data.name: Chainsaw Warrior (Classic)
data.detailed_description:
About Chainsaw Warrior

Chainsaw Warrior from Games Workshop is the classic nail-biting game for one strong-nerved player! It's the year 2032 and spatial warping has opened a hole into another dimension in the midst of the old municipal buildings at the heart of Manhattan. Bizarre and dangerous creatures are flooding into our dimension, intent on destruction. Behind their actions is a controlling intelligence known as 'Darkness', who intends to drag New York back into the warp – destroying it utterly!

Air strikes, ground assaults and WMDs have all failed to stop the swarming forces from beyond. All that remains is a single hope: a shadowy ex-special forces soldier, enhanced for combat and known only as 'Chainsaw Warrior'. Equipped with all the latest high-tech armaments, he must battle his way through to the trans-dimensional ground-zero and defeat Darkness. Not only are there swarms of zombies, mutants, traps, Chaos Agents and other twisted denizens between him and Darkness, time is the enemy too! Only an hour remains to save New York before it is torn from our world forever.

First published as a solo boardgame in 1987, it has been updated, translated and re-engineered for the digital generation. In Chainsaw Warrior it's just you against both the clock and a tide of evil! Can you prevail where all others have failed? You only have 60 minutes to save New York!

Warhammer Classics

Warhammer Classics is a collection of the greatest titles from the annals of Warhammer video game history, spanning the last 30 years, brought back to life as a series to celebrate their iconic legacy.

Because of their classic nature, some of the content may not accurately reflect current depictions, lore, or presentation within the current Warhammer universes and settings

data.name: Motive Power
data.detailed_description:
Run British Railways through four decades of the diesel and electric age

It is 1955, and the Modernisation Plan has handed you the money to replace steam. You hold the Chief Executive's chair from 1955 to 1994: every locomotive class BR ordered — or cancelled — is yours to commission, allocate, overhaul, refurbish, convert, store and finally withdraw.

What you do each month

  • Build the fleet — follow the real order book class by class, or divert the money: back designs BR cancelled, order deeper batches of the ones that worked, and live with the consequences for the following decades.

  • Keep it running — all 51 classes are researched individually, and every locomotive is an individual machine with its own works history, overhaul clock, equipment and depot. Works capacity is shared and finite; a neglected fleet fails in traffic.

  • Spend two budgets— a capital pot for orders, refurbishments and conversions, and a maintenance allowance drained by the fleet's running costs. Spending capital well is what relieves the maintenance account.

  • Direct the programmes — electric train heating, dual brakes, refurbishment life-extensions, sub-class conversions and renumberings, on historical schedules or your own.

  • Manage the map— allocate classes across the real depot network as it opens, closes and specialises across the era.

  • Face the era — the Beeching reports, the 1968 Transport Act, oil shocks, strikes and sectorisation arrive on their real dates, with real mandates attached.

    Answer for it every December

Each year closes with a graded report card marking your railway against the real one — budget, availability, fleet costs, objectives. At the end of 1994, four decades of your decisions stand against BR's actual record.

Two ways to play

  • Historical the calibrated museum: the fleet lives and dies as the record says it did, and your deviations are measured against it.

  • Living economy— demand drives the railway: surpluses go to store, deficits bite, the Treasury escalates, and your alternative history earns its own consequences. Never a game-over — the score simply records the wreckage.

    Features

  • 51 real locomotive classes, 1955–1994, researched from published records

  • Deterministic worlds — every game replays exactly from its seed

  • Era starts from 1955 to 1993, from the Pilot Scheme to the sector railway

  • An interface that lives in its era — BR green boardroom to sector-era skins

  • Period railway photography throughout

  • A full in-game player's guide covering every mechanic

  • Fleet strategy, not train driving — no timetables, no signalling, no micromanagement

  • Huge thanks to Platform 5 Publishing for their kind permission to use real data from their Motive Power Pocket Books and Combined Volumes

data.name: Gridiron Manager
data.detailed_description:
If you spend more time looking at depth charts than watching the quarterback, you belong in the front office.

Gridiron Manager is a hardcore management simulation built specifically for American Football. There are no reflex-based mini-games, no scripted animations, and no controller stick-skills to bail you out. You are the Head Coach and General Manager, and every game is won or lost entirely on your preparation, your roster, and your tactical execution.

A Game of Mathematics and Physics Forget arcade mechanics. This simulation runs entirely on a deterministic 20Hz physics engine. Every single run fit, blocking assignment, and pass trajectory is calculated in real time based on player ratings and your scheme. You watch the results unfold exactly as you drew them up.

The Coach's Chalkboard Command your team using a sleek, dark-mode interface designed to look like elite front-office analytics software. Swap personnel, view defensive shell previews, and call your plays on a massive, interactive 2D chalkboard.

Two Unique Ecosystems Choose your proving ground and build a dynasty in either the College or Professional ranks:

  • The College Game: Fight for your program's life in grueling, time-based recruiting battles, manage player eligibility, and try to survive the chaos of the transfer portal.

  • The Pro Game: Step into the war room to run a full-scale professional draft, balance a strict 53-man roster, and navigate complex salary caps and signing bonuses.

Tactics matter. Scheme matters. Matchups matter. If you want to outsmart your opponent instead of out-clicking them, your new front office is waiting.

data.name: Thread
data.detailed_description:
A puppet themed platformer metroidvania with a focus on platforming rather than combat. Throw your crystal scissors into walls to create your own platforms, explore a twisting and mysterious land, and solve puzzles on a worldwide scale.

Explore a World of Puppets

In this game you will uncover the forgotten lands of Terrastage. A once bustling place with puppets and marionettes all playing their part. But now, the world has fallen into rot and decay. The residents of the world have lost their will and now simply wander in aimless desperation.

Solve Area Wide Puzzles

In the age of prosperity, great structures were built in the world. Now these mechanisms block your path. Use your map to plan a way through the world and reach your goal.




Cut the Threads of Your Enemies

Use your magic scissors to cut the strings of your foes and clear your path. As you progress, find upgrades that enhance your platforming and combat abilities to become unstoppable.

data.name: Rainbow Shadow Livestream
data.detailed_description:
This is a streamer management simulation game where you play as an aspiring streamer, a "dark horse" joining AstraLive, the world's largest streaming agency. Over a 2-year period, your goal is to reach 10 million followers! You can choose your own development path: Will you become a Zatsudan (Chatting) streamer, a Singer/Music streamer, or a Gaming streamer? You can also choose all-around development and unlock your own story through various different endings! If you are interested in the game, don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!

Player Character

You are free to choose your gender. The male player character model is currently still under design, so please look forward to it!

Management/Development

Content As an excellent streamer, you will not only need to participate in training programs provided by the streaming agency but also perform extra "Recharges" in your daily life to enhance your professional skills!

Master the Streamer’s Life

An excellent streamer must actively engage with the live chat, block unfriendly messages, and even face off against antis during livestreams.

Outside of streaming, you’ll need to gather new topics from everyday life, take on sponsorship deals to earn more coins, invite colleagues for collaboration streams, manage public opinion and risk control, and recruit a reliable support team to back you up.

Life on the Island

Remember to balance work and play!

Sometimes, you need to step away from the internet and take a break on the island.
Enjoy delicious street food at the park, watch a movie at the cinema, and spend quality time with your favorite character on a warm and relaxing date.

Romanceable Characters

In future versions, the game will offer a total of 8 romanceable characters (4 male and 4 female). Regardless of your own gender, you can interact with, date, or establish a romantic relationship with the characters you like!

Supporting Character

In addition, there are dozens of residents on the island whose Affection Levels you can raise. When you become best friends with them, you will receive their help in your daily life!

Development Stage

The game is currently still in a very early development stage—many features are still being built. New content and systems will be added progressively in the future.

If you are interested in the game, don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!

data.name: Closer than Allowed: After the Bell
data.detailed_description:
The rules say keep your distance. After the bell, that gets harder.

You arrive at Greenfield High School's adult transfer program in the United States, surrounded by students trying to rebuild their lives on their own terms. Everyone here has a wall: a past they do not explain, a rumor they ignore, a family they left behind, or a secret life they keep hidden.

All romanceable characters are 18 years of age or older.

Closer than Allowed: After the Bell is a mature romantic visual novel about emotional distance, second chances, and the choices that turn friendship into something harder to walk away from. Expect lingering glances, late-night conversations, complicated trust, and routes where small decisions can change what happens next.

Four Heroines. Four Walls to Understand.

Emma Clarke - The girl who can barely meet your eyes in class. Behind the oversized hoodies and quiet apologies is an online world where she becomes someone else entirely. What happens when her secret life and yours collide?

Noelle Beaumont - Tall, composed, and almost impossible to read. The French transfer reads Camus and plays chess alone, keeping every emotion under glass. Get close enough, and you may hear what she whispers in French when she thinks no one is listening.

Val Moreno - Flat expression. Fewer words. A record she does not explain. Val acts like she does not care about you, or anyone else. So why does she keep showing up exactly when you need her?

Miki Tanaka - Loud, fearless, and impossible to ignore. Miki says exactly what she thinks, then dares you to keep up. But catch her in a quiet moment, and the bravado drops just long enough to reveal what she has been running from.

Choices That Shape the Story

  • Three complete episodes - Play from the prologue through Week 10 and the route epilogues.

  • Four heroines, 16 endings - Your choices, promises, and the trust you build shape each relationship's outcome.

  • 40 collectible CGs - Revisit unlocked images in the gallery and character profiles, and track completed endings.

  • 10 origins - Your background changes the prologue and details in later conversations.

  • Read at your own pace - Use saves, the dialogue history, instant text completion, and adjustable text size and contrast.

Not a Typical Campus Romance

Greenfield High School is not a postcard campus. Its adult transfer program is for people trying to restart their lives after the usual paths failed them. The setting is intimate, messy, and freer than a typical campus story, but every connection still has consequences.

This story contains mature romantic themes, suggestive situations, strong language, and references to difficult personal histories, and may not be suitable for all audiences.

The Complete Story

Version 1.0 includes Episodes 1, 2, and 3 in the base game. Continue from the first meetings in Episode 1 into Weeks 5-8 in Episode 2, then Weeks 9-10 and the route endings in Episode 3. Existing owners receive the complete update at no extra charge.

Launch Languages

The launch version supports English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, and Russian text.

Add to your Wishlist now.

Get closer.

data.name: B-17 Flying Fortress: World War II Bombers in Action
data.detailed_description:
1992 Classic is where it all started. Their chances for survival were slim. But, despite tremendous adversity, the crew of the Memphis Belle returned from their 25th mission to become heroes of the Allied air offensive in World War II.
What did the courageous flyboys of the Memphis Belle really experience as they plowed through relentless anti-aircraft fire over Nazi-occupied Europe? Find out for yourself as you lead a 10-men crew to victory... or defeat... against squadrons of Nazi warplanes in the legendary B-17 Flying Fortress!

A World War II adventure in the sky

The most complete and accurate bomber simulation ever produced, the B-17 Flying Fortress will have you negotiating 25 perilous missions in broad daylight from bases in eastern England.


Manage, fly, fight!

You'll allocate crew members to their specific tasks! You'll fly in authentic WW II formation with other B-17s! And you'll destroy strategic targets like canals, bridges, dockyards, submarine pens, and factories in dangerous bombing runs!


A Detailed simulation

Authentic flight dynamics, ordnance, and World War II atmosphere produce strikingly realistic flight simulation, down to the choice of historically authentic nose art!
Select 10 crew members by studying their past missions, promotions, and medals but be ready to take control of each and every position onboard.

Back from 1992!

This is the original MicroProse B-17 Flying Fortress, a real legend in the history of video games. Fly the B-17 Flying Fortress and become a legend before your own time!

data.name: Furry Farm
data.detailed_description:
Furry Farm is a farming simulator RPG!

Start your adventure in Tail Town and bring Furry Farm back to its paws! Roll up your sleeves, grab your tools, and get ready for hard work. Can you make this abandoned farm great again? Who knows… maybe your neighbors can help you out! The townsfolk are not hopeful for the Paw Festival this year, but maybe you can turn things around.

Features:

  • Rebuild the farm: Animals, crops, and maybe even a fishing pond! Find your own way to earn money and restore the farm.

  • 4 Player Co-Op: Invite your friends and play together!

  • Explore the town: Help the city NPCs turn their lives around. Over 20 NPCs with their own side quests.

  • Paw Festival: Coordinate the biggest annual event in Tail Town in your own way.

  • Home: You have a customizable house. Make it functional or just pretty!

  • Cook: Over 50 recipes for you to collect and prepare… but can you gather all the ingredients?

data.detailed_description:
Soul Warden is a deep, turn-based, dungeon-crawling RPG that combines classic roguelike gameplay with a pinch of collect-a-thon progression, tons of loot, extensive build customization and online multiplayer so you can dungeon-crawl with friends!

Fresh out of Warding Academy, you play the role of an inexperienced Soul Warden whose first day on the job is abruptly spoiled by hundreds of miscreant souls mysteriously breaking free from their slumber. Tasked with safekeeping the Underworld's most dangerous dungeons, it is your duty to face the dangers below and recapture the miscreants - down to the very last one of them!



Soul Wardens always carry Lanterns. These powerful artifacts absorb the very souls and abilities of enemies defeated in combat, including bosses. Different Souls grant Wardens different powers, meaning that every enemy defeated represents a brand new class to play in your collection.

Combat is turn-based, but Player and NPC actions are solved simultaneously. In true traditional roguelike fashion, time advances as you perform these actions.

Soul Warden's deep progression loop is constantly driven by the outstanding amount of class diversity and builds that originate from the combination of a Diablo-esque looting system, the unique ability to collect a fresh set of powers every time a new enemy is defeated, and the utility of an otherworldly crafting system.



• Classic Roguelike Combat System
• Storyline & Questing Systems
• Online Multiplayer Co-Op
• Hardcore (+) Game Modes
• Rarity-Driven Loot System
• Procedural Dungeon Generation
• Over 50 Collectible Souls
• Over 100 Unique Items
• Over 10 Boss Fights
• Shareable Player Dungeons
• In-Game Dungeon Creation Sandbox
• Crafting Systems



Soul Warden is a Classic Roguelike Dungeon-crawling RPG at it's core, but it comes with a very special twist: a true online multiplayer dungeoneering experience!

• Enjoy a classic Roguelike experience with your friends!
• Manage your characters, builds and collections in a single hub!
• Show off your collection of souls!
• Witness a seamless combination of procedurally generated and hand-made content!
• Enjoy an organic and intuitive multiplayer experience!

The Multiplayer solution


• Dungeons are divided into well-defined sectors where combat takes place
• Players are free to move in real time, interact in real time, make decisions in real time
• When a player enters a combat sector, turn-based time-shifting begins for that specific player and that sector of enemies only
• Players can wait for backup or face the challenges alone
• Others can join the fight at any time by approaching the active sector and will only be time-shift constricted once they enter it
• Allows for both joint and separate dungeon exploration
• Allows for a plug-and-play experience of joining or inviting a friend
• Allows for sharing your very own level creations with other players

data.name: Battle of Arachnidia
data.detailed_description:
Battle of Arachnidia is a top-down arcade shooter representing a modern adaptation of classic genre mechanics. The setting is based on battles between combat mechs and arachnid robots.

   The primary objective of the player is to defend the base and eliminate enemy units. The gameplay requires the application of tactical decisions, the progressive upgrade of the controlled robot's characteristics, and the use of auxiliary power-ups.

   The project includes an integrated custom level editor that expands the core functionality of the game. Editor characteristics:

  • Location scalability: The system allows for the design of maps of various dimensions, from compact arenas to large-scale levels.

  • Difficulty variability: Built-in tools provide the capability for detailed adjustment of the created map's difficulty level.

  • Network sharing: A file export function is implemented, enabling the transfer of created levels to other players.

Player objectives:

  • Defending the base.

  • Destroying enemies.

  • Upgrading robot stats.

  • Using power-ups in combat.

The built-in level editor allows the creation of custom maps. Its features:

  • Size adjustment: from small arenas to huge locations.

  • Difficulty selection: setting any difficulty level.

  • Level sharing: the ability to share created maps with friends to play.

The game is a solo project by Volodymyr Krysenko, created as a tribute to the classic arcade shooter genre.

* Delve deeper into the mysterious Invertica system and discover a terrifying global agenda

data.name: Brave Tales
data.detailed_description:
Brave Tales is an isometric action metroidvania where you explore the vast world of Slavic mythology and your story decisions can alter your world and reshape your destiny. You play as Kolya, who is the only one to save the village from pure evil.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Kolya, a simple peasant who lived his life in the countryside but became the Chosen One. The time has come: the forces of evil have attacked and destroyed many villages. Ghouls, vampires and monsters frighten people and destroy everything in their path. They want to conquer the ancient Slavic world and turn it into the Realm of the Dead. The king and princes are terrified. It's your destiny now to become the savior or...if your karma let you do it.

And remember…your decisions define your destiny!


The game is set in ancient Slavic world in X century when the king of Kiev decided to convert the faith of the whole country. Gods were not pleased with it and gathered together to wake up evil troops. Perun sent devils, vampires, ghouls on villages. Many were burnt to the ground, the earth flesh collapsed and more monsters came out of hell.
Fortunately, you play as a boy named Kolya who had secret magic powers. Your destiny is to defend Slavic world and defeat ancient Gods. Explore the villages, find secrets, unlock magic abilities and solve God's riddles.


  • Spirit of Slavic fairy tales and mythology

  • Colorful and unique Slavic characters
  • A system of karma that changes because of your actions
  • Card system which will make each run different

  • A world with different biomes
  • Hidden paths, abandoned villages, and a lot of secrets

    Magical scrolls! Collect magical scrolls throughout your journey to tune your abilities and give you advantages or disadvantages in gameplay. This mechanic brings you with random effects to add more fun in your battle.

data.name: In My Bubble •°
data.detailed_description:
Save dreams from the all-devouring shadows in a world that can no longer sleep.

One sheep… two sheep… people used to drift off counting sheep. But the sheep who delivered dreams have been stolen by a shadow that devours the world. As people stop falling asleep, the world loses its balance. Nightmares awaken, and the Dream Factory falls silent. Now you must purify the shadow-stained sheep and restart the broken chain of dreams.

Team up with a little lamb who escaped the nightmare—and bring back a dazzling morning.

Blow, Pop, and Bounce!

Wield your mysterious Bubble Stick to fight corrupted sheep and nightmares. Cleanse them with a flashy Bubble Dash, turning them back into dream couriers once more. Bubbles are both powerful weapons and springy platforms. Create, ride, and pop bubbles to cross gaps, climb terrain, and move freely through the world.

A Dazzling Morning After the Nightmare

Defeat towering bosses and return warm sunlight to the world. Thanks to your courage, people will finally fall asleep again—and wake up to a bright, lively morning.

data.name: The Devil's Womb
data.detailed_description:
The first chapter of the saga, The Devil's Womb is a free "Made in Italy" classic puzzle adventure-horror title produced by Insane Kat Studio and made with RPG Maker MV.

Part of the story is set during World War ll, more precisely in Krakow.

The protagonist, a girl named Franciszka Jung, is about to undergo the last psychiatric session before discharge. She suffered from various psychotic disorders in the past that led her parents to hospitalize her.
After years of prayers and treatment, that day was the last day for Franciszka: the day before her death.

Franciszka will completely lose the memories of what happened in those last days.

In the meantime, a sweet demon without memories and a past, named Luna, will wake up in a dark place before an ancient and abysmal evil.

How did Luna end up there? Is there any way to get out?
What mysteries are hidden among the inhabitants of that dark place?
What does the mark that Luna bears on her forehead even mean?

● Classic puzzle/RPG gameplay with a focus on the Horror genre, flavored with literature, poetry, friendship, and tenderness.

●Challenging puzzles will test your logic and deduction skills.

● 4 possible endings: Bad Ending, Neutral Ending, Good Ending, and Secret Ending.

● Full of digital computer-made illustrations by various Italian artists.

The game continues the game setting and gameplay of Sufferer Rescue Center 1.

This work tells part of the story before Zhang Ji established the "Lovelorn sanatorium on the main line. Zhang Ji was originally an ordinary migrant worker, but he suffered a sudden accident, and his only relative died in a factory accident. Afterwards, he was forced to lose his job, blamed for an accident by an unscrupulous boss, and suffered a series of unfair treatment and blows such as telecom fraud, and was arrested and imprisoned. When his life fell into a trough, he met his father's only relic during his lifetime, a talking rabbit, and started the funny work of "Lovelorn sanatorium ".

The game adopts dynamic comic performances, with rich pictures and simple gameplay, combined with mini-games to solve puzzles, the overall story plot is humorous and contains many popular hot spots. If you are familiar with Internet culture, you will like this series of works more.

data.name: Hunter A Hunter
data.detailed_description:
Lore and Story

Inspired by the 7 Deadly Sins, the lore of Hunter A Hunter is player being a person who had committed to one of the sins and placed in a test of life and death. Each sin is an individual world with designated scenery and gameplay.

Looks and Feel

The view of first-person and third-person with realistic graphic delivers the true horror look and feel. Then the sound of sorrow completed the experience from entering to exiting the arena.

Gameplay Overview

The gameplay is totally unscripted that brings an action game of terror. The skill and strategy is dynamic and in-depth respective to control and decision angles of racing/chasing game. Also, the mechanic of torch is new and refreshing that makes Hunter A Hunter unlike any horror game out there.


Gameplay Features

  • The mechanic of torch is the highlight of the action horror arena. When opening the torch, hunter, orbs and the true nature of the environment are unveiled. However, the torch depends on your energy and staying in darkness makes surviving even more terrifying.
  • The game mode is to set game match to a new experience or challenge. Every game mode gives both advantage and disadvantage to game mechanics. On top of it, the modes can exist concurrently. You may stack two, three or all of them just for fun.
  • The world is unlike the game mode as it brings a significant modification to gameplay such as having different ability and mechanic of the hunter. Moreover, the world has exclusive environment level design that has correlations with its sin. You pick what hunter you want to deal with.
  • The visual are reflecting realistic graphic together with object light to promote clarity. Even without torch, you should listen carefully to sounds that are happening around you.

Lore and Story

Inspired by the 7 Deadly Sins, the lore of Hunter A Hunter is player being a person who had committed to one of the sins and placed in a test of life and death. Each sin is an individual world with designated scenery and gameplay.

Looks and Feel

The view of first-person and third-person with realistic graphic delivers the true horror look and feel. Then the sound of sorrow completed the experience from entering to exiting the arena.

Gameplay Overview

The gameplay is totally unscripted that brings an action game of terror. The skill and strategy is dynamic and in-depth respective to control and decision angles of racing/chasing game. Also, the mechanic of torch is new and refreshing that makes Hunter A Hunter unlike any horror game out there.


Gameplay Features

  • The mechanic of torch is the highlight of the action horror arena. When opening the torch, hunter, orbs and the true nature of the environment are unveiled. However, the torch depends on your energy and staying in darkness makes surviving even more terrifying.
  • The game mode is to set game match to a new experience or challenge. Every game mode gives both advantage and disadvantage to game mechanics. On top of it, the modes can exist concurrently. You may stack two, three or all of them just for fun.

data.name: My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang!
data.detailed_description:
Will your comment get picked up by your oshi?

She calls herself seiso — but her emotions spill out at full volume. Meet a rookie VTuber who's earnest, all-in, and just a little bit of a mess. Jump into her stream as a viewer, and let your comments do the talking.
Pick 4 slang terms from the flowing chat and drop the perfect line — a brand-new kind of chat-based adventure.

[ KEY FEATURES ]

■ Get Your Comment Picked Up
Land a slang term that reads the room, and she'll call out your name and run with it. Miss, and your comment just scrolls on by like nothing happened. One line from you can steer where the stream goes.

■ "Seiso"? At Full Volume
She bills herself as "the pure, clear stream of the idol world." But hand her a brutally unfair rage game and — there's a tongue-click, there's a desk-slam, there's her real self spilling right out. Nobody in chat is fooled, and nobody minds — that's exactly why they're here. She overreacts, chat roasts her, she owns it and dives back in. That loop is the heart of the game.

■ Your Words, When It Counts
Sooner or later, one incident puts her through the wringer. When it does, it comes down to what you choose to send her — the right words at the right moment decide how she comes out the other side. The True End at 1,000,000 subscribers. A Normal End where she plays it safe. Or a Burnout Ending. And step on a landmine anywhere along the way? Swift Insta-Ban End, right there.

■ A Japanese Slang Dictionary You Actually Learn From
Powered by SlangPool, supervised by an active Japanese language teacher. The game packs over 100 terms, explaining not just what they mean, but when to actually use them. Fully available in 4 languages — Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese — with voiced audio for every example.

[ STAR CAST & CREATORS ]

■ Voiced by Aizawa Hina (VTuber)
Voice acting delivered by active VTuber Aizawa Hina!

■ Art & Live2D: Mogu Zaemon
A seriously skilled creator whose credits include members-only illustrations for well-known VTubers — handling everything here, from character design to Live2D modeling to the gorgeous key visuals!

■ Main Theme by Kairu Nagai (THA NEON LILY)
An original main theme written by a winner of the Outstanding Achievement in Music award at the 42nd Japan Academy Film Prize!

[ Estimated PLAYTIME ]

About 6 hours

[ STREAMING & VIDEOS ]

Go for it! Stream and monetize freely with no prior permission needed — just check these two things:

  • Include the game's title in your title. (Required)

  • List the Steam store page in your description. (Optional)

data.name: Fall For You
data.detailed_description:
If you're reading this, then you probably just died and got thrown out of Heaven. Sorry about that. Good news, though; you get to be on a gameshow!


Conquer Hell With Love and Snuggles!
Fall For You is a rhythm-based roguelike. Dash and attack with the beat, win the hearts of every damned soul you meet, traverse perilous obstacle courses, win fabulous prizes that change the way you play, and cuddle with a scary demon mom to keep yourself going!

Dance Party!
Dash when the kick drum kicks, and attack when the snare drum snares!


Friends in Unexpected Places!
Shoot fellow damned souls with Cuddle Bullets to earn their admiration! Do battle with the Underworld's scariest foes!


The World Changes Around You!
Stay above the UnderFog, as the world rises and falls around you! Take on procedurally generated challenges to stay in the game and win prizes!


Fabulous Prizes!
Win prizes that change your look, and the way you play!


A Place to Rest Your Head
Cuddle with a scary demon mom to keep your health bar up! Survive the crazed whims of a self-proclaimed Goddesz of Chaos! Be nice to the twins!

data.name: KIT-10
data.detailed_description:
KIT-10 is a charming arcade platformer inspired by classics from the mid '80s. Take control of KIT-10, the last operational KIT, to run, jump, meow, and throw your way through KITTI tower, save your fellow KITs, and stop the Katnipper invasion!

Featuring

  • 9 unique multi-screen stages across 3 distinct zones

  • 1 final boss showdown

  • 2 gameplay modes

  • Local and global leaderboards for bragging rights

  • Delightful mid-80s arcade graphics and sound

  • Catchy chiptunes sure to be stuck in your head for days

Story

Story for a 1980s arcade game? Sure, here goes...

The planet was peaceful, organized, and... boring. Citizens desired a little unpredictability in their lives. Thus was the Kinetic Independent Troublemaker (KIT) invented at the newly founded KIT Technical Institute (KITTI). These adorable little bots injected playful chaos into the world and became treasured companions of the people. Then, without warning, the Katnippers invaded. Recognizing the KITs as their biggest threat, they took over KITTI tower and knocked KITs 1-9 offline. It is up to the newest and most courageous model, KIT-10, to save the day and restore mostly organized peace!

data.name: Mob Control
data.detailed_description:
Experience the strangely satisfying thrill of watching your mob multiply as you aim and shoot at the gates. Witness your army grow to massive proportions! Strategically deploy your mighty champions to break through enemy mobs and reach their bases. Choose the best combo to win!

Use the special elements in the levels, such as speed boosts, multipliers, moving gates, and many more. Defend, conquer and rise to victory in this epic tower defense showdown!




If you need some help, you can invite a friend to play together in local multiplayer mode! Prepare for battle, devise a strategy together and fire your mobs from TWO cannons to triumph!

Win battles to unlock booster packs of varying rarities and enhance your card collection. Collectible cards hold the power to elevate your tower defense strategy to new heights. Unlock all the cannons, mobs and champions in the armory and discover their amazing evolutions as you level them up!


Features:

  • fire mobs from your cannon and grow your army
  • launch strong champions when your cannon is supercharged
  • play in local multiplayer mode with a friend and shoot two cannons at once!
  • use multiplier gates or speed boosts strategically to gain a more significant advantage over your enemy
  • destroy enemy bases and strengthen your own
  • play even against two enemies at the same time!
  • unlock and level up different cannons, super champions, mobs and a Rainbow Rage ultimate!
  • open booster pack to enhance your card collection

Rally your army, harness the power of collectible cards, and become the tower defense champion you were born to be!

data.name: stratO
data.detailed_description:
Glide, swoop, tuck, dive, magnetize, grind, walldrive, and burn your way through rings to advance the difficulty of the vast, procedurally-generated environment while avoiding the fog and getting stranded!

stratO is a demanding game that requires a lot of dedication and determination but rewards you with the ability to make a friction-fueled rocket-glider pull off stunts that surpass anything you've seen in a movie. But forget everything you know about other flight sims and flying games. IT CAN'T HELP YOU HERE!

Key Features


- Rather than telling your plane to go up/down/left/right, you control INDIVIDUAL air deflectors, and the sum of their generated torque is the result.
- This means that although the controls are harder to learn, a master pilot can pull off very tight aerobatic stunts and emergency recovery manoeuvres.
- Procedurally-generated world that gets more difficult as you collect more rings.
- Interwoven and deep game mechanics -- slide to boost, boost through rings or slide during a boost to refuel, tuck to magnetize wings and slide easier and double engine thrust and decrease drag, and that's just the start!
- Tight controls are simple to learn, but challenging to master. Being good at stratO is something to be _proud_ of.
- PC Version supports keyboard controls, XBOX Controllers (with vibration) and generic gamepads/flight sticks
- All controls are remappable (including menu & interface navigation)

Other Features


- Flightstick users can press+hold on the main control menu button(The one with the star on it for 3 sec) to toggle the game to pitch/yaw/roll controls
- Alternate colour scheme for airplane & orientation indicators for players with Deuteranopia

data.name: Yoku's Island Express
data.detailed_description:
OUT NOW!


About the Game

Yoku has arrived on Mokumana and he’s ready for the easy life, soaking up the sun and delivering parcels on a tropical paradise!

However, an ancient Island deity is trapped in a restless sleep - and it’s all down to Yoku to traverse the island using a unique blend of pinball mechanics, platforming and open world exploration, in an amazing adventure to help those in need!

Flip and bump our pint-sized protagonist around the stunning hand-painted island on your quest to rebuild the post-office, and wake an old god from its deep slumber.

Key Features:

OPEN-WORLD PINBALL ADVENTURE: Coupled with its unique pinball platforming play style, Yoku’s Island Express offers non-linear gameplay that gives you the freedom to choose your own path across multiple questlines.

WELCOME TO MOKUMANA ISLAND: Seamlessly Explore multiple regions of the island, including tropical beaches, lush jungles, snowy mountains, mysterious caves, and steamy hot springs!

UNLOCK THE AMAZING NEW ABILITIES: Help the friendly locals and earn a range of fantastic new power-ups! Vacuum explosive slugs and wake up sleepy villagers with the Noisemaker!

CAPTIVATING STORY: Meet a cast of unforgettable characters across multiple storylines - whilst uncovering the islands deepest secrets. And maybe rebuild the post office too!

EPIC BOSS BATTLES: Get ready to take on giant bosses using Yoku's trusty ball to 'deliver' the final blow.

BEAUTIFUL ARTWORK: Feast your eyes on the breathtaking, hand-painted artwork created by games industry veteran artists.

data.name: Poolar Bear
data.detailed_description:
Poolar Bear is a cozy yet clever minimalist puzzle game where you guide a curious bear through 100 different pools(There's a little surprise when you complete all 100). What starts as a calm swim quickly becomes a challenge of obstacles, surprises, and dangers - yep, I'm talking about sharks and piranhas.

Once you nudge the bear, it slides until it hits something. You have to find ways to use the obstacles and objects to your advantage to make it to the end of the pool. What make Poolar Bear different from other sliding puzzles is that there is more than one way to reach the finishing line. You finally cracked a level, I ask you to challenge yourself and complete the level with a different path.

✦ Features

  • 100 handcrafted puzzles – The levels are easy peasy at first, but after 50 pools you will really need to bring your A game.

  • Slide-until-wall mechanics – One push sets the bear in motion, so foresight is key.

  • Whirlpool portals – Warp across unreachable parts of the pool to unlock new routes.

  • Fans – Use gusts of air to redirect your path mid-level.

  • Plants – Bounce off them to shift direction in clever ways.

  • Deadly dangers – Avoid lurking sharks and piranhas that chase you relentlessly.

  • Headlights – Light your way through tricky nighttime levels.

  • Minimalist & cozy design – Clean visuals, calm vibes, and satisfying puzzle flow.

  • Simple controls – Just the arrow keys (Left, Right, Up, Down)  or WASD to guide the bear.

  • Surprise twists – Fresh mechanics and obstacles keep every pool engaging.

Relaxing yet challenging, Poolar Bear blends minimalist aesthetics with surprising depth. Think ahead, experiment with movement, and discover clever solutions as you guide your bear through every pool.

Can you master all 100 puzzles and help the bear reach the finish?

data.name: M.E.R.C. Genesis
data.detailed_description:
Step into the darkest corners of the future with "M.E.R.C Genesis", a spine-chilling Sci-Fi horror third-person shooter that will test your nerves and combat skills. Take on otherworldly journey through randomly generated levels, ensuring every playthrough is a unique and heart-pounding experience.

Randomly Generated Levels for Endless Re-playability: Prepare for the unexpected as the game crafts dynamic and unpredictable levels, guaranteeing that no two encounters are ever the same. Each new venture into the abyss will keep you on edge, exploring uncharted territories, and facing unknown horrors.

Dark Futuristic Settings: Immerse yourself in a hauntingly atmospheric world where advanced technology meets nightmarish monstrosities. Richly detailed environments, eerie soundscapes, and eerie lighting will plunge you into a harrowing and immersive experience.

Resource Acquisition for Character Development: In the depths of this Sci-Fi nightmare, you'll scavenge for vital resources to enhance your character's abilities and survive the terrors that await. Unlock new weapons, and upgrades to forge your path of specialization and tailor your playstyle to confront the lurking threats.

Special Upgrades and Augmentations: As you progress, uncover new technologies that grant powerful bonuses to your characters. Make strategic choices as you decide which upgrades to harness and wield. Will you favor raw firepower, stealthy movements, or unyielding resilience against the horrors?

Heart-Pounding Combat: Engage in intense and strategic combat against grotesque adversaries. Employ your wit and reflexes to exploit enemy vulnerabilities and survive the relentless onslaught.

Get ready to experience high-octane Sci-Fi horror with "M.E.R.C Genesis". Embark on a journey that pushes the boundaries of fear, survival, and discovery. Can you withstand the darkness that awaits?

Welcome to Poker Club.

Live the life of a poker pro in the most immersive poker simulation ever seen, with Ultra HD 4K visuals and breath-taking ray tracing. Join a community of online players on their way to the top and track your progress in more than 10 Texas Hold’em tournament modes. More ways to play
Raise your game with over 10 Texas Hold’em tournament modes including freezeouts, shootouts, super-turbos, bounties and more. Play online with the community or create your own custom games and play by your own rules.

Win together
Join a Club and team up with friends and players from across the world to earn rewards, unlock shared goals and level up your Club.

Become a PCC Poker Tour Pro
Advance from back-room games to big-money main events as you climb the ranks in the PCC Poker Tour. Customise your pro and play your way to the top.

Stay connected
Place your bets in daily online tournaments and take part in exclusive scheduled events to unlock the latest swag.

As close as it gets to the real thing
From the low-key basement of Ralph’s Pizzeria to the jaw-dropping Intensity Arena; place your bets in stunning environments delivered in Ultra HD 4K with full ray tracing support.

data.name: ATMOSFAR
data.detailed_description:
Uncover the fate of humanity's final outpost as you survive and explore a thrilling world of floating islands. Brave the skies on your own or assemble a squadron of friends, and scavenge scrap to engineer and upgrade flying vessels, bringing your airship along for the journey.

An Open World

Travel through an open world of floating islands and aerial wonders. Discover how this unique environment has shaped the creatures and biomes that inhabit it as you navigate the skies and level up your piloting skills.

The Wasp

The Wasp is an agile vessel that can both zip through the sky and hover in place. Available in several different classes, each type of Wasp has its own unique appearance, abilities, and aerodynamics.

Deploy a portable camp with the Utility Wasp, airlift heavy scrap with the Hauler Wasp, or stun your enemies with the Striker Wasp. It's all about bringing the right Wasp for the job.

The Wasps you rely on also rely on you. Make sure they're fueled, well-maintained, and repaired when needed so you're always ready to go when things get dangerous. Upgrade engine parts, hover modules, or entire hulls to get your preferred configuration. Give your Wasp a new paint job to make it look its best.

The Cloud Cruiser

The Cloud Cruiser is your mobile base: a buildable, fully customizable airship capable of housing everything important to you. Bring your Wasps and fuel supplies aboard by building Wasp pads and fuel tanks, furnish a lounge area to your liking, and pilot the airship yourself from the helm. Expand your Cloud Cruiser as you explore planet Tycos, island by island, adding new sections whenever you need to support increasingly demanding expeditions.

Explore, Build, and Survive

Live off the land by extracting scrap, processing minerals, and collecting organic materials. Craft items and manufacture resources, cook food, and research artifacts to gain knowledge about new things to create.

Your backpack houses a life support system that provides the power you and your tools need. Build camp equipment or Cloud Cruiser modules to expand your reach across planet Tycos.

Investigate the events surrounding the collapse of your old colony and uncover the promise of planet Tycos as humanity's final refuge.

Band of Vagabonds

You don't need to venture onto planet Tycos alone! Up to four players can camp out, hitch a ride on a friend's Wasp, or fly in formation. Work together to build and operate your shared Cloud Cruiser and experience the odyssey together.

Deadly Beautiful Flora and Fauna

Take cover when day turns to night or when calm weather gives way to unfavorable winds. From howling jet streams to thunderous rainstorms, the treacherous weather on planet Tycos will require you to master your piloting skills as you traverse the skies.

Get your bearings on your new home planet and investigate its alien characteristics. Discover a wealth of strange plants, explore lush biomes, and defend against threatening creatures and drones.

Are you ready for an epic adventure in Fright Knight Legend? You'll embark on a quest to save the cursed Kingdom of Brightmore, battling hordes of enemies and avoiding deadly traps to uncover scattered gems. But this is no ordinary tale - it's a story steeped in history, with heroes facing monsters believed lost to the ages.

data.name: Shelf Happens
data.detailed_description:
The shelves are a disaster, the records are everywhere, and the store opens soon. As the new clerk of a retro record store, your job is simple to say and hard to master: pick up every scattered vinyl, read its title, figure out its genre, and slot it into the right crate. No stickers, no hints — just your ear for music. Your survival behind the counter depends not on speed alone, but on how well you read every sleeve that lands in your hands.

From Blood Cabin to Quantum Drift, hundreds of original albums — and their follow-ups — are waiting to be filed. Rock, Jazz, Punk, Pop, Soul, Metal, Funk and many more genres each have their own dedicated crates. Guess right and the shelf glows green. Guess wrong and it flashes red, and the mess wins another round. Some sleeves are obvious, some will make you stop and think, and a few will fool you completely.

Efficiency is everything. Plan your route through the aisles, decide which records to grab first, and keep a band's discography together — Vol. 1, 2 and 3 of a series are scattered all over the store, waiting to be reunited in the same crate. Fill a whole crate to lock in your progress and push the store one step closer to perfect order. Hasty guesses waste time; smart crate-digging wins the day.

Enjoy the calm, cozy satisfaction of sorting alone, or invite your friends into 2–4 player co-op and turn tidying into beautiful chaos. Split the aisles, call out genres, pass records down the line — teamwork gets the store spotless faster... in theory.

Filing crates and earning XP unlocks abilities that make you a sharper, faster clerk. Carry more records at once, spot genres quicker, move faster between aisles, and build your own strategy for turning a mountain of vinyl into perfect order.

data.name: Crime Boss: Rockay City
data.detailed_description:
SPRING 2026 ROADMAP


About the Game

Rockay City is still alive and kicking – with new content being added throughout 2025! New adventures await, buddy.

Choose from a range of heists & robberies and rise to the top of the criminal underworld! Only then can you become the Crime Boss of Rockay City!

Play Co-operatively with friends.

Bring your friends across 4 player co-operative multiplayer heists and make the big bucks.

Choose your difficulty, create your boss, equip your weapons and perks and play missions alone, with bots or with your friends. Take on single missions or complete co-op mini-camapigns in the story-driven Urban Legends mode or randomise your missions with Shuffle mode. Add some variety by fighting off hordes of enemies in the Rockay Rumble mode.

Build up your stash of cash, hire new characters, purchase new weapons or upgrade your perks to increase your chances of taking all the loot.

Play with your friends across all supported platforms with cross platform multiplayer and maximise your chances of success with your friends.

Earn rewards on top of cash.

Earn XP in a universal progression system across both single-player and co-operative game modes!

Each level up allows players unlock new weapons, heisters, equipment and skins. Kit yourself for success by customising your loadouts and crew.

Keep an eye out for our double XP events to climb the ladder even faster.

Operate Solo in the Single-player Campaign!

Experienced players can take control of Travis Baker and win all the turf in Rockay City in a roguelite single-player campaign.

Build and manage your own crew of criminals and overthrow the current gang leaders in the city. Earn cash from completing missions, level up your heisters and gain permanent unlocks when you die to help you get closer to your ultimate goal in the next run.

With dozens of missions to choose from in the campaign, each randomised at the start of each run, you can make a name for yourself through petit thievery or grand, over the top heists.

data.name: Fairy Sweet Days
data.detailed_description:
About This Game


This is a confectionery crafting × life simulation game where you can enjoy two main modes: "Fairy Training Mode" and "Challenge Mode".


◆ Fairy Training Mode ◆

Your fairy has come to help Lily White run her sweets shop.

How you raise your fairy—and what kind of shop you aim to create—is entirely up to you!

Achieve your goals within a limited time and raise a truly unique fairy of your own.

Characters from the Touhou Project, such as Reimu and Marisa, will also appear as customers.

The fairies you raise can be uploaded to a server and may appear in other players’ games.



If you obtain special "Scenario Cards," the story may branch in unexpected ways...

Can you reach the best ending?





◆ Challenge Mode ◆

Form a team of fairies you’ve raised—or those raised by other players—and help Lily manage her sweets shop!

Take on the challenge of running the business and repay the money borrowed from Akyuu.

This mode focuses on management simulation, where efficiency and making the most of each fairy’s traits are key.



In this charming yet deep world of fairies, create your own ultimate “sweets shop story.”

data.name: Marco & Polo Go Round
data.detailed_description:
“Marco & Polo Go Round” is a virtual-reality short that defies the laws of gravity.

On the morning of his birthday, Marco joins his girlfriend Polo in the kitchen but something strange is going on. The chairs are battened to the floor and the cupboard and fridge doors are taped shut. Polo doesn’t seem to notice. She’s just excited to present him with the cake she has just made.

Little by little, the couple’s areas of disagreement come to the surface and the joyful atmosphere soon turns to shock as various objects come loose and start to fly around them.
“Marco & Polo Go Round” plunges the viewer into a young couple’s intimate relationship and invites them to physically experience the crisis they are going through as they navigate this distorted, topsy-turvy world.

This film uses several real-time approaches and technologies such as volumetric capture to preserve the glances and movements of the actors (Léane Labrèche-Dor and Emmanuel Schwartz).

MARCO & POLO GO ROUND:
- A film with an intimate, surreal screenplay that deals with love and its fragile nature
- An innovative approach based on volumetric capture and special effects to produce an immersive experience.
- An extraordinary visual universe in which the viewer moves around as if in a living painting.
- A 14-minute sensory and narrative experience.
- Selected for the Tribeca, Cannes XR and Annecy festivals and winner of the Kaohsiung XR Dreamland Festival

© ITEM 7 - BELGA PRODUCTIONS - ARTE FRANCE

data.name: Matter of the Dreams
data.detailed_description:
Matter of the Dreams is a first person shooter created exclusively for virtual reality, set in the kind of world of bloodthirsty zombies you'd expect to find on the other side of the silver screen. But what if that screen wasn't as strong as barrier as you thought it was? What if scientists were able to prove that thoughts had force and power, that just the act of imagining a creature brought it to life in some parallel dimension?
Then the flap of a butterfly's wings in our dimension could create a deadly storm in another. Maybe even a storm big enough to break the walls of reality, and allow horrible beasts to come spilling into our world!
Society has collapsed under an onslaught of the dead, and a ruthless military junta has seized control of civilization's remaining resources. The player takes on the role of a special forces operator, part of a team that refused an order to wipe out a civilian settlement. For committing the crime of demonstrating humanity in a fallen world, they're now hunted by the living and dead alike, desperately trying to survive in a world where everything wants them dead.
With threats all around them, the player has one job – kill anything that moves, so that their team can find the supplies they'll need to go on helping other survivors.

Game:
Matter of the Dreams - is a game for die-hard action fans. No exploration, no searching for keys to unlock paths – the player needs nothing more than good aim and a quick trigger finger to succeed.

Special for VR:
Matter of the Dreams has been built around providing the ultimate in VR action. Players will find themselves besieged by wave after wave of the hungry dead. The game goes full-tilt right from the start, and won't ever let you pause to catch your breath.

Vestibular comfort:
Many VR experiences can cause motion sickness due to awkward movement controls. Matter of the Dreams was constructed with this in mind, offering a completely comfortable, intuitive and user-friendly control scheme, which makes the game a good choice even for people with weak vestibular systems.

The best first virtual reality experience:
Beautiful crafted graphics will fully immerse players in the brutal world of Matter of the Dreams. This is an independent game in the purest sense, a unique experience that will thrill, terrify, and get the heart pumping.

data.name: Extinction Valley
data.detailed_description:
Just Another Day at the Office You didn't ask to save the world; you just asked for an hourly wage. Start your shift under the midday sun with a standard municipal contract to clear out the local park. Your targets? Overgrown rats, rabid wolves, and dive-bombing vultures. Standard exterminator stuff. Keep your finger on the trigger and the park clean.

Working Overtime Pest control is a slippery slope, and when the sun sets, the local wildlife gets weird. Survive the night shift by gunning down towering deer-human hybrids roaming the park grounds, then take the fight underground. You will need a heavy arsenal to clear the city sewers of the grotesque, festering mutants that have made it their home.

Above and Beyond Your Paygrade Just when you think the job is done and you head back up to the park, the earth cracks open. Portals to Hell are tearing through the municipal landscaping, spilling waves of flaming skeleton dogs and undead horrors into the physical world. There is only one way to finish the job: step through the portal and take the fight directly to the skeleton wizards on their own turf.

Cinematic Dark Comedy Between the frantic, trigger-happy arena shootouts, the story of your rapidly deteriorating workday unfolds through high-quality, fully animated cinematic cutscenes. Experience a heavy dose of dark humor as our hero reacts to increasingly impossible biological and demonic horrors with the irritated fatigue of an independent contractor who is definitely not getting paid enough for this.

Key Features

  • The Ultimate Escalation: Master fast-paced, third-person arena mechanics as the threat level skyrockets from standard municipal pests, to sewer mutants, to a literal demonic invasion.

  • A Wild Narrative Ride: An engaging, hilarious story driven by cinematic cutscenes that capture the sheer absurdity of the worst extermination job in history.

  • Dynamic Environments: Fight your way through distinct stages including a daytime park, night-time horrors, claustrophobic sewers, and the depths of Hell itself.

  • Tools of the Trade: Trade your bug spray for a heavy-hitting arsenal capable of clearing out an apocalypse.

Cinematic Dark Comedy Between the frantic, trigger-happy arena shootouts, the story of your rapidly deteriorating workday unfolds through high-quality, fully animated cinematic cutscenes. Experience a heavy dose of dark humor as our hero reacts to increasingly impossible biological and demonic horrors with the irritated fatigue of an independent contractor who is definitely not getting paid enough for this.

Key Features

  • The Ultimate Escalation: Master fast-paced, third-person arena mechanics as the threat level skyrockets from standard municipal pests, to sewer mutants, to a literal demonic invasion.

  • A Wild Narrative Ride: An engaging, hilarious story driven by cinematic cutscenes that capture the sheer absurdity of the worst extermination job in history.

  • Dynamic Environments: Fight your way through distinct stages including a daytime park, night-time horrors, claustrophobic sewers, and the depths of Hell itself.

  • Tools of the Trade: Trade your bug spray for a heavy-hitting arsenal capable of clearing out an apocalypse.
data.short_description: You are a biker hired to clear a few rats from a public park. Fast forward a few hours, and you are diving through a literal portal to Hell to kill skeleton wizards. Welcome to Extinction Valley, a comedy arena shooter where a routine pest control contract escalates into an apocalyptic nightmare.

data.name: Usurper of Fire
data.detailed_description:
Dark Epic of Defiance Against Angels and Demons

Angels no longer bring salvation, and demons no longer hide. Together, they have seized control of the Origin Fire, enslaving mankind for over a thousand years. You are a rebel bearing humanity’s last hope, usurping the power of angels and demons, uncovering the truth behind their strength, and ultimately overthrowing their rule. Amid ash and fire, witness humanity’s final stand.

Forge Your Own Combat Build

Choose between a warrior or a mage, each with a completely different path of progression. With dozens of skills, equipment systems, and talent paths, the two protagonists can develop hundreds of unique combat builds. Every choice you make can reshape the way you fight.

A Loot System That Drives Everything

Slay enemies and loot their gear. Collect hundreds of fine, epic, and legendary items, or acquire powerful sets with unique appearances and skills. Gear, skills, and talents interact in countless ways. A single item could transform your entire combat build.

Randomized Dungeons Full of Unknown Threats

Explore dozens of randomly generated dungeons where every adventure is a gamble. Elites and bosses no longer wait in fixed locations, you may encounter deadly threats anywhere. The risks are unpredictable, but the rewards are just as tempting. The deeper you go, the closer you come to true power… and to death.

data.name: Dirty Dirty Pirates
data.detailed_description:
You're a dirty scallywag with nothing to lose. Dirty Dirty Pirates is a fast-paced, chaotic, player versus player fighting game, where fast reflexes and improvisation will help you become victorious. Stab, throw, roll, dance, mount, catch, and smash your way through frenzied battles in a looped battleground and enjoy the hilarious brutality.

LOCAL-MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM

Brawl with 2-8 players in a top down, blood-soaked, pirate battleground not for the faint of heart.

CHAOTIC LOOPED BATTLEGROUND

You and your thrown weapons wrap around the level, creating chaotic ways to slay your enemies (or yourself)!

POUNCE AND EXECUTE

Mount a downed pirate and choose your killing method.

GRATIFYING KILL CAMS

Watch the final kill of the match in slow motion and celebrate the brutality.

WEAPONS WITH A MIND OF THEIR OWN


Not only are the weapons pointy and eager to impale – but they follow you! Better hide, catch, or roll, ya buccaneer.

SLAUGHTER IN DIVERSE LANDS


Slay your foes at ship docks, ancient jungle ruins, desert, caves, and icy tundras.

CUSTOMIZE THE CHAOS


Reduce or increase the blood/gore to your liking (or disable it). Color blind mode is available as well.

Please note: This is a local multiplayer game without online gameplay. For the best experience, find a comfy couch and some friendly mateys in the same room or with Steam Remote Play.

data.name: VHS Collection: Buried Alive
data.detailed_description:
The Game

VHS Collection: Buried Alive is a psychological horror experience that immerses players in a slow-burning descent into guilt, grief, and paranoia. Set in the fog-covered, snow-drenched town of Alebha, the game follows David, a man trying to escape the shadows of his past by starting a new life—only to find those shadows have followed him.

After taking a quiet job as an overnight graveyard security guard, David hopes the isolation will bring peace. But as the nights go on, peace is the last thing he finds. Disturbing dreams begin to bleed into reality. Whispers echo through the cemetery. Shapes move in the fog. Snow falls endlessly, muffling sounds that shouldn’t exist. And beneath it all lies something buried—something that refuses to stay dead.

As David’s mind begins to unravel, hallucinations become harder to distinguish from the truth. Memories resurface in fragmented nightmares, and a presence lurks in the distance, watching. Each night reveals more of Alebha’s dark history, and more of David’s internal torment.

Aesthetic

The game features a gritty VHS-inspired visual style, with analog distortion, grainy textures, and flickering effects that intensify the sense of disorientation. The snowy, fog-filled streets and desolate cemetery are brought to life through chilling ambient sound and oppressive atmosphere.

Features

  • VHS Visual Style

  • Psychological Horror Narrative

  • Interactive NPCs with haunting dialogue

  • Atmospheric First-Person Exploration

  • Creeping Snow, Fog, and Darkness

In Short

VHS Collection: Buried Alive isn’t just a horror game—it’s a journey into the cold heart of regret and isolation. As David slips deeper into his haunted mind, the line between nightmare and reality fades. Can you uncover what’s buried beneath the snow… or will you become part of it?

Welcome to Food Inc: Home of the Supply

        A cooperative adventure that invites you to build and improve your own farm! Up to 4 players you can plant crops as the seasons change, construct buildings for your needs and heal your animals when needed.

        Ride your horse and step into the shoes of a real farmer with an immersive third and first person view. Discover every part of food inc: Home of the Supply, a game that blends realistic elements with arcade ones.

        Explore the villages from the desert while collecting recources and unlocking new things. Discover the hole desert with your pickup truck and enjoy the unknown.

        Drive around to pick and deliver packages in order to improve your farming skills. Remember to feed your animals regularly so they can grow, and check on them frequently to heal any that may have gotten sick.

All you can do and much more to come

        In food Inc: Home of the Supply, you can: construct buildings, plant crops and trees, gather resources, unlock new skills, complete missions, expand your farm by unlocking new zones, complete achievements, unlock skins for your farmer and horse, raise animals, discover new areas, go fishing and mining, care for bees, refine new items, ride your horse through the farm, drive your pickup through the desert, and do all of this with your friends.

data.detailed_description:
Set off on a cross-country journey to feed the famished masses!

Guide an aspiring super chef named Claire as she serves her customers a variety of haute cuisine from her suped up food truck. As you help Claire and her crew race to keep up with demand, you'll perform tasks ranging from prepping dishes to taking photos of satisfied guests. The faster you work and the happier your patrons, the bigger your tip!

Between each fast-paced level, you'll be able to spend your earnings on upgrades for your eateries and watch a humorous story about Claire's misadventures with an big-headed competitor and the identity of a mysterious food critic unfold.

Packed with lively characters, addictive gameplay and tons of bonus materials, Claire's Cruisin' Cafe will satisfying your craving for fun even as it leaves you hungry for more!

data.name: Subsuelo
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis
Subsuelo puts you in the shoes of a writer of Argentine conspiracy theories who enters a dam abandoned in 1982, hoping to uncover the rumor that the government used it as a front to hide something more. Inside, he discovers a military bunker that has been sealed for more than four decades, where he ends up trapped, in complete darkness and surrounded by mysteries.

As the player, you must fight your way through the corridors, find useful items, solve puzzles, and find a way to survive both what they tried to hide and the terror of a bunker that seems to be falling apart. You will have to search for answers, collect evidence, and find a way out.

What was going on down there? Why has it remained hidden for so long? Will you find a way to prove it?

What is Subsuelo like?
Subsuelo aims to frighten the player using subtle tools such as sound, setting, and atmosphere, without constantly relying on cheap jump scares.

You will explore every room in search of useful items such as bullets, batteries, weapons, or even things that will help you solve puzzles later on. You will have to manage your inventory, leave behind what you don’t need, and carry only the essentials, but be careful: that battery you left behind might be exactly what you need later.

The game offers action in the style of classic survival horror, giving you weapons to defend yourself, but making it clear that fighting is not always the best solution: sometimes running away can save your life.

Enemies
You will come across different types of enemies: from those that will attack the moment they see you to others that seem to retain part of their intelligence. Even so, every one of them will see you as an intruder, or will they?

Story
The answers to your questions are scattered throughout the facility. Pay close attention to every detail, because if you do find a way out, you won’t have any way to prove what you saw.

Subsuelo is an Argentine game developed by a single person, inviting you to discover an alternate history of the events that took place between 1976 and 1983, in a fictional facility where the government buried a secret that was never meant to see the light of day.

data.detailed_description:
1982 is a FREE retro inspired blasta-thon that will test your gaming skills to the max.

The game was created using AppGameKit an easy, quick and powerful game development tool.

1982 GAME MODES


  • Arcade - battle through 50 progressively difficult levels against some familiar early 80's home computer and arcade enemies.
  • Survivor - how many points can you score with only one life?
  • Time Attack - score as many points as you can in 3 mins. Unlimited energy, but each hit reduces your score multiplier

POWER-UPS - Kill, Catch or Collect


Each power-up has 2 uses, one when collected by the players ship and the other when shot and destroyed.
If you catch a power-up before it hits the ground then it's effect is increased. (ie. More energy is regained or lasers, rockets or shield last longer.) A successful catch is indicated by a heart.

Kill, Catch or Collect?

The 4 types and uses are as follows:

1. Energy Power-ups (green)
Kill - creates a large explosion
Catch or Collect - restore player energy

2. Laser Power-ups (red)
Kill - deploys a temporary horizontally firing laser turret
Catch or Collect - grants the player a temporary weapon increase

3. Rockets Power-ups (purple)
Kill - deploys a temporary rotating rocket launching turret
Catch or Collect - grants player a temporary rocket power-up

4. Shield Power-ups (cyan)
Kill - creates a temporary portal that destroys all enemy bullets
Catch or Collect - grants the player a temporary shield protecting against all impacts

SCORING


General
Each enemy kill is worth 1 pt x score multiplier.
The Score Multiplier is increased by filling the kill gauge on the left of the screen. To do this string a lot of kills together quickly. Failing to kill anything causes the gauge to drop.

Abductions...of Man & Multipliers
When a certain number of enemies reach the ground a Man will be abducted by a yellow saucer. As well as abducting Man the saucer takes x3 from your multiplier.

Kill the saucer and allow Man to fall safely to the ground and your x3 multiplier is returned.

The number of enemies reaching the ground needed to trigger an abduction reduces as your multiplier increases. High multipliers are hard to defend.

Coins
Many in game actions such as killing certain enemies trigger a coin drop. Pick up the coins for extra points (5pts x multi), catch them for a further bonus (10pts x multi). Caught coins are indicated by a heart.

Bonuses
Complete any of these in game actions to trigger a bonus coin drop...

  • Arcadia - Survive a level
  • Astro Blaster - get a new high multiplier for your current game
  • Major Havoc - trigger 2 Astro Blasters within 5 secs
  • Missile Command - have 2 remote missile launchers active at the same time
  • Laser Zone - have 2 remote lasers active at the same time
  • Bomberman - kill lots of enemies in an energy power-up explosion
  • Defender - stop any enemy reaching the ground for 30 secs
  • Repulsar - Ram an enemy with your shields
  • 2084 - rescue Man from the saucers 3 times in a row

The number of enemies reaching the ground needed to trigger an abduction reduces as your multiplier increases. High multipliers are hard to defend.

Coins
Many in game actions such as killing certain enemies trigger a coin drop. Pick up the coins for extra points (5pts x multi), catch them for a further bonus (10pts x multi). Caught coins are indicated by a heart.

Bonuses
Complete any of these in game actions to trigger a bonus coin drop...

  • Arcadia - Survive a level
  • Astro Blaster - get a new high multiplier for your current game
  • Major Havoc - trigger 2 Astro Blasters within 5 secs
  • Missile Command - have 2 remote missile launchers active at the same time
  • Laser Zone - have 2 remote lasers active at the same time
  • Bomberman - kill lots of enemies in an energy power-up explosion
  • Defender - stop any enemy reaching the ground for 30 secs
  • Repulsar - Ram an enemy with your shields
  • 2084 - rescue Man from the saucers 3 times in a row
