data.detailed_description:
Play the Tape. Discover the Truth. Open the Museum.

In swamp_land.mp4, an atmospheric walking simulator with a found footage horror twist, you take on the role of a reclusive curator preparing to open a mysterious museum deep in the forests of southern Chile. But before the grand opening, you must confront your past—through a haunting metaphorical journey across the 7 levels of Dante’s Inferno, each representing a sin… and a secret.

Explore surreal, decaying landscapes tied to Pride, Envy, Wrath, Sloth, Greed, Gluttony, and Lust, where every step reveals a fragment of your story. What begins as a personal reflection soon unravels into something far darker.

Features:

  • A compelling narrative with unexpected twists and turns

  • Roughly 30 minutes of immersive, story-driven gameplay

  • Inspired by found footage aesthetics and psychological horror

data.name: Star of Games
data.detailed_description:
FOLLOW US

  • X: @Infini_Fun


About the Game

Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history?

Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world.

I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes

In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design.

  • Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes: Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations.

  • Recombine Genes, Create New Classics: Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game.

  • Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz: Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze.

II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends

Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone.

  • Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies: Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels.

  • Recruit Masters, Nurture New Talent: As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival.

  • Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech: Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make.

III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon

When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era.

  • Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire: Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally.

  • Elevate Value, Impact Society: Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce.

  • Reach the Pinnacle, Achieve Immortality: Establish your own video game museum, found an award named after you, and have your design philosophy written into textbooks. You are no longer just a successful businessperson—you have become a part of gaming culture itself.

Game Features

  • Dynamic Story Generator: Every new game is a unique story. The personal dramas of employees, competitors' business secrets, and the birth of legends are all dynamically generated by your choices.

  • Relatability Meets Relaxation: Authentically captures industry challenges like project delays, technical bottlenecks, and team conflicts—enough to make you smile wryly in recognition. The overall lighthearted and humorous tone makes strategizing and decision-making a genuine pleasure.

  • Ultimate Freedom of Exploration: From game concepts to corporate strategy, talent management to business alliances—there is no single formula for success. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome.

  • A Treasure Trove of Easter Eggs: The game is packed with countless Easter eggs referencing gaming history, industry jargon, and classic titles, waiting to be discovered and savored by true core players.

data.name: Boxing GO
data.detailed_description:
"Boxing Go" is an electrifying multiplayer cross-platform game that immerses players into the adrenaline-fueled world of poly boxing. Developed by a single game developer with additional freelancers, Boxing Go offers a seamless gaming experience across various platforms, including PC, Mac and mobile devices, allowing players to connect and compete regardless of their preferred gaming hardware.

In Boxing Go, players step into the shoes of aspiring boxers, navigating their journey from humble beginnings in local gyms to international stardom in legendary arenas. The game boasts stunning graphics and low-poly physics, bringing the intensity and spectacle of boxing matches to life on screen.

Key features of Boxing Go include:

Multiplayer Battles: Engage in fierce multiplayer battles against friends or other players from around the world in real-time matches. Whether you're dueling it out in one-on-one bouts or competing in intense tournaments, every match offers a thrilling test of skill and strategy.

Customization: Personalize your boxer with a wide array of customization options, from choosing their appearance and gear to fine-tuning their fighting style and techniques. As you progress, unlock new gear, skills, and abilities to enhance your boxer's performance in the ring.

Cross-Platform Play: Enjoy seamless cross-platform play, allowing you to compete against opponents on different devices with ease. Whether you're playing on a PC, console, or mobile device, Boxing Go ensures that no player is left out of the action.

Social Features: Stay connected with friends and rivals through integrated social features, including friend lists, leaderboards. Challenge rivals, and celebrate victories together as you climb the ranks and make a name for yourself in the world of boxing.

Regular Updates and Events: Keep the excitement going with regular updates and special events that introduce new content, challenges, and rewards to the game. With fresh content to be added regularly, there's always something new to discover and experience in Boxing Go.

Overall, Boxing Go delivers an exhilarating gaming experience that combines fast-paced action, strategic depth, and social interaction, making it a must-play for boxing fans and gamers alike. So lace up your gloves, step into the ring, and prepare to unleash your inner champion in Boxing Go!

data.detailed_description:
It's a hot vacation time. Surrounded by an atmosphere of freedom, away from everyday worries, spending free minutes under the starry sky on the seashore, the feelings flare up so often, starting a bright sense of falling in love, which turns into a summer love.



Summer love… Ideally, it has only three stages: ""getting to know each other,"" ""immense rapture and admiration,"" ""breaking up forever."" And the lucky ones find their one and only love just in a few weeks of vacation 😏

You Should Try It too!


Diana is a charming stranger with whom you are forced to live in the same bungalow due to the reception fault.

You are a young guy who came on vacation looking for a romantic adventure.

Sand Story is a kinetic visual novel, where you have to win the heart of a beautiful girl.

How will your relationship end? A little fling or a big disappointment?

Interact with the story's protagonists and other characters. Have fun at the beach, swim in the ocean, explore a cave, have a vacation fling, and much more.

Features:

  • HD graphics, enjoy stunning graphics in Full HD
  • Beautiful illustrations
  • Rich sound background, so you can fully immerse yourself in the game atmosphere
  • 38,000 words (30 minutes)
  • Scene gallery

data.name: Will The Man Get Frog
data.detailed_description:
Will The Man Get Frog is a semi-random writing game in which you compose haikus (japanese short poems) in a cute and soothing atmosphere. Carefully crafted constraints will help you be creative regardless of your writing skills. The minimal design gives you space to focus, explore and express yourself. No achievements, no scoring, no leaderboard. It's about you and the words spending quality time together.

A game session can take from 5 minutes to... well, hours. It all depends on how carried away you get. Sometimes you just want a little distraction, and sometimes it gets more introspective. Both are great ways to enjoy the game!

Pick words!Compose!Enjoy and Share!

FEATURES

  • Thousands of words to choose from!
  • Six beautiful pixel art backgrounds!
  • An Inspiring chip-tune soundtrack made by the talented c.diffin!
  • Gif recording system: share your art with the world!
  • Streamer-friendly! Ask your viewers for advice, or have a writing workshop all together!
  • Asynchronous multiplayer-ish! "Shared Game" mode allows players to compose with the same word set using a clever password system. Get together, play and compare your works, or play by yourself, send your friends a poem and wait for theirs!
  • ... That's it, really. It's a small game.

Ok, my poem is ready. What do I win?

Well, you win… a .gif of your creation, to use however you see fit!

Maybe you'll be so proud that you'll post it on every social media.
Maybe it'll remind you of a loved one. Why not send it like a digital postcard?
Maybe it'll be personal, so you'll simply keep it close. As a souvenir.
Maybe it won't make much sense. That's okay, things don't always have to make sense.
Maybe you just won't like it. That's okay too, writing is hard. You can try again later.

Point is, I can't tell what you'll get out of it.
But it's probably worth exploring!

这是一款充满古典气息的三国 MMORPG，这是千人同屏、真刀真枪的国战沙场。从本服厮杀到跨服争霸，从攻城拔寨到登基称帝，每一场战斗都靠操作和策略说话。在这里还有众多大家熟悉的历史人物如诸葛亮、关羽、吕布等都将以全新的形象呈现在玩家面前，他们都拥有独特的技能和属性。带上您的英雄们打出属于自己的江山！

🏴 核心玩法：灭国战，打的就是硬仗

游戏最爽的部分，就是 “灭国战”。

  • 本服灭国战：开服第 2、4、6、7 天晚 9 点开打，4 场对决决出本服霸主。

  • 跨服灭国战：开服 8 天后每周二、四、六晚 9 点，7 场鏖战，角逐全服最强。

攻方目标简单粗暴——击杀敌方主将。守方则要死守阵地，寸步不让。
你可以在军需官处消耗资源变身攻城器械或武将，5 分钟后还能召唤战争机器碾压战场。
高战力玩家正面硬刚，低战力玩家也能通过采集资源、驾驶冲车、配合队友打出关键一击——每个人都有自己的作用。

累积战功还能登上战功榜，前 5 名拿稀有永久称号，榜首独享金色称号“战场统帅”，走到哪里都带风。

⚡ 多模式战场，每天不重样

游戏里还有大量限时战场，节奏紧凑，奖励爽快：

  • 帝王争霸：家族集结，抢占 5 个据点积累民心。家族贡献第一的玩家直接当选“帝王”，坐拥专属坐骑和国王称号，号令全服。

  • 赤壁战场：阵营对战，抢占战旗据点。10 分钟时中央祭坛刷出洪荒巨兽，击杀即获海量积分，瞬间扭转战局。你还可以抢夺敌方战旗，送回己方大本营，全员加属性。

  • 血战沙场：击杀玩家和守卫攒积分，积分够了就冲下一层。第三层每分钟刷新一个宝箱，抢到就有机会拿绝版套装，手速和胆识缺一不可。

  • 攻城战：跨服大地图，三国城池全实景还原。消耗体力攻占毗邻城池，当上城主后每小时都有收益。占领越多，加成越猛，最终争夺“天子”之位。

  • 群雄大乱斗：拾取不同品质的物资和一次性技能，联合本家族淘汰所有对手。毒圈收缩、复活次数有限——这就是三国版的“吃鸡”，紧张刺激。

  • 家族神兽：每周二、四、六晚，全家族合力击杀 BOSS。BOSS 会召唤守护兽，击破守护兽才能解除无敌，每杀一只全队加伤 5%，配合起来超级燃。

🗡️ 四大职业，无论选啥都爽

进入游戏第一步，就是选定你的身份。共设四大职业，各有各的定位和打法，不过无论怎么选择都爽到爆！

  • ⚔️ 狂战 —— 正面硬刚，一夫当关

    追求力量至上的肉身之道，天生体格强横。精通重型兵器，拥有摧山裂石的爆发力。

    适合谁：喜欢冲在最前面、享受近身肉搏快感的玩家。操作门槛不高，生存能力拉满，团战里永远站在第一排。

  • 🏹 灵羽 —— 百步穿杨，来去如风

    行侠仗义的游侠之道，擅长弓箭远程攻击。静可隐匿无声，动则箭出如电。

    适合谁：喜欢远程输出、灵活走位、在安全距离打出成吨伤害的玩家。团队中集输出与支援于一身的关键存在。

  • 🧠 军师 —— 运筹帷幄，决胜千里

    精通观星辨卦的战术智慧，擅长法术战斗。深谙星象占卜与五行生克之道，以术法为刃。

    适合谁：喜欢策略战斗、远程控制、用脑子打游戏的玩家。战局中不可或缺的智囊核心，可细分为冰魄与雷霆两种定位。

  • ⚡ 破军 —— 冲锋陷阵，万军取首

    专精突击破阵的统御之道，擅长枪术与骑战。弓马娴熟，枪法诡谲，具备于千军万马中取敌将首级的过人本领。

    适合谁：喜欢冲锋陷阵、高爆发输出、带领团队撕开敌阵的玩家。可细分为骁骑和鬼魅两种定位。

🗡️ 技能与天赋：打得好不如打得巧

技能流派切换给了你极大的战术自由度。

  • 主动技能：可切换不同流派，一套技能打爆发，另一套打控制，灵活应对不同战场。

  • 被动技能：通过特定系统获取，升级后常驻增益，让你在混战中站得更稳。

  • 人物天赋：分为攻击、生命、通用、精通四类，自由加点，重置成本低，随时调整打法。

更酷的是 “无双变身”——战斗中你可以变身为无双武将，模型和技能全部替换，持续 15 秒，伤害爆炸。冷却 120 秒，关键时刻开大变身，一人扭转团战局势，那种爽感谁用谁知道。

🎯 武将助战：你不是一个人在战斗

你还可以收集三国名将，让他们陪你上阵。

  • 武将有 魏、蜀、吴、群雄 四大阵营，以及 强攻、防御、辅助、控制 四种定位。

  • 最多上阵 3 对武将（前军、中军、后军），主将死亡自动切换，副将还会概率召唤出来放技能。

  • 特定武将组合能激活羁绊技能，甚至组合技——比如刘关张一起上阵，就有强力联动。

武将是你的第二条命！

🌟 更多亮点，点到为止

  • 坐骑：进阶、幻化、学技能，战场上跑得快就是优势。

  • 奇门遁甲：镶嵌麒魂和绝技，自由组合出战增益，走输出还是走生存，你说了算。

  • 装备：强化、洗炼、宝石、套装，简单直接，换装备自动继承，不折腾。

  • 博物志：打怪挖宝收集图鉴，涨属性还加收集度，适合喜欢探索的玩家。

👑 适合谁玩？

  • 喜欢 大规模国战 的热血玩家；

  • 享受 策略搭配 和 技能连招 的操作党；

  • 热衷 收集名将、培养阵容 的养成控；

  • 只想 每天上线打几场爽快战场 的休闲战士。

不逼肝，不逼氪，只逼你拿出真本事。江山就在这里，你敢来打吗？

data.name: Unstoppable Arrow
data.detailed_description:
Raise your bow, nock an arrow and take aim as enemies close in through the dungeon. In Unstoppable Arrow, hands-on rune assembly brings elemental choices to first-person VR archery.

Draw, aim and loose

Face combat from a first-person VR perspective. Watch the distance and direction of approaching enemies, draw your bow and make each shot count.

Shape your arrows with runes

Physically pick up runes and place them into matching slots. Equip fire and frost cores, then combine them with supporting runes to adjust your combat abilities.

Wield fire and frost

Strike groups with fire arrows or slow their advance with frost. Add the appropriate rune to inflict lingering burns, or replace frost's slowing effect with freezing. Choose how your loadout balances damage and control.

Open the spellbook and enter the dungeon

Select combat stages through a magical book and face advancing enemies among stone corridors, prison walkways and torchlit halls. Watch the approaches and choose the arrow ability that suits the threat.

VR requirements
This is a single-player PC VR game. A VR headset connected to a compatible PC and tracked controllers are required.

data.name: Mage and Monsters II
data.detailed_description:
Recruit a hero to lead your army, and use spells while they fight for you. Mage & Monsters 2 is an active auto battler, where you choose to either enhance the strength of your hero, reinforce the might of your army, or increase the power of your spells.

Features:

- Choose between 18 different heroes to fight for you.

- Over 100 different upgrades.

- 13 unique spells you can use in battle to help your army.

- 25 different units you can recruit, and over 50 enemies.

- 3 different maps each with an unique challenge.

Cover Art by Dean Spencer.

data.name: Line Tower Wars
data.detailed_description:
Line Tower Wars is a lane-defense strategy game built on the classic custom-map formula. Every player defends their own lane. You attack by sending creeps, and they skip your lane and march down everyone else's. Gold buys either towers or sends, and balancing the two is the whole game.

Fifteen tower lines: five base elements, plus ten more forged by combining a pair of them. 105 towers in all. Wall off your lane, shape the route into a maze, and promote plain walls into real towers as the waves grow.

Sends run from cheap fodder that bleeds a defender's gold, to flyers that ignore your maze completely, to siege creeps that stop and tear your towers down. Killing a sent creep pays the defender a bounty, so a bad send funds the person you aimed it at.

Your champion walks the lane and raises every building by hand. Pick one of five at the start of the match. Last warband still holding a tether wins.

Modes:

  • Battle: free-for-all for 2 to 12 warbands. Fill the empty seats with bots at three difficulty levels.

  • Versus: the same free-for-all online for up to 12 players through Steam lobbies, public or friends-only, with overlay invites. Cross-platform between Mac and Windows. Both machines run the same deterministic simulation, and a desynced match is voided rather than played out wrong.

  • Text chat in lobby and in match, filtered through Steam's text filter.
data.about_the_game:
Line Tower Wars is a lane-defense strategy game built on the classic custom-map formula. Every player defends their own lane. You attack by sending creeps, and they skip your lane and march down everyone else's. Gold buys either towers or sends, and balancing the two is the whole game.

Fifteen tower lines: five base elements, plus ten more forged by combining a pair of them. 105 towers in all. Wall off your lane, shape the route into a maze, and promote plain walls into real towers as the waves grow.

Sends run from cheap fodder that bleeds a defender's gold, to flyers that ignore your maze completely, to siege creeps that stop and tear your towers down. Killing a sent creep pays the defender a bounty, so a bad send funds the person you aimed it at.

Your champion walks the lane and raises every building by hand. Pick one of five at the start of the match. Last warband still holding a tether wins.

Modes:

  • Battle: free-for-all for 2 to 12 warbands. Fill the empty seats with bots at three difficulty levels.

  • Versus: the same free-for-all online for up to 12 players through Steam lobbies, public or friends-only, with overlay invites. Cross-platform between Mac and Windows. Both machines run the same deterministic simulation, and a desynced match is voided rather than played out wrong.

  • Text chat in lobby and in match, filtered through Steam's text filter.
data.short_description: A standalone take on the classic lane-wars custom map. Wall off your lane, build a maze of elemental towers, and send creeps marching down everyone else's. Free-for-all for 2 to 12 warbands, against bots or online through Steam. Cross-platform Mac and Windows.

data.detailed_description: My Friend Aki is a puzzle-based exploration game focusing on the use of improvised tools to make your way through the hallways of an abandoned mall. Make your way forward by creatively utilizing what was left behind.

data.name: One Song, One Life
data.detailed_description:
“One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where your performance changes both the music and the story.
Every note you hit determines the path of a girl chasing her dream of becoming the best net artist and standing on the same stage as her idol.

You’ll play as Sumire Kirishima, a 19-year-old girl from Tokyo. Raised by her father after her parents’ divorce, Sumire is talented but selfish—willing to put everything on the line for her goals, even at the cost of others.

As she climbs the ladder of the music world, she’ll face temptation, manipulation, and betrayal.
But don’t worry—no matter how deep she falls, remember:
Life itself is just one song.

Characters

Sumire Kirishima
Age: 19 / Lives in Tokyo
Raised as a sheltered daughter by her father after her parents divorced.
Ambitious and strong-willed, but often self-centered and lacking in teamwork.

Game System

  • Tap notes in rhythm with the song to build your score!

  • Choose your path when “decision notes” appear—your choices shape the story!

  • Your performance determines both the music and the scenario that unfold!

  • Each song represents a lifetime—see where Sumire’s story ends!

  • Miss too many notes, and it’s game over!

Lots of Event CGs

Enjoy beautifully illustrated scenes depicting Sumire’s rise and fall.

About Streaming

Streaming and monetized videos are welcome!
Please include the Steam URL in your video description.
If that’s difficult, a verbal mention during your broadcast is also fine.

data.name: The Unseen
data.detailed_description:
House parties aren't supposed to result in your death, right?
Find yourself thrown into the depths of darkness with little chance of making it out alive in The Unseen. What starts as a seemingly normal house party quickly turns into a nightmare as you become trapped in a dark, twisting labyrinth beneath. But beware, you are not alone. To survive, you must understand your hunter...

Being Hunted

As apex predators, humans rarely rely on their senses in everyday life. That is about to change. You will need to sharpen your instincts and use the environment to your advantage to evade terrifying threats and unfavourable outcomes. Every shadow, sound, and hiding spot could mean the difference between life and death.

Resource Management

Scarcity breeds chaos. Can you truly trust another human to help you survive, or would you betray them to ensure your own survival? Resources are limited, and every decision matters. Banding together can help you cover more ground and increase your chances of survival, but always keep an eye on your 'friends'. That torch in their hand looks like it's in good condition... but would it look better in your hands?

Crafting

Crafting can ensure your survival, it could also attract some unwanted attention. One wrong move and all your hard work will count for nothing.

Survival

To survive like an animal, you must think like an animal. Cover your scent. Find food. Find water. Adapt to your environment. Use every resource at your disposal. As always, bring something heavy... just in case.

Secrets

Who would do something like this? Why would they do this? What is this place? Find the the answers in the deepest depths of this terrible place. Uncover the dark secrets that force you to fight for survival.

data.name: Chaotic Airport Construction Manager
data.detailed_description:
This game is a simulation of the largest permanent construction site of our time (we assume that and did not research it for security reasons). There is an airport in Berlin which took 14 years to get built. Initially it should have opened in 2012, but that didn't happen until October 2020. Why? Find out for yourself with this awesome and ultrarealistic game made by the biggest satire website in Germany "The Postillon"!
Slip into the role of the construction manager and build the airport BER from the ground up. Can you manage to open it on time?

Flaws appearing again and again!
We reveal more than 100 problems that have so far been kept under wraps by the site management, as well as the options for solving them. Flaws in this game are not bugs, but a feature!

Guaranteed high frustration factor!
You have a relaxed and happy life and want to feel the humility and disappointment you remember from the past? Or you have a humble and disappointing life and need an experience that makes your everyday life seem smooth and joyful in comparison? Look no further! The Crazy Airport Construction Simulator offers you the most frustrating experience since you tried to rescue the neighbor's cat from the tree with a softair.

Read articles!
We have lovelessly clapped the best articles about BER from our archive into the game. But not only that, for diligent players there are also four new, exclusive articles to discover.

data.name: ENIGMA:
data.detailed_description:
Special Offer


All owners of Enigma: will receive a free Mini Soundtrack and a digital copy of the game manual.


About the Game



The world is afflicted with a mysterious disease known as "The Enigma."
Chester, infected with this disease, finds himself washed onto a lonely island, Carlyle.

As he is being given a tour of the island by the girl who nursed him back to health, Chester finds himself feeling that something is off.
There are no doctors from the mainland. Not only is there no information of the outside world, but the inhabitants seem entirely oblivious of the worldwide epidemic.
---It's as if this place has been completely removed from the rest of the world.

After a while, Chester finds a conspicuous white forest in the middle of a green expanse.

"That forest devours people. That's what I believe."

The forest's name is Enigma.
The same as the disease consuming his body.

Features:

  • Unravel the mysteries of a fantasy world
  • Multiple Endings
  • Beautiful original soundtrack

data.name: Lucky Goal
data.detailed_description:
RUN, SLIDE AND TAKE CONTROL OVER THE BALL





HONE YOUR AIM AND UNLEASH YOUR GAME




Matchmaking are ranked based on the overall skill of all team members. You can play a matchmaking game solo, and you'll be automatically placed in a team with an available slot, or you can set up your own team and invite your friends.

Multiplayer mode will allow you to create your own custom match. The 2 modes available there:
1) Classic mode - 2 teams playing against each other. The team who scores more goals before the period is over, wins.
2) Mordor mode - 4 teams playing against each other. Each team has a number of lives. If one team concedes a goal, they lose one life. If they lose all the lives, they drop out of the game.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR STYLE!



Singleplayer mode is divided into three categories. In the first category, you will practice accuracy and ball control. In the second category, you will play soccer-golf. The third category will require you to heavily rely on your ball-handling skills to overcome a variety of challenging obstacles. After mastering each section, bonus levels await to challenge and reward you.

Coop or Solo call on a friend to help you win the trophy and defeat the long-armed goalkeeper.

data.name: BrainMess
data.detailed_description:
Your Brain is a Mess. Make it make sense.

"Have you tried making a list?" God, why do they always ask this. 

Yes, I tried making a list. But I didn't have pen or paper, so I had to try and hold onto those thoughts until I did have pen and paper. Then by the time I had pen and paper, I'd forgotten what was supposed to go on the list.

So I sat the list down and lost the list, and when I thought of what to write, I couldn't find the list. After wasting my day repeating this process, I finally went home, and realized I'd left the list at work. 

"No," they say, "Like, on the computer. Saved to the cloud."

OH, THE CLOUD. Why didn't I think of the CLOUD. So I get on the computer and instantly forget why I was on the computer. Eventually I stop scrolling through memes and remember to make the list.

I create a new document. I try to think of a name for the document. I spend fifteen minutes trying to think of a name for the document before I finally just name it The List. Then later I can't figure out which LIST is THE LIST because I have SEVENTEEN unfinished documents named THE LIST.

"It isn't that complicated," they say. PLEASE, EXPLAIN HOW IT ISN'T THIS COMPLICATED. Please show me the DIFFICULTY SETTINGS on my LIFE so I can TURN THEM DOWN from EUROPEAN EXTREME.

Oh. Speaking of video games, what if I just... made the list... in a video game?

"Why?!" They balk. "How would that be easier in any way?"

"Yeah..." I reply, already firing up Unity. "Yeah this is a way better idea."

Don't make a list. Make a CRAZY WALL.

BrainMess isn't the first mind-mapping product to exist, nor is it the best. But it is the only one with first person controls, set in a 3D room that you can plaster from wall-to-wall with notes, strings, and organized insanity.

It's also the ONLY mind-mapping product to be developed by an eighth grade English teacher who lost his job during quarantine, worked in a hospital during the pandemic, transitioned into a games startup after that, got diagnosed with ADHD, finally started to feel at peace with himself, IMMEDIATELY lost his games startup job, and couldn't find full time work anywhere except for the local MAXIMUM SECURITY PRISON.

And he'd really appreciate it if you'd buy his little productivity game for like, the cost of a cheap sandwich.

Do that, and he promises to keep working on it and adding features until it feels like it's worth AT LEAST three sandwiches.

data.name: 醉后打烊
data.detailed_description:
《Afterlast Call》 is a chaotic, family‑friendly 1–4 player cooperative party game!

The late‑night bar is about to step into its busiest and most chaotic hours. Team up with your friends, split up your duties, and survive the peak‑time madness all the way through to closing!

Assign your roles freely: one player focuses on mixing drinks, another rushes to serve orders, one keeps cleaning up constant messes, and the last maintains order across the whole bar. All kinds of customers keep pouring in — tall, short, plump, slim, each with their own personality, ready to party.

As drinks go down, wild emergencies keep popping up. Guests start brawling while drunk, pass out cold on the floor, or even vomit and make a huge mess. Total chaos is just around the corner!

You and your teammates have to react fast to every crisis: break up fights, wipe away stains, handle unconscious drunks, and keep things under control. Hold steady through the pandemonium and keep your bar running to safely finish your closing shift!

Take on this tough night shift solo, or team up online with friends for chaotic co‑op fun. Every shift brings brand‑new, hilarious disasters! Wild, funny, and teamwork‑testing — welcome to your crazy bar working challenge!

data.name: Dungeon Merchant
data.detailed_description:
Buy and sell weapons, armour, potions and more to grow your humble shop. Hire adventurers and equip them with items before sending them into the dungeon to collect gold and loot for you. You've got a debt to pay to the king and in order to pay it, you're going to have to buy low, sell high and hope your hired heroes make it out alive.



Dungeon Merchant is a hybrid, idle, dungeon crawler mixed with shop simulation game. In order to earn gold and improve your business, you must hire heroes to send into the dungeon and retrieve loot. As the dungeon changes so does the demand of certain items, armour and weapons. Use the changes in the dungeon to your advantage to buy low and sell high.



Don't get too greedy though! Lower levels of the dungeon provide better loot but more fierce monsters. If your hero dies in the dungeon, they're gone for good, along with all of the gear you equipped them with! Continue to grow your shop via upgrades and learn more about the world through character dialogue interactions.

data.name: Touhou Witch's Night Market
data.detailed_description:
Join our Discord "Touhou Witch's Night Market Community" for discussing！

💰️ REPAY THE DEBT

Marisa had sold all her magical items to raise money for 'Kappachinko'... Unfortunately she lost everything in it!

Driven by addiction, Marisa had stolen all across Gensokyo, even took on a malicious loan from Reimu! With no other choice, she's forced to join the magical item battles that was trending in Gensokyo, hoping to earn enough to repay her debts and escape from Reimu's relentless pursuit…

With her sharp intuition for magical items, she believes she can defeat all opponents. But... will things really go as she hopes?

🤓 BUILD YOUR CONSTRUCT

You will play as Marisa, collect items and skills to build your own construct, then try to defeat the opponents!

The game features a total of 158 items and 69 skills, each with its own unique attributes and effects. Unleash your creativity and combine them into powerful constructs! You might even discover new combinations that the dev team never imagined.

Each game lasts only around 15 minutes. Keep challenging and see how far you can go!

⏱️TIME TO FIGHT

Each game is divided into 10 days , with each day split into 4 moments.

In the daytime, You will encounter various events, where you can purchase items, learn skills, gain exp, fight random enemies, or even change the effect of an item!

At the end of each day, you will visit the night market and meet other Touhou charaters who specialize in different weapons (we won't spoil who they are, but let's just say you might run into Koishi, Remilia or Reisen). Choose who you want to talk to, then challenge and defeat them!

If you manage to survive until the end of Day 10, you will step into the 11th day where an unexpected challenge awaits. Overcome this mysterious being and then you can—

🔓️ UNLOCK EXTRA MODE

Clear the game several times on Lunatic difficulty to unlock EXTRA MODE, where you're able to challenge your historical data!

This mode also allows you to import other players' data. Share your save files with your friends and let them try to defeat your construct! But don't celebrate too soon—No matter how powerful your construct seems, there will always be a strategy that can counter it!

AND MORE THINGS...

Customize the background! Decorate it with your favorite Touhou Character's stickers!

Discover the memes and other touhou references hidden in the dialogue!

Visit the Meboxen club on the homepage to read messages left by devs and fans!

There are still many secrets waiting for you in Touhou Witch's Night Market...

Join our Discord "Touhou Witch's Night Market Community" for discussing！

data.name: Voltage
data.detailed_description:
READY TO PLAY?



Voltage: Episode 1 is now released from Steam Early Access. Development continues on Episode 2 and Super Retro. If you don't want to buy the game on current state, add it to your Wishlist. Remember to also join the game's community hub, so you will be informed directly about new updates & news!

Currently Voltage: Episode 1 has been graduated from the Early Access. Development continues on Episode 2 and Super Retro. The full VOLTAGE experience with these DLC:s will be available later.


About the Game





Inspired by the Amiga, Commodore 64 and PC '90s legends! Redneck Rampage, DukeNukem and Quake fans might find something familiar from this game, also Dino Crisis and Dinosaur Hunter fans. Graphically it is designed look like AAA Amiga game, however Voltage won't sent you back to the stone age, it is boosted with modern game features (which where not available 30 years ago..).





the small town of Frontier, Missouri, in the 1980s. A young man called Mark is having his summer holiday, the last summer before going to a college. Mark is our story hero, who is living in this idyllic small town, surrounded by a thick forests with a dozens of small lakes with crystal-clear water. This town even have famous American football league. But sometimes you can get bored even a burning hot sunny day like this, even a town like this.



that reason, Mark and his friends, Jesse, Benjamin and Simon, are exploring scrap yard, where they tend to go secretly to look for all the special stuff, mostly parts of the mopeds and cars. The only employee in the scrap yard has gone to lunch break, and Mark knows that this is their only change to explore treasures in a crap yard...



old truck which have -as every car in this scrap yard- seemed to be in a traffic accident. Logo of the truck is badly damaged, but he can read some text in it, about "Co" and "International". He peek into the truck, and notice that most of the stuff is badly damaged. But deeper inside truck trunk he finds a prototype of VR-glasses and a floppy disk. Mark smuggle the glasses and a floppy disk to his home and to his surprise, he find out that the glasses are compatible with his Amiga 500. Quickly he realizes that the truck and all techie stuff were a property of C-I Advanced Technology Department, which does cooperation with a military.



that these glasses are capable to unlock incredible hidden features in Amiga 500, able to take full advantage of the Amiga's potential. He launches a game that extends beyond what the games is likely to do, a whole virtual universe, which is somehow connected to another paralled universe. A universe, where the development of computers wen't through other paths and Amiga is world second biggest and the most advanced computer system. Mark log in to interconnected virtual space called the AOSYS and real adventure begins...

While exploring incredible AOSYS game environment with his glasses, Mark doesn't know that technology department in the other site have noticed their visitor from another dimension and they try to do their best to track the player and get their glasses back... with a help of army...





Full Episode 1 Release. The game certainly offers value for money and hours of game play. Voltage was originally a peaceful place. But since the C-I Advanced Department of Technology is trying to eliminate the player they bring a massive army of enemies inside the game. Complete all Episode 1 Sublevels* and bring peace back to the Voltage!

Full version of the Voltage: Episode 1 includes 8 huge Sublevels:

Sublevel 1: Tutorial Zone
This is optional on the game menu. We found out that some players were unfamiliar about box pushing and using switches, so on this optional level you learn the game logic. On the Tutorial Zone, you can practice many important skills and get to know to the game. Remember that you can always ask help from the Steam Community Hub.

Sublevel 2: Warm-up
A little warm-up before you start...

Sublevel 3: Hometown
Actual game starts at your hometown, and your mission is to find Amiga 500 computer inside the house and start your adventure in AOSYS... After you have found computer, your journey in AOSYS starts. We noticed that many player was interesting to explore hometown on the first version, so now this level is even more bigger, including many houses and surprises.

Sublevel X: Dark Side
Voltage Dark Side is mystic environment. Voltage has it's sunny side and Dark Side is place where AOSYS system spawns the "dead" characters, in order to Voltage run smoothly. When player enters to the Voltage he will be accidently spawned to this environment and mission is to find way out...

Sublevel 4: Star Qruiser
First mission is called 'Escape from the Star Cruiser': You are in a Star Cruiser. Seems that something has gone badly wrong and it's full of enemies (we don't reveal what kind of...). This level gives you about a 100-130 min gameplay. The game proceeds almost straightforwardly (spaceship is quite big) when you explore different parts of Star Cruiser and you desperate to escape... Boldly explore the Star Cruiser, who knows if you might even be able to find dinosaurs on their development section...

Sublevel 5: Terraria
In this sublevel you explore the space ship Terraria. Terraria is a place, which is used to harvest food to space ship crew. Terraria is also used to farm some extraordinally special animals, such as Dinosaurs. Be carefully not to release them from their cages...

Sublevel 6: Into the Desert
You have escaped from the Star Cruiser by using emergency shuttle. Unfortunately an error occurs and you find yourself from a burning hot desert. Try to find familiar town, or some vehicle to escape...

Sublevel 7: BunkerWay
You discovered way to the Bunker on previous level. This is the only "safe" way to the Voltage Town (Episode 2). Explore large sections on the bunker and find your way...

Goal is to include VoltageDinoLand, City of Voltage and Town of Voltage to the Episode 2.

Special features, which are now available

  • Turn on and off switches
  • Ability to dive and swim
  • Push and move movable objects. If objects does not move, it is not movable
  • Pick, Carry and drop (currently only one object is enabled for this, we are testing this feature)
  • Talking characters (text)



Ah, finally we get to the most important thing in the game :) Player has an access to a wide variety of different kind of guns. Episode 1 includes at least these guns:

Shotgun, Sniper M700, Magnum 357, Colt 1911, RPG, Crossbow, Dagger, Hatchet, Bow, Halberd, Mace, Stones tho throw, Grenades and even one futuretek gun..
Other type of weapons are Melee Weapons, which you also have access when exploring different levels. These Melee Weapons are: Baseball Bat, Bow Saw, Cleaver, Cricket Bat, Crowbar, File, Garden Fork, Hammer, Lead Pipe, Pickaxe, Screwdriver, Shovel, Sledgehammer, Spanner and Wrench.






dr. Stephen J. McRegon, scientist, computer engineer, and something an a dreamer was asked to help a medium large computer company, to create a ultimate virtual reality system, which was ahead of time. And he did it. On year 1982 he created an open world game for Amiga personal computer, called AOSYS, Amiga operating system. AOSYS was capable to unlock incredible hidden features in Amiga 500, able to take full advantage of it's potential. Unfortunately it was never introduced to the markets in your dimension, where you read this message. Until this day came. McRegon found a way to blend space and time by simple breaking the law's of nature; He was sending radio waves Faster Than Light and that way broke the Cosmic Speed Limit. That maneuver opened a portal (which can be used only for sending small mass objects or voice), and hence deliver AOSYS to our dimension. For you all to play. You see, all physical objects, even you and your chair, exist in three dimensions. Everything has a width, and a high and a length. But there is another kind of length, a length in time.



All characters and locations used in this game are fictitious in our universe and any resemblance to real persons, vehicles and places is purely coincidental.



The game contains the instruction manual. To view this manual, click on the Steam store page ”View the manual” link.

that these glasses are capable to unlock incredible hidden features in Amiga 500, able to take full advantage of the Amiga's potential. He launches a game that extends beyond what the games is likely to do, a whole virtual universe, which is somehow connected to another paralled universe. A universe, where the development of computers wen't through other paths and Amiga is world second biggest and the most advanced computer system. Mark log in to interconnected virtual space called the AOSYS and real adventure begins...

While exploring incredible AOSYS game environment with his glasses, Mark doesn't know that technology department in the other site have noticed their visitor from another dimension and they try to do their best to track the player and get their glasses back... with a help of army...





Full Episode 1 Release. The game certainly offers value for money and hours of game play. Voltage was originally a peaceful place. But since the C-I Advanced Department of Technology is trying to eliminate the player they bring a massive army of enemies inside the game. Complete all Episode 1 Sublevels* and bring peace back to the Voltage!

Full version of the Voltage: Episode 1 includes 8 huge Sublevels:

Sublevel 1: Tutorial Zone
This is optional on the game menu. We found out that some players were unfamiliar about box pushing and using switches, so on this optional level you learn the game logic. On the Tutorial Zone, you can practice many important skills and get to know to the game. Remember that you can always ask help from the Steam Community Hub.

Sublevel 2: Warm-up
A little warm-up before you start...

Sublevel 3: Hometown
Actual game starts at your hometown, and your mission is to find Amiga 500 computer inside the house and start your adventure in AOSYS... After you have found computer, your journey in AOSYS starts. We noticed that many player was interesting to explore hometown on the first version, so now this level is even more bigger, including many houses and surprises.

Sublevel X: Dark Side
Voltage Dark Side is mystic environment. Voltage has it's sunny side and Dark Side is place where AOSYS system spawns the "dead" characters, in order to Voltage run smoothly. When player enters to the Voltage he will be accidently spawned to this environment and mission is to find way out...

Sublevel 4: Star Qruiser
First mission is called 'Escape from the Star Cruiser': You are in a Star Cruiser. Seems that something has gone badly wrong and it's full of enemies (we don't reveal what kind of...). This level gives you about a 100-130 min gameplay. The game proceeds almost straightforwardly (spaceship is quite big) when you explore different parts of Star Cruiser and you desperate to escape... Boldly explore the Star Cruiser, who knows if you might even be able to find dinosaurs on their development section...

Sublevel 5: Terraria
In this sublevel you explore the space ship Terraria. Terraria is a place, which is used to harvest food to space ship crew. Terraria is also used to farm some extraordinally special animals, such as Dinosaurs. Be carefully not to release them from their cages...

Sublevel 6: Into the Desert
You have escaped from the Star Cruiser by using emergency shuttle. Unfortunately an error occurs and you find yourself from a burning hot desert. Try to find familiar town, or some vehicle to escape...

Sublevel 7: BunkerWay
You discovered way to the Bunker on previous level. This is the only "safe" way to the Voltage Town (Episode 2). Explore large sections on the bunker and find your way...

Goal is to include VoltageDinoLand, City of Voltage and Town of Voltage to the Episode 2.

Special features, which are now available

  • Turn on and off switches
  • Ability to dive and swim
  • Push and move movable objects. If objects does not move, it is not movable
  • Pick, Carry and drop (currently only one object is enabled for this, we are testing this feature)
  • Talking characters (text)



Ah, finally we get to the most important thing in the game :) Player has an access to a wide variety of different kind of guns. Episode 1 includes at least these guns:

Shotgun, Sniper M700, Magnum 357, Colt 1911, RPG, Crossbow, Dagger, Hatchet, Bow, Halberd, Mace, Stones tho throw, Grenades and even one futuretek gun..
Other type of weapons are Melee Weapons, which you also have access when exploring different levels. These Melee Weapons are: Baseball Bat, Bow Saw, Cleaver, Cricket Bat, Crowbar, File, Garden Fork, Hammer, Lead Pipe, Pickaxe, Screwdriver, Shovel, Sledgehammer, Spanner and Wrench.






dr. Stephen J. McRegon, scientist, computer engineer, and something an a dreamer was asked to help a medium large computer company, to create a ultimate virtual reality system, which was ahead of time. And he did it. On year 1982 he created an open world game for Amiga personal computer, called AOSYS, Amiga operating system. AOSYS was capable to unlock incredible hidden features in Amiga 500, able to take full advantage of it's potential. Unfortunately it was never introduced to the markets in your dimension, where you read this message. Until this day came. McRegon found a way to blend space and time by simple breaking the law's of nature; He was sending radio waves Faster Than Light and that way broke the Cosmic Speed Limit. That maneuver opened a portal (which can be used only for sending small mass objects or voice), and hence deliver AOSYS to our dimension. For you all to play. You see, all physical objects, even you and your chair, exist in three dimensions. Everything has a width, and a high and a length. But there is another kind of length, a length in time.



All characters and locations used in this game are fictitious in our universe and any resemblance to real persons, vehicles and places is purely coincidental.



The game contains the instruction manual. To view this manual, click on the Steam store page ”View the manual” link.

data.name: 4X-Galaxy 无主之地：银河
data.detailed_description:
“4X-Galaxy” is a game developed by the 4X concept system.



Although "4X-Galaxy" can be played for free, you need to enroll for the monthly card system in order to get the full benefit of the game's features. There is no in-app purchase mall for points, points are earned during the game. The number of points earned depends on the player's skill, experience. and on good outcomes against other player's (adversaries) online.

The main difference from other games is that this game doesn't require you to accumulate points through a lot of playing time. Instead, you accumulate points through explorations, correctly answering quizzes, collecting and creating planets, business acumen, and plundering from other players. If you don't buy a monthly card, you can still play the game albeit without these features.
An example quiz; In addition to our solar system, how many galaxies are there in the whole universe?

Players can create, name and operate their own galaxy. Each galaxy in the game is created, named, and operated by the player. Absolutely unique. In the dynamic space world, a player’s behavior can affect the entire universe, triggering over 100 different events.

The game has five main character types, each with its own specialized skills and characteristics. With a fair degree of freedom, you can be transformed into any of the following characters:

A brave and fearless explorer
An interstellar pirate
A bounty hunter who defends justice
A skilled diplomat
A finance conscious businessman

There is a total of 48 roles and a range of 150 skillsets. Others are in development.

You need artillery to survive. In the game world economy, the price of artillery in the game depends on the players’ buying and selling behavior, and the law of supply and demand determines the game world's commodity prices. The game has a wide range of spaceships. All spaceships in the universe are made by the players themselves. There is a total of 36 ships, in six categories, available. They are:

Cruiser: A flexible long-range attack warship suitable for guerrilla warfare.
Battleship: A powerful and stable long-range warship for inflicting a lot of damage.
Assault ship: a flexible fast battleship suitable for assault operations.
Plunder ship: a highly defensive tough battleship, that can absorb a lot of damage
Exploration ship: This is the fastest. Used to explore unknown places in space.
Cargo ship: has the largest cargo space, suitable for traders.

You can build your own team of like-minded players and use the advantage of your team’s strength in the galaxy. But at the same time, beware of enemies hiding in the shadows, they will always attack you!

The law of the jungle reigns supreme, you, therefore, need to choose your partners wisely in order to survive. Your team’s ‘strength in unity’ is the key to conquering the galaxy.

Join the Universe Alliance and participate in an epic war. In the end, the unified universe will meet the alien civilization!

Under the multi-branch talent tree of the game, you can learn and upgrade your skills to improve your ability. You can choose to become a specialist in one area, or you can become an all-rounder

data.name: Yugo: the non-game
data.detailed_description:
Yugo: the non-game is a virtual space where you can drive a car, listen to the radio, and invite people to talk and share the experience with. It's a space that allows long conversations and hangouts that are often harder to come by when communicating digitally. It's a non-gamification of common voice chat sessions between people playing a game. It is a game for non-gamers.

When a player starts a session, they are the car driver, and each person that joins is seated in one of the other three passenger seats. Players are automatically connected via voice chat. The radio stations are real-life internet radio streams and several of them are available by default, and more can be added or removed by the players.

The environment, while it is abstracted and contextless, still contains elements of a certain time and region. The serpentine roads in the game are inspired by the mountainous roads going from Kosovo to Montenegro. The car is modeled after Yugo, an iconic car produced in Yugoslavia in the 1980s’. The time of the day is reminiscent of dusks in Kosovo, mostly because of the omnipresence of crows and the sounds they make at evening flying back to their nests for the night. Similarly reminiscent of that region are also the monolithic-like objects on top of hills, inspired by Socialist-era Yugoslavian monuments in Kosovo and the rest ex-Yugoslavia. Aside from the significance they have for the area and people there, they have a striking visual appearance that blur the time and place perceptions.


What’s New in v2.0:

In addition to various improvements to existing features, Yugo: The Non-Game version 2.0 introduces exciting new elements:

Public Sessions

You can now join not just your friends, but also public sessions. Choose from a list of ongoing sessions or jump into a random one. This feature enhances the community aspect of the game, allowing for spontaneous interactions and connections with new players.

Customizable Radio

You can now add your own real-life radio stations and enjoy them with your fellow passengers in the car. We’ve also provided a database of available radio stream URLs to make it easy for you to find your favorite stations.

- changing gameplay and physics

- Smash the paintshop walls and paint them in a creative way
- Test your precision with balls and trash cans in photorealistic street levels
- At the end of each level, you need to survive a couple of surprises!

data.name: AeroDream
data.detailed_description:
AeroDream is a relaxing social exploration game inspired by Frutiger Aero and the optimistic digital aesthetics of the early 2000s.

Enter a bright, dreamlike world filled with peaceful environments, nostalgic sounds, glossy interfaces, and interactive activities designed to feel like a forgotten childhood memory.

EXPLORE A DREAMLIKE WORLD

Wander through colorful environments, discover hidden details, and enjoy the world at your own pace. AeroDream focuses on relaxation, exploration, and atmosphere rather than pressure or competition.

EXPRESS YOURSELF

Customize your character and create a look that matches your personality and the nostalgic style of the world.

data.name: DreamWorks Trolls Remix Rescue
data.detailed_description:
Jam with the Trolls in this exciting new adventure!

Play as Poppy, Branch and more of your favorite DreamWorks Trolls as you explore, smash, dance and battle your way towards rescuing the Troll Kingdom from a melodic mastermind who’s trying to alter the Trolls’ musical harmony.

Key Game Features:

PLAY AS THE TROLLS: Choose from your favorite Trolls including Poppy, Branch, Guy Diamond and more as you explore and journey through Troll Kingdom in a quest to save it!

CREATE AND PLAY As your own stylized Troll character featuring different hairstyles, facial features, outfits, and more with thousands of combination possibilities!

HAIR IS NOT JUST FOR LOOKS: Perform ‘Hair-Jitsu’ to whip your hair at enemies, twirl your hair to float like a helicopter, and use your hair to grab, carry, push, pull, throw, and smash objects along your quest.

MUSICAL MINI-GAMES & CHALLENGES: Compete in rhythm-based mini-games and solve fun and challenging environmental puzzles to unlock special items or new abilities.

MOVE TO THE BEAT OF THE TROLLS: The game soundtrack features music from DreamWorks Animation's Trolls film franchise, such as:

• Get Back Up Again
• Hair Up
• And more!

FULLY IMMERSE YOURSELF IN TROLL KINGDOM: Explore the wonders of your favorite Trolls kingdoms from Poppy & Branch’s Pop Village, Barb’s Volcano Rock City, Cooper’s Mothership City, and more!

FUN WITH FRIENDS: Up to 4 players co-op local multiplayer

data.name: Taskbar Fishing & Aquarium
data.detailed_description:
An aquarium in the corner of your desktop.

Taskbar Fishing & Aquarium is an idle fishing and aquarium game that keeps running beside your work.

A small window just above your taskbar catches fish on its own, so you never have to stop what you are doing.

Just leave it, and the fish come

  • Keep it running, and fish swim up and bite on their own

  • Fishing never stops, even while you are admiring your tank

  • Catches from while your PC was off are waiting for you next time (up to 12 hours)

Many fish, many rarities

  • 35 species across 10 rarity tiers, from Common to Cosmic

  • Display your catches in the tank to boost your fishing. The rarer the fish, the bigger the boost

  • Fill in a 350-entry log of every species and rarity

Build the aquarium you want

  • 66 items: backgrounds, floors, stone castles, coral, seaweed and more

  • Drag to place, flip and resize, or tuck decorations behind the fish

  • Display up to 8 of your catches and watch them swim

Upgrade your tackle and catch more

  • The more you upgrade your rod and hook, the better your fishing gets

Stays out of your way

  • Three window sizes, optional always-on-top, and see-through water

data.name: The Last Summoner's Legacy
data.detailed_description:
Experience a true indie fantasy RPG: no shortcuts, no ads, just the game.

Born from the pages of a fantasy novel and crafted over 500+ hours of passion, this is the RPG for anyone who misses the golden age of strategic turn-based combat. Play as 20+ unique characters and dive into a world where skill and strategy still matter.

[H2] 100% OFFLINE, NO ADS
No internet? No problem. Play anywhere, anytime. No intrusive ads, no energy bars to wait on, no hidden in-app purchases.

[H2] A BATTLE-DRIVEN JOURNEY
Over 35 hours of content set in an original fantasy universe. Your journey is only beginning.

[H2] MASTER OVER 300 SKILLS
Customize your party from a vast pool of abilities. Progress through 3 skill tiers as you level your heroes up to the max level of 20.

[H2] WEAPON SYSTEM — NO DUPLICATES
Unlock 70+ legendary weapons through gameplay. No real-money cost: earn tokens by defeating bosses, and you'll never pull a duplicate. Every token grants new powers.

[H2] 53 EPIC BOSS BATTLES
Face 53+ unique bosses, including 18+ high-level endgame encounters that will test your tactics.

[H2] EXPANSION MODULES INCLUDED
The adventure keeps growing with new characters, weapon banners and boss events.

[H2] A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER
I'm an independent developer and author. To bring a world of 100+ unique monsters to life, I used AI for most of the creature illustrations. This let me focus all my energy on what truly matters: a balanced, deep and rewarding gameplay experience.

[H2] THIS IS AN OLD-SCHOOL RPG

  • Everything the game contains is listed here. Nothing is hidden, nothing is missing.

  • No auto-battle. No "win" button. If you lose, you lose because you played badly.

  • Some fights are brutal by design. You're expected to think, plan, fail and try again.

  • Progress comes from understanding the systems, not from waiting.

If you're looking for a modern idle or casual experience, this isn't for you — and that's exactly the point. It's built for players who miss RPGs that asked for real effort.

If you want an honest, high-quality RPG made by a fan of the genre for fans of the genre, this one's for you.

Join the legend. Master the skills. Defeat the bosses. Offline.

data.name: A Day of Maintenance
data.detailed_description:
You're a distant blip amongst the sands around New Port City; It's been a long few shifts, but you're almost done with doing your sweep of the guidance stations for the docking spaceships. Take your Massive Self-Sustaining Installation Repair Truck (or MSSIRT for short); & travel the landscape to fix the last few on your list for the day with your trusty multi-tool crane.

A Day of Maintenance is a new, unusual kind of exploration game, taking cues from In Other Waters, 17776, Signal from Tolva, and Euro Truck Simulator 2

If you've ever found yourself thinking:

"I want a kind-of-technical driving game with a little gay romance but also some discussion over robot worker consciousness. (With crane operation gameplay)"

This game is for you.



  • Around 8 hours long
  • This game is deliberately slow-paced. Enjoy the drive, sip a cup of something warm, fix sites in the distant future.
  • Chat with your Robot Boyfriend, 6 workmates, & a couple other characters along the way.
  • Best played with a gamepad. But there's mouse & keyboard bindings for everything.



Chat with Orby about cool stuff like databases, satellite software, and the possibility of having your mind overwritten by a routine check-up.

As you drive the open desert, your crew of fellow maintenance robots will chew the scenery; debating over trains, spaceships, philosophy, and hats.

Oh! You might also uncover a conspiracy.

data.name: Sling-A-Thing
data.detailed_description:
Sling-A-Thing is a mind-boggling, laugh-out-loud, comedy action puzzler that will keep you entertained for hours. Dive into a whimsical world where you can transform into an incredible variety of cartoon characters and objects, all to find your way to the exit in the most creative ways possible.

Features:

Quirky, Surprising & Satisfying Gameplay

Every level is designed to surprise you with quirky challenges and satisfying solutions. The humor and creativity packed into each puzzle make every moment enjoyable.

Lovingly handcrafted levels to conquer

With lots of unique levels, there’s always a new challenge waiting for you. Each level presents different obstacles and puzzles that will test your wit and reflexes. Selected levels have optional challenges and secrets for particularly ambitious players!

Transform into many different things

One of the most exciting features of Sling-A-Thing is the ability to transform into more and more different characters and objects. From quirky creatures to everyday items, each transformation offers unique abilities that help you navigate through the puzzles. Heart and ghost, anvil and sun, Turtle and turd, the combinations are endless!

Original Transformation Mechanic

The transformation mechanic is truly original, allowing you to think outside the box. You’ll need to strategize which transformation to use and when, making the gameplay both challenging and fun!

Prepare for a delightful adventure with Sling-A-Thing! It’s the perfect blend of comedy and puzzle-solving action, ensuring an experience you won’t forget. Sling! Transform! Laugh!

data.name: SWORD FLINGER
data.detailed_description:
SWORD FLINGER is a roguelite action game where you fight by throwing a variety of weapons.

Swords fly in arcs, spears shoot straight, axes are heavy but hit hard, and scythes spin through the air.

Each weapon also comes with its own unique abilities. Master them all and find your perfect arsenal!

Even the slightest change in angle can dramatically alter your weapon's trajectory.

Stop the Shot Gauge at just the right moment to deal extra damage!

Master your angle and power to land the perfect shot!

Each time you throw a weapon, the enemy's action counter decreases. When it reaches zero, they attack!

But if your weapon returns to you, you'll trigger ONE MORE CHANCE!

Throw the same weapon again without advancing the enemy's turn!

Level up and clear stages to earn rewards and grow stronger.

Use active skills and items, or raise your shield to block incoming attacks.

Combine everything you find and create your own way to fight!

You awaken with no memories—and a mysterious gauntlet attached to your right arm.

Who are you?

Collect Memory Fragments throughout the labyrinth to improve your starting abilities as you uncover the truth behind your lost memories and the mysterious gauntlet.

data.name: Tennis Manager 2022
data.detailed_description:
Put on the suit of a tennis coach and manager of a tennis academy. Immerse yourself in the most realistic tennis simulation, both on and off the court. Beat the odds and take control!

Game description


From the junior circuit to the professional circuit, access over 2,000 tournaments. Among the 5,000 players present, find the talents that will lead your academy to glory.

Financial stability, contract negotiation, structural investments... Be clever in your management, reach your short and long term goals, and impress your board of directors.

Surround yourself with the best staff (coaches, technical, physical, tactical and mental trainers, etc.) and design the training program that best suits your players' abilities, their expectations and your style!

Perfect your speech in press conferences and show your board of directors, as well as your players, that you are the right man/woman for the job.

Thanks to the 3D engine, immerse yourself in the heart of the match and coach your player in real time! Are you more of a serve and volley player or a baseline filer? Exuberant or totally passive? Take control, impose your style and guide your player to the top.

Key features presentation

The 2nd opus of the saga is here, with something new.

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYER

Design your own player! Overpowered serve bot or inexhaustible marathoner? Extreme lifter or old school flat player? You can choose his style and shape him to lead your academy to titles and glory!


NEW INFRASTRUCTURE SYSTEM

Immerse yourself in the real life of an academy manager with a new infrastructure system that brings even more realism to your various investment decisions. You want clay court specialists? Then provide your structure with ochre training courts. You are not satisfied with the performance of your scouts? Then invest in your study center and boost their evaluation speed. You are the manager, you choose!


ROUND ROBIN

To win the Finals at the end of the season, you will have to go through the new group phase and hope to make the semi-finals. 2 groups of 4 players, the best 8 in the Race. This format is also used for the Next Gen Finals (under 21) and the Juniors Finals. Be sure to keep your scores high, as the title can be decided by a small difference!

TEAM MANAGEMENT TOOLS

Optimize your team management with new tools that are a must-have for any self-respecting manager! At a glance, you can now find all your team's key information (schedule for the week, next tournament, current form, status of commercial contracts, etc.), match history, detailed results, earnings per tournament or even the complete record of each player, and... new recruitment reports! What else?

NEW CONTRACT MANAGEMENT / NEGOTIATION SYSTEM

Negotiate with talent and skill the different contracts that will punctuate the life of your academy. Contracts and sporting objectives of players, agreements with equipment suppliers... The negotiation system has been reworked to reflect the reality of the business world. The agent of the academy becomes an essential actor to help you build your empire.


IMPORT / EXPORT OF GAME PLAN

One click to import Rafa's winning tactics against Roger in 2009, one click to export and become the star of the TM community.

MATCH SIMULATION ENHANCEMENTS

Take a seat on the court and vibrate with your player thanks to the improvement of the most realistic 3D simulation of the circuit. Improved AI, new behaviors (replacements, effects used, shot selection) and new animations (moves and moving shots). Closer to the court, more real, more emotional!

Design your own player! Overpowered serve bot or inexhaustible marathoner? Extreme lifter or old school flat player? You can choose his style and shape him to lead your academy to titles and glory!


NEW INFRASTRUCTURE SYSTEM

Immerse yourself in the real life of an academy manager with a new infrastructure system that brings even more realism to your various investment decisions. You want clay court specialists? Then provide your structure with ochre training courts. You are not satisfied with the performance of your scouts? Then invest in your study center and boost their evaluation speed. You are the manager, you choose!


ROUND ROBIN

To win the Finals at the end of the season, you will have to go through the new group phase and hope to make the semi-finals. 2 groups of 4 players, the best 8 in the Race. This format is also used for the Next Gen Finals (under 21) and the Juniors Finals. Be sure to keep your scores high, as the title can be decided by a small difference!

TEAM MANAGEMENT TOOLS

Optimize your team management with new tools that are a must-have for any self-respecting manager! At a glance, you can now find all your team's key information (schedule for the week, next tournament, current form, status of commercial contracts, etc.), match history, detailed results, earnings per tournament or even the complete record of each player, and... new recruitment reports! What else?

NEW CONTRACT MANAGEMENT / NEGOTIATION SYSTEM

Negotiate with talent and skill the different contracts that will punctuate the life of your academy. Contracts and sporting objectives of players, agreements with equipment suppliers... The negotiation system has been reworked to reflect the reality of the business world. The agent of the academy becomes an essential actor to help you build your empire.


IMPORT / EXPORT OF GAME PLAN

One click to import Rafa's winning tactics against Roger in 2009, one click to export and become the star of the TM community.

MATCH SIMULATION ENHANCEMENTS

Take a seat on the court and vibrate with your player thanks to the improvement of the most realistic 3D simulation of the circuit. Improved AI, new behaviors (replacements, effects used, shot selection) and new animations (moves and moving shots). Closer to the court, more real, more emotional!

data.name: Starry Museum
data.detailed_description:
~ Unveil the Truth of the Starry Sky ~

Experience a new kind of adventure that blends stunning starry visuals with horror in the fantasy-horror game 「Starry Museum」.

When you wake up, you find yourself beneath a vast, starry sky. Ahead lies a crumbling mansion, and a glowing cat leads you toward the memories of truth. What is that precious something you've forgotten? An elderly man ventures into the world of illusions, seeking his mission and his sins.

A Museum of Twinkling Stars

A museum where the starry sky glitters, and celestial globes are scattered about. It's a gallery of Aston's memories, but for Aston, who has lost them all, it's a barren beginning.

As you recover more memories, new exhibits and constellations appear, and you’ll find yourself captivated by the increasingly beautiful graphics.

Searching for Memories in a Dark Past

After being pulled into a celestial globe, you find yourself in an eerie mansion. This place is deeply connected to Aston's life before death… Together with Terrier the cat, you solve puzzles and overcome various challenges to proceed. At the deepest part of the celestial globe, both challenges and memories await.

A Story of Memories Hidden by the Stars

Using gorgeous illustrations, Aston's past is slowly revealed. The story features multiple endings—will you uncover the truth?

data.name: Iris's Idle Log
data.detailed_description:
A LONG ADVENTURE THAT FITS BESIDE YOUR DAY

Iris's Idle Log is a quiet, long-form idle RPG about preparation, discovery, and steady growth. Follow Iris and her mysterious companion, Bibi, as a small adventure log expands across new areas, resources, skills, and challenges.

The game supports a portrait layout, letting you place it freely in a corner of your screen and enjoy it while doing something else.

PREPARE WELL. PUSH FARTHER.

Exploration and combat unfold automatically, but your decisions shape every journey. Equip weapons and armor, prepare food, train Action Skills, and choose the area you want to explore.

Each new item, meal, rank, and upgrade gives Iris the strength to travel farther on her next exploration.

BUILD YOUR OWN GROWTH ROUTE

Progress reaches far beyond combat. A wide range of interconnected Life Skills lets you decide what Iris works on and how one part of her routine supports the next.

- Gather and Produce - Mining, Logging, Fishing, and Farming

- Craft and Prepare - Cooking, Brewing, Crafting, Smithing, and Enchanting

- Learn and Create - Training, Meditation, Rest, Familiar Training, Instrument Performance, Painting, and Writing

- Trade and Discover - Stealth, Commerce, Cartography, Camping, and Expedition

Gather raw materials, turn them into useful equipment and consumables, improve Iris's stats, unlock new destinations, and shape a progression route of your own.

PROGRESS THAT CONTINUES WHILE YOU ARE AWAY

Set up Auto Explore, dispatch an Expedition, or leave Iris working on a Life Skill before you step away. Even after you close the game, her routine continues offline, and a summary shows what happened when you return.

Check in for a moment, collect your progress, choose the next goal, and let Iris continue at your pace. Whether you actively plan every step or leave her to work while you focus on something else, her day keeps moving forward.

WRITE THE NEXT PAGE WITH IRIS

Explore unfamiliar areas, complete Objectives, discover resources, and prepare to face stronger enemies. Iris's world opens little by little through small decisions and steady growth - one task, one return, and one page at a time.

What will you gather today? What will you make next? How far will Iris travel before she turns back?

data.name: Climbing In Barrel With Double-Barrel
data.detailed_description:
This game is a challenging physics-based 2D-platformer about climbing a mountain using only a barrel, a double-barrel and lots of ammo.

Easy controls

Only the mouse is used for control:

  • Move the mouse to aim the double-barrel.
  • Press the mouse keys to shoot and fly away from the recoil.

Exciting challenge

Almost any mistake can cost you a huge part of progress. Practice, make mistakes and eventually you will be able to overcome all the obstacles.

On average, it takes 2-3 hours to get through the game, but if you practice enough, you can complete it in just 5-10 minutes.

Test your skills, reaction speed and patience in this frustrating game!

data.name: Settlers Cycle
data.detailed_description:
Build a city, develop it into a thriving settlement, then send settlers to found a new city deeper in the wilderness. Your previous settlements do not disappear - they continue supporting your newest city, creating an ever-growing network of interconnected settlements.

 The Settlers Cycle

Every city eventually reaches a point where it can launch a new group of settlers.

When you establish a new city, your previous cities remain in the game. They will:

  • Periodically provide Town Points and resources to your new settlement.

  • Offer trade deals.

  • Occasionally develop resource shortages that you can fulfill for additional rewards.

  • Can be donated to your faction to earn Favor and free up regional city slots.

 Develop Your City

Each new settlement begins as little more than a few tents.

Purchase Town Points to develop different aspects of your city. Higher Town Point levels unlock new research, products, and beneficial events within their respective categories.

Each Town Point also generates Production Points that can be spent on:

  • Research

  • Products

 Specialize Your Cities

Every faction offers unique city specializations.

A specialization grants additional Production Points while you actively control the city.

Once you establish a new settlement, your previous city's specialization also determines:

  • Which Town Points it periodically provides.

  • Which resources it supplies.

  • Which trade offers it generates.

Your previous cities continue to support and shape the growth of future settlements.

 Heroes

Recruit heroes and organize them into adventuring parties.

Heroes can:

  • Slay nearby monsters.

  • Hunt dangerous spellcasters.

  • Intercept incoming enemy armies and defeat their champions to weaken attacks before they reach your city.

  • Complete Heartland Quests.

  • Complete expeditions to obtain Maps required to found new settlements.

  • Explore the wilderness for additional resources.

Heroes improve by investing resources rather than gaining experience.

There is no permanent death.

 Defend Your Settlement

The frontier is dangerous. Monsters, evil spellcasters, and invading armies constantly threaten your city.

Send your heroes to eliminate nearby threats before they can damage your settlement.

When enemy armies approach, your heroes can defeat their champions to reduce the strength of the incoming attack before your city's troops fight the remaining forces.

 Explore the Frontier

The wilderness must be secured before you can expand.

Clear monster-infested areas to obtain Holdings, a resource required to launch your next settler caravan and establish a new city.

Complete expeditions to chart unexplored territories and obtain Maps, another requirement for founding new settlements.

Both Holdings and Maps are essential for expanding your frontier network.

 Your Region

Each region has a limited number of city slots.

From the regional overview you can:

  • Collect supplies from previous cities.

  • Trade with them.

  • Fulfill their shortages for additional Town Points and resources.

  • Donate cities to your faction to earn Favor and free city slots for future settlements.

Managing your regional network is just as important as developing your active city.

 Factions

You begin as a city of the Human Kingdom, but your allegiance can change.

As you discover new factions, you may join them to gain access to unique:

  • City specializations

  • Gameplay modifiers

  • Favor Shop items

Support your faction in its wars by contributing Town Points.

Earn Favor for your contributions and spend it to unlock city specializations, request valuable support from your faction, or influence diplomacy by forging new alliances or dissolving existing ones.

 Favor

Favor represents your standing and influence with your faction.

Earn Favor by:

  • Sending resources to the Heartlands.

  • Supporting your faction in its wars.

  • Donating cities to your faction.

Spend Favor to:

  • Request Town Point packages from your faction.

  • Unlock city specializations.

  • Influence your faction's diplomacy.

 

 Heartland Quests

The Heartlands regularly request the aid of adventurers.

Choose your reward, assign heroes to multi-turn quests, and make strategic decisions throughout their journey.

 Talent Requests

As more adventurers leave the Heartlands to seek fortune on the frontier, kingdoms, guilds, and merchants struggle to fill important positions.

Organizations may approach your Adventurers' Guild with offers to permanently recruit one of your heroes. Decide whether to keep the adventurer or accept compensation for allowing them to join another organization.

 Key Features

  • Build a network of interconnected frontier settlements.

  • Previous cities continue supporting your newest settlement.

  • Develop cities through the Town Point system.

  • Specialize settlements to shape your regional economy.

  • Recruit heroes and form adventuring parties.

  • Defend against monsters, spellcasters, and invading armies.

  • Explore the frontier to establish future settlements.

  • Join factions with unique gameplay modifiers.

  • Influence diplomacy and faction wars.
