  • Which Town Points it periodically provides.

  • Which resources it supplies.

  • Which trade offers it generates.

Your previous cities continue to support and shape the growth of future settlements.

 Heroes

Recruit heroes and organize them into adventuring parties.

Heroes can:

  • Slay nearby monsters.

  • Hunt dangerous spellcasters.

  • Intercept incoming enemy armies and defeat their champions to weaken attacks before they reach your city.

  • Complete Heartland Quests.

  • Complete expeditions to obtain Maps required to found new settlements.

  • Explore the wilderness for additional resources.

Heroes improve by investing resources rather than gaining experience.

There is no permanent death.

 Defend Your Settlement

The frontier is dangerous. Monsters, evil spellcasters, and invading armies constantly threaten your city.

Send your heroes to eliminate nearby threats before they can damage your settlement.

When enemy armies approach, your heroes can defeat their champions to reduce the strength of the incoming attack before your city's troops fight the remaining forces.

 Explore the Frontier

The wilderness must be secured before you can expand.

Clear monster-infested areas to obtain Holdings, a resource required to launch your next settler caravan and establish a new city.

Complete expeditions to chart unexplored territories and obtain Maps, another requirement for founding new settlements.

Both Holdings and Maps are essential for expanding your frontier network.

 Your Region

Each region has a limited number of city slots.

From the regional overview you can:

  • Collect supplies from previous cities.

  • Trade with them.

  • Fulfill their shortages for additional Town Points and resources.

  • Donate cities to your faction to earn Favor and free city slots for future settlements.

Managing your regional network is just as important as developing your active city.

 Factions

You begin as a city of the Human Kingdom, but your allegiance can change.

As you discover new factions, you may join them to gain access to unique:

  • City specializations

  • Gameplay modifiers

  • Favor Shop items

Support your faction in its wars by contributing Town Points.

Earn Favor for your contributions and spend it to unlock city specializations, request valuable support from your faction, or influence diplomacy by forging new alliances or dissolving existing ones.

 Favor

Favor represents your standing and influence with your faction.

Earn Favor by:

  • Sending resources to the Heartlands.

  • Supporting your faction in its wars.

  • Donating cities to your faction.

Spend Favor to:

  • Request Town Point packages from your faction.

  • Unlock city specializations.

  • Influence your faction's diplomacy.

 

 Heartland Quests

The Heartlands regularly request the aid of adventurers.

Choose your reward, assign heroes to multi-turn quests, and make strategic decisions throughout their journey.

 Talent Requests

As more adventurers leave the Heartlands to seek fortune on the frontier, kingdoms, guilds, and merchants struggle to fill important positions.

Organizations may approach your Adventurers' Guild with offers to permanently recruit one of your heroes. Decide whether to keep the adventurer or accept compensation for allowing them to join another organization.

 Key Features

  • Build a network of interconnected frontier settlements.

  • Previous cities continue supporting your newest settlement.

  • Develop cities through the Town Point system.

  • Specialize settlements to shape your regional economy.

  • Recruit heroes and form adventuring parties.

  • Defend against monsters, spellcasters, and invading armies.

  • Explore the frontier to establish future settlements.

  • Join factions with unique gameplay modifiers.

  • Influence diplomacy and faction wars.
data.short_description: Build a city, develop it, and send settlers deeper into the wilderness. Your old settlements remain behind, supporting each new city in an ever-growing network. Recruit heroes, defend your frontier, and support your faction against its rivals.

data.name: Steamboat Willie Rescue Mission
data.detailed_description:
A CLASSIC RESCUE MISSION!

Willie's sweet gal Winnie has been kidnapped by the dastardly Captain Pete! The steamboat is empty, the music has stopped, and it's up to you to bring her home.

Steamboat Willie: Rescue Mission is a love letter to classic 1928 animation, with visuals and gameplay inspired by the golden age of 8-bit games. Journey through 20 challenging levels spanning frozen woods, scorching deserts, jungle mazes, high-speed trains, and a haunted house.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Classic 8-Bit Platforming: Jump, climb, and run your way through treacherous traps, moving platforms, and deadly spikes.

  • Take to the Skies: Hop into your biplane for thrilling auto-scrolling flight levels! Dodge flying ducks and blast Captain Pete's airborne potato attacks.

  • Choose Your Nostalgia: Play in crisp modern color, or dive into the options menu to enable classic "Black and White" or nostalgic "Green Mode" to simulate the look of a 90s handheld console!

  • Unlockable Winnie Mode: Explore every nook and cranny. If you can collect every hidden musical note in the game, you'll unlock the ability to play through the entire adventure as Winnie!

  • Procedural Retro Audio: Tap your toes to a vibrant, chiptune soundtrack and authentic 8-bit sound effects.

Disclaimer: This game is based on the 1928 public-domain animated film "Steamboat Willie." This product is not affiliated with, authorized, or endorsed by The Walt Disney Company.

The Seven Districts of Sin: The Tail Makes the Fox is an otome visual novel which follows the daily activities of the demons of hell - and perhaps the relationships that in their midst.

Lilim is an auditor for the main Hell government. When her beloved Lord Lucifer tasks her with going to the Kumonoito District to investigate their governor for soul laundering, she has no choice but to obey.

Will little, naive Lilim be able to survive her stay at Kumonoito? Will she maybe find someone special? … Or will she just go right back to licking Lucifer’s boots?

data.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
data.detailed_description:
Rhythm is Life and Law

Rhythm is everything on the island of Suri, and when its harmony is broken, the land dances to a darker pulse.

Play as Ajira, a young girl fast and fearless, on her quest to find a fruit that can save her mother from the illness that killed her father.

But what begins as a simple trek through a forest, becomes a journey to restore the rhythmic balance of the island, and with it, life itself.

In SURI: The Seventh Note, rhythm isn’t decoration, but the law of nature. Learn its patterns. Trust its timing. When you move with the beat, the island moves with you

Game Features

• Rhythm-Driven Action – Run, jump, and phase in sync with the soundtrack. The world reacts to your timing, and missing the beat means losing your flow.

• Cinematic Escape Sequences – Push your reflexes through handcrafted chases where gameplay and music fuse into one.

• Evolving Abilities – Unlock rhythm-infused powers that expand your movement and combat as you learn to master the beat.

• A World That Breathes Music – From quiet ruins to chaotic arenas, each level is composed like a song  with its own tempo, tone, and emotion.

data.name: Vigor
data.detailed_description:
Join the game that has been played by over 20 million players and explore the harsh and unforgiving Outlands, the shattered remains of what was once Norway. Utilize any means necessary to survive. Set in a post-apocalyptic atmosphere in the early 90s, the landscape of the Outlands is as deadly as it is beautiful, so be careful out there.



Experience the thrills that Encounters have to offer, a high-stakes mode where survival is key. Extract the most valuable resources in order to build and upgrade your Shelter, or lose everything if you die!

Choose over 60 different weapons and consumables to customize your loadout based on the play style of your choice - sneaky looter or deadly shooter. Change the pace of the Encounter and gain an advantage over your enemies by controlling tactical points on the map.

Compete for Loot Events, special places that hold more valuable loot, and try to retrieve the Airdrop, the most precious haul in the Outlands. We dare you! Escape from specific exits at any time and avoid the deadly radiation cloud that sweeps over the map, killing everyone trapped inside it.



Play alone in Shootout, a fast-paced deathmatch, or join a squad with your friends in Elimination, a 5v5 tactical, round-based teamfight. In Encounter, you can team up with a friend as a Duo, or compete as a Lone Wolf where the risk vs. reward factor is greater as you square off against other squads on your own!



Identify as one of many groups of Outlanders that inhabit this broken world through various cosmetic sets. Choose between military, non-military and everything in between to instill fear in the hearts of your opponents.



Your Shelter is your safe haven in the apocalypse and your central hub for information. By collecting resources from Encounters, you can build and upgrade your Shelter, which will, in turn, provide you with more options (craft better weapons and consumables, generate Crowns and other materials) that will be essential to your survival. Practice your marksmanship in the Shooting Range, craft your necessary equipment in the Armory, and customize your character from the wardrobe while you keep building your Shelter to maximize its potential.

data.name: Glob
data.detailed_description:
Glob is a fast-paced platformer that really swings into action! Use your gooey sling to pull yourself around, or use it to throw obstacles at enemies!

Exciting sling mechanic

Master your sling as you use it to fly through levels at a blistering pace! The sling allows you to grab onto both terrain and various objects, most likely leading to you flying into a saw blade at first! Once you master the sling, you'll move around levels like a real glob!


Smash your Friends

Race your friends in the time trials or compete in a deathmatch to see who has the fastest sling! Online high scores and matchmaking ensures you'll always have a whole glob of fun!


PvP and Coop

Exciting levels which challenge your platforming and slinging skills as you try to overcome each level by yourself or with friends. It's up to you if you want to be able to sling your friends as you progress through the levels, leading to hilarious moments of betrayal.


Something for everyone

Many varying game modes to cater for everyone - Capture the Flag, Competitive Racing, Arena Battle, Cooperative Puzzles, and more! Group up in teams or try your luck as a lone glob.


Daring leaps and bounds

Featuring gripping sections of daring jumps and swings, you'll need to overcome many challenges to succeed. Did we mention there are lasers?!

data.name: Choo chop
data.detailed_description:
Bite-sized days, play anytime!

Choo Chop is a relaxing incremental game you can play with a mouse or a controller. As your train rolls through the forest, you guide your lumberjacks' work area, and they fell every tree inside it. At the whistle, the wood turns into money, and you'll want just one more day!

Fell the Forest

21 tree species spread across five regions: temperate woods, mountains, savanna, rainforest and flooded wetlands. Logs fly straight into the wagon, and every new species is worth more than the last. With the right upgrades, the forest grows back as the train goes by!

Unlock the Upgrade Tree

Spend your money on over 170 upgrades: longer days, a fuller forest, more valuaband locomotives. Every purchase opens the way to the next, and there's alwaysanother one within reach.

Choose Your Locomotive

There are 10 locomotives, and none of them is just for show: each one brings itsmperial pays more per tree, the Sower trades money for seeds, the Hatchet can fell a tree on the first hit, and the Thunder can recharge every wagon at once.

Buy Power Wagons

Four power wagons can join your train: the Cable Tower, the Chainsaws, the Flying Saw and the Cutting Drone. They recharge and fire on their own across the forest. Spend seeds to make them stronger and stronger.

Collect Artifacts

There are 20 artifacts to collect, like the Foreman's Watch, which stretches the day, and the Buyer's Seal, which makes all wood worth more. Each one levels up to 10. And keep an eye on the forest: chests and lost logs turn up along the way, full of seeds.

data.name: Memorial Circuit
data.detailed_description:
Memorial Circuit


"Memorial Circuit" is a text based visual novel game,
developed by Studio Elysian.

Memorial Circuit follows a scientist who lost his wife from a war, trying to bring her back to life. He participates in a secret research project to resurrect his wife, but as he progresses in his research he slowly falls into the conspiracy surrounding his company and the war.

Features

  • Genre : Sci-Fi + Romance
  • Playtime : 4~6 hrs of reading time
  • Story Route : Memorial Circuit follows a linear single-route storyline
  • Full 4K : Enjoy the game in its fullest visual quality

Various types of Collectable CGs

"Memorial Circuit" experiments with various visual graphics and effects such as Comics, Motion Graphics to maximize the story-reading experience for players.

data.name: Reaktorhallen R1 - Zombie Shooter
data.detailed_description:
DURING THE POST WORLD WAR II race among countries to arm themselves with nuclear weapons,
some risky decisions were made. One of them was the building of Sweden’s first nuclear reactor,
Reaktor 1, or R1, buried 25 meters directly underneath the the ground,
and within a 1 km of about 40,000 people. Nonetheless, in the heady days of the Cold War and nuclear armament,
it was deemed a tolerable risk for the scientists to be able to study reactions.

With the hope of achieving a scientific breakthrough, the scientists at R1 decided to conduct an experiment on July 13,
1954, at 18:59. They were attempting to generate a controlled nuclear fission reaction to produce more energy than what was put in.
But things went horribly wrong.

As the scientists activated the reactor, there was an eerie silence in the room. Then, suddenly, there was a loud buzzing sound,
followed by a blinding flash of light that filled the room. The reactor was not behaving as they had expected. Instead of a controlled reaction,
it was generating an uncontrollable chain reaction. The reactor began to overheat rapidly, and the control rods meant to control the reaction failed.

The situation quickly spiraled out of control. The scientists tried to contain the situation,
but they were helpless against the overpowering force of nuclear energy.
The reactor exploded, sending a massive cloud of radioactive material into the air.
The scientists working at the site were caught in the explosion and were transformed into zombies.

Now, 50 years later, the science lab has been overrun by the zombie scientists.
Your task is to clear out the lab and prevent the zombies from escaping.
The city has hired you as a professional zombie exterminator.
Armed with only a gun, you enter the lab. The silence is deafening,
and the eerie glow of the radiation reminds you of the tragedy that occurred here 50 years ago.
You cautiously make your way through the lab, searching for the zombies.
Suddenly, you hear a growling sound. You ready your weapon and prepare for the worst.

data.name: 7 Pillars
data.detailed_description:
NEW CONTENT AVAILABLE!

Just updated! Use your current saves to continue the 7 Pillars story and search for the remaining 4 relics. Prepare for the final fight against Aisa. This update is free to those who already purchased the game and will be included at the regular purchase price for anyone new who purchases the game.


About the Game

Basics: Single player RPG with turn based combat. Easy to pick up for first time RPG players. Accumulating enough XP will automatically level up your character. All you have to worry about from a customization standpoint is different weapons if you find them that are specific to each character. Higher level bosses will most likely require items (such as healing potions and revival stimulants), so exploration and random encounter battles are crucial for end game success. Core feature: CHOICES MATTER! One ending, but two different paths to get there. Story: You control a young man named CJ. Little is known about your history, but you are thrust right into a war with Ethos. She has returned after 500 years to establish her pillars and conquer the earth. It seems almost everyone is dead and it is up to you and your friends to stop her. You will have to make a handful of tough choices along the way and one in particular will affect how you face Ethos in the final battle. Things will appear off sometimes (e.g. some walls can be walked through, details may seem vague, etc.) and not until after defeating Ethos will you begin to understand what just happened...

data.name: Mr. President We Have A Situation!
data.detailed_description:
Mr. President We Have a Situation! is a desktop overlay game where you make tough decisions to secure the future of the country and the presidency. The decisions have long lasting effects.

The game is intended to be played alongside work or study sessions (or any kind of activity really, like playing other games or watching movies) using Pomodoro technique to focus on work. It utilizes focused work sessions with break sessions in between. At the start of such sessions, whether it is work or break, the game introduces issue cards for you (Mr. President) to make a decision on. It does not force you to make a decision right away, rather it notifies you that there's something that needs your attention. You can take care of it when you are available, for you are Mr. President, and no task can truly force your hand to take action at that exact moment. 

The gameplay is fairly simple. You just drag the issue card left or right depending on how you choose to resolve the issue. These decisions have lasting effects on the trend of your resources. Will you spend your hard-earned gold to feed the people and gain some political power in the process, or will you increase the influence of your army at the cost of the people's happiness? Remember: as too little of something is bad, it is equally bad (in some cases even worse) to have too much of something. As the saying goes: everything in moderation, especially resources in a desktop game! 

This game is something we made for ourselves and sincerely hope you enjoy it too.

data.name: Oh No! I Died and Woke Up a Greek God!
data.detailed_description:
You wake up on an unknown hill with the most beautiful woman standing over you.
Before you can speak, she informs you that you’re on Mount Olympus… Oh! And you’re dead.
As the newest god, it’s time for you to party! Attending galas and keggers, you find yourself surrounded by hotties of all kinds, but you can’t shake the rumors about your appearance. Will you discover the strange secrets of this world?



Who’s on this mountain anyway? Meet the sexy singles that inhabit Olympus!


  • Eris!
    Follow the explosion noises and you’ll find them! This firecracker is fiending for love!

  • Heracles!
    Such a hunk from his head down to his lion skins! What secrets lie below the surface of this laborious fellow?

  • Hecate!
    This witch is sure to cast a spell on you! This three-bodied minx will certainly have the key to your heart!

  • Hebe!
    She’s young, vibrant, bashful, and divorced. Do you have what it takes to make her blossom?

  • Delphin!
    You might cast a wide net, but this dapper gentleman has eyes only for you!

  • Thanatos
    A jaded avatar of death, this man is looking for someone to liven up his life!



  • Easy to Pick Up and Play
    This game is as easy as one click! No need to learn complicated mechanics or massive rule sheets, this game is as easy as click, click, fall in love!

  • Narrative-Based!
    The characters and story of “Oh No! I Died and Became an Olympian!” unfurls naturally, with many paths to go down. Despite its multiple endings, this game tells a clear story, so no need to worry about confusing cliffhangers!

  • Feel Good Story
    Need a little pick-me-up? This is just the game for you! The world of the Pantheon Harem series is safe and welcoming. No need to worry about the pains on Earth when you’re galavanting through the heavens!

  • Gorgeous Art!
    What’s dating without a little eye candy? All characters and backgrounds were lovingly created by Bixie Boots, whose unique style shines in every interaction.

  • Lovely Characters
    With many choices for your sweetheart, you are sure to find the one cutie who sets your heart on fire! Whether you like jocks, witches, emos, or even a dolphin… this is the game for you! But be warned, these gods are more complicated than they seem!

  • Freedom!
    Gender? Sexuality? These are IMMORTALS, baby! Date whoever you like, regardless of gender or sexuality!

data.name: pieces I: a maskros nebula game
data.detailed_description:
Mysterious planets are located in the Maskros Nebula—a galaxy far away from Earth.

In Pieces I: A Maskros Nebula Game, you solve three jigsaw puzzles that will give you a glimpse of three distant planets.

- First, we take a look at the exteriors of the pizzeria "PizzaPastaMaro" in the cyber city Emoh, which is located on the planet CobeeDot. PPM was founded by Maro, a sentient android, and is frequented by many pizza fans in the city.

- Next up is Nou-Raex—a planet not too far from CobeeDot that is rich in plants. Teenager Norx loves the quietude of the morning and enjoys his walks in the swamp.

- The third planet we visit is called Eskolea (or "Downpourlea" to its inhabitants). This rather dystopian planet is characterized by rainy, stormy, cloudy days and nights. Somewhat eerie that it's a rainless night all of a sudden...

Each puzzle consists of 144 pieces and takes about 30-60 minutes to complete. Featuring comic-style drawings, illustrative descriptions and a beautiful, soothing soundtrack, Pieces I introduces you to the universe of the Maskros Nebula and some iconic characters you will meet in later (narrative) owly crow games.

data.name: UNRIVALED
data.detailed_description:
Fight opponents inside the arena in epic anime-style fights. Power-ups, devastating techniques, transformations, and more await!


Choose one of the five elemental-themed classes. Use the powers of fire, water, air, lightning, and earth to distinguish your character.


Want to design a character with blue flames? Perhaps you prefer red lightning? Green ethereal swords? Using the character customization system, this is all possible!


Tired of fighting? Participate in a variety of training activities to level up and increase the power level of your character.


Explore Atlas City and meet friends and foes along your journey. Interact and speak with fellow fighters before you demolish them in the arena.

data.name: Mud and Blood
data.detailed_description:
The cult classic flash game is back with its own new engine, an evolved AI and a ton of new features.

Key Features

  • Key Features of Mud and Blood

    Unforgiving Tactical Gameplay

    • Command your squad through brutal, real-time battles where every decision matters. No hand-holding, no second chances—just pure tactical chaos.

    Procedural Battlefields

    • Each battlefield is procedurally generated, ensuring no two encounters are ever the same. Adapt to unpredictable terrain and shifting combat conditions.

    Unrelenting Realism

    • Experience the brutal realities of modern war, where small mistakes lead to big consequences. Soldiers panic, weapons jam, and death is swift.

    Trench Mode

    • Engage in large-scale trench warfare with simplified controls but heightened intensity. Build defenses, lead assaults, and outmaneuver your foes in this strategic mode.

    Dynamic Campaign

    • Start at D-Day and lead your squad across Europe, facing an increasingly skilled enemy as you progress. Each mission builds on your choices and tactics.

    Deck-Building Mechanics

    • Collect and deploy unique unit cards, from French Resistance fighters to Airborne Troops, adding depth and variety to your strategy.

    Historical Accuracy Meets Chaos

    • From realistic vehicle call signs to historically inspired enemy tactics, immerse yourself in an authentic yet chaotic World War II experience.

    Buildable Defenses

    • Fortify your position with trenches, bunkers, pillboxes, and more. Adapt your defenses to counter an ever-changing battlefield.

    Rewarding Progression

    • Earn campaign stars and ribbons to mark your achievements. Watch your soldiers grow from green recruits to hardened veterans—if they survive.

    A Community-Driven Legacy

    • Built over 16 years with community input, Mud and Blood is a passion project designed to challenge, frustrate, and reward like no other.

     Brutal AI Opponents

    • Face an enemy AI designed to outmaneuver and outgun you. German forces, from Fallschirmjägers to SS troops, will exploit every weakness in your strategy.

    Festive Events and Surprises

    • Seasonal events like the Xmas special bring unexpected twists and rewards to the battlefield.

    No Mercy, Just Mud and Blood

    • This is not a game for the faint of heart. It’s raw, unfair, and brutally honest—just like war itself.

    Step forward, Commander, and see if you have what it takes to endure the Mud and Blood.

About

Mud and Blood was, for the most part, created in an unlikely place: an outpost somewhere between Kandahar and Panjway, Afghanistan. Initially developed as a flash game by urb in between missions on a beat-up laptop, it became a way to decompress from the chaos. Ironically, a game about brutal, unforgiving war was itself forged in the heart of a conflict. What began as a personal project has since evolved into a cult classic, beloved by a fiercely loyal community for over 16 years.

At its core, Mud and Blood embraces a unique philosophy: challenge, not comfort. The gameplay is punishingly difficult, but it respects your tactical sense and cognitive ability. It doesn’t drip-feed you success to keep you engaged. Every decision matters, every mistake is costly, and every victory is hard-earned. This is a game that trusts its players to make tough calls on the fly, think critically, and persevere through chaos and loss.

In Mud and Blood, war is not heroic. It’s messy, unpredictable, and brutal. Yet amidst the carnage, there’s a raw beauty in the stories that emerge—a narrative forged by the player, much like the Dwarf Fortress of combat. Your experience becomes your own war story: a tale of triumph against an unrelenting enemy and the quiet pride of knowing you gave it everything you had.

Crafted with love, a touch of PTSD, and a deep respect for its community, Mud and Blood is a humble tribute to those who dare to face the impossible.

data.name: Thrower Defense
data.detailed_description:
THROW. RESUPPLY. DEFEND!

THROWER DEFENSE is a chaotic couch co-op tower defense for up to 4 players. Summon new units, carry them anywhere across the battlefield, and throw them into position. When their ammunition runs low, grab supplies and throw them to your units to keep them fighting. Your units can be moved and repositioned throughout the entire level, so adapt your defense as the battle unfolds!

CHAOS FOR 1–4 PLAYERS

Play the campaign solo or team up with up to 4 players in local co-op. Divide the work, communicate, and try to keep everything under control as the battlefield gets more chaotic.

BUILD YOUR ARMY

Choose from a variety of units with different roles and strengths. Some specialize in dealing damage, while others provide support for your team. Face different types of enemies and adapt your army to each wave.

UNLEASH ULTIMATE SKILLS

Every unit has a unique Ultimate Skill. Find special items on the battlefield and throw them to your units to activate their powerful abilities at the right moment.

DIFFERENT BATTLEFIELDS, DIFFERENT CHALLENGES

Fight through traditional stages where enemies follow their paths, as well as scrolling stages where the battlefield constantly moves forward and enemies flood in from all directions. Keep moving, reposition your units, resupply them, and survive the chaos!

data.name: Mysterious House
data.detailed_description:
A remote apartment. Its price is very cheap, attracting many people to live here. But the apartment is a mixed bag of good and bad, and no one cares about them. Here, people mysteriously disappear and die every day. The TV reports that a rabbit is committing crimes in the city. Are you saying all the crimes are caused by a rabbit? What is the truth? The protagonist explores this apartment, gradually lifting the veil of darkness. Fear shrouds the entire apartment. A family tragedy. What is the secret on the protagonist? What is the lonely old man waiting for in his rocking chair? The story is interlinked; the truth is even darker than imagined...

Core Gameplay:

Explore the apartment, uncover the truth, and evade monsters. Above all, survive. Beware of the rabbit lurking in the darkness, always ready to hunt. Solve mechanisms, use wires to restore power, and decipher various codes. Utilize the protagonist's phone to input different passwords, gaining access to information and fragments of the truth. As you delve deeper, the fear will gradually intensify.

Watch out for the Rabbit Monster — it can burrow through walls. Be cautious of the Vengeful Spirit; she may leap out and grab you at any moment. The little girl is friendly

The game creates a pseudo-urban legend atmosphere with a realistic dark style. It incorporates puzzle-solving mechanics, including using wires to restore power and utilizing clues hidden on notes scattered throughout the map to crack passwords for various websites on the protagonist's phone — all gradually uncovering the truth behind the mystery.

The protagonist relies on medication to maintain sanity, so always ensure you have pills in your inventory.

data.name: Edge Of Survival
data.detailed_description:
Escape to a relaxing, survival sandbox surrounded by wildlife and nature. Scavenge materials and craft tools to turn your base
into a warm, well-supplied home. Survive by fishing, hunting, cooking, and growing your own food. Complete tasks in order to
maintain the forest running. but... be careful though, the forest is as dangerous as it is wonderful.

EXPLORE

Explore a living, colorful world, ranging from dense forests to dark caves.


GATHER, CRAFT and BUILD

There are hundreds of items that can be crafted and used for survival, from the simplest tools made of sticks and rocks to advanced Rifle,
improved armor, and tools. You can also
build a variety of workshops, from primitive leather dryers to pre-industrial era machines

GROW
Nurture delicate (and delicious) plants, Eat them raw or cook them for better nutritional values.

SURVIVE

Dangerous animals roam some areas of the forest. It's best to keep your distance if you can. Or simply upgrade your gear to fight them

data.name: The Guest: Home Alone
data.detailed_description:
The Guest: Home Alone is a psychological horror game focused on atmosphere, tension, and subtle fear.

You play as Tyler, a man returning home after a long day at work. What should be a moment of rest slowly turns into something unsettling. The house feels different. Small details seem out of place. Silence becomes heavy.

As you explore your home, unease grows. There are no monsters chasing you, no loud jumpscares every second — only the creeping feeling that you are not alone.

The Guest is a short, immersive horror experience designed to be completed in a single session. It focuses on environmental storytelling, psychological tension, and slow-building dread.

Are you really home alone?

data.name: Detached
data.detailed_description:
Detached is a space exploration VR game that demands tactics and skill to survive. Strap yourself in for hardcore gameplay uniquely designed for VR headsets.

Trapped in an abandoned space station, you must race against borrowed time to find your crew before your oxygen supply runs out. As you solve puzzles to open airlocks, locate power cores and disable transmitters, something tells you that you won’t be alone when you finally escape into the universe’s deep infinity.


Core Features

  • Go Hardcore – Experience 360-degree freedom of movement, rotation and acceleration in a sandbox environment built for VR headsets.
  • It’s Getting So Atmospheric – Discover the wide blue yonder inspired by the sublimity of Gravity with an accompanying fully orchestrated score composed by Mikołaj Stroiński (The Witcher 3, The Vanishing of Ethan Carter).
  • Blast, Splinter and Charge – Employ Shield, Boost and EMP Rockets skills in both single-player and multiplayer modes. Hit targets with lock-on missiles built into your suit. Master weapon cool down times before your opponent gets the upper hand. Gain temporary immunity with the shield skill. Exploit boosting tunnels to gain a speed advantage.
  • Astronautic Drills – Get to grips with your spacesuit’s controls in a zero-G environment through a dynamic tutorial before venturing into outer space. FPS-style steering will introduce newbies and those sensitive to VR playing to the hardcore VR experience.
  • Blink and You’ll Miss It – Challenge a friend to Detached’s nail-biting PvP mode and then spend time getting acquainted with the infinite universe in single-player mode.


Warning

This is an extreme VR experience that simulates sudden and dramatic acceleration, freefalling, twisting and rolling. Even with the 90 FPS frame rate, it is not for VR-sensitive players.


Exploration. Rivalry. Survival.

These are the tenets of deep space society. Detached drops you at the edge of a universe destroyed by human misrule and extortion. Thanks to years of warfare and greed, the human colonies in deep space are no more. The great factions have crumbled; the corrupt corporations have dissolved.

Most people adhere to the last remaining code of humanity: no killing. But in the lonely expanse of space where resources are low, many are willing to bend the rules to survive.

“Detached will give you tons of freedom in how you play, and the gaming sensation is intense,” says Łukasz Hacura, Creative Director of Anshar Studios, “players of our Early Access release told us exactly what we needed to know to make the game absolutely electrifying for virtual reality headset users.”

Detached isn't just a game; it’s an experience. Unlike many games where VR is a mere expansion, VR is the primary asset of Detached. To complete the game, you must master the controls of your EVA spacesuit and develop your ability to move in a realistic zero-G environment.



Put your skills to the test in both single-player and multiplayer modes. Multiplayer pits you against your friends in an entirely new take on capture the flag. Race against each other to gather the necessary skills and complete your mission. Every second is precious, and every choice you make can mark the difference between life and death.

Single-player mode makes full use of the VR headset, giving you the chance to interact with the tranquil expanse of space. Beta players have lauded Detached’s sandbox environment that encourages players to enjoy the types of experiences normally only felt by astronauts.

data.name: Mad Jack. The Craziest Roguelike Game Ever!
data.detailed_description:
HUMOR AND EASTER EGGS
Mad Jack is a giant joke in the best possible way! Expect hilarious enemies, wacky bosses, and weapons so strange you'll be laughing and gasping at every turn. The game is packed with pop culture references and Easter eggs. Every run brings something new, and hidden surprises are waiting to be discovered each time you play!

A ROGUELIKE WITH A TWIST
Sure, you’ve probably played tons of roguelikes. But Mad Jack isn’t just another one. This game takes the roguelike genre and flips it on its head, with unpredictable mechanics, unique levels, and a constant stream of surprises. Every run feels like a brand-new adventure, packed with unexpected events and insane challenges. You'll never know what's coming next!

EPIC BOSSES AND CRAZY ENEMIES
They’re huge. They’re weird. And they’re out to get you! From massive, screen-filling bosses to bizarre enemies that require creative strategies, every fight in Mad Jack is a chaotic, hilarious struggle where the odds are stacked against you in the most fun way possible.

PROGRESSION AND CRAFTING
What’s better than getting stronger with every run? Collect materials, upgrade your weapons, and discover new ways to obliterate your enemies. The crafting system in Mad Jack lets you experiment, combine, and create ridiculous arsenals that make each subsequent run even more exciting.

REFERENCES EVERYWHERE
Are you a fan of Star Wars? Or maybe Game of Thrones is your thing? Mad Jack is full of clever references to iconic universes. Keep an eye out for hidden nods and Easter eggs that turn the game into a treasure hunt for pop culture lovers, giving you more to enjoy beyond just the gameplay.

data.name: Climb It Up
data.detailed_description:
Climb It Up is a vertical dungeon-climbing adventure built around movement, rewards, and co-op chaos.

Play solo or team up with up to 4 players as you climb a dangerous magical tower filled with broken bridges, hanging prison cells, unstable energy, corrupted enemies, treasure rooms, and deadly vertical paths.

Jump, climb, swing, fight, loot, and survive together — or fall because someone made one terrible decision.

CLIMB TOGETHER

Every floor is built around vertical traversal. Scale walls, leap between ledges, dolphin-jump across broken platforms, swing over deadly gaps, and climb through suspended dungeon structures as you push higher into the tower.

The goal is simple: keep moving up.

The problem is your friends.

CHOOSE POWERFUL REWARDS

Open reward totems and chests to change the way your run plays.

Choose movement tools, combat upgrades, and useful abilities that help you cross dangerous gaps, defeat enemies, reach hidden treasure, or save a run that is already going very badly.

Choose carefully. One reward can make the next climb easier. The wrong one can turn the whole team into a disaster.

SWING, JUMP, AND SURVIVE THE ABYSS

Use grappling hooks to swing across impossible gaps, recover from mistakes, reach distant ledges, or create completely new problems for everyone behind you.

Climb It Up is not just about reaching the next platform. It is about doing it under pressure, with enemies nearby, friends in the way, and the abyss waiting below.

FIGHT CORRUPTED ENEMIES

The tower is not empty.

Fight corrupted skeletons, magicians, and other enemies as you climb through broken prison floors, unstable archives, and dangerous chambers. Use melee weapons, ranged attacks, magic tools, and movement to survive each encounter.

Combat is not separate from climbing. Enemies attack while you are trying to move, jump, swing, and reach the next floor.

RISK IT FOR TREASURE

Some paths are safe. Others lead to treasure.

Search optional routes, open hidden chests, and decide with your team whether to escape safely or risk everything for one more reward. The best loot is rarely on the safest path.

BUILT FOR SOLO PLAY AND CO-OP CHAOS

Play alone and master the movement at your own pace, or bring your friends and turn every climb into a test of coordination, timing, greed, and trust.

One player can save the run.

One player can ruin everything.

Usually, it is the same player.

data.detailed_description:
《Story》


I, Takeshi Sayama, wake up to a sweet scent.
I realize I'm completely naked, and my head is throbbing.
When I go to the kitchen, a girl I don't know is cooking with nothing but an apron on.
(Just what did I do…?)

"Oh, are you awake? It's almost ready, so just wait a bit longer, okay?"

My hazy memories begin to come back to me.
We'd been having joint practice with another college's karate club until yesterday.
At the closing party, I approached an older girl from the other school whom everyone calls "the super sadistic mongoose."
During practice she has a mean glint in her eyes when she kicks and chops… but right now, she looks so gentle.
From the current situation… we definitely did the deed.

The girl gazes at me with lustful eyes.

"I've… never done anything like that before… It really turned me on…
It's embarrassing, but… I think I kind of like that sort of thing…"

She looks at my erect cock like a wild animal and places her mouth around the tip.

"This is Master's… ahh… mm…"

Just what did I do yesterday!?

《Characters》


Asuka Mihashi (CV: Yui Otokura)
"I like the super sadistic Takeshi that comes out when you're drunk."

Student at an all-girls college and a karate enthusiast.
Called "the super sadistic mongoose" by underclassmen in her karate club.
Her sadistic streak comes out during practice, but sexually, she's masochistic.
During her free time, she likes to eat at different restaurants and go on solo trips.
She's cheerful and openhearted and cries easily.
Outside of karate, her personality is completely different. She shows her softer side to her family and close friends.
She can also be pretty girly and enjoys making sweets.

data.name: KillCam FPS
data.detailed_description:
Please note: This is an early demo version focused on core mechanics and atmosphere. The game is currently in active development and may not yet include traditional win/loss conditions or full mission structures. We're continuing to expand and refine gameplay systems based on player feedback. This demo is part of an ongoing development process, and we welcome all feedback as we continue to shape the full experience. More structured objectives, mission progression, and full gameplay loops are planned for future builds.

KillCam FPS is an immersive single-player experimental FPS demo that explores the intensity of urban combat through a body camera perspective. Designed for players who enjoy tactical, atmospheric experiences, the game focuses on short, high-intensity engagements in detailed urban environments.

Key Features:

  • Body camera-style perspective for a raw and immersive combat experience.

  • Fast, high-stakes encounters that reward precision and quick reflexes.

  • Realistic weapon mechanics with authentic recoil, ballistics, and impactful audio.

  • Highly detailed environments, including apartments, industrial zones, tunnels, and urban streets.

  • Immersive audio design, featuring spatial gunfire, environmental ambience, and minimal HUD.

There are no HUDs, no tutorials, and no handholding — just you, your weapon, and the constant tension of an enemy waiting around every corner.

data.name: Buy a Croquette!
data.detailed_description:
Localization Notes

The English and Japanese translations have not yet been implemented.

We are currently working on the English and Japanese localizations of Buy a Croquette!, and will release an update announcement as soon as the translations are completed. Stay tuned!


About Us

Join our Discord: ysbxSfYaQs
Join our players’ QQ group chat: 1061372406
Publisher's Homepage: Click on the publisher “Eternal Dream” to visit our homepage. Follow us to get more updates on the game!


Original Art Collection & Bonus Pack

The Original Art Collection & Bonus Pack DLC is now available for purchase. Additional story DLC is also in development!


About the Game

Despite eating two boxes of bento for lunch, Chio Aozora's stomach is rumbling again!
"It's been such a long time since I last had a croquette. I really miss that crispy, golden goodness…”

The familiar aroma of croquettes is so tempting, but Chio has forgotten to bring money!
"I think I tucked some money into my textbook, but I left the textbook at school..."

Collect 380 yen in the shopping streets of Nagano to buy the croquette Chio has been dreaming of!
"But... where should I start?"

Help out at the store, run errands, collect urban legends, play word games, and even rummage through trash cans – all to get the yen coins you need!
"I never thought I'd have to resort to rummaging through the trash..."

The game features simple puzzles, mild depictions of horror (no chase scenes though!), multiple endings, and all sorts of quirky elements. Of course, there are also croquettes!

Tips on How to Buy a 380-Yen Croquette:

  • Yen coins are hidden all over Nagano! Investigate trash bins, bathroom sinks, park slides, vending machines, and other places throughout Nagano’s streets and alleys to find lost coins!

  • Be a good citizen by helping others! The kind-hearted Chio Aozora will assist the residents of Nagano with various requests, from finding lost items to counting the convenience store inventory, from solving mysterious cases to tailing suspicious individuals... There's nothing a high school girl can't do!

  • Uncover the buried secrets of Nagano! A notebook sealed with passwords and secrets… could it lead to a hidden treasure? Misplaced crates, Penrose stairs, abandoned houses, word games... Solving these puzzles might lead to unexpected rewards...

  • Receive the croquette from kind-hearted people! There might be ways to get a croquette without collecting coins. Maybe someone can lend Chio some yen, or maybe even hand over their croquette – Chio might even be able to get a free meal from the croquette vendor... All of these choices will lead to different endings!

  • Deal with unexpected crises (if you make a wrong choice)! While Chio is collecting coins, some choices might lead her into dangerous situations – she might encounter some terrifying urban legends!

Game Duration: 4-10 hours
Number of Endings: 12 (including 4 hidden endings)

A Brief How-to-Play:

data.about_the_game:
Despite eating two boxes of bento for lunch, Chio Aozora's stomach is rumbling again!
"It's been such a long time since I last had a croquette. I really miss that crispy, golden goodness…”

The familiar aroma of croquettes is so tempting, but Chio has forgotten to bring money!
"I think I tucked some money into my textbook, but I left the textbook at school..."

Collect 380 yen in the shopping streets of Nagano to buy the croquette Chio has been dreaming of!
"But... where should I start?"

Help out at the store, run errands, collect urban legends, play word games, and even rummage through trash cans – all to get the yen coins you need!
"I never thought I'd have to resort to rummaging through the trash..."

The game features simple puzzles, mild depictions of horror (no chase scenes though!), multiple endings, and all sorts of quirky elements. Of course, there are also croquettes!

Tips on How to Buy a 380-Yen Croquette:

  • Yen coins are hidden all over Nagano! Investigate trash bins, bathroom sinks, park slides, vending machines, and other places throughout Nagano’s streets and alleys to find lost coins!

  • Be a good citizen by helping others! The kind-hearted Chio Aozora will assist the residents of Nagano with various requests, from finding lost items to counting the convenience store inventory, from solving mysterious cases to tailing suspicious individuals... There's nothing a high school girl can't do!

  • Uncover the buried secrets of Nagano! A notebook sealed with passwords and secrets… could it lead to a hidden treasure? Misplaced crates, Penrose stairs, abandoned houses, word games... Solving these puzzles might lead to unexpected rewards...

  • Receive the croquette from kind-hearted people! There might be ways to get a croquette without collecting coins. Maybe someone can lend Chio some yen, or maybe even hand over their croquette – Chio might even be able to get a free meal from the croquette vendor... All of these choices will lead to different endings!

  • Deal with unexpected crises (if you make a wrong choice)! While Chio is collecting coins, some choices might lead her into dangerous situations – she might encounter some terrifying urban legends!

data.name: Invoker Tactics: Conquest
data.detailed_description:
Collect. Expand. Conquer.

Invoker Tactics: Conquest is a turn-based strategy game combining chess-like grid combat, army building, and a unique unit-merging mechanic.

Simple to play, difficult to master.

  • 5 moves per turn: Regardless of how many units you control. No long, drawn-out turns!

  • Move any unit, multiple times: Spend your actions across your army or use several on the same unit to set up the perfect play.

  • Automatic attacks & abilities: Attacks and abilities trigger based on player movement, focus on positioning and strategy rather than individual commands.

  • Merge your units: This unique mechanic give players access to powerful units mid fight.

Collect Units & Build Your Army.

  • A wide variety of units: Discover units with unique abilities, strengths, and interactions.

  • Build your own strategy: Choose units that complement each other and create an army suited to your playstyle.

  • Recruit new units: Strengthen your army by recruiting new units through battles and events.

Expand & Conquer.

  • Battle enemy armies: Put your strategies to the test across a variety of battles.

  • Expand your territory: Claim new lands by defeating the forces that stand in your way.

data.name: CRUSH IT ALL
data.detailed_description:
CRUSH IT ALL is a side-view vehicle-building roguelike. The real decisions happen before the charge: connect parts inside a limited grid, balance mass, center of gravity, propulsion, and impact surfaces, then watch your contraption hurl itself at an increasingly absurd target.

BUILD A VEHICLE THAT CAN SURVIVE ITS OWN HIT

Wheels, engines, frames, armor, weapons, and stranger parts all occupy real space and change how the whole vehicle behaves. A connection can decide whether the build reaches the target in one piece, while a single upgrade can completely alter the result.

THREE CHARGES. ONE HONEST BILL.

Each job gives you up to three charges. Mass, speed, and effects create the impact; the target sends recoil back through the parts that actually take the hit. If the first charge is not enough, rebuild between attempts, replace damaged components, and decide how the next collision should happen.

SMASH, GET PAID, REBUILD

Complete jobs, open crates, buy components and trinkets, and turn a pile of scrap into a focused build. Different vehicle classes change your starting machine, grid, and rules. Random bosses impose distinct conditions that force new plans instead of rewarding the same stat pile every time.

Start with a barely functional wreck and break through 8 districts and 24 jobs. Make sure the final balance is positive—and, ideally, that some of the vehicle is still attached.

data.name: Happy Surprise Garden
data.detailed_description:
Dangers lurking everywhere

The seemingly peaceful and beautiful natural scenery may be ambushed by brutal alien creatures. Animals with cute appearance may have been infected and may suddenly attack when approached. You need to be ready with weapons to repel them at any time.

Strengthen skills

Collect resources during exploration and adventure. Once you have enough resources, you can synthesize weapons on the crafting table. Each weapon has different characteristics and skills. Whether in single-player or multiplayer mode, you can experience a full sense of freshness.

Biotechnology

Defeat powerful monsters to obtain their DNA information, unlock powerful biotechnology, and transform into various animals and giant monsters, and unlock special skills.

Friendly interaction

Use various skills to help each other with good friends, such as using the transformation skill to turn your friends into cats to escape the monster's pursuit.

data.name: TAKARABAKO ～宝箱クラッシャー～
data.detailed_description:
Punch it. Open it. Sell it. Do it again.

You run a tiny shop in a back alley. Buy treasure chests from Mira the supplier, punch them open, stock the loot on your shelves, and sell it to the adventurers who drop by. Put the profits into better chests and grow your shop.

The more you punch, the better it feels

  • Stack up the chests you buy, then open them all in a row as they drop onto the table

  • Keep a combo going to raise item value and make gold rain from the ceiling

  • Critical hits, chests hiding more chests, and the rare Chest Eruption

  • Five rarities from Common to Legendary, with 10 Legendary items to find

Grow your shop

  • Six shop ranks; every rank brings new chests and unlocks new upgrades

  • The Upgrade Web: upgrades, automation, decor and expertise in one sprawling web — 82 upgrade levels alone

  • Customer requests, emergency rush hours, and a shady peddler at the back door

  • Choose shop policies to give each run its own flavor

Collect and keep going

  • A collection of 90 items — the more you collect, the more they sell for

  • Open the Chest of the Gods, then start a new branch with the stars you earned

  • 35 achievements

Play it your way

  • Mini window mode to keep your shop running in a corner of the screen

  • Your shop keeps earning while you're away

  • Fully playable with a gamepad

data.name: Mystery Case Files: Moths to a Flame Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Big Fish Editor's Choice! This title was selected for its exceptional quality and overwhelmingly positive reviews from our Game Club beta testers.

Eipix Entertainment proudly presents the next thrilling case in the series Mystery Case Files!

When a new assignment brings you to the Zenith Museum of Oddities, what was supposed to be an open and shut case spirals into a complex web of deceit. Someone knows about your past, and they’ve prepared a special tribute to all your biggest cases. But what do they want, and what will become of the innocents that stand in their way? You’ll need all your skills to stop the dangerous foe that threatens to use your past against you in this heart-pounding new chapter in the classic hidden-object puzzle adventure game saga!

See what our Beta testers had to say:
“Absolutely brilliant! I haven't had this much fun playing any game for a long time. The puzzles were superb, particularly the statue base and the lamppost puzzles, but the multiple Rube Goldberg puzzle was out of this world!” - beta tester

“Fantastic game! Love the references to earlier games - Ravenhearst, The Dalimar family, Madam Fate and her carnival characters - need to go back and replay the earlier games now!” - beta tester

- The Master Detective must figure out who is the Archivist’s last hostage! Help free the other MCF agents from the Archivist’s schemes! Disable the bomb set to destroy the MCF archives.
- Search for stamps, souvenirs, and morphing objects hidden throughout the game!
- Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games - and earn even more achievements!
- Enjoy memorable wallpapers, concept art, videos, and music.
- Keep your adventure on track with the strategy guide!


This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

data.name: ZombieZoid® Zenith
data.detailed_description:
Prepare yourself to get in a fantastic world of adventure, action and fun.
Prepare yourself for ZombieZoid - Zenith!

While the lovers were chatting on the Internet, the news reported that a terrible virus was infecting people in town and turning them into zombies hungry for brains. Now, this young boy will venture through the streets filled with undeads to reach the house of his girlfriend before the worst happens.
As Arthur, prove you are brave and confront the danger that you find ahead.
Your adventure begins at home that was invaded by kids zombies from the neighborhood. You will need to knock out everyone to protect the grandpa that is resting int the attic.
Those kids zombies are the most agile of all, therefore you need to be skillful to defeat them before they try to bite you from behind.
For twelve levels you will face strong enemies in unusual and comic situations.

The Tasmania Spin

An air vortex will be created around Arthur and will hit at every zombie that try to get close to you

Rush Hour

Using energies from the future, Arthur receive a big power and conjure the Rush Hour, pushing all the zombies in front of him and leaving a large trail of fire.

The Juggernaut´s Jump

The elements around you conjure one of the strongest powers of Arthur. With this jump you can knock out many zombies around you and get out of the problems quickly.

Judith, the Maid

Be carful, she's very angry! She wants a pay raise and the most she's got was having to clean up windows, now all she sees ahead she throws at someone. But she gets tired, enjoy this moment and send her to the dream world!

Benedict, The Cursed Popcorn Seller

All of the children become zombies and they don't want to eat popcorn anymore, just brains. Benedict is very angry. Be careful, because he's fast and hits running.

Father Damien

Father Damien is very angry because all the faithful are gone and now everybody only think about brains. Be careful whit his spin, it can hurt a lot and mess up the whole sacristy.

Bope, Knife in Skull

All the prisioners were cursed and were transformed into skulls. Be careful with fire invoked from the depths of evil. Water attacks can help you.

General Bielek Mole

The General is trying to organize all this mess but the zombies are very messy, it gets him very angry. Be careful not to be caught off guard when he digs.

Mack, The Lumberjack

The forest is a mess because of these zombies, let alone all the soldiers. Mack is very strong and can finish you in a few strokes. His leap is so strong that can even topple trees.

Otto, The Crazy Driver

There is an accident on the road and Otto is trying to help the passengers zombies to get out. He said that nobody can pass over here. He's throwing tires to stop anyone that tries to pass.

The Mother in Law

The Arthur's mother in law is unhappy, because it seems that every zombie from the city decided to invade her house. Be carful because she's dominated and she can transform herself into multiple enemies.


Through the course of the game Arthur may collect many weapons like the powerful baseball bat that is his faithful companion; many type of water pistols, bottles of holy water and even popcorn to trick the most stupid zombies.

Baseball Bat

Faithful companion of Arthur, with the bat things get more agile and defeat the zombies will be easier. Be careful because that the bat can break!

Holy Water

Researches has found that holy water causes a great itching in zombies and cause their his conversion, so their stop hunting humans and attack any another.

Popcorn

The popcorn shape confuses the zombies making them think it is small brains. Use to get attention and go undetected to some places.

Water Pistol

I saw in a movie that water hurts aliens. You know what? It hurts the zombies too! Use a water pistol to shot drops of water away. The gun is very fast, so pay attention because the ammunition ends fast.

Blunderbuss

Launches water grenades and causes several damage to the enemies zombies. The Blunderbuss uses a greate amount of water in each shot and also takes longer to load. Be careful because the zombies can attack you while it is loading.

Holy Cannon

Launches holy water grenades and convert the zombies without getting close to them. The Holy Cannon has a great amount of holy water in its tank and it can lanch the grenades at long distance.

Flashlight

With the flashlight you can see better in dark places and also scare away some animals from the darkness. I know that spiders are very afraid of the light, especially those who live in caves. Hahaha, it´s in wikipedia!

data.name: Heat Death: Survival Train
data.detailed_description:
Join our community


About the Game

Heat Death is a sci-fi survival game where you build, upgrade, and customize your own battle train and use it to explore and survive a frozen world! This train is not only your shelter and vehicle, but also your weapon and ally to face hostile drones, deadly storms, and hidden mysteries of an unknown world!


Build Your Train
Build your train from scratch in Heat Death. Construct structural elements such as walls, floors, and ceilings, and then install power generators, heavy weapons, drones, shields, and many other modules to your train. You can also personalize your train’s appearance and layout by selecting and arranging decals and modules.


Explore a Dynamic and Frozen World
The world of Heat Death is vast, dynamic, and unforgiving. Explore frozen lakes, mountain ranges, caves, frozen jungles, and cities where you can find loot, unlock new equipment, and discover the fate of humanity! Since you can move your base, you can explore these environments with ease!


Survive Deadly Storms
The environment itself is your first and most challenging enemy in Heat Death! Keep yourself warm during snowy storms by creating and upgrading your train or by taking shelter inside other buildings. Manage your resources such as power and food to stay alive.


Defeat Hostile Drones
In Heat Death you'll face various enemies that aim to attack and destroy your train. You can either build defensive modules such as auto-cannons, shields, and friendly drones to fight back or make your train fast enough to outrun them!

data.name: Quizrealms: From Stone to Steam
data.detailed_description:
Quizrealms: From Stone to Steam invites you into a world where knowledge reigns supreme and the spirit of the Victorian era breathes life into every corner of your adventure. Test your wits across a dazzling range of quiz modes, each richly themed and visually inspired by the grandeur, discovery, and curiosity of the 19th century.

With over 30,000 handcrafted questions spanning science, geography, pop culture, sports, and history, there's a challenge awaiting every kind of mind. Whether you’re a scholar seeking glory, a traveler mapping the world, or a curious soul diving into forgotten lore, Quizrealms offers a journey tailored to your passions.

Key Features:

  • 8 Unique Game Modes: From a child-friendly "Survival of the Smartest" mode to intense competitive duels, each mode offers a distinct gameplay experience.

  • Local Co-op and PvP: Team up with friends or face off in thrilling local multiplayer battles.

  • Victorian Visual Flair: Each mode features unique art and gameplay designs inspired by the rich textures and spirit of the Victorian age.

  • Massive Question Bank: Over 30,000 questions ensure endless replayability and fresh challenges.

  • Achievements Galore: Unlock over 30 in-game achievements and Steam achievements as you conquer modes and master your knowledge.

  • Expanding Horizons: Plans to introduce online multiplayer are in place, based on player interest and community feedback.

Step into the grand halls of Quizrealms, where only the sharpest minds and quickest wits will triumph. Will you rise to the challenge?

data.name: Hidden & Dangerous 2: Courage Under Fire
data.detailed_description:
Hidden & Dangerous 2

Hidden & Dangerous 2 is a first and third person tactical shooter that builds upon the tremendous success of Hidden & Dangerous. You lead a small squad of Allied soldiers deep behind enemy lines, to carry out secret missions during World War II. The gripping story line takes you to Europe, Africa, Burma, and other locations scattered across the globe. Each critical decision impacts you, your men, and your country. This unique blend of action, strategy, and tactics forces you to use your brain just as much as your trigger finger.

Hidden & Dangerous 2: Sabre Squadron

Reprise your role as commander of the elite Special Air Services (SAS) in World War II as you take on the Axis Powers in nine new missions set in France, Africa and Sicily. Fight through these campaigns alone or play co-operatively with friends. Sneak past enemy lines, infiltrate heavily guarded bases and outposts, and utilize superior tactics to eliminate the opposition.
  • Supply your squad with a number of weapons including pistols, sniper rifles, grenades, and bazookas!
  • A Fully Interactive Environment depicts the ineptness of drowsy guards, the shocking quickness of an elite German battalion spotting your movements, and the terrified look of the enemy as you shove the barrel of your rifle under his nose!
  • Complete over 20 missions in 9 campaigns from the lush jungles of Southeast Asia to the harsh deserts in Africa. Commandeer a variety of vehicles including trucks, tanks, motorcycles, and planes.

data.name: Lucky's Funhouse
data.detailed_description:
Short Description

You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Do your best to survive the monsters of the funhouse and uncover the mystery behind them. Multiple endings. Will you partake in the madness, or find a way out. She is coming.

Enjoy Your Time At Lucky’s Funhouse

Lucky’s Funhouse was once a place of celebration run by the Macmaster family. Suddenly, one day out of nowhere, the family disappeared, and the doors to the Funhouse were shut permanently. Local teens say they have heard children's screams coming from the Funhouse, but when the police investigated, no evidence was found.

The Mascots

The three children of the Macmaster family would dress up as creatures to entertain the children who came to the Funhouse. The youngest, as Sluggo, the middle child as Ratsun and sometimes the eldest daughter would show up as Lucky. The children always loved Lucky the most; she would even do private one on ones on occasion.

What Made Lucky’s so Fun

Everyone always loved running around, crawling through vents, hiding in closets and playing with the penguins. It was easy for the Macmaster parents to lose track of the guests, so they installed a CCTV system to make finding everyone easier.

Somebody will try to kill the President today.
But the country ruler have the plan:
Kick asses with golden .50 Pistol
Reload

A/D - Walking
Shift + A/D - Running
Space - Jumping
C - Stand control [Ragdoll toggle] [Okay, it's useless function]
E (hold) - Use buttons/Open doors
Shift + E (hold) - Knock doors
LMB - Shooting
RMB - Aiming
R (hold) - Reloading
F (hold) - Take ammo from magazines
MMB (Middle Mouse Button) - Toggle slow-motion

data.name: 趋光本能 Pygmalion
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to 《Pygmalion》 — an exploration game blending romance, puzzle-solving, and suspense elements.

Game Description

For a long time, Xie Wen has been haunted by the same recurring dream. In search of a way to break the cycle, she moves into a peculiar, eerie apartment and meets three neighbors: Zhou Tang, Ruan Qingqing, and Jiang Mian. This should have been the start of a warm and healing new life. You will explore the apartment, gather scattered clues, and grow closer to the girls through conversations.

Yet, as your bonds deepen, the buried sense of dissonance becomes ever more glaring — overly coincidental encounters, inexplicable anomalies, the obsessive undercurrents hidden beneath the girls' tenderness, and Xie Wen's own strangely hollow past. This apartment is a stage already set. As an actor — Are you ready to begin your life in this apartment?

Game Features

  • Meet three girls and develop unique stories and emotional bonds with each.

  • Multiple routes — your choices determine their endings.

  • Freely investigate your surroundings, collect clues and items, solve puzzles, and gradually piece together the truth.

Warnings

  • Contains LGBTQ+ content: Includes diverse representations of gender and emotional expression.

  • Flashing images: This game contains flashing patterns and images that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy.

data.name: SetList Battle
data.detailed_description:
Grow the setlist of your dreams… and fight!

SetList Battle is an auto-battler x management x deckbuilding roguelike. Assemble a setlist of your favorites, then send them into live shows that play out automatically as battles.

■ Assemble a Setlist of Nine

53 hololive members to choose from. Pick nine and equip each with one song card and five skill cards. Who performs, in what order, with which skills — your lineup is the strategy.

■ Auto-Battle on a 3x3 Grid

The stage is 3x3 — nine slots across front, middle, and back rows. The back row can't attack, but it's safe: where you place someone is what they do. When placement and equipment click into place, cards chain and the show accelerates. The battle is automatic; what decides it is how you built the team beforehand. A fight runs three minutes at most.

■ The Song You Equip Is the Song You Hear

When a member takes the stage, the song card she carries starts playing. 54 arranged hololive tracks are included — change your setlist and you change the show you hear. Who performs in what order is both a tactic and a setlist.

■ Twelve Months to Build Your Setlist

Advance through a 365-day calendar: choose plans, respond to events, scout new members, and train hidden talents. At the end of each month, a monthly battle tests how far your team has come. One season runs about 60–90 minutes.

■ 648 Cards, Endless Combinations

  • 648 cards (162 songs + 486 skills)

  • 15 theme effects and 10 elements

  • 54 tracks — 54 hololive member songs

  • Each member's hidden talent adds depth to your lineup

  • Ever-changing plans, events, and scouting give 50–100 hours of replay value

■ Endgame

When the year is over, there's still somewhere to prove yourself.

  • Survival — take one lineup through ten straight battles. One loss ends the run. How far can you go?

  • Arena — turn a full year into a score and post it to the leaderboard

  • Replay — trade setlist codes and watch anyone's lineup fight under identical conditions

  • Archive — a collection log of every member, card, and theme you've met. Filling it is a long journey

  • 30 achievements — including "win with a single member," "inflict all eight status ailments," and "close the final show with a special victory"

────────────────────────────

This is an unofficial fan-made work based on hololive production.

data.name: Echoes of Time
data.detailed_description:
"Echoes of Times" is a narrative independent game developed based on RPG Maker MV, focusing on free exploration and character interaction. Players will play the role of a protagonist lost in a world of time and space. By exploring the map, talking to different NPCs and completing exclusive tasks, they will gradually uncover the truth hidden in the "Echoes of Time".

This game adopts a free exploration advancement method, and the player's choice will affect the direction and ending of the story. In the process of solving puzzles and advancing tasks, you will face a deep discussion about memory, fate and choice.

Whether you like plot exploration, logical reasoning, or a casual player with light challenges, "Echoes of Times" can bring you a relaxing and thoughtful game journey.

Game Features:

Free exploration gameplay: No linear advancement is required, players can freely shuttle between multiple areas to unlock hidden content and side stories.

Minimalist art style and immersive sound effects: The elegant visual style and soothing background music that match the atmosphere of the story create a unique emotional experience.

Story structure with variable endings: Player behavior will determine the final direction of the game, bringing high replay value.

Lightweight experience suitable for all players: no high operation threshold, more emphasis on emotional resonance and narrative immersion.

data.name: Bel's Fanfare
data.detailed_description:
For many years, Belceboo and his many children have been left forgotten in the depths of The Witch of the Sea. Now, he has the chance to send his favorite daughter Bel to the outside, where she will serve the captain as the new aura cleaner.

Before parting, Belceboo grants Bel a final gift: the Ukoback gong-shield, an old family heirloom capable of disrupting and absorbing aura. 

To the passengers, Bel is restoring the ship to its former glory, but in secret, she is setting in motion a plan to free her family from their imprisonment.

  • Master the gong-shield for combat, exploration and puzzle-solving.

  • Explore the many (hidden) rooms of the Witch of the Sea.

  • Your choices matter. Push characters into a resolution and experience its consequences.

  • Defeat hostile aura in expressive combat arenas with surprises at every stage.

  • Meet otherworldly beings. Sometimes friends, sometimes foes, and anything in between.

Traverse the rooms of the ship in search for secrets. Some will lead you to interesting places. Others... will better be left ignored.

Ring your gong-shield to collect aura flies. Use their power to disrupt and cleanse cursed objects. You're the new aura cleaner after all!

Meddle into the issues of others and watch their stories unfold. Attend to a notorius wizard wedding, bow to the (ex) Queen of Mara, or mediate a neighbours squabble. Find drama at every scale.

Hostile aura resists being cleaned and will trap you into bullet hell arenas. Dodge bullets and block resonant (colored) projectiles until your shield is fully charged!

To truly erradicate aura, you must find its source inside the spirit of key passengers. There, a special challenge awaits you.

"Chin up, Bel! Your brothers and sisters are counting on you!"

data.name: Show Yourself (Director's Cut)
data.detailed_description:
What happened to Charlie? You will need courage to find the answer to this question.

Immerse yourself in this first-person psychological horror, where every choice matters in a non-linear narrative. Face the memories and demons of Charlie's past, but are they really demons? And, above all, do you really have to face them? Not doing so is also an option, but know that every choice has a consequence. Even not acting. Even not solving the environmental puzzles will lead you to the ending you deserve.

Will you trust the flying brain, a seemingly friendly figure, or the mysterious voice, a seemingly hostile figure? What is the right thing to do? What do you really want? A happy ending? These and other questions will only be answered if we have the courage to ask them and listen to the answers.

Features:

  • A dark environment that reflects Charlie's state of mind

  • Multiple choices that will lead to one of three endings, or to a senseless game over

  • Brain or voice? Rationality or feelings? How much should we use these two parts?

  • Traumatic Memories We Can Face or Run Away From

  • Did Charlie Really Do Wrong? Charlie's fate Is in Your Hands

data.name: Touhou Picross ~ Nazrin's Puzzles
data.detailed_description:
Help Nazrin solve the incident of the mysterious puzzle craze!


A new craze has swept Gensokyo. What started as a minor fad in the Human Village has turned into an obsession that has spread throughout the land, finding devotees even among the various low-level youkai.

What has caught everybody's attention is a puzzle game in which a grid of squares is notated with numerical clues, with the solution yielding a picture. It is a simple to learn, addictive game, and can be easily spread through cards upon which the puzzles are drawn.

Sensing that something is amiss with this situation, Shou Toramaru sends Nazrin to learn more about the puzzle craze, and to investigate its origins.

Bring Your Puzzle Skills!


  • Solve over 100 Touhou-themed puzzles throughout various modes like Story Mode, Puzzle Mode, and Mosaic Mode.
  • Select from several puzzle environments and music tracks.
  • Take advantage of features such as Hints and Quick Saves as you work through the puzzles.

Get To Work(shop)!


  • Create your own puzzles and submit them to the Workshop.
  • Play puzzles submitted by others.

data.name: Lowmoor Idle RPG: An Adventurer's Chronicle
data.detailed_description:
The Guild of Mereward issues you a torch and a numbered tag for the recovery of your remains. Roll up an adventurer, sign the ledger and send them down the Maw. When Old Snik throws down his crown and grabs a second spear, you may want to stick around for the next roll.

I made a whole dungeon crawl fit in a Windows 98-style character sheet. Your fighter rolls their own d20s and walks back to town when their pack is full. You can watch the fight in the corner of your desktop or close the game and read the expedition report when you get back.

Build a fighter who hits back

Teach your fighter to counterattack after a block. Or build around the shield itself, so blocking a boss heals the fighter holding it. Each of the 14 classes has its own talent tree. The caravaner brings a wagon into battle and has a crossbowman shoot back from behind it.

The Long Charter is the big skill tree every class shares. If you like planning builds, there are 2,112 skills to pick your way through. If you'd rather watch your fighter land bigger crits, point the Guild at that branch and let it spend the points for you.

Look up the thing that just bit you

The Guild's field notes recommend testing a suspicious chest with a pole. If it turns out to be a mimic, the Guild will pay for the tip of its tongue. You'll have to dry it yourself. Every creature your adventurers meet adds another ink drawing to the book.

Put the rat tails towards a better sword

Back in town, even the rat tails fetch a price. Take the gold to the forge and see if the smith can turn a shortsword into a shortsword +1. The smith remembers that pattern for whoever carries the next one.

Take a chance on a letter

A letter arrives from a fork in the tunnels. One passage has dry footing. The dwarven markings might lead to a paychest, if your adventurer can read them. Take a chance on the Intelligence check and watch the die land. Leave the letter sealed and the expedition carries on.

Choose a patron

Three gods share the Guild chapel. Orna lends you a shield at the start of a fight. Wern gets you back from market sooner, and Dagr puts more bite into an upgraded weapon. Pick one to travel with. The bond you build carries over to the next adventurer who chooses that patron.

Features

  • Three adventures. Brave the 30 floors of the Maw, choose the fate of the Mourning Vale and search for a lost Guild ship in the Last Anchorage.

  • Hundreds of hours of idle play. The Vale alone can keep an adventurer busy that long. Expeditions carry on while the game is closed.

  • Choose from 16 ancestries and 14 classes. Try a new class talent tree with your next recruit, or plan a critical-hit build on the shared Long Charter.

  • Fill an illustrated bestiary with 207 creatures. Your next adventurer picks up where the last one left off.

  • Hire a pack animal to haul your loot. You can also bring home pets, including a housebroken treasure chest.

  • Retire to a village of your own. Build homes and buy gear for the next adventurer you send down.
