data.name: Trumps Of Albion
data.detailed_description:
Merlin lost. Then he changed the rules.

After Camlann shattered Britain, the sorcerer sealed in the crystal cave bound every blade and every footstep into a card rite. No step is taken, no blow struck, except by the hand fate deals. The wars became the Great Game, and Merlin became the Dealer — dealing every soul its sixty cards a day. Death is just a discard; the fallen are shuffled home, bruised but breathing.

One hand, two uses. Your best travel card is your best attack card. Play a card to cross a route-map of the British Isles; play a card to strike in an instanced, tactical duel on a charge-time clock. The defense you wear is the guard printed on the card you just committed. Every play is a decision you can't take back.

The world never sleeps. Log out on any device and your character stays on the map — a living NPC others can meet, trade blows with, or hunt. There is one Britain, not a thousand copies: more players means more world, never more worlds.

Power paints a target. Merlin bound the great souls of Arthur's age into his deck as Trumps. Some have torn free and walk the map as bosses. Beat one and you rip its page loose — its skill is yours. But the deck wants its cards back, and every hand it deals now turns, quietly, toward you.

Grow a legend your way. Three bloodlines and a branching tree of callings — knights, hedge-mages, wayfarers and the promotions they open — let you build a fighter no one else is playing. Skills speak an elemental wheel; a torn page rewrites your hand.

A world played straight-faced. The tone is deadpan gag-comedy, and every absurd placard is true — because every joke is pulled from the real record: Malory, the Mabinogion, the Gawain-poet. You are the straight man. Britain is unhinged.

Plays in your browser or on desktop. English and 繁體中文 at launch.

data.name: Lost Yarnkeepers: Stockholm Stories
data.detailed_description:
The city’s stories have unraveled.

Only tangled yarn and fading memories remain.

In this cozy crochet collecting adventure, you explore a handcrafted storybook city where everyday objects hold fragments of the past. Interact with the environment to uncover poetic memories, solve yarn-based puzzles, and complete gentle mini games to gather colored yarn and adornments.

As threads are recovered, the lost Yarnkeepers return. Untangle their forms, renew their colors, and customize their appearance with newly found pieces. With each companion you bring back, your Yarn House grows, a living space you can decorate, arrange, and slowly fill with warmth.

Progress is guided by curiosity and care. No combat, no pressure, just exploration, collection, and the quiet satisfaction of mending what time has loosened.

Core Features

• Explore a tactile, fabric-inspired map filled with interactive story objects

• Solve crochet-themed puzzles and short, relaxing mini games

• Collect, untangle, and customize unique Yarnkeepers

• Expand and decorate your evolving Yarn House

• Discover a fragmented narrative through environmental storytelling

• A calm, failure-free experience focused on discovery and atmosphere

data.name: Shards of Memory
data.detailed_description:
When you wake up, it's chaos. The salt air burns your lungs, the merciless sun blinds your eyes, and your body aches with pain you don't remember inflicting. You're lying on the white sand of an unknown island, surrounded by turquoise but indifferent water. Around you is wreckage, but not of a ship or a plane. The wreckage of someone else's life. Your life.

The main wound is not on your body. It's inside. Your memory is a blank, torn canvas. Your name, your past, the reason for your presence here - all erased. You are not just a survivor. You are a ghost in your own body, and this island is your purgatory.

The island is riddled with "emotional anchors" - objects and places that resonate with your forgotten past. An abandoned hut, a rare flower - all of these can be the key.

Physical Survival: Fight with Nature

Classic Mechanics: Monitor your hunger, thirst, stamina, and health. Hunt wild animals, find edible plants, and fresh water.

Dynamic Weather: Wait out tropical rains and incur hypothermia, or seek shade during the scorching heat to avoid sunstroke.

Shelter is your only safe haven at night, when predators are especially active.

Dangerous Fauna and Flora: The island is inhabited not only by food sources. Aggressive boars and elusive predators hiding in the jungle will become a constant threat to you.

Detailed open world: explore a variety of locations, from picturesque beaches to dark mines and an abandoned military base.

Realistic crafting: create weapons, tools, clothes and medicines from scrap materials.

Dynamic day and night cycle: adapt to the island conditions, where danger lurks around every corner.

data.name: ALTER
data.detailed_description:
ALTER is a short first-person survival horror game set in the Paris catacombs.

You are the Exorcist sent to find two missing priests.

Explore the dark, follow what was left behind and uncover what took place down there.

You will not be alone.

Beneath the streets of Paris lies a forgotten labyrinth of bone and dirt. Take on the role of an Exorcist and navigate the endless passages, crumbling shrines and horrors that a hundred years of prayer couldn't keep buried.

When IT finds you, running will not be enough. Raise the cross and say the words aloud.

Speak your faith, or die with IT.

The dead have no use for what they left behind. Scavenge and manage anything and everything you can find. What you carry, what you use and what you leave will decide how long you last.

They left a trail.

Find their notes, follow their path and uncover what happened to the two missing priests.

Whatever they uncovered wasn't meant to be found.

data.name: Rust Born
data.detailed_description:
welcome to the new adventure!

Rust Born is a neo-noir top-down shooter about losing yourself, survival, and corporations that devour cities. You play as a detective named Gabriel, who by fate finds himself trapped in a strange, distorted city ruled by faceless corporations. This place is an anti-utopia that breathes steel, glass, and memories of a world that no longer exists. The player will face a linear top-down action game with a heavy atmosphere, a deep story, and survival elements. Every shot could be your last. Every shadow — a trap. Every decision — reshapes the world around you.

unique indie top-down shooter

A unique setting and weapons will not let you get bored, in an alternative universe where  science has taken a different direction, corporations rule the world and everything,and you  - are trying to survive!

And the constant tension, interesting plot, and surroundings will not let you get bored!

A unique story that you won't hear anywhere else!

In a world where religion never held back progress and the Second World War ended in a Nazi victory, humanity pushed far beyond the limits of possibility — and paid the price.

The year is 1958, according to the New Calendar.
On the ruins of old empires, technological conglomerates have risen — megacorporations that rule the world without mercy or competition. America, GBC, Vereinigt Stelle — global blocs keep populations in poverty, conduct experiments across entire continents, and reduce human life to the level of a commodity.

But the greatest threat isn't corporate greed.
It’s "The Bloom" — a synthetic living plant, originally designed as a bio-implant, which mutated into a sentient parasite. It grows through human flesh and mind, turning people into living sustenance. The infection spreads. Governments remain silent. Corporations are hiding something.

Gabriel is a former detective who lost everything.
Once, he tried to investigate the first Bloom incident. Now, he scrubs floors in a diner. But a chance awakening in a Chinese shipping container filled with cybernetic humans drags him back into a web of events where humanity teeters between survival — and complete absorption by a new form of life.

ENTER A WORLD WHERE:

  • Bioengineering governs body and mind.

  • Megacorporations decide who lives — and who blooms.

  • The Red Gulf is either the last bastion of freedom… or the cradle of an even greater horror.

  • And your own mind… may no longer be yours.

data.name: WriteNor
data.detailed_description:
Many of us have wished, at least once, that we could erase a single day — the one after which everything changed. But what if that day refuses to let you go? And what if moving forward means going back first, to where it all began?

One day that never ends. One year that won't let go.

WriteNor is a first-person psychological horror about a mind that won't leave itself in peace. You play as Johnny, and the first thing you'll notice is that his "today" doesn't move. The same walls, the same light, the same silence between one breath and the next. Then you close your eyes — and you're a year in the past, in the office, on the day it all began.

It was warm there. Nori was there — the one who came out to meet you first, when no one else did. You'll want to stay a little longer. But the past doesn't ask permission — it keeps moving forward, scene by scene, closer to the day Johnny has forbidden himself to think about. And sooner or later, the frozen "now" and the unfolding "then" will meet — right where the truth usually lives.

The game never sits in one genre for more than a couple of scenes: you'll explore, sift through someone else's messages for answers, choose lines that decide how Johnny will remember a moment, and simply watch a day unfold that refuses to end.

FEATURES

  • Two realities, one truth — a frozen present and an unfolding past that slowly converge

  • Gameplay that keeps changing shape — exploration, branching dialogue, investigation through files and messages, atmospheric puzzles

  • A world that remembers more than its protagonist — rooms repeat, voices return out of order, objects aren't where they were left

  • Nori — the one warm trace in a world Johnny is trying so hard to forget

There are no weapons. All you have is attention to detail — and the willingness to remember what was once buried alive.

The same walls, the same light, the same silence between one breath and the next. Then you close your eyes — and you're a year in the past, in the office, on the day it all began.

It was warm there. Nori was there — the one who came out to meet you first, when no one else did. You'll want to stay a little longer. But the past doesn't ask permission — it keeps moving forward, scene by scene, closer to the day Johnny has forbidden himself to think about. And sooner or later, the frozen "now" and the unfolding "then" will meet — right where the truth usually lives.

The game never sits in one genre for more than a couple of scenes: you'll explore, sift through someone else's messages for answers, choose lines that decide how Johnny will remember a moment, and simply watch a day unfold that refuses to end.

FEATURES

  • Two realities, one truth — a frozen present and an unfolding past that slowly converge

  • Gameplay that keeps changing shape — exploration, branching dialogue, investigation through files and messages, atmospheric puzzles

  • A world that remembers more than its protagonist — rooms repeat, voices return out of order, objects aren't where they were left

  • Nori — the one warm trace in a world Johnny is trying so hard to forget

There are no weapons. All you have is attention to detail — and the willingness to remember what was once buried alive.
data.short_description: One day that never ends. One year that won't let go. WriteNor is a psychological horror about a mind that can't forgive itself — and about Nori, who isn't there anymore.

data.name: Selective Memory
data.detailed_description:
In this short surreal third-person exploration game, you relive the same set of memories through three emotional lenses: idyllic, mundane, and horrific. Which lens do you wish to remember through?

As you loop through each distorted variation, a clearer picture begins to emerge -- but clarity comes at a cost. Eventually, you’ll face a final, irreversible choice. What do you wish to remember? And what are you willing to forget?

Key Features:
– Explore fragmented memories across three psychological versions of the same environment
– Uncover hidden details and narrative threads by comparing variations
– Atmospheric third-person gameplay with discovery mechanics
– A haunting, minimalist score and reactive soundscape
– A branching finale based on your choice and emotional alignment

data.name: ScareCrow Hunting VR
data.detailed_description:
The scarecrows have come to life and are running away. You are the last line of defence.
Become the guardian of the cornfield – you must be quick, accurate and have eyes in the back of your head
to face the scarecrows without fear and defend the Cornline. It's like a return to the best days
of retro gaming, but with a modern twist.

Come face to face with fear
ScareCrow Hunting VR is a dynamic VR shooter where every second counts. Waves of scarecrows
are advancing, and your accuracy, dexterity and cunning are the only things keeping them at bay.
Eliminate your opponents with one-shot pistol shots, shower them with bullets using a rifle,
or serve them a real bullet hell with a rocket launcher.

Be the best!
Climb to the top of the leaderboard! Fight, shoot, be quick. Make your opponents pop like popcorn
in a microwave and become the best defender of the cornfield in history!

Modify and have fun
Dozens of maps and different types of weapons! Choose gameplay modifications and beat your own records.
It's the perfect game for short, intense sessions - solo or competing with friends at your
next house party. Show them where fear lives!

Key features

  • Precise VR action - rapid fire, shots under pressure, bullet hell

  • Score attack - each wave is more difficult, each shot is more important

  • Unlockable content - new maps and weapons add depth to the gameplay

  • Session modifications - crank up the risk, have fun, beat your own records

  • Leaderboards - solid competition for the TOP 1 spot

  • Stylised, slightly surreal setting – a memorable atmosphere reminiscent of the best days of retro gaming.

Don't be intimidated! Join the battle and climb to the top of the leaderboard!

data.name: Frog Island
data.detailed_description:
“Oh, a visitor? We haven’t had one in quite some time…”

Waking up on a deserted island, you are greeted by a mysterious woman who asks you to take care of her frogs while she is away. ​However, she vanishes the next day, leaving you with only a hand-written note and some old tools. With nowhere to go, you have but two simple tasks:

  • Escape Frog Island

  • Accept the role of caretaker of Frog Island

In this spiritual successor to the classic creature collection games like Neko Atsume, build the island of your dreams, as you discover cute and curious frogs, and uncover the island's many hidden secrets, to try and piece together the past life you've somehow forgotten.

Meet over 60 unique frogs, from the bashful to the bold. Each frog has its own personality and style, food preferences, and special mementos and gifts! Dress frogs with accessories, play interactive minigames with them, and keep the frogs of your island happy as you fill out your compendium to discover more!

Unravel the island's history, and discover the key to your escape, all while forming lifelong bonds with the island's magical and divine frogs. The true answers lie hidden within the island, waiting for you to uncover them.

Transform a once deserted island into a beautiful frog sanctuary. WIth over 250 toys and decorations, and free-form placement, decorate your island your way, to help create the perfect home for your curious new froggy friends.

  • Discover and collect 60+ adorable frogs, each with unique personalities and looks, and some super secret frogs as well!

  • Explore the diverse wildlife of the island, with 60+ bugs, critters, and fish for you to catch!

  • Farm, cook, fish, and forage during your day-to-day caretaker activities

  • Discover 10+ hand crafted environments on the island, from a fiery volcano, to a magical field of flowers!

  • Build the island of your dreams, with over 250+ toys and decorations to fulfill all your decorating needs!

  • Dress your frogs with cute accessories, over 60+ to unlock!

  • Feed, sing songs, chat, clean, and so many more ways to interact with your frogs

  • Capture your favorite moments on the island with your camera, and save them in your photo album!

  • Features a story-driven narrative, special side quests, and other fun and whimsical events to discover!

  • And so much more!

Hi I’m DevFrog! Frog Island is my first ever video game! For the past 3 years, I’ve been sharing my development progress online, so if you want to see how Frog Island is made or want to share ideas, follow me on socials (the links are on the right side of the steam page).

data.name: Illville: Return instructions. Act 1
data.detailed_description:
Illville: Return Instructions is a gloomy 3D adventure set in an English village controlled by a secret organization. Try to escape from this town and distrust the people you might encounter. Even during the hardest moments there is always someone keeping their eyes on you. But who do these eyes belong to? A friend or foe?

Thrilling action

Take part in this classic 90`s-style 3D adventure surrounded by the tremor and mysteries of a mature storyline. Unveil what is going on in Illville and get back home safe and sound.

Narrative plot

The game introduces a complex plot which requires communication with the characters to fully understand what’s going on in the village. The sense of peril will not abandon you throughout the whole quest.

Puzzle solving

Decipher different enigmas as you interact with the inhabitants of this town. Analyze your dialogues with the people you meet up with to find out the clue to the obscurity of the people in Illville.

data.name: Halloween Rhythm
data.detailed_description:
This is a Chiptune Rhythm game for Halloween aficionados everywhere! Six spooky songs with two difficulty settings. The easy mode has you controlling a witch as she collects pumpkins to the beat. Hard mode will test your reflexes as you move the little witch's wand in rhythm.

  • Saint-Saëns – Danse Macabre
  • Paul Dukas - The Sorcerer's Apprentice
  • Richard Wagner - Ride of the Valkyries
  • Mussorgsky – Night on Bald Mountain
  • Giuseppe Verdi - Dies Irae from his Requiem
  • Chopin – “Funeral March” from his Piano Sonata No. 2

You must hit the notes at the right time

Left click....................................Choose a game

[Normal Mode]

Spacebar....................................Toggle Pause

[Hard Mode]
Left/Right Arrow...................Move left or right
Spacebar..................................Toggle Pause

[Pause Mode]
Spacebar..................................Toggle Pause

data.name: Danger Room
data.detailed_description:
So, you’ve finally decided to show up, eh? Do you even know what you’re here for? Whatever. Our previous subjects kept dying on us, so you’ll have to do. Just stand there and destroy the turrets before they destroy you. Oh, and please do your best to not suck like the others. What do you mean there're too many of them? Sigh, are you that slow? Just suck in what the turrets are hitting you with and fire back a huge explosive shot! Also, in case you haven’t noticed, (which I doubt you have, with your dimwittedness) the lasers are dangerous too. And they're fast. You might want to avoid them if you have any attachment to life, not that it matters to us. Don't worry, if the worst happens, there're others waiting to take your place. But DO try and stay alive anyway, we can’t afford to keep replacing test dummies.

FEATURES

  • Awesome Laser Blasters: They really are quite awesome
  • Slow Time: Dodge and shoot in style when things get too fast for you.
  • Suck Enemy Bullets: Charge up your weapons by sucking in enemy bullets and firing back a huge explosive shot
  • Compete in Online and Local Leaderboards: Prove yourself as the best test subject.

data.name: Akai Katana Shin
data.detailed_description:
It is now the Taisho era in a world similar to olden Japan during a period of rapid economic growth.
Fighter jets, tanks, and battleships have entered the war, and giants known as Guardians and Mugen are tearing their way through the battlefield.
This is the exciting stage of Akai Katana Shin, a horizontal shoot 'em up game.


The Japanese-inspired military game visuals and gorgeous character designs
portray a dramatic story of clashes between family and old friends.
These elements are tied together by strategic game mechanics, which feature a wide variety of attack methods to experiment with.
Find out for yourself why this game has such a strong base of ardent fans!


Contains Three Titles From Cave's Akai Katana Series
Akai Katana
The first arcade game of the series released in 2010. Supports two players.

Akai Katana Shin
A home console version with an aspect ratio of 16:9 and new game features such as Hagane and Katana.

Akai Katana Zetsu
Based on Akai Katana with an aspect ratio of 16:9. Game mechanics have been adjusted for balance.


From Strategy Crafting to Score Attack—Versatile Enough to Play It Your Way
The player unit known as Fighter
can switch between its normal form and a giant ninja known as Guardian using Soul-shift.
The unit also comes equipped with two different bullet shots.
Attack Mode has more power and Defense Mode boosts mobility.
Make good use of a combination of forms and modes to break through enemy ranks and destroy them.

Soul-shift is a crucial technique that boosts the player for a short while.
In Akai Katana and Akai Katana Zetsu, timing the shift well can block enemy bullets even on a screen that's full of them.
In Akai Katana Shin, generate and fire a Katana shot to quickly defeat strong enemies.
The highlight of this title is the ability to negate or dispel attacks instead of simply avoiding them.
Make good use of Soul-shift to turn the tide in your favor and earn a higher score.


Quality Game Modes Packed With Features
Settings: Adjust options such as sound volume and screen display.
Turn Screen Frame on to see captions for character voices during the game.

Training: Specify a stage and adjust your unit's condition to carry out individual training.

Score Attack: See how far you can go with only one life. No continues or restarts allowed.
Rank and replays can be saved separately from normal gameplay.

Online Leaderboard: See how your score compares against other players online.

Replay: Record and save gameplay data from start to end of session.
Other than playing and pausing the replay, you can also use the Edit function to jump right into the game from a specific point in time.


Daisuke Matsumoto's New Soundtrack Masterpieces
Daisuke Matsumoto, music composer of Gothic wa Mahou Otome and sound effects producer for the Akai Katana series, returns with exciting new musical arrangements for the game's soundtrack.
You can switch between three different versions of BGM for this game,
including the original audio and new tracks created for Akai Katana Shin.

data.name: Dynasty
data.detailed_description:
Your king father is dead, and you are now alone. A day ago he stood strong and proud. The royal advisors found cause and means to open your king father's chest to voice their dissent against his rule. "Trust no one," were his dying words. You do not know why they killed him, or how they killed him, but there is no denying that they succeeded. The mandate of heaven falls to you. You must prolong the Dynasty.

Dynasty is a social deduction roguelike in which you must rule your kingdom through your advisors, who you are unsure whether you can trust. Your advisors hold the keys to power. You must please them enough to keep them loyal and grant them the power to administrate your kingdom. But beware-- the more power you grant them, the more they may use that power against you. You must survive 30 turns without being assassinated. If you have not been assassinated by your advisors by turn 30, you win.

Features:

  • Play a social deduction roguelike in which you must avoid assassination by your advisors as you administer your kingdom.
  • 200 programs
  • 30 turns
  • 15 abilities
  • 6 advisors
  • 1 monarch

There are six primary advisors:

  • Seneschal Belmin: The majordomo of your palace. Through him you can curry the loyalty of your other advisors. He can help you expand your palace and staff, and with enough power can learn the true loyalty of your other advisors.
  • Captain Niri: The Captain of your Crownguard. She will help you discover and foil assassination plots. If you suspect another advisor of plotting against you, you can have her arrest them, to be replaced by another hopefully more loyal second.
  • Treasurer Chaddik: Of the Royal Treasury. He safeguards your income and manages your coffers and expenses. Through him you can purchase the loyalty of other advisors.
  • Magistrate Elenda: Of the Ministry of the Commons. She represents the will of your subjects. Without her resourceful solutions to the problems your kingdom faces, there would surely be unrest and revolts.
  • Unitary Alesanvi: The highest religious officiant. The piety of other advisors only offers her more power, though she tells you that her power comes only from the heavens.
  • General Higan: The commander of the Royal Army. Through his military might you can command fear and obedience. Beware that you do not turn your kingdom into a military dictatorship.

data.name: Trucks & Trailers
data.detailed_description:
Trucks & Trailers puts your driving skills to the ultimate test with 50 individual truck driving challenges. Compete against the clock to complete intricately designed courses and tasks that put you firmly into the driver's seat. Can you avoid obstacles whilst reversing a trailer? Do you have the lateral thinking required to sort a series of trucks & trailers in the yard into their correct positions? Can you park with precision?

As your skills increase, upgrading the difficulty level will guarantee that there is always a task that will put you and your truck to the ultimate test! At the highest difficulty setting external camera views are disabled, forcing you to maneuver like the pros using only in-cab mirrors. A test that will award you the gold medals and the honor of being a real trucking titan!

Key features


  • 50+ challenges, with achievements and awards, guarantees you will want to keep on truckin'
  • Incredible 3D graphics that bring beautifully detailed trucks and trailers to life
  • Multiple camera views of an intricate 3D world
  • From the makers of truck simulation games in the 18 Wheels of Steel series and the Euro Truck Simulator series

data.name: LOCKDOWN
data.detailed_description:
THE GAME

LOCKDOWN is a narrative psychological horror and social drama game set in São Paulo during the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020.

The player follows ROCK SILVA, an eccentric and lonely actor who remains confined to his apartment while the city, his routine, his relationships, and his psychological stability progressively deteriorate.

The apartment begins as a refuge.

Then it becomes a confinement.

Finally, it becomes a psychological prison.

The horror should not primarily rely on monsters, creatures, or jump scares.

The main threat emerges from:

  • isolation;

  • loneliness;

  • paranoia;

  • scarcity;

  • illness;

  • conflicts between neighbors;

  • domestic violence;

  • alarming news reports;

  • unexplained sounds;

  • the deterioration of routine;

  • the degradation of the environment;

  • the loss of a sense of time;

  • the fear of human contact;

  • declining health;

  • deteriorating mental stability.

The experience should progressively make the player question:

"What really happened?"

"What is Edson imagining?"

"What is happening in the apartment next door?"

"To what extent can we trust the protagonist's perception?"

GAMEPLAY

LOCKDOWN is a first-person narrative and atmospheric experience.

The player should live through Edson's routine rather than simply watch the story unfold.

The gameplay should combine:

EXPLORATION

Move throughout the apartment and explore limited areas of the building.

INTERACTION

Manipulate and interact with important objects.

OBSERVATION

Observe the window, television, peephole, objects, and environmental changes.

ROUTINE

Perform everyday household tasks.

ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING

Discover information and pieces of the story through the environment.

AUDIO

Investigate events primarily through sounds and what can—or cannot—be heard.

RESOURCES / SCARCITY

Progressively manage the dwindling supply of certain resources.

SANITY / PSYCHOLOGICAL STATE

Represent Edson's psychological deterioration through the player's experience, rather than relying solely on a numerical sanity meter.

"To what extent can we trust the protagonist's perception?"

GAMEPLAY

LOCKDOWN is a first-person narrative and atmospheric experience.

The player should live through Edson's routine rather than simply watch the story unfold.

The gameplay should combine:

EXPLORATION

Move throughout the apartment and explore limited areas of the building.

INTERACTION

Manipulate and interact with important objects.

OBSERVATION

Observe the window, television, peephole, objects, and environmental changes.

ROUTINE

Perform everyday household tasks.

ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING

Discover information and pieces of the story through the environment.

AUDIO

Investigate events primarily through sounds and what can—or cannot—be heard.

RESOURCES / SCARCITY

Progressively manage the dwindling supply of certain resources.

SANITY / PSYCHOLOGICAL STATE

Represent Edson's psychological deterioration through the player's experience, rather than relying solely on a numerical sanity meter.
data.short_description: Confined during an extreme lockdown, a declining actor watches his reality unravel as isolation, paranoia, and scarcity consume his sanity. A minimalist psychological horror about loneliness, fear, and the fragile boundary between reality and delusion.

data.name: HexLemma
data.detailed_description:
Sudoku meets Picross, on a hex grid.

HexLemma is a constraint-satisfaction deduction puzzle played on a hexagonal board. Each cell holds a hidden value from 1 to 7. Your job is to deduce every one — guided by six clue families that compose into intricate proofs.

You never guess. Wrong moves are blocked before they can land. Every commit you make is provably correct, every elimination provably necessary. The puzzle is fair, and the proof is yours alone.

The six clue families

  • Pair-Same (=) — two distant cells share a value.

  • Pair-Differ (≠) — two distant cells must differ.

  • Order (<, >) — one cell's value is smaller than its partner's.

  • Count (N·V) — exactly N of a cell's six neighbors hold value V.

  • Parity (E / O) — the cell holds an even or odd value.

  • Vertex Sum (Σ) — three cells meeting at a corner sum to a target number.

The clues compose. A Count tells you where 3s can land; a Pair-Differ narrows it further; a Vertex Sum rules out the last ambiguity. Every solve is an emergent chain you build, not a recipe you follow.

Three ways to play

  • Campaign — 25 hand-tuned puzzles across five stages. Each stage introduces one new clue family. Start with the basics in Stage 1 (Foundations); finish on full-grammar Insane boards in Stage 5 (Capstone).

  • Daily Challenge — one puzzle per UTC date, the same for every player worldwide. Compete on the Steam leaderboard.

  • Random Puzzle — pick a board shape, difficulty, and seed. Eight board shapes (Hex Disk, Rectangle, Triangle, Parallelogram, Hex Star, L-Shape, Donut, organic blobs). Four difficulties from Easy to Insane.

Built for sitting with

  • No timer. No mistake cap. Take five minutes or take an hour.

  • Cloud saves across machines.

  • Move replays for every puzzle you finish.

  • 13 achievements across campaign progress, perfectionist runs, and daily streaks.

Coming Soon

  • Localization: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Finnish, Norwegian, Swedish, Turkish, Portuguese (Portugal + Brazil).

  • Themes: Four themes including two designed for colorblind players (deuteranopia + tritanopia).

  • Full controller support with hex-natural six-way cursor navigation. Steam Deck ready. Partial support already baked. Working on control scheme optimizations.

A relaxation puzzle with teeth. Settle in.

data.name: Wickwood
data.detailed_description:
One night. One town. One lantern.

Wickwood is a top-down pixel-art action game about getting out of a small town in the woods before your light runs out.



No hunger bar. No thirst. No crafting bench, no base to build, no inventory to sort. A weapon in your hands, fuel on your belt, and a road heading south.

The light is the clock

A full tank burns for four minutes. While it burns, the warm circle around you closes in: the colour drains from white to orange, and in the last quarter the light begins to stutter.

Nothing on screen counts down. You read the time you have left off the ground at your feet.

Jerry cans are out there in the dark. Finding one is not a bonus — it is the difference between finishing the job and walking home blind.

Three things come for you

  • The Walker takes hit after hit and never stops closing.
  • The Runner is made of glass and crosses the gap in a single lunge.
  • The Spitter never comes near you. It doesn't have to.
They arrive in waves, with quiet in between. Break away far enough for long enough and they lose you — but the quiet never lasts.

Everything is melee

  • You start with a bat and earn an axe. Both swing in an arc in front of you, and both root you in place while they do.
  • The dodge roll has real invulnerability frames — a sliver in the middle of the roll, not the whole of it.
  • Death costs you ground, not progress. You wake at the last campfire with full health and walk back in.

Work your way out

The campground. The old cemetery. The hollow. The dump. The worksite. The rail sidings. The Last Chance Gas station. The sheriff's office.

The jobs chain into one another until the last one: an abandoned car on the road south, missing a battery, a jack and a wheel. Carry the battery and you cannot swing at anything. Pick your route.

Plainly

  • About an hour from the first swing to the sunrise, in one sitting.
  • No NPCs, no dialogue trees, no shopkeepers. The town tells you what it needs, where it needs it.
  • One continuous night. The only sunrise in the game is the one you drive into.

data.name: For the People
data.detailed_description:
For the People is an acute social novel with strategic elements that puts the player in the shoes of a state official.

Congratulations, dear comrade! From now on, you are the head of a small but important industrial center bearing the proud name of Iron-1. Your task will be to manage and rebuild it amidst the formation of a new totalitarian regime, currently faced with the consequences of the recent revolution, such as a deepening social crisis and an utter economic deficit.
Yet we remain confident that it is young specialists such as yourself, who will lead this county to a stable and prosperous future.

Glory to the Union of People's Orange Communes! Glory to Comrade Steel!

Key features

Develop a taste for power
– Hooligans, ganging up on a defenseless old man? Lock 'em up!
– It appears that grandpa is a veteran counter-revolutionary...
– In that case, let the poor boys go... Pops had it coming!
Manage the appeals for justice from your citizens, grant or dismiss requests from subject departments, and untangle a web of political intrigue. Information is your most valuable resource, so do not be afraid to obtain it by any means necessary!


Always be two steps ahead
Every district in Iron-1 needs your help, but with a limited budget, you cannot help everyone. Strategically distribute resources to the people to earn their trust and increase your influence over them. There is no chance to please everyone, so you will inevitably have to take sides.


Over 5 possible endings
Every decision has a consequence. You will need to balance the interests of the party, the future of the country, and the very livelihood of your citizens.
So, whose side will you really be on?
data.about_the_game:
For the People is an acute social novel with strategic elements that puts the player in the shoes of a state official.

Congratulations, dear comrade! From now on, you are the head of a small but important industrial center bearing the proud name of Iron-1. Your task will be to manage and rebuild it amidst the formation of a new totalitarian regime, currently faced with the consequences of the recent revolution, such as a deepening social crisis and an utter economic deficit.
Yet we remain confident that it is young specialists such as yourself, who will lead this county to a stable and prosperous future.

Glory to the Union of People's Orange Communes! Glory to Comrade Steel!

Key features

Develop a taste for power
– Hooligans, ganging up on a defenseless old man? Lock 'em up!
– It appears that grandpa is a veteran counter-revolutionary...
– In that case, let the poor boys go... Pops had it coming!
Manage the appeals for justice from your citizens, grant or dismiss requests from subject departments, and untangle a web of political intrigue. Information is your most valuable resource, so do not be afraid to obtain it by any means necessary!


Always be two steps ahead
Every district in Iron-1 needs your help, but with a limited budget, you cannot help everyone. Strategically distribute resources to the people to earn their trust and increase your influence over them. There is no chance to please everyone, so you will inevitably have to take sides.


Over 5 possible endings
Every decision has a consequence. You will need to balance the interests of the party, the future of the country, and the very livelihood of your citizens.
So, whose side will you really be on?
data.short_description: For the People is a mix of a political management sim and a visual novel, putting players in the shoes of an idealistic young state official tasked with shaping the future of a communist factory town. Will the party provide for the people, or are the people just cogs in its machine?..

data.detailed_description:
More than 20 swords to choose , each with a unique attack style. Whether to motive your sword by the force of five elements or the power from underworld, it's all about a moment of thought.

Up to 90 kinds of splendid swordsmanship and 24 schools can be selected at your will. Slash the enemy through exquisite skills or unleash an abyss of blood engulfing everything?

Monsters have returned, and only the sharp blade in thy hand can save the realm. Travel between time and space, encountering marvelous adventures, unraveling the mystery behind the temporal collapse.






Cultivate the meridians, nurture cinnabar fields and study the martial arts from various sects.

data.name: Valledi
data.detailed_description:
After years stuck in grief, Diana depart on a journey in search of an ancient myth - A mystical place where legend says to realize the deepest wish of the person who find it. But Diana is about to find out that reaching there will be much harder than she thought, and now with her drone companion, she will face a hard journey of challenge and overcoming.

About the game

Valledi brings a different take on the platforming genre: instead of jumping, the player shoots the drone and teleport to wherever the drone is. With this mechanic, the player can pass through cliffs and hazardous terrains, while other interactions with the drone allow to take on enemys and puzzles along the way.

Contents

  • Over 250 stage screens

  • Constant new game mechanics every new level

  • A careful crafted pixel art world

  • Acessibility options to reduce struggle.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________

"When I first learned about my eyes, I thought science would be the best thing in my life. But now, all I can do is search in the mystic the solution that the science could not help me"

data.name: Soviet Prison: Red Winter
data.detailed_description:
The winter never ends here. You run a labour camp cut out of the taiga: build it, staff it, feed it and keep it warm. Push the prisoners too far and they push back.


Prisoners smuggle shivs, steal tools and form gangs. Fights draw crowds, and crowds turn into riots. Your guards carry batons, rifles and submachine guns. Search, chain, beat or execute, then live with what it does to the camp.


The cold is the first enemy. Stoves need wood, blizzards close the road and bring the power line down, and searchlights go dark when they do. A stove left burning too hot can take a whole cell block with it.


In Escape mode you are one of the prisoners. Steal a weapon, recruit a gang and get through the wire and into the trees before the towers spot you. In the warden's chair you can take control of any guard and do the job yourself.


Drag out a cell block, mess hall or workshop at any size and the layout fills itself in. Workers fell the forest, haul the bricks and raise it wall by wall. Run power and water, hire the staff and plan every hour of the prisoners' day.


Lock the cells at night, man the towers and sweep the yard with searchlights. Armed guards shoot anyone they catch going over the wire.


Online multiplayer for up to 8 players in one camp. Wardens run it together while escapists play the prisoners trying to get out. Switch sides whenever you like.


  • Low-poly 3D in a crisp pixel-art style, with a day and night cycle and snow that settles and drifts
  • Fifteen building types that lay themselves out, from solitary blocks to the incinerator
  • Six prisoner classes, from minimum security to death row
  • Staff with their own jobs: guards, armed guards, cooks, workers, doctors, janitors, clerks and the warden
  • A research tree of 16 projects
  • Needs, tension, contraband, disease and gangs that feed into each other
  • Weather, power cuts and fires, plus a fire brigade and an ambulance you can call in
  • A guided tutorial, Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud saves

data.name: Neofold
data.detailed_description:
The infinite creature-collector where each pet is uniquely yours, generated live by your GPU. Hatch endless weirdos, adopt the ones you love, and grow a living sanctuary of species that exist only on your desktop.



  • ✨ Infinite unique creatures: Each pet is uniquely yours, generated in real-time by your GPU! No suitable graphics card? A collection of 1500+ pre-generated pets is ready to go.
  • 🥚 Idler at your pace: Watch your pets roam and interact freely while you wait for your eggs to hatch, or speed it up by tapping eggs as they shake.
  • 🌿 Meaningful choices: Each batch contains five newborns, but you can only keep one! Pick your absolute favorite, give it a name, and release the rest into the wild.
  • 🌷 Cozy wallpaper: Your sanctuary (optionally) becomes your desktop's animated wallpaper, featuring a real-time day/night cycle, soothing ambient sounds, and a built-in MP3 player.
  • 🌍 Huge open world: Expand your horizons by collecting location DLCs to seamlessly expand the map and unlock new vistas for your weirdos to inhabit.
  • 🔒 100% offline, 100% yours: No internet connection, no account, no subscriptions. Everything is generated on your machine and stays there. Do with the creature sprites as you please, they're yours!
  • ⚙️ Highly customizable: Tweak your creatures, the animations, UI, audio, and even the core world and engine settings. This is your sanctuary.



Developer's note: Weird creatures have fascinated me for as long as I remember. Neofold is my love letter to creature-collectors such as Pokémon and Palworld, bringing an infinity of real-time generated weirdos right to your desktop. Every hatch is a surprise that's yours alone, giving you something novel to look forward to each day. After months of development, I've yet to go a day without being amazed by a generation. Hope you enjoy it as much as I do!

Ready to grow your sanctuary of weirdos?
100% offline. Infinite creatures. Uniquely yours.

data.name: Distorted Echos
data.detailed_description:
Development Update, Extensive Changes

Massive Development Update: Jan 2024


  • Co-op Multiplayer Support is being added to the game, at the current development roadmap players will be able to have a party of 3 people to co-op with

  • Full Item Crafting System Has been Added to the game, Players now are able to Craft more advanced items from the primary items they find in the game. Crafting Can be conducted using different fabricators. Fabricators have different number of item slots depending on the type of fabricator. Over 70 new items have been added to the game and craft system, including different types of projectiles, Spears, Mines, build structures such as walls, Platforms, Stairs, Power generating items such as Fuels, Electric generators and many more.

  • Full mining system has been added to the game, Players now Can mine resources to craft items

  • Day/Night Cycle, Dynamic Weather System, Environmental Hazards and other Dynamic Environment elements have been added to the game, Players now have a clock indicating the current time of day. Realtime Sunset and sunrise with dynamic change of Day/Night visual Effects. Environmental Hazards Such as Sandstorm, Acid rain and Meteor shower have been added, As well as shelters to shield from such hazards

  • Vehicles have been added to the game, Players are now able to use vehicles such as Hovercrafts to and Rover to navigate through the map.some vehicles require power, fuel and some can carry multiple players, hook other items, attach weapons and so on.

  • Player Ability system has been added to the game, Player now can Slide, use jetpacks, extract minerals, Use scanner and have different types of close and long range attacks, with new weapons and new AI NPCs to fight with

The biggest Update so far is under development, Stay Tuned for more, more than 70 Items are to be added to the game. A list of the developed items will be released in a patch note soon.


About the Game

After crashing into an Alien planet called Yolk, You find yourself oblivious and left alone with your AI companion , Find your way through the unknown, discover the mysteries of Yolk and find out what happened to you and everyone else!

In this action-adventure experience, players find themselves stranded in an alien planet called Yolk,
The main objective of this game is to survive harsh threats of the Yolk and uncover the protagonist's lost memories, players will face numerous threats including Alien species ,Cyborgs, Drones, Anomaly entities, Corrupted Robots which once were used to serve human scientists on Yolk research stations. Moreover, there are numerous unknown mysteries and hidden threats waiting to be discovered.

This game is currently in development stage and yet to be released, according to the game's road map ,further features have been planned to be developed in future design pipeline, including more environmental Threats and events such as Acid Rains and Meteor showers, Player Buildable structures such as Tents , Shelter and extended levels and environment design.

data.name: A Case of Distrust
data.detailed_description:
A Case of Distrust is a narrative mystery from 1924 San Francisco. Play as private investigator Phyllis Cadence Malone in this historical 2D adventure game. Explore underground speakeasies, smoke-filled billiard halls, classic barber shops, and more. Catch suspects in lies by using evidence, statements, and your wits. Intrinsic challenges face our heroine, as she struggles against a pushback on emancipation, leading to many doubts, both internal and external. Uncover the truth in a mystery full of deception!

Critical Reception

  • "Perfect video game noir... 9/10" - Polygon

  • "Impressed me with its nuanced, careful construction" - Newsweek

  • "Stunning two-dimensional silhouettes" - PC Gamer

  • "Beautiful noirish graphics... suspenseful mystery" - Vogue Magazine

Features

  • A hardboiled mystery, working past deceptive characters towards the truth

  • 1924 San Francisco with historically accurate details

  • Saul Bass inspired visuals and scene transitions

  • Finger-snapping music that gives style to the roaring 20s

  • Themes of poverty, racism, and emancipation that tie into contemporary issues

data.name: Monkey Land 3D: Reaper Rush
data.detailed_description:
Monkey Land 3D: Reaper Rush is 100% full of gameplay! There's bananas, treasure coins, Piggys in need of saving, locked treasure chests and thats just in the first 10 seconds! Find new abilities like the STOMPY-BUTT by finding the precious Dinosaur Feathers!

You can also find and unlock the DOUBLE JUMP, the DASH ATTACK, and unleash a 3 hit combo DRAGON BACKFLIP that can also do GATE CRUSHING amounts of damage!

Find weapons, power ups, kill monsters, fight bosses, beat time trials, explore huge worlds, and help out the inslanders all in Monkey Land 3D: Reaper Rush!


Mugen is a pirate monkey out on a quest for adventure... and booty! His crew has landed on a strange island that looks like fun and games but something is strange about the islands inhabitants. Some are locked up in cages and they don't know why? Only Mugen can save them and find out who or what is behind all the mischief!

Weapons like the Morning Star make swords look lame. A SPIKED BALL of DOOM on a chain is so much more fun than a sword! But a Sword with Lightning going through it is pretty fun indeed! Both of these weapons just need to be found and picked up to have for the rest of the game! The Piggys of Volcano Island and the Golden Butterflies are being kept prisoner all over on the island and only you can free them. The Viking Helmet and Viking Shield will be your protection. But you might find your own protection like that spike shelled turtle over there can probably be used as a weapon and defense! The Owl-Crates around the island hold power-ups too so be sure to SMASH all the BOXES!

Watch out for Skeleton Wizards of dark magic and the evil Saber-toothed Bats! The creepy spiders will be sure to come after you. The Firefly demons are mostly harmless so it's not all bad. But the spiked shell turtles can be quite fast by the water front so be careful. The Pumpkins are extra bouncy this time of year too.

The Squishy Fishy's are not so squishy and shoot deadly poison stars so be extra careful near water! And one last thing, use the Banana button to pause and go to options and use the Heart button to adjust the camera. You can adjust the control placement in the Options menu and be sure to unlock all the levels by BEATING the GAME! And do replay after you beat a certain someone because there might just be a special thing like a reward for beating the game but nobody knows for sure what it is!

Boss fighting can be dangerous so make sure you have found at least one weapon before trying to take on the last boss. I mean unless you want to be some crazy hero that don't need no weapons to defeat the game then by all means, be my guest. Take your best shot, that little head is probably the weakest spot.

Oh and one more thing, the new abilities you get from the treasure chests, they come in a different order every time you start a new game so you might get an ability you really really want at first, and you might get it last! It's what the kids call procedural random gameplay and it's so hot right now!



Single Player Adventure with HOURS of gameplay!

Unlock special abilities like Double Jump and Dash Attack!

Boost off pumpkins to get to super high places!

Side quests with POWERFUL rewards!

Boss Fights that require EXTREME fighting action!

Huge levels are like mini worlds and can be explored all over!

Power ups like Big Mode, Speed Boost, Triple Jump, Tiny Mode, and more!

Sword fighting action!

Melee weapons with PHYSICS like the spiked ball and chain weapons!

Randomly generated chests make each play through unique!

Percent based completion, can you beat Reaper Rush to 100% completion?



Let us know what you think about Monkey Land 3D: Reaper Rush!

data.name: Park of Hidden Desires
data.detailed_description:
Park of Hidden Desires is a magical story-driven adventure set in a mysterious city park, where every shadow holds a secret and every path leads to a new discovery.

Take on the role of a quirky ghost detective, forever bound to this park until all the hidden desires of its visitors are fulfilled.

By day, the park is alive with laughter, romance, and lively conversations along sunlit paths. When night falls, lanterns begin to glow, fireflies drift through the air, and the most cherished dreams and secrets awaken under the trees. You are an invisible observer, able to eavesdrop on secret conversations, peek at romantic encounters, help lost children, or unravel the motives of mysterious strangers.

Explore winding trails, uncover hidden stories, solve engaging puzzles, and help characters fulfill their deepest wishes. Every choice you make influences the story and the atmosphere of the park—some secrets come to light, while others slip away into the shadows.

The game combines charming hand-drawn graphics, fluid animation, and an atmospheric soundtrack to immerse you in a world of mysteries, emotions, and unexpected encounters. Interact with unique characters, uncover their fates, restore broken bonds, and change the lives of the park’s inhabitants for the better… or not!

Become an invisible guardian, helping lost souls find their way, or meddle in their destinies, changing their wishes forever. In this park, everyone has a dream—and every dream has its own story.

Uncover the secrets, desires, and smiles hidden in the shadows of Park of Hidden Desires—where every wish matters, and every secret has its own fate.

data.name: Elven Assassin
data.detailed_description:
Join our Discord


About the Game

Should I join?

Is there anything more epic than slaying hordes of orcs with a bow in Virtual Reality? When nothing comes to your mind, then you probably should try this.
If you thought: "Of course, slaying them with my friends online in co-op mode!", then this is the matter of destiny.

Become an elven assassin.

Take a bow and kill hundreds of orcs of different types that want to get into the elven town and destroy it. As an elven assassin, you will make spectacular shots like long distant headshots or you will send lethal arrows through the windows. All this to conquer global leaderboards of other elven assassins.

Piece of cake then?

Not really. This is real orcs assault. The Orcs are running fast making the game more competitive. They break into houses to hide from your arrows, and when they got furious their massive axe is thrown to splash you head into pieces.

Assassin United.

Two, Three or Four assassin may unite to defend the town. Use wisely the four available archery spots to survive as long as possible. You can choose one of the public servers, that asks for your support or decide to defend the castle only with the brothers you know on the private server.

PvP Deathmatch.

For those who would rather test themselves against other players online in a competitive mode, the PvP Deathmatch was introduced. But be careful with this one as there are some extremely skilled archers waiting for a challenge there.

VR Parks and Arcades.

If you are the owner of VR park visit:

Additional info.

The game was created from the ground up for Room-Scale Virtual Reality Experience.
If you don't own VR headset you can try the game in good VR Parks & Arcades.

The game contains the voice chat, so watch your language and remember the Steam Online Conduct.

Disclaimer:
This game is not associated with any other fantasy movie, game or book.
Any similarity is purely coincidental.

data.name: Beach Invasion 1915-Gallipoli
data.detailed_description:
Next addition to the Beach Invasion game series, this time bringing the players to defend against the greatest amphibious operation during the First World War.

In this FPS/Tower defense game, players defend the beach fortifications against invading forces who will attack your position with troops, armored cars, biplanes, planes and more! Use a variety of iconic and authentic WWI weapons stretching from machine guns to coastal artillery, and field cannons to anti-air guns.

Beach Invasion 1915-Gallipoli brings modern FPS realism to arcade style on-rail shooter game mechanics. The players can choose to play two scenarios; in the first as a Turkish soldier  defending the beaches of Gallipoli, in the second one as a British soldier defending the Suez Canal. Moreover they can play together with friends in online CO-OP gamemode.

During these immense amphibious operations, player's task is to destroy as many of the invading forces as possible in continous waves, utilizing a variety of weapons and bonuses from the supply drops, such as Poison Gas, Armor Piercing, Explosive and Incendiary ammunition.

Compared to previous games in the franchise, players can now determine the precise location of where they want the artillery fire to hit. New enemies include infantry who will charge with their bayonets, armored cars, motorcycles, bi-planes and more!

data.name: Reactonix Sandbox
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Reactonix!

Create your own worlds—or leave nothing but ashes!

  • A wealth of tools. Materials, living creatures, forces of nature and much, much more are in your hands. What happens to the world is up to you.

    P.S. Most importantly, don't try at home what you do in the game! (=

  • Forces of destruction. After all, who doesn't need a little fire for fun now and then?

  • Life — from familiar to alien. From ordinary plants to unimaginable beings and an evolutionary life system that depends on environmental conditions.

  • Physical processes. Detailed simulation of natural phenomena, down to the ability to control individual cells.

Don't be alone!

  • Co-op. Invite friends into your world or join theirs to create and destroy together! Or maybe, not entirely together... (=

  • Workshop. Share your worlds and recorded statistics with the community!

  • Mod support. The game includes tools for integrating mods into many parts. Create new tools, materials, processes—or something bigger—if you want!

More than just sight!

  • Multiple view modes. Is it boring to look at the world with only your eyes? Observe temperature, creatures and other processes separately!

  • Statistics. Ever wanted to feel like a scientist? Now you can rely not only on your eyes but also on numbers and charts!

And remember, EVERYTHING here is under your control! (Unless your friends get in the way. (= )

data.name: Stardom
data.detailed_description:
*** This Game is only available in Chinese ***
《明星志願》由大宇資訊於1995年1月15日推出，是一款模擬養成遊戲，也是《明星志願》系列遊戲的開篇之作。在遊戲中，玩家將扮演周映彤的高中同學，並經營一間經紀公司。必須於兩年內按照董事長的要求，取得三項大獎的經營類遊戲。

成為星探

千里馬常有，而伯樂不常有。走上街頭，在百貨公司、Pub、民歌餐廳發現潛藏的明日之星，並說服他們加入你的公司，和你一起打拼！

最佳經紀人

幫公司的藝人接取通告、安排行程，讓他們的明星道路更上一層樓！讓你的公司成為業界最知名的造星工廠！

經營、戀愛兩不誤

追求喜歡的女生，在遊戲中體驗戀愛。

綜藝小遊戲

明星保齡球、快問亂答……參與綜藝活動，遊玩小遊戲，還可獲得多種獎勵~

登場角色


周映彤
1972年9月12日出生，處女座，身高168公分、體重54公斤。
本遊戲的主要角色之一，也是玩家於高中時期的校花。由於美貌動人，在學校，似乎有一大堆人想追求她，但映彤卻沒有浪費時間在談情說愛上。可能是處女座自我要求很高的因素，肯吃苦，也只到民歌餐廳駐唱，並等待機會。直到扮演高中同學的玩家找上映彤，提拔她到玩家所屬的「綺麗之夢」經紀公司，人生才有了轉變。

余紫茵
1974年6月30日出生，巨蟹座，身高165公分，體重53公斤。於遊戲內的「星期六」時間出現。
出生於雖貧窮，但卻還能有正面想法，也能自得其樂的家庭。有著好的資質，卻沒有強烈的企圖心。最大的願望，就是成為快樂的家庭主婦。

高明權
1974年10月10日出生，天秤座，身高182公分，體重75公斤。有著深棕色的馬尾長髮是其特徵。於遊戲內的「星期四」時間出現。
從小出生於職業賭場，因此家庭與黑道扯上了關係。明權原有一雙胞胎哥哥，但在一次意外中不幸喪生，因此明權在不斷的省思後，體驗出生命意義，因此決定脫離家族關係，開創出屬於自己的一條道路。由於有著家族的一些血統，因此還是個很講義氣的漢子，且武術也不錯。

林妮雯
1975年9月15日出生，處女座。於遊戲內的「星期三」時間出現。
自小出生於婚姻失敗家庭的妮雯，總是像皮球一樣的，被父母、親戚們踢來踢去，所以有著強烈的背叛心理，更不相信所謂的「婚姻速食愛情」這樣的想法。不過運動神經卻是相當的好，困難的動作，妮雯卻能輕易做出。

徐心寧
1973年9月1日出生，處女座。於遊戲內的「星期日」時間出現。
從小生在軍事化的家庭，凡事都要一板一眼。父親嚴以律己的教育，讓心寧成為乖巧的小女孩，並造就了心寧拘謹的心態。也因此，心寧只能有看書的唯一嗜好。

蔡筱韻
1976年3月29日出生，牡羊座，身高170公分，體重56公斤。於遊戲內的「星期一」時間出現。
自小出生於聲望很高的家庭，父母親都是白領階級。因此造就了筱韻態度傲慢的個性，也有毅力太差，不能吃苦的缺點，更有很容易記仇的特點。但就是因為出生於富有的家庭，因此對於穿著打扮的要求非常高，一登場就有十足的明星架勢。家人也希望，筱韻能夠成為明星，是共同的願望。

林俊穎
1977年1月22日出生，水瓶座，身高169公分，體重62公斤。最大的特徵，是有著一頭綠色的頭髮。於遊戲內的「星期五」時間出現。
家裡很算富有的俊穎，算是「小開等級」的「大戶」。林家的三代單傳，希望俊穎能夠開枝散葉，努力的讓林家更能壯大。由於可能是「天資異稟」，所以有著花言巧語，算是一種令女性感到可怕的「殺手」，也可算是典型的花花公子。

許媛媛
1977年5月20日出生，金牛座，身高162公分，體重48公斤。
媛媛由於家裡母親早逝，所以只與父親及三個哥哥共同生活，造就了媛媛「男性化」的成果。就是因為與家中男性成員打成一片，所以膚色給人一種很健康的感覺。

蘇長志
1975年5月25日出生，雙子座，身高175公分，體重65公斤。
自小與身為賭鬼的父親一起生活，所以學會了撲克牌的技巧。但巧言令色的個性，讓人覺得非常不好相處。
長志是遊戲中，無法被玩家「邀請」並成為「綺麗之夢」的成員之一。

袁珮琪
1977年4月16日出生，牡羊座。
由於父親是個一夜致富的大財主，造就了珮琪放縱與傲慢的個性。這種危險的教養法，卻還讓珮琪沉溺在父親的溺愛中，養成了珮琪不知道自己犯下錯誤的特點。
珮琪也是遊戲中，無法被玩家「邀請」並成為「綺麗之夢」的成員之一。

data.name: Messy Up
data.detailed_description:
About us

Hello everyone meow (●ˇ∀ˇ●) we are the lovely LIQUIDMEOW studio!

If you like this cute cats and dogs demolition game, I hope you can give it to the other meow friends around me~ also welcome you to follow our latest news, for the game suggestions ah ( -̀ ω -́ )


Third-party online methods

The game supports steam REMOTE PLAY, but if the lag delay is severe when using REMOTE PLAY, it is recommended to use third-party software online, such as Parsec.


About the Game

"Messy UP" is a cute pet collaboration game featuring cats and dogs~

Due to the owner's busy life after graduation and starting work, there is less time to spend with the pets. The pets plan to create a big mess at home to grab the owner's attention and encourage them to spend more time together. After all, what mischief could a little dog possibly have in mind?






  • Take on the role of cats and dogs and go wild, wreaking havoc at home! Each pet possesses unique abilities and skills, with various types of pets waiting for you to explore~
  • When other pet companions are caught, you can go to rescue them~
  • Either cause mayhem alone or collaborate with friends to create trouble for the owner. Up to three players can cooperate in dismantling the house.
  • Play as either the owner or a pet, deciding whether to demolish or defend the furniture and lock up the mischievous pets.






  • Utilize various mechanisms to dismantle and destroy homes. Fans, soccer balls, doors, takeout food—everything around you can become your tool of destruction!
  • Whether it's at home, on the beach, at the office, or in a castle, any place can become the target of the pets' demolition！





  • Gather a group of adorable pet companions, each with their own distinct personalities that can be freely customized~
  • Collect photos, qualifications, trophies, keychains, and various unique and cute rewards await you~









  • In addition to the main storyline missions, there are also numerous other gameplay modes available!
  • Build your own adorable pet home through DIY in the home construction mode~

data.name: Tower Craft
data.detailed_description:
Protect the Queen!

Tower Craft is a voxel tower defense about holding the road. Wave after wave marches down every lane toward your Queen. Read the map, post her guard, and upgrade the right defender at the right moment — when the road forks, one bad call is the whole run.

A 20-Map Campaign

Fight from Greenwood Meadow to the void gates. Every map is hand-built with its own lanes, terrain and wave plan. Your roster and its ranks unlock as you push deeper — you start with a bowman and a man-at-arms, and end commanding legends. The deeper you march, the stranger the horde — thirty-one enemy breeds, from yeti packs and skeleton legions to war zeppelins dropping raiders as they drift.

Eight Defenders, Five Ranks Each

Every defender is a little voxel soldier, not a turret — archers draw and loose, kegs arc, falcons dive.
  • Archer, Man-at-Arms, Crossbowman, Wizard, Falconer, Standard Bearer, Ninja, Bombardier
  • Five ranks each, with new gear and new abilities at every rank
  • The Wizard's whole school changes as he ranks — fireballs to frostbolts to meteors

Co-op: One Queen, Shared Fate

Up to four defenders, separate purses, one Queen, endless waves. The run ends when her last life does — and the leaderboard remembers how deep you got.

Ranked, Tracked, Remembered

Nineteen achievements, a career stat line, and global leaderboards for your deepest wave, maps cleared and versus wins.

An Honest Simulation

The battle is deterministic to the bit: every player computes the identical fight, so replays are exact and leaderboards can't be fooled.
